jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant (Japanese/Korean Speaker)
jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE

• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.

• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory.

Who you are :

• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.

• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.

• Proficient in English, Japa

• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.

Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory. Who you are :
• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.
• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.
• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.
• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.description:
Roche fosters diversity, equity and inclusion, representing the communities we serve. When dealing with healthcare on a global scale, diversity is an essential ingredient to success. We believe that inclusion is key to understanding people’s varied healthcare needs. Together, we embrace individuality and share a passion for exceptional care. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1) 进行数据整理及分析，洞察业务机会和风险，协助区域生态群负责人制定属地化一体化策略，包含学术平台的搭建和资源布局、准入与安全运营、创新平台和患者可支付性的提升等所有和提升诊疗水平和患者全程管理相关的举措。
2) 负责生态群内各平台和项目的协同，确保资源的有效实施和整合，最大化资源使用效率
3) 合理布局患者解决方案团队的工作重点，支持到生态圈负责人的各项关键任务的落地实施
4) 对接圈外（总部）的医学/法务合规/准入/市场/培训等跨部门，建立沟通和合作机制，确保生态圈内外部的及时精准的传递
5) 负责团队管理和人员辅导，不断促进团队的工作效能，打造敏捷的工作氛围和方式

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 具备业务敏锐度和市场洞察、规划能力
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 合作伙伴及大客户管理能力
• 团队管理或无职权情况下的团队管理经验

Years of Working Experience工作年限
• 8年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先
• 有跨职能、或者治疗领域经验优先

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
• 本科及以上学历（医学、药学、市场相关更优）

Who we are
At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche China consists of the full value chain of Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics fields, from early research, clinical development, manufacturing to commercialization. With more than 7,000 employees, Roche China is now working to develop itself into Roche's third global strategic center after Basel and San Francisco, and making sustained efforts to fulfill its long-term commitment to China, so as to meet Chinese patients’ unmet needs.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE
• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc
• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.
• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.
• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory. Who you are :
• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.
• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.
• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Able to commit for business travel when required.
• Proficient in English, Japa

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 94.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt. Vom ersten Tag an werden Sie bei Roche von einem kollegialen Team aufgenommen und unterstützt. Neben zahlreichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen und einer attraktiven Vergütung erwarten Sie Angebote zum Thema Familie Beruf.

Was Sie erwartet
Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften beinhaltet folgende Themen:

• Unterstützung der Anwälte der Rechtsabteilung bei der umfassenden rechtlichen Beratung der Fachabteilungen

• Bearbeitung verschiedener typischer wirtschafts- und pharmarechtlicher Fragestellungen aus dem Alltag eines Syndikusrechtsanwaltes

• Verhandlungen mit Vertragspartnern und Regelung außergerichtlicher Streitigkeiten

• Kostenlose Unterkunft im Roche Boardinghaus ab einer Entfernung zum Wohnort von mind. 100 km

• Die Möglichkeit aus dem Home Office heraus zu arbeiten

Wer Sie sind
Für Ihr Referendariat im Bereich Rechtswissenschaften bringen Sie folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Sie sind Referendar (m/w/d) der Rechtswissenschaft

• Die erste juristische Staatsprüfung mit kleinem Prädikat haben Sie bereits erfolgreich bestanden

• Ihre Persönlichkeit zeichnet sich durch Professionalität, Teamfähigkeit, Kreativität und Verhandlungsgeschick aus

• Sie handeln selbständig und eigenverantwortlich und sind aufgeschlossen für neue Ideen und Wege

Referendaren (m/w/d) wird die Absolvierung der Pflichtwahl oder Anwaltsstation (Teilableistung in Wirtschaftsunternehmen bis zu 4 Monaten) geboten.

Für weiterführende Informationen besuchen Sie bitte: https://www.roche.de/about/standorte/grenzach

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche Pharma AG at Grenzach-Wyhlen is steering central elements of the technical quality control for the whole European region. For the German market clinical research, marketing and all sales activities are located there. Grenzach-Wyhlen is the location of Roche Deutschland Holding GmbH. From here, the German Roche Group coordinates the financial activities of the national organization. From your beginning with Roche, our motivated team will welcome and support you. Numerous opportunities for personal development, flexible work hours, attractive compensation packages and special family assistance programs are available.

jobs.title: Development Engineer (contract 80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department within R&D is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Development Engineer, you will work as a cross-functional team on automating and tooling to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Elaborating on (Cobots-)Robotics concepts within a laboratory environment towards our vision of a dark lab by fully automating laboratory operations and workflows.

• Programming, testing, and maintaining of newly created and existing automated solutions within our laboratories.

• Supporting our Integration Teams in the installation and troubleshooting of Robotics Solutions within our laboratory environment

• Plan, coordinate, and execute work packages within your area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating topics or issues to the team and management.

• Be able to work as an individual and as part of a team.

Who you are:

• You are graduated with a bachelor's or master preferably in computer science, with specific knowledge in, e.g., robotics and/or vision, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or systems engineering or equivalent.

• Knowledge of professional Software development with one or more programming languages (e.g. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• You are excited to work as a professional in the medical diagnostics industry.

• Excellent spoken and written command of English (German is advantageous).

• You can communicate appropriately with different target groups.

• You are motivated to build, manage, and foster relationships and networks within the department and the related projects.

• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues conceptual and creative thinking.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

In un ambiente globale e interfunzionale, il reparto System Development (SD) all'interno della R&D è responsabile dell'ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro e dell'integrazione con successo hardware, software, materiali di consumo e reagenti per eseguire la verifica del sistema degli strumenti diagnostici. Come ingegnere di sviluppo, lavorerai come team interfunzionale per automatizzare e attrezzare per mantenere e sviluppare ulteriormente i sistemi diagnostici complessi.

In questa posizione, sarete responsabili delle seguenti aree:

• Elaborazione di concetti (Cobots-)Robotics all'interno di un ambiente di laboratorio verso la nostra visione di un laboratorio scuro automatizzando completamente le operazioni di laboratorio e i flussi di lavoro.

• Programmazione, collaudo e mantenimento di nuove soluzioni automatizzate esistenti all'interno dei nostri laboratori.

• Supportare i nostri team di integrazione nell'installazione e nella risoluzione dei problemi di Robotics Solutions all'interno del nostro ambiente di laboratorio

• Pianificare, coordinare ed eseguire pacchetti di lavoro all'interno della vostra area di responsabilità, tra cui la segnalazione e l'escalation di argomenti o problemi al team e alla gestione.

• Essere in grado di lavorare come individuo e come parte di una squadra.

Chi sei:

• Siete laureati con uno scapolo o master preferibilmente in informatica, con conoscenze specifiche in, ad esempio, robotica e/o visione, ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica o ingegneria dei sistemi o equivalente.

• Conoscenza dello sviluppo di software professionale con uno o più linguaggi di programmazione (ad esempio UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• Sei entusiasta di lavorare come professionista nel settore della diagnostica medica.

• Ottimo comando parlato e scritto di inglese (il tedesco è vantaggioso).

• È possibile comunicare in modo appropriato con diversi gruppi target.

• Siete motivati a costruire, gestire e promuovere relazioni e reti all'interno del dipartimento e dei progetti correlati.

• Rapida comprensione e comprensione di questioni complesse pensiero concettuale e creativo.

Si prega di notare che questo posto vacante non è attualmente collegato a una posizione aperta. Stiamo anticipando i bisogni futuri nella nostra organizzazione. Se siete interessati a questo tipo di ruolo, si prega di applicare oggi, e possiamo contattare si dovrebbe una posizione corrispondente al tuo profilo diventare disponibile.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

In einer globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung ist die Abteilung für Systementwicklung (SD) innerhalb von R & D für die Workflow-Optimierung und die erfolgreiche Integration von Hardware, Software, Verbrauchsmaterialien und Reagenzien verantwortlich, um die Systemüberprüfung von Diagnoseinstrumenten durchzuführen. Als Entwicklungsingenieur arbeiten Sie als funktionsübergreifendes Team an der Automatisierung und dem Tooling, um eingeführte komplexe Diagnosesysteme zu warten und weiterzuentwickeln.

In dieser Position sind Sie für folgende Bereiche verantwortlich:

• Ausarbeitung von (Cobots-)Robotik-Konzepten in einer Laborumgebung für unsere Vision eines dunklen Labors durch die vollständige Automatisierung von Laborbetrieb und Workflows.

• Programmierung, Test und Wartung von neu erstellten und bestehenden automatisierten Lösungen in unseren Labors.

• Unterstützung unserer Integrationsteams bei der Installation und Fehlerbehebung von Robotiklösungen in unserer Laborumgebung

• Planen, koordinieren und führen Sie Arbeitspakete in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich aus, einschließlich der Berichterstattung und Eskalation von Themen oder Problemen an das Team und das Management.

• Sie können als Einzelperson und als Teil eines Teams arbeiten.

Wer du bist:

• Sie haben einen Bachelor oder Master vorzugsweise in Informatik, mit spezifischen Kenntnissen in z.B. Robotik und / oder Vision, Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder Systemtechnik oder gleichwertig.

• Kenntnisse der professionellen Softwareentwicklung mit einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen (z.B. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• Sie freuen sich, als Profi in der medizinischen Diagnostikbranche zu arbeiten.

• Hervorragende gesprochene und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse (Deutsch ist vorteilhaft).

• Sie können mit verschiedenen Zielgruppen angemessen kommunizieren.

• Sie sind motiviert, Beziehungen und Netzwerke innerhalb der Abteilung und der damit verbundenen Projekte aufzubauen, zu verwalten und zu pflegen.

• Schnelles Erfassen und Verstehen komplexer Themen konzeptionelles und kreatives Denken.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Vakanz derzeit nicht mit einer offenen Position verbunden ist. Wir antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse in unserer Organisation. Wenn sie an dieser art von rolle interessiert sind, bewerben sie sich bitte noch heute, und wir können sie kontaktieren, wenn eine position, die ihrem profil entspricht, verfügbar wird.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel, le département Développement système (SD) de R-D est responsable de l'optimisation des flux de travail et de l'intégration réussie du matériel, des logiciels, des consommables et des réactifs pour effectuer la vérification du système des instruments de diagnostic. En tant qu'ingénieur en développement, vous travaillerez comme une équipe interfonctionnelle sur l'automatisation et l'outillage pour maintenir et développer des systèmes de diagnostic complexes lancés.

Dans ce poste, vous serez responsable des domaines suivants :

• Elaborer sur (Cobots-)Les concepts de robotique dans un environnement de laboratoire vers notre vision d'un laboratoire sombre en automatisant entièrement les opérations et les workflows de laboratoire.

• Programmation, mise à l'essai et maintien de solutions automatisées nouvellement créées et existantes dans nos laboratoires.

• Soutenir nos équipes d'intégration dans l'installation et le dépannage des solutions robotiques dans notre environnement de laboratoire

• Planifiez, coordonnez et exécutez des paquets de travail dans votre secteur de responsabilité, y compris les rapports et l'escalade des sujets ou des problèmes à l'équipe et à la direction.

• Être capable de travailler en tant qu'individu et en équipe.

Qui vous êtes :

• Vous êtes diplômé d'un baccalauréat ou d'un master de préférence en informatique, avec des connaissances spécifiques en robotique et/ou en vision, en génie électrique, en génie mécanique ou en génie de systèmes ou l'équivalent.

• Connaissance du développement logiciel professionnel avec un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (p. ex. UR-Polyscope, Python, C#/NET, LabView)

• Vous êtes heureux de travailler comme professionnel dans l'industrie du diagnostic médical.

• Excellente maîtrise orale et écrite de l'anglais (l'allemand est avantageux).

• Vous pouvez communiquer adéquatement avec différents groupes cibles.

• Vous êtes motivé à établir, gérer et favoriser des relations et des réseaux au sein du Ministère et des projets connexes.

• Une compréhension et une compréhension rapides des questions complexes de pensée conceptuelle et créative.

Veuillez noter que cette vacance n'est actuellement pas liée à un poste ouvert. Nous anticipons les besoins futurs de notre organisation. Si vous êtes intéressé par ce type de rôle, s'il vous plaît postuler aujourd'hui, et nous pouvons vous contacter si un poste correspondant à votre profil devient disponible.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Lab Technician (contract)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are
Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a Lab Technician, you will work as a cross-functional team to maintain and further develop launched complex diagnostic systems.
In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Responsible for laboratories supervision and laboratory equipment

• Representing the working group in the quality team for laboratories

• Support of R&D and validation projects

• Carry out and analyze molecular biology experiments following established SOPs

• Ordering, tracking, and accepting test samples and consumables according to SOPs

• Independent communication with other departments

• Report experimental results to project managers in a timely manner

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

The ideal candidate for our dynamic, international team will have the following skills and experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in biology or related field preferred.

• Experience and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels 1 and 2.

• Enthusiastic team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Solution-oriented, autonomous, and proactive working style.

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• You write and speak English fluently; German is a plus.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position

In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.
As a System Development Software Tester, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development of new complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidics, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical, and biochemistry elements.
As a Software Testergineer in the new Analyzer Project, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):

• Plan and execution of the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalation of issues to the management.

• Experienced with Windows and Linux Operations System

• Know-how in setting up an automated testing environment and familiar in using data analysis tools to provide statistical data to the management

• Experienced in using Network Protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, and SSL)

• Familiar in using Gateways, Firewalls and using Remote Access

• Subject matter expert for Communications protocols between instruments and Laboratory informations systems(LIS). Provide guidance and support to others. Flexibility to transfer knowledge to different tasks/subprojects within SD.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the lab. Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports in support of daily activities and be able to author official documents in English (e.g., Design history Files) for the preparation of milestones. Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to own or other groups.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware-, Software-, Consumables-, Assay-and Algorithm-Development.

Who you are

You’re someone who wants to influence your development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

To be successful in this role (you provide):

• Degree in a technical or life sciences discipline (e.g., Software- or Electrical Engineering,

• Electronic/Automation, Bio- and Process-Engineering,) or related job experience.

• Minimum 1 years of work experience in the development of diagnostic systems in a System Development or related field

• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking

• Experience in statistical data analysis

• Experience in and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels S1and S2

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a Development Engineer, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team, working on Nucleic Acid Purification, PCR and Sequencing, on developing complex diagnostics systems. You will perform hands-on experiments, Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) testing, including evaluation of system performance, error handling, and reliability improvements.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Plan and execute the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating issues to management.

• Subject matter expert for an assigned area of responsibility. Provide guidance and support to team members.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to team and management.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the biosafety levels S1 and S2 laboratory.

• Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Document and maintain software functionality.

• Coordinate efforts with other functional areas to accomplish tasks: Hardware, Software-, Consumables-and Assay-Development.

Who you are

You are someone who wants to influence your development. You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. A job title is not considered the final definition of who you are but the starting point.

The ideal candidate for our dynamic, international team will have the following skills and experience:

• Degree in a relevant life science discipline (e.g. (e.g. biology, biotechnology, biomedical informatics, engineering related to life sciences) or corresponding job experience

• Interest in resolving technical problems and interdisciplinary teamwork

• Experience and willingness to work in a highly regulated industry and labs with biosafety levels S1 and S2.

• Familiarity with or strong interest in software and engineering applications and tools .

• Enthusiastic team player with good communication and collaboration skills. Solution-oriented, autonomous, and proactive working style.

• Proven experience in laboratory diagnostics and/or service & support, as well as supporting HW and SW, are additional assets.

• Working knowledge of English (written and spoken), and German a strong asset

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

Key Responsibilities:

• Data Excellence: Review and set up new suppliers, customers, or change existing vendor/customer details in SAP, adhering to our Vendor Master Data SOP.

• Accuracy in Action: Enter vendor data accurately in MDGS platform, including bank details and change requests, ensuring data integrity.

• Quality Assurance: Approve data and enhancements based on supporting, verifying bank details as per SOP and ICFR requirements.

• Collaborative Validation: Validate records sent by business for user requests, maintaining data accuracy.

• Continuous Improvement: Provide data and root cause analysis for process enhancements, supporting a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Accountabilities:

• Data Integrity Champion: Ensure accuracy and integrity of master data for vendors and customers, adhering to corporate policies and procedures.

• Compliance Steward: Monitor and resolve emails in the vendor master email box, ensuring adherence to Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR) and local statutory requirements.

• Efficiency Enabler: Timely creation, verification, and cleanup of vendor and customer master data, supporting business requirements seamlessly.

• Support Maestro: Provide timely helpdesk support, training, and collaboration with internal stakeholders for master data processes.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Excellent communication skills in English, fostering effective collaboration.

• Minimum 1 year of experience in transactional accounting or shared service environment, with exposure to master data management.

• Proficiency in SAP or other ERP accounting systems, as well as MS Office tools.

• Experience in shared services or business process outsourcing is a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
Roche Data Scientists are essential leaders in driving and implementing a broad range of quantitative drug development strategies; they bring data to life and enable the organization to make the best possible data-driven decisions.
As a Data Scientist at Roche Pharma, you’ll actively shape the future of healthcare as a member of Data and Statistical Sciences (DSS) within Product Development (PD) and PD Data Sciences (PDD).
You will be responsible for the strategic and analytical activities of the molecules and devices in our pipeline on a level matching your seniority.
DSS activities span multiple therapeutic areas, a wide range of data types, and collaborations with a variety of experts, all with the goal to develop innovative healthcare solutions for patients and society.
Your responsibilities in support of our PDD products may include a wide variety of contributions: partnering with key stakeholders, working on the molecule portfolio, supporting specialized business areas, or contributing to key initiatives that shape our technical, business and healthcare environments. You may be a work product owner and leader, quantitative expert on a project team, or driver of key internal or external relationships.

Key Accountabilities
Data Sciences Leadership

• Accountable for the development and implementation of Data Sciences products.

• Lead and/ or support multiple elements of the drug development process across various phases of clinical trials.

• Lead and/ or support regular review of opportunities to simplify and innovate, and collaborate with experts in DSS, PDD and beyond to accelerate and deliver patient benefits faster.

• Lead and/ or support prioritization efforts, demonstrating urgency and taking smart risks to make considered decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Drug Development Strategy and Execution

• Lead or contribute technical expertise to multiple elements of the business, including: strategic planning; communication; and implementation.

• Support and/or represent DSS and PDD across multiple functions of the Roche global organization, which may include; Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED); Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED); PD; Market Access, Global Product Strategy (GPS); and Pharma Technical (PT).

• Purposefully collaborate and influence to support PDD to be at the forefront of our industry for Data Sciences.

• Collaborate with Global Health Authorities to support our product pipeline.

• Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying stakeholders across the Roche global organization in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance.

Career Development

• Continuously look for opportunities to broaden knowledge, capabilities and skill set to enable talent to flow into different Specialties and Disease Areas.

• Role model knowledge sharing within DSS, PDD, and beyond.

• Act as a coach, mentor, or buddy to help colleagues grow and develop.

Technical Accountability

• Contribute technical, therapeutic and business expertise within and external to DSS and PDD, which may include: Research and Development products; Drug development and clinical trial products; Current and new technologies; Working with external data and external organizations; Global Health Authority requirements; Data Sciences industry landscape; Statistical methods and techniques; Analytical strategies; Programming languages; Software development; Data sta

Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Roche Data Scientists sind wesentliche Führer bei der Durchführung und Umsetzung einer breiten Palette von quantitativen Drogenentwicklungsstrategien; sie bringen Daten zum Leben und ermöglichen es der Organisation, die bestmöglichen datenbasierten Entscheidungen zu treffen. Als Data Scientist bei Roche Pharma werden Sie die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung als Mitglied der Data and Statistical Sciences (DSS) innerhalb der Produktentwicklung (PD) und PD Data Sciences (PDD) aktiv gestalten. Sie sind verantwortlich für die strategischen und analytischen Aktivitäten der Moleküle und Geräte in unserer Pipeline auf einem Niveau, das Ihrer Seniorität entspricht. DSS-Aktivitäten umfassen mehrere therapeutische Bereiche, eine breite Palette von Datentypen und Kooperationen mit einer Vielzahl von Experten, alle mit dem Ziel, innovative Gesundheitslösungen für Patienten und Gesellschaft zu entwickeln.
• Ihre Verantwortung für die Unterstützung unserer PDD-Produkte kann eine Vielzahl von Beiträgen umfassen: die Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Interessenvertretern, die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Molekülportfolio, die Unterstützung spezialisierter Geschäftsfelder oder die Unterstützung wichtiger Initiativen, die unsere technischen, geschäftlichen und Gesundheitswesens gestalten. Sie können ein Produktbesitzer und -führer sein, quantitativer Experte für ein Projektteam oder Treiber von wichtigen internen oder externen Beziehungen. Strategie zur Drogenentwicklung und -ausübung - Führen Sie oder tragen Sie technische Expertise zu mehreren Elementen des Unternehmens bei, einschließlich: strategische Planung; Kommunikation; und Umsetzung. - Unterstützung und/oder Vertretung von DSS und PDD über mehrere Funktionen der Roche Global Organisation, einschließlich Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED); Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED); PD; Market Access, Global Product Strategy (GPS); und Pharma Technical (PT). - Zweckmäßig kooperieren und beeinflussen, um PDD zu unterstützen, um an der Spitze unserer Branche für Data Sciences zu stehen. - Mit Global Health Authorities zusammenarbeiten, um unsere Produktpipeline zu unterstützen. - Mit Unterstützung von Roche-Produkten, Programmen, Prozessen, Systemen und/oder Compliance schaffen Sie starke Partnerschaften und Möglichkeiten, mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern in der globalen Organisation von Roche zusammenzuarbeiten und zu innovieren. Évolution des carrières - Chercher continuellement des occasions d'élargir les connaissances, les capacités et les compétences afin de permettre aux talents de s'intégrer dans différents domaines de spécialité et de maladie. - Le partage des connaissances au sein du SSD, de la DDP et au-delà. - Agir en tant qu'entraîneur, mentor ou ami pour aider les collègues à grandir et à se développer. Responsabilité technique - Contribuer à l'expertise technique, thérapeutique et commerciale à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur du SSD et de la DDP, ce qui peut comprendre : Développement de médicaments et produits d'essais cliniques; les technologies actuelles et nouvelles; Travail avec des données externes et des organisations externes; exigences de l'Autorité mondiale de la santé; paysage industriel des sciences des données; méthodes et techniques statistiques; stratégies analytiques; langages de programmation; développement de logiciels;

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1）协助在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息

• （3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件

所负责领域，与CE各治疗领域达成关键业务院外目标共识;
定期复盘进展，确保新业极各领域的业务转化达成；

对患者、DTP、医院的价值转化，并不断形成新业极在医疗体系和患者获益端的影响力

The Opportunity
As an Account Manager, you will:

• Identify and Cultivate Leads: Discover sales opportunities, cultivate new business relationships, and engage key decision-makers in the sequencing community.

• Execute Growth Plans: Develop and monitor regional commercial growth plans, focusing on key success metrics to achieve revenue and strategic goals.

• Optimize Sales Opportunities: Manage sales opportunities effectively through Salesforce/CRM.

• Present and Consult: Conduct product presentations and consultative discussions to showcase the value of our sequencing solutions.

• Drive Technical Sales: Provide technical expertise throughout the sales process, including application consultations and data analysis support.

• Enhance Brand Visibility: Represent Roche at conferences, trade shows, and networking events to establish thought leadership and engage potential customers.

• Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with marketing, product management, service, and support teams to align sales efforts with company objectives and customer needs.

• Regional Execution: Partner with subregional teams across Europe to develop and implement strategic plans for successful market penetration.

Who You Are
You possess:

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Business, or a related field.

• Sales Experience: Proven experience in selling capital equipment within the diagnostics/life sciences industry.

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Next Generation Sequencing and related genomic techniques.

• Strategic and Negotiation Skills: Demonstrated excellence in negotiation, strategic planning, and organizational abilities.

• Consultative Selling: Ability to identify technical needs and provide business solutions.

• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Strong business acumen and drive to navigate complex sales processes.

• Communication Skills: Ability to deliver impactful group presentations and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Travel Requirements: Willingness to undertake national and international travel.

• Preferred Experience: 5+ years in a clinical research or academic laboratory environment, experience selling Sequencers for NGS applications, and proficiency in NGS data analysis.

• Language Skills: Fluent in English. Knowledge of German and/or other European languages is an advantage.

Join Roche Sequencing Solutions to make a difference in the genomic landscape and deliver state-of-the-art sequencing solutions to the world. Apply now and become a part of a company dedicated to innovation and excellence.

Please note, that this is a requisition for Talent Pool building purposes, which means it may not necessarily reflect a current opening with ongoing recruitment or selection process, but a position we are frequently recruiting for or we are planning to open in the near future.

Who we are

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Als Account Manager bei Roche Sequencing Solutions stehen Sie an der Spitze der Revolution der Sequenzierungslandschaft. Nutzen Sie diese einzigartige Gelegenheit, mit einem dynamischen Team zusammenzuarbeiten und unsere innovativen Produkte zum Markterfolg zu treiben. In den Warenkorb - Identifizieren und kultivieren Leads: Entdecken Sie Verkaufsmöglichkeiten, pflegen neue Geschäftsbeziehungen und engagieren Sie wichtige Entscheidungsträger in der Sequenziergemeinschaft. - Execute Growth Plans: Entwicklung und Überwachung von regionalen kommerziellen Wachstumsplänen, die sich auf wichtige Erfolgsmetriken konzentrieren, um Umsatz und strategische Ziele zu erreichen. - Optimieren Sie Sales Opportunities: Verwalten Sie Verkaufsmöglichkeiten effektiv durch Salesforce/CRM. - Present and Consult: Führen Sie Produktpräsentationen und beratende Diskussionen, um den Wert unserer Sequenzierungslösungen zu präsentieren. - Fahren Sie den technischen Vertrieb: technisches Know-how im gesamten Vertriebsprozess, einschließlich Bewerbungsberatungen und Datenanalyseunterstützung. - Verbessern Sie die Markenvisibilität: Repräsentieren Sie Roche auf Konferenzen, Messen und Networking-Veranstaltungen, um Gedankenführung zu etablieren und potenzielle Kunden zu engagieren. - Verbundene Across-Teams: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketing-, Produktmanagement-, Service- und Support-Teams zusammen, um Vertriebsbemühungen mit Unternehmenszielen und Kundenbedürfnissen auszurichten. - Regionale Umsetzung: Partner mit subregionalen Teams in ganz Europa, um strategische Pläne für eine erfolgreiche Marktdurchdringung zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Voraussetzungen - Bildungshintergrund: Bachelor-Abschluss in Life Science, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich. - Vertriebserfahrung: Bewiesene Erfahrung beim Verkauf von Kapitalanlagen in der Diagnostik/Lebenswissenschaften. - Technisches Wissen: Tiefes Verständnis der Next Generation Sequenzierung und verwandte genomische Techniken. - Strategische und Verhandlung Fähigkeiten: Demonstrierte Exzellenz in Verhandlungen, strategische Planung und organisatorische Fähigkeiten. - Consultative Selling: Fähigkeit, technische Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren und Geschäftslösungen bereitzustellen. - Entrepreneurial Spirit: Starkes Geschäft acumen und fahren, um komplexe Vertriebsprozesse zu navigieren. - Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, wirkungsstarke Gruppenpräsentationen zu liefern und effektiv mit verschiedenen Interessenvertretern zu kommunizieren. - Reisevoraussetzungen: Bereitschaft zur nationalen und internationalen Reise. - Bevorzugte Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre in einer klinischen Forschung oder akademischen Laborumgebung, Erfahrung Verkauf von Sequencern für NGS-Anwendungen und Kenntnisse in der NGS-Datenanalyse. - Sprachkenntnisse: fließend auf Englisch. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Contattoo Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine Voraussetzung für das Talent Pool-Gebäude ist, was bedeutet, dass es nicht notwendigerweise eine aktuelle Eröffnung mit laufendem Rekrutierungs- oder Auswahlprozess widerspiegelt, sondern eine Position, für die wir häufig rekrutieren oder in naher Zukunft öffnen wollen. Chi Siamo Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns an
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni En tant que responsable de compte chez Roche Sequencing Solutions, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la révolution du séquençage. Embrassez cette occasion unique de collaborer avec une équipe dynamique et de conduire nos produits innovants à la réussite du marché. Responsabilité - Identifier et cultiver des pistes : Découvrez les opportunités de vente, cultivez de nouvelles relations d'affaires et engagez les décideurs clés dans la communauté séquentielle. - Exécuter des plans de croissance : Élaborer et surveiller des plans régionaux de croissance commerciale, en mettant l'accent sur les indicateurs de succès clés pour atteindre les revenus et les objectifs stratégiques. - Optimiser les opportunités de vente : gérer efficacement les opportunités de vente grâce à Salesforce/CRM. - Présenter et consulter : Mener des présentations de produits et des discussions consultatives afin de mettre en évidence la valeur de nos solutions de séquençage. - Promotion des ventes techniques : fournir une expertise technique tout au long du processus de vente, y compris des consultations sur les demandes et un soutien à l'analyse des données. - Améliorer la visibilité de la marque : Représenter Roche lors de conférences, de salons professionnels et d'événements de réseautage afin d'établir un leadership de réflexion et d'engager des clients potentiels. - Collaborer entre les équipes : travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de marketing, de gestion des produits, de service et de soutien pour aligner les efforts de vente sur les objectifs de l'entreprise et les besoins des clients. - Exécution régionale: Partenaire avec des équipes sous-régionales à travers l'Europe pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans stratégiques pour une pénétration réussie du marché.
• Requisiti - Études : Licence en sciences de la vie, en affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. - Expérience de vente: Expérience éprouvée dans la vente d'équipement au sein de l'industrie du diagnostic et des sciences de la vie. - Connaissances techniques : compréhension approfondie du séquençage de la prochaine génération et des techniques génomiques connexes. - Compétences stratégiques et de négociation : excellence démontrée dans la négociation, la planification stratégique et les capacités organisationnelles. - Vente consultative : Capacité à identifier les besoins techniques et à fournir des solutions d'affaires. - Esprit Entrepreneuriel: Forte entreprise et conduite pour naviguer dans les processus de vente complexes. - Compétences en communication : Capacité de présenter des exposés de groupe pertinents et de communiquer efficacement avec divers intervenants. - Conditions de voyage : Volonté d'entreprendre des voyages nationaux et internationaux. - Expérience préférée : 5 ans et plus dans un environnement de recherche clinique ou de laboratoire universitaire, expérience de vente de séquenceurs pour les applications de NGS et compétence en analyse des données de NGS. - Compétences linguistiques : maîtrise de l'anglais. La connaissance de l'allemand et/ou d'autres langues européennes est un avantage.
• Cosa offriamo Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Contatto Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'une demande de création d'un bassin de talents, ce qui signifie qu'elle ne reflète peut-être pas nécessairement une ouverture actuelle avec un processus de recrutement ou de sélection en cours, mais un poste auquel nous recrutons fréquemment ou que nous prévoyons ouvrir prochainement. Chi Siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Molecular Lab
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us
At Roche, we are committed to making a meaningful impact on society through innovative healthcare solutions. We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment where you can grow, learn, and contribute to cutting-edge advancements in diagnostics. Join us to be part of a purpose-driven company that values diversity, flexibility, and professional development.

The Opportunity
As the Head of Molecular Lab , you will report to the designated executive leader and be based in China. This pivotal role combines strategic vision with operational excellence, driving the growth and success of our Molecular Diagnostics division. You will collaborate with global teams, lead high-performing teams, and shape the future of diagnostics in China.

What You Will Be Working On

• Act as the key interface with Regional/Global Marketing Groups to secure resources and align strategies.

• Lead product launch processes, ensuring milestones are met and compliance standards are upheld.

• Represent Roche in business partnerships and key customer interactions to foster strong relationships.

• Oversee sales, marketing, and customer service operations to maximize effectiveness.

• Mentor and develop talent to build a high-performing team and ensure robust succession planning.

• Develop and implement strategies for distributor management, pricing, and regulatory compliance.

• Identify market opportunities, monitor industry trends, and drive innovative business initiatives.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in a science/medical-related field; MBA or postgraduate qualifications are a plus.

• Experience: 15+ years in sales and marketing management within multinational pharmaceutical/medical device companies, preferably in In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

• Skills: Proficiency in English (written and spoken), strong command of MS Office, and deep industry/market expertise.

• Values: Alignment with Roche’s core values of Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

• Leadership: Proven ability to drive operational excellence, manage P&L, and inspire teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: T&E Compliance Analyst (Japanese Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Coordinates and manages compliance activities for the assigned affiliate in the assigned division. Evaluates existing and evolving healthcare and privacy compliance, ethics and related legislation and regulations and other marketplace/industry dynamics to determine requirements for Roche policies and procedures. Assess the employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

Manages and completes internal and external reporting regarding the affiliate's healthcare, privacy, ethics and related compliance. Responds to inquiries and provides guidance and advice on compliance and resources to support business operations, team and individual adherence. Where observed, escalates actual or potential compliance violations or other issues to relevant colleagues or management, according to local, regional and/or global policies and procedures.

Role Responsibilities:
Operational

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

• Escalates issues and recommend resolution plans in a timely manner to the RSS Line Manager and Affiliate (where required)

• Support the preparation of reports and training material on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc.)

• In collaboration with Reporting Line Manager make appropriate recommendation to HOD for process improvement and be part of the solution provision activities

Qualifications and Experience

• University degree or equivalent experience or above (prefer business, law or finance related major)

• More than 2 years’ experience in compliance reviews or its equivalent and its implementation in a highly regulated environment or in audit firms

• Strong analytical skills, be able to assess the facts with professional skepticism

• Strong communications skills, Fluent in both written and spoken English and Japanese as this role will required to support Roche Japan counterpart

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.title: Medical Enabler
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• Medical Enabler in Roche is a group of people who are purpose-driven, experienced, and passionate with experience in medical affairs. We put patients and science at the center of all actions and we serve as the medical content expert in one or more therapeutic areas within the organization; build scientific partnership with external partners; ensure access to our products and clinical trials and attend diligently to patient safety and the needs of our healthcare professionals.

• We work hand in hand with our external partners and internal teams to discover the unmet medical needs along the patient journey, being obsessed with what they need to deliver exceptional patient care and acting boldly with them to transform science and ultimately patient lives by accelerating "better outcomes for more patients faster".

Role scope:
Functional expertise

• Developing and cultivating strategic relationships with therapeutic area experts and other healthcare influencers.

• Translating insights into strategic actionable recommendations for varied and broad stakeholder groups to impact the way we work and ensure we help deliver positive change in healthcare systems widely e.g nationally, beyond affiliates or globally especially through co-creation.

• Advising on, contributing to, or leading the strategic planning and driving the desired outcomes, taking into account patients’ needs, Taiwan uniqueness, business needs, resource requirements, regulatory and market access considerations. Can think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

• Optimizing clinical development throughout the product lifecycle to bring better treatment to patients.

• Generating and communicating medical evidence that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions.

• Initiating and implementing medical or innovative projects e.g. compassionate use program, local access mechanism to address access needs, or digital solutions.

• Internalizing the network way of working through transparent sharing of knowledge and resources to improve working effectiveness and create a bigger impact for the organizations.

• Working in a self-managed team of peers and acting as a coach or mentor with VACC mindst to make people hold each other accountable to deliver solutions for the healthcare systems effectively.

Mindset & behaviors

• Entreprise thinking, eager to learn, system thinker, self-managed & directed, bold, and being able to prioritize

• VACC mindset

• The ability to work with cross-functional teams is a must

• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools

• Embracing & implementing agile ways of working is a must

• Entrepreneurial mindset with good partnering capabilities (ability to deeply listen, question & understand, communicate smoothly)

• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, takes risks and experiments, embrace challenges and failures, and contributes to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside Roche

Operating Principles

• Put Patients First: I always act as if patients I know are in the room and do what's best for them.

• Follow the science: I seek answers through experiments, data and debate, and act on facts.

• Act as one team: I care, collaborate and commit without boundaries, and trust others to do their part.

• Embrace differences: I seek diverse persp

jobs.title: (Senior) Medical Science Manager (BC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related
biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events;
Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs,
preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic
company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical
strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy,
incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and
investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross
functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
