titleByLocale.it: Stage nella gestione globale dei materiali clinici (Kaiseraugst)
titleByLocale.en: Internship in Global Clinical Materials Management (Kaiseraugst)
titleByLocale.de: Praktikum in Global Clinical Materials Management (Kaiseraugst)
titleByLocale.fr: Stage en gestion mondiale des matériaux cliniques (Kaiseraugst)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Join our innovative and purpose-driven team within PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, where we work to ensure life-changing medicines reach patients who need them the most. As a Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in our Production Enablement function, you will play a pivotal role in leading procurement and supply planning for clinical trials, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with global partners in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Together, we make a difference while optimizing quality, cost, and timely delivery of vital clinical supplies.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact by taking on the following key responsibilities:

• Ensure seamless availability of drug products and packaging materials to meet clinical manufacturing requirements, guaranteeing timely production of investigational medical products.

• Maintain accurate master data for drug products in SAP systems, including defining, compiling, and continuously updating product-specific data and documents.

• Manage purchase orders for development, partner, and commercial drug products from both internal and external suppliers using the appropriate procurement systems.

• Lead supplier relationship management by monitoring supplier performance through KPIs, driving continuous improvements, and fostering transparent collaborations.

• Ensure batch availability and readiness of drug products and packaging materials for downstream manufacturing processes.

• Proactively identify, address, and resolve supply chain and procurement issues to ensure smooth global clinical supply operations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an inclusive, innovative, and international environment to drive excellence in clinical supply chain management.

• Contribute to a high-performing team culture where teamwork, professional growth, and delivering impact for patients are prioritized.

Who You Are

These qualities and experiences make you an ideal candidate for this role:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences or Supply Chain Management, with experience in SAP systems and the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry as a valuable asset.

• You are a clear and professional communicator, both in writing and verbally, with excellent English skills (basic knowledge of German is a plus).

• You excel in building trustful relationships with diverse business partners, demonstrating high cultural awareness and social competence in international and cross-functional settings.

• You are a problem solver with keen attention to detail, strong decision-making abilities, and an understanding of technical systems, allowing you to quickly learn and adapt to new challenges.

• You thrive in collaborative environments and bring well-developed teamwork, negotiation, and organizational skills to complex situations.

Planned start date: December 2025
Duration: 12 months
Ready to apply? Please upload the following documents: your updated CV, a cover letter, and copies of your diplomas.
For Non-EU/EFTA citizens: Due to regulations, you must provide a letter from your university confirming that an internship is mandatory for your studies and specifying the required length of the internship. Please upload this letter, along with your enrollment certificate, CV, and cover letter.

We are looking forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La posizione Unisciti al nostro team innovativo e mirato all'interno di PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, dove lavoriamo per garantire che i farmaci che cambiano la vita raggiungano i pazienti che ne hanno più bisogno. In qualità di Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) nella nostra funzione di Production Enablement, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione di approvvigionamento e fornitura leader per gli studi clinici, nella guida dell'eccellenza operativa e nella collaborazione con partner globali in un ambiente dinamico e inclusivo. Insieme, facciamo la differenza ottimizzando la qualità, il costo e la consegna tempestiva di forniture cliniche vitali. Responsabilità In questo ruolo, avrete la possibilità di avere un impatto significativo assumendo le seguenti responsabilità chiave: - Assicurare la disponibilità senza soluzione di continuità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione clinica, garantendo la produzione tempestiva di prodotti medici investigativi. - Mantenere dati master accurati per i prodotti farmaceutici nei sistemi SAP, tra cui la definizione, la compilazione e l'aggiornamento continuo dei dati e dei documenti specifici del prodotto. - Gestire gli ordini di acquisto per lo sviluppo, partner e prodotti di droga commerciali da fornitori sia interni che esterni utilizzando i sistemi di approvvigionamento appropriati. - Gestione dei rapporti dei fornitori di piombo monitorando le prestazioni dei fornitori tramite KPI, guidando miglioramenti continui e promuovendo collaborazioni trasparenti. - Assicurare la disponibilità e la disponibilità di prodotti farmaceutici e materiali di imballaggio per i processi produttivi a valle. - Identificare, affrontare e risolvere i problemi della supply chain e degli approvvigionamenti per garantire operazioni di approvvigionamento clinico a livello globale. - Collaborare con team interfunzionali in un ambiente inclusivo, innovativo e internazionale per guidare l'eccellenza nella gestione della supply chain clinica. - Contribuire a una cultura di squadra altamente performante in cui il lavoro di squadra, la crescita professionale e la fornitura di impatto per i pazienti sono prioritari.
• Requisiti Queste qualità ed esperienze ti rendono un candidato ideale per questo ruolo: - Lei ha una laurea o Master in Scienze della Vita o Gestione della Supply Chain, con esperienza nei sistemi SAP e l'industria farmaceutica o biofarmaceutica come un bene prezioso. - Lei è un comunicatore chiaro e professionale, sia per iscritto che verbalmente, con eccellenti competenze inglesi (la conoscenza di base del tedesco è un plus). - Si eccelle nella costruzione di relazioni fiduciose con diversi partner commerciali, dimostrando alta consapevolezza culturale e competenza sociale in contesti internazionali e interfunzionali. - Lei è un risolutore di problemi con molta attenzione ai dettagli, forti capacità decisionali e una comprensione dei sistemi tecnici, permettendo di imparare e adattarsi rapidamente alle nuove sfide. - Tu prosperi in ambienti collaborativi e porti competenze di teamwork, negoziazione e organizzazione ben sviluppate a situazioni complesse. Posizione - Data di inizio prevista: dicembre 2025 - Durata: 12 mesi Vieni qui. Pronto per l'applicazione? Si prega di caricare i seguenti documenti: il vostro CV aggiornato, una lettera di copertura e copie dei vostri diplomi. Per i cittadini non UE/EFTA: A causa di regolamenti, è necessario fornire una lettera dalla vostra università confermando che uno stage è obbligatorio per i vostri studi e specificando la lunghezza necessaria dello stage. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join our innovative and purpose-driven team within PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, where we work to ensure life-changing medicines reach patients who need them the most. As a Global Clinical Materials Manager (GCMM) in our Production Enablement function, you will play a pivotal role in leading procurement and supply planning for clinical trials, driving operational excellence, and collaborating with global partners in a dynamic, inclusive environment. Together, we make a difference while optimizing quality, cost, and timely delivery of vital clinical supplies. The Opportunity In this role, you will have the chance to make a meaningful impact by taking on the following key responsibilities:
• Ensure seamless availability of drug products and packaging materials to meet clinical manufacturing requirements, guaranteeing timely production of investigational medical products.
• Maintain accurate master data for drug products in SAP systems, including defining, compiling, and continuously updating product-specific data and documents.
• Manage purchase orders for development, partner, and commercial drug products from both internal and external suppliers using the appropriate procurement systems.
• Lead supplier relationship management by monitoring supplier performance through KPIs, driving continuous improvements, and fostering transparent collaborations.
• Ensure batch availability and readiness of drug products and packaging materials for downstream manufacturing processes.
• Proactively identify, address, and resolve supply chain and procurement issues to ensure smooth global clinical supply operations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an inclusive, innovative, and international environment to drive excellence in clinical supply chain management.
• Contribute to a high-performing team culture where teamwork, professional growth, and delivering impact for patients are prioritized. Who You Are These qualities and experiences make you an ideal candidate for this role:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences or Supply Chain Management, with experience in SAP systems and the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry as a valuable asset.
• You are a clear and professional communicator, both in writing and verbally, with excellent English skills (basic knowledge of German is a plus).
• You excel in building trustful relationships with diverse business partners, demonstrating high cultural awareness and social competence in international and cross-functional settings.
• You are a problem solver with keen attention to detail, strong decision-making abilities, and an understanding of technical systems, allowing you to quickly learn and adapt to new challenges.
• You thrive in collaborative environments and bring well-developed teamwork, negotiation, and organizational skills to complex situations. Planned start date: December 2025 Duration: 12 months Ready to apply? Please upload the following documents: your updated CV, a cover letter, and copies of your diplomas. For Non-EU/EFTA citizens: Due to regulations, you must provide a letter from your university confirming that an internship is mandatory for your studies and specifying the required length of the internship. Please upload this letter, along with your enrollment certificate, CV, and cover letter. We are looking forward to your application! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni La position Rejoignez notre équipe innovante et axée sur l'objectif au sein de PTDS Global Clinical Supply Chain Management, où nous travaillons pour garantir que les médicaments qui changent la vie atteignent les patients qui en ont le plus besoin. En tant que gestionnaire mondial des matériaux cliniques (GCMM) dans notre fonction d'activation de la production, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la planification des achats et des approvisionnements pour les essais cliniques, la conduite de l'excellence opérationnelle et la collaboration avec des partenaires mondiaux dans un environnement dynamique et inclusif. Ensemble, nous faisons une différence tout en optimisant la qualité, le coût et la livraison en temps opportun des fournitures cliniques vitales. Responsabilité Dans ce rôle, vous aurez la chance d'avoir un impact significatif en assumant les responsabilités clés suivantes : - Assurer la disponibilité transparente des produits pharmaceutiques et des matériaux d'emballage pour répondre aux exigences de fabrication clinique, garantissant la production en temps opportun de produits médicaux expérimentaux. - Tenir à jour des données de référence précises sur les produits pharmaceutiques dans les systèmes SAP, y compris la définition, la compilation et la mise à jour continue des données et des documents propres aux produits. - Gérer les commandes de produits pharmaceutiques de développement, de partenaires et commerciaux de fournisseurs internes et externes en utilisant les systèmes d'approvisionnement appropriés. - Diriger la gestion des relations avec les fournisseurs en surveillant la performance des fournisseurs grâce aux ICR, en favorisant des améliorations continues et en favorisant des collaborations transparentes. - Assurer la disponibilité et la disponibilité des lots de produits pharmaceutiques et de matériaux d'emballage pour les procédés de fabrication en aval. - Identifier, traiter et résoudre de façon proactive les problèmes de chaîne d'approvisionnement et d'approvisionnement afin d'assurer la fluidité des opérations d'approvisionnement clinique à l'échelle mondiale. - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles dans un environnement inclusif, innovant et international pour stimuler l'excellence dans la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement clinique. - Contribuer à une culture d'équipe à haut rendement où le travail d'équipe, la croissance professionnelle et l'impact pour les patients sont prioritaires.
• Requisiti Ces qualités et expériences font de vous un candidat idéal pour ce rôle : - Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en sciences de la vie ou gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, avec une expérience dans les systèmes SAP et l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique comme un atout précieux. - Vous êtes un communicateur clair et professionnel, à la fois par écrit et verbalement, avec d'excellentes compétences en anglais (la connaissance de base de l'allemand est un plus). - Vous excellez dans l'établissement de relations de confiance avec divers partenaires commerciaux, faisant preuve d'une grande sensibilisation culturelle et de compétence sociale dans des contextes internationaux et interfonctionnels. - Vous êtes un résolveur de problèmes avec une attention particulière au détail, de fortes capacités de décision, et une compréhension des systèmes techniques, vous permettant d'apprendre rapidement et de s'adapter aux nouveaux défis. - Vous prospèrez dans des environnements de collaboration et apportez des compétences bien développées en travail d'équipe, en négociation et en organisation à des situations complexes. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Receive, sort, verify, handle exceptions, bar code, scan, and pre-archive Accounts Payable (AP) documents for further processing.

• Validate and process Purchase Order (PO) and contract-based invoices, non-PO invoices, prepayments, and down payments.

• Review supplier open items (due invoices, credit notes, debit balances, etc.) before executing payments.

• Handle internal and external queries and resolve them within the agreed timeline.

• Investigate and reverse non-successful payments.

• Perform supplier statement of account reconciliation and follow up on open items for closure.

• Perform month-end closing activities, including purchasing accrual according to the closing timetable/ schedule.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, or yearly reporting, such as monthly KPI reports and other operational reports based on affiliate requirements.

• Reconcile AP balance sheet accounts and clear aged items (e.g., GR/IR, GIT, suspense account).

• Participate in compliance audits, prepare statutory audit reports & respond to audit queries as necessary.

• Troubleshoot AP issues (workflow, OCR, BOT, process) and work with respective teams (IT, Automation& GBPS) for resolution

• Participate & support implementation of projects/ initiatives from global, business partners & RSS.

• Engage in system integration and testing.

• Initiate and drive process improvement projects.

• Provide technical mentorship to team members and conduct internal process training for new joiners.

• Process suppliers and intercompany invoices accurately and within the predefined KPIs

• Ensure timely payment of suppliers and Intercompany invoices in accordance with agreed payment terms & Intercompany payment schedule

• Respond promptly to internal and external queries, adhering to predefined KPIs.

• Perform timely and accurate AP month-end closing activities, including purchasing accruals, and provide related reports.

• Create and maintain up-to-date work documentation and processes in compliance with ICFR, group policies, guidelines, and local statutory/legal requirements within agreed timelines

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English & Japanese Languages.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir streben danach, das Leben von Patient:innen heute und für zukünftige Generationen zu verbessern. Dabei ist es uns auch wichtig, dass unsere Mitarbeiter:innen selbst nach der Arbeit gesund nach Hause gehen können. Deshalb koordinieren wir in der Abteilung Site Safety als Expert:innen Dienstleistungen bzgl. Arbeitsschutz und Anlagensicherheit bei der Gestaltung, Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung der Prozesse. Die Sicherheit der Menschen, der Umwelt und der technischen Anlagen sowie die Nachhaltigkeit und Qualität von effizienten, gesetzes- und Roche-konformen Prozessen und Produkten stehen im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Dafür ergreifen wir erfolgreich die Initiative und handeln leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Um unsere Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, suchen wir eine:n Expert:in, der/die es versteht, unseren Leistungen durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen ein Gesicht zu geben. Folgende Tätigkeiten gehören dazu:

• Als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit in der Abteilung Site Safety Penzberg bist Du als kompetente:r Ansprechpartner:in zu Themen der Arbeits- und Anlagensicherheit am Standort Penzberg tätig.

• Du arbeitest in einer Matrixstruktur und unterstützt Fachabteilungen und Führungskräfte am Standort in der sicherheitstechnischen Beratung hinsichtlich des Arbeitsschutzes und der Anlagensicherheit.

• Planen, koordinieren, moderieren: Du erstellst Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, legst durch Begehungen, Ereignis- und Unfallanalysen usw. Maßnahmen für einen sicheren Betrieb fest und hältst diese nach.

• Im Rahmen von Neu- und Umbauprojekten bist Du im Projektteam aktiver Partner und erstellst, koordinierst und moderierst, sicherheitsrelevante Dokumente, wie z.B. SHE-Konzepte, -Checklisten und Reviews.

• Du analysierst Ereignisse von Maßnahmen zur zukünftigen Vermeidung und trägst dadurch zur stetigen Verbesserung bei.

• Nicht zuletzt “coachst” du Führungskräfte und moderierst Programme zur Verbesserung der Sicherheitskultur und vermittelst Dein Wissen im Rahmen von Schulungen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium des Ingenieurwesens mit Fachrichtung Verfahrenstechnik, Sicherheitstechnik oder einen Master in Naturwissenschaften erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position, idealerweise in der Industrie mit.

• Als erfahrene Sicherheitsfachkraft gem. § 7 ASiG arbeitest du strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und verfügst idealerweise auch über Expertise bei der Erstellung von technischen Risikoanalysen (HAZOPs) und bei der Erstellung von Exschutzdokumenten

• Du bist in der Lage, Gefahren in Ex-Bereichen und in der chemisch- / pharmazeutischen Produktion zu erkennen und beurteilen sowie Sicherheitskonzepte zu erarbeiten und diese gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern nachzuhalten.

• Für Deine tägliche Arbeit bringst Du eine sehr hohe Affinität zu IT-Tools zur Datenerfassung, -analyse und – auswertung sowie der Präsentation mit, um gezielte Schutzmaßnahmen zu erarbeiten und zu etablieren.

• Mit Hilfe Deines sicheren Auftretens und deiner Kommunikationsstärke gelingt es Dir, Stakeholder auf den verschiedensten Hierarchieebenen erfolgreich zu beraten. Hierbei ist Dein Antrieb, durch innovative und präventive Arbeitsschutz- und Anlagensicherheitskonzepte, jederzeit ein Optimum an Sicherheit zu gewährleisten und dadurch einen Beitrag zur Senkung von Betriebskosten und Unfallzahlen zu leisten.

• Dir macht es Freude, Dein Wissen in Präsentat

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Основні обов'язки:

• Інсталяція та валідація: Проведення монтажу, налаштування, валідації та введення в експлуатацію нових лабораторних систем Roche .

• Технічне обслуговування: Виконання планового та профілактичного обслуговування обладнання згідно з міжнародними стандартами та регламентами компанії.

• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.

• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.

• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.

• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).

• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин.

Вимоги до кандидата:

• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).

• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.

• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.

• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .

• Мови:
Українська – вільно.
Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.

• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.

• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.

• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Основні обов'язки:
• Інсталяція та валідація: Проведення монтажу, налаштування, валідації та введення в експлуатацію нових лабораторних систем Roche .
• Технічне обслуговування: Виконання планового та профілактичного обслуговування обладнання згідно з міжнародними стандартами та регламентами компанії.
• Діагностика та ремонт: Оперативна діагностика несправностей (як на місці у клієнта, так і за допомогою засобів віддаленої підтримки) та проведення ремонтних робіт будь-якої складності.
• Технічна підтримка: Надання професійних консультацій та навчання персоналу лабораторій (лікарів-лаборантів, біологів, інженерів клієнта) щодо правил експлуатації та догляду за обладнанням.
• Модернізація: Встановлення оновлень програмного забезпечення та апаратних модифікацій (апгрейдів) систем.
• Звітність та документація: Своєчасне та точне ведення всієї сервісної документації, заповнення актів виконаних робіт та звітів у корпоративній CRM-системі (відповідно до стандартів ISO та внутрішніх політик).
• Управління запчастинами: Ефективне управління власним складом запасних частин. Вимоги до кандидата:
• Освіта: Вища технічна освіта (біомедична інженерія, електроніка, радіотехніка, метрологія, ІТ або суміжні спеціальності).
• Досвід роботи: Від 2-х років на посаді сервісного інженера з медичним або складним лабораторним обладнанням.
• Технічні знання: Глибоке розуміння принципів роботи електроніки, механіки, оптики та гідравліки.
• ІТ-навички: Впевнений користувач ПК. Розуміння принципів роботи комп'ютерних мереж (TCP/IP, LIS/HIS інтеграція) .
• Мови: Українська – вільно. Англійська – не нижче рівня Intermediate (B1). Обов'язкова вимога для читання технічної документації, проходження навчань у виробника та листування з глобальною підтримкою.
• Мобільність: Наявність водійського посвідчення категорії «В» та досвід водіння.
• Готовність до відряджень: Робота має роз'їзний характер, готовність до регулярних відряджень по Україні.
• Особисті якості: Висока клієнтоорієнтованість, відмінні комунікативні навички, відповідальність, аналітичний склад розуму, вміння працювати в режимі багатозадачності та самостійно приймати рішення. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升
学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bist Du bereit, Dein Know-how im Explosionsschutz und der Anlagensicherheit in einer hochmodernen chemischen Produktion einzubringen? Möchtest Du durch Eigenverantwortung, technische Expertise und pragmatische Lösungen aktiv die Compliance und Sicherheit unserer Anlagen gestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres agilen Teams in Penzberg!

Dein Beitrag – Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft
In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellst Du sicher, dass die Anlagensicherheit – insbesondere der Explosionsschutz – in unserer chemischen Produktion jederzeit gewährleistet ist. Du übernimmst dabei selbstständig Verantwortung für zentrale Aufgaben:

• Technische Expertise & Dokumentation: Du führst technische Prüfungen (als zur Prüfung befähigte Person nach BetrSichV oder mit vergleichbarer Erfahrung) durch und erstellst die zugehörigen Dokumente zum Explosionsschutz.

• Problemlösung & Umsetzung: Du findest und bewertest technische sowie organisatorische Lösungen, begleitest deren Machbarkeit und sorgst als aktiver Partner für die zielorientierte Umsetzung im Produktionsbetrieb.

• Compliance & Digitalisierung: Du verknüpfst, pflegst und nutzt Daten zur Betriebscompliance, um maximale Sicherheit zu gewährleisten und treibst die Digitalisierung von Dokumenten voran.

• Zusammenarbeit & Change Management: Im Matrix-Umfeld engagierst Du Dich aktiv mit Sicherheits-, Produktions- und Technikeinheiten für den betrieblichen Bedarf und lebst das Management of Change.

• Fachliche Führung & Weiterentwicklung: Durch Deine fachliche Führung ermöglichst Du eine effiziente Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Schnittstellen. Du hältst Dich kontinuierlich auf dem Stand der Technik (Fortbildungen, Messen etc.).

Was uns ausmacht – Dein zukünftiges Team und Umfeld
Als Teil von Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist der Bereich DOZ essentiell für die termingerechte Produktion chemischer und biochemischer Einsatzstoffe.

• Das Team: Wir sind eine agile, 45-köpfige Abteilung, die nahezu alle Einheiten der Division Diagnostics mit wichtigen Produkten beliefert.

• Deine Gruppe: Wir sind der zentrale Partner für die Betriebscompliance, chemische Sicherheit, Anlagen- und Explosionsschutz sowie Umweltschutz in der chemischen Produktion. Kontinuierliches Verbessern, gemeinsames Lernen und Vielfalt zeichnen uns aus.

Dein Profil – Mit diesen Kompetenzen überzeugst Du uns
Du bist eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit einem starken Fokus auf technische Sicherheit und pragmatische Umsetzung:

• Ausbildung/Studium: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektroniker, Mechatroniker, Industriemechaniker o.ä.) mit langjähriger praktischer Erfahrung mit Produktionsanlagen oder ein erfolgreiches Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau o.ä.) mit zusätzlicher praktischer Anwendung in der betrieblichen Compliance und vertieftem Wissen im technischen Explosionsschutz.

• Spezialisierung: Fundierte, nachgewiesene fachliche Spezialisierung im betrieblichen Explosionsschutz (z.B. Prüfwesen, Befähigung als "zur Prüfung befähigte Person", Sachkunde nach ATEX RL 2014/34/EU).

• Praxis: Praktische Erfahrung in diverser industrieller Produktion (Technika, Labore, Produktionsbetrieb) und idealerweise aus relevanten Gremien/Berufsverbänden.

• Arbeitsweise: Du bist verantwortungsbewusst, engagiert, strukturiert und zeichnest Dich durch eine selbstständige, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise aus. Du motivierst Dich durch die technische Umsetzung sicherer Lösungen.

• IT & Kommunikation: Gute Englisch- und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. R

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity：

- Operational

• Responsible for assessing compliance of employee expense claims in a timely and accurate manner, against the Company’s Policies*, Procedures and External regulatory requirements.

Note: *The number of affiliates supported will be determined by operational requirements

• Participate in compliance programs, projects and other ad-hoc tasks assigned by Line Manager/Global Lead.

• Clearly documents all compliance assessment (i.e. assessment results) activities in concur during claim processing

• Escalates issues and recommend resolution plans in a timely manner to the RSS Line Manager and Affiliate (where required)

• Support the preparation of reports and training material on a periodic basis to address updates to the compliance monitoring process

- Continuous Improvement

• As part of day-to-day operations work collaboratively with the team to identify opportunities to improve compliance documentations (e.g. review manuals, return reason coding etc)

• In collaboration with Reporting Line Manager make appropriate recommendation to Global Lead for process improvement and be part of the solution provision activities

Who you are:

• University degree or above.business, law or finance related major

• More than 2 years’ experience in compliance reviews or its equivalent and its implementation in a highly regulated environment or in audit firms ( Applications by individuals with less than 2 years’ experience will be at the Associate Compliance Analyst level)

• Fluent in both written and spoken English and Japanese

• Strong analytical skills, be able to assess the facts with professional skepticism

• Thinks out of the box, challenges the status quo and with excellent team work with s trong communications skills

• Motivated and takes full ownership of personal developmen and Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks efficiently

• Understanding of pharma business risks is preffered

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a) 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b) 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c) 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点
3. 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育
4. 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2．了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
3. 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

Years of Working Experience工作年限
•3年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•跨职能工作经验为佳

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试
•在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Quality Solution Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Quality Solutions Lead within our PDQ, you will work within a team of experts and collaborate with peers within the function and across the organization to identify, design and execute fit-for-purpose quality solutions, driving the delivery and sustainability of a robust and regulatory compliance Quality Management System (QMS) ，drive quality culture and implement in China. You will ensure the timely completion of quality solution deliverables and partner with business/stakeholder, overseeing and providing technical expertise in the delivery of high quality solutions to deliver regulatory compliant and high quality processes. You will also contribute to functional, cross-functional, enterprise-wide or external initiatives that shape our technical landscape, business and healthcare environments. You will need strong strategic, collaboration and communication skills, as well as an entrepreneurial mindset, to evolve the way we design and deliver the QMS and to enable accelerated delivery medicines and access for our patients.

As a Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to implement and deliver quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. You will partner with cross-functional teams and external partners and work with considerable independence. Contributes to the continual improvement of internal processes and system support.

As a Senior Quality Solutions Lead , you will be accountable to deliver quality solutions through designing innovative/new/efficient quality solutions to demonstrate confidence in our QMS in order to accelerate regulatory review and approval for medicines and integrated healthcare solutions. We will look to you to contribute to complex cross-functional or cross chapter squads taking a leading role and navigating situations within the QMS landscape.

Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities :

• QUALITY SOLUTIONS : Deliver quality solutions which enable Roche to meet regulations/standards /HA expectations, in an efficient and effective way. Activities may include, but are not limited to:

○ Regulatory Intelligence - proactively analyzes regulatory landscape and assesses impact of emerging and changes to existing regulations to Roche processes.
○ Process design & procedures development - partners with business to design processes, maximally leveraging automation and system workflow, development of performance metrics/signals/evidence-based oversight measures.
○ Process deployment - partners with the business to implement processes, including delivery of training/performance solutions to demonstrate qualification and competency of business to execute processes.
○ Continuous Improvement - drives process improvement activities, leveraging Quality Analytics & Insights and strong decision making for and with Global Process Owners; partner with the business to proactively identify, analyze and improve existing processes and create solutions to optimize performance, meet best practice standards or improve quality and the user experience for customers and end-users.

• QMS EXCELLENCE: Demonstrate process integrity to health authorities

○ Develop process strategies and proactively manage timelines to ensure successful oversight and delivery of quality solutions, including the implementation and adoption of new technologies and solutions that drive efficiency and cost savings.
○ Continuously improve internal proc

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come leader di soluzioni di qualità all'interno del nostro PDQ, lavorerai all'interno di un team di esperti e collaborerai con coetanei all'interno della funzione e in tutta l'organizzazione per identificare, progettare ed eseguire soluzioni di qualità fit-for-purpose, guidando la consegna e la sostenibilità di una conformità robusta e regolamentare Quality Management System (QMS) , guidando la cultura della qualità e l'implementazione in Cina. Ti garantirai il completamento tempestivo delle soluzioni di qualità consegnabili e partner con business/stakeholder, supervisionando e fornendo competenze tecniche nella fornitura di soluzioni di alta qualità per fornire conformi normativi e processi di alta qualità. Contribuirai anche a iniziative funzionali, interfunzionali, aziendali o esterne che modellano il nostro ambiente tecnico, aziendale e sanitario. Avrete bisogno di forti capacità strategiche, di collaborazione e di comunicazione, nonché di una mentalità imprenditoriale, per evolvere il nostro modo di progettare e consegnare il QMS e per consentire farmaci di consegna accelerati e l'accesso per i nostri pazienti. Come leader di soluzioni di qualità, sarete responsabili di implementare e fornire soluzioni di qualità per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione e l'approvazione normativa per i farmaci e soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Potrai collaborare con team interfunzionali e partner esterni e lavorare con notevole indipendenza. Contribuisce al miglioramento continuo dei processi interni e del supporto del sistema. In qualità di Senior Quality Solutions Lead, sarete responsabili di fornire soluzioni di qualità attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni di qualità innovative/nuove/efficienti per dimostrare la fiducia nel nostro QMS al fine di accelerare la revisione normativa e l'approvazione per i farmaci e le soluzioni sanitarie integrate. Vi cercheremo di contribuire a complesse squadre di capitoli trasversali o incrociati assumendo un ruolo di primo piano e navigando situazioni all'interno del paesaggio QMS. Responsabilità e responsabilità primarie:
• SOLUZIONI DI QUALITÀ: fornire soluzioni di qualità che consentano a Roche di soddisfare le normative/standard /HA aspettative, in modo efficiente ed efficace. Le attività possono includere, ma non sono limitate a: ○ Regulatory Intelligence - analizza proattivamente il paesaggio normativo e valuta l'impatto di emergenze e modifiche alle normative esistenti ai processi Roche. ○ Sviluppo di processi e procedure - partner con processi di business to design, sfruttando al massimo l'automazione e il flusso di lavoro di sistema, lo sviluppo di metriche/segnali di performance/misure di supervisione basate sulle prove. ○ Distribuzione di processi - partner con l'azienda per implementare processi, compresa la fornitura di soluzioni di formazione/performance per dimostrare la qualifica e la competenza del business per eseguire i processi. ○ Miglioramento continuo - guida le attività di miglioramento del processo, sfruttando Quality Analytics & Insights e il forte processo decisionale per e con Global Process Owners; partner con il business per identificare, analizzare e migliorare i processi esistenti e creare soluzioni per ottimizzare le prestazioni, soddisfare i migliori standard di pratica o migliorare la qualità e l'esperienza degli utenti per i clienti e gli utenti finali.
• ESCELLENZA QMS: Dimostrare l'integrità del processo alle autorità sanitarie ○ Sviluppare strategie di processo e gestire in modo proattivo le linee temporali per garantire una corretta supervisione e consegna di soluzioni di qualità, tra cui l'implementazione e l'adozione di nuove tecnologie e soluzioni che favoriscano l'efficienza e il risparmio di costi. ○ Migliorare continuamente il proc interno

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Quality Solutions Lead in unserem PDQ arbeiten Sie innerhalb eines Teams von Experten und arbeiten mit Kollegen innerhalb der Funktion und in der gesamten Organisation zusammen, um passende Qualitätslösungen zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die Lieferung und Nachhaltigkeit eines robusten und regulatorischen Compliance Quality Management Systems (QMS) zu steuern, Qualitätskultur anzutreiben und in China umzusetzen. Sie sorgen für die zeitnahe Fertigstellung von Qualitätslösungen und Partner mit Business/Stakeholdern, die Überwachung und Bereitstellung technischer Expertise bei der Lieferung hochwertiger Lösungen zur Bereitstellung regulatorischer und qualitativ hochwertiger Prozesse. Sie werden auch zu funktionellen, funktionsübergreifenden, unternehmensweiten oder externen Initiativen beitragen, die unsere technischen Landschafts-, Geschäfts- und Gesundheitsumgebungen prägen. Sie benötigen starke strategische, kooperative und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie ein unternehmerisches Denkvermögen, um die Art und Weise zu entwickeln, wie wir das QMS entwerfen und liefern und beschleunigte Liefermedikamente und Zugang zu unseren Patienten zu ermöglichen. Als Quality Solutions Lead können Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen implementieren und liefern, um das Vertrauen in unser QMS zu demonstrieren, um die regulatorische Überprüfung und Zulassung für Arzneimittel und integrierte Gesundheitslösungen zu beschleunigen. Sie werden mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten und mit großer Unabhängigkeit arbeiten. trägt zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der internen Prozesse und der Systemunterstützung bei. Als Senior Quality Solutions Lead können Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen liefern, indem Sie innovative/neue/effiziente Qualitätslösungen entwickeln, um das Vertrauen in unser QMS zu demonstrieren, um die regulatorische Überprüfung und Zulassung für Arzneimittel und integrierte Gesundheitslösungen zu beschleunigen. Wir werden Sie dazu auffordern, zu komplexen kreuz- oder querverzahnten Kapitelquads beizutragen, die eine führende Rolle und navigierende Situationen in der QMS-Landschaft einnehmen. Primäre Verantwortungen und Rechenschaftspflichten:
• QUALITY SOLUTIONS : Liefern Sie qualitativ hochwertige Lösungen, die es Roche ermöglichen, die Vorschriften/Standards /HA-Erwartungen effizient und effektiv zu erfüllen. Aktivitäten können beinhalten, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf: ○ Regulatory Intelligence - analysiert die regulatorische Landschaft und bewertet die Auswirkungen der aufstrebenden und Änderungen bestehender Regelungen auf Roche-Prozesse proaktiv. ○ Prozessgestaltung & Verfahrensentwicklung - Geschäftspartner mit Business-to-design-Prozessen, maximaler Automatisierungs- und System-Workflow, Entwicklung von Performance Metriken/Signalen/evidence-basierten Aufsichtsmaßnahmen. ○ Prozess-Bereitstellung - Partner mit dem Unternehmen, um Prozesse zu implementieren, einschließlich der Bereitstellung von Trainings-/Performance-Lösungen, um Qualifikation und Kompetenz des Unternehmens zur Durchführung von Prozessen zu demonstrieren. ○ Kontinuierliche Verbesserung - treibt Prozessverbesserungsaktivitäten an, nutzt Quality Analytics & Insights und starke Entscheidungsfindung für und mit Global Process Owners; Partner mit dem Unternehmen, bestehende Prozesse proaktiv zu identifizieren, zu analysieren und zu verbessern und Lösungen zu schaffen, um die Leistung zu optimieren, Best Practice Standards zu erfüllen oder die Qualität und das Nutzererlebnis für Kunden und Endbenutzer zu verbessern.
• QMS EXCELLENCE: Demonstrate Prozessintegrität an Gesundheitsbehörden ○ Entwickeln Sie Prozessstrategien und verwalten Sie proaktiv Zeitlinien, um eine erfolgreiche Aufsicht und Lieferung von Qualitätslösungen zu gewährleisten, einschließlich der Umsetzung und Einführung neuer Technologien und Lösungen, die Effizienz und Kostenersparnis steigern. ○ Kontinuierlich verbessern interne Proc
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que responsable des solutions de qualité au sein de notre PDQ, vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe d'experts et collaborerez avec des pairs au sein de la fonction et dans l'ensemble de l'organisation pour identifier, concevoir et exécuter des solutions de qualité adaptées à l'usage, en conduisant à la livraison et à la durabilité d'un système de gestion de la qualité (SGQ) robuste et réglementaire, dynamiser la culture de qualité et mettre en œuvre en Chine. Vous veillerez à ce que les produits livrables de la solution de qualité soient achevés en temps opportun et qu'ils soient en partenariat avec les entreprises et les intervenants, en surveillant et en fournissant une expertise technique dans la prestation de solutions de haute qualité pour offrir des processus conformes à la réglementation et de haute qualité. Vous contribuerez également à des initiatives fonctionnelles, interfonctionnelles, à l'échelle de l'entreprise ou externes qui façonnent notre paysage technique, nos milieux d'affaires et de santé. Vous aurez besoin de solides compétences stratégiques, de collaboration et de communication, ainsi que d'un état d'esprit d'entreprise, afin d'évoluer dans la façon dont nous concevons et livrons le SGQ et de permettre une livraison accélérée des médicaments et un accès pour nos patients. En tant que responsable des solutions de qualité, vous devrez mettre en œuvre et fournir des solutions de qualité pour démontrer votre confiance dans notre SGQ afin d'accélérer l'examen réglementaire et l'approbation des médicaments et des solutions de santé intégrées. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des partenaires externes avec une indépendance considérable. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus internes et du soutien des systèmes. En tant que responsable principal des solutions de qualité , vous serez responsable de fournir des solutions de qualité en concevant des solutions de qualité innovantes/nouvelles/efficaces pour démontrer votre confiance dans notre SGQ afin d'accélérer l'examen réglementaire et l'approbation des médicaments et des solutions de santé intégrées. Nous comptons sur vous pour contribuer à des équipes interfonctionnelles ou transversales complexes qui jouent un rôle de premier plan et qui naviguent dans le paysage de QMS. Responsabilités et responsabilités principales :
• SOLUTIONS DE QUALITÉ : Offrir des solutions de qualité qui permettent à Roche de répondre aux attentes réglementaires/normes/HA, de manière efficace et efficiente. Les activités peuvent comprendre, sans s'y limiter, les éléments suivants : - Renseignements réglementaires - Analyse proactive du paysage réglementaire et évaluation de l'impact des changements et des changements aux règlements existants sur les processus Roche. - Oui. Conception de processus et élaboration de procédures - partenaires avec les entreprises pour concevoir des processus, tirer le meilleur parti possible de l'automatisation et du flux de travail du système, élaboration de mesures de rendement, de signaux et de mesures de surveillance fondées sur des preuves. - Oui. Déploiement de processus - Partenaires avec l'entreprise pour mettre en oeuvre des processus, y compris la prestation de solutions de formation et de rendement pour démontrer la qualification et la compétence de l'entreprise pour exécuter des processus. L'amélioration continue - stimule les activités d'amélioration des processus, en tirant parti de l'analyse de la qualité & Insights et d'une prise de décision solide pour et avec Global Process Owners; partenaire avec l'entreprise pour identifier, analyser et améliorer proactivement les processus existants et créer des solutions pour optimiser les performances, répondre aux normes de bonnes pratiques ou améliorer la qualité et l'expérience utilisateur pour les clients et les utilisateurs finaux.
• EXCELLENCE DU SGQ : démontrer l'intégrité des processus aux autorités sanitaires - Élaborer des stratégies de processus et gérer de façon proactive les délais afin d'assurer la supervision et la prestation réussies de solutions de qualité, y compris la mise en oeuvre et l'adoption de nouvelles technologies et de solutions qui favorisent l'efficacité et les économies. Amélioration continue du processus interne

jobs.title: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

titleByLocale.en: 副总监 - 医院战略合作
titleByLocale.de: 副总监 - 医院战略合作

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 您是谁：
• 作为医院战略合作部门区域负责人，您将带领团队 与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。

您的主要职责：
• 1、与负责区域的外部医疗机构建立长期、深度、多元的战略伙伴关系。作为医院非临床各职能科室的首要对接窗口，充分依托罗氏的创新资源禀赋，为医院提供一体化支持方案，从而全面助力医院实现高质量发展目标。
• 1.1 了解和挖掘所负责区域关键医院业务和学术发展需求，并提供相应的学术支持
• 1.2 设计和实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 1.3 部门合作推动所负责区域关键医院与公司的战略合作关系

2、负责所属区域关键医院的准入工作
• 2.1根据部门与业务共识的医院准入目标，确保在开发成功率和有效执行
• 2.2 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 2.3 负责所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作

• 3、负责所属区域关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 3.1完成和完善区域关键医院的 项目及预算计划
• 3.2 监督SAM执行所负责关键医院的计划执行
• 3.3 协同业务和跨部门一起完善和落实相关项目的落地和高效执行

4、负责团队和人员管理
• 4.1按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告，严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策
• 4.2负责区域T&E费用预算审核及实际费用审核，对预算负责
• 4.3 根据团队业绩考核目标，定期辅导和跟进计划执行，以确保业务目标达成

5、 参与或带领部门或跨部门的相关项目

我们期待这样的你加入：
• 1，具备医院准入，市场准入或医药销售二线管理工作经验。
• 2， 具备项目管理能力，辅导及提升团队项目管理知识及流程；辅导团队设计项目；能对风险及突发事件处理及预防。
• 3， 具备团队合作能力，能建立跨部门沟通合作机制；具有全局观和全面思考能力，从公司策略角度引导开展区域及跨区域活动会议，促成跨区域内部合作，形成品牌项目。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Leader digitale del flusso di valore del prodotto (Lab Connected)
titleByLocale.en: Digital Product Value Stream Leader (Connected Lab)
titleByLocale.de: Digital Product Value Stream Leader (Connected Lab)
titleByLocale.fr: Leader du volet de la valeur numérique des produits (laboratoire relié)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The opportunity:
The Digital Product Value Stream Leader is a strategic leadership role responsible for owning the end-to-end lifecycle and commercial success of Roche Diagnostics China’s "Connected Lab"; digital portfolio. This role
requires a visionary leader who will define the long-term strategic direction and vision, as well as a roadmap for connected laboratory solutions, ensuring alignment with Roche’s broader digital ecosystem and the specific needs of the Chinese market.

In this capacity, you will lead, coach and empower a team of Product Managers, fostering a culture of agility, customer-centricity, and outcome-based delivery. This role serves as a critical bridge, ensuring seamless synergy between technical engineering, commercial go-to-market strategies, and customer experience,
ensuring that our digital value stream maximizes laboratory efficiency, data connectivity, and diagnostic value. You will also be accountable for the P&L performance, adoption, and sustained growth of the Connected Lab product suite.

You will:

• Value Stream Strategy: Define and execute a cohesive digital stratgy for the Connected Lab value stream, transitioning products from concept to launch and maturity while ensuring seamless ineration with laboratory hardware and middleware.

• Team Leadership: Build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Product Managers; drive functional excellence in product disovery, backlog prioritization, and roadmap planning.

• Lifecycle Management: Oversee the complete product lifecycle (PLM) for the portfolio, making data-driven decisions on investment, iteration, and sunsetting to maximize ROI.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the primary interface beween local R&D, Global teams, Commercial, and Customer Support to remove bottlenecks and ensure timely delivery of value to customers.

• Market Success: Deeply understand the China diagnostics landscape to drive product-market fit, ensuring solutions address local regulatory requirements, workflow challenges, and digital trends.

Who you are:

• Master or bachelor's degree in IT, Finance, Business or Biomedical Sciences

• Deep curiosity about the healthcare ecosystem with a fluency in common business models and knowledge of the competitive landscape for digital health and diagnostics

• Exceptional problem-solving and analytical tills, ability to work alone as product business owner to drive the projects forward.

• Leadership skills, including strategic thinking, creativity, integrity, trust, accountability, credibility, judgment, persuasion/influence, fairness and high ethical standards.

• Ability to positively approach new challenges and opportunities, using creative thought processes to uniquely solve problems

• Ability to build and execute processes with a mindset toward the future

• Strong strategic planning skills

• High tolerance for ambiguity

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to multi-task and meet deadlines

• Organized, detail-oriented

• High level of written and oral communication skills

• 12+ years of experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Information, Scientific Communications, or Clinical Informatics, preferably in a pharmaceutical, medical device, or health technology setting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mill

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche bewegt uns täglich die Frage: Was brauchen Patient:innen jetzt? Als Customer Partnering Manager (m/w/d) im Bereich Ophthalmologie bist Du die Antwort darauf. Du gestaltest aktiv die Versorgungslandschaft für Menschen mit neovaskulärer, altersbedingter Makuladegeneration (nAMD) und Diabetischem Makulaödem (DMÖ) und schaffst so einen echten Mehrwert – für Patient:innen, das Gesundheitssystem und für uns.

Dein neues Team
Dich erwartet ein cross-funktionales und engagiertes Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für Patient:innen zu erzielen. Wir leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir neue Wege zu gehen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Customer Partnering Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Ophthalmologie aktiv mit. Deine Aufgaben sind dabei so wirkungsvoll wie vielfältig:

• Wirkungsvolle Strategien entwickeln: Du analysierst die Versorgungswege von Patient:innen (Patient Journey), identifizierst Hürden sowie Chancen und leitest daraus wirkungsvolle Maßnahmen ab.

• Wissenstransfer auf Augenhöhe: Du führst einen fundierten wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit medizinischen Expert:innen und stellst die korrekte und angemessene Anwendung unserer etablierten Medikamente sicher.

• Partnerschaften gestalten: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Zielkund:innen und baust nachhaltige, partnerschaftliche Beziehungen entlang der gesamten Patient Journey auf.

• Netzwerke beleben: Du planst und gestaltest proaktiv Fortbildungsveranstaltungen sowie Produktschulungen für Ärzt:innen und medizinisches Fachpersonal, sowohl digital als auch vor Ort.

• Versorgung optimieren: Du gestaltest die regionalen Versorgungsstrukturen aktiv mit, um unser Portfolio im Sinne der Patient:innen optimal zu positionieren.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke und strategisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die mit Leidenschaft Brücken zwischen Wissenschaft und Praxis baut.

• Deine Basis: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (z.B. in Medizin, Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften) und erfüllst die Voraussetzungen als Pharmaberater:in nach §75 AMG.

• Deine Erfahrung: Du bringst bereits Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Industrie mit, idealerweise im wissenschaftlichen Außendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten Rolle.

• Dein Antrieb: Erfolgreiche und mit Freude und Überzeugung geführte Verkaufsgespräche sind Dein Beitrag zur Versorgung von Patient:innen mit unseren innovativen Produkten.

• Deine Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst souverän und partnerschaftlich auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl persönlich als auch über digitale Kanäle, und kannst komplexe wissenschaftliche Inhalte klar vermitteln.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist - TALENT POOL

titleByLocale.it: Media a pagamento Specialista - TALENT POOL

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest!

The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Paid Media Specialist is responsible for supporting and partnering with our Business Partners in executing on the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The role is expert in all aspects of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Planning, executing, and optimizing global digital marketing campaigns across key channels such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Display, in close collaboration with digital marketing managers and social media leads worldwide. This includes a focus on media buying, strategically purchasing ad space to reach our target audiences effectively and efficiently through our media agency.

• Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders, managing key KPIs and budgets, and continuously driving improvements

• Conducting A/B testing and audience optimization to refine targeting, ad copy, landing pages, and bidding strategies, ensuring data-driven enhancements and higher conversion rates

• Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices, leveraging research and insights to keep campaign strategies at the forefront, while discovering and learning the pharma advertising space

• Contributing to process optimization and knowledge sharing, establishing process governance, collaborating cross-functionally to align campaign goals, share learnings, and strengthen team capabilities

Who you are:

• You have a degree in Business or Marketing (BSc/MSc) and bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in paid media campaign management, running campaigns across platforms focusing mainly on LinkedIn Ads, and have a good understanding of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Display Advertising

• You are analytical and data-driven, with strong technical skills, and have experience using tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics. You know how to develop effective strategies, analyze performance, and continuously optimize campaigns for better results

• You are an excellent communicator with a C1-level English proficiency, confident in managing global stakeholders, collaborating with agencies and digital managers, and engaging with senior leaders to drive campaign success.

• You have a consultancy mindset, proactively providing insights and recommendations, developing actionable plans, and contributing to process improvements and best practices within the team

• You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, are detail-oriented and well-organized, and bring a passion for digital technologies along with strong project management skills to keep initiatives on track

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PTE is the department within Roche’s PT - Pharma Technical Operations - that leads Operational Excellence, Digital, and Advanced Analytics capabilities. As part of PTE, Operational Excellence empowers Roche PT teams to achieve their performance goals by cultivating a strong, inclusive, and cross-functional community. We focus on embedding Lean thinking, driving continuous improvement, and thoughtfully advancing Digital and Analytics solutions to deliver tangible business value.

Operational Excellence champions a culture of continuous improvement—promoting Lean as a way of working, simplifying complex processes, and enabling teams to address root causes effectively. Our mission is to build lasting capabilities that enable smarter, faster, and more sustainable ways of working, ultimately benefiting both our colleagues and patients.

The Global Operational Excellence Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for PTT — our MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability organization — acts as the primary liaison between PTT teams and the global OE strategy and execution. This role drives alignment, leads Lean and continuous improvement initiatives, and fosters a culture of operational excellence across the PTT organization.

The Opportunity:

• Architect: Collaborate with senior management to identify and prioritize improvement opportunities and integrate Operational Excellence (OE) with Digital & Analytics Technologies to create a joint roadmap. Educate and influence senior leaders on using OE/Lean and digital measures to drive outcomes.

• Catalyst: Support key decision-making, take accountability for improvement plan execution and outcomes, and lead complex improvement initiatives combining OE and Digital methodologies. Monitor performance, promote Lean practices, and identify and address potential roadblocks.

• Coach: Guide senior and function managers on Lean Leadership, build skills and mindsets across the network, and facilitate a unified digital community.

• Collaboration & Leadership: Engage PTT Leaders to uncover needs and remove barriers. Align with other PT OE Partners to ensure cohesive, cross-functional solutions. Communicate clearly, foster collaboration, and bring high energy and ownership.

What You Bring:

• M.Sc., or Bachelor’s in a relevant field preferred; Engineering, Manufacturing Science, Biology, Chemistry etc. MBA a plus.

• At least 5 years of Operational Excellence / Lean experience with strong systemic and analytical thinking.

• Experience in biotech or pharma is a must. Ideally you have a background in Biologics manufacturing.

• Deep MSAT/Engineering understanding.

• Ability to influence and drive sustainable change across complex stakeholder groups.

• Leadership strength in both vision and execution, especially in behavioral transformation.

• Growth mindset, digital fluency, and comfort in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• A competitive executive compensation package, including bonus and long-term incentives.
