The Position We are seeking a strategic visionary and execution-focused leader to become our Head of Commercial Excellence, China. This is a critical role designed to build the strategic "connective tissue" across our entire China commercial operation. You will be the architect of our capabilities, processes, and systems, empowering our teams to achieve peak performance in one of the world's most dynamic healthcare markets. Your mission is to transform data into strategy and strategy into flawless execution, ensuring we are agile, data-driven, and perfectly aligned to win. What You’ll Do:
• Develop Strategic Vision: Act as a key partner to the China Leadership Team, crafting and championing a 3-5 year Commercial Excellence roadmap to shape our future.
• Architect Go-To-Market Strategy: Lead the integrated GTM strategy, ensuring seamless and compliant alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Market Access teams.
• Drive Sales & Field Force Excellence: Lead Field Force Effectiveness (FFE), including segmentation, targeting, territory design, and incentive compensation to foster a high-performance culture.
• Enable Marketing & Launch Excellence: Partner with brand teams on omnichannel marketing and own a best-in-class launch excellence framework for flawless product introductions.
• Power Data-Driven Decisions: Build a robust data and analytics powerhouse to deliver actionable insights and sophisticated models for pricing, access, and strategy.
• Optimize Commercial Technology: Oversee the commercial tech stack (e.g., CRM, AI tools), ensuring maximum adoption and ROI to enable our teams.
• Lead & Inspire a High-Performing Team: Train, mentor, and lead a multi-disciplinary Commercial Excellence team, fostering a culture of agility and continuous improvement.
• Build Future-Ready Capabilities: Design and deploy comprehensive training programs to develop the strategic capabilities of our commercial field force and cross-functional teams. Who You Are:
• You bring 15+ years in the pharma/biotech industry, with at least 5-7 years in a senior Commercial Excellence leadership role.
• You have a non-negotiable, proven track record and deep, applied understanding of the mainland China healthcare ecosystem, policy landscape, and digital environment.
• You seamlessly pivot between building a 5-year strategic vision and driving a 30-day operational sprint to enable execution.
• You demonstrate exceptional leadership with proven experience building, inspiring, and developing high-performing, cross-functional teams.
• You possess superior analytical skills, with a history of leveraging data to challenge conventions and drive business performance.
• You foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement, championing a data-driven mindset across the organization.
• You hold an advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD preferred) and are fluent in both Mandarin Chinese and English.
• You are energized by the "green-light" to innovate, build, and transform how we operate. What We Offer:
• A high-visibility, high-impact leadership role with significant future career development opportunities within a top-tier global enterprise.
• The unique opportunity to architect and shape the commercial future in our most critical market.
• A mandate to innovate—to build, transform, and implement your strategic vision.
• A competitive executive compensation package, including bonus and long-term incentives. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together,

jobs.title: Analyst (Business Operations)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) was established to drive analytics and technology-driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

The Opportunity:
As the Analyst (Business Operations) , you will join the GATE team to manage critical data contracts, third-party agreements (TPA), and related finance and budgetary processes.

In this role, you will act as a key liaison between US business partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure the efficient, compliant, and timely execution of all data agreements, with a specific focus on the Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences domain.

Key Responsibilities

Contract & Agreement Management

• End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Process Data Contracts and Third-Party Agreements (TPA) from initiation to completion, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Procurement, Legal) and external vendors.

• Vendor Onboarding: Lead the onboarding process for new vendors by collaborating with the Vendor Master Data team to obtain necessary approvals and system setup.

• Compliance & Access: Partner with stakeholders to validate appropriate use cases and data sources for TPAs to prevent discrepancies and unauthorized access.

• System Administration: Oversee the efficient and accurate processing of all documents, preventing oversights and ensuring seamless execution.

• Issue Resolution: Oversee daily communication and ensure the smooth resolution of any issues related to the TPA process.

Financial & Budget Operations

• Budget Tracking: Continuously update the master contract and budget tracking sheet to monitor contract statuses and accurately track total expenditure (spent-to-date) against budget metrics.

• Financial Reconciliation: Perform data validation, resolve Purchase Order (PO) amount discrepancies with the Finance reporting system, and accurately manage year-wise accruals for multi-year contracts.

• Procurement Support: Facilitate full service contract processing for Data Management by collaborating directly with the Procurement team to secure necessary Purchase Orders (POs).

• WBS Management: Submit SMART Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code requests for contracts requiring multiple splits, and accurately process WBS and Change Order requests when applicable.

Data & Process Optimization

• Process Improvement: Document and maintain current workflows, identifying and implementing opportunities for process optimization within contract operations.

• Data Analysis: Conduct data assessments, gap analyses, and ad hoc data analyses to provide valuable insights for decision-making.

• Inquiry Handling: Efficiently handle incoming data inquiries, sourcing and implementing solutions, and retrieving data for ad hoc requests.

Who You Are

Experience

• Professional Background: 2+ years of professional experience in a Business Analyst, Finance Operations, or Contracts Management role.

• Contract Expertise: Knowledge in managing and processing Data Contracts and Third-Party Agreements (TPA), demonstrating a strong process-oriented approach.

• Forecasting: Aware of forecasting and predicting financial trends based on historical data.

• Industry Knowledge: Experience in the Pharma, Life Science, or Biotech domain is a significant advantage.

Skills & Competencies

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to interact professionally and effectively with senior leadership and diverse stakeholders.

• Technical Prof

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The opportunity
As the Ecosystem Enabler, you are a member of the Affiliate Enabling Team and shape how Roche Central Asia delivers impact across the portfolio. You connect strategy to execution across three Disease Areas, strengthen customer engagement and digital/omnichannel excellence, and build the capabilities and operating model that enable high performance.
You role model an agile leadership stance (VACC: Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach)—creating clarity of direction, enabling empowered teams, and accelerating learning and performance. You operate with an enterprise mindset, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and partner closely across functions and countries to ensure disciplined execution and sustainable outcomes for patients and the healthcare system.

Key responsibilities

Strategy, outcomes and performance

• Co-create, with the Affiliate Enabling Team, the affiliate’s near- and long-term strategic direction and translate it into clear outcomes, priorities and execution plans.

• Lead integrated portfolio planning across the three Disease Areas to ensure coherence, focus, and disciplined delivery.

• Ensure responsible resource and budget stewardship, enabling the highest-impact opportunities and sustainable execution.

• Establish and maintain fit-for-purpose governance, planning routines and performance reviews to drive execution quality.

Disease Area leadership

• Provide strategic direction and enable execution across the affiliate’s three Disease Areas (end-to-end: strategy, customer engagement approach, and delivery through squads/teams).

• Ensure disease area strategies are insight-led and differentiated, with clear choices on priorities, target segments and value communication.

• Drive alignment across Disease Areas on shared capabilities, ways of working, and cross-portfolio opportunities.

Customer engagement and digital/omnichannel enablement

• Strengthen customer engagement by streamlining touchpoints and improving end-to-end experience for key audiences (HCPs, payers, patients, partners).

• Lead the affiliate’s digital/omnichannel strategy and execution, ensuring coordinated, measurable, customer-relevant content and initiatives.

• Drive data- and insights-led decision making by leading analysis of trends, customer insights, and performance indicators that inform priorities and improve effectiveness.

Ecosystem shaping and external partnerships

• Lead and coordinate participation in national and regional healthcare programs/projects aligned with public health priorities and Roche’s commitments.

• Build trusted partnerships and engage with key stakeholders (health authorities, payers/funds, NGOs, partners) on strategic and project-related topics.

Leadership, capability building and culture

jobs.title: Senior Scientist - Cell Culture Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal - Chef de la culture cellulaire

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
JOB DESCRIPTION
SENIOR SCIENTIST OF Biologics CMC
at China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR)

POSITION
At Roche, over 90,000 colleagues are working together and doing what patients need next. Our ambition is to deliver novel therapeutics, diagnostic solutions and insights to patients with game changing clinical benefits. China Innovation Center of Roche is seeking a talented and experienced Senior/Principal Scientist in Biologics CMC group for developing cell line development and cell culture strategy and driving execution of strategies to support biologics discovery and development programs. The final position offered depends on the experience level of the candidate. The successful candidate will work with dynamic and highly motivated teams to drive the discovery and development of antibody therapeutics for unmet medical needs. The position requires effective collaboration on multidisciplinary teams with members from multiple functions of CICoR, and interfaces with Discovery, CMC, Pharma Technical Development (PTD), Quality, Regulatory and external CRO/CDMO partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop cell line development and cell culture process development strategy as a part of overall project technical development strategy to support IND and early clinical development

• Drive cell line development and cell culture process development activities in collaboration with Roche TDTs and Roche qualified CDMO partners, including development and scale-up of mammalian cell culture and harvest process, from seed train to bioreactor harvest for production of biologics, lead clone selection, and process optimization. Author, review and/or approve technical reports for documenting process development activities

• Support technology transfer of manufacturing processes from biotech partners to Roche or a Roche CDMO partner, or from one Roche site/CDMO partner to another Roche site/CDMO partner

• Ensure cGMP compliance with ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements

• Serve as a CLD and CCPD technical SME on biologics technical development teams, CMC due diligence teams and CDMO assessment/qualification teams

• Drive transient CHO expression and purification to support discovery and preclinical projects in collaboration with Discovery teams

• Close communication and collaboration with Discovery, CMC, Quality, Technical Regulatory and PTD to ensure alignment and E2E mindset

• Participate in due diligence to evaluate external opportunities for in-licensing of assets or technologies

• May serve as CMC lead that designs and executes project CMC development strategies and risk mitigation strategies, drives planning and operational excellence of early development CMC projects, manages seamless collaboration with CMC-related functions to deliver biologics CMC projects

CANDIDATE PROFILE
Qualification and experience
The candidate qualifications include a Ph.D. in Biology, Protein Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biochemical Engineering or related field, including at least 5 years of recent CLD and/or CCPD experience preferably in a biotech or pharma setting, or a MS in above areas with at least 8 years of relevant experience. A track record of effective support in drug discovery and development programs.
Competencies
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated competence in the following areas:

• Hands-on experience in bioreactors for biopharmaceutical/biologic production, experience in leading mammalian cell culture process development activities

• Understanding of cell biolo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Title: AI Medical Innovation leader
Location: Shanghai, China

What will you be working on:
Lead and coach a team of strategy professionals to develop and execute a comprehensive strategic roadmap for AI for medical solutions, aligned with company objectives and market dynamics.

• Lead and coach the team to develop a comprehensive strategy that aligns with the company's strategic objectives.

• Ensure the strategy is adaptable to changes in the healthcare landscape and company priorities.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including medical, commercial, and external partners to integrate disease-specific solutions and platform-based events into the overall strategy.

• Architect and catalyze actions that maximize medical clicial research and scientific communication productivity and optimal execution of the digital health development and launch

• Identify opportunities for business growth through innovative healthcare solutions and develop mechanism to capture these opportunities

• Lead and coach team to conduct market assessments, competitive analyses, and stakeholder engagements to identify opportunities and challenges within different disease areas.

• Monitor industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies to anticipate market shifts and inform strategic planning.

D rive the development and implementation of innovative solutions in disease areas, programs, partnerships, and business models that address unmet healthcare needs and drive business growth, to bring better clinical outcome and sustainable development of AI for medical.

• Integrate solutions from various disease areas to create a cohesive strategy and facilitate collaboration between different teams to leverage synergies and best practices.

• Lead the planning and execution of proof-of-concept and incubator of AI for medical showcase the company's innovative healthcare solutions and to ensure sustainable development and enrich the AI for medical portfolio.

• Ensure these events are strategically aligned and contribute to the overall business goals and bring better patient outcomes.

Define and prioritize key initiatives, resource allocation, and KPIs to ensure effective execution and measurable impact of integrated healthcare programs.

• Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of the integrated strategy and provide regular updates on the team's performance against these KPIs to senior management.

• Assess and manage risks associated with the implementation of the integrated strategy, develop and implement contingency plans to mitigate potential risks.

• Manage the team's budget and allocate resources effectively to ensure the successful execution of the strategy and ensure the team has the necessary tools and support to achieve its objectives.

Provide strategic guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Lead and coach the team member to achieve their full potential.

• Foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-performing team environment.

Engage with internal and external stakeholders, including healthcare providers, payers, and physicians to understand their needs and incorporate their feedback into the strategy. Communicate the team's strategy and progress to senior management and other stakeholders

jobs.title: Toxicology Project Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Toxicology Project Leader

The position is within the toxicology group in Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) and located at China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR). This group leads in the development of the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

Your responsibilities are:
· Developing and executing high quality, timely, integrated and scientifically sound nonclinical safety strategies from target assessment through discovery and global clinical development.
· Representing the toxicology function on multi-functional project teams and acting as a key contributor to the selection and development of potential new medicines through close interactions with other functions such as DMPK, biology, CMC and clinical development.
· Generating concise safety assessments and leading efforts of investigating mechanisms of toxicity for internal decision making, accountable for result analysis and interpretation, trouble shooting, as well as contributing to protocol/report of safety studies and related documentation.
• · Developing and optimizing immunosafety and immunogenicity assay strategies to characterize candidate molecules
• · Managing assay outsourcing to local and global CROs and develop/troubleshoot mechanistic immunosafety and immunogenicity assays in house where needed
• · Collaborating with global subject matter experts (SMEs) and external partners to provide relevant immunosafety and immunogenicity input locally where needed and act as local SME

In addition, you are expected to:
• · Live the culture of humility, curiosity, and responsibility
• · Embrace agile ways of working and collaborative spirit
• · Aim for scientific excellence, embrace innovation and utilize emerging technologies to support risk assessments with continuous learning
· Expand scientific visibility and maintain effective interactions with internal and external collaborators, and contribute to scientific advancements in the toxicology and immunosafety/immunogenicity field

Profile:
You have a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM), PhD (immunology/toxicology or pharmacology preferred) or equivalent and >1 year of post-doc/working experience in relevant immunology/toxicology areas. Large molecule toxicology and immunosafety/immunogenicity experience is preferred. Good knowledge of toxicology including common safety assessment strategy and technology. Strong interpersonal skills and team player. Good organizational and multi-tasking abilities. Good English communication and presentation skills.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Execute the day-to-day activities according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and best practice. Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

• Follow the instructions of the Managers regarding the daily work coordination.

• Develop knowledge and capability to raise competence to expected levels to meet current and future business needs.

• Contribute process and technical expertise to process improvement initiatives. Support on assigned projects or programs.

• Key Accountabilities: Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions/Shopping Carts to Purchase Orders. Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation.Manage and resolve internal and external queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process. Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch.

• ​Execute and produce accurate and timely reports. Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable. Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely.

• Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement SOPs.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Who you are :

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English and Japanese (N2 level)

• 3-years experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

jobs.title: Capability Building Coach

titleByLocale.it: Coach per la costruzione di capacità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Role Purpose

• Build and enhance commercialization capabilities, ensuring alignment with Taiwan Pharma Ambition and boosting ecosystem mastery for customer-facing roles.

• Address skill gaps through coaching, insights, and learning programs, driving improved performance and patient value delivery.

• Support affiliate-wide excellence by connecting global best practices and fostering capability-driven strategies across all commercial functions.

Role scope:

• Lead commercialization capability learning programs, ensuring direct alignment with Pharma International’s overall business strategy and connecting with Taiwan Pharma Ambition.

• Translate global standards into local actionable roadmaps that ensure every PJP and partner has a clear path from foundational skills to advanced ecosystem mastery.

• Act as a strategic partner with PJS cluster leads and PJP team leads to identify key skill gaps and provide data-driven insights to improve individual and ecosystem-wide performance.

• Provide field coaching and timely feedback on customer engagement to remove roadblocks and unlock value for patients.

• Responsible for design and implement necessary trainings and connect internal / external resources

• Collaborate with Agile Coach to foster Working by Outcome realization at the affiliate level and facilitate key rituals like Impact Retrospectives to translate learnings and insights into business strategies.

• Partner with the Taiwan leadership team and chapter leaders to focus on capability building, ensuring end-to-end excellence across all commercialization functions.

• Serve as the Primary Subject Matter Expert and central point of contact for functional commercialization capability needs for Taiwan Pharma.

• Connect across APAC, Pharma International, and the extended global network to support ACE realization and share best practices across borders.

Requirements:
Qualifications:
Education:

• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.

Working Experience:

• At least 8+ years work experience in commercial functions in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence

• Solid experience in commercialization roles, such as Marketing, Sales, Medical, or Digital, with the ability to act as a credible coach for senior stakeholders

• Experienced in in-house training design, capability building, L&D, or Organizational Development within a complex, matrixed environment is a plus

Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and program/system design skills

• Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage, inspire and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Innovative mindset with a continuous improvement approach to learning and development practices.

• Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and inspire teams without formal authority.

• Fast-learner, good digital fluency with the ability to leverage AI tools, data analytics, and modern learning platforms to enhance learning experience.

• Fluent in the local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desired

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthc

jobs.title: Head of Planning
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)

Work out Production Plan, Capacity Plan, Resource Plan and Material Requirement Plan to meet sales requirement as well as to control inventory within reasonable level. Continuous enhancement of Integrated Production Plan to consolidate and reconcile all site activities plus downtimes meanwhile to maximize capacity/facility utilization at a consistent level.
制定生产/产能/资源计划和物料需求计划以满足销售需求并将库存控制在合理的水平。持续改善整合生产计划，整合并协调厂区的各种活动以及停产时间，于此同时实现产能/设备利用率的持续性和最大化。

2. Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities

1. Take overall charge of PT Shanghai Budget process, get alignment with cross functional teams to ensure the maximum capacity utilization with reasonable inventory level and acceptable period cost; Act as China SPOC to ensure a timely and accurate budget publication as well as to clarify all the details with Global.

2. Be responsible for site production capacity plan and resource plan, which are the baseline for site budget and Headcount plan; Be responsible for site Master Production Schedule and Daily Production Schedule with all the factors into consideration including sales demand, production capacity, inventory level, etc.

3. Take care of Material Requirement Plan for packaging material and excipient, ensure sufficient material supplies to support consistent production without any shortage.

4. Monitor the procedure of procurement, delivery, production, testing, releasing and deviation etc. Assess business impact for major variance beyond tolerance and lead cross-functional coordination for action plans when necessary to meet sales demand on time.

5. Coordinate with involved stake holders to integrate all necessary site activities and projects so as to maximize capacity/facility utilization as well as to minimize any negative impact to production.

6. Closely cooperate with regional & global demand/supply planners and PSCO to exchange the latest production data and information as well as to obtain necessary support and resource for PT Shanghai.

7. Be responsible for CMO products supply plan including DS/DP replenishment coordination; Be responsible for CMO finish goods, DS inventory level management.

8. Lead production and material planning team, coach and develop subordinates.

3. Qualification and Experience

Education/
• Qualifications
l Degree Holder

Leadership Competencies
l Good management & influencing skill to coach, engage and motivate subordinates to realize their potential so as to meet expectation from both business growth and individual development.

Job Required Competencies
l Above 10 years working experience (more than 8 years in production planning preferred)
l Familiar with SAP system (PP&MM modules, APO)
l With good English (CET6) and skillful operation of computer
l Good interpersonal skill
l Good analytical and expressive skill
l Good at communication, cross-functional cooperation and ability of adaptability

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future,

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the most senior member in the team, set strategy and priorities for the team, allocate resources accordingly, provide coaching and mentorship to the team members and represent the team internally and externally or otherwise delegate as appropriate.
Orchestrate and oversee pre-launch registration strategies and lead the co-creation of launch readiness in collaboration with respective pods
Oversee and manage all Regulatory Affairs work of the Affiliate; oversee external parties, such as distributors, agents, etc. if applicable.
Drive continuous process optimization in the Regulatory Affairs area, with an aim to improve efficiency as well as compliance
Engage Health Authorities, government bodies, as well as pharmaceutical industry associations in shaping regulatory policies and environment towards continuous improvement in addressing unmet medical needs for patients.
All Roche employees are expected to practice high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations as well as participate and be involved in SHE initiatives within the Company.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Regulatory Strategy & Influence: Develop and implement innovative, risk-based regulatory strategies for all affiliate products to accelerate access, and lead/influence the development of global regulatory strategies, considering local regulations and business needs.

• Filings and Submissions: Lead strategic oversight of all regulatory filing activities across product life cycles, ensuring timely regulatory submissions and approvals for new products, line extensions, and maintenance updates, aligned with commercial and supply continuity.

• Stakeholder Relations: Build trusted partnerships by leading contacts and negotiations with local Healthcare Authorities (HAs) and internal stakeholders, influencing for successful regulatory outcomes, and communicating filing statuses.

• Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness: Ensure all Affiliate regulatory activities comply with Roche global standards and local regulations, maintain current knowledge of practices and standards, and ensure the Affiliate is prepared for regulatory inspections and audits.

• Leadership and Team Management: As the senior team member, set the team's strategy and priorities, allocate resources, provide coaching and mentorship, and assist in recruiting and retaining talent.

• Regulatory Intelligence and Policy Shaping: Own the gathering and dissemination of regulatory intelligence for the Affiliate, and actively shape the regulatory environment through leadership roles in industry associations.

• Product and Documentation Support: Oversee end-to-end local product packaging and labeling, act as the Company Pharmacist for specific compliance (e.g., Poison/Psychotropic License), support local market access, and ensure affiliate regulatory documentation is maintained and archived compliantly.

Requirements:

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years in a regulatory affairs role within a pharmaceutical environment.

• Training: Trained in Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements for pharmaceuticals.

• Education and Accreditation: Possesses a Degree in Pharmacy, accredited by the relevant authority with the Ministry of Health, Malaysia, and is eligible to hold necessary pharmaceutical licenses.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Knowledgeable in pharmaceutical regulations and registration requirements in Malaysia.

• Language and Computer Skills: Fluent in w

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 依据抗感染市场策略、行业发展及数据分析，结合内外部资源，筛选区域重点客户并制定全国重点客户发展策略，带领团队与重点客户达成长期战略合作，完成业务目标
− 结合抗感染市场策略、零售药店行业发展趋势，筛选区域重点客户，并完善区域重点客户的合作模式、管理机制、差异化策略；
− 带领区域重点客户团队设计重点客户管理体系与模式，制定重点客户发展策略，与目标区域重点连锁达成战略合作
− 深入洞察客户发展策略及方向，分析与我司的切入点和双方特点，进行框架协议谈判、战略合作评估、销售目标制定、投资计划制定等
− 建立业务为导向的业务跟进及过程管理机制，实施中不断优化，最大化投入产出比，推动业务持续向前发展

2、带领团队制定速福达在区域重点客户的联合发展计划，并设定相应管理机制，确保联合发展计划高质量落实及确保结果导向的过程管理；
− 带领团队与区域重点客户共同制定联合发展计划，设定结果导向的过程管理机制，确保联合发展计划的业务导向，推动业务结果产出；
− 带领团队结合总部推动策略，推动重点区域客户的深度合作，并完成项目高质量落地
− 设定区域重点客户及旗舰门店管理机制，确保重点客户进行关键分子公司和旗舰门店的高效管理

3、与内部相关团队及生态圈内跨团队建立良好的沟通与联动合作机制，最大化公司业务目标
− 积极配合市场部执行公司在零售端的品牌策略，扩大目标产品在患者端知晓度
− 保持与医院销售相关团队的密切合作，探索院内外联动机制，推动业务增长
− 同经销商管理团队及供应链等团队保持沟通，确保药品目标终端快速可及和便利性

4、其他相关工作
− 收集市场多方反馈，协助上级主管进行策略迭代，探索建立和优化以患者为中心的生态圈
− 不断提升自身业务能力，追求高绩效
− 上级指派的其他临时性任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/
• Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
大学本科及以上
医学、药学、市场营销或相关专业优先

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力
政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力
结果导向、具有典型成长思维
客户谈判、沟通与管理能力
协作团队文化建设

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
1）10年以上工作经验，5年以上零售区域管理经验（OTC或处方药）
2）对医药零售行业政策及发展趋势有较为深度的认知和判断
3）热爱销售工作，负有责任心，敢于创新
4）良好的沟通和语言表达能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 依据抗感染市场策略、行业发展及数据分析，结合内外部资源，制定重点客户发展策略，并与重点客户达成长期战略合作，完成业务目标

• 结合抗感染市场策略、零售药店行业发展趋势，设计重点客户管理体系与模式，制定重点客户发展策略，与多家全国性连锁达成战略合作

• 深入洞察客户发展策略及方向，分析与我司的切入点和双方特点，进行框架协议谈判、战略合作评估、销售目标制定、投资计划制定等

• 同客户共建业务跟进管理机制，实施中不断优化，最大化投入产出比，推动业务持续向前发展

2、制定速福达在重点客户的联合发展计划，作为重点客户全国合作的全面对接人，整合内外部资源，将联合发展计划落实

• 与重点客户全国总部共同制定联合发展计划，结合客户特点，设计以推动业务为目的的合作项目

• 结合总部推动和重点分部共同合作的方式，推动项目高质量落地

• 协助重点客户进行关键分子公司和旗舰门店的推广管理

3、与内部相关团队及生态圈内跨团队建立良好的沟通与联动合作机制，最大化公司业务目标

• 积极配合市场部执行公司在零售端的品牌策略，扩大目标产品在C端知晓度

• 保持与医院销售相关团队的密切合作，探索院内外联动机制，推动业务增长

• 同经销商管理团队及供应链等团队保持沟通，确保药品目标终端快速可及和便利性

4、其他相关工作

• 收集市场多方反馈，协助上级主管进行策略迭代，探索建立和优化以患者为中心的生态圈

• 不断提升自身业务能力，追求高绩效

• 上级指派的其他临时性任务

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书
大学本科及以上
医学、药学、市场营销或相关专业优先

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力
政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力
结果导向、具有典型成长思维
客户谈判、沟通与管理能力

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力
1）8年以上工作经验，5年以上零售连锁销售管理经验（OTC或处方药），连锁总部管理经验优先
2）对医药零售行业政策及发展趋势有较为深度的认知和判断
3）热爱销售工作，负有责任心，敢于创新
4）良好的沟通和语言表达能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Mitarbeitende:n für unsere Cafeteria in Kaiseraugst AG.

Aufgaben:

• Korrekte Auskunft über das Angebot sowie aktiver Verkauf und attraktive Warenpräsentation, Vorbereitungsarbeiten in der Cafeteria

• Entgegenkommen bei Sonderwünschen

• Verantwortlich für korrekte und attraktive Ausgabe von Speisen und Getränken am Buffet und einen reibungslosen Ablauf aller Servicestationen (Buffet, Kasse, Ausgabe und Office)

• Bedienung an der Kasse inkl. korrekte Erfassung des Angebots sowie Abrechnung

• Mitverantwortlich für die täglichen Bestellungen

• Einhaltung der Vorschriften zu Lebensmittelhygiene und Qualitätsvorschriften, Umsetzen aller TQM-Vorgaben

• Durchführung von Reinigungsarbeiten einschließlich Grundreinigung

• Einsatzbereitschaft von MO-FR zwischen 6.00-19.30 Uhr

• Einsatzbereitschaft in verschiedenen Abteilungen sowie bei Sondereinsätzen ausserhalb der üblichen Arbeitszeiten zu arbeiten

Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Gastronomie und/oder Hotel von Vorteil

• Mehrjährige Arbeitserfahrung in der Gastronomie in einer ähnlichen Position

• Barista-Ausbildung und entsprechende Erfahrung von Vorteil

• Sicheres, kundenorientiertes Auftreten und sehr gute Umgangsformen

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Selbstständige, flexible und organisierte Arbeitsweise

• Gastgeberpersönlichkeit mit einem freundlichen Auftreten

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana In oltre 30 anni, Taverne Roche ha sviluppato un'azienda gastronomica di successo. Tavero AG è una controllata al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nei siti di Basilea e Kaiseraugst utilizziamo circa 350 dipendenti provenienti da oltre 41 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia i ristoranti del personale che offrono una varietà di piaceri, così come i ristoranti di Fine Dining con cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Inoltre, ci sono ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varianti, incantati dai nostri baristi, così come i saloni più alti in Svizzera – posti di lavoro fantastici sui tetti della città. Grab'n'Go offre da sushi a Burger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Inoltre, offriamo ai nostri ospiti sala riunioni e catering per eventi fino a 1.500 persone. La gastronomia pubblica, lo Schöpfli nel parco e il Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely completano la nostra offerta. Stiamo cercando un dipendente:n:n per la nostra caffetteria in Kaiseraugst AG. Compiti:
• Informazioni corrette sull'offerta, vendite attive e presentazione di beni interessanti, lavoro preparatorio in caffetteria
• Contrariamente a richieste speciali
• Responsabile per la corretta e attraente emissione di cibo e bevande al buffet e per una gestione fluida di tutte le stazioni di servizio (buffet, cassa, emissione e ufficio)
• Servizio presso la cassa incl. corretta raccolta dell'offerta e fatturazione
• Responsabile degli ordini quotidiani
• conformità alle normative in materia di igiene alimentare e di qualità, implementazione di tutti i requisiti TQM
• realizzazione di lavori di pulizia, compresa la pulizia di base
• MO-FR pronto all'uso tra 6.00-19.30
• La volontà di lavorare in vari dipartimenti e in operazioni speciali al di fuori delle normali ore di lavoro Profilo:
• Allenamento completo in gastronomia e/o hotel di vantaggio
• Esperienza pluriennale nella gastronomia in una posizione simile
• Formazione Barista e corrispondente esperienza di vantaggio
• aspetto sicuro, orientato al cliente e forme di gestione molto buone
• Le abilità di squadra e l'affidabilità sono autoevidenti
• Lavoro autonomo, flessibile e organizzato
• Personalità ospitante con un aspetto amichevole
• Hai una buona conoscenza di tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura per essere in grado di consigliare i tuoi clienti in modo competente
• In un mondo digitale, vogliamo anche garantire una gestione sicura dei programmi informatici (MS Office) Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

titleByLocale.fr: Expert en conception de système Android (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Roche utilizes a unified Design System to streamline the user interfaces of its digital products and deliver a consistent, harmonized user experience for our customers. The One Design System encompasses all web and mobile applications developed at Roche Diagnostics.

Our Engineering Team is looking for an Android Expert able to lead the development of Android Mobile components ensuring the correct design and implementation of cutting-edge user interfaces for Android mobile applications. You are able to translate UX and clients requirements into technical solutions and vice versa, and you will lead the development of such components.

You will be located either in of Vienna, or in Sant Cugat (near Barcelona).

Your upcoming mission:

Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:

• Architect, develop, maintain the Design System components & interaction patterns for mobile, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

• Write and review clean, testable, scalable code aligned with best practices and design patterns.

• Maintain code quality through automated testing, code review, and continuous integration pipelines.

• Provide Technical assessment of development of the design components in mobile, ensuring the approach is of quality, it is customer centric, future thinking and easy to use.

• Participate actively in the creation of the architecture for Mobile Applications, consistent with platform strategies, governance policy, and standards.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Collaborate with Design & Development teams to align on goals, scope and business outcomes.

• Ensure Documentation on Mobile Components and support the mobile development community in adoption, implementation, testing and maintenance.

• Work with Roche clients (project leaders, architects, designers, front-end developers) to establish collaboration, understanding their needs and solve their doubts.

• Champion the adoption of the Design System together with the client and the Usability Engineers across Roche.

Creative / Strategic activities:

• Brainstorm improvements and propose innovative solutions to improve community engagement.

• Evaluate new technologies, patterns, and frameworks for potential adoption.

• Contribute to design review, prototypes, and mobile user experience standards.

AI powered design system:

• Create documentation for AI agents to ensure the users of the design system can vibe code with the library

• Create test applications using vibe coding to ensure the compatibility of the library with AI

• Document all the components in Fiigma code connect

Essential skills for your mission:

• Android Developer for at least 5 years

• Expert in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Git

• Experience with Material Design 3 for Jetpack Compose and Design Systems in general

• Strong experience to build reusable, testable, composable UI components

• Proficiency to write unit tests, screenshot tests, Compose UI tests

• Deep knowledge of implementing accessibility best practices (A11y) in Jetpack Compose

• RTL Knowledge

Bonus skills:

• Vivid interest in modern technology trends and best practices

• Curiosity in domains outside of Android: iOS development, Cross-platform solutions knowledge.

• Innersourced products experience

• Engagement in dev communities, community management, active contribution to open s

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme! Combinando i nostri punti di forza unici, ridefiniamo la salute attraverso l'azione sostenibile e l'innovazione. Per uno sguardo dietro le quinte, controllare questo video per vedere come siamo a Roche stanno rendendo l'assistenza sanitaria personalizzata una realtà. La mySugr GmbH è stata acquisita da Roche nel 2017 e il nostro ufficio di Vienna è uno dei siti globali di Roche. Ti troverai qui, nel cuore di Vienna, non importa se lavori su mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® o qualsiasi altro prodotto o soluzione Roche. Potete leggere di più sulla storia di mySugr & Roche qui . Ecco cosa stiamo cercando: Roche utilizza un sistema di progettazione unificato per semplificare le interfacce utente dei suoi prodotti digitali e fornire un'esperienza utente coerente e armonizzata per i nostri clienti. Il sistema One Design comprende tutte le applicazioni web e mobile sviluppate presso la Roche Diagnostics. Il nostro team di ingegneria sta cercando un esperto Android in grado di condurre lo sviluppo di componenti Android Mobile garantendo la corretta progettazione e implementazione di interfacce utente all'avanguardia per applicazioni mobili Android. Siete in grado di tradurre i requisiti UX e dei clienti in soluzioni tecniche e viceversa, e guiderete lo sviluppo di tali componenti. Vi troverete sia a Vienna, sia a Sant Cugat (vicino a Barcellona). La vostra prossima missione: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:
• Architetto, sviluppare, mantenere i componenti e i modelli di interazione di Design System per il mobile, coerente con le strategie di piattaforma, la politica di governance e gli standard.
• Scrivere e rivedere codice pulito, testabile e scalabile allineato con le migliori pratiche e modelli di progettazione.
• Mantenere la qualità del codice attraverso test automatizzati, revisione del codice e pipeline di integrazione continua.
• Fornire la valutazione tecnica dello sviluppo dei componenti di progettazione in mobile, assicurando che l'approccio è di qualità, è centrico cliente, pensiero futuro e facile da usare.
• Partecipa attivamente alla creazione dell'architettura per applicazioni mobili, coerente con le strategie di piattaforma, la politica di governance e gli standard. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaborazione:
• Collaborare con i team di progettazione e sviluppo per allineare obiettivi, obiettivi e risultati aziendali.
• Assicurare la documentazione sui componenti mobili e sostenere la comunità di sviluppo mobile in adozione, implementazione, test e manutenzione.
• Lavorare con i clienti Roche (progetti, architetti, progettisti, sviluppatori di front-end) per stabilire la collaborazione, comprendere le loro esigenze e risolvere i loro dubbi.
• Campione dell'adozione del sistema di progettazione insieme al cliente e agli ingegneri di usabilità attraverso Roche. Attività creative / strategiche:
• Miglioramenti del Brainstorm e proporre soluzioni innovative per migliorare il coinvolgimento della comunità.
• Valutare le nuove tecnologie, i modelli e i quadri per una potenziale adozione.
• Contribuire alla revisione di progettazione, ai prototipi e agli standard di esperienza dell'utente mobile. Sistema di progettazione alimentato AI:
• Creare documentazione per gli agenti AI per garantire che gli utenti del sistema di progettazione possano intuire il codice con la libreria
• Creare applicazioni di test utilizzando la codifica delle vibrazioni per garantire la compatibilità della libreria con AI
• Documentare tutti i componenti del codice Fiigma connettersi Competenze essenziali per la vostra missione:
• Sviluppatore Android per almeno 5 anni
• Esperto in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose e Git
• Esperienza con Material Design 3 per Jetpack Compose e Design Systems in generale
• Forte esperienza nella costruzione di componenti UI riutilizzabili, testabili e componibili
• Proficienza di scrivere test di unità, test di screenshot, Compose UI test
• Conoscenza profonda dell'attuazione delle migliori pratiche di accessibilità (A11y) in Jetpack Compose
• RTL conoscenza Competenze bonus:
• Vivid interesse per le moderne tendenze tecnologiche e le migliori pratiche
• Curiosità nei domini al di fuori di Android: sviluppo iOS, conoscenza delle soluzioni Cross-platform.
• Esperienza di prodotti in risorse interne
• Engagement in comunità di sviluppo, gestione della comunità, contributo attivo all'apertura

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bauen wir gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft! Durch die Kombination unserer einzigartigen Stärken definieren wir die Gesundheitsversorgung durch nachhaltiges Handeln und Innovationen. Sehen Sie sich dieses Video an, um zu sehen, wie wir bei Roche eine personalisierte Gesundheitsversorgung zur Realität machen. Die mySugr GmbH wurde 2017 von Roche übernommen und unser Büro in Wien gehört zu den weltweiten Standorten von Roche. Sie befinden sich hier im Herzen von Wien, egal ob Sie an einem mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® oder einer anderen Roche-Produkt oder Lösung arbeiten. Lesen Sie hier mehr über die Geschichte von mySugr & Roche . Hier ist, was wir suchen: Roche nutzt ein einheitliches Design-System, um die Benutzeroberflächen seiner digitalen Produkte zu optimieren und für unsere Kunden ein einheitliches, harmonisiertes Nutzererlebnis zu bieten. Das One Design System umfasst alle Web- und mobilen Anwendungen, die bei Roche Diagnostics entwickelt wurden. Unser Engineering-Team ist auf der Suche nach einem Android-Experten in der Lage, die Entwicklung von Android-Mobile-Komponenten zu führen, um die korrekte Gestaltung und Implementierung von hochmodernen Benutzeroberflächen für Android-Mobilanwendungen zu gewährleisten. Sie sind in der Lage, UX- und Kundenanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und umgekehrt, und Sie werden die Entwicklung solcher Komponenten führen. Sie befinden sich entweder in Wien oder in Sant Cugat (bei Barcelona). Ihre kommende Mission: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Ausführung:
• Architekt, entwickeln, pflegen die Design-System-Komponenten und Interaktionsmuster für mobile, im Einklang mit Plattformstrategien, Governance-Politik und Standards.
• Schreiben Sie und überprüfen Sie saubere, testbare, skalierbare Code mit besten Praktiken und Design-Muster.
• Erhalten Sie die Codequalität durch automatisierte Tests, Code-Reviews und kontinuierliche Integrationspipelines.
• Technische Bewertung der Entwicklung der Konstruktionskomponenten im mobilen Bereich, um sicherzustellen, dass der Ansatz von Qualität ist, ist es kundenzentriert, zukünftiges Denken und einfach zu bedienen.
• Nehmen Sie aktiv an der Schaffung der Architektur für mobile Anwendungen teil, die mit Plattformstrategien, Governance-Politik und Standards vereinbar ist. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
• Zusammenarbeit mit Design & Entwicklung Teams, um Ziele, Umfang und Geschäftsergebnisse auszurichten.
• Stellen Sie die Dokumentation zu mobilen Komponenten sicher und unterstützen Sie die mobile Entwicklungsgemeinschaft bei Adoption, Umsetzung, Tests und Wartung.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Roche-Kunden (Projektleiter, Architekten, Designer, Front-End-Entwickler) zusammen, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und ihre Zweifel zu lösen.
• Champion die Einführung des Design Systems zusammen mit dem Kunden und den Usability Engineers über Roche. Kreative / strategische Aktivitäten:
• Verbesserungen der Brainstorm und innovative Lösungen zur Verbesserung des Community Engagements.
• Neue Technologien, Muster und Rahmen für eine mögliche Adoption bewerten.
• Tragen Sie auf Design-Review, Prototypen und mobile Benutzererfahrungsstandards bei. KI powered design system:
• Erstellung von Dokumentationen für AI-Agenten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Benutzer des Design-Systems mit der Bibliothek
• Erstellen Sie Testanwendungen mit Vibe-Codierung, um die Kompatibilität der Bibliothek mit AI zu gewährleisten
• Dokumentieren Sie alle Komponenten in Fiigma-Code-Verbindung Wesentliche Fähigkeiten für Ihre Mission:
• Android Developer für mindestens 5 Jahre
• Experte in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose und Git
• Erfahrung mit Material Design 3 für Jetpack Compose und Design Systems im Allgemeinen
• Starke Erfahrung zum Aufbau von wiederverwendbaren, testbaren, kompilierbaren UI-Komponenten
• Proficiency zu schreiben Einheitstests, Screenshot-Tests, Compose UI Tests
• Tiefe Kenntnisse über die Umsetzung der besten Praktiken der Zugänglichkeit (A11y) in Jetpack Compose
• RTL Wissen Bonusfähigkeiten:
• Vivid Interesse an modernen Technologietrends und Best Practices
• Curiosität in Domains außerhalb von Android: iOS-Entwicklung, Cross-Plattform-Lösungen Wissen.
• Innersourcen-Produkte Erfahrung
• Engagement in dev-Communities, Community-Management, aktiver Beitrag zur Öffnung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Laissez-les construire un avenir plus sain, ensemble! En combinant nos forces uniques, nous redéfinissons les soins de santé par une action durable et l'innovation. Pour un regard en coulisses, regardez cette vidéo pour voir comment nous, à Roche, faisons des soins de santé personnalisés une réalité. La mySugr GmbH a été acquise par Roche en 2017 et notre bureau de Vienne est l'un des sites mondiaux de Roche. Vous serez situé ici, au cœur de Vienne, peu importe si vous travaillez sur un mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® ou tout autre produit ou solution Roche. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur l'histoire de mySugr & Roche ici. Voici ce que nous recherchons : Roche utilise un système de conception unifié pour rationaliser les interfaces utilisateur de ses produits numériques et offrir une expérience utilisateur cohérente et harmonisée à nos clients. Le système One Design englobe toutes les applications web et mobiles développées chez Roche Diagnostics. Notre équipe d'ingénierie est à la recherche d'un expert Android capable de diriger le développement de composants mobiles Android assurant la conception et la mise en œuvre correctes d'interfaces utilisateur de pointe pour les applications mobiles Android. Vous êtes en mesure de traduire les exigences de UX et de clients en solutions techniques et vice versa, et vous dirigerez le développement de ces composants. Vous serez situé soit à Vienne, soit à Sant Cugat (près de Barcelone). Votre prochaine mission: Hands-On Engineering & Tech Execution:
• Architecte, développe, maintient les composants du système de conception et les modèles d'interaction pour mobile, en conformité avec les stratégies de plate-forme, la politique de gouvernance, et les normes.
• Écrire et commenter un code propre, testable, évolutif aligné sur les meilleures pratiques et les modèles de conception.
• Maintenir la qualité du code au moyen d'essais automatisés, d'examens de code et de pipelines d'intégration continue.
• Fournir une évaluation technique du développement des composants de conception dans le mobile, en veillant à ce que l'approche soit de qualité, qu'elle soit centrée sur le client, la pensée future et facile à utiliser.
• Participer activement à la création de l'architecture pour les applications mobiles, conformément aux stratégies des plateformes, aux politiques de gouvernance et aux normes. Collaboration des intervenants et interfonctions :
• Collaborer avec les équipes de conception et de développement pour s'aligner sur les objectifs, la portée et les résultats opérationnels.
• Assurer la documentation sur les composants mobiles et aider la communauté du développement mobile à adopter, mettre en œuvre, tester et entretenir.
• Travailler avec les clients Roche (chefs de projet, architectes, concepteurs, développeurs de front) pour établir la collaboration, comprendre leurs besoins et résoudre leurs doutes.
• Championne de l'adoption du système de conception avec le client et les ingénieurs d'utilisation de Roche. Activités créatives/stratégiques:
• Améliorations de brainstorm et propositions de solutions innovantes pour améliorer l'engagement communautaire.
• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies, modèles et cadres en vue de leur adoption éventuelle.
• Contribuer à l'examen de la conception, des prototypes et des normes d'expérience des utilisateurs mobiles. Système de conception alimenté par l'IA :
• Créer une documentation pour les agents de l'IA pour s'assurer que les utilisateurs du système de conception peuvent vibrer le code avec la bibliothèque
• Créer des applications de test en utilisant le codage par vibration pour assurer la compatibilité de la bibliothèque avec l'IA
• Documenter tous les composants du code Fiigma connecter Compétences essentielles pour votre mission :
• Développeur Android depuis au moins 5 ans
• Expert en Kotlin, Jetpack Compose et Git
• Expérience avec la conception de matériaux 3 pour Jetpack Compose et les systèmes de conception en général
• Forte expérience pour construire des composants d'interface réutilisables, testables et composables
• Compétence pour écrire des tests unitaires, des tests de capture d'écran, des tests d'interface Compose
• Connaissance approfondie de la mise en oeuvre des meilleures pratiques d'accessibilité (A11y) dans Jetpack Compose
• Compétences en bonus de connaissances RTL :
• Intérêt vif pour les tendances et les meilleures pratiques technologiques modernes
• Curiosité dans les domaines en dehors d'Android : développement iOS, connaissances sur les solutions multiplates.
• L'expérience des produits de sources internes
• L'engagement dans les communautés de développement, la gestion communautaire, la contribution active à l'ouverture

titleByLocale.en: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 浙江区域
titleByLocale.de: 区域经理 - 市场准 boiling- 浙江区域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责 / 责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1、 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。
Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.
2、 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。
Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.
3、 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。
Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.
4、 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。
Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.
5、 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。
Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
本科及以上；医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少2年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 2 years of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少2年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通PPT制作及数据分析技能。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

titleByLocale.en: Customer Support Center - Medical Laboratory Diagnostics (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung
Wir freuen uns auf Unterstützung und Deine Ideen im Teams des Regional Customer Support Centers in Mannheim. Wir sind verantwortlich für den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice: vom technischen Produktmanagement über Trainings zur Bedienung von Analysegeräten bis zur telefonischen Hotline. Während Deines Praktikums arbeitest Du zusammen mit unseren Spezialisten im Bereich der Laborsysteme zur medizinischen Diagnostik. Hier sammelst Du Erfahrungen direkt an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik, IT, Naturwissenschaft und Medizin und lernst unsere teils internationalen Kunden aus Labor und Krankenhaus in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Belgien, der Niederlande, Griechenland und der Türkei kennen.

Deine Aufgaben
• Du unterstützt und koordinierst applikative und technische Serviceprojekte

• Du hilfst bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Wissensmanagement-Tools

• Du unterstützt bei der Trainings- und Hotlineplanung sowie der Reklamationsbearbeitung

• Du arbeitest aktiv an der Optimierung und Bearbeitung von Prozessbeschreibungen mit

• Du erstellst Analysen und Reports für Controlling-Zwecke

Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem Masterstudium der Fachrichtung Biologie, Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Chemie, Medizin oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung eingeschrieben

• Du hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrungen in Projektmanagement gesammelt

• Du hast Routine im Umgang mit dem MS / Google-Office-Paket, insbesondere Excel und Powerpoint beherrschst du sehr gut

• Du überzeugst mit einer analytischen Herangehensweise, hinterfragst konventionelle Denkmuster und verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Eigenständigkeit und Koordinationsfähigkeit

• Arbeiten im Team ist für dich selbstverständlich, speziell auch im internationalen Kontext

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268€ Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf und Anschreiben online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year.

Zeitraum: ab Juli 2026 für 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Core Lab & POC
Location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key Responsibilities
Sales and Market Strategy

• Responsible for planning and executing business plans to achieve sales targets for the Mass Spec product line.

• Formulate and execute customized sales strategies for key customers.

• Coordinate sales activities in conjunction with clinical chemistry/immunoassay equipment and pioneer new markets for TDM, Vitamin D, and High Medical Value Assays.

• Deliver differentiated value by achieving customer retention, expansion, and new acquisition through opportunity identification, solution proposal, and execution.

Customer Management

• Build relationships and establish long-term business connections with key decision-makers and KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).

• Maximize the value of integrated solutions and customer satisfaction through KAM (Key Account Management).

• Utilize specialized knowledge to resolve technical inquiries and provide professional customer support.

• Provide necessary support and solutions to customers in a timely manner by collaborating with various organizations such as Marketing, Application Specialist, Service Engineer, and Medical Affairs.

Collaboration and Accountability

• Drive business success through close cooperation with relevant departments (Marketing, Finance, Service, etc.).

• Enhance overall diagnostic business performance through collaboration with other business units, including the Digital Business Unit, Molecular Diagnostics Business Unit, and Automation-related departments.

• Responsible for sales forecasting, contract management, and sales reporting.

Competency Development

• Practice continuous learning and internal sharing of Mass Spec technology, market trends, and competitor information.

• Strengthen expertise in automation systems, LC-MS/MS analysis principles, and Total laboratory automation integration technology.

• Continuously develop sales competencies (negotiation, strategic thinking, communication).

Who You Are

Education and Experience

• Major in a related field such as Life Science, Chemistry, Biochemistry, or Clinical Chemistry

• 5+ years of experience in the diagnostics, biotech, life science instruments, or analytical equipment sectors

Required and Preferred Experience

• Sales experience with LC-MS/MS or Mass Spec equipment portfolio

• Experience with LC-MS/MS reagent application (overall operation)

• Experience and understanding of clinical application of High Medical Value Assays, Vitamin D, Immunosuppressants, etc

• Understanding of the central laboratory operating environment, including Clinical Laboratory Automation Workflow, Laboratory Information System/Total laboratory automation, Clinical Chemistry/Immunoassay, or CBC

• Essential in English for technical communication and information sharing with Global/APAC teams

• Native-level proficiency in Korean is required

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives
