jobs.title: Head of Medical Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

 Drive strategic and organizational alignment
- Drive alignment and coordination of goals, priorities, and efforts for the Medical Affairs Department.
- Establish and maintain a structure for co-creation and co-execution of WBO.
- Develop and support the Medical Affairs team around future-looking vision, mission and strategic initiatives.
- Lead cross-therapeutic areas and functions strategic programs to support Medical Affairs priorities.
 Lead operational efforts to execute medical excellence
- Lead in working across boundaries within the broader organization and cross-functional team to establish excellent ways of working/ process workflows.
- Enable the implementation of strategic priorities with a closed-loop management approach.
- Lead in developing integrated medical plan across Medical Affairs department to prioritize tasks to ensure strategic focus and timely execution of deliverables.
- Enable the operational effectiveness of Medical Affairs to manage complexity and oversee the performance; Responsibility for development & delivery of medical dashboard and associated metrics with cross-functional teams by timely collection, reporting and aligned interpretation of performance metrics and key activities across Medical Affairs department.
- Organize regular meetings and activities, ensuring seamless coordination across value chains.
- Gather and prepare internal and external information for the Medical Affairs Head to facilitate key business decisions and generate important speeches/slides.
 Drive for people excellence
- Drive development of Medical Affairs competencies; Oversight of Medical Affairs professional development and training both in terms of technical as well as soft skills.
People development and management to building up the capacity and capability of medical excellence team by providing coaching and feedback to team members.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications
- Master’s degree and above with Medical, R&D, Marketing, Access or Corporate strategy experience in Pharmaceutical or related industry. MBA or top consulting firm background is a plus.
- Have experience in people leadership.

Leadership Competencies
- A VACC (visionary, architect, coach, catalyst) leader
- Ability to influence and manage in a matrix organization
- Ability to build an effective team and handle difficult people issues
- Excellent influential, communication and negotiation skills
- Strong cross-functional collaboration capability. Self-motivated

Job Required Competencies
- Strategic agility with innovative approaches
- Deep understanding of medical affairs value to the whole business, customer and patients
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Mandarin and English
- Confident in communication with management team, ability to partner and connect with people from all levels of the medical organization.
- Good strategic agility and analytic capability.
- Have the ability to see the big picture as well as the sensitivity to critical details.
- Track record in project management and problem-solving skills to handle complexity.
- High learning agility and open-minded and able to work under pressure.

Travel Frequency出差频率
<25%

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Always innovating, we bring together dedicated people and diverse perspectives from across our global network, empowering each other to keep breaking new ground.
We are People Insights & Technology (PI&T), part of the People & Culture (P&C) organization. Our vision is to unleash exponential people & business impact through data driven decisions, surfacing actionable insights and embracing people-centric technology.
As part of the People Insights Area of Practice (AoP), we work as one team to unlock the full potential of our people data and technology, informing Roche decisions through research-based insights.

The Opportunity:

Senior Data Engineer to work on an Agile team with other data and software engineers to develop and maintain robust data pipelines and data management systems. Partners closely with data science and business intelligence teams to understand business needs and co-create solutions in service of downstream products. Brings strong attention to detail and a passion for delivering highly accurate and available data to enable downstream insights and drive business value.

• Delivers enhancements to existing data pipelines and develops new pipelines based on defined requirements with minimal guidance

• Demonstrates strong understanding of data engineering tools and concepts and considered a SME for most, if not all pipelines

• Detail-oriented mindset and co-creates pipelines with secure, well-validated data across multiple system domains with other squad members in a way that aligns with long-term strategy for People Insights

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications in technical or leadership competencies can be advantageous

• Python experience (Pandas preferred)

• CI/CD tools and methodologies (GitLab, branches, code reviews, merge requests, etc)

• Understanding of DataOps Practices

• RDBMS/NoSQL

• Docker experience

• AWS experience preferred (EC2 / Lambda / Glue / S3)

• Snowflake or similar cloud data platform experience preferred

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.
We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role.

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Business Partnering DIA China

titleByLocale.en: Head of Business Partnering DIA China

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic leader who can bridge the gap between business vision and technology innovation?

We are seeking a visionary Head of Business Partnering, DIA China, to be more than just a liaison—to be a catalyst for our Digital, Innovation, and Analytics (DIA) transformation in China. This is not a traditional IT management role; it is a strategic leadership position designed for a forward-thinker who can shape the future of our healthcare ecosystem in one of the world's most dynamic markets.
In this pivotal role, you will act as the primary strategic conduit between our China business functions (commercial, affiliate, site operations) and the global RDT (Research & Development Technology) organization. You will ensure that our technology investments are not just aligned with, but are actively driving, our business outcomes. As a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will own the technology strategy, orchestrate cross-functional delivery, and cultivate a culture of high performance and relentless innovation.

Why Join Us?

This is your opportunity to make a tangible impact on the Chinese market. You will:

• Shape the Future: Define and execute the technology roadmap that directly enables the commercial success of our RD China market.

• Drive Patient & Customer Impact: Translate unique local customer and patient experience needs into omnichannel strategies that drive satisfaction and loyalty.

• Navigate a Complex Landscape: Ensure our products and strategies are perfectly aligned with China's specific data privacy and security requirements, turning compliance into a competitive advantage.

• Lead with Influence: Partner with senior stakeholders to co-create innovative capabilities that redefine our healthcare ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

1. Be a Strategic Partner & Trusted Advisor

• Forge deep, trusted relationships with business leaders to deeply understand their goals and co-create aligned RDT strategies.

• Partner closely with senior stakeholders to define the strategic direction, shaping the digital roadmap and portfolio for China.

• Champion the business's needs within the global RDT organization, while effectively translating complex IT capabilities into clear business value for local stakeholders.

• Bring thought leadership to the table, proactively identifying and shaping innovative solutions that drive significant impact.

2. Own Delivery & Drive Value

• Take end-to-end accountability for the technology project portfolio, overseeing planning, prioritization, and execution to ensure all initiatives meet business objectives on time and within budget.

• Rigorously manage project scope, proactively escalate risks, and ensure the highest quality standards are met.

• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to ensure every technology investment delivers tangible business value.

• Champion the adoption of new solutions across the market, ensuring that value is not just created, but realized.

3. Inspire People & Foster a Culture of Excellence

• Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing, multidisciplinary team. Foster an environment where innovation thrives, professional growth is encouraged, and teamwork is paramount.

• Provide clear direction, coaching, and performance management to help each team member reach their full potential.

• Collaborate effectively with both internal and external partners, sharing insights and aligning strategies to maximize the impact of our technology investments.

Who You Are

• A Proven Leader

• Collaborate effectively with both internal and external partners, sharing insights and aligning strategies to maximize the impact of our technology investments. Who You Are
• A Proven Leader

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
Planning and Financial Management:

• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short term and long term

• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.

• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.

• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.

• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.

• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.

• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.

• Ensure brand-in-charge performance

Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.

• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.

• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach

• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P

Tactical Market Plan / Implementation

• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy

• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.

• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.

• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan

• Innovation and MCM apply in activities

Who you are

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines

• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry

Who we are

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

La tua opportunità
Pianificazione e gestione finanziaria:

• Proattivamente acquisisce una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente esterno (sistema sanitario, politiche e riforme) per anticipare le tendenze future e formula una visione strategica del mercato, della concorrenza e dell'erosione dei prodotti a breve termine e a lungo termine

• Localizzare e definire la strategia di gestione del ciclo di vita per i prodotti responsabili.

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei principali stakeholder, tra cui account chiave, payers, gruppi di advocacy pazienti, associazioni professionali e responsabili politici, e sviluppare piani di sviluppo per i migliori leader di opinione clinica per l'area della terapia.

• Costruire piani di marketing analizzando i mercati pertinenti e definendo obiettivi qualitativi e quantitativi a lungo e a breve termine.

• Dove rilevante, implementare il framework di eccellenza di lancio per costruire i principali piani di lancio.

• Traduci il brand plan in un forte piano operativo attuabile con obiettivi chiari, azioni, responsabilità e misure attraverso il team interfunzionale.

• Imposta obiettivi responsabili e impegnativi con i KPI appropriati per il marchio che hanno un chiaro impatto positivo sulle prestazioni aziendali.

• Assicurare prestazioni di marca in carica

Gestione delle risorse / Eccellenza di marketing

• Garantire la buona attuazione dei piani tattici collaborando con il team interfunzionale (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Assicurare la fornitura e la scorta sana.

• Ottimizzare le strategie di segmentazione e di targeting per i prodotti in gestione.

• Costruire il pacchetto di comunicazione del marchio per le attività per assicurarsi qualità e impegno del marchio & raggiungere

• Key in carica per i Brand KPI (Lead, Lag), le prestazioni di vendita e A&P

Piano di mercato tattico / Attuazione

• Raggiungere gli obiettivi di marketing concordati con la gestione, la gestione dello sviluppo e l'attuazione di piani di marketing coerenti con la strategia di approvazione

• Garantire il raggiungimento del bilancio dei prodotti nel BP approvato e nel piano di marketing integrato.

• Contabile per garantire le regole di conformità e il codice etico quando si lavora con i professionisti del settore sanitario per rafforzare l’immagine dell’azienda.

• Assicurarsi che tutto il supporto per il team di vendita/MA sia conforme agli atti pertinenti, alla domanda legale e agli standard etici e in linea con il piano di marketing

• Innovazione e MCM si applicano nelle attività

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea o master in Scienze della salute / Scienza/Pharmaceutica o discipline mediche

• Esperienze multinazionali nell'industria sanitaria

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico / diagnostico

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.

Ihre Chance
Planung und Finanzmanagement:

• Erwirbt proaktiv ein tiefes Verständnis des externen Umfelds (Gesundheitssystem, Politik und Reformen), um zukünftige Trends zu antizipieren, und formuliert eine strategische Sichtweise der kurz- und langfristigen Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Produkterosion

• Lokalisieren und definieren Sie die Life-Cycle-Management-Strategie für die verantwortlichen Produkte.

• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Stakeholder, einschließlich Key Accounts, Kostenträger, Patientenvertretungsgruppen, Berufsverbände und politische Entscheidungsträger, und entwickeln Sie Entwicklungspläne für die wichtigsten klinischen Meinungsführer für den Therapiebereich.

• Erstellen Sie Marketingpläne, die die relevanten Märkte analysieren und langfristige und kurzfristige qualitative und quantitative Ziele definieren.

• Gegebenenfalls Umsetzung des Exzellenzrahmens für den Start, um führende Startpläne zu erstellen.

• Übersetzt den Markenplan in einen umsetzbaren Betriebsplan mit klaren Zielen, Maßnahmen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Maßnahmen im gesamten funktionsübergreifenden Team.

• Setzt verantwortungsvolle und anspruchsvolle Ziele mit geeigneten KPIs für die Marke, die sich eindeutig positiv auf die Geschäftsentwicklung auswirken.

• Gewährleistung der Brand-in-Charge-Leistung

Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Sicherstellung der guten Umsetzung taktischer Pläne durch die Zusammenarbeit mit dem funktionsübergreifenden Team (Sales Force / Market Access / Medical Affairs / SFE)

• Versorgungssicherheit und gesunde Bestände.

• Optimierung von Segmentierungs- und Targetingstrategien für die verwalteten Produkte.

• Erstellen Sie ein Markenkommunikationspaket für Aktivitäten, um Qualität und Markenbindung und -reichweite sicherzustellen

• Verantwortlich für die Marken-KPIs (Lead, Lag), die Verkaufsleistung und A&P

Taktischer Marktplan / Umsetzung

• Erreichung der mit dem Management vereinbarten Marketingziele, Verwaltung der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingplänen im Einklang mit der Genehmigungsstrategie

• Sicherstellung der Erreichung des Produktbudgets im genehmigten BP und integrierten Marketingplan.

• Verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Compliance-Regeln und des Ethikkodex bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsexperten, um das Image des Unternehmens zu stärken.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Unterstützung für das Verkaufsteam / MA-Team den einschlägigen Gesetzen, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und ethischen Standards sowie dem Marketingplan entspricht

• Innovation und MCM gelten in Aktivitäten

Wer du bist

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Gesundheits-/Wissenschafts-/Pharma- oder Medizindisziplinen

• Erfahrungen multinationaler Unternehmen in der Gesundheitsbranche

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharma- / Diagnoseindustrie

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

Votre opportunité
Planification et gestion financière :

• Acquérir une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement extérieur (système de soins de santé, politiques et réformes) pour anticiper les tendances futures et formuler une vision stratégique de l'érosion du marché, de la concurrence et des produits à court et à long terme

• Localiser et définir la stratégie de gestion du cycle de vie des produits en charge.

• Développer une compréhension approfondie des principaux intervenants, y compris les comptes clés, les payeurs, les groupes de défense des patients, les associations professionnelles et les décideurs, et élaborer des plans de développement pour les principaux leaders d'opinion clinique dans le domaine de la thérapie.

• Élaborer des plans de marketing analysant les marchés pertinents et définissant des objectifs qualitatifs et quantitatifs à long et à court terme.

• Le cas échéant, mettre en œuvre le cadre d'excellence du lancement pour élaborer des plans de lancement de premier plan.

• Traduit le plan d'image de marque en un solide plan opérationnel réalisable avec des objectifs clairs, des actions, des responsabilités et des mesures à l'échelle de l'équipe interfonctionnelle.

• Définit des objectifs responsables et stimulants avec des KPI appropriés pour la marque qui ont un impact positif évident sur la performance des entreprises.

• Assurer la performance de la marque en charge

Gestion des ressources / Excellence en marketing

• Assurer la bonne mise en œuvre des plans tactiques en collaborant avec l'équipe interfonctionnelle (Force de vente/Accès au marché/Affaires médicales/SFE)

• Assurer l'approvisionnement et la santé des stocks.

• Optimiser la segmentation et les stratégies de ciblage des produits sous gestion.

• Construire un paquet de communication de marque implémenter pour les activités pour assurer la qualité et l'engagement de la marque et atteindre

• Clé en charge des KPI de marque (Lead, Lag), performance des ventes, et A&P

Plan tactique du marché / Mise en oeuvre

• Réalisation des objectifs de marketing convenus avec la direction, gestion de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de plans de marketing conformes à la stratégie d'approbation

• Assurer la réalisation du budget des produits dans le PB approuvé et le plan de commercialisation intégré.

• Responsabilité pour assurer la conformité aux règles & code éthique lors de la collaboration avec les professionnels de la santé pour renforcer l'image de l'entreprise.

• Veiller à ce que tout le soutien apporté à l'équipe de vente/l'équipe de l'AMA soit conforme aux lois pertinentes, aux exigences légales et aux normes éthiques et conforme au plan de marketing

• Innovation et MCM s'appliquent aux activités

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la santé/pharmaceutique ou en médecine

• Expériences des entreprises multinationales dans le secteur de la santé

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en Pharma / Diagnostic

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Global Business Process Specialist - Manufacturing Finance & Intercompany (Fixed-term)

titleByLocale.it: Global Business Process Specialista - Manufacturing Finanza & Intercompany (Fixed-term)
titleByLocale.en: Global Business Process Specialist - Manufacturing Finance & Intercompany (Fixed-term)
titleByLocale.de: Global Business Process Spezialist - Manufacturing Finanzen & Intercompany (Fixed-term)
titleByLocale.fr: Global Business Process Spécialiste - Manufacturing Finance & Intercompany (Fixed-term)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Acts as a link between global and local Finance, Supply Chain and Manufacturing, IT and Business Process Management and the project Aspire work streams to reach alignment within and across the divisions with specific focus on Roche Diagnostics.
Translates detailed business requirements to IT organization and manages changes to such specifications. Defines and implements global template solutions including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training for the area of Supply Chain Finance.

Disclosure note: The opportunity is available on a fixed-term basis until the end of 2027.

The Opportunity

• Lead Process Design and Strategy: Actively pursue and drive the implementation of the End-to-End Business Process Management (E2E BPM) strategy, defining global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process designs.

• Empowered Decision-Making: Serve as an empowered decision-maker for your process area across divisions, operating within the E2E Business Process Management guardrails.

• Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management: Act as a critical link and strive for cross-functional and divisional alignment across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, IT, and Business Process Management to achieve E2E Process Harmonization.

• Lean and Standardized Solutions: Design and implement lean cross-divisional processes and solutions, maximizing standardization and harmonization while collaborating closely with the E2E Global Business Process Managers (GBPMs).

• Template Support and Safeguarding: Support and safeguard the Global ASPIRE Template and deployment activities, ensuring business acceptance globally.

• Solution Documentation & Implementation: Define and implement global template solutions, including solution documentation, implementation via Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) , and integrated training for Supply Chain Finance.

• IT Liaison and Requirements Management: Translate detailed business requirements for the IT organization and manage changes, leveraging strong IT knowledge to assess technical feasibility.

• Independent Task Execution: Work independently to drive key tasks in the Supply Chain Finance stream, leveraging strong business knowledge to discuss, assess, and justify business requirements.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Extensive Experience in Supply Chain Finance: Possess a Master’s degree (or equivalent) and a minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Finance, management accounting, and product costing.

• Global Transformation Leadership: Demonstrated ability to successfully lead major global transformational projects with a proven track record of cross-functional and cross-divisional implementation.

• SAP & Process Expertise: Strong knowledge of SAP FI/CO, MM, PP, and MES systems, along with experience in driving SAP Supply Chain Finance process transformation and End-to-End process standardization.

• Advanced Project & Business Skills: Expertise in Project Management, Business Process Management, superior analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience with agile, Lean, and rapid development methodologies.

• Stakeholder & Communication Proficiency

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Acts as a link between global and local Finance, Supply Chain and Manufacturing, IT and Business Process Management and the project Aspire work streams to reach alignment within and across the divisions with specific focus on Roche Diagnostics. Translates detailed business requirements to IT organization and manages changes to such specifications. Defines and implements global template solutions including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training for the area of Supply Chain Finance. Disclosure note: The opportunity is available on a fixed-term basis until the end of 2027. The Opportunity
• Lead Process Design and Strategy: Actively pursue and drive the implementation of the End-to-End Business Process Management (E2E BPM) strategy, defining global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process designs.
• Empowered Decision-Making: Serve as an empowered decision-maker for your process area across divisions, operating within the E2E Business Process Management guardrails.
• Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management: Act as a critical link and strive for cross-functional and divisional alignment across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, IT, and Business Process Management to achieve E2E Process Harmonization.
• Lean and Standardized Solutions: Design and implement lean cross-divisional processes and solutions, maximizing standardization and harmonization while collaborating closely with the E2E Global Business Process Managers (GBPMs).
• Template Support and Safeguarding: Support and safeguard the Global ASPIRE Template and deployment activities, ensuring business acceptance globally.
• Solution Documentation & Implementation: Define and implement global template solutions, including solution documentation, implementation via Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) , and integrated training for Supply Chain Finance.
• IT Liaison and Requirements Management: Translate detailed business requirements for the IT organization and manage changes, leveraging strong IT knowledge to assess technical feasibility.
• Independent Task Execution: Work independently to drive key tasks in the Supply Chain Finance stream, leveraging strong business knowledge to discuss, assess, and justify business requirements. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
• Extensive Experience in Supply Chain Finance: Possess a Master’s degree (or equivalent) and a minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Finance, management accounting, and product costing.
• Global Transformation Leadership: Demonstrated ability to successfully lead major global transformational projects with a proven track record of cross-functional and cross-divisional implementation.
• SAP & Process Expertise: Strong knowledge of SAP FI/CO, MM, PP, and MES systems, along with experience in driving SAP Supply Chain Finance process transformation and End-to-End process standardization.
• Advanced Project & Business Skills: Expertise in Project Management, Business Process Management, superior analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience with agile, Lean, and rapid development methodologies.
• Stakeholder & Communication Proficiency

jobs.title: Sales Executive - HCM
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As a Sales Executive you will manage Account and Ensure Sales Achievement in Assigned Territory & Product lines, assist District Sales Manager in relieving their duties whenever necessary.

Your opportunity

• Manage existing Accounts actively to ensure long-term partnership and customer satisfaction pro-actively

• Develop new accounts with proper and close follow-up of sales opportunity

• Develop and maintains good customer relationships with important and relevant personnel

• Proactive and creative solve problems in managing customers’ complaint by proper investigation and close follow-up in resolving issues (eg: product deliveries/application troubleshooting)

• Coordinate with Distribution partner /Third Party to better serve customers

• Work closely with the Professional Service team to deliver the post-sales service for the maximum customers’ satisfaction.

Who you are

• Have Bachelor in Health/Science

• Have 3 year multinational companies experience in Pharmaceutical/ Diagnostic/ Healthcare industrial sales

• Have effective communication and interpersonal skill

• Have creative problem solving and negotiation skill

• Have customer complaint handling skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 07.04.2026
(Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist)

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Mobile Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior DevOps Mobile Engineer
Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona

The Patient Software Insights group within Roche Information Solutions (RIS) is responsible for a portfolio of software solutions that support healthcare providers and patients across various applications and disease areas.

For a quick look at what we do, check out Roche tech4life .

The Opportunity:
Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

You will oversee application releases and manage the automation process to support building our applications. Tasks may include scripting, testing, troubleshooting problems, and communicating issues to software engineers.

Who you are:
We seek an experienced, motivated DevOps Mobile Engineer who will work closely with engineers and our product teams. Required skills to accomplish your mission:

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience automating CI/CD pipelines specifically for mobile apps.

• Strong skills with mobile development platforms and tools like Fastlane, Apple App Store Connect, Google Play Console, TestFlight, Firebase, and managing certificates.

• Experience working with Python or a similar language.

• Deep experience in:

• Setting up and maintaining CI systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

• Building containers (Containerd, Docker).

• Managing artifact repositories (Nexus, Artifactory).

• Integrating SAST and DAST security tools (SonarQube, Mayhem, Trivy).

• A real enthusiasm for teamwork and helping others across different teams.

• A desire to mentor colleagues and share your knowledge.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

The following skills significantly strengthen your application:

• Familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud platforms.

• Experience in building and testing mobile applications (e.g., Device Farm) and feature flags.

• Background in developing digital products such as SaaS, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms.

• Knowledge of the diabetes or similar healthcare industries.

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• We welcome technical evangelists, so if you are interested in any thought leadership contributions (blogs, conferences) within the realm of the organization, we are happy to support you.

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget,...)

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the specific requirements of medical software, be it security, medical risk management, safe and resilient programming, or certifications and audits.

You will have direct contact with our users, learning about their daily struggles living with diabetes, as well as customers and partners, understanding the unique needs and mechanics of healthcar

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Enterprise IM Reliability

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team Engineering Enterprise IM Reliability
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead Engineering Enterprise IM Reliability
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe Engineering Enterprise IM Reliability

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Identity Management Reliability Team, supporting a mission-critical SailPoint IIQ platform and transforming how identity services operate at scale in a global, highly regulated environment. This platform sits at the core of our Identity Governance strategy, ensuring secure, seamless access for thousands of users across the organization. In this role, you won’t just keep the lights on—you’ll help us redefine how reliability is built and sustained. You will lead the shift from reactive support to a proactive, automation-driven SRE model, improving performance, scalability, and overall user experience. At its core, this role is about building empowered teams, creating reliable systems, and driving meaningful change in how identity services are delivered at scale.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Support team members in shaping their career paths while removing roadblocks and maintaining a healthy, sustainable pace

• Drive improvements in platform reliability, stability, and performance in a complex, high-volume environment

• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and implement automation to improve efficiency and scalability

• Partner closely with Product, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure identity services

• Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) performance, ensuring accountability, SLA adherence, and service quality

• Bring structure and clarity to operations through better monitoring, incident management, and continuous optimization

​
Who you are

• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.

• 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering or technical teams

• Experience working in pharma, biotech, or other regulated industries

• Strong experience in Identity & Access Management (SailPoint IIQ is a strong plus)

• Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and Access Governance in regulated and large-scale environments.

• Solid understanding of running production systems (monitoring, alerting, incident response, performance tuning)

• Experience with tools like Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar observability platforms

• Experience managing SailPoint IIQ upgrades, patches, and regression testing

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global environment

• Experience working with managed service providers or system integrators

• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) are a plus.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Manager to lead our Enterprise Identity Management Reliability Team, supporting a mission-critical SailPoint IIQ platform and transforming how identity services operate at scale in a global, highly regulated environment. This platform sits at the core of our Identity Governance strategy, ensuring secure, seamless access for thousands of users across the organization. In this role, you won’t just keep the lights on—you’ll help us redefine how reliability is built and sustained. You will lead the shift from reactive support to a proactive, automation-driven SRE model, improving performance, scalability, and overall user experience. At its core, this role is about building empowered teams, creating reliable systems, and driving meaningful change in how identity services are delivered at scale. The Opportunity
• Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement
• Support team members in shaping their career paths while removing roadblocks and maintaining a healthy, sustainable pace
• Drive improvements in platform reliability, stability, and performance in a complex, high-volume environment
• Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and implement automation to improve efficiency and scalability
• Partner closely with Product, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver reliable and secure identity services
• Oversee Managed Service Provider (MSP) performance, ensuring accountability, SLA adherence, and service quality
• Bring structure and clarity to operations through better monitoring, incident management, and continuous optimization ​ Who you are
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field.
• 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering or technical teams
• Experience working in pharma, biotech, or other regulated industries
• Strong experience in Identity & Access Management (SailPoint IIQ is a strong plus)
• Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and Access Governance in regulated and large-scale environments.
• Solid understanding of running production systems (monitoring, alerting, incident response, performance tuning)
• Experience with tools like Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or similar observability platforms
• Experience managing SailPoint IIQ upgrades, patches, and regression testing
• Ability to navigate complexity, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global environment
• Experience working with managed service providers or system integrators
• Professional Information Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) are a plus. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Acts as a link between global and local Finance, Supply Chain and Manufacturing, IT and Business Process Management and the project Aspire work streams to reach alignment within and across the divisions with specific focus on Roche Diagnostics.
Translates detailed business requirements to IT organization and manages changes to such specifications. Defines and implements global template solutions including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training for the area of Supply Chain Finance.

Disclosure note: The opportunity is available on a fixed-term basis until the end of 2027.

The Opportunity

• Lead Process Design and Strategy: Actively pursue and drive the implementation of the End-to-End Business Process Management (E2E BPM) strategy, defining global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process designs.

• Empowered Decision-Making: Serve as an empowered decision-maker for your process area across divisions, operating within the E2E Business Process Management guardrails.

• Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Management: Act as a critical link and strive for cross-functional and divisional alignment across Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, IT, and Business Process Management to achieve E2E Process Harmonization.

• Lean and Standardized Solutions: Design and implement lean cross-divisional processes and solutions, maximizing standardization and harmonization while collaborating closely with the E2E Global Business Process Managers (GBPMs).

• Template Support and Safeguarding: Support and safeguard the Global ASPIRE Template and deployment activities, ensuring business acceptance globally.

• Solution Documentation & Implementation: Define and implement global template solutions, including solution documentation, implementation via Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) , and integrated training for Supply Chain Finance.

• IT Liaison and Requirements Management: Translate detailed business requirements for the IT organization and manage changes, leveraging strong IT knowledge to assess technical feasibility.

• Independent Task Execution: Work independently to drive key tasks in the Supply Chain Finance stream, leveraging strong business knowledge to discuss, assess, and justify business requirements.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Extensive Experience in Supply Chain Finance: Possess a Master’s degree (or equivalent) and a minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Finance, management accounting, and product costing.

• Global Transformation Leadership: Demonstrated ability to successfully lead major global transformational projects with a proven track record of cross-functional and cross-divisional implementation.

• SAP & Process Expertise: Strong knowledge of SAP FI/CO, MM, PP, and MES systems, along with experience in driving SAP Supply Chain Finance process transformation and End-to-End process standardization.

• Advanced Project & Business Skills: Expertise in Project Management, Business Process Management, superior analytical and problem-solving skills, and experience with agile, Lean, and rapid development methodologies.

• Stakeholder & Communication Proficiency

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GenMark Diagnostics is seeking a Lead SDET to architect the next generation of our automated verification strategy. This is a high-impact "Player-Coach" role where you will balance hands-on framework development with the leadership of a dedicated team of Software Quality Engineers.

You will lead the technical evolution of our testing capabilities for FDA-regulated diagnostic instruments. Your mandate is to champion a culture of automation—architecting robust C#/.NET test harnesses, integrating them into modern CI/CD pipelines, and mentoring the team to ensure high-velocity, high-quality releases.

The Opportunity
Automation Architecture & Technical Leadership (40%)

• Technical Debt Remediation: Act as the specialist in reducing our manual testing burden. Identify and automate "High-Value/Low-Effort" manual tests first to rapidly buy the team breathing room and accelerate feedback cycles.

• Framework Design: Architect and build scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks (using C#, Selenium, Appium, or similar) to support both UI and backend logic, utilizing advanced object-oriented programming.

• Hardware & Integration Testing: Design test strategies that account for hardware-in-the-loop (HiL) testing and software interactions with physical diagnostic instruments and sensors.

• Continuous Integration & Security: Partner with the DevOps/Architecture team to integrate automated suites into Azure DevOps pipelines. Lead the automation of vulnerability scanning and static/dynamic analysis (SAST/DAST) to align with modern FDA cybersecurity guidelines.

• Tooling Selection: Evaluate and select the right tools for performance profiling, load testing, and security scanning to ensure comprehensive coverage.

Team Management & Mentorship (40%)

• Technical Mentorship: Act as the technical anchor for the SW Quality team. Mentor Quality Engineers on coding best practices, automation scripting, and source control management.

• Team Growth: Foster a collaborative environment where manual testing expertise is complemented by growing technical skills. Lead code reviews for test scripts to ensure they meet production-quality standards.

• Resource Management: Balance hands-on coding (the "Player") with team leadership (the "Coach"). Align team activities with the software roadmap, ensuring that verification activities happen in parallel with development rather than lagging behind.

Regulatory & Process Compliance (20%)

• Tool Validation: Collaborate closely with Regulatory Affairs (RA) to formally validate automated testing tools, ensuring they meet strict regulatory compliance standards.

• V&V Modernization: Enhance Master V&V Plans to support automated evidence generation, ensuring strict compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 820 and ISO 13485 standards.

• Metrics Driven: Define and track key quality metrics (e.g., Defect Density, Automation Coverage) to drive continuous improvement and transparency.

• Risk Analysis: Participate in software hazard analysis (FMEA) to ensure safety-critical workflows are prioritized in the automation strategy.

Who you are
Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.

• 8+ years of software engineering or SDET experience (Must have hands-on coding experience).

• 3+ years of leadership experience (Team Lead or Manager).

• Experience transforming a manual testing team into an automation-first team is highly preferred.

• Technical Debt Remediation: Act as the specialist in reducing our manual testing burden. Identify and automate "High-Value/Low-Effort" manual tests first to rapidly buy the team breathing room and accelerate feedback cycles.

• Technical Mentorship: Act as the technical anchor for the SW Quality team. Mentor Quality Engineers on coding best practices, automation scripting, and source control management.
• Team Growth: Foster a collaborative environment where manual testing expertise is complemented by growing technical skills. Lead code reviews for test scripts to ensure they meet production-quality standards.

• Tool Validation: Collaborate closely with Regulatory Affairs (RA) to formally validate automated testing tools, ensuring they meet strict regulatory compliance standards.

• Metrics Driven: Define and track key quality metrics (e.g., Defect Density, Automation Coverage) to drive continuous improvement and transparency.
• Risk Analysis: Participate in software hazard analysis (FMEA) to ensure safety-critical workflows are prioritized in the automation strategy. Who you are Education and Experience
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
• 8+ years of software engineering or SDET experience (Must have hands-on coding experience).
• 3+ years of leadership experience (Team Lead or Manager).
• Experience transforming a manual testing team into an automation-first team is highly preferred. T

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

• Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 10% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Springfield, Massachusetts or Central, Connecticut.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Requirements

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available with this job posting.
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Massachusetts is $74,600- $138,600 annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Device Development function within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support.
The Device Engineering department combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities.

The Opportunity

• In this role, you will have considerable cross-functional interaction, notably including QA, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial functions. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into Roche’s Device Development function.

• Technical Leadership: Act as a technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market. Lead the evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies.

• Engineering Excellence: Apply advanced engineering theory to establish robust technical product requirements and develop reliable design solutions. Use Digital Twins to verify that devices consistently meet performance requirements across the full product lifecycle. Rigorously assess design robustness and reliability through simulation-based methods, including finite element analysis (FEA), tolerance analysis, and other predictive engineering tools.

• Design for Manufacturing : Leverage deep expertise in injection molding, tool design, and mold flow analysis to ensure designs are optimized for large-scale production.

• Design Control: Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, URS, Design Inputs/Outputs, Design Verification Plans, and DHF creation/maintenance), conformity assessments, and risk management documentation.

• Project Management: Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality, and cost constraints, utilizing Lean management principles to drive efficiency and state-of-the-art results.

• Compliance: Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g., ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR 820.30).

Who You Are

• Education: You have a university-level education (engineering degree or related discipline).

• Experience: You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development in pharma or other closely regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).

• Specialization: You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.

• Technical Toolbox: You possess strong engineering expertise including CAD construction, Simulation (FEM, Monte Carlo), reliability engineering, and Material Science.

• Analytical Skills: You have demonstrable knowledge of Tolerance Analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, and manufacturing processes.

• Regulatory Savvy: You have sound knowledge of legislation, industry standards, and experience with Health Authority interactions.

• Methodology: You have a demonstrated application of Lean management principles in a technical development environment.

• Communication: You possess excellent documentation, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Languages: You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La funzione di sviluppo del dispositivo all'interno di Roche Technical Development è responsabile per lo sviluppo e il supporto dei dispositivi di distribuzione della droga per il portafoglio prodotti. Le nostre attività abbracciano una gamma di discipline ingegneristiche dalla fase di definizione dei requisiti fino alla commercializzazione e al supporto dei prodotti commercializzati. Il dipartimento di ingegneria dei dispositivi combina progettazione, ingegneria, test e produzione per sviluppare dispositivi di consegna affidabili e sicuri della droga che soddisfano le esigenze di pazienti, fornitori di assistenza sanitaria e autorità sanitarie. L'opportunità
• In questo ruolo, avrete notevoli interazioni interfunzionali, tra cui QA, Affari Regolatori, funzioni cliniche e commerciali. Questo ruolo riporta alla Sezione Capo di Ingegneria dei dispositivi ed è integrato nella funzione di sviluppo dei dispositivi di Roche.
• Leadership tecnica: agire come esperto tecnico per portare con successo prodotti combinati e dispositivi medici sul mercato. Guidare la valutazione delle nuove e innovative tecnologie.
• Eccellenza ingegneristica: applicare la teoria ingegneristica avanzata per stabilire robusti requisiti tecnici del prodotto e sviluppare soluzioni di progettazione affidabili. Utilizzare Digital Twins per verificare che i dispositivi soddisfino costantemente i requisiti di prestazioni in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Valuta con forza la robustezza e l'affidabilità del design attraverso metodi basati sulla simulazione, tra cui l'analisi degli elementi finiti (FEA), l'analisi della tolleranza e altri strumenti di ingegneria predittiva.
• Progettazione per la produzione: Leverage profonda competenza nello stampaggio ad iniezione, nella progettazione degli utensili e nell'analisi del flusso dello stampo per garantire che i progetti siano ottimizzati per la produzione su larga scala.
• Controllo di progettazione: Documentazione di controllo dell'autore (Piani di sviluppo di progettazione, URS, Input di progettazione/Outputs, Piani di verifica di progettazione e creazione/manutenzione DHF), valutazioni di conformità e documentazione di gestione del rischio.
• Project Management: Previsione e pianificazione delle risorse per i progetti di sviluppo dei dispositivi. Eseguire i progetti all'interno del tempo concordato, la qualità e i vincoli di costo, utilizzando principi di gestione Lean per guidare l'efficienza e risultati all'avanguardia.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Device Development function within Roche Technical Development is responsible for the development and support of drug delivery devices for the product portfolio. Our activities span a range of engineering disciplines from the requirements definition phase through to commercialization and marketed product support. The Device Engineering department combines design, engineering, testing, and manufacturing to develop reliable and safe drug delivery devices that meet the needs of patients, healthcare providers and Health Authorities. The Opportunity
• In this role, you will have considerable cross-functional interaction, notably including QA, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Commercial functions. This role reports to the Section Head of Device Engineering and is integrated into Roche’s Device Development function.
• Technical Leadership: Act as a technical expert to successfully bring combination products and medical devices to the market. Lead the evaluation of new and breakthrough technologies.
• Engineering Excellence: Apply advanced engineering theory to establish robust technical product requirements and develop reliable design solutions. Use Digital Twins to verify that devices consistently meet performance requirements across the full product lifecycle. Rigorously assess design robustness and reliability through simulation-based methods, including finite element analysis (FEA), tolerance analysis, and other predictive engineering tools.
• Design for Manufacturing : Leverage deep expertise in injection molding, tool design, and mold flow analysis to ensure designs are optimized for large-scale production.
• Design Control: Author design control documentation (Design Development Plans, URS, Design Inputs/Outputs, Design Verification Plans, and DHF creation/maintenance), conformity assessments, and risk management documentation.
• Project Management: Forecast and plan resource demands for device development projects. Execute projects within the agreed time, quality, and cost constraints, utilizing Lean management principles to drive efficiency and state-of-the-art results.
• Compliance: Apply knowledge of the regulatory landscape to ensure standard compliant designs (e.g., ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO 14971, and 21 CFR 820.30). Who You Are
• Education: You have a university-level education (engineering degree or related discipline).
• Experience: You have a minimum 10-year proven track record in mechanical engineering and drug delivery device development in pharma or other closely regulated environments (cGxP, QSR).
• Specialization: You have hands-on Pen injector / Auto injector development expertise.
• Technical Toolbox: You possess strong engineering expertise including CAD construction, Simulation (FEM, Monte Carlo), reliability engineering, and Material Science.
• Analytical Skills: You have demonstrable knowledge of Tolerance Analysis, statistical techniques, process capability, and manufacturing processes.
• Regulatory Savvy: You have sound knowledge of legislation, industry standards, and experience with Health Authority interactions.
• Methodology: You have a demonstrated application of Lean management principles in a technical development environment.
• Communication: You possess excellent documentation, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Languages: You have an excellent command of the English language; proficiency in German is preferable. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than

Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Die Position Die Geräteentwicklungsfunktion bei Roche Technical Development ist für die Entwicklung und Unterstützung von Medikamentenliefergeräten für das Produktportfolio verantwortlich. Unsere Aktivitäten umfassen eine Reihe von Engineering-Disziplinen von der Definitionsphase der Anforderungen bis hin zur Vermarktung und Vermarktung von Produkten. Die Abteilung Device Engineering vereint Design, Engineering, Testing und Fertigung, um zuverlässige und sichere Medikamentenliefergeräte zu entwickeln, die den Bedürfnissen von Patienten, Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Gesundheitsbehörden entsprechen.
