• In dieser Rolle haben Sie eine erhebliche funktionsübergreifende Interaktion, insbesondere QA, Regulatory Affairs, Klinische und kommerzielle Funktionen. Diese Rolle berichtet an den Abteilungsleiter für Gerätetechnik und ist in die Geräteentwicklungsfunktion von Roche integriert.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La fonction Développement des dispositifs au sein de Roche Technical Development est responsable du développement et du soutien des dispositifs de livraison de médicaments pour le portefeuille de produits. Nos activités couvrent une gamme de disciplines d'ingénierie, de la phase de définition des exigences jusqu'à la commercialisation et le soutien des produits commercialisés. L'opportunité

Évaluer rigoureusement la robustesse et la fiabilité de la conception au moyen de méthodes fondées sur la simulation, y compris l'analyse des éléments finis (AFE), l'analyse de la tolérance et d'autres outils d'ingénierie prédictive.

• Contrôle de conception : documentation de contrôle de conception de l'auteur (plans de conception, URS, entrées/sorties de conception, plans de vérification de conception, création/entretien de DHF), évaluations de conformité et documentation de gestion des risques.
• Gestion de projet: Prévision et planification des demandes de ressources pour les projets de développement d'appareils. Exécuter les projets dans les délais, la qualité et les contraintes de coûts convenus, en utilisant les principes de gestion Lean pour stimuler l'efficacité et les résultats les plus récents.
• Conformité : Appliquer les connaissances du paysage réglementaire pour assurer la conformité aux normes (par exemple ISO 13485, 21CFR820, ISO 14971 et 21 CFR 820.30). Qui vous êtes
• Éducation : vous avez une formation universitaire (diplôme d'ingénierie ou discipline connexe).
• Expérience : Vous avez fait la preuve d'une expérience d'au moins 10 ans dans le domaine du génie mécanique et de la mise au point d'appareils de livraison de médicaments dans des environnements pharmaceutiques ou d'autres environnements étroitement réglementés (cGxP, QSR).
• Spécialisation: Vous avez une expertise pratique Pen injecteur / Auto injecteur développement.
• Boîte à outils technique: Vous possédez une solide expertise en ingénierie, y compris la construction CAO, la simulation (FEM, Monte Carlo), l'ingénierie de la fiabilité et la science des matériaux.
• Compétences analytiques: Vous avez une connaissance démontrable de l'analyse de tolérance, des techniques statistiques, de la capacité des procédés et des procédés de fabrication.
• Regulatory Savvy: Vous avez une bonne connaissance de la législation, des normes de l'industrie et de l'expérience des interactions avec les autorités sanitaires.
• Méthodologie: Vous avez une application démontrée des principes de gestion de Lean dans un environnement de développement technique.

jobs.title: Executive Operations Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Executive Operations Lead

Reporting to: General Manager/ Finance Manager
Subordinates: 4

Role Description
The Admin Manager / Chief of Staff is a dual-impact role, serving as a strategic partner to the General Manager and a functional leader for the organization’s administrative and business support infrastructure. Reporting to the Finance Manager, the role holder acts as a "bridge-builder" between the Enabling Team and business units, ensuring operational excellence across executive support, office management, and event logistics. As a leader of the Business Support team, they are responsible for optimizing administrative processes, fostering a high-performance service culture, and ensuring that the physical and logistical environment of the office empowers the team to deliver value to patients and stakeholders.

Summary of Main Responsibilities:

Executive Support & Strategic Coordination

• Act as the primary Executive Assistant to the General Manager, proactively managing complex calendars, domestic/international travel logistics, and migration/visa requirements.

• Handle confidential business and personal tasks for the GM to optimize their leadership capacity.

• Provide high-level administrative partnership to the Enabling Team, ensuring departmental priorities are supported.
People Leadership & Process Excellence

• Directly manage and coach a diverse team including Administrative and Business Support Coordinators and the Driver

• Standardize and continuously improve administrative business processes to increase organizational efficiency and simplify complex workflows.

• Distribute tasks among specialists based on their competencies and workload, providing daily mentorship on Roche systems, tools, and methods.

• Supervise Business Support Coordinators to ensure high-quality logistical assistance and event support is provided to all business-driving teams.

• Oversee the full lifecycle of vendor relations and documentation, from tendering and contract preparation to the control of invoices and financial closing.

• Control the organization of international congresses, speaker trainings, and internal events, including stakeholder (KOL) engagement and logistics.

• Ensure all administrative operations are executed with precision, maintaining high ethical standards and safeguarding confidential company information.
Office Operations & Fleet Management

• Oversee total office maintenance, including cleaning services, supply procurement (stationery, catering/food), and coordinating technical repairs.

• Manage the corporate car fleet, ensuring compliance, maintenance, and efficient logistics for the organization.

• Optimize the office environment to reflect the company’s culture and ensure a productive workspace for all employees.
Corporate Events & Stakeholder Hosting

• Provide essential support in the planning and execution of major corporate milestones, including Kick-off meetings, Cycle meetings, and internal team events.

• Serve as the lead host and coordinator for visits from Top Management and key external stakeholders, ensuring professional hospitality and seamless logistics.
Requirements:

• University degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in administrative management or executive support, preferably within an international environment.

• Proven experience in leading and developing a diverse administrative team.

• Exceptional organizational skills: ability to manage high-level

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Contracts Manager - Site Services Facilities

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

As Contract Manager Site Services Facilities you are part of the Global Procurement in the Risk, Contracts & Compliance team Direct Materials & Site Services (DM&SS) Contracts group.

You will report directly to the Head of Direct Materials and Site Services Contracts and be focusing on supporting Third-Party Risk Management processes including contract drafting and negotiations.

You will support our team in Basel in the following exciting challenges:

• The focus of the work is on supporting local and global procurement and business partners in contract negotiations and contract preparation.

• This includes, but is not limited to, advising business partners and influencing the various business partners in relation to legal or compliance issues as well as identifying specific risks.

• You are drafting the contractual terms based on strategy discussions, business partner input and organizational needs and expectations.

• You have the ability to independently handle contractual clauses and legal issues. You put this knowledge in the contract design and development until the finalization of the contract. You will be supported by the legal department.

• You ensure service delivery and contribute to optimizing the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of the service level as part of a continuous improvement process.

• Working closely with procurement, business partners, and subject matter experts, you can work out solutions to problems and ensure that their strategies are reflected in the contracts.

• You have a proven track record of general contract procedures and advise business partners with important contract contents and ensure that they are reflected in the contracts.

• If required, you take over the (sub) project management in subject-specific projects.

Who you are:

• The basis for your success in this versatile area of responsibility is a successfully completed study with a legal and/or technical focus or an equivalent university degree (Master of Laws / Bachelor of Laws / Master of Business Laws / Diploma in Engineering).

• You have legal expertise for contract drafting and are able to draft complex contractual contracts and terms on your own. .

• You have 7+ years of experience in contract management and Site Services Facilities projects and ideally have experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• You have already successfully demonstrated to use your professional competence in complex contract negotiation and contract structuring in your professional practice as well as in risk management areas.

• Based on your strong communication skills and your negotiation skills, you will be able to communicate in a business-oriented and targeted manner with internal and external partners at all levels of the hierarchy.

• Against this background, excellent written and spoken English skills are indispensable.

• German fluency - nice to have.

• You have the assertiveness and act goal-oriented.

• Furthermore, you have many years

jobs.title: Business Process Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Business Process Specialist (Diagnostics Division)
• Company: Roche Ukraine LLC (Diagnostics Division)
• Work format: Remote
• Schedule: Mon–Fri, 09:00–18:00 (with lunch break)
• Location: Ukraine (occasional short business trips within Ukraine, up to ~10%)
• Role purpose
To ensure seamless operational support for the Diagnostics division: from supporting direct contracts between Roche Diagnostics Poland (RDP) and healthcare institutions / laboratories and onboarding new customers, to coordinating promotional materials, logistics of service tools, hotline operations, and participation in complaint handling (including for indirect channel customers via the Distributor).
• The role acts as the key “process integrator” between Sales (RDP), Service/Field Service, Medical / Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Logistics, and other enabling functions.
• Key responsibilities
• (broken down by functional area)
1) Support of direct contracts between Roche Diagnostics Poland (RDP) and healthcare institutions / laboratories ● Manage document flow between Roche Diagnostics Poland (RDP) and healthcare institutions / laboratories (agreements, addenda, service acts, specifications), including verification of counterparties’ legal and financial details.
• ● Organise internal contract approvals with Finance/Tax, Legal, and Compliance; monitor SLA for approvals.
• ● Maintain contract registers in internal systems (ERP/CRM/DMS); ensure timely status/version updates.
• ● Track renewal/termination timelines, monitor fulfilment of KPIs / service obligations.
• ● Ensure alignment with internal policies (anti-corruption, interactions with healthcare professionals / institutions, promotional practices).

• 2) Customer onboarding and training ● Own and execute onboarding checklists: document collection, account set-up, supply / delivery schedule coordination.
• ● Plan and coordinate trainings (online/offline): introduction to products/services, ordering process, service request process, warranty policies.
• ● Develop / adapt training materials (user guides, SOPs, short video/step-by-step instructions); collect feedback; provide post-onboarding support at 30–60–90 days.
• ● Maintain a customer-facing knowledge base (FAQ, instructions, recorded webinars) in the DMS / customer portal.

• 3) Process and document flow optimisation ● Draft, standardise, and regularly review SOPs / instructions / templates; implement checklists and quality control points.
• ● Drive “paper → digital” transition: rollout of DMS / e-forms; keep responsibility matrices up to date.
• Perform internal process audits for compliance with QMS, internal policies, and regulatory requirements.
• ● Prepare process analytics: turnaround time (TAT), document completeness rate, SLA performance; propose improvement actions.

• 4) Processing and coordination of promotional materials ● Plan, request, localise, submit for Legal / Compliance review, produce, and distribute promotional materials.
• ● Ensure that all promotional activities comply with Ukrainian advertising law and internal policies governing interaction with the medical community.
• ● Track and document circulation and use of materials: print runs, stock levels, transfer to events / field teams, and proper disposal according to procedure.
• ● Prepare post-campaign reports: execution vs plan, reach / utilisation, and recommendations for optimisation.

5) Logistics of service tools ● Coordinate the movement of service tools / kits / spare parts to and from field locations (including reverse logistics).
● Maintain invento

jobs.title: Product Designer (Strategic)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

• Early-Stage Prototyping & Requirement Analysis:

- Translate ambiguous innovation ideas into tangible low/high-fidelity prototypes for early AI products (e.g., Vertical Agents, AIGC tools).
- Capture and translate complex medical logic into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRD) and functional specifications.

• Strategic Storytelling & High-Impact Design:

- Design and draft professional presentations (PPT/Keynote) for Solution Design, Brand Value Promotion, and POC Center Construction.
- Visualize the roadmap and strategic vision of AI medical products to align with business goals.

• AI Education & Training:

- Internal Literacy: Develop and deliver AI literacy training programs and workshops for internal teams to foster an "AI-native" culture.
- External Evangelism: Conduct AI science popularization and technical briefings for external medical partners and HCPs to demonstrate the value of the Lab's digital solutions.
- Simplify complex AI concepts (e.g., LLMs, RAG, Agents) into digestible content for non-technical audiences.

• Internal Media & Content Curation:

- Manage internal self-media channels, including the creation of industry briefs and innovation newsletters to keep the organization updated on emerging AI trends.

• AI Tool Integration & Execution:

- Oversee the application of GenAI in medical content creation, ensuring clinical value and compliance.
- Continuously explore newest technical frameworks to match the needs of innovative products.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or related fields. MBA or Master’s preferred.
● > 3-5 years’ experience in product management, with a proven track record of launching successful digital or AI products.
● Experience in Digital Health, MedTech, or AI Product Management is highly preferred.
● Senior AIGC “player” is highly preferred.
Leadership Competencies
● Strategic agility
● Technical and business expertise
● Inspiring and influencing
● Teamwork and collaboration
Job Required Competencies
● Product & Design Proficiency: Strong ability in requirement analysis and prototyping tools like Axure, Figma, or XMind.
● Visual Narrative & PPT Mastery: Exceptional skills in crafting strategic presentations that balance logic and aesthetics.
● Training & Facilitation : Excellent public speaking and communication skills; ability to design curriculum and lead interactive training sessions.
● AI Savvy: Deep understanding of AI capabilities/limitations and hands-on experience with modern AI productivity tools.
● Strategic Thinking: Ability to anticipate industry shifts and define long-term product strategies.
Travel Frequency
25% - 50%

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub's long-term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

The Opportunity:

• Support SEO execution: technical, on-page SEO, and off-page optimization, as well as have an understanding of digital & content marketing

• Research SEO keywords to use throughout the company's website and marketing materials (Keyword Research) using several tools, providing keyword variations, and grouping them in clusters

• Select, prioritize, and grade the keywords based on their value to the business and the specific project

• Prepare briefs for content creators, following the provided internal guidelines and focusing on the keywords provided in the Keyword Research (using tools such as SurferSEO and SEMrush)

• Perform and prepare SEO and organic traffic reports for websites

• Execute tests, collect & analyze data and results, identify trends and insights to achieve maximum ROI

Who you are:

• You hold a BSc/MSc degree in a related field and 2+ years of SEO experience in a similar position.

• You have good knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Google Search Console; SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, Screaming Frog, etc.); Excel, Google Sheets, Smartsheet; CSS, HTML.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential, additional languages a plus, based on region/customer requirements.

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and efficient with time management.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching/mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global, inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes, and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: htt

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.
As a Service Delivery Lead (SDL) , you are accountable for ensuring effective, scalable, and high-quality operational service delivery within your assigned focus area of the global Roche content and digital services Lab .

You oversee the operational governance of services delivered through internal teams and external vendors, ensuring alignment with defined service models, performance standards, and business priorities. Your focus is on service reliability, performance transparency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Strategic Medical Writing Leadership – Direct medical writing service delivery across therapeutic areas, ensuring content production meets regulatory standards, business objectives, and therapeutic-specific demands while maintaining quality and compliance

• Workflow Harmonization & Cross-Functional Integration – Streamline medical writing processes with marketing, medical affairs, and compliance functions, creating seamless content workflows that align creative storytelling with regulatory requirements across all pillars

• Regulatory & Compliance Alignment – Partner with compliance and medical affairs teams to embed regulatory governance into content development, serving as the bridge between creative execution and regulatory oversight

• Service Delivery Accountability – Own day-to-day performance metrics, SLAs, and KPIs for medical writing services, acting as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, business leads, GDH leads, and external vendors to ensure consistent execution against agreed standards

• Operational Excellence & Process Optimization – Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, delivery frameworks, and performance monitoring systems; identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives with structured governance and data-driven insights

• Cost-Conscious Scalability & Innovation – Design scalable service delivery models that optimize resource allocation and cost-efficiency while championing technology adoption—including GenAI tools—to enhance operational productivity and service quality

• Capacity & Risk Management – Coordinate capacity planning, manage service incidents and escalations, monitor operational trends, and support business continuity planning to maintain service reliability, workload balance, and proactive risk mitigation

Who you are:
You operate effectively in structured governance environments and are comfortable balancing operational oversight with stakeholder alignment. You anticipate risks, address delivery challenges in a timely manner, and contribute to a culture of continuous service improvement. You maintain attention to process integrity, performance transparency, and service consistency.
For this position, you bring the following qualifications :

• 3+ years of relevant experience in service delivery management, operational governance, or structured digital/content operations environments (corporate or agency).

• Experience working within global or multi-regional delivery models, including collaboration with offshore/onshore teams.

• A university degree in a field that emphasizes li

titleByLocale.en: 创新渠道高级准入策略经理

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
您的机会：
目标管理

• 据公司重点和业务环境，协助制定多渠道策略，并负责创新项目方案设计及实施计划和跟进有效性。

• 保罗氏业务在多渠道间的健康有序开展

• 创新渠道模式标杆案例。
创新项目孵化与落地

• 主导传统商业渠道创新项目的全程管理，包括需求调研、可行性分析、方案设计、试点执行及规模化推广。

• 探索创新服务模式 及数字化工具 在传统和新兴渠道的应用，推动渠道效率与患者服务体验升级。

• 推动 建立 患者体验与支付 评价体系 ， 定期复盘 机制 并 持续 优化 。

• 协调跨部门资源，确保创新项目符合法规及公司政策，并高效完成试点验证及全国复制。

商业集团总部深度合作管理

• 与合作伙伴建立广泛的合作和信任，深度理解商业集团业务需求，挖掘合作潜力，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动。

• 区域龙头商业集团总部的战略合作对接，制定并执行多渠道合作策略，推动商业总部的资源整合与项目落地。

• 监控合作执行情况，定期分析合作项目进度和渠道数据，定期输出合作效能分析并提出优化方案及推动改进。

跨部门协同与资源整合

• 联动公司业务部门和相关支持部门，协调内外部资源，将渠道创新与产品策略结合，搭建创新试点平台，推动项目从概念验证到全国推广的快速迭代，支持核心产品增长目标。

• 监测医药流通领域政策变化及新兴渠道趋势，输出针对性分析，为管理层制定渠道战略提供决策支持。

期待您：

• 本科及以上学历，优先考虑医药相关专业

• 5年以上医药行业渠道管理、商务合作或创新项目管理经验

• 有成功主导创新项目从0到1落地经验

• 优秀的内外部沟通协调能力、谈判技巧、资源整合能力

• 政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力、大客户管理和谈判能力、项目管理和敏捷执行能力、跨部门沟通协调能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Media Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Media Operations Specialist you work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of our Paid Media priorities. You are responsible for paid media campaigns of the Global Digital Marketing teams with an emphasis on digital campaign implementation, optimization, and performance reporting. You work with relevant stakeholders and assist them on how to further develop their media performance and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

The Media Operations Specialist is responsible for supporting our Business Partners in executing the paid media strategy by delivering a full suite of objectives across the Roche online presence. The preferred candidate gained experience in multiple areas of paid campaign management across different channels and platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports
the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Support the development, execution, and optimization of digital campaigns, including conception, launch, evaluation, and performance tracking.

• Collaborate with partners, colleagues, and external agencies to ensure innovative digital marketing strategies and exceptional results.

• Align media strategies across global, regional, and affiliate levels, providing actionable insights and optimizing processes.

• Manage paid media budgets and define, measure, and evaluate relevant KPIs for channel performance.

• Execute campaigns alongside Digital Marketing managers, Social Leads, and external publishers, maintaining adherence to industry best practices.

• Oversee agency relationships, drive accountability, and monitor campaign enablers like SoW, POs, and activation proofs.

• Stay informed about brand, therapeutic, and disease area needs while serving as a single point of contact for assigned organizations.

Who you are:

• You have 2+ years of experience in the world of (digital) paid media and understands technical aspects of tracking paid media performance (quantitative and qualitative), adserving, as well as having knowledge of biddable platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, programmatic).

• You have experience either on media agency side or on client side as part of a media team working closely with a media agency.

• Ideally you have experience with project/workflow management tools like Trello, Asana, Monday, Wrike or other.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential and additional languages are a plus, based on region/customer requirements.

• You are detail oriented, well organized and efficient with time management.

• You are dynamic and flexible in working within continuously changing environment.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Off

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Maintenance Specialist provides advanced technical support to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment. This role performs troubleshooting, corrective repairs, and preventive/predictive maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems to minimize downtime and sustain equipment performance. The Maintenance Specialist works independently or within a team to resolve simple to complex issues, maintains accurate GxP-compliant documentation, and supports engineering activities. This position requires strong mechanical aptitude, practical troubleshooting experience, and the ability to interpret technical instructions, schematics, and automation-related information. The role also collaborates closely with Engineering, Production, and cross-functional teams to support equipment reliability, continuous improvement initiatives, and overall operational readiness.

Responsibilities:

• Perform troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems, resolving simple to medium-complexity failures and identifying true root causes.

• Execute preventive and predictive maintenance tasks to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.

• Work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks, escalating complex issues as needed.

• Maintain accurate and compliant maintenance records, following GxP and strong documentation practices using CMMS and software systems (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, etc.).

• Provide support to Senior Maintenance Specialists and peers during repairs, including part retrieval, teardown/rebuild assistance, and basic troubleshooting support.

• Demonstrate full competence in the use of hand tools, power tools, test instruments, and precision measurement devices required for maintaining manufacturing equipment.

• Collaborate with engineering, production, and cross-functional teams on equipment-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements:

• Minimum 5 years of troubleshooting and repair experience with electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems in a manufacturing or industrial operations environment. Or, an Associates degree in a technical field or equivalent military training with 2 years of relevant maintenance experience

• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.

• Strong mechanical aptitude, analytical thinking, and ability to follow technical instructions and schematics.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain a wide range of equipment.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Ability to learn new equipment and technologies through on-the-job training and formal instruction.

Preferred:

• 7+ years of total experience in mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic maintenance.

• Experience with RSLogix/Studio 5000, servo drives, and basic automation systems.

• Knowledge of GxP requirements.

• Working knowledge of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) concepts.

• Experience with Lean methodologies (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma).

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 51,500.00 - 95,700.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretion

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Maintenance Specialist provides advanced technical support to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of manufacturing equipment. This role performs troubleshooting, corrective repairs, and preventive/predictive maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems to minimize downtime and sustain equipment performance. The Maintenance Specialist works independently or within a team to resolve simple to complex issues, maintains accurate GxP-compliant documentation, and supports engineering activities. This position requires strong mechanical aptitude, practical troubleshooting experience, and the ability to interpret technical instructions, schematics, and automation-related information. The role also collaborates closely with Engineering, Production, and cross-functional teams to support equipment reliability, continuous improvement initiatives, and overall operational readiness. Responsibilities:
• Perform troubleshooting and corrective maintenance on electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems, resolving simple to medium-complexity failures and identifying true root causes.
• Execute preventive and predictive maintenance tasks to improve equipment reliability and reduce unplanned downtime.
• Work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks, escalating complex issues as needed.
• Maintain accurate and compliant maintenance records, following GxP and strong documentation practices using CMMS and software systems (Google Suite, Microsoft Office, SAP, etc.).
• Provide support to Senior Maintenance Specialists and peers during repairs, including part retrieval, teardown/rebuild assistance, and basic troubleshooting support.
• Demonstrate full competence in the use of hand tools, power tools, test instruments, and precision measurement devices required for maintaining manufacturing equipment.
• Collaborate with engineering, production, and cross-functional teams on equipment-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives. Requirements:
• Minimum 5 years of troubleshooting and repair experience with electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems in a manufacturing or industrial operations environment. Or, an Associates degree in a technical field or equivalent military training with 2 years of relevant maintenance experience
• Experience with Precision Maintenance practices.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
• Strong mechanical aptitude, analytical thinking, and ability to follow technical instructions and schematics.
• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, repair, and maintain a wide range of equipment.
• Strong communication skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
• Ability to learn new equipment and technologies through on-the-job training and formal instruction. Preferred:
• 7+ years of total experience in mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic maintenance.
• Experience with RSLogix/Studio 5000, servo drives, and basic automation systems.
• Knowledge of GxP requirements.
• Working knowledge of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) concepts.
• Experience with Lean methodologies (5S, Kaizen, TPM, Six Sigma). Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 51,500.00 - 95,700.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretion

jobs.title: Head of Process Engineering Indianapolis - Controls

titleByLocale.en: Head of Process Engineering Indianapolis - Controls

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. The customer area Near Patient Care (NPC) unites Roche’s Point of Care and Diabetes Care portfolios. Our ambition is to improve disease management by enabling critical answers and personalized care, closer to the people we serve. With our passion we bring testing closer to patients and empower people to better monitor their own health and help healthcare professionals make faster, more confident decisions closer to the patient.

Within NPC Operations, we are globally accountable for the end-to-end production of solutions for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM), blood glucose monitoring (BGM), and insulin delivery (IDS), as well as Point-of-Care (POC) products. The most relevant internal manufacturing sites are Mannheim in Germany and Indianapolis in the USA.

Your New Team
As Manufacturing Science and Technology in NPC Operations, we bridge the gap between development and manufacturing. With around 200 colleagues across Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Rotkreuz, we lead technology strategy, product design industrialization, and collaboration with external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

As a project-based organization, we enable scalable product designs ready for mass production, ensure robust processes and equipment for excellent yields, and ensure scalable QC processes. Partnering with external networks, we secure competitive manufacturing costs and reliable production.

We are committed to building a global, inclusive team, bringing together various perspectives and skills to foster innovation and create a great place to work for all.

Your New Role
As the Head of Process Engineering - Controls (m/f/d), you will lead a local high-performing team of automation and electrical engineers and shape an inclusive work environment that drives digital innovation through global collaboration and diverse perspectives. In this central position, you and your team will be responsible for the automation strategy and the electrical design for our complex special-purpose machines for the assembly of medical devices. Your focus will be on translating innovative R&D concepts into intelligent, networked, and mass-production-ready processes.

Your Main Tasks

• Leadership and strategic development of a team of automation, software, and electrical engineers. Fostering a diverse and inclusive team culture that drives digital and electrotechnical innovation.

• Definition and global implementation of the automation strategy (hardware, software, control technology) for highly complex medical device assembly systems.

• Translating product designs into smart, automated processes. Responsibility for the seamless integration of sensor technology, actuator technology, and control technology to scale systems for mass production.

• Management and partnership-based collaboration with external automation service providers, control cabinet manufacturers, and software suppliers (including acceptance of code, electrical designs, and support for FAT/SAT).

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements for medical technology with a focus on automation (e.g., GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, machine safety/CE/UL) and responsibility for Computer System Validation (CSV).

• Development and integration of inline quality controls (e.g., vision systems) and ensuring smooth data acquisition and connection to higher-level systems (MES, ERP, SCADA) for efficiency improvement and cost optimization.

• Close coordination with Process Science, Process Engineering, IT,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives. In addition, you will work with senior medical writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

You will be :

As a Medical Writer, you will contribute to the growing medical writing team within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. You will develop medical writing and digital content solutions across various therapeutic areas and play an integral role in business development and stakeholder engagement.
Key Responsibilities:

• Create and edit medical content for various digital channels and platforms, including patient information, educational materials for healthcare professionals (slides, posters, speaker briefs, and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports, study summaries, and materials for public relations. May research, write, and edit pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from studies.

• Assist in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation, prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters. Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring timely delivery. Ensure content complies with regulatory guidelines and Roche best practices.

• Monitor and manage workload, anticipate capacity issues, and provide solutions. Ensure projects meet deadlines and maintain scientific accuracy. Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM, including referencing.

• Collaborate with the Creative Artworker to develop content. Contribute creative ideas and suggestions. Liaise professionally with internal teams, clients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses.

• Understand customer business needs to create relevant content. Engage resources, using both formal and informal networks to achieve goals and work closely with Business Partners. Suggest improvements to service and responsiveness to business partners.

Who you are :

We are looking for dynamic individuals who are highly involved and

jobs.title: Complaint Handling Engineer - Medical Software

titleByLocale.it: Ingegnere di manipolazione di reclami - software medico
titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de traitement des plaintes - Logiciel médical

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Complaint Handling Engineer - Medical Software you will be dealing with complaints concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms.

As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal Software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about Software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance, all of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.

• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.

• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.

• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.

• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.

• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations.

Who you are:

• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science, or an IT related field.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of Software related or bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.

• Experience reading source code

• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.

• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues.

Apply if you are:

• Looking for an opportunity to continue growing in your career while mixing both the technical (IT) and medical fields.

• Quick technology learner.

• A team player who truly believes that together we can go further.

• Not afraid to fail and learn.

• Comfortable with uncertainty.

• Looking for a purpose where your work will have a real impact on patient lives. Your work

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come un Ingegnere di Manipolazione della Cappella - Medico Software si tratta di reclami per quanto riguarda la qualità delle soluzioni digitali e le prestazioni di prodotto dei sistemi di informazione ospedaliera/laboratoria (HIS/LIS), reti di dati medici, soluzioni middleware. comunicazione dati, algoritmi app. Come membro del Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali, lavorerai in un ambiente Software molto trasversale avendo l'opportunità di lavorare con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. È necessario essere in grado di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente per scoprire il fattore causa/causale radice di un problema SW malfunzionamento/SW, e anche essere in grado di conoscere i requisiti del software, correggere il processo di bug (anche se non li si corregge) e la manutenzione generale del codice, tutto in un ambiente Agile dove si potrebbe contribuire con le proprie idee e proposte in un team in continuo miglioramento A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità:
• Contabile per la tempestiva gestione dei singoli casi (informazioni, reclami, potenziali segnalabili e problemi di sicurezza) secondo i requisiti e le normative del Sistema di Qualità ISO, e le esigenze delle Organizzazioni del Paese tra cui creazione, accettazione, classificazione, indagine, documentazione completa, risoluzione dei problemi in loco e risoluzione dei casi.
• Sostiene i casi nell'area assegnata, potenzialmente richiedendo la consultazione con più membri del team senior sugli aspetti tecnici o legati al processo.
• Interfaccia con gli Affiliati e si assume la responsabilità per una tempestiva comunicazione di informazioni di qualità relative alle Organizzazioni del Paese. Supporta iniziative e misure per mantenere interfacce potenziate con organizzazioni di paesi e rappresentanti regionali.
• Analizza i dati utilizzando misure statistiche per determinare un potenziale problema di prestazioni del prodotto.
• Responsabile di casi di escalation che non possono essere risolti direttamente a livelli appropriati e avviando ulteriori indagini e comunicando le informazioni relative ai casi, se del caso.
• Assicura che i casi siano conformi e conformi ai processi, agli standard e ai regolamenti di qualità stabiliti. Chi sei:
• Possiedi una laurea in bioinformatica, biologia computazionale, ingegneria biomedica, informatica o un campo relativo all'IT.
• Le forti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) sono essenziali
• L'esperienza di lavoro nell'area del Software correlato o bioinformatica e/o nelle funzioni relative al supporto è desiderata.
• Esperienza di lettura codice sorgente
• Si desidera la comprensione delle piattaforme di cloud computing e la gestione dell'esperienza nell'infrastruttura di premessa (compresi i server e i cluster di calcolo ad alte prestazioni).
• È possibile leggere e debug codice sorgente di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati. Applicare se sei:
• Alla ricerca di un'opportunità per continuare a crescere nella tua carriera mescolando sia i campi tecnici (IT) che quelli medici.
• Imparatore di tecnologia veloce.
• Un giocatore di squadra che crede veramente che insieme possiamo andare oltre.
• Non ha paura di fallire e imparare.
• Confortevole con incertezza.
• Alla ricerca di uno scopo in cui il vostro lavoro avrà un impatto reale sulla vita del paziente. Il tuo lavoro

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Beschwerde-Handling-Ingenieur - Medical Software Sie werden sich mit Beschwerden über die Qualität und Produktleistung von Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medizinische Datennetze, Middleware-Lösungen beschäftigen. Datenkommunikation, Apps Algorithmen. Als Mitglied des Kapitels Digital Solutions arbeiten Sie in einer sehr transversalen Software-Umgebung mit der Möglichkeit, mit modernsten Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen für On-Premise und Cloud-basierte Software zu arbeiten. Sie müssen in der Lage sein, Quellcode zu lesen und zu verstehen, um herauszufinden, die Ursache / Mausal Faktor einer SW-Störung / SW-Problem, und auch in der Lage, über Software-Anforderungen zu lernen, Fehler-Prozess zu beheben (auch wenn Sie sie nicht beheben werden) und allgemeine Code-Wartung, alles in einer Agile Umgebung, wo Sie mit Ihren eigenen Ideen und Vorschlägen in einem Team kontinuierlich verbessern Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Wir verlangen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Durchschnitt zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Bedarf variieren, z.B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathause, Teamtreffen und andere kollaborative Veranstaltungen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Berechnungsfähig für die zeitnahe Handhabung einzelner Fälle (Anfragen, Beschwerden, potenzielle Berichts- und Sicherheitsfragen) nach ISO-Qualitätssystem-Anforderungen und -Vorschriften und Anforderungen der Länderorganisationen einschließlich Erstellung, Akzeptanz, Klassifizierung, Untersuchung, vollständige Dokumentation, Fehlersuche vor Ort und Auflösung von Fällen.
• Behebung von Fällen im zugewiesenen Bereich, die möglicherweise eine Konsultation mit höheren Teammitgliedern zu technischen oder prozessbezogenen Aspekten erfordern.
• Schnittstelle mit Affiliates und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die rechtzeitige Kommunikation von qualitativ hochwertigen Informationen mit den Landorganisationen. Unterstützt Initiativen und Maßnahmen zur Aufrechterhaltung verbesserter Schnittstellen mit Landorganisationen und regionalen Vertretern.
• Analysiert Daten mit statistischen Maßnahmen zur Bestimmung eines potenziellen Produktentwicklungsproblems.
• Verantwortlich für die Eskalation von Fällen, die nicht direkt auf geeignete Ebenen gelöst werden können, und die Einleitung weiterer Untersuchungen und die Übermittlung von Fallinformationen als angemessen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Fälle den etablierten Qualitätsprozessen, Standards und Vorschriften entsprechen. Wer du bist:
• Sie besitzen einen Abschluss in Bioinformatik, Rechenbiologie, Biomedizinischer Technik, Informatik oder einem IT-bezogenen Bereich.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) sind essentiell
• Arbeitserfahrung im Bereich Software- oder Bioinformatik und/oder in unterstützenden Funktionen ist erwünscht.
• Erleben Sie Lesequellencode
• Verständnis von Cloud-Computing-Plattformen sowie Erfahrungsmanagement auf der Infrastruktur (einschließlich Servern und Hochleistungs-Computing-Clustern) ist erwünscht.
• Sie sind in der Lage, Quellcode verschiedener Programmiersprachen zu lesen und oder zu debuggen, um die Ursache von gemeldeten Problemen zu verstehen. Anwenden, wenn Sie sind:
• Auf der Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, in Ihrer Karriere weiter zu wachsen und gleichzeitig die technischen (IT) und medizinischen Felder zu mischen.
• Schneller Techniker.
• Ein Teamplayer, der wirklich glaubt, dass wir gemeinsam weiter gehen können.
• Keine Angst zu scheitern und zu lernen.
• Bequem mit Unsicherheit.
• Auf der Suche nach einem Zweck, wo Ihre Arbeit einen echten Einfluss auf das Patientenleben haben wird. Ihre Arbeit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'ingénieur chargé du traitement des plaintes - Services médicaux Logiciels que vous traiterez des plaintes concernant la qualité des solutions numériques et la performance du produit des systèmes d'information hôpital/laboratoire (HIS/LIS), des réseaux de données médicales, des solutions intermédiaires. communication de données, algorithmes d'applications. En tant que membre du chapitre Solutions numériques, vous travaillerez dans un environnement logiciel très transversal ayant la possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe et différents langages de programmation pour des logiciels sur site et basés sur le cloud. Vous devez être en mesure de lire et comprendre le code source afin de découvrir la cause racine / facteur causal d'un problème SW dysfonctionnement/SW, et aussi être en mesure d'apprendre sur les exigences du logiciel, la correction des bogues processus (même si vous ne les corrigerez pas) et la maintenance générale du code, tout cela dans un environnement Agile où vous pourriez contribuer avec vos propres idées et propositions dans une équipe en constante amélioration Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La possibilité :
• Responsable du traitement en temps voulu des cas individuels (questions d'enquête, de plainte, de déclaration éventuelle et de sécurité) conformément aux exigences et règlements du système qualité ISO, et des besoins des organisations de pays, y compris la création, l'acceptation, la classification, l'enquête, la documentation complète, le dépannage sur place et le règlement des cas.
• Résoudre les cas dans le domaine assigné, ce qui pourrait nécessiter des consultations avec des membres plus expérimentés de l'équipe sur les aspects techniques ou liés aux processus.
• Interface avec les affiliés et prise en charge de la communication en temps voulu d'informations de qualité aux organisations de pays. Appuie les initiatives et les mesures visant à maintenir des interfaces renforcées avec les organisations de pays et les représentants régionaux.
• Analyser les données en utilisant des mesures statistiques pour déterminer un problème potentiel de performance du produit.
• Responsable de l'escalade des affaires qui ne peuvent être résolues directement à des niveaux appropriés et de l'ouverture d'une enquête plus approfondie et de la communication, le cas échéant, de l'information dérivée des affaires.
• S'assurer que les dossiers sont conformes aux processus, aux normes et aux règlements établis en matière de qualité. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un diplôme en bioinformatique, en biologie informatique, en génie biomédical, en informatique ou en informatique.
• De solides compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé) sont essentielles
• Une expérience de travail dans le domaine des logiciels ou de la bioinformatique et/ou des fonctions de soutien est souhaitée.
• Expérience de lecture du code source
• La compréhension des plateformes de calcul en nuage ainsi que l'expérience de gestion sur l'infrastructure de base (y compris les serveurs et les clusters de calcul à haute performance) est souhaitée.
• Vous pouvez lire et ou déboguer le code source de différents langages de programmation pour comprendre la cause profonde des problèmes signalés. Si vous êtes :
• Vous cherchez l'occasion de poursuivre votre carrière tout en mélangeant les domaines techniques (IT) et médicaux.
• Apprentisseur de technologie rapide.
• Un joueur d'équipe qui croit vraiment que nous pouvons aller plus loin ensemble.
• Ne pas avoir peur d'échouer et d'apprendre.
• Confortable avec l'incertitude.
• La recherche d'un but où votre travail aura un impact réel sur la vie des patients. Votre travail

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Specjalista / Specjalistka ds. Serwisu Technicznego (Service Engineer)

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty lub Specjalistki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa kujawsko-pomorskiego:

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa kujawsko-pomorskiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne specjalności)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Atrakcyjny pakiet benefitów

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego

• Stanowisko z możliwością wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests condu

jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ GI
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 辽宁区域

titleByLocale.en: 区域经理 - 市场准入- 辽宁区域
titleByLocale.de: 区域经理 - 市场准 boiling- 辽宁区域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position)（职位的首要职能）

• 建立并维系 与区域政府决策部门及核心智囊机构的战略合作关系； 制定并落地 区域市场准入策略，推动产品 加速纳入 多层次医疗保障体系并实现报销覆盖最大化； 深度协同 区域业务团队，确保持续、顺畅的医保落地与报销执行。 Establish and cultivate strategic partnerships with regional government authorities and key think tanks. Formulate and execute regional market access strategies to accelerate product inclusion into multi-level reimbursement schemes and maximize coverage. Collaborate closely with the Regional Business Team to ensure seamless reimbursement implementation.

• 确保区域准入策略与产品核心策略的深度协同 ；基于全生命周期管理要求及新政策环境，制定并落地区域市场准入计划。通过 优化医保报销政策 、 前瞻性化解准入风险与壁垒 ，持续最大化患者的用药可及性。 Ensure strategic alignment between regional market access initiatives and core product strategies. Formulate and execute regional access plans grounded in lifecycle management and the evolving policy landscape. Optimize reimbursement policies , proactively mitigate risks and barriers , and maximize patient accessibility.

• 确保中央准入策略在团队内的协同与高效执行 ；建立并维护区域内医疗及卫生技术（HTA）领域的关键利益相关者关系； 全方位支持 从中央到省级及区域层面的市场准入工作。 Ensure alignment and execution of central market access strategies within the team. Manage key stakeholders in the medical and health technology (HTA) sectors. Provide comprehensive support for market access initiatives at national, provincial, and regional levels.

• 构建并运营 区域市场准入平台，确立与政府部门的 长期战略合作 机制，统筹相关项目的落地实施。 深度研判 区域医药政策趋势，为业务决策提供智力支持，并 赋能 区域业务团队，确保政策信息的精准传达与应用。 Establish and operate regional market access platforms , ensuring the effective execution of collaborative projects. Cultivate long-term strategic partnerships with government authorities. Analyze and interpret key regional healthcare policies to support business decision-making, while empowering local commercial teams with actionable policy intelligence.

• 构建区域跨职能协作与资源整合平台 ，统筹各部门资源以最大化利用效率； 强化 部门间协调机制，确保公司级项目中的深度协同，共同 驱动 区域业务目标的达成。 Establish a cross-functional collaboration and resource integration platform within the region. Orchestrate inter-departmental coordination to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring seamless synergy on corporate projects to drive the achievement of business objectives.

Q ualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications教育程度 / 所获资格证书 : 本科及以上, 医学、药学、药经或相关领域优先考虑
Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry and policy affairs. 至少 2 年医药行业及政策事务相关工作经验。

• Specialization: Possess at least 4 years (please verify) of experience in reimbursement account management. 具备至少 2 年政府客户管理经验。

• Project Management: Proven track record in project management and execution. 具备出色的项目管理与落地执行能力。

• Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication and networking skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong professional relationships. 卓越的人际沟通与影响力，善于建立并维护稳固的业务关系网。

• Personal Attributes: Proactive, passionate, and highly self-motivated. 工作积极主动，富有激情，具备高度的自我驱动力。

• Teamwork: Strong sense of accountability, dedication, and a collaborative team spirit. 强烈的责任心与敬业精神，优秀的团队协作意识。

• Language: Proficiency in written and spoken English. 优秀的英语听说读写能力（可作为工作语言）。

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in data analysis and presentation (PowerPoint/Excel). 精通 PPT 制作及数据分析技能。
