jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to develop novel therapeutics that will have an impact on patient lives. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, the Computational Biology and Medicine department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease pathogenesis, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across Roche, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Neuroscience and Rare Diseases therapeutic area. In this role, you will be a key member of an interdisciplinary team dedicated to advancing our understanding of neurological diseases. As Roche continues to build and advance its capabilities in computational and data-driven R&D, this position offers an integral role in our strategy. You will identify novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers by analyzing high-dimensional data. You will collaborate closely with leading laboratory scientists and clinicians, contributing directly to a pipeline of innovative medicines for patients with neurodegenerative and neuroinflammation diseases. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit of the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

• Lead the analysis of high-dimensional datasets such as single-cell, spatial, proteomics, metabolomics, and human genetics data to support therapeutic and biomarker development

• Collaborate closely with the AI/ML Foundation Model development teams and apply advanced quantitative methods, supporting drug discovery projects in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases.

• Deliver clear and objective data-driven insights to inform portfolio decision-making

Collaboration & Strategy

• Contribute to the data and analytics strategy for Neuroscience and Rare Diseases efforts in collaboration with partners in the therapeutic area

• Develop effective working relationships with key stakeholders in the disease therapeutic area, laboratory teams, and computational teams

Team & Culture

• Contribute to a collaborative workplace culture of scientific rigor, continuous improvement, and open feedback

• Support the scientific growth of team members by sharing knowledge and expertise

Who you are

You are a dedicated scientist with a strong background in applying computational methods to biological problems. You are motivated by scientific challenges and have a clear interest in translating data into meaningfu

In Partnerschaft mit unseren Wissenschaftlern über Roche schaffen wir bessere Medikamente, indem wir jeden Teil der FuE durch unsere datenorientierte Kultur verstärken. Die Gelegenheit: Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem hochmotivierten Informatiker, der sich unserem Neurowissenschaften und Seltenen Krankheiten therapeutisch anschließt. In dieser Rolle werden Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied eines interdisziplinären Teams sein, das sich dem Verständnis neurologischer Erkrankungen widmet. Da Roche weiterhin seine Fähigkeiten im rechnerischen und datengetriebenen FuE-Bereich baut und vorantreibt, bietet diese Position eine integrale Rolle in unserer Strategie. Sie werden neue therapeutische Ziele und Biomarker identifizieren, indem Sie hochdimensionale Daten analysieren. Sie arbeiten eng mit führenden Laborwissenschaftlern und Klinikern zusammen und tragen direkt zu einer Pipeline innovativer Medikamente für Patienten mit neurodegenerativen und neuroinflammatorischen Erkrankungen bei. Sie werden auch Teil der umfangreichen Computational Biology and Medicine Unit des Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence sein, die sich auf die gemeinsame Erfahrung und Expertise von Kollegen weltweit stützt. Datenanalyse & Insight Generation
• Führen Sie die Analyse von hochdimensionalen Datensätzen wie Einzelzellen-, Raum-, Proteomik-, Metabolomik- und Humangenetikdaten zur Unterstützung der therapeutischen und biomarkerischen Entwicklung
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams der AI/ML Foundation Model und Anwendung fortschrittlicher quantitativer Methoden, Unterstützung von Drogenentdeckungsprojekten in Neurowissenschaften und seltenen Krankheiten.
• Klare und objektive datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse liefern, um Portfolioentscheidungen zu informieren Zusammenarbeit und Strategie
• Beitrag zur Daten- und Analysestrategie für Neurowissenschaften und Seltene Krankheiten in Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern im therapeutischen Bereich
• Entwicklung wirksamer Arbeitsbeziehungen mit den wichtigsten Akteuren im Bereich der Krankheitstherapie, Laborteams und Computerteams Team & Kultur
• Beitrag zu einer kollaborativen Arbeitsplatzkultur wissenschaftlicher Strenge, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und offenem Feedback
• Unterstützung des wissenschaftlichen Wachstums von Teammitgliedern durch Austausch von Wissen und Know-how Wer bist du? Sie sind ein engagierter Wissenschaftler mit einem starken Hintergrund bei der Anwendung von Rechenmethoden auf biologische Probleme. Sie sind von wissenschaftlichen Herausforderungen motiviert und haben ein klares Interesse an der Umsetzung von Daten in Bedeutungfu

jobs.title: China Technical Regulatory (CMC) Policy Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chef de file de la politique de réglementation technique de la Chine

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

• Provide Leadership, oversight and execution of technical regulatory policy activities for the Roche Pharma Group relevant to China including the development of Roche policy positions on key topics relevant to Pharma Technical, and effective advocacy of such positions externally.

• Collaborate closely with the regulatory colleagues in China and globally to develop and execute the China regulatory policy roadmap

• Ensure alignment and stakeholder engagement within Pharma Technical Operations, Product Development, Pharma International, governmental affairs as well as external interest groups

Key Responsibilities and Tasks

Identify and enable regulatory policy activities in China such that Roche is globally recognized as an industry leader with health authority agencies and industry peer groups and that significant value is realized in facilitating pipeline development, marketing authorizations and excellence in manufacturing

Build and maintain relationships based on trust and respect with key health authority professionals, relevant academic and opinion leaders and non-profit scientific associations

Establish a strong partnership and networks with internal (i.e. Regulatory, Technical, Quality, Medical,, Gov. Affairs ) and external stakeholders

Ensure the development, execution and communication of the China regulatory policy roadmap

Lead strong cross-functional teams and regional/global regulatory communities of practice to drive policy change in China

Represent Roche technical regulatory policy views in China (and beyond) during external stakeholder engagement

Take leadership in local, regional and/or global associations (e.g. RDPAC, BIO, IFPMA…) and/or governmental organizations (e.g. APEC, ICH) in line with the Roche positions .

Provide leadership and consultancy to Roche Pharma Division leaders on regulatory policy and strategy related topics affecting China

Act as subject matter expert for key technical regulatory policy and strategy areas as assigned, lead the development of specified Global Regulatory Policy positions in close collaboration with SMEs.

Build influencing and advocacy knowledge and capacity and empowers other colleagues to shape the regulatory environment

Core Competencies, Skills
Excellent collaboration skills

Recognized expert in relevant CMC technical/regulatory area with established external credibility as thought leader

Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with global health authorities

Strong team player and communicator

Creates an environment of strong team spirit, good communication, high motivation, inspire cross-functional project teams

Excellent advocacy, communication and presentation skills

Strategic thinking and analytical skills, ability to simplify complex topics and to pull it all together to strategic planning.

Challenges the status quo to drive innovation

Ability to operate successfully in a global matrix environment with shared accountability and responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience

Degree in relevant technical area ( Analytical, Biochemistry, Biology, Pharmacy)

At least 10 years of work experience in relevant area or advanced degree (PhD) in relevant technical area combined with a minimum of 5 yrs work experience

Previous experience in Regulatory (Industry or Agency) is preferred

In depth Knowledge of China regulatory environment

Previous participation and proven effectiveness in international regulatory/industry forums is highly preferr

titleByLocale.it: Partner di Business Amministrativo Senior - SPG

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Administrative Business Partner - SPG

As a Senior Administrative Business Partner, you will independently manage complex administrative functions, including high-level scheduling, project coordination, managing POs, accruals, and event planning. In this role, you will interact with key internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure smooth communication and efficient workflows.
By applying your advanced financial management knowledge and proficiency in organizational tools, you will play a significant role in team strategy, proactively streamline administrative processes, and handle a wide range of problems with autonomy to contribute to our operational goals.

Join us in our Warsaw or Poznań office 2 days per week - a hybrid approach designed to balance focused remote work with high-impact, in-person collaboration.

The Opportunity:

• Independently manage complex administrative functions, high-level scheduling, and project coordination.

• Demonstrate advanced knowledge of financial processes, managing POs, invoices, and accruals while providing input on workflow improvements.

• Solve problems independently and take full ownership of projects to optimize efficiency with minimal supervision.

• Interact with both internal and external stakeholders, including senior management and key clients to ensure seamless communication and professional relationship management.

• Support team strategy and operational goals by proactively identifying and streamlining administrative process improvements.

• Manage high-complexity tasks and intricate scheduling for large teams or multiple projects with sharp attention to detail.

• Utilize advanced proficiency in organizational systems, office tools, and project management software to drive procedures.

Who you are:

• Experience in high-level scheduling, project coordination, and large-scale event logistics.

• Proven ability to drive initiatives from initiation to completion with full autonomy.

• Skilled in stakeholder relationship management.

• Advanced skills in office management software and project management platforms to drive departmental efficiency.

• Experience managing financial workflows, specifically PO creation, invoice processing, and financial accruals.

• Strong command of organizational systems and procedures, with a focus on implementing best practices.

• Demonstrated success in identifying and refining operational workflows to significantly increase team efficiency.

• Proven ability to maintain high accuracy while effectively managing high-density workloads and rapidly shifting priorities.

• Flexible availability to align with various time zones and management needs.

• Full professional proficiency in English.

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę).

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter).

• Take Time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more!

INTERESTED? APPLY!
If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Partner di Business Amministrativo Senior - SPG In qualità di Senior Administration Business Partner, gestirai in modo indipendente funzioni amministrative complesse, tra cui pianificazione di alto livello, coordinamento dei progetti, gestione dei PO, accruals e pianificazione degli eventi. In questo ruolo, si interagirà con i principali stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui la gestione senior, per garantire una comunicazione fluida e flussi di lavoro efficienti. Applicando la vostra conoscenza e la competenza della gestione finanziaria avanzata negli strumenti organizzativi, si svolgerà un ruolo significativo nella strategia del team, razionalizzare proattivamente i processi amministrativi e gestire una vasta gamma di problemi con autonomia per contribuire ai nostri obiettivi operativi. Unisciti a noi nel nostro ufficio di Varsavia o Poznań 2 giorni alla settimana - un approccio ibrido progettato per bilanciare il lavoro remoto focalizzato con la collaborazione di alto impatto in persona. L'opportunità:
• Gestione indipendente di funzioni amministrative complesse, pianificazione di alto livello e coordinamento del progetto.
• Dimostrare la conoscenza avanzata dei processi finanziari, la gestione dei PO, delle fatture e delle accruals, fornendo al contempo input sui miglioramenti del flusso di lavoro.
• Risolvere i problemi in modo indipendente e prendere la piena proprietà dei progetti per ottimizzare l'efficienza con una supervisione minima.
• Interagire con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, tra cui la gestione senior e i clienti chiave per garantire la comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità e la gestione dei rapporti professionali.
• Supporta la strategia del team e gli obiettivi operativi attraverso l'identificazione proattiva e la semplificazione dei miglioramenti dei processi amministrativi.
• Gestire attività ad alta complessità e pianificazione intricata per grandi team o progetti multipli con una forte attenzione ai dettagli.
• Utilizzare la competenza avanzata in sistemi organizzativi, strumenti per ufficio e software di gestione del progetto per guidare le procedure. Chi sei:
• Esperienza nella pianificazione di alto livello, coordinamento del progetto e logistica di eventi su larga scala.
• Prove capacità di guidare iniziative dall'avvio al completamento con piena autonomia.
• Abilitato nella gestione delle relazioni degli stakeholder.
• competenze avanzate nel software di gestione dell'ufficio e piattaforme di gestione del progetto per guidare l'efficienza del reparto.
• Esperienza di gestione dei flussi di lavoro finanziari, in particolare la creazione di PO, l'elaborazione delle fatture e l'accumulazione finanziaria.
• Forte comando di sistemi e procedure organizzative, con l'obiettivo di implementare le migliori pratiche.
• Successo dimostrato nell'identificazione e nella raffinazione dei flussi di lavoro operativi per aumentare significativamente l'efficienza del team.
• comprovata capacità di mantenere alta precisione, gestendo efficacemente i carichi di lavoro ad alta densità e spostando rapidamente le priorità.
• Disponibilità flessibile per allineare con vari fusi orari e esigenze di gestione.
• Completa competenza professionale in inglese. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Contratto di lavoro (Umowa o pracę).
• Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione sulla vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Administrative Business Partner - SPG As a Senior Administrative Business Partner, you will independently manage complex administrative functions, including high-level scheduling, project coordination, managing POs, accruals, and event planning. In this role, you will interact with key internal and external stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure smooth communication and efficient workflows. By applying your advanced financial management knowledge and proficiency in organizational tools, you will play a significant role in team strategy, proactively streamline administrative processes, and handle a wide range of problems with autonomy to contribute to our operational goals. Join us in our Warsaw or Poznań office 2 days per week - a hybrid approach designed to balance focused remote work with high-impact, in-person collaboration. The Opportunity:
• Independently manage complex administrative functions, high-level scheduling, and project coordination.
• Demonstrate advanced knowledge of financial processes, managing POs, invoices, and accruals while providing input on workflow improvements.
• Solve problems independently and take full ownership of projects to optimize efficiency with minimal supervision.
• Interact with both internal and external stakeholders, including senior management and key clients to ensure seamless communication and professional relationship management.
• Support team strategy and operational goals by proactively identifying and streamlining administrative process improvements.
• Manage high-complexity tasks and intricate scheduling for large teams or multiple projects with sharp attention to detail.
• Utilize advanced proficiency in organizational systems, office tools, and project management software to drive procedures. Who you are:
• Experience in high-level scheduling, project coordination, and large-scale event logistics.
• Proven ability to drive initiatives from initiation to completion with full autonomy.
• Skilled in stakeholder relationship management.
• Advanced skills in office management software and project management platforms to drive departmental efficiency.
• Experience managing financial workflows, specifically PO creation, invoice processing, and financial accruals.
• Strong command of organizational systems and procedures, with a focus on implementing best practices.
• Demonstrated success in identifying and refining operational workflows to significantly increase team efficiency.
• Proven ability to maintain high accuracy while effectively managing high-density workloads and rapidly shifting priorities.
• Flexible availability to align with various time zones and management needs.
• Full professional proficiency in English. What you get:
• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę).
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter).
• Take Time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).
• Stock share purchase additions.
• Yearly sales of company equipment and many more! INTERESTED? APPLY! If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it. The controller of your personal data is Roch

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Partenaire administratif principal - SPG En tant que partenaire administratif principal, vous gérerez de façon indépendante des fonctions administratives complexes, y compris la planification de haut niveau, la coordination de projet, la gestion des OP, les charges à payer et la planification des événements. Dans ce rôle, vous interagirez avec les principaux intervenants internes et externes, y compris la haute direction, pour assurer une communication fluide et des flux de travail efficaces. En appliquant vos connaissances avancées en gestion financière et vos compétences en outils organisationnels, vous jouerez un rôle important dans la stratégie de l'équipe, simplifierez les processus administratifs de façon proactive et traiterez un large éventail de problèmes avec autonomie pour contribuer à nos objectifs opérationnels. Rejoignez-nous dans notre bureau de Varsovie ou Poznań 2 jours par semaine - une approche hybride conçue pour équilibrer le travail à distance ciblé avec la collaboration en personne à impact élevé. La possibilité :
• Gérer indépendamment les fonctions administratives complexes, le calendrier de haut niveau et la coordination des projets.
• Démontrer une connaissance approfondie des processus financiers, gérer les OP, les factures et les charges à payer tout en fournissant des informations sur l'amélioration des flux de travail.
• Résoudre les problèmes de manière indépendante et prendre pleinement en charge les projets pour optimiser l'efficacité avec une supervision minimale.
• Interagir avec les parties prenantes internes et externes, y compris la haute direction et les clients clés, afin d'assurer une communication transparente et une gestion des relations professionnelles.
• Appuyer la stratégie de l'équipe et les objectifs opérationnels en identifiant et en rationalisant les améliorations apportées aux processus administratifs.
• Gérer des tâches à haute complexité et des horaires complexes pour de grandes équipes ou plusieurs projets avec une attention particulière aux détails.
• Utiliser des compétences avancées dans les systèmes organisationnels, les outils de bureau et les logiciels de gestion de projet pour conduire les procédures. Qui vous êtes :
• Expérience en planification de haut niveau, en coordination de projets et en logistique d'événements à grande échelle.
• Capacité éprouvée de conduire les initiatives de l'initiation à l'achèvement en toute autonomie.
• Compétence en gestion des relations avec les parties prenantes.
• Compétences avancées en logiciels de gestion de bureau et en plates-formes de gestion de projet pour stimuler l'efficacité du département.
• Expérience de la gestion des flux de travail financiers, en particulier la création de PO, le traitement des factures et la comptabilité d'exercice.
• Une bonne maîtrise des systèmes et procédures organisationnels, l'accent étant mis sur la mise en oeuvre des meilleures pratiques.
• Le succès démontré dans l'identification et le perfectionnement des flux de travail opérationnels afin d'accroître considérablement l'efficacité de l'équipe.
• Capacité éprouvée de maintenir une précision élevée tout en gérant efficacement les charges de travail à forte densité et en changeant rapidement les priorités.
• Disponibilité flexible pour s'aligner sur différents fuseaux horaires et besoins de gestion.
• Compétence professionnelle complète en anglais. Ce que vous obtenez:
• Contrat de travail (Umowa o pracę).
• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance.
• Soins de santé privés (paquets LuxMed), assurance-vie collective (UNUM) et multisports.
• Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre).
• Programme de prise de temps (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin).
• Emplacement flexible (possibilité d'effectuer notre travail à partir de différents endroits du monde pour une certaine période de temps).
• Prenez du temps pour la charité (un congé payé supplémentaire de 2 semaines maximum pour participer à l'action de charité de votre choix).
• Ajouts d'actions.
• Ventes annuelles de matériel d'entreprise et beaucoup plus! Intéressant ? S'il vous plaît ! Si vous pensez que cette offre convient à un de vos amis, n'hésitez pas à la partager. Le responsable de vos données personnelles est Roch

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
1.Filling the registration dossiers and get the approval according to the registration plan with compliance the regulations and SOP manner.
2.Make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers. Maintain the registration and approved dossiers per company requirements.
3.Per company requirements, cross check for the registration dossier to make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers.
4.Establish and maintain the good and closed relationship with NMPAtesting centers. And successfully gains product QC testing reports per registration forecast plan.
5.Close working together with COand CCOEteamsto provide the regulatory supports on time.
6.Provide the cross cooperation with other department.
7.Establish and maintain the good relationship with key contacts. Recommend valuable suggestion to company.

Main Tasks& 
• Responsibilities:
1.Prepare the registration dossier to submit to NMPA and obtain the approval to meet the registration plan.
2. Make sure the accuracy and truthfulness of the registration dossiers and maintain all the submission and approved dossiers in related IT systems, share points, V drive,and notify all the stakeholders per company SOP requirements.
3.Complete the related payment procedure in systems on time, place order for FOC for the QC testing.
4. Active join the discussion and verification of in the national standard or panel verification or national/industrial standard discussion and verification.Guide and influence the formulation of Standards
5. Working together with global team, to draft the PTR and complete the type testing on time if needed.
6. Active involve the regulation, guidance discussion, provide the feedback to authority aligned with Roche Regulatory Strategy.Guide and influence the formulation of guidelines.
7. As a member of RD, provide active and strong regulatory supports to internal dep. as needed.
8. Initiatively deal with daily works. Keep records. Have clear filing and maintain of all documents, update information on time based on relevant requirements.
9. Productively work-share in multi-functional teams with different perspectives and approaches. Proactively resolve issues; Build effective networks and maintain efficient cross-functional collaboration.
10. Proactively identify and assess regulations and relative changes, and contribute constructive ideas on key project registration strategies.
11. Handle risk assessment, risk levels and risk analysis; Proactively anticipate regulatory risks throughout the product line lifecycle, and figure out the mitigation plan in advance.
12. Figure out registration strategies, and propose innovative registration strategies with appropriately regulation and resources, to accelerate the product launch.
13. Manage stakeholder expectations from BAs' perspective; proactively and strategically facilitate project completion for cross-functional teams while ensuring time limit, budgets and compliance.
14. Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager.
15. Conduct business in full compliance including but not limited to Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, Roche Safety, Security Health and Environmental Protection.
16. Understand and fulfill the responsibility of line manager's SHE tasks and duties (as defined in SHE handbook).

Roche Pharmaceuticals

Job Purpose

The Patient Safety Partner (Lead) is accountable for the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies) and sets the strategic direction for patient safety including risk management within the Affiliate, ensuring alignment with IPS priorities and local business needs.

Key Responsibilities

General

• Lead/facilitate APS strategy and planning to enable effective prioritisation for impact.

• Collaborate strategically with the Country Cluster Lead, Safety Net, Affiliate PV Net, Patient Safety Operations, and affiliate leadership by leveraging country safety insights to determine priorities, shape organisational strategies, and influence regional and global decisions.

PV System

• Act as the local single point of contact for safety-related aspects , internally and externally, including the local regulatory authority.
(In Case of a formal requirement for a local QPPV /Local PV Officer (depending on the wording of local legislation) replace with the following):
Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV): As the named and qualified point of contact, the Local Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) holds responsibility for both establishing and maintaining the local PV system, and for guaranteeing adherence to local requirements mandated by the local Regulatory Authority.

• Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of local PV processes and PV oversight ensuring they are effective and efficient, while driving continuous improvement and alignment with evolving needs and requirements globally and locally. Ensure appropriate escalation and action taken in case of compliance gaps.

• Enable operational excellence and maintain oversight* of safety-related activities relevant to the PV system through collaboration with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, by ensuring that day-to-day operations are executed effectively and efficiently to maintain the monitoring of the safety profile of Roche medicinal products and medical devices and their safety risk management, meet regulatory requirements, and ensure license to operate.
Key areas of oversight/activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):

• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection and submissions to HA)

• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products

• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to HA)

• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)

• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)

• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)

• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments

• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File

*Oversight includes activities to ensure that the local PV system is in line with local regulatory requirements and internal procedures including the review of relevant compliance metrics.

• Lead in shaping country PV regulation and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, in particular in order to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with, and not limited to, pharma trade associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc, where applicable.

• Ensure business continuity and coordinate APS

jobs.title: Patient Safety Partner

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la sécurité des patients

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceuticals

Job Purpose
Support the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies), to ensure an efficient and effective PV system that complies with global Roche and local legal/regulatory authority PV requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate.
Support the execution of IPS & Affiliate’s Patient Safety (APS) strategies, ensuring high-quality implementation of global and local safety solutions, while demonstrating leadership in ownership, collaboration, and decision-making within assigned responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

PV System

• Execution of safety-related activities relevant to the PV system through partnership with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, to ensure monitoring of the safety profile of Roche products and their safety risk management, meet regulatory requirements, and ensure license to operate. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize the PV system.

Key areas of activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):

• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection and reporting to HA)

• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products

• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. data collection and submission to HA)

• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)

• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)

• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)

• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments

• Local Pharmacovigilance System Master File

• As a contributor, shape country PV regulations and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, in particular in order to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with, and not limited to, local pharma industry associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc, where applicable.

Local Safety Risk Management

• Generate and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

Further responsibilities may include assuming additional roles (e.g. RMP IC, core or extended member of the Affiliate Safety Disease Area Communities (ASDACs), Safety Responsible for MAP and DiCELA, Disease Area Expert, PV System Expert).

Education/Qualifications

• Qualification and/or Degree in life science or healthcare-related discipline (e.g., PharmD, Pharmacy, Nursing, Medicine, Master of Science, Bachelor of Science, etc.).

Experience

• 1-3 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

• Understanding of decision-makin

jobs.title: Senior Medical Writer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2 office days/week on average).
The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.
Position Summary

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focussing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

Key accountabilities:

• Apply your broad knowledge of medical writing for the pharmaceutical industry, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including medical, scientific, and commercial partners, to understand client needs and develop tailored and effective scientific content for digital implementation

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines

• Ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Monitor assigned tasks and manage own workload, taking ownership and anticipating capacity issues and potential solutions

• As a trained and experienced senior medical writer you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to other medical writers in the team, as well as new writers joining the team

• As a senior medical writer you will be a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications as well as lead the team in assigned, specific therapeutic areas.

Key responsibilities:

• Your role will require taking responsibility and ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, local and international

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders and to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses to queries

• Diligently keep u

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about people, communication, and making a real difference in a global organization? If you excel at coaching, building relationships, and solving complex problems, we want you! Join our People Support Solutions team as a Talent Acquisition Specialist and leverage your expertise in human interaction to launch a career in global talent acquisition.

The Opportunity:

• Launch your career in Talent Acquisition by learning to manage the full recruiting lifecycle within a supportive global team.

• Act as a key communication partner for hiring managers and senior leaders, applying your coaching and interpersonal skills to guide them through the hiring process.

• Learn to conduct in-depth candidate assessments, focusing on evaluating core competencies and fit.

• Manage and optimize the candidate experience, ensuring clear, consistent communication from application to offer.

• Utilize advanced HR technology (Workday) to streamline recruiting activities and support crucial data management.

• Collaborate closely on internal talent management efforts, including succession planning and internal mobility, applying a strategic lens to organizational needs.

• Contribute to process innovation, helping us challenge the status quo and continuously improve our talent search strategies.

Who You Are:

• Advanced language skills in German and English (both written and spoken) are mandatory.

• You bring 3+ years of senior experience in a people-focused field (e.g., teaching, therapy, counseling, psychology, advanced customer relationship management, or translation etc.) where strong communication and coaching were central

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science or equivalent work experience is required.

• You possess a strong customer-centric, growth, and agile mindset, thriving in ambiguous and multicultural environments.

• You demonstrate proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to manage expectations and build trust with diverse partners.

• You are capable of working independently, effectively managing multiple, competing priorities, and driving toward results with a positive attitude.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please note that the position official name is Talent Acquisition Partner.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

jobs.title: Principal Real World Data Scientist

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal de données sur le monde réel

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

In Roche's Research and Early Development organisations, we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient’s response to treatment by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

The Opportunity:

This position will focus on delivering world-leading real-world data (RWD) analytical capabilities at scale. You will play a senior scientific role within the Real World Data Insights team in Computational Medicine.

Together with other real-world data experts and collaboration partners, you will lead the design and execution of complex, high-impact RWD studies, improving our understanding of disease biology, informing biomarker strategies and generating actionable insights into patient populations and treatment outcome prediction. You will drive the integration of diverse real-world data sources (e.g., EHR, claims, registries, and linked datasets) and apply advanced analytical approaches to inform clinical development decisions. You will influence and optimize study designs, patient eligibility criteria, and endpoint strategies, ensuring that RWD is effectively leveraged across the drug development lifecycle. You will operate as a trusted strategic partner to senior stakeholders, translating complex analytical findings into impactful decisions.

As part of the Computational Biology and Medicine department, you will contribute to the broader scientific and technical strategy, drawing on global expertise and driving best practices in RWD analysis. You will also play a key role in mentoring and developing talent, and establishing methodological standards and scalable analytical solutions.

The Real World Data Insights team is collectively accountable for delivering critical insights for the portfolio. Your success is measured not only by your individual contributions but by your ability to lead, influence, and drive impact across teams and the broader organization, delivering high-value insights for the portfolio and ultimately for patients.

In this role you will:

• Strategic Decision Support: Lead the design and execution of complex data analyses to guide investment and clinical decisions across early-phase programs.

• Methodological Excellence: Ensure all RWD outputs are reproducible, statisticall

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Nelle organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche, facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non meritevoli del mondo. Siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza è un’organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED e gRED) di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adept e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All’interno del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza, la Medicina Computazionale si concentra sullo sviluppo e l’applicazione di soluzioni innovative per l’analisi dei dati per supportare lo sviluppo clinico migliorando la nostra comprensione della malattia, della progressione della malattia e della risposta del paziente individuale al trattamento, avendo accesso ai più grandi dataset R&D Pharma al mondo. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. L'opportunità: Questa posizione si concentrerà sulla fornitura di capacità analitiche leader mondiale di dati reali (RWD) in scala. Si svolgerà un ruolo scientifico senior all'interno del team Real World Data Insights in medicina computazionale. Insieme ad altri esperti di dati reali e partner di collaborazione, guiderai la progettazione e l'esecuzione di studi RWD complessi e ad alto impatto, migliorando la nostra comprensione della biologia delle malattie, informando le strategie di biomarcatore e generando intuizioni attuabili sulle popolazioni dei pazienti e la previsione dei risultati del trattamento. Potrai guidare l'integrazione di diverse fonti di dati reali (ad esempio, EHR, reclami, registri e dataset collegati) e applicare approcci analitici avanzati per informare le decisioni di sviluppo clinico. Potrai influenzare e ottimizzare i progetti di studio, i criteri di eleggibilità dei pazienti e le strategie di endpoint, assicurando che RWD sia effettivamente sfruttato attraverso il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del farmaco. Potrai operare come partner strategico di fiducia per gli stakeholder senior, traducendo i risultati analitici complessi in decisioni di impatto. Nell'ambito del dipartimento di Biologia e Medicina Computazionale, contribuirai alla più ampia strategia scientifica e tecnica, attingendo alle competenze globali e alle migliori pratiche nell'analisi RWD. Potrai anche svolgere un ruolo chiave nel mentoring e nello sviluppo del talento, e stabilire standard metodologici e soluzioni analitiche scalabili. Il team Real World Data Insights è responsabile collettivamente per fornire informazioni critiche per il portafoglio. Il vostro successo è misurato non solo dai vostri contributi individuali, ma dalla vostra capacità di condurre, influenzare e guidare l'impatto tra le squadre e l'organizzazione più ampia, fornendo intuizioni di alto valore per il portafoglio e, infine, per i pazienti. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Supporto decisionale strategico: guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di analisi di dati complesse per guidare gli investimenti e le decisioni cliniche nei programmi di fase iniziale.
• Eccellenza metodologica: assicurarsi che tutte le uscite RWD siano riproducibili, statistica

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. In Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Wir sind vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Das Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence ist eine globale Organisation, die es Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungseinheiten (pRED und gRED) ermöglicht, datengesteuerter, digitaler adeptischer und besser auf die Herausforderungen der Zukunft vorbereitet zu werden. Im Exzellenzzentrum Computational Sciences konzentriert sich die Computational Medicine auf die Entwicklung und Anwendung innovativer Datenanalyselösungen, um die klinische Entwicklung zu unterstützen, die unser Verständnis für Krankheit, Krankheitsfortschritt und die Reaktion des einzelnen Patienten auf die Behandlung durch den Zugang zu den größten Pharma-FuE-Datensätzen der Welt fördert. In Partnerschaft mit unseren Wissenschaftlern über pRED und GRED schaffen wir bessere Medikamente, indem wir jeden Teil der FuE durch unsere datenbasierte Kultur verstärken. Die Gelegenheit: Diese Position konzentriert sich auf die Bereitstellung von weltweit führenden realen Daten (RWD) analytische Fähigkeiten im Maßstab. Sie werden eine hochrangige wissenschaftliche Rolle im Real World Data Insights Team in der Computational Medicine spielen. Gemeinsam mit anderen Real-World-Datenexperten und Kooperationspartnern führen Sie die Konzeption und Durchführung komplexer, hocheffizienter RWD-Studien, das Verständnis der Krankheitsbiologie, die Aufklärung von Biomarker-Strategien und die Erstellung von handlungsfähigen Erkenntnissen in Patientenpopulationen und Therapieergebnissen. Sie werden die Integration verschiedener realer Datenquellen (z.B. EHR, Forderungen, Registries und verknüpfte Datensätze) vorantreiben und erweiterte analytische Ansätze zur Information klinischer Entwicklungsentscheidungen anwenden. Sie beeinflussen und optimieren Studiendesigns, Patientenförderkriterien und Endpunktstrategien, um sicherzustellen, dass RWD über den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Arzneimittelentwicklung effektiv genutzt wird. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Partner für Senior Stakeholder tätig sein und komplexe analytische Erkenntnisse in effektvolle Entscheidungen übersetzen. Im Rahmen der Abteilung Computational Biology and Medicine tragen Sie zur breiteren wissenschaftlichen und technischen Strategie bei, die sich auf globales Know-how und bewährte Praktiken in der RWD-Analyse stützt. Sie werden auch eine wichtige Rolle bei der Mentorisierung und Entwicklung von Talenten spielen und methodische Standards und skalierbare analytische Lösungen festlegen. Das Real World Data Insights Team ist kollektiv für die Bereitstellung kritischer Erkenntnisse für das Portfolio verantwortlich. Ihr Erfolg wird nicht nur durch Ihre individuellen Beiträge gemessen, sondern durch Ihre Fähigkeit, die Auswirkungen auf Teams und die breitere Organisation zu führen, zu beeinflussen und zu treiben, um hochwertige Erkenntnisse für das Portfolio und letztlich für Patienten zu liefern. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Strategische Entscheidungsunterstützung: Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Durchführung komplexer Datenanalysen, um Investitions- und klinische Entscheidungen über Frühphasenprogramme zu leiten.
• Methodologische Exzellenz: Alle RWD-Ausgänge sind reproduzierbar, statistisch
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Dans les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches (PRED et GRED) de devenir davantage axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles, la médecine computationnelle met l'accent sur l'élaboration et l'application de solutions novatrices d'analyse de données pour appuyer le développement clinique, ce qui nous permet de mieux comprendre la maladie, la progression de la maladie et la réponse individuelle des patients au traitement en ayant accès aux plus grands ensembles de données sur la R-D pharmaceutique au monde. Nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en partenariat avec nos scientifiques dans les domaines de la R-D et de la R-D, grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. La possibilité : Cette position mettra l'accent sur la fourniture à l'échelle de capacités d'analyse des données du monde réel. Vous jouerez un rôle scientifique senior au sein de l'équipe Real World Data Insights en Médecine Computationnelle. En collaboration avec d'autres experts en données du monde réel et des partenaires de collaboration, vous dirigerez la conception et l'exécution d'études complexes et à impact élevé sur la DAR, améliorerons notre compréhension de la biologie des maladies, éclairerez les stratégies des biomarqueurs et générerez des informations concrètes sur les populations de patients et la prédiction des résultats du traitement. Vous dirigerez l'intégration de diverses sources de données du monde réel (p. ex. DSE, revendications, registres et ensembles de données liés) et appliquerez des approches analytiques avancées pour éclairer les décisions de développement clinique. Vous influencerez et optimiserez les plans d'étude, les critères d'admissibilité des patients et les stratégies de fin de traitement, en veillant à ce que la DAR soit efficacement exploitée tout au long du cycle de développement des médicaments. jobs.title: Business Partnership Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position) （职位的首要职能）
1 、 销售策略与业务计划制定执行
根据公司整体品牌策略，制定并落地非目标医院、基层医疗等广阔市场的年度销售策略计划、区域分解与行动方案。
规划渠道销售模式，因地制宜，探索并制定适合不同市场类型的商业化模式
结合各地基药、医保、集采等政策，制定针对性销售策略，保障销售稳定增长。
2 、 渠道与外部合作伙伴管理
负责CSO及合作商业客户的筛选、评估、签约与日常管理和赋能，建立长期稳定和共赢的合作关系。
搭建外部合作团队的管理、考核与激励机制，提升合作方执行力、覆盖能力与推广效率。
定期走访关键渠道客户与合作伙伴，解决市场问题，推动终端覆盖与销量持续提升。
3 、 销售团队（ BPM ）管理与赋能
负责拓展渠道销售团队（BPM）的日常管理、目标拆解、过程追踪与绩效评估。
定期协访一线市场，指导区域销售拓展、客户开发与上量动作，提升团队实战能力。
联合市场、培训部门搭建销售能力体系，开展产品知识、学术推广、渠道开发等专项培训。
4 、 客户开发与学术销售联动
推动非核心医院、基层医疗机构等关键客户开发与关系维护。
联动市场部落地学术推广活动，将医学内容转化为销售动作，提升客户认可与处方转化。
根据一线市场信息、竞品动态与客户需求，制定策略并优化执行。
5 、销售项目管理与业绩达成
策划、落地各类销售提升项目，针对不同省份特点设计差异化上量方案。
监控销售数据、渠道库存、终端覆盖与投入产出，及时调整动作确保目标达成。
跨部门协同市场、医学、商务、供应链等部门，打通流程、解决障碍，保障业务高效运转。

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

• 教育背景
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 资格证书
・ 大学本科及以上学历
・ 医学、药学、市场营销及相关专业优先

• Leadership Competencies 领导者胜任力
・ 聚焦结果交付，高效驱动团队达成核心目标
・ 具备较强的人际敏锐度和学习敏锐度，拥抱不确定性，具备创新能力
・ 极强的目标感、结果导向、执行力与抗压能力
・优秀的团队辅导、跨部门协同及人际沟通能力

• Job Required Competencies 岗位核心胜任力
・ 10年以上医药行业销售管理/渠道拓展经验，有基层医疗、广阔市场、院外渠道经验
・ 具备商业政策设计与规划能力，尤其是0到1的落地经验； 经销商 / CSO 管理、商业渠道运作、基药 / 非公医疗开发经验者优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Site Manager - China Supplier & CDMO Operations

titleByLocale.it: Site Manager - Cina Fornitore e operazioni CDMO
titleByLocale.en: Site Manager - China Supplier & CDMO Operations
titleByLocale.de: Site Manager - China Supplier & CDMO Operations
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de site - Chine Fournisseur et opérations CDMO

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role
Roche's External Manufacturing organization is seeking an experienced Site Manager to lead China-based supplier and CDMO relationships and serve as the primary external manufacturing contact for China-originated product development and due diligence activities.
Based at our Shanghai facilities, you will manage a diverse supplier portfolio spanning small molecules, peptides, and biologics (including E. coli-derived products). You will own the end-to-end relationship with China CDMOs across the product lifecycle—from supplier selection and technology transfer (where appropriate) through commercial supply and decommissioning—while ensuring full alignment with Roche's quality, compliance, and operational standards.

Key Responsibilities
Supplier Selection & Partnership Development

• Lead due diligence activities to evaluate CDMO capacity, GMP compliance, and strategic fit

• Define outsourcing requirements, manage RFP processes, and drive supplier selection in collaboration with cross-functional teams

• Establish governance frameworks and long-term relationships with strategic CDMO partners

• Negotiate contracts and commercial terms in alignment with business objectives

Operational & Project Management

• Manage technology transfers, product launches, and development activities across multiple CDMOs

• Lead cross-functional project and joint management teams spanning development, quality, supply chain, and regulatory functions

• Monitor production performance, identify supply constraints, and drive continuous improvement initiatives

• Own budgets for prelaunch activities, commercial production, and technical projects

Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure GMP, quality, safety, and environmental standards are consistently met across all partner sites

• Coordinate corporate audits and drive implementation of corrective actions

• Perform regular risk reviews and define mitigation strategies with partners

• Maintain full regulatory and business compliance throughout all supplier relationships

Strategic Collaboration

• Partner with internal stakeholders ( Development, Technical and Business product Teams, procurement, regulatory, quality, Finance) to align supplier strategies with product development timelines and commercial objectives

• Serve as the primary relationship manager and escalation point for China CDMO matters

• Contribute to cost reduction initiatives and supply chain optimization across the product lifecycle

Who You Are
Experience & Education

• 10+ years in operations, manufacturing within a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical environment

• 5+ years managing complex, cross-functional projects or operational units

• 3+ years leading direct reports or equivalent experience in matrix/cross-functional team leadership

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or related field (MBA or advanced degree preferred)

• Demonstrated experience with contract manufacturers, drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP) development, and GMP compliance

Core Competencies

• Strategic agility: Balance long-term partnerships with adaptability to changing business needs

• Results-driven: Deliver superior outcomes by empowering teams and maintaining focus on key priorities

• Leadership & collaboration: Influence at all organizational levels with strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Business acumen: Understand cost-of-goods calculations and drive price negotiations

• Integrity & accountability: Upho

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Purpose:
Maintain the site’s Right to Operate and enable excellence in manufacturing by providing validation support to the production organization that results in safe, high quality, and continuously improving production.

Own, execute and improve the validation lifecycle from Plan to Retire, for manufacturing processes and equipment. This includes, but is not limited to oversight of Equipment, Facility, and Utility Qualification, Cleaning Validation, Shipping Validation in partnership with Distribution, and administration of the Periodic Review and Revalidation Program. Accountable for ensuring compliance with PQS and HA requirements.

Key 
• Responsibilities:
Support the day-to-day operation of approved Validation SOPs / Plan / Policies for a multi-platform, multi-product, GMP biotech contract manufacturing facility.
·Develop Validation SOPs, templates, guidelines, Validation Protocols and Reports including supporting site discrepancies and deviations investigation / closure in line with corporate policies and standards.
· Provide guidance and direction on all validation activities at the Singapore site.
· Ensure that all validation activities with respect to process, cleaning, facilities/equipment and computerized system stated in validation plan/ protocol are carried out in accordance with relevant policies, standards, procedures and guidelines, and completed in a timely fashion.
· Participate actively in investigations or troubleshooting discrepancies/ deviation encountered during commissioning and qualification.
·Generate training materials and to conduct workshops on general validation activities.
· Serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) in support of department functions.
· Participate in site Validation Maintenance Program.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a machine learning engineer in AI Enablement, you will be working closely with folks that span across Computational Scientists, Research Scientists, AI/ML experts, Product leaders, DevOps, and everyone in between. You'll build, own, and constantly improve scalable AI/ML based systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients.

• Design, develop, and test robust, scalable, and maintainable AI/ML facing scientific web applications and backend systems.

• Build tools to evaluate AI/ML model performance and establish new ways to understand AI quality.

• Partner with product managers and scientists to understand user needs, shape requirements, and translate them into actionable technical specifications.

• Develop and maintain systems for collecting, structuring, and storing diverse scientific data that support advanced analytics, machine learning, and other data-driven initiatives.

• Implement, adopt, or evaluate new AI/ML algorithms and analytical techniques

• Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and the evolution of our development processes.

• Be willing to span the stack and contribute where needed, even outside of your core area of expertise.

• Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices and adopt a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and curiosity.

•
Who You Are:

• Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science or similar technical field, or equivalent experience

• Established professional experience in machine learning engineering roles.

• Strong proficiency with AI/ML frameworks, libraries, and toolsets.

• Expert knowledge of statistics, machine learning theory, and algorithms.

• Strong knowledge of ML performance optimization, GPU best practices.

• Experience with kubernetes, relational databases, NoSQL databases, or data lakes, and experience working on cloud-native architectures in public clouds (ideally AWS).

• Proven understanding and application of engineering best practices.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with internal and external collaborators.

• Ability to quickly acquire new technologies and programming languages and a passion for continuous learning.

Preferred But Not Required:

• Experience with imaging or biological data and processes is a strong plus.

• Experience working with scientists or in a research environment is advantageous.

• Experience with workflow automation, GenAI, and/or agents is a plus.

Who We Are

We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial I

jobs.title: Data Product Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Data Products Specialist plays a key role in shaping and delivering analytics-ready data products that accelerate evidence generation and insight delivery. Sitting under the Data Product Lead, you will collaborate with engineering, governance, and domain teams to define data product specifications, design data pipelines, and ensure product usability and compliance. You will help translate scientific and operational needs into structured, scalable data products that enable reuse and facilitate insight generation across PD. This role requires strong experience in data modeling, product thinking, and an understanding of cross-functional data workflows in R&D.

• You support the development and maintenance of curated datasets and data marts used for clinical and operational insights

• You build proficiency in translating user needs into data product requirements, specifications, and roadmaps

• You understand organizational needs and data challenges that drive the need for foundational data products that improve interoperability, reusability, and downstream analysis

• You assist with data ingestion, cleaning, and standardization processes under the guidance of senior colleagues

• You participate in implementing and testing transformations to ensure data consistency, traceability, and alignment with business rules

• You document data sources, assumptions, and transformations to promote transparency and reuse

• You build relationships with business stakeholders and end-users to advocate for data products, fostering trust and enhancing value

• You contribute to troubleshooting data quality issues and collaborating with engineering or product partners to resolve blockers

• You contribute to KPIs and usage metrics tracking for continuous improvement

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related technical discipline

• You have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience working with structured data in support of analytics or reporting use cases, or an advanced degree with 0-2 years of equivalent work experience
