Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Domain Architect - Diagnostics R&D Der Domain Architect – Diagnostics R&D ist eine hochrangige, zentrale Position im Strategie-, Portfolio & Governance Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions Team. Diese Position spielt eine entscheidende Rolle zwischen der Strategie, Portfolio & Governance (SPG) Organisation und der Diagnostics R&D Funktion. Wenn Sie direkt an den Leiter der Unternehmensarchitektur Business Partnering Functions mit einer gepunkteten Linie an den Leiter der Dia RDT für DIA R&D melden, werden Sie unsere Unternehmensarchitektur-Praktiken unter tiefem Verständnis der einzigartigen Komplexitäten der Diagnostics R&D-Umgebung. Crucially, in unserem federated Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Modell, werden Sie als Hauptorchester des Diagnostics R&D-Architekturnetzwerks fungieren. Durch das Führen dieses Netzwerks – das sich neben allen Domänen- und Lösungsarchitekten einschließt, die direkt in der Diagnostics R&D-Organisation eingebettet sind – werden Sie die Governance und Strategieformulierung der Architektur vorantreiben, die Unternehmenskohärenz sicherstellen und Geschäftsziele in anpassungsfähige, zukunftsfähige Roadmaps übersetzen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Der Bereich Enterprise Architecture Business Partnering Functions dient als strategischer architektonischer Ansprechpartner für Business-Domain-Leiter und fördert die Zusammenarbeit, um Anwendungen, Business-Fähigkeiten und Informationsvermögen mit Technologielösungen auszurichten. Für die Diagnostics R&D-Domain beinhaltet dies eine tiefe Integration mit Teams wie DIA R&D Labs, DIA R&D Computational Science and Engineering, DIA R&D Instrumentation, DIA Clinical Development and Medical Affairs und DIA Portfolio & Project Management, um Effizienz und Innovation mit End-to-End-Rechenbarkeit zu steigern. Diese Rolle stellt sicher, dass die Brücke zwischen der Unternehmensvision von SPG und der operativen Durchführung von Diagnostics R&D nahtlos, kollaborativ und hochwirksam ist. Die Gelegenheit:
• Sie werden als strategische Verbindung zwischen SPG EA und Diagnostics R&D fungieren und mit der Führung zusammenarbeiten, um Geschäftsprioritäten mit mehrjährigen Fahrplänen auszurichten.
• Sie leiten das R&D-Architekturnetzwerk Diagnostics, formen gemeinsame strategische Prioritäten und ermöglichen Architekten, gleichzeitig die Ausrichtung des Unternehmens durchzuführen.
• Sie bieten Führung für die Aktivitäten der Architekturverwaltung, die Überwachung von Liefer- und Technologieschutzläufen, um Sicherheit und Widerstand zu gewährleisten.
• Sie treiben den Erfolg großer, kritischer Technologieprogramme, indem Sie Strategie in handlungsfähige, transformative Initiativen übersetzen, die Unternehmenswert liefern.
• Sie entwickeln und pflegen Kernarchitektur-Artefakte, einschließlich Capability Maps und Target-State Architectures, mit der Standard RDT-Toolchain.
• Sie arbeiten mit Portfolio Management zusammen, um architektonische Einsichten in Investitionsentscheidungen einzubetten, die Plattform wiederverwenden und technische Schulden zu verwalten.
• Sie überwachen aufstrebende Technologietrends und bewerten die Anbieter, um sicherzustellen, dass die R&D-Architektur Diagnostics innovativ und zukunftsbereit bleibt.
• Sie beeinflussen ein komplexes, föderiertes RDT-Modell, die Unternehmenskohärenz mit der für die lokale operative Durchführung erforderlichen Agilität ausgleichen. Wer du bist:
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss und bringen 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der IT- und Unternehmensarchitektur, speziell in komplexen, Matrix- oder federführenden globalen Organisationen.
• Sie verfügen über eine tiefe Domänenerfahrung in der Diagnostics R&D, mit einem umfassenden Verständnis der wissenschaftlichen, klinischen und technischen Prozesse – von der Informatik und Instrumentierung bis zur Trocken- und Nasslabor-Optik
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de domaine - Recherche et développement diagnostiques L'Architecte de domaine – Diagnostic La R-D est un poste clé de niveau supérieur au sein de l'équipe des fonctions de partenariat d'affaires Stratégie, Portefeuille et Gouvernance. Ce poste joue un rôle crucial entre l'organisation de la Stratégie, du Portefeuille et de la gouvernance (SPG) et la fonction de R-D en matière de diagnostic. Sous l'autorité directe du responsable de l'architecture d'entreprise Business Partnering Functions, avec une ligne pointillée du chef de la DDT Dia pour la R-D DIA, vous allez défendre nos pratiques d'architecture d'entreprise tout en comprenant profondément les complexités uniques de l'environnement de R-D Diagnostics. Principalement, dans notre modèle fédéré Roche Digital Technology (RDT), vous agirez en tant que principal orchestre du réseau d'architecture de R-D Diagnostics. En dirigeant ce réseau, qui comprend tous les architectes de domaines et de solutions intégrés directement au sein de l'organisation de R-D Diagnostics, vous dirigerez la gouvernance de l'architecture et la formulation de stratégies, assurerez la cohérence de l'entreprise et traduireez les objectifs commerciaux en feuilles de route adaptables et prêtes à l'avenir. Description de la zone Le secteur des fonctions de partenariat d'affaires en architecture d'entreprise sert de point de contact stratégique pour les chefs de domaine d'affaires, favorisant la collaboration pour aligner les applications, les capacités d'affaires et les actifs d'information sur les solutions technologiques. Dans le domaine de la R-D en matière de diagnostic, il faut s'intégrer en profondeur avec des équipes telles que les laboratoires de R-D de l'IDA, les sciences et le génie de la R-D de l'IDA, l'instrumentation de R-D de l'IDA, le développement clinique de l'IDA et les affaires médicales, ainsi que le portefeuille de l'IDA et la gestion de projets pour stimuler l'efficacité et l'innovation grâce à la responsabilisation de bout en bout. Ce rôle assure que le pont entre la vision d'entreprise de SPG et l'exécution opérationnelle de la R-D diagnostique est transparent, collaboratif et très efficace. La possibilité :
• Vous jouerez le rôle de liaison stratégique entre SPG EA et Diagnostics R&D, en partenariat avec le leadership pour aligner les priorités opérationnelles sur les feuilles de route pluriannuelles.
• Vous dirigez le réseau d'architecture de R & D Diagnostics, façonnant des priorités stratégiques partagées et permettant aux architectes d'exécuter tout en maintenant l'alignement des entreprises.
• Vous dirigez les activités de gouvernance de l'architecture, supervisez les produits livrables et les garde-corps technologiques pour assurer la sécurité et la résilience.
• Vous dirigez le succès de grands programmes technologiques critiques en transformant la stratégie en initiatives concrètes et transformatrices qui apportent une valeur opérationnelle.
• Vous développez et maintenez des artefacts d'architecture de base, y compris des cartes de capacités et des architectures d'état cible, en utilisant la chaîne d'outils RDT standard.
• Vous vous associez à Portfolio Management pour intégrer des idées architecturales dans les décisions d'investissement, maximiser la réutilisation des plateformes et gérer la dette technique.
• Vous surveillez les nouvelles tendances technologiques et évaluez les fournisseurs pour vous assurer que l'architecture de R-D Diagnostics demeure novatrice et prête à l'avenir.
• Vous influencez un modèle RDT complexe et fédéré, en conciliant la cohérence de l'entreprise avec l'agilité requise pour l'exécution opérationnelle locale. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master et apportez 7 ans d'expérience dans l'architecture informatique et d'entreprise, en particulier au sein d'organisations mondiales complexes, matricielles ou fédérées.
• Vous possédez une expérience approfondie en R & D diagnostique, avec une compréhension complète des processus scientifiques, cliniques et d'ingénierie — de la science informatique et de l'instrumentation au laboratoire sec et humide

• proactividad. Capacidad de detectar necesidades no cubiertas y transformarlas en

• influyente, puede construir y mantener una comunicación abierta y transparente
• con los diferentes interlocutores del ecosistema.

• nuevos desafíos.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Payable Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for Accounts Payable matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

The Opportunity

• Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) operations, including invoice processing (PO/non-PO), payments, reconciliations, and query resolution.

• Support month-end closing activities, including accrual analysis, balance sheet reconciliations, and preparation of financial and KPI reports.

• Ensure compliance and accuracy through duplicate checks, sanction screening, audit support, and maintenance of process documentation.

• Handle stakeholder communication by resolving internal and external queries and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

• Support operational excellence through system troubleshooting, process improvements, training, and participation in projects, system integration, and UAT.

Who you are

• A degree in Finance & Accounting, Commerce, or equivalent. Professional qualifications (e.g., ACCA, CPA, MIA) are an advantage.

• Good communication skills and proficiency in English language.

• Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking the specific country language for business communications.

• At least 2 years of experience in transactional accounting teams within a performance-driven environment.

• SAP skill & AP related process knowledge is added advantage

• Knowledge and experience with SAP or other ERP/Accounting systems.

• Experience working in a shared service center across a global or large organization is advantageous.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Referendariat - Juristische Wahlstation am Standort Penzberg (m/w/d)

Dein Team
Roche ist eines der weltweit führenden Biotechnologieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Medikamente, Diagnostika und digitale Lösungen, um die Gesundheitsversorgung nachhaltig zu verbessern. Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an.

Unser Team am Standort Penzberg besteht aus 4 Legal Counsel sowie 4 Paralegal, wobei wir standortübergreifend, Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Mannheim und der Schweiz, agieren.

Unser Arbeitsstil ist von Wertschätzung, Technologie-Offenheit, guter Teamarbeit, Kreativität sowie nicht zuletzt Spaß an den Aufgaben geprägt. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche.

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Dein Referendariat
Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.

• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.

• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.

• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.

• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt.

Deine Benefits
Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)

• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung

• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere

• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

Gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft zu gestalten, heißt für uns, Stärken zu verbinden, Innovationen zu fördern und Verantwortung zu übernehmen - in einem Umfeld voller Vertrauen, Vielfalt und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Unser Team der Rechtsabteilung Deutschland berät die Geschäftsführungen der deutschen Landesgesellschaften sowie deren Geschäftsbereiche und Tochterunternehmen in allen Rechtsangelegenheiten. Zum umfassenden Aufgabengebiet, in das der Referendar (m/w/d) praxisnah und aktiv miteinbezogen wird, gehören die Prüfung von Rechtsfragen, die Erteilung von Rechtsrat sowie die Mitgestaltung von Vertragsverhältnissen mit Kunden und Kooperationspartnern. Wir bieten eigenständiges Arbeiten mit der Möglichkeit des direkten Mandantenkontaktes an. Unser Team am Standort Penzberg besteht aus 4 Legal Counsel sowie 4 Paralegal, wobei wir standortübergreifend, Hand in Hand mit unseren Kollegen in Mannheim und der Schweiz, agieren. Auf diese Weise erreichen wir nicht nur passende, sondern innovative Lösungen für unsere Geschäftsbereiche. Dein Referendariat Im Rahmen deiner juristischen Wahlstation hast du bei uns als Referendar (m/w/d) die Möglichkeit, die Arbeitswelt eines Juristen in einem internationalen Großkonzern kennenzulernen. Deine Aufgaben
• An der Seite unserer Legal Counsel bearbeitest du nationale und internationale Fragestellungen aus dem allgemeinen Wirtschaftsrecht und gewerblichen Rechtsschutz, Einblicke in weitere Rechtsgebiete möglich.
• Du wirkst bei Vertragsverhandlungen und der Vertragsgestaltung für den Abschluss künftiger Kooperationen – bspw. mit Universitäten oder Kliniken – mit.
• Das Erstellen von Gutachten unterschiedlichster Fragestellungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in deine Hände.
• Als Teil unseres kreativen Teams wirkst du zudem aktiv an nationalen und internationalen Projekten mit.
• Dein Examen hat Priorität, daher unterstützen wir deine ganzheitliche Ausbildung und stellen sicher, dass dir genügend Zeit für Arbeitsgemeinschaften und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung bleibt. Deine Benefits Eingebettet zwischen der Großstadt München und dem schönen Voralpenland liegt unser Standort Penzberg mit gut 7.700 Mitarbeitenden. Damit du neben dem Lerneffekt auch die Vorteile unseres Standortes nutzen kannst, bieten wir unseren Referendaren u. a. folgende Benefits:
• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung (in Präsenz vor Ort/Home-Office)
• Attraktive monatliche Vergütung
• Vielfältige Unterstützung bei Fragen rund um deine berufliche Karriere
• Sehr gute Anbindung an das ÖPNV-Netz im Penzberger

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ERP Accounts Payable Solution Architect
The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.

Description of the area
Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution.
You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program.
You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within Accounts Payables solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fit requirements. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within the Accounts Payable product scope, managing the architectural complexities of specific ERP applications or components. In addition provides

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Accounts Payable Solution Architetto Il Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard e future-ready nel contesto Accounts Payables. In questo ruolo, si progettano soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, mentre gestiscono i requisiti non funzionali e l'evoluzione dell'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Risolvendo complessi problemi tecnici, definendo architetture di riferimento, e allineando con la più ampia comunità di architettura per la governance, ti garantirai robuste implementazioni ERP che offrono un valore aggiunto all'organizzazione. Descrizione della zona Il nostro paesaggio nell'area Accounts Payables integra SAP ECC e S/4HANA con diverse piattaforme di approvvigionamento per supportare il ciclo di vita Invoice-to-Pay. Garantiamo l'elaborazione senza soluzione di continuità dalla ricevuta della fattura e i flussi di lavoro di approvazione finanziaria conformi alla consegna di successo delle istruzioni di pagamento alla soluzione del Tesoro. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella navigazione della transizione dagli ambienti legacy agli standard ERP moderni, garantendo l'integrazione resilienza e scalabilità come ri-ingegneria del nostro panorama ERP globale attraverso il programma ASPIRE. Potrai servire come interfaccia critica per tradurre i requisiti aziendali in linguaggio tecnico / IT. La vostra missione primaria è quella di approfondire e definire il "perché" funzionale dietro le richieste aziendali, assicurando che ogni soluzione tecnologica sia costruita su una base di processi chiaramente mappati e di esigenze organizzative convalidate. L'opportunità:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni ERP che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno del contesto di soluzioni Accounts Payables. Gestisce i requisiti non operativi (NFR) e i requisiti di vestibilità. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per una corretta governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Sostegni problemi complessi, prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione ERP assegnata. Assesse e consultazioni su impatti e dipendenze di iniziative su capacità, rischi e il paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e onlogie per la soluzione e le relative interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, necessari NFR, e assicura l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) sono registrati. Guida le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valuta la fattibilità per la soluzione, comprese le valutazioni dei fornitori.
• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni tecniche difficili o sensibili e lavora in collaborazione per costruire il consenso tra team di prodotti, stakeholder aziendali e colleghi tecnici.
• Impatto/Strategia: Sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto nel contesto della soluzione. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su specifiche tecnologie ERP per i team di prodotto. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti, gestire il debito tecnico, e le ricerche, valuta, piloti e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona principalmente all'interno dell'ambito del prodotto Accounts Payable, gestendo le complessità architettoniche di specifiche applicazioni o componenti ERP. Inoltre fornisce

In dieser Rolle werden Sie Lösungen entwickeln, die Produktanforderungen, Unternehmensprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards erfüllen und nicht-funktionale Anforderungen verwalten und die Architektur im gesamten Produktlebenszyklus weiterentwickeln. Durch die Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme, die Definition von Referenzarchitekturen und die Ausrichtung auf die breitere Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance, sorgen Sie für robuste ERP-Implementierungen, die der Organisation einen Mehrwert bieten. Beschreibung der Fläche Unsere Landschaft im Bereich Accounts Payables integriert SAP ECC und S/4HANA mit vielfältigen Beschaffungsplattformen, um den Lebenszyklus Invoice-to-Pay zu unterstützen. Wir sorgen für eine nahtlose Verarbeitung von Rechnungseingang und konformen finanziellen Genehmigungs-Workflows bis hin zur erfolgreichen Lieferung von Zahlungsbefehlen an die Treasury-Lösung. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der Navigation des Übergangs von den alten Umgebungen zu modernen ERP-Standards spielen, um die Integrationsfähigkeit und Skalierbarkeit zu gewährleisten, da wir unsere globale ERP-Landschaft durch das ASPIRE-Programm neu entwickeln. Sie dienen als kritische Schnittstelle zur Übersetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in technische/ IT-Sprache. Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, die funktionalen "Warum" hinter Geschäftsanforderungen zutiefst zu erforschen und zu definieren, um sicherzustellen, dass jede technologische Lösung auf einer Grundlage von klar abgebildeten Prozessen und validierten organisatorischen Bedürfnissen aufgebaut wird. Die Gelegenheit:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Entwirft ERP-Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Unternehmensprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards im Kontext der Accounts Payables-Lösung erfüllen. Verwaltet Nicht-Functional Requirements (NFR) und fit Anforderungen. Dokumente und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an die Architekturgemeinschaft für eine ordnungsgemäße Governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves komplexe Probleme, eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen und das Urteil auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen. Bewahrt die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für die zugeordnete ERP-Lösung. Unterstützung und Beratung zu Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für die Lösung und die damit verbundenen Schnittstellen. Definiert und steuert Referenzarchitekturen, benötigte NFRs und stellt sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungsrekorde (ADRs) aufgezeichnet werden. treibt Trends der externen Technologie voran und beurteilt Machbarkeit für die Lösung, einschließlich Herstellerbewertungen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Architecte de solutions à payer pour les comptes ERP L'Architecte de la solution ERP des comptes créditeurs met l'accent sur la conception de solutions axées sur l'entreprise, fondées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans le contexte des comptes créditeurs. Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles et en évoluant l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. En résolvant des problèmes techniques complexes, en définissant des architectures de référence et en s'adaptant à l'ensemble de la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance, vous assurerez des implémentations robustes du PGI qui apportent une valeur ajoutée à l'organisation. Description de la zone Notre paysage dans le secteur des comptes créditeurs intègre SAP ECC et S/4HANA avec diverses plateformes d'approvisionnement pour soutenir le cycle de vie de la facturation à la paye. Nous assurons un traitement sans faille de la réception des factures et des processus d'approbation financière conformes jusqu'à la livraison réussie des instructions de paiement à la solution du Trésor. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la navigation de la transition des environnements hérités vers les normes ERP modernes, assurant la résilience et l'évolutivité de l'intégration au fur et à mesure que nous réaménagerons notre paysage ERP mondial grâce au programme ASPIRE. Vous servirez d'interface critique pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles en langage technique/informatique. Votre mission principale est d'explorer en profondeur et de définir le « pourquoi » fonctionnel derrière les demandes d'affaires, en veillant à ce que chaque solution technologique soit construite sur une base de processus clairement cartographiés et de besoins organisationnels validés. La possibilité :
• Portée / (Chef de projet) : Concevoir des solutions ERP qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans le contexte de la solution Comptes créditeurs. Gère les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les exigences d'ajustement. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour une bonne gouvernance.
• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Se pose des problèmes complexes, adopte une nouvelle perspective sur les solutions existantes et exerce son jugement sur la base de l'analyse de multiples sources d'information. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution ERP assignée. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le paysage des applications. Crée des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, des taxonomies et des ontologies pour la solution et les interfaces connexes. Définir et piloter les architectures de référence, les NFR nécessaires et s'assurer que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) sont enregistrés. Incite les tendances technologiques externes et évalue la faisabilité de la solution, y compris les évaluations des fournisseurs.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : Explique les informations techniques difficiles ou sensibles et travaille en collaboration pour établir un consensus entre les équipes de produits, les parties prenantes et les pairs techniques.
• Impact/Stratégie: développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit dans le contexte de la solution. Fournit aux équipes de produits une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies PGI spécifiques. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels, améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies.
• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne principalement dans le domaine des comptes à payer, en gérant les complexités architecturales des applications ou composants spécifiques ERP. En outre

jobs.title: Strategic Insights and Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
[Key 
• Responsibilities]

1. Portfolio Specialist
Play a key role to bring China market considerations and fit the China market needs in global product life cycle processes and strategies ; enable asset and major LE GO/NO GO decision in CBRC
· In-depth market and competitor insights generation . Ensure inputs to TPP/pre TPP captured;
· Lead cross functional squad team to build robust business case .
· Form commercial narratives and facilitate GO/NO GO decision of asset and core line extensio n through CBRC
·
2. Bridge and Advocates
Serve as a crucial link between the China and global. Ensure that the specific needs, concerns, and perspectives of China market are effectively conveyed to global and that global strategies and decisions are properly received
· Build and maintain healthy long-term relationship with DAL and IL; Regularly engage with global and local key stakeholders to understand their needs and challenges.
· Responsible for timely discussion and communication between the China affiliate and global to discuss product development strategies, roadmap updates, and issue resolutions . Ensure China acceleration opportunities identified & captured
· Actively promote the interests and opportunities of the China market , ensure that it receives appropriate attention and resources in global asset planning, to drive potential China acceleration

3. Local Business Partner
Support and Drive informed business decisions and resource allocation through robust forecast
· In-line Forecast Management: Take charge of Annual Forecasts and key Event-driven Forecasts for In-line products. Collaborate closely with local cross functional teams, including but not limited to CE, Access, and Finance, to build objective, rigorous forecast models.
· Business Influence: When business expectations are overheated or overly conservative, utilize data insights to provide an objective third-party perspective, assisting management decision making.
· Business Development (BD) Support: Support the China BD team by conducting in-depth commercial assessments and forecasts for "China for China" external partnerships and deal opportunities. Provide objective data insights to support high-quality investment and partnership decisions.

4. Insight generation
Lead insight generation activities when needed

[Key Capabilities]

1. Forecasting Mastery & Customer Insight:
· Forecasting Modeling Master: Mastery in building various forecast models (Epidemiology-based, probabilistic, time series), capable of handling complex variables and outputting robust results.
· Solid Customer Insight: Possess solid customer insights; ability to go beyond surface-level data to uncover the true business logic behind the numbers by combining qualitative market research with clinical understanding.

2. Organizational Agility & Cross-functional Collaboration:
· Capable of navigating a complex matrix organization with ease. Keenly perceive the needs of different stakeholders (Global vs. Local, R&D vs. Commercial). Build consensus and advance goals among multiple parties through Influencing without Authority in a mature, appropriate, and professional manner.

3. Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen:
· Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations from a macro Portfolio perspective. Understand both the global strategy logics and the practical pain points of China business teams.

4. Growth Mindset & Adaptability:
· Embrace change and comfortable and capable of navigating through ambiguity.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect - Genesys
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Description of the area
The Customer Interaction Platform and Services team is part of the Enterprise Platforms group. We provide Contact Center and Telephony services to all Roche divisions globally, including Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics. Our team supports critical communication channels for both internal staff (such as Service Desk and other internal services) and external customers (including Patients, HCPs, and other partners).
We are currently transforming our Contact Center platform into a solution that allows us to innovate faster, deliver solutions to our consumers more quickly, and enable new AI transformative use cases.
Our team works closely with other architects within Enterprise Platforms, such as the Salesforce and ServiceNow teams. This collaboration ensures our systems are aligned, follow proper governance, and work together to provide a great user experience across the entire technology ecosystem.
We are a global team with a presence in all regions, supporting the Roche community wherever they are located.

The Role: Your day-to-day at Roche
In this position, you will lead the architectural vision for complex, large-scale products that serve both our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions.

• Architectural Leadership: You will design standards-based solutions that balance product requirements with Roche’s Enterprise standards. You’ll be the "guardian" of the roadmap, managing technical debt and ensuring our landscape remains agile.

• Innovation & AI: You’ll drive the adoption of AI transformative use cases within our CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) environment, evaluating new technologies and conducting vendor assessments to keep us at the forefront of the industry.

• Strategic Collaboration: You will work side-by-side with other architects and product teams, providing technical oversight and ensuring our data models, ontologies, and integration pathways are world-class.

• Mentorship & Influence: As a senior expert, you’ll mentor others and help evolve our global Architecture Practices. You’ll be a master at explaining complex concepts to stakeholders and negotiating solutions that drive real value.

Who You Are: Your Profile
You are someone who thrives in complex, global environments. You are a natural problem-solver who uses analytical depth to find innovative paths forward. You are passionate about people, technology, and change.

Your technical toolkit should include:

• Extensive Experience: Proven track record as a Solution Architect in complex, multi-product environments.

• CCaaS Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with cloud-based telephony products, specifically Genesys Cloud (CCaaS) . You understand End-to-End voice topologies.

• Tech Savvy: Expert knowledge in Cloud Foundation, Security & Compliance, and a strong passion for AI & Conversational Technologies .

• Architectural Craft: Proficiency in creating Data

The Position The Senior Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt. Description of the area The Customer Interaction Platform and Services team is part of the Enterprise Platforms group. We provide Contact Center and Telephony services to all Roche divisions globally, including Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics. Our team supports critical communication channels for both internal staff (such as Service Desk and other internal services) and external customers (including Patients, HCPs, and other partners). We are currently transforming our Contact Center platform into a solution that allows us to innovate faster, deliver solutions to our consumers more quickly, and enable new AI transformative use cases. Our team works closely with other architects within Enterprise Platforms, such as the Salesforce and ServiceNow teams. This collaboration ensures our systems are aligned, follow proper governance, and work together to provide a great user experience across the entire technology ecosystem. We are a global team with a presence in all regions, supporting the Roche community wherever they are located. The Role: Your day-to-day at Roche In this position, you will lead the architectural vision for complex, large-scale products that serve both our Pharmaceuticals and Diagnostics divisions.
• Architectural Leadership: You will design standards-based solutions that balance product requirements with Roche’s Enterprise standards. You’ll be the "guardian" of the roadmap, managing technical debt and ensuring our landscape remains agile.
• Innovation & AI: You’ll drive the adoption of AI transformative use cases within our CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) environment, evaluating new technologies and conducting vendor assessments to keep us at the forefront of the industry.
• Strategic Collaboration: You will work side-by-side with other architects and product teams, providing technical oversight and ensuring our data models, ontologies, and integration pathways are world-class.
• Mentorship & Influence: As a senior expert, you’ll mentor others and help evolve our global Architecture Practices. You’ll be a master at explaining complex concepts to stakeholders and negotiating solutions that drive real value. Who You Are: Your Profile You are someone who thrives in complex, global environments. You are a natural problem-solver who uses analytical depth to find innovative paths forward. You are passionate about people, technology, and change. Your technical toolkit should include:
• Extensive Experience: Proven track record as a Solution Architect in complex, multi-product environments.
• CCaaS Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with cloud-based telephony products, specifically Genesys Cloud (CCaaS) . You understand End-to-End voice topologies.
• Tech Savvy: Expert knowledge in Cloud Foundation, Security & Compliance, and a strong passion for AI & Conversational Technologies .
• Architectural Craft: Proficiency in creating Data

jobs.title: Senior Director, Translational Medicine China
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Role:
We are seeking a highly motivated individual to lead the Translational Medicine (TM) and Development Sciences (DevSci) Teams in China for Roche. The TM China team works with our global partners to primarily lead biomarker development efforts as well as support activities across Bioanalytical sciences, Clinical Pharmacology and Safety Assessment. This role directly oversees clinical development projects in China and the Asia Pacific region for programs in early and late stage clinical development spanning multiple therapeutic modalities and areas including Oncology, Hematology, Neuroscience,, Immunology, Cardiovascular, Metabolism and Ophthalmology.

The Senior Director role serves as the site head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China, leading a lab enabled team of 13+ talented researchers and scientists. In this role the Senior Director represents TM China on local development and study teams as well as global teams and will develop and execute the biomarker, CDx and translational research strategies for the respective therapeutic modalities. This role plays an important part in communicating to and developing collaborative relationships with key investigators and thought leaders in China and APAC, which will be essential in driving our translational sciences forward.

The Senior Director and Site Head for Translational Medicine and Development Sciences China will report to the Head of Translational Medicine Oncology with a dotted reporting line the the Head of Development Sciences within Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) based in South San Francisco, USA and is a member of the Roche Product Development China Leadership Team. This role requires an individual who possesses a cross-enterprise (borderless) mindset with outstanding communication and leadership skills that enable collaboration across the Roche organization and the ability to build and facilitate strong relationships internally and externally.

Responsibilities:

• Communicate and collaborate globally with Translational Medicine (TM) and Development Sciences (Dev Sci) leadership across Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED).

• Provide exceptional scientific leadership to team and peers across the organization

• Lead and drive China biomarker strategies and collaborations, data analysis and interpretation, and presentation to review forums and governance committees

• Participate and lead as a key member of Roche Leadership activities including the Product Development China Leadership team, Roche Human Genetics Resources Administration of China (HGRAC) monitoring committee, China PHC working group, and China Medical affairs

• Contribute to the biomarker regulatory strategy for China/APAC, participate in interactions with health authorities in China and contribute to preparation of relevant regulatory documents

• Develop and lead biomarker strategy and plan for medical affairs sponsored activities in China collaboration with the International medical leaders for the respective programs and the country medical affairs organization

• Develop and lead biomarker collaborations with key investigators and thought leaders

• Strategic oversight of DevSci-wide goals and activities in China (BioAnalytical Sciences and Clinical Pharmacology), including oversight over local external bioanalytical service providers and local Health Authority engagements, strategic vision for making an impact across programs in China, and ways to increase PTS or acc

jobs.title: Mobility Reward Analyst - Operations (Maternity cover)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Mobility Reward Analyst specializing in Mobility Operations at Roche, you will play a critical role in performing key operational tasks within the Mobility domain. This role involves close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to efficiently complete these tasks. You will be a part of a dynamic team, reporting to the Team Lead for Mobility Operations, and contribute to improving operational processes and knowledge sharing within the team.

The opportunity:

• Process Management: you consistently perform dedicated processes related to Mobility Operations, and engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure task delivery and use APro reporting on various ad hoc business requests

• Team Collaboration and Development: you build and maintain a network with Mobility Operations colleagues to improve processes and share knowledge, and collaborate with client-facing MRAs in support of their direct work with Roche transferees. You onboard and train new team members and focus on enhancing the skills of existing members

• Knowledge Management: you ensure up-to-date maintenance of training materials, process maps, and knowledge management resources

• Operational Tasks including mobility finances, cost estimates, tax equalizations, data analysis, systems management, tax operations, immigration operations, payroll processing. In addition, you manage annual and recurring tasks such as coordinating the annual compensation review, AIRINC data updates, COLA and fx rate adjustments

• You drive and manage the documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Step-By-Step Instructions (SWIs), and you lead and support continuous process improvement initiatives within the Mobility Operations domain

• Local Moves : you initiate and manage Inter-Company Transfers, Foreign Local Hires and Domestic Moves, create and review one way transfer cost estimates and net to net calculations, and work with vendors to trigger cases and support questions.

Please note that this position is a fixed-term maternity cover.

Who you are:
This role is ideal for someone passionate about operational efficiency and excellence in global mobility. You will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to process enhancement and team development within Roche’s Mobility Operations.

• You have a strong command of both written and spoken English

• You bring expertise in areas such as mobility, compensation, reward, or finance, coupled with a passion for advancing your career in the dynamic field of mobility. Experience with Workday and AssignmentPro is considered a plus

• You have proven experience in delivering process-driven tasks with a strong emphasis on accountability and successful outcomes

• You bring diligent adherence to deadlines and time management and strong attention to detail to drive exemplary customer experience

• You are a proactive and organized individual with a strong focus on operational excellence in global mobility and an end-to-end process approach

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy pro

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Regulatory
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
POSITION SUMMARY
Performs end-to-end regulatory activities for biologics segmented manufacturing pilot project in China. Recommends strategies for earliest possible approvals for biologics segmented manufacturing project, based on comprehensive assessment per related regulations and specific project situations. Supports policy influencing and interacts with HA on defined matters. Coordinates and performs document authoring and prepares filing packages for regulatory submissions for biologics in Shanghai site to ensure alignment and compliance with local and regional registration requirements as well as with company policies from all areas of company as well as internal audits and inspections. Compiles all materials required in the related submissions. Recommends changes for materials, labeling, manufacturing and marketing for regulatory compliance. Monitors and improves tracking/control systems. Performs other regulatory activities per demand. Keeps abreast of regulatory procedures and changes. Works independently within guidelines and policies, receives minimal guidance. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience and provides functional guidance.

Your Opportunity
 You will provide recommendations on regulatory strategies for the biologics segmented manufacturing pilot project to enable earlier submission and approval, based on related regulations and specific project situations.
 You will support policy influencing and interact with regulatory agencies on defined matters, especially for segmented manufacturing.
 You will participate in the coordinating and authoring of high quality CMC regulatory regulatory documents as well as preparation of filing packages for the biologics produced in Shanghai site in accordance with Roche corporate standards and the requirements of applicable health authorities, in support of local/global SMEs, and contribute to the timely regulatory approval for the local manufactured product.
 You will keep key stake holders (incl. site MSAT, manufacturing, Quality, global regulatory, etc.) fully apprised of the pilot project status and potential submission risks and impact to defined regulatory strategies and timelines.
 You will manage regulatory aspects of change control and perform appropriate communication to stakeholders regarding management of technical changes. Provide regulatory support for relevant quality systems such as change control, discrepancy management, as well as Health Authority inspection support as required and/or serving as a liaison with the local health authority on behalf of the site.
•  You will contribute to regulatory excellence by identifying opportunities, mitigating risks and supporting continuous improvement.
•  You will perform other assigned regulatory activities per demands across lifecycle management.
•  You will support team leader and collaborate with the China technical partners and China Partners in PDR China to facilitate "One Regulatory Voice".

Who you are
• Education
•  Master’s Degree in life science disciplines is preferred
• Experience
•  3 or more years’ work experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or related industry in CMC, Regulatory, Manufacturing and Quality or related
•  Experience on generating technical registration dossier for China/EU/USA, or MSAT / manufacturing process development experience is preferred.
•  Filing experience in Regulatory Affairs is a plus
•  Analytical development, or supply chain experience would be a plus
• Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Technica

Als Medical Leader (d/w/m) - CVRM bist Du nicht nur Fachperson für Dein Indikationsgebiet, sondern die treibende Kraft hinter strategischen Entscheidungen, die wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in echten Patientennutzen verwandeln.

Dein neues Team
Du wirst Teil unserer Medical Affairs Community in Grenzach – einem dynamischen Netzwerk aus Expert:innen, die gemeinsam an der Spitze der medizinischen Innovation stehen. Im Bereich CVRM bewegen wir uns in einem hochspannenden, wachsenden Feld und laden Dich ein, als Pionier dieses neue Therapiegebiet für Roche zu erschließen. Wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens und der gegenseitigen Unterstützung, in der Deine Meinung zählt und wir gemeinsam über den Tellerrand hinausblicken.
Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle bist Du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Wissenschaft, Strategie und Marktvorbereitung. Du agierst wie ein Architekt für medizinische Konzepte und stellst sicher, dass unsere Innovationen den Weg in die Versorgung finden.

• Du verantwortest die medizinische Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Produkt-Launches im Bereich CVRM und entwickelst die lokale medizinische Strategie.

• Du analysierst und optimierst Versorgungsmodelle und -netzwerke, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Therapien effektiv in das Gesundheitssystem integriert werden.

• Als Brückenbauer:in pflegst Du intensive Kontakte zu Expert:innen (KOLs) und gestaltest den wissenschaftlichen Dialog z.B. in Advisory Boards oder Symposien und entwickelst neue Formate.

• Du identifizierst strategische Datenlücken (Evidence Gaps) im CVRM-Umfeld und arbeitest eng mit der Evidence Generation Group zusammen, um diese durch hochwertige Real-World-Daten oder Studien zu schließen.

• Du triffst mutige, strategische Entscheidungen innerhalb Deines Squads und agierst als Mentor:in für deine Projektteams.

• Um den Puls des Marktes und der Wissenschaft zu spüren, bist Du ca. 30% Deiner Zeit auf Reisen, um Stakeholder zu treffen sowie Netzwerke zu erschließen und zu pflegen.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die Komplexität vereinfacht , den Launch-Spirit mitbringt und Menschen durch Kompetenz und Empathie verbindet.

• Du hast Dein Studium der Medizin, Pharmazie oder Naturwissenschaften (idealerweise mit Promotion) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Metabolic oder alternativ im Bereich Herz-Kreislauf (Klinik, Forschung oder Industrie).

• Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung in der Markteinführung von Medikamenten und ein tiefes Verständnis für die deutschen Versorgungsstrukturen.

• Du verstehst es, komplexe Daten zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten und souverän gegenüber externen Stakeholdern zu vertreten.

• Der Aufbau tragfähiger Beziehungen und Netzwerke fällt Dir leicht und du bist bereit für eine Reisetätigkeit von ca. 30%.

• In einem globalen Umfeld bewegst Du Dich sicher und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten Dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit Dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen

jobs.title: Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist (Fixed-term contract till end Sep. 2027)

Position summary
The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business.
As a Payroll, Time & Benefits Specialist, you are responsible for executing HR system data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner, in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, and several local and global benefits. etc.

You will support the following countries for the Polaris implementation:

• Bosnia and Herzegovina

• North Macedonia

• Albania

• Georgia

Responsibilities:
Service Delivery

• Execute system data maintenance and administrative activities in support of P&C business processes in the area of payroll, tax, social insurance, time, several local and global benefits administration, etc.

• Provide customer service on pay, time and benefits related activities, such as inquiry resolution, request management, and troubleshooting.

• Understand and have working knowledge of local time/absence policies.

• Correspondence with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time/absence entry.

• Manage, process and reconcile mass upload files for all pay frequencies.

• Monitor data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy

• Ensure integrations are processed timely and resolve any errors ensuring accurately processed

• Ensure regulatory compliance in line with the countries, customers, and regulations.

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships and communications to partner in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way.

• Supports P&C Chapters in system maintenance activities.

• Provide guidance and advisory to first level P&C support teams.

• Be up to date on processes, own the knowledge development on processes, and contribute to the update of relevant documentations (KA, SWIs).

• Ensure consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced.

• Implement processes and initiatives to ensure continuous improvement as well as service enhancement.

• Ensure end to end ownership of resolution

• Ensure operations according to defined KPIs and ServiceNow OKRs.

• Support country non-PTB activities upon the business needs if applicable.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build relationships with P&C colleagues as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

• Collaborate with peers within the region and globally to ensure the People Support Solutions network provides consistent and effective services to our customers.

• Achieve our P&C vision by driving local consistency through collaboration.

Outputs & Deliverables

• Continuous contribution to the improvement of the performance of People Support Solutions

• Reaching high customer satisfaction through consistent, high quality delivery and application of customer care principles (measured by defined stakeholder feedback)

Who you are
In this role you will be working within a team focusing on a customer group from one of the regions and across various functions and levels within the organization.
You bring the following experience :

• 1-2 years of experience in payroll services and benefits administration, in a shared service center environment preferably.

• Knowledge

jobs.title: Complaint Handling Engineer - Sequencing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Complaint Handling Engineer - Sequencing

As a Complaint Handling Engineer you will be dealing with queries concerning Digital Solutions quality and product performance of Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS), medical data networks, middleware solutions. data communication, apps algorithms.

As a member of the Digital Solutions Chapter, you will be working in a very transversal software environment having the opportunity to work with cutting edge technologies and different programming languages for on-premise and cloud-based software. You need to be able to read and understand source code in order to find out the root cause/causal factor of a SW malfunction/SW issue, and also be able to learn about software requirements, fixing bugs process (even if you will not fix them) and general code maintenance. All of it in an Agile environment where you could contribute with your own ideas and proposals in a team continuously improving

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for the timely handling of individual cases (Inquiry, Complaint, Potential Reportable and Safety issues) according to ISO Quality System requirements and regulations, and needs of the Country Organizations including creation, acceptance, classification, investigation, complete documentation, on-site trouble-shooting and resolution of cases.

• Resolves cases in the assigned area, potentially requiring consultation with more senior team members on technical or process-related aspects.

• Interface with Affiliates and assumes responsibility for timely communication of quality related information to the Country Organizations. Supports initiatives and measures to maintain enhanced interfaces with country organizations and regional representatives.

• Analyzes data using statistical measures for determining a potential product performance issue.

• Responsible for escalating cases which cannot be directly resolved to appropriate levels and initiating further investigation and communicating case derived information as appropriate.

• Ensures cases are compliant and conform to established quality processes, standards, and regulations.

• May be required to perform other duties as assigned to meet the PMQ goals and objectives as appropriate

Who you are:

• You own a degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, biomedical engineering, computer science (with knowledge on bioinformatics or genomics will be a plus), or a related field. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential

• Work experience in the area of bioinformatics and/or in support related functions is desired.

• Experience reading source code and working with Linux/Unix operating systems for working with sequencing pipelines is desired.

• Experience with workflow management tools like Nextflow, Snakemake, CWL, or similar is desired.

• Understanding of cloud computing platforms as well as experience managing on premise infrastructure (including servers and high performance computing clusters) is desired.

• Knowledge of containerization technologies is desired.

• You are able to read and or debug source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues.

What you get:

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up

jobs.title: Reward Analyst - Compensation (German speaking)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Reward Analyst - Compensation (German speaking) is responsible for providing essential services to the People Reward and Recognition (PR&R) chapter independently, focusing on job leveling, data submission, benchmarking, data analysis and the related administrative processes for Germany.
This role requires a deep understanding of global and local reward processes and timelines, with the ability to clearly articulate them. The Reward Analyst will also offer guidance on recurring reward inquiries and have a firm grasp of Roche Rewards policies and procedures.

The opportunity:

• Collaborating with Reward Partners on understanding organizational structures and roles

• Performing job evaluations and position description analysis

• Submitting data to benchmark provider and determine/recommend pay grades based on benchmark data

• Conducting internal and external compensation analysis to identify comparative salary trends and ensure equity across the organization

• Conducting audits and analysis on current programs, policies and procedures in order to develop recommendations on potential changes, gaps or enhancements to significantly improve existing practices and to create a more efficient and streamlined organization

• ​ Behaving as role model to team members, showing positive and flexible attitude

• Developing and managing key stakeholder relationships in a proactive and customer outcomes focused way

• Building relationships with HR colleagues within the PSS organization as well as with customers to ensure ongoing service delivery effectiveness.

Who you are:
We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience, knowledge in the compensation practice area which includes experience with benchmark data and leveling

• Fluent in written and spoken English AND German

• Strong customer centricity, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset

• Advanced critical thinking, end-to-end focus, customer service expertise

• Exceptional analytical skills, ability to turn data into a story

• Familiarity with analysis tools (i.e. Excel, Access, Smartsheet) and HR systems

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

titleByLocale.de: Volontariat im Bereich Communications & Public Affairs (m/w/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Abteilung Communications & Public Affairs arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, aus den vielfältigen Inhalten unseres Unternehmens spannende Geschichten zu entwickeln und diese mit kreativen Ideen und Formaten für unsere Mitarbeitenden, Medienvertreter und unser Umfeld kommunikativ umzusetzen. So unterstützen wir die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens und machen die Identität von Roche erlebbar. Als Volontär:in erhältst Du Einblicke in die inhaltlichen und organisatorischen Abläufe der internen und externen Unternehmenskommunikation und lernst unser kommunikatives Tagesgeschäft kennen.

Unser 18-monatiges, bezahltes Volontariat im Bereich Communications & Public Affairs bietet Dir eine solide Ausbildung „on-the-Job“ sowie gezielte und unterstützende theoretische Ausbildungsmöglichkeiten. Unser Ausbildungsprogramm ist DAPR-zertifiziert und so können wir unseren Volontären eine bestmögliche Qualifizierung parallel zum Job anbieten. Unsere Volontär:innen profitieren von der theoretisch fundierten und stets auf den praktischen Kommunikationsalltag ausgerichteten Seminargestaltung der DAPR, die die Anwendbarkeit im Job sicherstellt.

Für diese abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben suchen wir Dich:

• Kommunikation mit Konzept: Du erstellst Kommunikationskonzepte und lernst, wie man Projekte organisiert und umsetzt. Dabei betreust Du eigenständig Kommunikationsprojekte unter unserer Anleitung.

• Texte, die ankommen: Du verfasst Texte aller Art - von der Pressemitteilung über Intranet-News bis hin zu Artikeln für interne und externe Medien.

• Gute Inhalte, viele Formen: Du setzt Themen für verschiedene Kanäle und in verschiedenen Formaten um: vom Podcast bis zur tagesaktuellen News-App. Dabei berücksichtigst Du unterschiedliche Perspektiven, planst zielgruppengerecht und bist kreativ bei der Aufbereitung.

• Event mit Planung: Du unterstützt bei der Organisation und kommunikativen Begleitung von externen und internen Events oder Pressegesprächen.

• Kommunikation in allen Facetten: Du erhältst Einblicke in die verschiedenen Aufgabengebiete der Kommunikationsabteilung wie Produkt- und Diseasekommunikation, interne Kommunikation, Executive-Kommunikation, Change-Kommunikation, Medienarbeit oder Eventkommunikation

Je nach Vorerfahrung wird eine begleitende, personalisierte Ausbildung bei der DAPR oder eine weiterführende Ausbildung durch flexible Trainings angeboten. Dabei wird die Auswahl der Weiter- und Fortbildungen gemeinsam mit Dir getroffen und so perfekt auf Deine Bedürfnisse abgestimmt. Die Ausbildungskosten werden von Roche übernommen.

Wer Du bist
Du möchtest selbst entscheiden, wie Du Dich entwickelst. Du bist auf der Suche nach einem Unternehmen, in dem Du als Mitglied eines agilen Teams Deinen Interessen nachgehen kannst und in dem die Stellenausschreibung nicht die endgültige Definition, sondern nur den Ausgangspunkt Deiner Rolle darstellt? Dann haben wir die perfekte Stelle für Dich.

Für dieses Volontariat bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Deinen Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) hast Du bereits abgeschlossen. Die Fachrichtung ist nicht entscheidend. Wichtiger ist uns, dass Du Dich für das Kommunikationsfach begeisterst, aufgeschlossen bist für die Vielfalt der Themen und diese attraktiv und zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten weißt.

• Du hast Freude am Texten, Konzeptionieren, grafischen Gestalten und Organisieren.

• Du bringst Kenntnisse über die Anwendung digitaler Medien in der Kommunikation mit und hast erste Erfahrungen in der Produktio
