A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'organizzazione Corporate Business Development supporta le partnership di Roche e Genentech in tutto il mondo, comprendendo attività R&D, tecnologie (sia biotecnologiche che digitali), e offerte commerciali. Come pioniere nel settore sanitario, Roche è dedicata alla guida della scienza e della tecnologia innovative che trasforma la vita dei pazienti, e l'innovazione esterna è una pietra angolare della sua strategia R&D, completando la sua vasta pipeline interna. Il Partnering Transaction Group (PTG) è composto da professionisti di sviluppo aziendale altamente esperti a Basilea e San Francisco con profonda esperienza nell'esecuzione di licenze farmaceutiche e accordi di collaborazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un candidato eccellente per unire il nostro gruppo a Basilea per garantire che i risultati negoziati delle nostre offerte riflettano chiaramente le disposizioni di partnership desiderate e allineano con i nostri obiettivi aziendali. L'opportunità Come membro del Gruppo di Transazione Partnering, sarete parte integrante dei team di negoziazione per strutturare e negoziare offerte ad alto impatto, e modellare la direzione delle nostre partnership globali attraverso le seguenti responsabilità:
• Agire come membro principale del team di affari per guidare partnership strategiche e progetti di licensing in tutte le aree terapeutiche e fasi di sviluppo della droga in tutto il mondo.
• Guidare o co-promuovere la preparazione delle offerte (NBO, schede termiche) e i negoziati con i team esecutivi di biofarmaci e con i consulenti esterni.
• Partecipare a briefing con la gestione senior presso le sedi chiave del progetto per guidare le decisioni aziendali.
• Concentrati su tutti gli elementi della strategia e dell'esecuzione degli accordi, comprese le strutture di negoziazione proposte e finanziarie basate su valutazioni di valutazione, rischi e diligenza.
• Progetto di fogli di termine e fornire commenti dettagliati su accordi di licenza complessi mentre guida la risoluzione di problemi di affare.
• Evidenziare le deviazioni da norme sulle clausole di licenza finanziaria e chiave, identificare i rischi risultanti e le possibili strategie di mitigazione.
• Prendere un vantaggio nello sviluppo delle capacità di transazione e di negoziazione dell'organizzazione creando e fornendo materiali di formazione. Chi sei Sei un autoproiettore energico, guidato dai risultati con una forte presenza esecutiva e un track record di progetti strategici leader in un ambiente di affari complesso, soddisfando i seguenti requisiti:
• Laurea Avanzata in Scienza, Business, Finanza, Giurisprudenza, o in una zona relativa.
• Un minimo di 10 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico/biotecnico, compresi i servizi professionali, consultivi o studi legali che sostengono i clienti biofarmaci.
• Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza specifica in materia di transazioni farmaceutiche/biotecniche.
• Esperienza significativa nella negoziazione di licenze complesse o accordi M&A, preferibilmente come il negoziatore principale nello spazio biofarmaco.
• Una comprensione approfondita delle funzioni aziendali, tra cui finanza, contabilità, legalità e proprietà intellettuale (IP).
• competenze di comunicazione efficaci con una mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di pensare strategicamente attraverso un giudizio professionale avanzato. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst team is at the heart of designing and delivering modernised medical communication and engagement models. As part of the Global Integrated Medical Engagement chapter in PDMA, we focus on the evolution of medical engagement and the tools, processes, and mindsets required for the future. We bridge the gap between today’s standards and a future defined by personalised, scientific exchange.

As a Change Management Lead, you will be a "Catalyst" for organisational transformation. You will ensure that our medical network successfully navigates shifts in how we communicate and engage with customers by addressing both systemic requirements and day-to-day implications for individuals. This is a highly collaborative role, working across PDMA, GIME, and our global affiliate medical network to make our new engagement frameworks a sustainable reality.

• Architect the Change Journey: Design and implement end-to-end transformation strategies that bridge the gap between initial design and sustainable business-as-usual adoption.

• Lead Change Interventions: Serve as the primary change lead for major work packages, integrating human-centric plans into the technical delivery of new frameworks.

• Drive a Future-Ready Culture: Foster a growth and experimental mindset across the medical network, empowering teams to move toward proactive, value-based relationships.

• Ensure Sustainable Adoption: Establish and nurture a network of change agents and champions to drive adoption and ensure new frameworks are successfully scaled globally.

• Design Learning Strategies: Execute learning strategies that upskill the workforce in digital fluency and insight-driven engagement for the future operating model.

• Influence Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with Commercial, Digital, and Technology partners to ensure a "One Roche" approach to the customer experience.

• Uphold Ethical Standards: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including HCP engagement policies and Roche directives.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader who thrives in complex, fast-changing environments and has a passion for guiding people through transformational shifts. You look beyond current processes to solve customer pain points and are skilled at translating technical shifts into human-centric value propositions. You are a natural coach and facilitator, able to navigate ambiguity and build trust across a global matrix.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Expert Qualifications: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD) or equivalent experience in organisational development, alongside 5+ years of Medical Affairs knowledge.

• Change Mastery: Proven experience applying structured change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) to large-scale organisational shifts, preferably in an Agile environment.

• Strategic Storytelling: The ability to craft a compelling "Case for Change" that connects transformation to higher business impact and the "Triple Win."

• Matrix Fluency: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to speak the language of medical, digital, and commercial teams to drive a unified vision.

• Problem-Solving Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritise tasks, anticipate barriers, and focus on successful outcomes.

Relocation benefits are available for this position

Who we are
A healthier future drive

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il team di Engagement Medical Engagement Catalyst è al centro della progettazione e della fornitura di modelli di comunicazione medica e di fidanzamento modernizzati. Nell'ambito del capitolo Global Integrated Medical Engagement in PDMA, ci concentriamo sull'evoluzione dell'impegno medico e degli strumenti, processi e mentalità necessari per il futuro. Colpiamo il divario tra gli standard di oggi e un futuro definito da uno scambio scientifico personalizzato. Come Lead Change Management, sarai un "Catalyst" per la trasformazione organizzativa. Ti assicurerai che la nostra rete medica naviga con successo i cambiamenti nel modo in cui comunichiamo e ci impegniamo con i clienti affrontando sia i requisiti sistemici che le implicazioni quotidiane per gli individui. Questo è un ruolo altamente collaborativo, lavorando in PDMA, GIME, e la nostra rete medica di affiliazione globale per rendere i nostri nuovi framework di fidanzamento una realtà sostenibile.
• Architetto il Change Journey: Design e implementare strategie di trasformazione end-to-end che colmano il divario tra progettazione iniziale e adozione sostenibile business-as-ual.
• Interventi di cambiamento di piombo: Servire come il cambiamento primario piombo per i principali pacchetti di lavoro, integrando piani umani-centrici nella consegna tecnica di nuovi quadri.
• Guidare una cultura Future-Ready: promuovere una crescita e una mentalità sperimentale attraverso la rete medica, consentendo ai team di muoversi verso relazioni proattive e basate sul valore.
• Assicurare l'adozione sostenibile: istituire e nutrire una rete di agenti e campioni di cambiamento per guidare l'adozione e garantire che i nuovi quadri siano scalati con successo a livello globale.
• Strategie di apprendimento di progettazione: Eseguite strategie di apprendimento che migliorano la forza lavoro nella fluidità digitale e l'impegno orientato agli insight per il futuro modello operativo.
• Influenza Cross-Functional Alignment: Collabora con partner commerciali, digitali e tecnologici per garantire un approccio "One Roche" all'esperienza del cliente.
• Aggiornare gli standard etici: assicurarsi che tutte le attività seguano i codici legali, normativi e aziendali, comprese le politiche di impegno HCP e le direttive Roche. Chi sei Sei un leader visionario che prospera in ambienti complessi e in rapida evoluzione e ha una passione per guidare le persone attraverso cambiamenti trasformazionali. Si guarda oltre i processi attuali per risolvere i punti di dolore del cliente e sono abili a tradurre i cambiamenti tecnici nelle proposizioni di valore umano-centrico. Sei un allenatore naturale e facilitatore, in grado di navigare ambiguità e costruire la fiducia in una matrice globale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Qualifiche di esperti: un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (PhD, PharmD, o MD) o un'esperienza equivalente nello sviluppo organizzativo, insieme a 5+ anni di conoscenza degli Affari medici.
• Cambia Mastery: Esperienza comprovata che applica quadri di gestione dei cambiamenti strutturati (ad esempio Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) a turni organizzativi su larga scala, preferibilmente in un ambiente Agile.
• Storytelling Strategico: La capacità di creare una convincente "Case for Change" che collega la trasformazione ad un maggiore impatto commerciale e alla "Triple Win".
• Matrix Fluency: eccellenti competenze interpersonali con la capacità di parlare il linguaggio dei team medici, digitali e commerciali per guidare una visione unificata.
• Problem-Solving Agility: Forte capacità di gestione del progetto con la capacità di priorità compiti, anticipare le barriere e concentrarsi sui risultati di successo. Le prestazioni di trasferimento sono disponibili per questa posizione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano

Dans le cadre du chapitre sur l'engagement médical global intégré de la PDMA, nous nous concentrons sur l'évolution de l'engagement médical et les outils, processus et mentalités nécessaires pour l'avenir. Nous comblons l'écart entre les normes actuelles et un avenir défini par des échanges scientifiques personnalisés. En tant que responsable de la gestion du changement, vous serez un "catalyseur" pour la transformation organisationnelle. Vous vous assurerez que notre réseau médical navigue avec succès dans la façon dont nous communiquons et intervenons avec les clients en répondant à la fois aux exigences systémiques et aux implications quotidiennes pour les individus. Il s'agit d'un rôle hautement collaboratif, travaillant à travers PDMA, GIME, et notre réseau médical mondial affilié pour faire de nos nouveaux cadres d'engagement une réalité durable.
• Architect the Change Journey: Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de transformation de bout en bout qui comblent l'écart entre la conception initiale et l'adoption d'entreprises durables comme d'habitude.
• Mener des interventions de changement : servir de chef de file pour les grands ensembles de travaux, intégrer les plans axés sur l'homme dans la prestation technique de nouveaux cadres.
• Favoriser une culture axée sur l'avenir : favoriser une croissance et un état d'esprit expérimental dans l'ensemble du réseau médical, donner aux équipes les moyens de s'orienter vers des relations proactives fondées sur la valeur.
• Assurer l'adoption durable : établir et entretenir un réseau d'agents et de champions du changement pour favoriser l'adoption et veiller à ce que de nouveaux cadres soient appliqués avec succès à l'échelle mondiale.
• Concevoir des stratégies d'apprentissage : Exécuter des stratégies d'apprentissage qui améliorent la compétence de la main-d'œuvre en matière de fluidité numérique et d'engagement axé sur les connaissances pour le futur modèle opérationnel.
• Influence sur l'alignement interfonctionnel : Collaborer avec les partenaires commerciaux, numériques et technologiques pour assurer une approche « One Roche » de l'expérience client.
• Normes éthiques : veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent les codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris les politiques d'engagement du HCP et les directives Roche. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et en évolution rapide et qui a une passion pour guider les gens à travers des changements transformationnels. Vous regardez au-delà des processus actuels pour résoudre les points de douleur du client et sont qualifiés pour traduire les changements techniques en propositions de valeur centrées sur l'homme. Vous êtes un entraîneur et un facilitateur naturel, capable de naviguer l'ambiguïté et de bâtir la confiance à travers une matrice globale. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Qualifications d'expert : Diplôme de sciences de la vie (PhD, PharmD ou MD) ou expérience équivalente en développement organisationnel, parallèlement à 5 ans de connaissances en affaires médicales.
• Maîtrise du changement : expérience éprouvée en appliquant des cadres structurés de gestion du changement (par exemple, Prosci/ADKAR, Kotter) à des changements organisationnels à grande échelle, de préférence dans un environnement agile.
• Histoire stratégique : la capacité d'élaborer un « cas pour le changement » convaincant qui relie la transformation à un impact commercial plus élevé et la « triple victoire ».
• Matrice Fluency: Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles avec la capacité de parler le langage des équipes médicales, numériques et commerciales pour conduire une vision unifiée.
• Agilité de résolution des problèmes : Des compétences solides en gestion de projet avec la capacité de prioriser les tâches, d'anticiper les obstacles et de se concentrer sur les résultats fructueux. Des prestations de réinstallation sont disponibles pour ce poste Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain

jobs.title: Pathology Scientist (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) is seeking a full-time Pathology Scientist (m/f/d) to join the Pathology team of the US-accredited Companion Diagnostics (CDx) laboratory located in Penzberg. If you have experience in Immunohistochemistry (IHC), in situ hybridization (ISH), or quantitative image analysis using artificial intelligence or machine learning, we want to hear from you!

At Roche PHCS, we value collaboration, innovation, and the drive to make significant contributions to healthcare. As part of our team, you'll work in a multidisciplinary environment, engaging with experts in bioinformatics, oncology, digital pathology, and biomarker development.

The Opportunity

Join a global team of over 20 pathologists located in both Germany and the United States who work together to drive innovation and bring new products to market. In this challenging role you will

• Provide medical oversight for pathology and slide reading for early phase clinical trials, assay development, CE-IVD and Pharma clients. Ensure quality and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.

• Support R&D activities for primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, special stains, and digital pathology, contributing to new product development and process improvements.

• Serve as the medical representative on project teams, addressing all pathology-related aspects and queries, and making strategic contributions through medical knowledge.

• Participate in Pharma client meetings to support biomarker hypothesis testing strategies, and drive activities for publication and/or patent potential.

• Coordinate the work of contracted pathologists, including training, assigning work and advising on day-to-day activities, as needed.

• Contribute to internal pathology education programs, perform training and scoring of slides, read clinical trial patient samples for the CDx laboratory (Penzberg), and stay up-to-date on pathology, oncology, and molecular biology literature.

• Serve as Principal Investigator with medical accountability across multiple European clinical trials within global CDx development programs, acting as the primary medical interface to Pharma partners.

• Provide medical oversight of laboratory processes, procedures, and quality management systems. Ensure compliance with local regulatory requirements as well as global Roche and international standards and supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are

• We seek a Pathologist (m/f/d) with German board certification, a valid German medical license and at least one year of clinical or industry experience

• The ideal candidates will have proven expertise in immunohistochemistry

• You are experienced in interpretation and assessment of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, and molecular platforms

• You are proficient in providing pathology support to project teams and clinical trials

• Furthermore, you are skilled in leading people while communicating effectively, and working within multidisciplinary teams

Your Application
Please submit your updated CV. References and certificates are not required at this stage.
Please note that no additional documents can be submitted

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Roche is seeking a Medical Affairs leader to shape the future of our Multiple Sclerosis (MS) therapy area. As the Group Leader Medical Affairs , you will lead an experienced team of Global Medical Science Leaders (MDs, PhDs, and PharmDs) who are collectively responsible for our MS medical affairs strategy. This team defines the integrated medical strategy—driving evidence generation, strategic engagement, and medical insights that directly influence how we bring innovative assets to patients worldwide. You will sit at the center of a cross-functional ecosystem, collaborating with specialists in Scientific Communications, Patient Partnership, and Real-World Data to ensure our science changes lives.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will:

• Architect Evidence Strategies: Lead the design and execution of global evidence generation plans, bridging medical and market access gaps through clinical studies and Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS).

• Forge Purposeful Networks: Build and lead scientific exchange with top-tier academic specialists, clinical influencers, and healthcare stakeholders globally to drive RWD initiatives and research collaborations.

• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthesize complex medical insights to steer commercialization strategies at both the asset and Disease Area levels.

• Enable Market Access: Provide the medical "north star" for market access strategies, ensuring our innovations are positioned for maximum patient benefit and operational success.

• Champion Scientific Innovation: Secure the strategic input necessary to enable the introduction of next-generation therapies.

• Lead with Global Influence: Collaborate seamlessly across Roche’s Pharma and Diagnostics Divisions and our global affiliate network to ensure a unified medical voice.

Who You Are

You are a visionary leader with deep scientific roots and a relentless passion for Neurology. You don’t just manage teams; you inspire experts to push the boundaries of what’s possible.
Your credentials include:

• Deep Expertise: An advanced life-science degree ( MD, PhD, or PharmD ) with a specialization in Neurology or equivalent high-level industry experience.

• Proven Leadership: A distinguished track record in Medical Affairs, with a demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing expert teams.

• Patient-Centric Ethics: Unwavering ethical standards and a mindset that places the patient at the center of clinical development and medical practice.

• Strategic Agility: The ability to navigate complex global environments, make informed decisions under pressure, and influence stakeholders through exceptional communication.

• Global Fluency: Mastery of written and verbal communication, capable of engaging and inspiring diverse audiences worldwide.

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover how your leadership can redefine the MS landscape at Roche!

Questo team definisce la strategia medica integrata: la generazione di prove, l'impegno strategico e le intuizioni mediche che influenzano direttamente il modo in cui portiamo beni innovativi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. • Champion Scientific Innovation: assicura l'ingresso strategico necessario per consentire l'introduzione di terapie di nuova generazione.
• Guidare con l’influenza globale: collaborare senza soluzione di continuità attraverso le Divisioni Farmacie e Diagnostica di Roche e la nostra rete di affiliazione globale per garantire una voce medica unificata. Chi sei Sei un leader visionario con profonde radici scientifiche e una passione incessante per la neurologia. Non si gestisce solo team; si ispirano esperti a spingere i confini di ciò che è possibile. Le tue credenziali includono:
• Profonda competenza: un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (MD, PhD, o PharmD) con una specializzazione in neurologia o equivalente esperienza di settore di alto livello.
• Prove Leadership: un disco distinto in Medical Affairs, con una capacità dimostrata di guidare, mentore e sviluppare team di esperti altamente performanti.
• Etica paziente-critrica: Unwavering standard etici e una mentalità che colloca il paziente al centro dello sviluppo clinico e della pratica medica.
• Agility strategica: la capacità di navigare in ambienti globali complessi, prendere decisioni informate sotto pressione e influenzare gli stakeholder attraverso una comunicazione eccezionale.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Roche sucht einen Medical Affairs-Führer, um die Zukunft unseres Therapiegebiets Multiple Sclerosis (MS) zu prägen. Als Group Leader Medical Affairs führen Sie ein erfahrenes Team von Global Medical Science Leaders (MDs, PhDs und PharmDs), die gemeinsam für unsere MS Medical Affairs Strategie verantwortlich sind. Dieses Team definiert die integrierte medizinische Strategie – treibende Beweiserzeugung, strategisches Engagement und medizinische Erkenntnisse, die direkt Einfluss darauf haben, wie wir weltweit innovative Assets für Patienten bringen. Sie werden im Zentrum eines funktionsübergreifenden Ökosystems sitzen, das mit Spezialisten in der wissenschaftlichen Kommunikation, der Patientenpartnerschaft und der Real-World-Daten zusammenarbeitet, um unseren Wissenschaftswandel zu gewährleisten. Die Chance In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Architekt Evidence Strategies: Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Durchführung von globalen Beweiserzeugungsplänen, überbrücken medizinische und Marktzugangslücken durch klinische Studien und Investigator-Initiierte Studien (IIS).
• Forge Purposeful Networks: Errichten und führen Sie den wissenschaftlichen Austausch mit hochrangigen akademischen Spezialisten, klinischen Influencern und Interessenvertretern im Gesundheitswesen weltweit, um RWD-Initiativen und Forschungskooperationen zu fördern.
• Übersetzen Sie Einblicke in die Strategie: Synthesisieren Sie komplexe medizinische Erkenntnisse, um die Vermarktungsstrategien sowohl auf der Ebene des Asset- als auch des Krankheitsbereichs zu steuern.
• Marktzugang aktivieren: Bereitstellung des medizinischen "Nordsterns" für Marktzugangsstrategien, damit unsere Innovationen für maximalen Patientennutzen und betrieblichen Erfolg positioniert werden.
• Champion Scientific Innovation: Sichern Sie den strategischen Beitrag, der erforderlich ist, um die Einführung von Therapien der nächsten Generation zu ermöglichen.
• Lead with Global Influence: nahtlos in die Pharma- und Diagnostikabteilungen von Roche und unser globales Affiliate-Netzwerk um eine einheitliche medizinische Stimme zu gewährleisten. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein visionärer Führer mit tiefen wissenschaftlichen Wurzeln und einer unerbittlichen Leidenschaft für Neurologie. Sie verwalten nicht nur Teams; Sie inspirieren Experten, um die Grenzen des Möglichen zu verschieben. Ihre Anmeldeinformationen beinhalten:
• Deep Expertise: Ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss (MD, PhD, oder PharmD) mit einer Spezialisierung auf Neurologie oder gleichwertigem High-Level-Branche-Erlebnis.
• Proven Leadership: Ein ausgezeichneter Erfolg in Medical Affairs, mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit zu führen, Mentor, und entwickeln hochperforming Expertenteams.
• Patient-Centric Ethics: Unwavering ethische Standards und eine Denkweise, die den Patienten in den Mittelpunkt der klinischen Entwicklung und der medizinischen Praxis stellt.
• Strategische Agilität: Die Fähigkeit, komplexe globale Umgebungen zu navigieren, fundierte Entscheidungen unter Druck zu treffen und Stakeholder durch außergewöhnliche Kommunikation zu beeinflussen.
• Global Fluency: Meisterschaft der schriftlichen und verbalen Kommunikation, in der Lage, verschiedene Publikum weltweit zu begeistern. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns auf Ihr Gehör. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt zu entdecken, wie Ihre Führung die MS-Landschaft bei Roche neu definieren kann! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche cherche un leader des affaires médicales pour façonner l'avenir de notre zone de thérapie de la sclérose en plaques (MS). En tant que chef de groupe des affaires médicales, vous dirigerez une équipe expérimentée de leaders mondiaux des sciences médicales (MD, doctorats et PharmDs) qui sont collectivement responsables de notre stratégie en matière de sciences médicales. Cette équipe définit la stratégie médicale intégrée – génération de preuves de conduite, engagement stratégique et perspectives médicales qui influencent directement la façon dont nous apportons des actifs innovants aux patients dans le monde entier. Vous siégerez au centre d'un écosystème interfonctionnel, en collaboration avec des spécialistes des communications scientifiques, du partenariat patient et des données du monde réel afin de s'assurer que notre science change les vies. L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Stratégies en matière de preuves architecturales : Diriger la conception et l'exécution de plans mondiaux de production de preuves, combler les lacunes médicales et d'accès aux marchés grâce à des études cliniques et à des études menées par des chercheurs.
• Forge Des réseaux ciblés : Construisez et dirigez des échanges scientifiques avec des spécialistes universitaires de haut niveau, des influenceurs cliniques et des intervenants dans le domaine de la santé à l'échelle mondiale afin de stimuler les initiatives et les collaborations en matière de DDR.
• Translate Insights into Strategy: Synthétiser des informations médicales complexes pour orienter les stratégies de commercialisation tant au niveau des actifs qu'au niveau des maladies.
• Permettre l'accès au marché : fournir la « étoile nord » médicale pour les stratégies d'accès au marché, en veillant à ce que nos innovations soient positionnées pour un maximum d'avantages pour le patient et de succès opérationnel.
• Champion de l'innovation scientifique : Sécuriser l'apport stratégique nécessaire pour permettre l'introduction de thérapies de nouvelle génération.
• Diriger avec l'influence mondiale : Collaborer de manière transparente entre les divisions Pharma et Diagnostics de Roches et notre réseau mondial d'affiliation pour assurer une voix médicale unifiée. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader visionnaire aux racines scientifiques profondes et à la passion incessante pour la neurologie. Vous ne gérez pas simplement des équipes ; vous inspirez les experts à repousser les limites de ce qui est possible. Vos références comprennent :
• Deep Expertise : Diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (M.D., Ph.D. ou PharmD) avec spécialisation en neurologie ou expérience professionnelle équivalente de haut niveau.
• Leadership prouvé : Un parcours remarquable en affaires médicales, avec une capacité démontrée de diriger, de guider et de développer des équipes d'experts hautement performantes.
• Éthique du patient : Des normes éthiques inébranlables et un état d'esprit qui place le patient au centre du développement clinique et de la pratique médicale.
• Agilité stratégique : Capacité de naviguer dans des environnements mondiaux complexes, de prendre des décisions éclairées sous pression et d'influencer les parties prenantes par une communication exceptionnelle.
• La fluidité globale : maîtrise de la communication écrite et verbale, capable d'engager et d'inspirer divers publics dans le monde entier. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir comment votre leadership peut redéfinir le paysage MS à Roche! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Doing now what patients need next. Near Patient Care is committed to helping people with diabetes everywhere in the world think less about their daily diabetes routine, so they can get true relief, day and night. We offer a broad portfolio of solutions for both people with diabetes and their professionals - from blood glucose monitoring to information management to continuous glucose monitoring. Our aim is to offer innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis is a function within Roche Diagnostics - Near Patient Care Operations, responsible for the strip manufacturing of the majority of our blood glucose monitoring portfolio for the global demand of our patients. In the future, Internal Manufacturing Indianapolis will also be responsible for sensor manufacturing for our continuous glucose monitoring portfolio.

The Opportunity:

As a Sr Manufacturing Engineer - Controls, you will provide technical engineering support of automated and semi-automated manufacturing equipment as required by the production schedule. You will troubleshoot equipment and process issues, lead/contribute to process improvement/characterization projects, train maintenance and production personnel, conduct pilot and validation activities following Roche Diagnostics – Near Patient Care Operations policies and procedure. You will ensure the validated state of the production process/equipment is maintained.

Your Responsibilities;

• Leads the development, implementation and maintenance of manufacturing methods, procedures and processes in the manufacture of products, components, subassemblies and final assemblies.

• Develops and improves automation and electromechanical processes by studying requirements; researching and testing manufacturing and assembly methods and materials; and soliciting observations from operators and maintenance technicians.

• Interfaces with design and process development engineering in coordinating the release of new products to the manufacturing process.

• Helps to estimate manufacturing cost and makes recommendations for tooling, controls system hardware and software, and process requirements of new or existing production lines.

• Manages multiple projects and time scopes for each project.

• Ensures process changes are characterized and implemented following validation policies and procedures.

• Assures system and product quality by designing testing methods; testing finished -product and system capabilities; and confirming fabrication, assembly, and installation processes.

• Assists department leadership in setting strategic direction.

• Possess and apply a broad knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures of the field.

• Maintains product and company reputation by complying with government regulations.

• Provide guidance and advice to lower level staff.

• Participates in the on-call rotation to provide off shift / weekend support to production, as needed.

• Support key initiatives such as information management, cyber security, and life cycle management.

•

Knowledge/Skills/Attributes

• This role requires hands-on experience in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment controls systems. Key areas of focus include, but are not limited to:

• Electrical systems

• PLC ladder logic and structured text (preferably Allen Bradley PLCs using RSLogix/Studio 5000)

• Motion Controls (e.g. VFDs, servos, etc.)

• Human Machine Interface (HMI) (p

jobs.title: Ad Operations Coordinator (Fixed-term)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has newly been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

The Ad Operations Coordinator plays a central role in ensuring high-quality campaign activation and reliable data foundations for reporting and performance measurement. This role requires a hands-on operator with strong technical expertise in ad serving platforms, combined with a structured, detail-oriented mindset and a focus on scalable and sustainable operations.

This is a fixed-term opportunity for 1,5 year.

The Opportunity:

• Manage and support the setup, configuration, and ongoing operation of Roche Pharma’s ad server environment, including the rollout and adoption of usage across teams in line with defined standards and best practices

• Execute and oversee campaign trafficking end-to-end, ensuring accurate setup, tagging, ad assignment, and launch readiness, while reviewing and correcting builds to maintain high execution quality

• Act as a subject matter expert for ad server governance, maintaining naming conventions, taxonomy, and trafficking standards, and ensuring consistency, auditability, and operational discipline

• Ensure data integrity across the ad server ecosystem by supporting tagging and tracking frameworks, validating reporting outputs, and collaborating with analytics teams to enable reliable dashboards and measurement

• Troubleshoot campaign and data issues, serve as a key point of contact for stakeholders, and drive continuous improvement of workflows, processes, and scalable ad operations practices

Who you are:

• You have 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, ad operations, campaign management, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience in ad trafficking and ad server operations, ideally within a media agency or comparable in-house function

• You have strong hands-on experience with ad-serving platforms such as Campaign Manager 360 (CM360) or equivalent, and understand campaign setup, tagging workflows, placement structures, creatives, and tracking methodologies

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential and additional languages are a plus, based on region/customer requirements

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and efficient with time management

• You are able to work under pressure and work independently

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching/mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global, inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes,

jobs.title: PSS Transformation Solution Partner

titleByLocale.it: Partner della soluzione di trasformazione PSS
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la solution de transformation PSS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Transformation and Solution Partner (TSP) , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor (TSA). You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow.

Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner:

• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.

• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.

• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.

• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network.Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.

• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.

• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability.

Who you are:
You bring the following skills and competencies:

• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.

• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.

• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.

• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.

• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority.

Further requirements:

• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.

• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.

• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.

• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.

• Certification: Project management and/or process

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
岗位名称：（高级）渠道拓展策略经理
工作地点：上海/北京

负责从战略规划到绩效达成的全流程管理。基于美多芭产品特性，构建医院广阔市场与院外零售市场双轨战略，与跨部门建立基于产品的高效合作机制，充分整合内外部资源、赋A能经销商，创新业务模式，最终实现业务的成功转型与稳健增长。

您将有机会：
负责核心战略规划与绩效管理：

• 分渠道策略制定： 深度洞察VBP政策、市场竞争及患者需求，分别制定美多芭在医院广阔市场与零售市场的精准业务策略、目标与实施路径。

• 整合策略设计： 主导制定医院与零售渠道的协同整合策略，确保患者在不同场景间的无缝流转。

• 策略迭代与优化： 建立策略追踪与评估体系，紧密监控落地过程，基于市场反馈与数据洞察，及时发起并领导策略的动态调整，确保战略敏捷性。

• 绩效目标设定： 主导设定两大渠道的年度/季度绩效目标，并确保目标清晰传达至所有相关执行团队及合作伙伴。

• 绩效监控与分析： 建立并主导定期的业务绩效复盘会议，深入分析绩效差距的根本原因，识别风险与机会。

负责跨部门领导与资源统筹：

• 横向协同枢纽：主动与销售市场部、销售部、医学部、财务及数字化团队进行无缝沟通与协调，确保各职能部门对整体战略的理解一致与行动同步。

• 资源整合与分配： 根据双轨策略的优先级，统筹并优化市场与渠道投入的预算与资源，向管理层提供基于投资回报分析的资金分配建议，确保资源投向最高价值领域。

负责生态构建与伙伴策略：

• 全域伙伴管理：主导构建基于产品特性的全域伙伴网络，从战略层面规划合作模式，赋能伙伴共同成长。

• 零售生态打造： 探索并推动与互联网医院、线上平台及患者社区等多元主体的深度合作，构建一个服务患者的创新零售生态体系。

创新模式探索与落地：

• 创新推广与患者管理： 探索并试点两个渠道的创新推广模式及患者管理模式。

• 创新支付与医疗生态： 牵头探索创新支付模式，并积极布局与各类医疗健康服务提供方的合作，共同构建服务于帕金森病患者的“诊-疗-付-管”一体化医疗新生态。

我们期待您：

• 本科及以上学历

• 8年以上药企经验，至少3年担任全国市场经理、高级产品经理或战略项目经理等职位，具有从策略制定到落地，并直接对业务指标达成负责的成功经验。

• 必须拥有深厚的绩效管理经验，包括但不限于：KPI体系设计、业务复盘、预算与资源分配的绩效导向管理。

• 必须同时具备医院市场与零售市场的深厚知识，并拥有直接管理或深度协同销售团队及外部伙伴达成业绩的成功案例。

• 政策理解和行业洞察力、较强的策略分析能力、大客户管理和谈判能力、项目管理和敏捷执行能力、跨部门沟通协调能力。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
The Patient Solution Manager will play a crucial role in planning, executing, and closing projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. This role requires exceptional organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

Key Responsibilities:
Define nation-wide and local (by different ecosystem circle) projects scope, goals, and deliverables. Develop comprehensive project plans, budgets, and timelines.
• Build and lead cross-functional project teams. Set clear expectations, delegate tasks, and ensure team members are motivated and productive.
• Allocate and manage project resources efficiently. Monitor resource utilization and adjust as needed.
• Identify project risks and develop mitigation plans. Proactively address issues to keep projects on track.
• Ensure that project deliverables meet quality standards. Conduct regular quality checks and reviews.
• Maintain clear and open communication with stakeholders, team members, and senior management. Provide regular project status updates and reports.
• Monitor project budgets and expenses. Control costs and seek opportunities for cost savings.
• Manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs. Assess the impact and communicate changes effectively.
• Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, schedules, and status reports.
• Build strong relationships with KOLs or other key stakeholders. Ensure their needs and expectations are met throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualification Requirement:
Job Required Competencies
• Proven experience as a Project Manager, with a track record of successfully delivering projects on time and within budget.
• Solid leadership and team management skills.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Proficiency in project management software and tools.
• Problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
• Knowledge of industry best practices in project management

Years of Working Experience
• 5 years above experience in pharmaceutical industry

Education/Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, project management, or a related field. PMP certification is a plus.
• An MBA or relevant certifications may be preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Information Solutions (RIS), we now do what patients need next. We are transforming healthcare through digital innovation, building high-scale, cloud-native platforms that support clinicians and patients globally. We are seeking a high-seniority Java Developer for our Warsaw-based hub who can be co-located, and brings an AI-first mindset to the software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity

You will work on a cloud-native digital pathology platform that is transforming how pathology laboratories operate worldwide. The system enables pathologists, histotechnicians, and laboratory coordinators to digitize tissue slide specimens, manage clinical cases end-to-end, review high-resolution slide images remotely, run AI-powered algorithms for diagnostic decision support, and seamlessly exchange data with laboratory information systems (LIS) and PACS archives. The vision is to deliver advanced medical insights and drive personalized healthcare by replacing manual, microscope-bound workflows with a connected, software-defined laboratory experience.

As a Java Developer, you will build and evolve the microservices that power these clinical workflows — from image ingestion and case management to algorithm orchestration and third-party integrations — directly contributing to faster, more confident diagnoses for patients globally.

Who you are:

The "AI-First" Mindset

Beyond technical mastery, we value developers who treat AI agents as a core partner in their workflow:

• SDLC Optimization: Using AI tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, or LLMs) to accelerate refactoring, boilerplate generation, and complex bug hunting.

• Agentic Awareness: Understanding how to leverage AI agents to automate routine tasks such as unit test generation, documentation, and PR descriptions.

• Efficiency: A proactive approach to using prompt engineering to drive speed and quality in production-ready code.

Technical Skills :

• Strong Knowledge of Java: Deep understanding of core Java (including Java 17+ features), JVM internals, memory management, and concurrency.

• Extensive Spring Experience: Proficient in Spring Boot, including modules like Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security.

• Microservices Architecture: Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying microservices-based applications.

• Cloud Technologies: Hands-on experience with the AWS cloud platform.

• Databases: Proficiency in SQL databases, specifically PostgreSQL.

• Testing: Solid experience with unit testing (JUnit, Mockito), integration testing, and end-to-end testing.

• Version Control: Advanced proficiency with Git, including branching strategies and code review processes.

• APIs: Strong understanding of RESTful API design and development.

Skills & Experience:

• A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Java software development.

• Code Quality: A strong advocate for high-quality code, best practices, and clean code principles (SOLID).

• Fluent English

• Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex, distributed issues.

• Project Ownership: Capable of taking full ownership of features and projects, from initial conception to deployment and maintenance.

• Independence and Autonomy: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and be proactive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Strong Communication: Excellent skills in articulating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Team C

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who We Are

Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to millions of patients worldwide. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine from the development process through clinical trials and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of the production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.
Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is an integral part of this mission. As an organization of over 2,500 people globally, PTD is responsible for developing the manufacturing processes, products, analytical methods, and Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) strategies to deliver all new products in Roche’s pipeline. This work encompasses the full range of development functions, including biologics, synthetic molecules, devices, clinical supply chain management, and project and portfolio management. PTD applies leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical-stage products globally, reliably delivering the pipeline and supporting commercial manufacturing operations. We excel through innovation, collaboration, dedication, and mutual respect, continuously improving what we do to ensure Roche’s supply of quality products to patients. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, technical excellence, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Position Purpose

As the Global Head of Pharma Technical Development Synthetic Molecules (PTDC), you are an enterprise leader responsible for the strategic direction, development, clinical manufacturing of Roche’s Synthetic Molecule portfolio. This is a triple-impact role: you lead the end-to-end technical development (CMC) for small molecules, oligonucleotides and peptides, while simultaneously serving as the PTD Basel Site Head .
You are also responsible for internal manufacturing of launch and commercial supply of drug substance for the synthetic molecules.

You are the primary accountable leader of the new Synthetic Molecule Facility (SMF), ensuring it is delivered on time and on budget to deliver Pharma Ambition. You act as a catalyst for "Collective Leadership" within PTD, bridging the gap between early-stage innovation and commercial launch excellence.

Key Responsibilities

1. Synthetic Molecule Portfolio & End-to-End Development

• E2E Accountability: Lead the vision and execution for synthetic molecule drug substance, from discovery support and clinical manufacturing to commercial launch and lifecycle management.

• Launch Excellence: Ensure "Right First Time" (RFT) delivery of CMC packages for NMEs (New Molecular Entity) and Line Extensions, directly contributing to Roche's overall goals and R&D Excellence goals.

• Technical Innovation: Drive next-generation synthetic capabilities, including digital automation, "Lab to Plant" models, and sustainable "Green Chemistry" processes.

2. Basel Site Leadership (PTD Site Head)

• Site Governance: Serve as the single point of accountability for all PTD site-related matters in Basel. This includes oversight of Quality, Safety, Sustainability, and Infrastructure.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Chi siamo Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) è l'organizzazione che produce e fornisce le terapie innovative di Roche a milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. PT è coinvolto nella produzione di ogni farmaco Roche dal processo di sviluppo attraverso studi clinici e continua a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) è parte integrante di questa missione. Come organizzazione di oltre 2.500 persone a livello globale, PTD è responsabile per lo sviluppo di processi di produzione, prodotti, metodi analitici, e Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) strategie per fornire tutti i nuovi prodotti nella pipeline di Roche. Questo lavoro comprende l'intera gamma di funzioni di sviluppo, tra cui biologici, molecole sintetiche, dispositivi, gestione della supply chain clinica e gestione del progetto e del portafoglio. PTD applica competenze tecniche leader per la progettazione, lo sviluppo, la fornitura e la registrazione di prodotti a livello globale, fornendo in modo affidabile la pipeline e supportando le operazioni di produzione commerciale. Eccelleremo attraverso innovazione, collaborazione, dedizione e rispetto reciproco, migliorando continuamente ciò che facciamo per garantire la fornitura di prodotti di qualità ai pazienti. Ci impegniamo al rigore scientifico, all'eccellenza tecnica, all'etica insopportabile e all'accesso alle innovazioni mediche per tutti. Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Oggetto Come Capo Globale dello Sviluppo Tecnico di Pharma Molecules sintetico (PTDC), sei un leader aziendale responsabile della direzione strategica, dello sviluppo, della produzione clinica del portafoglio di Roche Synthetic Molecule. Si tratta di un ruolo triplo-impatto: si guida lo sviluppo tecnico end-to-end (CMC) per piccole molecole, oligonucleotidi e peptidi, mentre allo stesso tempo serve come PTD Basel Site Head . Sei anche responsabile per la produzione interna di lancio e la fornitura commerciale di sostanza farmacologica per le molecole sintetiche. Sei il leader principale responsabile della nuova Sintetico Molecule Facility (SMF), assicurando che sia consegnato in tempo e sul budget per consegnare Pharma Ambition. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Qui nous sommes Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à des millions de patients dans le monde entier. PT est impliqué dans la production de chaque médicament Roche depuis le processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques et jusqu'à la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de cette mission. En tant qu'organisation de plus de 2 500 personnes à l'échelle mondiale, PTD est responsable du développement des procédés de fabrication, des produits, des méthodes d'analyse et des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour livrer tous les nouveaux produits dans le pipeline de Roche. Ce travail englobe toute la gamme des fonctions de développement, y compris les produits biologiques, les molécules synthétiques, les dispositifs, la gestion clinique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la gestion de projets et de portefeuilles. La PTD applique une expertise technique de premier plan à la conception, au développement, à l'approvisionnement et à l'enregistrement des produits en phase clinique à l'échelle mondiale, à la livraison fiable du pipeline et au soutien des activités de fabrication commerciale. Nous excellons par l'innovation, la collaboration, le dévouement et le respect mutuel, en améliorant continuellement ce que nous faisons pour assurer la fourniture de produits de qualité aux patients. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'excellence technique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Fonction En tant que responsable mondial du développement technique des molécules synthétiques (PTDC), vous êtes un chef d'entreprise responsable de la direction stratégique, du développement, de la fabrication clinique du portefeuille des molécules synthétiques Roches. C'est un rôle à triple impact : vous dirigez le développement technique de bout en bout (CMC) pour les petites molécules, oligonucléotides et peptides, tout en servant simultanément comme tête de site de la PTD Basel. Vous êtes également responsable de la fabrication interne du lancement et de l'approvisionnement commercial de la substance médicamenteuse pour les molécules synthétiques. Vous êtes le chef de file principal responsable de la nouvelle installation de molécules synthétiques (MFS), vous assurant qu'elle est livrée à temps et dans le budget pour livrer Pharma Ambition. Vous servez de catalyseur pour le « leadership collectif » au sein de la DPT, comblant l'écart entre l'innovation en début de carrière et l'excellence du lancement commercial. Principales responsabilités 1. Portefeuille des molécules synthétiques et développement de bout en bout
• E2E Responsabilisation: Diriger la vision et l'exécution de la substance médicamenteuse à molécule synthétique, du soutien à la découverte et à la fabrication clinique au lancement commercial et à la gestion du cycle de vie.
• Lancer Excellence : assurer la livraison des trousses de CMC pour les EMN (nouvelle entité moléculaire) et les extensions de lignes, contribuant directement aux objectifs généraux de Roche et aux objectifs d'excellence en R-D.
• Innovation technique: Diriger les capacités synthétiques de nouvelle génération, y compris l'automatisation numérique, les modèles "Lab to Plant" et les processus durables "Green Chemistry". 2. Leadership du site de Bâle (chef du site du DPT)
• Gouvernance du site: Servir de point unique de responsabilité pour toutes les questions liées au site de la PTD à Bâle. Cela comprend la surveillance de la qualité, de la sécurité, de la durabilité et de l'infrastructure.
• Membre actif de l'équipe de gestion de Bâle/Kaiseraugst : représentant efficacement et faisant avancer les intérêts de la PTD et du site lors de la réunion de gestion de Bâle Kaiseraugst.
• Les gens et la culture : favoriser une organisation à haut rendement (HPO). Formation des employés principaux, initiatives de mobilisation

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

As an Accounts Receivable & Treasury Analyst, you play a key role in performing the day-to-day activities for AR & Treasury matters according to the highest standards of financial control, compliance and effective practices.

You will be :

• You are responsible in processing Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement.

• You process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Then, you also prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for key individuals further actions.

• You perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Also, reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit assessment and make credit limit recommendation.

• You ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if vital as per company’s debt collection procedure.

• You ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines. You also engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project.

Who you are

• You possess Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• You have minimum 3-5 years working experiences in Accounts Receivable and Treasury or other accounting functions

• Experience in using SAP or other ERP accounting systems will be added advantage.

• You possess good proficiency in English and Japanese language is required with good communication skill as the role will be supporting our counterpart in Japan.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Responsable Territorial Equipe Services (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale en région Parisienne

Mission :

• En tant que responsable d'une équipe service pour cette zone géographique, il/elle est responsable de la qualité du service produit par l’équipe et de l’amélioration continue des processus qu’il/elle supervise.

• Leader, il/elle sait partager et engager autour d’une vision stratégique, et structurer les activités de manière efficace et collaborative. En tant que coach, il/elle accompagne le développement de son équipe.

• Multiplicateur de la culture agile, il/elle met en place dans son équipe un cadre d’ autonomie croissante et crée les conditions d’une décision déléguée efficace; il/elle recrute les talents dont l’organisation a besoin, anticipe sur les nouvelles compétences grâce à sa veille des évolutions du marché, et enfin, il/elle incarne les Leadership commitments.

Principales responsabilité:

• De manière opérationnelle, il/elle participe à des projets au sein de son chapter/de la filiale/ de la région .

• Il/elle pilote les activités de ses équipes et assure l’amélioration continue des processus de son activité. Il est le point d’entrée de l’équipe admin Service pour le dispatch et assure un soutien sur les procédures d’inventaires

• Il/elle met en place les conditions facilitant les gains d’efficacité de l’activité, et les plans d’accompagnement au changement vers ces évolutions (notamment partenariats externes et internes)

• Il/elle priorise les activités de son équipe en prenant en compte: les besoins des networks; les plans de déploiements sur son territoire + vision nationale; nos engagements avec les clients; la criticité (business continuité) des nos clients et de RDF

• Il s’assure du maintien à jour des processus métiers liés à son activité et est le garant de la gestion de la connaissance liée à son activité

• Il/elle garantit le respect des règles de conformité au sein de son équipe

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro (ou équivalent) en lien direct avec les dimensions techniques (hardware ou application) et organisationnelle.

• Vous présentez de bonnes qualités de leadership et avez de bonnes appétences pour le coaching et le développement des équipes

• Votre niveau d'Anglais est professionnel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che vantate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete stimati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di tre sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui amiamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Posizione Ideale nella Missione di Parigi:
• Come capo di un team di assistenza per questa area geografica, è responsabile della qualità del servizio prodotto dal team e del continuo miglioramento dei processi che supervisiona.
• Leader, può condividere e coinvolgere una visione strategica e le attività di struttura in modo efficace e collaborativo. Come allenatore, sostiene lo sviluppo della sua squadra.
• Multiplicando la cultura agile, crea un quadro per aumentare l'autonomia all'interno del suo team e crea le condizioni per una decisione delegata efficace; recluta i talenti di cui l'organizzazione ha bisogno, anticipa nuove competenze grazie alla sua anticipazione degli sviluppi del mercato, e infine, incarna Leadership Commitments. Responsabilità principali:
• Operativamente, partecipa a progetti nel suo Capitolo/Subsidiary/Region.
• Gestisce le attività dei suoi team e garantisce un continuo miglioramento dei processi della sua attività. È il punto di ingresso del team di servizio di amministrazione per la spedizione e fornisce supporto alle procedure di inventario
• Egli crea condizioni per facilitare i guadagni di efficienza in attività e piani per sostenere i cambiamenti verso questi sviluppi (compresi i partenariati esterni e interni)
• Preferisce le attività del suo team tenendo conto delle esigenze delle reti; piani di implementazione nel suo territorio + visione nazionale; i nostri impegni con i clienti; la criticità (conformità commerciale) dei nostri clienti e RDF
• Assicura il mantenimento dei processi aziendali relativi alla sua attività ed è il garante della gestione delle conoscenze relative alla sua attività. Assicura il rispetto delle regole di conformità all'interno del suo team Chi sei:
• Hai un'esperienza significativa nel campo della diagnosi in vitro (o equivalente) direttamente legata a dimensioni tecniche (hardware o applicazione) e organizzative.
• Hai buone qualità di leadership e buone competenze per coaching e sviluppo di team
• Il tuo livello inglese è professionale Chi siamo Un futuro sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all'avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 trilioni di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un dipendente di pari opportunità.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:
• Operationell beteiligt er sich an Projekten innerhalb seines Kapitels/der Tochtergesellschaft/Region.
• Er/sie verwaltet die Aktivitäten seiner Teams und sorgt für eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Prozesse seines Geschäfts. Es ist der Eingangspunkt des Admin-Service-Teams für den Versand und bietet Unterstützung bei Inventarverfahren
• Er/sie schafft Bedingungen, um Effizienzgewinne in der Tätigkeit zu erleichtern und den Wandel zu diesen Entwicklungen zu unterstützen (einschließlich externer und interner Partnerschaften)
• Er/sie priorisiert die Aktivitäten seines Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Bedürfnisse von Netzwerken; Bereitstellungspläne in seinem Gebiet + nationale Vision; unsere Verpflichtungen mit Kunden; die Kritik (Kontinuität der Unternehmen) unserer Kunden und RDF

• Sie haben gute Führungsqualitäten und gute Fähigkeiten für Coaching und Teamentwicklung
