jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
(Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagement of Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PD of Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality vailable information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the af

jobs.title: Service Design Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints.

About the role

As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals.
Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is.

What you'll do

Research support

• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals

• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks

• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation

• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets

Service design

• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction

• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders

• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing

• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly

Conversational design

• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces

• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context

• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings

• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX

Collaboration

• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts

• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques

• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions

• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints

Who we're looking for

• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field

• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do

• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects

• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments

• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus

• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking

Nice to have

• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail

• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences

• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods

• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design

• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible

What we offer: The internship experience

• A full

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
We are currently looking for two Process Technicians to join our Process Engineering team on a 12-month contract , with the possibility of extension. Both positions will involve the same day-to-day responsibilities outlined below; however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

As a Process Technician you will work closely with the sensor manufacture and packaging teams and will become highly skilled and competent in all aspects of manufacturing (e.g. line operation & packaging, processes and procedures). Be able to diagnose product and process issues quickly and effectively using a logical approach. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring the highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained. Analyse manufacturing data and conduct product / process testing to ensure CTQs are met. Update documentation such as standard operating procedures, work instructions and bills of material.

This is an on-site role based at our Athena Motherwell location. Please note that you will spend approximately 70% of your time working from our Bathgate site, however, one of the roles will also require working at our Dumyat location.

Responsibilities:
Technical:

• Work in close collaboration with manufacturing technicians and engineers to become highly competent in sensor manufacture line operation, processes and procedures

• Support monitoring of product and process data using statistical analysis techniques

• Quick and effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of problems using a methodical approach and report progress in a structured way

• Conduct CTQ testing and material / product analysis techniques

• Investigate and resolve non-conformances and help develop robust OCAP’s and preventative measures

• Support NPD projects through transfer of pilot work to high volume manufacture

• Support validation activities and completion of validation documentation in line with business needs

• Help drive continuous improvement initiatives through engagement of production team on shift

• Ensures highest levels of quality and compliance are maintained

• Lead/support change control updates to manufacturing documentation.

Who you are:

Essential Education/ Qualifications:

• Process Excellence Yellow or Green belt additional advantage.

• Preferably Degree qualified or relevant experience.

• Experience in rotary converting and / or reel to reel printing (rotary screen / flexographic etc.) additional advantage

• Knowledge of Statistical Analysis methods / techniques

Requirements (incl. Key Skills):

• GMP experience

• A hands-on Process Technician with a good level of relevant industry experience (preferably medical device related)

• Experience of optimising product and processes

• High level of computer literacy

• Team player and takes accountability for any manufacturing challenges

• Analyse production data and conduct process / product analysis to ensure CTQs are met

• Strong problem-solving skills and sense of urgency

• Detail orientated and ensures highest levels of quality and productivity are maintained on a daily basis

Recruitment process

Phase I:

• Submission of Cover Letter & CV: Evaluation of technical skills and motivation.

Phase II:

• In-person interview in Athena Motherwell (will be shared with the shortlisted candidates later)

Purpose - our focus in the

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission

As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times.

You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs.
Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps.

You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented.

Key Accountabilities

• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.

• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.

• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.

• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.

• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

• Main responsible for auditing and analyzing the compliance levels of the cases handled by GPC Advisors.

• Close collaboration with global safety and post-market quality teams to ensure end-to-end compliance in the complaint handling process.

• Foster a culture of excellence, inclusivity, and collaboration while driving team and individual performance.

• Cultivate an inspiring team environment that promotes diversity, overcoming the challenges of a multi-location setup.

• Ensure the team delivers exceptional service while optimizing efficiency and effectiveness through continuous improvement.

• Drive the talent acquisition and hiring process, focusing on retaining top talent and maintaining a positive work environment.

• Provide proactive feedback and coaching to team members, managing performance and contributing to succession planning and talent management.

Key skills and Experience

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Solution Architect - Commercial Content Supply Chain

Roche Digital Technology (RDT ) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Be part of the revolution in our commercial content ecosystem. You will spearhead the adoption of Generative AI (GenAI) and Automation solutions, building robust technical foundations and seamless integrations that empower bespoke customer experiences at scale.

Serving as a Lead Architect and Strategist , you will orchestrate the technology roadmap and direct the comprehensive deployment of systems designed to achieve measurable business impact.

The opportunity:

• Defining the Vision and Strategy by serving as the lead architect for our future-state digital supply chain ecosystem.

• Curating the Technology Stack through the selection and integration of modern tools at the crossroads of artificial intelligence and automated workflows.

• Providing Implementation Oversight by directing technical execution and deployment phases to guarantee consistent alignment with our strategic business objectives.

• Driving Personalization at Scale by engineering robust frameworks that facilitate highly.

Who you are:

• Substantial Professional Background including at least a decade in software engineering, with a minimum of five years focused on architectural leadership.

• Strategic Domain Expertise in the architectural design and large-scale deployment of Commercial Content Supply Chains .

• Adobe Platform Mastery , specifically regarding technical proficiency across AEM and AEP integrated technology stacks.

• Engineering Excellence in crafting tailor-made applications through advanced Java , Python , and JavaScript development.

• AI-Driven Innovation demonstrated through the successful execution of GenAI implementations that catalyze significant business value and ROI.

• Life Sciences Insight with a nuanced perspective on Pharma customer journeys and highly regulated industry workflows.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 075-35 425 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed pack

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Senior Solution Architect - Catena di approvvigionamento di contenuti commerciali Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, w e offre un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Partecipa alla rivoluzione nel nostro ecosistema dei contenuti commerciali. Proverai l'adozione di soluzioni Generative AI (GenAI) e Automation, costruendo solide basi tecniche e integrazioni senza soluzione di continuità che consentono di esprimere le esperienze dei clienti su scala. Servendo come Lead Architect e Strategist , orchestrerete la roadmap tecnologica e dirigerete la distribuzione completa di sistemi progettati per raggiungere un impatto commerciale misurabile. L'opportunità:
• Definire la Visione e la Strategia servendo come architetto leader per il nostro ecosistema della supply chain digitale di stato futuro.
• Curare lo Stack Tecnologico attraverso la selezione e l'integrazione di strumenti moderni all'incrocio di intelligenza artificiale e flussi di lavoro automatizzati.
• Fornire la supervisione dell'implementazione, indirizzando fasi di esecuzione e di distribuzione tecniche per garantire un allineamento coerente con i nostri obiettivi strategici aziendali.
• Guidare la personalizzazione a Scale mediante l'ingegneria di strutture robuste che facilitano molto. Chi sei:
• Sfondo professionale sostanziale che include almeno un decennio di ingegneria del software, con un minimo di cinque anni focalizzati sulla leadership architettonica.
• Esperienza di dominio strategico nella progettazione architettonica e distribuzione su larga scala delle catene di approvvigionamento dei contenuti commerciali .
• Adobe Platform Mastery, in particolare per quanto riguarda la competenza tecnica negli stack di tecnologia integrati AEM e AEP.
• Eccellenza ingegneristica nella realizzazione di applicazioni su misura attraverso lo sviluppo avanzato di Java , Python e JavaScript.
• AI-Driven Innovation ha dimostrato attraverso l'esecuzione riuscita di implementazioni GenAI che catalizzano il valore aziendale significativo e ROI.
• Life Sciences Insight con una prospettiva sfumata sui viaggi dei clienti di Pharma e sui flussi di lavoro del settore altamente regolamentati. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Gamma di indennità 19 075-35 425 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale basato sulle prestazioni.
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetto di lusso

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are driven by a shared ambition: to create a healthier future through continuous innovation, advancing science, and expanding access to healthcare for people worldwide. Our purpose is to help build a world where people can spend more time with those who matter most.

As healthcare continues to evolve, Global Procurement is transforming to deliver greater strategic value—enhancing supplier partnerships, driving innovation, and improving outcomes for patients and healthcare systems globally. By actively managing a complex supplier ecosystem, we ensure we meet today’s needs while anticipating those of tomorrow.

The Opportunity

As Analytics & Insights Business Partnering Lead , you will lead the strategic direction of Analytics within the Procurement Enablement chapter. This function is central to building a best-in-class Procurement organization through data-driven insights, governance, capability development, and digital innovation.

You will shape how data is leveraged across Global Procurement, unlocking its full potential to inform decision-making, drive performance, and create tangible business impact. Operating in a highly dynamic, global environment, you will guide teams to apply structured thinking, advanced Analytics, and actionable insights to complex business challenges.

Your Impact

In this leadership role, you will act as a strategic advisor and capability builder, working across Procurement, Finance, and cross-functional Analytics teams. You will lead, coach, and inspire others while delivering high-impact Analytics solutions and fostering a strong data-driven culture.

Key areas of accountability include:

• Setting the vision and strategy for Analytics and insights within business partnering, aligning with broader Global Procurement objectives

• Acting as a senior subject matter expert, guiding best practices in data strategy, Analytics, visualization, and insight generation

• Leading the development and continuous improvement of Analytics products, frameworks, and scalable solutions

• Influencing senior stakeholders to embed data-driven decision-making and improve data quality across the organization

• Building and developing high-performing teams, while contributing to cross-functional initiatives, squads, and enterprise-wide programs

• Championing innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies, methodologies, and ways of working

Who You Are

You are an experienced leader with a strong track record in Analytics, Procurement, and account management within complex, matrixed organizations. You bring both strategic vision and hands-on expertise, along with the ability to influence at the highest levels.

You will typically bring:

• A university degree (business, Analytics, or life sciences preferred)

• 10+ years of experience in Procurement, Analytics, business analysis, or management consulting

• Proven experience translating complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions

• Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to influence and drive adoption of new strategies and technologies

• Deep expertise in data, visualization, and insight generation, combined with experience leading teams and initiatives

• Category management experience is highly advantageous

• Previous account management experience also desirable

• Fluency in English

• Leadership Mindset

You embody an enterprise mindset, thinking beyond functional boundaries to create integrated, customer-centric solu

In einem hochdynamischen, globalen Umfeld werden Sie Teams leiten, um strukturiertes Denken, fortschrittliche Analytics und hilfreiche Einblicke in komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu finden. • Als hochrangiger Fachexperte handeln, Best Practices in der Datenstrategie, Analytics, Visualisierung und Wissensgenerierung leiten

• Erprobte Erfahrung, die komplexe geschäftliche Herausforderungen in skalierbare analytische Lösungen überträgt

The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture.

In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED e gRED, creiamo farmaci migliori aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura data-driven. Come Digital Measures Lead , si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nell'integrazione di tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori nel cuore dei nostri programmi di sviluppo di droga pRED e gRED. Nelle aree di malattia come il morbo di Alzheimer e la Sclerosi Multipla, sarete responsabili di modellare ed eseguire strategie che ci permettono di aumentare la produttività R&D utilizzando le valutazioni dei risultati clinici digitali, i biomarcatori digitali e le misure digitali esplorative raccolte da wearables, smartphone e altre tecnologie di salute digitale basate sui sensori (DHT). Sarete parte di un team di esperti che si trova a Basilea e nel sud di San Francisco e riferirete al gruppo Sensor Data Insights leader nel reparto Biologia e Medicina Computazionale. L'opportunità:
• Collaborare con i team di sviluppo della droga per creare opportunità ad alto impatto che favoriscano i miglioramenti della produttività di trial clinici con DHT basati sui sensori; integrarli in aree di malattia, sviluppo clinico e strategie di biomarcatore.
• Sviluppare mappe stradali complete per realizzare queste opportunità, compresa la valutazione delle esigenze di misura non soddisfatte; valutare, sviluppare, convalidare i DHT basati sui sensori; guidare verso l'accettazione della comunità e della regolamentazione
• Guidare la consegna di queste roadmap. Ciò include la garanzia di approvazione e risourcing della governance; la consegna del team di matrice CoE leader; la gestione dei partenariati di fornitori/tecnologie; l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei DHT basati sui sensori in studi clinici, tra cui progetti di studio, operazioni, analisi dei dati; l'interpretazione dei risultati di supporto.
• Promuovere partnership esterne con industria, fornitori di tecnologia, centri accademici, regolatori e pazienti per rafforzare e accelerare questi sforzi.
• Guidare la comunicazione scientifica e la leadership di pensiero sia all'interno che all'esterno di Roche attraverso conferenze e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, mentre sostenere il rigore scientifico e la concentrazione dei pazienti in tutte le attività. Chi sei?
• Ha un Ph.D. o un'esperienza equivalente in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience o una disciplina correlata accoppiata con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale sfruttando DHT basati sui sensori per migliorare la produttività R&D nelle prove di Fase I-IV
• Possiedi una profonda esperienza in neuroscienze, tra cui la malattia di Alzheimer e la sclerosi multipla, e capire come i DHT basati sui sensori possono essere applicati per i casi di uso di prova clinica in queste aree (ad esempio l'efficacia/sicurezza

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence (CoE) is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units (pRED and gRED) to become more data-driven, more digitally adept, and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the CoE, Computational Medicine focuses on developing and applying innovative data analysis solutions to support clinical development — furthering our understanding of disease, disease progression, and individual patient response to treatment. In partnership with our scientists across pRED and gRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture. As Digital Measures Lead , you will play a pivotal role in embedding sensor-based digital health technologies into the heart of our pRED and gRED drug development programs. In disease areas like Alzheimer’s disease and Multiple Sclerosis, you will be responsible for shaping and executing on strategies that allow us to increase R&D productivity using digital clinical outcome assessments, digital biomarkers and exploratory digital measures collected from wearables, smartphones and other sensor-based digital health technologies (DHTs). You will be part of a team of experts located in Basel and South San Francisco and report to the Sensor Data Insights group lead in the Computational Biology and Medicine department. The Opportunity:
• Partner with drug development teams to shape high-impact opportunities that drive clinical trial productivity improvements with sensor-based DHTs; embed them into disease area, clinical development, and biomarker strategies.
• Develop comprehensive roadmaps to realize these opportunities, including assessing unmet measurement needs; evaluating, developing, validating sensor-based DHTs; driving towards community and regulatory acceptance
• Lead the delivery of these roadmaps. This includes securing governance endorsement and resourcing; leading CoE matrix team delivery; managing vendor/technology partnerships; ensuring seamless integration of sensor-based DHTs into clinical trials, including study designs, operations, data analyses; supporting results interpretation.
• Foster external partnerships with industry, technology providers, academic centers, regulators, and patients to strengthen and accelerate these efforts.
• Drive scientific communication and thought leadership both within and outside Roche through conferences and peer-reviewed publications, while upholding scientific rigor and patient-centricity in all activities. Who You Are:
• You hold a Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Digital Health, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Neuroscience or a related discipline coupled with at least 5+ years of professional experience leveraging sensor-based DHTs to improve R&D productivity in Phase I-IV trials
• You possess deep expertise in neuroscience, including Alzheimer's disease and Multiple Sclerosis, and understand how sensor-based DHTs can be applied for clinical trial use cases in these areas (e.g. efficacy/safet

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally.

The Opportunity
As a TDL, you will lead Technical Development Teams (TDTs) to develop and drive Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (CMC) strategies for clinical drug candidates from early human trials through product launch ensuring technical integrity and proactive risk mitigation.

• Leadership: Lead technical teams throughout the product lifecycle, from preclinical development to product launch, ensuring the scientific integrity of the CMC strategy.

• Strategy & Execution: Designs and implements multifaceted technical strategies - encompassing manufacturing processes, drug product and device configurations, and global supply chains - to ensure seamless regulatory approval and commercial success.

• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Provides enterprise-level perspectives to ensure deliverables remain patient- and customer-focused; serves as a primary liaison to asset teams, senior management and governance committees, delivering transparent updates that facilitate informed decision-making.

• Operational Excellence: Oversees end-to-end CMC development, including financial stewardship, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking to ensure flawless execution.

• Risk & Decision Management: Drives informed decision-making for CMC investments and risk mitigation, developing robust contingency plans and proactively communicating potential impacts to relevant leadership and governance bodies.

Who You Are

• You are a recognized thought leader in CMC/product development with a proven ability to lead complex, high-stakes pharmaceutical projects.

• Education: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Technical Expertise: Extensive pharmaceutical industry experience, including a strong background in biologics process development and CMC team leadership.

• Strategic and Critical Thinking: Advanced understanding of the full drug development process with a history of successful innovation. Business acumen is a plus

• Program Management: Demonstrated ability to handle complex cross-functional programs while thinking strategically and proactively.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional negotiation and verbal/written communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior management and third parties.

.

• Leadership: Leader team tecnici in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dallo sviluppo preclinico al lancio del prodotto, garantendo l'integrità scientifica della strategia CMC.
• Strategia & Esecuzione: Progetta e implementa strategie tecniche sfaccettate, che comprendono processi produttivi, configurazioni di prodotti e dispositivi, e catene di approvvigionamento globali, per garantire una perfetta approvazione normativa e un successo commerciale.
• allineamento aziendale e governance: fornisce prospettive a livello aziendale per garantire che i responsabili rimangano pazienti e orientati al cliente; funge da collegamento primario ai team di asset, ai comitati di gestione e governance senior, fornendo aggiornamenti trasparenti che facilitano il processo decisionale informato.
• Eccellenza operativa: supervisiona lo sviluppo CMC end-to-end, tra cui la gestione finanziaria, la previsione delle risorse e il tracciamento delle pietre miliari per garantire l'esecuzione impeccabile.
• Gestione del rischio e delle decisioni: guida il processo decisionale informato per gli investimenti CMC e la mitigazione dei rischi, lo sviluppo di piani di contingenza robusti e la comunicazione proattiva dei potenziali impatti per gli organismi di leadership e di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Sei un leader di pensiero riconosciuto nello sviluppo CMC / prodotto con una comprovata capacità di condurre progetti farmaceutici complessi e ad alto consumo.
• Istruzione: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chimica, Farmacia, Ingegneria Chimica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Competenza Tecnica: Ampia esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, tra cui un forte background nello sviluppo dei processi biologici e nella leadership del team CMC.
• pensiero strategico e critico: comprensione avanzata del processo di sviluppo completo della droga con una storia di innovazione di successo. Business acumen è un plus
• Gestione del programma: capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi interfunzionali complessi mentre si pensa strategicamente e proattivamente.
• Comunicazione e influenza: negoziazione eccezionale e capacità comunicative verbali/scritte, con un track record di influenzare la gestione senior e terze parti. . Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Die Chance Als TDL führen Sie technische Entwicklungsteams (TDTs) dazu, Chemie, Fertigung und Control (CMC) Strategien für klinische Arzneimittelkandidaten aus frühen humanen Studien zu entwickeln und zu treiben, indem Sie die technische Integrität und proaktive Risikominderung gewährleisten.
• Führung: Führen Sie technische Teams während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der präklinischen Entwicklung bis zum Produktstart, um die wissenschaftliche Integrität der CMC-Strategie zu gewährleisten.
• Strategy & Execution: Entwirft und implementiert vielseitige technische Strategien, die Fertigungsprozesse, Produkt- und Gerätekonfigurationen und globale Lieferketten umfassen, um eine nahtlose regulatorische Genehmigung und kommerziellen Erfolg zu gewährleisten.
• Enterprise Alignment & Governance: Bietet Unternehmensperspektiven, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lieferungen geduldig und kundenorientiert bleiben; dient als primäre Verbindung zu Asset-Teams, Senior Management- und Governance-Komitees und liefert transparente Updates, die die fundierte Entscheidungsfindung erleichtern.
• Operationelle Exzellenz: Übersieht die end-to-end CMC-Entwicklung, einschließlich finanzieller Stewardship, Ressourcenprognose und Meilensteinverfolgung, um eine einwandfreie Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• Risiko- und Entscheidungsmanagement: treibt fundierte Entscheidungsfindung für CMC-Investitionen und Risikominderungen an, entwickelt robuste Notfallpläne und kommuniziert potenzielle Auswirkungen auf relevante Führungs- und Leitungsorgane proaktiv. Wer bist du?
• Sie sind ein anerkannter Denkführer in der CMC/Produktentwicklung mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, komplexe, hochverdiente pharmazeutische Projekte zu führen.
• Ausbildung: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Chemie, Pharmazeutika, Chemische Technik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Technische Expertise: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie, einschließlich eines starken Hintergrunds in der Prozessentwicklung der Biologik und CMC-Team-Führung.
• Strategisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittenes Verständnis des gesamten Drogenentwicklungsprozesses mit einer Geschichte erfolgreicher Innovation. Business acumen ist ein Plus
• Program Management: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Programme zu handhaben, während strategisch und proaktiv denken.
• Kommunikation & Einfluss: Außergewöhnliche Verhandlungs- und mündliche/schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit einem Überblick über die Einflussnahme von Führungskräften und Dritten. . Sind Sie bereit, einen Unterschied für unsere Patienten zu machen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – jetzt beitreten und Teil unserer Reise werden! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Basel. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam über 100’000 Mitarbeiter

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Position Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) est l'organisation qui fabrique et livre des thérapies révolutionnaires à 127 millions de patients dans le monde. PT participe à la production de tous les médicaments Roche – du processus de développement jusqu'aux essais cliniques – et continue à atteindre la maturité du produit. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) fait partie intégrante de la mission de Roches de développer des médicaments innovants et transformatifs significatifs pour les patients en appliquant une expertise technique de premier plan pour concevoir, développer, fournir et enregistrer des produits de stade clinique dans le monde entier. L'opportunité En tant que TDL, vous dirigerez des équipes de développement technique (TDT) afin d'élaborer et de piloter des stratégies de chimie, de fabrication et de contrôle (CMC) pour les candidats aux médicaments cliniques, depuis les premiers essais humains jusqu'au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité technique et l'atténuation proactive des risques.
• Leadership : Diriger les équipes techniques tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, du développement préclinique au lancement du produit, en assurant l'intégrité scientifique de la stratégie CMC.
• Stratégie et exécution : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies techniques multiformes - englobant les procédés de fabrication, les configurations de produits et d'appareils pharmaceutiques et les chaînes d'approvisionnement mondiales - pour assurer une approbation réglementaire et un succès commercial sans faille.
• Alignement et gouvernance de l'entreprise : offre des perspectives à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour s'assurer que les produits livrables restent axés sur le patient et le client; assure la liaison principale avec les équipes d'actifs, les cadres supérieurs et les comités de gouvernance, en fournissant des mises à jour transparentes qui facilitent la prise de décisions éclairées.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Supervise le développement de bout en bout du MCC, y compris la gérance financière, la prévision des ressources et le suivi des étapes pour assurer une exécution parfaite.
• Gestion des risques et des décisions : favorise la prise de décisions éclairées pour les investissements du MCC et l'atténuation des risques, l'élaboration de plans d'urgence robustes et la communication proactive des impacts potentiels aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un chef de file reconnu dans le développement de CMC/produit avec une capacité éprouvée de diriger des projets pharmaceutiques complexes et à fort débit.
• Éducation: B.S./M.S./Ph.D. en chimie, pharmacie, génie chimique, ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Expertise technique : vaste expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique, y compris une solide expérience dans le développement de procédés biologiques et le leadership de l'équipe du CMC.
• Pensée stratégique et critique: compréhension avancée du processus de développement complet des médicaments avec une histoire d'innovation réussie. Le sens des affaires est un atout
• Gestion des programmes : Capacité démontrée de gérer des programmes interfonctionnels complexes tout en pensant de façon stratégique et proactive.
• Communication & influence: compétences exceptionnelles en négociation et en communication verbale/écrite, avec une expérience d'influence sur la haute direction et les tiers. . Êtes-vous prêt à faire une différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et devenez partie intégrante de notre voyage! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle pourrait être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents en matière de rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés

jobs.title: PRACTICANTE DE TALLER
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras.

Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos.

Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche.

Como Practicante de taller , te unirás a nuestro equipo técnico para aprender sobre el mantenimiento de equipos de diagnóstico médico de vanguardia . Esta es una oportunidad única para desarrollar tus habilidades técnicas en un entorno ágil, colaborativo y con un impacto real en la salud de los pacientes .

Oportunidad

• Apoyas las actividades del taller, adquiriendo conocimientos profundos sobre equipos de diagnóstico médico y procesos de gestión .

• Realizas mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos bajo la supervisión del responsable del taller .

• Colaboras con los Ingenieros de Servicio de Campo (FSE) en la instalación y puesta a punto de analizadores Roche (Cobas y Sysmex) .

• Desarrollas aplicaciones para la mejora y automatización de proyectos y actividades internas del taller .

• Gestionas el soporte documentario para los procesos de importación de repuestos y materiales operativos .

• Aseguras el cumplimiento de procedimientos administrativos técnicos, incluyendo la preparación de reportes y manejo de software CRM .

• Participas activamente en los entrenamientos técnicos y sesiones de capacitación impartidas en el taller .

• Contribuyes a la organización de materiales, reactivos y periféricos necesarios para la continuidad del servicio al cliente .

Quien eres

• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Ingeniería Electrónica, Mecatrónica, Biomédica o afines .

• Cuentas con un nivel de inglés intermedio que te permite comprender manuales técnicos .

• Posees un manejo intermedio de MS Office, con énfasis en el uso de Excel para gestión de datos .

• Te caracterizas por tu proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje rápido y orientación al detalle .

• Eres una persona con habilidades para el trabajo en equipo y una fuerte ética profesional .

• Experiencia previa o conocimientos en gestión de laboratorios clínicos sería preferible mas no requerido.

Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst - Quote Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape .

Description of the area
The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .

• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .

• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .

• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .

• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .

• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .

• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .

• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards .

Who you are:

• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .

• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .

• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .

• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .

• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

Description of the area The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM. The Opportunity:
• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .
• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .
• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .
• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .
• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .
• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .
• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .
• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards . Who you are:
• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .
• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .
• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .
• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .
• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

您是谁

教育程度/所获资格证书

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche können Sie so sein, wie Sie sind – mit all den einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönliche Entfaltung, offene Dialoge und aufrichtige Beziehungen. Hier werden Sie für die Person, die Sie sind, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert, sodass Sie sich persönlich und beruflich entfalten können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Mensch heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werde Teil von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position:

• Die Abstimmung des Projektportfolios mit den Kapazitäten und Fähigkeiten von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ist die Kernaufgabe

• Als Projekt-Liaison sind Sie die primäre Kontaktperson für Projekte aus Forschung und Entwicklung (REDs), Einlizensierungen sowie für lokale und globale Planungsrollen und -gremien. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern wie Synthetic Molecule Technical Development, Galenik, Regulatory und Quality gewährleisten Sie, dass die jeweiligen Projektziele abgestimmt sind.

• Sie übernehmen die Leitung für strategische Projektplanung & Machbarkeit und führen somit die langfristige strategische Planung aus, insbesondere eine 5-Jahres-Ausblicks für Betriebsanlagen und Personal, sowie Durchführung von Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Kapazitätsbewertungen.

• In der Rolle des Ressourcenkoordinators stimmen Sie Ressourcen in Kollaboration mit den Sektionen innerhalb von DS Clinical & Commercial Supply ab und überwachen die Planung innerhalb der Abteilung.

• Sie fungieren als Fachexperte und Berater für Herstellungsprozesse und/oder -anlagen und stellen Ihr Fachwissen zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme sowie strategischer Fragestellungen bereit. Sie leiten komplexe Untersuchungen, identifizieren Ursachen und implementieren wirksame Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen.

• Als Mentor und Coach unterstützen Sie unsere Mitarbeiter bei deren kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung ihrer beruflichen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.

• Treten Sie als treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung auf , indem Sie innovative Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung und Produktivitätssteigerung identifizieren, Lean-Prinzipien und digitale Lösungen zur Verbesserung der Abläufe nutzen und implementieren.

• Fungieren Sie als Matrix-Lead , welcher die strategische Planung und Zielsetzung der Abteilung gestaltet und der einen starken Teamgeist und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Dringlichkeit sowie der hohen Motivation fördert, um diese Ziele zu erreichen.

Wer Sie sind:

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Chemie oder Chemieingenieurwesen und mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Prozesschemie für synthetische Moleküle.

• Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in der chemischen Synthese, chemischen Prozesstechnologien und der Produktion in einer cGMP-Umgebung.

• Als technischer Experte verstehen Sie es, Teams in einer Matrixorganisation zu motivieren und einen starken Zusammenhalt zu schaffen, um gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

• Ihre Stärken liegen in der Zusammenarbeit: Sie pflegen ausgezeichnete Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern und navigieren geschickt durch Verhandlungen und funktionsübergreifende Projekte.

• Sie sind ein aktiver Impulsgeber für den Wandel, der eine flexible und offene Kultur für neue Möglichkeiten schafft.

• Sie sind eine treibende Kraft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung und packen neue Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft an.

• Sie kommunizieren fliessend in Deuts

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche vous pouvez être comme vous êtes – avec toutes les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture favorise le développement personnel, les dialogues ouverts et les relations sincères. Ici vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour la personne que vous êtes, afin que vous puissiez vous développer personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous voulons prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et veiller à ce que chaque personne ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Faites partie de DS Clinical & Commercial Approvisionnement, où chaque voix compte. Fonction:
• Ils constituent le lien entre nos processus opérationnels et les normes d'entreprise mondiales. Ils s'attachent à garantir le respect des règlements du GMPc, des lignes directrices de la SHE et des principes de Roche, tout en rendant les processus robustes et efficaces.
• Expertise pratique: ils sont le principal représentant de DS Clinical & Commercial Approvisionnement dans l'évaluation de faisabilité et le développement des exigences mondiales. Ils dirigent et soutiennent la mise en œuvre de ces normes dans un environnement de production dynamique.
• Responsabilité du projet en tant que représentant utilisateur: En tant que principal représentant de nos équipes, vous participez activement à la conception et à la mise en œuvre de projets complexes. Ils veillent à ce que les résultats répondent aux attentes et aux besoins de l'organisation.
• Ils agissent en tant que spécialiste et consultant pour les processus de fabrication et/ou les usines et fournissent votre expertise pour résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes et des questions stratégiques. Ils mènent des enquêtes complexes, identifient les causes et mettent en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives efficaces.
• En tant que mentor et coach, nos collaborateurs vous soutiennent dans leur développement continu de leurs compétences et connaissances professionnelles.
• Être un moteur de l'amélioration continue en identifiant des solutions innovantes pour l'optimisation des processus et l'amélioration de la productivité, en utilisant des principes maigres et en mettant en œuvre des solutions numériques pour améliorer les processus.
• Devenir un chef de file matricielle qui développe la planification stratégique et l'objectif du département et promeut un esprit d'équipe fort et une culture de coopération, d'urgence et de motivation élevée pour atteindre ces objectifs. Qui vous êtes :
• Ils ont un diplôme en chimie ou en génie chimique et au moins 10 ans d'expérience en chimie des processus pour les molécules synthétiques.
• Ils ont une connaissance approfondie de la synthèse chimique, des technologies de procédés chimiques et de la production dans un environnement cGMP.
• En tant qu'expert technique, vous comprenez les équipes motivantes dans une organisation matricielle et créez une forte cohésion pour réussir ensemble.
• Leurs points forts résident dans la coopération: ils entretiennent d'excellentes relations avec les parties prenantes et naviguent habilement à travers les négociations et les projets interfonctionnels.
• Ils sont un moteur actif du changement, créant une culture flexible et ouverte pour de nouvelles opportunités.
• Ils sont un moteur d'amélioration continue et répondent avec passion à de nouveaux défis.
• Ils communiquent bien en allemand et en anglais et convainquent avec leurs excellentes compétences en communication. Êtes-vous prêt pour vos qualités uniques à DS Cl

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division.

Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029.

The Opportunity

• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting

• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.

• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.

• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.

• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.

• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.

• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.

• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.

• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

jobs.title: Intern Digital Customer Excellence
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum (m/w/d) im Team Digital Customer Excellence
Roche Pharma AG

Wer wir sind
Bei Roche leisten über 101.000 Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt. Die Roche Pharma AG an ihrem Standort in Grenzach-Wyhlen steuert zentrale Elemente der technischen Qualitätssicherung für den gesamten europäischen Raum sowie die klinische Forschung, das Marketing und die Vertriebsaktivitäten für den deutschen Markt.

Das Kundenerlebnis in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen, Digital-First zu denken und Omnichannel-Marketing zu leben entspricht Deinem Mindset? Wir wollen jeden Touchpoint unserer Kunden mit Roche mit einer besonders positiven Customer Experience belegen. Passt das zu Dir? Dann bist Du bei Roche und in unserem Team genau richtig. Ein umfangreicher Einarbeitungsplan hilft Dir gemeinsam mit dem Team, alle Teilbereiche von Digital Customer Excellence kennen- und verstehen zu lernen. Und dann heißt es mit Unterstützung deines Buddys aus dem Team „Learning by doing“.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Superior Customer Experience mitgestalten

• Unterstützung und Auswertung digitaler Kampagnen und Omnichannel-Kommunikation für strategische, abteilungsübergreifende Produkte

• Wissenstransfer digitaler Konzepte in die Kundeninteraktion und standortweite Implementierung

• Omnichannel-Kommunikation (Fokus Digital) erlebbar machen

• Analyse & Bewertung nutzerfreundlicher digitaler Plattformen und Kanäle

• Erarbeitung und Mitwirkung bei digitalen Kampagnen und Konzepten

• Maßnahmen mitgestalten, die einen WOW-Effekt bei unseren Kunden erzeugen und ein nachhaltiges CX-Mindset fördern

• Recherche und interne Kommunikation von Best-Practice-Beispielen zu Customer Centricity

• Content-Erstellung für deutschsprachige Kanäle; Workshop-Moderation und Ergebnisdokumentation in deutscher Sprache

Wer Du bist:
Für Dein Praktikum im Team von Digital Customer Excellence (Bezeichnung der Abteilung) bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen mit:

• Generelle Voraussetzung zur Beschäftigung als Praktikant/in ist die ordentliche Immatrikulation während des gesamten Praktikums oder aber das Praktikum wird innerhalb eines Gap Years absolviert, also nach dem Bachelorabschluss in Vorbereitung auf ein Masterstudium oder auf die Promotion.

• Du bist Student (m/w/d) mit den Schwerpunkten Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Digitales Management und/oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Du bist ein "Early Adopter" von neuen, digitalen Tools/Plattformen und zeichnest Dich aus durch Deine Neugierde in Bezug auf die Entwicklung und Implementierung digitaler Kommunikationsformen.

• Du verfügst über eine gute digitale Affinität sowie eine analytische Herangehensweise.

• Interesse an Marketing in der Pharmabranche und allgemeinen Fragestellungen im gesundheitspolitischen Umfeld.

• Idealerweise praktische Erfahrungen im Vertrieb oder Gesundheitsmanagement.

• Interesse an CX/UX & Content Management wünschenswert.

• Du überzeugst durch Deine kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Dein Ideenreichtum.

• Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Dein analytisches Denken hast Du in Projekten eingesetzt und diese selbstständig vorangetrieben.

• Du bist ein Teamplayer, gibst und erhältst gerne Feedback und agierst immer mit dem Ziel, das Portfolio des Teams zu verbessern.

• Sichere Kommunikation in Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden D
