jobs.title: Digital Content Strategist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope.

Your Opportunity
In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:

• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain

• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem

• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively

• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value

• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies

• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments

• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners

Who you are
You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:

• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience

• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)

• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges

• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill

• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities

• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave f

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

Your Opportunity
The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines. In the position you will be focusing on:

● Managing the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.
● Incorporating feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.
● Instructing stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area
● Supporting Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication
● Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-
quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations. You have:

● Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
● Min 1+ years of proven experience in project management, preferably in digital marketing or content creation.
● Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management.
● Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with a track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously.
● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
● Experience in coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders, strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
● Openness to learn project management tools and software, experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additio

jobs.title: Design Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types.

Your Opportunity:
This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment.
In this position you will be focusing on:

• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.

• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.

• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.

• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.

• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.

• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.

• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress.

Who you are:

• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.

• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.

• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver l

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de Service et Maintenance - Bretagne (d/f/m)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Localisation idéale : Bretagne.

Missions
Vous serez en charge de la réalisation des installations (& désinstallation) , des maintenances préventives, curatives et correctives sur l’ensemble du portefeuille de nos systèmes analytiques et pré-post analytiques pour la filiale Roche Diagnostics France.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous validez les installations techniques simples et gérez les déménagements

• Vous gérer les pré-installations et installations techniques

• Vous assurez les maintenances préventives et curatives

• Vous effectuez les désinstallations

• Vous réalisez les rétrofits hardware/software des systèmes

• Vous assurez un reporting exact de votre activité, maitrisez les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent votre activité et êtes responsable de la mise à niveau de vos connaissances.

Qui vous êtes:

• De formation technique en électronique ou électricité et/ou licence biomédicale

• Bonne maitrise technique (électricité, hydraulique, mécanique, robotique, électronique…)

• Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans le domaine du diagnostic dans l'idéal, ou vous possédez une forte appétence pour ce domaine.

• Vous avez une bonne aisance relationnelle, une attitude positive, l’esprit d'équipe et un très bon sens du service client

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de ponctualité

• Bon niveau d’anglais technique requis

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Decision Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe that data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of innovation. As a Decision Analytics Consultant , you won’t just be analyzing requirements; you will be a trusted advisor and a strategic bridge between complex technical landscapes and business outcomes.
You will lead end-to-end business analysis workstreams, leveraging advanced analytics and statistical modeling to tackle ambiguity and transform complex clinical or operational data into actionable insights. Your mission is to ensure that every solution we build provides demonstrable value to our patients and our organization.

Your Impact & Responsibilities

• Strategic Advisory & Leadership: Independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams. You will act as a consultant to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and aligning project goals with long-term solution roadmaps.

• Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to gather, analyze, and interpret complex datasets (quantitative and qualitative) to inform product and UX decisions; Experience translating user behavior, metrics, and feedback into actionable insight; Proficiency in tools such as SQL, Excel, or Tableau

• Solution Design & Product Development: Translate complex business requirements into strategic implementation plans. You will design data products (datasets, KPI frameworks) and evaluate vendor solutions to ensure they meet our technical and business standards.

• User Behavior & Experience Analysis: Strong capability to analyze user journeys, pain points, and interaction patterns; Experience with usability testing, A/B testing, and heuristic evaluations; Familiarity with UX research tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Mixpanel

• Requirements Elicitation & Problem Structuring: Expertise in breaking down ambiguous business problems into structured requirements and hypotheses; Ability to synthesize stakeholder needs, technical constraints, and user expectations into clear functional and non-functional requirements; Skilled in creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows

• Process Excellence & Mentorship: As a senior member of our Community of Practice, you will mentor junior and intermediate BAs, proactively shaping our methodologies and driving continuous improvement in our operational workflows.

• Technical Integrity: Drive the analysis and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability, maintaining a focus on data governance and change management.

Who You Are
You are someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves tackling "gray areas," and is passionate about the intersection of technology and human health. You bring structure to chaos and are a natural communicator.
Qualifications & Experience:

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy, with at least 3+ years within the Life Sciences/Pharma industry.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in one of the following fields - Information Systems / Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration (with a focus on IT, Analytics, or Operations), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or UX-related discipline, Data Analytics / Data Science. Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) in - MBA (Information Systems or Product Management focus), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI),Data Analytics / Business Analytics is highly desirable.

• Analytical Mastery: SQL, BI tools (Tableau/Power BI), UX analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Mixpanel), and collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence). Familiarity

jobs.title: Facilities Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you organized, detail-oriented, and energized by keeping complex operations running smoothly? Roche is seeking a Facilities Specialist to serve as a key contributor to our facilities management team. You'll coordinate maintenance, manage SAP systems, supervise contractors, and be the trusted liaison between our internal customers and facilities services. If you have SAP Plant Maintenance expertise, strong customer service skills, and thrive in regulated environments, this role offers the perfect blend of technical and interpersonal challenge.

The Opportunity
Essential Job Functions & Major Contributions

• Coordinates facility repair and maintenance frequently involving the supervision of contractors. Inspects completed work for quality, compliance with local procedures and documentation for final approval. Primary liaison between internal customers and facilities management for unscheduled maintenance and projects, local personnel and equipment relocations, and small projects.

• Coordinates and supervises various contracted maintenance services that includes but is not limited to mechanical, plumbing and electrical equipment and systems. Assesses service provider performance at least annually.

• Primary or back-up SAP Plant Maintenance coordinator, adding equipment master records, functional locations, setting up maintenance plans and general equipment task lists, generating and tracking PM and maintenance orders, documenting order completion, and auditing of maintenance records and reports to ensure regulatory compliance of the maintenance program. Generates CMMS reports based on gathered metrics.

• Assist with delegating repair/service tickets to the Facilities Team

• Assists with handles invoices for review, approval, payment, and filing. Acts as the primary liaison GenMark Facilities group, service providers and Accounts Payable.

• Responsible for collection and prompt reporting of any customer service-related issues directly to the Facilities Manager or Director. Responsibilities may include preparing, tabulating, and analyzing customer satisfaction surveys related to any or all of the wide array of service provided by the group through ServiceNow.

• Support O&M technical leads, which may include periodically performing daily rounds and on-call services

• Maintains GMP SOPs and non-GMP Facilities documents

• Trained to input SOP Change Requests

• Other tasks delegated to by the Manager

Who You Are
Education & Experience

• Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, etc.

• Minimum 2 years working experience with SAP Plant Maintenance Module software and knowledge of Archibus

• Minimum 4 years’ experience working in a customer service intensive role and /or facilities maintenance planning

• Exceptional customer service skills

• Experience working in an ISO and FDA regulated environment.

• Advanced computer skills - e.g., MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Google Workspace

Preferred:

• Technical/trade school specializing in electrical, plumbing or mechanical systems.

• Thorough expertise using SAP Plant Maintenance Module software, Archibus, and ServiceNow

• 6 or more years’ experience working in a relevant Facilities Management and Planning position

• Experience working with Monday.com

This position is not eligible for relocation.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $66,900 - $124,200 USD Annual. Act

jobs.title: RWD Scientist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Strategic planning
● Shape and influence strategy for complex evidence generation deliveries and cross-functional projects
● Lead and/or support evidence generation strategy/plan setting up as critical component of local integrated evidence plan for multiple portfolio and pipeline products across therapeutic areas
● Provide epidemiological inputs with solid understanding of strategic business context in the medical planning process across therapeutic areas
Implementation
● Lead the RWD project/studies design, analyses and interpretation.
● Map / license RWD sources and build research collaborations to increase the availability of fit - for - purpose RWD.
● Implement the RWE plan and execute RWE projects timely in close collaboration with cross - functional partners.
● Identify and implement scientifically innovative RWE programs that can support to address business needs and overcome key challenges in drug development using RWD or enable to provide meaningful RWE in support of regulatory decision making (e.g. label changes, new indications), payer decision making and clinical practice.
Communication
● Build strong partnerships and opportunities to collaborate and innovate with varying internal and external stakeholders in support of Roche products, programs, processes, systems, and/or compliance
● Communicate scientifically and develop/maintain KOL network in medical/clinical community to ensure appropriate academic consultation/support and address the varying evidence requirements of stakeholders
● Lead the development of new and innovative partnerships with external stakeholders across healthcare ecosystems to co - design and execute innovative study designs and implementation science that address pre identified evidence needs.
Development
● Act as a coach, mentor or consult to provide technical expertise on the RWE/epidemiology basics and internal/external trainings.
● Serve as franchise / division level RWE lead to ensure a broad understanding of the value of RWE to the product value demonstration both locally and globally.
● Maintain process standards across the therapeutic areas according to Roche SOPs, China CDE requirements and GPP guidelines with regard to pharmacoepidemiology

Qualification and Experience
● Education/Qualifications
- Master degree or above in the epidemiology, biostatistics, public health or equivalent combination of education and experience
- Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in designing, implementation and report of epidemiology/observational studies
- Working experiences as real world data scientist/epidemiologist in multinational pharmaceutical company or Clinical Research Organization, experience in oncology studies will be plus
● Leadership Competencies
Ability to work effectively in a matrix team
● Job Required Competencies
- Expert knowledge of epidemiology/observational methodologies and applications
- Previous experience as a key RWD scientist or lead epidemiologist
- Good knowledge of statistical programming skill (including SAS programming)
- Strong communication skills and ability to work both, independently and collaboratively, as required
- Demonstrated project management skills is strongly preferred
- Business acumen
- Be able to handle technical discussion in fluent English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to health

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Praktikum im Project Portfolio Management mit Schwerpunkt IT-Architektur & KI-Anwendungen (m/w/d)

Möchten Sie die Zukunft des Project Portfolio Managements mitgestalten und innovative KI-Lösungen entwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!

Wer wir sind:
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg (DOZ) ist der zweitgrößte Produktionsstandort innerhalb Roche Global Operations und Rohstofflieferant für die gesamte Diagnostics Division. Als führender Hersteller für biologische und chemische Einsatzstoffe ist DOZ ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt im weltweiten Roche Netzwerk.

Wir suchen eine/n engagierte/n und motivierte/n Praktikanten/in, die/der unser Team im Bereich Project Portfolio Management (PPM) verstärkt. In dieser spannenden Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen IT-Architektur und der Implementierung von Künstlicher Intelligenz, um unsere Projektmanagementprozesse zu optimieren und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Wenn Sie begeistert vom Projektmanagement und der Steuerung eines großen Projektportfolios sind, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung einer zukunftsweisenden IT-Architektur für das Project Portfolio Management: Sie helfen uns dabei, eine skalierbare und effiziente Architektur zu konzipieren, die den Anforderungen unserer wachsenden Projektlandschaft gerecht wird.

• Identifizierung und Evaluierung von Potenzialen für den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen im PPM: Sie recherchieren und bewerten innovative KI-Lösungen, die zur Verbesserung von Prognosen, Ressourcenplanung, Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung im Projektportfolio eingesetzt werden können.

• Mitarbeit bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) für ausgewählte KI-Anwendungen: Sie sind aktiv an der Umsetzung erster Prototypen beteiligt, um die Machbarkeit und den Mehrwert von KI-basierten Lösungen zu demonstrieren.

• Analyse von Projektmanagement-Daten zur Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen: Sie unterstützen uns bei der Datenanalyse, um Engpässe und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in unseren bestehenden PPM-Prozessen zu identifizieren.

• Dokumentation von Prozessen, Architekturen und Best Practices: Sie tragen zur Erstellung und Pflege relevanter Dokumentationen bei, um Wissenstransfer und Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützung des Teams im Tagesgeschäft des Project Portfolio Managements: Sie erhalten Einblicke in die täglichen Abläufe und unterstützen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Ihr Profil:

• Immatrikulierte/r Student/in der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.

• Hohe Motivation, Lernbereitschaft und Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung .

• Begeisterung für Projektmanagement oder erste Berührungspunkte mit Projekt- oder Portfoliomanagement.

• Interesse an IT-Architektur und Faszination für KI sowie Bereitschaft, sich in neue Technologien

• Analytische, problemlösungsorientierte Denkweise und der Wunsch, Herausforderungen aktiv anzunehmen .

• Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, gute Kommunikation und Teamgeist.

• Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Einblicke in die spannende Welt des Project Portfolio Managements und der KI-Entwicklung in einem d

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift.

Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will:

Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met.

Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes.

Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments.

Qualifications

• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.

• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.

• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.

• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings

• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.

• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.

• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders

• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale chemical and biological data, enabling deeper understanding of molecular behavior and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, medicinal chemistry, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and interpretation, helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) to design and build interactive tools for small-molecule drug discovery, with a particular focus on chemical data, molecular design workflows, and model interpretability. You will shape the technical and product direction of platforms that enable medicinal and computational chemists to explore data, test hypotheses, and design better drugs. This role is fullstack, with a strong emphasis on scientific data visualization, workflow design, and integration with computational pipelines. Success will be measured not only by technical delivery, but by the impact on how scientists design and evaluate small-molecule candidates. Your work will include:

• Partnering directly with medicinal chemists, cheminformaticians, and AI scientists to understand real-world molecular design and analysis workflows, including ambiguous or evolving needs.

• Designing and building end-to-end platforms—spanning front-end interfaces, backend services, and data integrations—that enable scientists to run analyses, explore data, and interpret model outputs.

• Leading the development of intuitive, extensible user experiences for complex scientific workflows, with a focus on interactive visualization, usability, and scientific fidelity.

• Architecting and implementing APIs, data models, and services that support scalable, data-intensive applications, including integration with computational pipelines and machine learning systems.

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies (including AI-assisted development tools) to accelerate iteration, while exploring new approaches to scient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, dati e scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il nuovo Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare questo potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e trasformativi per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il gruppo di analisi e flussi di lavoro all'interno del Centro di eccellenza (CoE) è dedicato a trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili che anticipano la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Ci avvaliamo di tecnologie all'avanguardia ad alto rendimento e modelli di machine learning multimodali fondamentali per analizzare i dati chimici e biologici su larga scala, consentendo una comprensione più approfondita del comportamento molecolare e l'identificazione di nuove opportunità terapeutiche. Nonostante i progressi in questi campi, tuttavia, la trasformazione dei dati grezzi e dei modelli computazionali in insight significativi rimane una sfida chiave. In questo ruolo, lavorerai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della chimica medica e dell'ingegneria per costruire strumenti analitici innovativi che colmano il divario tra la generazione dei dati e l'interpretazione, aiutando a sbloccare nuovi viali per la scoperta scientifica e l'impatto. L'opportunità Stiamo cercando un Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack) per progettare e costruire strumenti interattivi per la scoperta della droga di piccole molecole, con una particolare attenzione ai dati chimici, ai flussi di lavoro di progettazione molecolare e all'interpretazione del modello. Potrai modellare la direzione tecnica e del prodotto di piattaforme che permettono ai chimici medicinali e computazionali di esplorare i dati, le ipotesi di test e progettare farmaci migliori. Questo ruolo è fullstack, con una forte enfasi sulla visualizzazione dei dati scientifici, la progettazione del flusso di lavoro e l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali. Il successo sarà misurato non solo dalla consegna tecnica, ma dall'impatto su come gli scienziati progettano e valutano i candidati alla piccola molecola. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà:
• Collaborare direttamente con chimici medicinali, cheminformatici e scienziati dell'IA per comprendere i flussi di lavoro di progettazione e analisi molecolari del mondo reale, comprese le esigenze ambigue o in evoluzione.
• Progettazione e costruzione di piattaforme end-to-end: interfaccia front-end, servizi backend e integrazioni dei dati, che permettono agli scienziati di eseguire analisi, esplorare i dati e interpretare le uscite dei modelli.
• Conducendo lo sviluppo di esperienze utente intuitive ed estensibili per complessi flussi di lavoro scientifici, con un focus sulla visualizzazione interattiva, l'usabilità e la fedeltà scientifica.
• Architettare e implementare API, modelli di dati e servizi che supportano applicazioni scalabili, ad alta intensità di dati, tra cui l'integrazione con pipeline computazionali e sistemi di machine learning.
• Valutazione e applicazione delle tecnologie emergenti (inclusi gli strumenti di sviluppo assistiti dall'IA) per accelerare l'iterazione, esplorando nuovi approcci allo scient

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Fortschritte in der KI, Daten und rechnerischen Wissenschaften verwandeln die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Drogen. Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen von Genentech (gRED) und Pharma (pRED) haben gezeigt, wie diese Technologien die FuE beschleunigen, Daten nutzen und neue Rechenmodelle nutzen, um Auswirkungen zu erzielen. Der nahtlose Datenaustausch und der Zugriff auf Modelle über gRED und pRED sind unerlässlich, um diese Möglichkeiten zu maximieren. Das neue Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) ist eine strategische, einheitliche Gruppe, deren Ziel es ist, diese transformative Kraft von Daten und Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu nutzen, um unseren Wissenschaftlern in pRED und GRED zu helfen, innovativere und transformative Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Die Gruppe Analytics und Workflows im Center of Excellence (CoE) widmet sich dem Umsetzen komplexer Daten in handlungsfähige Erkenntnisse, die die Entdeckung und Entwicklung von Medikamenten vorantreiben. Wir nutzen modernste High-Throughput-Technologien und grundlegende multimodale maschinelle Lernmodelle, um groß angelegte chemische und biologische Daten zu analysieren, um ein tieferes Verständnis des molekularen Verhaltens und die Identifizierung neuer therapeutischer Möglichkeiten zu ermöglichen. Trotz Fortschritten in diesen Bereichen bleibt jedoch die Umwandlung von Rohdaten und Rechenmodellen in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse eine zentrale Herausforderung. In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Datenwissenschaft, medizinischer Chemie und Ingenieurwissenschaften, um innovative analytische Werkzeuge zu bauen, die die Lücke zwischen Datenerzeugung und Interpretation überbrücken und neue Wege für wissenschaftliche Entdeckung und Wirkung entsperren. Die Chance Wir suchen einen Senior Scientific Software Engineer (Fullstack), um interaktive Werkzeuge für die Entdeckung von Kleinmolekülen zu entwerfen und zu bauen, mit einem besonderen Schwerpunkt auf chemischen Daten, molekularen Design-Workflows und Modellinterpretationsfähigkeit. Sie werden die technische und Produktrichtung von Plattformen prägen, die es medizinischen und rechnerischen Chemikern ermöglichen, Daten zu erforschen, Hypothesen zu testen und bessere Medikamente zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle steht in vollem Zusammenhang mit der wissenschaftlichen Datenvisualisierung, dem Workflow-Design und der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines. Der Erfolg wird nicht nur durch technische Lieferung gemessen, sondern durch die Auswirkungen auf die Gestaltung und Bewertung von Kleinmolekülkandidaten. Ihre Arbeit beinhaltet:
• direkt mit medizinischen Chemikern, Cheminformatikern und KI-Wissenschaftlern zusammenarbeiten, um reale molekulare Design- und Analyse-Workflows zu verstehen, einschließlich mehrdeutiger oder sich entwickelnder Bedürfnisse.
• Entwicklung und Aufbau von End-to-End-Plattformen – die sich über Frontend-Schnittstellen, Backend-Dienste und Datenintegrationen erstrecken – die es Wissenschaftlern ermöglichen, Analysen durchzuführen, Daten zu erforschen und Modellausgänge zu interpretieren.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung intuitiver, erweiterbarer Benutzererlebnisse für komplexe wissenschaftliche Workflows, mit Fokus auf interaktive Visualisierung, Usability und wissenschaftliche Treue.
• Erstellung und Implementierung von APIs, Datenmodellen und Dienstleistungen, die skalierbare, datenintensive Anwendungen unterstützen, einschließlich der Integration mit rechnerischen Pipelines und maschinellen Lernsystemen.
• Bewertung und Anwendung von aufstrebenden Technologien (einschließlich AI-gestützter Entwicklungstools) zur Beschleunigung der Iteration und Erkundung neuer Ansätze für Scient
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Les progrès dans l'IA, les données et les sciences informatiques transforment la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Les organisations de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, en tirant parti des données et des nouveaux modèles de calcul pour stimuler l'impact. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le nouveau Centre d'Excellence des Sciences Computationnelles (CdE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est de tirer parti de cette puissance transformatrice de données et d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques en pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et transformatifs pour les patients du monde entier. Le groupe Analytics and Workflows au sein du Centre d'excellence (CdE) se consacre à transformer des données complexes en idées concrètes qui favorisent la découverte et le développement de médicaments. Nous mettons à profit des technologies de pointe à haut débit et des modèles d'apprentissage de machines multimodales fondamentales pour analyser les données chimiques et biologiques à grande échelle, permettant une meilleure compréhension du comportement moléculaire et l'identification de nouvelles opportunités thérapeutiques. Toutefois, malgré les progrès réalisés dans ces domaines, la transformation des données brutes et des modèles de calcul en données probantes demeure un défi majeur. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la chimie médicinale et de l'ingénierie pour construire des outils analytiques novateurs qui comblent l'écart entre la production de données et l'interprétation, aidant à débloquer de nouvelles pistes de découverte scientifique et d'impact. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un ingénieur scientifique principal (Fullstack) pour concevoir et construire des outils interactifs pour la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en mettant l'accent sur les données chimiques, les workflows de conception moléculaire et l'interprétation des modèles. Vous façonnerez la direction technique et produit des plates-formes qui permettent aux chimistes médicaux et calculateurs d'explorer les données, de tester les hypothèses et de concevoir de meilleurs médicaments. Ce rôle est complet, l'accent étant mis sur la visualisation des données scientifiques, la conception des flux de travail et l'intégration avec les pipelines informatiques. Le succès sera mesuré non seulement par l'exécution technique, mais aussi par l'impact sur la façon dont les scientifiques conçoivent et évaluent les candidats aux petites molécules. Votre travail comprendra :
• Établir des partenariats directs avec des chimistes, des chimistes et des scientifiques de l'IA pour comprendre les processus de conception moléculaire et d'analyse du monde réel, y compris les besoins ambigus ou en évolution.
• Concevoir et construire des plates-formes de bout en bout, des interfaces front-end, des services de backend et des intégrations de données, qui permettent aux scientifiques d'effectuer des analyses, d'explorer des données et d'interpréter les résultats des modèles.
• Diriger le développement d'expériences utilisateur intuitives et extensibles pour des workflows scientifiques complexes, en mettant l'accent sur la visualisation interactive, la convivialité et la fidélité scientifique.
• Architecte et mise en œuvre d'API, de modèles de données et de services qui prennent en charge des applications évolutives et à forte intensité de données, y compris l'intégration avec des pipelines de calcul et des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique.
• Évaluer et appliquer les nouvelles technologies (y compris les outils de développement assistés par l'IA) pour accélérer l'itération, tout en explorant de nouvelles approches de la science

The Position EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:
• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:
• • M.D. Required
• Therapeutic knowledge within metabolism, obesity, and diabetes with relevant clinical, scientific, and clinical trial/development experience required
• Academic/teaching background is a plus
• Experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance
• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred
• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

• Up to 30% global travel Key Skills and Behaviours
• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values
• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail
• Business Acumen: Has working knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process. Regularly leads development of disease strategies and plans
• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget
• Interpersonal skills : Good interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority
• Writing: Strong written communication skills

jobs.title: Logistics Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics.
You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.

• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.

• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.

• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.

• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.

• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.

• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.

• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.

• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow.

Who You Are

• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.

• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY AND PURPOSE:
Roche’s Clinical Development organization is structured by therapeutic area and is responsible for developing and executing the late development (Phase II – III) clinical strategies and plans that deliver medically-differentiated therapies that provide meaningful improvement to patients.
The Lead Medical Director leads or makes major contributions to development of the Clinical Development (CD) strategy and plan and is responsible for effective and efficient execution for the assigned molecule(s)/indication(s).
Lead Medical Directors are expected to perform their responsibilities with more independence by comparison to Medical Directors.
EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• Academic/Scientific/Clinical:

• M.D. Required

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Academic/teaching background is a plus

• Significant experience working with the principles and techniques of data analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Significant pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized expert in the field

• Significant experience designing and conducting clinical trials (i.e. one or more trials)

• Experience authoring a global development plan is preferred

• Understanding of Phase II – III drug development

• Knowledge and understanding of Phase I & IV drug development is a plus

• Understanding of product and safety profiles

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is required

• 4 or more years pharma/biotech industry experience OR is a recognized local expert in the field (e.g Assistant Professor or equivalent)

• Up to 30% global travel

Key Skills and Behaviours

• Ethics: Has impeccable ethics. Demonstrates, or proven ability to demonstrate, Roche Values

• Attention to detail: Outstanding attention to detail

• Is regarded as knowledgeable in his/her field, is respected by others, can effectively contribute to longer-range drug development, and can lead cross-functional teams to successful results

• Business Acumen: Has sound knowledge of the pharma/biotech industry, the multiple functions and roles involved in the drug development process.

• Organization: Can prioritize multiple tasks and goals on time, on target, and within budget

• Interpersonal skills: Strong interpersonal, verbal communication and influencing skills: can influence without authority and has proven experience building and cultivating relationships with key partners and stakeholders, both internally and externally

• Writing: Outstanding written communication skills

• Presentation skills: Strong business presentation skills: effective at summarizing and presenting the key considerations and decision-points.Confident and competent when interacting with others internally and externally: stays focused and on-point, is able to raise problems or challenges in a productive and mature manner

• Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills: can effectively drive discussions and decisions toward desired end-results

• Decision Making: Makes good business decisions and exercises sound judgment. Balances decisions with imperatives for ethics and efficacy. Able to mak

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L’organizzazione di sviluppo clinico di Roche è strutturata dall’area terapeutica ed è responsabile dello sviluppo e dell’esecuzione delle strategie cliniche di sviluppo tardivo (Phase II – III) e dei piani che forniscono terapie medicalmente differenziate che forniscono un significativo miglioramento ai pazienti. Il Direttore Medico di Piombo conduce o apporta importanti contributi allo sviluppo della strategia e del piano di sviluppo clinico (CD) ed è responsabile dell'esecuzione efficace ed efficiente per le molecole/indicazioni assegnate. I direttori medici di piombo sono tenuti a svolgere le loro responsabilità con più indipendenza rispetto ai direttori medici.
• L'industria farmaceutica e l'industria farmaceutica (in inglese) Dimostra, o comprovata capacità di dimostrare, Valori Roche
• Attenzione ai dettagli: eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• È considerato conoscibile nel suo campo, è rispettato da altri, può contribuire efficacemente allo sviluppo di farmaci a più lungo raggio, e può portare squadre interfunzionali a risultati di successo
• Business Acumen: Ha una solida conoscenza del settore farmaceutico / biotecnologico, le molteplici funzioni e ruoli coinvolti nel processo di sviluppo della droga.
• Organizzazione: Può dare priorità a più compiti e obiettivi nel tempo, nell'obiettivo e nel budget
• Capacità interpersonali: Forte comunicazione interpersonale, verbale e capacità di influenzare: può influenzare senza autorità e ha dimostrato esperienza di costruire e coltivare relazioni con partner chiave e stakeholder, sia internamente che esternamente
• Scrivere: eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritta
• Capacità di presentazione: Forte capacità di presentazione aziendale: efficace a sintetizzare e presentare le considerazioni chiave e punti di decisione. Confidente e competente quando interagisce con gli altri internamente ed esternamente: rimane concentrato e on-point, è in grado di sollevare problemi o sfide in modo produttivo e maturo
• Competenze di negoziazione: Forte capacità di negoziazione: in grado di guidare efficacemente discussioni e decisioni verso i risultati finali desiderati
• Decision Making: Prende buone decisioni di business ed esercita giudizio positivo. Saldo decisioni con imperativi per l'etica e l'efficacia. Able a mak

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position GENERAL POSITION UND PURPOSE: Die Organisation für klinische Entwicklung von Roche ist durch therapeutische Bereiche strukturiert und ist für die Entwicklung und Durchführung der späten Entwicklung (Phase II – III) klinischen Strategien und Pläne verantwortlich, die medizinisch differenzierte Therapien liefern, die den Patienten eine sinnvolle Verbesserung bieten. Der Lead Medical Director führt oder leistet wichtige Beiträge zur Entwicklung der klinischen Entwicklung (CD) Strategie und des Plans und ist für eine effektive und effiziente Durchführung des zugewiesenen Moleküls/Indikation(en) verantwortlich. Lead Medical Directors sollen ihre Verantwortung gegenüber Medical Directors mit mehr Unabhängigkeit erfüllen.
•  Nachweise oder bewährte Nachweisfähigkeiten, Roche-Werte
• Blick auf das Detail: Blick auf das Detail
• Wird in seinem Bereich als kenntnisreich angesehen, wird von anderen respektiert, kann effektiv zu einer längeren Drogenentwicklung beitragen, und kann funktionsübergreifende Teams zu erfolgreichen Ergebnissen führen
• Business Acumen: Hat fundiertes Wissen über die Pharma-Biotech-Industrie, die vielfältigen Funktionen und Rollen, die am Drogenentwicklungsprozess beteiligt sind.
• Organisation: Kann mehrere Aufgaben und Ziele auf Zeit, Ziel und innerhalb des Budgets priorisieren
• Interpersonal Fähigkeiten: Starke zwischenmenschliche, verbale Kommunikation und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten: kann ohne Autorität beeinflussen und hat bewährte Erfahrungen Aufbau und Kultivierung von Beziehungen zu Schlüsselpartnern und Interessenvertretern, sowohl intern als auch extern
• Schreiben: Hervorragende schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Starke Business-Präsentation Fähigkeiten: effektiv bei der Zusammenfassung und Präsentation der wichtigsten Überlegungen und Entscheidungspunkte. Vertraut und kompetent bei der Interaktion mit anderen intern und extern: Aufenthalte konzentriert und on-point, ist in der Lage, Probleme oder Herausforderungen in produktiver und reifer Weise zu lösen
• Verhandlung Fähigkeiten: Starke Verhandlung Fähigkeiten: kann effektiv Gespräche und Entscheidungen zu gewünschten Endresultaten führen
• Entscheidungsfindung: Machen Sie gute Geschäftsentscheidungen und Übungen fundiertes Urteil. Salden Entscheidungen mit Imperativ für Ethik und Wirksamkeit. Able zu mak
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position RÉSUMÉ GÉNÉRAL DE LA POSITION ET OBJET : L'organisation de développement clinique Roches est structurée par domaine thérapeutique et est responsable de l'élaboration et de l'exécution des stratégies et des plans cliniques de développement tardif (phase II – III) qui offrent des thérapies différenciées sur le plan médical et qui apportent une amélioration significative aux patients. Le directeur médical principal dirige ou apporte une contribution importante à l'élaboration de la stratégie et du plan de développement clinique (DC) et est responsable de l'exécution efficace et efficiente de la ou des molécules/indications attribuées. Les directeurs médicaux principaux doivent s'acquitter de leurs responsabilités avec plus d'indépendance par rapport aux directeurs médicaux. EXPÉRIENCE ET QUALIFICATIONS :
• Académique, scientifique et clinique:
• M.D. Requis
• Expérience pertinente d'essais/de développements cliniques, scientifiques ou cliniques dans le même domaine thérapeutique/similaire requis
• L'enseignement supérieur est un plus
• Expérience significative de travail avec les principes et techniques d'analyse des données, d'interprétation et de pertinence clinique
• L'expérience de la publication des résultats d'une étude scientifique dans une revue évaluée par des pairs est privilégiée
• Expérience importante de l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique OU est un expert reconnu dans le domaine
• Expérience significative de conception et de réalisation d'essais cliniques (c'est-à-dire un ou plusieurs essais)
• L'expérience de l'élaboration d'un plan de développement mondial est privilégiée
• Compréhension de la phase II – développement de médicaments III
• La connaissance et la compréhension de la phase I et IV du développement de médicaments est un plus
• Compréhension des profils de produits et de sécurité
• Réglementation : Connaissance des aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des exigences techniques relatives à l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres lignes directrices et règlements pertinents
• 4 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique OU est un expert local reconnu dans le domaine (par exemple professeur adjoint ou équivalent)
• Jusqu'à 30 % de voyages mondiaux Compétences et comportements clés
• Éthique : a une éthique impeccable. Démonstration ou capacité prouvée de démontrer Roche Valeurs
• Attention aux détails : attention aux détails
• Est considéré comme compétent dans son domaine, est respecté par d'autres, peut contribuer efficacement au développement de médicaments à plus longue portée, et peut conduire des équipes interfonctionnelles à des résultats fructueux
• Business Acumen: possède une bonne connaissance de l'industrie pharmaceutique/biotech, des multiples fonctions et rôles impliqués dans le processus de développement des médicaments.
• Organisation : Peut hiérarchiser plusieurs tâches et objectifs dans les délais, les objectifs et les budgets
• Compétences interpersonnelles : Une communication interpersonnelle forte, verbale et influence les compétences : peut influencer sans autorité et a prouvé l'expérience en établissant et en cultivant des relations avec des partenaires et des parties prenantes clés, tant à l'intérieur qu'à l'extérieur
• L'écriture: compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite
• Compétences en présentation: compétences solides en présentation des affaires: efficacité à résumer et à présenter les considérations clés et les points de décision. Confiance et compétence lors de l'interaction avec les autres à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur: reste concentré et sur-le-champ, est capable de soulever des problèmes ou des défis d'une manière productive et mature
• Compétences en négociation : Fortes compétences en négociation : peut conduire efficacement les discussions et les décisions vers les résultats finals souhaités
• Prise de décision: prend de bonnes décisions commerciales et fait preuve de jugement. Équilibre les décisions avec les impératifs d'éthique et d'efficacité. Peut être mak

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant que Spécialiste IT et Workflow (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des missions essentielles pour garantir l'autonomie et la satisfaction de nos clients pour une large gamme de nos solutions de laboratoire.

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités

• Installer nos solutions informatiques et de workflow et former les clients à l’utilisation du Middleware.

• Assurer le suivi et l’amélioration continue des solutions Roche.

• Apporter votre expertise en avant-vente si nécessaire.

• Réaliser la préparation et la mise à jour des installations Middleware Roche.

• Installer les nouvelles connexions automates validées.

• Installer les e-solutions IT et établir le paramétrage péri-analytique (Pré et post).

• Assurer un reporting exact de votre activité et maîtriser les règles et procédures Qualité Sécurité Environnement impactant votre domaine.

Quoi vous êtes:

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou équivalent en spécialisation informatique et réseaux.

• Double compétence « biologie / informatique médicale » ou une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement du laboratoire d’analyses médicales ou d’un éditeur de logiciel SIL (Système Informatique de Laboratoire), Middleware, Application médicale est un atout.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (systèmes d’exploitation, réseaux, applicatif) des infrastructures informatiques.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, de l'écoute, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Installer les nouvelles connexions automates validées.

• Double compétence « biologie / informatique médicale » ou une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement du laboratoire d’analyses médicales ou d’un éditeur de logiciel SIL (Système Informatique de Laboratoire), Middleware, Application médicale est un atout.

jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) Réseau Terrain -Région Ouest (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions
En tant qu' Ingénieur Réseau Terrain (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à collaborer avec les équipes supports et IT sur des missions liées à l'installation et à la maintenance des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d'analyses médicales (privés et hospitaliers).

Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux

Vos principales responsabilités :

• Concevoir les schémas réseau, les matrices de flux et assurer leur déploiement. Gestion de son parc informatique et mise à jour des documents clients (Document d’Architecture Technique, Document d’Exploitation)

• Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Spécialiste IT et Workflow.

• Garantir les plans d'actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. Agir rapidement lors d’élaboration de PRI (Plan de Réponse aux Incidents)

• Effectuer les rétrofits hardware / software IT réseau Roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions chez nos clients.

• Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche.

• Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting précis de vos interventions et des mises à niveau .

Votre profil :

• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou Master spécialisé en informatique et réseaux.

• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (réseaux, pare-feu, accès) des infrastructures informatiques clients.

• Aisance à l’oral, levée d’objection étant identifié comme Interlocuteur privilégié des Directions des Services Informatiques (DSI) pour expliquer les pré requis d’installation des solutions digitales Roche et échanger sur les besoins clients.

• Anglais professionnel

• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).

• Sens du résultat, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
