jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea (한국로슈진단)
Division: Core Lab & POC (진단검사 사업부)
Location: 서울
Position: Sales Representative (영업)

Your key responsibilities
Job Summary
한국로슈진단은 고객 중심의 영업 활동 을 통해 진단 분야의 혁신적인 가치를 전달하며, 시장 리더십을 강화할 영업 전문가를 찾고 있습니다.

Responsibilities

1. 고객 관리

• 기존 고객사를 관리하고 유지하며 매출 증대

• 신규 고객사 발굴 및 개발

2. 대리점 관리

• 대리점과 협력하여 매출 목표 달성

• 대리점 재고 모니터링 및 관리

• 제품 교육 실시

• 대리점 영업 활동 지원

3. 마케팅 및 영업 활동

• 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성

• 신규 장비 설치

• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가

4. 기술 지원

• 장비 및 시약 관련 고객 문의 및 요청사항 응대

Who you are

• 학사 학위 이상 또는 이에 준하는 학력 (신입 ~ 경력 7년 이하 선호)

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호

• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력

• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Mit dieser Vision im Blick leistet Roche Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Dabei gründet sich unser Erfolg auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten, um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben. Auch im Bereich People Relations leben wir diese Kultur - um sie gemeinsam mit uns in den Arbeitsweisen der gesamten Organisation zu verankern, suchen wir Dich.

Dein neues Team
Als Teil des People & Culture Teams bei Roche, ist es unser Bestreben, das Potenzial unserer Mitarbeiter:innen zu entfalten. Als globale Funktion schaffen wir eine Kultur und ein Umfeld, das Eigenverantwortung fördert und den Fokus auf das Wesentliche richtet. Dafür arbeiten wir auf lokaler und globaler Ebene eng mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unseren Kunden aus der gesamten Roche Wertschöpfungskette sowie anderen internen und externen Partner:innen zusammen. Gemeinsam mit ihnen stellen wir sicher, dass sowohl Unternehmens- als auch Mitarbeitendeninteressen gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Mit unseren vielfältigen Themen und Projekten bieten wir ausgewogene Perspektiven und proaktive Lösungen in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen, um Geschäfts- und Personalstrategien erfolgreich voranzubringen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der dynamischen Rolle bei Roche begleitest und gestaltest Du Veränderungsprozesse. Du bringst Deine Expertise im Arbeitsrecht ein, agierst vermittelnd als (strategischer) Partner und treibst Projekte voran. Um maßgeblich zum Erfolg von Roche und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung beizutragen, übernimmst Du folgende Aufgaben:

• Du leitest komplexe P&C- relevante Projekte, einschließlich Restrukturierungen und Verhandlungen mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, unter Berücksichtigung globaler Rahmenbedingungen und lokaler arbeitsrechtlicher Anforderungen.

• Du pflegst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu den Arbeitnehmervertretungen an all unseren deutschen Standorten und stellst mit lösungsorientierten Ansätzen den geschäftlichen Erfolg sicher.

• Du agierst als Expert:in und Berater:in für individuelle und kollektive Arbeitsrechtsthemen und unterstützt die Organisation in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, die den rechtlichen Standards und unseren Unternehmenswerten entsprechen.

• Du optimierst Prozesse und Lösungen in Deinem Fachbereich, um die organisatorische Effizienz zu steigern und die Einhaltung aktueller Regularien sicherzustellen.

• Du baust ein professionelles Netzwerk nach innen und außen auf und bist in der Lage, neue Trends zu bewerten und in die Prozessgestaltung einzubeziehen, um die Relevanz und Wirksamkeit von P&C-Initiativen zu erhöhen.

• Du berätst und unterstützt die Führungsebene mit fundierten Analysen und Handlungsempfehlungen zu kritischen P&C-Themen und trägst so zur strategischen Entscheidungsfindung bei.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Nach Abschluss Deines juristischen oder (personal)wirtschaftlichen Studiums und mindestens 5 Jahren einschlägiger Berufserfahrung bringst Du die nötige Seniorität und Empathie mit. Du besitzt umfassende Kompetenzen in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Projekten in Transformationsumgebungen.

• Du verfügst über Expertise in der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen, wodurch Du versiert mit der Gestaltung und Pflege von Beziehungen umgehst.

• Deine vielseitigen Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht (sowohl individuell als auch kollektiv) und im Projektmanagement bilden das Fundament für die Beratung und Strategieentwi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. Con questa visione, Roche sta fornendo un lavoro pionieristico nella sanità. Il nostro successo si basa sull'innovazione, la curiosità e la diversità – e guardiamo le nostre differenze come un vantaggio per far progredire la salute attraverso l'innovazione. Viviamo anche nella zona delle persone relazioni - per ancorarle insieme con noi nelle opere di tutta l'organizzazione, stiamo cercando voi. La tua nuova squadra Nell'ambito del team People & Culture di Roche, il nostro obiettivo è quello di sviluppare il potenziale dei nostri dipendenti. Come funzione globale, creiamo una cultura e un ambiente che promuove l'auto-responsabilità e si concentra sugli elementi essenziali. A questo scopo, lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, i nostri clienti dall'intera catena di valore Roche e altri partner interni ed esterni. Insieme a loro, ci assicuriamo che sia gli affari che i dipendenti siano sostenuti allo stesso modo. Con i nostri diversi argomenti e progetti, offriamo prospettive equilibrate e soluzioni proattive in materia di diritto del lavoro per migliorare con successo le strategie aziendali e del personale. responsabilità Ti aspetti Nel ruolo dinamico di Roche, accompagni e forma i processi di cambiamento. Porti la tua esperienza nel diritto del lavoro, mediando come partner (strategico) e promuovendo progetti. Per contribuire in modo significativo al successo di Roche e al miglioramento continuo, Hai i seguenti compiti:
• Conduci progetti P&C-relevant complessi, tra cui ristrutturazioni e negoziati con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti, tenendo conto delle condizioni quadro globali e dei requisiti di diritto del lavoro locale.
• Hai una buona idea di fidarti dei rapporti con i rappresentanti dei lavoratori in tutte le nostre sedi tedesche e garantire il successo aziendale con approcci orientati alla soluzione.
• Lei agisce come esperto:in e consulente: in caso di problemi individuali e collettivi di diritto del lavoro e sostiene l'organizzazione nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di strategie che soddisfano gli standard legali e i valori aziendali.
• Scegli processi e soluzioni nel tuo campo per aumentare l'efficienza organizzativa e garantire il rispetto delle normative vigenti.
• Costruisci una rete professionale all'interno e all'esterno e sei in grado di valutare nuove tendenze e incorporarle nella progettazione dei processi per aumentare la pertinenza e l'efficacia delle iniziative P&C.
• Si consiglia e supporta il livello di leadership con analisi sonore e raccomandazioni per l'azione su questioni critiche P&C e quindi contribuire al processo decisionale strategico. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Dopo aver completato gli studi legali o (personali) economici e almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante Hai l'anzianità e l'empatia necessarie. Hai competenze complete nella riuscita realizzazione di progetti in ambienti di trasformazione.
• Hai esperienza nella collaborazione con le rappresentanze dei dipendenti, che ti guiderà con la progettazione e la cura delle relazioni.
• La vostra conoscenza versatile del diritto del lavoro (sia individualmente che collettivamente) e la gestione del progetto sono la base per la consulenza e lo sviluppo della strategia
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position A healthier future. With this vision, Roche is providing pioneering work in healthcare. Our success is based on innovation, curiosity and diversity – and we look at our differences as an advantage to advance healthcare through innovation. We also live in the area of people relations - in order to anchor them together with us in the workings of the entire organization, we are looking for you. Your new team As part of the People & Culture team at Roche, our aim is to develop the potential of our employees. As a global function, we create a culture and an environment that promotes self-responsibility and focuses on the essentials. For this purpose, we work closely with employee representatives, our customers from the entire Roche value chain and other internal and external partners. Together with them, we ensure that both business and employees are supported equally. With our diverse topics and projects, we offer balanced perspectives and proactive solutions in labour law issues to successfully advance business and personnel strategies. Responsibilities You're expecting In the dynamic role at Roche, you accompany and shape change processes. You bring your expertise in labour law, mediating as a (strategic) partner and driving projects forward. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming facilities operations to support cutting-edge science and patient care? Join Roche Diagnostics as the Director of Facilities & Engineering for our Bay Area sites, where you'll take charge of shaping the strategic direction and operational excellence of our Pleasanton and Santa Clara campuses. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to oversee large-scale capital projects, optimize site master plans, and drive continuous improvements in reliability, safety, and efficiency. As a key member of the Site Leadership Team, you will inspire and develop a high-performing team, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of compliance and performance—empowering Roche’s mission to deliver extraordinary outcomes for patients around the world.

This role is responsible for the strategic leadership of all Facilities & Engineering initiatives across the Bay Area sites ( Pleasanton and Santa Clara ). This includes directing operations and maintenance, campus master planning, capital investment strategies and execution, asset lifecycle management, and reliability engineering. The Director is ultimately accountable for ensuring facilities operations are compliant, reliable, fiscally responsible and directly support the organization's overarching business objectives. This leader inspires and empowers a culture of operational excellence where every employee can achieve extraordinary outcomes for customers and patients every day.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Oversees the curation and management of the Facilities CAPEX portfolio for Roche Diagnostics Sites in the Bay Area. Directs all facility related capital projects in support of the Facility Master Plan. Capital projects range from 100,000 USD to 100,000,000 USD with the following responsibilities: project scope, cost and schedule development, funding documentation development and presentation to senior management, construction, move coordination and project close-out. May direct capital project planning and execution for sites outside the Bay Area based on need and available resources.

• Develops and executes annual and long range strategic Facility Master Plans based on Site Business Plans. Plan development and execution requires interaction across all functional areas of the business and senior management, with strong negotiation skills to solve complex problems affecting nearly all employees at Roche sites.

• Direct facility operations and maintenance programs performance measurement, service provider management, and resource planning as well as developing, sharing and adopting technical innovations, life cycle costing models, best practices, KPIs and benchmarking information with the global Facilities community.

• Direct engineering services which include life cycle costing, energy conservation, asset management, reliability engineering, performance measurement and resource planning.

• Directs and leads efforts to ensure engineering-related policies, procedures, and practices are effective, efficient and consistent. Provides regular, consistent updates on facilities and engineering matters to support ongoing awareness and continuity of business operations.

• Interacts at a high level with internal and external resources to ensure the Company is in compliance with local, state, federal, and corporate regulations as well as internal Quality System and regulatory compliance programs.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei un leader visionario con la passione per la trasformazione delle operazioni di strutture per supportare la scienza all'avanguardia e la cura dei pazienti? Unisciti a Roche Diagnostics come Direttore di Strutture e Ingegneria per i nostri siti di Bay Area, dove ti occuperai di modellare la direzione strategica e l'eccellenza operativa dei nostri campus di Pleasanton e Santa Clara. Questo ruolo fondamentale offre l'opportunità di supervisionare progetti di capitale su larga scala, ottimizzare i piani di master del sito e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità, la sicurezza e l'efficienza. In qualità di membro chiave del team di Leadership del sito, ispirerete e svilupperete un team di alto livello, promuovere una cultura dell’innovazione, e garantire che le nostre strutture soddisfino i più elevati standard di conformità e prestazioni, potenziando la missione di Roche per fornire risultati straordinari per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Questo ruolo è responsabile della leadership strategica di tutte le iniziative di Strutture e Ingegneria nei siti Bay Area ( Pleasanton e Santa Clara). Ciò include la gestione di operazioni e manutenzione, la pianificazione master del campus, le strategie di investimento di capitale e l'esecuzione, la gestione del ciclo di vita degli asset e l'ingegneria di affidabilità. Il Direttore è in ultima analisi responsabile per garantire che le operazioni delle strutture siano conformi, affidabili, responsabile fiscale e sostengano direttamente gli obiettivi aziendali di supervisione dell'organizzazione. Questo leader ispira e potenzia una cultura di eccellenza operativa dove ogni dipendente può ottenere risultati straordinari per clienti e pazienti ogni giorno. L'opportunità responsabilità
• supervisiona la cura e la gestione del portafoglio Servizi CAPEX per i Siti diagnostici Roche nell'area della baia. Dirige tutti i progetti di capitale relativi alla struttura a sostegno del Facility Master Plan. I progetti di capitale variano da 100.000 USD a 100,000,000 USD con le seguenti responsabilità: portata di progetto, sviluppo dei costi e dei programmi, sviluppo della documentazione di finanziamento e presentazione alla gestione senior, costruzione, coordinamento del movimento e chiusura del progetto. Può la pianificazione e l'esecuzione del progetto di capitale diretto per i siti al di fuori della Bay Area in base alle necessità e alle risorse disponibili.
• Sviluppa ed esegue piani strategici di Facility Master annuali e a lungo raggio basati su Piani di business del sito. Lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione del piano richiedono l'interazione in tutte le aree funzionali del business e della gestione senior, con forti capacità di negoziazione per risolvere problemi complessi che interessano quasi tutti i dipendenti dei siti Roche.
• Misura diretta delle prestazioni delle operazioni di impianti e dei programmi di manutenzione, gestione dei fornitori di servizi e pianificazione delle risorse, nonché sviluppo, condivisione e adozione di innovazioni tecniche, modelli di costo del ciclo di vita, best practice, KPI e informazioni di benchmarking con la comunità globale delle strutture.
• Servizi di ingegneria diretta che includono il costo del ciclo di vita, la conservazione dell'energia, la gestione degli asset, l'ingegneria dell'affidabilità, la misurazione delle prestazioni e la pianificazione delle risorse.
• Diretti e conduce gli sforzi per garantire politiche, procedure e pratiche connesse all'ingegneria sono efficaci, efficienti e coerenti. Fornisce aggiornamenti regolari e coerenti su strutture e questioni ingegneristiche per supportare la consapevolezza e la continuità in corso delle operazioni aziendali.
• Interagisce ad alto livello con risorse interne ed esterne per garantire che la Società sia conforme alle normative locali, statali, federali e societarie, nonché al sistema di qualità interno e ai programmi di conformità alle normative.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous un leader visionnaire passionné par la transformation des installations pour appuyer les sciences de pointe et les soins aux patients? Rejoignez Roche Diagnostics en tant que directeur des installations et de l'ingénierie pour nos sites de Bay Area, où vous prendrez en charge l'orientation stratégique et l'excellence opérationnelle de nos campus Pleasanton et Santa Clara. Ce rôle central offre l'occasion de superviser les grands projets d'immobilisations, d'optimiser les plans directeurs du site et d'améliorer continuellement la fiabilité, la sécurité et l'efficacité. En tant que membre clé de l'équipe de leadership du site, vous inspirerez et développerez une équipe hautement performante, favoriserez une culture d'innovation et veillerez à ce que nos installations répondent aux normes de conformité et de performance les plus élevées. Ce rôle est responsable du leadership stratégique de toutes les initiatives en matière d'installations et d'ingénierie dans la région de Bay (Pleasanton et Santa Clara ). Il s'agit notamment de diriger les opérations et l'entretien, de planifier la maîtrise du campus, de stratégies d'investissement en immobilisations et d'exécution, de gérer le cycle de vie des biens et d'ingénierie de la fiabilité. Le directeur est ultimement responsable de s'assurer que les activités des installations sont conformes, fiables, responsables sur le plan financier et appuient directement les objectifs opérationnels généraux de l'organisation. Ce leader inspire et renforce une culture d'excellence opérationnelle où chaque employé peut atteindre des résultats extraordinaires pour les clients et les patients chaque jour. L'opportunité Responsabilités
• Supervise la curation et la gestion du portefeuille des installations CAPEX pour les sites de diagnostic de Roche dans la région de Bay. Dirige tous les projets d'immobilisations liés aux installations à l'appui du plan directeur des installations. Les projets d'immobilisations vont de 100 000 à 100 000 000 dollars, les responsabilités étant les suivantes : portée du projet, coûts et calendrier, élaboration et présentation de documents de financement à la haute direction, construction, coordination des déménagements et clôture du projet. Peut diriger la planification et l'exécution des projets d'immobilisations à l'extérieur de la baie en fonction des besoins et des ressources disponibles.
• Élaborer et exécuter des plans directeurs d'installations stratégiques annuels et à long terme fondés sur les plans d'activités du site. jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English, Arabic is advantage

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche.

Description of the area:
Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.

You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. • Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.

Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.

titleByLocale.fr: Consultant en solutions ERP - SAP EWM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM

We are seeking an experienced Senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer with MFS experience to join our team and take ownership of a highly complex, validated warehouse management solution. This warehouse is one of the biggest ones of the Roche Pharma division with a high degree of automation. You guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level.

The Opportunity

• Design & Implementation : Develop and implement complex enhancements to our SAP EWM solution, including MFS and WebDynpro user interfaces

• Independent Problem-Solving : Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions; troubleshoot issues at the code level without requiring constant guidance

• Technical Deep-Dive : Investigate complex technical challenges, debug code, and optimize system performance

• Stakeholder Collaboration : Work closely with business teams to understand requirements, manage expectations, and communicate technical constraints and timelines

• Validated Environment Management : Execute changes in compliance with our regulated environment, including documentation, test cases, and validation requirements

• Knowledge Transfer : Document solutions and share expertise with team members to build organizational capability

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Required Qualifications

• Extensive SAP EWM Experience : Minimum 5+ years working with SAP EWM in production environments, including complex configurations and customizations

• MFS Expertise : Proven hands-on experience implementing and maintaining SAP MFS

• ABAP Development Skills : Solid programming background with ability to debug, and optimize ABAP code

• Validated Environment Experience : Demonstrated familiarity with regulated environments, change management processes, and compliance documentation

• SAFe Framework Knowledge : Working understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices

• Fluent English : Strong verbal and written communication skills (essential)

• German Language (Preferred) : Fluency in German is a significant plus

Who you are:

• Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 15%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Solution Consultant - SAP EWM Stiamo cercando un esperto senior SAP EWM Specialist & Developer con esperienza MFS per unire il nostro team e prendere la proprietà di una soluzione di gestione del magazzino altamente complessa e validata. Questo magazzino è uno dei più grandi della divisione Roche Pharma con un alto grado di automazione. Guida team di prodotti, responsabilità dei campioni e comunica efficacemente con tutti gli stakeholder. Si risolverà problemi complessi, prendere decisioni indipendenti a livello di prodotto, fornire la supervisione tecnica, e rapporto a livello di prodotto. L'opportunità
• Progettazione e attuazione: sviluppare e implementare miglioramenti complessi alla nostra soluzione SAP EWM, comprese le interfacce utente MFS e WebDynpro
• Indipendente Problem-Solving: analizzare i requisiti aziendali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche; risolvere i problemi a livello di codice senza richiedere una guida costante
• Deep-Dive tecnico: individuare complesse sfide tecniche, debug code e ottimizzare le prestazioni del sistema
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali per comprendere i requisiti, gestire le aspettative e comunicare vincoli tecnici e tempistiche
• Gestione dell'ambiente convalidata: Eseguire le modifiche nel rispetto del nostro ambiente regolamentato, inclusi i requisiti di documentazione, casi di test e convalida
• Knowledge Transfer: soluzioni di documenti e competenze con i membri del team per costruire capacità organizzative
• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti Qualificazioni richieste
• Ampia esperienza SAP EWM: minimo 5+ anni di lavoro con SAP EWM in ambienti produttivi, comprese configurazioni complesse e personalizzazioni
• Competenza MFS: comprovata esperienza di attuazione e mantenimento di SAP MFS
• ABAP Development Skills: Solid background di programmazione con capacità di debug e ottimizzare il codice ABAP
• Esperienza ambientale convalidata: familiarità dimostrata con ambienti regolamentati, processi di gestione dei cambiamenti e documentazione di conformità
• Conoscenza quadro SAFe: comprensione di lavoro dei principi e delle pratiche di Agile Framework (SAFe)
• Inglese fluente: Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta (essenziale)
• Lingua tedesca (preferita) : La fluenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Chi sei:
• Campo d'insalatura 14.175 - 26.325 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.
• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 15%).
• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).
• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).
• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).
• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.
• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).
• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).
• Assistenza sanitaria privata (pacchetti LuxMed), assicurazione vita di gruppo (UNUM) e Multisport.
• Aggiunti di acquisto azionario.
• Vendita annuale di computer portatili aziendali e automobili e molti altri! jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche Near Patient Care , we create the tools that help people with diabetes think less about their daily routine and more about their lives. Our Indianapolis site is a global hub for blood glucose strip manufacturing and the future home of our next-generation continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors.

The Opportunity
As a Controls Engineer , you are the technical backbone of our automated production lines. You won’t just be sitting at a desk; you’ll be hands-on with high-speed equipment, ensuring our manufacturing processes are stable, validated, and constantly improving.

What You’ll Do

• Optimize & Innovate: Lead the evolution of our automation and electromechanical processes. You’ll use data and operator feedback to make our lines faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Launch New Tech: Partner with R&D and Process Development to bridge the gap between design and high-volume manufacturing for new product launches.

• Own the Controls: Program, modify, and troubleshoot the "brains" of our machines, ensuring every sensor, motor, and PLC is performing at peak efficiency.

• Manage Quality & Validation: Lead equipment qualifications (IQ/OQ/PQ) and ensure all process changes meet strict regulatory standards without sacrificing production speed.

• Strategic Leadership: Manage multiple project lifecycles, mentor junior staff, and provide expert on-call support to keep our 24/7 operations running smoothly.

• On-Site: Engineers are dedicated to the Indianapolis site. Travel typically < 10%.

What You’ll Bring

• PLC & HMI Proficiency: Deep experience with Allen Bradley (RSLogix/Studio 5000) and FactoryTalk View. You are comfortable modifying code to drive continuous improvement.

• The "Troubleshooter" Mindset: Strong knowledge of electromechanical systems, motion controls (Servos/VFDs), Distributed I/O, sensors, and Cognex/Keyence Vision Systems.

• Validation Expertise: Proven ability to develop and execute equipment qualification protocols and write clear, technical documentation.

• Vendor Management: Experience collaborating with external partners to source specialized solutions or navigate component obsolescence.

• Analytical Drive: A highly logical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to run simulations and use test data to make informed decisions.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or closely related discipline with a minimum of 2 years of related experience; advanced degree may substitute for previous experience or equivalent experience

• Related experience must include troubleshooting, modifying, and/or developing industrial equipment controls systems (PLCs, HMIs, Motion Control, etc.)

Preferred:

• Familiar with GMP in a regulated environment (Medical Device or Pharmaceutical).

• Strong electro-mechanical skills that can look at the machine from all engineering aspects: mechanical, electrical, and controls.

• Previous experience troubleshooting controls systems of high volume/speed manufacturing equipment.

• Previous training or experience in Process Improvement Methodologies (e.g. LSS, PDCA, etc.).

• Demonstrates excellent interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills.

• Strong ability to teach and educate key stakeholders and other colleagues.

• Deep commitment to cross-functional collaboration and breaking down silos to achieve the best results for the organization.

This is an onsite role in Indianapolis. Relocation benefits are not available.

The expected salary range for the Manufacturing

jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

Our Verification and Validation team, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is responsible for ensuring a software product meets its specified requirements and performs as intended by rigorously testing and analyzing the software throughout its development lifecycle.

As a Principal Software Developer in Test, you will be responsible for test design, development, automation, deployment, execution, and reporting. Specifically, you will develop an integrated hardware-software framework for end-to-end test automation that leverages a third-party Hardware-in-the-Loop solution. In this role, you will represent quality engineering and verification on behalf of your team in all events and activities related to this effort, working closely with software and hardware engineers across multiple global locations.

The Opportunity

• You develop solutions for Hardware-in-the-Loop testing for end-to-end testing of embedded instrument software

• You author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including:

• Testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.)

• Testing level (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.)

• Testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.)

• You automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering for:

• Instrument software

• Web applications

• You automate deployment and testing pipelines across branches and stages

• You report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards

• You perform root cause analysis of defects and discoveries

• You develop automation frameworks and validate automation toolchains

• You ensure regulatory compliance of quality engineering deliverables

• You partner with Test Architects, Test Leads, and Verification & Validation Leads on practices

• You collaborate with designers, architects, developers, system engineers and testers on product development

• You participate in all development events, and activities and guide junior testing team members as needed

• Technologies which may be utilized : C++, Java, Cucumber (Behavior-Driven Development), Gherkin, Playwright, Windows, Cypress/JDI/Selenium/WebDriver/TestNG, Typescript/Javascript, Angular, Docker, Jenkins, Groovy, Bash, Jira, Github, Confluence, Google Suite, macOS/Linux, MS SQL, Vector HIL Solutions

Who You Are

• You have a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related. Advanced degree preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, with three years of experience for each year of missing education

• You have 10+ years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience with Jav

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1. 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2. 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1. 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户 ( 尤其重点专家 ) 对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2. 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识； 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )
• ● 既往有销售 / 市场 / 医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过 RDPAC 考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Product Planner - Fixed Term
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our Indianapolis and Mannheim, Germany hubs. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role.

In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs.

We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key.

This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence!

The Opportunity

• Supply Planning: Develops global supply plan based on affiliate forecasts and GSC strategic guidance. Delivers supply plans to Manufacturing and supplier partners. Works with external suppliers to ensure agreed plans are met. In case of exception, works with partners to resolve situations with the least disruption to customers. Monitors cycle time, critical batches and the optimization of planning parameter settings to avoid destruction costs or stock outs. Monitors schedule adherence and discusses if below target during Supply Review meetings (S&OP). Monitors system alerts for potential / actual supply issues throughout the global network. Makes recommendations to provide timely resolution with minimum impact to customers: Works with IBL/IPM to define regional/country product allocations in case of bottleneck; Keeps Regions / Affiliates / BAs informed as to potential and actual product bottlenecks.

• Inventory & Product availability management: Manages inventories at global distribution centers to ensure high service level to customers at low

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。 A 规范诊疗
• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升 B 学科建设
• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范 C 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化 我们期待这样的您加入:
• 3年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳 教育程度/所获资格证书 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: （高级）治疗领域专员 - 免疫治疗领域 - 柳州

titleByLocale.it: (高级) REGISTRATI 专 alcuni - UG)TRENO MINUTI - locali - М州
titleByLocale.en: （高级）治疗领域专员 - 免疫治疗领域 - 柳州
titleByLocale.de: (高级)治疗领域专员 - 免疫治疗领域 - 柳州

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital & Innovation Hub Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description:
Join our Innovation Hub to pioneer the next generation of AI-driven pharmaceutical solutions. Unlike a traditional data role, this internship focuses on bridging the gap between cutting-edge LLM (Large Language Model) research and practical healthcare applications.

Key Responsibilities:

• Full-Stack AI Development: Architect and build AI-driven applications from the ground up.

• Cloud Architecture & Publishing: Take ownership of the deployment process. You will containerize applications and publish them to Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) , ensuring they are accessible and scalable.

• Database Management: Design and implement basic data storage architectures to handle application state, session memory, and knowledge retrieval.

• End-to-End Ownership: Monitor the live application, troubleshoot cloud environment issues, and iterate on model performance independently.

• Technical Translation: Work with stakeholders to refine project requirements and ensure the final product meets pharmaceutical industry standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• You are a self-starter, independent & highly motivated.

• Internship Duration: Capability to commit to a 6-month full-time internship (highly preferred).

• AI Solution Engineering: Proven ability to build an AI application from scratch (Portfolio/GitHub evidence of independent projects is highly preferred).

• Technical Proficiencies: Strong hands-on experience with Python

• Database Basics: Understanding of how to store and retrieve data from a database (e.g., NoSQL, Vector DBs, or simple Cloud Storage)

• AI Fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM architectures, API integrations, and the basics of Natural Language Processing (NLP).

• Software Engineering Basics: Familiarity with Git for version control and the SDLC.

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or Software Engineering, or a related field.

What We Offer:

• End-to-End Project Ownership: You won’t just be assisting; you will be the lead developer of your assigned project, responsible for its architecture and success.

• Production Experience: A rare opportunity to see your "from-scratch" builds published and running in an enterprise-grade cloud environment.

• Corporate Working Environment @ a leading MNC : You will be part of a qualified and engaged professional team and organization where you will experience corporate culture at the intersection of healthcare industry and digital innovation in a globally leading pharma company

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data

At Roche, we believe every individual can make a difference. We are looking for a Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data to join our team in a role that sits at the intersection of engineering excellence and business impact. In this position, you will lead and grow high-performing data and analytics engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and business-critical solutions that support commercial decision-making across sales, marketing, pricing, and customer engagement .

The Commercial Data, Analytics and AI area supports Service, Marketing, Sales, and Commercial Operations across Roche Diagnostics’ global organization, enabling data-driven decision-making and operational excellence at scale. The area spans global, regional, and country-level teams and covers a wide range of commercial activities, including customer engagement, sales effectiveness, service performance, pricing, installed base management, and operational optimization.

Operating in a highly regulated, global environment, the Commercial Data & Analytics function partners closely with business, IT, Digital, and central Data & AI platform teams to deliver trusted data foundations, analytics, and AI-enabled insights. Solutions are designed to be scalable, compliant, and reusable across markets, while remaining flexible enough to address local needs.

By providing reliable data products, analytics capabilities, and advanced insights, the area plays a critical role in improving commercial effectiveness, service quality, and customer experience, ultimately supporting Roche Diagnostics’ mission to deliver innovative diagnostics solutions to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity:

• Lead and develop high-performing data and analytics engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous professional growth .

• Scale engineering capabilities to support diverse Commercial use cases across Service, Marketing, Sales, and Operations through modern data modeling and transformation .

• Drive technical standards by establishing and enforcing best practices for dbt-based development, CI/CD, automated testing, and comprehensive documentation .

• Evolve data onboarding as a service to enable efficient, standardized, and scalable ingestion of new data sources while maintaining strict security and governance .

• Design robust pipelines that power advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions, ensuring all datasets are production-grade and "AI-ready" for downstream science teams .

• Collaborate with platform teams to align commercial data solutions with enterprise architecture, ensuring the reuse of platform capabilities and avoiding tool duplication .

• Manage team delivery on a day-to-day basis, translating complex commercial requirements into reliable analytics layers and high-impact insight products .

• Champion engineering craftsmanship by reviewing technical designs and guiding your team toward maintainable, cost-efficient, and scalable architectural decisions .

Who you are:

• Experienced Leader: You possess 5+ years of experience in data engineering leadership or architecture, with a proven track record of building high-performing teams .

• Industry Expert: You bring 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry to navigate complex compliance needs .

• Formally Educated: You hold a Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science or a similar f

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Team Lead Engineering Dati commerciali A Roche, crediamo che ogni individuo possa fare la differenza. Stiamo cercando un Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data per unire il nostro team in un ruolo che siede all'incrocio di eccellenza ingegneristica e impatto aziendale. In questa posizione, guiderai e cresci team di ingegneria dati e analisi altamente performanti per fornire soluzioni scalabili, affidabili e business-critical che supportano il processo decisionale commerciale attraverso vendite, marketing, prezzi e coinvolgimento dei clienti. L’area Commercial Data, Analytics e AI supporta il Servizio, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni Commerciali attraverso l’organizzazione globale di Roche Diagnostics, consentendo il processo decisionale e l’eccellenza operativa in scala. L'area abbraccia team globali, regionali e di livello nazionale e copre una vasta gamma di attività commerciali, tra cui l'impegno del cliente, l'efficacia delle vendite, le prestazioni del servizio, i prezzi, la gestione delle basi installate e l'ottimizzazione operativa. Operando in un ambiente globale altamente regolamentato, la funzione Commercial Data & Analytics collabora a stretto contatto con i team di piattaforme aziendali, IT, Digital e Central Data & AI per fornire fondazioni di dati affidabili, analisi e informazioni AI-enabled. Le soluzioni sono progettate per essere scalabili, conformi e riutilizzabili in tutti i mercati, pur rimanendo abbastanza flessibili per soddisfare le esigenze locali. Fornendo prodotti di dati affidabili, funzionalità di analisi e approfondimenti avanzati, l'area svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel migliorare l'efficacia commerciale, la qualità del servizio e l'esperienza del cliente, supportando infine la missione di Roche Diagnostics di fornire soluzioni diagnostiche innovative ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. L'opportunità:
• Guidare e sviluppare team di ingegneria di dati e analisi altamente performanti, favorendo una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, responsabilità e crescita professionale continua.
• Capacità di ingegneria scala per supportare diversi casi di uso commerciale in Servizi, Marketing, Vendite e Operazioni attraverso la modellazione e la trasformazione dei dati moderni.
• Guidare gli standard tecnici, stabilendo e rafforzando le migliori pratiche per lo sviluppo basato su dbt, CI/CD, test automatizzati e documentazione completa.
• Coinvolgere i dati a bordo come servizio per consentire un'ingestione efficiente, standardizzata e scalabile di nuove fonti di dati, mantenendo al contempo una stretta sicurezza e governance.
• Progettazione di robuste condotte che alimentano soluzioni di analisi avanzate e AI/ML, assicurando che tutti i dataset siano di qualità produttiva e "AI-ready" per i team di scienza a valle.
• Collaborare con i team di piattaforma per allineare le soluzioni di dati commerciali con l'architettura aziendale, garantendo il riutilizzo delle funzionalità della piattaforma e evitando duplicazioni degli strumenti .
• Gestire la consegna del team su base giornaliera, traducendo complessi requisiti commerciali in livelli di analisi affidabili e prodotti di analisi ad alto impatto.
• Artigianato di ingegneria campione esaminando i progetti tecnici e guidando il vostro team verso decisioni architettoniche mantenuti, convenienti e scalabili. Chi sei:
• Leader esperto: Possiedi 5+ anni di esperienza nella leadership dell'ingegneria dei dati o nell'architettura, con una comprovata traccia di costruzione di team di alto livello.
• Esperto del settore: Portate 2+ anni di esperienza all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o della tecnologia sanitaria regolamentata per navigare complesse esigenze di conformità.
• Formally Educated: Hai una laurea o una laurea avanzata in Informatica o un f simile

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem Team Lead Engineering Commercial Data, das unserem Team in einer Rolle beitritt, die an der Schnittstelle von Engineering Excellence und Business Impact sitzt. In dieser Position führen und wachsen Sie leistungsstarke Daten- und Analyse-Engineering-Teams, um skalierbare, zuverlässige und geschäftskritische Lösungen zu liefern, die die kommerzielle Entscheidungsfindung über Vertrieb, Marketing, Preisgestaltung und Kundenbindung unterstützen. Der Bereich Commercial Data, Analytics und AI unterstützt Service-, Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Handelsoperationen in der globalen Organisation von Roche Diagnostics und ermöglicht datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung und operative Exzellenz im Maßstab. Das Gebiet umfasst globale, regionale und landesweite Teams und umfasst eine breite Palette von kommerziellen Aktivitäten, darunter Kundenengagement, Verkaufseffizienz, Serviceleistung, Preisgestaltung, installiertes Basismanagement und operative Optimierung. Die Kommerzielle Daten & Analytics-Funktion arbeitet in einem hochregulierten, globalen Umfeld eng mit den Teams Business, IT, Digital und Central Data & AI zusammen, um vertrauenswürdige Datengrundlagen, Analysen und AI-fähige Erkenntnisse zu liefern. Lösungen sind so konzipiert, dass sie skalierbar, konform und über die Märkte wiederverwendbar sind, während sie flexibel genug bleiben, um lokale Bedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Durch die Bereitstellung von zuverlässigen Datenprodukten, Analysefähigkeiten und fortschrittlichen Erkenntnissen spielt der Bereich eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Verbesserung der kommerziellen Effektivität, der Servicequalität und der Kundenerfahrung und unterstützt letztendlich die Mission von Roche Diagnostics, innovative Diagnoselösungen für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Die Gelegenheit:
• Führen und entwickeln Sie hochperformierende Daten- und Analyse-Engineering-Teams, die eine Kultur der technischen Exzellenz, Rechenschaftspflicht und kontinuierliches professionelles Wachstum fördern.
• Scale Engineering-Funktionen, um verschiedene kommerzielle Anwendungsfälle über Service, Marketing, Vertrieb und Operationen durch moderne Datenmodellierung und Transformation zu unterstützen.
• Führen Sie technische Standards, indem Sie Best Practices für dbt-basierte Entwicklung, CI/CD, automatisierte Tests und umfassende Dokumentationen festlegen und forcieren.
• Erarbeiten Sie Daten über Bording als Service, um eine effiziente, standardisierte und skalierbare Aufnahme neuer Datenquellen zu ermöglichen und gleichzeitig strenge Sicherheit und Governance zu gewährleisten.
• Entwerfen Sie robuste Pipelines, die fortschrittliche Analytik und AI/ML-Lösungen betreiben und sicherstellen, dass alle Datensätze produktionsfähig und "AI-ready" für nachgelagerte Wissenschaftsteams sind.
• Mit Plattformteams zusammenarbeiten, um kommerzielle Datenlösungen mit der Unternehmensarchitektur auszurichten, um die Wiederverwendung von Plattformfunktionen zu gewährleisten und die Werkzeugvervielfältigung zu vermeiden.
• Manage Team-Lieferung auf Tagesbasis, Übersetzen komplexer kommerzieller Anforderungen in zuverlässige Analyseschichten und hocheffiziente Einsichtsprodukte.
• Champion-Engineering-Handwerk durch Überprüfung von technischen Designs und Führung Ihres Teams auf beständige, kostengünstige und skalierbare Architekturentscheidungen . Wer du bist:

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chef d'équipe Ingénierie Données commerciales Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque individu peut faire la différence. Nous cherchons une équipe responsable de l'ingénierie Données commerciales pour rejoindre notre équipe dans un rôle qui se situe à l'intersection de l'excellence en génie et de l'impact commercial. Dans cette position, vous dirigerez et développerez des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement pour fournir des solutions évolutives, fiables et critiques pour les affaires qui soutiennent la prise de décision commerciale à travers les ventes, le marketing, les prix et l'engagement des clients. Le secteur des données commerciales, de l'analyse et de l'intelligence artificielle soutient l'organisation mondiale des services, du marketing, des ventes et des opérations commerciales dans l'ensemble de Roche Diagnostics. La zone s'étend aux équipes mondiales, régionales et nationales et couvre un large éventail d'activités commerciales, y compris l'engagement des clients, l'efficacité des ventes, la performance des services, les prix, la gestion de base installée et l'optimisation opérationnelle. Opérant dans un environnement mondial hautement réglementé, la fonction Commercial Data & Analytics s'associe étroitement aux équipes de plateformes commerciales, informatiques, numériques et centrales de Data & AI pour fournir des bases de données fiables, des analyses et des informations adaptées à l'IA. Les solutions sont conçues pour être évolutives, conformes et réutilisables sur tous les marchés, tout en restant suffisamment souples pour répondre aux besoins locaux. En fournissant des produits de données fiables, des capacités d'analyse et des informations avancées, la région joue un rôle essentiel dans l'amélioration de l'efficacité commerciale, de la qualité du service et de l'expérience client, soutenant finalement la mission de Roche Diagnostics pour fournir des solutions diagnostiques innovantes aux patients dans le monde entier. La possibilité :
• Diriger et développer des équipes d'ingénierie de données et d'analyse à haut rendement, favorisant une culture d'excellence technique, de responsabilité et de croissance professionnelle continue.
• Capacités d'ingénierie à l'échelle pour soutenir divers cas d'utilisation commerciale dans les services, le marketing, les ventes et les opérations par la modélisation et la transformation de données modernes.
• Conduire les normes techniques en établissant et en appliquant les meilleures pratiques pour le développement basé sur le DBT, le CI/CD, les tests automatisés et la documentation complète.
• Evolver les données à bord en tant que service permettant une ingestion efficace, normalisée et évolutive de nouvelles sources de données tout en maintenant une sécurité et une gouvernance strictes.
• Concevoir des pipelines robustes qui alimentent l'analyse avancée et les solutions AI/ML, en veillant à ce que tous les ensembles de données soient de qualité de production et « prêts à l'AI » pour les équipes scientifiques en aval.
• Collaborer avec les équipes de plate-forme pour aligner les solutions de données commerciales sur l'architecture d'entreprise, en assurant la réutilisation des capacités de la plate-forme et en évitant la duplication des outils.
• Gérer la prestation de l'équipe au quotidien, en traduisant des exigences commerciales complexes en couches d'analyse fiables et en produits à fort impact.
• Métier d'ingénierie champion en examinant les conceptions techniques et en guidant votre équipe vers des décisions architecturales durables, rentables et évolutives. Qui vous êtes :
• Leader expérimenté : vous possédez 5 ans d'expérience dans le leadership ou l'architecture de l'ingénierie des données, avec une expérience éprouvée de la construction d'équipes performantes.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

工作职责

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划
客户管理与区域合作
• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 和准入团队合作保证区域内治疗药物的可及性
团队管理
•参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划
•吸引，招聘，辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展
•打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景
财务和合规管理
•分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标
•确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境
自我管理
• 积极的进行领导技能的学习，以身作则执行公司各项规章制度，进行有效的团队管理
• 践行公司价值观，展现专业素养和领导力

岗位所需胜任力
• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者
• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质，高效整合资源能力•
• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历，7 年以上销售，市场，医学或准入工作经验
• 业务及资源规划能力
• 较高的沟通能力

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 2. 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识； 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )
• ● 既往有销售 / 市场 / 医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过 RDPAC 考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化
