descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Menschenführer führt ein Team von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Profis, die für China regulatorische CMC-Vorträge verantwortlich sind, durch die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von robusten End-to-End-China-Filing-Strategien basierend auf einer engen Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Entwicklungsteams, China-Geschäftsprioritäten, China-Regelanforderungen und Landschaft. Der Umfang umfasst das komplette Roche-Portfolio, die globalen Produkte (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neue Modalitäten). Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt darin, die Teammitglieder zu leiten und zu trainieren, um den Drogenzugriff und die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten zu beschleunigen, indem die richtigen Erstanträge an chinesische Gesundheitsbehörden und effektive Interaktionen mit der Gesundheitsbehörde sichergestellt werden. Die Rolle ist dafür verantwortlich, das regulatorische Umfeld in China in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der PTR-Politik zu gestalten und in innovative regulatorische Strategien umzusetzen. Im Einklang mit der China-Strategie von Roche und der China-First-Initiative ist dies eine Rolle mit einem hohen geschäftlichen Einfluss. In dieser Position ist der Personenführer für das Management von China Technical Partners (CTPs) und CMC-Programmmanagern verantwortlich, die Leistungsziele festlegen, zeitnah Feedback liefern und eine Ausrichtung von kurzfristigen Entwicklungszielen mit langfristigen Karrierezielen gewährleisten. Bietet Beratung und verwaltet Arbeitsaktivitäten von anderen für spezifische Projekte und/oder Ziele. Demonstriert die Grundlagen der effektiven Coaching Fähigkeiten und Mentoring. Passt Coaching-Stil, um die Bedürfnisse des Einzelnen zu erfüllen. Der Menschenführer führt funktionsübergreifende regulatorische Initiativen und Strategien, definiert assoziierte kritische Schritte und Ressourcen, die benötigt werden, und übernimmt die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung dieser Initiativen und Strategien. Proaktiv kommuniziert mit regulatorischen und funktionsübergreifenden Mitarbeitern zur Unterstützung interner und partnerschaftlicher Projektziele. Zusammenarbeit mit Management in führenden Kommunikationen mit HA über Projekte und Initiativen großer Komplexität. Entscheidungen auf der Grundlage von funktionsübergreifenden Prioritäten statt funktioneller Schwerpunkte. Projekt People Leader
• Führen Sie ein Team von Regulierungsexperten.
• Verantwortlich für das Leistungsmanagement der Mitarbeiter.
• Arbeiten Sie mit direkten Berichten und stellen Sie sicher, dass den Mitarbeitern objektives und zeitnahes Feedback zur Verfügung gestellt wird, konzentrieren Sie sich auf die Entwicklung des Mitarbeiters durch regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche und Check-ins.
• Bereitstellung von Coaching und Mentoring an Kollegen für einen zugewiesenen Bereich der technischen Regulierungsverantwortung.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Portfolioleiter zusammen, um Ressourcen und Prioritäten auf Portfolioebene zu koordinieren.
• Befolgen und überprüfen Sie regelmäßig den Fortschritt jedes einzelnen Projekts im Team, erleuchten Sie das Team, um Einreichungsstrategien für verschiedene Anwendungen zu entwickeln und regulatorische Risiken zu identifizieren und Migrationspläne zu entwickeln.
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine gesunde Beziehung zu internen und externen Schlüsselakteure, wie NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, Supply Chain, Qualität und Compliance, PDR China und PTR global,
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schlüsselakteuren für die Entwicklung und Ausrichtung der technischen Strategie, Maximierung und Balance der regulatorischen und Versorgungsbedürfnisse in China. QUALIFIKATIONEN Bildung Master-Abschluss in Life Sciences Disziplinen ist bevorzugt; Post Graduate Degree ist ein Plus. Erfahrung
• 8 oder mehr Jahre Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder verwandten Industrie und CMC, Qualität, regulatorische oder verwandte Erfahrung.
• Vorheriges Personalmanagement o
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le chef du personnel dirige une équipe de partenaires techniques chinois (PTC) et de professionnels du CMC qui sont responsables des présentations de CMC réglementaires en Chine, en élaborant et en mettant en oeuvre des stratégies de classement de bout en bout de la Chine fondées sur une collaboration étroite avec les équipes de développement mondial, les priorités commerciales de la Chine, les exigences réglementaires de la Chine et le paysage. La portée comprend le portefeuille complet de Roche, les produits mondiaux (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouvelles modalités). Ce rôle a pour but de diriger et d'entraîner les membres de l'équipe afin d'accélérer l'accès aux médicaments et l'approvisionnement continu des patients en veillant à ce que les premières présentations appropriées aux autorités sanitaires chinoises et les interactions efficaces avec l'autorité sanitaire. Le titulaire du rôle est responsable de façonner l'environnement réglementaire en Chine en étroite collaboration avec la Politique sur les PTR et de la traduire en stratégies réglementaires novatrices. Conformément à la stratégie de la Chine et à l'initiative China First, il s'agit d'un rôle qui a un impact commercial élevé. Dans ce poste, le chef de file est responsable de la gestion des partenaires techniques de la Chine (PTC) et des gestionnaires de programme du MCC, ce qui comprend l'établissement d'objectifs de rendement, la fourniture de rétroaction en temps opportun et l'harmonisation des objectifs de perfectionnement à court terme avec les objectifs de carrière à plus long terme. Fournit des conseils et gère les activités de travail d'autres personnes pour des projets ou des objectifs précis. Démontre les principes fondamentaux de l'efficacité de l'encadrement et du mentorat. Adapte le style de coaching pour répondre aux besoins de l'individu. Le chef des personnes dirige des initiatives et des stratégies de réglementation interfonctionnelles, définit les étapes et les ressources essentielles qui s'y rattachent et assume la responsabilité de la mise en oeuvre de ces initiatives et stratégies. Communiquer de façon proactive avec le personnel de réglementation et le personnel interfonctionnel à l'appui des objectifs des projets internes et associés aux partenaires. Collabore avec la direction pour diriger les communications avec l'AP sur les projets et les initiatives de grande complexité. Prendre des décisions fondées sur des priorités interfonctionnelles plutôt que sur des priorités fonctionnelles. Chef de projet Personnes
• Diriger une équipe de professionnels de la réglementation.
• Responsable de la gestion de la performance des salariés.
• Collaborer avec des rapports directs et veiller à ce que des commentaires objectifs et opportuns soient fournis aux employés, en mettant l'accent sur le perfectionnement de l'employé en facilitant des discussions régulières sur le perfectionnement et des vérifications.
• Fournir un encadrement et un encadrement aux collègues dans un domaine de responsabilité réglementaire technique assigné.
• Collaborer étroitement avec le chef de portefeuille pour coordonner les ressources et les priorités au niveau du portefeuille.
• Suivre et vérifier régulièrement l'avancement de chaque projet spécifique de l'équipe, éclairer l'équipe pour élaborer des stratégies de soumission pour différentes applications, identifier les risques réglementaires et élaborer des plans de migration.
• Établir et maintenir des relations saines avec les principaux acteurs internes et externes, tels que NMPA, CDE, NIFDC, chaîne d'approvisionnement, qualité et conformité, PDR Chine et PTR mondial,
• Collaborer avec les principales parties prenantes internes à l'élaboration et à l'alignement de la stratégie technique, en maximisant et en équilibrage des besoins en matière de réglementation et d'approvisionnement en Chine. QUALIFICATIONS Éducation Masters Le diplôme en sciences de la vie est préféré; le diplôme d'études supérieures est un plus. Expérience
• 8 ans ou plus d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, la biotechnologie ou l'industrie connexe et le CMC, la qualité, la réglementation ou l'expérience connexe.
• Gestion des personnes précédente

jobs.title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy.

As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance.

The Opportunity

• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.

• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.

• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.

• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.

• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.

• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes.

Who You Are

jobs.title: Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM

titleByLocale.it: Gestione della filiale di sicurezza EMEA-LATAM

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the Role:

The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates.

We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field.

Your Responsibilities:

• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.

• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.

• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.

• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.

• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.

• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.

• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.

• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.

• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.

• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.

• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers.

Your Experience & Skills:

• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.

• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.

• Commercial mindset.

• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.

• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.

• Highly influential relationship builder.

• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.

• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.

• EU residence/citizenship preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Technical Services and Operations (TSO) group within DDC is accountable for providing application support (Level 1-3) for hundreds of software solutions. In addition, TSO is responsible for DevOps and Operations for the DDC’ application landscape, both Cloud and On Premise. Finally, TSO provides technical support for systems that offer tools to train large language models (LLMs) and create autonomous agents, as well as ensuring users are effectively enabled to leverage these advanced systems, from LLM training platforms to autonomous agent building tools.

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will join the TSO Leadership team and will work closely with DDC colleagues as well as directly with our key stakeholders including Computational Scientists, ML Scientists and Research Scientists. You will also work closely with vendors who provide managed services which form the core of many of the TSO activities.

You are an experienced and hands-on technical expert with the proven ability to lead and deliver enterprise scale technical operations. You will be managing operations for Applications and Software and also contributing as an SRE supporting our Infrastructure. Together with the Technical Operations leadership team, you will integrate expertise across on-premises operations, cloud services, and advanced AI/ML technologies. Your strategic focus will be on ensuring high performance, user enablement, and efficient service delivery while effectively managing relationships with external vendors. This comprehensive approach will drive operational excellence and support the evolving technical needs of our organization.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Develop and implement strategic plans aligned with organizational goals, integrating managed services, on-premises operations, and cloud initiatives while leveraging AI as a key accelerator.

• Vendor & Stakeholder engagement – Vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and ensure adherence to SLAs.

• Operational Excellence & Change Management – Applying software engineering principles to operations to scale and maintain highly reliable production systems, balancing the rapid release of new features w

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il gruppo Servizi Tecnici e Operazioni (TSO) all'interno di DDC è responsabile per fornire supporto alle applicazioni (Level 1-3) per centinaia di soluzioni software. Inoltre, TSO è responsabile per DevOps e Operazioni per il paesaggio delle applicazioni DDC, sia Cloud che On Premise. Come Ingegnere Principale Software, si unirà al team di Leadership TSO e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i colleghi DDC e direttamente con i nostri principali stakeholder, tra cui scienziati computazionali, scienziati ML e scienziati di ricerca. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori che forniscono servizi gestiti che formano il nucleo di molte delle attività TSO. Sei un esperto e pratico esperto tecnico con la comprovata capacità di guidare e fornire operazioni tecniche su scala aziendale. Potrai gestire le operazioni per applicazioni e software e contribuire anche come SRE supportando la nostra infrastruttura. Insieme al team di leadership Technical Operations, integrerai le competenze nelle operazioni on-premise, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie AI/ML avanzate. Il vostro obiettivo strategico sarà quello di garantire prestazioni elevate, l'attivazione degli utenti e la consegna efficiente dei servizi, mentre la gestione efficace dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Questo approccio completo guiderà l'eccellenza operativa e sosterrà le esigenze tecniche in evoluzione della nostra organizzazione. L'opportunità
• Strategic Planning & Service Integration – Sviluppare e implementare piani strategici allineati a obiettivi organizzativi, integrando servizi gestiti, operazioni on-premise e iniziative cloud, sfruttando l'IA come acceleratore chiave.
• L'impegno del venditore & Stakeholder – le relazioni del venditore, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'adesione a SLAs.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Investigator Relations Technology Informatics Partner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Site and Investigator Engagement area delivers the comprehensive digital ecosystem and integrated platforms required to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of clinical site interactions, covering efficient study planning, country and site selection, site activation, and patient enrollment forecasting. Additionally, it manages the core technologies to handle complex administrative tasks, including budgeting and negotiation, clinical contracts, payments, and clinical information exchange. The team acts as a strategic liaison connecting Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Country Operations, strategic CROs, and Clinical Sites. Through this alignment, the area architects technology portfolios that foster strong external relationships and drive a unified, partner-centric clinical ecosystem. ​

As an Informatics Partner at this level, you lead strategic and complex cross-functional efforts across countries or domains, aligning initiatives with country-wide priorities and business outcomes. You anticipate and solve complex, systems-level problems, drive innovation, and shape domain vision while managing multiple workstreams with high accountability.

The opportunity:

• Scope/Content Leadership: Leads initiatives across multiple teams, and actively shapes business outcomes. Acts as a subject matter expert, influencing country-wide or cross-functional strategies, and fostering collaborations with stakeholders across organizational levels. Responsible for aligning team or domain objectives with country-wide goals, focusing on strategic projects that drive substantial impact. Frequently manages complex, cross-functional work streams.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads problem-solving at the country-wide or cross-functional level, taking accountability for multiple workstreams or outcomes that influence strategic objectives. Anticipates and mitigates potential issues before they arise, using advanced analysis to address complex problems. Employs a systems-thinking approach to propose solutions that align with business and global goals, demonstrating high accountability in driving sustained improvements and efficiencies across teams. Navigates highly complex, competing demands between global and local teams. Employs data-driven frameworks to transition subjective business priorities into objective, scalable technology roadmaps and robust operational resolutions.

• Stakeholder Management: Manages relationships across Global Pharma Clinical Operations, Co

Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. La zone d'engagement du site et du chercheur offre l'écosystème numérique complet et les plateformes intégrées nécessaires pour gérer le cycle de vie de bout en bout des interactions du site clinique, couvrant la planification efficace des études, la sélection du pays et du site, l'activation du site et la prévision de l'inscription des patients. De plus, il gère les technologies de base pour gérer des tâches administratives complexes, notamment la budgétisation et la négociation, les contrats cliniques, les paiements et l'échange d'information clinique. L'équipe agit comme une liaison stratégique reliant les Opérations cliniques Global Pharma, les Opérations par pays, les ORC stratégiques et les Sites cliniques. Grâce à cet alignement, les portefeuilles technologiques d'architectes régionaux qui favorisent de solides relations externes et stimulent un écosystème clinique unifié et axé sur les partenaires. En tant que partenaire informatique à ce niveau, vous dirigez des efforts interfonctionnels stratégiques et complexes dans tous les pays ou domaines, en alignant les initiatives sur les priorités nationales et les résultats opérationnels. Vous anticipez et résolvez des problèmes complexes au niveau des systèmes, stimulez l'innovation et façonnez la vision du domaine tout en gérant plusieurs flux de travail avec une haute responsabilité. L'occasion :
• Portée et contenu Leadership : Dirige les initiatives de plusieurs équipes et oriente activement les résultats opérationnels. Agir à titre d'expert en la matière, influencer les stratégies nationales ou interfonctionnelles et favoriser la collaboration avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux organisationnels. Responsable de l ' harmonisation des objectifs de l ' équipe ou du domaine avec les objectifs nationaux, en mettant l ' accent sur les projets stratégiques qui ont un impact considérable. Il gère fréquemment des flux de travail complexes et interfonctionnels.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : dirige la résolution des problèmes à l'échelle du pays ou au niveau interfonctionnel, en prenant en compte la responsabilité de multiples secteurs de travail ou résultats qui influent sur les objectifs stratégiques. Anticiper et atténuer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent, en utilisant une analyse avancée pour résoudre les problèmes complexes. Utilise une approche de conception de systèmes pour proposer des solutions qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs commerciaux et mondiaux, démontrant une haute responsabilité dans la conduite d'améliorations et d'efficacités durables entre les équipes. Navigue sur des demandes très complexes et concurrentes entre équipes mondiales et locales. Utiliser des cadres fondés sur les données pour transformer les priorités subjectives des entreprises en feuilles de route technologiques objectives, évolutives et des résolutions opérationnelles robustes.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key activities & Deliverables

• Co-ordinate and execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with work instructions and month end close checklist

• Perform and analyse booking accounting transactions, working and calculations are executed on timely and accurately

• Clearing of open items in accounts

• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, cost center checks and transaction posting checks

• Ensure accruals are properly justified and correctly posted

• To ensure all journals are performed accurately and timely

• Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliation, highlight and rectify any anomalies encountered

• Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reporting packages accurately and within specified timescale

Documentation & Controlling

• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines

• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required

• Participate in any compliance audits and respond to audit queries

Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations

• Initiate and execute the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Work collaboratively with customers and stakeholders

• Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project

• Proactively identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation

• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team

Coaching/Sharing

• Support the review entries posted by the team to ensure accuracy

• Extends coaching and guidance to juniors in daily operation

• Support the when there are any ad hoc activities or projects

• Contribute inputs/findings to establish a knowledge database of issue encountered, proposed resolution steps to facilitate continuous learning, development and cross sharing of knowledge and lesson learnt across the teams

Qualifications & Experience Required

• Degree or Diploma in Finance & Accounting/Commerce or equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English.

• Minimum 5 years working experiences in the related field, preferable in the area of General Accounting and Management Accounting

• SAP knowledge or other ERP accounting systems and MS Office tools

• Proficiency in English and Japanese language are mandatory with good communication skill (writing and speaking).

Desirable qualifications

• External experience in a shared service or business process outsourcing engagement will be preferable

• Prior leadership or project management type supervisory role may be an advantage.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare soluti

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire financier commercial (gestion de la demande)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value.

Key Responsibilities
1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management

• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.

• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.

• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.

• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows.

2. Budgeting & Financial Planning

• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.

• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L.

3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs

• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.

• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.

• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness.

4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration

• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.

• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices.

5. Compliance & Risk Management

• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations.

Key Requirements

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).

• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.

• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record.

titleByLocale.en: Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Affairs International (EAi), part of the Roche Pharma CEO Office, ensures the company can shape the policies, funding decisions, and market conditions that determine how healthcare innovation is valued and rewarded. We influence globally where strategic priorities are defined and enable locally where business impact is delivered. Through focused advocacy and a connected global network, EAi builds trusted relationships with governments, multilateral institutions, and global partners, develops third-party advocates, and forges alliances that protect and grow Roche’s business while improving patient access to innovation.

The Opportunity
The Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy is a high-impact strategic expert responsible for designing and driving Roche’s policy strategies across priority Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Reporting to the Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, you serve as the definitive policy expert, ensuring that the external policy environment and healthcare systems deliver rapid and sustainable access to innovation. This role requires a unique blend of technical policy mastery, commercial acumen and strategic diplomacy to navigate complex supra-national environments, influence senior stakeholders, and orchestrate global-to-local disease area policy alignment without the need for direct hierarchical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the development and implementation of the global policy strategy portfolio and performance metrics across priority TAs, ensuring full alignment with global, regional, and affiliate functions.

• Define the long-term global disease area policy vision, strategy, objectives and crafting sophisticated policy projects, evidence, tools and positioning that addresses the needs of patients, medical professionals, and the business.

• Act as a primary catalyst for shaping policy environments by architecting external engagement and advocacy frameworks for a broad cross-section of disease area policy and health system stakeholders, while identifying and mitigating barriers to access among governments and NGOs.

• Serve as the primary global point-of-contact for disease area policy, providing timely and expert direction to the business

• Partner strategically across Roche regions and affiliates to ensure consistent application of health policy expertise, enabling local implementation of disease area policy strategies, and to drive the External Affairs mission through the organization.

• Lead the development of portfolio-wide content, analytical tools, and disease area policy strategies that translate complex external policy and healthcare challenges into actionable business insights and tactics.

• Manage high-impact global strategic policy initiatives and project workstreams, ensuring resource transparency and evidence-based recommendations to enable high-level business decision-making.

• Support organizational growth by sharing global health policy expertise and educating cross-functional peers to foster a culture of functional excellence and innovation.

Who You Are

• You hold a Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent in Political Science, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in health policy or public affairs within the life sciences sector or government,with a deep mastery and knowledge of disease area policy, health system and access environments.

• A recognized leader with a demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and policymakers

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Esterni International (EAi), parte dell'Ufficio CEO di Roche Pharma, assicura che l'azienda possa modellare le politiche, le decisioni di finanziamento e le condizioni di mercato che determinano come l'innovazione sanitaria sia valutata e premiata. Influenziamo a livello globale dove vengono definite le priorità strategiche e consentiamo a livello locale dove l'impatto aziendale viene consegnato. Attraverso l’advocacy focalizzata e una rete globale collegata, EAi costruisce relazioni di fiducia con governi, istituzioni multilaterali e partner globali, sviluppa sostenitori di terze parti, e forgia alleanze che proteggono e crescono gli affari di Roche, migliorando l’accesso dei pazienti all’innovazione. L'opportunità La politica globale Lead, Malattia Area Policy è un esperto strategico ad alto impatto responsabile della progettazione e della guida delle strategie politiche di Roche attraverso aree terapeutiche prioritarie (TA). Segnalando al Global Disease Area Policy Team Lead, sei l'esperto di politica definitiva, assicurando che l'ambiente di politica esterna e i sistemi sanitari garantiscano un accesso rapido e sostenibile all'innovazione. Questo ruolo richiede una miscela unica di padronanza della politica tecnica, acume commerciale e diplomazia strategica per navigare ambienti sovranazionali complessi, influenzare gli stakeholder senior e orchestrare l'allineamento della politica globale-locale delle malattie senza la necessità di autorità gerarchiche dirette. Principali responsabilità
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'attuazione del portafoglio di strategia di politica globale e metriche di performance attraverso TA prioritari, garantendo il pieno allineamento con le funzioni globali, regionali e affiliate.
• Definire la visione, la strategia, gli obiettivi e la realizzazione di progetti politici sofisticati, prove, strumenti e posizionamento a lungo termine che rispondono alle esigenze dei pazienti, dei medici e del business.
• Agire come catalizzatore primario per la modellazione degli ambienti politici attraverso l'archiviazione di schemi di impegno e di advocacy esterni per una vasta sezione trasversale delle parti interessate della politica della malattia e del sistema sanitario, identificando e mitigando le barriere all'accesso tra governi e ONG.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale globale per la politica dell'area delle malattie, fornendo una direzione tempestiva ed esperta al business
• Partner strategicamente nelle regioni e nelle affiliate di Roche per garantire un'applicazione coerente delle competenze in materia di politica sanitaria, consentendo l'implementazione locale delle strategie di politica delle malattie e di guidare la missione Affari Esteri attraverso l'organizzazione.
• Condurre lo sviluppo di contenuti a livello di portafoglio, strumenti analitici e strategie politiche di area malattia che traducono complesse sfide di politica esterna e di assistenza sanitaria in insight aziendali e tattiche attuabili.
• Gestire iniziative di politica strategica globale ad alto impatto e flussi di lavoro di progetto, garantendo trasparenza delle risorse e raccomandazioni basate su prove per consentire un processo decisionale di alto livello.
• Sostenere la crescita organizzativa condividendo le competenze della politica sanitaria globale e istruire i coetanei interfunzionali per promuovere una cultura di eccellenza funzionale e innovazione. Chi sei
• Hai un master, MBA, o equivalente in Scienze Politiche, Politica Pubblica, Salute Pubblica, Gestione della Sanità, o un campo relativo.
• 8+ anni di esperienza nella politica sanitaria o negli affari pubblici nel settore delle scienze della vita o del governo, con una profonda padronanza e conoscenza della politica della zona delle malattie, del sistema sanitario e degli ambienti di accesso.
• Un leader riconosciuto con una capacità dimostrata di influenzare dirigenti e politici senior

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position External Affairs International (EAi), Teil des Roche Pharma-CEO-Büros, sorgt dafür, dass das Unternehmen die Politiken, Förderentscheidungen und Marktbedingungen prägen kann, die bestimmen, wie Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen geschätzt und belohnt werden. Wir beeinflussen global, wo strategische Prioritäten definiert sind und lokal in die Lage versetzt werden, wo Geschäftsauswirkungen erzielt werden. Durch fokussierte Advocacy und ein vernetztes globales Netzwerk baut EAi vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Regierungen, multilateralen Institutionen und globalen Partnern auf, entwickelt Drittanbieter-Befürworter und forge Allianzen, die das Unternehmen von Roche schützen und wachsen und gleichzeitig den Zugang zu Innovationen verbessern. Die Chance Die Global Policy Lead, Disease Area Policy ist ein hochprägsamer strategischer Experte, der die politischen Strategien von Roche in vorrangigen Therapeutischen Bereichen (TAs) entwickelt und vorantreibt. Als definitiver politischer Experte, der sicherstellt, dass das außenpolitische Umfeld und die Gesundheitssysteme einen schnellen und nachhaltigen Zugang zu Innovation bieten. Diese Rolle erfordert eine einzigartige Mischung aus technischer Politik-Meisterschaft, kommerzieller acumen und strategischer Diplomatie, um komplexe supranationale Umgebungen zu navigieren, Senior Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und global-to-local Disease Area politische Ausrichtung ohne direkte hierarchische Autorität. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung des globalen Strategieportfolios und der Performance Metriken über prioritäre TAs aus, um eine vollständige Ausrichtung auf globale, regionale und Affiliate-Funktionen zu gewährleisten.
• Definieren Sie die langfristige globale Strategie, Strategie, Ziele und die Gestaltung von anspruchsvollen politischen Projekten, Beweisen, Werkzeugen und Positionierungen, die sich auf die Bedürfnisse von Patienten, medizinischen Fachleuten und das Geschäft beziehen.
• Aktivieren Sie als primärer Katalysator für die Gestaltung von politischen Umgebungen, indem Sie externes Engagement und Advocacy-Framework für einen breiten Querschnitt von Interessenvertretern im Bereich der Krankheits- und Gesundheitspolitik unter gleichzeitiger Identifizierung und Minderung von Barrieren für den Zugang zwischen Regierungen und NRO darstellen.
• Als primärer globaler Ansprechpartner für die Politik des Krankheitsbereichs dienen und dem Unternehmen zeitnah und kompetente Orientierung geben
• Partner strategisch über Roche-Regionen und Affiliates, um eine konsequente Anwendung der Gesundheitswesen-Expertise zu gewährleisten, die lokale Umsetzung von Krankheitsgebiet-Politikstrategien zu ermöglichen und die Mission für Auswärtige Angelegenheiten durch die Organisation zu fördern.
• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von portfolioweiten Content-, analytischen Tools- und Krankheitsfeldstrategien, die komplexe externe Politik- und Gesundheitsprobleme in handlungsfähige Unternehmens- und Taktiken übersetzen.
• Verwalten hocheffizienter globaler strategischer Initiativen und Projektarbeit, um Ressourcentransparenz und evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen zu gewährleisten, um eine hochrangige Unternehmensentscheidung zu ermöglichen.
• Unterstützung des organisatorischen Wachstums durch den Austausch globaler gesundheitspolitischer Expertise und Ausbildung von funktionsübergreifenden Peers, um eine Kultur funktionaler Exzellenz und Innovation zu fördern. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Master-Abschluss, MBA oder gleichwertig in Politikwissenschaft, Public Policy, Public Health, Healthcare Management oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Ein anerkannter Führer mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte und Politiker zu beeinflussen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position External Affairs International (EAi), qui fait partie du bureau du PDG de Roche Pharma, veille à ce que l'entreprise puisse façonner les politiques, les décisions de financement et les conditions du marché qui déterminent la valeur et la récompense de l'innovation en matière de soins de santé. Nous influons à l'échelle mondiale là où les priorités stratégiques sont définies et nous permettons à l'échelle locale d'avoir un impact sur les entreprises. Grâce à un plaidoyer ciblé et à un réseau mondial connecté, EAi établit des relations de confiance avec les gouvernements, les institutions multilatérales et les partenaires mondiaux, développe des défenseurs tiers et forge des alliances qui protègent et développent les affaires de Roches tout en améliorant l'accès des patients à l'innovation. L'opportunité Le responsable de la politique mondiale, Politique sur les zones de maladies, est un expert stratégique à fort impact chargé de concevoir et d'orienter les stratégies stratégiques de Roche dans les zones thérapeutiques prioritaires. Rendre compte au responsable de l'équipe de la politique mondiale sur les maladies, vous êtes l'expert en politiques définitives, vous assurant que l'environnement politique externe et les systèmes de soins de santé offrent un accès rapide et durable à l'innovation. Ce rôle exige un mélange unique de maîtrise des politiques techniques, de sens commercial et de diplomatie stratégique afin de naviguer dans des environnements supranationaux complexes, d'influencer les principaux intervenants et d'orchestrer l'alignement des politiques mondiales sur les zones de maladies locales sans avoir besoin d'une autorité hiérarchique directe. Principales responsabilités
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre du portefeuille de stratégies politiques mondiales et des indicateurs de performance dans les AT prioritaires, en assurant une alignement complet avec les fonctions mondiales, régionales et affiliées.
• Définir la vision politique, la stratégie, les objectifs et l'élaboration de projets politiques sophistiqués, de données probantes, d'outils et de positionnement qui répondent aux besoins des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des entreprises.
• Agir en tant que principal catalyseur de la mise en place d'un environnement politique en élaborant des cadres d'engagement et de plaidoyer extérieurs pour un large éventail d'acteurs de la politique et du système de santé, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les obstacles à l'accès entre les gouvernements et les ONG.
• Servir de principal point de contact mondial pour la politique en matière de maladies, fournissant une orientation opportune et experte aux entreprises
• Établir des partenariats stratégiques dans les régions de Roche et les filiales afin d'assurer une application cohérente de l'expertise en matière de politique de santé, de permettre la mise en œuvre locale des stratégies de lutte contre la maladie et de conduire la mission Affaires extérieures à travers l'organisation.
• Diriger l'élaboration de contenus à l'échelle du portefeuille, d'outils d'analyse et de stratégies politiques dans le domaine des maladies qui traduisent des politiques extérieures complexes et des défis en matière de soins de santé en idées et tactiques opérationnelles réalisables.
• Gérer les initiatives stratégiques mondiales à haut impact et les axes de travail des projets, en assurant la transparence des ressources et en formulant des recommandations fondées sur des données factuelles pour permettre une prise de décisions de haut niveau.
• Soutenir la croissance organisationnelle en partageant l'expertise mondiale en matière de politique de santé et en éduquant les pairs interfonctionnels pour favoriser une culture d'excellence fonctionnelle et d'innovation. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master, d'un MBA ou d'un équivalent en sciences politiques, politiques publiques, santé publique, gestion des soins de santé ou un domaine connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de politique de santé ou d'affaires publiques dans le secteur des sciences de la vie ou au sein du gouvernement, avec une maîtrise et une connaissance approfondies de la politique en matière de maladies, du système de santé et des environnements d'accès.
• Un dirigeant reconnu ayant une capacité démontrée d'influencer les cadres supérieurs et les décideurs

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
This role serves as a strategic leader driving the scaling and value acceleration of Roche’s AI and digital healthcare solutions from “10 to 100.” You will lead a hybrid team of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to expand application scenarios, accelerate ecosystem adoption, and strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital
healthcare through ecosystem collaboration and innovation initiatives. The mandate is anchored in two core pillars:
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Accelerating the adoption, expansion, and measurable value realization of Roche’s established AI and digital solutions across internal and external healthcare ecosystems.
2. Ecosystem Architecture & Policy Shaping
Building strategic partnerships, influencing healthcare innovation dialogue, and shaping policy and ecosystem mechanisms that enable sustainable AI healthcare transformation.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling
Lead the strategic scaling and value acceleration of Roche AI and digital healthcare solutions by expanding application scenarios, accelerating ecosystem adoption, and establishing scalable value realization models.
➢ Scaling Strategy, Scenario Expansion & Product Generalization:
Drive the “10 to 100” scaling strategy for Roche AI and digital solutions by identifying scalable application scenarios, healthcare customer groups, and ecosystem opportunities, while translating successful pilots into reusable healthcare solution models.
➢ Customer Adoption & Value Realization:
Drive the adoption and integration of Roche AI solutions across hospitals, HCPs, and ecosystem partners through effective deployment strategies, value demonstration frameworks, and measurable clinical and business impact validation.
➢ Strategic Storytelling & Scaling Optimization:
Translate complex AI capabilities into compelling healthcare and business narratives while leveraging real-world insights and ecosystem feedback to continuously optimize solution positioning and scaling strategy.
2. Ecosystem Architecture, Policy Shaping & Healthcare Value Acceleration
Architect and orchestrate a sustainable healthcare innovation ecosystem that accelerates AI solution value release through strategic partnerships, ecosystem collaboration, innovation platforms, and policy engagement.
➢ Healthcare Ecosystem Architecture & Digital Intelligence Incubator Leadership:
Build strategic collaborations with hospitals, academic institutions and other ecosystem stakeholders. Through the Digital Intelligence Incubator, connect healthcare scenarios, validation resources, ecosystem partners to accelerate solution maturation and value realization.
➢ Healthcare Value Model Exploration & Policy Shaping:
Explore innovative healthcare value frameworks, collaboration mechanisms, reimbursement pathways, and policy engagement opportunities that unlock sustainable value creation for patients and healthcare systems.
➢ Innovation Platform, External Engagement & Thought Leadership:
Lead ecosystem collaborations, and strategic engagement initiatives [e.g., WAIC, CIIE…] to strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital healthcare and identify future ecosystem opportunities.
3. Team Leadership & Capability Development
Manage and mentor a hybrid team composed of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to accelerate AI solution scaling, ecosystem collabor

jobs.title: Country Chief Accountant - Bulgarian speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The opportunity

As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist.

R2R

• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.

• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting

• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.

• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.

• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions.

DtP

• Handling all accounts payable related matters

Master Data

• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc.

Other

• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs

Who you are:

• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience

• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage

• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making

• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support fle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards.
You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design

• Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards

• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns

• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance)

Data & Integration

• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data
Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation

• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance

Platform (Adobe Stack)

• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA

• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation

• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems

Real-time & Orchestration

• Design event-driven and streaming architectures

• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)

• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks

Strategy & Delivery

• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases

• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities

• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams

• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment

Qualifications

Experience

• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems

• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)

• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams

• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP)

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of:

• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation

• Event-driven / streaming architectures

• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems

• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR)

What Success Looks Like

• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards

• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

• Real-time orchestration and activation across channels

• Measurable business impact through improved customer engagement

• Strong stakeholder alignment through clear communication and effective translation of complex concepts into business value

• Ability to influence and drive adoption of architectural decisions across cross-functional teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest.

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. This is the reason why we are continuously expanding, looking for new talents join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. • Vendor creation/maintenance in SAP

• Bank maintenance in SAP

• Vendor Request validation and approval

• Participation in data cleansing activities

• Replication monitoring

What you should bring to our company:

• Ongoing Hungarian University studies

• Able to work at least 30 hours per week

• Fluent English

• Knowledge of MS Office

• SAP knowledge is a plus

Why you should join us:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Free language courses

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role after graduation

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: (Senior) Biostatistician for Clinical Algorithms
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Department
We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights.

Your Team
Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development.

Your Main Objectives and Tasks

• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.

• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.

• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.

• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.

• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams.

Who You Are

• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.

• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.

• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.

• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.

• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt.

Dein neues Team:
Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:

• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.

• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.

• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.

• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.

• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.

• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:

• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.

• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.

• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich.

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser.

Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest.
