jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapte r is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist I to join our global service and support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how—understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools, enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Your key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems. You may be the primary contact for R&D scientists and engineers in the use of our internal enterprise systems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Business Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, training system data, change requests) for timely and accurate execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Who you are:

Education : Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

Experience : 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

System Proficiency:

• Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

• P

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.

The Role

We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.
Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.

• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.

• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.

• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.

• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

• Provide data monitoring and statistics You may be asked to support audits by showing adherence to our quality management systems and pr

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing the complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos. The Role We are seeking an R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist II to join our global internal service and support team. In this mid-level role, you will apply your conceptual knowledge and significant working experience to perform a range of assignments with limited guidance. You will act as a reliable service provider with a customer-oriented mindset to handle critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients. Rather than just managing system change requests, you will manage the integrity of the business process within our internal tools. By developing a deep understanding of the R&D organization and unique team needs, you will translate diverse business needs into effective system and data configurations. You will handle complex requests, ensuring that as our internal digital infrastructure evolves, our global R&D teams remain compliant, organized, and productive. Key Responsibilities
• Execute System Requests with Limited Guidance: Fulfill customer requests and generate business metrics by performing a range of assignments related to your discipline, ensuring that enterprise system tool configurations / data updates align with actual R&D workflows / needs.
• Anticipate and Solve Complex Problems: Understand the impact of system changes on the broader level to anticipate issues. Analyze possible solutions to operational issues and system problems by relying on your experience, judgment, and established precedents.
• Functional Decision-Making: Use your knowledge of your internal customers (the R&D teams) and their diverse needs to make informed decisions on system logic, such as grouping training curricula based on learner job functions, or making logical document hierarchies based on your learned organisational knowledge.
• Organizational Transition Management: Execute structural data migrations and updates within system tools driven by acquisitions, reorganizations, and digitalization projects to ensure user permissions, configurations, access, and data reflect the current state of the company.
• Mentorship and Guidance: Provide guidance to new team members and R&D internal customers. Based on your expertise navigating our enterprise tool workflows, configurations, and data - you provide guidance and oversight of system usage. You routinely will need to explain information to others in a straightforward manner, and deliver presentations when needed to support training, onboarding, and engaging stakeholders participation in our projects.
• Anticipate Customer Needs: Understand key organizational drivers and areas of expertise to proactively anticipate needs, accomplish your work, and represent internal customers' needs to global project teams.
• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes

jobs.title: ERP Business Analyst - Finance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a ERP Business Analyst - Finance, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity, strong ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications. You will demonstrate a full understanding of the business-finance domain, as well as integrate with other domains like commercial, supply chain and procurement, and related technologies, eco-systems and the interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business / Technical ability: Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• 2+ years of solid finance experience with SAP S4 and integrated eco-systems, with demonstrated ability to translate complex business-finance processes into functional specifications;

• Rich Business Analysis or project experience in finance and integrate with commercial, supply chain and procurement;

• Proven experience independently managing end-to-end BA workstreams, navigating ambiguous requirements, and evaluating strategic solution options.

• Demonstrated experience in translating requirements into strategic implementation

jobs.title: Specjalista / Specjalistka ds. Serwisu Technicznego
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Service Engineer

W Roche Diagnostics skupiamy się na wprowadzaniu innowacyjnych rozwiązań w obszarze medycyny laboratoryjnej. W Polsce działamy od kilkudziesięciu lat i należymy do wiodących pracodawców na światowym rynku diagnostycznym. Opracowujemy i wdrażamy rozwiązania diagnostyczne, które odpowiadają dzisiejszym wyzwaniom i są przygotowane na przyszłe potrzeby.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy Specjalisty/-ki ds. Serwisu Technicznego z województwa mazowieckiego .

Zatrudnienie przez zewnętrzną agencję na okres 18 miesięcy

Zadania:

• Instalacje i wdrażanie aparatury laboratoryjnej

• Naprawy gwarancyjne i pogwarancyjne sprzętu

• Szkolenia klientów z obsługi aparatury i systemów laboratoryjnych

• Pomoc techniczna dla klientów

• Raportowanie wyników pracy

O Tobie:

• Mieszkasz na terenie województwa mazowieckiego

• Posiadasz wyższe wykształcenie techniczne (preferowane: mechanika precyzyjna, elektronika lub pokrewne)

• Z łatwością potrafisz zrozumieć potrzeby Klienta i efektywnie się komunikować

• Posiadasz prawo jazdy kategorii B

• Dobrze znasz język angielski (min. B2)

• Umiesz priorytetyzować zadania i pracować pod presją czasu

• Doświadczenie w pracy na podobnym stanowisku będzie dodatkowym atutem

Oferujemy:

• Zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę tymczasową

• Pracę w przyjaznej atmosferze w międzynarodowym środowisku

• Możliwość wdrażania własnych inicjatyw

• Program szkoleniowy i wdrożeniowy

Brzmi interesująco? Nie czekaj - aplikuj!

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Poland. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 1. 职位职责：
• （ 1） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （ 2） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （ 3） 协助 开展学术会议，向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （ 4） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

2. 职位要求：
• （ 1）在校大学生
• （ 2）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （ 3）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （ 4）熟练运用 Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （ 5）拥有良好的英语书写能力

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Analyst Professional - RDT Group Function

We are looking for an experienced Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner to partner with the Business Product Owners in translating compliance requirements into strategic digital solutions. You will drive the strategic vision, roadmap, and delivery of Compliance-related products within Roche . This includes platforms supporting Group Audit and Risk Advisory, Group Compliance spanning global teams across Pharma and Diagnostics. The Technical Business Analyst and Product Owner will play a key role in analyzing complex business processes, identifying optimization opportunities, and enabling automation and digitization of the compliance processes, from review, approval, oversight, to monitoring, review and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with the "One Roche" philosophy.

Description of the area
About RDT Group Functions Compliance Product in Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-function: as a trusted and agile partner, we are empowered to boost global innovative solutions on the group risk, compliance and assurance digital prioritization journey.
The Compliance Product allows Roche to manage global risk, ensure financial and legal compliance and provide assurance of compliant processes and behavior in other words ensuring that the provisions of these regulations are met in practice. As part of the Compliance Product, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) creates, manages and operates solutions which improve processes, efficiency, effectiveness and collaboration especially among Group Compliance communities, Group Audit and Risk Advisory (GA & RA).

The opportunity:

• Drive the detailed discovery, scoping, and analysis of compliance, audit, and risk processes across global teams to target current pain points and maximize optimization opportunities .

• Translate complex business requirements into clear, functional specifications and technical specifications for development teams, bridging the gap between business and tech .

• Develop comprehensive business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and impact assessments for compliance products to systematically quantify and deliver measurable business value .

• Collaborate closely with the Business Product Owner to define compliance product strategies, roadmap priorities, and long-term tech goals like AI-driven solutions .

• Lead vendor selection processes by defining business criteria, conducting fit-for-purpose assessments, and partnering with Procurement to satisfy privacy and data security rules .

• Facilitate global requirements workshops across Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma, and Diagnostics teams to seamlessly harmonize and prioritize cross-functional business needs .

• Own the technical solution definition and requirements management from initial ideation and prototyping through to testing, adoption, and support transitions .

• Ensure all compliance platforms fully align with Roche’s legal, regulatory, data privacy, and security standards while strictly maintaining requirement traceability trails .

Who you are:

• Education & Experience: You possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, combined with previous experience as a Technical Business Analyst or Product Owner.

• Industry Expertise: You have a proven track record working within compliance, audit, risk, or governance environments, ideally within the global corporate, pharmaceutical, or diagnostics industries.

Questo include piattaforme che supportano il Gruppo Audit e Risk Advisory, Compliance di Gruppo che spazia tra i team globali di Pharma e Diagnostics. Il Technical Business Analyst e Product Owner svolgeranno un ruolo chiave nell'analisi di processi aziendali complessi, nell'individuazione delle opportunità di ottimizzazione e nell'automazione e nella digitalizzazione dei processi di conformità, dalla revisione, approvazione, supervisione, al monitoraggio, alla revisione e ai quadri di governance, garantendo l'allineamento con la filosofia "One Roche". Il Prodotto di Compliance consente a Roche di gestire il rischio globale, garantire la conformità finanziaria e legale e garantire processi e comportamenti conformi in altre parole assicurando che le disposizioni di queste normative siano soddisfatte in pratica. Nell'ambito del prodotto Compliance, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crea, gestisce e gestisce soluzioni che migliorano processi, efficienza, efficacia e collaborazione soprattutto tra le comunità di Compliance Group Audit e Risk Advisory (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Guidare la scoperta dettagliata, scoping, e l'analisi di conformità, audit e processi di rischio in team globali per individuare i punti di dolore attuali e massimizzare le opportunità di ottimizzazione. - Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in specifiche chiare e funzionali e specifiche tecniche per i team di sviluppo, colmare il divario tra business e tecnologia. - Sviluppare casi aziendali completi, analisi dei costi e valutazioni di impatto per i prodotti di conformità per quantificare sistematicamente e fornire un valore commerciale misurabile. - Collaborare a stretto contatto con il proprietario del prodotto aziendale per definire le strategie di conformità del prodotto, le priorità della roadmap e gli obiettivi tecnologici a lungo termine come soluzioni AI-driven. - Processi di selezione dei fornitori di piombo definendo criteri aziendali, conducendo valutazioni fit-for-purpose e collaborando con Procurement per soddisfare le regole di privacy e sicurezza dei dati. - Facilitare i workshop sui requisiti globali attraverso i team di Compliance, GA&RA, Pharma e Diagnostics per armonizzare e dare priorità alle esigenze aziendali interfunzionali. - Proprio la definizione della soluzione tecnica e la gestione dei requisiti da ideazione iniziale e prototipazione fino a test, adozione e transizioni di supporto. - Assicurare tutte le piattaforme di conformità pienamente allineare con gli standard legali, regolamentari, privacy dei dati e sicurezza di Roche, mantenendo rigorosamente i percorsi di tracciabilità dei requisiti. Chi Sei: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Possiedi una laurea o Master in Informatica, Business Administration, o un campo correlato, combinato con l'esperienza precedente come analista tecnico o proprietario del prodotto. - Esperienza Settoriale: Hai una comprovata esperienza nel campo della conformità, dell'audit, del rischio o della governance, idealmente all'interno delle industrie aziendali, farmaceutiche o diagnostiche globali. - Analitico

L'analyste technique des affaires et le propriétaire du produit joueront un rôle clé dans l'analyse des processus opérationnels complexes, la détermination des possibilités d'optimisation et la facilitation de l'automatisation et de la numérisation des processus de conformité, depuis l'examen, l'approbation, la surveillance, jusqu'aux cadres de surveillance, d'examen et de gouvernance, en passant par l'harmonisation avec la philosophie « One Roche ». Descrizione dell'Area À propos du Groupe RDT Fonctions Conformité Produit dans la sous-fonction juridique, Conformité & Communication du Groupe: en tant que partenaire fiable et agile, nous sommes habilités à stimuler des solutions innovantes au niveau mondial sur le parcours de priorité numérique de risque, de conformité et d'assurance de groupe. Le produit de conformité permet à Roche de gérer le risque mondial, d'assurer la conformité financière et juridique et d'assurer la conformité des processus et des comportements, c'est-à-dire de s'assurer que les dispositions de ces règlements sont respectées dans la pratique. Dans le cadre du produit Conformité, Roche Digital Technology (RDT) crée, gère et exploite des solutions qui améliorent les processus, l'efficience, l'efficacité et la collaboration, en particulier entre les communautés Conformité de Groupe, Audit de Groupe et Avis de Risque (GA & RA). L'Oportunità: - Diriger la découverte détaillée, la détermination de la portée et l'analyse des processus de conformité, d'audit et de risque dans les équipes mondiales afin de cibler les points de douleur actuels et de maximiser les possibilités d'optimisation. - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et techniques pour les équipes de développement, combler l'écart entre les entreprises et les technologies. - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation complètes, des analyses coûts-avantages et des analyses d'impact pour les produits de conformité afin de quantifier et de produire systématiquement une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. - Collaborer étroitement avec le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise pour définir les stratégies de conformité des produits, les priorités de la feuille de route et les objectifs technologiques à long terme comme les solutions axées sur l'IA. - Diriger les processus de sélection des fournisseurs en définissant les critères opérationnels, en procédant à des évaluations adaptées à l'usage et en établissant des partenariats avec Approvisionnement pour satisfaire aux règles de confidentialité et de sécurité des données. - Faciliter l'organisation d'ateliers sur les exigences mondiales à l'échelle des équipes Conformité, AG&RA, Pharma et Diagnostics afin d'harmoniser et de prioriser les besoins opérationnels interfonctionnels. - Posséder la définition de la solution technique et la gestion des exigences, de l'idée initiale et du prototypage à l'essai, l'adoption et le soutien des transitions. - Veiller à ce que toutes les plateformes de conformité s'harmonisent pleinement avec les normes légales, réglementaires, de confidentialité des données et de sécurité de Roche, tout en maintenant strictement les pistes de traçabilité des exigences. C'est quoi ? - Istruzione & Esperienza: Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une maîtrise en technologie de l'information, administration des affaires, ou un domaine connexe, combiné avec une expérience antérieure en tant qu'analyste technique des affaires ou propriétaire de produit. - Esperienza Settoriale: Vous avez une expérience éprouvée de travail dans des environnements de conformité, d'audit, de risque ou de gouvernance, idéalement dans les industries mondiales de l'entreprise, pharmaceutique, ou de diagnostic. - Analyse

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

• Formulate and implement strategic and tactical sales in the assigned territory

• Oversee all necessary commercial activities to fulfill strategic objectives

• Develop relationships with existing clients and maximize revenue potential

• Provide timely and reliable sales reporting via REXIS and in company meetings/ presentations to senior management

• Product Knowledge: Ensure good understanding the product portfolio and competitive advantages of the products

• Develops and leverages relationships with the leadership of key/strategic customers to deliver value-based solutions and achieve business results.

• Tender Management: establishes priorities in the hospitals/groups with product listing for tender submission

• Apply existing marketing activities to ensure awareness of the company among all target groups

• Conduct presentations at small and medium customer sites and work with marketing for key account sites

• Build strong relationships with key accounts and develop a long term strategy how to grow business in key accounts

• Identify and seize opportunities for new business in existing (increase Roche share) and new customers

• Represent Vietnam in regional initiatives, projects and meetings as assigned by senior management

• Work closely with marketing team to ensure accurate forecasting for respective customer segments

• Work closely with Service and Applications to understand potential issues at the customer and work together to ensure high customer satisfaction

• Inform Service and Applications timely about customer needs, e.g. installations, trouble shootings…

• Upskill DSMs and Sales Reps in their team and ensure high performance spirit among the team

Who you are

• Medical Doctor, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnology University Degree

• Multinational companies in a similar industry with sales management at least 5 years is preferred

• Good commercial understanding and understanding of Diagnostics buying cycle

• Sales experience in related industries is required.

• Supervisory/Managerial experience is required

• Languages: Conversant in both English and Vietnamese (conversational & writing)

• Key Account Management Skills

• Effective Communication Skill

• Good Interpersonal Skill

• Creative Problem Solving and Negotiation Skill

• Customer Complaint Handling Skill

• Time Management Skill

• Leadership and Coaching Skill

• Computer skills: <Google WorkSpace, Google Docs Editor, Microsoft Office

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Opportunity:
Job Responsibilities:

Ensure quality and accurate delivery of services within agreed key performance indicators (KPIs) and as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) and SOPs of the respective business sub-process.

jobs.title: Senior Patient Safety Partner

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire principal de la sécurité des patients

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Our Team: Senior Patient Safety Partner
Are you a pharmacovigilance (PV) professional looking to make a strategic impact on patient safety? We are looking for a Senior Patient Safety Partner to drive excellence in our local PV systems and help shape the future of patient care.

Job Purpose
In this role, you will be the guardian of our local PV system for Spain. Your mission is to ensure we remain fully compliant with Roche global standards and local regulatory requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. You will lead the execution of International Patient Safety (IPS) strategies, turning global solutions into high-quality local results.

Key Responsibilities

• PV System Excellence: Partner with global and local teams to monitor safety profiles of Roche Products and manage their risks effectively.

• Operational Oversight: Manage critical PV activities including individual case safety reports, Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. Safety Data Exchange Agreement), Risk Management and Safety Communication, Local Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., Interventional Clinical Trials, Non-interventional studies, Market Research Programs, Patient Support Programs, Compassionate Use Programs, Post Trial Access Programs, Digital Activities).

• Local Safety Risk Management

• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.

• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.

• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team.

• Strengthen cross-functional and cross-country collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional partnerships and represent affiliate safety interests in IPS forums, strategically influencing cross-country initiatives and implementing global solutions into local clinical practice

• Regulatory Influence: Actively shape local PV regulations and ecosystems by collaborating with industry associations and health authorities.

What You Bring

• Education: A degree in life sciences or a healthcare-related field (e.g., PharmD, Medical Doctor, Bachelor in Life Sciences, or Nursing).

• Experience:

• At least 5 years experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting

• PV Compliance Expertise: In-depth knowledge of global & local PV regulations and the ability to oversee comprehensive compliance monitoring systems.

• Decision-making ability in the local & global PV ecosystem

• Experienced in collaborating within global and local matrix environments, including proven ability in stakeholder management and influencing

• Advantage : Experience in other affiliate medical functions (e.g., Regulatory, Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, Medical Information) or global functions such as Clinical Safety

Core Competencies & Skills
1. Strategic Leadership & Big-Picture Thinking

• Strategic Planning: Ability to align complex projects with the company’s long-term goals.

• Syst

The Position

As a Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Supported by senior experts, you will dive into code and logs to untangle software issues, growing your expertise in both cutting-edge IT and medical compliance frameworks. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

• You are accountable for handling medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Hospital/Laboratory Information Systems (HIS/LIS) , medical data networks, middleware solutions, data communication, apps, and algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator . You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of transfering to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT related field.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UNUM);

• Training, language courses, and diversified career paths are available

• Recharge Days (2 days off per quarter)

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Head of Healthcare Transformation
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose

• The Head of Healthcare Transformation serves as a cornerstone in advancing Roche Diagnostics' commitment to enhancing patient care. By synthesizing clinical evidence, access frameworks, and governmental advocacy with business development, this leader ensures that breakthrough diagnostics gain market entry, clinical recognition, and financial sustainability within Taiwan. This executive role fundamentally evolves the local medical landscape while establishing Roche as a premier partner in the health ecosystem.

• A primary focus involves the evaluation and refinement of healthcare pathways and public policy to foster robust internal and external partnerships, thereby modernizing the local environment to drive substantive commercial growth. Achieving systemic change necessitates the seamless integration of policy shaping, medical insights and reimbursement expertise. Furthermore, you will identify and cultivate emerging business opportunities that respond to shifting clinical trends, overseeing the launch of programs that improve healthcare delivery and ensure the enduring availability of innovative diagnostic tools.

• Possessing a profound sense of purpose, the incumbent will mobilize teams to achieve superior outcomes under the "Pioneering Diagnostics and Shaping Effective Healthcare in Taiwan" vision, directly contributing to the execution of the RDTW 1000 days strategic roadmap.

• In this capacity, you will demonstrate an entrepreneurial spirit and system-wide perspective, converting visionary concepts into disciplined, high-impact strategies that secure organizational success across both immediate and future horizons.

• As a member of the RD Taiwan Leadership Team, you will role model VACC behaviors and uphold the LT Purpose Statement. Close collaboration with peers across the Leadership Team is essential to realize the company's broader objectives. This leadership approach centers on cultivating high-performing, customer-centric teams within an agile and continuously evolving organizational culture.

• Ultimately, you must exhibit the determination and resilience required to transform Taiwan's healthcare landscape, embodying the core Roche mission: "Doing what patients need next."

Key Responsibilities:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute an integrated medical, market access & policy strategy aligned with global/regional guidelines and local business objectives.

• Medical Affairs Strategy: Lead the generation and dissemination of scientific evidence, foster strategic relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and medical societies, and ensure scientific accuracy in all activities.

• Market Access & Reimbursement: Drive successful NHI (National Health Insurance) listing and optimal pricing strategies for key diagnostic products, utilizing health economics and outcomes research (HEOR).

• Public Policy & Government Affairs: Proactively monitor the healthcare policy landscape. Engage collaboratively with government authorities (e.g., MOHW, NHIA), industry associations, and patient advocacy groups to shape favorable policies for diagnostic innovations.

• Business Development: Identify, develop, and manage strategic emerging business opportunities and partnerships that promote growth and innovation and ensure the delivery of scalable and impactful healthcare solutions.

jobs.title: Praktikum im Marketing & Produktmanagement Labordiagnostik (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.en: Internship in Marketing & Product Management Laboratory Diagnostics (m/f/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Stage dans les diagnostics de laboratoire de commercialisation et de gestion de produits (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Abteilung

Im Produktmanagement & Marketing des Bereichs Labordiagnostik der Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH betreuen und vertreiben wir Lösungen für diagnostische Labore im deutschen Markt. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Analysensysteme und Assays für die Klinische Chemie, Immunologie, Gerinnungs- und Urindiagnostik. Ganzheitliche Konzepte für Labore aller Größenordnungen werden durch innovative Hardware und Software Lösungen zur automatisierten Prä- und Postanalytik, zur Steuerung des Proben- und Datenflusses sowie zur Unterstützung der operativen und medizinischen Entscheidungsfindung realisiert. Im Marketing- und Produktmanagement stellen wir eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Verkauf, Service und Produktentwicklung dar.

Die Position

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einem Praktikum, in dem Du Dich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst? In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Bachelor- und Masterstudierenden die Möglichkeit, die Arbeit im Marketing und Produktmanagement kennenzulernen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier werden naturwissenschaftliche Grundlagen mit betriebswirtschaftlichen und technologischen Themen vereint. Mögliche Aufgabenfelder beinhalten:

• Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Multi-Channel Marketingkampagnen, Schulungen und Events

• Mitarbeit bei der Einführung von neuen Produkten

• Konzeption von Marketingmaterialien (z.B. Online- und Social Media Marketing, Präsentationen und Broschüren)

• Identifikation, Analyse und Zusammenfassung von wissenschaftlicher Literatur und Studienergebnissen

• Markt- und Potentialanalysen

Qualifikationen

Für Dein Praktikum im Produktmanagement und Marketing bringst Du folgende Voraussetzungen und Kenntnisse mit:

• Du bist immatrikulierte/r, fortgeschrittene/r Bachelor- oder Masterstudierende/r der Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Medizin, des Ingenieurwesens, der Informationstechnologie oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

• Du bist es gewohnt, selbständig und mit hohem Engagement zu arbeiten und verfügst über eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Komplexe Fragestellungen aus dem Gesundheitswesen motivieren Dich und Herausforderungen treiben Dich an

• Du hast Spaß, im Team zu arbeiten und gemeinsam Erfolge zu erzielen

• Du bist sicher in der Anwendung der gängigen MS Office und Google-Programme

• Deutsch ist Deine Muttersprache oder Du hast C2 Niveau

• Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft runden Dein Profil ab

Die Benefits

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 4 Monate

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Die Bewerbung

Bitte bewirb Dich ausschließlich online und füge Deiner Bewerbung Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben, Zeugniskopien sowie eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung in einem Dokument bei.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : für 6 Monat

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Soluzione Architettura Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead
titleByLocale.en: Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead
titleByLocale.de: Lösung Architektur Praxis Lead & Architektur Community Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Solution Architecture Pratique Responsable et Architecture Responsable communautaire

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead

As the Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, you will be the principal orchestrator of our global Architecture Community. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and practical execution, ensuring our architectural practices are co-created with the very teams that bring them to life. Join us in transforming architecture into a dynamic catalyst for global delivery and innovation.

Description of the area
The Enterprise Architecture Foundations team acts as the backbone of the architecture function, focusing on Community, Ways of Working, and Enablement. We define Enterprise and Solution Architecture practices, oversee our integrated toolchain (including ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS, and our AI Architecture Co-Pilot), and build organizational capability through learning curriculums and the Tech University. Our goal is to connect architects across a federated organization, empowering them to design sustainable technology solutions through shared principles and active community engagement.

The Opportunity:

• Lead the continuous maturation of Solution Architecture practices to adapt to evolving business needs and agile delivery models.

• Drive the transition from static documentation to dynamic solution modeling by leveraging our ArchiMEDES platform.

• Design and host global engagement forums, workshops, and community events to foster knowledge sharing and collaboration.

• Serve as the principal facilitator for the Architecture Community, inspiring a shared sense of identity across our global network.

• Partner with federated delivery teams to co-create standards that reduce friction and accelerate high-quality product delivery.

• Collaborate with Tech University to develop learning curriculums and upskill the community on modern solution design.

• Own and evolve the Solution Architect Onboarding Kit to ensure a seamless entry for new joiners into our culture and tools.

• Champion a data-driven approach to architecture, promoting the use of integrated toolchains to support transparent decision-making.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with professional background in solution or enterprise architecture within complex organizations.

• You possess applied experience as a Solution Architect, demonstrating a deep understanding of the practical realities of technology delivery.

• You offer comprehensive expertise in solution architecture methodologies and modern digital platforms like Cloud, Data, and AI.

• You are proficient with architecture modeling platforms (e.g., SAP LeanIX) and can translate enterprise principles into actionable designs.

• You have a proven track record in cultivating, motivating, and facilitating vibrant and active communities of practice.

• You demonstrate a co-creation mindset, viewing practice development as a shared journey rather than a top-down mandate.

• You are a master of influencing and storytelling, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders through empathy and clear communication.

What you get:

• Salary range 23 300 - 43 300 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subs

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Soluzione Architettura Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead Descrizione del ruolo Come Enterprise Architect - Solution Architecture Practice Lead & Architecture Community Lead, sarai il principale orchestratore della nostra comunità globale di architettura. Ponteggerai il potenziale tra la strategia di alto livello e l'esecuzione pratica, assicurandoti che le nostre pratiche di architettura siano co-create con i team che le rendono vive. Unisciti a noi per trasformare l'architettura in un catalizzatore dinamico per la consegna globale e l'innovazione. Descrizione dell'area Il team di Enterprise Architecture Foundations agiscono la spina dorsale della funzione di architettura, concentrandosi sulla Comunità, i Modi di Lavorare e l'Enablement. Definiamo le pratiche di Enterprise e Solution Architecture, sovrintendiamo alla nostra catena di strumenti integrati (compresi ArchiMEDES/SAP LeanIX, ITONICS e il nostro AI Architecture Co-Pilot) e costruiamo la capacità organizzativa attraverso i curricula di apprendimento e la Tech University. Il nostro obiettivo è connettere gli architetti in un'organizzazione federata, empowermentli a progettare soluzioni tecnologiche sostenibili attraverso principi condivisi e l'impegno della comunità. Opportunità - Guidare la maturazione continua delle pratiche di Solution Architecture per adattarsi alle esigenze aziendali in evoluzione e ai modelli di consegna agile. - Guidare la transizione dalla documentazione statica al modello di soluzione provvisoria utilizzando la nostra piattaforma ArchiMEDES. - Progettare e ospitare forum di impegno globale, workshop e eventi organizzati per favorire la condivisione delle conoscenze e la collaborazione. - Fare da facilitatore principale per la comunità di architettura, ispirando un senso di identità condiviso nella nostra rete globale. - Collaborare con i team di consegna federati per co-creare gli standard che servono gli attriti e accelerano la consegna dei prodotti di alta qualità. - Collaborare con la Tech University per sviluppare i curricula di apprendimento e aggiornare la comunità sulle moderne progettazioni di soluzione. - Possedere e evolvere il Kit di Onboarding del Solution Architect per garantire un ingresso fluido per i nuovi arrivati nella nostra cultura e negli strumenti. - Promuovere un approccio basato sui dati all'architettura, promuovendo l'uso delle catene di strumenti si integrano per supportare le decisioni trasparenti. Chi sei? - Hai un Bachelor's o Master's Degree con un'esperienza professionale in soluzione o enterprise architecture all'interno di organizzazioni complesse. - Offri un'esperienza applicata come Solution Architect, dimostrando una profonda comprensione delle realtà pratiche della consegna tecnologica. - Offri un'esperienza completa nelle metodologie di soluzione architecture e nelle piattaforme digitali moderne come Cloud, Data e AI. - Sei esperto nelle piattaforme di modellazione dell'architettura (ad esempio SAP LeanIX) e puoi tradurre i principi aziendali in pianificazione azionabili. - Hai un'esperienza comprovata nella coltivazione, motivazione e facilitazione di comunità di pratica attive e vivaci. - Dimostri un mindset di co-creazione, vedendo lo sviluppo delle pratiche come un viaggio condiviso piuttosto che un mandato dall'alto. - Sei un maestro dell'influenza e della narrazione, con la capacità di discernere i senior stakeholder attraverso l'empatia e la comunicazione chiara. Cosa? - Gamma salariale 23 300 - 43 300 PLN lordi basati sul contratto di lavoro. - Bonus annuale basato sulla tua performance. - Budget di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati, ecc.). - Venerdì di ricarica (2 venerdì liberi per trimestre disponibili). - Programma di congedo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Congedo vacanza

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Global MSAT & Engineering function is undergoing a strategic modernization initiative to introduce innovative, efficient, and sustainable manufacturing technologies across our global device manufacturing footprint. As the Group Lead for Device Process Engineering, you will be the architect of our technical talent and process excellence. This is a dual-impact leadership role: you will serve as a senior technical authority for our most complex device programs and lead a world-class chapter of Process Engineers, ensuring they have the skills, tools, and standardized methodologies to deliver next-generation medical devices and drug-device combination products to patients worldwide.

The Opportunity

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of process engineers, setting clear expectations for technical excellence and functional capability.

• Define and drive the global process-engineering strategy for device and combination product assembly, packaging, and sterilization across the entire product lifecycle.

• Act as the senior technical authority for complex engineering decisions, balancing quality, compliance, supply, and speed-to-market.

• Drive structured process characterization using DOE and statistical tools to define operating windows and ensure process understanding.

• Establish methodologies for identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes to ensure robust control strategies.

• Own design transfer activities, translating design outputs into production specifications, equipment requirements, and manufacturing work instructions.

• Define and govern risk-based validation strategies for manufacturing processes, equipment qualification, and sterilization.

• Manage the process-engineering framework for continued process verification, investigation support, and lifecycle optimization.

• Ensure all engineering practices comply with global regulatory requirements, including FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and EU MDR.

Who you are
You are a strategic and technically credible leader who moves fluently between executive decision-making and deep engineering problem-solving. You have the ability to explain complex validation decisions to diverse audiences, translating technical risks into clear business impacts. You are a dedicated coach and talent developer who sets high standards for technical rigor while empowering your team to act. As an effective communicator and resilient collaborator, you build trust across matrixed organizations and remain focused on shared objectives even during periods of ambiguity or change.

Further you have the following qualifications and experiences:

• Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• 12-15+ years of experience in process engineering or technical operations within regulated medical device or pharma environments.

• Proven track record in formal people leadership and influencing across a matrixed global organization.

• Deep expertise in device assembly, packaging, sterilization, and automated manufacturing from development to commercial scale.

• Strong knowledge of design controls, risk management (ISO 14971), DfM, and technical transfer processes.

• Experience working with global external manufacturing partners and supplier networks.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives u

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Opportunità di lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La funzione Global MSAT & Engineering sta subendo un'iniziativa di modernizzazione strategica per introdurre tecnologie di produzione innovative, efficienti e sostenibili attraverso la nostra impronta globale di produzione di dispositivi. In qualità di Gruppo Lead for Device Process Engineering, sarai l'architetto del nostro talento tecnico e dell'eccellenza del processo. Questo è un ruolo di leadership dual-impact: servirai come autorità tecnica senior per i nostri programmi di dispositivo più complessi e condurre un capitolo di livello mondiale di ingegneri di processo, assicurando loro di avere le competenze, gli strumenti e metodologie standardizzate per fornire dispositivi medici di prossima generazione e prodotti combinati droga-dispositivi a pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità - Lead, coach e sviluppare un team di ingegneri di processo altamente performanti, ponendo chiare aspettative per l'eccellenza tecnica e la funzionalità. - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di ingegneria del processo per l'assemblaggio, l'imballaggio e la sterilizzazione del prodotto di dispositivo e combinazione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Agire come autorità tecnica senior per decisioni di ingegneria complesse, bilanciare la qualità, la conformità, la fornitura e la velocità di mercato. - Guidare la caratterizzazione del processo strutturato utilizzando DOE e strumenti statistici per definire le finestre operative e garantire la comprensione del processo. - Stabilire metodologie per identificare i parametri di processo critici (CPP) e gli attributi materiali per garantire strategie di controllo robuste. - Attività di trasferimento di progettazione proprie, traducendo uscite di progettazione in specifiche di produzione, requisiti di attrezzature e istruzioni di lavoro di fabbricazione. - Definire e governare strategie di validazione basate sui rischi per processi di produzione, qualificazione delle attrezzature e sterilizzazione. - Gestire il quadro di ingegneria del processo per la verifica continua del processo, il supporto di indagine e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita. - Assicurarsi che tutte le pratiche ingegneristiche siano conformi ai requisiti normativi globali, tra cui FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 e EU MDR. Chi sei? Sei un leader strategico e tecnicamente credibile che si muove fluentemente tra il processo decisionale esecutivo e la risoluzione dei problemi di ingegneria profonda. Hai la capacità di spiegare complesse decisioni di validazione a diversi pubblico, traducendo i rischi tecnici in chiari impatti aziendali. Sei un allenatore dedicato e sviluppatore di talenti che stabilisce standard elevati per il rigore tecnico, consentendo al tuo team di agire. Come un efficace comunicatore e collaboratore resiliente, si costruisce fiducia tra le organizzazioni matrici e si concentrano su obiettivi condivisi anche durante i periodi di ambiguità o cambiamento. Inoltre, hai le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienze: - Laurea (B.S., M.S. o Ph.D.) in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Farmaceutica, o un campo tecnico correlato. - 12-15 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi o nelle operazioni tecniche all'interno di dispositivi medici regolamentati o in ambienti farmaci. - Provato record di traccia nella leadership delle persone formali e influenzando attraverso un'organizzazione globale matrice. - Profonda competenza nel montaggio, imballaggio, sterilizzazione e produzione automatizzata da sviluppo a scala commerciale. - Forte conoscenza dei controlli di progettazione, gestione dei rischi (ISO 14971), DfM e processi di trasferimento tecnico. - Esperienza di lavoro con partner di produzione esterni globali e reti di fornitori. Contatto Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci guida.

descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Stellenangebote Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Mansion Die globale MSAT & Engineering-Funktion unternimmt eine strategische Modernisierungsinitiative zur Einführung innovativer, effizienter und nachhaltiger Fertigungstechnologien in unserem weltweiten Fertigungs-Fußabdruck. Als Group Lead for Device Process Engineering werden Sie der Architekt unseres technischen Talents und Prozess-Exzellenz sein. Dies ist eine dual-impact-Führungsrolle: Sie werden als leitende technische Behörde für unsere komplexesten Geräteprogramme dienen und ein erstklassiges Kapitel der Prozessingenieure führen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie die Fähigkeiten, Werkzeuge und standardisierten Methoden haben, um medizinische Geräte der nächsten Generation und Arzneimittel-Geräte-Kombinationsprodukte an Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Zur Übersicht - Führen, Coach und entwickeln ein hochperformierendes Team von Prozessingenieuren, das klare Erwartungen an technische Exzellenz und Funktionsfähigkeit legt. - Definieren und treiben Sie die globale Prozess-Engineering-Strategie für Geräte- und Kombinationsproduktmontage, Verpackung und Sterilisation über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg. - Gesetz als leitende technische Behörde für komplexe technische Entscheidungen, Balance von Qualität, Compliance, Angebot und Geschwindigkeit zu Markt. - Führen Sie die strukturierte Prozesscharakterisierung mithilfe von DOE und statistischen Tools aus, um Bedienfenster zu definieren und das Prozessverständnis zu gewährleisten. - Methoden zur Identifizierung kritischer Prozessparameter (CPPs) und Materialattribute, um robuste Steuerungsstrategien zu gewährleisten. - Eigene Design-Transfer-Aktivitäten, Übersetzen von Design-Ausgängen in Produktionsspezifikationen, Geräteanforderungen und Fertigungsaufträge. - Festlegung und Regelung von risikobasierten Validierungsstrategien für Fertigungsprozesse, Gerätequalifikation und Sterilisation. - Verwalten Sie den Prozess-Engineering-Rahmen für die kontinuierliche Prozessprüfung, Untersuchungsunterstützung und Lifecycle-Optimierung. - Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle technischen Praktiken den globalen Regulierungsanforderungen entsprechen, einschließlich FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 und EU MDR. Chi sei Sie sind ein strategischer und technisch glaubwürdiger Anführer, der sich fließend zwischen der Entscheidungsfindung und der Problemlösung im Tiefbau bewegt. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, komplexe Validierungsentscheidungen für unterschiedliche Publikum zu erklären und technische Risiken in klare geschäftliche Auswirkungen zu übersetzen. Sie sind ein engagierter Coach und Talent-Entwickler, der hohe Standards für technische Rigor setzt und Ihr Team befähigen, zu handeln. Als effektiver Kommunikator und widerstandsfähiger Mitarbeiter bauen Sie Vertrauen in Matrix-Organisationen und bleiben auf gemeinsame Ziele auch während Perioden von Mehrdeutigkeit oder Veränderung konzentriert. Darüber hinaus haben Sie folgende Qualifikationen und Erfahrungen: - Grad (B.S., M.S. oder Ph.D.) in Maschinenbau, Pharmatechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich. - 12-15+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Verfahrenstechnik oder im technischen Betrieb in regulierten Medizinprodukten oder Pharmaumgebungen. - Bewiesene Erfolgsbilanzen in der förmlichen Menschenführung und Einflussnahme auf eine weltweite Matrix. - Tiefes Know-how in der Gerätemontage, Verpackung, Sterilisation und automatisierten Fertigung von der Entwicklung bis zum kommerziellen Maßstab. - Starkes Wissen über Designsteuerungen, Risikomanagement (ISO 14971), DfM und technische Transferprozesse. - Erleben Sie die Zusammenarbeit mit globalen externen Fertigungspartnern und Lieferantennetzwerken. Contattoo Sind Sie bereit, einen Unterschied für unsere Patienten zu machen? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung – jetzt beitreten und Teil unserer Reise werden!
