descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Possibilité d'emploi Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni La fonction Global MSAT & Engineering fait l'objet d'une initiative de modernisation stratégique pour introduire des technologies de fabrication innovantes, efficaces et durables dans notre empreinte de fabrication d'appareils. En tant que chef de groupe pour l'ingénierie des procédés d'appareils, vous serez l'architecte de notre talent technique et de l'excellence des procédés. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership à double impact : vous servirez d'autorité technique supérieure pour nos programmes d'appareils les plus complexes et dirigerez un chapitre de classe mondiale des Ingénieurs de procédés, s'assurant qu'ils possèdent les compétences, les outils et les méthodologies normalisées nécessaires pour fournir aux patients du monde entier des dispositifs médicaux et des produits combinés d'appareils pharmaceutiques de nouvelle génération. Annexe - Diriger, entraîner et développer une équipe hautement performante d'ingénieurs de processus, en établissant des attentes claires en matière d'excellence technique et de capacité fonctionnelle. - Définir et piloter la stratégie globale d'ingénierie des processus pour l'assemblage, l'emballage et la stérilisation des appareils et des produits combinés tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. - Agir en tant qu'autorité technique principale pour les décisions techniques complexes, équilibrer la qualité, la conformité, l'approvisionnement et la rapidité de mise en marché. - Diriger la caractérisation structurée des processus à l'aide de DOE et d'outils statistiques pour définir les fenêtres d'exploitation et assurer la compréhension des processus. - Établir des méthodes pour identifier les paramètres critiques du processus (PPC) et les attributs matériels afin de garantir des stratégies de contrôle robustes. - Des activités de transfert de conception propres, transformant les résultats de conception en spécifications de production, besoins en équipement et instructions de travail de fabrication. - Définir et régir des stratégies de validation fondées sur le risque pour les procédés de fabrication, la qualification de l'équipement et la stérilisation. - Gérer le cadre d'ingénierie des processus pour la vérification continue des processus, le soutien aux enquêtes et l'optimisation du cycle de vie. - Veiller à ce que toutes les pratiques d'ingénierie soient conformes aux exigences réglementaires mondiales, y compris la norme FDA QMSR, ISO 13485 et la norme européenne MDR. Les Vous êtes un leader stratégique et techniquement crédible qui se déplace couramment entre la prise de décision exécutive et la résolution de problèmes en ingénierie profonde. Vous avez la capacité d'expliquer des décisions de validation complexes à divers publics, transformant les risques techniques en impacts commerciaux clairs. Vous êtes un entraîneur et développeur de talents dédié qui fixe des normes élevées pour la rigueur technique tout en donnant à votre équipe les moyens d'agir. En tant que communicateur efficace et collaborateur résilient, vous renforcez la confiance entre les organisations matricielles et demeurez concentré sur des objectifs communs, même en période d'ambiguïté ou de changement. De plus, vous avez les qualifications et expériences suivantes: - Degré (B.S., M.S. ou Ph.D.) en génie mécanique, en génie pharmaceutique ou dans un domaine technique connexe. - 12 à 15 ans d'expérience en génie des procédés ou en opérations techniques dans des environnements réglementés d'instruments médicaux ou pharmaceutiques. - Expérience éprouvée en matière de leadership formel et d'influence dans une organisation mondiale matricielle. - Une expertise approfondie dans l'assemblage, l'emballage, la stérilisation et la fabrication automatisée, du développement à l'échelle commerciale. - Bonne connaissance des contrôles de conception, de la gestion des risques (ISO 14971), du DfM et des processus de transfert technique. - Expérience de travail avec des partenaires de fabrication et des réseaux de fournisseurs extérieurs. Contatto Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! • Cooperation with distributors and other business partners.

At least 3 years’ experience as commercial roles(sales or marketing) in healthcare industry
Proficiency in both spoken and written English
Good command of MS office software application and google document, slides, sheet

jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity

Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience in the chem

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista di vendita digitale Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita Roche Digital Solutions come Digital Central Lab Consultant dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche Navify ai clienti di IHN, ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, operazioni di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente gli stakeholder di laboratorio clinici sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. Responsabilità - Genera la nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc). - Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori di livello esecutivo. - Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita. - Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni. - Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno. - Adept per tradurre le esigenze del cliente in azione interna per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave. - Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche. - Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente. - Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate. - Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business. - Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei? - Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente. - 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendita di diagnostica di laboratorio) - Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving - Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri - Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Qualifiche Preferite - Esperienza preferenziale nella chem
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Digital Sales Specialist A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams. Responsibilities
• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).
• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.
• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.
• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.
• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.
• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.
• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.
• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.
• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)
• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills
• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems
• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences Preferred Qualifications
• Preferred experience in the chem

Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Middleware, Business Intelligence Tools, etc.) und Laborinformationssysteme (LIS), um effektiv mit klinischen Labor-Stakeholdern auf maßgeschneiderte Roche-digitale Lösungen zu konsultieren und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen bereitzustellen. Chi Sei - Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (d.h. Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung. - 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d.h. Vertrieb von digitalen Gesundheitslösungen, Vertrieb von Labordiagnostik) - Muss autonom und mit effektiver Kommunikation, Verhandlungen und Problemlösung Fähigkeiten organisiert werden - Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lösungen, Labor Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus LIS-Systemen - Erfahrung mit der Präsentation technischer Informationen für große externe und interne Publikum Qualifiche Präferenz - Bevorzugte Erfahrung im Chem

Chi Sei - Baccalauréat Diplôme dans un domaine connexe (p. ex. technologie de l'information, technologie médicale, sciences de la vie) ou expérience équivalente. - 5 ans d'expérience pertinente ou équivalente (vente de solutions numériques de soins de santé, ventes de diagnostics de laboratoire) - Doit être autonome et organisé avec des compétences de communication, de négociation et de résolution de problèmes efficaces - Familiarité avec les solutions numériques, les solutions intermédiaires de laboratoire et les systèmes LIS hospitaliers - Expérience de la présentation de l'information technique à un large public externe et interne Qualifiche Preferite - Expérience préférée dans la chimie

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Work shift: M-F 2:00pm - 10:30pm

The Facilities Technician II at GenMark Diagnostics, A Member of the Roche Group, is responsible for the overall maintenance, upkeep, and cleanliness of the designated facility, preventative or otherwise. In this position, you are

• Preventative Maintenance & Operations – Perform routine maintenance on HVAC and central plant equipment, conduct daily facility tours, monitor all rooftop and building systems, and make necessary operational adjustments
• Work Request Management & Response – Handle internal customer facility work requests, respond to alarm system alerts 24/7, investigate and document process alarms, and provide on-call coverage
• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders

Who you are

• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.

• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.

• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license

Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.

• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.

• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).

• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.

• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments.

Work Environment
The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment.

While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.

Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

• Equipment & Inventory Support – Maintain spare parts inventory, manage repair parts for work requests, conduct maintenance on specialized systems (water purification, heating/cooling, humidity control, building controls), and support validation protocols
• Quality & Compliance – Ensure all duties comply with ISO, FDA, and regulatory requirements; demonstrate awareness of quality consequences and potential device defects; support Quality Management System implementation
• Coordination & Professional Development – Coordinate contractor/vendor site escorts and training, support cross-functional staff training, collaborate with technicians on daily tasks, and maintain professionalism with internal and external stakeholders Who you are
• You possess a High School Diploma, or Technical Education with 2 to 4 years of maintenance experience preferably in Biotech, cGMP, medical or health related environment or equivalent.
• You must be available to work any shift and be “on call” via pager and/or cell phone.
• You possess a clean & valid CA driver’s license Behaviors, Competencies, and Qualities of the ideal applicant.
• Proficiency with power tools and machine shop equipment, knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration systems, and plumbing; ability to read schematics and drawings.
• Experience in high-paced manufacturing environments, routine building and grounds maintenance, and familiarity with welding and precision tools (drill press, hand tools).
• Excellent understanding and application of safety procedures; knowledge of federal regulations including QSR, ISO, and ISO 13485 standards; CMDR familiarity preferred.
• Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently; basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Access, Google); excellent documentation and record-keeping abilities.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and cooperation skills; ability to work effectively with diverse teams in regulated environments. Work Environment The essential functions of the job are usually performed in an environmentally controlled facility where the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position may involve a combination of office and biotechnology laboratory environments. You may be exposed to hazardous chemicals, blood-borne, pathogens and automated equipment. While performing the job duties, you are regularly required to sit; reach with hands and arms and talk or hear. You are frequently required to stand and walk. You may sometimes be required to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting The expected salary range for this position based on California is 53,800.00 - 99,800

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Personalized Healthcare (PHC) Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable des soins de santé personnalisés

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Scope

I. Team Leadership and People Development

• Lead and Coach : Provide direct line management, coaching, mentorship, development to a team of PHC Partners, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and entrepreneurial thinking.

• Performance Management : Set clear performance objectives, conduct regular reviews, and manage the goals/sales performance of the team, ensuring goals/sales and profitability targets are met or exceeded.

• Recruitment and Onboarding : Participate in the recruitment and development of talent

II. Commercial Strategy Execution & Business Results

• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.

• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.

• Medical Value Delivery: Ensure that the team's strategies deliver demonstrable medical value of high medical value assays to healthcare systems, clinicians, and patients, enabling optimal disease management to achieve better patient outcomes.

• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.

• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance

• Distributor Management: As distributor owner, collaborate with Strategic Planning, Business and Commercial Excellence Team to drive distributor strategies which enable sales growth

III. Customer Experience Excellence

• KOL (clinicians) Engagement: Working together with Diagnostic Value Team and Medical Team, maintain a high level of market intelligence and a close liaison with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical experts in the industry to gather insights and drive changes in respective hospitals and the Taiwan healthcare ecosystem.

• Customer Advocacy: C hampion customer needs internally, ensuring seamless collaboration with Diagnostics Value (Marketing), Customer Experience Team, Global Service Team (FMI APAC and Global teams) and other functions to improve, resolve issues and enhance the end-to-end customer journey.

IV. Compliance and Integrity

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Requirements

Qualifications:

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Education:

• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred.

Working Experience:

• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.

• > 2 year

• Strategic Planning : Translate the overall business strategy into actionable, time-bound business plans and sales/account strategies for your team and territory to drive adoption of high medical value assays and utilization of hospital point-of-care solutions. Closely collaborate with Diagnostics Value Team (Marketing) and other relevant teams to define and review product marketing strategies.
• Sales/Account Strategy Execution : Oversee and drive the execution of the account strategies across the designated hospital accounts, drive cross-functional collaboration in particular with Customer Success Partners for Hospital and Lab, other field colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive execution and maximize account opportunities.

• Account and Territory Management: Manage the overall territory plan and key accounts, allocate resources effectively.
• Forecasting and Reporting: Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline visibility, and timely reporting on business performance

• A bachelor’s degree in medical/pharmaceutical/Life Sciences/marketing related field. An advanced (master’s or doctorate) degree is preferred. Working Experience:
• > 7 years of progressive experience in IHC/FMI/NGS/Oncology related field, with a proven track of driving customer centric ways of working.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

工作职责
目标管理

• 根据公司产品管线的整体策略，因地制宜地制定生态群发展目标，并负责实施计划和跟进有效性

区域合作与客户管理

• 与客户及合作伙伴建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 发展管理区域生态圈合作伙伴，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作保证区域内治疗药物的可及性

• 对接支持部门，建立沟通机制，确保生态圈内外部信息一致统一

团队管理

• 管理生态圈管理委员会，进行人员及业务管理，并率领团队制定并执行相应计划

• 通过识别正确的思维，能力和背景，吸引和选拔一支高效和多样化的团队

• 辅导和发展员工，打造团队的人才梯队

• 打造一个绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，以实现公司愿景和创新的工作模式

财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源以实现生态群目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训、以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

自我管理

• 积极的进行领导技能的学习，以身作则执行公司各项规章制度，进行有效的团队管理

• 践行公司价值观，展现专业素养

能力要求

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质。（思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维。领导力特质：系统思维，成长思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养。）

• 业务规划能力，高效整合资源能力

• 良好的沟通能力

• 10 年以上销售，市场，医学或准入工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 跨地区/跨部门/多产品管理的工作经验优先

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready product backl

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics e la prova clinica Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Il Principal Business Analyst è un ruolo senior, ad alto impatto che siede al crocevia della scienza clinica, della strategia del prodotto e della consegna della tecnologia. Mentre si posiziona come Business Analyst, questo ruolo opera con l'ampiezza, la profondità e l'influenza strategica di un analista esperto che possiede la visione, l'innovazione pipeline, e la consegna caratteristica dello Studio Designer, un prodotto di punta che consente ai team di prova clinici di progettare studi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci. Questo individuo porta una rara combinazione di profonda credibilità scientifica, leadership di prodotto e fluidità tecnica - in grado di guadagnare la fiducia degli scienziati clinici in un incontro e di guidare uno sprint di ingegneria nel prossimo. • Collaborazione clinica e scientifica: agire come collegamento primario tra team clinici/scientifici e ingegneria dei prodotti, costruire relazioni a lungo termine e facilitare i laboratori di scoperta con esperti medici per comprendere profondamente il design di prova e rappresentare la voce dell'utente clinico.
• Innovazione di funzionalità del prodotto: Definire e possedere la roadmap caratteristica bilanciando le esigenze aziendali, scientifiche e tecniche; promuovere l'innovazione attraverso progetti di pensiero di progettazione per identificare nuove opportunità, creare casi aziendali convincenti, e tracciare metriche di successo / KPI post-release. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Summary: The Senior Product Managerfor New Product Launch acts as the "strategic architect" and "commercial driver" for upcoming innovative drugs, new indications, or core medical devices in the pipeline. This role is responsible for defining the product’s core value proposition, developing the cross-functional Go-to-Market strategy, building strong scientific advocacy among Top KOLs, and empowering the field force. The ultimate goal is to ensure a compliant, high-impact, and commercially successful market entry and accelerated post-launch uptake.

1. Pre-Launch Market Insight & Strategic Positioning

• Clinical & Unmet Need Assessment: Conduct deep dives into medical literature, clinical trial data, and treatment guidelines to identify target patient profiles and critical unmet medical needs.

• Core Value Proposition : Translate complex clinical and evidence-based medical data into compelling, differentiated, and compliant brand stories and product positioning.

• Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitors’ clinical pipelines, pricing structures, and marketing activities to develop effective defense and counter-attack strategies.
2. Go-to-Market & Access Strategy Development

• Brand Plan Ownership: Design and execute the 1-to-3-year strategic and tactical Brand Plans for the product launch, effectively allocating the Marketing Budget to maximize ROI.

• Cross-Functional Synergy: * Partner with the Medical Affairs team to align on post-launch evidence generation, Investigator-Initiated Trials, or Real-World Studies.Collaborate with the Market Access team to provide pharmacoeconomic data supporting National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) negotiation and provincial bidding.

• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM): Develop and implement a digital/omnichannel engagement strategy tailored to Healthcare Professionals to expand brand share-of-voice .
3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy

• KOL Network Building: Establish and maintain robust academic relationships with national and regional Key Opinion Leaders , medical associations, and guideline committee members.

• High-Impact Academic Events: Plan and lead nationwide launch events, standalone symposia, advisory boards, and satellite meetings to establish scientific credibility.

• Compliance Management: Ensure all marketing materials (Detailing Aids, Slides, Patient brochures) and events strictly adhere to industry compliance standards (e.g., RDPAC guidelines), local Advertising Laws, and internal policies.
4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking

• Launch Toolkits Generation: Create high-quality, scientifically sound marketing toolkits, detailing flows, objection handling guides, and FAQs for the field force.

• Field Force Training: Lead product strategy and message training for the sales team (VFE, Regional Managers, Medical Representatives) to ensure message consistency and executional excellence.

• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: Track and analyze key launch metrics (e.g., hospital listing rate, target physician penetration, prescription conversion, and market share). Dynamically adjust tactics based on market feedback.
【Job Requirements】

• Education background: * Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Pharmacy, Biology, Life Sciences, or a related field (Master’s, Ph.D., or MBA is highly preferred). A strong scientific background is critical to understanding clinical data.

• Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years of marketing experience in the pharmaceutical/biote

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sintesi della posizione: Il Senior Product Manager for New Product Launch agisce come "architetto strategico" e "pilota commerciale" per i prossimi farmaci innovativi, nuove indicazioni, o dispositivi medici core nella pipeline. Questo ruolo è responsabile della definizione della proposizione di valore centrale del prodotto, sviluppando la strategia di Go-to-Market cross-funzionale, costruendo una forte advocacy scientifica tra i Top KOL e potenziando la forza di campo. L'obiettivo finale è quello di garantire una voce di mercato conforme, ad alto impatto e commercialmente di successo e un'accelerazione post-lancio. 1. Pre-Launch Market Insight & Strategic Positioning
• Valutazione dei bisogni clinici e non metri: condurre immersioni profonde nella letteratura medica, i dati di prova clinica e le linee guida del trattamento per identificare i profili dei pazienti target e le esigenze mediche non metriche critiche.
• Proposizione del valore di base: Tradurre dati medici clinici e basati sulle prove complessi in storie di marca e posizionamento convincenti, differenziati e conformi.
• Intelligenza Competitiva: Monitorare le condotte cliniche dei concorrenti, le strutture dei prezzi e le attività di marketing per sviluppare strategie efficaci di difesa e contrattacco. 2. Go-to-Market & Access Strategy Development
• Brand Plan Ownership: Progettare ed eseguire i Brand Plan strategici e tattici da 1 a 3 anni per il lancio del prodotto, allocando efficacemente il budget di marketing per massimizzare il ROI.
• Synergy cross-Functional: * Partner con il team di Medical Affairs per allineare sulla generazione di prove post-lancio, prove avviate da investitori o studi reali. Collabora con il team Market Access per fornire dati farmacoeconomici che supportano la negoziazione della National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) e le offerte provinciali.
• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM): Sviluppare e implementare una strategia di fidanzamento digitale/omnichannel su misura per i professionisti sanitari per espandere la condivisione del marchio di fattura . 3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy
• KOL Network Building: Stabilire e mantenere robuste relazioni accademiche con i leader nazionali e regionali delle opinioni chiave, associazioni mediche e membri del comitato di orientamento.
• Eventi Accademici di alto impatto: pianificare e condurre eventi di lancio a livello nazionale, simposi standalone, consiglieri e riunioni satellitari per stabilire credibilità scientifica.
• Gestione della conformità: Assicurare tutti i materiali di marketing (Aiuti dettaglianti, Scivoli, opuscoli dei pazienti) e gli eventi aderiscono rigorosamente agli standard di conformità del settore (ad esempio, linee guida RDPAC), leggi pubblicitarie locali e politiche interne. 4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking
• Avviare Toolkits Generazione: creare strumenti di marketing di alta qualità, scientificamente sano, dettaglianti flussi, guide di gestione delle obiezioni e FAQ per la forza di campo.
• Field Force Training: Guidare la strategia dei prodotti e la formazione dei messaggi per il team di vendita (VFE, Regional Managers, Medical Representatives) per garantire la coerenza dei messaggi e l'eccellenza esecutiva.
• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: Traccia e analizza le metriche di lancio chiave (ad esempio, il tasso di elenco ospedaliero, la penetrazione del medico di destinazione, la conversione della prescrizione e la quota di mercato). Regolare dinamicamente le tattiche in base al feedback di mercato. 【 Requisiti di lavoro
• Sfondo educativo: * Laurea di laurea o superiore in medicina clinica, farmacia, biologia, scienze della vita, o un campo correlato (Master’s, Ph.D., o MBA è altamente preferito). Un forte background scientifico è fondamentale per comprendere i dati clinici.
• Esperienza di lavoro: minimo 5 anni di esperienza di marketing nel farmaceutico/bioto

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Senior Product Manager für New Product Launch fungiert als "strategischer Architekt" und "kommerzieller Treiber" für kommende innovative Medikamente, neue Indikationen oder medizinische Kerngeräte in der Pipeline. Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Definition des Kernwertversprechens des Produkts, die Entwicklung der funktionsübergreifenden Go-to-Market-Strategie, den Aufbau einer starken wissenschaftlichen Interessenvertretung unter den Top-KOLs und die Stärkung der Feldkräfte. Das ultimative Ziel ist es, einen konformen, wirkungsvollen und kommerziell erfolgreichen Markteintritt und eine beschleunigte Markteinführung nach dem Start sicherzustellen. 1. Pre-Launch Market Insight und strategische Positionierung Klinische und unerfüllte Bedarfsanalyse: Führen Sie tief in medizinische Literatur, klinische Studiendaten und Behandlungsrichtlinien ein, um Zielpatientenprofile und kritische unerfüllte medizinische Bedürfnisse zu identifizieren. Core Value Proposition: Übersetzen Sie komplexe klinische und evidenzbasierte medizinische Daten in überzeugende, differenzierte und konforme Markengeschichten und Produktpositionierung.
• Competitive Intelligence: Überwachen Sie die klinischen Pipelines, Preisstrukturen und Marketingaktivitäten der Wettbewerber, um effektive Verteidigungs- und Gegenangriffsstrategien zu entwickeln. 2. Entwicklung einer Markt- und Zugangsstrategie Brand Plan Ownership: Entwerfen und Ausführen der 1- bis 3-jährigen strategischen und taktischen Markenpläne für die Produkteinführung, wobei das Marketingbudget effektiv zugewiesen wird, um den ROI zu maximieren.
• Funktionale Synergie: * Partnerschaft mit dem Medical Affairs-Team, um die Generierung von Evidenz nach dem Start, von Forschern initiierte Studien oder Real-World-Studien abzustimmen. Arbeiten Sie mit dem Market Access-Team zusammen, um pharmakoökonomische Daten zur Verfügung zu stellen, die die Verhandlungen mit der National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) und die Ausschreibungen der Provinzen unterstützen. Omnichannel-Marketing (OCM): Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer digitalen/Omnichannel-Engagement-Strategie, die auf Healthcare Professionals zugeschnitten ist, um den Stimmenanteil der Marke zu erweitern. 3. KOL Engagement & Academic Advocacy
• KOL Network Building: Aufbau und Pflege solider akademischer Beziehungen zu nationalen und regionalen Key Opinion Leaders, medizinischen Verbänden und Mitgliedern des Richtlinienausschusses. High-Impact Academic Events: Planen und leiten Sie landesweite Startveranstaltungen, eigenständige Symposien, Beiräte und Satellitentreffen, um wissenschaftliche Glaubwürdigkeit zu etablieren.
• Compliance Management: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Marketingmaterialien (Detailing Aids, Slides, Patientenbroschüren) und Veranstaltungen strikt den Industrie-Compliance-Standards (z. B. RDPAC-Richtlinien), lokalen Werbegesetzen und internen Richtlinien entsprechen. 4. Sales Enablement & Launch Performance Tracking
• Launch Toolkits Generation: Erstellen Sie qualitativ hochwertige, wissenschaftlich fundierte Marketing-Toolkits, Detaillierung von Flüssen, Anleitungen zur Bearbeitung von Einwänden und FAQs für die Feldkräfte.
• Field Force Training: Führen Sie Produktstrategie- und Botschaftstraining für das Verkaufsteam (VFE, Regionalmanager, medizinische Vertreter), um die Konsistenz der Botschaft und die Exzellenz der Ausführung zu gewährleisten.
• KPI-Tracking & Kurskorrektur: Verfolgen und analysieren Sie wichtige Einführungsmetriken (z. B. Krankenhausauflistungsrate, Zielarztdurchdringung, Rezeptumwandlung und Marktanteil). Dynamische Anpassung der Taktik basierend auf Marktfeedback. 【Arbeitsanforderungen】
• Bildungshintergrund: * Bachelor-Abschluss oder höher in klinischer Medizin, Pharmazie, Biologie, Life Sciences oder einem verwandten Bereich (Master, Ph.D. oder MBA ist sehr bevorzugt). Ein starker wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund ist entscheidend für das Verständnis klinischer Daten.
• Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Marketingerfahrung im Pharma- / Biot
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Sommaire du poste : Le gestionnaire principal du produit pour le lancement d'un nouveau produit agit en tant qu'« architecte stratégique » et « pilote commercial » pour les médicaments innovateurs, les nouvelles indications ou les dispositifs médicaux de base à venir dans le pipeline. Ce rôle est responsable de la définition de la proposition de valeur de base du produit, de l'élaboration de la stratégie interfonctionnelle Go-to-Market, de la mise en place d'un plaidoyer scientifique fort parmi les meilleurs KOL et de l'autonomisation de la force sur le terrain. L'objectif ultime est d'assurer une entrée sur le marché conforme, à fort impact et commercialement réussie et une adoption accélérée après le lancement. 1. Aperçu du marché et positionnement stratégique avant le lancement
• Évaluation des besoins cliniques et non satisfaits: Mener des plongées profondes dans la littérature médicale, les données d'essais cliniques et les lignes directrices de traitement pour identifier les profils de patients cibles et les besoins médicaux non satisfaits critiques.
• Proposition de valeur fondamentale : Traduire des données médicales cliniques et factuelles complexes en histoires de marque et en positionnement de produits convaincants, différenciés et conformes.
• Intelligence compétitive: Surveiller les concurrents en ce qui concerne les pipelines cliniques, les structures de tarification et les activités de marketing afin de développer des stratégies de défense et de contre-attaque efficaces. 2. Élaboration d'une stratégie de mise en marché et d'accès
• Propriété du plan de marque: Concevoir et exécuter les plans stratégiques et tactiques de 1 à 3 ans pour le lancement du produit, en allouant efficacement le budget de marketing pour maximiser le rendement.
• Synergie interfonctionnelle : * Partenaire avec l'équipe des affaires médicales pour s'aligner sur la génération de preuves après le lancement, les essais initiés par l'enquêteur ou les études du monde réel. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'accès aux marchés afin de fournir des données pharmacoéconomiques à l'appui des négociations sur la Liste nationale des médicaments à remboursement (LMNR) et des soumissions provinciales.
• Omnichannel Marketing (OCM) : Développer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie d'engagement numérique/omnichannel adaptée aux professionnels de la santé pour élargir le partage de la voix de marque. 3. Engagement du KOL et défense des intérêts universitaires
• KOL Network Building: établir et maintenir des relations académiques solides avec les chefs d'opinion clés nationaux et régionaux, les associations médicales et les membres du comité directeur.
• Manifestations académiques de haut niveau : planifier et diriger des manifestations à l'échelle nationale, des colloques autonomes, des conseils consultatifs et des réunions par satellite pour établir la crédibilité scientifique.
• Gestion de la conformité : Veiller à ce que tous les documents de marketing (aide détaillée, diapositives, brochures sur les patients) et les événements respectent strictement les normes de conformité de l'industrie (p. ex., lignes directrices de RDPAC), les lois locales sur la publicité et les politiques internes. 4. Suivi des performances d'activation et de lancement des ventes
• Launch Toolkits Generation: Créez des outils marketing de haute qualité, scientifiquement solides, détaillant les flux, des guides de manipulation des objections et des FAQ pour la force sur le terrain.
• Formation de la Force sur le terrain : la stratégie du produit et la formation du message pour l'équipe de vente (VFE, gestionnaires régionaux, représentants médicaux) afin d'assurer la cohérence des messages et l'excellence de l'exécution.
• KPI Tracking & Course Correction: suivre et analyser les paramètres clés de lancement (p. ex. taux d'inscription à l'hôpital, pénétration des médecins cibles, conversion des ordonnances et part de marché). Régler dynamiquement les tactiques en fonction de la rétroaction du marché. Exigences en matière d'emploi
• Études : * Baccalauréat en médecine clinique, en pharmacie, en biologie, en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe (Master, Ph.D. ou MBA est très préféré). Une solide expérience scientifique est essentielle pour comprendre les données cliniques.
• Expérience professionnelle: minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en marketing dans le domaine pharmaceutique/biote

jobs.title: Medical Enabler, APAC Rare Diseases
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Pharmaceutical

At Roche, we are driven by an urgent commitment to delivering medical solutions today while innovating for tomorrow. Our bold new A2 operating model leverages collective capabilities across the enterprise to create rapid, impactful solutions for patients globally. We believe in personalized, sustainable healthcare and are uniquely positioned to integrate pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, digital health, and big data.

We are seeking a passionate Medical Enabler to join our dynamic APAC Rare Diseases team. This permanent, full-time role is an above-country pooled resource position, requiring an 80-100% FTE above country commitment within our network .

Ideally, we are seeking someone who has extensive experience working healthcare systems across Asia and will be located in Hong Kong or Taiwan, however this role offers a thrilling opportunity to focus on cross-border work packages and enablement, collaborating across various regional and Global networks to drive meaningful change.

What You'll be working on:
As a Medical Enabler, (APAC) Rare Diseases, you will:

• Provide strategic input and operational support for late-stage development/near-launch therapies in Rare Diseases.

• Act as a scientific expert for our medicines and solutions throughout their product life cycles.

• Work in virtual, cross-border, cross-functional teams to realize and scale country, regional and Global outcomes.

• Foster meaningful scientific collaborations and value-based partnerships with Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), healthcare professionals, patient organizations across multiple healthcare systems.

• Contribute to understanding data gaps and support data generation plans (e.g., Phase IV studies, registries).

• Build high-value continuing medical education programs for external stakeholders.

• Provide strategic medical review and approval for materials and communications.

• ​Liaise closely with global medical colleagues and teams to ensure coordination and consistency to our data dissemination

Who you are:
You are a passionate Medical Affairs professional ready to make a significant impact on Rare Disease health across Asia. As a subject matter expert with the potential for future leadership roles you have an entrepreneurial spirit, identify opportunities, are comfortable with ambiguity and challenge the status quo.

You have:

• Relevant experience in a Medical Affairs role within Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Health Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields.

• Experience of working in Rare Diseases would be very desirable.

• Strong data comprehension, critical appraisal, synthesis, and delivery skills.

• A "System Thinker" mindset, able to build strong internal/external collaborations to drive change.

• Customer-Centric approach, co-creating solutions to address needs and transform clinical practice.

• A culture of humanity, curiosity, and responsibility, thriving in an empowered, dynamic, and agile working environment.

• Proven track record of building, leading, and contributing to high-performing, diverse, agile / matrix teams.

• MD degree; PhD or Bachelor’s degree in science, biology, immunology, neuroscience, or equivalent preferred. Clinical experience in Rare Diseases is a plus.

This is an incredible development opportunity to apply your scientific expertise, collaborate with colleagues and customers from across the globe, and contribute to innovation that will impact families living with rare diseases across Asia and beyond.

Where

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Pharmaceutical A Roche, siamo guidati da un impegno urgente per fornire soluzioni mediche oggi mentre innovare per domani. Il nostro nuovo modello operativo A2 sfrutta le capacità collettive di tutta l'azienda per creare soluzioni rapide e impattanti per i pazienti a livello globale. Crediamo nella salute personalizzata e sostenibile e siamo in posizione unica per integrare prodotti farmaceutici, diagnostica, salute digitale e grandi dati. Siamo alla ricerca di un appassionato medico Enabler per unirsi al nostro team dinamico APAC Malattie Rare. Questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno è una posizione di risorse in pool sopra il paese, che richiede un 80-100% FTE sopra l'impegno del paese all'interno della nostra rete. Idealmente, stiamo cercando qualcuno che ha una vasta esperienza di sistemi sanitari di lavoro in tutta l'Asia e si trova a Hong Kong o Taiwan, tuttavia questo ruolo offre un'emozionante opportunità di concentrarsi su pacchetti di lavoro transfrontalieri e di abilitazione, collaborando attraverso varie reti regionali e globali per guidare cambiamenti significativi. Su cosa lavorerai: Come ambulante medico, (APAC) Malattie Rare, si:
• Fornire input strategici e supporto operativo per lo sviluppo del tardo stadio / terapie a distanza in Malattie Rare.
• Agire come esperto scientifico per le nostre medicine e soluzioni durante i loro cicli di vita del prodotto.
• Lavorare in team virtuali, transfrontalieri, interfunzionali per realizzare e scalare i risultati del paese, regionale e globale.
• Promuovere collaborazioni scientifiche significative e partnership basate sul valore con Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), professionisti sanitari, organizzazioni dei pazienti attraverso sistemi sanitari multipli.
• Contribuire alla comprensione delle lacune dei dati e sostenere i piani di generazione dei dati (ad esempio, studi di fase IV, registri).
• Costruire programmi di istruzione medica continua ad alto valore per gli stakeholder esterni.
• Fornire una rassegna medica strategica e l'approvazione per materiali e comunicazioni.
• Liaise a stretto contatto con colleghi e team medici globali per garantire il coordinamento e la coerenza alla diffusione dei dati Chi sei: Sei un appassionato professionista medico pronto a fare un impatto significativo sulla salute delle malattie rare in tutta l'Asia. Come esperto di materia con il potenziale per i ruoli di leadership futuri avete uno spirito imprenditoriale, identificare le opportunità, sono confortevoli con ambiguità e sfidare lo status quo. Hai...
• Esperienza rilevante in un ruolo di Affari medici all'interno di settori farmaceutici, diagnostici, scienze della salute, biotecnologie o correlati.
• L'esperienza di lavorare nelle malattie rare sarebbe molto auspicabile.
• Forte comprensione dei dati, valutazione critica, sintesi e capacità di consegna.
• Una mentalità "System Thinker", in grado di costruire forti collaborazioni interne/esterne per guidare il cambiamento.
• approccio Customer-Centric, soluzioni di co-creazione per soddisfare le esigenze e trasformare la pratica clinica.
• Una cultura dell'umanità, della curiosità e della responsabilità, che prospera in un ambiente di lavoro potenziato, dinamico e agile.
• Provato track record di costruzione, leader, e contribuendo a team di alta qualità, diversi, agili / matrice.
• Laurea in scienze, biologia, immunologia, neuroscienze, o equivalente preferito. L'esperienza clinica nelle malattie rare è un vantaggio. Questa è un'incredibile opportunità di sviluppo per applicare le tue competenze scientifiche, collaborare con colleghi e clienti da tutto il mondo, e contribuire all'innovazione che influenzerà le famiglie che vivono con malattie rare in tutta l'Asia e oltre. Dove

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Roche Pharma Bei Roche sind wir von einer dringenden Verpflichtung, heute medizinische Lösungen zu liefern, während wir für morgen innovieren. Unser mutiges neues A2-Betriebsmodell nutzt die kollektiven Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen, um schnelle, schlagkräftige Lösungen für Patienten weltweit zu schaffen. Wir glauben an personalisierte, nachhaltige Gesundheitsversorgung und sind einzigartig positioniert, um Pharmazeutika, Diagnostik, digitale Gesundheit und Big Data zu integrieren. Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen Medical Enabler, um unserem dynamischen APAC Rare Diseases Team beizutreten. Diese dauerhafte, Vollzeit-Rolle ist eine über-Lande-Pool-Ressource-Position, die eine 80-100% FTE über Land Engagement in unserem Netzwerk erfordert. Idealerweise suchen wir jemanden, der über langjährige Erfahrung in der Arbeitsmedizin in ganz Asien verfügt und sich in Hongkong oder Taiwan befindet, aber diese Rolle bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit, sich auf grenzüberschreitende Arbeitspakete und -ermöglichung zu konzentrieren, die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen regionalen und globalen Netzwerken, um einen sinnvollen Wandel zu fördern. An was du arbeitest: Als medizinischer Enabler (APAC) Seltene Krankheiten, werden Sie:
• Strategische Input- und operative Unterstützung für späteste Entwicklungs-/Near-Launch-Therapien in seltenen Krankheiten.
• Handeln Sie als wissenschaftlicher Experte für unsere Medikamente und Lösungen während ihrer gesamten Produktlebenszyklen.
• Arbeiten in virtuellen, grenzüberschreitenden, grenzübergreifenden Teams, um Länder, regionale und globale Ergebnisse zu realisieren und zu skalieren.
• Foster aussagekräftige wissenschaftliche Kooperationen und wertbasierte Partnerschaften mit Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs), Gesundheitsexperten, Patientenorganisationen in verschiedenen Gesundheitssystemen.
• Um Datenlücken zu verstehen und Datengenerierungspläne zu unterstützen (z.B. Phase IV-Studien, Register).
• Aufbau hochwertiger Weiterbildungsprogramme für externe Akteure.
• Strategische medizinische Überprüfung und Genehmigung für Materialien und Kommunikation.
• Liaise eng mit globalen medizinischen Kollegen und Teams zusammen, um die Koordination und Konsistenz unserer Datenverbreitung zu gewährleisten Wer du bist: Sie sind ein leidenschaftlicher Arzt, der bereit ist, einen erheblichen Einfluss auf die Gesundheit von seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien zu machen. Als Thema Experte mit dem Potenzial für zukünftige Führungsrollen haben Sie einen Unternehmergeist, identifizieren Chancen, sind komfortabel mit Mehrdeutigkeit und fordern den Status quo. Sie haben:
• Relevante Erfahrung in einer medizinischen Rolle in der Pharma-, Diagnostik-, Gesundheits-, Biotechnologie- oder verwandten Bereichen.
• Die Erfahrung der Arbeit in seltenen Krankheiten wäre sehr wünschenswert.
• Starkes Datenverständnis, kritische Beurteilungs-, Synthese- und Lieferfähigkeiten.
• Ein "System Thinker" Mindset, in der Lage, starke interne/externe Kollaborationen zu bauen, um Veränderungen voranzutreiben.
• Customer-Centric-Ansatz, Co-Creating-Lösungen, um Bedürfnisse zu lösen und klinische Praxis zu transformieren.
• Eine Kultur der Menschlichkeit, Neugier und Verantwortung, die in einem bestärkten, dynamischen und agilen Arbeitsumfeld blüht.
• Bewährte Erfolgsbilanz von Gebäuden, Führungen und Beiträgen zu hochperformierenden, vielfältigen, agilen / Matrix-Teams.
• MD-Abschluss; PhD oder Bachelor-Abschluss in Wissenschaft, Biologie, Immunologie, Neurowissenschaften oder gleichwertig bevorzugt. Klinische Erfahrung in seltenen Krankheiten ist ein Plus. Dies ist eine unglaubliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeit, um Ihr wissenschaftliches Know-how anzuwenden, mit Kollegen und Kunden aus aller Welt zusammenzuarbeiten und zu Innovationen beizutragen, die Familien mit seltenen Krankheiten in ganz Asien und darüber hinaus beeinflussen. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Pharmaceutique Chez Roche, nous sommes animés par un engagement urgent à fournir des solutions médicales aujourd'hui tout en innovant pour demain. Notre nouveau modèle d'exploitation A2 audacieux met à profit les capacités collectives de l'entreprise pour créer des solutions rapides et efficaces pour les patients à l'échelle mondiale. Nous croyons en des soins de santé personnalisés et durables et sommes particulièrement bien placés pour intégrer les produits pharmaceutiques, les diagnostics, la santé numérique et les mégadonnées. Nous cherchons un activateur médical passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique APAC maladies rares. Ce rôle permanent à temps plein est un poste de ressource commun au-dessus du pays, exigeant un engagement de 80 à 100% ETP au-dessus du pays au sein de notre réseau. Idéalement, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui possède une vaste expérience des systèmes de soins de santé en Asie et qui sera situé à Hong Kong ou à Taïwan, mais ce rôle offre une occasion passionnante de se concentrer sur les paquets de travail transfrontaliers et de permettre, en collaborant à travers divers réseaux régionaux et mondiaux pour conduire un changement significatif. Vous allez travailler sur : En tant que catalyseur médical des maladies rares (PACA), vous :
• Apporter une contribution stratégique et un soutien opérationnel aux thérapies de développement et de lancement précoce des maladies rares.
• Agir en tant qu'expert scientifique pour nos médicaments et solutions tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Travailler dans des équipes virtuelles, transfrontalières et transfonctionnelles afin de réaliser et d'élargir les résultats nationaux, régionaux et mondiaux.
• Favoriser des collaborations scientifiques significatives et des partenariats fondés sur la valeur avec des experts des domaines thérapeutiques, des professionnels de la santé, des organisations de patients dans plusieurs systèmes de santé.
• Contribuer à la compréhension des lacunes dans les données et appuyer les plans de production de données (par exemple, études de phase IV, registres).
• Élaborer des programmes de formation médicale continue de grande valeur à l'intention des intervenants externes.
• Fournir un examen médical stratégique et l'approbation des documents et des communications.
• Assurer une liaison étroite avec les équipes et collègues médicaux mondiaux pour assurer la coordination et la cohérence de notre diffusion des données Qui vous êtes : Vous êtes un professionnel passionné des affaires médicales prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur la santé des maladies rares en Asie. En tant qu'expert en matière de leadership potentiel, vous avez un esprit d'entreprise, identifiez les possibilités, êtes à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et contestez le statu quo. Vous avez :
• Expérience pertinente dans le domaine des affaires médicales dans le domaine des produits pharmaceutiques, des diagnostics, des sciences de la santé, de la biotechnologie ou dans des domaines connexes.
• L'expérience du travail dans les maladies rares serait très souhaitable.
• Une bonne compréhension des données, une évaluation critique, une synthèse et des compétences d'exécution.
• Un état d'esprit "System Thinker", capable de construire de solides collaborations internes/externes pour stimuler le changement.
• Approche client-centre, co-créant des solutions pour répondre aux besoins et transformer la pratique clinique.
• Une culture de l'humanité, de la curiosité et de la responsabilité, prospère dans un environnement de travail dynamique, dynamique et agile.
• Expérience éprouvée de la construction, de la direction et de la contribution à des équipes de haute performance, diversifiées, agiles et matricielles.
• Diplôme MD; doctorat ou baccalauréat en sciences, biologie, immunologie, neurosciences ou équivalent préféré. L'expérience clinique dans les maladies rares est un plus. C'est une occasion incroyable de développer votre expertise scientifique, de collaborer avec des collègues et des clients du monde entier et de contribuer à l'innovation qui touchera les familles vivant avec des maladies rares en Asie et au-delà. Où
