jobs.title: Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

titleByLocale.it: Gestione dei programmi strategici (Programmi di potenziamento degli appalti)
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des programmes stratégiques (Programmes d'amélioration des achats)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs)

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity:

This role sits within the Strategic Programs Execution team in the Strategy and Solutions Chapter. Our purpose is to guide strategic priorities, advance value delivery through solutions and digital excellence, govern compliance and drive sustainability to deliver continuous improvement and strengthen Global Procurement’s impact on the wider Roche organization. The Strategic Programs Execution team is dedicated to driving complex procurement-led programs that deliver high impact benefits for Roche and result in a step change in how we work with suppliers, use technology, partner with the business or collaborate with each other in Procurement.

As a Strategic Programs Manager (Procurement Enhancement Programs), you will work in partnership with teams from Global Procurement and other Roche functions to accelerate and enhance the delivery of GP led strategic programs. You will have a strong focus on Procurement Enhancement Programs, with the aim to enhance the overall level of effectiveness, efficiency and customer experience of Global Procurement.

• You utilise your expertise and in-depth knowledge in project management methodologies to lead and facilitate the execution of strategic procurement-led programs, focusing on transformative initiatives such as Operating Model Design and Implementation, Technology Deployment and Adoption, and Procurement Strategy Realization.

• You work closely with procurement, business stakeholders, and other relevant colleagues in a matrix setup either as a peer, coach, project / workstream lead, or subject matter lead, to align on needs, create the business case for change, prioritize, execute, and realize project goals.

• You develop change management strategies and integrate change management activities in project execution to drive transformational changes in the organisation. You manage the people-side of the change to drive behavioral changes and adoption.

• You contribute to the further development of project management and change management capabilities in the team, advocate and accelerate the advancement of best practices methodologies.

• You act as a practitioner and catalyst, applying GP’s core procurement capabilities and approaches in the programs you work on, and contribute to continuous enhancement of procurement excellence.

• You act as a role model, demonstrating curiosity, passion, an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree, preferably in business, engineering or technology.

• You have 5+ years procurement, project management, or management consulting experience, ideally within a matrix o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a team member of Roche Services (Europe) Ltd. Site Services Department, the Procurement & Car Fleet Management Intern is responsible for:

• Supporting the work of the Strategic Procurement Partner and the Office Executives in administration regarding Procurement tasks and Car Fleet Management.

Responsibilities
Car fleet:

• Managing administrative duties including: monitoring car fleet contract start/end dates, highway tickets, penalties etc.

• Keeping contact with the Leasing companies and following up the incoming messages.

• Informing the employees about the car policy and assisting them with any car fleet related questions.

• Managing and updating the database containing comprehensive car fleet details.

• Supporting the car handover process and performing regular car condition checks.

• Assisting with the request, distribution, and record-keeping of fuel cards and motorway vignettes.

• Supporting the team with ad-hoc projects and tasks as needed.

• Supporting system related activities in MyBuy, eg.: PO creation, reports.

Procurement:

• Supporting the Strategic Procurement Partner providing administrative assistance during the bidding process and organizing tender documentation.

• Analyzing supplier offers and maintaining data accuracy to support decision-making.

• Creating Purchase Orders (POs) and ensuring all transaction details are correct.

• Following up on orders and deliveries with vendors.

• Partnering with various departments to ensure their procurement needs are met efficiently and Ensuring all activities and documentation align with the official Procurement Policy.

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

What you can bring to our team

• Fluency in English & Hungarian

• You are currently studying in Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule

• You are available to work 20-30 hours on a weekly basis

• B category driving license with active driving experience

• Stakeholder management skills, ability to multi-task

• Strong service orientation and communication skills

• Precise, focused, accountable way of working, high level of organizational and problem solving skills

• Proactive mindset

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Team player attitude, accuracy, ability to meet deadlines and set the right priorities

• Ability to adapt changes quickly

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Graphic Design Intern assists in creating visually compelling designs while gaining hands-on experience in a professional design environment. Working closely with senior designers and team members, they contribute to various creative projects across print, digital, and social media platforms.

In this role, the intern supports the team to design scalable Showpad pages, build automated template workflows, explore new Ai key features, and enforce governance across global Roche design assets. This role ensures 100% compatibility with Figma/Illustrator. They have the opportunity to enhance their creative skills, and learn how to create lovable marketing assets for customers using ABX approach.
This internship is ideal for students or recent graduates looking to build their portfolio, work on real-world projects, and collaborate within a dynamic design team.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

• Vector-First Production: Design, build, and migrate Showpad pages and UI assets strictly within Figma and Illustrator, ensuring all global assets are lightweight, editable, and scalable.

• Template Engineering: Turn standard layouts into robust, modular Figma components and design systems so that "simple design tasks" can be executed instantly or self-sourced by affiliates.

• Asset Optimization: Ensure all imagery and graphics comply with Roche UI guidelines

• Assist in designing marketing materials such as brochures, social media graphics, presentations, banners, and other visual assets.

• Support the team in maintaining brand consistency across all design outputs.

• Work closely with senior designers and other team members to understand project requirements and deliver creative solutions.

• Edit and refine design elements based on feedback and brand guidelines.

• Explore AI page creation and section templates in Showpad to scale approach

• Develop a strong understanding of the organization's brand identity and apply it consistently across all design projects.

• Actively participate in design critiques, team meetings, and professional development opportunities to continuously improve skills and knowledge.

• Adapt to changing priorities and work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Who you are

You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You love to stay abreast of the latest digital updates in order to provide partners with cutting-edge design capabilities, being fully aware of the most current design trends.

Further requirements

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field at a Hungarian University.

• You are available to work 30 hours on a weekly basis

• Proficient in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).

• Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design.

• A keen eye for detail and a passion for creative storytelling through design.

• Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Strong communication skills and openness to receiving feedback.

• Basic knowledge of digital design principles for web and social media is a plus.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Internship in protein chemistry: Novel antibody-based formats for in-vitro diagnostics (m/f/d)

Suchst Du ein Praktikum, in dem Du dich sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir suchen jemanden, der uns bei unseren vielfältigen Aufgaben unterstützt. Dies gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die verschiedenen Einheiten innerhalb unserer Abteilung kennenzulernen und einen Überblick über die unterschiedlichen Aktivitäten zu gewinnen.

Die Abteilung

Sie werden in der Abteilung „Proteinchemie“ arbeiten, die zur Einheit „Reagent Research and Design“ von Roche Centralized and Point of Care Solutions gehört und sich auf die Entwicklung von protein basierten Reagenzien für immunologische Diagnostik Tests konzentriert.
Hier entwickeln, realisieren und bewerten wir innovative Lösungen für Diagnostik Systemkonzepte basierend auf dem Roche Cobas e-Analyzer zur zielgerichteten und hochsensitiven Quantifizierung von menschlichen Körperflüssigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie werden aktiv an Forschungsprojekten teilnehmen, um die Entwicklung von Antikörper basierten Reagenzien für aktuelle und zukünftige Technologien zu optimieren.

• Sie werden verschiedene Techniken zur Antikörperreinigung durchführen.

• Sie werden Antikörper mit sowohl ortsspezifischen als auch unspezifischen Markierungsstrategien konjugieren und anschließend reinigen.

• Sie werden die Leistungsfähigkeit dieser Reagenzien auf Cobas e-Analyzer evaluieren.

• Sie werden wissenschaftliche Literatur überprüfen und bewerten und Ihre Ergebnisse präsentieren.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit mehreren Teams zusammen, die über verschiedene Abteilungen verteilt sind (Chemie, Proteinchemie, Antikörperentwicklung und Enzymtechnologie).

Ihr Profil

Sie sind eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) in Chemie, Biochemie, Chemischer Biologie oder einem
verwandten Bereich oder in einem vergleichbaren Masterstudiengang oder befinden sich in einem Gap
Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Ihre Stärken

• Sie haben Kenntnisse in organischer Chemie und Proteinbiochemie, erste Erfahrungen sind

• von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in instrumenteller Analytik (z.B. UV-Vis, HPLC).

• Grundkenntnisse in Immunologie sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gemeinsam im Team Konzepte zu entwickeln.

• Sie sind kreativ und setzen Ihre Ideen gerne in die Praxis um.

• Sie können sich selbstständig organisieren und Ihren Arbeitsalltag strukturieren.

• Sie besitzen gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung (37.5 Std./Woche)

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vergünstigte Essenspreise (-50 %) in unserer Mitarbeiterkantine

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

Ihre Bewerbung

Bitte laden Sie nur Ihren Lebenslauf online hoch.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) richtet, die derzeit
eingeschrieben sind oder sich in einem Gap Year befinden (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Zeitraum: Ab Oktober 2026 oder früher für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Bitte beachten, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been newly established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As the Social Media Specialist (Community Management) , you would supports the Digital Communities team within Group Communications, you'll play a crucial role in orchestrating digital engagement and shaping the presence of Roche across various social media platforms. You will be working very closely with Digital Communications Engagement Managers and their stakeholders to support and enhance global social media channels and external audience interactions. You will be responsible for managing and growing our online presence across various platforms, the caretaker of our brand’s online presence, fostering a vibrant community, driving engagement through innovative and effective social media strategies, and ensuring positive and productive community interactions.

The Opportunity:

• Monitoring and replying to customer queries received via inbox and/or global social media channels.

• Cultivate and manage online communities by responding to comments, moderating interactions, and fostering meaningful engagement aligned with Roche’s brand voice.

• Building relationships with the Roche executive community, influencers, brand advocates, and partners to amplify brand messaging, and proactively manage potential social media issues by implementing crisis communication plans with the Global Insights/Crisis team.

• Proactively recommending improvements to strengthen digital presence, and identifying process enhancements to ensure innovative approaches across community, channel, and creative aspects while coaching junior colleagues as well.

• Business Process Management: as a center of excellence, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation within the scope of responsibility.

Who you are:

• You have a Bachelor's degree and 3 to 5 years of experience in global social media management, proficient in channel management, audience-centric strategies, social media tools, and managing agencies (experience in managing executive profiles is a big plus).

• You have experience with advertisement platforms and are strong in social metrics, content strategies for major platforms, and project management.

• You have excellent German and English communication skills; creative thinking for innovative content.

• You have strong interpersonal skills for teamwork and are skilled in conflict resolution, community moderation, and handling complex issues independently.

• You are a quick learner with a passion for technology, flexible with tools, and adept at adopting new technologies.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário(a) de Estratégia e Soluções Integradas, você terá a oportunidade de entender a jornada do paciente e envolver-se na cocriação e implementação de projetos e soluções. Esta vaga oferece uma trilha de desenvolvimento clara, onde você expandirá o seu impacto e responsabilidades ao longo do programa de estágio.

A Oportunidade
No seu dia a dia, você participa em melhorias de processos internos com foco na agilidade para o cliente e auxilia na implementação de eventos, campanhas e materiais. A sua jornada será estruturada da seguinte forma:

No 1º ano de estágio:

• Você realiza a imersão nas políticas internas e implementa processos end-to-end, como gestão de contratos, cadastro de speakers (PF e PJ) e parceiros de negócios, atuando como ponto focal de pagamentos.

• Você gerencia a abertura de eventos no SalesForce, realiza o upload de materiais no PromoMats para aprovação (de acordo com RDC 96 e PAMDE) e faz o preenchimento do GSD.

• Você colabora com a organização de repositórios nos iHubs, faz a interface direta com fornecedores e instituições patrocinadas, e modera as cerimónias do chapter de ESI.

No 2º ano de estágio:

• Você implementa, de ponta a ponta, projetos e eventos de média complexidade e participa, junto ao analista e coordenador, no desenvolvimento de projetos de alta complexidade.

• Você modera as syncs dos iHubs, atua na governança do guia de processos ESI e faz a interface com estratégias omnichannel.

• Você cria materiais e briefings para parceiros de negócios e realiza a revisão de materiais segundo as normas (RDC 96 e PAMDE).

Quem é você

• Você cursa graduação em áreas relacionadas a Marketing, Administração, Comunicação, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou na área da Saúde (Farmácia, Enfermagem, Biomedicina, etc.).

• Você tem disponibilidade para cumprir um contrato de estágio de, no mínimo, 1 ano e meio (formatura a partir de Dez de 2027).

• Você possui um nível intermediário do idioma Inglês.

• Você tem conhecimentos básicos nas ferramentas Excel e PowerPoint.

Diferenciais

• Você possui noções e interesse em gestão de projetos.

• Você tem conhecimento de metodologias ágeis.

*Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete mostrarevi come siete, comandate per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuine, dove siete valorizzati, attrezzature e rispettati per chi siete, permettendo a voi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come intendiamo portare, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare a tutti l'accesso ai servizi sanitari oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unitevi a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Estagiario(a) di Estratégia e Soluzioni Integrata, immagina l'opportunità di comprendere la storia del paziente e di coinvolgervi nella cocreazione e nell'implementazione di progetti e soluzioni. Questa posizione offre una traccia di sviluppo chiara, dove potrete ammirare l'impatto e le responsabilità lungo il programma di stage. L'Oportunità Nel quotidiano, parteciperete a finali di processi interni con focus sull'agilità per il cliente e aiutaete nell'implementazione di eventi, campagne e materiali. La tua storia sarà strutturata in questo modo: Anno 1 di Stage - Realizzerete l'immersione nelle politiche interne e implementerete processi end-to-end, come gestione di contratti, cattura di speaker (PF e PJ) e partner di business, agendo come punto focale di pagamenti. - Gestionerete l'apertura di eventi nel SalesForce, realizza l'upload di materiali nel PromoMats per approvazione (in base a RDC 96 e PAMDE) e tariffe il preenchimento del GSD. - Collaborerete con l'organizzazione di repositori nei iHubs, farete l'interfaccia diretta con fornitori e istituzioni patrocinate, e modorerete le cerimonie del capitolo di ESI. Anno 2 di Stage - Implementerete, da ponta a ponta, e eventi di media complessità e parteciperete, insieme all'analista e al coordinatore, nel sviluppo di progetti di complessità alta. - Modorerete le sync dei iHubs, agire nella governanza del guida di processi ESI e farete l'interfaccia con strategie omnichannel. - Creerete materiali e briefings per partner di business e realizza la revisione di materiali secondo le norme (RDC 96 e PAMDE). Chi è la persona giusta - Cursate la laurea in aree correlate a Marketing, Amministrazione, Comunicazione, Ingegneria di Bioprocessi o nell'area della Salute (Farmacia, Ingegneria, Biomedicina, ecc.). - adempiere a un contratto di stage di, almeno, 1 anno e mezzo (formatura a partire da Dicembre 2027). - Possedete un livello intermedio del linguaggio inglese. - conoscenze basilari nelle ferramenta Excel e PowerPoint. Differenziali - Possedete nozioni e interessanti in gestione di progetti. - Avete conoscenza di metodi agili. *Benefici di relocalizzazione non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso ai servizi sanitari oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri medicinali e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Abbiamo il potere di decidere a esplorare nuove possibilità, di favorire la creatività e di mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni di saluto che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik-Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team
Unser Team im Themencluster Festphasenchemie produziert modifizierte Oligonucleotide, Peptide und Konjugate im kleinen Maßstab unter GMP-Bedingungen. Diese Produkte unterstützen zahlreiche diagnostische Assays wie PCR, Immundiagnostik und Sequencing. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Herstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Produkte, der Einführung innovativer Artikel und der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Experte in der organischen Chemie/Festphasenchemie stellst du hochwertige Produkte für die In-vitro-Diagnostik her. Deine Tätigkeiten finden in einem GMP-regulierten Bereich statt.
Neben der Abarbeitung von Produktionsaufträgen unterstützt du unser Team aktiv bei folgenden Themen:

• Übernahme neuer Verfahren und Implementierung neuer Produkte.

• Bearbeitung von Abweichungen, CAPAs, OOS-Fällen und Troubleshootings.

• Prozessverbesserungen, Scale-ups und Changes.

• Erstellung und Überarbeitung von HVs und SOPs.

• Unterstützung bei Validierungen und Qualifizierungen sowie bei technischen Themen.

• Mitarbeit bei der Produktionsplanung und Unterstützung bei Arbeitssicherheitsthemen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast dein Studium der Chemie (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der organischen Chemie mit. Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung im Bereich der Festphasenchemie.

• Du besitzt theoretische und praktische Erfahrung in der analytischen und präparativen Chromatographie.

• Berufserfahrung in einem Produktionsumfeld sowie Kenntnisse im Bereich der Arbeitssicherheit sind ein Plus.

• Auf deine sehr guten Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr guten Kenntnisse gängiger EDV-Anwendungen können wir uns jederzeit verlassen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise.

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Inclusion & Belonging (I&B) Country Partner, you will be a strategic leader responsible for the localized execution and measurable impact of our I&B Strategy. You will partner with senior leaders to translate enterprise standards into meaningful local initiatives, ensuring an inclusive culture is deeply woven into our daily business outcomes. This is a unique opportunity to champion a culture of belonging while holding local leadership accountable for sustainable, inclusive progress.

The Opportunity

• Lead the implementation of the I&B and divisional strategies within your designated country.

• Partner with local senior leaders to strengthen I&B within business units, linking it directly to specific strategic priorities.

• Equip leaders with practical tools and resources to achieve measurable outcomes through tailored KPIs and metrics.

• Provide thought leadership and expertise, ensuring I&B is linked to the local business strategy in areas of greatest impact.

• Diagnose evolving local needs by listening to the organization and developing proactive, localized interventions.

• Serve as an executive coach to senior leaders, building I&B capability and mentoring colleagues across the country.

• Manage resource allocation and prioritization, making strategic trade-offs regarding budget and capacity.

• Embed I&B behaviors into the local organizational culture so they become part of both strategic and daily employee experiences.

Who You Are
You are a visionary leader who understands that inclusion is a driver of culture change and employee engagement. You thrive in international environments and possess the cultural intelligence needed to translate global strategy into local reality.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Influence Strategically: Partner directly with senior division leaders to actively shape their people agenda.

• Mobilize Communities: Activate the organization and drive matrixed resources without needing direct authority.

• Deliver Tangible Impact: Move past the "theory" of I&B and deliver concrete, measurable results that empower the business.

• Extensive Leadership Experience: Over 10 years of experience in I&B or a related field, with a significant focus on leading the agenda at a country level.

• Strategic & Data-Driven Mindset: A proven ability to demonstrate ROI by linking data to business outcomes and using insights to drive recommendations.

• Executive Influence: Outstanding skills in collaborating with and influencing management at all levels, including securing commitment for major initiatives.

• International Acumen: Deep understanding of the cultural, social, and economic dynamics within international markets.

• Change Management Expertise: Experience transforming how an organization relates to I&B and integrating these practices into people processes.

• Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken) is required to effectively partner with local and global stakeholders.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

IT GRC Expert - RDT Quality, Risk & Compliance

As an IT GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Expert - RDT (Roche Digital Technology) Quality, Risk & Compliance you design and implement comprehensive IT resilience, risk management, and compliance strategies aligned with business objectives. You lead complex risk assessments, develop refined audit and continuity programs, and establish best practices for handling critical disruptions and regulatory compliance. Acting as an expert advisor to high-level stakeholders, you lead responses to critical incidents and ensure the scalability and future-proofing of enterprise-wide risk and continuity solutions.

The Opportunity:

• You will develop and refine enterprise-wide risk management, compliance, and continuity strategies to enhance our global recovery plans.

• Lead the response to critical IT risk, audit, and continuity events while establishing global best practices for handling disruptions.

• Conduct post-incident reviews and "deep-dives" to identify systemic failures and implement continuous improvement frameworks.

• Manage high-level stakeholder relationships, acting as a strategic advisor to align risk policies with evolving business needs.

• Provide strategic insights based on industry best practices to ensure our compliance frameworks remain world-class.

• Oversee the scalability of IT resilience solutions, integrating complex policies with existing enterprise systems.

• Evaluate and select advanced tools for enterprise management to future-proof our technical resilience landscape.

• Facilitate advanced training sessions for cross-functional teams on BCM best practices and advanced problem-solving techniques.

Who you are:

• You possess extensive experience in architecting enterprise-wide IT resilience and risk management strategies at a strategic level.

• Expert in Life Sciences regulations, including GxP, SOX, and HIPAA, with a deep understanding of computer systems validation (CSV).

• Highly knowledgeable in IT General Controls (ITGC) and frameworks such as SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2, and DORA.

• Technically proficient in AWS and Azure environments, specifically regarding shared responsibility models and cloud-native DR orchestration.

• Proven ability to establish governance guardrails for emerging technologies like Generative AI, RPA, and SaaS.

• Skilled in secure SDLC and DevOps stacks (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) with the ability to implement Compliance-as-Code.

• Holder of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or Cybersecurity, and at least one active credential: CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 22301.

What you get:

• Salary range 19 000 - 35 400PLN g ross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport.

• Stock share purchase additions.

• Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!

Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

Vous dirigez des évaluations des risques complexes, élaborez des programmes de vérification et de continuité améliorés et établissez des pratiques exemplaires pour gérer les perturbations critiques et la conformité réglementaire. En tant que conseiller expert auprès des intervenants de haut niveau, vous dirigez les interventions en cas d'incident critique et vous assurez l'évolutivité et la protection future des solutions de risque et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Annexe - Vous développerez et affinerez des stratégies de gestion des risques, de conformité et de continuité à l'échelle de l'entreprise afin d'améliorer nos plans de redressement mondiaux. - Diriger la réponse aux risques critiques liés aux TI, à la vérification et à la continuité tout en établissant les meilleures pratiques mondiales pour gérer les perturbations. - Procéder à des examens post-incident et à des « directives profondes » pour déceler les défaillances systémiques et mettre en place des cadres d'amélioration continue. - Gérer les relations de haut niveau avec les intervenants, agir à titre de conseiller stratégique pour harmoniser les politiques sur les risques avec l'évolution des besoins opérationnels. - Fournir des renseignements stratégiques fondés sur les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie pour s'assurer que nos cadres de conformité demeurent de calibre mondial. - Surveiller l'évolutivité des solutions de résilience informatique, en intégrant des politiques complexes aux systèmes d'entreprise existants. - Évaluer et sélectionner des outils avancés pour la gestion d'entreprise pour mettre à l'épreuve notre paysage de résilience technique. - Faciliter les séances de formation avancée à l'intention des équipes interfonctionnelles sur les meilleures pratiques de la BCM et les techniques avancées de résolution de problèmes. Les - Vous possédez une vaste expérience dans l'architecture de stratégies de résilience informatique et de gestion des risques à l'échelle de l'entreprise au niveau stratégique. - Expert en sciences de la vie, y compris GxP, SOX et HIPAA, avec une compréhension approfondie de la validation des systèmes informatiques (CSV). - Haute connaissance des contrôles généraux des TI (ITGC) et des cadres tels que SOC2, ISO 27001, NIS2 et DORA. - Techniquement compétent dans les environnements AWS et Azure, en particulier en ce qui concerne les modèles de responsabilité partagée et l'orchestration de RD native en nuage. - Capacité éprouvée d'établir des garde-corps de gouvernance pour les technologies émergentes telles que Generative AI, RPA et SaaS. - Compétence dans les piles SDLC et DevOps sécurisées (Jira, Jenkins, Bitbucket) avec la capacité de mettre en œuvre la conformité comme code. - Titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique ou cybersécurité, et au moins un titre actif : CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP ou ISO 22301.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道 , 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（ HCP ）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学 / 疾病 / 产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生 / 科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 ( 使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维 )

工作年限
• 3 年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广 / 市场 / 医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are Roche, committed to advancing science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm for Pharma — shaping Roche’s strategic direction, ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape.

As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, you will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor, guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy. The PSI team, composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, delivers consistent, targeted, and technology-enabled insights that drive quality decision-making across the enterprise, providing unbiased, expertly curated intelligence to inform lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies.

The Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) team is looking for a Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader to join us in shaping Roche's Pharma strategy through market, portfolio and customer-centric insights. This role functions as an internal consultant and strategist, partnering with commercial and cross-functional leaders to generate insights that span Therapeutic Areas and shape cross-portfolio decisions.

The Opportunity

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir sind Roche, verpflichtet, die Wissenschaft voranzubringen, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Unser Team von Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) ist das Herzstück von Pharma, das den Rhythmus für Pharma festlegt – die strategische Ausrichtung von Roche zu prägen und sicherzustellen, dass unser Portfolio weltweit sinnvolle Innovationen für Patienten liefert. Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht nach einem Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Market Insights Leader, der uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharma-Strategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse beitritt. Diese Rolle fungiert als interner Berater und Stratege und arbeitet mit kommerziellen und funktionsübergreifenden Führungskräften zusammen, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die sich auf Therapeutische Bereiche erstrecken und Cross-Portfolio-Entscheidungen formen. Die Chance Der Beyond TA Market Insights Leader ist für die operative Abwicklung branchenführender Methoden in der Primär- und Sekundärmarktforschung verantwortlich, um strategische Entscheidungen zu leiten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie innovative Projekte und Workstreams leiten, die neue Methoden wegweisen, neue Technologien anwenden und Analysen erstellen, die Entwicklung und kommerzielle Strategie prägen. Sie werden in EI und anderen PSI-Teams umfassend zusammenarbeiten, um das Engagement, die Embed-Erweiterungen zu fördern und den vollen Wert der entwickelten Lösungen zu realisieren. Sie navigieren eine komplexe globale Matrix, um funktionsübergreifende Partner rund um wirkungsstarke, einsichtsorientierte Lieferungen auszurichten. Sie werden dem EI Beyond TA Enabling Leader melden. Mansion - Insights Excellence: Erhöhen Sie die Qualität und Wirkung von EI-Leistungen durch die Förderung von Forschungspraktiken in Primär- und Sekundärquellen. Sie stellen sicher, dass unsere Forschung in bester Klasse bleibt, indem Sie hocheffiziente Methoden und Tools implementieren, die Einblicke ermöglichen, strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen direkt zu informieren und zu beschleunigen. - Zukunftsbereite Roadmap: Entwerfen und führen Sie eine mehrjährige Roadmap zur Entwicklung von Primary Market Research und sekundären Erkenntnissen. Sie führen Piloten für innovative Forschungsmotoren und skalieren erfolgreiche Methoden weltweit, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Einsichtsinfrastruktur agil, skalierbar und vor Branchentrends ist. - Cross-Portfolio-Einsichten: Führen Sie die Generierung strategischer Erkenntnisse zu Themen mit Multi-TA-Wirkung, wie Digital Health, Drug Delivery und Next-Generation-Marketing-Modellen. Sie verbinden die Punkte über das Portfolio, um den Geschäftswert zu entsperren - Upskilling and Training: Definieren Sie den Goldstandard für Marktforschung innerhalb der EI. Sie entwerfen und liefern einen umfassenden Lehrplan, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Fähigkeiten branchenführend und zukunftssicher bleiben - Strategischer Anbieter und Compliance-Übersicht Contattoo (Non fornito)
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file de l'Espace Thérapeutique (TA) pour se joindre à nous pour façonner la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives axées sur le marché, le portefeuille et la clientèle. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Au-delà de l'AT Market Insights Leader est chargé de rendre opérationnelles les méthodes de pointe de l'industrie dans les études de marché primaires et secondaires pour guider les décisions stratégiques. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Mansioni - Insights excellence: Accroître la qualité et l'impact des produits livrables de l'AE en faisant progresser les pratiques de recherche dans les sources primaires et secondaires. Vous veillerez à ce que nos recherches demeurent les meilleures en classe en mettant en oeuvre des méthodologies et des outils à impact élevé qui permettent d'éclairer et d'accélérer directement les décisions stratégiques. - Feuille de route prête pour l'avenir : Concevoir et exécuter une feuille de route pluriannuelle pour faire évoluer la recherche sur les marchés primaires et les capacités secondaires de connaissances. Vous dirigerez des projets pilotes pour des moteurs de recherche innovants et des méthodologies efficaces à l'échelle mondiale, en veillant à ce que notre infrastructure d'information soit agile, évolutive et devant les tendances de l'industrie. - Perspectives transversales : Diriger la production de perspectives stratégiques sur des thèmes ayant un impact multi-TA, tels que la santé numérique, la prestation de médicaments et les modèles de commercialisation de la prochaine génération. Vous connecterez les points à travers le portefeuille pour débloquer la valeur de l'entreprise - Améliorer les compétences et la formation : Définir la norme d'or pour les études de marché au sein de l'IE. Vous allez concevoir et fournir un programme d'études complet pour assurer que nos capacités restent leader de l'industrie et la preuve future - Surveillance stratégique des fournisseurs et de la conformité Contatto (Non fornito)

Durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen, kommerziellen und Markteinblicken treibt GPS unternehmensweite Strategie, Portfoliopriorisierung und Unternehmensmodellinnovation an, um Roches Führung in der sich entwickelnden Gesundheitslandschaft voranzubringen. Im Rahmen des Portfolio-, Strategie- und Insights (PSI)-Teams im GPS-Bereich werden Sie als strategischer Denkpartner und vertrauenswürdiger Berater tätig sein, der das Produkt, den Krankheitsbereich, die Pharma- und die Unternehmensstrategie von Roche leitet. Das PSI-Team, bestehend aus Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads und Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, bietet konsistente, gezielte und technologiefähige Erkenntnisse, die die Qualitätsentscheidungsfindung im gesamten Unternehmen vorantreiben und unvoreingenommene, fachkundig kuratierte Intelligenz bereitstellen, um Lifecycle Management, Commercialization Excellence und Portfoliostrategien zu informieren. Das Global Ecosystem Insights (EI)-Team sucht nach einem Beyond Therapeutic Area (TA) Insights Product Enablement Leader, um uns bei der Gestaltung der Pharma-Strategie von Roche durch Markt-, Portfolio- und kundenzentrierte Erkenntnisse zu unterstützen. • Prozessoptimierung: Optimieren Sie Einblicke in Workflows durch Technologielösungen. Sie werden es dem Team ermöglichen, von der Datenanalyse bis zur strategischen Beratung zu schwenken und den Fokus auf die höchsten geschäftlichen Herausforderungen zu stellen
• Lösungsintegration: Identifikation, Pilot, Bereitstellung und Verwaltung einer Suite von internen und externen Technologielösungen. Sie werden mit AABI zusammenarbeiten, um den Ecosystem Tool Stack, einschließlich GenAI und Syntheseplattformen, zu kuratieren, um qualitativ hochwertige Erkenntnisse schneller und kostengünstiger zu liefern
• Workflow: Führen Sie die erfolgreiche Einführung neuer Technologien durch Überbrückung der Lücke zwischen technischen Fähigkeiten und täglichen Forschungsabläufen. Sie werden sicherstellen, dass KI- und digitale Werkzeuge nicht nur eingesetzt werden, sondern tief integriert werden

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous sommes Roche, engagés à faire avancer la science afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre équipe de Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le cœur de Pharma, fixant le rythme de Pharma — façonnant l'orientation stratégique de Roche, assurant notre portefeuille offre une innovation significative aux patients du monde entier. En intégrant les connaissances scientifiques, commerciales et commerciales, le GPS stimule la stratégie à l'échelle de l'entreprise, la priorisation des portefeuilles et l'innovation de modèles d'affaires pour faire progresser Roches dans le paysage des soins de santé en évolution. Dans le cadre de l'équipe Portefeuille, Stratégie et Perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance, guidant Roches produit, domaine de la maladie, pharmaceutique et stratégie d'entreprise. L'équipe de l'ISP, composée de Advanced Analytics for Business Insights (AABI), Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights (EI), Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, et Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, fournit des informations cohérentes, ciblées et axées sur la technologie qui stimulent la prise de décisions de qualité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, fournissant des renseignements impartiaux et spécialisés pour éclairer la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Ecosystem Insights (EI) est à la recherche d'un chef de file en habilitation de produits Beyond Therapeutical Area (TA) Insights pour se joindre à nous dans l'élaboration de la stratégie Pharma de Roche par le biais de perspectives de marché, de portefeuille et de clients. Ce rôle joue le rôle de consultant et de stratège interne, en partenariat avec des leaders commerciaux et interfonctionnels pour générer des idées qui couvrent les domaines thérapeutiques et façonner les décisions interportfolio. L'opportunité Le responsable de l'activation des produits Beyond TA Insights est chargé d'exploiter les solutions numériques et d'IA next-gen dans les études de marché primaires, les sources de données secondaires et les prévisions afin de fournir des informations de qualité supérieures avec une rapidité et une rentabilité accrues. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des projets innovateurs et des flux de travail qui sont les pionniers de nouvelles méthodologies, appliqueront de nouvelles technologies et créeront des analyses qui façonneront le développement et la stratégie commerciale. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec d'autres équipes de l'IE et d'autres PSI, dont ABBI, pour stimuler l'engagement, intégrer des améliorations et réaliser la pleine valeur des solutions développées. Vous naviguerez sur une matrice mondiale complexe pour aligner les partenaires interfonctionnels autour de produits livrables à impact élevé et axés sur les idées. Vous ferez rapport à l'IE au-delà du chef habilitant de l'AT. Domaines d ' intervention et responsabilités
• Renforcement des capacités en matière d'IA : établir le cadre d'intégration de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'analyse avancée au cœur de la recherche de marché primaire, des connaissances secondaires et des prévisions. Vous mettrez en place des approches tech-augmentées qui libèrent les idées et créent un avantage concurrentiel distinct pour nos AT
• Optimisation des processus : Rationaliser les flux de connaissances grâce à des solutions technologiques. Vous permettrez à l'équipe de pivoter de l'analyse de données à l'avis stratégique, en veillant à se concentrer sur les défis commerciaux de la plus haute valeur
• Intégration des solutions: Identifier, piloter, déployer et gérer une série de solutions technologiques internes et externes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec AABI pour la mise en place de l'Ecosystem Tool Stack, y compris les plateformes GenAI et de synthèse, afin de fournir des informations de haute qualité plus rapidement et de manière plus rentable.
• Flux de travail: Conduire l'adoption réussie de nouvelles technologies en comblant l'écart entre les capacités techniques et les flux de recherche quotidiens. Vous vous assurerez que l'IA et les outils numériques ne sont pas simplement déployés, mais profondément intégrés

jobs.title: Engagement Marketing Manager - Oncology & Nephrology

titleByLocale.it: Engagement Marketing Manager - Oncologia e Nefrologia
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de marketing engagement - Oncologie et néphrologie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Engagement Marketing Manager – Oncology & Nephrology
Roche Nederland B.V. – Woerden

Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging op het vlak van omnichannel marketing in een leuk team van marketing & digital professionals? Ben jij een expert in marketingexecutie die energie krijgt van het vertalen van strategie naar tastbare impact? Bij Roche Nederland werk je in een agile omgeving aan onze missie: de beste zorg voor de patiënt in Nederland.

Functieomschrijving
Als Engagement Marketing Manager maak je deel uit van het Marketing & Digital Team en ben je de regisseur van onze marketingplannen. Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? Met een mix van creativiteit en een resultaatgerichte mindset zet jij je in voor de beste zorgoplossingen voor de patiënt, de zorgverlener en Roche.

Wat ga je doen?

• Omnichannel Orchestratie : Je ontwerpt en optimaliseert de klanten-touchpoint-journey, waarbij je persoonlijke en niet-persoonlijke interacties integreert om onze klanten te overtuigen van de waarde van onze geneesmiddelen voor oncologie en nefrologie en reumatologie.

• Tactische Executie: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige 'pull-through' van het omnichannel marketingplan, inclusief de ontwikkeling van gepersonaliseerde content op basis van diepe klantinzichten.

• Content & Campaign Management : In afstemming met ons digital team creëer je impactvolle content die aansluit bij de klanten touchpoint-journey, waarbij je zorgt voor een snelle en compliant marktintroductie via o.a. Veeva PromoMats, rekening houdend met CGR.

• Impactmeting & Optimalisatie: Je kiest en monitort KPI’s en analyseert de effectiviteit van campagnes om datagedreven beslissingen te nemen en lopende tactieken continu te verbeteren.

• Cross-functionele samenwerking: Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van onder andere Medical, Access en Customer Engagement om ervoor te zorgen dat tactieken naadloos aansluiten op de behoeften in het regionale ecosysteem.

• Financieel Beheer: Je draagt bij aan het beheer van het marketingbudget en waarborgt een sterke financiële verantwoording van de uitgevoerde initiatieven.

Wat breng je mee?

• Ervaring: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in digital/non-digital marketing binnen de farmaceutische industrie. Ervaring in een fieldfunctie is een plus.

• Omnichannel Expertise : Een diepgaande kennis van het executeren van omnichannel campagnes, meten van impact en het vertalen van strategie naar implementatie van taktieken.

• Data-gedrevenheid: Bewezen kennis en kunde in het faciliteren en nemen van beslissingen op basis van data en inzichten op tactisch en uitvoerend niveau.

• Technische & Analytische vaardigheden: Geavanceerde kennis van CRM-systemen (zoals Veeva/Salesforce), marketing automation, digitale tools en AI-oplossingen voor marketing.

• Mindset: Je hebt een passie voor digitale en persoonlijke interactie met onze klanten, een ondernemende 'can-do' mentaliteit, plezier in executie, een sterke focus op de klantervaring en het meten van impact plus het vermogen om te gedijen in een dynamische, agile- cross functionele omgeving.

• Opleiding & Taal: Een afgeronde HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijv. Business of Science) en uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels bij het schrijven van teksten.

Waarom Roche?
Bij Roche maak je deel

Ben jij een expert in marketingexecutie die energie krijgt van het vertalen van strategie naar tastbare impact? Bij Roche Nederland werk je in een agile omgeving aan onze missie: de beste zorg voor de patiënt in Nederland. Functieomschrijving Als Engagement Marketing Manager maak je deel uit van het Marketing & Digital Team en ben je de regisseur van onze marketingplannen. Je slaat de brug tussen strategie en uitvoering voor de teams Oncologie en Nefrologie & Reumatologie. Door slimme omnichannel-campagnes (zowel fysiek als digitaal) te lanceren en de impact daarvan direct te meten, optimaliseer je de klantervaring. Jouw doel? jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
Customer Partner

Role Purpose
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

In this role, you will
Account Management

• Responsible in solution/technical/consultative selling.

• Leads sales process including prospecting, qualification, quantification, needs assessment, competitive differentiation, presentation, closing, contracting and implementation and ensuring after sales support is maintained and of the highest standard.

• Build long-term value-based relationships through continuously uncovering customers’ changing needs, improving customer experience, anticipating new opportunities for their business in the future and adding values through creative solutions / products

• Build credibility with customers and other stakeholders at different levels through demonstrating business acumen and professional expertise, confidence and effective communication.

• Develop and build strategic engagement and partnering with KOLs and relevant stakeholders in key accounts. Be a partner/consultant in shaping their plans, decisions and supporting their professional objectives to achieve RDMY business strategy and goals.

• Understand the customers’ working / communication styles and flex one’s style to adapt to that.

• Identify and develop business opportunities within the area of responsibility and collaborate across teams to ensure attainment.

• Implement a sales management process to assist the team in identifying and prioritizing customers and prospects.

• Responsible for developing and leading implementation of annual territorial plans with the goal of achieving sales objectives and future growth.

• Identify new accounts in line with the marketing strategy.

• Retain, extend and acquire customers and accounts through effective identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Responsible for profiling accounts, placing RDMY in the strongest position to win tenders and new accounts.

• Update Accounts and contacts in Salesforce regularly to ensure accuracy of data

• Ensure Salesforce activities, business opportunities are entered in REXIS on a weekly basis.

• Monitor all Opportunities to ensure they are up to date.

• Able to conduct Basic troubleshooting.

• Proficient in Global Deal Calculator (GDC) in preparing sales proposal.

• Participation in relevant marketing events/exhibition/trade.

• Responsible for arranging and conducting relevant training or presentation sessions for customers.

Product Knowledge

• Strong knowledge of assigned product portfolio to manage sales process, involving cross function team’s expertise, as needed

• Promote co-positioning of cross-BA products, where applicable, with the objective to maximize RDMY total revenues and profitability

Teamwork

•

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within the DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our Data and Digital Catalyst team as a Software Engineer, where you will develop the modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems that are foundational to our research. You'll build robust and scalable systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data, directly accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients. This is a unique opportunity to empower our scientists and advance data-driven science through innovative technology.

The Opportunity

• Build and enhance a modern, scalable ecosystem of applications and tools to capture, move, and prepare scientific data for analysis.

• Design and deliver complex, user-friendly data applications and pipelines that integrate diverse data sets across key scientific domains.

• Leverage standard patterns like microservices and event-driven architecture to improve our data workflows and application ecosystem.

• Champion technical excellence by ensuring our solutions are innovative, best-in-class, and seamlessly integrated.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power Artificial Intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and Natural Language Search capabilities.

• Collaborate directly with computational and research scientists to understand their challenges and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Provide technical leadership on ongoing initiatives and identify new opportunities to build common, reusable solutions.

• Mentor junior developers, fostering their professional growth and upholding high engineering standards.

Who You Are

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. I progressi in AI, i dati e le scienze computazionali stanno trasformando la scoperta e lo sviluppo della droga. Le organizzazioni di ricerca e sviluppo precoce di Roche a Genentech (gRED) e Pharma (pRED) hanno dimostrato come queste tecnologie accelerano la R&D, sfruttando i dati e i nuovi modelli computazionali per guidare l'impatto. La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza (CS CoE) è un gruppo strategico e unificato il cui obiettivo è quello di sfruttare il potere trasformativo dei dati e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) per aiutare i nostri scienziati sia in pRED che in GRED a fornire farmaci più innovativi e mutevoli per la vita per i pazienti in tutto il mondo. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. Unisciti al nostro team Data e Digital Catalyst come Software Engineer, dove svilupperai gli ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi che sono fondamentali per la nostra ricerca. Costruirete sistemi robusti e scalabili che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici, accelerando direttamente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento della vita per i pazienti. Questa è un'opportunità unica per potenziare i nostri scienziati e promuovere la scienza dei dati attraverso la tecnologia innovativa. L'opportunità
• Costruire e migliorare un ecosistema moderno e scalabile di applicazioni e strumenti per catturare, spostare e preparare i dati scientifici per l'analisi.
• Progettare e fornire applicazioni e tubazioni di dati complesse e facili da usare che integrano diversi set di dati in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Levare modelli standard come microservizi e architettura orientata agli eventi per migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'ecosistema delle applicazioni.
• Campione di eccellenza tecnica assicurando che le nostre soluzioni siano innovative, di classe migliore e perfettamente integrate.
• Integrare diversi set di dati per alimentare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI), l'apprendimento automatico (ML), e le capacità di ricerca della lingua naturale.
• Collaborare direttamente con gli scienziati computazionali e di ricerca per comprendere le loro sfide e tradurli in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Fornire leadership tecnica sulle iniziative in corso e identificare nuove opportunità per costruire soluzioni comuni e riutilizzabili.
• Mentor junior sviluppatori, promuovendo la loro crescita professionale e mantenendo elevati standard di ingegneria. Chi sei Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere software appassionato e collaborativo con un talento per la costruzione di piattaforme scalabili e affidabili. Si prospera sul coinvolgimento di partner scientifici per risolvere la conformità

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.
