Les organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Genentech (GRED) et de Pharma (PRED) ont démontré comment ces technologies accélèrent la R-D, tirent parti des données et de nouveaux modèles de calcul pour produire des effets. Le partage de données sans soudure et l'accès aux modèles à travers gRED et pRED sont essentiels pour maximiser ces opportunités. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles (CS CoE) est un groupe stratégique unifié dont l'objectif est d'exploiter la puissance transformatrice des données et de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider nos scientifiques dans les domaines pRED et gRED à fournir des médicaments plus innovants et changeants pour les patients du monde entier. Au sein de l'organisation du Conseil de l'Europe, l'organisation Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) dirige la modernisation de nos écosystèmes informatiques et de données en intégrant les technologies numériques dans la recherche et le développement précoce pour autonomiser les parties prenantes, faire progresser la science axée sur les données et accélérer la prise de décisions. L'équipe Solutions de l'organisation DDC développe des écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés. L'écosystème des données est fondamental pour construire des solutions qui accélèrent le travail de nos chercheurs en informatique et en banque et permettent la création et l'adoption d'outils ML/AI. Notre équipe est spécialisée dans la construction de pipelines de données et applications pour l'acquisition, la collecte, le stockage, la transformation, le couplage et le partage de données. Rejoignez notre équipe Data and Digital Catalyst en tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, où vous développerez les écosystèmes informatiques et de données modernisés et interconnectés qui sont fondamentaux pour notre recherche. Vous allez construire des systèmes robustes et évolutives qui libèrent le potentiel de nos diverses données scientifiques, accélérant directement la découverte et le développement de traitements qui changent la vie des patients. C'est une occasion unique d'habiliter nos scientifiques et de faire progresser la science axée sur les données grâce à une technologie novatrice. L'opportunité
• Construire et améliorer un écosystème moderne et évolutif d'applications et d'outils pour capturer, déplacer et préparer des données scientifiques à analyser.
• Concevoir et fournir des applications et des pipelines de données complexes et conviviaux qui intègrent divers ensembles de données dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Tirer parti des modèles standard comme les microservices et l'architecture événementielle pour améliorer nos flux de données et l'écosystème d'application.
• Championne l'excellence technique en s'assurant que nos solutions sont innovantes, de qualité supérieure et parfaitement intégrées.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'intelligence artificielle (AI), l'apprentissage automatique (ML) et la recherche en langage naturel.
• Collaborer directement avec les chercheurs et les chercheurs pour comprendre leurs défis et les traduire en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Fournir un leadership technique sur les initiatives en cours et identifier de nouvelles possibilités d'élaborer des solutions communes et réutilisables.
• Mentor junior développeurs, favorisant leur croissance professionnelle et le maintien de normes d'ingénierie élevées. Qui vous êtes Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel passionné et collaboratif avec un talent pour construire des plateformes évolutives et fiables. Vous prospèrez en vous engageant avec des partenaires scientifiques pour résoudre

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and life-changing medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CS CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organization leads the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems by integrating digital technologies across Research and Early Development to empower stakeholders, advance data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

The Solutions team within DDC Organization develops modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystems. The Data Ecosystem is foundational to building solutions that accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable ML/AI tool creation and adoption. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

As a Software Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will build robust, scalable, and reusable capabilities for our shared data platform. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Leaders, and scientific partners to design and implement systems that unlock the potential of our diverse scientific data. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating the discovery and development of life-changing treatments for patients by building the modern ecosystem that captures, moves, and prepares scientific data for analysis.

The Opportunity

• Ensure technical excellence by delivering innovative, best-in-class data flows and pipelines across key scientific domains.

• Promote the adoption of key trends and technologies by applying an Open Source, Cloud First, API First, and AI First approach to problem-solving.

• Improve our data workflows and application architecture by leveraging standard patterns like microservices and event-driven design.

• Integrate diverse data sets to power AI/ML, Natural Language Search, and downstream visualization and analytics tools.

• Facilitate the implementation of cutting-edge AI models that take advantage of advances in machine learning.

• Influence technical decisions around data workflows and application development in collaboration with key partners.

• Learn and deeply understand our Data Ecosystem to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

Who You Are

You are a passionate engineer who cares about technical and product excellence, with a drive to build highly usable solutions. You thrive in a collaborative environment, leveraging modern development practices to translate complex challenges into effective technology solutions.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a similar technica

La condivisione e l'accesso dei dati senza cuciture ai modelli in GRED e pRED sono essenziali per massimizzare queste opportunità. All'interno dell'organizzazione CS CoE, l'organizzazione Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) conduce l'ammodernamento dei nostri ecosistemi computazionali e dati integrando le tecnologie digitali attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce per potenziare gli stakeholder, promuovere la scienza dei dati e accelerare il processo decisionale. Il team Solutions all'interno dell'Organizzazione DDC sviluppa ecosistemi computazionali e dati modernizzati e interconnessi. Il Data Ecosystem è fondamentale per costruire soluzioni che accelerano il lavoro svolto dai nostri scienziati Computazionali e Bench e consentono la creazione e l'adozione di strumenti ML/AI. Il nostro team è specializzato nella costruzione di Data Pipelines e Applicazioni per l'acquisizione, la raccolta, lo stoccaggio, la trasformazione, il collegamento e la condivisione dei dati. In qualità di Ingegnere software del nostro team di Ingegneria Soluzioni, costruirai funzionalità robuste, scalabili e riutilizzabili per la nostra piattaforma dati condivisa. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Data Engineers, Product Leaders e partner scientifici per progettare e implementare sistemi che sbloccano il potenziale dei nostri diversi dati scientifici. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà direttamente ad accelerare la scoperta e lo sviluppo di trattamenti per il cambiamento di vita per i pazienti costruendo l'ecosistema moderno che cattura, si muove e prepara i dati scientifici per l'analisi. L'opportunità
• Assicurare l'eccellenza tecnica offrendo flussi di dati innovativi e di alta qualità e tubazioni in ambiti scientifici chiave.
• Promuovere l'adozione di tendenze e tecnologie chiave applicando un approccio Open Source, Cloud First, API First e AI First alla risoluzione dei problemi.
• Migliorare i nostri flussi di lavoro dati e l'architettura delle applicazioni sfruttando modelli standard come microservizi e design orientato agli eventi.
• Integra diversi set di dati per alimentare AI/ML, Natural Language Search e strumenti di visualizzazione e analisi a valle.
• Facilitare l'implementazione di modelli AI all'avanguardia che sfruttano i progressi nell'apprendimento automatico.
• Influenza delle decisioni tecniche sui flussi di lavoro dei dati e sullo sviluppo delle applicazioni in collaborazione con partner chiave.
• Imparare e comprendere profondamente il nostro Data Ecosystem per promuovere un miglioramento continuo e un'innovazione. Chi sei Sei un ingegnere appassionato che si preoccupa dell'eccellenza tecnica e del prodotto, con l'obiettivo di costruire soluzioni altamente utilizzabili. Si prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, sfruttando le pratiche di sviluppo moderne per tradurre sfide complesse in soluzioni tecnologiche efficaci.
• Una laurea in Informatica o una tecnica simile

L'opportunité
• Assurer l'excellence technique en fournissant des flux de données et des pipelines innovants et de qualité supérieure dans des domaines scientifiques clés.
• Promouvoir l'adoption de tendances et de technologies clés en appliquant une approche Open Source, Cloud First, API First et AI First à la résolution de problèmes.
• Améliorer nos flux de travail de données et l'architecture d'application en tirant parti des modèles standard tels que les microservices et la conception d'événements.
• Intégrer divers ensembles de données pour alimenter l'IA/ML, la recherche en langage naturel et les outils de visualisation et d'analyse en aval.
• Faciliter la mise en œuvre de modèles d'intelligence artificielle de pointe qui tirent parti des progrès de l'apprentissage automatique.
• Influencer les décisions techniques sur les flux de données et le développement des applications en collaboration avec les principaux partenaires.
• Apprenez et comprenez profondément notre écosystème de données pour stimuler l'amélioration continue et l'innovation. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un ingénieur passionné qui se soucie de l'excellence technique et des produits, avec un moteur pour construire des solutions hautement utilisables. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement collaboratif, en tirant parti des pratiques de développement modernes pour traduire les défis complexes en solutions technologiques efficaces.
• Baccalauréat en informatique ou technica similaire

jobs.title: Business Excellence Chapter Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chapitre sur l'excellence en affaires Chef de file

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Purpose
The chapter lead of business excellence serves as the core person for bridging high-level corporate strategy with on-the-ground commercial execution. The Chapter Lead translates the company's strategic vision into tangible commercial projects, manages the strategic initiatives, and ensures cross-functional alignment to deliver measurable business outcomes and drive sustainable revenue growth.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
I. Strategic Planning and development

• Strategy Formulation: Partner with senior leaders to support the annual and long-range company strategy planning process

• Strategic Roadmap: Translate approved corporate and commercial strategies into a defined, prioritized roadmap of projects and initiatives

• Business Case Development: Lead the development of robust business cases for strategic commercial investments, defining expected financial return (ROI), resource requirements, and measurable success criteria.

II. Project Management Office (PMO) Leadership

• Project Execution Oversight: Act as the lead or co-lead for high-priority, complex strategic projects, driving accountability, managing interdependencies, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.

• Performance Reporting: Develop and maintain a comprehensive portfolio dashboard for executive leadership, providing clear, concise status updates on project health, key milestones, budget adherence, and projected impact realization.

III. Commercial Excellence Oversight
A. Channel & Distributor Management:

• Focus on maximizing revenue growth and profitability through the optimization of go-to-market channels and the professional management of distributors and business partners.

• Direct the design, implementation, and governance of sales incentive compensation (IC) plans for the direct sales force and partner reward programs.

• Ensure the implementation of a robust performance review framework and regular commercial compliance audit programs for distributors, reviewing anti-bribery, data privacy, and ethical selling practices.

B. Customer Experience & Operational Processes:

• Lead the function responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing seamless service journeys for clinicians and patients across the product lifecycle.

• Ensure the establishment, documentation, and socialization of robust Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all critical customer-facing and back-office processes, ensuring compliance and efficiency.

• Manage the governance model for external partners , defining and enforcing strict SLAs and KPIs for third-party vendors (e.g., tech support, specialty pharmacies).

C. Sales Analytics & Performance Management :

• Oversee the entire process of sales target setting and management (annual, quarterly, regional, individual).

• Direct the design and maintenance of optimal sales territory structures to maximize market coverage and ensure fair opportunity distribution.

• Drive the development and dissemination of actionable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and dashboards for sales pipeline health and performance.

• Lead the successful execution of the Objectives and Key Results (OKR) framework within the sales organization, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.

D.Customer Relationship Management & Digital Adoption:

• Assess the business needs in development of customer relationship management and direct strategic framework, implementation, and optimization of the Customer Relationship Man

jobs.title: Country Medical Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Country Medical Director is a senior leader who easily navigates between science, data and business in service of our vision at Roche. You are an experienced professional with a solid scientific background. You are confident in playing a key role in developing the local medical strategy to enable future success of the organization and you have experience in transforming complex healthcare challenges into clear and compelling actions that benefit patients.

Building relationships and scientific partnerships with our stakeholders is your second nature. Considering the nature of Bosnia and Herzegovina healthcare system, the Medical Director will bring understanding of the operating environment (or comparable market) and its challenges. You come with a strong vision on evidence generation and data enabled healthcare. You are passionate about innovation and can envision how healthcare data and science can have a sustainable impact on the healthcare system.

As a member of the Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina Enabling/Leadership Team, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction and achieving company objectives within the Affiliate and Medical Chapter, including strategic decision making and empowering teams. You will serve as a role model to the entire organization, lead the functional chapter, and focus on upskilling and coaching team members, while also co-creating organizational strategies and fostering agility and cultural change. Additionally, you will collaborate with other Country Medical Directors, Chapter Heads and Squad Leads to allocate resources and support professional development within the Network, Affiliate and Chapter.

Who are we looking for?

Beyond strong focus on external engagement, strategic partnerships, data and science you have the following responsibilities:

• Shape and develop the overall affiliate medical strategy based on external insights and Roche’s product portfolio developments

• Drive above-brand medical strategy and alignment

• Represents Roche medical authority with key external stakeholders

• As a member of the Enabling /Leadership Team, develop and implement the vision, mission and overarching strategy for Roche Bosnia and Herzegovina and ensure it adheres to the highest scientific and ethical standards and fulfills all regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Ensure excellence in scientific consulting with stakeholders, patient safety, quality, compliance, regulatory, evidence generation and medical information

• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance acting as the local delegate of authority of Roche`s Pharma CMO ensuring business integrity and company reputation.

• Drive early health data gap identification, prioritization and integrated evidence planning inclusion by being actively involved and by collaborating with strong medical enablers

• Bring clinical practice perspective and act as a sparring partner to decide how (and which) data should be used / generated to build the medical narrative in the respective disease areas

• Work closely with local, cross-country and global compliance networks, strong cross-functional partnership with other affiliate (and network) functions and actively engage with Roche global functions and group members.

• Being a servant leader to the entire affiliate and network acting with courage and integrity. Role model creative leadership and network mindset supporting transparency across the organization.

The Technical Reward Analyst - Compensation is responsible for providing essential services to the People Reward and Recognition (PR&R) chapter independently, focusing on Workday configuration, data analysis, and administrative processes for all Roche positions. This role requires a deep understanding of global reward processes and timelines , with the ability to clearly articulate them. The Reward Analyst will also offer guidance on recurring reward inquiries and have a firm grasp of Roche Rewards policies and procedures.

The opportunity:

• Collaborate with Reward Partners to understand organizational structures and roles.

• Perform system configuration activities in Workday.

• Contribute to the Annual Compensation review cycle management, including system preparation and resolving incoming queries.

• Conduct system testing activities prior release.

• Support the introduction and development of innovative technologies.

• Conduct audits and analysis on programs, policies, and procedures to recommend enhancements or changes that improve existing practices.

• Contribute to the continual improvement of work processes within the PR&R chapter to create a more streamlined and efficient organization.

Who You Are:

• Experience in HR support, Customer Service, or Payroll roles

• Strong analytical skills with advanced critical thinking and the ability to turn data into actionable insights.

• Expertise in analysis tools (e.g., Excel, Access, Smartsheet) and HR systems, with prior experience in data management and system updates.

• Customer-centric mindset , with the ability to anticipate needs, demonstrate cultural mindset awareness, and provide clear, effective responses.

• Fluency in written and spoken English .

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities : Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility : We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average).

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• This role is for a temporary one-year contract with the possibility of extension.
• The successful candidate will be employed by a third-party agency on behalf of Roche.

Hlavním cílem a úkolem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní podporu zákazníkům v rámci České republiky ,převážně v regionu Čechy (instalace, pravidelnou údržbu, opravy, softwarové modifikace) analyzátorů a systémů Roche řady cobas, umístěných v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří. Budete úzce spolupracovat s ostatními odděleními Roche Diagnostics při přípravě a implementacích komplexních projektů laboratorních řešení. Preferované bydliště Praha/Střední Čechy

Hlavní odpovědnosti
• ● Provozovat rutinní servisní podporu na analytických přístrojích Roche v úzké spolupráci s centrem zákaznické podpory a dalšími týmy Professional Services.
• To zahrnuje:
• o Instalace přístrojů v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří
• o Provádění periodické údržby přístrojů - opravovat přístroje na základě požadavků zákazníků
• o Provádění výrobcem předepsané modifikace přístrojů
• o Poslední fází veškerých servisních služeb je konečná zkouška příslušného analyzátoru a potvrzení jeho plné funkčnosti.
• ● Provádět příslušnou dokumentaci v digitální formě (dokumentace servisních aktivit, reportování v globálním CRM systému)
• ● Sledovat servisní bulletiny za účelem zajištění co nejlepší přípravy na servisní proces a zajištění kvalitních služeb
• ● Samostatně si plánovat aktivity, zajišťovat objednávky potřebných náhradních dílů ve spolupráci se servisním zázemím
• ● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti
• Vhodný/á kandidát/ka:
• ● Absolvent/ka vysoké školy technického směru (zaměření na elektroniku nebo IT)
• ● Absolvent/ka střední školy se zaměřením na elektroniku a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.
• ● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
• ● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
• ● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
• ● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
• ● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
• ● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50)
• ● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
• ● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• This role is for a temporary one-year contract with the possibility of extension.
• The successful candidate will be employed by a third-party agency on behalf of Roche. Hlavním cílem a úkolem této pozice je zajišťovat servisní podporu zákazníkům v rámci České republiky ,převážně v regionu Čechy (instalace, pravidelnou údržbu, opravy, softwarové modifikace) analyzátorů a systémů Roche řady cobas, umístěných v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří. Budete úzce spolupracovat s ostatními odděleními Roche Diagnostics při přípravě a implementacích komplexních projektů laboratorních řešení. Preferované bydliště Praha/Střední Čechy Hlavní odpovědnosti
• ● Provozovat rutinní servisní podporu na analytických přístrojích Roche v úzké spolupráci s centrem zákaznické podpory a dalšími týmy Professional Services.
• To zahrnuje:
• o Instalace přístrojů v laboratořích nemocnic a komerčních laboratoří
• o Provádění periodické údržby přístrojů - opravovat přístroje na základě požadavků zákazníků
• o Provádění výrobcem předepsané modifikace přístrojů
• o Poslední fází veškerých servisních služeb je konečná zkouška příslušného analyzátoru a potvrzení jeho plné funkčnosti.
• ● Provádět příslušnou dokumentaci v digitální formě (dokumentace servisních aktivit, reportování v globálním CRM systému)
• ● Sledovat servisní bulletiny za účelem zajištění co nejlepší přípravy na servisní proces a zajištění kvalitních služeb
• ● Samostatně si plánovat aktivity, zajišťovat objednávky potřebných náhradních dílů ve spolupráci se servisním zázemím
• ● Dodržovat všechny zákonné normy a interní pravidla společnosti
• Vhodný/á kandidát/ka:
• ● Absolvent/ka vysoké školy technického směru (zaměření na elektroniku nebo IT)
• ● Absolvent/ka střední školy se zaměřením na elektroniku a 3 roky praxe v oblasti zdravotnických přístrojů atp.
• ● Zvládání anglického jazyka na úrovni potřebné pro studium technické dokumentace a absolvování školení v anglickém jazyce
• ● Schopnost plánování a provádění samostatné práce u zákazníků v laboratořích a ochota přizpůsobit se časově
• ● Ochota cestování v rámci regionu
• ● Schopnost týmové spolupráce v rámci oddělení Professional Services a spolupráce s kolegy/němi z jiných oddělení
• ● Řidičský průkaz kat.B podmínkou
• ● Kvalifikační stupeň osoby pro samostatnou činnost dle NV 194/2022 Sb.(dříve §6 vyhl.50)
• ● Prozákaznický přístup, schopnost porozumět potřebám zákazníkům a být jim partnerem
• ● Předchozí pracovní zkušenost v oblasti technické podpory zdravotnických přístrojů je výhodou, ale není podmínkou Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant compliance (f/h/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l'équipe
Au sein du Département de la Communication, de la RSE et du Site, et rattaché au Responsable de l’équipe administrative, vous occuperez un poste d'assistante administrative.

Vos Missions:

Expertise Compliance & Médicale (Focus majeur)

Garant(e) de notre intégrité vis-à-vis des réglementations françaises, vous assurez un suivi rigoureux des relations avec les professionnels de santé :

• Gestion contractuelle : Élaboration et suivi des contrats avec les experts et professionnels de santé en conformité avec la loi "Encadrement des Avantages" (Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

• Gestion de l'activité médicale : Pilotage avec les parties prenantes des contrats et suivi rigoureux des expertises et études médicales avec le déclenchement des engagements financiers.

• Interface privilégiée : Gestion des échanges avec les experts et coordination des process administratifs liés à leurs interventions.

Business Partner & Soutien Opérationnel

• Accompagnement de proximité : Support administratif sur-mesure pour les collaborateurs et People Leaders de différents services.

• Garant des process : Diffusion et contrôle du respect des procédures administratives internes au sein de la filiale.

• Soutien logistique : Participation active à l’organisation et à la tenue d’événements internes ou externes.

​

Votre Profil :
Vous êtes la candidate (ou le candidat) idéal(e) si :

• La rigueur est votre seconde nature : Vous avez le souci du détail, indispensable pour la gestion des dossiers de compliance où chaque virgule compte.

• Vous êtes un "Caméléon" relationnel : Capable de passer d’un sujet complexe avec le service compliance à un soutien logistique et administratif.

• L’esprit d'équipe vous anime : Pour vous, la réussite est avant tout collective.

• (connaissance des réglementations DMOS/Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

• Industrie Pharmaceutique ou de l' Santé Une expérience dans le secteur de la

• Le + qui fait la différence. Une expérience dans le secteur de la Santé ou de l' Industrie Pharmaceutique (connaissance des réglementations DMOS/Loi Anti-Cadeaux).

​ Postulez dès maintenant pour construire la santé de demain! ​

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 25% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in Connecticut.

Who You Are

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.
• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

jobs.title: Commissioning & Qualification Manager (m/f/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Engineering executes projects in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), and other divisions within Roche on demand. Within Global Engineering, the Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Manager has overall responsibility for the compliant, in time and in budget delivery of Commissioning & Qualification deliverables. The Commissioning & Qualification Manager reports to the PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Work is self-directed in nature. Projects / initiatives can vary in both length of time and complexity, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and agile execution strategies in support of GMP manufacturing operations, affiliates and CMOs. The position requires excellent internal and external collaboration and influencing skills and the ability to lead diverse, cross-functional teams.

Are you ready to lead large-scale engineering projects that deliver life-saving medicines to patients worldwide? Join our Global Engineering team and take overall responsibility for the compliant and timely delivery of Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) for our pharmaceutical technical operations

The Opportunity
As a C&Q Manager, you will act as a Sub-Project Manager within Global Engineering, driving excellence in a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
You will:

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate and inspire diverse teams during the C&Q phase, setting clear expectations and fostering a "one team" culture.

• Drive Project Success: Manage C&Q project scope to ensure deliverables are met within the approved budget and schedule.

• Ensure Global Compliance: Execute all deliverables in full alignment with the Roche Pharmaceutical Quality Management System (PQS) and international regulatory standards.

• Innovate and Challenge: Identify better ways to accomplish objectives by introducing best practices and innovation for C&Q Capex project management.

• Partner Strategically: Proactively build trustful relationships with key stakeholders and customers to support Roche’s strategic business goals.

Who you are

You bring:

• A University Degree in Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

• Bachelor with 6-8 years experience, Master with 5-7 years experience in the (bio)pharmaceutical industry, specifically in sterile drug product manufacturing or qualification.

• You have gained particular experience in leading a drug product sterile filling facility commissioning and qualification, leading the commissioning and qualification of packaging and autoinjector assembly, as well as in the commissioning and qualification of cleanroom systems.

• Deep knowledge of C&Q strategies (ASTM E2500), risk-based approaches, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH).

• Proficient in both German and English (written and spoken) with the ability to adjust your style to various audiences.

• Travel (20%) may be required to meet the business need, in order to lead the team at the project site/location. Expectation if assigned to a specific project during design or construction it is required to spend most of the time on site.

This is a 100% full time role and locally based in potential future EU sites and / or Mannheim / Penzberg.

Application documents - very pragmatic:
We ask you for a current CV in English and your official (educational) certificates/credentials. Further documents are not mandatory at the moment. Please note before sending your application that no further documents can be added afterwards.
Apply now - we are looking forward to it!

Your contact to us! Wit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Global Engineering realizza progetti in Pharma Technical Operations (PT), e altre divisioni all'interno di Roche su richiesta. All'interno di Global Engineering, il Manager di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) ha la responsabilità generale per la conformità, nel tempo e nella consegna di bilancio dei consegnabili Commissioning & Qualification. Il Commissioning & Qualification Manager riporta al PTT Regional Head of C&Q. Il lavoro è autodiretto in natura. Progetti / iniziative possono variare sia in termini di durata che di complessità, richiedendo ampie strategie di collaborazione interfunzionale e di esecuzione agile a supporto delle operazioni di produzione GMP, affiliati e CMO. La posizione richiede un'eccellente collaborazione interna ed esterna e influenza le competenze e la capacità di guidare squadre diverse e interfunzionali. Siete pronti a condurre progetti di ingegneria su larga scala che forniscono farmaci salvavita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo? Unisciti al nostro team di Global Engineering e assumi la responsabilità generale per la fornitura conforme e tempestiva di Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) per le nostre operazioni tecniche farmaceutiche L'opportunità Come C&Q Manager, agirai come Sub-Project Manager all'interno di Global Engineering, guidando l'eccellenza in un ambiente di team dinamico e collaborativo. Lo farai:
• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Motivate e ispira diverse squadre durante la fase C&Q, ponendo chiare aspettative e promuovendo una cultura "una squadra".
• Drive Project Success: Gestisci lo scopo del progetto C&Q per garantire che i responsabili siano soddisfatti all'interno del budget approvato e del calendario.
• Assicurare il Compliance Globale: Eseguire tutti i prodotti in pieno allineamento con il sistema di gestione della qualità farmaceutica Roche (PQS) e gli standard normativi internazionali.
• Innovare e sfida: Identificare modi migliori per raggiungere gli obiettivi introducendo best practice e innovazione per la gestione dei progetti C&Q Capex.
• Partner Strategicamente: Proattivamente costruire relazioni fiduciose con i principali stakeholder e clienti per sostenere gli obiettivi strategici di Roche. Chi sei Tu porti:
• Una laurea in Ingegneria, Scienza o una disciplina relativa.
• Corso di laurea con 6-8 anni di esperienza, Master con 5-7 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (bio), in particolare nella produzione o nella qualificazione di prodotti di droga sterili.
• Hai acquisito una particolare esperienza nella guida di un impianto di riempimento sterile del prodotto di droga che commissiona e qualifica, conducendo la messa in servizio e la qualificazione di imballaggio e assemblaggio di autoiniettori, così come nella messa in servizio e nella qualificazione dei sistemi di cleanroom.
• Conoscenza profonda delle strategie C&Q (ASTM E2500), approcci basati sui rischi e normative globali (FDA, EMA, ICH).
• Proficiente sia in tedesco che in inglese (scritto e parlato) con la capacità di regolare il vostro stile a vari pubblico.
• Il viaggio (20%) può essere richiesto per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali, al fine di guidare il team presso il sito/location del progetto. L'aspettativa se assegnata a un progetto specifico durante la progettazione o la costruzione è tenuto a trascorrere la maggior parte del tempo in loco. Questo è un ruolo a tempo pieno al 100% e localmente basato in potenziali futuri siti UE e / o Mannheim / Penzberg. Documenti di applicazione - molto pragmatico: Vi chiediamo un CV corrente in inglese e i vostri certificati/credential ufficiali (educativi). Ulteriori documenti non sono obbligatori al momento. Si prega di notare prima di inviare la domanda che nessun ulteriore documento può essere aggiunto in seguito. Applica ora - non vediamo l'ora! Il tuo contatto con noi! Wit

Melden Sie sich an unserem Global Engineering-Team und übernehmen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für die konforme und rechtzeitige Lieferung von Provisioning & Qualification (C&Q) für unsere pharmazeutischen technischen Operationen Die Chance Als C&Q Manager fungieren Sie als Sub-Project Manager in Global Engineering und treiben Exzellenz in einer dynamischen und kollaborativen Teamumgebung. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Global Engineering exécute des projets dans Pharma Technical Operations (PT), et d'autres divisions au sein de Roche sur demande. Au sein de Global Engineering, le gestionnaire de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) assume la responsabilité globale de la conformité, à temps et dans l'exécution du budget des produits livrables de la mise en service et de la qualification. Le gestionnaire de la mise en service et des qualifications relève du chef régional du PTT de C&Q. Le travail est de nature autonome. Les projets et les initiatives peuvent varier en fonction du temps et de la complexité, ce qui exige une collaboration interfonctionnelle étendue et des stratégies d'exécution agiles à l'appui des activités de fabrication des BPF, des filiales et des OCM. Le poste exige une excellente collaboration interne et externe et influe sur les compétences et la capacité de diriger diverses équipes interfonctionnelles. Êtes-vous prêt à diriger des projets d'ingénierie à grande échelle qui fournissent des médicaments qui sauvent des vies aux patients du monde entier? Rejoignez notre équipe d'ingénierie mondiale et prenez la responsabilité globale de la mise en service et de la qualification (C&Q) conformes et en temps opportun pour nos activités techniques pharmaceutiques L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire de C&Q, vous agirez comme gestionnaire de sous-projets au sein de Global Engineering, conduisant à l'excellence dans un environnement d'équipe dynamique et collaboratif. Vous:
• Équipes interfonctionnelles de premier plan : motiver et inspirer diverses équipes pendant la phase C&Q, établir des attentes claires et favoriser une culture « une seule équipe ».

• Assurer la conformité mondiale : Exécuter tous les produits livrables en pleine conformité avec le système de gestion de la qualité pharmaceutique Roche (SQP) et les normes réglementaires internationales.
• Innover et relever le défi : trouver de meilleures façons d'atteindre les objectifs en introduisant des pratiques exemplaires et de l'innovation pour la gestion de projet C&Q Capex.

• Baccalauréat avec 6-8 ans d'expérience, Master avec 5-7 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie (bio)pharmaceutique, en particulier dans la fabrication ou la qualification stérile de produits pharmaceutiques.
• Vous avez acquis une expérience particulière dans la conduite d'une installation de remplissage stérile de produits pharmaceutiques, la mise en service et la qualification de l'emballage et de l'assemblage d'autoinjecteurs, ainsi que dans la mise en service et la qualification des systèmes de salle blanche.

jobs.title: Global Strategic Pricing Leader

titleByLocale.fr: Leader stratégique mondial de la tarification

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche .

At Roche Diagnostics, we are driven by our vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, and changing lives. We are excited to see this vision come to life.

The opportunity
Join our team as the Global Strategic Pricing leader in the Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P) team. You'll play a vital role in developing strategic global pricing guidance for our products and solutions, collaborating closely with global, regional, and local teams to optimize revenues and ensure sustainable access. Be part of shaping our global pricing strategy and policy for a brighter future.
Your impact:

• Lead the design and implementation of global value-based pricing strategies for prioritized pipeline and on-market products, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability.

• Co-lead the roll-out of pricing strategies, including innovative pricing and contracting solutions, in collaboration with access and commercial stakeholders to drive market access and profitability.

• Act as the main responsible for exception management, providing clear guidance and supporting affiliates with local strategy development to address access barriers.

• Be the key responsible for price monitoring and insights generation using internal databases (e.g., DIAprice, sCORE), delivering actionable insights to affiliates, regions, and IBTs.

• Establish and lead pricing committee meetings, issue price memos, and drive pricing governance, including the maintenance and monitoring of pricing policies, controls, and KPIs (e.g., floor price).

• Conduct and leverage primary and secondary payer, reimbursement, and pricing research to inform global strategy and provide consolidated pricing and reimbursement advice to relevant product teams.

• Partner cross-functionally to inform IBTs and their Product Managers on recommended price setting, ensuring adherence to relevant governance processes.

Who You Are

• Minimum 8-10 years of professional experience with recognized expertise in pricing and reimbursement, preferably in the diagnostics, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry. Affiliate and/or regional experience is a plus.

• Possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field such as business, finance, economics, health economics, life sciences, or public health. An MBA or other Graduate/higher-level Degree is beneficial.

• Deep financial and commercial understanding with in-depth knowledge of the global reimbursement environment, competitive intelligence, and market segmentation for effective global price setting.

• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen with strong influencing, negotiation, and Agile leadership skills to excel in a global matrix organization and lead diverse multicultural teams.

• Committed to permanently optimizing processes to increase quality and efficiency standards and implement pricing competence and awareness across the organization through training and support.

Essential Skills

• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Must be able to design and implement global value-based pricing strategies, utilizing analytics to assess elasticity, forecast trends, and manage profitability. Deep financial and commercial understanding is critical.

Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche . A Roche Diagnostics, siamo guidati dalla nostra visione: innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute e cambiare la vita. Siamo entusiasti di vedere questa visione nascere. L'opportunità Unisciti al nostro team come leader Global Strategic Pricing nel team Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Potrai svolgere un ruolo vitale nello sviluppo di una guida strategica globale dei prezzi per i nostri prodotti e le nostre soluzioni, collaborando a stretto contatto con i team globali, regionali e locali per ottimizzare i ricavi e garantire un accesso sostenibile. Essere parte di modellare la nostra strategia globale dei prezzi e la politica per un futuro più luminoso. Il tuo impatto:
• Guidare la progettazione e l'implementazione di strategie globali di prezzi basati sul valore per le pipeline prioritarie e i prodotti on-market, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze di previsione e gestire la redditività.
• Co-promuovere il roll-out delle strategie di pricing, comprese le soluzioni innovative di pricing e contracting, in collaborazione con gli stakeholder di accesso e commerciali per guidare l'accesso al mercato e la redditività.
• Agire come principale responsabile della gestione delle eccezioni, fornire una chiara guida e sostenere gli affiliati con lo sviluppo di strategia locale per affrontare le barriere di accesso.
• Essere la chiave responsabile per il monitoraggio dei prezzi e la generazione di insight utilizzando database interni (ad esempio, DIAprice, sCORE), fornendo informazioni attuabili a affiliati, regioni e IBT.
• Stabilire e condurre riunioni dei comitati di prezzi, emettere i memo dei prezzi, e guidare la governance dei prezzi, compreso il mantenimento e il monitoraggio delle politiche dei prezzi, dei controlli e dei KPI (ad esempio, prezzo del pavimento).
• Condurre e sfruttare il payer primario e secondario, il rimborso e la ricerca sui prezzi per informare la strategia globale e fornire consulenza consolidata sui prezzi e sui rimborsi ai rispettivi team di prodotto.
• Partner interfunzionalmente per informare gli IBT e i loro Product Manager sull'impostazione dei prezzi consigliati, garantendo l'adesione ai processi di governance rilevanti. Chi sei
• Minimo 8-10 anni di esperienza professionale con competenze riconosciute nei prezzi e nel rimborso, preferibilmente nella diagnostica, dispositivo medico, o industria farmaceutica. Affiliazione e/o esperienza regionale è un plus.
• Possedere una laurea in un campo rilevante come affari, finanza, economia, economia sanitaria, scienze della vita, o la salute pubblica. Un MBA o un altro laureato / diploma di livello superiore è vantaggioso.
• Profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale con una conoscenza approfondita dell'ambiente di rimborso globale, dell'intelligenza competitiva e della segmentazione di mercato per un'efficace impostazione dei prezzi globale.
• Acumen Strategico e Analitico Dimostrato con forti influenze, negoziazioni e capacità di leadership Agile per eccellere in un'organizzazione di matrice globale e condurre diverse squadre multiculturali.
• Impegnati a ottimizzare in modo permanente i processi per aumentare gli standard di qualità ed efficienza e implementare le competenze e la consapevolezza dei prezzi in tutta l'organizzazione attraverso la formazione e il supporto. Abilità essenziali
• Acumen strategico e analitico: deve essere in grado di progettare e implementare strategie di prezzi basate sul valore globale, utilizzando analisi per valutare l'elasticità, le tendenze delle previsioni e gestire la redditività. La profonda comprensione finanziaria e commerciale è critica.

So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche . Die Gelegenheit Begleiten Sie unser Team als Global Strategic Pricing Leader im Team Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entwicklung einer strategischen globalen Preisorientierung für unsere Produkte und Lösungen spielen und eng mit globalen, regionalen und lokalen Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Einnahmen zu optimieren und einen nachhaltigen Zugang zu gewährleisten. Seien Sie Teil unserer globalen Preisstrategie und Politik für eine hellere Zukunft. Ihre Wirkung:
• Führen Sie die Gestaltung und Umsetzung globaler wertebasierter Preisstrategien für priorisierte Pipeline- und On-Marke-Produkte, wobei Analytik zur Beurteilung von Elastizität, Prognosetrends und zur Verwaltung von Rentabilität verwendet wird.
• Ko-Leitfaden für die Einführung von Preisstrategien, einschließlich innovativer Preis- und Vertragslösungen, in Zusammenarbeit mit Zugang und kommerziellen Interessenvertretern, um Marktzugang und Rentabilität zu fördern.
• Aktivieren Sie als Hauptverantwortlicher für das Ausnahmemanagement, bieten klare Anleitungen und unterstützende Partner mit der lokalen Strategieentwicklung, um die Zugangsbarrieren anzusprechen.
• Seien Sie der Schlüssel, der für die Preisüberwachung und Einsichten-Generierung mit internen Datenbanken (z.B. DIAprice, sCORE) verantwortlich ist und hilfreiche Einsichten für Affiliate, Regionen und IBTs liefert.
• Einrichtung und Leitung von Sitzungen des Preisausschusses, Ausgabe von Preis-Memos und treiben die Preis-Governance, einschließlich der Wartung und Überwachung von Preispolitiken, Kontrollen und KPIs (z.B. Bodenpreis).
• Führen und nutzen primäre und sekundäre Zahler, Rückerstattung und Preisforschung, um die globale Strategie zu informieren und konsolidierte Preis- und Erstattungsberatung an relevante Produktteams zu bieten.
• Partner interfunktional, um IBTs und ihre Produktmanager über die empfohlene Preiseinstellung zu informieren, um die Einhaltung relevanter Governance-Prozesse zu gewährleisten. Wer bist du?
• Mindestens 8-10 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit anerkanntem Know-how in der Preis- und Rückerstattung, vorzugsweise in der Diagnostik, Medizintechnik oder Pharmaindustrie. Affiliate und/oder regionale Erfahrung ist ein Plus.
• Besteht einen Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich wie Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Life Sciences oder öffentliche Gesundheit. Ein MBA oder ein anderer Graduierten/Hochgrad ist vorteilhaft.
• Tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis mit fundierten Kenntnissen über das globale Rückerstattungsumfeld, wettbewerbsfähige Intelligenz und Marktsegmentierung für eine effektive globale Preisgestaltung.
• Demonstrated Strategic & Analytical Acumen mit starken Einfluss-, Verhandlungs- und Agile-Führungsfähigkeiten, um in einer globalen Matrix-Organisation zu exceln und verschiedene multikulturelle Teams zu führen.
• Es wird darauf hingewiesen, die Prozesse permanent zu optimieren, um Qualitäts- und Effizienzstandards zu erhöhen und Preiskompetenz und Bewusstsein in der gesamten Organisation durch Schulung und Unterstützung zu implementieren. Grundlegende Fähigkeiten
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Muss in der Lage sein, globale wertebasierte Preisstrategien zu entwerfen und umzusetzen, Analytik zur Beurteilung von Elastizität, Prognosetrends und Rentabilität zu nutzen. Ein tiefes finanzielles und kommerzielles Verständnis ist entscheidend.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui nous fait Roche. Chez Roche Diagnostics, nous sommes animés par notre vision : innover le diagnostic, façonner les soins de santé et changer les vies. Nous sommes heureux de voir cette vision prendre vie. L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe en tant que leader de la tarification stratégique mondiale dans l'équipe Diagnostics Global Access & Policy (GA&P). Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le développement d'orientations stratégiques de tarification mondiale pour nos produits et solutions, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes mondiales, régionales et locales pour optimiser les revenus et assurer un accès durable. Faites partie de l'élaboration de notre stratégie de tarification mondiale et de notre politique pour un avenir meilleur. Votre impact :
• Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies mondiales de fixation des prix fondées sur la valeur pour les pipelines prioritaires et les produits sur le marché, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, prévoir les tendances et gérer la rentabilité.
• Codiriger le déploiement de stratégies de tarification, y compris des solutions de tarification et de passation de marchés innovantes, en collaboration avec les acteurs de l'accès et du commerce pour stimuler l'accès au marché et la rentabilité.
• Agir en tant que principal responsable de la gestion des exceptions, fournir des orientations claires et aider les affiliés à élaborer une stratégie locale pour surmonter les obstacles à l'accès.
• Être la principale responsable du suivi des prix et de la production d'informations à l'aide de bases de données internes (par exemple DIAprice, sCORE), fournir des informations exploitables aux filiales, aux régions et aux IBT.
• Établir et diriger les réunions du comité des prix, publier des notes de prix et encourager la gouvernance des prix, y compris le maintien et le suivi des politiques de prix, des contrôles et des KPI (par exemple, le prix plancher).
• Mener et exploiter des recherches sur le payeur primaire et secondaire, le remboursement et les prix pour éclairer la stratégie globale et fournir des conseils consolidés en matière de prix et de remboursement aux équipes de produits concernées.
• Partenaire interfonctionnel pour informer les IBT et leurs responsables de produits sur la fixation des prix recommandée, en assurant le respect des processus de gouvernance pertinents. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 8 à 10 ans d'expérience professionnelle avec une expertise reconnue en matière de prix et de remboursement, de préférence dans l'industrie du diagnostic, du matériel médical ou pharmaceutique. L'expérience d'affiliation et/ou régionale est un plus.
• Avoir un baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent comme les affaires, les finances, l'économie, l'économie de la santé, les sciences de la vie ou la santé publique. Un MBA ou un autre diplôme d'études supérieures est bénéfique.
• Compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie avec une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement de remboursement mondial, de l'intelligence concurrentielle et de la segmentation du marché pour une fixation efficace des prix mondiaux.
• L'Acumen Stratégique et analytique démontré avec une forte influence, la négociation et Agile compétences de leadership pour exceller dans une organisation matricielle mondiale et diriger diverses équipes multiculturelles.
• S'engage à optimiser en permanence les processus afin d'améliorer les normes de qualité et d'efficacité et de mettre en œuvre les compétences et la sensibilisation en matière de tarification dans l'ensemble de l'organisation par la formation et le soutien. Compétences essentielles
• Strategic & Analytical Acumen: Doit être en mesure de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre des stratégies globales de tarification basées sur la valeur, en utilisant l'analyse pour évaluer l'élasticité, les tendances prévisionnelles et gérer la rentabilité. Une compréhension financière et commerciale approfondie est essentielle.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Summary: As the Operations Quality Site Head for Suzhou, you are fully accountable for the quality of the products manufactured at the site and for ensuring end-to-end compliance with global specifications, local Health Authority regulations, and corporate quality standards. You serve as a key member of the Global perations Quality Leadership Team (GOQLT) and the Site Leadership Team, modeling Agile behaviors and driving operational excellence. Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities: Drive business results and customer value a) Responsible for ensuring that manufactured products in Suzhou meet Health Authority regulations, Notified Body requirements, Company standards and expectations. Establish and support inspection readiness to ensure successful outcomes. Prepare adequate and timely responses to any inspection observations and implement appropriate and thorough corrections, as necessary. b) Engage and influence the organization to ensure that Product Quality is our focus by ensuring that products manufactured in Suzhou meet regulatory requirements and product specifications. Works directly in a complex, global environment with the chapters and the other Network Leads to deliver high quality products, ensure our right to operate and continuously improve. c) Provide leadership and guidance to staff directing Quality functions, manage performance and development of direct reports to ensure achievement of organizational, and departmental goals and a productive environment. d) Maintain an effective Quality governance and continually improve the governance to meet business and compliance needs. Communicate significant quality or regulatory issues and risks that may impact product quality or regulatory compliance in a timely manner to Executive Management. e) Develop annual budget, revise forecasts to meet business needs and monitor/control expenditures to assure efficient use of company resources. f) Appointed as the Site Management Representative and Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) equivalent under China Medical Device GMP regulations and international standards (e.g., ISO 13485:2016). Accountable for ensuring the site’s technical documentation, quality management systems, and regulatory filings are meticulously drawn up, maintained up-to-date, and fully aligned with NMPA, FDA, and European regulations to safeguard our right to operate. 2. Advance the work of the Network, making tradeoffs and breaking silos a) Partner with the Operations Site Head on strategic business direction and decisions. Break down silos and improve working effectiveness as an “integrator” across the organization as needed; in particular through collaboration with other Networks Leaders and stakeholders to resolve escalated bottlenecks and dependencies, as well as rebalance work & help in line with greater strategic priorities. b) Build and maintain strong partnerships with other site and network leaders to assure alignment around strategic projects and day-to-day activities and to assure mutually successful working relationships. c) Coordinate with Functional Partners to aggregate upcoming LCTs’ needs and upcoming priorities, to better understand upcoming resource demands on the Network. Empower and enable the Network a) Develop and communicate organizational strategies, which ensure the GMP compliance of the site, continuous improvements and achievement of long-term goals. b) Negotiate with Senior Leadership across the organization to influence decision making. c) Lead,

jobs.title: Spécialiste SHE (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
Dans le cadre de l’application de la réglementation Française, des directives du Groupe et des normes, le spécialiste SHE définit et garantit le bon fonctionnement et le suivi des procédures liées à la Santé, la Sécurité, l’Hygiène et l’Environnement (SHE) afin de prévenir et réduire les risques SHE au sein de l’entreprise.
Par ailleurs, le spécialiste SHE fait vivre la politique SHE du Groupe Roche au sein de la filiale.

Principales Responsabilités:

DU et Prévention des Risques Physiques et Psychosociaux au travail

• De manière générale, le spécialiste SHE est responsable de définir et mettre en oeuvre la politique de gestion et de prévention des risques professionnels au sein de l’entreprise et vis à vis de nos clients, dans le respect des normes et procédures applicables et la diffusion d’une culture de la prévention dans l’entreprise le spécialiste SHE pilote en outre l'organisation SST et guides et serres files (formation, zoning….)

• Il est également responsable de l’analyse et de la prévention des risques inhérents aux postes de travail, que ce soit au siège, en itinérance ou chez nos Clients, en lien avec notre DUERP, afin de mener des actions ciblés (ex : risque routier, geste et posture, EPI, ergonomie, etc)

• Il participe à la détection, la prise en charge et le suivi des potentiels cas de RPS en lien avec les parties prenantes que sont les RH, les élus et le pôle santé

• Il a la responsabilité partagée du suivi de l’accidentologie et la gestion administrative associées (enquête suite à accident, déclaration, tenue des registres, reporting etc…) et d’identifier si besoin les actions correctives immédiates afin de limiter le risque - notamment en lien avec les initiatives groupe

• Il organise des visites périodiques des installations avec les parties prenantes pour s’assurer de la bonne conformité et application des mesures de sécurité du site.

Onboarding des nouveaux collaborateurs et Veille règlementaire

• Organisation des formations SHE : identification des besoins, planification, suivi démarche d'accueil des nouveaux embauchés, mais également suivi et organisation des formations de recyclage (habilitations électriques, SST, etc)

• Est responsable que l’entreprise soit toujours à jour des évolutions réglementaires dans les domaines sécurité des personnes et environnement, dans ses pratiques et procédures ainsi que dans la mise à jour de la plateforme du Groupe.

Gestion des déchets

• Amélioration de nos processus et solutions pour réduire la production de nos déchets sur le site et suivi des déchets chez nos prestataires (notamment DEEE)

Reporting

• Définit et réalise en temps et en heures les reporting associés à son activité

• (reporting SHE, et contribution au rapport RSE, BDES etc...)

RSE interne et Externe

• Participe au comité de pilotage RSE et à l’élaboration du rapport annuel

• Actions de communication sur l’ensemble des activités

• Partie client (plan de prévention)

• Prépare les sujets CSSCT en lien avec son expertise

Audit SHE et SQB

• Mise en place d’audits auprès des fournisseurs critiques (dans le cadre d’une qualification ou d’un suivi : audit documentaire ou physique)

• Participe au Supplier Quality Board (SQB)

Biosafety Officer

• Evaluation et gestion des risques biologiques et chimiques

• Conformité et réglementation : veiller au respect strict des lois locales et internationales

• Sensibiliser, former les collaborateurs aux bonnes pratiques

• Superviser les protocoles de décontamination et d

jobs.title: Medical Affairs (Field MSL) - Neuro - NSW/QLD

titleByLocale.de: Medizinische Angelegenheiten (Field MSL) - Neuro - NSW / QLD

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Join us in making this happen with:

• Effective customer engagement across NSW and QLD

• Expertise in the field of Neuroscience (Multiple sclerosis)

• Medical Science Liaison (MSL) experience within the healthcare setting

This field based Medical Affairs (MSL) position is internally referred to as the Medical Patient Journey Partner (M-PJP). This is a local customer facing role unlocking value along the patient journey - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards integrated solutions, much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption.

The M-PJP is a medical affairs role with a reporting line culminating with the Country Medical Director; this role has a Quality Use of Medicines (QUM) focus and operates at all times with non-promotional intent.

The M-PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster (the “triple win”).

What you will be working on:
The M-PJP is an empowered leader and the local medical affairs face of Roche who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche. In this role, you will be involved in:

• Scientific Leadership: Serve as a scientific expert for the company’s Neuroscience pipeline and marketed products, providing deep expertise to internal teams and external stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Build and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), clinical investigators, and academic researchers within the Neuroscience field.

• Education & Training: Provide scientific education and training to healthcare professionals, internal teams, and partners, ensuring accurate, up-to-date information about our products.

• Evidence Generation and Clinical Support: Support clinical trial development by providing scientific insights and collaborating with clinical teams on ongoing and upcoming clinical trials.

• Data Communication: Effectively communicate complex scientific data, including clinical trial results, in a clear, concise manner to a wide range of audiences.

• Field Intelligence: Gather and analyze scientific and clinical insights from the field, and provide feedback to shape product strategy, development, and commercialization efforts.

• Compliance & Documentation: Ensure all interactions comply with industry regulations and ethical standards. Maintain accurate documentation of scientific activities.

Who you are:
As a driven medical affairs professional, you think from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally. You have:

• University degree (life sciences) and/or Healthcare professional qualification with practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies. An advanced degree in Life Sciences and/or MBA is a plus

• At least 5 years of demonstrated experience in the medical affairs or related field (e.g. MSL) within in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry with up to date knowledge of Medicines Australia Code of Conduct

• Scientific and Therapy Area expertise in Neuroscience in mapping patient journeys and related treatments in the assigned TA, enabling engagement at the specialist level

• Ro
