This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations is focused on delivering professional IT support for our Roche affiliates in the EMEA region and globally as well in cooperation with our service centers in Costa Rica and Malaysia. Our teams consist of English, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish and French speaking Service Desk Specialists from beginners to highly skilled professionals.

Disclosure Note: The final job title is Employee Experience Operations IT Specialist.

The Opportunity

• Provide first-level support for software and hardware incidents and service requests across Mac, Windows, Microsoft Office, and Google environments.

• Engage with users across multiple channels, including phone, chat, and self-service portal.

• Thrive as a key member of a truly AI-powered IT support operations team.

• Champion the end-users' needs, escalating critical situations as required to ensure swift resolution.

• Keep users updated on their request status, guiding them toward the best solutions for their productivity and satisfaction.

Who you are

We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University education in IT or related discipline is preferred

• 1.5 - 2 years of experience in call center, service desk, or IT desk-side support

• Experience with Apple and Microsoft operating systems, Google suite, Microsoft Office products, SAP, corporate networks, and video conferencing systems

• Strong troubleshooting, task prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in German and English

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

​ Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Mission:
En tant que Key Account Manager Comptes Publics et rattaché(e) au SubChapter Lead Key Account Manager, vous intégrez une équipe dynamique et êtes Expert(e) des comptes stratégiques.

Vous êtes la voix des clients et représentez Roche auprès de ces derniers. A ce titre, vous avez une compréhension parfaite de la cartographie des interlocuteurs et de la matrice décisionnelle des comptes, de l'environnement, des enjeux et visions stratégiques des clients. Vous avez également une vue précise du positionnement compétitif de Roche vis à vis de ces enjeux, ce qui vous permet de définir et porter la responsabilité de la stratégie commerciale et financière des comptes - existant(s) ou futur(s). Enfin, vous définissez la stratégie de négociation et la mettez en œuvre

Localisation idéale : région Parisienne

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous déterminez la stratégie Roche Diagnostics France à déployer pour les grands comptes publics sous votre responsabilité, en identifiant les leviers soutenant le développement d’un partenariat solide et capable de générer de la valeur pour toutes les parties.

• A toutes les étapes de la relation commerciale, vous identifiez et saisissez les différentes opportunités au sein des comptes pour contribuer à l’atteinte des objectifs stratégiques de Roche; en collaboration avec les experts internes, notamment les équipes commerciales, vous co-designez et proposez les solutions Roche adaptées aux besoins des clients et différenciantes. Vous êtes responsable de l'atteinte des objectifs business, de l'évolution du chiffre d'affaires et de la profitabilité des comptes.

• En étroite collaboration avec le chef de projet Appels d'Offres, vous coordonnez l’équipe projet engagée autour de la construction de la réponse et vous vous assurez que celle ci permettra l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux et financier attendus; Vous vous assurez également de la bonne contractualisation en adéquation avec les règles du groupe et de la filiale.

• Responsable de la bonne exécution des marchés notifiés et de la satisfaction du client, vous mettez en place et suivez les indicateurs de performance pertinents pour les comptes sous votre responsabilité et engagez les équipes sur l’amélioration continue des actions; Vous êtes garant(e) de la pertinence et de l'efficacité du schéma de communication au sein des comptes.

• Squad lead: en collaboration avec les chapter/subchapter leads, vous identifiez les compétences requises et constituez une équipe engagée autour des besoins du client, la stratégie commerciale, l'atteinte des objectifs et du plan d'actions.

• Vous vous assurez de la bonne compréhension, par les membres de la squad, de l’actualité du compte et de notre position compétitive, afin que l’équipe soit en mesure de prioriser ses actions. Vous tenez l’équipe informée des KPIs des comptes et engagez avec elle toutes les actions nécessaires à l’atteinte de nos objectifs et la satisfaction client.

• Ambassadeur Compliance : vous garantissez le respect de la compliance dans les relations avec le client

• Vous garantissez la justesse et l'exhaustivité des information relatives au client dont vous avez la charge dans le CRM

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous possédez une forte compréhension des enjeux stratégiques et business du secteur du Diagnostic In Vitro et, plus largement, de l’industrie de la Santé.

• Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation commerciale et de gestion de projet. Une culture scientifique constitue un réel atout.

• Vous faites

jobs.title: Supply Chain Assistant (1 year contract)

titleByLocale.it: Assistente a catena di fornitura (1 anno di contratto)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Purpose
To provide essential administrative and operational support to the supply chain and logistics team. This role focuses on executing day-to-day routine tasks, including sales order data entry, basic inventory monitoring, and assisting with shipment follow-ups, to ensure the overall supply chain workflow operates smoothly.

Responsibility & Accountability

• Responsible for sales order intake and planning of delivery schedules to ensure timely delivery and commitment to customers' requests.

• Perform accurate data entry for customer orders into the SAP system.

• Maintain good after-sales service and customer engagement.

• Coordinate with 3PL to ensure that inbound shipments are received and stored on time and achieve the KPI target.

• Follow up and communicate with the global headquarters on shipment and delivery statuses.

• Handle export China shipments under the guidance of senior team members.

• Assist in the inventory movement and monitoring process.

• Assist the team in preparing timely reports on all aspects of the Supply Chain.

• Assist in manipulating SAP data for analysis purposes.

• Assist the team to streamline process flows or practices to improve efficiency by learning and exploring new technology.

• Collaborate with different internal and external stakeholders in various projects.

Requirements:
Education:

• HKDSE (Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education), Form 5/Form 7 graduate, or a Diploma/Certificate in Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:
0–2 years of working experience in customer service, data entry, or clerical support.

• Fresh graduates with a positive learning attitude are highly welcome.

• Previous experience with SAP or similar ERP systems is an advantage but not strictly required.

Competency:

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on data entry accuracy.

• Proficient in MS Office applications (Word, Excel) and Chinese word processing.

• Good basic command of written and spoken English and Mandarin.

• Patient, responsible, and a strong team player able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Alliance Director
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Corporate Business Development (CBD) is dedicated to sourcing innovation outside of the Company by identifying compounds that fit into our pipeline, looking for technologies that can be integrated into our drug discovery process and diagnostics, establishing connections with academic institutions and other life sciences companies and entering into and managing collaborations. Together with R&D this is a key pillar of the Pharma business and our aim is to transform promising innovation into healthcare solutions of the future. Our approach to partnering is open and flexible. We aim to accelerate innovation in China by helping our partners expand their impact on patient health through joint development and delivery of novel therapies; the Global Alliance Management function within Roche is leading all strategic partnerships across the globe and we are proud to be recognized amongst the best in the industry.
We are looking for a Global Alliance Director (GAD) to join our Global Alliance Management team in Shanghai. You shall have the responsibility of managing a portfolio of China based alliances while closely interfacing with Alliance Directors in Basel and San Francisco. You will interact with senior leadership of partner companies and actively liaise with Asia Partnering as well as other Roche functions including PD, GPS, pRED, gRED, CiCor and Dia Partnering. The incumbent for the role shall be strongly connected to the China ecosystem including biotech companies and VCs and act as a facilitator and catalyst for our efforts and partnerships in China. This role will report to Beth Odeh-Frikert and is based in Shanghai.

Your responsibilities shall include:

• Successfully lead and manage a portfolio of China-based alliances.

• Establish and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Chinese partners to align expectations, anticipate challenges, and effectively resolve operational issues as they arise. Drive alliance governance and operational processes, proactively identify and address key risks and issues, and lead by influence across cross-functional teams. Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and proactively manage conflicts and escalations in the best interest of the alliance.

• Partner closely with Basel and SSF based Global Alliance Directors (GADs) to support their alliance portfolios with Chinese partners. Act as an internal advisor and facilitator for Basel/SSF-led alliances and provide local context to help the global GADs navigate language, cultural nuances and business etiquette.

• Act as a center of expertise for China partnerships and systematically share local market insights, regulatory knowledge and relationship best practices to empower and upskill global GADs in Basel and SSF.

• Actively build and sustain high-value relationships within the Chinese biotech and VC ecosystems to drive collaborative initiatives and identify scalable partnership opportunities

• Identify, lead negotiations and implement necessary contractual amendments, and/or subsequent agreements in coordination with BD, Finance, Legal and all relevant internal stakeholders

• Brief Roche senior management on the strategy and status of assigned China alliances as needed

• Represent Corporate Business Development in public forums (conferences, congresses, other presentation opportunities) in China

In order to be successful in this role, you have:

• Advanced degree (i.e. Master, Diploma, MD, PhD, PharmD) in business, finance or science related field

• Significant

We aim to accelerate innovation in China by helping our partners expand their impact on patient health through joint development and delivery of novel therapies; the Global Alliance Management function within Roche is leading all strategic partnerships across the globe and we are proud to be recognized amongst the best in the industry. We are looking for a Global Alliance Director (GAD) to join our Global Alliance Management team in Shanghai. You shall have the responsibility of managing a portfolio of China based alliances while closely interfacing with Alliance Directors in Basel and San Francisco. You will interact with senior leadership of partner companies and actively liaise with Asia Partnering as well as other Roche functions including PD, GPS, pRED, gRED, CiCor and Dia Partnering. The incumbent for the role shall be strongly connected to the China ecosystem including biotech companies and VCs and act as a facilitator and catalyst for our efforts and partnerships in China. This role will report to Beth Odeh-Frikert and is based in Shanghai. Your responsibilities shall include:
• Successfully lead and manage a portfolio of China-based alliances.
• Establish and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with Chinese partners to align expectations, anticipate challenges, and effectively resolve operational issues as they arise. Drive alliance governance and operational processes, proactively identify and address key risks and issues, and lead by influence across cross-functional teams. Ensure adherence to contractual obligations and proactively manage conflicts and escalations in the best interest of the alliance.
• Partner closely with Basel and SSF based Global Alliance Directors (GADs) to support their alliance portfolios with Chinese partners. Act as an internal advisor and facilitator for Basel/SSF-led alliances and provide local context to help the global GADs navigate language, cultural nuances and business etiquette.
• Act as a center of expertise for China partnerships and systematically share local market insights, regulatory knowledge and relationship best practices to empower and upskill global GADs in Basel and SSF.
• Actively build and sustain high-value relationships within the Chinese biotech and VC ecosystems to drive collaborative initiatives and identify scalable partnership opportunities
• Identify, lead negotiations and implement necessary contractual amendments, and/or subsequent agreements in coordination with BD, Finance, Legal and all relevant internal stakeholders
• Brief Roche senior management on the strategy and status of assigned China alliances as needed
• Represent Corporate Business Development in public forums (conferences, congresses, other presentation opportunities) in China In order to be successful in this role, you have:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for an enthusiastic and agile successor for our People Support Solutions Team Lead position within the People Support Solutions German Network . In this role, you will lead a team of HR generalists providing first-line support to our German-based employees, managing a diverse and high-impact portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead and inspire a team of HR specialists providing first-line support across the entire German network.

• Manage a diverse portfolio encompassing Employee Lifecycle Management, Compensation, Payroll, Time & Benefits, and Compliance.

• Navigate an extensive stakeholder network , partnering closely with Business & Talent Acquisition Partners and various Project Teams.

• Drive operational excellence by supporting your team in solving complex cases and engaging in demanding professional conversations.

• Benefit from a broad professional scope , moving beyond a single vertical to master a diversified P&C service landscape.

• Empower your team to take E2E accountability, fostering an environment where self-management and initiative are the norms.

• Act as a catalyst for growth , helping team members navigate transformations and reorganizations with confidence.

Who You Are

• A seasoned People Leader with at least 1 year of direct Line Management experience and a passion for developing others.

• Fluent in German (near-native/C1-C2) with the ability to communicate with sophistication and nuance in a regulated business environment.

• Highly proficient in English , enabling you to collaborate effectively within our global corporate structure.

• An empathetic leader who prioritizes empowerment, coaching, and a people-first mindset in your daily leadership practice.

• A strategic navigator comfortable managing complex stakeholder networks and diagnosing organizational needs.

• A disciplined professional with a university degree (HR or Business preferred) and a strong grasp of logical reasoning.

• An agile specialist who may come from a Second Level background but is ready to master the diverse, fast-paced world of Front Line HR.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science

jobs.title: Global Access Engagement and Reimbursement Leader - Roche Diagnostics

titleByLocale.it: Leader globale dell'engagement and Reimbursement di accesso - Roche Diagnostics
titleByLocale.en: Global Access Engagement and Reimbursement Leader - Roche Diagnostics
titleByLocale.de: Global Access Engagement und Reimbursement Leader - Roche Diagnostics
titleByLocale.fr: Leader mondial de l'accès et du remboursement - Roche Diagnostics

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we commit ourselves to achieving access to medical and diagnostics innovations for all. Together with our regional and country organizations, we are building health systems ready to provide the future of care and make access a reality, thus, enabling people and patients around the world to live their best lives.

This global leadership position is responsible for bringing our diagnostics solutions to the forefront of care and growing access, reimbursement and funding effectively for our established portfolio as well as our ground breaking innovations.
The incumbent will closely collaborate with the global functions in Medical, Commercial, Market Access and Health System Policy enabling our affiliates to effectively co-design and apply the global tools, setting specific access targets in their respective environments and pulling through effective plans for their realization in mutual accountability.
As you are versatile in many environments and wish to impact external access delivery, you will closely accompany affiliates in their efforts to build the health system of tomorrow. Through this lived proximity to market realities, you will enable better global tools and deliverables, always pushing for the next level in furthering our affiliate support.

The Opportunity

Your responsibilities include:

• Market Analysis and Opportunity Identification : Research and analyze access coverage, reimbursement levels, health and payer policies, competitive access landscapes to identify business opportunities enabled through access and assess the probability and impact of affecting positive change.

• Access Insight and Strategy Development : Apply expertise in consolidating and providing relevant access insights and supporting the development and execution of global access strategies and impactful access tools including the Access Reimbursement Toolkit.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.

• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.

• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.

• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.

• Requires travel of up to 20%

Who you are

• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred

• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

• Strategic Access Engagement Leadership : Act as a catalyst and coach for regional and affiliate implementation of global access strategies, identifying gaps, tailoring approaches, and accelerating time to reimbursement and the effective funding for your prioritized products.
• Global-Regional-Affiliate Interface : Create frameworks for efficient transfer of global strategies and catalyze learning, sharing, and collaboration across organizations and territories by leading the Access Nexus pilot of your area - our key interface to the Regions and Countries driving your work in achieving reimbursement and funding.
• Affiliate Support : Support regions and affiliates in executing payer-relevant access approaches, addressing access, reimbursement and funding barriers holistically, and leading projects to enhance local access capabilities with delivering tangible business growth through the realization of access opportunities.
• Shaping Sustainable Healthcare Systems : Support regions and affiliates in building plans and networks that aim for the creation of sustainable Health Care Systems in affecting the regulatory frameworks of payers, Health Technology Assessment bodies and their advising network.
• Requires travel of up to 20% Who you are
• Master’s degree in business economics, life sciences, public health, marketing, or a related discipline; additional educational programs in market access preferred
• 5+ years of commercial and/or access experience in the diagnostic/pharmaceutical or related industry. Additional experience in related functions such as Strategy, Marketing, or Health Policy preferred.

jobs.title: Director, Customer Support Center
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Director, Customer Support Center

The Opportunity:
As the Director of Customer Support Center for Roche Diagnostics USA, you will lead the evolution of our support ecosystem into a next-generation diagnostic hub. Your primary goal is to minimize instrument downtime by championing Remote-First resolution. By integrating AI-assisted troubleshooting tools with our core platforms, you will empower our frontline experts to solve complex clinical and technical issues with unprecedented speed and accuracy. You will serve as a strategic leader who bridges the gap between high-level business objectives and world-class service delivery.

We are seeking a transformational leader who thrives on variety. You don’t just manage a department; you look for ways to help the entire company win. You are as comfortable leading a cross-functional project as you are implementing a new AI-guided troubleshooting tool, all while ensuring your team feels secure, valued, and empowered in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

Job Facts:

1. Strategic Leadership & Remote Excellence

• Expedited Fix Strategy: Define the roadmap for a proactive support model, utilizing assistive technologies within ServiceMax and Salesforce to increase first-contact resolution and maximize laboratory uptime.

• Operational & Financial Oversight: Direct accountability for expense budgets (P&L), resource planning, and performance data to ensure a cost-effective, high-output operation.

• Omnichannel Innovation: Oversee the optimization of CCaaS platforms (e.g., Genesys) to ensure seamless, data-driven interactions across all customer touchpoints.

2. People-Centric Innovation

• Augmented Support: Oversee the implementation of 'co-pilot' technologies—like predictive error mapping and automated case surfacing—that simplify complex workflows and protect agents from burnout.

• Change Management: Lead with transparency to ensure the team views new digital tools as career-enhancing assets rather than replacements.

• Talent Development: Direct all HR activities, including recruitment, training, and career planning, to build a resilient pipeline of leadership talent.

3. Strategic Business Partnership & Enterprise Impact

• Cross-Functional Synergy: Act as a high-level consultant to internal partners (Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Field Service), aligning support strategies to directly bolster sales objectives and product reliability.

• Commercial Alignment: Partner with Sales leadership to ensure that our service excellence becomes a competitive differentiator and a primary driver of contract renewals.

• Silo-Breaking Leadership: Navigate our matrixed organization to build consensus and lead initiatives that require cooperation across multiple departments to solve systemic customer pain points.

• Dynamic Flexibility: Proactively take on additional responsibilities and pivot resources to support other departments during periods of high demand or special product launches.

4. Compliance & Technical Quality

• Regulatory Stewardship: Ensure every remote-fix protocol and service action strictly adheres to Roche’s quality system and FDA/global regulatory requirements.

• Service Integrity: Maintain a work culture 100% committed to accuracy, ensuring that remote interventions provide the same level of reliability as an on-site visit.

Who You Are (Required Qualifications & Experience):

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Clinical Laboratory, Business or rel

jobs.title: Principal DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Principal DevOps Engineer (DevOps Lead)

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.

Description
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity
The Principal DevOps​ ​Engineer​ (DevOps Lead) ​is a key member in engineering and DevOps groups and will apply knowledge of design principles, practices in the implementation of complex, enterprise-scale software systems. The Principal engineer is a hands-on leader of the DevOps function. General responsibilities include design concept generation, participating in reviews for components or features, development, and testing of the core software stack, and reliability testing.

Key Responsibilities:

• Software​ ​Development​: This is a software development position to write high quality software that will perform at scale, be supportable, and be extensible

• Process​ ​&​ ​Operations: Ensure the software stack integrates with our existing CI pipeline and contribute to continuous improvement; independently design, plan and deliver high-quality software

• Leadership​: Ensure a culture that values technical excellence together with support and compassion for individuals

• Evangelism: As a key evangelist, you will work to evangelize a healthy DevSecOps software development practice within the Roche Engineering Community

Who You Are:

• BS in Computer Science, or Computer Engineering, or related field.

• 10+ years of hands-on experience in public cloud AWS, Google, or Azure (AWS Preferred) of which at the minimum 5 years of experience in the software industry.

• Scripting experience is required and highly desirable, using shell, python, ruby, or similar languages.

• Experience leading DevOps teams and in building and maturing CI/CD pipelines

• Expertise in overall areas in DevSecOps including CI/CD with build & release, Internal tooling, and production operations.

• Build and operation tools that monitor backend production, Make sure backend services scale economically, Develop tooling framework, Help the dev team resolve production issues

• Hands-on System Administration experience with Unix based systems including experience with system configuration and networking (DNS, DHCP, rout tables and routing).

• Experience automating using infrastructure as code: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, etc.

• Hands-on automation development using chef or ansible desired

• Experience deploying or managing large scale distributed Unix environments Partake in an on-call rotation alongside the engineers who build our production backends, Comfortable with large scale production systems and technologies, including load balancing, monitoring, distributed systems, and/or configuration management.

• Experience in contemporary platforms extended from cloud such as docker containers, Mesos, and/or Ku

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Il ruolo di Principal DevOps Engineer (DevOps Lead) è un membro chiave dei gruppi di ingegneria e DevOps e applichiamo conoscenze di principi di progettazione, pratiche nell'implementazione di sistemi software a scala enterprise complessi. L'ingegnere principale è un leader a mano a funzione DevOps. Le responsabilità generali comprendono la generazione di concetti di progettazione, la partecipazione a revisioni per componenti o funzionalità, lo sviluppo e la verifica del core software stack, e la verifica della affidabilità. Responsabilità chiave: - Sviluppo software: Questo è un ruolo di sviluppo software per scrivere software di qualità alta che eseguirà a scala, sarà support e sarà estensibile. - Processi e operazioni: Assicurarsi che lo stack software si integri con il nostro pipeline esistente CI e contribuire alla continua miglioramento; pianificazione, pianificazione e ricezione software di alta qualità in modo indipendente. - Leadership: Assicurarsi una cultura che valorizzi l'eccellenza tecnica insieme con il supporto e la compassione per gli individui. - Evangelismo: Come evangelista chiave, lavorerai per evangelizzare una pratica di sviluppo software DevSecOps sana all'interno della comunità di ingegneria Roche.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o campo correlato. - 10+ anni di esperienza diretta in cloud pubblico AWS, Google o Azure (AWS Preferito) di cui almeno 5 anni di esperienza nell'industria software. - Esperienza di scripting è richiesta e altamente desiderabile, utilizzando shell, pitone, ruby o linguaggi simili. - Esperienza di leadership di team DevOps e nella costruzione e maturazione di pipeline CI/CD. - Esperti in aree generali di DevSecOps, inclusi CI/CD con build e rilascio, strumenti interni e operazioni di produzione. - Costruire e operare strumenti di monitoraggio per backend di produzione, Assicurarsi che i servizi backend si scalino economicamente, Piattaformare un framework di strumenti, Aiutare il team di sviluppo a risolvere problemi di produzione. - Esperienza di amministrazione di sistema diretto con sistemi Unix, inclusa esperienza con la configurazione del sistema e la rete (DNS, DHCP, tabella di routing e routing). - Esperienza di automazione utilizzando codice di infrastruttura: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, ecc. - Esperienza di sviluppo di automazione diretta utilizzando chef o desideri accessibili. - Esperienza di distribuzione o gestione di ambienti Unix suddivis a sistemi scala Partecipare a una rotazione di chiamata in on-call insieme agli ingegneri che costruiscono iscono backend di produzione, Comodo con sistemi di produzione a larga scala e tecnologie, inclusi bilanciamento del carico, monitoraggio, distribuzione e/o gestione della configurazione. - Esperienza in piattaforme contemporanee estese dal cloud come contenitore Docker, Mesos e/o Ku. Cosa? - Una cultura che valorizza l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, destinata e rispettato per chi sei, voluti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. - L'opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e innovativo, dove ogni voce conta. Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare.

La responsabilité générale inclut la generazione di concetti di progettazione, la partecipazione a revisioni per componenti o funzionalità, lo sviluppo e la verifica del core software stack, e la verifica della affidabilità. Responsabilità chiave: - Sviluppo software: Questo è un ruolo di sviluppo software per scivere software di alta qualità che eseguirà a scala, sarà supportabile e sarà estensibile. - Processi e operazioni: Assicurarsi che lo empil software si integri con il nostro pipeline CI esiste e contribuire alla continua miglioramento; progettare, pianificare e consegnare software di alta qualità in modo indipendente. - Leadership: Assicurarsi una cultura che valorizzi l'eccellenza tecnica insieme con il supporto e la compassione per gli individui. - Evangelismo: Venez evangelista chiave, lavorerai per evangelizzare una pratica di sviluppo software DevSecOps sana all'interno della comunità di ingegneria Roche.
• Requisiti - Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o campo correlato. - 10+ anni di esperienza diretta in cloud pubblico AWS, Google o Azure (AWS Preferito) di cui almeno 5 anni di esperienza nell'industrie logiciel. - Esperienza di scripting è richiesta e altamente desiderabile, usingzando shell, python, ruby o linguaggi simili. - Esperienza di leadership di team DevOps e nella costruzione e maturazione di pipeline CI/CD. - Esperti in aree generali di DevSecOps, y compris CI/CD con build e rilascio, strumenti interni e opérazioni di produzione. - Costruire e opérare strumenti di monitoraggio per backend di produzione, Assicurarsi che i servizi backend si scalino economicamente, Sviluppare un framework di strumenti, Aiutare il team di sviluppo a risolvere problemi di produzione. - Esperienza di amministrazione di sistema diretta con sistemi Unix, inclusa esperienza con la configurazione del sistema e la rete (DNS, DHCP, tabella di routing e routing). - Esperienza di automazion usingzando codice di infrastruttura: AWS Cloudformation, Terraform, ecc. - Esperienza di sviluppo di automazion diretta usingzando chef o ansible desiderata. - Esperienza di distribuzione o gestione di ambienti Unix distribuiti a larga scala Partecipare a una rotazione di chiamata in on-call insieme agli ingegneri che costruiscono i backend di produzione, Comodo con sistemi di produzione a larga scala e tecnologie, inclusi bilancamento del carico, monitoaggio, sistemi distribuiti e/o gestione della configuzione. - Esperienza in piattaforme contemporanee estese dal cloud come container Docker, Mesos e/o Ku.
• Cosa offriamo - Una cultura che valorizza l'impressione personnelle, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni authentique, dove sei valorizzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, consentendoti di prosperare sia personnalmente che professionalmente. - L'opportunità di lavorare dans un ambiente dinamico e innovativo, colombe ogni voce conta. Contatto - Par ulteriori informazioni, contattaci.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du rotierst durch kaufmännische und technische Bereiche wie IT, Logistik oder Finance und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk auf.

• Du bildest die direkte Brücke zwischen den Fachbereichen und der IT und koordinierst spannende gemeinsame Projekte.

• Du entwickelst smarte IT-Lösungen von der ersten Idee über die Programmierung bis zur Einführung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum.

• Du optimierst aktiv betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse und steuerst Abläufe – sei es in der Logistik, der Produktion oder im Controlling.

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit. Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?
• Du rotierst durch vielfältige Fachbereiche wie Global IT, Produktion oder Finance und baust dir ein starkes Netzwerk auf.
• Du programmierst Software, Datenbanken und Webanwendungen unter anderem mit Python und Java.
• Du analysierst komplexe Geschäftsprozesse und übersetzt diese in passgenaue IT-Lösungen.
• Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung im IT-Projektmanagement, Consulting und dem Betrieb unserer Kernsysteme (z. B. ERP und CRM). Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Lörrach abgehalten. Für die Unterkunft in Lörrach gewähren wir einen Mietkostenzuschuss. Außerdem erhältst Du eine Fahrtkostenerstattung. Deine Vorteile bei uns: Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit. Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:
• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.
• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.
• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.
• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung. Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?
• Allgemeine Hochschulreife
• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife
• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium? 3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch. Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com. Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu. Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen.
Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du lernst Roche in seiner ganzen Vielfalt kennen: Du rotierst durch spannende Bereiche – von der IT über Logistik und Finance bis hin zum Marketing – und siehst, wie alles zusammenhängt.

• Du machst Big Data nutzbar: Du sammelst, strukturierst und analysierst komplexe Datensätze und schaffst so die Basis für wichtige Entscheidungen.

• Du erzählst die Geschichte hinter den Zahlen: Aus unübersichtlichen Rohdaten generierst du echtes Business-Wissen und wertvolle Insights.

• Du bringst KI in die Praxis: Du entwickelst smarte Algorithmen und mathematische Modelle, mit denen wir Trends und Geschäftsprozesse präzise vorhersagen können.

• Hands-on von Tag 1: Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern übernimmst Verantwortung in IT-Projekten – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Programmierung eigener Anwendungen.

Die praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert das Duale Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung. Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• In verschiedenen kaufmännischen und technischen Bereichen des Unternehmens, wie beispielsweise Logistik, Einkauf, Vertrieb, Controlling und Produktion, absolvierst Du Praxiseinsätze.

• Du planst, steuerst und gestaltest betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse, wie die Optimierung logistischer Abläufe, die Konzeption, Gestaltung und Unterstützung von Fertigungsprozessen sowie die Unterstützung des Qualitätsmanagements.

• Die Vermittlung und Koordination zwischen technischen Abteilungen und dem betriebswirtschaftlichen Umfeld übernimmst Du.

• Du entwirfst neue, innovative Technologien im betrieblichen Umfeld.

Die praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim ( Außenstelle Eppelheim ) abgehalten.
Im Hauptstudium belegst Du die Vertiefungsrichtung „Produktion und Logistik“.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.
Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen : Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung : Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Duales Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges allgemeines unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung . Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Praxiseinsätze in technischen Bereichen des Unternehmens, z. B. Logistik, Forschung & Entwicklung, Produktion, Engineering und Arbeitssicherheit

• Planung, Steuerung und Gestaltung technischer Prozesse, z. B. Optimierung logistischer Abläufe, Konzeption, Gestaltung und Unterstützung von Fertigungsprozessen, Unterstützung des Qualitätsmanagements

• Vermittlung und Koordination zwischen technischen Abteilungen

• Entwurf von neuen, innovativen Technologien im betrieblichen Umfeld

• Anlagenbau, Sicherheitstechnik und Gebäudetechnik

Deine praktische Ausbildung findet bei Roche Diagnostics in Mannheim statt. Die Vorlesungen werden an der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg in Mannheim abgehalten.
Im Hauptstudium wird die Vertiefungsrichtung in zwei der folgenden Wahlmodulen Kälte- und Tieftemperaturtechnik, Nachhaltige Energiesysteme oder Qualitätsmanagement belegt.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.

Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Fachhochschulreife und Nachweis des bestandenen Eignungstests der Dualen Hochschule Baden-Württemberg

Wie lange dauert Dein Studium?
3 Jahre. Vorgeschaltet einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Praktikum

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

• Spezialist für die Gestaltung, Automatisierung, Qualitätssicherung und Optimierung von Produktions- und Logistikprozessen im Pharmazeutischen Umfeld

• Mitarbeit in laufenden Produktionsprozessen, Einrichtung, Wartung und Inbetriebnahme von Produktionsanlagen

• Simulation von Abläufen und Prototyping mittels 3D Druck - Additives Fertigungsverfahren sowie Computer Aided Design (CAD)

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einer vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Ausbildung? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Montage und Inbetriebnahme: Du baust komplexe mechatronische Systeme für die Laborautomatisierung aus mechanischen, elektrischen und elektronischen Baugruppen zusammen und nimmst diese fachgerecht in Betrieb.

• Programmierung und Steuerungstechnik: Du erlernst die Installation von Systemsoftware sowie die Programmierung und Konfiguration von mechatronischen Steuerungssystemen (z. B. SPS-Steuerungen).

• Fehlersuche und Instandhaltung: Du gehst auf Spurensuche! Mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten analysierst Du Störungen an unseren Diagnostik-Systemen und tauschst defekte Bauteile aus.

• Arbeit mit technischen Dokumentationen: Du lernst, technische Zeichnungen, Schaltpläne und Konstruktionsunterlagen sicher zu lesen, zu verstehen und selbst zu erstellen.

• Qualitätssicherung: Da unsere Produkte im medizinischen Bereich Leben retten können, prüfst Du die fertigen Komponenten und Systeme streng auf ihre Funktion, Sicherheit und die Einhaltung unserer hohen Qualitätsstandards.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:
Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.

Das bieten wir dir zusätzlich:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?
Mindestens guter Hauptschulabschluss

Wie lange dauert Deine Ausbildung?
3,5 Jahre, bei guten Leistungen 3 Jahre

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung . Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com .

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Mindestens mittlerer Bildungsabschluss

3 Jahre

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einer vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Ausbildung? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich:

• Softwareentwicklung & Tool-Einsatz: Du entwickelst aktiv Softwarelösungen mit verschiedenen Programmiersprachen und nutzt dabei ein modernes Spektrum an Entwicklungs-Tools, um Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.

• User Experience & Interface Design: Du gestaltest ergonomische und intuitive Bedienoberflächen, damit die Nutzer am Ende effizient und gerne mit deinen Anwendungen arbeiten.

• Datenmanagement & Backend: Du konzipierst und programmierst solide Datenmodelle und Datenbanken, die als stabiles Fundament für die gesamte Datenhaltung dienen.

• Analyse, Planung & Inbetriebnahme: Von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse mit dem Kunden über die Planung bis hin zur finalen Installation und Inbetriebnahme begleitest du den gesamten Lebenszyklus eines IT-Systems.

• Fehlerbehebung & Innovation: Du analysierst Störungen im laufenden Betrieb, behebst Fehler und evaluierst gleichzeitig ständig neue Technologien, um bestehende Prozesse innovativ zu verbessern.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Entwicklung: Intensive Prüfungsvorbereitung, Fachhochschulreife (optional) und vielfältige Weiterbildungen.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, Auslandseinsätze und vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?
Mindestens mittlerer Bildungsabschluss

Wie lange dauert Deine Ausbildung?
3 Jahre

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung . Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com .

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Arbeiten mit Mikroorganismen und Zellkulturen

• Anwendung biochemischer, immunologischer und molekularbiologischer Verfahren zur Entwicklung neuer Diagnostika und Therapeutika

• Herstellen von biotechnologischen Produkten zur Erkennung, Vorbeugung und Behandlung von Krankheiten

• Versuchstierkundliches Arbeiten nach dem Tierschutzgesetz

• Dokumentation und Auswertungen der Versuche mittels digitaler Systeme

​
Auf die gesamte Ausbildungszeit verteilt, nimmst Du an diversen Praktika im Ausbildungslabor teil, z. B. Mikrobiologie, Zellkultur, Fermentation, Pharmakologie, Histologie, Biochemie/Immunologie, Molekularbiologie, Hämatologie, Physikalische und analytische Methoden, Instrumentelle Analytik/Chromatographie.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:

• Finanzen : Attraktive Vergütung sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.

• Work-Life-Balance : 30 Tage Urlaub, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
jaDu bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich?

• Du bildest die direkte Brücke zwischen den Fachbereichen und der IT und koordinierst spannende gemeinsame Projekte.

• Du entwickelst smarte IT-Lösungen von der ersten Idee über die Programmierung bis zur Einführung mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum.

• Du optimierst aktiv betriebswirtschaftliche Prozesse und steuerst Abläufe – sei es in der Logistik, der Entwicklung, der Produktion oder im Controlling.

• Du wirkst aktiv an spannenden Daten- und IT-Projekten mit und trägst durch den Einsatz innovativer Ansätze zur digitalen Transformation bei.

• Du sammelst Praxiserfahrung in einem der verschiedenen Unternehmensbereiche, wie beispielsweise Finance & Controlling, Entwicklung, Produktion, Personalwesen oder Site Management.

Deine vorlesungsfreie Zeit und das Praxissemester verbringst Du bei der Roche Diagnostics GmbH in Penzberg. Auch Deine Bachelorarbeit machst Du bei uns im Unternehmen. Die Vorlesungen finden an der Technischen Hochschule in Rosenheim statt.

Deine Vorteile bei uns:

• Finanzen: Attraktive Vergütung.

• Work-Life-Balance : anteiliger Urlaub in den Praxisphasen, Betriebssport und umfassende Gesundheitsvorsorge.

• Extras : Internationales Arbeitsumfeld, vergünstigte Kantinenverpflegung.

Welche Voraussetzung musst Du erfüllen?

• Allgemeine Hochschulreife

• Fachgebundene Hochschulreife

• Englisch Level B2

Wie lange dauert Deine Ausbildung?
Insgesamt 3,5 Jahre (bzw. 7 Semester). Vorgeschaltet ist ein ca. einmonatiges, unternehmensspezifisches Onboarding-Praktikum, damit Du perfekt startest.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – lade mit Deiner Bewerbung einen Lebenslauf, ein Anschreiben sowie Deine letzten beiden Schulzeugnisse als eine PDF-Datei hoch.

Wichtig: Bitte achte auf die Vollständigkeit Deiner Bewerbung . Es können nachträglich keine Dokumente hochgeladen werden.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Bei Rückfragen oder Problemen wende Dich gerne an deutschland.recruiting_ausbildung@roche.com .

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Du bist auf der Suche nach einem vielfältigen und zukunftsorientierten Dualen Studium? Dann erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung neu.
Bei Roche entwickeln wir innovative Diagnostika und Medikamente, um Menschen ein längeres und besseres Leben zu ermöglichen. Werde Teil dieser Mission und leiste von Anfang an einen entscheidenden Beitrag für Patient:innen weltweit.

Welche Aufgaben erwarten Dich im Daily Business?

• Marktanalyse & Strategie: Du analysierst den Gesundheitsmarkt, scannst Trends und hilfst dabei, unsere Produkte perfekt bei Ärzten, Apotheken und Kliniken zu platzieren.

jobs.title: Planning Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
1. Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
Roche China is driving a major capital investment in Zhangjiang, Shanghai, establishing a state-of-the-art biologics manufacturing center for Roche-owned products. Currently in its critical commissioning and qualification (C&Q) phase, this landmark project offers a unique, hands-on opportunity for high-caliber interns.
We are seeking a proactive intern to integral support the Material Management department during this high-impact period. In this role, you will work closely with Planning, Master Data, Warehouse teams to manage documentation, support SAP master data readiness, actions tracking, and ensure smooth day-to-day departmental operations.

2. Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities

1) Business Support & Data Management
- Data & SOP Maintenance : Assist in drafting SOPs; collect and input master data into the ERP system to ensure data accuracy.
- Bilingual Translation : Assist the department with English-Chinese translation of routine documents, SOP, and meeting minutes.
2) Team Operations & Administrative Support
- Admin & Logistics : Handle day-to-day administrative and logistical tasks to ensure smooth department operations.
- Meetings & Document Processing : Draft meeting minutes, track action items, and prepare routine official documents and announcements.
3) Team Culture & General Affairs
- Event Organization : Assist in planning and organizing team events and training sessions to foster a positive team culture.
Ad-hoc Tasks : Efficiently complete other temporary or phase-based tasks assigned by supervisors.

Qualification and Experience

Open minded, active, learning spirit, good at communication.

At least 3-5 days/week. The student who can stay until Jun 2027 and based in Shanghai will be preferrable.

Education/Qualifications

(1) Bachelor's degree or above with a major related to Business Administration, Supply Chain/Logistic Management
(2) Possess good communication skills, learning ability, execution ability, stress tolerance, and team spirit.
(3) Proficient in using office application software such as Excel, PPT, and Word, especially PPT skill
(4) CET-6 (College English Test Band 6) or above.
(5) Plus: Skills in photography, videography, and video editing, with the ability to support department event filming and video production.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
