descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analista aziendale IT - Ricerca e sviluppo farmaceutico L'analista aziendale IT possiede una conoscenza approfondita del dominio aziendale della gestione dei dati clinici farmaceutici e una comprensione delle tecnologie di ingegneria e analisi dei dati, operando all'intersezione tra strategia aziendale, dati e esigenze tecnologiche. In questo ruolo, applicherai il pensiero sistemico per navigare nella complessità dei dati degli studi clinici e dei sistemi di dati del mondo reale (RWD), traducendo le esigenze aziendali in requisiti di sistema, supervisionando le iniziative con piena autonomia e guidando gli sforzi di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui. Agendo come consulente fidato della leadership, plasmerai attivamente tabelle di marcia a lungo termine, guiderai il consenso attraverso una comunicazione persuasiva e consiglierai soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali per garantire un'acquisizione e una gestione efficienti dei dati degli studi clinici. Chi siamo: questo team è responsabile della fornitura di sistemi software per l'acquisizione e l'elaborazione dei dati degli studi clinici Roche, fungendo da fonte di verità per Roche Pharma. I sistemi fondamentali in quest'area includono l'acquisizione elettronica dei dati (EDC) di Roche - Medidata Rave, i sistemi non CRF e i data warehouse clinici. Questi sistemi sono fondamentali per lo sviluppo dei farmaci, poiché alimentano la revisione dei dati clinici, la reportistica sulla sicurezza, gli approfondimenti operativi per i team clinici e supportano le prime attività di sviluppo nelle RED. Forniscono dati agli ecosistemi di Analytical Data Science per standardizzare e analizzare i dati per le presentazioni normative. Inoltre, i dati clinici standardizzati provenienti da questi sistemi sono essenziali per l’integrazione con le piattaforme specializzate in modalità dati di Roche, tra cui omics, imaging clinico e tecnologie sanitarie digitali. Un obiettivo chiave in quest’area sarà quello di sfruttare le tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale emergenti per ottimizzare le pipeline di dati di acquisizione dei dati clinici. Ciò include l’arricchimento dei metadati e la creazione di set di dati pronti per l’intelligenza artificiale per abilitare sistemi di intelligenza artificiale con agenti autonomi e human-in-the-loop che stanno trasformando il processo di sviluppo dei farmaci. L'opportunità:
• Leadership e fornitura dell'analisi aziendale: condurre l'analisi aziendale per iniziative o flussi di lavoro con autonomia, coordinando complessità e scala. Definisce e guida le attività di analisi in spazi altamente ambigui, traducendo requisiti di dati complessi in mappe di processo, epiche, funzionalità e storie degli utenti.
• Problem Solving: guida l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, definendo l'ambito del problema e conducendo un'analisi completa delle cause profonde che può estendersi oltre i confini dell'organizzazione. Previene in modo proattivo lo spostamento dell'ambito, gestisce la complessità dei vari ambiti di cambiamento ed è, in ultima analisi, responsabile dei risultati dell'analisi aziendale garantendo l'allineamento tra funzioni e sistemi dipendenti.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: identifica e coinvolge i principali stakeholder, incluso il management, oltre i confini dell'IT e dell'organizzazione aziendale. Definisce la strategia come consulente fidato della leadership, affronta attivamente i conflitti per raggiungere l'allineamento e dà potere ai team nella gestione degli stakeholder.
• Impatto e strategia: determina un impatto significativo su progetti e programmi garantendo la fornitura di soluzioni di alto valore in linea con la strategia aziendale. Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership, you will actively shape long-term roadmaps, drive consensus through persuasive communication, and recommend optimal technology solutions to ensure efficient acquisition and management of clinical trial data. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s electronic data capture (EDC) - Medidata Rave, non-CRF systems, and clinical data warehouses. These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the REDs. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies. A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition data pipelines. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position IT-Business-Analyst – Pharma-Forschung und -Entwicklung Der IT-Business-Analyst verfügt über fundierte Kenntnisse des Geschäftsbereichs klinisches Datenmanagement in der Pharmaindustrie sowie über Verständnis für Datentechnik und Analysetechnologien und agiert an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Daten und Technologieanforderungen. In dieser Rolle wenden Sie Systemdenken an, um die Komplexität klinischer Studiendaten und realer Datensysteme (RWD) zu bewältigen, Geschäftsanforderungen in Systemanforderungen umzuwandeln, Initiativen mit völliger Autonomie zu überwachen und Analysebemühungen in höchst unklaren Bereichen zu leiten. Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung gestalten Sie aktiv langfristige Roadmaps, sorgen durch überzeugende Kommunikation für Konsens und empfehlen optimale Technologielösungen, um eine effiziente Erfassung und Verwaltung klinischer Studiendaten sicherzustellen. Wer wir sind: Dieses Team ist für die Bereitstellung von Softwaresystemen für die Datenerfassung und -verarbeitung der Daten aus klinischen Studien von Roche verantwortlich und dient als Quelle der Wahrheit für Roche Pharma. Zu den grundlegenden Systemen in diesem Bereich gehören die elektronische Datenerfassung (EDC) von Roche – Medidata Rave, Nicht-CRF-Systeme und klinische Data Warehouses. Diese Systeme sind für die Arzneimittelentwicklung von entscheidender Bedeutung, da sie die Überprüfung klinischer Daten, Sicherheitsberichte und betriebliche Erkenntnisse für klinische Teams ermöglichen und frühe Entwicklungsaktivitäten in den REDs unterstützen. Sie stellen Daten für die Ökosysteme der Analytical Data Science bereit, um Daten für behördliche Einreichungen zu standardisieren und zu analysieren. Darüber hinaus sind standardisierte klinische Daten aus diesen Systemen für die Integration in die spezialisierten Datenmodalitätsplattformen von Roche, einschließlich Omics, klinische Bildgebung und digitale Gesundheitstechnologien, unerlässlich. Ein Hauptaugenmerk in diesem Bereich wird auf der Nutzung neuer KI-Technologien liegen, um die Datenpipelines für die klinische Datenerfassung zu optimieren. Dazu gehört die Anreicherung von Metadaten und der Aufbau KI-fähiger Datensätze, um autonome Agenten- und Human-in-the-Loop-KI-Systeme zu ermöglichen, die den Arzneimittelentwicklungsprozess verändern. Die Gelegenheit:
• Führung und Bereitstellung von Geschäftsanalysen: Führen Sie Geschäftsanalysen für Initiativen oder Arbeitsabläufe mit Autonomie durch und koordinieren Sie Komplexität und Umfang. Definiert und leitet Analysebemühungen in höchst unklaren Bereichen und übersetzt komplexe Datenanforderungen in Prozesskarten, Epics, Features und Benutzergeschichten.
• Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, definiert den Problembereich und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse durch, die sich über Organisationsgrenzen erstrecken kann. Verhindert proaktiv das Ausweiten des Umfangs, verwaltet die Komplexität verschiedener Änderungsbereiche und ist letztendlich für die Ergebnisse der Geschäftsanalyse verantwortlich, um die Abstimmung zwischen Funktionen und abhängigen Systemen sicherzustellen.
• Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert und bindet wichtige Stakeholder, einschließlich des Managements, über die Grenzen der IT- und Unternehmensorganisation hinweg ein. Gestaltet die Strategie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater der Führung, steuert aktiv Konflikte, um eine Abstimmung zu erreichen, und befähigt Teams beim Stakeholder-Management.
• Wirkung und Strategie: Führt zu erheblichen Auswirkungen auf Projekte und Programme, indem es die Bereitstellung hochwertiger Lösungen sicherstellt, die mit der Geschäftsstrategie übereinstimmen. Leitet die Bewertung strategischer Lösungsoptionen, einschließlich erweiterter Wertanalyse und Risikobewertung, und gestaltet aktiv langfristige Roadmaps.
• Komplexität: Funktioniert typischerweise auf mehreren Systemen in der gesamten Unterfunktion und verwaltet effektiv höchst mehrdeutige und sich entwickelnde Anforderungen. Demonstriert eine End-to-End-Sichtweise zur Analyse von Problemen unter Berücksichtigung des Datenflusses
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Analyste commercial informatique - R&D pharmaceutique L'analyste commercial informatique possède une connaissance approfondie du domaine commercial de la gestion des données cliniques pharmaceutiques et une compréhension des technologies d'ingénierie et d'analyse des données, opérant à l'intersection de la stratégie commerciale, des données et des besoins technologiques. Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez la pensée systémique pour naviguer dans la complexité des systèmes de données d'essais cliniques et de données du monde réel (RWD), en traduisant les besoins de l'entreprise en exigences système, en supervisant les initiatives en toute autonomie et en dirigeant les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus. En tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des dirigeants, vous façonnerez activement des feuilles de route à long terme, générerez un consensus grâce à une communication persuasive et recommanderez des solutions technologiques optimales pour garantir une acquisition et une gestion efficaces des données d'essais cliniques. Qui nous sommes : Cette équipe est chargée de fournir des systèmes logiciels pour l'acquisition et le traitement des données des essais cliniques de Roche, servant de source de vérité au sein de Roche Pharma. Les systèmes fondamentaux dans ce domaine comprennent la capture électronique de données (EDC) de Roche - Medidata Rave, les systèmes non CRF et les entrepôts de données cliniques. Ces systèmes sont essentiels au développement de médicaments, car ils alimentent l'examen des données cliniques, les rapports de sécurité, les informations opérationnelles pour les équipes cliniques et soutiennent les premières activités de développement dans les RED. Ils fournissent des données aux écosystèmes de l’Analytical Data Science pour normaliser et analyser les données à des fins de soumissions réglementaires. De plus, les données cliniques standardisées de ces systèmes sont essentielles à intégrer aux plateformes de modalités de données spécialisées de Roche, notamment les technologies omiques, d’imagerie clinique et de santé numérique. Un objectif clé dans ce domaine sera de tirer parti des technologies émergentes d’IA pour optimiser les pipelines de données d’acquisition de données cliniques. Cela inclut l’enrichissement des métadonnées et la création d’ensembles de données prêts pour l’IA pour permettre des systèmes d’IA autonomes, agents et humains dans la boucle, qui transforment le processus de développement de médicaments. L'opportunité :
• Leadership et réalisation de l'analyse commerciale : diriger l'analyse commerciale d'initiatives ou de flux de travail avec autonomie, en coordonnant la complexité et l'échelle. Définit et dirige les efforts d'analyse dans des espaces très ambigus, traduisant les exigences de données complexes en cartes de processus, épopées, fonctionnalités et témoignages d'utilisateurs.
• Résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse des problèmes commerciaux, en définissant l'espace du problème et en conduisant une analyse complète des causes profondes pouvant dépasser les limites de l'organisation. Empêche de manière proactive la dérive de la portée, gère la complexité des différentes portées de changement et est, en fin de compte, responsable des livrables de l'analyse commerciale, garantissant l'alignement entre les fonctions et les systèmes dépendants.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie et implique les principales parties prenantes, y compris la direction, au-delà des frontières organisationnelles informatiques et commerciales. Élabore la stratégie en tant que conseiller de confiance du leadership, gère activement les conflits pour parvenir à l'alignement et responsabilise les équipes dans la gestion des parties prenantes.
• Impact et stratégie : génère un impact significatif sur les projets et les programmes en assurant la fourniture de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée qui s'alignent sur la stratégie commerciale. Dirige l’évaluation des options de solutions stratégiques, y compris l’analyse avancée de la valeur et l’évaluation des risques, et façonne activement les feuilles de route à long terme.
• Complexité : fonctionne généralement sur plusieurs systèmes dans la sous-fonction, gérant efficacement les exigences très ambiguës et évolutives. Démontre un point de vue de bout en bout pour analyser les problèmes, en tenant compte de la façon dont les données circulent

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech.

Twoja Rola:

• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.

• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).

• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.

• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.

• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki.

O Tobie:

• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).

• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).

• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.

• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.

• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​

Oferujemy:

• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.

• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .

• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.

• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi.

Dodatkowe informacje:

• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)

• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo)

Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl .

Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen .
​

Compensation & Benefits
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Gestión global de proyectos relacionados con la instalación, soporte y mantenimiento del software de gestión integral del Tratamiento Anticoagulante Oral (y otros productos POC). El dispositivo informático facilita la gestión integral descentralizada de los pacientes en tratamiento anticoagulante oral, gracias a una aplicación web ágil y flexible (y otros productos POC como CGM y NaPOC Operations. Asimismo facilita la integración de la información con otros sistemas del Área Sanitaria gracias al uso de estándares de comunicación.

Responsabilidades:

• Gestión de instalaciones y actualizaciones.

• Formación al cliente final.

• Apoyo al cliente en incidencias, dudas, nuevos proyectos, etc.

• Gestión Documental de los proyectos e instalaciones

• Gestión de las conexiones de instrumentos.

• Soporte a la red de ventas

Perfil requerido:

• Ingeniería Técnica o superior de Informática de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones

• Inglés Nivel Medio

• Conocimientos mínimo técnicos de BBDD

• Conocimientos de sistemas Windows y Linux

• Persona comunicativa

• Disponibilidad para viajar (esporádicamente)

Perfil Deseado:

• Conocimientos técnicos de BBDD (SQL, MysQL y Oracle)

• Conocimientos mensajería HL7 y Motor integración Mirth

• Conocimientos de herramientas de ticketing

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: R&D Business Tools Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Digital Innovation and Operational Services Chapter is a global team in R&D that focuses on internal improvement: increasing productivity, efficiency, and the ability of the R&D organization to collaborate across its global organizational interfaces. Our work involves reducing complexity of our systems, harmonizing processes, tools, and business practices, and building connections across geographical and organizational silos.
We are seeking a R&D Enterprise Tools Operations Specialist to join our global support team. You are well organized and detail-oriented. You will be the reliable service provider handling critical system requests within our core business tools, ensuring our scientists and engineers worldwide can focus on developing innovative products for patients.

This role requires building organizational know-how —understanding who our internal customers are, how they work, and solving problems in a way that anticipates their support needs. You are quick in learning new software systems and tools , enjoy helping your coworkers every day, and are motivated to innovate internal processes to automate tasks, you will fit right into our team!

Key Responsibilities

As a part of a global centralized expert support team, execute enterprise tool system tasks based on R&D customer requests, leveraging expert knowledge of business tools, compliance requirements, and R&D teams and processes.

• Execute R&D System Requests: Fulfill customer tool requests using expertise in business systems and compliance standards.

• Provide Timely Expert Support: Offer professional, empathetic, and quick solutions to R&D operational issues and system problems.

• Expert in our Global Business Applications: Act as the subject matter expert for one or more complex R&D business applications.

• Specialize in R&D Processes: Develop deep expertise in key processes (e.g., records management, lab data, change requests) for high-accuracy execution.

• Maximize Scientist Productivity: Use your expertise across business data and organizational structure to streamline operations and save significant time for R&D scientists.

• Anticipate Customer Needs: Build organizational know-how of R&D roles and priorities to deliver proactive system support.

• Maintain Global Service Excellence: Demonstrate a strong, collaborative customer service mindset within a diverse, global team.

• Drive Process Improvement: Identify manual steps and actively suggest opportunities for digitization and improvement.

• Automate Administrative Tasks: Apply or develop automation and AI tools to reduce administrative load on R&D staff.

• Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Guarantee all activities strictly adhere to regulated R&D processes, supporting audits and data retrieval.

Requirements:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

• Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in an operations, technical support, or system administration role, or equivalent academic projects / internships

• Language Skills: Excellent written and verbal English Language skills are required to support our global organization. German language skills are a plus.

• System Proficiency: Ability to quickly learn new software, systems, and processes is essential.

•
• Prior experience in enterprise business applications is desirable (e.g., Electronic Document Management Systems, Learning Management Systems, or Project Management tools).

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Applied AI
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Scientist - Applied AI

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, applying advanced data engineering practices, and integrating cutting-edge external capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans across multiple high-impact initiatives, from developing intelligent data products to enabling end-to-end AI workflows. Whether it’s structuring complex data ecosystems or collaborating with external research institutions, this is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data and AI at Roche by directly supporting key strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As a Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in shaping and delivering AI and machine learning capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to develop scalable machine learning models, intelligent workflows, and data-driven solutions that improve visibility, prioritization, operational efficiency, and strategic decision making.
This role focuses on applied AI, machine learning, predictive modeling, and operational intelligence rather than purely research-oriented AI. You will help translate complex business challenges into scalable AI and analytics solutions that create measurable business impact across partnering operations.

You will be responsible for:

Machine Learning & Applied AI Solutions

• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and AI-enabled solutions that support partnering activities such as opportunity prioritization, portfolio intelligence, forecasting, operational insights, and decision support.

• Apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, and emerging AI techniques to solve complex business problems and deliver scalable intelligence capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

Model Development & Experimentation

• Lead exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation for machine learning and AI-enabled solutions.

• Design and evaluate multiple modeling approaches, establish appropriate evaluation metrics, and optimize models for scalability, reliability, and business impact.

Business Problem Solving & Decision Support

• Partner closely with business stakeholders and product teams to translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches, machine learning solutions, and scalable intelligence capabilities.

• Support data-driven prioritization and strategic decision making through actionable insights, predictive models, and operational intelligence.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

• Collaborate with AI, data, and engineering teams to operationalize AI-enabled capabilities and support the adoption of scalable intelligence solutions across partnering platforms and workflows.

• Evaluate and apply modern AI techniques including predictive modeling, NLP, LLM-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation approaches to enhance partnering operations and decision making.

Data & Intelligence Development

• Design and develop analytics solutions, dashboards, KPIs, and intelligence capabilities that improve visibilit

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Scientist - AI applicato Informazioni sul nostro team: Partnering Digital Solutions Unisciti al nostro team di Partnering Digital Solutions, un gruppo strategico focalizzato sulla massimizzazione dell'impatto del partenariato attraverso ecosistemi digitali e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per promuovere il business di Pharma e DIA Partnering. Siamo all'avanguardia nell'innovazione: la costruzione di infrastrutture dati scalabili, l'applicazione di pratiche di ingegneria dei dati avanzate e l'integrazione di capacità esterne all'avanguardia per accelerare il processo decisionale e sbloccare il valore aziendale. Il nostro lavoro si estende su più iniziative ad alto impatto, dallo sviluppo di prodotti di dati intelligenti per consentire flussi di lavoro AI end-to-end. Che si tratti di strutturare ecosistemi di dati complessi o di collaborare con istituzioni di ricerca esterne, questa è un'opportunità unica per contribuire a plasmare il futuro dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale a Roche sostenendo direttamente le decisioni strategiche chiave in tutta la nostra organizzazione globale Partnering. responsabilità In qualità di Data Scientist, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione e nella fornitura di capacità di apprendimento automatico e di intelligenza artificiale nell'ecosistema Partnering Digital Solutions. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti, ingegneri di dati, architetti e stakeholder aziendali per sviluppare modelli scalabili di machine learning, flussi di lavoro intelligenti e soluzioni basate sui dati che migliorano la visibilità, la priorità, l'efficienza operativa e il processo decisionale strategico. Questo ruolo si concentra sull'IA applicata, l'apprendimento automatico, la modellazione predittiva e l'intelligenza operativa piuttosto che l'IA puramente orientata alla ricerca. Ti aiuterà a tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in soluzioni scalabili AI e analytics che creano un impatto commerciale misurabile attraverso le operazioni di partner. Sarete responsabili di: Apprendimento della macchina & Soluzioni AI applicate
• Progettazione, sviluppo e distribuzione di soluzioni di machine learning e AI-enabled che supportano attività di partner come la priorità delle opportunità, l'intelligenza del portafoglio, la previsione, le intuizioni operative e il supporto decisionale.
• Applicare l'analisi avanzata, la modellazione statistica, l'apprendimento automatico e le tecniche AI emergenti per risolvere problemi aziendali complessi e fornire funzionalità di intelligenza scalabile in tutto l'ecosistema partner. Sviluppo del modello e sperimentazione
• Analisi dei dati esplorativi di piombo, ingegneria delle caratteristiche, selezione dei modelli, formazione, convalida e valutazione delle prestazioni per l'apprendimento automatico e soluzioni AI-enabled.
• Progettare e valutare più approcci di modellazione, stabilire metriche di valutazione appropriate e ottimizzare i modelli per scalabilità, affidabilità e impatto aziendale. Risolvere i problemi aziendali e sostenere le decisioni
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder aziendali e i team di prodotti per tradurre complesse sfide aziendali in approcci analitici, soluzioni di machine learning e capacità di intelligenza scalabile.
• Supporta la priorità dei dati e il processo decisionale strategico attraverso intuizioni attuabili, modelli predittivi e intelligenza operativa. AI & Intelligence Enables
• Collaborare con i team AI, i dati e l'ingegneria per gestire le funzionalità abilitate all'IA e supportare l'adozione di soluzioni di intelligenza scalabile attraverso piattaforme di partner e flussi di lavoro.
• Valutare e applicare tecniche AI moderne, tra cui la modellazione predittiva, NLP, flussi di lavoro abilitati a LLM, e approcci di automazione intelligente per migliorare le operazioni di partner e il processo decisionale. Sviluppo dei dati e dell'intelligence
• Progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni di analisi, dashboard, KPI e funzionalità di intelligenza che migliorano la visibilità

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Scientifique des données - AI appliquée À propos de notre équipe: Partenaires Solutions numériques Rejoignez notre équipe de Solutions numériques partenaires, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact du partenariat grâce aux écosystèmes numériques et à l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de Partenariats Pharma et DIA. Nous sommes à l'avant-garde de l'innovation - construire une infrastructure de données évolutive, appliquer des pratiques avancées en matière d'ingénierie des données et intégrer des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décisions et débloquer la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend à de multiples initiatives à impact élevé, depuis le développement de produits de données intelligents jusqu'aux flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu'il s'agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des institutions de recherche externes, il s'agit d'une occasion unique de contribuer à façonner l'avenir des données et de l'IA à Roche en appuyant directement les décisions stratégiques clés de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant que Data Scientist, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'élaboration et la fourniture de capacités d'IA et d'apprentissage automatique dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème des solutions numériques partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de produits, les ingénieurs de données, les architectes et les intervenants commerciaux pour développer des modèles d'apprentissage automatique évolutives, des workflows intelligents et des solutions axées sur les données qui améliorent la visibilité, la priorisation, l'efficacité opérationnelle et la prise de décisions stratégiques. Ce rôle est axé sur l'intelligence artificielle appliquée, l'apprentissage automatique, la modélisation prédictive et l'intelligence opérationnelle plutôt que sur la recherche. Vous aiderez à traduire des défis d'affaires complexes en solutions d'IA et d'analyse évolutives qui créent un impact commercial mesurable dans les opérations de partenariat. Vous serez responsable : Apprentissage automatique et solutions d'IA appliquées
• Concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA qui soutiennent des activités de partenariat telles que la priorisation des opportunités, le renseignement de portefeuille, les prévisions, les perspectives opérationnelles et le soutien à la décision.
• Appliquer des techniques avancées d'analyse, de modélisation statistique, d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA émergentes pour résoudre des problèmes d'affaires complexes et fournir des capacités d'intelligence évolutives dans l'écosystème partenaire. Développement et expérimentation de modèles
• Diriger l'analyse des données exploratoires, l'ingénierie des caractéristiques, la sélection des modèles, la formation, la validation et l'évaluation des performances pour l'apprentissage automatique et les solutions compatibles avec l'IA.
• Concevoir et évaluer plusieurs approches de modélisation, établir des paramètres d'évaluation appropriés et optimiser les modèles pour l'évolutivité, la fiabilité et l'impact commercial. Résolution des problèmes d'affaires et soutien à la décision
• S'associer étroitement avec les parties prenantes et les équipes de produits pour traduire les défis complexes en approches analytiques, solutions d'apprentissage automatique et capacités d'intelligence évolutives.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Please submit your CV in English.
The role is based in Estonia.

As a Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP), you will serve as a strategic thought partner, advisor, and consultant to the business. You will ensure financial excellence and compliance in our daily operations while guiding decision-making on resource allocation. Your role is to bridge the gap between financial data and actionable strategy, ensuring that prioritized business areas receive the support necessary to deliver outstanding value to patients.

Key Areas of Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Strategic Partnering and Performance

• Support the local business planning, budgeting and forecasting in close collaboration with wider Baltics team.

• Guide strategic resource allocation decisions and oversee the financial performance of the affiliate’s operating expenses.

• Provide relevant insights and recommendations through regular performance reporting and dashboards to facilitate decision-making.

Local Stewardship, Governance & Operational Excellence

• Act as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics, and Roche's Code of Conduct while maintaining robust internal control standards.

• Oversee essential local financial tasks including payment approvals, local reporting and others as required.

• Serve as primary local contact for local government authorities

• Lead local tax compliance, including alignment of global requirement to local regulation (for example: impact calculations for co-payment schemes; dividend payment support; and preparation for statutory audits).

• Identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and efficiency gains in finance processes and systems.

• Support the organizational transition to updated ERP systems.

Cluster & Regional Collaboration

• Act as a role model for collaboration within the Baltic countries, ensuring a unified approach to financial challenges and opportunities.

• Lead or contribute to cross-functional projects and initiatives as business needs evolve within the Baltics and the wider region

• As part of the broader Finance community, participate in above-country squads to leverage network effects and achieve desired outcomes.

Who You Are

• Entrepreneurial Mindset : Proactively identify opportunities, take calculated risks, and drive innovative solutions to challenges.

• Strategic Agility : Ability to navigate both strategic and operational tasks while adapting to rapidly shifting priorities.

• Effective Communication : Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.

• Collaborative Influence : Ability to influence and work effectively with different teams and functions across the cluster and within the broader Roche finance community.

Qualifications & Experience

• University degree (Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field)

• Strong understanding of Estonian accounting and tax regulations

• 5+ years of relevant experience in Finance Business Partnering, Controlling or a similar strategic finance role

• Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or Healthcare sector is an advantage

• Experience with ERP systems, SAP highly preferred

• Fluent in Estonian and English (written and spoken)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and fo

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

AI Solutions Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, enabling intelligent workflows, and integrating advanced AI capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.

Our work spans multiple high-impact initiatives, including AI-enabled partnering solutions, intelligent data products, workflow automation, and enterprise-scale data and AI integrations. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of AI-enabled partnering at Roche by operationalizing innovative capabilities that directly support strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will play a critical role in enabling and operationalizing AI and intelligence capabilities across the Partnering Digital Solutions ecosystem. You will work closely with product owners, data engineers, Data Scientists, architects, and business stakeholders to implement scalable AI-enabled workflows, integrations, automation solutions, and intelligent applications that support partnering operations and decision making.

This role combines AI enablement, integration engineering, workflow orchestration, cloud-native solution development, and operationalization of AI capabilities at enterprise scale. In addition, the role offers opportunities to contribute to modern web application development and user-facing AI experiences where needed.

You will be responsible for:

AI Workflow & Solution Enablement

• Support the implementation and operationalization of AI-enabled solutions across partnering platforms and intelligence products.

• Develop and integrate AI workflows that support automation, decision support, insights generation, and orchestration of AI-enabled capabilities across the partnering ecosystem.

System Integration & API Development

• Develop and maintain APIs and integration services that connect AI capabilities, enterprise platforms, and data ecosystems.

• Enable seamless integration between internal platforms, external data sources, AI services, and workflow orchestration frameworks.

AI & Agent Integration:

• Support the integration of AI services, LLM-based applications, and agentic workflows into enterprise solutions and partnering processes.

• Collaborate with AI and data teams to operationalize intelligent capabilities and scalable automation workflows.

Cloud-Native Solution Development

• Build and deploy scalable services and integrations using cloud-native technologies and AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, and API-based architectures.

• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and Roche security standards

Data & Platform Integration

• Support integration of structured and unstructured data sources across partnering platforms, analytics solutions, and AI-enabled capabilities.

• Enable reliable data exchange and orchestration across internal and external systems. ● Frontend & User Experience Development (Bonus Capability)

• Contribute to the development of modern web applications and user-facing AI experiences using technologies such as React or similar frontend frameworks. ○ Support creation of dashboards, AI assistants, intelligent workflows, and

descriptionByLocale.it: AI Solutions Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions Descrizione del Ruolo At Roche, puoi mostrare il tuo vero io, apprezzato per le tue qualità uniche. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni Come Ingegnere delle Soluzioni AI, giocoai un ruolo critico nell'abilitare e nell'operazionalizzare le capacità AI e intelligenti all'interno dell'ecosistema delle Soluzioni Digitali di Partnering. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i proprietari del prodotto, gli ingegneri dei dati, i Data Scientist, gli architetti e i stakeholder aziendali per implementare flussi di lavoro AI abilitati, integrazioni, soluzioni di automazione e applicazioni intelligenti che supportano le operazioni di partnering e la decisione-making. Questo ruolo combina l'abilitazione AI, l'ingegneria delle integrazioni, l'orchestrazione dei flussi di lavoro, lo sviluppo di soluzioni native del cloud e l'operazionalizzazione delle capacità AI su scala aziendale. Inoltre, il ruolo offre opportunità per contribuire allo sviluppo di applicazioni web moderne e alle esperienze AI a interfaccia utente quando necessario. Sarai responsabile di: AI Workflow & Solution Enablement - Supportare l'implementazione e l'operazionalizzazione delle soluzioni AI-abilitate all'interno delle piattaforme di partnership e dei prodotti di intelligenza. - Sviluppare e integrare i flussi di lavoro AI che supportano l'automazione, il supporto alle decisioni, la generazione di insight e l'orchestrazione delle capacità AI-abilitate all'interno dell'ecosistema di partnering. System Integration & API Development - Sviluppare e mantenere le API e i servizi di integrazione che connettono le capacità AI, le organizzazioni aziendali, gli ecosistemi dei dati e i framework di orchestrazione dei flussi di lavoro. - Abilitare l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra le piattaforme interna, le fonti esterne, i servizi AI e i framework di orchestrazione dei flussi di lavoro. AI & Agent Integration - Supportare l'integrazione dei servizi AI, delle applicazioni basate su LLM e dei flussi di lavoro agentivi nelle soluzioni aziendali e nei processi di partnering. - Collaborare con i team AI e dei dati per operazionalizzare le capacità intelligenti e i flussi di lavoro di automazione scalabili. Cloud-Native Solution Development - Costruire e distribuire servizi e integrazioni scalabili utilizzando le tecnologie native del cloud e i servizi AWS come ECS, Lambda e architetture basate su API. - Garantire che le soluzioni siano scalabili, sicure, affidabili e allineate con l'architettura aziendale e gli standard di sicurezza di Roche. Integrazione dati & Platform - Supportare l'integrazione delle fonti dati strutturate e non strutturate all'interno delle piattaforme di partnering, delle soluzioni analitiche e delle capacità AI-abilitate. - Abilitare lo scambio di dati affidabili e l'orchestrazione tra i sistemi interni ed esterni. Frontend & User Experience Development (Bonus Capability) - Contribuire allo sviluppo di applicazioni web moderne e alle esperienze AI a interfaccia utente utilizzando tecnologie come React o framework frontend simili. - Supportare la creazione di dashboard, assistenti AI, flussi di lavoro intelligenti e altro ancora. Esperienza - Prova di almeno 5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di ingegneria del software o di sviluppo, con almeno 3 anni di esperienza specifica in AI, machine learning o dati. - Esperienza nella progettazione, sviluppo e implementazione di soluzioni AI su larga scala. - Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di API e servizi di integrazione. - Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di flussi di lavoro e processi aziendali. - Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di applicazioni web moderne. Conoscenze Tecniche - Conoscenza avanzata di linguaggi di programmazione come Python, Java, JavaScript o C++. - Conoscenza avanzata di architetture cloud come AWS, GCP o Azure. - Conoscenza avanzata di tecnologie di machine learning e AI come TensorFlow, PyTorch o scikit-learn. - Conoscenza avanzata di tecnologie di sviluppo frontend come React, Angular o Vue.js. - Conoscenza avanzata di tecnologie di sviluppo backend come Primavera, Node.js o Django. - Conoscenza avanzata di tecnologie di database come SQL, NoSQL o big data. - Conoscenza avanzata di tecnologie di integrazione come Apache Kafka, MuleSoft o Dell Boomi. Abilità Interpersonali - Capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare con stakeholder società, ingegneri del software, data science e altri professionisti. - Capacità di comunicare in modo efficace con i membri del team e gli stakeholder aziendali. - Capacità di risolvere problemi e di prendere decisioni in modo critico e creativo. - Capacità di gestire progetti e di rispettare le scadenze. - Capacità di adattarsi a un ambiente in rapido cambiamento. Cosa somministra Sviluppo Professionale - Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo continuo per aiutare a raggiungere il tuo pieno potenziale. - No. Un ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e inclusivo dove puoi mostrare il tuo vero io e contribuire al successo dell'azienda. - L'opportunità di lavorare su progetti di alto impatto che influenzano la vita delle persone in tutto il mondo. Benefit - Un pacchetto di beneficio competitivo che includono assicurazione sanitaria, pensionistica e tempo libero flessibile. - No. Un programma welfare di business che include sconti su prodotti e servizi selezionati. - No. Un ambiente di lavoro flessibile che ti permette di bilanciare al meglio il lavoro e la vita personale. Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarti, visita il nostro sito web all'indirizzo www.roche.com e cerca "Lavora con Noi".

jobs.title: Project Manager CAPEX
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
With an eye to the future, we are actively shaping the continued development of the Roche site in Rotkreuz. The Engineering & Project department makes a vital contribution to this endeavor: It holds the responsibility for the strategic advancement of the site and all capital investments in buildings and facilities (CAPEX). This encompasses complex construction projects as well as the realization of infrastructure and modern process plants in the areas of production and research. In all our activities, we place particular emphasis on sustainability, safety (SHE), quality, and cost-effectiveness.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you are responsible for:

• Accountable that the project design and execution meets project objectives outlined in the approved Credit Application, URB, URS, project charter, PEP (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, SHE, sustainability, maintenance & reliability, quality, construction safety)

• Establish, onboard and lead the engineering team, coordinate their activities and acquire the necessary resources

• Ensure compliance with corporate and site directives / SOP’s, local laws and building codes

• Implement project controls (scope, cost, schedule, progress, risk, change mgmt.) and ensure monthly cost and schedule forecast of the project (PMR) from PI to HO

• Report project status, key issues and corrective actions to project SC on a regular basis

Who you are:

• Bachelor or Master/University degree in engineering, construction, etc.

• Min 5-10 years work experience as project manager in capital projects

• Experience managing DIA process projects.

• Excellent collaboration, teambuilding and communication skills at all levels of the project

• Proven ability to lead large teams working in a matrix environment

• Very good understanding of customer needs

• Excellent project mgmt and planning skills

• Very good analytical and problem solving skills

Be part of our 'Engineering & Project' team in Rotkreuz, apply now !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Senior Software Developer (C#) for a hybrid engineering (75%) and Scrum Master (25%) role in Spain. You will take ownership of the full software development lifecycle - leveraging your deep expertise in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 to build high-performance applications - while also guiding the development team through Agile principles as a servant leader.
If you thrive on navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and are passionate about both exceptional code quality and team empowerment, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities:

Engineering & Development (75%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Team Collaboration & Planning: Self-organizing and proactive in defining, estimating, planning, and implementing work packages within the development team. Provide timely work status updates and issue notifications to the team and project management.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Scrum Master Responsibilities (25%)

• Act as a servant leader for the development team, applying Scrum principles to facilitate progress, resolve conflicts, and increase transparency.

• Empower the team by removing blockers and applying proven Agile techniques to drive continuous improvement.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who excels at navigating ambiguity and taking end-to-end ownership of technical problems. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about data-heavy infrastructure, and thrive when facilitating team progress and empowering others to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

Education and General Experience

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT,

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python / FastAPI)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Backend Python Engineer to build robust, scalable APIs and services that power our digital products in the life sciences sector. Working closely with our Frontend/UX team and Data Scientists, you will design the backend infrastructure required to process, manage, and serve complex bioinformatics and machine learning data.

In this highly collaborative role, you will tackle challenges ranging from optimizing database queries for massive datasets to architecting cloud-native solutions on AWS. We value engineers who are comfortable exploring complex data structures, establishing clean API boundaries, and ensuring high reliability as we scale our platforms to support critical scientific innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain high-performance, asynchronous backend services and robust RESTful APIs.

• Architect, deploy, and manage scalable and secure cloud infrastructure, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

• Design efficient database schemas, manage complex data relationships, execute seamless migrations, and ensure performant query optimization for massive datasets.

• Build and maintain data pipelines to ingest, normalize, and process large volumes of structured and unstructured scientific and bioinformatics data.

• Champion engineering excellence by writing clean, testable code, implementing comprehensive automated testing, and maintaining reliable CI/CD pipelines.

• Partner directly with the UX/Frontend team to establish seamless API integrations, and collaborate with Data Scientists to bring machine learning models into production workflows.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative software engineer who thrives on solving complex backend challenges. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are passionate about clean API boundaries, and excel at transforming data infrastructure to drive meaningful progress.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with Python as your primary language.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including robust API design and experience building and scaling RESTful systems.

• Solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, schema migrations, and query optimization.

• Proven experience building, deploying, and managing scalable infrastructure in cloud environments, ideally utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• A strong focus on code quali

jobs.description:

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams.

Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).

• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.

• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning.

UX Engineering & System Design:

• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.

• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements.

Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:

• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.

• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.

• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements.

Who You Are
You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship.

Qualifications & Skills

The Must-Haves:

• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.

• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine. We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact. This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions. The Opportunity We are looking for a visionary Lead UX Designer & Frontend Engineer to shape the future of our digital products in the life sciences sector. In this hybrid leadership role, you will be the driving force behind the user interfaces and complex dashboards that empower our Machine Learning and Data Science teams. Operating at the intersection of UX design and high-performance frontend engineering, you will translate complex bioinformatics, PCR, and sequencing data into intuitive, lightning-fast web applications. If you are passionate about building scalable UI architectures and graphing millions of data points to drive scientific innovation, this is the role for you. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Architecture:
• Act as the bridge between UX, Frontend, and Backend teams, driving architecture and design discussions to establish robust technical solutions and API designs (REST/GraphQL).
• Lead the end-to-end frontend implementation of enterprise-scale business applications deployed on AWS.
• Mentor and guide junior frontend engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, code quality, and continuous learning. UX Engineering & System Design:
• Own the user experience for highly complex data tools, ensuring seamless workflows for data scientists and researchers.
• Champion, maintain, and expand our internal component library (R-Design System) to ensure visual consistency across all products.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams in an Agile/SCRUM environment to map out user journeys and interface requirements. Advanced Frontend & Data Visualization:
• Build scalable, responsive, and highly interactive frontends using Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.
• Architect high-performance data visualization solutions capable of rendering millions of data points smoothly in the browser using D3.js.
• Interface directly with AWS cloud services and help shape backend interface requirements. Who You Are You are an engineering champion and a collaborative technical leader who is passionate about leveraging technology to transform medicine. You thrive when navigating ambiguity, enjoy solving complex data challenges, and excel at empowering your team through technical mentorship. Qualifications & Skills The Must-Haves:
• 5+ years of hands-on software development experience using modern JavaScript MVC frameworks, with deep, proven expertise in Vue.js.
• Strong practical experience with D3.js, including optimizin

jobs.title: Office & Workplace Experience Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Our office at Trattnerhof 1 isn’t just a place to work; it’s a three-floor hub of digital innovation and collaboration. We are looking for a proactive Team Lead to lead our office squad and ensure our physical environment keeps pace with our digital evolution.

As our Office & Workplace Experience Lead , you won't just manage a front desk (which we don’t have, btw); you will be the architect of our "Office-as-a-Service" philosophy. You will lead a team of three people and manage external vendors to provide a world-class experience for our employees and the many global visitors who call our office their favorite place to work.

The Anchor of our Hub: While many of our roles offer high flexibility for remote work, the nature of this leadership position requires a consistent on-site presence. You are the face of the office and the primary caretaker of our physical culture, ensuring that whether it's a Monday morning or a high-stakes workshop Friday, the site is buzzing and functional.

Your upcoming mission

• Lead & Empower: Mentor and lead our Office Team (3 people), fostering a culture of service excellence and proactive problem-solving.

• Global Collaboration Host: Orchestrate the experience for global Roche partners and international visitors. From high-level workshops to cross-site collaboration weeks, you ensure every visitor feels the unique welcoming energy of our site.

• Workspace Innovation: Continuously improve our 3-floor office for hybrid usage. You’ll find creative ways to make our space work for both high-energy collaboration and global virtual meetings.

• Building & Facility Management: Take full ownership of building maintenance, improvements, and construction projects. You’ll be the point of contact for external providers and contractors.

• Employee Experience: Maintain the spirit and continuously improve our space for our 250+ on-site staff, ensuring our office reflects our vibrant culture from the moment someone walks through the door.

Essential skills for your mission:

• You are a "people person" with a technical backbone. You understand that a broken coffee machine is a crisis, but a poorly planned office layout is a strategic hurdle.

• Industry Experience: 7+ years of relevant work experience

• Experience: You have a proven track record in Office Management, Facility Management, and Project Management, preferably within a professional digital or tech-heavy environment.

• Language Skills: You have native-level German skills (essential for local vendor management and legal compliance) and excellent English (our "official" company language and the key to greeting our global partners).

• Leadership Style: You lead with empathy and a "can-do" attitude. You enjoy being "where the action is" and thrive on the daily interactions that come with being on-site while always keeping the big picture in mind.

• Hospitality Mindset: You treat office management like premium hospitality, anticipating the needs of workshop facilitators and ensuring our facilities support seamless collaboration.

• Organizational Talent: You can juggle multiple projects at once without losing your cool.

Bonus skills:

• Experience with office construction project management

• Experience in a corporate / global environment

What to expect:

• Ambitious and passionate people building m

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Timkl est une entreprise de services en santé de nouvelle génération née en 2019 d’une démarche soutenue par le groupe Roche , acteur majeur de la santé en France et premier investisseur dans l’innovation santé. Nous proposons une prestation de suivi renforcé pour tous les patients diabétiques sous insulinothérapie par pompe, y compris ceux équipés des systèmes les plus innovants, comme la boucle fermée.

Notre modèle est aujourd’hui accessible sur tout le territoire français hexagonal. Il est co-construit avec les acteurs de soins, parmi lesquels : les pharmaciens, les infirmiers libéraux, les diabétologues et les médecins généralistes.

Tu as le goût du challenge ?
Tu souhaites t'impliquer dans le développement d’un modèle innovant pour améliorer la prise en charge des personnes vivant avec un diabète? Prends part à cette aventure au sein d'une équipe motivée et dynamique.

Responsabilités Principales :

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe marketing / ventes, tes missions auront pour objectif d’aider à la stratégie et au pilotage de l’activité commerciale :

• Réseaux Sociaux : Accompagnement pour le lancement de Timkl sur le réseau Instagram

• Communication Partenaires : Lancement des Newsletters Professionnels de Santé

• Relation Presse : aide à la rédaction de communiqué de presse selon l’actualité, travailler la relation avec les journalistes de l’environnement diabète

• GSite - intranet interne: Mise à jour des pages en appliquant la charte graphique et en s’assurant auprès des "page owner" que les informations sont à jour.

• Veille marché & environnement France : Nourrir les équipes marketing, ventes et administration commerciale des évolutions de marché, des concurrents et des nouvelles tendances. Analyser et traiter les chiffres clés du marché grâce à des bases de données en open data)

• Veille presse : mise en place d’un processus de partage auprès collaborateurs Timkl sur l’environnement diabète.

Idéalement, tu correspondes au profil suivant :

• Tu prépares actuellement un diplôme d'étude supérieur pour valider votre cursus M2 (Domaines: Ecole de commerce / Business intelligence : ).

• Tu es dynamique, autonome, organisé(e)

• Tu as la capacité de manipuler des données et des chiffres, avec une bonne compréhension des enjeux business opérationnels et de la collaboration avec des organisations transversales.

• Tu fais preuve d’agilité dans l’utilisation d’Excel et dans la représentation des données sous forme de graphiques.

• Tu possèdes une vision stratégique, une curiosité naturelle et des compétences en analyse de marché.

• Tu as des connaissances d’un outil de CRM (Salesforce ou autre).

• Tu démontres une capacité d’analyse et de synthèse.

Poste basé à Montbonnot (Isère, 38)

Stage de 6 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 /
Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes.
● Tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de personnes en situation de handicap. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler en amont de l’entretien.
● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature
