jobs.title: Pathology Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pathology Solutions Specialist

The Opportunity:

The Pathology Solutions Specialist in Tissue Diagnostics is responsible for protecting and growing the High Medical Value IHC portfolio and research market share. Implements sales plans designed to achieve established revenue and financial goals. Knows and understands the Advanced Staining competitive landscape including product, sales tools, and pricing for Roche Pathology Lab and all competitors. Leverages current business relationships to maintain and grow current customer base. Works in coordination with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to call on perspective and current customers. Works closely with Account Managers to sell capital equipment to most prominent health systems, hospitals and reference laboratories, either via capital expenditures or bundling with reagents.

Has a complete knowledge of company products and services, and is viewed as an expert by the company and customers. May be tasked with sales of new or strategic products. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Focuses on critical, large, complex, high-visibility, strategic or tactically important accounts. Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments.

Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

This is a field based role - the territory includes: OH, PA & WV . Candidate must reside within 50 miles of the territory border. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role.

Job Facts:

• Assumes an active leadership role during the development and implementation of capital equipment sales strategies to attain assigned sales objectives. Intimacy with company and competitive market dynamics.

• Provides professional leadership in planning, organizing, and controlling balanced sales growth, continued account penetration, and customer satisfaction.

• Utilizes strong product/market knowledge and sales experience to manage complex sales and resolve customer questions and concerns.

• Continuously builds knowledge of current industry trends, competitive information, and industry/technical knowledge and shares with other Roche colleagues.

• Responsible for the effective management of sales funnel by identification of opportunities and the creation and implementation of solutions.

• Establishes and works with Account Managers and Strategic Account Managers to build strong client relationships that allow for growth, profitability and predictability. Communicates with other relevant Roche functions to ensure needed sales support and delivery of programs/products.

• Effectively utilizes internal sales and operations support teams to advance the sale.

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

• You hold 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience required with the highest level of sales proficiency

Preferred:

• PhD or Master's Degree

• Expertise in competitive business and instrumentation, reimbursement landscape, and all other product lines.

• Leadership presence and business acumen with an understanding of the IHC and Anatomic Pathology laboratory landscape and the ability to create/drive solutions with others.

• Proven success in previou

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Specialista delle Soluzioni di Patologia L'Opportunità Il Specialista delle Soluzioni di Patologia in Diagnostica tissutale è responsabile della protezione e dell'aumento della quota di mercato dei prodotti ad alto valore medico IHC e di ricerca. Implementa i piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere gli obiettivi di logica e finanziaria stabilità. Conosce e comprende il panorama competitivo delle colorazioni avanzate, inclusi prodotti, strumenti di vendita e prezzi per Roche Pathology Lab e tutti i concorrenti. Utilizzare i rapporti commerciali esistenti per mantenere e aumentare la base di clienti esistenti. in coordinamento con gli Account Manager e gli Strategic Account Manager per contattare i clienti potenziali e esistenti. a stretto contatto con gli Account Manager per vendere l'attrezzatura di capitale alle principali strutture sanitarie, ospedali e laboratori di riferimento, tramite acquisti di capitale o bundle con i reagenti. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e dei servizi dell'azienda e viene considerato un esperto dall'azienda e dai clienti. Essere incaricati delle vendite di nuovi o prodotti strategici. sui problemi di ampia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede l'evaluazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella selezione dei metodi e delle tecniche per ottenere le soluzioni. Si connette con il personale interno ed esterno nel proprio campo di competenza. Si concentra sui conti critica, di grandi dimensioni, complessi, ad alta visibilità, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Agisce in modo indipendente per determinare i metodi e le procedure per i nuovi o speciali incarichi. È responsabile del mantenimento e dell miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e dell'ottenimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso le azioni quotidiane. Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo - il territorio includono: OH, PA & WV. Il candidato deve stabilire entro 50 miglia dal confine del territorio. Non sono previsti beneficiari di trasferimento per questo ruolo. Il lavoro del lavoro * Assume un ruolo di leadership attiva durante lo sviluppo e l'implementazione delle strategie di vendita dell'attrezzatura di capitale per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita assegnati. Conoscenza completa dell'azienda e della dinamica del mercato competitivo. * Indicae una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite bilanciate, della ricerca continua dei conti e della soddisfazione del cliente. * Utilizza la forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e l'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le intenzioni dei clienti. * Continua a costruire la conoscenza delle attuali tendenze del settore, delle informazioni competitive e della conoscenza tecnica del settore e la condivisione con i poteri di Roche. * È responsabile della gestione efficace della pipeline delle vendite attraverso l'accettazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione delle soluzioni. * Stabilisce e lavora con gli Account Manager e gli Strategic Account Manager per costruire relazioni con i clienti forti che permettono la crescita, la conseguente e la prevedibilità. Comunica con le altre funzioni di Roche pertinenti per garantire il supporto alle vendite e la consegna dei programmi/prodotti. * Utilizza in modo efficace i team interni di supporto alle vendite e alle operazioni per avanzare la vendita. Chi sei? * Hai un Diploma di Laurea o un'esperienza equivalente * Hai 5+ anni di esperienza di vendita o equivalente, con il più alto livello di professionalità nelle vendite Preferito: * Dottorato o Master * Esperienza nella concorrenza aziendale e nell'istrumentazione, nel paesaggio del rimborso e in tutte le altre linee di prodotti. * Presenza di leadership e acume per gli affari con una comprensione del paesaggio IHC e di Patologia anatomica e la capacità di creare/driven

jobs.title: Senior Statistical Methodology Data Scientist

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal de la méthodologie statistique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This role is in the Statistical Methodology group, a core function within Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) that strives to enable the most impactful use of quantitative methodology at Roche through internal collaboration, external outreach, and continuous capability building.

The Opportunity
The Statistical Methodology group is a core function within Product Development Data Sciences, enabling the impactful use of quantitative methodology across Roche through internal collaboration, external outreach and continuous capability building.
As a Senior Statistical Methodology Data Scientist, you will play a strategic role in advancing the adoption of fit-for-purpose statistical methodologies that strengthen scientific rigor, evidence generation and decision-making across clinical development programs and portfolios. Acting as a methodological thought partner, you will collaborate with study teams, biostatisticians and cross-functional stakeholders to identify needs, prototype solutions and support scalable adoption through training, templates, frameworks and tools.

In this role, you will:

• Provide expert methodological guidance to study teams on complex study design, analysis strategies and quantitative decision-making across programs.

• Lead the development and implementation of innovative statistical approaches, such as estimand frameworks, trial simulations, covariate adjustment strategies, model-based projections and quantitative go/no-go frameworks.

• Translate methodological insights into scalable solutions, including templates, training, open-source tools and best practices that strengthen analytical excellence across the organization.

• Support portfolio-level analyses, scenario modeling and quantitative frameworks that inform clinical strategy, optimize development decisions and enable evidence-based prioritization.

• Represent Roche externally through scientific collaborations, consortia, working groups, publications or regulatory-facing initiatives, helping the organization stay at the forefront of methodological advances.

Who You Are

• You hold a PhD, in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science or another related quantitative discipline.

• You have 2+ years of experience designing and applying advanced statistical or data science methods to complex biomedical data, ideally in clinical trial research or pharmaceutical development.

• You bring strong expertise in statistical computing, advanced modeling and the development of novel or fit-for-purpose analytical solutions for complex datasets.

• You are recognized as a technical expert and trusted thought partner, with the ability to translate complex methodology into clear recommendations for scientific, clinical and cross-functional stakeholders.

• You have experience contributing to internal standards, capability building, training or strategic initiatives, and you enjoy mentoring others to strengthen methodological understanding and adoption.

• You bring a collaborative and inclusive mindset, show respect for cultural differences in a global environment, and ideally have a track record of publications, presentations or thought leadership in emerging areas such as AI/ML, real-world data integration or predictive biomarkers.

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

• Hai 2 anni di esperienza nella progettazione e nell'applicazione di metodi avanzati di statistica o di scienza dei dati a dati biomedici complessi, idealmente nella ricerca clinica o nello sviluppo farmaceutico.
• Portate una forte esperienza nel calcolo statistico, nella modellazione avanzata e nello sviluppo di soluzioni analitiche innovative o fit-for-purpose per set di dati complessi.
• Sei riconosciuto come esperto tecnico e partner di pensiero di fiducia, con la capacità di tradurre una metodologia complessa in chiare raccomandazioni per gli stakeholder scientifici, clinici e interfunzionali.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle fait partie du groupe de la méthodologie statistique, une fonction essentielle au sein des Sciences des données de développement de produits (DDP) qui s'efforce de permettre l'utilisation la plus efficace de la méthodologie quantitative à Roche par la collaboration interne, la sensibilisation externe et le renforcement continu des capacités. L'opportunité Le groupe de la méthodologie statistique est une fonction essentielle au sein des Sciences des données de développement de produits, permettant l'utilisation efficace de la méthodologie quantitative à Roche par la collaboration interne, la sensibilisation externe et le renforcement continu des capacités. En tant que chercheur principal en données de méthodologie statistique, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique dans l'adoption de méthodes statistiques adaptées à l'usage qui renforcent la rigueur scientifique, la production de données probantes et la prise de décisions dans tous les programmes et portefeuilles de développement clinique. En tant que partenaire de réflexion méthodologique, vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'étude, les biostatisticiens et les intervenants interfonctionnels pour identifier les besoins, les solutions prototypes et soutenir l'adoption évolutive par la formation, les modèles, les cadres et les outils. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Fournir des conseils méthodologiques spécialisés aux équipes d'étude sur la conception d'études complexes, les stratégies d'analyse et la prise de décisions quantitatives dans l'ensemble des programmes.
• Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en œuvre d'approches statistiques novatrices, telles que les cadres d'estimation, les simulations d'essai, les stratégies d'ajustement covariables, les projections fondées sur des modèles et les cadres quantitatifs aller/aller.
• Traduire les idées méthodologiques en solutions évolutives, y compris les modèles, la formation, les outils libres et les meilleures pratiques qui renforcent l'excellence analytique dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Appuyer les analyses de portefeuille, la modélisation de scénarios et les cadres quantitatifs qui éclairent la stratégie clinique, optimisent les décisions de développement et permettent l'établissement de priorités fondées sur des données probantes.
• Représenter Roche à l'extérieur par des collaborations scientifiques, des consortiums, des groupes de travail, des publications ou des initiatives axées sur la réglementation, aidant l'organisation à rester à l'avant-garde des avancées méthodologiques. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en statistique, informatique, informatique ou autre discipline quantitative connexe.
• Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience dans la conception et l'application de méthodes avancées de statistique ou de science des données à des données biomédicales complexes, idéalement dans la recherche clinique ou le développement pharmaceutique.
• Vous apportez une forte expertise dans le calcul statistique, la modélisation avancée et le développement de solutions d'analyse innovantes ou adaptées pour des ensembles de données complexes.
• Vous êtes reconnu comme un expert technique et un partenaire de pensée de confiance, avec la capacité de traduire la méthodologie complexe en recommandations claires pour les acteurs scientifiques, cliniques et interfonctionnels.
• Vous avez de l'expérience en matière de normes internes, de renforcement des capacités, de formation ou d'initiatives stratégiques, et vous aimez encadrer d'autres personnes pour renforcer la compréhension méthodologique et l'adoption.
• Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif et inclusif, montrez le respect des différences culturelles dans un environnement mondial, et idéalement avoir un bilan de publications, de présentations ou de leadership de pensée dans des domaines émergents tels que l'IA/ML, l'intégration de données dans le monde réel ou les biomarqueurs prédictifs. Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Business Partner (advisory) Team Lead, you will lead a team of Business Partners (advisory) in the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization within one of the regions. The Business Partner (advisory) partners flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, the Business Partner (advisory) provides coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensures effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters.

Working closely with P&C colleagues, this leader will lead 13 BPAs spread across different countries, supporting different enterprises and an open and diverse work culture based on trust and performance. Your activities uphold Roche's reputation as an attractive employer – today and going forward.

• Team Leadership and Culture: Manage all employment decisions (hiring, development, performance, compensation), establish the team's budget, act as an escalation point, and build an engaging culture aligned with Roche Leadership commitments.

• Service Delivery: Ensure high customer and employee satisfaction by providing urgent, high-quality, end-to-end P&C solutions and successfully completing cases and projects.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PSS teams, P&C chapters, and enabling functions (Finance, IT, Procurement) across regions to ensure consistent and effective service delivery and global consistency.

• Strategic P&C Guidance (Business Acumen): Offer immediate, short-term strategic guidance to leaders on core P&C needs like succession, talent management, performance, and compensation, leveraging P&C experts for timely solutions.

• Process and Compliance: Consult, advise, and train leaders on global P&C processes and system topics (e.g., new system launches, global grading), ensuring alignment with policies and compliance with legislative requirements.

• Trusted Partner in P&C Areas (Leadership): Serve as a trusted partner to leaders, diagnosing and proposing fit-for-purpose approaches for complex P&C topics (e.g., talent, compensation, change management, conflict resolution).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As ITOT Site Operation Manager, you will be the driver of business opportunities enabled by information and operational technologies. As the business partner to the campus your focus is always on site priorities including Make, Assess, Release and delivering the pipeline of new products in alignment with network priorities under RDT organization. Being accountable for the end to end ITOT landscape, you are the strategic RDT interface for development of digital technology and processes, risk and relationship management. In addition, you take a key role in the digitalization of PT's global manufacturing network, which targets to deliver reliable PT network defi ned services through standardization of the ITOT environment. Your contribution will be fundamental to embed the new operating model and culture into the entire function. As PT endeavors a lean and agile way of working, you will be infl uencing and coordinating a growing, global contingent of employees in shifting mentalities and agile ways of working. What you'll be working on Provide strong inspirational, engaging leadership and coaching to direct reports and develop the next generation of leaders while nurturing a culture of agility and collaboration following Roche Leadership commitment Catalyze organizational growth, negotiate and infl uence through being a coach, change agent, trainer, mentor and sounding board for team members, develop team people and skill up the ITOT site team’s capability in digitalization and leadership Lead ITOT site operation team and manage the external vendor to provide the sustainable and reliable ITOT service for site operations to contribute site business goals and meet the PTSH defi ned KPI including, RFT,OEE,OLT, deviation, and etc. Develop and maintain a high digital capability ITOT team for PTSH site operation Accountable for cross-functional teams in an agile set-up, taking the role of advising, educating and challenging the status quo with a customer oriented E2E mindset Ultimately driving end-to-end Make Assess Release (MAR) digital capability to support PTSH site manufacturing, warehouse logistic, maintenance, technical transfer, qualifi cation & validation, quality and Lab business to ensure the business commitment is delivered. As accountable for the site IT OT Operation Services and Product Portfolio, ensure overall production strategy and commitments are met, supported by a conductive environment for robust manufacturing execution and continuous improvement. In partnership with PTSH Site Leadership team colleagues, take a key role in defi ning the site operation execution activities together with site head and SLT, identifying business opportunities and co-creating technology-enabled strategies in alignment with overall Manufacturing Site and Network level Themes & Epics. Facilitate continuous improvement of prioritized initiatives and operational processes, ensuring mobilization of needed resources and skills to advance the ITOT system life-cycle, including cybersecurity remediation, systems, equipment and digital integration, deployment, upgrades. Defi ne the site digital roadmap and responsible for the execution and effectiveness review, identify the site business opportunities and leading the digital execution initiation, identify the site business risks and defi ne the mitigation actions in ITOT areas and provide professional digital consulting to
business. Be fully accountable for site ITOT operation fi nancial target to ensure the service running and ne

jobs.title: Laborant Qualitätskontrolle (m/w/d, befristet)

titleByLocale.fr: Contrôle de la qualité en laboratoire (m/f/j, temporaire)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:
Der Bereich Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist weltweit der wichtigste Roche Diagnostics Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen und Zwischenprodukten für die gesamte diagnostische Produktion von Roche. Die Einheit Qualitätskontrolle ist verantwortlich für die Analytik und Freigabe dieser Produkte. Der Fokus für diese Stelle liegt auf molekularbiologischer und immunologischer Analytik und funktionellen Freigabemethoden.

Das Team:
Im modernen Labor der Gruppe DOZQSX erwarten dich 13 Kolleginnen, welche im engen Austausch untereinander und mit weiteren Gruppen der Qualitätskontrolle arbeiten. Zur Seite stehen dir Laborassistenten, die den Laborbetrieb planen und Fragen rund um die Analytik beantworten können. Über die Gruppen hinaus sind wir mit den Schnittstellen Musterziehung, Planung und Produktion eng vernetzt. Dich erwartet ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es dir leichtmachen wird, Fuß zu fassen. Wir haben eine ausgewogene Mischung aus langjährig erfahrenen und jungen Mitarbeitern. Die gute und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit im Team ist ein wichtiger Baustein unseres Erfolgs.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du führst Analytik im Bereich Molekularbiologie (z.B. RealTime PCR, Nukleinsäureaufreinigung) und Sequenzierung (NGS) durch

• Du wertest Analytik-Ergebnisse selbstständig aus und dokumentierst diese gemäß DIN ISO / GMP bzw. geltenden Arbeitsanweisungen

• Du erkennst, dokumentierst und bearbeitest Abweichungen

• Du pflegst deinen Laborarbeitsplatz und übernimmst die Verantwortung für Equipment

• Du führst eigenständig Testmessungen im Rahmen von Validierungen sowie Optimierungen analytischer Testmethoden durch

• Anfallende Zusatzaufgaben sowie Spezialanalysen erledigst du nach Einweisung durch deinen Vorgesetzten selbstständig

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Islamabad
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love
Your Opportunity ​

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products)

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Responsible to report incident/accident immediately to SHE department. Attend / complete all requisite on-line and F2F trainings (Role specific, Safety Responsibility and Compliance) within specified time limit to ensure the learning outcome after the training has been implemented.

• Responsible to own the SHE goals as individual goals and play his/her part to achieve the goal in line with strategies/action plan.

• Identifies, collects and immediately reports all safety related information on Roche products to Local

• Safety Responsible as per Roche requirements and local regulations.

• Responsible for maintenance of records (electronic and physical as per the Local Core Map policy.

• Any other duties that maybe assigned from time to time as required by the business.

Who you are
EDUCATION

• Science degree ( Pharm D / Dentistry will be an added advantage)

• Business Degree is a plus

EXPERIENCE & KNOWLEDGE

• Minimum 3 years of relevant therapeutic area experience

• Consistent track record of achieving objectives, collaboration and team work

• Experience in agile ways of working is a plus

• Cross functional experience

• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience

• excellence.

• Growth mindset

• Deep understanding of patient journey(s) and related treatments in defined disease area(s), enabling

• engagement at the specialist level.

• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on

• future-based solutions.

• Robust understanding of medical affairs strategies and tactics including clinical research.

What we offer
Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders.

Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. We strive for excellence and extraordinary results and take a genuine interest in our people and their well-being, and our patients.

Take pride in knowing you can make a difference to millions of patients worldwide in developing diagnostics and treatments for oncology, neuroscience, inflammation, immunology, ophthalmology, rare disease

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
Every role at Roche contributes uniquely to delivering greater value to patients and healthcare systems. In this role, you will join a dynamic engineering team in Spain, driving technical excellence and shaping solutions that transform lives.
As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of the entire software development lifecycle—from early feasibility studies and architectural design to implementation and testing—leveraging your deep expertise to build robust, high-performance applications.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, including feasibility studies, architectural design, development, testing, bug fixing, and continuous software maintenance.

• Translate complex software requirements and project architecture into clear unit and subsystem specifications.

• Design and implement high-quality, robust code, ensuring comprehensive test coverage to verify full functionality against specifications.

• Collaborate proactively within an Agile environment (Scrum/Kanban) to define, estimate, plan, and execute development work packages.

• Champion quality assurance by conducting thorough code reviews for your own work and collaborating on peer reviews to enhance application performance, design, and usability.

• Navigate ambiguity confidently, leveraging modern AI-supporting tools throughout the lifecycle to streamline coding, testing, and troubleshooting.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, self-organizing engineer who thrives in collaborative, fast-paced technical environments. You are passionate about software craft, code quality, and driving engineering practices forward. You are an empathetic communicator who enjoys sharing knowledge and working alongside diverse teams to solve complex health technology challenges.

Your Qualifications & Skills:

• Technical Experience: Extensive professional experience in software development (typically 7+ years), with highly advanced skills in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0.

• Database & Architecture: Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and leveraging ORMs such as Entity Framework.

• Modern Engineering Practices: Strong proficiency with version control systems (Git/GitHub) and a deep understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).

• AI & Automation: Demonstrated proficiency in utilizing AI-supporting tools throughout the development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and debugging, alongside basic exper

jobs.description:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this unique role, you will combine high-impact hands-on engineering with servant leadership to guide your development team toward continuous improvement. You will join a highly collaborative team environment where you will drive the full software development lifecycle while championing Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility studies and application design to testing, bug fixing, and software maintenance.

• Design, implement, and test high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Act as a Scrum Master and servant leader for the development team, facilitating progress, resolving blockers, and increasing workplace transparency.

• Empower the team by applying proven Agile techniques, fostering conflict resolution, situational awareness, and continuous improvement.

• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing teams to define, estimate, and plan high-impact work packages.

• Leverage modern AI-supporting tools throughout the entire development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and troubleshooting workflows.

• Review application designs, functionality, and source code to champion technical excellence and drive ongoing enhancements.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, collaborative technical professional who excels at navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are deeply passionate about exceptional code quality, and thrive when empowering cross-functional teams to succeed.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a strong background in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.

• Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator for a software development team diligently applying Scrum practices and theory.

• Certification in Scrum methodologies (such as CSM or PSM I) alongside deep knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, and team empowerment techniques.

• Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and utilizing ORMs like Entity Framework.

• Practical understanding of modern development ecosystems, including Git/GitHub version control and setting up basic build environments.

• Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to connect teams and resolve conflicts.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine. We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact. This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions. The Opportunity In this unique role, you will combine high-impact hands-on engineering with servant leadership to guide your development team toward continuous improvement. You will join a highly collaborative team environment where you will drive the full software development lifecycle while championing Agile methodologies. Key Responsibilities:
• Drive all phases of the software development lifecycle, from feasibility studies and application design to testing, bug fixing, and software maintenance.
• Design, implement, and test high-quality code utilizing C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.
• Act as a Scrum Master and servant leader for the development team, facilitating progress, resolving blockers, and increasing workplace transparency.
• Empower the team by applying proven Agile techniques, fostering conflict resolution, situational awareness, and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate proactively within self-organizing teams to define, estimate, and plan high-impact work packages.
• Leverage modern AI-supporting tools throughout the entire development lifecycle to optimize coding, testing, and troubleshooting workflows.
• Review application designs, functionality, and source code to champion technical excellence and drive ongoing enhancements. Who You Are You are a proactive, collaborative technical professional who excels at navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong analytical mindset, are deeply passionate about exceptional code quality, and thrive when empowering cross-functional teams to succeed. Qualifications & Skills:
• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a strong background in C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0 frameworks.
• Proven experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Facilitator for a software development team diligently applying Scrum practices and theory.
• Certification in Scrum methodologies (such as CSM or PSM I) alongside deep knowledge of servant leadership, facilitation, and team empowerment techniques.
• Solid experience with SQL Server, including database design and utilizing ORMs like Entity Framework.
• Practical understanding of modern development ecosystems, including Git/GitHub version control and setting up basic build environments.
• Exceptional English communication and interpersonal skills, with a natural ability to connect teams and resolve conflicts.
• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). At Ro

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (Rust)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
In this foundational role, you will act as our premier Rust expert, spearheading the strategic migration of our core execution engines, algorithms, and high-performance systems from C# to Rust. You will join a forward-thinking and collaborative environment where your technical vision shapes the future of our engineering stack.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the strategic migration of legacy C# (.NET) codebases, execution engines, and complex algorithms into highly optimized, safe, and concurrent Rust applications.

• Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance software components throughout the full software development lifecycle.

• Define all aspects of development for the new stack, establishing rigorous coding standards, workflows, and appropriate build and CI/CD environments.

• Provide technical guidance, expertise, and coaching to developers, playing a central role in upskilling the team and building internal Rust expertise from the ground up.

• Monitor team progress to ensure consistency with the initial architectural design, technical vision, and quality standards.

• Ensure all software strictly complies with requirements for quality, security, modifiability, and extensibility while leveraging modern AI-supporting tools to optimize efficiency.

Who You Are
You are a visionary technical leader and a passionate educator who thrives when navigating ambiguity and driving technological evolution. You possess deep engineering intuition, love tackling complex architectural challenges, and excel at empowering others to adopt new modern paradigms.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Extensive professional experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production-grade Rust applications.

• Exceptional, production-level proficiency in Rust, including a deep mastery of its memory safety guarantees, lifetimes, async runtimes (such as Tokio), concurrency models, and standard tooling (Cargo, Clippy).

• Strong foundational knowledge of C# and .NET architectures to effectively understand, reverse-engineer, and transition existing codebases.

• Demonstrated architectural skills with a proven ability to design complex, scalable software systems and define clear technical visions.

• Exceptional talent for coaching, mentoring, and providing high-level technical guidance to engineering teams while navigating ambiguity with a forward-progress mindset.

• Excellent interpersonal and English

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Engineer/Scientist in Electrochemical Method Development , you will be the primary owner of analytical performance specifications for Blood Gas and Electrolyte (BGE) parameters. You will work at the intersection of electrochemistry, advanced mathematics, and medical technology to ensure our diagnostic systems deliver clinical excellence.

• Innovate Measurement Methods: Define and optimize electrochemical and optical measurement methods, collaborating across sensor, hardware, and software teams to push the boundaries of diagnostic precision.

• Master Mathematical Modeling: Create robust models for measurement and calibration, translating complex physical principles into precise signal interpretation algorithms.

• Drive Algorithmic Progress: Apply modern development techniques, including model-based design and machine learning, to continuously improve data workflows and diagnostic accuracy.

• Solve Issues: Conduct deep-dive scientific investigations into product issues, developing innovative remedial solutions to maintain peak performance.

• Engineer Performance: Manage tolerance budgets and control all influence factors on analytical results, ensuring strict traceability to global reference materials.

• Lead System Validation: Spearhead the planning and execution of functional and stability tests, using statistical characterization to evaluate system-wide results.

• Solve Complex Challenges: Conduct deep-dive scientific investigations into real-world product issues, developing innovative remedial solutions to maintain peak performance.

Who You Are
You are a scientifically driven expert who values technical rigor and thrives in interdisciplinary environments. You are passionate about applying your expertise to solve challenges that directly impact patient health.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Development Engineer/ Mathematician/ Data Analyst , you will be a vital part of our development team in Spain, focusing on our innovative Blood Gas & Electrolyte Analyzers. You will transform complex physical measurement data into precise, life-saving results through mathematical excellence.

• Robust Algorithms: Develop and refine sophisticated methods, algorithms, and failsafes that extract highly reliable results from physical measurement data. Drive projects from initial conception through to rigorous testing and final completion.

• Model the Future: Create mathematical models and provide expert statistical consulting (including Design of Experiments and Validation) to drive data-driven decision-making and product excellence.

• Bridge Science and Compliance: Implement biometric methods into specification documents, ensuring our products meet the highest health authority requirements and regulatory standards.

• Drive Product Approvals: Support global product launches by developing solid statistical rationales and customized solutions for ongoing product maintenance.

• Unlock Insights: Extract, clean, and visualize large datasets, collaborating with an interdisciplinary team to present actionable insights that drive medical innovation.

• Lead as a Technical Expert: Act as a central point of contact and own the technical solutions, providing the rationale necessary to ensure product quality and scientific integrity.

Who You Are
You are an analytical thinker, solution-oriented who enjoys working in a team at the intersection of engineering, mathematics, physics, and medical technology. You thrive in collaborative, international environments, not hesitant to proactively raise your voice and you are passionate about using your quantitative skills to improve patient care.

• Quantitative Expert: You hold a Master's degree or higher in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.

• Experience: You ​have 7+ years of professional industry related experience.

• Control Engineering/Signal Processing Specialist: You have deep knowledge of system identification, model-based filtering, and classic or model-predictive control methods.

• Sensor & Modeling Pro: You bring experience in modeling electrochemical sensors and optimizing robust calibration methods to ensure precision.

• Statistical Powerhouse: You are highly proficient in modern statistical software such as MATLAB (preferred), Pyt

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Field Service Engineer (Jaén)
• Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.
En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.
El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva, convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche, y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.
Responsabilidades Principales
Operaciones Técnicas y Servicio Operativo:
● Excelencia operativa: Ejecutar de forma impecable los procedimientos de mantenimientos preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos, instalaciones y modificaciones de los sistemas asignados, así como que la experiencia del cliente alrededor de todas esas intervenciones sea excelente.
● Monitorización: Incorporar y promover el uso de herramientas digitales en el seguimiento de los clientes asignados para evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente, proactivo y orientado a maximizar la experiencia del cliente.
● Reporte y calidad: Registrar te en el CRM todas las actividades realizadas (remotas o in situ ), garantizando la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación según los estándares de la organización.
● Planificación: Asegurar el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos mediante el uso del Dashboard de Servicio, en las cuentas asignadas.
Gestión de Cuentas Clave:
● Referencia técnica: Actuar como referente en la gestión del cliente de las cuentas clave de Jaén así como referente a nivel nacional ( cross country ) en el soporte e implementación de las cuentas estratégicas.
● Gestión dedicada (100% enfocada en satisfacción y KPIs): Proporcionar un servicio integral y proactivo, implementando decisiones que optimicen la prestación del servicio e impacten positivamente en la experiencia del cliente.
• Resolución de Problemas y Soporte Proactivo:
• ● Atención al cliente: Establecer y mantener una comunicación excelente y proactiva, informando sobre actualizaciones de reactivos, sistemas y controles de calidad.
• ● Gestión de incidencias: Resolver de forma eficiente quejas y reclamaciones, procesando las modificaciones solicitadas y proporcionando un seguimiento constante hasta la resolución completa.
• ● Sinergia comercial: Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para abordar las necesidades de los clientes y respaldar las ventas de soluciones y ofertas de servicio.

Requisitos: Formación y Experiencia
• ● Formación Académica: Grado en Ingeniería (Electrónica, Mecánica, Biomédica, Ingeniería Técnica o disciplinas afines).
• ● Experiencia Requerida:

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Buscamos un profesional para proporcionar servicio científico/técnico a sistemas y soluciones implementadas en las instalaciones de clientes en el área de las tecnologías de la información.

¿Quiénes somos?
En Roche, somos pioneros en el campo de la biotecnología y nos dedicamos a mejorar la salud y el bienestar de las personas en todo el mundo. Con un enfoque en la innovación y la excelencia, buscamos talentos excepcionales que se unan a nuestro equipo y contribuyan a nuestros objetivos.

El Field Services presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas:
Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor que Roche y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Descripción del puesto:

Proporcionar soporte técnico integral y de alta visibilidad al cliente, incluyendo:

• Instalación y configuración de equipos: Liderar la instalación y configuración de analizadores y soluciones en el laboratorio del cliente, asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos y estándares de la compañía.

• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.

• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.

• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.

• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.

• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.

• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.

• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.

• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.

• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente.

Información del Puesto:

• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)

• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español

• Dominio del inglés

• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.

• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional

• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

• Ejecución de mantenimientos (preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos) e instalaciones para alcanzar y mantener un nivel operativo excelente en todos los instrumentos, reactivos y software asignados, y capacitar a los usuarios en su uso.
• Establecer y mantener una comunicación proactiva, seguimiento y colaboración excelente con el cliente, incluyendo la notificación de actualizaciones de reactivos, controles de calidad y la implementación de nuevos protocolos.
• Proporcionar información científica y técnica experta a los clientes sobre el portfolio completo de Roche Diagnostics.
• Gestión y Optimización del workflow: configurar, monitorizar y optimizar continuamente los flujos de trabajo y las rutas de las muestras en las soluciones automatizadas, definiendo prioridades para maximizar la eficiencia operativa de las soluciones y el cumplimiento de los tiempos de respuesta.
• Mejorar y optimizar los procesos de instalación, configuración y formación al usuario, garantizando la sostenibilidad y la satisfacción del cliente mediante el uso de herramientas digitales de la compañía.
• Reporte y documentación rigurosa: Reportar toda la actividad (remota o in situ) en el CRM y asegurar la correcta documentación y actualización de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente, siguiendo los estándares de calidad de reporte.
• Trabajar estrechamente con el Área Comercial para satisfacer las necesidades del cliente y apoyar activamente la venta de soluciones y las ofertas de servicio de la compañía.
• Maximizar la eficiencia de todas las intervenciones de servicio e implementar un mantenimiento predictivo y proactivo de los equipos a través de la gestión y monitorización remota.
• Monitorizar y analizar los Indicadores Clave de Servicio (KPIs) en las cuentas asignadas para garantizar la excelencia del servicio al cliente. Información del Puesto:
• Requisitos Educativos: Formación en Grado en Ingeniería técnica, electrónica, biomédica o similar (Ciencias de la Salud)
• Requisitos Especiales:
• Nivel fluido español
• Dominio del inglés
• Residencia preferente: Santiago, se valorarán otras zona s.
• Movilidad geográfica en territorio nacional
• Flexibilidad horaria: turno deslizante

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:
En tant que FMI - Chef de Produit (d/f/m), vous intégrez l’équipe marketing responsable des activités de diagnostic moléculaire au sein de Roche Diagnostic France et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le/la responsable des solutions de séquençage. Vous êtes en charge de la gestion du cycle de vie d’une nouvelle gamme de produits FMI (Fondation médecine) intégrés dans la filiale et des lancements qui complètent cette gamme. Vous êtes le point de contact privilégié pour toutes questions expertes sur les produits de cette gamme. Vous collaborez avec vos homologues au niveau régional/groupe et participez à des projets en lien avec votre expertise.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous développez un réseau de leaders d’opinion autour de cette gamme

• Vous possédez une connaissance intime des enjeux du marché et des besoins des clients sur cette offre et savez démontrer sa valeur ajoutée

• Vous initiez et gérez des actions de Co marketing en collaboration avec notre partenaire (l'Institut Gustave Roussy) pour donner de la visibilité à ce partenariat et supporter le développement du business

• Vous êtes en charge d’élaborer le plan marketing annuel pour votre gamme et d'en assurez le suivi en lien avec les informations fournies par le groupe

• Vous mettez en place des plans d’actions correctives et tactiques pour garantir une expérience et satisfaction client optimum sur votre gamme

• Vous gérez le cycle de vie des produit/solutions (lancement, prévisions de commandes, plan d’obsolescence ..), en assurez la promotion par des contenus adaptés aux différents supports de communication et mesurez l’impact de ces campagnes.

• Vous suivez l’évolution de la croissance de votre gamme en terme de revenu et proposez des actions correctives si besoin

• Vous produisez des indicateurs clés de performance et les suivez en permanence afin d’ajuster la stratégie marketing et d'accroître la satisfaction client sur le produit

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous avez une formation supérieur scientifique/médicale complétée par une formation management/marketing

• Vous avez une expérience reconnue en marketing produit, techniques marketing et l'établissement de business models

• Vous êtes autonome et possédez des capacités d’innovation, d’anticipation, d’analyse et de synthèse

• Vous démontrez une aisance relationnelle, la capacité de fédérer et d'influencer, vous aimez communiquer à l’écrit et à l’oral

• Une bonne connaissance du marché et des parcours patients en oncologie serait un réel atout

• Enfin, votre niveau d'Anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Servizio Clienti RDT DIA
titleByLocale.en: Technical Product Owner - RDT DIA Customer Service
titleByLocale.de: Technical Product Owner - RDT DIA Kundendienst
titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire de produits techniques - RDT DIA Service à la clientèle

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner - RDT DIA Customer Service

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we o ffer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The opportunity:

The Technical Product Owner drives the definition, alignment, and delivery of complex system capabilities across the RDT Customer and Service Enablement Team . Operating at the intersection of business and technology, you ensure that initiatives are strategically aligned, technically sound, and deliver measurable value. In this strategic role , you provide direction across Delivery Leads and Engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge through publications , inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service solutions. You own and evolve the system-level vision and roadmap, translating strategic objectives into a prioritized backlog and guiding delivery from concept through implementation. You work closely with engineering teams to shape scalable, sustainable solutions, making informed trade-offs across architecture, performance, and time-to-market.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Outcome Accountability & Execution : Own the product backlog for assigned systems, prioritizing features and operational needs based on business value and compliance. You will be accountable for the backlog execution in accordance with CSV and best QA practices. Actively champion high-value work and challenge low-impact efforts.

• Architecture & Non-Functional Excellence : Proactively ensure all solutions adhere to established architectural patterns, enterprise technology strategies, and non-functional expectations (performance, reliability, scalability).

• Business Collaboration: Partner closely with BPOs to align technical execution with commercial objectives, translating functional customer service needs into robust technical realities.

• System Ownership & Governance: Serve as the accountable System Owner, ensuring applications remain fit-for-purpose, secure, and fully compliant with IT governance throughout their lifecycle.

• Financial Responsibilities: Manage project budgets and resource allocation effectively, ensuring all initiatives are delivered within financial constraints and optimized.

• Knowledge Transfer & Operational Continuity: Drive the structured capture of product knowledge, comprehensive system documentation, and operational runbooks to ensure high availability and seamless operational handovers.

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Drive alignment across integrations, data workflows, and Managed Servi

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Servizio Clienti RDT DIA Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. L'opportunità: Il proprietario del prodotto tecnico guida la definizione, l'allineamento e la consegna di complesse funzionalità di sistema attraverso il team di implementazione del cliente e del servizio RDT . Operando all'incrocio tra business e tecnologia, si assicura che le iniziative siano strategicamente allineate, tecnicamente solide, e diano valore misurabile. In questo ruolo strategico , si fornisce la direzione attraverso i lead di consegna e gli ingegneri, eccellere nei negoziati di stakeholder, e fornire la direzione per gli obiettivi a medio-lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica attraverso pubblicazioni, ispirare l'innovazione e guidare il design di soluzioni multi-servizio complesse. Possiedi ed evolu la visione a livello di sistema e la roadmap, traducendo obiettivi strategici in backlog a priori e guidando la consegna dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione. Si lavora a stretto contatto con i team di ingegneria per modellare soluzioni scalabili e sostenibili, rendendo gli scambi informati tra architettura, performance e time-to-market. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili di:
• Responsabilità e esecuzione dei redditi: il proprio backlog del prodotto per i sistemi assegnati, la priorità delle funzionalità e delle esigenze operative basate sul valore aziendale e sulla conformità. Sarete responsabili per l'esecuzione backlog in conformità con le pratiche CSV e QA migliori. Campione attivo lavoro ad alto valore e sfida gli sforzi a basso impatto.
• Architettura & Eccellenza non funzionale: assicurarsi che tutte le soluzioni aderiscano a modelli architettonici consolidati, strategie tecnologiche aziendali e aspettative non funzionali (prestazioni, affidabilità, scalabilità).
• Collaborazione aziendale: collaborare a stretto contatto con BPO per allineare l'esecuzione tecnica con obiettivi commerciali, traducendo le esigenze funzionali del servizio clienti in solide realtà tecniche.
• Proprietario di sistema & Governance: Servire come proprietario responsabile del sistema, garantire che le applicazioni rimangano adeguate, sicure e pienamente conformi alla governance IT durante il loro ciclo di vita.
• Responsabilità finanziarie: gestire i bilanci di progetto e l'allocazione delle risorse in modo efficace, garantire che tutte le iniziative vengano consegnate all'interno di vincoli finanziari e ottimizzate.
• Trasferimento di conoscenze e continuità operativa: guidare la cattura strutturata della conoscenza del prodotto, la documentazione completa del sistema e i runbook operativi per garantire elevata disponibilità e consegne operative senza interruzioni.
• Coordinamento trasversale: allineamento dell'unità attraverso integrazioni, flussi di dati e Managed Servi
