A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, il nostro dipartimento Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) ha lo scopo di migliorare la salute per i pazienti, valutando e comunicando il profilo di sicurezza dei medicinali Roche per ottimizzare il loro profilo di rischio. L'opportunità Il Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) fornisce leadership strategica, competenza e supervisione per un team globale nella progettazione, sviluppo, implementazione e coordinamento delle attività relative allo sviluppo della sicurezza, innovazione, progettazione dei processi e miglioramento continuo, a nome del PDS. Come membro del PVSD Leadership Team, il Senior Group Director guida la funzione SDP globale in 4 siti di sviluppo di prodotti globali (Basel in Svizzera, South San Francisco negli Stati Uniti, Welwyn nel Regno Unito, e Mississauga in Canada). Il ruolo assicura che i processi critici per la sicurezza siano progettati, sviluppati, “di proprietà” e supportati in linea con i requisiti aziendali e con i continui obiettivi di miglioramento. Essi assicurano che i piloti, i progetti e i programmi principali, destinati a migliorare gli approcci di sicurezza scientifica, siano consegnati o coordinati in linea con i piani concordati. Essi sono anche responsabili di garantire che PDS “sempre di lavoro” adattarsi alle mutevoli esigenze del cliente, e che la più ampia comunità PDS ha accesso a consigli esperti a sostegno dei loro sforzi per fornire valore allo sviluppo della droga e alla gestione del rischio paziente. Il Direttore del Gruppo Senior è responsabile di garantire che il team SDP adotti l'innovazione, anticipa e agisce su nuovi sviluppi significativi o miglioramenti necessari ai modi di lavoro PDS e fornisce un contributo efficace alle future strategie di abilitazione in PDS. Il Senior Group Director sfrutta i punti di forza di una squadra globale diversificata e crea un ambiente stimolante in cui i membri del team SDP si sentono in grado di prendere la proprietà dei responsabili, costruire conoscenze e distribuire le risorse in modo efficace, sempre sforzandosi per il miglioramento continuo e l'innovazione. Essi sono responsabili per l'implementazione e il funzionamento di processi globali e/o funzionali definiti, compresi i collegamenti con sistemi/strumenti associati di progettazione/sviluppo, attraverso le vaste aree di sicurezza legate all'impegno del team. Il remit della squadra SDP copre le seguenti aree principali:
• Progettazione, sviluppo, manutenzione, supervisione e miglioramento continuo dei processi di sicurezza in conformità ai domini GVP, GCP e Medical Device.
• Sostenere la capacità dell’organizzazione di eseguire i processi di sicurezza attraverso la fornitura di competenze tecniche e scientifiche.
• La progettazione, lo sviluppo, l’implementazione e il coordinamento delle attività di miglioramento strategico e continuo che progrediscono gli obiettivi a breve e a lungo termine del PDS.
• Facilitazione e coordinamento dell'innovazione di sicurezza nella coesione con le esigenze dei processi di sicurezza.
• Fornitura di competenze scientifiche di nicchia che beneficiano potenzialmente delle esigenze del portafoglio. Responsabilità e responsabilità primarie:
• Leadership: Fornisce la linea-leadership per la sotto-funzione SDP globale; i membri degli allenatori per massimizzare il potenziale e il benessere mentre sostengono un clima di scopo e urgenza
• Direzione Strategica: Responsabile per la definizione e l'articolazione della visione e della strategia per SDP, in allineamento con PVSD, PDS e strategie aziendali overarching
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con varie funzioni di Pharma in base alla necessità business-critical emergente.
• Contabile per assicurare che SDP possa anticipare, sviluppare e sostenere le “strade di lavoro” scientifiche migliorate/coerenti,
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, our Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) department aims to enhance healthcare for patients by elucidating and communicating the safety profile of Roche medicines to optimise their benefit-risk profile. The Opportunity The Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) provides strategic leadership, expertise and oversight for a global team in the design, development, implementation and coordination of activities relating to safety development, innovation, process design and continuous improvement, on behalf of PDS. As a member of the PVSD Leadership Team, the Senior Group Director leads the global SDP function across 4 global product development sites (Basel in Switzerland, South San Francisco in the USA, Welwyn in the UK, and Mississauga in Canada). The role ensures that safety-critical processes are designed, developed, ‘owned’ and supported in line with business requirements and continuous improvement goals. They ensure that pilots, projects and major programs, intended to improve scientific safety approaches, are delivered or coordinated in line with agreed plans. They are also responsible for ensuring that PDS ‘ways of working’ adapt to changing customer requirements, and that the wider PDS community have access to expert advice in support of their efforts to deliver value to drug development and patient risk management. The Senior Group Director is responsible for ensuring the SDP team fosters innovation, anticipates and acts on significant new developments or improvements required to PDS ways of working, and provides effective input to future enablement strategies in PDS. The Senior Group Director leverages the strengths of a diverse global team and creates an inspiring environment where the SDP team members feel empowered to take ownership of deliverables, build knowledge and deploy resources effectively, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation. They are accountable for the implementation and functioning of defined global and/or functional process(es), including the links with associated systems/tools design/development, across the broad safety-related areas of the team's remit. The SDP team's remit spans the following main areas:
• The design, development, maintenance, oversight, and continuous improvement of the Safety processes in compliance with GVP, GCP, and Medical Device domains.
• Sustaining the organisation’s ability to execute Safety processes through the provision of both technical and scientific expertise.
• The design, development, implementation, and coordination of both strategic and continuous improvement activities that advance PDS’s short and long-term objectives.
• Facilitation and coordination of safety innovation in cohesion with the needs of the Safety processes.
• Provision of niche scientific expertise that potentially benefits the needs of the portfolio. Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
• Leadership: Provides line-leadership for the global SDP sub-function; coaches members to maximise potential and well-being while sustaining a climate of purpose and urgency
• Strategic Direction: Responsible for defining and articulating vision and strategy for SDP, in alignment with the overarching PVSD, PDS and wider enterprise strategies
• Partnering closely with various functions in Pharma based on emerging business-critical need.
• Accountable for ensuring SDP can anticipate, develop, and support improved/consistent scientific ‘ways of working’,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche zielt unser Global Product Development Safety & Risk Management (PDS) darauf ab, die Gesundheitsversorgung für Patienten zu verbessern, indem es das Sicherheitsprofil von Roche-Medikamenten zur Optimierung ihres Nutzen-Risikoprofils erläutert und kommuniziert. Die Chance Der Senior Group Director of Safety Development & Processes (SDP) bietet strategische Führung, Kompetenz und Aufsicht für ein globales Team in der Gestaltung, Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Koordination von Aktivitäten in Bezug auf Sicherheitsentwicklung, Innovation, Prozessgestaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung im Auftrag von PDS. Als Mitglied des PVSD Leadership Teams leitet der Senior Group Director die globale SDP-Funktion über 4 globale Produktentwicklungsstandorte (Basel in Switzerland, South San Francisco in den USA, Welwyn in Großbritannien und Mississauga in Kanada). Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass sicherheitskritische Prozesse im Einklang mit den Geschäftsanforderungen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungszielen entwickelt, entwickelt, „besitzen“ und unterstützt werden. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Piloten, Projekte und wichtige Programme, die wissenschaftliche Sicherheitsansätze verbessern sollen, im Einklang mit vereinbarten Plänen geliefert oder koordiniert werden. Sie sind auch dafür verantwortlich, dass sich PDS „Arbeitswege“ an sich ändernde Kundenanforderungen anpassen und dass die breitere PDS-Gemeinschaft Zugang zu Expertenberatungen zur Unterstützung ihrer Bemühungen zur Bereitstellung von Werten für die Drogenentwicklung und das Patientenrisikomanagement hat. Der Senior Group Director ist dafür verantwortlich, dass das SDP-Team Innovationen fördert, Innovationen erwartet und auf bedeutende neue Entwicklungen oder Verbesserungen reagiert, die für PDS-Arbeitsmethoden erforderlich sind, und einen effektiven Beitrag zu zukünftigen Aktivierungsstrategien in PDS bietet. Der Senior Group Director nutzt die Stärken eines vielfältigen globalen Teams und schafft ein inspirierendes Umfeld, in dem sich die SDP-Teammitglieder als befähigt fühlen, sich an Auslieferungen zu beteiligen, Wissen aufzubauen und Ressourcen effektiv einzusetzen, immer bemüht sich um kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Innovation. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Umsetzung und Funktionsweise definierter globaler und/oder funktionaler Prozesse, einschließlich der Verbindungen mit zugehörigen Systemen/Werkzeugen-Design/Entwicklung, über die breiten sicherheitsrelevanten Bereiche des Teams. Die Aufgaben des SDP-Teams umfassen folgende Hauptbereiche:
• Design, Entwicklung, Wartung, Aufsicht und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Sicherheitsprozesse in Übereinstimmung mit GVP-, GCP- und Medical Device-Domains.
• Die Fähigkeit der Organisation, Sicherheitsprozesse durch technische und wissenschaftliche Expertise durchzuführen.
• Entwicklung, Umsetzung und Koordinierung der strategischen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten, die die kurz- und langfristigen Ziele der PDS vorantreiben.
• Erleichterung und Koordinierung der Sicherheitsinnovation im Zusammenhalt mit den Erfordernissen der Sicherheitsprozesse.
• Bereitstellung von Nischen wissenschaftlichen Know-how, die potenziell den Bedürfnissen des Portfolios zugute kommen. Primäre Verantwortung und Rechenschaftspflichten:
• Leadership: Bietet Linienführung für die globale SDP-Unterfunktion; Coaches-Mitglieder, um Potenzial und Wohlbefinden zu maximieren und gleichzeitig ein Klima von Zweck und Dringlichkeit zu erhalten
• Strategische Richtung: Verantwortlich für die Definition und Artikulation von Vision und Strategie für SDP, in Abstimmung mit der übergeordneten PVSD, PDS und breiteren Unternehmensstrategien
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Funktionen in Pharma auf der Grundlage des aufstrebenden geschäftskritischen Bedarfs.
• Rechenschaftspflicht für die SDP kann verbesserte/konsistente wissenschaftliche „Arbeitswege“ erwarten, entwickeln und unterstützen,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, notre département Développement de produits mondiaux Sécurité et gestion des risques (PDS) vise à améliorer les soins de santé pour les patients en déterminant et en communiquant le profil de sécurité des médicaments Roche afin d'optimiser leur profil bénéfice-risque. L'opportunité Le Directeur principal du développement et des processus de sécurité (SDP) assure le leadership stratégique, l'expertise et la supervision d'une équipe mondiale dans la conception, l'élaboration, la mise en oeuvre et la coordination des activités liées au développement, à l'innovation, à la conception des processus et à l'amélioration continue, au nom de PDS. En tant que membre de l'équipe de direction du PVSD, le directeur principal du groupe dirige la fonction de SDP mondial sur quatre sites mondiaux de développement de produits (Base en Suisse, South San Francisco aux États-Unis, Welwyn au Royaume-Uni et Mississauga au Canada). Ce rôle garantit que les processus critiques en matière de sécurité sont conçus, développés, « possédés » et soutenus conformément aux exigences opérationnelles et aux objectifs d'amélioration continue. Ils veillent à ce que les projets pilotes, les projets et les grands programmes, destinés à améliorer les approches scientifiques en matière de sécurité, soient exécutés ou coordonnés conformément aux plans convenus. Ils sont également chargés de veiller à ce que les PDS s'adaptent aux besoins changeants des clients et à ce que la communauté des PDS ait accès à des conseils d'experts à l'appui de leurs efforts visant à valoriser le développement des médicaments et la gestion des risques pour les patients. Le directeur du groupe principal est chargé de s'assurer que l'équipe du PDD favorise l'innovation, anticipe et agit sur les nouveaux développements importants ou les améliorations nécessaires aux méthodes de travail du PDS et apporte une contribution efficace aux stratégies de facilitation futures du PDS. Le directeur principal du groupe tire parti des forces d'une équipe mondiale diversifiée et crée un environnement inspirant où les membres de l'équipe du SDP se sentent habilités à prendre en charge les produits livrables, à acquérir des connaissances et à déployer des ressources efficacement, en s'efforçant toujours d'améliorer et d'innover continuellement. Ils sont responsables de la mise en œuvre et du fonctionnement de processus mondiaux et/ou fonctionnels définis, y compris les liens avec les systèmes/conception/développement d'outils connexes, dans les grands domaines de compétence liés à la sécurité de l'équipe. Le mandat de l'équipe SDP couvre les domaines principaux suivants :
• La conception, le développement, la maintenance, la surveillance et l'amélioration continue des processus de sécurité conformément aux domaines GVP, GCP et Medical Device.
• Maintenir la capacité de l'organisation à exécuter les processus de sécurité en fournissant une expertise technique et scientifique.
• La conception, l'élaboration, la mise en œuvre et la coordination d'activités d'amélioration à la fois stratégiques et continues qui favorisent la réalisation des objectifs à court et à long terme du PDS.
• Facilitation et coordination de l'innovation en matière de sécurité, en cohérence avec les besoins des processus de sécurité.
• Fourniture d'une expertise scientifique de niche susceptible de profiter aux besoins du portefeuille. Responsabilités principales et responsabilités :
• Leadership: assure la direction de la sous-fonction SDP mondiale; entraîne les membres pour maximiser le potentiel et le bien-être tout en maintenant un climat d'urgence et d'objectif
• Orientation stratégique: Responsable de la définition et de l'articulation de la vision et de la stratégie en matière de PDD, conformément à la stratégie globale de PVSD, de PDS et de stratégies d'entreprise plus larges
• S'associer étroitement à diverses fonctions en Pharma en fonction de nouveaux besoins critiques pour les entreprises.
• Responsable de veiller à ce que le PDD puisse anticiper, développer et soutenir des « voies de travail scientifiques améliorées/consistantes » ,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Missions:

• En tant que Directeur / Directrice Régional des Ventes pour la Gamme Core Lab, vous êtes responsable de la qualité du service produit par l’équipe et de l’amélioration continue des processus que vous supervisez.

• Leader VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coach), vous savez engager autour d’une vision stratégique, et structurer les activités de manière efficace et collaborative.

• En tant que coach, vous accompagnez le développement de votre équipe, savez repérer et faire grandir les talents.

• Multiplicateur de la culture agile, vous mettez en place au sein de votre équipe un cadre d’autonomie croissante et créez les conditions d’une décision déléguée efficace; vous recrutez les talents dont l’organisation a besoin, anticipez les nouvelles compétences grâce à la veille des évolutions du marché et à vos connexions au sein du groupe,

• Enfin, vous incarnez les Leadership commitments.

Vos principales responsabilités:

• Vous participez à des projets/squads au sein de votre Chapter/de la FIiliale/ de la Région

• Vous pilotez l’activité commerciale des comptes locaux et mettez en œuvre l’évolution des pratiques et compétences des CSM (Customer Success Managers) au regard des objectifs stratégiques de la filiale et du groupe (notamment en lien avec les Key Account Managers).

• Vous êtes également garant(e) du strict respect de la compliance pour votre équipe et du respect des politiques et processus de pricing pour les gammes, par segment.

• Vous coopérez avec les Network Leads et le Resource Manager de manière à garantir le bon niveau de compétence et de ressources pour les SPS dans le respect des objectifs financiers .

• Agent du changement, vous êtes responsable de la bonne adoption des nouveaux processus vente dans la filiale et de la coopération inter Chapters

Qui vous êtes:

• Vous bénéficiez d'une solide culture de l'industrie du diagnostic et, plus largement, de l'écosystème de la santé

• Expérimenté en management d’équipe, vous maîtrisez les postures de leader et de coach pour inspirer, engager et faire grandir vos équipes

• Doté d'une forte pensée systémique, vous excellez dans la gestion d'environnements complexes et pilotez vos projets avec agilité

• Vos compétences en négociation de haut niveau et votre sens des affaires (business acumen) sont reconnus

• Vous possédez une excellente communication (écrite et orale), un esprit de synthèse affûté

• Votre anglais est courant

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Estagiário de engenharia
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Estagiário de Engenharia na área de Customer Experience, você terá a oportunidade única de aplicar seus conhecimentos acadêmicos e técnicos na prática, desenvolvendo-se profissionalmente ao lado de uma equipe de especialistas de campo.

A Oportunidade

• Você realiza o cadastro de peças e consolida informações essenciais em planilhas de Excel.

• Você controla e afere instrumentos e ferramentas, gerenciando também modificações e ações preventivas.

• Você presta suporte diário ao time de especialistas e interage ativamente com a equipe de campo.

• Você monitora casos de preparação de local (site preparation), instalação e desinstalação de equipamentos.

• Você fornece suporte on-site aos clientes de sua base, bem como assistência às ferramentas ASA, Online Support e Cobas Link.

Quem é você

• Você possui uma base de conhecimento técnico/científico na área de engenharia e domina, no mínimo, o nível intermediário do Pacote Office.

• Você se destaca pelo raciocínio analítico, lógico e focado, e não se importa em lidar com rotinas operacionais de forma atenta e cuidadosa.

• Você é proativo, tem grande interesse em aprender e busca sempre seu desenvolvimento contínuo.

• Você cultiva um bom relacionamento interpessoal com todas as áreas e valoriza o trabalho em equipe.

Desejável

• Você possui conhecimentos de inglês em nível intermediário.

*Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta posição.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Global Head of Brand & Digital Experience

titleByLocale.en: Global Head of Brand & Digital Experience

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Group Communications (GC) is responsible for building Roche’s reputation and fostering a clear, authentic understanding of Roche's commitment to healthcare. We communicate Roche’s strategy and connect our global colleagues and external partners to our core purpose: “Doing now what patients need next”.

We partner closely with our business and commercial organisations to build our reputation, advance business outcomes, and inspire our global teams to deliver innovations to patients. As an organisation, we value forward-looking creativity, genuine collaboration, and a willingness to learn. We strive to create an environment where diverse teams can thrive, develop new capabilities, and enjoy working together toward a shared mission.

The Role

As the Global Head of Brand & Digital Experience, you are an enterprise leader within the global Communications Leadership team. You will champion Roche’s brand identity and spearhead our global digital ecosystem to maximise engagement, trust, and business impact.

Your strategic responsibilities will include:

• Enterprise Leadership: Inspire, lead and develop a high-performing global organisation of 40+ digital and brand experts led by five senior people leaders. Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture that values innovation, psychological safety, and continuous growth.

• Global Digital Architecture: Define and execute the future-state Roche Group digital communications strategy, ensuring our corporate website, social media ecosystem, and internal digital channels deliver world-class user experience and engagement.

• AI-Driven Transformation: Serve as architect for the vision, governance, and deployment of AI-enabled communications at Roche, positioning the company at the forefront of digital innovation.

• Data-Driven Influence: Transform internal data and advanced analytics capabilities, embedding predictive insights into the fabric of Roche’s global communication strategies.

• Brand Stewardship: Shape and safeguard the Roche corporate brand strategy, driving cohesive, compelling, and modern creative brand expressions across all global touchpoints.

• Strategic Board-Level Advisory: Act as a trusted partner and strategic advisor to executive stakeholders, translating complex corporate and divisional achievements into high-impact digital narratives.

Who you are

You are a visionary communicator and an authentic, courageous leader with a proven track record of operating successfully at the executive levels in a global, highly regulated matrix organisation. You possess the gravitas to influence executive committees, the strategic acumen to anticipate industry shifts, and a deep passion for people development.

Qualifications & Competencies:

• Executive Experience: 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in corporate digital communications, brand strategy, or digital marketing within a complex, multinational environment (Pharma/Healthcare experience is an asset, but top-tier global corporate experience is required).

• Scale of Leadership: At least 8+ years of experience managing large, multi-layered teams, with a proven track record of developing senior people leaders and fostering diverse, inclusive cultures in global teams.

• Digital & AI Pioneer: Documented success in deploying enterprise-wide digital strategies and leveraging emerging technologies, including deep familiarity with generative AI applications, content automation, and advanced analytics.

• Global Campaign & Infrastructure Le

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) serves as the central engine that sets the rhythm for collective success across the Roche Pharma Division. Positioned at the unique intersection of R&D, Commercial, and Manufacturing, GPS acts as the steward for Pharma, Portfolio, and Product strategies. Our mission is to catalyze the Roche ecosystem by leading end-to-end lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and competitive fitness.

We are a future-focused organization committed to delivering on Roche’s Pharma Ambition — to launch 20 transformative medicines by 2030. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies, data insights, and an "outside-in" market perspective, GPS ensures that groundbreaking scientific discoveries are transformed into impactful healthcare solutions that reach patients swiftly and sustainably. In GPS, we work with a clear purpose and sense of urgency, knowing that the strategic choices we make today fundamentally transform the lives of people tomorrow.

As we strive toward our 2030 Pharma Ambition, the newly created Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit is designed to ensure our internal operational backbone is efficient, compliant, and scalable. In the complex ecosystem we operate in, we drive consistency, transparency, and quality across all initiatives, ensuring that strategic goals are translated into measurable business impact.

The Opportunity
The Global Program Manager is a critical leadership role within the newly established GPS Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit . While the Head of BPO sets the vision and the Business Manager enables the operations, you are the architect of coherence and driver of effective delivery .
Your mission is to bring structure to complexity while also proactively removing roadblocks and navigating through ambiguity. You will lead high-priority enterprise initiatives, ensuring they are designed with a customer-centric lens , ensuring that our "customers" (internal stakeholders across Therapeutic Areas, Functions and Organisational Units) experience clarity, not noise. You will be responsible for creating the frameworks that ensure GPS initiatives are not just launched, but successfully pulled through the organization with strategic alignment and operational excellence.
In this position, you will:

• Drive Strategic Execution Through Program Management Excellence: Architect pragmatic and user-focused solutions and lead the execution of complex, enterprise-wide programs across GPS and partner functions. Establish clear milestones, governance structures, dependencies, and accountability frameworks, while maintaining consistent program management standards and overseeing key GPS strategic processes to ensure successful delivery of strategic priorities and business objectives.

• Enable Cross-Functional Alignment and Strategic Coherence: Partner with leaders, project teams, strategic process owners, and communications partners to translate strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps while embedding maturing new capabilities and create a clear understanding of the "why" behind key initiatives. Drive alignment across the GPS operating model, ensuring initiatives are connected, prioritized effectively, and contribute to broader Pharma and GPS strategic goals.

• Advance Operational Business Excellence, Intelligence and Communications: Drive operational excellence by embedding effective processes, governance models, systems, business analytics, and ways of working that enhance organizationa

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) serve come motore centrale che imposta il ritmo per il successo collettivo in tutta la Divisione Roche Pharma. Posizionato all'intersezione unica di R&D, Commerciale e Manufacturing, GPS funge da amministratore per le strategie Pharma, Portfolio e Prodotto. La nostra missione è quella di catalizzare l'ecosistema Roche attraverso la gestione del ciclo di vita end-to-end, l'eccellenza della commercializzazione e il fitness competitivo. Siamo un'organizzazione incentrata sul futuro impegnata a consegnare l'ambiente di farmaci di Roche — per lanciare 20 farmaci trasformativi entro il 2030. Utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia, intuizioni di dati e una prospettiva di mercato "outside-in", il GPS assicura che le scoperte scientifiche innovative vengano trasformate in soluzioni di assistenza sanitaria che raggiungono i pazienti in modo rapido e sostenibile. Nel GPS, lavoriamo con uno scopo chiaro e un senso di urgenza, sapendo che le scelte strategiche che facciamo oggi trasformano fondamentalmente la vita delle persone domani. Mentre ci sforziamo verso il nostro 2030 Pharma Ambition, l'unità di Business Process & Operations (BPO) di nuova creazione è progettata per garantire che la nostra spina dorsale operativa interna sia efficiente, conforme e scalabile. Nel complesso ecosistema in cui operiamo, guidiamo coerenza, trasparenza e qualità in tutte le iniziative, assicurando che gli obiettivi strategici siano tradotti in un impatto commerciale misurabile. L'opportunità Il Global Program Manager è un ruolo di leadership critica all'interno della nuova unità GPS Business Process & Operations (BPO). Mentre il Capo di BPO imposta la visione e il Business Manager consente le operazioni, sei l'architetto di coerenza e driver di consegna efficace. La vostra missione è di portare la struttura alla complessità, mentre anche la rimozione proattiva dei blocchi stradali e la navigazione attraverso l'ambiguità. Condurrai iniziative di impresa ad alta priorità, assicurando che siano progettate con una lente orientata al cliente, assicurando che i nostri "clienti" (parti interessate interne in aree terapeutiche, funzioni e unità organizzative) sperimentino chiarezza, non rumore. Sarete responsabili della creazione dei quadri che assicurano che le iniziative GPS non siano appena avviate, ma con successo trascinate attraverso l'organizzazione con allineamento strategico ed eccellenza operativa. In questa posizione:
• Guidare l'esecuzione strategica attraverso la gestione del programma Eccellenza: Architetto soluzioni pragmatiche e orientate all'utente e condurre l'esecuzione di programmi complessi e a livello aziendale attraverso funzioni GPS e partner. Stabilire chiare pietre miliari, strutture di governance, dipendenze e framework di responsabilità, mantenendo coerente standard di gestione del programma e supervisionando i processi strategici chiave GPS per garantire la consegna di priorità strategiche e obiettivi aziendali.
• Abilitare l'allineamento trasversale e la coerenza strategica: collaborare con leader, team di progetto, proprietari di processi strategici e partner di comunicazione per tradurre priorità strategiche in roadmap attuabili, integrando nuove capacità e creando una chiara comprensione del "perché" dietro iniziative chiave. Allineamento dell'unità attraverso il modello operativo GPS, assicurando che le iniziative siano connesse, prioritizzate in modo efficace e contribuiscono a obiettivi strategici più ampi di Pharma e GPS.
• Advance Operational Business Excellence, Intelligence e Communications: guidare l'eccellenza operativa incorporando processi efficaci, modelli di governance, sistemi, analisi aziendale e modi di lavoro che migliorano l'organizzazione

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) dient als zentraler Motor, der den Rhythmus für kollektive Erfolge in der Roche Pharma Division festlegt. An der einzigartigen Schnittstelle von R&D, Commercial und Manufacturing fungiert GPS als Steward für Pharma-, Portfolio- und Produktstrategien. Unsere Mission ist es, das Roche-Ökosystem durch führendes End-to-End-Lebenszyklus-Management, Vermarktung Exzellenz und wettbewerbsfähige Fitness zu katalysieren. Wir sind eine zukunftsgerichtete Organisation, die sich für die Lieferung an Roche’s Pharma Ambition einsetzt – um bis 2030 20 transformative Arzneimittel zu starten. Durch den Einsatz modernster Technologien, Dateneinsichten und eine "outside-in" Marktperspektive sorgt GPS dafür, dass bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen zu schlagkräftigen Gesundheitslösungen umgewandelt werden, die Patienten schnell und nachhaltig erreichen. Im GPS arbeiten wir mit einem klaren Zweck und einem Gefühl der Dringlichkeit zusammen und wissen, dass die strategischen Entscheidungen, die wir heute treffen, das Leben der Menschen grundlegend verändern. Wie wir uns für unsere 2030 Pharma Ambition einsetzen, ist die neu geschaffene Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit so konzipiert, dass unser internes operatives Rückgrat effizient, konform und skalierbar ist. In dem komplexen Ökosystem, in dem wir tätig sind, treiben wir Konsistenz, Transparenz und Qualität in allen Initiativen und sorgen dafür, dass strategische Ziele in messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen umgesetzt werden. Die Chance Der Global Program Manager ist eine wichtige Führungsrolle innerhalb der neu gegründeten GPS Business Process & Operations (BPO) Unit . Während der Leiter der BPO die Vision und der Business Manager die Operationen ermöglicht, sind Sie der Architekt der Kohärenz und Treiber der effektiven Lieferung. Ihre Mission ist es, Struktur zu Komplexität zu bringen, während auch proaktiv zu entfernen Straßenblöcke und navigieren durch Mehrdeutigkeit. Sie werden hochprioritätsorientierte Unternehmensinitiativen führen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie mit einem kundenzentrierten Objektiv entworfen werden, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere "Kunden" (interne Stakeholder in den Therapeutischen Bereichen, Funktionen und Organisationseinheiten) Klarheit und keine Geräusche erfahren. Sie werden dafür verantwortlich sein, die Rahmen zu schaffen, die sicherstellen, dass GPS-Initiativen nicht nur gestartet werden, sondern erfolgreich durch die Organisation mit strategischer Ausrichtung und operativer Exzellenz gezogen werden. In dieser Position werden Sie:
• Drive Strategic Execution through Program Management Excellence: Architekt pragmatische und nutzerzentrierte Lösungen und führen die Ausführung komplexer, unternehmensweite Programme über GPS- und Partnerfunktionen hinweg. Erstelle klare Meilensteine, Governance-Strukturen, Abhängigkeiten und Rechenschaftsrahmen, unter Beibehaltung einheitlicher Programm-Management-Standards und Überwachung wichtiger strategischer GPS-Prozesse, um eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten und Unternehmensziele zu gewährleisten.
• Aktivieren Sie Cross-Functional Alignment and Strategic Coherence: Partner mit Führungskräften, Projektteams, strategischen Prozessbesitzern und Kommunikationspartnern, um strategische Prioritäten in handlungsfähige Roadmaps zu übersetzen und gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten zu sichern und ein klares Verständnis der "Warum" hinter wichtigen Initiativen zu schaffen. Führen Sie die Ausrichtung über das GPS-Betriebsmodell aus, stellen Sie sicher, dass Initiativen effektiv verbunden, priorisiert werden und zu breiteren strategischen Zielen von Pharma und GPS beitragen.
• Advance Operational Business Excellence, Intelligence and Communications: Führen Sie operative Exzellenz durch die Einbettung von effektiven Prozessen, Governance-Modellen, Systemen, Business Analytics und Möglichkeiten der Arbeit, die Organisation zu verbessern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) est le moteur central du succès collectif de la division Roche Pharma. Positionné à l'intersection unique de la R-D, du commerce et de la fabrication, le GPS sert de responsable des stratégies Pharma, Portfolio et Produit. Notre mission est de catalyser l'écosystème Roche en dirigeant la gestion du cycle de vie de bout en bout, l'excellence de la commercialisation et le conditionnement physique compétitif. Nous sommes une organisation axée sur l'avenir qui s'est engagée à mettre en œuvre Roches Pharma Ambition – à lancer 20 médicaments transformatifs d'ici 2030. En tirant parti des technologies de pointe, des connaissances en matière de données et d'une perspective de marché « externe », le GPS veille à ce que les découvertes scientifiques révolutionnaires soient transformées en solutions de soins de santé efficaces qui atteignent les patients rapidement et durablement. Dans le GPS, nous travaillons avec un objectif clair et un sens de l'urgence, sachant que les choix stratégiques que nous faisons aujourd'hui transforment fondamentalement la vie des gens demain. Alors que nous nous efforçons d'atteindre notre Ambition Pharma 2030, l'unité des processus et opérations opérationnels (BPO) nouvellement créée est conçue pour assurer que notre colonne vertébrale opérationnelle interne est efficace, conforme et évolutive. Dans l'écosystème complexe dans lequel nous oeuvrons, nous procédons à la cohérence, à la transparence et à la qualité de toutes les initiatives, en veillant à ce que les objectifs stratégiques se traduisent en un impact opérationnel mesurable. L'opportunité Le gestionnaire de programme mondial est un chef de file essentiel au sein de l'unité des processus et des opérations GPS (BPO) nouvellement créée. Tandis que le chef de BPO définit la vision et le chef d'entreprise permet les opérations, vous êtes l'architecte de la cohérence et le moteur d'une livraison efficace. Votre mission est de rendre la structure plus complexe tout en éliminant les barrages routiers et en naviguant par l'ambiguïté. Vous dirigerez des initiatives d'entreprise hautement prioritaires, en s'assurant qu'elles sont conçues avec une lentille centrée sur le client, en veillant à ce que nos « clients » (intervenants internes dans les domaines thérapeutiques, les fonctions et les unités organisationnelles) connaissent la clarté et non le bruit. Vous serez responsable de la création des cadres qui garantissent que les initiatives GPS ne sont pas seulement lancées, mais que l'organisation a réussi à s'aligner stratégiquement et à atteindre l'excellence opérationnelle. Dans cette position, vous :
• Diriger l'exécution stratégique grâce à l'excellence en gestion de programme : Architecte des solutions pragmatiques et axées sur l'utilisateur et dirige l'exécution de programmes complexes à l'échelle de l'entreprise dans l'ensemble des fonctions GPS et partenaires. Établir des jalons clairs, des structures de gouvernance, des dépendances et des cadres de responsabilisation, tout en maintenant des normes de gestion des programmes uniformes et en surveillant les processus stratégiques clés du GPS pour assurer la réalisation des priorités stratégiques et des objectifs opérationnels.
• Permettre l'alignement interfonctionnel et la cohérence stratégique : partenariat avec les dirigeants, les équipes de projet, les responsables de processus stratégiques et les partenaires de communication pour traduire les priorités stratégiques en feuilles de route réalisables tout en intégrant de nouvelles capacités de maturation et en créant une compréhension claire du « pourquoi » derrière les initiatives clés. Diriger l'alignement à travers le modèle d'exploitation du GPS, s'assurer que les initiatives sont reliées, hiérarchisées efficacement et contribuer à des objectifs stratégiques plus larges de Pharma et de GPS.
• Faire progresser l'excellence opérationnelle, le renseignement et les communications : favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle en intégrant des processus efficaces, des modèles de gouvernance, des systèmes, des analyses commerciales et des méthodes de travail qui améliorent l'organisationa

titleByLocale.de: Lead bei der Umsetzung von Umweltprodukten
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la mise en oeuvre des produits environnementaux

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Objective
As a Product Environmental Lead, you will be a key member of our team in China, responsible for ensuring compliance with product environmental regulations to support successful market launch of Roche Diagnostics products. This role requires a blend of product stewardship, an understanding of regulatory affairs, solid experience in EH&S Data Management and strong project management skills. You will navigate the complexities of product localization, new product development, and importation for the Chinese market. This position is a unique opportunity for a professional who is fluent in Chinese and English and has a deep understanding of the local culture and business landscape to make a significant impact on our operations in China.
Key Responsibilities

• Product Stewardship:

•
• Independently manage product stewardship activities within existing guidelines.

• Contribute to project teams, taking ownership of ongoing activities and goals.

• Conduct comprehensive product stewardship assessments and support data collection efforts in collaboration with other functions.

• Support local sourcing inquiries

• Support R&D with setting of environmental product requirements

• Environmental Regulatory Compliance/ Implementation:

•
• Apply your in-depth knowledge of environmental regulations affecting Roche Diagnostics products to ensure the compliance of all assigned products in the Chinese market.

• Stay informed about changes and updates to local regulations.

• Process Application and Development & mQMS:

•
• Work with and improve upon existing processes tied to the mQMS and the direct organization.

• Lead process improvements for product stewardship by applying your experience and innovative ideas.

• EH&S Data and Insights Management

•
• Validate EH&S and product-related data in alignment with global data standards and local regulatory requirements (e.g. China REACH, GHS, chemical inventory management) to support operations compliance and trade compliance

• Support execution of EH&S data management processes according to global governance and procedures.

• Generate and analyze data reports to support compliance monitoring, performance tracking, and management decisions.

• Support internal and external communication on product compliance and sustainability data.

• General Duties:

•
• Develop and conduct training sessions for internal stakeholders.

• Contribute to team meetings and participate in relevant discussions.

• Act as a key member of the business team, providing insights and support for our operations in China.

Scenario-Specific Responsibilities

• For Already Launched & Localized Products:

•
• Oversee the re-assembly process in Suzhou, ensuring compliance for products made in China.

• Manage labeling requirements, including China-specific information, and coordinate with the responsible department.

• Explore and manage local component sourcing options.

• Support the transfer of reagents and assays

• For Product Updates:

•
• Lead change management processes for product environmental regulations..

• Coordinate with established PCQTs in Europe/US, ensuring they also cover localized products.

• Handle notifications and support all re-labeling activities.

• For New Product Developments:

•
• Support the transfer of new products to China during the D&D process.

• Contribute to sourcing plans for components, including local sourcing options.

• Provide support as needed for necessary notifications, registrations, and imp

jobs.title: Study Start Up Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a member of the PDG Country Study Start-Up Team, your primary focus is to drive and facilitate efficient study start-up processes to contribute to the delivery of clinical trials to patients. You will enable innovative clinical trial delivery, address study start up needs across various therapeutic areas, and ensure seamless trial execution for patients, investigators, and clinical site staff. Collaboration with local internal and external country teams, global study teams, and CROs is essential to this role.

Key 
• Responsibilities
This role focuses on the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials by developing and implementing effective start-up strategies, overseeing start-up operations, and driving process improvements at the country and site level while maintaining regulatory compliance.
Key responsibilities include:
● Leading the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.
● Overseeing start-up operations and ensuring timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.
● Ensuring alignment with global strategies and timelines.
● Managing amendments throughout the study lifecycle.
● Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardization, and innovation.
● Collaborating with regional and global counterparts to harmonize systems and improve
timelines.
● Participating in external industry collaborations to influence country start-up
environments.
● Engaging with government and institutional bodies to align on clinical trial policies and
practices (e.g., with Ethics Boards, Health Authorities).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Contribuire alla strategia e alla revisione delle valutazioni di sicurezza e delle relazioni sulla sicurezza dei farmaci per segnali o problemi (inc, qualità del prodotto) o in risposta alle richieste dell'Autorità di regolamentazione ● Contribuire allo sviluppo della strategia di sicurezza del prodotto e fornire input di sicurezza della droga nella strategia di sviluppo clinico ● Contribuire alle attività di gestione del rischio, tra cui la preparazione e la manutenzione di CCDS, l'etichettatura della manutenzione dei documenti (incluso IB), le comunicazioni di rischio, RMP, REMS ● Contribuire alla gestione dello studio da una prospettiva di sicurezza attraverso attività SMT/PET e la revisione e la manutenzione dei documenti attraverso il continuum di sviluppo (prima fase di studi post marketing), tra cui PASS ● Contribuire alle richieste dell'autorità di regolamentazione (Applicazioni di Nuovi farmaci/IND, Nuove Applicazioni di Droga/NDA, Applicazioni di Autorizzazione di Marketing/MAA, Variazioni, Rinnovi, ecc.) esaminando i dati di sicurezza e preparando le relative sezioni dei pacchetti di archiviazione e presentazione in consultazione con SPL ● Responsabile per la preparazione e la manutenzione delle sezioni di sicurezza della Scheda Dati Core e/o Informazioni di Sicurezza di riferimento nell'IB ● Partecipare e fornire input per i comitati di monitoraggio della droga (iDMC) o riunioni del comitato di monitoraggio interno (IMC), come applicabile ● In collaborazione con il SSL, la presentazione di importanti questioni di sicurezza al Comitato per la sicurezza della droga (DSC), il Comitato per la revisione dello sviluppo (DRC) e altri comitati di controllo e di governance interni ed esterni. ● Autore o contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche (abstracts, manifesti, documenti) per incontri scientifici/giorni ● agisce indipendentemente per gestire le responsabilità di sicurezza sui team di studio e nelle attività di supporto alla scienza della sicurezza ● Assumere la responsabilità per ruoli specializzati con PCS. Questi possono includere, ma non sono limitati a; proprietario di processo operativo, esperto di materia. (
• Responsabilità dovute a qualifiche mediche) Essi forniranno competenze mediche cliniche e processi decisionali, in aree in cui questo è specificamente richiesto per supportare i colleghi in PCS. Situazioni in cui l'ingresso medico clinico qualificato può in genere essere cercato potrebbero includere, ma non sono limitati a: ● Interpretazione dei dati rilevanti per la sicurezza, nell'ambito dell'esperienza acquisita durante la pratica in settori rilevanti di medicina clinica/assistenza sanitaria. ● Definire i tipi di domanda di sicurezza o problema di sicurezza, nel contesto di una molecola/programma, che possono richiedere specifiche valutazioni o decisioni di sicurezza medica. ● Effettuare valutazioni sull'impatto della pratica medica nel contesto di problemi di sicurezza della qualità del prodotto (ad esempio, nell'ambito di attività definite delineate nei processi gestiti da PT che richiedono una valutazione formale da parte di qualifiche mediche

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Sous la direction matricielle du chef de la stratégie de sécurité (CSS) et en collaboration avec des collègues du Portefeuille en sécurité clinique (SCP), pour : ● Développer et maintenir une compréhension du profil d'innocuité de leur produit ou de leurs zones thérapeutiques. Élaborer et maintenir une compréhension experte du profil d'innocuité du ou des produits assignés ainsi que de la compréhension du contexte stratégique pertinent (p. ex. maladie à l'étude, profil d'innocuité des concurrents, mécanisme d'action) ● Responsable des activités individuelles et globales de rapport de cas, y compris la gestion des cas du CISR (examen médical) et les rapports globaux (c.-à-d. DSUR, PBRER) ● Responsable des activités de détection et de gestion des signaux, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'entretien STAR, ISMP. Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'examen des évaluations de l'innocuité et des rapports sur l'innocuité des médicaments pour les signaux ou les questions (y compris la qualité du produit) ou en réponse aux demandes de l'autorité réglementaire ● Contribuer à l'élaboration de la stratégie d'innocuité des produits et fournir des renseignements sur l'innocuité des médicaments dans la stratégie de développement clinique ● Contribuer aux activités de gestion des risques, y compris la préparation et l'entretien du SCD, la maintenance des documents d'étiquetage (y compris le BI), la communication des risques, le PGR, le SGRR ● Contribuer à l'étude de la gestion du point de vue de la sécurité par le biais des activités SMT/PET et de l'examen et de l'entretien des documents dans tout le continuum de développement (phase initiale à post-commercialisation), y compris le PASS ● Contribuer aux présentations d'autorités réglementaires (demandes de nouveaux médicaments/IND, demandes de nouveaux médicaments/DNA, demandes d'autorisation de mise en marché/AAM, modifications, renouvellements, etc.) en examinant les données d'innocuité et en préparant les sections pertinentes des dossiers de présentation et de présentation en consultation avec SPL ● Responsable de la préparation et de l'entretien des sections de sécurité de la fiche de données de base de l'entreprise et/ou des renseignements de référence sur la sécurité dans l'IB ● Participer aux réunions des comités de surveillance des médicaments ou des comités de surveillance interne (CIM) et y contribuer, selon le cas ● En partenariat avec le SSL, appuyer la présentation d'importantes questions d'innocuité au Comité de l'innocuité des médicaments, au Comité d'examen du développement et à d'autres comités d'examen et de gouvernance internes et externes, au besoin. ● Auteur ou contribution à des publications scientifiques (abstractions, affiches, articles) pour des réunions/journals scientifiques ● Assure une gestion indépendante des responsabilités en matière de sécurité au sein des équipes d'étude et des activités de soutien aux sciences de la sécurité ● Prendre en charge les rôles spécialisés avec PCS. Il peut s'agir, sans s'y limiter, du propriétaire fonctionnel des processus opérationnels, expert en la matière. (
• Responsabilités dues aux qualifications médicales) Ils fourniront l'expertise médicale clinique et la prise de décisions, dans les domaines où cela est spécifiquement nécessaire pour soutenir les collègues du SCP. Les situations où l'on peut généralement demander une contribution médicale qualifiée pourraient inclure, sans toutefois s'y limiter : ● Interprétation des nouvelles données relatives à la sécurité, dans le contexte de l'expérience acquise dans les domaines pertinents de la médecine clinique et des soins de santé. ● Définir les types de questions de sécurité ou de problèmes de sécurité, dans le contexte d'une molécule ou d'un programme, qui peuvent nécessiter des évaluations ou des décisions spécifiques de sécurité médicale clinique. ● Effectuer des évaluations de l'impact de la pratique médicale dans le contexte des questions d'innocuité de la qualité des produits (par exemple dans le cadre d'activités définies décrites dans les processus gérés par PT qui exigent une évaluation formelle par qualité médicale

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability & Exposure Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Security Monitoring & Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche is dedicated to protecting our networks, systems, applications, and users from constantly evolving cyber threats. As a Security Engineer within the Vulnerability & Exposure Management team, you will play a critical role in identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and reducing cybersecurity risks across Roche’s global environment.

This role goes beyond reviewing scanner outputs. You will help investigate critical vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, improve security tooling and automation capabilities, and partner with stakeholders globally to strengthen Roche’s security posture.

You will join a collaborative and highly technical cybersecurity team that values innovation, curiosity, continuous learning, and proactive risk reduction.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities impacting Roche systems and applications

• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities identified through security tools and external programs, including bug bounty initiatives

• Research emerging threats and assess exploitability against Roche’s attack surface

• Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, application, and security teams to drive remediation activities

• Assess company systems and web applications using automated and manual testing approaches

• Engineer and enhance vulnerability scanning, detection, automation, and monitoring capabilities

• Contribute to security monitoring and incident response activities within a global environment

• Develop scripts, detection logic, templates, and automation workflows to improve operational efficiency

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across vulnerability and exposure management processes

Who you are
You bring a strong cybersecurity foundation combined with analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving complex security challenges.

You also bring:

• Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of professional experience in information security, with demonstrated experience triaging, analyzing, and escalating security vulnerabilities

• Strong understanding of web application, network, endpoint, and cloud security concepts, including vulnerability management or attack surface management within complex enterprise environments

• Hands-on scripting or programming experience using languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js, with familiarity in security tooling, detection logic, automation, or custom scripting

• Experience validating vulnerabilities, assessing exploitability, and supporting security monitoring or incident response activities

• Ability to communicate technical risks effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, while balancing operational priorities and research initiatives

• Passion for cybersecurity, continuous learning, and emerging security trends, with exposure to open-source security projects or modern AI-assisted engineering workflows considered advantageous

• Professional fluency in English, with industry certifications related to offensive or application security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE) and enterprise cloud security experience viewed as strong assets

jobs.title: Medical Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Medical Specialist is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building deep and long-term connections with key customers, you will anticipate and proactively optimize medical practice, ensuring Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas. Operating with an end-to-end perspective, you will serve as a critical driver of competitiveness to accelerate our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, and maximize patient access to our life-changing innovations.

What you will be working on:
As a Medical Specialist, you will:

• Proactively contribute strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise to differentiate our portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Lead the medical component of the integrated local strategy, shaping a scientifically sound value story that reflects an end-to-end commercialisation.

• Spend a significant time in the field, proactively engaging Therapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders in full alignment with cross-functional roles.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies to anticipate future medical trends and shape local medical practice.

• Manage post-launch engagement to ensure the right patients are treated at the right time while expanding our scope to underserved patient populations.

• Establish effective peer-to-peer relationships, identify science-driven collaborations, and deliver high-quality, non-promotional medical education to external customers.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate clinical practice and patient insights into strategic, actionable recommendations for your squad.

• Independently manage the end-to-end execution of insight initiatives like advisory boards, ensuring strict adherence to compliance standards.

• Design and manage the local Integrated Evidence Plan (IEP), identifying evidence gaps and executing tactics like Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies.

• Provide clinical context and expertise to local Health Authority submissions to support high-quality regulatory approvals and product licenses.

Who You Are:
You have:

• Completed Medical degree along with prior experience in Medical Affairs or Clinical Research.

• A strong grasp of complex clinical data sets, including clinical trials and Real-World Evidence, with the ability to leverage digital and AI tools to shape strategy.

• A comprehensive understanding of the Bangladesh healthcare system, allowing you to seamlessly navigate the patient journey across public and private sectors.

• The capability to independently author scientific materials and conduct contextual material reviews utilizing a strong working knowledge of the Pharmaceutical Code of Marketing Practices.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to build trust and have direct, respectful scientific exchanges on a peer-to-peer level.

• A growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and the comfort required to navigate ambiguity while proposing pragmatic, value-adding solutions.

• A highly collaborative nature that thrives when showing leadership, self-motivation, and accountability within a multi-skilled, cross-functional network.

This rol

titleByLocale.it: Alternate - Specialista tecnico del supporto clienti (d/f/h)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Présentation de l’équipe :
Rattaché(e) à la Division Service Clients – Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) et reportant au Responsable Customer Support Hardware, tu prends en charge les demandes clients et les accompagner pour de l'assistance téléphonique

Quel sera ton impact ?
Tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur les missions suivantes :

• Réception et traitement des demandes clients

• documentation dans le CRM

• diagnostic de pannes et proposition de solutions

• utilisation des possibilités de support à distance

• identification et traitement des réclamations et des problèmes de qualité

• gestion de réclamations simples (communication avec RCSC et équipes filiales)

• identification des problèmes de qualité et escalade au niveau d’expertise supérieur

• participer aux différents projets innovants initiés au sein du service

• contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques

• assurer la progression de ses propres compétences.

Tu es quelqu'un qui veut influencer son propre développement. Tu recherches une entreprise où le titre du poste n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui tu es, mais le point de départ.

Ton ADN:

• Formation Bac + 2/Bac +3 dans les domaines de l’automatisme, de l’instrumentation, de l’électronique et de l’informatique. (ex : DUT/BUT Mesures physiques, G2II…)

• Formation dans le domaine de l'analyse de biologie médicale avec une spécialisation dans l’instrumentation biomédicale (Licence professionnelle ScVBM, Instrumentation et Maintenance Biomédicales…)

• Français courant

• Anglais est indispensable (B1-B2)

Alternance de 12 mois à compter de septembre 2026
Poste basé à Meylan (38)

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Nous sommes convaincus qu’il est urgent de proposer des solutions thérapeutiques et de diagnostic dès aujourd’hui, tout en innovant pour l’avenir. Améliorer la vie des patients est notre raison d’être. Nous décidons et agissons avec courage. Et nous croyons fermement qu’une conduite responsable de nos activités servira le monde de demain. Rigueur scientifique, éthique irréprochable, accès à l’innovation médicale pour tous : tels sont nos engagements.

Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif.

Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Specialist (Clinical Laboratory Support)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

At Roche Diagnostics, we understand that behind every test result is a patient. Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is looking for a Hungarian-speaking Product Specialist who wants to transition from the laboratory bench to a regional expert role. Whether you are an engineer or a lab professional, your expertise can help shape the future of diagnostics.

Please note that this is a CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

Special Focus: Are you a Lab Professional looking for a career shift?

• Tired of shift work? Join us for a structured, professional office/hybrid environment.

• Ready to drop the lab coat but keep the expertise? Your hands-on experience with analyzers, reagents, and daily lab challenges is exactly what our customers need.

• Want to see the bigger picture? Move from running tests to mastering the entire diagnostic ecosystem, including IT integrations and cutting-edge software.

Your Impact:

• Technical & Application Support: Provide expert remote guidance for Hungarian laboratories and hospitals on IVD systems.

• Agile Problem Solving: Use your diagnostic "gut feeling" and our remote tools to prevent system downtimes.

• Knowledge Sharing: Be the bridge between complex technology and the people who use it every day.

• Professional Travel: Combine a structured office/hybrid setup with occasional customer site visits - using them as perfect opportunities for hands-on learning and staying connected to the lab reality

Who You Are:

• Background: Degree in Biochemistry, Medical Biology, Laboratory Diagnostics, IT, or Engineering .

• Language: Native-level Hungarian is essential; strong English for international training and collaboration.

• Experience: If you have worked in a clinical laboratory (Biochemist, Lab Technician) or in technical support, you have a head start!

• Mindset: You are empathetic to customer needs, curious about how things work "under the hood," and enjoy a collaborative "Agile" culture.

• Mobility: You possess a valid driving license and are ready to hit the road when duty calls, turning occasional customer visits into a change of scenery

What’s in it for you?

• A prestigious career path in a global healthcare leader.

• Comprehensive technical training (we teach you the engineering part; you bring the lab logic).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。 ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応 ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明 ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成 ・保守契約の締結、請求

応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識
• ・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可

（歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方 ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション
• ・調整を取ってきた方 ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識 ・病院でのMEとしての経験

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

　　　　　• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所

　　　　　　　　• ※本社での6か月間の研修後、仙台オフィスへ配属予定。
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 • 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 • 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
