At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio.* We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

It is an exciting time for Haematology at Roche. This is your chance on a launch product, in a team that has multiple new indications and New Molecule Entities planned for launch over the next 3 - 5 years. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Haematology Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team.

As a Haematology Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Haematology treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key haematological stakeholders, including haematologists and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Haematology accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Haematology products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with haematologist and other healthcare professionals

• Meet customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system and the role of multiple stakeholders within this therapeutic area

• Bachelor’s degree (or relevant diploma) in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field (essential).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

• Medical Affairs role focused on Ophthalmology

• Sydney-based role ( 12 Months Maximum Term Contract)

• Flexible & agile work environment

The Medical Partner is a trusted, externally focused, and scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key customers over a meaningful period of time, you will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, ensuring that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.

The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end-to-end perspective. In this role, you will maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, champion community engagement, and advance patient access.

What will you be working on:
As a Medical Partner, you will:

• Act as the ultimate scientific expert for our Ophthalmology pipeline and portfolio, proactively contributing strong therapeutic area expertise.

• Lead the medical component of the local strategy.

• Proactively engage externally, including withTherapeutic Area Experts (TAEs) and key stakeholders, as an active partner in our engagement strategy.

• Drive proactive, pre-launch end-to-end strategies and tactics that deliver superior experiences, anticipate future medical trends, and shape medical practice.

• Systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific insights and clinical practice perspectives into actionable strategic recommendations.

• Systematically identify evidence gaps and solutions to support local medical practice.

Who are you:
You are a qualified Medical Affairs professional with a completed Medical, Pharmaceutical, or Natural Sciences degree (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).

You have:

• Demonstrated experience within Medical Affairs as a Medical Adviser or Medical Manager, ideally with deep expertise in the Ophthalmology therapeutic landscape and established relationships with Australian TAEs

• A comprehensive knowledge of the drug development process, clinical trials, R eal-World Evidence (RWE) , and the nuanced Australian medical and regulatory landscape

• A strong working knowledge of the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct , allowing you to conduct comprehensive reviews of materials and resolve compliance issues proactively.

• An entrepreneurial and growth mindset , meaning you love to seek out opportunities, experiment, navigate ambiguity, and challenge the status quo to deliver positive change

• Excellent assertive communication and interpersonal skills, giving you the ability to articulate complex data clearly and build trusted internal and external collaborations

• AI literacy and a digital-forward learner mindset, confidently incorporating digital tools and human-in-the-loop oversight into your daily work.

Full eligibility to live and work in Australia is required for this Sydney-based role as visa and/or relocation support is not available for this role.

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes or enquiries from recruitm

As a SW Technical Expert, you will define tasks for others, drive large-scale initiatives, and mentor colleagues to foster their growth. This role involves providing global-level support for technical initiatives, sharing knowledge internationally, and shaping the organization's technical direction. You will possess deep expertise across multiple technology areas, set high standards for code quality and security, and remove obstacles for teams, continuously improving developer productivity and the overall software development lifecycle.

The Opportunity:

• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Define tasks for others and drive successful Medium to Large (M/L) initiatives at the Product or Product Line level. Challenge others in a growth-enabling way, leverage team strengths effectively, and act as a coach and/or lead for others.

• Stakeholder Management: Possess a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provide direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provide global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Give speeches and share knowledge in local/international events and knowledge-sharing initiatives, and actively engage in RDT Data Domain/Site-related activities.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Operate at the Product / Domain / Site level.

• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (for example, by serving as a capability owner). Inspire innovation, drive innovative solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems.

Who you are:

• 10+ years proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve organization-wide technical problems and aligning disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.

• Possess a deep understanding of data processing principles and AI-readiness data needs. Hold experience in building solutions for data experts (e.g., Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners, and Digital Asset Management).

• Exhibit deep expertise in multiple technology areas and the ability to select and apply appropriate technologies to solve complex problems.

• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.

• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.

• Apply expertise in cybersecurity best practices, ensuring that software solutions comply with security standards in coordination with appropriate Roche experts.

• Possess comprehensive knowledge of softwar

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione SW Technical Lead - Piattaforme di dati Come sviluppatore di software personalizzato, si agirà come leader strategico e innovatore. Definirai i compiti per gli altri, guiderai iniziative su larga scala e i colleghi di mentore per promuovere la crescita. Questo ruolo consiste nel fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative tecniche, condividere conoscenze a livello internazionale, e modellare la direzione tecnica dell'organizzazione. Possiederai una profonda esperienza in più aree tecnologiche, stabilirai standard elevati per la qualità del codice e la sicurezza, e rimuoverai gli ostacoli per le squadre, migliorando continuamente la produttività degli sviluppatori e il ciclo di vita globale dello sviluppo del software. L'opportunità:
• Ambito: fornire una guida tecnica strategica e impostare la direzione per lo sviluppo di prodotti digitali in linea con gli obiettivi e le priorità aziendali.
• Evoluzione architettonica: guidare la transizione strategica da un monolite modulare a microservizi, assicurando che i confini del dominio siano rispettati e le prestazioni rimangono elevate. Partecipa allo sviluppo di nuovi componenti e idee collaborando con un team multidisciplinare per offrire esperienze end-to-end agli utenti finali.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Definire i compiti per gli altri e guidare le iniziative di successo Medium to Large (M/L) a livello Product Line. Sfidare gli altri in un modo di crescita, sfruttare i punti di forza del team in modo efficace, e agire come allenatore e / o guidare per gli altri.
• Gestione degli stakeholder: Possedere una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornire la direzione per obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.
• Impatto/Strategia: fornire supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Fai discorsi e condividi la conoscenza in eventi locali/internazionali e iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze, e impegnarsi attivamente in attività correlate a RDT Data Domain/Site.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): Operare a livello del prodotto / dominio / sito.

Ispirare l'innovazione, guidare soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche, e concentrarsi sulla progettazione di nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti. Chi sei:

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position SW Technical Expert - Data Platforms As a SW Technical Expert, you will define tasks for others, drive large-scale initiatives, and mentor colleagues to foster their growth. This role involves providing global-level support for technical initiatives, sharing knowledge internationally, and shaping the organization's technical direction. You will possess deep expertise across multiple technology areas, set high standards for code quality and security, and remove obstacles for teams, continuously improving developer productivity and the overall software development lifecycle. The Opportunity:
• Scope: Provide strategic technical guidance and set the direction for digital product development in alignment with business goals and priorities.
• Architectural Evolution: Lead the strategic transition from a modular monolith to microservices, ensuring domain boundaries are respected and performance remains high. Take ownership of the development of new components and ideas as you cooperate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver end-to-end experiences to the End Users.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Define tasks for others and drive successful Medium to Large (M/L) initiatives at the Product or Product Line level. Challenge others in a growth-enabling way, leverage team strengths effectively, and act as a coach and/or lead for others.
• Stakeholder Management: Possess a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provide direction for mid- to long-term goals and objectives.
• Impact/Strategy: Provide global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Give speeches and share knowledge in local/international events and knowledge-sharing initiatives, and actively engage in RDT Data Domain/Site-related activities.
• Complexity/ (Product Size): Operate at the Product / Domain / Site level.
• Business/Technical ability: Actively contribute to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (for example, by serving as a capability owner). Inspire innovation, drive innovative solutions in line with technology trends, and focus on designing new approaches to existing problems. Who you are:
• 10+ years proven experience driving cross-functional collaboration to solve organization-wide technical problems and aligning disparate engineering efforts toward common goals.
• Possess a deep understanding of data processing principles and AI-readiness data needs. Hold experience in building solutions for data experts (e.g., Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners, and Digital Asset Management).
• Exhibit deep expertise in multiple technology areas and the ability to select and apply appropriate technologies to solve complex problems.
• Maintain proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-driven architecture, or similar technologies.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, including performance tuning and scalability.
• Leverage excellent knowledge of market-available software development tooling to suggest adoption into the current Roche toolset, continuously improving developer productivity and experience Roche-wide.
• Apply expertise in cybersecurity best practices, ensuring that software solutions comply with security standards in coordination with appropriate Roche experts.
• Possess comprehensive knowledge of softwar
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position SW Technical Lead - Datenplattformen Als Custom Software Developer fungieren Sie als strategischer Führer und Innovator. Sie werden Aufgaben für andere definieren, Großinitiativen und Mentorkollegen zur Förderung des Wachstums antreiben. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Bereitstellung globaler Unterstützung für technische Initiativen, das Teilen von Wissen international und die Gestaltung der technischen Richtung der Organisation. Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen, setzen hohe Standards für die Codequalität und Sicherheit, und entfernen Hindernisse für Teams, kontinuierlich die Produktivität der Entwickler und den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Softwareentwicklung. Die Gelegenheit:
• Anwendungsbereich: Strategische technische Beratung bereitstellen und die Richtung für die digitale Produktentwicklung in Abstimmung mit Geschäftszielen und Prioritäten festlegen.
• Architektonische Evolution: Führen Sie den strategischen Übergang von einem modularen Monolith zu Mikroservices, um sicherzustellen, dass Domaingrenzen eingehalten werden und die Leistung bleibt hoch. Nehmen Sie das Eigentum an der Entwicklung neuer Komponenten und Ideen, während Sie mit einem multidisziplinären Team zusammenarbeiten, um End-to-End-Erfahrungen an die Endbenutzer zu liefern.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Aufgaben für andere definieren und auf der Ebene der Produkt- oder Produktlinie erfolgreiche Initiativen mit mittlerer bis großer (M/L) vorantreiben. Fordern Sie andere auf wachstumssteigernde Weise heraus, hebeln Sie Teamstärken effektiv und fungieren als Trainer und/oder führen Sie für andere.
• Stakeholder Management: Besteht ein starkes Verständnis der Stakeholder-Ökosysteme und deren Bedürfnisse, die sich in Verhandlungen und Partnerschaften für gegenseitige Vorteile auszeichnen. Richten Sie Richtung für mittel- bis langfristige Ziele und Ziele.
• Impact/Strategy: Globale Unterstützung für innovative und technologische Initiativen. Sprechen Sie an lokalen/internationalen Veranstaltungen und Wissensaustauschinitiativen und beteiligen Sie sich aktiv an RDT Data Domain/Site-bezogenen Aktivitäten.
• Komplexität/ (Produktgröße): Betrieb auf der Produkt-/Domain-/Site-Ebene.
• Business/Technische Fähigkeit: Aktiver Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung des technischen Wissens im Feld durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen und Mentorship (z.B. als Leistungsinhaber). Inspirieren Sie Innovation, treiben Sie innovative Lösungen im Einklang mit Technologietrends und setzen Sie auf die Entwicklung neuer Ansätze für bestehende Probleme. Wer du bist:
• 10+ Jahre bewährte Erfahrung, die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit vorantreibt, um organisatorische technische Probleme zu lösen und unterschiedliche technische Anstrengungen zu gemeinsamen Zielen auszurichten.
• Ein tiefes Verständnis der Datenverarbeitungsprinzipien und des Bedarfs an AI-Readiness-Daten. Erfahrung in Gebäudelösungen für Datenexperten halten (z.B. Data Owners, Data Consumers, Data Product Owners und Digital Asset Management).
• Erwarten Sie tiefes Know-how in mehreren Technologiebereichen und die Fähigkeit, geeignete Technologien zur Lösung komplexer Probleme auszuwählen und anzuwenden.
• Erhalten Sie Kenntnisse in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, Event-getriebene Architektur oder ähnliche Technologien.
• Demonstrieren Sie ein starkes Verständnis von Software-Entwicklungs-Lebenszyklus-Praktiken, einschließlich Leistungsabstimmung und Skalierbarkeit.
• Vermitteln Sie hervorragende Kenntnisse über marktübliche Software-Entwicklungstools, um die Einführung in den aktuellen Roche-Toolset vorzuschlagen, die Entwicklerproduktivität und Erfahrung Roche-weit kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
• Kompetenz in der Cybersicherheit Best Practices anwenden, um sicherzustellen, dass Softwarelösungen Sicherheitsstandards in Abstimmung mit einem geeigneten Roche-Experten erfüllen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Lead technique SW - Plateformes de données En tant que développeur de logiciel personnalisé, vous agirez comme leader stratégique et innovateur. Vous définirez des tâches pour les autres, stimulerez des initiatives à grande échelle et mentorez vos collègues pour favoriser la croissance. Ce rôle consiste à fournir un appui mondial aux initiatives techniques, à partager les connaissances à l'échelle internationale et à façonner l'orientation technique de l'organisation. Vous posséderez une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques, établirez des normes élevées pour la qualité et la sécurité des codes, et supprimerez les obstacles pour les équipes, améliorant continuellement la productivité des développeurs et le cycle de vie global du développement logiciel. La possibilité :
• Portée: Fournir des orientations techniques stratégiques et définir l'orientation pour le développement de produits numériques en conformité avec les objectifs et les priorités des entreprises.
• Evolution architecturale: Diriger la transition stratégique d'un monolithe modulaire à un microservices, en assurant le respect des limites du domaine et le maintien des performances. Prenez en charge le développement de nouveaux composants et idées alors que vous coopérez avec une équipe multidisciplinaire pour fournir des expériences de bout en bout aux utilisateurs finaux.
• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : Définir les tâches pour les autres et mener à bien les initiatives moyennes à grandes (M/L) au niveau du produit ou de la gamme de produits. Définer les autres de façon à favoriser la croissance, tirer parti des forces de l'équipe et agir comme entraîneur et/ou chef de file pour les autres.
• Gestion des parties prenantes: posséder une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes des parties prenantes et de leurs besoins, excellant dans les négociations et les partenariats pour des avantages mutuels. Fournir une orientation pour les buts et objectifs à moyen et à long terme.
• Impact/Stratégie: fournir un appui au niveau mondial pour les initiatives innovantes et technologiques. Donner des discours et partager des connaissances sur les événements locaux et internationaux et les initiatives de partage des connaissances, et participer activement aux activités liées au domaine de données et au site de RDT.
• Complexité/ (Taille du produit): Fonctionnez au niveau du produit/domaine/site.
• Capacités commerciales/techniques: contribuer activement à l'avancement des connaissances techniques sur le terrain au moyen de publications, de présentations et de mentorat (par exemple, en servant de propriétaire de capacités). Inspirer l'innovation, proposer des solutions innovantes en fonction des tendances technologiques et se concentrer sur la conception de nouvelles approches des problèmes existants. Qui vous êtes :
• Plus de 10 ans d'expérience prouvée conduisant à une collaboration interfonctionnelle pour résoudre des problèmes techniques à l'échelle de l'organisation et aligner les efforts d'ingénierie disparates sur des objectifs communs.
• Posséder une compréhension approfondie des principes de traitement des données et des besoins en données de préparation à l'IA. Avoir de l'expérience dans la construction de solutions pour les experts en données (p. ex., les propriétaires de données, les consommateurs de données, les propriétaires de produits de données et la gestion numérique d'actifs).
• Exposer une expertise approfondie dans plusieurs domaines technologiques et la capacité de sélectionner et d'appliquer des technologies appropriées pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
• Maintenir la compétence en Java, Spring Boot, Angular, AWS, ECS, Docker, PostgreSQL, GitOps, l'architecture d'événements ou des technologies similaires.
• Démontrer une bonne compréhension des pratiques de développement du cycle de vie des logiciels, y compris le réglage des performances et l'évolutivité.
• Tirer parti d'une excellente connaissance des outils de développement de logiciels disponibles sur le marché pour suggérer l'adoption dans l'outil Roche actuel, améliorant en permanence la productivité du développeur et l'expérience à l'échelle de Roche.
• Appliquer l'expertise dans les meilleures pratiques de cybersécurité, en veillant à ce que les solutions logicielles respectent les normes de sécurité en coordination avec l'expert Roche approprié

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager - Diagnostics

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de compte de vente - Diagnostics

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pathology Sales Specialist – Tissue Diagnostics

Elevate Healthcare with Cutting-Edge Cellular Pathology Solutions

Join the Roche sales team and be a part of revolutionising healthcare diagnostics in the North UK region. Due to an internal promotion, we're excited to offer a rewarding opportunity for a highly motivated Sales Specialist to advance our leading-edge Cellular Pathology products in the world's most advanced laboratories, including hospital-based and private pathology departments.

About Your Role:

As a Sales Specialist in Tissue Diagnostics, you will be instrumental in shaping the healthcare landscape by promoting our robust product portfolio to key stakeholders in the NHS and private sectors. This position is within the following NHSi Pathology Networks: North 1 South (Teesside), North 2 (North and East Yorkshire) and North 6 (Sheffield Doncaster and Barnsley), North 7 (York, Hull and Scarborough) and reports to the Regional Sales Manager. 
• We offer a fantastic opportunity to drive growth and market presence at an opportune time.

Key 
• Responsibilities:

● Strategic Sales Execution : Lead the sales strategy and execution for our product portfolio, ensuring alignment with customer needs and organisational goals.
● Complex Procurements Management : Coordinate and manage comprehensive procurements, engaging with decision-makers at all levels to ensure successful outcomes.
● Market Insights : Stay ahead of changes in the NHS landscape, including payment structures and procurement processes, to maximise opportunities and mitigate challenges.
● Innovative Strategy Development : Devise strategies to maintain existing Roche affiliations and expand our reach to new sites, enhancing our market footprint.

Your 
• Profile:

● Educational Background : BSc (Hons) / BA Degree or equivalent in a life science or related experience such as a biomedical scientist background. Field sales experience or familiarity with laboratories and Roche Cellular Pathology / Tissue Diagnostics products is preferred.
● Resilience and Creativity : You are resilient, tenacious, and possess a blend of discipline and creativity, essential for navigating and succeeding in a dynamic environment.
● Relationship Building : Skilled in defining customer needs and establishing strong, effective partnerships.
● Digital Proficiency : Adept at using digital sales engagement tools to drive commercial excellence across your territory.

Why Join Roche?

At Roche, our passion for improving patient lives drives everything we do. We're proud of our collaborative culture and continuous innovation. This role not only offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package but also provides continuous support for your professional development. Roche has been ranked number 1 in the UK's Top 25 Best Big Companies to Work For List 2021, reflecting our commitment to our employees and their growth.

Take the Next Step:

If you're driven to make a significant impact in the healthcare industry and thrive in fast-paced, innovative environments, apply now to join our Tissue Diagnostics sales team. Help us transform the future of healthcare diagnostics and build a rewarding career with Roche.
Roche is an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Apply today and be part of a team that's redefining healthcare.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone

jobs.title: Global Medical Affairs Lead, Liver Disease

titleByLocale.it: Leader degli affari medici globali, malattie del fegato
titleByLocale.en: Global Medical Affairs Lead, Liver Disease
titleByLocale.fr: Affaires médicales mondiales Chef de file, maladie du foie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe care should start before disease takes hold. Join our collaborative and dedicated team of Global Medical Affairs Leads within Clinical Development and Medical Affairs. In this pivotal role, you will partner closely with international business teams and digital information solution units to develop and commercialise innovative diagnostic solutions for Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) and Chronic Liver Disease (CLD), including liver fibrosis. You will have an unparalleled opportunity to advance healthcare globally, improve patient outcomes, and shape the future of early detection.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Global Medical Strategy : Provide strategic medical and scientific leadership to develop and execute global medical plans, including evidence generation, investigator-initiated studies, and research collaborations.

• Cultivate Global Partnerships : Build and maintain strong, compliant relationships with global thought leaders, academic networks, investigators, and professional societies to drive the safe adoption of diagnostic solutions.

• Lead Scientific Communications : Develop and deliver impactful medical education programs, scientific symposia, publications, and congress presentations to effectively communicate clinical data both internally and externally.

• Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with international stakeholders and regional affiliates across cultures and time zones to identify mutual opportunities for collaboration and foster an environment of belonging.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Chez Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne prenne fin. Rejoignez notre équipe collaborative et dévouée de responsables des affaires médicales mondiales au sein du développement clinique et des affaires médicales. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes d'affaires internationales et des unités de solution d'information numérique pour développer et commercialiser des solutions diagnostiques innovantes pour le carcinome hépatocellulaire (CHC) et la maladie du foie chronique (CLD), y compris la fibrose hépatique. Vous aurez une occasion inégalée de faire progresser les soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale, d'améliorer les résultats des patients et de façonner l'avenir de la détection précoce. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger la stratégie médicale mondiale : fournir un leadership scientifique et médical stratégique pour élaborer et exécuter des plans médicaux mondiaux, y compris la production de données probantes, des études initiées par les chercheurs et des collaborations de recherche.
• Cultiver des partenariats mondiaux : établir et maintenir des relations solides et conformes avec les leaders de la pensée mondiale, les réseaux universitaires, les chercheurs et les sociétés professionnelles pour favoriser l'adoption sûre de solutions diagnostiques.
• Responsable des communications scientifiques : Élaborer et fournir des programmes d'éducation médicale, des colloques scientifiques, des publications et des présentations de congrès pour communiquer efficacement les données cliniques à l'interne et à l'externe.
• Favoriser la collaboration intersectorielle : partenariat avec les acteurs internationaux et les affiliés régionaux dans les cultures et les fuseaux horaires pour identifier les possibilités de collaboration mutuelle et favoriser un environnement d'appartenance.
• Championne Patient-Centricité : Intégrez un esprit patient-premier dans les actions quotidiennes, garantissant que toutes les activités médicales respectent strictement les directives réglementaires mondiales, les normes juridiques et les codes d'interaction des professionnels de la santé (HCP).
• Mentor et coach : Agir en tant que leader autonome et autonome et servir de coach pour soutenir le développement de collègues moins expérimentés. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel de la santé proactif et réfléchi aux systèmes à la recherche d'un lieu de travail où vous pouvez poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les géographies et les fonctions. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements complexes et en évolution rapide et vous voulez tirer parti de votre expertise scientifique pour avoir un impact durable sur les patients dans le monde entier. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Un MD et/ou un doctorat avec une expertise spécialisée en Hépatologie et une compréhension approfondie des applications cliniques pour le diagnostic, comme les biomarqueurs et les algorithmes.
• Expérience acquise dans le domaine des affaires médicales ou du développement clinique, en dirigeant la conception et la mise en oeuvre d'études cliniques, d'initiatives d'éducation médicale et de communications scientifiques.
• Matrix Compétences en leadership : Une expérience éprouvée de programmes complexes et de prise de décisions stratégiques dans des environnements matriciels mondiaux et interculturels.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et présentation : Compétences de communication quasi natives ou couramment parlées en anglais, avec la confiance nécessaire pour transmettre des messages cliniques complexes à divers publics avec énergie, clarté et impact.
• Œcuménisme réglementaire: une compréhension approfondie des cadres juridiques, de conformité et réglementaires qui influent sur l'industrie des soins de santé, des produits biopharmaceutiques et du diagnostic médical.
• Mobilité: flexibilité et volonté de voyager jusqu'à 20% au niveau national ou international. Ensemble, nous progresserons tout au long du parcours patient avec l'aspiration à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies. Postulez aujourd'hui ! 主要工作职责 :
• 1、管理销售业绩,完成主管指定的销售指标
• 2、执行重点客户管理系统
• 3、持续加强与KOL在各领域的合作

教育背景与专业资格:
• 1、临床诊断或相关科学学位毕业
• 2、英语说写能力俱佳
• 3、熟练应用微软办公软件

jobs.title: Digital Content Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

The Digital Content Specialist is expert in all aspects of digital project management, content management and publishing across different web platforms and is able to build out reporting metrics that supports the business in continuing their growth to meet KPIs and objectives.

The Opportunity:

• Publish and manage content for global websites, ensuring all digital assets are well-structured, easy-to-find, up-to-date, and accurate.

• Work with multiple key global stakeholders and content owners to facilitate content updates, while reinforcing legal compliance in global digital governance.

• Triage incoming publishing requests with the appropriate stakeholders to streamline digital operations and maintain efficient, organized workflows.

• Conduct global content audits and regular platform health-checks to identify gaps, eliminate redundancies, and keep the ecosystem clean.

• Guide and train key global stakeholders to ensure common knowledge and experience across our digital operating landscape.

Who you are:

• You have a BSc/MSc degree and 3+ years of experience in website management, IT systems, and platforms, with a basic understanding of HTML and CSS.

• You have excellent written and spoken English communication skills, combined with good interpersonal skills to work as part of a team and engage with senior leaders.

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and highly efficient with time management, ensuring precision and quality across all digital platforms.

• You are a quick learner passionate about technology and the web, bringing a dynamic, flexible approach to working with different tools.

In exchange, we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)

• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Salary starts from 1900 EUR gross/monthly.

jobs.title: Safety Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position

As an Safety Business Analyst (BA) you will be responsible for scoping, planning and supporting the successful implementation of process automation solutions by providing business analysis, best practice research, detailed requirements and user stories definition and user acceptance facilitation. In addition you will be required to work closely with Business Users, Product Owners, Product Managers, IT Business Partners and IT Architects to develop a conceptual architecture for the solutions.

The Safety BA is an active role in the product’s lifecycle management. The primary focus is to make sure that a solution is chosen to fulfill known and understood business requirements, fitting into the Product roadmap definitions and continuously providing business value over its lifecycle.

What you’ll be working on:

• Actively engage with IT Product Manager and IT Business Partner in the portfolio management processes

• Lead and drive the scoping phase of automation use cases. Collaborate with business and informatics stakeholders to lead the business case development for new initiatives including high level solution options and resource estimates

• Translates the IT enabled business strategy developed by the C-Pod into an Informatics context and works with IT Product Managers, IT Business Partners and IT Architects to develop project proposals and roadmaps that support the strategy

• Support the business partner and IT Business Partner to obtain project approval from the portfolio committees, e.g. PD PEC, PDx MEP etc

• Drive the identification of the most appropriate solution for Roche through formal RFI/RFP/RFQ (Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation) processes. Evaluate feasibility of potential solutions in collaboration with business users and Subject Matter Experts

• Prepare mandatory deliverables supporting the PMM “initiate” and “define” phases together with the Project Manager.

• On the basis of identified business needs is responsible for establishing user requirements and any related documentation as required by PMM

• Participate in Squads working on significant enhancements to understand business needs and translate them into requirements

• Strives for harmonization of business processes across sites and departments by propagating common standardized data models, applications and technologies that are in line with the cross-functional or functional Informatics strategies and architectures.

• Drives cross functional teamwork by collaborating with BA’s within Chapter and across Org Units to continuously harmonize and further develop skills and working practices specific to the BA community

• Determine the automation potential of each particular process in order to filter out those unfit for automation to narrow down the scope of work

• Drive definition of KPIs and compare the expected results to the actual ones to ensure automation is bringing the expected value in terms of acceleration or quality increase.

• Adopt Agile delivery methodologies to speed up user feedback cycles and E2E delivery timelines

• Creation of automation architecture and solution proposals

• Develops RPA and BPA prototypes, mockups and Proofs of Concept

The ideal candidate:

• Has Bachelor / Master of Science in Computer Science, engineering, Biostats, etc

• Has domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical, Pharma Development or Life Science industry, or from a consulting firm

• Has extensive experience with large projects (>1M projects, large number of stake

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was macht unseren Bereich aus:
Diagnostics Operations Penzberg ist als Teil der Diagnostics Global Operations der wichtigste Produzent von qualitativ hochwertigen Einsatzstoffen bis hin zu speziellen Kits für die Diagnostik- Division von Roche. Es erwartet Sie eine vielseitige, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Bereich Manufacturing. Hier werden biochemische und chemische Reagenzien und Einsatzstoffe für alle Geschäftsbereiche und vor allem die In-vitro-Diagnostik mehrerer Roche Geschäftseinheiten hergestellt.

Das Team:
Unser Team ist Teil des Themenclusters Festphasenchemie und stellt eine Vielzahl modifizierter Oligonukleotide, Peptide sowie Konjugate und anderer bioorganische Moleküle her. Mit diesen Produkten unterstützen wir diagnostische Assays im Bereich der PCR, Immundiagnostik und im Sequencing-Umfeld. Darüber hinaus ist unser Team maßgeblich in der Produktion zukunftsweisender Technologien involviert. Unser Antrieb gilt der Produktion dieser qualitativ hochwertigen Produkte, der Einführung neuer Produkte und der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsprozesse in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld.

Gestalten Sie unseren Bereich für die Zukunft mit und unterstützen Sie uns mit Ihrem Know-how:

• In dieser Rolle steigen Sie tief in die operative Praxis unseres Themenclusters ein und entwickeln sich sukzessive zu einer fachlichen Schlüsselperson an den Schnittstellen.

• Einstieg in die Produktion: Sie planen, begleiten und überwachen Produktions- und Validierungsansätze unter Einhaltung der SHE- und Qualitätsvorgaben.

• Troubleshooting, Prozessoptimierung, Design Transfer: Sie wirken aktiv bei der Ursachenanalyse mit und begleiten Projekte zur Prozessoptimierung und zum Scale-Up. Sie wirken aktiv bei der Implementierung neuer Produkte mit.

• Dokumentation und Compliance: Sie übernehmen die Erstellung und Überarbeitung von qualitäts- und sicherheitsrelevanten Dokumenten.

• Schnittstellenarbeit: Sie arbeiten dabei eng mit Teams aus Projektmanagement, MSAT, Technik, Qualität und Sicherheit zusammen.

• Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung wachsen Sie in die fachliche Führung und Koordination von Mitarbeitenden hinein und übernehmen schrittweise delegierte Aufgaben der Gruppenleitung (z.B. im Abweichungsmanagement oder bei Freigabeprozessen).

Für diese verantwortungsvolle und spannende Position suchen wir genau SIE:

• Sie haben Ihr Studium der Chemie mit einer Promotion im Bereich der (bio)organischen Chemie abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringen Sie ein abgeschlossenes ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium und fundierte Erfahrung in der regulatorischen und technischen Betreuung chemischer Produktionsbetriebe mit.

• Sie verfügen über fundierte theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in Ihrem Fachgebiet (idealerweise Festphasensynthese, klassische organische Synthese, Chemieingenieurwesen).

• Sie bringen ein hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein mit; erste Berührungspunkte mit GMP, Arbeitssicherheit oder regulatorischer Fragestellungen sind von Vorteil.

• Sie haben die Motivation, sich in Richtung fachliche Führung zu entwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit EDV- Anwendungen runden Ihr Profil ab.

Bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns!
Wir machen’s einfach! Wir bitten Dich um einen aktuellen Lebenslauf - weitere Dokumente werden nicht benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden könne

jobs.title: Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Omnichannel Customer Experience Partner, you will act as an expert in marketing, digital marketing, and strategy, while providing integrated systems thinking and leadership. Your responsibilities include developing, owning, and jointly implementing team outcomes with pod members, co-defining portfolio strategy, and leading or contributing to related work packages and initiatives.

In terms of Omnichannel capabilities, you are expected to serve as a powerful lever to deliver a seamless customer experience across face-to-face and digital channels, having demonstrated experience in creating and delivering Omnichannel campaigns that blend our “traditional” activities with digital touchpoints in an orchestrated way, with a focus on effective messaging, customer satisfaction, speed, and cost-effectiveness.

Although hired into a country affiliate, this role requires you to be part of an APAC collaboration, working across borders to realize and scale country outcomes by contributing to virtual, cross-border, cross-functional work package teams.

Roche expects all employees to hold high standards of compliance with both external and internal policies and regulations and actively participate in SHE initiatives within the Company.

Key Responsibilities

• Co-own and pursue outcomes alongside assigned, empowered self organized teams (such as pods and work package teams) in an agile work environment with a fluid resourcing model (i.e., assignment to one or more teams that can change over time, contribution to work packages on local and international level).

• Contribute expertise in digital marketing and product strategy development to create a cohesive customer experience across all touchpoints.

• Lead comprehensive marketing efforts, including market analysis and market research that informs both traditional and digital channels.

• Define and implement customer segmentation strategies that operate seamlessly across all channels.

• Manage campaigns that leverage both traditional and digital engagement methods for maximum reach.

• Collaborate with PPOCs (eg. PJPs) and relevant stakeholders to identify and analyze insights aligned to outcome defined by the Disease Area team, owning the space relating to EpicX and relevant qualitative & quantitative insights to optimize the overall customer experience.

• Establish KPIs that measure the effectiveness and performance of integrated campaigns across all platforms.

• Ensure all business activities within the ecosystem comply with relevant company SOPs, PHARMA Code of Conduct, iFPMA, Symphony (and of equivalence) and are of high ethical standard

• Work closely with subject matter experts for Access and other team members on outcomes and initiatives aiming to increase access for patients to our medicines and other healthcare solutions, including coordination and support of advocacy building as well as listing and funding initiatives.

• Any other duties that may be assigned from time as required by the business.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor degree (marketing, scientific, technical, digital, economic or business degree)

• Proven knowledge and skills in Marketing, including Digital Marketing (digital transformation, omni-channel marketing, content marketing, data analytics)

• In-depth knowledge of digital marketing channels, strategies, and best practices.

• Proficiency in utilizing digital marketing tools, analytics platforms, and content management systems.

• Significant experience in a comme

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile soluzioni per i pazienti _Area terapia del seno
titleByLocale.en: 患者解决方案经理 _乳腺治疗领域

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
患者解决方案经理是相应疾病领域 HCP（医疗专业人士）的主要接触点，负责制定患者整体解决方案相关的策略和相关项目的支持和执行工作，包含但不限于患者全程管理、创新支付解决方案、疾病认知（患者教育）、准入及安全运营以及上市前后产品的学术平台搭建等，从而提升标准化诊疗水平，提高患者知晓率和可及性，从而实现患者获益。

A. 患者全程管理

• 梳理并建立生态圈内患者跨院/院内的分级诊疗与双向转诊路径（Patient Flow)，从而更好的推动全程管理在医院内/间的落地.

• 协助生态圈内医院及相关科室推进和打造会诊通道，协助上下层医院间衔接流转，助力绿色转诊通道的建立，最终实现患者获益。

• 管理生态圈内患者全程管理项目的各项落地实施，并确保其合规性。

B. 支付方案

• 与准入团队合作，协助整合罗氏相关支付方案，依法依规传递相关支付解决方案信息。

C. 疾病认知（患者教育）

• 与第三方机构协作，针对相关疾病领域区域现状及整体策略，协助开展患者教育，提升疾病认知，促进患者获益。

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 跨职能、或者相关治疗领域经验优先

• 拥有成长性思维和快速学习能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.title: Power Platform Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you will demonstrate proven expertise in the platform’s foundation and component technologies. You will guide the platform team in making the platform available to the broader enterprise, so that citizen developers and federated application teams can create business value by leveraging the platform. You will effectively translate organizational goals into a robust technical roadmap, guiding the strategic direction for a secure, compliant, and scalable low-code ecosystem. You will create governance frameworks and provide best practices to empower developers. In addition, you will design the automated administration of the platform, leveraging AI, so that tasks like monitoring platform capacity and user licensing do not need to be done manually. You will act as a technical leader for the platform team, while at the same time collaborating with the global architect community and the technical experts responsible for other Microsoft components.

Job Responsibilities

• Content Leadership: Treats platform services as internal products with clear documentation, lifecycle management, and stakeholder feedback loops. Designs and documents components of shared technology platforms (e.g., CI/CD, observability, DLP policies) while creating proof of concepts, reference implementations, automation scripts, and platform tooling. Closely follows Microsoft’s Power Platform roadmap and general developments in the low-code, no-code and AI space to identify opportunities and challenges within Roche.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the platform level. These initiatives may include the implementation of platform level initiatives, such as the deployment of the Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit or other automations to support platform administrations. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Leads the platform team to ensure that platform is fit for use, socializes the platform to prospective internal customers, and represents the platform within architect communities. Maintains a bigger picture view informed by Microsoft’s roadmap and general low-code, no-code, and AI trends. Understands how various platform components fit into the overall organizational strategy and goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development plans with the global strategy. Gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live) and gets involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.

• Complexity: Operates at the platform level with a direct impact on the platform team’s technical decisions and an indirect impact on the decisions of citizen developers, professional developers, and business use case owners. Records decisions in architecture decision records and other formal documentation.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, investing time and energy in initiatives that boost automation and innovation while maintaining the highest engineer

Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications .
Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public.

Role scope:

Key responsibilities

• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies

• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas

• Plan and handle medical budgets

• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions

• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness

• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues

• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions

• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers

• Review of non-, and promotional materials

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

Additional task, duties and responsibilities:

• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)

• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology

• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups

Requirements:
Education and experience

• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).

• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .

• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.

• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years

Required skills and qualifications

• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity

• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note this is a fixed-term role for 2 years.

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments

• Manage vendor accounts

• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution

• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries

• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams

• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer

Who you are:

• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience

• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage

• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues

• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations

• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

• Proficiency in English and Italian

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Wir setzen auf das Modell der Personalisierten Ausbildung : Du gestaltest deine Ausbildungsinhalte in enger Absprache mit deinen Ausbilder:innen aktiv mit.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern - Portuguese speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for you to join Roche and our Services & Solutions Center in Budapest .

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals.

What we do:
The Demand to Pay (D2P) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with end-to-end D2P services & solutions tailored to their needs. The D2P teams provide customer service to Roche affiliates on D2P systems and processes (Accounts Payable, Payment Management, Order & Contract Management), ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions.

Your day to day responsibilities are:
As an Accounts Payable Intern you are supporting the Roche-site in Budapest. Our team handles bills for all Roche employees working in mainly Europe and manages administration of all accounts payable related processes. In this function, you will contribute actively to dealing with complex processes and issues in the area of ​​accounts payable.
We are seeking a talented and highly motivated individual who will shape the future of this challenging function.

As an Intern, you:

• Support AP invoice resolution

• Handle documents

• Work together closely with the Accounts Payable department

• Process PO invoices

• Invoice image archiving

• Email handling

What can you bring to our team:
​We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you are currently studying in a Hungarian University/College on a day-time schedule. You have Portuguese and English knowledge .

Furthermore you have the following skills and qualifications:

• You have good communication skills

• You are available to work 25-30 hours on a weekly basis

• You are accurate and you like to work in a team

• Spanish language is an advantage

In exchange we provide you with:
We offer you a strategic opportunity in a truly international work environment with high-profile colleagues and excellent in-house learning and networking opportunities, plus lots of flexibility to make your mark at Roche. We will make sure your daily work will make an impact and you will be able to learn a lot along the way.

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training opportunities

• Good, accessible location

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Product Manager

The Opportunity:
Roche Diagnostics is seeking an innovative Senior Product Manager to join our Near Patient Care (NPC) diagnostics marketing team. In this role, you will act as the technical and commercial business owner for several portfolios, inclusive of Molecular Point of Care, Immunoassay and Clinical Chemistry, and Blood Gas and Electrolytes.

We are seeking a professional with a passion for product excellence through on-market planning and product stewardship while simultaneously managing product lifecycles, pricing strategies, and global stakeholder alignment. You will help shape the US launch plans for on-market instrument menu expansion as well as new platforms while serving as the primary liaison between many cross-functional groups across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the definitive technical expert and business owner for the utility and use of assigned products in the marketplace.

• Partner with demand planning teams to gather data and create product forecasts and business plans that drive growth.

• Generate and execute product launch plans inclusive of pricing strategies, customer segmentation, and sales enablement.

• Collaborate with global business partners to drive US market requirements into current and future product portfolios; influence global life cycle teams on specific product requirements.

• Responsible for internal processes driving software/hardware updates, and product expirations. Serve as the strategic lead on product availability and back-order management for the field sales force.

• Utilize high-level stakeholder management skills to influence teams without formal authority to ensure alignment, proactively identify bottlenecks, and mobilize resources to keep complex, long-term projects on track and achieve business milestones

• Own the annual business plan for your future portfolio, including the development and implementation of tactics and the evaluation of performance through business reviews.

• Influence the business plan for on market products through the business planning process with additional Near Patient Care marketers and cross-functional partners

• Instilling leadership through others by acting as a role model to drive impactful business solutions and positive change, encouraging, motivating and empowering others and helping others to success.

• Develops business area mastery to include understanding of market segments, business model, analysis of key metrics that define success, forecasting sales and product, share performance, trends, competition, customer critical success factors and needs through interaction with customers for integration with programs.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field

• You hold 5 years of marketing, business, sales or relevant business experience

Preferred:

• Strong project management skills

• Strong stakeholder management skills

• Experience working across multiple life-science subject matter areas

• High level executive presence

• Ability to influence cross-functional teams

• High intellectual curiosity and attention to detail

• Ability to travel moderately as dictated by business need

• Ability to manage multiple projects

• Regulatory and compliance awareness (e.g. USDA, ISO 9000, CLIA, FDA, GMP), ISO 9000, CLIA, FDA, GMP)

Location:

• This position is based onsite in our Indianapolis campus.

• No relocation benefits are provided for this role.
