jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen Roche's digital capabilities globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting, and Creative Design.

The Opportunity:

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub's long-term outcomes and strategy, as well as excellent delivery of our various digital operations priorities. You are responsible for supporting and executing different initiatives. You work with relevant stakeholders and consult on how to develop their digital performance further and ensure they leverage the available digital tools in order to meet their overall goals.

• Support SEO execution: technical, on-page SEO, and off-page optimization, as well as have an understanding of digital & content marketing

• Research SEO keywords to use throughout the company's website and marketing materials (Keyword Research) using several tools, providing keyword variations, and grouping them in clusters

• Select, prioritize, and grade the keywords based on their value to the business and the specific project

• Prepare briefs for content creators, following the provided internal guidelines and focusing on the keywords provided in the Keyword Research (using tools such as SurferSEO and SEMrush)

• Perform and prepare SEO and organic traffic reports for websites

• Execute tests, collect & analyze data and results, identify trends and insights to achieve maximum ROI

Who you are:

• You hold a BSc/MSc degree in a related field and 2+ years of SEO experience in a similar position.

• You have good knowledge of Adobe Analytics and Google Search Console; SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, Screaming Frog, etc.); Excel, Google Sheets, Smartsheet; CSS, HTML.

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken) are essential, additional languages a plus, based on region/customer requirements.

• You are detail-oriented, well-organized, and efficient with time management.

Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Project Management Officer

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la gestion des projets

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities :
China Strategy Formulation

• Strategic Framework Design: Formulate and continuously iterate a comprehensive, end-to-end strategic framework for Pharma China across the entire value chain, establishing the foundational roadmap for the organization's long-term vision.

• Data-Driven Narrative Architecture ("The China Story"): Architect and evolve a compelling, data-driven strategic narrative that clearly communicates local market realities, structural shifts, and future growth opportunities to global stakeholders.

• Connecting the Dots & Insight Generation: Effectively connect distinct business elements and generate high-value strategic insights.

• Executive Synthesis & Global Communication: Translate complex local market, clinical, and regulatory nuances into clear business contexts, gathering and preparing critical information to craft high-impact briefings, executive presentations, and strategic speeches/slides for the General Manager and global leadership.

Corporate Project Management

• Project Governance Framework: Design, standardize, and govern the PMO framework for various company projects, embedding a robust "closed-loop" management approach to monitor execution and maintain full visibility across the portfolio.

• Outcome-Driven Delivery: Maintain a strong focus on project outcomes, implementing tracking mechanisms that ensure high-quality, seamless coordination, and timely delivery across all value chains.

• Leadership Dialogue Facilitation: Organize and manage the operational structure for regular leadership review meetings, CNET activities, and strategic dialogues to facilitate quick, data-backed business decisions.

• Resource & Risk Management: Proactively identify project delivery risks, dependencies, and resource bottlenecks, optimizing resource mobilization across competing enterprise initiatives to keep core priorities on track.

Cross-Functional Project Leadership & Delivery

• Lead High-Complexity Initiatives: Manage cross-functional projects, organizing agile project squads to solve complex operational challenges.

• Process Optimization: Diagnose systemic operational friction points across the organization and establish optimized project management workflows to increase delivery speed and efficiency.

• Matrix Stakeholder Management: Master stakeholder management by influencing and aligning diverse, cross-functional teams toward shared corporate goals

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education & Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or above. An MBA or background in a top-tier strategy consulting firm is highly preferred.

• Professional Expertise: Recognized expert in corporate strategy, marketing, or access within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional verbal and written communication in Mandarin and English. Ability to craft compelling narratives and high-impact speeches for executive audiences.

• Strategic Agility: Proven track record of handling high levels of complexity and ambiguity. Ability to see the "big picture" while maintaining extreme sensitivity to critical tactical details.

• Leadership Track Record: Demonstrated ability to lead large, or cross-functional teams and influence senior management to adopt new perspectives or strategic shifts.

Leadership Mindset and Attributes

• VACC Leader: A role model for Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach leadership styles.

• Courageous Authenticity: Willin

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Organisation “Site Network Basel/Kaiseraugst”, Teil der globalen Group Function “Corporate Strategy, Sustainability & Sites”, stellt die Infrastruktur und Services für den gesamten Standort bereit und entwickelt diese kontinuierlich und auf innovative Art weiter. Wir arbeiten mit allen Anspruchsgruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zusammen, von der frühen Forschung bis zur Versorgung der Patient:innen. Bei uns kannst du dich auf ein modernes Organisationsmodell freuen, in welchem du in Eigenverantwortung deine Talente in sinnhafter Arbeit einbringen kannst. Wir garantieren Gestaltungsspielraum und Entscheidungsfreiheit in unserer Organisation. Klassische Vorgesetzte suchst du bei uns vergebens.

Innerhalb unseres Bereichs Site Assets & Spaces, der die unternehmerische Verantwortung für zukunftsorientierte, inspirierende Arbeitswelten und den Betrieb der im Eigentum stehenden Assets (Gebäude und zugehörige Anlagen) am Standort trägt, bist du im Herzstück der digitalen Transformation tätig: der Virtual Factory. Dieser hochmoderne, multifunktionale Hub dient als Katalysator für Kreativität, immersives Lernen und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit am gesamten Standort.

Wir suchen einen engagierten und visionären Virtual Factory XR Lead, der die Leitung dieser essentiellen Innovationsräume übernimmt. In dieser Rolle stehst du in direktem Austausch mit allen Business Units und arbeitest eng verzahnt mit den anderen Community Leads (insbesondere für 3D-Druck und Media Creation) zusammen.

Du agierst als strategischer Partner, der technologische Möglichkeiten mit konkreten operativen Business-Herausforderungen verbindet und innovative Lösungen erarbeitet.

Deine Möglichkeit

• Strategische Planung und Umsetzung von XR/VR-Use Cases sowie weiteren digitalen Projekten. Du treibst digitale Innovation und operative Exzellenz voran in dem du use-cases priorisiert und erfolgreich umsetzt, und so echten Mehrwert für unsere Mitarbeitenden und den Standort schaffst.

• Budgetverantwortung für den XR-Space. Du steuerst die finanziellen Mittel und triffst zielgerichtete Investitionsentscheidungen in Hard- und Software, um die Infrastruktur optimal für zukünftige technologische Entwicklungen aufzustellen und gleichzeitig Kosteneinsparungen bei unseren Business Partnern zu ermöglichen.

• End-to-End Technologie- & Betriebsmanagement. Du verantwortest den Lifecycle aller relevanten XR-Spaces am Standort , inklusive dem Scouting neuer Trends, deren Evaluation und allfälligen Implementierung, sowie dem Skalieren von Business Lösungen und langfristiger Sicherstellung des stabilen technischen Betriebs.

• Sicherstellung des technischen Betriebs und der Stabilität der XR Area. Dies beinhaltet Hardware-Upgrades, Buchungsprozesse, Netzwerk-Einrichtungen sowie robuste Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Strategien.

• Community Building & Stakeholder Management. Du baust die Aktive XR Anwender Community auf, erstellst Lernpfade, und agierst als Bindeglied zu globalen Teams & und unserem Senior Management.

• Zuständigkeit für die Ausbildung, Betreuung und das zielgerichtete Coaching von ICT- und Mediamatik-Lernenden , um diese aktiv in Innovationsprojekte einzubinden.

Wer du bist

• Tiefgreifende, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementierung und Betreuung von Virtual, Augmented und Mixed Reality Lösungen im industriellen Umfeld

• Starkes Entrepreneurial Mindset und die Fähigkeit, als Brücke zwischen IT-Anforderungen, Business-Bedürfnissen und Wirtschaftlich

• In profondità, diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella concezione, implementazione e supporto di soluzioni di realtà virtuali, potenziate e miste nell'ambiente industriale

jobs.title: International Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently.

In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Quality Strategies: Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP), using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.

• Lead Global Audits: Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.

• Partner with Stakeholders: Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.

• Support Inspections: Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.

• Advance PDQ Processes: Participate actively in assigned departmental goals and initiatives, contributing directly to the continuous improvement of PDQ processes.

• Maintain GxP Expertise: Maintain deep awareness and expertise in global regulations (such as FDA, EU, and ICH guidance) across GCP, GVP, or Medical Device frameworks.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Education: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.

• Industry Experience: Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.

• GxP Knowledge: Strong exposure to and understanding of global GxP regulations and quality roles, specifically within GCP, GVP, or IVD/MD frameworks.

• Data & Digital Literacy: Excellent digital capabilities, with a good understanding of audit management and analytical reporting tools to drive data-led solutions.

• Critical Thinking: Proven problem-so

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As a Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality division, you will support the Roche/Genentech organisation by developing and delivering robust Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions across molecules in development, post-approval products, and global processes. You will act as a trusted partner, ensuring our operations maintain the highest standards of compliance while directly influencing how we bring innovative therapies to patients safely and efficiently. In this dynamic role, you will apply a risk-based approach to Quality Assurance using our Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework. By generating actionable data and insights through audits, you will collaborate closely with international stakeholders and play a vital part in preparing for and supporting regulatory authority inspections. This is an exceptional opportunity to utilise your expertise in a truly global, agile matrix environment where your insights drive continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities:
• Drive Quality Strategies: Support the execution of risk-based Quality Assurance strategies and conclusions in predominantly Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) as well as Good Clinical Practice (GCP), using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework.
• Lead Global Audits: Plan, perform, and lead audits, grouping individual issues into systematic trends to provide valuable quality data that fulfils regulatory requirements.
• Partner with Stakeholders: Establish and maintain strong partnerships with business stakeholders, presenting audit observations and associated compliance risks clearly.
• Support Inspections: Play a key role in regulatory authority inspection preparation and management.
• Advance PDQ Processes: Participate actively in assigned departmental goals and initiatives, contributing directly to the continuous improvement of PDQ processes.
• Maintain GxP Expertise: Maintain deep awareness and expertise in global regulations (such as FDA, EU, and ICH guidance) across GCP, GVP, or Medical Device frameworks. Who You Are You are a proactive, analytical quality professional who thrives on transforming complex data into clear, actionable solutions. You are an excellent communicator, highly skilled at collaborating across cultures and influencing stakeholders at various levels with or without formal authority. You look for opportunities to develop your skills within an international team and are passionate about continuous growth. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Education: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field, or equivalent combined experience.
• Industry Experience: Proven experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with solid knowledge of end-to-end product operationalisation.
• GxP Knowledge: Strong exposure to and understanding of global GxP regulations and quality roles, specifically within GCP, GVP, or IVD/MD frameworks.
• Data & Digital Literacy: Excellent digital capabilities, with a good understanding of audit management and analytical reporting tools to drive data-led solutions.
• Critical Thinking: Proven problem-so

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à la transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir de la gestion de la qualité dans les soins de santé? En tant que responsable de la qualité au sein de notre division Développement Pharma Qualité, vous soutiendrez l'organisation Roche/Genentech en élaborant et en fournissant des stratégies d'assurance qualité robustes, des audits et des conclusions entre molécules dans le développement, les produits post-approbation et les processus mondiaux. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance, vous assurant que nos opérations respectent les normes de conformité les plus élevées tout en influençant directement la façon dont nous apportons des thérapies innovantes aux patients en toute sécurité et efficacement. Dans ce rôle dynamique, vous appliquerez une approche fondée sur le risque à l'assurance de la qualité en utilisant notre cadre de référence Critical to Quality (CtQ). En générant des données et des renseignements exploitables au moyen d'audits, vous collaborerez étroitement avec les intervenants internationaux et jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la préparation et le soutien des inspections des autorités de réglementation. Principales responsabilités :
• Diriger les stratégies de qualité : Appuyer l'exécution de stratégies et de conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur le risque dans le cadre principalement de bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance (BVP) et de bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP), en utilisant le cadre de CtQ.
• Diriger les audits mondiaux : planifier, effectuer et diriger les audits, regrouper les questions individuelles en tendances systématiques afin de fournir des données de qualité précieuses qui répondent aux exigences réglementaires.
• Partenariat avec les parties prenantes: Établir et maintenir des partenariats solides avec les parties prenantes, en présentant clairement les observations d'audit et les risques de conformité associés.
• Soutien aux inspections : jouer un rôle clé dans la préparation et la gestion des inspections par les autorités de réglementation.
• Avancer les processus de PDQ : Participer activement aux objectifs et initiatives ministériels assignés, contribuant directement à l'amélioration continue des processus de PDQ.
• Tenir à jour l'expertise GxP : maintenir une connaissance et une expertise approfondies des réglementations mondiales (telles que la FDA, l'UE et les conseils de l'ICH) dans les cadres GCP, GVP ou de dispositifs médicaux. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et de qualité analytique qui prospère en transformant des données complexes en solutions claires et réalisables. Vous êtes un excellent communicateur, hautement qualifié pour collaborer à travers les cultures et influencer les intervenants à différents niveaux avec ou sans autorité formelle. Vous recherchez des occasions de développer vos compétences au sein d'une équipe internationale et êtes passionné par la croissance continue. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez:
• Éducation: Un baccalauréat ou équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité, ou équivalent expérience combinée.
• Expérience de l'industrie : Expérience éprouvée au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, de la biotechnologie ou des dispositifs médicaux, avec une solide connaissance de l'opérationnalisation de bout en bout des produits.
• Connaissances GxP : Forte exposition et compréhension des règlements GxP mondiaux et des rôles de qualité, en particulier dans les cadres GCP, GVP ou IVD/MD.
• Data & Digital Literacy: Excellentes capacités numériques, avec une bonne compréhension de la gestion de l'audit et des outils de rapport analytique pour piloter des solutions basées sur les données.
• Pensée critique : un problème avéré

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Scientist in Pharmaceutical Development, you are part of the Department “Pharmaceutical Development” in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel, Switzerland. The department Pharmaceutical Development is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products (Synthetic molecules and Biologics) from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for parenteral drug products for all clinical stages and the market launch, the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites, commercial product support and line extension development.

The opportunity

• Leading development: Pharmaceutical development of parenteral formulations for clinical development and market (including line extensions). Understanding stability behavior (e.g. biophysics, chemical degradation)

• Management of Data: Ensure seamless integration of structured and unstructured data across the department.

• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to perform deep-dive Data Mining. Identify trends and correlations associated with scientific data.

• Functional expertise as project management: Representation of Pharmaceutical Development as pharmaceutical project leader in global CMC teams, functional representative in cross-functional teams and global committees within Roche.

• Regulatory submissions: Authoring drug product sections for clinical IND/IMPDs and MAAs.

Who you are

• You hold a Ph.D. degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields Or you hold a masters degree in chemical/process/bioprocess engineering or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional (industry) experience in a pharmaceutical company.

• You bring hands-on experience applying data analytics to pharmaceutical development, CMC, formulation, stability or process development datasets, including scripting in Python, R or similar tools.

• Proven experience of establishing and managing large data sets, including exposure to scripting associated with data analysis.

• Deep understanding of statistical modeling including linear/logistic regression, cluster analysis, time-series forecasting, longitudinal study data analysis, and multivariate testing.

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical product development and associated requirements.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements for different clinical and commercial stages of development.

• Excellent communication skills and collaborative behaviors, with end-to-end and global thinking, as well as excellent stakeholder management skills

Are you ready to make a difference for our patients? We are looking forward to your application – join us now and become part of our journey!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que Scientifique en Développement Pharmaceutique, vous faites partie du département Développement Pharmaceutique (PTD) à Bâle, Suisse. Le ministère du Développement pharmaceutique est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux (molécules de synthèse et produits biologiques) de la phase 1 jusqu'au lancement. Les activités comprennent la formulation et l'élaboration de procédés de fabrication pour les produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le lancement du marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciale, le soutien des produits commerciaux et le développement d'extensions de gamme. L'opportunité
• Développement avancé: Développement pharmaceutique de formulations parentérales pour le développement clinique et le marché (y compris les extensions de lignées). Comprendre le comportement de stabilité (par exemple biophysique, dégradation chimique)
• Gestion des données : assurer une intégration transparente des données structurées et non structurées dans l'ensemble du département.
• Data Mining & Pattern Discovery: Utilisez des techniques avancées de statistique et d'apprentissage automatique pour effectuer l'extraction de données en profondeur. Déterminer les tendances et les corrélations associées aux données scientifiques.
• Expertise fonctionnelle en tant que gestion de projet : Représentation du développement pharmaceutique en tant que chef de projet pharmaceutique dans les équipes mondiales du CMC, représentant fonctionnel dans les équipes interfonctionnelles et les comités mondiaux au sein de Roche.
• Présentations réglementaires : Autoriser les sections des produits pharmaceutiques pour les ID/IMPD cliniques et les AAM. Qui vous êtes En tant que candidat retenu, vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes. Ou vous êtes titulaire d'une maîtrise en génie chimique/procédé/bioprocédé ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle (industrie) dans une entreprise pharmaceutique.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'établissement et de la gestion de grands ensembles de données, y compris l'exposition à des scripts associés à l'analyse des données.
• Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation statistique, y compris la régression linéaire/logistique, l'analyse en grappes, la prévision de séries chronologiques, l'analyse longitudinale des données des études et les essais multivariés.
• Connaissance du développement des produits pharmaceutiques et des exigences connexes.
• Compréhension des exigences réglementaires pour les différents stades cliniques et commerciaux du développement.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et comportement collaboratif, avec une réflexion de bout en bout et globale, ainsi que d'excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes Êtes-vous prêt à faire la différence pour nos patients ? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature – rejoignez-nous maintenant et faites partie de notre voyage! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global MSAT DS Senior Process Steward

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Pharma Technical Technology (PTT) within Pharma Technical Operations (PT) enhances industrialization and product management by integrating SHE, maintenance, performance optimization, and scalable processes for improved robustness, efficiency, and reliability.

Roche’s global Manufacturing Science and Technology (gMSAT) manages commercial products, new technologies, standardization, and risk mitigation, organized into Large and Small Molecule (DS & DP) teams.

The Process Steward Large Molecule DS connects global MSAT with manufacturing sites, supporting process industrialization, driving improvements, managing second-source transfers, and providing second-level support for product issues. They represent network technological needs in governance forums and stakeholder interactions.

The Opportunity

• Support Product Technical Leads and Product Stewards in ensuring process industrialization, coordinate and execute process gap assessments, integrate identified risks into the risk log, and develop mitigation strategies.

• Drive systematic process and continuous technical product health and supply improvements based on insights, including second source and change strategies

• Execute validated state support activities and respond to evolving conditions to ensure compliance (e.g., VICs, RCAs)

• Provide technical expertise for technical and engineering runs and hands-on second-level support for investigations, CAPAs, and troubleshooting in partnership with the internal and external manufacturing network. Lead non-product specific RCAs and investigations

• Leverage the pilot plant team for real-life and scaled experimentation to support process-related projects, including validation studies and process transfer to manufacturing sites

• Ensure the implementation of network initiatives that are aligned and prioritized with manufacturing site plans, and incorporate portfolio-wide impacting aspects like direct material changes and Health Authority requirements

• Collaborate closely with global and site functions, leadership, and other gMSAT and PTT teams. Serve as a digital enabler, translating business needs to digital strategy and digital product development teams and driving technical sustainability improvements for product, process, and technology

Who you are

• B.S. or M.S. degree in Chemical, Biochemical Engineering, or related discipline with 7+ years of relevant industrial experience in process development, process engineering, or manufacturing operations. A PhD is advantageous

• Experience in collaborative, matrix team leadership and decision-making

• Demonstrated experience in process engineering, technical process development, process validation, or technology transfer (E. coli & CHO processes). Familiarity with pharmaceutical quality systems, industry guidelines, regulatory submission, health authority requirements, and platform-specific technology, processes, and equipment

• Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to define and articulate team deliverables effectively, including towards senior leadership

• Willingness to travel less than 10% as required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate

jobs.title: AI Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The role
​
You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.

• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.

• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.

• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.

• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.

• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices

• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools

Who You Are

• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field

• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail

• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment

• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred)

Who We Are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams.

Are you ready to apply?
We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.
• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.
• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.
• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.
• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.
• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices
• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools Who You Are
• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail
• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment
• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred) Who We Are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Design Researcher
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your Chapter
We are a global team of 60+ Designers, Researchers, and Human Factors Engineers dedicated to designing and building an accessible, seamless, and effective healthcare ecosystem. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Vienna and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to transform complex healthcare challenges into human-centered realities through intuitive, connected digital solutions for everyone, everywhere.

Your Department
Our team thrives on revealing pivotal, unmet human needs, de-risking product decisions, and instilling deep empathy for users and customers across the organization. We are heavily involved across the entire product lifecycle, from early discovery to development and continuous improvement. Driven by curiosity and a commitment to integrity, we take a proactive approach to solve complex problems. Collaboration is at our core as we bridge our partners in Business and Engineering with the patients and healthcare professionals who use our products.

Your responsibilities

• Independently determine research strategy and design, plan and executive research studies for a product area.

• Operate cross-functionally, providing user research expertise and execution across products

• Inform product strategy and identify & evaluate new opportunities, solutions and concepts based on user needs

• Collaborate with product on defining “success” from qualitative and quantitative perspectives to ensure research is focused and closely tied to business goals

• Work closely with product teams to identify and prioritize research topics

• Conduct research using a wide variety of qualitative and quantitative methods to generate actionable insights across the product development lifecycle, including up front generative research to identify new opportunities, iterative concept evaluation, and post-launch testing.

• Operate according to ethical standards and data privacy regulations necessary when interacting with healthcare providers and patients

• Conduct internal cross-functional workshops using design-thinking methodologies

• Present to a variety of audiences from product teams to executive teams

• Communicate and advocate for research findings in a way that inspire people to act

• Drive and recommend proactive broad-based research programs

• Work closely with product designers to make design recommendations based on research results and help drive those recommendations to reality

• Stay current with trends, best practices, and methodologies in areas of UX, user research and behavioral analytics

• Create holistic summary dashboards at a regular cadence for sharing with management teams

• Exhibit a high-level of expertise in driving the data strategy across multiple listening channels (e.g., usage metrics, surveys, usability testing, etc)

Your profile

• 5+ years of experience in user research

• Can operate with a high degree of independence in ambiguous and complex situations and subject matters

• Experience working with Healthcare Provider and/or Patient-facing digital products

• Deeply skilled and experienced in user research activities across a variety of methodologies including focus groups, ethnography/field research, interviews, concept validation, in-lab usability testing, remote usability testing, card sorting, testing on mobile devices, surveys, workshop facilitation, etc.

• Analytically minded and very strong in data analysis, knowledge of statistical analysis, experience creating metrics dashboards

• High degree

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il vostro capitolo Siamo un team globale di 60+ Designer, ricercatori e ingegneri di Fattori Umani dedicati alla progettazione e costruzione di un ecosistema sanitario accessibile, senza soluzione di continuità ed efficace. Situato tra i siti di Roche Diagnostics a Vienna e Sant Cugat del Vallès, la nostra missione è quella di trasformare complesse sfide sanitarie in realtà centrate sull'uomo attraverso soluzioni digitali intuitive e connesse per tutti, ovunque. Il vostro Dipartimento Il nostro team si basa sulla rivelazione dei bisogni umani cardine e insoddisfacenti, sulla de-risurrezione delle decisioni dei prodotti, e sull'instillazione dell'empatia profonda per gli utenti e i clienti di tutta l'organizzazione. Siamo fortemente coinvolti in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta precoce allo sviluppo e al miglioramento continuo. Guidati dalla curiosità e dall'impegno per l'integrità, prendiamo un approccio proattivo per risolvere problemi complessi. La collaborazione è al nostro centro mentre collaboriamo con i nostri partner in Business and Engineering con i pazienti e i professionisti del settore sanitario che utilizzano i nostri prodotti. Le vostre responsabilità
• Indipendentemente determinare strategia di ricerca e progettazione, piani e studi di ricerca esecutivi per una zona di prodotto.
• Informare la strategia del prodotto e identificare e valutare nuove opportunità, soluzioni e concetti basati sulle esigenze degli utenti
• Collaborare con il prodotto per definire il “successo” da prospettive qualitative e quantitative per garantire che la ricerca sia focalizzata e strettamente legata agli obiettivi aziendali
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di prodotto per identificare e privilegiare i temi della ricerca
• Condurre la ricerca utilizzando una vasta gamma di metodi qualitativi e quantitativi per generare intutti sul ciclo di prodotti
• Operare secondo gli standard etici e le normative sulla privacy dei dati necessarie per interagire con i fornitori di servizi sanitari e con i pazienti
• Condurre workshop interfunzionali utilizzando metodologie di progettazione-thinking
• Presente a una varietà di spettatori dai team di prodotto ai team esecutivi
• Comunicare e sostenere i risultati della ricerca in un modo che ispira le persone ad agire
• Guidare e consigliare programmi di ricerca a livello ampio proattivo
• Lavorare con i progettisti di prodotto per fare raccomandazioni di progettazione basate sui risultati di ricerca sulle tendenze Analiticamente ragionato e molto forte nell'analisi dei dati, conoscenza dell'analisi statistica, esperienza nella creazione di dashboard metriche
• Alta laurea

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Ihres Kapitels Wir sind ein globales Team von 60+ Designer, Forscher und Human Factors Engineers widmen sich der Gestaltung und dem Aufbau eines zugänglichen, nahtlosen und effektiven Gesundheitssystems. Unsere Mission an den Roche Diagnostics Standorten in Wien und Sant Cugat del Vallès ist es, komplexe Herausforderungen im Gesundheitswesen durch intuitive, vernetzte digitale Lösungen für alle und überall in menschenzentrierte Realitäten zu verwandeln. Unser Team lebt davon, wichtige, unerfüllte menschliche Bedürfnisse aufzudecken, Produktentscheidungen zu minimieren und Benutzern und Kunden im gesamten Unternehmen tiefe Empathie zu vermitteln. Wir sind über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus hinweg stark involviert, von der frühen Entdeckung über die Entwicklung bis hin zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung. Angetrieben von Neugier und der Verpflichtung zur Integrität verfolgen wir einen proaktiven Ansatz zur Lösung komplexer Probleme. Die Zusammenarbeit steht in unserem Mittelpunkt, da wir unsere Partner in Business und Engineering mit den Patienten und medizinischen Fachkräften, die unsere Produkte verwenden, verbinden. Ihre Aufgaben
• Bestimmen Sie unabhängig die Forschungsstrategie und Design, Planung und Executive Research Studien für einen Produktbereich.
• Betrieben Sie funktionsübergreifend und bieten Sie Anwenderforschungskompetenz und -ausführung über Produkte hinweg
• Informieren Sie die Produktstrategie und identifizieren und bewerten Sie neue Möglichkeiten, Lösungen und Konzepte basierend auf den Benutzerbedürfnissen
• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Produkt zusammen, um den „Erfolg aus qualitativen und quantitativen Perspektiven zu definieren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Forschung konzentriert und eng mit den Geschäftszielen verbunden ist
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktteams zusammen, um Forschungsthemen zu identifizieren und zu priorisieren
• Führen Sie Forschung mit einer Vielzahl von qualitativen und quantitativen Methoden durch, um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse über den gesamten Produktentwicklungslebenszyklus zu generieren, einschließlich vorab generativer Forschung, um neue Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, iterative Konzeptbewertung und Post-Launch-Tests.
• Arbeiten Sie nach ethischen Standards und Datenschutzbestimmungen, die bei der Interaktion mit Gesundheitsdienstleistern und Patienten erforderlich sind
• Führen Sie interne funktionsübergreifende Workshops mit Design-Thinking-Methoden durch
• Präsentieren Sie eine Vielzahl von Zielgruppen von Produktteams bis hin zu Führungsteams
• Kommunizieren und befürworten Sie Forschungsergebnisse in einer Weise, die die Menschen zum Handeln anregt
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktdesignern zusammen, um Designempfehlungen basierend auf Forschungsergebnissen zu erstellen und diese Empfehlungen in die Realität zu tragen
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit Trends, Best Practices und Methoden in Bereichen von UX, Benutzerforschung und Verhaltensanalyse
• Erstellen Sie ganzheitliche Zusammenfassungs-Dashboards in regelmäßigen Abständen für den Austausch mit Management-Teams
• Zeigen Sie ein hohes Maß an Know-how bei der Entwicklung der Datenstrategie über mehrere Hörkanäle hinweg
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Benutzerforschung
• Können Sie mit einem hohen Maß an Unabhängigkeit arbeiten Mehrdeutigkeit und komplexe Situationen und Themenbereiche
• Erfahrung in der Benutzerforschung Aktivitäten mit einer Vielzahl von Methoden einschließlich Fokusgruppen, Ethnographie / Feldforschung, Interviews, Konzeptvalidierung, In-Lab-Usability-Tests Analytisch denkend und sehr stark in der Datenanalyse, Kenntnisse der statistischen Analyse, Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Metriken Dashboards
• Hoher Grad

jobs.title: Medical Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

We are looking for a Medical Intern to join Roche Diagnostics.

• Supports the daily operations of the Medical Department.

• Conducts scientific literature reviews, research activities, and report preparation.

• Assists in the monitoring and coordination of clinical studies and related projects.

• Contributes to the development of medical materials, presentations, and documentation.

• Supports the coordination of events and activities involving healthcare professionals, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.

• Assists with data analysis, reporting, and the development of business insights and models.

• Participates in the organization of medical training programs, meetings, and scientific events.

• Maintains departmental documentation, archiving processes, and supports continuous process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

• Preferably a 3rd or 4th year student majoring in Medicine or Pharmacy

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to liaise with internal/external stakeholders

• Highly collaborative nature with the ability to work within a team

• Good written and verbal communication skills in Turkish and English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data Architect

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Data Architect, you will shape future-ready data architectures that directly impact our mission to improve global healthcare. Operating within a collaborative data ecosystem, you will translate complex product requirements into scalable, enterprise-standard solutions.

You will contribute to this vision by:

• Designing innovative solutions that meet business priorities, technical standards, and critical non-functional requirements across the data product life cycle.

• Maintaining the strategic architectural roadmap, vision, and current landscape for our data solutions to ensure scalability and long-term viability.

• Solving complex data challenges with a fresh perspective, evaluating multiple sources of information to drive sound architectural choices.

• Defining reference architectures and patterns, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are rigorously documented and maintained.

• Partnering with delivery teams to provide architectural oversight, consult on design patterns, proactively manage technical debt, and optimize existing data systems.

• Evaluating emerging data technologies and piloting cutting-edge solutions to continuously enhance data governance and business value.

• Fostering consensus across diverse stakeholder groups by communicating complex technical information with clarity, openness, and empathy.

Who You Are

You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning data complexity into clarity. You are passionate about data governance and eager to collaborate with cross-functional teams to build sustainable, high-impact systems.

To find success in this role, you bring:

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready data architectures across single or multiple data domains.

• Deep technical knowledge in core data technology areas, including a strong understanding of Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies.

• Proven capability in establishing reference architectures, defining fitness functions, tracking industry trends, and assessing vendor technology feasibility.

• Exceptional communication skills with a natural ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and build collaborative consensus.

• A proactive, growth-oriented mindset focused on minimizing technical debt, identifying value-add opportunities, and mentoring peers within the broader data community.

What you get

• Salary range 14.000 - 26.000 PLN gross based on the

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data Architetto Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Operando all'interno di un ecosistema di dati collaborativo, tradurrai requisiti di prodotto complessi in soluzioni scalabili e standard aziendali. Contribuirai a questa visione da:

• Mantenere la roadmap architettonica strategica, la visione e il paesaggio attuale per le nostre soluzioni di dati per garantire scalabilità e affidabilità a lungo termine.
• Risolvere complesse sfide di dati con una prospettiva nuova, valutare più fonti di informazioni per guidare scelte architettoniche sonore.
• Definire architetture e modelli di riferimento, assicurando che i registri delle decisioni di architettura (ADR) siano rigorosamente documentati e mantenuti.
• Collaborare con i team di consegna per fornire supervisione architettonica, consultare i modelli di progettazione, gestire in modo proattivo il debito tecnico e ottimizzare i sistemi di dati esistenti.
• Valutare le tecnologie dei dati emergenti e pilotare soluzioni all'avanguardia per migliorare continuamente la governance dei dati e il valore aziendale.
• Promuovere il consenso tra diversi gruppi di stakeholder comunicando informazioni tecniche complesse con chiarezza, apertura ed empatia. • Esperienza dimostrata che progetta architetture di dati gestite da aziende, basate su standard e pronte per il futuro in domini di dati singoli o multipli.
• Una profonda conoscenza tecnica nelle aree principali della tecnologia dei dati, tra cui una forte comprensione dei modelli di dati concettuali e logici, delle tassonomie e delle Ontologie.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration. L'opportunité En tant qu'architecte de données, vous façonnerez des architectures de données prêtes à l'avenir qui influent directement sur notre mission d'améliorer les soins de santé mondiaux. En travaillant au sein d'un écosystème collaboratif de données, vous transformerez les exigences complexes du produit en solutions évolutives et standard pour l'entreprise. Vous contribuerez à cette vision en :
• Concevoir des solutions innovantes qui répondent aux priorités des entreprises, aux normes techniques et aux exigences critiques non fonctionnelles tout au long du cycle de vie des produits de données.
• Maintenir la feuille de route stratégique, la vision et le paysage actuel pour nos solutions de données afin d'assurer l'évolutivité et la viabilité à long terme.
• Résoudre les défis complexes en matière de données avec une nouvelle perspective, en évaluant de multiples sources d'information pour générer des choix architecturaux solides.
• Définir les architectures et les modèles de référence, en veillant à ce que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) soient rigoureusement documentés et tenus à jour.
• Établir des partenariats avec les équipes chargées de l'exécution pour assurer la supervision architecturale, consulter les modèles de conception, gérer de manière proactive la dette technique et optimiser les systèmes de données existants.
• Évaluer les nouvelles technologies de données et mettre à l'essai des solutions de pointe pour améliorer continuellement la gouvernance des données et la valeur opérationnelle.
• Favoriser le consensus entre les divers groupes d'intervenants en communiquant des informations techniques complexes avec clarté, ouverture et empathie. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader technique avant-gardiste qui prospère en transformant la complexité des données en clarté. Vous êtes passionné par la gouvernance des données et désireux de collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour construire des systèmes durables et à impact élevé. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expérience démontrée en matière de conception d'architectures de données axées sur les entreprises, basées sur des normes et prêtes à l'avenir dans des domaines de données uniques ou multiples.
• Connaissances techniques approfondies dans les domaines fondamentaux de la technologie des données, y compris une bonne compréhension des modèles conceptuels et logiques de données, des taxonomies et des ontologies.
• Capacité éprouvée d'établir des architectures de référence, de définir les fonctions de conditionnement physique, de suivre les tendances de l'industrie et d'évaluer la faisabilité technologique des fournisseurs.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication avec une capacité naturelle d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes aux acteurs non techniques et d'établir un consensus collaboratif.
• Un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur la croissance, axé sur la réduction de la dette technique, l'identification des possibilités d'ajout de valeur et le mentorat des pairs au sein de la communauté des données. Ce que vous obtenez
• Salaires compris entre 14 000 et 26 000 PLN brut

jobs.title: Medical Lead (Oncology)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Lead is the key Medical Affairs role that develops broad medical & scientific expertise within the given Disease/Therapeutic Areas. As a Medical Lead, you support the development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies and primarily drive scientific exchange and evidence generation activities.

Key Responsibilities

• You are a strategic partner who provides medical insights and expertise to the organisation and executes all planned medical activities.

• You will be the medical responsible of the team and will be more in the field.

• You manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communicated internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes.

• You collaborate with stakeholders in identifying and prioritising relevant research ideas and developing them into research projects.

• You collaborate closely with Clinical Operations across different phases of interventional clinical trials: Gaining clarity and communicating/spreading the knowledge to communities of interest, helping to define and maintain country participation strategy, supporting development of sites selection strategy through a disease area lens by different means including participation in site feasibility activities, pre-activation site visits and other F2F and remote interactions with the sites as needed, patient recruitment & retention, protocol & patient-related issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

• You detect the medical gap/need for RWD/E generation activities by reviewing Integrated Evidence Plans, communicate, agree and document, plan & execute and/or participate in respective work in non-interventional studies and RWD/E generation activities: Definition of the research questions and study objectives, study design and protocol, study budget, feasibility, site selection, pre-activation and ad-hoc visits, patient recruitment, protocol & patient issues, scientific communication of study results, clinical study report and scientific publications.

Who You Are

• You have a Medicine, Pharmacy, or Dentistry degree

• Your experience in Oncology (Lung) is preferred

• You have previous experience in the Pharma Industry

• You are fluent in Turkish and English

• You have strategic thinking and a growth mindset

• You are collaborative and experienced in stakeholder management

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Program Lead for Third Party Risk and Resilience Management establishes and maintains a robust governance framework for all Offshore Development Centers (ODCs), bridging R&D innovation requirements with Global IT security, infrastructure, and compliance standards. This leader ensures ODCs function as strategic extensions of Roche's R&D engine while maintaining zero major IT compliance breaches, and guides vendors during ODC setup to ensure full compliance with Roche Security standards.

Compliance of all ODC setups and ongoing operations. Ensure alignment on scope, methodologies, processes at the nexus of R&D organization, Global procurement, and IT. Elimination of governance gaps and friction points between R&D and IT. Implementation of standardized, global ODC management framework across business units Security risks, incidents, and incident/change/problem management processes at ODC sites Strategic positioning of ODCs as value creators rather than cost centers

The Opportunity

• Determine ODC necessity based on country risk and data sensitivity

• Initiate new ODC setups, coordinate vendor office space establishment, and guide vendors on Roche Security standards

• Conduct Security Risk Assessment (SRA) and Data Classification Review (DCR) for all services and applications

• Identify services unsuitable for external business partners and escalate to product/service owners or DSM for remediation

• Create, review, and maintain ODC Manuals, Impact Assessments, and Security Control Tables

• Periodically review and update impact assessment documents to remove retired services

• Ensure compliance with legal requirements (GDPR, CCPA) and Roche security protocols

• Act as the owner for role-specific training curricula

• Ensure training compliance for all external personnel by verifying mandatory security and role-specific requirements are met prior to system access.

• Accountable for the systematic tracking and enforcement of training completion for vendor resources, leveraging the Roche Training Solution system

• Approve all ODC changes including staff assignments, project onboarding, and service modifications

• Manage ServiceNow requests for infrastructure (NAS storage, VD/VDI creation/updates, application packaging)

• Identify VSA requirements and maintain vendor security/privacy capabilities throughout ODC lifecycle

• Ensure security audits completed prior to service commencement and conduct periodic audits

• Conduct assessments when major changes occur (new projects with higher security needs)

• Track and remediate audit findings with vendors

• Ensure mandatory notifications are formally integrated into processes (e.g., GSP) for all new vendor collaborations

• Coordinate dedicated VDI planning with Citrix when default environments cannot support daily tasks

• Optimize virtual desktop and application virtualization to reduce VDI requirements

• Manage port opening for DIA, RDI, VDIs, and coordinate VDI creation

• Collaborate with Network, Perimeter, and Citrix teams on connectivity and URL whitelisting

• Ensure Business Partner Organization (BPO) approvals for applications, systems, URLs, RDP/SSH access

• Populate and verify application inventories, URLs, and RDP/SS

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Senior Production Technician you will be able to set up and operate equipment and processes in accordance with standard operating procedures and pilot
protocols. Inspect product for quality and adherence to specifications. Completes and ensures accuracy of all process orders and associated required documentation, records
and metrics. Participate in the development and review of documentation changes to ensure accuracy and efficiency. Prepare work centers for appropriate line clearance procedures and conduct regular cleaning in
accordance with standard operating procedures. Trains other employees, as needed. Participates in process improvement teams and helps implement improvements. Acts as a liaison with engineering staff on process improvement and development and communicates to the production team. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality
objectives through daily actions. Performs semi-routine support duties of a specialized nature within an assigned area.

The opportunity:

• Have key responsibilities supporting manufacturing operations either in the manufacturing, packaging, and/or product labeling areas.

• Set up and operate a variety of automatic or semi-automatic machines used in the production of the company's product.

• Work from process sheets or written/verbal instructions given by supervisor to perform production tasks.

• Check and inspects operations against predetermined tolerances.

• Provide support to an area, person, or program. Interfaces with internal customers.

• Function as a subject matter expert in the area of knowledge.

• Participate in the development and/or delivery of training for other employees on equipment and/or procedures.

Who you are:

• You hold a High school diploma with 2 years of related experience.

• You have specialized training or certification in particular area, system or equipment

• You have experience in team oriented work environment

• You have experience in regulated work environment

• You have thorough understanding of appropriate safety, health, and environmental procedures

• ERP and/or Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) experience

• Ability to engage, lead, and communicate in written and verbal format

• Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing methodology

• Basic computer skills with competency using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)

• Thorough understanding of the principles and applications of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and ISO 9001

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Pay transparency
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 44,200.00 - 82,200.00 USD Annual . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law.
