titleByLocale.fr: Expert en sécurité et conformité, ERP Data Platform

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Security and Compliance Expert, ERP Data Platform
Are you passionate about Information Security and Compliance, specifically in ERP environments with a focus on data integrity and governance? Join a global team where you'll lead the change as a Security and Compliance expert in optimizing processes through experience and automation.
The Mission
Your primary mission is to ensure that the organization's technology landscape, data practices, and security measures do not expose the business to legal penalties, financial loss, or reputational damage. As a recognized expert, you will implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP ERP platform systems and data products, providing leadership across both on-premise and cloud SAP Data platform ecosystems.

The Opportunity

• Platform Security: Implement and maintain security, authorization, and compliance standards for SAP platforms (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA, and SAP Datasphere). Develop and mature capabilities in cloud compliance and security, particularly within SAP Datasphere.

• Regulatory Alignment & Framework Management: Continuously monitor relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) and industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) to ensure the platform remains ahead of global compliance requirements.

• Policy Development & Data Governance: Drive the creation and refinement of internal policies and data governance frameworks to maintain high standards of integrity, security, and structured data handling.

• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , taking accountability for the end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) lifecycle, GxP controls, and other relevant regulations.

• Monitoring & Remediation: Lead weekly and monthly monitoring of SoD (Segregation of Duties) conflicts via GRC dashboards, work with SoD Champions to mitigate risks, and address non-compliant items flagged in the SAP Security Standards Roche documentation.

• System Integrity: Oversee application error reviews (e.g., failed jobs) and sign off on monitoring results in tools like ICAt to provide evidence for control checks.

• Access Governance: Perform quarterly reviews of Critical access , GRC FireFighter roles (Controllers, Owners, Admins), and HANA DB users, initiating timely removals to maintain a "least privilege" environment.

• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT audit support by defining control activities, approving auditor documentation, and acting as the primary point of contact for auditors during peak cycles (Sep/Oct).

• Strategic Direction: Set technological development directions by analyzing and implementing new solutions, tools, and IT standards, with a focus on data governance, validation, and automation.

• Risk Assessment: Annually review and update the System Risk Assessment (SRA) and Data Classification to ensure alignment with the Minimum Security Baseline.

• Process Optimization: Actively conduct innovation projects to optimize processes, introduce new solutions, and increase efficiency through automation in Data products.

• Collaboration: Partner with system teams and stakeholders to ensure task ownership, bridge data privacy awareness gaps, and onboard/train new team members on ICFR control activities.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering with a minimum of 5 years’ post-secondary experience in SAP Security and a deep understanding of Compliance.

Unisciti a un team globale in cui guiderai il cambiamento come esperto di sicurezza e conformità nell'ottimizzazione dei processi attraverso l'esperienza e l'automazione. La missione La vostra missione primaria è garantire che il paesaggio tecnologico dell'organizzazione, le pratiche di dati e le misure di sicurezza non espongono l'azienda a sanzioni legali, perdita finanziaria, o danni reputazionali. In qualità di esperto riconosciuto, implementerai e manterrai standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per i sistemi e i prodotti di dati della piattaforma SAP ERP, fornendo leadership sia sugli ecosistemi della piattaforma SAP Data on-premise che sul cloud. L'opportunità
• Sicurezza della piattaforma: implementare e mantenere standard di sicurezza, autorizzazione e conformità per le piattaforme SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA e SAP Datasphere). Sviluppare e maturare funzionalità nella conformità e nella sicurezza del cloud, in particolare all'interno di SAP Datasphere.
• Allineamento normativo e gestione quadro: monitorare costantemente le normative pertinenti (ad esempio, GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) e gli standard del settore (ad esempio, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) per garantire che la piattaforma resti davanti ai requisiti di conformità globali.
• Politica di sviluppo e governance dei dati: guidare la creazione e la raffinatezza delle politiche interne e dei quadri di governance dei dati per mantenere elevati standard di integrità, sicurezza e gestione dei dati strutturati.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Vice and Control Owner , tenendo conto della responsabilità del ciclo di vita ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting), dei controlli GxP e di altre normative pertinenti.
• Monitoraggio e riparazione: Condurre il monitoraggio settimanale e mensile dei conflitti SoD (Segregation of Duties) tramite cruscotti GRC, lavorare con SoD Champions per mitigare i rischi e affrontare gli elementi non conformi contrassegnati nella documentazione di SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Integrità di sistema: supervisionare le recensioni degli errori delle applicazioni (ad esempio, lavori falliti) e firmare il monitoraggio dei risultati in strumenti come ICAt per fornire prove per i controlli di controllo.
• Access Governance: Eseguire recensioni trimestrali di accesso critico , GRC FireFighter ruoli (Controllers, Owners, Admins), e HANA DB utenti, avviando rimozioni tempestive per mantenere un ambiente "meno privilegio".
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR Il supporto dell'audit IT definendo le attività di controllo, approvando la documentazione dell'auditor e fungendo da punto di contatto primario per gli auditor durante i cicli di picco (Sep/Oct).
• Direzione strategica: Impostare le direzioni di sviluppo tecnologico analizzando e implementando nuove soluzioni, strumenti e standard IT, con un focus sulla governance dei dati, la convalida e l'automazione.
• Valutazione del rischio: rivedere e aggiornare annualmente la valutazione del rischio di sistema (SRA) e la classificazione dei dati per garantire l'allineamento con la Baseline di sicurezza minima.
• Ottimizzazione dei processi: condurre attivamente progetti di innovazione per ottimizzare i processi, introdurre nuove soluzioni e aumentare l'efficienza attraverso l'automazione dei prodotti Data.
• Collaborazione: Partner con i team di sistema e le parti interessate per garantire la proprietà delle attività, colmare le lacune di consapevolezza della privacy e formare nuovi membri del team sulle attività di controllo ICFR. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea in Informatica, IT o Ingegneria con un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza post-secondaria in SAP Security e una profonda comprensione della conformità.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte, ERP-Datenplattform Sind Sie leidenschaftlich über Informationssicherheit und Compliance, speziell in ERP-Umgebungen mit dem Fokus auf Datenintegrität und Governance? Begleiten Sie ein globales Team, in dem Sie den Wandel als Sicherheits- und Compliance-Experte bei der Optimierung von Prozessen durch Erfahrung und Automatisierung vorantreiben. Die Mission Ihre Hauptaufgabe ist es, sicherzustellen, dass die Technologielandschaft der Organisation, Datenpraktiken und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen das Geschäft nicht auf rechtliche Strafen, finanziellen Verlust oder Rufschäden aussetzen. Als anerkannter Experte implementieren und pflegen Sie Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP ERP-Plattformsysteme und Datenprodukte, die sowohl über On-Premise- als auch Cloud-Systeme der SAP Data-Plattform führen. Die Chance
• Plattformsicherheit: Umsetzung und Aufrechterhaltung von Sicherheits-, Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Standards für SAP-Plattformen (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA und SAP Datasphere). Entwickeln und reifen Fähigkeiten in der Cloud-Compliance und -Sicherheit, insbesondere in SAP Datasphere.
• Regulatorische Ausrichtung & Rahmenmanagement: Kontinuierlich relevante Regelungen (z.B. DSGVO, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) und Industriestandards (z.B. ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) überwachen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Plattform weiterhin den globalen Compliance-Anforderungen entspricht.
• Policy Development & Data Governance: Die Schaffung und Verfeinerung interner Politiken und Data Governance-Frameworks, um hohe Standards an Integrität, Sicherheit und strukturiertem Datenhandling zu erhalten.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Act as the System Owner Deputy and Control Owner , unter Berücksichtigung der Verantwortung für den end-to-end ICFR (Internal Control over Financial Reporting) Lebenszyklus, GxP-Kontrollen und andere relevante Vorschriften.
• Monitoring & Sanierung: Führen Sie wöchentliche und monatliche Überwachung von SoD-Konflikten (Segregation of Duties) über GRC-Dashboards, arbeiten mit SoD-Champs zusammen, um Risiken zu mindern und nicht-konforme Objekte, die in der SAP-Sicherheitsstandards Roche-Dokumentation markiert sind, anzusprechen.
• Systemintegrity: Übersehen Sie die Fehlerbeurteilungen der Anwendung (z.B. gescheiterte Arbeitsplätze) und melden Sie sich bei der Überwachung der Ergebnisse in Werkzeugen wie ICAt an, um Nachweise für Kontrollkontrollen zu liefern.
• Access Governance: Führen Sie vierteljährliche Bewertungen von Critical Access, GRC FireFighter Rollen (Controller, Eigentümer, Admins) und HANA DB-Nutzer aus, die rechtzeitige Entfernungen zur Aufrechterhaltung einer "Least Privileg"-Umgebung einleiten.
• Audit Leadership: Lead ICFR IT-Audit-Unterstützung durch Definition von Kontrolltätigkeiten, Genehmigung der Auditor-Dokumentation und als primärer Ansprechpartner für Auditoren während der Spitzenzyklen (Sep/Oct).
• Strategische Richtung: Setzen Sie technologische Entwicklungsrichtungen durch Analyse und Implementierung neuer Lösungen, Tools und IT-Standards, mit einem Fokus auf Daten-Governance, Validierung und Automatisierung.
• Risikobewertung: Jährliche Überprüfung und Aktualisierung der System-Risikobewertung (SRA) und der Datenklassifizierung, um die Anpassung an die Mindestsicherheit Baseline sicherzustellen.
• Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Durchführung von Innovationsprojekten zur Optimierung von Prozessen, Einführung neuer Lösungen und Steigerung der Effizienz durch Automatisierung in Datenprodukten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Partner mit Systemteams und Stakeholdern, um Aufgabeneigentum zu gewährleisten, Datensicherheitslücken zu überbrücken und neue Teammitglieder auf ICFR-Kontrolltätigkeiten zu trainieren. Wer bist du?
• Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, IT oder Engineering mit mindestens 5 Jahren postsekundärer Erfahrung in SAP Security und einem tiefen Verständnis der Compliance.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Expert en sécurité et conformité, ERP Data Platform Êtes-vous passionné par la sécurité et la conformité de l'information, en particulier dans les environnements ERP, en mettant l'accent sur l'intégrité et la gouvernance des données? Rejoignez une équipe mondiale où vous dirigerez le changement en tant qu'expert en sécurité et conformité dans l'optimisation des processus par l'expérience et l'automatisation. La Mission Votre mission principale est de s'assurer que le paysage technologique, les pratiques en matière de données et les mesures de sécurité de l'organisation n'exposent pas l'entreprise à des pénalités légales, à des pertes financières ou à des dommages à sa réputation. En tant qu'expert reconnu, vous appliquerez et maintiendrez des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les systèmes et les produits de données SAP ERP, assurant ainsi un leadership à la fois sur site et dans les écosystèmes de la plateforme SAP Data Cloud. L'opportunité
• Sécurité des plateformes: Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des normes de sécurité, d'autorisation et de conformité pour les plateformes SAP (SAP BW 7.5 HANA, SAP BW4HANA et SAP Datasphere). Développer et développer des capacités en matière de conformité et de sécurité cloud, en particulier dans SAP Datasphère.
• Alignement de la réglementation et gestion du cadre: surveiller en permanence les réglementations pertinentes (par exemple, RGPD, CCPA, HIPAA, SOX) et les normes de l'industrie (par exemple, ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST) afin de s'assurer que la plateforme reste en avance sur les exigences mondiales de conformité.
• Développement des politiques et gouvernance des données: Favoriser la création et le perfectionnement de politiques internes et de cadres de gouvernance des données pour maintenir des normes élevées d'intégrité, de sécurité et de traitement structuré des données.
• ICFR & Control Ownership: Agir en tant que propriétaire de système adjoint et propriétaire de contrôle, en prenant la responsabilité du cycle de vie de bout en bout ICFR (contrôle interne des rapports financiers), des contrôles GxP et d'autres règlements pertinents.
• Surveillance et réparation: Diriger la surveillance hebdomadaire et mensuelle des conflits de SoD (ségrégation des fonctions) via les tableaux de bord du GRC, travailler avec les champions de SoD pour atténuer les risques et traiter les éléments non conformes signalés dans la documentation SAP Security Standards Roche.
• Intégrité du système: Surveiller les examens d'erreurs d'application (par exemple, les emplois échoués) et signer le suivi des résultats dans des outils comme ICAt pour fournir des preuves pour les contrôles.
• Gouvernance de l'accès : Effectuer des examens trimestriels de l'accès critique, des rôles de FireFighter du GRC (Contrôleurs, Propriétaires, Administrateurs) et des utilisateurs de HANA DB, en initiant des suppressions en temps opportun pour maintenir un environnement « le moins privilégié ».
• Leadership de l'audit : chef de file du CIRF Soutien à la vérification de la TI en définissant les activités de contrôle, en approuvant la documentation de l'auditeur et en agissant comme principal point de contact pour les vérificateurs pendant les cycles de pointe (sept/oct).
• Orientation stratégique: Définir des orientations de développement technologique en analysant et en mettant en œuvre de nouvelles solutions, outils et normes informatiques, en mettant l'accent sur la gouvernance des données, la validation et l'automatisation.
• Évaluation des risques : Revoir et mettre à jour chaque année l'évaluation des risques du système et la classification des données afin d'assurer l'alignement sur la base minimale de sécurité.
• Optimisation des processus : Mener activement des projets d'innovation pour optimiser les processus, introduire de nouvelles solutions et accroître l'efficacité grâce à l'automatisation des produits Data.
• Collaboration: partenariat avec les équipes du système et les parties prenantes pour assurer l'appropriation des tâches, combler les lacunes en matière de sensibilisation à la protection des données et former de nouveaux membres d'équipes aux activités de contrôle du CIRF. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou en génie avec un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience postsecondaire en sécurité SAP et une compréhension profonde de la conformité.

jobs.title: Software Testing Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Purpose of the role

This position aims at offering the opportunity to develop competences in the area of testing, integration and validation of Software solutions in the field of Laboratory connectivity components in Roche Laboratories. Our team is responsible for developing connectivity solutions which are enabling interoperability of all components part of the Diagnostics of our clients (instruments, Network integrators, IT solutions, LIS…). The position will support this ambition by covering activities related to gain understanding of requirements at business and technical level so that they can support on the component, E2E and field validation of functionality, testing activities and integration with other solutions. The role will also provide technical requirements to development teams when appropriate.

How would your day to day look like?

You will be part of a development team based in Sant Cugat and as part of it, you will join their Agile ceremonies (SAFE Framework). You will work in some activities from your team backlog related to your role. You will be in the office an average of 1 to 2 days per week together with the rest of the team for specific testing needs. In addition, you will need to travel 3-4 times per year to Switzerland or other client locations.

Who are you?

You are a recent graduate (max 3 years after graduation) in the fields of Informatics, Telecommunications and Biotech.
You are a person with high curiosity and willingness to learn from other domains. You try to find autonomy in your work and are able to ask for help or advice in order to ensure you are doing valuable work. You are authentic, tell the truth and explain the why, strive for excellence and continuously improve and live our values of Integrity, Courage and Passion.

What do we offer?

We offer a learning environment and opportunities to develop quickly yourself both on our domains and on your personal growth and leadership. 
• We offer you a mature organization with Innovative and passionate people, very customer centric and open to change and continuously improving and delivering value fast. You also will be trained on the basic competencies you need to work with us and will feel safe for failing and learning as the essence to growing with us.

This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Digital Sales Specialist - Central Lab

titleByLocale.it: Specialista di vendita digitale - Laboratorio centrale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Digital Sales Specialist- Central Lab

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Digital Central Lab Consultant where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio to IHN, hospital, and reference laboratory customers. This field-based position requires consultative sales experience and expertise in lab workflow, IT infrastructure, data flow, informatics, laboratory medicine, laboratory operations, digital applications (i.e. middleware, business intelligence tools, etc.), and Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) to effectively consult with clinical laboratory stakeholders on customized Roche digital solutions and provide strategic recommendations on digital processes. This position engages early in the sales cycle to understand customer needs, deliver customized demos, and design customized digital solutions in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Roche’s and customers’ teams.

Responsibilities

• Generates new customer demand across the full portfolio of Core Lab and Molecular navify products (middleware, connectivity, informatics, apps, etc).

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.

• Conduct laboratory process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.

• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.

• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.

• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.

• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.

• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.

• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.

• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the walls of the laboratory.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, laboratory diagnostics sales)

• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills

• Familiarity with digital solutions, laboratory middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems

• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences

Preferred Qualifications

• Preferred experience

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Specialista di vendita digitale - Laboratorio centrale Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Unisciti all'organizzazione di vendita Roche Digital Solutions come Digital Central Lab Consultant dove sarai responsabile della vendita del portafoglio digitale Roche Navify ai clienti di IHN, ospedale e laboratorio di riferimento. Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nel flusso di lavoro di laboratorio, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, medicina di laboratorio, operazioni di laboratorio, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente gli stakeholder di laboratorio clinici sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. responsabilità
• Genera una nuova domanda del cliente attraverso il portafoglio completo dei prodotti Core Lab e Molecular Navify (middleware, connettività, informatica, applicazioni, ecc).
• Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori a livello esecutivo.
• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita.
• Condurre analisi di processo di laboratorio, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretto allineamento con gli stakeholder interni.
• Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno.
• Adept per tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in azioni interne per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave.
• Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche.
• Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente.
• Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate.
• Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business.
• Seguire un approccio end-to-end standardizzato che crea valori differenziati e basati su prove per il portafoglio soluzioni, sia all'interno che all'esterno delle pareti del laboratorio. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente.
• 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica di laboratorio)
• Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving
• Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni di middleware di laboratorio e sistemi LIS ospedalieri
• Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Qualificazioni predestinate
• Esperienza preferenziale

Middleware, Business Intelligence-Tools usw.) und Laborinformationssysteme (LIS), um sich effektiv mit klinischen Laborbeteiligten zu maßgeschneiderten digitalen Lösungen von Roche zu beraten und strategische Empfehlungen zu digitalen Prozessen zu geben. Diese Position engagiert sich früh im Verkaufszyklus, um die Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen, maßgeschneiderte Demos zu liefern und maßgeschneiderte digitale Lösungen in Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern in den Teams von Roche und Kunden zu entwerfen. • Generiert neue Kundennachfrage im gesamten Portfolio von Core Lab und Molecular Navify Produkten (Middleware, Konnektivität, Informatik, Apps usw.).
• Engagieren Sie sich in strategischen digitalen Diskussionen mit wichtigen Kundeneinflüssen, von technischen Endbenutzern bis hin zu Entscheidungsträgern auf Führungsebene.
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern in Vertriebs- und Implementierungsteams, um Vertriebsstrategien für Gesamtlösungen zu definieren und auszurichten, um die Verkaufsziele konsequent zu erreichen und zu übertreffen.
• Durchführung von Laborprozessanalysen, Entwicklung von Präsentationen von Lösungsvorschlägen und Bereitstellung von Empfehlungen für Kunden in enger Abstimmung mit internen Stakeholdern.

• Übersetzen Sie die Kundenbedürfnisse in interne Maßnahmen, um diese Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen und gleichzeitig wichtige Geschäftsprioritäten und -ziele in Einklang zu bringen.
• Starker klinischer und finanzieller Scharfsinn mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, die Kundenbedürfnisse zu verstehen und zu übersetzen, um den Wert digitaler Roche-Lösungen effektiv zu positionieren.

• Befolgen Sie einen standardisierten End-to-End-Ansatz, der einen evidenzbasierten, differenzierten Wert für das Lösungsportfolio sowohl innerhalb als auch außerhalb der Wände des Labors schafft. Wer Sie sind
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (dh Informationstechnologie, Medizintechnik, Life Sciences) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
• 5+ Jahre relevante oder gleichwertige Erfahrung (d. H. Verkauf digitaler Lösungen im Gesundheitswesen, Verkauf von Labordiagnostik)
• Muss autonom und mit effektiven Kommunikations-, Verhandlungs- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten organisiert sein
• Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lösungen, Labor-Middleware-Lösungen und Krankenhaus-LIS-Systemen
• Erfahrung mit der Präsentation technischer Informationen für große externe und interne Zielgruppen Bevorzugte Qualifikationen

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste de spécialiste des ventes numériques - Central Lab Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. The Opportunity Venez rejoindre l'organisation de vente de Roche Digital Solutions en tant que consultant en Digital Central Lab où vous serez responsable de la vente du portefeuille numérique de Roche navify à des clients IHN, hôpital et laboratoire de référence. Ce poste sur le terrain exige de l'expérience et une expertise en matière de ventes consultatives dans les domaines suivants : flux de travail en laboratoire, infrastructure informatique, flux de données, informatique, médecine de laboratoire, opérations de laboratoire, applications numériques (c.-à-d. intergiciels, outils d'intelligence d'affaires, etc.) et systèmes d'information de laboratoire (SIL) pour consulter efficacement les intervenants des laboratoires cliniques sur les solutions numériques Roche personnalisées et formuler des recommandations stratégiques sur les processus numériques. Cette position s'engage dès le début du cycle de vente pour comprendre les besoins des clients, fournir des démos personnalisées et concevoir des solutions numériques personnalisées en partenariat avec des intervenants interfonctionnels à travers les équipes Roche et les clients. Responsabilités
• Génère la demande de nouveaux clients dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits Core Lab et Molecular navify (milieux, connectivité, informatique, applications, etc.).
• S'engager dans des discussions numériques stratégiques avec des influences clés sur l'achat des clients, des utilisateurs finaux techniques aux décideurs de niveau exécutif.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes des équipes de vente et de mise en oeuvre afin de définir et d'aligner les stratégies de vente de solutions totales pour atteindre et dépasser systématiquement les objectifs de vente.
• Effectuer des analyses de processus en laboratoire, élaborer des propositions de solutions et présenter des recommandations aux clients en étroite harmonie avec les parties prenantes internes.
• Fournir des démos logicielles et des présentations techniques adaptées aux publics internes et externes.
• S'efforcer de traduire les besoins des clients en actions internes pour répondre à ces besoins tout en conciliant les priorités et les objectifs clés de l'entreprise.
• Forte concentration clinique et financière avec une capacité démontrée de comprendre et de traduire les besoins du client pour positionner efficacement la valeur des solutions numériques Roche.
• Qualifier efficacement les pistes et utiliser les résultats de l'analyse des flux de travail et des études d'impact pour fournir une différenciation concurrentielle et une valeur à la solution globale du client.
• Fournit une expertise technique approfondie concernant les gammes de produits assignées.
• Travailler de concert avec les parties prenantes internes pour partager l'information et les meilleures pratiques tout en restant activement informé des tendances de l'industrie et des clients qui influent sur les entreprises.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Instrument Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of instrument operations within the Indianapolis Distribution Center. This role focuses on operational investigations, systems troubleshooting, inventory accuracy, and process optimization to ensure efficient instrument movement and order fulfillment.
This position will serve as a key operational resource for resolving complex issues, improving workflows, and supporting cross-functional initiatives that impact instrument distribution and warehouse execution. The role will work closely with warehouse operations, transportation, supply chain planning, and quality teams to ensure operational stability and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
Operational Execution & Issue Resolution

• Investigate and resolve operational issues related to order fulfillment, inventory discrepancies, and system transactions.

• Troubleshoot SAP and warehouse management system transactions to identify root causes of operational disruptions.

• Support accurate execution of transfer orders, shipments, and instrument movements.

• Monitor operational workflows and escalate issues as needed to maintain service levels.

Systems & Process Expertise

• Serve as an operational resource for SAP and warehouse management processes related to instrument operations.

• Identify recurring issues or process gaps and recommend improvements to strengthen operational efficiency.

• Support development and maintenance of work instructions, process documentation, and operational standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Supply Chain, Transportation, Quality, and Warehouse teams to resolve operational issues and improve workflow coordination.

• Support communication between operational teams and system stakeholders when troubleshooting issues or implementing process changes.

Continuous Improvement

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on workflow optimization, operational efficiency, and inventory accuracy.

• Support implementation and sustainment of CI tools such as 5S, root cause analysis, and standard work documentation.

• Identify opportunities to improve throughput, reduce operational friction, and strengthen process reliability.

Operational Reporting & Analysis

• Track and review operational performance indicators related to inventory integrity and order execution.

• Support analysis of operational data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field OR equivalent combination of education and relevant operations experience

• 3+ years of experience in supply chain, warehouse operations, distribution, or logistics

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP or warehouse management systems (WMS)

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to investigate operational issues and identify root causes

• Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in supply chain or distribution center operations

• Experience troubleshooting SAP transactions or warehouse management system processes

• Experience supporting operational investigations, inventory management, or order execution workflows

• Experience with continuous improvement tools such as Lean, root cause analysis, or 5S

• Strong organizational, documentat

jobs.title: Procurement Analyst (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be :

• Validate and process (fix & check) Purchase Requisitions to ensure completeness and in compliance with Procurement Policy. Convert Purchase Requisitions to Purchase Orders.

• Purchase Order amendment, close and cancellation. Manage and resolve internal queries. Participate in invoice reconciliation process.

• Work closely with Accounts Payable team to resolve any outstanding invoice reconciliation or mismatch. Execute and produce accurate and timely reports.

• Manage and execute the quote collections and multiple source biddings when applicable.Review and update SOP, DTP & LP timely. Ensure adherence to the Procurement Policy, Directive, Guidelines and Local Procurement policies.

• Actively participate in new project, such as ASPIRE/MyBuy and etc. Attend related meetings, trainings, knowledge transfer and etc.

Key skills and Experience:

• Degree or Diploma in Business Studies, Finance & Accounting/Commerce, Supply Chain or Procurement equivalent.

• Good communication skill and able to communicate effectively in English. Additional Chinese/Mandarin in speaking and writing is required.

• 3-5 years’ experience in a centralized purchasing environment and Supply Chain with production planning background.

• Experience of working in a shared service center across a global / large organization will be an added advantage.

• Good negotiation and analytical skills, resourceful in identifying new sources of items requested and results oriented.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
（高级）治疗领域专员
Therapeutic Area Specialist

主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

jobs.title: Manager/Senior Manager - Channel Data 渠道数据团队负责人

titleByLocale.en: Manager/Senior Manager - Channel Data 渠道数据团队负责人
titleByLocale.de: Manager/Senior Manager - Channel Data 渠道数据团队负责人
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire/Directeur principal - Données sur les canaux

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
全面统筹罗氏中国MCE渠道数据的治理与渠道折扣的体系化运作。在确保渠道数据（DDI）、与折扣管理的绝对准确、完整、及时与合规的基础上，以前瞻性的行业视野，引入自动化、智能化（AI）等先进的数据管理工具与系统，驱动业务流程的精益化重塑。引领渠道数据团队进行精益化、数智化的转型，实现团队效能的降本增效。同时通过精准的数据洞察赋能商业决策，打造行业领先的渠道数据管理生态标杆。

您将有机会：
1. 渠道数据治理

• 全面统筹渠道数据（包含但不限于 DDI 直连数据、流向数据、进销存数据、主数据等）的日常直连、收集、清洗、校验等工作。

• 建立并优化数据管理体系，确保数据的准确性、完整性与及时性，满足公司对业务决策与追踪、财务审计及合规风控的要求。

• 协同内外部资源，探索并建立药品追溯码数据管理机制等，作为 DDI 数据以外的前瞻性战略补充。
2. 渠道折扣管理

• 负责渠道折扣管理标准流程与运作机制的设计与维护，确保其严格符合内外部法律法规与合规审计要求。

• 主导折扣名单、协议、计算、核对、发放、对账等全链路流程管理，确保折扣执行结果的严谨准确以及公司资金安全。

• 联合策略、财务与业务部门，定期监控与分析折扣兑付情况，为商业政策与折扣政策的迭代提供数据支撑。
3. 数智化转型与效能跃升

• 敏锐识别现有数据处理与折扣执行流程中的痛点，主导并落地 RPA、AI 工具、管理系统与平台等项目，为团队增优提效。
4. 业务赋能与跨部门协同

• 从海量数据中提炼业务洞察，搭建直观的数据看板与报告，为业务管理与决策提供数据支持。

• 与跨职能团队组成敏捷工作矩阵，协同实现渠道生态体系多元化业务价值的效能支撑。

• 助力渠道运营“集中化”建设，推动运营团队内部跨职能轮岗，实现运营团队跨职能深度融合与打通。
5. 团队领导与人才孵化

• 建立梯队化的人才培养机制，鼓励团队成员多元化发展，激发团队创新思维，打造一支具备“敏捷迭代”能力与自驱基因的复合型高绩效团队。

期待您：
Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书

• 本科及以上学历，信息/计算机科学、财务、数据分析或商业管理类专业优先。

• 大学英语六级及以上，具备优秀的中英文书面与口头商务沟通能力。

Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力

• 行业经验：具有 8 年以上医药企业工作经验，其中至少 3 年以上渠道数据管理（DDI）、SFE、财务或商业运营管理经验。

• 专业技能：精通医药行业渠道数据管理与折扣管理模式。具备较强的数据敏感度与逻辑分析能力，熟悉 BI 工具（如 Tableau, PowerBI）、ERP 系统及主数据管理逻辑。有主导过 RPA、AI 工具引入或数据自动化系统落地经验者优先。

• 业务敏锐度：具备出色的商业敏锐度与全局观。能够穿透数据表面，深刻理解渠道策略、渠道运营、合规管控之间的内在联系，具备将海量复杂底层数据转化为高价值业务洞察并反哺业务决策与管理的能力。

• 领导力特质：具备“破局”意识，能够积极拥抱环境变化，敢于在不确定性中重塑和精益化现有流程，同时底线思维清晰，确保在变革过程中业务结果的绝对准确可靠。

• 卓越协同： 出色的跨部门沟通与谈判能力，擅长在错综复杂的相关（如策略、业务、财务、合规）之间拉齐共识，探寻复杂挑战的最优解并强力推进项目落地。

• 人才教练： 认可并善于激发团队成员的潜力，能够为下属设定清晰的发展目标、提供建设性反馈，并推行轮岗与技能拓宽，打造高绩效的自驱型敏捷组织。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 建立并优化数据管理体系，确保数据的准确性、完整性与及时性，满足公司对业务决策与追踪、财务审计及合规风控的要求。
• 协同内外部资源，探索并建立药品追溯码数据管理机制等，作为 DDI 数据以外的前瞻性战略补充。 2. 渠道折扣管理
• 负责渠道折扣管理标准流程与运作机制的设计与维护，确保其严格符合内外部法律法规与合规审计要求。
• 主导折扣名单、协议、计算、核对、发放、对账等全链路流程管理，确保折扣执行结果的严谨准确以及公司资金安全。
• 联合策略、财务与业务部门，定期监控与分析折扣兑付情况，为商业政策与折扣政策的迭代提供数据支撑。 3. 数智化转型与效能跃升
• 敏锐识别现有数据处理与折扣执行流程中的痛点，主导并落地 RPA、AI 工具、管理系统与平台等项目，为团队增优提效。 4. 业务赋能与跨部门协同
• 从海量数据中提炼业务洞察，搭建直观的数据看板与报告，为业务管理与决策提供数据支持。
• 与跨职能团队组成敏捷工作矩阵，协同实现渠道生态体系多元化业务价值的效能支撑。
• 助力渠道运营“集中化”建设，推动运营团队内部跨职能轮岗，实现运营团队跨职能深度融合与打通。 5. 团队领导与人才孵化
• 建立梯队化的人才培养机制，鼓励团队成员多元化发展，激发团队创新思维，打造一支具备“敏捷迭代”能力与自驱基因的复合型高绩效团队。 期待您： Education/Qualifications 教育程度 / 所获资格证书
• 本科及以上学历，信息/计算机科学、财务、数据分析或商业管理类专业优先。
• 大学英语六级及以上，具备优秀的中英文书面与口头商务沟通能力。 Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
• 行业经验：具有 8 年以上医药企业工作经验，其中至少 3 年以上渠道数据管理（DDI）、SFE、财务或商业运营管理经验。
• 专业技能：精通医药行业渠道数据管理与折扣管理模式。具备较强的数据敏感度与逻辑分析能力，熟悉 BI 工具（如 Tableau, PowerBI）、ERP 系统及主数据管理逻辑。有主导过 RPA、AI 工具引入或数据自动化系统落地经验者优先。
• 业务敏锐度：具备出色的商业敏锐度与全局观。能够穿透数据表面，深刻理解渠道策略、渠道运营、合规管控之间的内在联系，具备将海量复杂底层数据转化为高价值业务洞察并反哺业务决策与管理的能力。
• 领导力特质：具备“破局”意识，能够积极拥抱环境变化，敢于在不确定性中重塑和精益化现有流程，同时底线思维清晰，确保在变革过程中业务结果的绝对准确可靠。
• 卓越协同： 出色的跨部门沟通与谈判能力，擅长在错综复杂的相关（如策略、业务、财务、合规）之间拉齐共识，探寻复杂挑战的最优解并强力推进项目落地。
• 人才教练： 认可并善于激发团队成员的潜力，能够为下属设定清晰的发展目标、提供建设性反馈，并推行轮岗与技能拓宽，打造高绩效的自驱型敏捷组织。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 主要工作目标
• 治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责
• 规范诊疗
• 1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
• 学科建设
• 1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范
• 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

能力与经验
• 岗位所需胜任力
• ● 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• ● 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• ● 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• ● 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
• 教育程度/所获资格证书
• ● 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
• ● 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

jobs.title: (高级)专员 - 生产支持/(Sr.) Specialist - Manufacturing

titleByLocale.en: (高级)专员 - 生产支持/(Sr.) Specialist - Manufacturing

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, CHT, SHT etc. to contribute to project delivery.

• Support the initial development and optimization of logistic processes.

• Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, e.g. draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.

• Trained and qualified on equipment operation and procedure.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:

• Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.

• Performing the following tasks: e.g. facility cleaning, cleanroom garments preparation, cleaning and sterilization of components.

• Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.

• Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.

• Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.

• Support regular validation activities, such as autoclave requalification.

• Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.

• Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.

Qualification and Experience
Education/Qualifications

• College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies

• 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.

• Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.

• Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.

• Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement GMP-related systems, processes, and workflows for the production department.
● Develop and implement GMP training programs tailored to production staff, aligned with corporate quality policies and regulatory requirements.
● Establish the deviation management and CAPA processes in manufacturing for handling non- conformances effectively and ensuring timely resolutions.
● Implement a robust change control process, ensuring GMP compliance and proper documentation of changes in the production environment.
● Participate in the preparation for facility qualification audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all systems and practices meet GMP standards.
● Lead consumable materials/service introduction and track the status to ensure to meet the manufacturing requirement.
● Support the development of GMP documentation including SOPs, validation protocols, and project-specific documentation for compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Serve as the primary interface between the production department and QA/Compliance teams for GMP-related matters.
● Manage ongoing GMP training programs, ensuring production personnel are regularly updated on GMP and compliance requirements.
● Oversee the timely identification, investigation, and resolution of deviations, ensuring proper execution of CAPAs to avoid recurrence.
● Evaluate and coordinate changes within the production department, ensuring proper implementation and documentation in line with regulatory requirements.
● Act as the production department’s primary liaison during internal and external audits, ensuring inspection readiness and addressing observations.
● Monitor GMP compliance in daily operations, identifying gaps and implementing corrective actions.
● Proactively identify areas for improvement in GMP operations, driving initiatives to enhance quality and productivity while maintaining compliance.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Education/
• Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in GMP compliance roles in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of facility including design, commissioning & qualification is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Hands-on experience in deviation handling, CAPA management, change control, and audit preparation is required.
● Familiarity with compliance tools and systems for managing training, deviations, and CAPAs.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

jobs.title: （Senior) Specialist - Filling/分装(高级)专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Maintenance Specialist (1st Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Doing now what patients need next. A pioneer in the development of blood glucose monitoring and insulin delivery systems, Roche Diabetes Care is committed to helping people with diabetes live lives that are as normal and active as possible and helping healthcare professionals manage their patients' condition in an optimal way. The ACCU-CHEK® portfolio-from blood glucose monitoring through information management to insulin delivery - offers innovative products, services and comprehensive solutions for convenient, efficient and effective diabetes management.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Maintenance Specialist , you will perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning electro-mechanical equipment used in the manufacturing process. You will dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches or drawings. You’ll use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts. You will rebuild manufacturing equipment as required. You will also perform equipment modifications as directed by manufacturing engineers. You may use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.

The Maintenance Specialist position will entail specialized knowledge of a particular area, system, or equipment and requires specific training and certification. You will apply some advanced skill to the position or specialization. You may adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Your duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks. You will resolve most questions and problems and refer only the most complex issues to higher levels. You will apply basic skills and may develop advanced skills appropriate for the position. Your duties and tasks are standardized. You will work under direct supervision and follow standard procedures to accomplish tasks.

You will also be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

The opportunity :

• Performs troubleshooting to determine problems and may be required to do corrective maintenance. Completes preventative maintenance task according to detailed procedures and schedules. May provide emergency call-in support for operations that run during off-hours. Maintain accurate records of all activities.

• Provides technical set-up support for manufacturing areas.

• Performs equipment modifications, including installation, validation support and start-up, of new equipment as well as decommissioning activities.

Who you are:
Minimum Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalency

• 4 years related operations or manufacturing experience

• In-depth knowledge of company policies a

jobs.title: Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to be at the forefront of patient safety and shape how critical data enters a global healthcare leader?

As a Safety Data Acquisition & Partnering Specialist , you will join our Patient Safety Operations team to build and secure the vital "Front-End" pillar of our safety data network. In this role, you will support strategic partnerships and ensure compliance, directly impacting our ability to deliver safe, life-changing innovations to patients worldwide. We strive for operational excellence as we deliver and oversee implementation activities of Safety agreements and monitor compliance.

This position offers you a unique opportunity to grow your expertise across two key operational areas: Data Acquisition implementation or Safety Agreement management. Working within a dynamic, cross-functional matrix environment, you will solve moderately complex operational challenges, collaborate with international stakeholders, and directly contribute to the smooth delivery of our global Patient Safety strategy.

• Manage safety agreements: Support global business process owners in developing, maintaining, and overseeing compliance for safety agreement templates.

• Monitor business performance: Provide expertise to develop and implement metrics, KPIs, and performance measures to track incoming data trends.

• Support mergers & acquisitions: Facilitate the efficient, compliant transfer of safety data and documentation during product and company acquisitions.

• Collaborate with suppliers: Proactively partner with internal and external suppliers, providing pharmacovigilance (PV) guidance to ensure absolute alignment.

• Implement data collection: Support the scoping of new data sources and implement innovative methods to collect safety data within an evolving strategy.

• Ensure audit readiness: Perform quality assurance activities related to safety agreement implementation to support inspections and audits.

• Drive operational excellence: Apply Roche ways of working to daily tasks, collaborate with matrix teams, and support the Quality Management System.

Who You Are

You are an analytical, relationship-oriented professional who thrives in a process-focused environment and loves solving complex puzzles. You are looking for a place where you can expand your expertise, take ownership of meaningful tasks, and collaborate with diverse global teams in an inclusive and supportive environment.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Relevant industry experience: Around 3 years of experience within a pharmacovigilance system, exposure to safety agreements management with degree- level qualification

• Regulatory & PV knowledge: A solid understanding of the drug development process, PV systems, and GVP/GCP regulations, experience in PV Agreements and/or Safety Data Exchange Agreements.

• Strong communication & influencing skills: Well-developed interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across all levels without direct authority.

• Matrix collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within global, cross-functional, or virtual team structures.

• Problem-solving mindset: Creative problem-solving abilities combined with excellent conflict resolution skills.

• Flexibility for travel: The ability and willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10%).

Location: This position is based in Budapest . Relocation Assistance is not available.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Principal Commercial Training Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary
According to RDSL business and people strategies, partner with business stakeholders, perform comprehensive analysis of business knowledge and capabilities gaps. Provide the commercial training consultancy, design and develop an effective and consistent commercial training system and content, implement the learning plan effectively to ensure the good learning experience. Continue to evolve the commercial training system to ensure fit-for-future organizational needs.

Main Tasks & 
• Responsibilities
1. Develop and implement annual training plan of entire business to facilitate meeting organizational goals and individual professional needs.
2. Collect, evaluate, and identify training requirements of entire business with internal and external resources including global partners to develop, review and improve training programs, including customized programs, design and implement training strategies and solutions
3. Develop and organize training materials including manuals, slides, and other materials， deploy the online and offline trainings in bilingual language (English and Mandarin)
4. Develop measurement mechanism， evaluate and follow up of training effectiveness, report the feedbacks to the business.
5. Support training program effective communication plan to enhance the business engagement
6. Create and manage training budget to maximum return on investment
7. Other projects or tasks assigned by line manager

Education& 
• Qualifications:
1. Bachelor Degree in Clinical Laboratory, Medical or business related major
2. Ability in facilitation and consultation, training organization and strong in communication skills
3. Good command of MS office software application
4. Training expertise is desired, healthcare industry background is a plus

Experience:
1. At least 5 years similar experience in the relevant function
2. Experience in project management with strong business acumen
3. Experience in cross function collaboration and result driven for business impact.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a pro-active, passionate and talented Strategic Talent Acquisition Intern colleague for our Corporate People & Culture Team. As a Talent Acquisition Intern you will be responsible for supporting the daily work of the Talent Acquisition Partner and the People & Culture Business Partners in the recruitment process for open roles.
Throughout the course of your internship here at Roche Services and Solutions (RSS), you will be able to gain suitable experience and skills in order to lead the recruitment process of certain positions end-to-end. In this position you will focus on:

• Using social media platforms (such as Linkedin Recruiter), professional networking sites/platforms/databases (like Profession.hu, Phenom People) to source and identify potential candidates

• Conducting phone screenings , checking the candidates' professional background, motivation and language knowledge via telephone interview

• Organizing and partaking in online and face-to-face interviews

• Supporting the candidates' hiring journey comprehensively from start to finish

• Ensuring accurate administration of the whole recruitment process

• Creating compelling and accurate job advertisements that will play a pivotal role in attracting top talent

Who you are ​

• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University/college

• ​You are available at least 25- 30 hour s per week

• ​​You have a good command of English, Hungarian and you have outstanding communication skills, German is a plus

• ​You have a customer oriented mind-set and you are creative, enthusiastic, proactive and​ open to taking over new tasks

• You have the passion to find people careers rather than simply jobs

In exchange we provide you with:

• Valuable professional experience

• Competitive salary

• Flexible working hours according to your studies

• Support for university thesis writing

• Training, mentoring and development opportunities

• Great, people-focused company culture

• Home-office opportunity (4-days/week)

• Young and dynamic environment

• Social events & team-building opportunities

• Opportunity for full time role within the Roche organization after graduation

Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process: https://go.roche.com/budapest-data-privacy-notice-candidate

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

Routine Operation :

Perform the physical and chemical testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

Assist Head of Analytical Testing lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance. Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely to, internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.

By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of bioanalytical materials and cell supplies

Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification

Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness :

Analytical method transfer execution: Support and execute the analytical method transfer for the aseptic product.

Analytical Method Validation and Qualification: Execute the methods comparison, qualification and validation activities.

Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience

Education/Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies

• 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on bioanalytical and bioassay testing. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
