jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
"Synthetic Molecules Technical Development" (PTDC) bringt eine breite Palette von Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP) und Analytical Sciences mit und arbeitet eng mit wichtigen Partnern in den Bereichen Forschung und frühe Entwicklung zusammen (pRED / gRED), kommerzielle Herstellung kleinmolekularer Wirkstoffe (PTC) und globale technische Entwicklung (PTD). PTDC ist verantwortlich für die späte technische Entwicklung unserer Pipeline für kleine Moleküle und die Herstellung von DS und DP für klinische Studien.

Die Gelegenheit
In PTDC transformieren die Small Molecules Teams synthetische Moleküle in Medikamente. Wir entwickeln robuste, kosteneffiziente Herstellungsprozesse, liefern klinische Ware und schaffen Wissen durch Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in einem kollaborativen Umfeld.
Innerhalb der Abteilung Chemische Verfahrensentwicklung tragen die Pilotierungs- und Produktionsbetriebe von Scale-up & Supply (PTDC-S) wesentlich dazu bei, dass die Verfahren zur Herstellung neuer Pharmawirkstoffe für grosstechnische Anwendungen robust und optimal entwickelt werden, um so die benötigten Mengen Wirksubstanz in der geforderten Qualität termingerecht für die klinischen und toxischen Studien herzustellen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören:

• Durchführung von chemischen Reaktionen und physikalischen Einheitsoperationen auf Mehrzweckproduktionsanlagen im Dreischichtbetrieb

• Vorbereitung und Reinigung der Mehrzweckanlagen

• Mithilfe bei Umbauten und Reparaturen der Anlagen

• Dokumentation der Arbeiten und Einhalten der guten Herstellpraxis (GMP-Richtlinien)

• Umsetzen und vollständiges Einhalten der relevanten Roche Policies, Verfahren und Standards in den Bereichen Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umweltschutz

• Flexibles und selbstständiges Arbeiten

Wer Sie sind:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Chemie und Pharmatechnologen (m/w/d)

• Selbstständige und exakte Arbeitsweise und gute GMP-Kenntnisse

• Interesse an neuen Technologien und Erfahrung in der Bedienung von modernen Anlagen mit speicherprogrammierbarer Steuerung

• Gute MS Office Kenntnisse

• Dynamischer und initiativer Arbeitsstil und Teamgeist

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblem Arbeitseinsatz

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch ist von Vorteil

Diese Stelle ist befristet auf 2 Jahre.

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione "Synthetic Molecules Technical Development" (PTDC) offre una vasta gamma di esperienze in Drug Substance (DS), Drug Product (DP) e scienze analitiche, lavorando a stretto contatto con i partner chiave nella ricerca e sviluppo precoce (pRED/gRED), produzione commerciale di piccoli ingredienti attivi molecola (PTC) e ingegneria globale (PTD). PTDC è responsabile dello sviluppo di ingegneria tardiva della nostra piccola molecola pipeline e della produzione di DS e DP per gli studi clinici. In PTDC, i team di Small Molecules stanno trasformando le molecole sintetiche in farmaci. Sviluppiamo processi produttivi robusti e convenienti, forniamo prodotti clinici e creiamo conoscenze attraverso innovazione e miglioramento continuo in un ambiente collaborativo. All'interno del reparto Sviluppo Processo Chimico, le aziende pilota e produttive di Scale-up & Supply (PTDC-S) contribuiscono in modo significativo allo sviluppo robusto e ottimale dei processi per la produzione di nuovi principi attivi farmaceutici per applicazioni industriali su larga scala al fine di produrre le quantità richieste di sostanza attiva nella qualità richiesta in tempo per gli studi clinici e tossici.
• Performare le reazioni chimiche e le operazioni di unità fisica su impianti di produzione multifunzionali in tre operazioni a turni
• Preparazione e pulizia di impianti multifunzionali
• Assistenza alle conversioni e riparazioni di impianti
• Documentazione del lavoro e conformità con le Buone pratiche di fabbricazione (Linee guida GMP)
• Attuazione e piena conformità con le pertinenti politiche, procedure e standard Roche nei settori della sicurezza, della salute e della protezione ambientale
• Lavoro flessibile e indipendente Questa posizione è limitata a 2 anni. Applicare ora e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all'avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Dans le PTDC, les équipes de petites molécules transforment des molécules synthétiques en médicaments. Nous développons des procédés de fabrication robustes et rentables, fournissons des produits cliniques et créons des connaissances grâce à l'innovation et à l'amélioration continue dans un environnement collaboratif. Au sein du département Développement des procédés chimiques, les sociétés pilotes et de production de Scale-up & Supply (PTDC-S) contribuent de façon significative au développement robuste et optimal des procédés de production de nouveaux ingrédients actifs pharmaceutiques pour les applications industrielles à grande échelle afin de produire les quantités requises de substance active dans la qualité requise à temps pour les études cliniques et toxiques.
• Préparation et nettoyage d'installations polyvalentes
• Aide à la conversion et à la réparation d'installations
• Documentation du travail et conformité avec les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (lignes directrices sur les BPF)
• Mise en œuvre et respect intégral des politiques, procédures et normes Roche pertinentes dans les domaines de la sécurité, de la santé et de la protection de l'environnement
• Travail flexible et indépendant Formation complète en tant que spécialiste de la chimie et de la pharmacotechnologie (m/f/d)
• Méthode de travail indépendante et exacte et bonne connaissance des BPF
• Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'expérience dans le fonctionnement de systèmes modernes avec contrôle logique programmable
• Bonne connaissance de MS Office
• Style de travail dynamique et d'initiative et esprit d'équipe
• Volonté de travailler avec souplesse
• Connaissance fluide de l'allemand et de l'anglais est bénéfique Ce poste est limité à deux ans. Postuler maintenant et faire partie de notre équipe pour façonner le futur ensemble! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés du monde entier se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant ainsi à tous l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Sachsen, Thüringen, Nordbayern eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Jena , Nürnberg, Dresden, Würzburg ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktikumsumfeld mit

jobs.title: P&C Business Partner (Advisory) - German speaking
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
What we do:
The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas.

The Opportunity:
As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization.
Your day to day responsibilities are:

• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.

• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.

• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.

• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application.

​
Who You Are:

• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.

• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.

• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.

• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.

• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.

• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.

• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures.

In Exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Unsere QC Mikrobiologie, bestehend aus 7 Mitarbeitenden, ist ein wichtiger Pfeiler in der Freigabe unserer diagnostischen Einsatzstoffe. Wir freuen uns auf ein hilfsbereites und flexibles neues Teammitglied, das Spaß an der täglichen Arbeit hat und eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre unterstützt.
Wir möchten dir als Praktikant:in einen umfassenden Einblick in das „Daily Business“ der Qualitätskontrolle geben und dir zusätzlich die Möglichkeit bieten, dich aktiv in der Optimierung unserer Arbeitsabläufe einzubringen. Du erhältst spannende Einblicke in ein GMP-reguliertes Umfeld und lernst, wie man Qualität und Effizienz vereint.

Deine Aufgaben
Das Praktikum bietet dir eine spannende Mischung aus mikrobiologischer Analytik und der Mitarbeit an zukunftsgerichteten Projekten im Bereich Operational Excellence (OpEx):

1. Qualitätskontrolle & strategische Laborprojekte

• Routine & GMP: Du unterstützt bei der mikrobiologischen Analytik (z. B. Keimzahl- oder Endotoxinbestimmung) für die Freigabe diagnostischer Einsatzstoffe und sammelst wertvolle Praxis-Erfahrung im GMP-regulierten Umfeld.

• Nachhaltigkeit & Portfolio-Pflege: Du begleitest uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Methoden-Portfolios. Dabei unterstützt du beispielsweise bei der Evaluierung nachhaltiger Alternativen oder bei der Vorbereitung auf neue digitale Labor-Systeme.

2. Operational Excellence (OpEx)

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du hilfst uns dabei, etablierte Laborabläufe weiter zu optimieren und datenbasierte Potenziale für eine noch effizientere Arbeitsweise zu identifizieren.

• Lean-Kultur & Kommunikation: Du unterstützt dabei, Prozessdaten in anschauliche Erfolgsgeschichten zu übersetzen. Durch die kreative Gestaltung von internen News-Formaten (z. B. Interviews, digitale Beiträge) trägst du aktiv zu unserer Lean-Kultur bei.

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium immatrikuliert (B.Sc. / M.Sc. Biologie, Mikrobiologie, Biochemie o.ä.) oder befindest dich in deinem Gap-Year.

• Du bringst bereits allgemeine praktische Laborerfahrung mit. Spezifische Grundkenntnisse in der Mikrobiologie sind dabei ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.

• Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Denkweise mit und hast Freude daran, Prozesse stetig zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern.

• Eine Affinität zu digitaler Kommunikation und die Kompetenz, Inhalte kreativ und ansprechend aufzubereiten, runden dein Profil ab.

• Erste Berührungspunkte mit Lean Management oder Operational Excellence sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss – am wichtigsten sind uns deine Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Motivation!

• Du bist fließend in Deutsch (Wort und Schrift) und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in oncology and hematology therapeutic areas as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in oncology/hematology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of oncology/hematology

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD in oncology/hematology, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice in oncology/hematology

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience in oncology/hematology

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research You have a very good understanding of oncology/hematology global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 b

In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La posizione Nel Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) China Early Development (ED) di Roche, svolgiamo un ruolo fondamentale nell'accelerare lo sviluppo precoce globale di farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti, al fine di affrontare alcune delle esigenze sanitarie insoddisfatte più difficili del mondo. Siamo un partner strategico dei team globali di sviluppo iniziale di Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED) e pharma Product Development (PD) per integrare la Cina nei programmi globali di sviluppo iniziale. Insieme, portiamo avanti in tempi rapidi innovazioni straordinarie che cambiano la vita. Questa posizione si trova nella funzione di scienza clinica di Roche Product Development China, sede del China ED CoE. Questa posizione è dedicata alla guida e alla guida di programmi di sviluppo iniziale nelle aree terapeutiche di oncologia ed ematologia come responsabile clinico. L'opportunità Questo ruolo avrà l'opportunità di definire la strategia globale di sviluppo precoce e il CDP, di guidare la progettazione innovativa di sperimentazioni di sviluppo precoce, di avere un impatto significativo sull'efficienza e il successo dei nostri programmi di sviluppo precoce in oncologia/ematologia e di contribuire all'ecosistema di innovazione dello sviluppo di farmaci in Cina. Nel tuo ruolo:
• Contribuirai e influenzerai la strategia asset globale e il CDP di sviluppo iniziale come membro dei team asset globali
• Identificherai in modo proattivo opportunità di accelerazione e ottimizzazione del CDP globale per ED sfruttando competenza, esperienza, velocità e scala in Cina
• Guidarai il team interfunzionale cinese per valutare le opportunità della Cina di aderire ai programmi globali per ED o ai primi studi clinici in Cina da prospettive strategiche, scientifiche, normative e operative
• Guidare la progettazione di studi innovativi e la conduzione di studi in stretta collaborazione con esperti funzionali globali di sviluppo iniziale sui primi studi clinici in Cina
• Essere il Medical Monitor per gli studi clinici ED in Cina
• Coinvolgere scientificamente i TAE cinesi e le parti interessate interne ed esterne di Roche
• Servire come punto di contatto scientifico per i team globali di sviluppo iniziale di oncologia/ematologia
• Fare da mentore ai direttori medici junior per sviluppare ulteriormente le capacità e le capacità del CoE ED Chi sei
• Possiedi un MD in oncologia/ematologia o una laurea/master in Medicina Clinica con almeno 3 anni di pratica clinica post-laurea in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza nel settore biofarmaceutico e una vasta esperienza di sviluppo iniziale in oncologia/ematologia
• Hai esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di CDP di sviluppo iniziale, progettazione e conduzione di studi clinici di sviluppo iniziale, interazione con le autorità sanitarie, collaborazione con ricercatori e ricerca clinica Hai un'ottima conoscenza delle linee guida e dei regolamenti di sviluppo globale di oncologia/ematologia, inclusi CDE, FDA ed EMEA
• Sei un comunicatore efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese scritto e verbale, con la capacità di presentare concetti complessi a team interfunzionali globali, comitati di governance e le principali parti interessate in modo logico e conciso

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Position
In Roche’s China Early Development (ED) Center of Excellence (CoE), we play a critical role in accelerating the global early development of transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. We are a strategic partner to global early development teams of Roche Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED), Genentech Research and Early Development (gRED), and pharma Product Development (PD) to integrate China into the global early development programs. Together, we bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This position is located in the clinical science function of Roche Product Development China, home of the China ED CoE. This position is dedicated to leading and driving early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology as a clinical lead.

The Opportunity
This role will have the opportunity to shape global early development strategy and CDP, to drive innovative early development trial design, to make significant impacts to the efficiency and success of our early development programs in therapeutic areas of immunology, neurology, CVRM, and ophthalmology, and contribute to the China drug development innovation ecosystem.
In your role, you will:

• Contribute to and influence global asset strategy and early development CDP as a member of the global asset teams

• Proactively identify opportunities of accelerating and optimizing global ED CDP leveraging expertise, experience, speed, and scale in China

• Lead the China cross-functional team to evaluate opportunities of China joining global ED programs or China-first trials from strategic, scientific, regulatory, and operational perspectives

• Drive innovative trial design and trial conduct in close partnership with global early development functional experts on China-first clinical trials

• Being the Medical Monitor for China ED clinical trials

• Scientifically engage China TAEs, Roche internal and external stakeholders

• Serve as a scientific point of contact to global early development asset teams of non-oncology therapeutic areas (immunology, neurology, CVRM, ophthalmology)

• Mentor junior medical directors to further build capability and capacity of ED CoE

Who you are

• You hold a MD, or a Bachelor/Master of Clinical Medicine with at least 3 years of post-graduation clinical practice; clinical expertise in immunology preferred

• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in biopharmaceutical industry and extensive early development experience, early development experience in immunology preferred

• You have hands-on experience in developing early development CDP, designing and running early development clinical trials, interacting with Health Authorities, collaborating with investigators and clinical research sites, and interpreting early development clinical trial data

• You have a very good understanding of global development guidelines and regulations, including CDE, FDA and EMEA

• You are an effective communicator: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts to global cross functional teams, governance committees and key stakeholders in a logical and succinct manner

• You are a great team player; highly collaborative, good interpersonal and influencing skills, can influence without authority

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the glob

jobs.title: Solution Architect - DIA R&D
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Solution Architect - DIA R&D

The Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a specific solution context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions. You will develop and maintain the product's technology roadmap, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a specific solution context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes.

Technical Skills

• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions and interfaces.

• Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions.

• Strong capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for the solution, including conducting vendor assessments.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain difficult or sensitive information and successfully build consensus.

• Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improve existing solutions, and manage technical deb

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. The Position Solution Architect - DIA R&D The Solution Architect si concentra sulla progettazione di soluzioni business-driven, standard-based e future-ready in un contesto di soluzione specifico. In questo ruolo, si progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali, mentre la gestione di requisiti non funzionali (NFR) e funzioni di fitness. Si svilupperà e manterrà la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto, fornire supervisione tecnica ai team di prodotto, e valutare nuove tecnologie per migliorare continuamente le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il debito tecnico. Opportunità:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): progetta soluzioni che soddisfano i requisiti di prodotto, le priorità aziendali e gli standard aziendali all'interno di uno specifico Context Solution. Gestisce i requisiti non operativi (NFR) e le funzioni di fitness. Documenti ed evolve l'architettura in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto e si allinea con la comunità di architettura per la governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Sostegni problemi complessi prendendo una nuova prospettiva sulle soluzioni esistenti ed esercitando un giudizio basato sull'analisi di più fonti di informazione. Mantiene la visione, la roadmap e il paesaggio attuale per la soluzione. Assesse e consultazioni sugli impatti e le dipendenze delle iniziative sulle capacità, sui rischi e sul paesaggio delle applicazioni. Crea modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e ontologie per la soluzione e le sue interfacce. Definisce e guida architetture di riferimento, modelli, e assicura che l'Architettura Decision Records (ADRs) sono adeguatamente registrati.
• Stakeholder Management: Spiega informazioni difficili o sensibili in modo chiaro e attivo lavora per costruire il consenso tra gli stakeholder. Guida la condivisione e lo scambio di informazioni sulla soluzione.
• Impatto/Strategia: sviluppa e mantiene la roadmap tecnologica del prodotto. Fornisce la supervisione tecnica, la guida e la consultazione su tecnologie specifiche per i team di prodotti. Migliora le soluzioni esistenti, gestisce il debito tecnico e le ricerche, valuta, pilota e guida l'adozione di nuove tecnologie. Identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): funziona principalmente all'interno di un contesto di soluzione definito.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: si basa sulla conoscenza generale e approfondita in una o due aree tecnologiche. Contribuisce in modo minimo ma efficace allo sviluppo e alla mentoring di Architecture Practices. Chi sei: Istruzione / Esperienza
• Esperienza dimostrata che progetta soluzioni business-driven, basate su standard, future-ready all'interno di uno specifico contesto di soluzione.
• Esperienza nel mantenimento della visione, della roadmap e dell'attuale paesaggio per soluzioni tecniche, e valutazione degli impatti delle iniziative sui paesaggi di rischio e di applicazione. Competenze tecniche
• Conoscenza generale e approfondita in una o due aree tecnologiche.
• Proficienza nella creazione di modelli di dati concettuali e logici, tassonomie e ontologie per soluzioni e interfacce.
• Capacità di definire e guidare architetture di riferimento, modelli, NFR e funzioni di fitness.
• Forte capacità di guidare le tendenze della tecnologia esterna e valutare la fattibilità per la soluzione, tra cui condurre valutazioni dei fornitori. Ulteriori qualifiche
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di spiegare informazioni difficili o sensibili e costruire con successo il consenso.
• Proattiva mentalità per identificare le opportunità per migliorare il valore e i processi aziendali, migliorare le soluzioni esistenti e gestire il deb tecnico

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. The Position Solution Architect - DIA R&D Der Solution Architect konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter und zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext. In dieser Rolle entwerfen Sie Lösungen, die den Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards entsprechen und gleichzeitig nicht funktionale Anforderungen (NFRs) und Fitnessfunktionen verwalten. Sie entwickeln und pflegen die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts, bieten den Produktteams technische Aufsicht und bewerten neue Technologien, um bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und technische Schulden zu verwalten. The Opportunity:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Entwirft Lösungen, die Produktanforderungen, Geschäftsprioritäten und Unternehmensstandards in einem bestimmten Lösungskontext erfüllen. Verwaltet nichtfunktionale Anforderungen (NFR) und Fitnessfunktionen. Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an der Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance aus.
• Rechenschaftspflicht / Problemlösung: Löst komplexe Probleme, indem Sie eine neue Perspektive auf bestehende Lösungen einnehmen und ein Urteil auf der Grundlage der Analyse mehrerer Informationsquellen fällen. Behält die Vision, Roadmap und aktuelle Landschaft für die Lösung bei. Beurteilt und berät über die Auswirkungen und Abhängigkeiten von Initiativen auf Fähigkeiten, Risiken und die Anwendungslandschaft. Erstellt konzeptionelle und logische Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für die Lösung und ihre Schnittstellen. Definiert und steuert Referenzarchitekturen, Muster und stellt sicher, dass Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) angemessen aufgezeichnet werden. Stakeholder Management: Erklärt schwierige oder sensible Informationen klar und arbeitet aktiv daran, einen Konsens zwischen den Stakeholdern zu schaffen. Fördert den Informationsaustausch und Austausch über die Lösung.
• Impact/Strategie: Entwickelt und pflegt die Technologie-Roadmap des Produkts. Bietet technische Aufsicht, Anleitung und Beratung zu spezifischen Technologien für Produktteams. Verbessert bestehende Lösungen, verwaltet technische Schulden und erforscht, bewertet, pilotiert und treibt die Einführung neuer Technologien voran. Identifiziert Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert- und Geschäftsprozessen.
• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert hauptsächlich in einem definierten Lösungskontext.
• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Wendet allgemeines und fundiertes Wissen in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen an. Trägt minimal, aber effektiv zur Entwicklung und Betreuung von Architekturpraktiken bei. Wer Sie sind: Bildung / Erfahrung
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Gestaltung unternehmensorientierter, standardbasierter, zukunftsfähiger Lösungen in einem spezifischen Lösungskontext.
• Erleben Sie, wie Sie die Vision, den Fahrplan und die aktuelle Landschaft für technische Lösungen beibehalten und die Auswirkungen von Initiativen auf Risiko- und Anwendungslandschaften bewerten. Technische Fähigkeiten
• Allgemeine und fundierte Kenntnisse in einem oder zwei Technologiebereichen.
• Kenntnisse in der Erstellung konzeptioneller und logischer Datenmodelle, Taxonomien und Ontologien für Lösungen und Schnittstellen.
• Fähigkeit, Referenzarchitekturen, Muster, NFRs und Fitnessfunktionen zu definieren und zu steuern.
• Starke Fähigkeit, externe Technologietrends voranzutreiben und die Machbarkeit der Lösung zu bewerten, einschließlich der Durchführung von Lieferantenbewertungen. Zusätzliche Qualifikationen
• Starke Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, schwierige oder sensible Informationen zu erklären und erfolgreich einen Konsens aufzubauen.
• Proaktive Denkweise, um Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung von Wert- und Geschäftsprozessen, zur Verbesserung bestehender Lösungen und zur Verwaltung technischer Deb zu identifizieren

Dans ce rôle, vous concevrez des solutions qui répondent aux exigences des produits, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise tout en gérant les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de fitness. Vous développerez et conserverez la feuille de route technologique du produit, fournirez une supervision technique aux équipes de produits et évaluerez les nouvelles technologies pour améliorer continuellement les solutions existantes et gérer la dette technique. • Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans un contexte de solution spécifique. Gérer les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les fonctions de conditionnement physique. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance.

Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la solution. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Définit et anime les architectures de référence, les modèles et veille à ce que les documents décisionnels d'architecture (ADR) soient dûment enregistrés.

• Impact/Stratégie: développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliore les solutions existantes, gère la dette technique et recherche, évalue, pilote et stimule l'adoption de nouvelles technologies. Indique les possibilités d'améliorer la valeur et les processus opérationnels.

• Capacités commerciales/techniques: Applique des connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques. Contribue de façon minime mais efficace au développement et au mentorat des pratiques d'architecture. Qui vous êtes : Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience du maintien de la vision, de la feuille de route et du paysage actuel pour des solutions techniques, et évaluation de l'impact des initiatives sur les paysages à risques et à applications. Compétences techniques
• Connaissances générales et approfondies dans un ou deux domaines technologiques.
• Compétence en création de modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, taxonomies et ontologies pour des solutions et des interfaces.
• Capacité à définir et à piloter des architectures de référence, des modèles, des NFR et des fonctions de fitness.
• Forte capacité d'orienter les tendances technologiques externes et d'évaluer la faisabilité de la solution, notamment en procédant à des évaluations des fournisseurs. Qualifications supplémentaires

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As an Account Executive - Molecular Diagnostics, you will:

• be responsible for promoting molecular diagnostic testing, including infectious disease, respiratory and transplantation.

• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role: The territory is Washington, DC.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience in diagnostics sales is strongly preferred

• Good oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting and problem solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Washignton is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan for the rol

titleByLocale.it: Senior Identity And Access Management Ingegnere - Cloud Environment
titleByLocale.en: Senior Identity And Access Management Engineer - Cloud Environment
titleByLocale.de: Senior Identity And Access Management Ingenieur - Cloud Environment
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Identity And Access Management Ingénieur - Cloud Environment

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Security and Cybersecurity Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and independent leader who drives the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems
By bridging deep business and technical understanding, you will manage end-to-end security analysis tasks across multiple products within a domain
You will shape stakeholder perspectives, champion accountability by taking on security incident lead or project owner roles, and foster continuous improvement in security operations and best practices

Description of the area
The Identity Management Support Team manages and operates the solutions and components used to provide customers with Directory and Identity Management Services using SailPoint. We are part of a global Roche Digital Technology group (RDT).

Job Responsibilities
In this role, you are mainly responsible for the multi-cloud Identity Management environment, focusing specifically on Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), while maintaining consistency with AWS. This includes the design of new solutions, consultancy, maintenance, performance, tactical lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies.

Scope

• Strong background in IAM concepts at design level and evolution in Cloud environments, Azure and/or GCP.

• Contributes to the design of new solutions based on SailPoint and PingFederate, AD, Privilege Access Management.

• Design and implement Centralized Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) based on Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) principles.

• Access Governance and Controls: Enforce strong security controls across cloud environments, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Identity Protection. Implement Least Privilege policies, often involving custom roles and organizational-level controls. Implement IAM Deny Policies to strictly block high-risk actions, ensuring separation of duties

• Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Drive the core value of "Automate as much as possible". Design and implement IAM infrastructure using IaC, leveraging Terraform. For Azure, this mandates IaC using Terraform and Azure Verified Modules (AVM) with CI/CD pipelines in GitLab

• Privileged Access Management (PAM): Design and support Just-in-Time (JIT) Access mechanisms, ensuring no standing privileges for administrators, using tools like Cyberark for Just-in-Time access

• Operational Excellence: Act as an expert in the release management activities, providing 2nd and 3rd level support for the Identity Management Infrastructure. Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management

• Actively focus on self-development in creating actionable plans to improve.

Stakeholder Management

• Consultancy and Collaboration: Act as a mentor and reference, working closely with stakeholders to provide the right level of consultancy. Ensure regular interactions with the Managed Service Provider

• Acts as a strategic influencer, defining and driving stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops, resolving conflicts, and proactively shaping stakeholder perspectives to align with project goals

Impact/Strategy

• Demonstrates strong and consistent performance across diverse products, with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster

• Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans that align with overall business objectives, and takes a proactive role in shaping team pro

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
El equipo de Enabling Team de Roche Farma Argentina busca incorporar un Access Head para liderar las estrategias comerciales y de acceso en la filial. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de guiar a un equipo multidisciplinario hacia modelos de salud innovadores, asegurando que nuestras soluciones lleguen a más pacientes de manera rápida y sostenible. Formarás parte de un entorno colaborativo y de alta confianza, actuando como un asesor clave enfocado en la acceso y el impacto a largo plazo.
Nuestras ambiciones para los pacientes a los que servimos son altas, trabajamos en base a resultados esperados y nos impulsamos en modelos de pago y/o reembolso innovadores, competitivos y basados en el valor.

La Oportunidad:

Estrategia de acceso: Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de acceso (precios, reembolso, HTA, acuerdos innovadores), alineada con los objetivos del negocio y las prioridades de salud pública.
Proporciona liderazgo al equipo comercial, así como a los procesos y estrategias en los mercados público y privado, integrando a todos los interesados internos y externos involucrados. Todo esto con una visión sistémica y analítica del negocio, evolucionando la política comercial siempre que sea necesario.
Liderazgo de equipo: Guiar, desarrollar y empoderar al equipo, asegurando una cultura de alto desempeño, colaboración transversal, cocreacion con actores externos e innovación constante.
Valor y evidencia: Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Medical y Estrategia para identificar las brechas de una estrategia conjunta y generen evidencia de vida real local necesarias y relevantes para el acceso (real world evidence, PROs, análisis farmacoeconómicos)
Liderar e impulsar el trabajo colaborativo con otras áreas de la compañía para asegurar que las estrategias de acceso incluyan la visión integral de todos los stakeholders necesarios.
Catalizar el desarrollo continuo de capacidades de acceso líderes en la industria y preparadas para el futuro en su área, con un mayor enfoque en el aprovechamiento de la analítica, la tecnología, la IA.
Permitir la priorización efectiva y la asignación de recursos en toda la organización al servicio de nuestros resultados a largo plazo.
Actuar como un asesor clave de confianza para el Enabling Team (ET) de Roche Argentina y brindar liderazgo y consulta en su área respectiva de experiencia.
Ser un líder de servicio para toda la filial y la red, actuando con coraje e integridad. Modelar el liderazgo VACC, creativo y un mindset de red, apoyando la transparencia en toda la organización.

Tu Perfil:

• Cuentas con un título universitario en Ciencias de la Salud, Ingenierías, Economía o carreras afines. Deseable Maestría en Salud Pública, Economía de la Salud, Políticas Públicas o MBA.

• Aportas experiencia de +5 años liderando estrategias de acceso al mercado o políticas sanitarias dentro de la industria farmacéutica o el sector salud .

• Demuestras trayectoria de 3 a 5 años en posiciones direcciones/regionales/globales

• Conocimientos específicos: HTA, economía de la salud, políticas públicas, pricing & reimbursement, manejo de stakeholders y regulaciones del sector salud.

• Posees un nivel de inglés bilingüe y fluido para interactuar eficazmente en entornos globales.

• Destacas por tu capacidad analítica y una mentalidad orientada a la creación de valor y al trabajo colaborativo transversal .

• Capacidad para movilizar equipos construyendo relaciones efectivas para promover el trabajo en equipo, la colaboración y el int

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen.

Dein neues Team:
Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten.
Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Deine strategische Rolle

• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.

• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.

• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.

• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.

• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.

• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.

• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.

• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.

• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.

• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner

• Du kommunizierst stark und klar auf Deutsch und

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位概述:
负责指定区域内客户管理以及达成业务指标

主要工作职责:

• 向客户（终端客户）推广及销售部门产品，及时解决产品出现的问题，完成或超过月度和年度指标

• 准确的月度和季度销售预测

• 配合维修工程师和应用技术专员进行仪器安装，进行仪器标示应用范围内的培训

• 更新客户资料，拜访重点客户，传递产品标示应用范围内的信息，并及时得到用户的反馈

• 与市场和应用技术支持协作以确保客户满意度

• 及时获取最新的市场和竞争信息

• 监督管理所辖区域内的销售和应用支持专员，包括但不限于：辅导，培训，指派工作，绩效评估，约束员

• 工，处理投诉，解决问题

基本任职资格 :

• 生命科学或相关领域硕士及以上学历

• 英语说写能力俱佳

• 熟练应用微软办公软件

• 产品和应用的专业知识

• 5年以上相关行业销售，应用支持，客户服务或培训等外企管理工作经验

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.de: Senior Safety, Health, and Environmental Spezialist
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Safety, Health, and Environmental Spécialiste

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche's Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) Department as a Senior SHE Specialist and make a meaningful impact on workplace safety and environmental stewardship. In this pivotal role, you'll identify and evaluate risks to employee safety and the environment while establishing robust controls to mitigate those hazards. Working collaboratively across the R&D department and throughout the business, you'll leverage detailed analysis, expert problem-solving skills, and extensive SHE expertise to protect our employees, our environment, and Roche's right to operate. Through strategic risk identification, comprehensive incident investigation and management, accident prevention, compliance management, and innovative program development, you'll help build and maintain a safe, compliant, and resilient workplace culture.

The Opportunity

As an expert leader with strong business acumen and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, you'll demonstrate mastery in executing and evaluating SHE risk assessments—including job hazard assessments, equipment safety evaluations, PPE assessments, and ergonomic risk assessments. Your proficiency in interpreting regulatory and technical documents, combined with your extensive knowledge of industrial environmental management and emergency response procedures, will be instrumental in driving compliance and protecting our workforce. With a background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology, along with your demonstrated expertise in biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, and chemical hygiene, you'll bring the technical depth needed to excel in our science-driven medical device R&D environment.

• Provide SHE business partner support for the R&D department of a dynamic medical diagnostic device company

• Lead or facilitate investigation of SHE incidents to identify root causes and implement corrective and preventative actions to reduce risk of recurrence

• Develop, review, and revise SHE programs through technical writing to ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations

• Manage action plans to ensure incident follow-up is complete, effective, and timely

• Prepare, coordinate, and conduct regular SHE-related meetings, inspections, and training sessions

• Maintain comprehensive SHE documentation, incident databases, injury and illness records, and required permits in accordance with compliance standards

• Develop metrics, summaries, and communications to provide accurate and timely reporting of SHE-related data and trend analysis

Who you are

• Bachelor's degree in occupational health and safety, engineering, or related technical field with minimum 8 years of dedicated professional SHE experience

• Extensive experience in highly regulated and science-driven industries (e.g., medical device, clinical diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or R&D environments) with demonstrated expertise in executing SHE risk assessments and emergency response procedures

• Demonstrated expertise in medical device R&D environments, including biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, chemical hygiene, and preferred background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology

• Proven ability to autonomously manage complex SHE projects, lead incident response and management, interpret regulatory and technical documents, and develop business-wide SHE programs in matrixed organizations

• Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with expert ability to manage complex workloads, deliver high-quality work with meticulous

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al Dipartimento Sicurezza, Salute e Ambientale di Roche (SHE) come Senior SHE Specialist e avere un impatto significativo sulla sicurezza sul posto di lavoro e sulla gestione ambientale. In questo ruolo fondamentale, identificherai e valuterai i rischi per la sicurezza dei dipendenti e per l'ambiente, stabilendo controlli robusti per mitigare tali rischi. Lavorando in collaborazione attraverso il reparto R&D e in tutto il mondo del business, potrete sfruttare analisi dettagliate, competenze di problem solving esperti e una vasta esperienza SHE per proteggere i nostri dipendenti, il nostro ambiente e il diritto di Roche di operare. Attraverso l'identificazione strategica del rischio, l'indagine completa degli incidenti e la gestione, la prevenzione degli incidenti, la gestione della conformità e lo sviluppo di programmi innovativi, vi aiuterà a costruire e mantenere una cultura di lavoro sicura, conforme e resiliente. L'opportunità In qualità di leader esperto con un forte acume aziendale e una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni, dimostrerai la padronanza nell'esecuzione e nella valutazione delle valutazioni dei rischi SHE, comprese le valutazioni dei rischi di lavoro, le valutazioni sulla sicurezza delle attrezzature, le valutazioni dei PPE e le valutazioni ergonomiche del rischio. La vostra competenza nell'interpretare documenti normativi e tecnici, unitamente alla vostra vasta conoscenza delle procedure di gestione ambientale industriale e di risposta alle emergenze, sarà determinante per la conformità alla guida e la protezione della nostra forza lavoro. Con uno sfondo in chimica, elettrochimica, o microbiologia, insieme con la vostra esperienza dimostrata in biosicurezza, patogeni e igiene chimica, porterete la profondità tecnica necessaria per eccellere nel nostro ambiente R&D dispositivo medico guidato dalla scienza.
• Fornire il supporto del partner commerciale SHE per il reparto R&D di una società di dispositivi diagnostici dinamici
• condurre o facilitare l'indagine di incidenti SHE per identificare le cause di root e implementare azioni correttive e preventive per ridurre il rischio di ricorrenza
• Sviluppare, rivedere e rivedere i programmi SHE relativi attraverso la scrittura tecnica per garantire la conformità dei dati federali, di stato e di regolamentazioni locali applicabili
• Gestire i piani di azione per garantire il follow-up degli incidenti è completo, efficace e comportamento tempestivo
• • Una vasta esperienza in settori altamente regolamentati e orientati alla scienza (ad esempio, dispositivi medici, diagnostica clinica, prodotti farmaceutici o ambienti R&D) con una comprovata competenza nell'esecure le valutazioni del rischio SHE e le procedure di risposta di emergenza
• Competenze dimostrate negli ambienti R&D del dispositivo medico, comprese le procedure di analisi del rischio SHE e di risposta di emergenza

• Demonstrated expertise in medical device R&D environments, including biosafety, bloodborne pathogens, chemical hygiene, and preferred background in chemistry, electrochemistry, or microbiology
• Proven ability to autonomously manage complex SHE projects, lead incident response and management, interpret regulatory and technical documents, and develop business-wide SHE programs in matrixed organizations
