Vous établirez la stratégie pour votre ministère et aurez l'entière responsabilité des RH pour vos employés. L'opportunité
• Vous serez chargé d'assurer un leadership et une gestion interfonctionnels afin de s'assurer que les lancements de produits respectent les délais, les budgets et les spécifications (tous les projets (y compris les projets PCQT).
• Vous veillerez à la planification et au respect des budgets, des échéanciers, des plans d'atténuation des risques et des ressources en coordination avec les intervenants en Finances, Gestion de projets, Opérations et R-D.
• Vous développerez des stratégies globales de développement de produits depuis l'initiation du projet jusqu'à la décision de lancement du marché. En particulier, vous élaborerez des options stratégiques fondées sur les principes du temps, des coûts et des risques, en tenant compte des exigences techniques, réglementaires, commerciales et opérationnelles.
• Vous communiquerez les risques liés à l'élaboration de solutions et à la mise en oeuvre de plans d'atténuation des risques.
• Vous dirigez, motivez et organisez l'équipe du projet (fondée sur les principes de leadership de Roche) pour définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de projet innovante et durable conforme aux objectifs et au budget du LCT.
• Vous démontrerez des compétences de leadership parmi vos collègues PL pour mener des discussions transversales sur les projets LCT et CA/BA, créer un environnement positif, encourager des idées créatives ou non conventionnelles et s'assurer qu'elles sont utilisées par l'équipe. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme en sciences, génie ou équivalent (MBA ou doctorat est un avantage).
• +8 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en gestion de projet et en leadership et idéalement plus de 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en diagnostic ou en pharmacologie dans le développement ou les opérations.
• Expérience en MDR et IVDR, références concernant les projets d'approbation de produits aux États-Unis (510k ou équivalent)
• Vous avez des compétences en leadership dans la gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires dans un environnement matriciel global : Ici, vous avez de l'expérience dans le développement et la constitution d'équipes et gérer le changement et la résolution de conflits.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience avec des projets (FDA) dans la gamme du portefeuille (planification et exécution des études pertinentes de la FDA, processus d'approbation de la FDA, ainsi que l'expérience dans l'interaction avec la FDA américaine)
• Vous communiquez clairement, présentez avec précision et orientées vers les parties prenantes devant de grands groupes

jobs.title: Government & External Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Government & External Affairs Lead
Team: Health System Shaping Lab
Reports to: General Manager

Roche Slovensko is seeking a Government & External Affairs Lead to join the Local Leadership Team (Purpose Enabling Board - PEB). This senior role is responsible for shaping national policy and creating patient access strategies.

The successful candidate will proactively drive changes in the national policy and legislative environment. You will lead strategies to influence key stakeholders, ensuring patient access to our innovations. This position requires strategic thinking, political knowledge, and an entrepreneurial approach to impact the Slovak healthcare system.

Key Responsibilities:

• Policy Advocacy: Lead targeted efforts to influence public health and pricing legislation to drive systemic improvements for patient access and innovation.

• Stakeholder Management: Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with political stakeholders, decision-makers, and payers at the national level.

• External Representation: Serve as the primary representative for OneRoche, building alliances with external organizations to enhance reputation and create value.

• Strategic Alignment: Manage the External Engagement Strategy, ensuring it supports Patient Access goals and integrates across Pharma, Diagnostics, and the wider Roche enterprise.

• Leadership: Participate in the Purpose Enabling Board (Affiliate Leadership Team), connecting the Health System Shaping group's goals to the affiliate strategy, and guiding the team.

Required Qualifications:

• Experience: Minimum 5 years in Government & External Affairs (policy/network development). Minimum 7 years of experience in the Slovak Health Care. Minimum 6 months in leadership roles.

• Expertise:
Deep understanding of healthcare funding and external conditions impacting the system. Proven ability in strategy development, execution, and navigating complex or uncertain situations (Triple Win concept).

• Mindset:

• Systemic & Enabling: Focus on leveraging networks for value creation and scaling.

• Entrepreneurial: Self-managed, comfortable with risk, committed to continuous learning.

• Ethical: High integrity and strong alignment with affiliate values.

• Skills:
Strategic Thinking (Enterprise Mindset), VACC Leadership, Influencing, Effective Decision Making (in ambiguity), Strategic Agility (managing long-term goals amid change).

• Education & Language:
Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Medicine, Law, Health Economics). Fluent in Slovak and proficient in English.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 64,900.00 EUR - 120,540.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

jobs.title: System Shaping Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Health System Shaping Lab as a System Shaping Partner . This pivotal role is your opportunity to drive large-scale, long-term national health system reform. Leverage your deep policy expertise and strategic agility to proactively influence legislation, align diverse stakeholders, and ensure sustainable access to cutting-edge healthcare for patients.

As the strategic analyst and implementation expert, you will report to the Government & External Affairs Lead. Your core mission is to shape a resilient market environment by addressing systemic healthcare challenges and championing policy changes that directly support our organization's strategic vision—both current and future.

Key Accountabilities

• Policy and Legislative Foresight: Conduct advanced Legislative Monitoring and Policy Analysis to deliver strategic intelligence, mitigate risks, and uncover opportunities for healthcare innovation.

• National Advocacy: Design and execute high-impact advocacy initiatives, including the development of compelling narratives, position papers, and white papers to advance our National Policy Shaping strategy.

• Stakeholder Ecosystem Collaboration: Build and maintain strategic partnerships with critical external stakeholders—policymakers, thought leaders, payers, and academic institutions—to build evidence and co-create solutions that generate mutual value for patient care and system efficiency.

• Integrated Strategy Execution: Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercialization Community to ensure a unified "OneRoche" approach in all external engagements and communications.

Candidate Profile
Education and Professional Experience

• Education: Master’s degree (required) in Business, Economy, Health Economics, Medicine, Pharmacy, or an equivalent academic background in Life Sciences.

• Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in Reimbursement, Market/Patient Access, or Health Policy, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of healthcare financing, reimbursement systems, and relevant compliance frameworks.

• Minimum 7 years of professional experience within the Health Care sector in Slovakia.

Required Mindset and Competencies

• Strategic Agility: Ability to maintain a clear focus on the long-term vision while effectively navigating ambiguity, complexity, and uncertainty.

• System Thinking: Capacity to think and operate at an enterprise level, looking beyond organizational boundaries to achieve optimal outcomes for the local health environment.

• Impactful Communication: Exceptional skill in articulating complex value propositions and translating external insights into actionable intelligence for internal teams.

• Agile Mindset: Enthusiastic adoption of agile, self-managed working models based on trust, continuous learning, and adaptability.

• VACC Leadership: Embodies the principles of Visionary, Architect, Coach, and Catalyst, driving change both externally and internally.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is 44,390.00 EUR - 82,450.00 EUR. Roche Slovakia provides 13th month Salary. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 25% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package .

Learn more

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Join an experienced and collaborative team of dedicated Global Medical Affairs Leaders in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) at Roche Diagnostics. Work with the Oncology Assays Lifecycle Team on the deployment and commercialization of Cervical Cancer Screening solutions. This is an unparalleled opportunity for career development and job satisfaction as you help improve healthcare around the globe.

Essential Functions of the role include the following:

• Provide subject matter expertise in cervical cancer screening as well as leadership in developing and executing global medical strategies for integrated evidence generation, collaborations, medical communications and engagements like advisory boards, scientific symposia and educational events.

• Drive evidence-based screening adoption and advocate for public health initiatives that support cervical cancer elimination strategy including adoption of HPV testing, self sampling and specialised dual stain cytology.

• Build strong partnerships with medical and patient communities including global thought leaders, academic networks and professional societies while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with industry regulations and HCP interaction guidelines.

• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within or outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.

• Partner across functions (including commercial, access and policy), regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.

​
Additional responsibilities include:

• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.

• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.

• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.

• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience.

Who you are:

You’re someone who wants to advance healthcare globally and influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a seasoned project engineer with a passion for driving innovation in complex infrastructure within a regulated, high-tech environment? At Roche, we are committed to pioneering solutions that advance global health, and we need a dedicated Project Engineer to lead vital capital infrastructure projects that bolster our facilities’ safety, efficiency, and compliance. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence Roche’s operational excellence by managing projects from inception to completion, ensuring they align with our strategic goals and contribute to sustainable growth.

In this dynamic role, you'll collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams—including engineering, operations, quality, and SHE—to deliver projects that meet regulatory standards and organizational needs. Your technical expertise will be essential in troubleshooting facility systems, optimizing utilities, and maintaining comprehensive documentation of infrastructure modifications. Roche’s culture of continuous improvement means your innovative ideas and process enhancements will help shape best practices across our global engineering network.

The Opportunity
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of capital projects, managing scope, schedule, and budget for initiatives typically ranging from $500K to $2M.

• Develop precise project scopes by identifying core problems, functional requirements, and performing risk and cost-benefit analyses to recommend optimal solutions.

• Oversee design reviews and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to promote space efficiency, asset utilization, and alignment with Roche’s site master plans.

• Manage small to medium projects through all phases from conception to commissioning, qualification, and operational handover, ensuring seamless transitions.

• Maintain comprehensive knowledge of site infrastructure systems—HVAC, electrical, utilities—and provide troubleshooting support for critical facilities.

• Facilitate stakeholder coordination by preparing engineering documentation, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting change control processes.

• Commit to continuous improvement by sharing best practices, supporting cross-site collaborations, and advancing engineering standards within Roche’s network

Who You Are
Qualifications

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline) or equivalent professional experience. A Professional Engineer (PE) license or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.

• 5+ years of combined experience in project management, project engineering, or capital planning within regulated or high-tech manufacturing environments, including biotech, pharmaceutical, or similar industries, preferred.

• Proven experience delivering capital projects from concept to completion, with responsibility for managing budgets and schedules. Experience with capital project governance frameworks such as stage-gate or portfolio management is advantageous.

• Proficiency with MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent project management tools. Experience with SAP, AutoCAD, building management systems, or process control systems is a plus.

• Strong knowledge of facility systems, utilities infrastructure, or building engineering, with familiarity with BIM (Building Information Modeling) tools or digital asset management platforms preferred.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of presenting technical information effectively to divers

A Roche, siamo impegnati a soluzioni pionieristiche che promuovono la salute globale, e abbiamo bisogno di un Project Engineer dedicato per condurre progetti di infrastruttura di capitale vitale che rafforzano la sicurezza, l’efficienza e la conformità delle nostre strutture. Questo ruolo offre un’opportunità unica per influenzare l’eccellenza operativa di Roche gestendo progetti dall’inizio al completamento, garantendo loro di allineare con i nostri obiettivi strategici e contribuire alla crescita sostenibile. In questo ruolo dinamico, collaborerai a stretto contatto con team multidisciplinari, tra cui ingegneria, operazioni, qualità e SHE, per fornire progetti che soddisfino gli standard normativi e le esigenze organizzative. La vostra competenza tecnica sarà essenziale nei sistemi di risoluzione dei problemi, ottimizzare le utenze e mantenere la documentazione completa delle modifiche delle infrastrutture. La cultura di Roche di miglioramento continuo significa che le vostre idee innovative e miglioramenti dei processi aiuteranno a plasmare le migliori pratiche nella nostra rete di ingegneria globale. L'opportunità responsabilità
• Condurre la consegna end-to-end di progetti di capitale, la gestione del campo di applicazione, il programma e il budget per iniziative tipicamente da $ 500K a $2M.
• Sviluppare obiettivi di progetto precisi identificando i problemi fondamentali, i requisiti funzionali, l'esecuzione di analisi di rischio e di costi-benefici per consigliare soluzioni ottimali.
• Superare le recensioni di progettazione e collaborare con team multidisciplinari per promuovere l’efficienza dello spazio, l’utilizzo degli asset e l’allineamento con i piani di master del sito Roche.
• Gestire progetti di piccole e medie dimensioni attraverso tutte le fasi dal concepimento alla messa in servizio, alla qualificazione e alla consegna operativa, garantendo transizioni senza soluzione di continuità.
• Mantenere la conoscenza completa dei sistemi di infrastruttura del sito – HVAC, elettrico, utilità e fornire il supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi per le strutture critiche.
• Facilitare il coordinamento delle parti interessate preparando la documentazione ingegneristica, garantendo la conformità alle normative e supportando i processi di controllo dei cambiamenti.
• Impegnarsi a un miglioramento continuo condividendo le migliori pratiche, supportando collaborazioni cross-site e migliorando gli standard di ingegneria all’interno della rete di Roche Chi sei Qualifiche
• Laurea in Ingegneria (civile, meccanico, elettrico o disciplina correlata) o equivalente esperienza professionale. È preferibile una licenza di ingegnere professionale (PE) o la certificazione di Project Management Professional (PMP).
• 5+ anni di esperienza combinata nella gestione dei progetti, nell'ingegneria dei progetti o nella pianificazione dei capitali all'interno di ambienti di produzione regolamentati o high-tech, tra cui industrie biotecnologiche, farmaceutiche o simili, preferiti.
• Esperienza comprovata che offre progetti di capitale dal concept al completamento, con responsabilità per la gestione di budget e programmi. L'esperienza con i quadri di governance del progetto di capitale, come la fase-gate o la gestione del portafoglio è vantaggiosa.
• Proficienza con MS Project, Smartsheet o strumenti di gestione del progetto equivalenti. L'esperienza con SAP, AutoCAD, sistemi di gestione degli edifici o sistemi di controllo dei processi è un vantaggio.
• Forte conoscenza dei sistemi di impianti, delle infrastrutture di utilizzo o dell'ingegneria degli edifici, con familiarità con gli strumenti BIM (Building Information Modeling) o le piattaforme di gestione degli asset digitali preferite.
• Eccellente capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, in grado di presentare informazioni tecniche efficacemente ai subacquei

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Êtes-vous un ingénieur expérimenté avec une passion pour la conduite de l'innovation dans des infrastructures complexes dans un environnement réglementé et high-tech? Chez Roche, nous sommes déterminés à proposer des solutions novatrices qui favorisent la santé mondiale, et nous avons besoin d'un ingénieur de projet dédié pour diriger des projets d'infrastructure vitale qui renforcent nos installations. Ce rôle offre une occasion unique d'influer sur l'excellence opérationnelle de Roche en gérant des projets depuis leur création jusqu'à leur achèvement, en s'assurant qu'ils correspondent à nos objectifs stratégiques et contribuent à une croissance durable. Dans ce rôle dynamique, vous collaborerez étroitement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires (ingénierie, opérations, qualité et SHE) pour réaliser des projets qui répondent aux normes réglementaires et aux besoins organisationnels. Votre expertise technique sera essentielle dans les systèmes d'installation de dépannage, l'optimisation des services publics et le maintien d'une documentation complète des modifications de l'infrastructure. Roches culture d'amélioration continue signifie que vos idées innovantes et les améliorations de processus aideront à façonner les meilleures pratiques dans notre réseau mondial d'ingénierie. L'opportunité Responsabilités
• Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout des projets d'immobilisations, gérer la portée, le calendrier et le budget des initiatives qui vont généralement de 500 000 $ à 2 millions de dollars.
• Développer des champs d'application précis en identifiant les problèmes essentiels, les exigences fonctionnelles et en effectuant des analyses de risques et de coûts-avantages pour recommander des solutions optimales.
• Superviser la conception et collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires pour promouvoir l'efficacité spatiale, l'utilisation des actifs et l'alignement sur les plans directeurs du site de Roches.
• Gérer les projets de petite à moyenne dimension à toutes les étapes, de la conception à la mise en service, à la qualification et au transfert opérationnel, en assurant des transitions sans heurts.
• Tenir à jour une connaissance complète des systèmes d'infrastructure du site — CVC, électricité, services publics — et fournir un soutien pour le dépannage des installations essentielles.
• Faciliter la coordination des parties prenantes en préparant des documents d'ingénierie, en assurant la conformité aux règlements et en appuyant les processus de contrôle du changement.
• S'engager à l'amélioration continue en partageant les meilleures pratiques, en soutenant les collaborations entre sites et en faisant progresser les normes d'ingénierie au sein du réseau Roches Qui vous êtes Compétences
• Baccalauréat en génie (civil, mécanique, électrique ou discipline connexe) ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. Une licence d'ingénieur professionnel (PE) ou une certification professionnelle de gestion de projet (PMP) est préférée.
• 5 ans d'expérience combinée dans la gestion de projets, l'ingénierie de projets ou la planification d'immobilisations dans des environnements de fabrication réglementés ou de haute technologie, y compris les industries biotechnologiques, pharmaceutiques ou similaires, préférés.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'exécution de projets d'immobilisations du concept à l'achèvement, avec la responsabilité de la gestion des budgets et des calendriers. L'expérience des cadres de gouvernance des projets d'immobilisations, comme la gestion par étapes ou par portefeuille, est avantageuse.
• Compétence avec le projet MS, Smartsheet ou des outils de gestion de projet équivalents. Expérience avec SAP, AutoCAD, systèmes de gestion de bâtiments, ou systèmes de contrôle de processus est un plus.
• Une connaissance approfondie des systèmes d'installation, de l'infrastructure des services publics ou de l'ingénierie des bâtiments, avec la connaissance des outils BIM (Building Information Modeling) ou des plateformes numériques de gestion des actifs préférées.
• Excellente capacité de communication verbale et écrite, capable de présenter efficacement l'information technique aux plongeurs

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de programme de TI - Fusions et acquisitions

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Program Manager – Mergers & Acquisitions

The Opportunity
Lead the charge on complex, large-scale IT integrations and organizational change. As an IT Program Manager for M&A, you will navigate organizational complexity to define solution visions, define and execute integration roadmaps, and bridge cultural gaps during critical acquisitions. Operating as a senior delivery leader (Program Manager, RTE, STE), you will drive strategic alignment, influence senior stakeholders, and ensure seamless transitions that maximize business value.

Key Responsibilities

• Strategic Delivery & Scope: Define, manage, and execute the scope and delivery roadmaps for highly complex, cross-domain M&A IT initiatives.

• Stakeholder Alignment: Build and navigate complex stakeholder networks, influencing senior management and resolving conflicts to drive consensus across boundaries.

• Agile Leadership & Optimization: Champion Agile best practices and innovative delivery frameworks to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and elevate team efficiency.

• Cultural Integration: Successfully bridge cultural gaps between Roche and acquired companies, fostering collaboration and mentoring teams through complex transitions.

• Financial/Vendor Management: Experience building and managing complex IT budgets, negotiating vendor contracts, and overseeing third-party integration teams.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. (MBA, PMP, PgMP certifications are highly preferred).

• 12+ years of senior-level program/project management, with a proven track record leading IT M&A integrations, global rollouts, and large-scale delivery programs.

• Deep expertise in SDLC lifecycle, Agile frameworks, advanced analytics for complex problem-solving, and aligning IT delivery with broader market trends and business strategies.

• Exceptional communication, negotiation, and facilitation skills, backed by a strong capability to coach and mentor less experienced professionals. Proven ability to lead cross-functional, globally distributed teams within a highly matrixed organization.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis, IN is between $118,700 - $220,400. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

Benefits

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

#RDT2026

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

The Opportunity
Join Roche Digital Technology and make an impact on global healthcare. In this role, you will architect and implement robust Directory Services solutions (primarily Microsoft Active Directory) while driving operational excellence through tier 2-3 support, performance optimization, and continuous innovation. Collaborating with specialists across multiple initiatives and time zones, you'll ensure the identity and access infrastructure that powers our mission to help patients live longer, better lives.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate in technical teams to design end-to-end infrastructure solutions, produce comprehensive documentation, and interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters

• Evaluate promising solutions and technologies through Proofs of Concepts (PoCs) and feasibility studies to determine success criteria and drive innovation

• Provide tier 2-3 operational support, manage and implement Directory Services Infrastructure on-premises for manufacturing environments, and support associated applications and complements

• Proactively monitor systems for performance, availability, and capacity management to minimize escalations and ensure solution reliability

• Promptly respond to customer requests, resolve incidents, and implement changes while maintaining high levels of customer engagement and satisfaction

• Understand and implement relevant ITIL, GxP, and Project Management concepts including Request, Incident, Change, Problem, and Document Management, as well as Qualification and Validation

• Actively pursue self-development, create actionable improvement plans, provide 24x7 on-call support with schedule flexibility, and occasional international travel as required

Who you are

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; or equivalent professional experience with 4+ years of hands-on Active Directory administration and advanced troubleshooting

• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry, with proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively across multiple countries and cultures

• Strong design and hands-on technical expertise in Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP), and desirable experience with Entra ID; proficiency in PowerShell scripting required

• Commitment to operational excellence with willingness to cross-train, continuously evolve technical and soft skills, and learn additional technical expertise

• Proactive, collaborative, and supportive approach with strong customer focus, highly responsive service delivery ethic, and adaptability to change in a large organization

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and documentation skills with strong spoken and written English proficiency

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche as a Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) Business Partner and help us advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In this dynamic role, you'll be the trusted expert and strategic partner across manufacturing, facilities, R&D, supply chain, and other key business functions—developing and implementing comprehensive SHE policies, programs, and initiatives that ensure regulatory compliance while fostering a culture of safety and sustainability. You'll work with considerable independence, lead cross-functional teams on complex projects, mentor colleagues, and make a measurable impact on how we protect our people and environment at Roche.

The Opportunity

• Coordinates, develops, implements, and maintains SHE policies, procedures, and programs for regulatory compliance, company Directives, and site/Bay Area-wide initiatives—managing critical programs such as Hazardous and Medical Waste, Industrial Wastewater, Compressed Gases, TSCA/FIFRA, and Refrigerant Management.

• Serves as the subject matter expert in program implementation, leads identification of improvement opportunities, and creates and leads teams to address deficiencies.

• Conducts proactive inspections and hazard evaluations of work areas; assesses impacts from equipment, materials, processes, and facilities to identify and control hazardous conditions and regulatory non-compliance.

• Develops, implements, and conducts formal campus-wide SHE inspections and audits; assists with or leads external audits and tracks resolution of issues.

• Provides technical expertise to management and staff in resolving difficult problems, interpreting laws, regulations, and Roche standards while supporting new staff orientation and training.

• Analyzes key program areas and trends; works with vendors and business functions to identify opportunities, implement initiatives, and establish systems to track, measure, and report on assigned activities.

• Participates in emergency planning and response, and supports SHE management with cross-functional projects impacting multiple business areas and divisions

Who You Are

• Bachelor's Degree in physical science, life science, environmental sciences, engineering, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

• 5+ years of progressive experience in industries such as diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, or related sectors with demonstrated expertise in SHE programs.

• Proven ability to influence opinions and drive change across multiple business functions and units without direct authority, with strong knowledge and application of relevant laws and regulations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex scientific, technical, and regulatory information to diverse audiences and audiences.

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to develop effective training materials while building and maintaining smooth, cooperative working relationships across multiple departments and business units

• Preferred Skills: Completion of a national certification, or ability to obtain, such as a Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM).

Relocation benefits for this position are not available.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $86,200-$160,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geog

jobs.title: Design Quality Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action. We believe that good business means a better world.
We are seeking a highly motivated Design Quality Partner (DQP) to join our Product Development Quality organization. In this role, you will be a key enabler of project acceleration, balancing workload across customer areas through flexible allocation and ensuring effective partnerships within Q&R. You will be an example of living collective success—working, trusting, and empowering each other while the team builds an ambitious, next-generation AI tool.

Your Impact: What you will achieve
Driving Business Results & Customer Value

• Milestone Readiness: Partner with Strategic Quality Partners (SQP) and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the completeness and appropriateness of applicable milestone deliverables.

• Quality & Compliance: Review and approve milestone deliverables within development projects, acting as a Risk Enabler in decision-making.

• Process Excellence: Ensure timely execution and quality process management for design change requests, Non-Conformances (NC), and CAPA.

• Continuous Improvement: Reduce complexity and drive standardization of deliverables (templates, review processes, content) across all projects with pragmatic, agile solutions.

• Audit Readiness: Support internal and external regulatory audits.

Advancing the Organization & Culture

• Knowledge Management: Embed and continuously improve knowledge sharing and retention within Pre-Market Quality.

• Change Management: Lead and support effective change management across Product Development Quality, R&D, and related functions.

• Matrix Leadership: Build, inspire, and provide effective matrix leadership for global project teams, ensuring customer solutions deliver optimal contribution to the Roche Diagnostics Vision.

• Coaching & Mentorship: Serve as a coach to support colleagues' growth, fostering a learning-oriented environment (especially crucial for guiding our junior team members).

Who you are
You are a proactive, agile professional who thinks in terms of impact and outcomes rather than tasks. You are comfortable in dynamic environments and possess a unique blend of quality rigor and a tech-forward mindset.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Experience: 3+ years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and design controls.

• Regulatory Knowledge: Strong understanding of Quality and Regulatory requirements for reviewing Design History File (DHF) content (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA, GMP, or other heavily regulated industries).

• AI & Tech Savvy: A solid understanding or curiosity about AI capabilities and models is highly valued, as you will support tech-driven compliance initiatives.

• Skills: Exceptional technical writing, data interpretation, communication, collaboration, and facilitation skills. Ability to focus on the right degree of detail.

• Mobility: Willingness to travel internationally depending upon business activities.

Our Operating Principles
As a DQP at Roche, you are expected to demonstrate and live our Operating Principles every day:

• Put patients first | Follow the science | Act as one team | Embrace differences

• Accelerate learning | Simplify radically | Make impact now | Think long term

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees acros

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容 　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
就業場所
（雇い入れ直後）: 大宮オフィス　〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16シーノ大宮ノースウイング　10F
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置 　屋内全面禁煙

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
• Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
• That’s what makes us Roche.

Position summary

As a team member of RSS, you execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level requirements, in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process.
It is also key to follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination.
You are responsible for managing incoming and outgoing phone calls based on the predefined SLAs and processes and incoming Service Now tickets. With your dedicated work, you contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche.

Responsibilities

● Service Delivery
o Your key responsibilities will be providing support on 1st level questions, system related questions, role management, consultancy services on existing procurement functionalities of the system/platform for end users
• o Providing support primarily by phone and ticketing tool for above mentioned system related queries coming from Indirect Procurement End Users
• o Creating/maintaining and following up cases/tickets in the adequate quality and in timely manner – within 24 hours if possible- in order to achieve the best response and end-to-end resolution time
• o Proceed with role ownership tickets in timely manner according to the guidelines
• o Responsible for first level issue resolution and being able to make decision on further actions for completing and resolving the upcoming requests and issues
• o Being a bridge between other resolver groups and the business, by reviewing feedback related incidents and sharing the knowledge and instructions with the Requestor on the adequate level
• o Work on scheduled and ad-hoc reporting activities, pro-actively practice the available and required tool sets
• o Work on the regular and ad-hoc monitoring activity and apply fixes as needed.
• o Being responsible and contribute to a proper availability planning within the Team by discussing planned holiday/training schedule in advance

● Cross-Functional Collaboration
o Contribute continuously to the implementation of new tasks and responsibilities coming to the RSS

● Outputs & Deliverables
o Maintaining SOPs, Annexes and training materials for 1st level support. Prepare and share knowledge base documents in timely manner or for the requested deadline

Employees are responsible for performing their duties in line with the SHE (Safety, Security, Health and Environmental Protection) Guidelines and the applicable law. It is required to complete the mandatory training courses and follow procedures and instructions accordingly.

Your skills:

• ● You bring the following skills and competencies:
• o Experience in supplier relationship management
• o Basic understanding of procurement support
• o Familiar with ticketing tools
• o Good numerical and analytical skills
• o React to problems in an appropriate manner
• o Able to work in a fast paced environment
• o Good at time management
• o Open to working in afternoon schedule until 6:00 pm
• o Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills
• o Outstanding customer service and interpersonal skills
• o Highly accountable, agile, and results oriented.
• o Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and written
• o Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize tasks
• o S

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities
I. Sales Target Setting and Management
• Support the preparation of annual and quarterly sales target-setting by providing historical data, market trends, and performance insights.

• Maintain and update sales performance against targets daily/weekly/monthly, identifying variances and provide data summaries to Sales Leadership for follow-up actions.

• Ensure targets are equitably distributed and clearly communicated across the sales force.

• Manage the sales performance relevant process(contract fillment, sales rebate, allowance)
II. Territory Design and Management
• Partner with sales leaders to develop and optimize sales territory structures to ensure fair opportunity distribution, minimize channel conflict, and maximize market coverage and penetration.

• Develop and maintain territory assignment rules and policies, performing regular audits and re-alignments based on business changes, market potential, and sales force size.

• Provide analysis and recommendations on optimal sales resource deployment and headcount planning.
III. Sales Performance Management and Market intelligence Analytics
• Develop, maintain, and disseminate key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards that provide clear, actionable insights into the health of the sales pipeline and overall performance.

• Conduct deep-dive analysis on sales trends, productivity metrics, and funnel conversion rates to identify bottlenecks and areas for process improvement.

• Support regular business review preparation and follow-up, including identifying performance gaps and tracking improvement actions.
IV. Tender coordination
• Partner with sales leaders to build the systematic approach to monitor and capture tender opportunities and follow up with the sales team.

• Filter the tender by portfolio and dispatch to the respective territory sales team

• Support sales team to prepare tender documentation and compilation .

V. Process Improvement and Enablement
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize core sales processes (e.g., forecasting, pipeline management, account planning).

• Partner with Sales Enablement to translate best practices and process improvements into effective training content and tools.
Compliance & Additional Tasks

• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity.

• Perform other tasks as assigned by the line manager.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics Adriatic Division, is seeking a motivated, responsible, and reliable student to support its Sales and Finance department. This role is ideal for someone passionate about laboratory medicine, eager to learn, and skilled in handling professional documentation and data analysis tools such as Excel and Word.

Key Responsibilities:

• Assist in preparing technical documentation related to the sale of Roche analyzers and solutions in laboratory medicine (biochemistry, immunochemistry, and urine diagnostics) with public and private healthcare institutions.

• Organize files, tables, and label technical content within documentation.

• Collect and manage data from various public databases and sources.

• Support analysis of sales process efficiency.

• Regularly update and maintain pricing information in the company database.

• Verify accuracy of financial data in internal ERP systems.

• Prepare dynamic financial analyses and monthly sales reports.

• Provide occasional administrative support and participate in internal sales team meetings.

Who You Are:

• Current University student in a Natural Sciences Field (e.g., laboratory biomedicine, biochemistry, pharmacy, medicine, chemistry).

• Tech skills, including proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word), Google applications (Docs, Sheets, Slides), SmartSheet, and CRM systems.

• Good command of English and Slovenian.

• Detail-oriented, responsible, and organized.

• Available for at least one year, flexible to work 20–30 hours per week, with potential for increased hours based on performance.

We Offer:

• Flexible working hours accommodating study obligations.

• Combination of on-site work in Ljubljana and remote work.

• Long-term student employment opportunity (minimum one year).

• Immediate start.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Questo ruolo è ideale per chi è appassionato di medicina di laboratorio, desideroso di apprendere e esperto nella gestione di documentazione professionale e strumenti di analisi dei dati come Excel e Word. Mansioni - Assistenza nella preparazione della documentazione tecnica relativa alla vendita di analizzatori e soluzioni Roche in medicina di laboratorio (biochimica, immunochimica e diagnostica delle urine) con istituzioni sanitarie pubbliche e private. - Organizzare file, tabelle ed etichettare i contenuti tecnici all'interno della documentazione. - Raccogliere e gestire dati da vari database e fonti pubbliche. - Supportare l'analisi dell'efficienza del processo di vendita. - Aggiornare e mantenere regolarmente le informazioni sui prezzi nel database aziendale. - Verificare l'accuratezza dei dati finanziari nei sistemi ERP interni. - Preparare analisi finanziarie dinamiche e rapporti mensili sulle vendite. - Fornire supporto amministrativo occasionale e partecipare alle riunioni del team di vendita interno.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Affairs Business Analyst - Pharma R&D

The opportunity
Within the Pharma Organisation Medical Affairs serves as the bridge between clinical development and the commercialization of medicines. The domain is increasingly focused on External Stakeholder Engagement, aiming to derive deep insights into unmet medical needs, treatment barriers, and patient perceptions of data. By synthesizing these insights, Medical Affairs shapes the organization’s overall strategic direction. As an IT Business Analyst in this space, you will support the digital transformation of how scientific evidence is generated, managed, and communicated to the global medical community.

• End-to-End Workstream Management: Independently drive and manage comprehensive business analysis workstreams, navigating ambiguous problem spaces and adapting standard frameworks to deliver clear, structured outcomes.

• Problem Solving & Requirements Accountability: Lead domain research and root cause analysis to define comprehensive requirements, contribute heavily to technical solution selection, and propose creative process improvements.

• Technical Landscape & Product Strategy Alignment: Maintain a holistic view of how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy, formulating technical strategies that align directly with broader organizational objectives.

• Application & Data Domain Mastery: Serve as the authoritative Subject Matter Expert (SME) by bridging the gap between business processes and technical execution, maintaining expert knowledge of the end-to-end information lifecycle and data transformations.

• Cross-Functional & Site-Level Collaboration: Operate at the product or site level to directly influence technical decisions, leading cross-functional teams to resolve complex business or systems issues.

• Knowledge Sharing & Community Engagement: Act as a technical mentor to junior team members, actively present at internal tech events (e.g., Tech Talks, DevOps Days), and engage in initiatives outside the regular project scope to drive engineering innovation.

Who you are

• Professional Experience: Bring 5+ years of Business Analysis or consultancy experience, including at least 3+ years within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Workstream & Requirement Management: Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end BA workstreams, navigate ambiguous requirements, and translate them into strategic implementation plans.

• Technical BA Proficiency: Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, documentation, traceability, and change management, with the ability to apply standard process and usability analysis tools.

• Data Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, data visualization techniques, relational databases, and non-relational data structures.

• Stakeholder & Problem Solving Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to prioritize effectively, maintain a big-picture strategic view, and propose process improvements .

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate.
To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.
Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
That’s what makes us Roche.

We create chemistry! Based on modern analytical methods and synthesis procedures we design and develop a great variety of chemical assay components for Dia and Pharma. With our domain knowledge and our wide spectrum of methods, we also accompany the whole lifecycle of active diagnostics ingredients.

We provide in “Chemistry Technologies” a full spectrum of chemical technologies from small molecules to biooligomers and polymers to find the right solutions for diagnostic questions and beyond. We design tailor-made molecules and develop lab scale procedures to provide a competitive advantage for our products.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Development of synthesis strategies within projects that require particularly complex nucleic acid chemical and organic syntheses

• Conducting these syntheses in the laboratory

• Observing the field of nucleic acid chemistry and modern preparative organic chemistry through literature and patent studies, and attending conferences

• Building and maintaining a network through contacts with external and internal experts

• Collaborating with cooperating partners, e.g., in the USA

• Ensuring the required technology through the generation of own IP

• Adhering to internal and external regulations regarding occupational safety and environmental protection, quality management, labor law, confidentiality, etc.

• Representing the team leadership at project meetings and assisting in the professional supervision of employees

Who you are

• You have completed a university degree in chemistry and additionally a PhD in the field of organic chemistry

• You are an expert in oligonucleotide synthesis and preparative organic synthesis as well as in the purification of synthesis products. You gained this special knowledge by working in the pharmaceutical industry for at least 3 -5 years.

• Ideally, you have experience with non-standard oligo building blocks and ultra high purity reagents for the synthesis of highly pure oligonucleotides and experience with large scale, high quality oligonucleotide synthesis

• At the same time, you bring good knowledge in nucleic acids, excellent chemical knowledge, and basic knowledge in biochemistry

• You are strong in communication, both in German and English

• To build a network, you know how to use and maintain your contacts to establish a good relationship of trust

• You also place a high value on good teamwork to find the best solutions and to assist in the professional supervision of employees

• Projektmanagement in an industrial setting is even so well known to you

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only your updated CV and your latest certificates.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 mil

jobs.title: Device Technology Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network.
Global MSAT ensures seamless technical product health and lifecycle management, develops and deploys new technologies and network standards, systematically improves processes across the pharma portfolio, solves operational challenges through data-driven insights and ensures sustainable scaling of innovations across the network.
Device Manufacturing Engineering defines and drives the Pharma TechOps device manufacturing process characterization, development, and technology deployment, ensuring robust, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective manufacturing of Roche's medical devices and drug-device combination products across their entire life cycle, from early design through continuous improvement.

The Opportunity
As the Device Technology Deployment Manager, you lead and execute end-to-end device and packaging technology deployment projects and sub-projects within regulated manufacturing environments. Your role includes the following main responsibilities:

• Drive strategic equipment and process initiatives to enhance product robustness, efficiency, and future-readiness, including the introduction of novel technologies across the entire product lifecycle.

• Own the technology lifecycle from concept assessment and pilot execution through to large-scale deployment, rigorously evaluating feasibility, scalability, and implementation readiness

• Proactively identify risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to ensure project objectives, scope, and timelines are achieved.

• Oversee and execute critical equipment acceptance protocols (FAT, SAT), coordinating user engagement and ensuring compliance with regulated standards.

• Ensure timely review and approval of critical design, qualification, and validation deliverables (e.g., technical specifications, test documentation) in partnership with Site Engineering, Quality, Device Development, MSAT and User teams.

• Ensure seamless, cross-functional coordination and alignment among key project stakeholders, including Automation, Quality/Compliance, Process Engineering, and Manufacturing Operations.

• Manage the full supplier relationship lifecycle, including selection, contract engagement, performance monitoring, and comprehensive review of critical technical documentation.

Who you are
We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient individual who is ready to lead complex technology deployment projects within a regulated environment.

• Bachelor's (B.S.) or Master's (M.S.) degree in Engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Biomedical, Chemical), Science, or a closely related technical field.

• 7+ years of technical Project Management experience (e.g. CAPEX-projects), specifically focused on the deployment, industrialization, and qualification of complex new equipment and technologies, including expertise in supplier management, URS, machine risk assessments, and C&Q strategies.

• Experience in a highly regulated environment (preferably Medical Device or Pharmaceutical manufacturing), a solid understanding of cGMP, ISO standards (e.g., ISO 13485), and FDA regulations (21 CFR Part 820), and deep knowledge of medical device manufacturing processes, with hands-on experience in at

La Posizione PTT (MSAT & Engineering) ist dafür verantwortlich, dass PT an der Spitze der Technologie in unseren Einrichtungen bleibt und unsere robusten Prozesse und effizienten Abläufe unterstützt. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Integration von Produktgesundheit, Prozessgesundheit mit brauchbaren Geräten und Anlagenbereitschaft zur Unterstützung des Produktionsnetzwerks. Global MSAT gewährleistet ein nahtloses technisches Produktgesundheits- und Lebenszyklusmanagement, entwickelt und setzt neue Technologien und Netzwerkstandards ein, verbessert systematisch Prozesse im gesamten Pharmaportfolio, löst operative Herausforderungen durch datengesteuerte Erkenntnisse und sorgt für eine nachhaltige Skalierung von Innovationen im gesamten Netzwerk. Device Manufacturing Engineering definiert und steuert die Charakterisierung, Entwicklung und Technologiebereitstellung des Pharma TechOps-Geräteherstellungsprozesses und gewährleistet eine robuste, effiziente, konforme und kostengünstige Herstellung der medizinischen Geräte und Kombinationsprodukte von Roche über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg, von der frühen Entwicklung bis zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung. L'Opportunità Als Device Technology Deployment Manager leiten und führen Sie End-to-End-Projekte und Teilprojekte für Geräte- und Verpackungstechnologie in regulierten Fertigungsumgebungen durch. Ihre Rolle umfasst die folgenden Hauptverantwortungen: - Führen Sie strategische Ausrüstungs- und Prozessinitiativen durch, um die Robustheit, Effizienz und Zukunftsfähigkeit der Produkte zu verbessern, einschließlich der Einführung neuartiger Technologien über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. - Besitzen Sie den Technologielebenszyklus von der Konzeptbewertung und Pilotausführung bis hin zur groß angelegten Bereitstellung, wobei Machbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Implementierungsbereitschaft streng bewertet werden - Erkennen Sie proaktiv Risiken und implementieren Sie effektive Minderungsstrategien, um sicherzustellen, dass Projektziele, -umfang und -zeitpläne erreicht werden. Überwachen und Ausführen von Protokollen zur Annahme kritischer Geräte (FAT, SAT), Koordinierung der Benutzerbindung und Gewährleistung der Einhaltung regulierter Standards. - Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen Überprüfung und Genehmigung kritischer Design-, Qualifizierungs- und Validierungsergebnisse (z. B. technische Spezifikationen, Testdokumentation) in Zusammenarbeit mit Site Engineering, Qualität, Geräteentwicklung, MSAT und Benutzerteams. - Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen, funktionsübergreifenden Koordination und Abstimmung zwischen den wichtigsten Projektbeteiligten, einschließlich Automatisierung, Qualität/Compliance, Prozesstechnik und Fertigung. Verwalten Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Lieferantenbeziehung, einschließlich Auswahl, Vertragsbindung, Leistungsüberwachung und umfassender Überprüfung kritischer technischer Dokumentation. Chi-Sei Wir suchen eine sehr erfahrene und technisch kompetente Person, die bereit ist, komplexe Technologieeinführungsprojekte in einer regulierten Umgebung zu leiten. - Bachelor (BS) oder Master (MS) in Ingenieurwissenschaften (z. B. Mechanik, Biomedizin, Chemie), Naturwissenschaften oder einem eng verwandten technischen Bereich. - 7+ Jahre Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement (z. B. CAPEX-Projekte), die sich speziell auf den Einsatz, die Industrialisierung und die Qualifizierung komplexer neuer Geräte und Technologien konzentrieren, einschließlich Expertise in Lieferantenmanagement, URS, Maschinenrisikobewertungen und C & Q-Strategien. - Erfahrung in einer stark regulierten Umgebung (vorzugsweise Medizinprodukte oder Pharmazeutische Fertigung), ein solides Verständnis von cGMP, ISO-Standards (z. B. ISO 13485) und FDA-Vorschriften (21 CFR Part 820) sowie fundierte Kenntnisse der Herstellungsprozesse von Medizinprodukten mit praktischer Erfahrung in der Praxis

jobs.title: Healthcare Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division : Customer Integrated Solutions
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Main Responsibilities
1. Drive End-to-End Laboratory Optimization

• Propose customized, data-driven laboratory systems by analyzing unique customer environments at the earliest stage.

• Design optimal configurations and spatial layouts prior to deployment to align with customer operational goals.

• Partner with customers post-setup to optimize physical workflows and ensure maximum operational stability.
2. Lead Market Standards & Value Creation

• Research and establish new consulting packages and frameworks to position Roche as an industry pioneer.

• Identify hidden customer needs to deliver sustainable healthcare innovation and maximize business win rates.

• Transform intangible consulting activities into tangible data to set benchmarks for automation tracking.
3. Stakeholder Communication & CA Collaboration

• Align local consulting practices with Global and APAC regional lab consulting teams (Lab 1.0).

• Coordinate closely with related departments to provide professional, data-backed product support.

• Collaborate intensely with CA (Customer Area) Sales/Marketing and Agile teams to streamline automation proposals.
4. Continuous Skill-Up as a Lab Operations Expert

• Upskill consulting capabilities to position oneself as a premier laboratory operations expert in the IVD market.

• Acquire a profound, structured understanding of complex hospital laboratory workflows and total ecosystems.

• Apply consultative and solution-oriented thinking to eliminate operational waste and maximize customer success.

Requirements
1. Core Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher (Biomedical Science/Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or healthcare-related preferred).

• Experience: Minimum 3 years in the IVD industry, hospital laboratory environments, clinical lab operations, or the healthcare sector.

• Analytical & Tech Skills: Strong data analysis skills with high proficiency in MS Office (Excel/PPT) and a proactive aptitude for utilizing AI productivity tools.

• Communication: Professional working proficiency in English (verbal/written) with the ability to manage both local and global stakeholders.
2. Preferred Competencies

• Consulting & Workflow: Experience in healthcare/laboratory consulting, strategic planning, or workflow optimization (Lean Six Sigma understanding preferred).

• Growth Mindset & Adaptability: High learning agility and resilience to take risks, try new initiatives, and adapt quickly to change.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to build networks and collaborate effectively within integrated, cross-functional teams.

Submission

※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.

jobs.title: Analytics & Intelligence - Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As an Senior Analyst, you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 4-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 2-5 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable additional qualification

• Deve dimostrare esperienza nelle operazioni commerciali di farmacia degli Stati Uniti e possedere un forte background in analisi delle vendite, analisi dei reclami, analisi dei prodotti, analisi dei pazienti, previsione e analisi ROI
• Esperienza con una serie di set di dati secondari, compresi i dati di vendita IQVIA, 867 dati, reclami LAAD, affiliazioni, interazioni sul campo, Veeva, dati medici, e altro ancora, è un vantaggio significativo
• L'esposizione a aree terapeutiche come oncologia, neurologia, immunologia, ecc., insieme a una conoscenza di lavoro di Salesforce o Veeva, è una valida qualifica aggiuntiva

This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster .

Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch.
