Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life .

The Opportunity

The Clinical Development Lead is an integral member of the Clinical Development Clinical Evidence In-Vitro Diagnostics (CEI) team at Roche Diagnostic Solutions (RDS) whose primary focus includes providing documentation support for a multitude of clinical study documents, including reports, protocols, clinical study reports, investigator brochures etc., and IVDR performance evaluation documents. The position will function as a strategic partner within Clinical Development to support clinical evidence generation and/or clinical study design of In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) for registration with regulatory agencies.

• Strategically supports clinical evidence generation by analyzing the product portfolio across a specific customer area and creating documentation to support compliance to IVD-Regulation.

Descrizione Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Bei Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) ist unsere Mission klar: früher zu diagnostizieren, schneller zu entwickeln und die Behandlung zu personalisieren, weil jeder Patient einzigartig ist. Unser Team für klinische Entwicklung und medizinische Angelegenheiten (CDMA) treibt Innovationen voran, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. • Anforderungen, Qualitätskontrollsystemen / -verfahren und Zeitschriftenanforderungen für wissenschaftliche Publikationen. - Enge Verbindung mit anderen Mitgliedern des CEI-Teams, um Best Practices auszutauschen, projekt- und kundenbezogene Erfahrungen transparent zu kommunizieren und Teammanagement- und Prozessverbesserungsaktivitäten (wie GSP/Template) zu unterstützen

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer plus tôt, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous voyons nous-mêmes et nos clients comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel ensemble. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins, en tirant parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous nous rapprochons de leurs besoins réels. jobs.title: 治疗领域专员_ BC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。
A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions.

• Minimum 3 year of experience in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS).

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Packaging Operator 包装操作工
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
罗氏正在上海建设全新的大分子工厂。我们开放了包装操作工的岗位，该职位要求具备出色的执行能力和丰富的包装操作经验，精通核心包装流程，并能够操作和日常维护包装设备，以确保生产的连续性和可靠性。此外，该职位还需与项目团队紧密合作，共同执行这项战略计划，包括工厂设计、验证、生产准备和启动等工作。
包装操作工负责在工艺步骤（例如针头切割、贴标和包装）中达成生产目标，确保产品安全、及时地生产，并完全符合GMP/SHE要求以及罗氏的企业原则、质量政策和标准。

• 负责包装线上相关工艺设备的操作和清洁，包括针头切割机、贴标机、装盒机、药监码系统、装箱机和码垛机。

• 负责包装物料的转运和管理，包括包装线上的针头检查。

• 协助进行包装线的设备验证和工艺验证。

•
负责高质量、高效率地执行资质认证和生产活动。

工程项目支持和运行准备阶段:

• 参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 支持包装工艺的初步开发和优化。

• 参与运行准备工作的实施，例如：起草设备操作规程和日志、现场5S 管理、根据准备计划进行现场机器清洁等。

• 接受包装设备操作和 CCS 实施方面的培训并获得相关资质。

• 完成其他分配的任务。

日常运营阶段:

• 确保日常操作符合罗氏的GMP/SHE及相关法规要求。

• 执行以下生产操作：例如，针头切割和目视检查、贴标和包装。

• 执行常规包装生产操作并填写GMP记录。

• 确保所有包装活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

• 在包装过程中实施冷链管理。

• 在维护工程师的支持下，及时诊断并解决设备故障，以最大限度地减少停机时间。

• 相关IT系统操作，例如SAP、MES。

• 执行其他分配的任务。
岗位要求：

教育背景/资质

• 大专及以上学历（药学/生物学专业优先）。

岗位所需胜任力

• 拥有3年及以上注射剂制药行业运营经验，有跨国生物制药公司经验者优先。

• 具备包装设施战略项目经验者优先，包括设计、调试和验证。

• 熟悉cGMP及制药行业相关法规，尤其是生物制药行业相关法规。

• 能够与团队成员和干系人有效沟通、协作并建立积极的互动关系。具备基本的英语沟通能力优先。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• 负责包装线上相关工艺设备的操作和清洁，包括针头切割机、贴标机、装盒机、药监码系统、装箱机和码垛机。

• 协助进行包装线的设备验证和工艺验证。

• 参与新厂房的设计和建设，包括但不限于工厂验收测试 (FAT)、现场验收测试 (SAT)、安装运行性能确认 (IOPQ) 等，为项目交付做出贡献。

• 执行以下生产操作：例如，针头切割和目视检查、贴标和包装。
• 执行常规包装生产操作并填写GMP记录。
• 确保所有包装活动的数据准确性、完整性和可追溯性。

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:

• Products for the respective area of responsibility shall obtain Regulatory approvals in defined markets in close cooperation with other functions.

• The documents/deliverables for submissions are coordinated and compiled in a timely manner to support planned product registration timelines.

• The obtained Regulatory approvals/licenses products are maintained throughout the life cycle of the product by applying successful Regulatory change controls.

• The efficiency and the success of the Regulatory activities and strategies are maintained by clear agreements with other functions, stakeholders and external partners (authorities, companies, NBs etc).

• The regulatory requirements and strategic aspects are understood, communicated and implemented, kept up to date and are transparent within the organization.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities:
1. Regulatory document and submission compilation:

• Oversees the development of submission/product registration dossiers of more complex products/programs. Develops and manages at least parts of comprehensive global regulatory submissions and registration plans. May act as mentor for more junior team members in this area.

2. External interface management:

• Understands the structure, key roles and responsibilities of external customers/stakeholders. Understands and communicates timely and effectively the needs of external customers/stakeholders. Builds effective and enduring external relationships and applies effective stakeholder management practices. Actively contributes to audits by supporting preparation, execution and follow up.

3. Regulatory knowledge and strategy:

• Leads the organization to adapt to evolving regulatory environment and requirements.

• Experience in solving complex, critical health authority issues or equivalent.

• Understanding of external environmental changes, precedents, to navigate complex situations and influence strategies and decision making.

• Ability to interpret and apply understanding of the regulators' thinking to projects and apply strategies to the different needs of different regions without significant guidance.

• Proactively creates unique/innovative regulatory strategies and influencing approaches to avoid regulatory obstacles and accelerate worldwide approvals.

4. Stakeholder management and influencing:

• Effectively partners with stakeholders to understand and provide best solutions. Takes initiative to address problems or opportunities and involves stakeholders for best solutions. Develops relationships that significantly influence the current and future direction for Roche and our products. Understands what motivates other people to perform at their best. Is skilled at managing and influencing peers. Fosters an exchange of ideas amongst key stakeholders to be able to shift perspectives to reach a common agreeable outcome. Negotiates with stakeholders and creates win-win compromises.

5. Decision making: :

• Has courage to make decisions even outside of scope/comfort zone.

• Proactively Initiates activities independently and initiates interactions across departments as applicable. Embrace the good decision making principles. Pushes decision making to the lowest appropriate level. Commits to decisions that have been made. Shows good judgment in decision making. Makes good decisions without necessarily having all the information in a timely manner.

6. Innovation and problem solving: :

• Drives innovation across the organization/sites. Advocates for and

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position - Manager-Repair Centre
Location - Chennai

This position is within the Roche Professional Service Team, where we strive for excellence for our customers by leveraging our knowledge and a team of highly qualified professionals. Our goal is to ensure customers enjoy an experience that meets their needs and aligns with the expectations of a global industry leader.
A key strength lies in our commitment to customers and our deep knowledge of our solutions. We aim to stand by our customers—particularly during complex projects—to help them overcome challenges. As a member of the operations team, you will be responsible for ensuring high customer satisfaction in complex service projects involving your team, while also driving improvements in the efficiency and sustainability of the activities performed. As the Manager Repair Center at our Chennai repair center , you will be responsible for repair & refurbishment activities for the solutions designed by the organization.

Roles and 
• Responsibilities:

1) Repair & Refurbishment: Repair, Refurbish and validate field-returned instruments, ensuring all performance checks pass as per the defined criteria by manufacturer.
2) Case Closure: Ensure all cases raised for refurbishment activities are closed immediately upon completion of the task.
3) Spare Parts Management: Consume all ordered spare parts and consumables within agreed timelines in the respective work order.
4) RA Spare Parts Return: Return all parts categorized as "RA Spare parts" immediately after the completion of the refurbishment activity.
5) Records and Reports: Safely and accurately maintain all reports and records generated during the refurbishment process according to instructions.
6) Monitoring of Service Parameters for Repaired/Refurbished systems.
7) Training Management for Repair Centre FSE’s and Development of the team on technical competencies.
8) Secondary level of Support on Spare Part Management for Logistics Teams.

Who You Are

Graduate with BTech/BSc as an added advantage
Experience in Repairs & refurbishment
Experience in working with Medical Devices/ IVD industry
Excellent communication skills

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer for Network Security
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Network Security, you will lead the Design, Build, and Improvement of critical security infrastructures, specifically focusing on Cisco ISE, Wired Access Control (WAC), and Palo Alto Networks. This is a dual-impact role: you are the technical authority for the secure access layer, while simultaneously leading the engineering of a custom observability framework. You will develop the front-end, back-end, and integration logic required to provide deep visibility into the security product health and asset inventory.

Job Responsibilities

1. SME:
Secure Access (ISE, WAC, Palo Alto)

• Design & Architecture: Lead the high-level and low-level design (HLD/LLD) for global Cisco ISE deployments and Wired Access Control (WAC) strategies to ensure seamless, identity-based security.

• Palo Alto SME: Serve as the primary engineer for Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including advanced threat prevention, decryption, and secure egress/ingress traffic management.

• Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the current security posture and implement technical enhancements to NAC policies, SGT (TrustSec) propagation, and firewall rule-sets.

• Build & Implementation: Act as the lead "implementer" for complex global migrations and new feature rollouts across the network security stack.

​
2. Observability Framework Engineering

• Full-Stack Development: Architect and develop a custom framework (front-end and back-end) to provide a "single pane of glass" for infrastructure health.

• Inventory & Integration: Build automated integrations with external data sources (CMDB, IPAM, etc.) to maintain a real-time, dynamic inventory of all network assets and security nodes.

• Telemetry Logic: Design custom logic to ingest and visualize telemetry from ISE, WAC, and Palo Alto using APIs, SNMP, and Syslog.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the lead engineer for complex network security escalations, providing root-cause analysis and implementing long-term, automated architectural fixes.

• Security Observability: Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility into the "connected landscape," identifying insecure nodes or unauthorized devices before they can affect the network.

• Automation & Orchestration: Manage security policies as code while continuously improving automation workflows and cross-platform orchest

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection , Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN) , Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Cybersecurity Engineer within the AI Innovation workstream, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for the hands-on execution of our AI/ML security strategy. Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks.

Job Responsibilities

1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).

• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.

• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​

2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory

• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.

• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.

• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams.

​
3. Proactive Defense & Automation

• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.

• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.

• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape.

​

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Educational Bac

Working as part of a specialized team, you will assist in developing and implementing AI capabilities to optimize service delivery across the Design, Build, and Operations phases of our network security solutions. Your role is to help bridge the gap between network security engineering and data science, contributing to the development of intelligent automation that reduces manual intervention and shifts our infrastructure toward a proactive, self-healing model. You will apply your technical expertise to ensure these technologies integrate seamlessly with our core stack, including Cisco ISE, 802.1x, and Palo Alto Networks. Job Responsibilities 1. AI Strategy & Roadmap Execution
• Strategy Definition: Partner with product owners to define the vision for AI adoption within Network Security (e.g., predictive threat detection, automated policy optimization).
• Hands-on Implementation: Lead the technical execution of AI workstreams, moving from Proof of Concept (POC) to production-ready security enhancements.
• SME for AI Security: Act as the Subject Matter Expert for how AI can be leveraged to improve the efficacy and performance of Cisco ISE, Palo Alto, and 802.1x infrastructures. ​ 2. AI-Driven Observability & Inventory
• Intelligent Monitoring: Develop AI/ML models to identify anomalies in network traffic and security appliance telemetry that traditional threshold-based monitoring misses.
• Automated Classification: Enhance asset inventory and device profiling (NAC) by applying machine learning to identify complex IoT and medical device patterns.
• Framework Integration: Integrate AI insights into the existing observability front-end and backend frameworks to provide actionable intelligence to operations teams. ​ 3. Proactive Defense & Automation
• Predictive Analytics: Implement tools to predict potential security bottlenecks or infrastructure failures before they impact the global network.
• Policy Optimization: Use AI to analyze firewall and NAC policy usage, recommending automated cleanup or hardening of security rules.
• Continuous Improvement: Lead the "Design, Build, and Improve" cycle for AI-driven security controls, ensuring they evolve alongside the threat landscape. ​ Qualifications Education / Experience

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about applying systems thinking to navigate complex digital landscapes and driving sustainable business transformation?
As our Principal Business Analyst for Data, AI & Insights, you will act as a trusted advisor to leadership, actively shaping long-term roadmaps and defining innovative technology solutions. Working with full autonomy, you will lead analysis efforts across highly ambiguous and evolving spaces, helping to translate complex organizational needs into high-value digital strategies. In this role, you will look at the big picture to manage interconnected systems, ensure cross-functional alignment, and cultivate a data-driven culture that directly impacts how we deliver excellence across our global informatics structures.

Your Responsibilities

• Drive Strategic Analysis: Define and lead business analysis efforts across highly ambiguous spaces, navigating complex frameworks while managing the quality of core analytical content.

• Shape Long-Term Roadmaps: Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, evaluating strategic solution options through advanced value analysis and risk assessments to guide future-ready technology decisions.

• Solve Complex Business Problems: Lead deep-dive root cause analyses of complex business challenges, defining the problem space and delivering sustainable, innovative technical solutions.

• Manage Stakeholders & Align Teams: Partner with key stakeholders and management across cross-functional boundaries, navigating conflicts gracefully to build consensus and drive strategic alignment.

• Oversee High-Impact Initiatives: Maintain full accountability for business analysis deliverables, managing scope effectively and anticipating macro-implications across related domains.

• Foster Community & Mentorship: Actively contribute to organizational development by championing our internal practices and mentoring senior business analysis practitioners.

Who You Are
You are a proactive, delivery-focused strategic thinker with an enterprise mindset who thrives on turning ambiguity into clarity. You excel at breaking down operational silos, building collaborative relationships across diverse teams, and guiding complex technical initiatives with confidence and autonomy.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Business Analysis Expertise: A proven track record of overseeing complex, large-scale initiatives with full autonomy, backed by advanced knowledge of business analysis advisory and consultancy practices.

• Systems Thinking & Problem Solving: Demonstrated mastery in domain knowledge, with the ability to apply systems thinking to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice and advanced risk assessments.

• Methodology Innovation: Strong capability to extend standard analytical approaches, tailoring and combining methodologies creatively to fit unique and evolving problem spaces.

• Exceptional Stakeholder & Change Management: Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with a proven ability to influence senior management, drive consensus, and navigate cross-functional dynamics smoothly.

• Leadership & Mentorship: A dedication to driving teamwork, acting as a collaborative role model across informatics and business teams, and supporting the professional growth of fellow practitioners.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Based in Turkey and reporting to the General Manager Türkiye and Head of MC Central Asia and Caucasia, you will be a key member of the Turkey Leadership Team.
Beyond your core responsibilities, you will be jointly accountable for affiliate transformation, fostering an environment of trust, transparency, and patient-centricity that inspires teams to grow, adapt, and excel in a fast-changing market. In this role, you will lead and oversee External Affairs, Market Access, and Corporate Communications across the affiliate. You will drive strategic public affairs, government relations, and external communication activities, ensuring that healthcare policies, stakeholder engagement, and market access strategies are effectively implemented, aligned with organizational strategy, and continuously improved to maximize patient access.
A natural leader and coach with a strong entrepreneurial and enterprise mindset, you will architect an environment that enables growth, fast decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration in a complex and volatile landscape. You will thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing organization, empowering your team to reach ambitious targets while partnering with peers to deliver overarching business goals. Acting as a central integrator across functions, you will ensure alignment with global and regional strategies, manage external stakeholders and legal partners, oversee contract and litigation processes, drive risk assessment, support audits, and coordinate with authorities and institutions.

What’s expected from you could be categorized as:

VACC Leadership

• As a visionary, connect the enterprise vision to people within the affiliate

• As an architect, formulate a strategy to reach our enterprise ambition and ensure affiliate architecture would be enabling factors to achieve those outcomes

• As a catalyst, remove roadblocks, encourage smart-risking taking, experimentation, and rapid learning

• As a coach, empower people to take business decisions

Accountabilities

Strategic Government Relations & Public Policy

• Drive and lead robust government relations across the entire healthcare ecosystem, establishing a strong network and influence within key decision-making bodies

• Act as the strategic liaison to navigate complex local reimbursement, pricing, and policy-shaping processes by effectively engaging with key decision-makers, policymakers, regulatory authorities, and governmental economic committees

• Formulate and execute high-impact public affairs strategies to influence the adoption of international diagnostic standards, guidelines, and healthcare economics policies at the highest levels of state administration and policymaking

​
Market Access & Healthcare Policy

• Map, engage, and manage high-level stakeholders to shape the policy and access environment while driving market access strategies for diagnostic solutions.

• Act as the key interface for Diagnostics and Pharma affiliates to co-create joint access programs, stakeholder mapping, policy shaping, and reimbursement activities.

• Lead and coordinate overall market access processes, planning, and budgeting to support health system transformation and improve patient outcomes.

​
Government Affairs & Public Affairs

• Lead innovative and digital strategies to engage key healthcare decision-makers and influencers across the entire ecosystem.

• Enable team members to influence the adoption of local or international guidelines and best practices through active participation

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Basato in Turchia e segnalando al Direttore Generale Türkiye e Capo di MC Asia Centrale e Caucasia, sarai un membro chiave del Team di Leadership della Turchia. Al di là delle vostre responsabilità fondamentali, sarete congiuntamente responsabili per la trasformazione della filiale, promuovendo un ambiente di fiducia, trasparenza e focalizzazione del paziente che ispira i team a crescere, adattarsi e eccellere in un mercato in rapida evoluzione. In questo ruolo, guiderai e supervisionerai gli Affari Esterni, l'accesso al mercato e le comunicazioni aziendali attraverso la filiale. Potrai guidare gli affari pubblici strategici, le relazioni governative e le attività di comunicazione esterna, assicurando che le politiche sanitarie, l'impegno degli stakeholder e le strategie di accesso al mercato siano effettivamente implementate, allineate con la strategia organizzativa e migliorate continuamente per massimizzare l'accesso dei pazienti. Leader naturale e allenatore con una forte mentalità imprenditoriale e imprenditoriale, si architetto un ambiente che consente la crescita, il processo decisionale veloce e la collaborazione interfunzionale in un paesaggio complesso e volatile. Si prospererà in un'organizzazione veloce, altamente performante, che consente al vostro team di raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi, collaborando con i pari per fornire obiettivi aziendali overarching. Agendo come integratore centrale attraverso le funzioni, si assicurerà l'allineamento con le strategie globali e regionali, gestire gli stakeholder esterni e partner legali, supervisionare i processi di contratto e contenzioso, guidare la valutazione del rischio, sostenere gli audit e coordinare con le autorità e le istituzioni. Cosa ci aspetti da te VACC Leadership - Come visionario, collegare la visione aziendale alle persone all'interno della filiale - Come architetto, formulare una strategia per raggiungere la nostra ambizione aziendale e garantire l'architettura della filiale sarebbe fattori che consentano di raggiungere tali risultati - Come catalizzatore, rimuovere i blocchi stradali, incoraggiare l'assunzione di smart-risking, la sperimentazione e l'apprendimento rapido - Come allenatore, consentire alle persone di prendere decisioni aziendali Responsabilità Strategic Government Relations & Public Policy - Guidare e condurre relazioni governative robuste in tutto l'ecosistema sanitario, stabilire una forte rete e influenza all'interno di organi decisionali chiave - Agire come il collegamento strategico per navigare complessi rimborsi locali, prezzi e processi di policy-shaping, impegnandosi efficacemente con i decisori chiave, responsabili politici, autorità di regolamentazione, e comitati economici governativi - Agire come l'interfaccia chiave per le affiliate di Diagnostics e Pharma per co-creare programmi di accesso congiunto, mappatura degli stakeholder, modellazione delle politiche e attività di rimborso. - Guidare e coordinare i processi generali di accesso al mercato, pianificazione e budget per supportare la trasformazione del sistema sanitario e migliorare i risultati dei pazienti. Affari governativi e Affari pubblici - Guidare strategie innovative e digitali per coinvolgere i decisori e gli influencer sanitari chiave in tutto l'ecosistema. - Abilitare i membri del team di influenzare l'adozione di linee guida e best practice locali o internazionali attraverso la partecipazione attiva

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Au-delà de vos responsabilités fondamentales, vous serez conjointement responsable de la transformation des filiales, favorisant un environnement de confiance, de transparence et de centricité patiente qui inspire les équipes à grandir, à s'adapter et à exceller dans un marché en évolution rapide. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et superviserez les Affaires extérieures, l'Accès aux marchés et les Communications corporatives dans l'ensemble de la société affiliée. Vous dirigerez des activités stratégiques d'affaires publiques, de relations gouvernementales et de communication externe, en veillant à ce que les politiques en matière de soins de santé, la participation des intervenants et les stratégies d'accès aux marchés soient mises en oeuvre efficacement, alignées sur la stratégie organisationnelle et continuellement améliorées pour maximiser l'accès des patients. Leader naturel et coach avec une solide mentalité entrepreneuriale et d'entreprise, vous allez concevoir un environnement qui permet la croissance, la prise de décision rapide, et la collaboration inter-fonctionnelle dans un paysage complexe et volatil. Vous prospérerez dans une organisation rapide et performante, donnant à votre équipe les moyens d'atteindre des objectifs ambitieux tout en s'associant à des pairs pour atteindre des objectifs commerciaux globaux. En tant qu'intégrateur central dans toutes les fonctions, vous assurerez l'alignement avec les stratégies mondiales et régionales, gérerez les intervenants externes et les partenaires juridiques, superviserez les processus de passation de marchés et de litiges, dirigerez l'évaluation des risques, appuierez les audits et coordonnerez avec les autorités et les institutions. Cosa ci aspetti da te VACC Leadership - En tant que visionnaire, connectez la vision d'entreprise aux personnes au sein de l'affilié - En tant qu'architecte, formuler une stratégie pour atteindre notre ambition d'entreprise et assurer l'architecture d'affiliation serait des facteurs permettant d'atteindre ces résultats - En tant que catalyseur, supprimer les barrages routiers, encourager la prise de risques intelligents, l'expérimentation et l'apprentissage rapide - En tant qu'entraîneur, autonomiser les gens pour prendre des décisions d'affaires Responsabilità Strategic Government Relations & Public Policy - Diriger et diriger des relations gouvernementales solides dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème de soins de santé, établir un solide réseau et exercer une influence au sein des principaux organes décisionnels - Agir en tant que liaison stratégique pour naviguer dans les processus complexes de remboursement, de tarification et de formulation des politiques au niveau local en engageant efficacement les décideurs clés, les décideurs, les autorités réglementaires et les comités économiques gouvernementaux - Formuler et exécuter des stratégies d'affaires publiques à haut impact afin d'influencer l'adoption de normes, de lignes directrices et de politiques internationales en matière de diagnostic aux plus hauts niveaux de l'administration de l'État et de l'élaboration des politiques en matière d'accès aux marchés et de soins de santé - Planifier, engager et gérer des intervenants de haut niveau pour façonner les politiques et l'environnement d'accès tout en favorisant les stratégies d'accès aux marchés pour des solutions diagnostiques. - Agir comme interface clé pour les affiliés Diagnostics et Pharma afin de cocréer des programmes d'accès conjoints, la cartographie des intervenants, l'élaboration des politiques et les activités de remboursement. - Diriger et coordonner l'ensemble des processus d'accès aux marchés, de planification et de budgétisation pour appuyer la transformation du système de santé et améliorer les résultats des patients. Affaires gouvernementales et affaires publiques - Diriger des stratégies novatrices et numériques pour mobiliser les décideurs et les influenceurs clés dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème. - Permettre aux membres de l'équipe d'influencer l'adoption de lignes directrices et de pratiques exemplaires locales ou internationales par une participation active

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A Field Services Engineer is responsible for performing the field service activities for Professional Diagnostics by provision and co-ordination of all activities relating to instrument troubleshooting, instrument installation, instrument preventative maintenance, software and hardware modification’s, relating to both pre and post sales requirements.
This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Support

• Take accountability for cases being resolved by receiving cases, contacting clients, providing telephonic support

• Coordinate the resolution of escalated technical cases by identifying issues that require escalation, referring to appropriate escalation processes, providing feedback to customers, internal sales and line manager, following up until resolved and closing cases within customer expectations.

• Proactively provide technical support to customers by receiving ad-hoc customer support requests while on site, after hours etc., by receiving request for support from customers, logging case on system, providing technical support and closing case or distributing case correctly immediately.

• Provide expert technical support by receiving escalated cases, evaluating and resolving or escalating according to escalation policy and providing feedback to customers until resolved.
Modifications

• Conduct modifications by receiving notification of modification/enhancements, upskilling on technical requirements, contacting customers to schedule modifications and conducting as per specifications and standards and within deadlines. Manage the modification projects by engaging with internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance.
Installations & De-Installations

• Initiate project installations / de-installations by being appointed as project installation lead, engaging with Project Manager, agreeing installation requirements and specifications, conducting site inspection, understanding customer expectations and Customer Service and Support

• Maintain a customer centric approach with all customer engagements by aligning with the Roche values, maintaining professionalism, providing quality technical support and advice and delivering according to their expectations and SLA at all times.

• Proactively resolve customer issues by conducting courtesy visits, identifying potential issues and resolving and taking preventative action at all times.

You, as an ideal candidate, will have the following skills, experience and education:

• Qualifications: Diploma in Electrical Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Biomedical Technology or equivalent.

• Experience working with chemistry / core lab instruments.

• Willingness to be on-call during evenings, weekends, and holidays (team rotation basis).

• Experience in technical support services– advantage

• Experience in the medical diagnostic industry-advantage

• High-level fluency in Hebrew and English.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, Ability to work independently.

• The successful candidate needs to be in possession of a valid driver's license

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our a

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst den digitalen Wandel im Gesundheitsmarkt als Führungspersönlichkeit von morgen aktiv mitgestalten und die Diagnostik durch patientenzentrierte Innovationen revolutionieren? Starte als Leadership StartUp Trainee (m/w/d) bei Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH in eine unbefristete Karriere mit echter Verantwortung. Wir bieten dir Raum für deinen individuellen Führungspfad, agile Projekte und die strategische Prägung der Gesundheitsversorgung. Werde die treibende Innovationskraft!

Wer wir sind
Als Partner für innovative Diagnostik- und datenbasierte Entscheidungsunterstützung tragen wir dazu bei, die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen gemeinsam zu gestalten. Dabei setzen wir auf digitale Vernetzung, intelligente Technologien und enge Zusammenarbeit.

Diese Vision verfolgen wir als Vertrieb Deutschland tagtäglich mit unserem vollen Einsatz - immer im Sinne der Patient:innen.

Willst Du auch Teil davon sein?

Was bieten wir dir
Während Deines 24-monatigen Programms wirst Du vom ersten Tag an:

• Deine Leistungs- und Entwicklungsziele definieren und diesen durch intensives Training on und off the job jeden Tag einen Schritt näher kommen.

• Verantwortung für Projekte (Product Owner, Projektleitung) übernehmen, in klassischen Projekten und agilen Settings (lokal oder international) mitarbeiten und diese den entsprechenden Stakeholdern präsentieren.

• Seminare und Workshops besuchen, sowie eine:n erfahrene:n Senior Manager:in für Deine Progamm- und Karriereplanung an Deiner Seite als Mentor:in haben.

• Dein persönliches internationales Netzwerk mit aktuellen und ehemaligen Trainees sowie mit Kollegen:innen in anderen Funktionen und Bereichen aufbauen und so sehr viele Erfahrungen und Erkenntnisse in einem sich derzeit stark verändernden Umfeld sammeln.

• Die Möglichkeit haben, an einem unserer anderen Standorte im Ausland zu arbeiten und dort ein Projekt zu übernehmen.

Wer du bist
Du bist jemand, der seine eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Du liebst das Experimentieren und Vorangehen in unbekannten Gebieten. Du bist die treibende Kraft, agierst innovativ und hinterfragst Bestehendes. Du willst rasch Verantwortung übernehmen und bist bereit, die Extrameile zu gehen. Darüber hinaus hast Du ein hohes Interesse an unserem Gesundheitsmarkt, denkst unternehmerisch und willst die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.

Deine Qualifikationen

• Hervorragend abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (wirtschafts- oder naturwissenschaftlicher Studiengang)

• Relevante Praxiserfahrung durch Praktika oder bis zu 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens dreimonatige Auslandserfahrung (außerhalb DACH-Region)

• Affinität für Digitalisierung und den medizinischen Wert der Diagnostik

• Verhandlungssicheres Englisch sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, soziale Kompetenz, Zielstrebigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Nachweisbares Engagement über das Studium hinaus (Ehrenamt, Sport etc.)

Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser!

• Lerne von den Besten: Profitiere von maßgeschneiderten Trainings und exklusiven Coachingangeboten, die wir speziell für unsere Trainee-Community entwickelt haben.

• Networking auf Augenhöhe: Werde Teil unseres lebendigen Trainee-Netzwerks. Bei uns gibt es kein „Einzelkämpfer-Dasein“ – regelmäßige Events und Networking-Sessions gehören fest dazu.

• Rundum abgesichert & fit: Vielfältige Sport- und Vorsorgeangebote oder smarte Lösungen für deine Altersvorsorge – wir investieren in deine Gesundheit und deine finanzielle Zukunft.

Neugierig auf

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) is a global business organization of more than 3,700 employees dedicated to transforming Roche's operations. Our mission is to provide innovative business services and solutions to our customers/partners, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. We enable Roche to thrive in a competitive and constantly evolving business landscape in areas ranging from Finance and procurement to regulatory affairs to analytics and automation. Roche Services & Solutions operates from various strategic locations across the world, including Costa Rica, Hungary, India, Latvia, Malaysia and Switzerland. Discover the Roche Services & Solutions Center and how we work together as a truly global team!

The Opportunity
As the RSS Enablement Operations Manager, you will work in a dynamic global environment ensuring seamless communication, efficient operations, and alignment of strategic priorities across RSS. This will include the planning of annual key RSS events, as well as the follow up on agreed action items and RSS LT deliverables. You will directly manage projects and initiatives and lead the RSS enabling support team.

Your key responsibilities:

• Act as the main enabling role to the Head of RSS Strategy and Enablement and the RSS leadership team; this includes developing and supporting the creation of management materials, such as presentations, memos, strategy documents, and content as needed.

• Coordinate the strategic calendar of global RSS events, such as (extended) leadership team meetings, site visits, forecasting events, operational and financial check-ins, etc.

• Ensure the definition of the RSS Leadership team agendas for regular meetings, and ensure appropriate documentation of outcomes, as well as follow up for agreed action items

• Utilise your expertise and experience to lead and guide strategic projects

• Support the annual planning cycle for RSS, including strategy and roadmap reviews, as well as the regular / quarterly review of OKRs in RSS

• Lead and develop the RSS enabling support team

Who you are

• You hold a university degree in business or a similar field and have 5-8 years of professional experience, ideally gained in business services organisation or healthcare industry or in strategy consulting.

• You have a proven track record in a role or through consulting engagements supporting a senior leader or leadership team, driving change, harmonization, and alignment.

• You have proven ability to communicate difficult or complex business-related concepts and influence others (including senior stakeholders) to adopt a new or complementary view, approach, or way of working.

• You have advanced skills creating management-level presentations, including effective storyboarding, content creation, and the ability to translate complex ideas and topics into accessible output for various audiences.

• You have strong business acumen, including a solid understanding and comfort with principles of finance, strategic planning, organisational development, and benchmarking.

• You are known for your ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams, and your agility to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• You are open-minded and inclusive, generously sharing ideas and knowledge, while being receptive to ideas and feedback from others.

• You are fluent in English to a Business level; knowledge of German is a strong advantage.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Togethe

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) è un'organizzazione aziendale globale di oltre 3.700 dipendenti dedicata alla trasformazione delle operazioni di Roche. La nostra missione è quella di fornire servizi e soluzioni aziendali innovative ai nostri clienti/partner, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Permettiamo a Roche di prosperare in un panorama aziendale competitivo e in continua evoluzione in settori che vanno dalla finanza e dall'approvvigionamento alle questioni regolamentari all'analisi e all'automazione. Roche Services & Solutions opera da diverse sedi strategiche in tutto il mondo, tra cui Costa Rica, Ungheria, India, Lettonia, Malesia e Svizzera. Scopri il Roche Services & Solutions Center e come lavoriamo insieme come team veramente globale! L'Opportunità Come RSS Enablement Operations Manager, lavorerai in un ambiente globale dinamico che garantisca una comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità, operazioni efficienti e allineamento delle priorità strategiche attraverso RSS. Questo includerà la pianificazione di eventi chiave annuali RSS, così come il follow up su oggetti d'azione concordati e RSS LT consegnabili. Gestirai direttamente progetti e iniziative e guiderai il team di supporto RSS abilitante. Le tue responsabilità principale: - Atto come il ruolo principale che consente al Capo della Strategia RSS e dell'Abilitazione e al team di leadership RSS; questo include lo sviluppo e il supporto della creazione di materiali di gestione, come presentazioni, memo, documenti di strategia e contenuti secondo le necessità. - Coordinare il calendario strategico degli eventi RSS globali, come (esteso) incontri di team di leadership, visite di siti, eventi di previsione, check-in operativo e finanziario, ecc. - Assicurare la definizione degli ordini del team di RSS Leadership per riunioni regolari, e garantire la documentazione appropriata dei risultati, così come seguire per gli elementi d'azione concordati - Utilizzare la vostra competenza e l'esperienza per condurre e guidare i progetti strategici - Supporta il ciclo di pianificazione annuale per il trimestre RSS, tra cui strategia e roadmap Hai una laurea in economia o in un campo simile e hai 5-8 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente acquisita nell'organizzazione di servizi aziendali o nell'industria sanitaria o nella consulenza strategica. - No. Hai un record di traccia provata in un ruolo o attraverso la consulenza di impegni che supportano un senior leader o team di leadership, il cambiamento di guida, l'armonizzazione e l'allineamento. - No. Hai dimostrato la capacità di comunicare concetti aziendali difficili o complessi e influenzare gli altri (compresi gli stakeholder senior) per adottare una nuova o complementare visione, approccio o modo di lavorare. - No. Hai competenze avanzate che creano presentazioni a livello di gestione, tra cui storyboard efficace, creazione di contenuti, e la capacità di tradurre idee complesse e argomenti in output accessibile per vari pubblico. - No. Hai un forte acume aziendale, tra cui una solida comprensione e comfort con principi di finanza, pianificazione strategica, sviluppo organizzativo e benchmarking. - No. Siete noti per la vostra capacità di influenzare e collaborare efficacemente tra i team, e la vostra agilità di adattarsi a cambiare le priorità in un ambiente veloce. - No. Sei aperto e inclusivo, generosamente condividere idee e conoscenze, pur essendo ricettivo a idee e feedback da altri. - No. Sei fluente in inglese a livello aziendale; la conoscenza del tedesco è un forte vantaggio. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. A

descriptionByLocale.de: Descrizione Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. La Posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) ist eine globale Unternehmensorganisation mit mehr als 3.700 Mitarbeitern, die sich der Transformation der Geschäftstätigkeit von Roche widmet. Unsere Mission ist es, unseren Kunden/Partnern innovative Geschäftsdienstleistungen und Lösungen anzubieten, damit sie sich auf patientenzentrierte Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. Wir ermöglichen Roche, in einer wettbewerbsorientierten und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Geschäftslandschaft in Bereichen von Finanzen und Beschaffung über regulatorische Angelegenheiten bis hin zu Analysen und Automatisierung zu gedeihen. Roche Services & Solutions operiert von verschiedenen strategischen Standorten auf der ganzen Welt aus, darunter Costa Rica, Ungarn, Indien, Lettland, Malaysia und die Schweiz. Entdecken Sie das Roche Services & Solutions Center und wie wir als wirklich globales Team zusammenarbeiten! L'Opportunità Als RSS Enablement Operations Manager arbeiten Sie in einer dynamischen globalen Umgebung, die eine nahtlose Kommunikation, einen effizienten Betrieb und die Ausrichtung der strategischen Prioritäten auf RSS gewährleistet. Dies umfasst die Planung von jährlichen wichtigen RSS-Events sowie die Weiterverfolgung der vereinbarten Aktionspunkte und RSS LT-Ergebnisse. Sie werden Projekte und Initiativen direkt verwalten und das RSS-Unterstützungsteam leiten. Le tue responsabilità principali: - Handeln Sie als Hauptfunktion für den Leiter der RSS-Strategie und -Enablement und das RSS-Führungsteam; dazu gehört die Entwicklung und Unterstützung der Erstellung von Managementmaterialien wie Präsentationen, Memos, Strategiedokumenten und Inhalten nach Bedarf. - Koordinieren Sie den strategischen Kalender globaler RSS-Veranstaltungen, wie (erweiterte) Treffen von Führungsteams, Besuche vor Ort, Vorhersageereignisse, operative und finanzielle Check-ins usw. - Sicherstellen der Festlegung der Tagesordnungen des RSS-Führungsteams für regelmäßige Treffen und sorgen Sie für eine angemessene Dokumentation der Ergebnisse sowie für die Nachverfolgung vereinbarter Maßnahmen - Nutzen Sie Ihre Expertise und Erfahrung, um strategische Projekte zu leiten und zu leiten - Unterstützen Sie den jährlichen Planungszyklus für RSS, einschließlich Strategie- und Roadmap-Überprüfungen sowie die regelmäßige / vierteljährliche Überprüfung von OKRs in RSS - Führen und entwickeln Sie das RSS-Unterstützungsteam Chi sei - Sie haben einen Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaft oder einem ähnlichen Bereich und verfügen über 5-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Unternehmensdienstleistungsorganisation oder Gesundheitsbranche oder in der Strategieberatung. - Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in einer Rolle oder durch Beratungseinsätze, die eine leitende Führungskraft oder ein Führungsteam unterstützen und Veränderungen, Harmonisierung und Ausrichtung vorantreiben. - Sie haben nachweislich die Fähigkeit, schwierige oder komplexe geschäftsbezogene Konzepte zu kommunizieren und andere (einschließlich leitender Stakeholder) dazu zu bewegen, eine neue oder ergänzende Sichtweise, einen neuen Ansatz oder eine neue Arbeitsweise anzunehmen. - Sie verfügen über fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen auf Managementebene, einschließlich effektivem Storyboarding, der Erstellung von Inhalten und der Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen und Themen in zugängliche Ergebnisse für verschiedene Zielgruppen zu übersetzen. - Sie haben einen starken Geschäftssinn, einschließlich eines soliden Verständnisses und Komforts mit Prinzipien der Finanzierung, strategischen Planung, Organisationsentwicklung und Benchmarking. - Sie sind bekannt für Ihre Fähigkeit, Teams effektiv zu beeinflussen und zusammenzuarbeiten, und Ihre Agilität, sich an sich ändernde Prioritäten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung anzupassen. - Sie sind aufgeschlossen und inklusiv, teilen großzügig Ideen und Wissen und sind gleichzeitig empfänglich für Ideen und Feedback von anderen. - Sie sprechen fließend Englisch auf Business-Niveau; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil. Chi siamo Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Togethe

jobs.title: Head of Supply Chain Karenzvertretung (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche ist ein führendes, globales Pharma- und Diagnostikunternehmen, das sich der Verbesserung der Gesundheit und Lebensqualität von Menschen weltweit verschrieben hat. Mit einem breiten Portfolio innovativer Produkte streben wir kontinuierlich danach, neue Maßstäbe in der medizinischen Versorgung zu setzen.

Für unseren Bereich Supply Chain und Customer Value Stream (Roche Pharma) suchen wir eine engagierte und strategisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit. In dieser Schlüsselposition übernimmst du die Leitung des Supply Chain Teams und agierst als zentrales Bindeglied für eine partnerschaftliche, kundenorientierte Zusammenarbeit entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette.

Die Position ist für die Dauer der Karenz befristet.

Was dich erwartet:
Supply Chain Leadership

• Verantwortung für den Bereich Supply Chain zur Gewährleistung der Liefer-& und Versorgungssicherheit

• Eigenständige Koordination von Projekten innerhalb der Abteilung und funktionsübergreifender Projekte unter Berücksichtigung aller Stakeholder

• Überwachung von KPIs und Analyse aller Aktivitäten und laufender Prozesse zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung

• Führung, Entwicklung und Motivation des österreichischen Supply Chain Teams inklusive einer vorausschauenden Ressourcenplanung um nachhaltigen Erfolg der Abteilung zu gewährleisten

• Priorisierung von Aufgaben auf Länder- und übergeordneter Ebene im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen sowie Sicherstellung aller internen und externen Regularien / Compliance Richtlinien

Customer Value Stream Partnering (CVSP)

• Identifikation von Veränderungen in der Gesundheitslandschaft zur Ermittlung von Wertschöpfungspotenzialen

• Bindeglied zwischen der globalen Supply Chain/Organisationen und den lokaler Affiliate

• Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des S&OP-Prozesses sowie anderer Prozesse (z. B. Business Partner Management) in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und lokalen Stakeholdern sowie Digitalisierung von Prozessen zur Steigerung der Kosteneffiziens

• Entwicklung und Steuerung einer kundennahen Großhandelsstrategie, Sicherstellung einer erstklassigen Customer Experience (inkl. Engagement-Plänen) sowie Vertretung der Kund:inneninteressen als internes Sprachrohr.

• Verantwortlichkeit für die 0–12M Volumen-Prognoseplanung der Fertigwaren unter Nutzung prädiktiver Analysen und Erkenntnisse sowie des SC O2C-Prozesses, einschließlich der kommerziellen Abstimmung mit Teams, Finance und dem Product Life-Cycle Management

Wer du bist:

• Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Supply Chain

• Starke Planungs- und Analysefähigkeiten sowie ganzheitliche Sicht auf unsere Geschäftsprozesse

• Führungserfahrung und Freude daran ein Team zu fördern und zu entwickeln

• Wissen über den österreichischen Pharmamarkt von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse von SAP-Systemen / anderen ERP-Systemen und Office-IT-Tools

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Es erwartet Dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 65.000€ brutto (auf Vollzeitbasis), sowie attraktive Benefits. Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Betriebsrestaurant, betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung und vielfältige Sportangebote sind nur einige davon. Abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche ist ein führendes, globales Pharma- und Diagnostikunternehmen, das sich der Verbesserung der Gesundheit und Lebensqualität von Menschen weltweit verschrieben hat. Mit einem breiten Portfolio innovativer Produkte streben wir kontinuierlich danach, neue Maßstäbe in der medizinischen Versorgung zu setzen. Für unseren Bereich Supply Chain und Customer Value Stream (Roche Pharma) suchen wir eine engagierte und strategisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit. In dieser Schlüsselposition übernimmst du die Leitung des Supply Chain Teams und agierst als zentrales Bindeglied für eine partnerschaftliche, kundenorientierte Zusammenarbeit entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Die Position ist für die Dauer der Karenz befristet. Was dich erwartet: Supply Chain Leadership
• Verantwortung für den Bereich Supply Chain zur Gewährleistung der Liefer-& und Versorgungssicherheit
• Eigenständige Koordination von Projekten innerhalb der Abteilung und funktionsübergreifender Projekte unter Berücksichtigung aller Stakeholder
• Überwachung von KPIs und Analyse aller Aktivitäten und laufender Prozesse zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung
• Führung, Entwicklung und Motivation des österreichischen Supply Chain Teams inklusive einer vorausschauenden Ressourcenplanung um nachhaltigen Erfolg der Abteilung zu gewährleisten
• Priorisierung von Aufgaben auf Länder- und übergeordneter Ebene im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen sowie Sicherstellung aller internen und externen Regularien / Compliance Richtlinien Customer Value Stream Partnering (CVSP)
• Identifikation von Veränderungen in der Gesundheitslandschaft zur Ermittlung von Wertschöpfungspotenzialen
• Bindeglied zwischen der globalen Supply Chain/Organisationen und den lokaler Affiliate
• Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des S&OP-Prozesses sowie anderer Prozesse (z. B. Business Partner Management) in Zusammenarbeit mit globalen und lokalen Stakeholdern sowie Digitalisierung von Prozessen zur Steigerung der Kosteneffiziens
• Entwicklung und Steuerung einer kundennahen Großhandelsstrategie, Sicherstellung einer erstklassigen Customer Experience (inkl. Engagement-Plänen) sowie Vertretung der Kund:inneninteressen als internes Sprachrohr.
• Verantwortlichkeit für die 0–12M Volumen-Prognoseplanung der Fertigwaren unter Nutzung prädiktiver Analysen und Erkenntnisse sowie des SC O2C-Prozesses, einschließlich der kommerziellen Abstimmung mit Teams, Finance und dem Product Life-Cycle Management Wer du bist:
• Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Supply Chain
• Starke Planungs- und Analysefähigkeiten sowie ganzheitliche Sicht auf unsere Geschäftsprozesse
• Führungserfahrung und Freude daran ein Team zu fördern und zu entwickeln
• Wissen über den österreichischen Pharmamarkt von Vorteil
• Kenntnisse von SAP-Systemen / anderen ERP-Systemen und Office-IT-Tools
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Es erwartet Dich ein Jahresgehalt ab € 65.000€ brutto (auf Vollzeitbasis), sowie attraktive Benefits. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Who are we

Doing now what patients need next.

Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) :

We believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action. And we believe that good business means a better world.
That is why we come to work each day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigour, unassailable ethics, and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
We are proud of who we are, what we do, and how we do it. We are many, working as one across functions, across companies, and across the world.

pRED Clinical Operations:

Our North Star is to increase R&D Productivity and Patient Inclusivity. This is supported by our CO Strategy to deliver value for pRED CO and our portfolio. We aspire to be a leading edge Clinical Operations organisation that drives innovative patient-inclusive approaches in study design and execution, utilises advanced analytics to drive data-driven decisions, and embeds innovative technologies into our ways of working to improve productivity delivery of programs and studies. We strive to create a workplace where team members own their own development and learning and are empowered to create and innovate.

Contract Purpose:

As a contract Study Manager you will be assigned to pRED early phase clinical studies, and as part of a cross-functional study team, you will be responsible for delivering study management and clinical operations activities under the direction and leadership of a Study Management Team Leader.

Through your direct study responsibilities you will also contribute to the management of external stakeholder relationships by helping Roche to be the preferred sponsor for sites, patients and other important healthcare providers.

What you will do / Expectations during your assignment:

During your assignment you will participate as a member of the Study Management Team contributing to the delivery and execution of early phase study protocols. You will:

• DELIVER STUDY EXECUTION by providing operational expertise into protocol design and feasibility, country selection, patient centricity and data delivery plans in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Ensure study quality and integrity by developing and maintaining study systems and documentation (including informed consent forms, communication plan, Trial Monitoring Plan, Trial Master File etc).

• PROVIDE COUNTRY OVERSIGHT, for insourced studies, by supporting or managing feasibility assessments to ensure countries and sites are selected for participation in studies. Provide guidance to country operational representatives during studies to ensure countries start-up on time and deliver on their recruitment commitments.

• MANAGE VENDOR PERFORMANCE by providing direction and actively managing relationships. Ensure vendors and third-party suppliers deliver against contracted scope of work and performance expectations and adhere to all appropriate standards (including ICH/GCP, SOPs and other regulations).

• PLAN DEMAND AND SUPPLY by overseeing the forecasting and maintenance of supplies (including IMP) needed to ensure sites have the necessary resources to run clinical studies.
