jobs.title: Stagiaire - Departement Achat
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Le stagiaire agit en tant que facilitateur opérationnel pour garantir l'efficacité du processus achat, de la sélection du fournisseur au paiement final.

Responsabilités Principales
Support à la Conformité et Gestion des Risques
- Due Diligence Fournisseurs : Vérifier que les dossiers contiennent toutes les pièces justificatives requises (documents fiscaux, bancaires, etc.) avant le référencement.
- Suivi du Risque : Assister dans l'évaluation de la santé financière des partenaires (Due Diligence) pour minimiser les risques de défaillance.
- Garantir le strict respect des processus et des règles de conformité du groupe au sein de la filiale.

Facilitateur des Opérations Achat (Support Transactionnel)
- Point d'Entrée Utilisateurs : Servir de premier contact pour les clients internes sur les questions relatives aux processus et outils achats (SAP, Smartsheet).
- Gestion des Commandes et Litiges : Gérer les demandes d'achats indirects et collaborer avec la comptabilité pour résoudre les litiges factures.

Gestion Contractuelle et Bases de Données
- Cycle de vie des contrats : Suivre le circuit de signature des accords-cadres et assurer une alerte sur le renouvellement des contrats arrivant à échéance.
- Master Data : Piloter le référencement effectif et la mise à jour des fournisseurs dans SAP et les outils informatiques de la filiale.

Support au process achat
- Réaliser des analyses comparatives d'offres financières (RFI/RFQ) lors des appels d'offres.
- Aider les utilisateurs à respecter la procédure achat et les guider dans leurs achats courants.
- Actualisation du G-site achat destiné aux utilisateurs internes.

Qui vous etes?
Formation Requise
- Récemment diplômé(e) avec une spécialisation en Achats, Supply Chain, Gestion ou Management International.
- Une première expérience (stage ou projet associatif) en milieu corporatif est un plus, mais non obligatoire.
- Maîtrise courante du Français et de l'Anglais

Competences Requises
- Forte attention aux détails et esprit analytique
- Excellente communication verbale et écrite
- Gestion des Priorités et Organisation
- Appétence pour les Outils Informatiques. Une familiarité ou une forte volonté d'apprendre des outils de gestion (SAP, Smartsheet ou Google Sites) est essentielle.
- Esprit d'Équipe et Proactivité

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Are you seeking an exciting challenge in a critical support role that directly contributes to the vital NHS Pathology services, where your work truly matters and makes a meaningful impact?

Does the prospect of a rewarding career with a progressive, high-tech organisation inspire you?

Key Information

• Supporting Southern Counties Pathology Network (South 6)

• Ideal for experienced field engineers, with strong diagnostic service/support background

• Primary focus support for electro-mechanical hardware, including routine proactive and reactive maintenance.

• Additional responsibilities in applications support, IT support, and customer training

• Must reside in or be willing to relocate to the Hampshire/Dorset area

About the Role

Roche Diagnostics is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical Engineer to join our team as a Field Service Representative in the South region (Hampshire/Dorset area) directly supporting customers in NHS pathology laboratories.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide frontline support across various Roche product portfolio at customer sites.

• Troubleshoot and taking ownership of technical faults

• Minimise unplanned downtime of laboratory equipment

• Use of digital tools for proactive preventative measures

• Conduct training for laboratory staff

Required Qualifications and Skills

• Ideally, degree-educated in Life Sciences OR qualified to HNC/HND level in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or with equivalent demonstrable experience - you will bring a current and comprehensive understanding of the IVD industry, paired with strong experience in delivering world-class support

• E xcellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

• Strong communication and teamwork abilities

• Resilient and tenacious, able to thrive under pressure

• Growth mindset

For this position, the location is in the Hampshire/Dorset area.

You will be expected to collaborate with the wider team and all other areas of Roche to provide best-in-class service to our customers. Amongst other duties, this will involve attending customer review meetings to outline key achievements and objectives attained.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

titleByLocale.en: Internship in External Service Medical Technology (m/w/d)
titleByLocale.de: Praktikant:in im Service Außendienst Medizintechnik im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen (m/w/d)
titleByLocale.fr: Stage en Service Externe Technologie Médicale (H/F)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Was Dich erwartet:

Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen.

Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten.

Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen.

Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt.

Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet.

Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) .

Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:

• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).

• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.

• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.

• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.

• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.

• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).

• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.

• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.

• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi mostrarti come be, assegnato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi essere, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come vogliono prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare che tutti hanno accesso tutti cura oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Cosa ti aspetta: La diagnostica laboratoristica è il cuore del nostro sistema sanitario e di fondamentale importanza per ogni singolo paziente. Stime approssimative che il 70% di tutte le decisioni cliniche si basano su test di diagnostica in vitro. La assoluta affidabilità dei nostri sistemi è quindi la condizione base per diagnostica sicurezza e scelte mediche. Per il nostro programma di tirocinio stiamo cercando studenti motivati, tecnologicamente care e curiosi, che siano in grado di supportare concretamente il nostro team di servizio e di costruire con noi le basi per una di successo a Roche. Unisciti alla nostra organizzazione di servizio! Con molta energia, passione e spirito innovativo portando avanti la diagnostica laboratoristica in Germania e stiamo attivamente plasmare il futuro del sistema sanitario. A Roche puoi portare ogni giorno le do idee e il tuo sapere teorico e pratico per risolvere questioni complesse nel team. Come tirocinante (m/w/d) seguirai i nostri collaboratori esperti nella pianificazione, installazione, manutenzione e modifica dei nostri sistemi di analisi cobas® pro e cobas® pure. Inoltre, immergerai profondamente la connessione IT dei nostri sistemi. Durante le do missioni quotidiane in diversi ospedali e laboratori privati, la tua iniziativa personale, la tua orientamento al cliente e le do abilità tecniche saranno richieste. Il tuo perfetto inizio: all'inizio del tuo tirocinio riceve un'addestramento fondato sulle nostre immunologia cobas®-systeme e sarai seguito da un mentore fermo o una mentore durante tutto il tuo impiego esterno. Sarai impiegato nella regione di Niedersachsen, Amburgo, Brema e potrai godere della libertà di scegliere il tuo luogo di residenza all'interno di questo territorio (ideale che sia nella regione di Amburgo, Hannover, Brema). I seguenti punti saranno al centro del tuo tirocinio nel servizio esterno:
• Formazione professionale: assolverai un addestramento di manutenzione specializzata a due moduli di immuno (cobas® e402 e cobas® e801) nel mese di settembre (28.09. - 02.10.2026).
• Pratica tecnica: dimostraerai le do abilità manuali e tecniche direttamente durante le installazioni di apparecchiature e le manutenzioni pregiudizi.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Was Dich erwartet: Die Labordiagnostik ist das Herzstück unseres Gesundheitswesens und von entscheidender Bedeutung für jeden einzelnen Patienten. Schätzungsweise 70 % aller klinischen Entscheidungen basieren auf In-vitro-diagnostischen Tests. Die absolute Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme ist daher die Grundvoraussetzung für sichere Diagnosen und medizinische Weichenstellungen. Für unser Praktikantenprogramm suchen wir motivierte, technologiebegeisterte und wissbegierige Studierende, die unser Service-Team tatkräftig unterstützen und gemeinsam mit uns den Grundstein für eine erfolgreiche Karriere bei Roche legen möchten. Werde Teil unserer dynamischen Serviceorganisation! Mit viel Energie, Leidenschaft und Innovationsgeist bringen wir die Labordiagnostik in Deutschland voran und gestalten die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mit. Bei uns kannst Du tagtäglich Deine eigenen Ideen und Dein theoretisches und praktisches Wissen einbringen, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen im Team zu lösen. Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) begleitest Du unsere erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden bei der Planung, Installation, Wartung und Modifikation unserer Analysensysteme cobas® pro und cobas® pure . Darüber hinaus tauchst Du tief in die IT-Vernetzung unserer Systeme ein. Bei den täglichen Einsätzen in verschiedenen Krankenhaus- und Privatlaboren sind Deine Eigeninitiative, Deine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Dein technisches Geschick gefragt. Dein perfekter Start: Zu Beginn Deines Praktikums erhältst Du eine fundierte Ausbildung auf unseren Immunologie cobas®-Systemen und wirst während Deines gesamten Außendiensteinsatzes von einem festen Mentor oder einer Mentorin intensiv begleitet. Du wirst im Raum Niedersachsen, Hamburg, Bremen eingesetzt und genießt die Freiheit, Deinen Wohnort innerhalb dieses Gebiets frei zu wählen (idealerweise im Raum Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen ) . Folgende Schwerpunkte erwarten Dich bei Deinem Praktikum im Service Außendienst:
• Professionelles Training: Du absolvierst im September (28.09. – 02.10.2026) ein spezialisiertes Wartungstraining an zwei Immunologie-Modulen ( cobas® e402 und cobas® e801 ).
• Praktische Technik: Du stellst Dein handwerkliches und technisches Geschick direkt bei Geräteinstallationen und präventiven Wartungen unter Beweis.
• Problem-Solving: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in die Analyse sowie Behebung komplexer technischer und applikativer Fragestellungen und unterstützt unser Team aktiv bei der Ursachenforschung.
• Perspektivenwechsel: Du fokussierst Dich auf die Bereiche Klinische Chemie und Immunologie, hast jedoch jederzeit die Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen auch andere spannende Unternehmensbereiche kennenzulernen.
• Zukunftsthema IT: IT-Netzwerke und IT-Sicherheit wecken Deinen Ehrgeiz – bei der Installation von Firewalls lernst Du direkt von unseren IT-Spezialisten.
• Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Deine organisatorischen Fähigkeiten ein und übernimmst selbstständig definierte Aufgabenpakete (z. B. die professionelle Einweisung unserer Kunden in die Nutzung unserer Online-Plattform Navify ).
• Kommunikationstalent: Du schärfst Deine Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im direkten Dialog mit unseren Kunden sowie bei der kollegialen Abstimmung im Team.
• Flexibilität: Kleinere Projektaufgaben bearbeitest Du ganz flexibel an einzelnen Tagen im Homeoffice. Die meiste Zeit bist Du jedoch dort, wo unsere Geräte stehen: direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kunden.
• Wachstumsumfeld: Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives und wertschätzendes Praktik

jobs.title: Solution Architect, Global Supply Chain
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In alignment with our core corporate purpose—"Doing now what patients need next"—the Solution Architect provides strategic technical leadership and architectural governance to optimize our global supply chain and logistics systems. This critical role acts as the primary conduit between complex operational requirements and enterprise digital ecosystems, ensuring our warehouse management, material tracking, and cold-chain infrastructure remain scalable, resilient, and fully compliant.

The Opportunity
This position champions an integrated, system-wide approach focused on three core imperatives:

• Architectural Blueprinting: Design and govern the end-to-end technical architecture for warehouse operations, integrating ERP, WMS, and automated data monitoring tools.

• Operational Integrity: Ensure all technical platforms satisfy regulatory compliance boundaries while safeguarding the continuity of supply.

• Digital Transformation: Catalyze the modernization of legacy supply chain systems, introducing advanced automation, predictive data models, and unified communication matrices across local and external partner networks.

What You Do

• Formulate and articulate a compelling, long-term technical vision for our supply chain infrastructure, ensuring software systems scale seamlessly with product portfolio growth.

• Actively monitor and anticipate shifts in enterprise cloud capabilities, digital compliance requirements, and IoT tracking frameworks to engineer future-proof architectures.

• Author comprehensive architectural blueprints that seamlessly unify operational warehouse management systems (Exacta, Syncro, SAP) with global material planning frameworks (ERP / SAP), optimizing data synchronization and transaction velocity

• Partner with the Data Insights team to design well structured and real-time metric dashboards, enabling automated reporting.

• Act as an enterprise technical advisor to cross-functional teams, translating complex architectural choices into practical, operational realities for business stakeholders.

• Influence internal development teams and third-party vendors to adhere to rigid architectural standards, prioritizing continuous system refinement and robust cyber-security posture.

• Serve as the core technical connector bridging Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Global Logistics, and Corporate IT networks to eliminate digital friction.

• Lead the technical risk mitigation strategies required during the deployment of automated high-density storage platforms, cloud migrations, or shifting network structures.

• Design and maintain scalable system architectures that integrate core warehouse operations with peripheral data layers, emphasizing system uptime, data redundancy, and robust API frameworks.

• Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with enterprise software vendors and external integrators, ensuring deliverables satisfy rigorous service level agreements (SLAs).

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Systems, or a related technical discipline.

• 5-8+ years of progressive experience in enterprise solution architecture and/or data engineering with documented success designing integrations for ERP (e.g., SAP) and modern Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) within high-density logistics networks.

Preferred Technical Credentials & Skills

• Architectural Frameworks: Certified in TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or

jobs.title: Inbound & Storage Senior Supervisor - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
In this role you will be accountable for setting the direction and strategy for assigned team. Continually assesses daily process flows with the goal of implementing improvements to increase efficiency, improve customer experience, and meet the Supply Chain “On Time and In Full” (OTIF) KPIs. Collaborates and aligns with manager on direction and improvement of team processes to ensure objectives, timelines, and all requirements are achieved (including but not limited to local, regional, & global regulations, finance, tax, safety, environmental, transportation, Customs, and internal company standard requirements). Devotes a significant amount of time to leading employees, overseeing both the day-to-day operations and long term goals for assigned team. Provides feedback to the manager on employees' work performance and has input into employment decisions. Responsible for managing to a prescribed budget, training and development of staff, resource management, work assignments, interprets and ensures consistent application of organizational policies. Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Demonstrate strong customer focused skills. May have responsibilities that covers multiple shifts, warehouses and/or team leads. Responsible for hiring and onboarding of new employees.

What You Do:

• Lead shift activities across Inbound and Storage operations, driving inventory replenishment efforts for effective global distribution while ensuring the proper handling of sensitive materials.

• Participate in project teams as both a functional subject matter expert and an operational representative to drive site logistics success.

• Maintain hands-on operational agility by mastering the functional responsibilities of the team, ensuring the ability to step in and support daily business continuity when needed.

• Collaborate with management and key stakeholders to align daily execution with broader organizational requirements, milestones, and strategic goals.

• Develop and monitor operational KPIs to ensure optimal team performance, inventory accuracy, and workflow efficiency.

• Schedule: 2nd Shift, Monday through Friday, 13:30 - 22:00

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Science, Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field (or 4 years of related experience while actively pursuing a degree).

• Demonstrated leadership skills in managing key project objectives to achieve high-level organizational benefits and continuous improvement.

• Excellent communication (oral and written), interpersonal, and organizational skills.

• Proficient with Google Workspace/Office Suite and analytical tools.

Preferred Experience:

• 2+ years of supervisory or leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to motivate teams and foster collaboration.

• Experience with SAP, EWM, and other warehouse management systems (WMS).

• Strong cultural awareness and the ability to work effectively across multi-cultural and cross-functional teams.

• Customer service-oriented with the ability to support clients within a complex, global, and regulated environment.

• Proven ability to work in a fast

titleByLocale.fr: Soutien à la commercialisation (étudiant en cours d'emploi)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Role Overview
We are seeking a motivated and organized Working Student to join our Marketing department. In this part-time role, you will support our team across various marketing initiatives, from administrative tasks to digital media campaigns and creative coordination. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic diagnostics environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Administrative Support:

• Purchase Order (PO) creation and new vendor setup.

• General administrative support.

• Marketing Coordination:

• Coordinating product-related updates and communications across the Product Management team.

• Coordinating Marketing Team Meetings and corresponding tasks.

• Digital & Social Media:

• Creating content for social media channels and influencer campaigns.

• Facilitating communication with agencies and external partners.

• Marketing Materials Creation:

• Executing simple graphic design tasks.

• Performing translation checks.

Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a university degree program (e.g., Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field).

• Interested in healthcare and diagnostics.

• Fluent in English.

• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to balance administrative tasks with creative projects.

• Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Compensation & Benefits
The expected minimum hourly rate for this position, based on the primary location of Bratislava Pribinova is From 7 EUR gross / hour. Pay for this position will be pro-rated for the contracted working hours. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sr. Corporate Counsel, US Privacy

titleByLocale.it: Senior Corporate Counsel, Privacy negli Stati Uniti
titleByLocale.fr: Conseil Juridique Principal, Confidentialité aux États-Unis

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

We believe in the potential of science, data and insights to improve the standard of care for humankind. We also believe the right to privacy is a fundamental human right. We process personal data with due care. Team members of the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team contribute their talents with a strong focus on collaboration and teamwork to support Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, North America affiliates and Group colleagues on privacy and digital legal matters.

As Senior Counsel, US Privacy, you would join our North America Digital & Privacy team to play a key role in providing legal advice on a wide range of matters related to data protection, digital initiatives, US privacy laws and regulations, and data governance.

The Opportunity

○ Provide guidance to key stakeholders including, other Legal and Compliance colleagues, the business and the Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy team in order to support the organizations’ compliance with US state and federal privacy laws (e.g., HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, TCPA), and other applicable data protection and privacy laws and regulations. Such guidance may include:
• ○ Review privacy impact assessments for new projects and technologies and advise on risk mitigation strategies.
• ○ Support the Diagnostics US Privacy Office in developing and maintaining policies, procedure and communications.
• ○ Develop and conduct training programs for our Legal and Compliance colleagues and other workforce members on compliance with data privacy laws and best practices for data governance.
• ○ Review and negotiate contracts with third parties, ensuring that data protection and privacy clauses align with Roche’s policies and positions.
• ○ Advise and support during the response to a suspected Breach or other data privacy incidents, including internal investigations and advising on notification and reporting obligations.
• ○ Stay updated on applicable cybersecurity requirements, new digital technologies like blockchain, AI, and the Internet of Things and advise on their legal implications.
○ Develop and maintain networks by working closely with other Legal and Compliance colleagues, IT security, People & Culture, Finance, Support Services, and other business teams to ensure a cohesive approach to US data protection and digital operations.

Who You Are

You are someone who has:

● A Doctor of Jurisprudence from an ABA-accredited law school, licensed to practice law in one or more of the 50 states in good standing.
● At least eight (8) years’ experience practicing law at a large- to medium-sized law firm or experience within a privacy, compliance, legal or contracting department in a Life Sciences company (i.e., Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech).
● Knowledge of, and working experience advising on data privacy and digital matters, federal, state, and international information security and privacy laws, rules, regulations, and industry standards (such as HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR).
● Experience reviewing, drafting, and negotiating; experience with information security and privacy provisions in agreements, Business Associate Agreements and data transfer or processing agreements is preferred.
● A demonstrated ability to establish and maintain open, candid, collaborative, and trusting work relationships.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Crediamo nel potenziale della scienza, dei dati e delle intuizioni per migliorare lo standard di cura per l'umanità. Crediamo anche che il diritto alla privacy sia un diritto umano fondamentale. Elaboriamo i dati personali con la dovuta cura. I membri del team Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy contribuiscono al loro talento con una forte attenzione alla collaborazione e al lavoro di squadra per supportare le aree clienti diagnostiche Roche, le affiliate del Nord America e i colleghi del Gruppo sulla privacy e questioni legali digitali. In qualità di Senior Counsel, US Privacy, si unirà al nostro team North America Digital & Privacy per svolgere un ruolo chiave nel fornire consulenza legale su una vasta gamma di questioni relative alla protezione dei dati, iniziative digitali, leggi e regolamenti sulla privacy degli Stati Uniti e la governance dei dati. Opportunità - Fornire una guida ai principali stakeholder, tra cui, altri colleghi legali e di conformità, il business e il team Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy al fine di supportare la conformità delle organizzazioni alle leggi sulla privacy degli Stati Uniti e federali (ad esempio, HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, TCPA), e altre leggi e regolamenti sulla privacy applicabili. Tali orientamenti possono includere: - Valutazione dell'impatto sulla privacy per nuovi progetti e tecnologie e consulenza sulle strategie di mitigazione del rischio. - Supporta l'Ufficio per la privacy degli Stati Uniti per lo sviluppo e il mantenimento di politiche, procedure e comunicazioni. - Sviluppare e condurre programmi di formazione per i nostri colleghi Legali e Compliance e altri membri della forza lavoro nel rispetto delle leggi sulla privacy dei dati e delle migliori pratiche per la governance dei dati. - Verificare e negoziare i contratti con terze parti, assicurando che le clausole sulla protezione dei dati e sulla privacy si allineino alle politiche e alle posizioni di Roche. - consulenza e supporto durante la risposta a un presunto Breach o ad altri incidenti sulla privacy dei dati, comprese le indagini interne e la consulenza sugli obblighi di notifica e segnalazione. - Resta aggiornato sui requisiti di sicurezza informatica applicabili, le nuove tecnologie digitali come blockchain, AI e Internet of Things e consiglia sulle loro implicazioni legali. - Sviluppare e mantenere le reti lavorando a stretto contatto con altri colleghi Legali e Compliance, Sicurezza IT, People & Culture, Finanza, Servizi di Supporto e altri team aziendali per garantire un approccio coeso alla protezione dei dati e alle operazioni digitali degli Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Descrizione Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. La Posizione Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Wir glauben an das Potenzial von Wissenschaft, Daten und Erkenntnissen, um den Standard der Versorgung der Menschheit zu verbessern. Wir glauben auch, dass das Recht auf Privatsphäre ein grundlegendes Menschenrecht ist. Wir verarbeiten personenbezogene Daten mit der gebotenen Sorgfalt. Teammitglieder des Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy-Teams bringen ihre Talente mit einem starken Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit und Teamarbeit ein, um Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, Nordamerika-Tochtergesellschaften und Gruppenkollegen bei Datenschutz und digitalen Rechtsfragen zu unterstützen. Als Senior Counsel, US Privacy, würden Sie unserem North America Digital & Privacy-Team beitreten, um eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bereitstellung von Rechtsberatung in einer Vielzahl von Fragen im Zusammenhang mit Datenschutz, digitalen Initiativen, US-Datenschutzgesetzen und -vorschriften und Data Governance zu spielen. Opportunità - Bereitstellung von Leitlinien für wichtige Interessengruppen, darunter andere Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen, das Unternehmen und das Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy-Team, um die Einhaltung der US-amerikanischen Datenschutzgesetze (z. B. HIPAA, CCPA / CPRA, TCPA) und anderer anwendbarer Datenschutz- und Datenschutzgesetze und -vorschriften zu unterstützen. Diese Leitlinien können Folgendes umfassen: - Überprüfung der Datenschutzfolgenabschätzungen für neue Projekte und Technologien und Beratung zu Strategien zur Risikominderung. Unterstützung des Diagnostics US Privacy Office bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Verfahren und Kommunikation. - Entwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungsprogrammen für unsere Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen und andere Mitarbeiter zur Einhaltung der Datenschutzgesetze und Best Practices für Data Governance. - Überprüfung und Verhandlung von Verträgen mit Dritten, um sicherzustellen, dass Datenschutz- und Datenschutzklauseln mit den Richtlinien und Positionen von Roche übereinstimmen. - Beratung und Unterstützung bei der Reaktion auf einen vermuteten Verstoß oder andere Datenschutzvorfälle, einschließlich interner Untersuchungen und Beratung bei Benachrichtigungs- und Berichtspflichten. Bleiben Sie über die geltenden Cybersicherheitsanforderungen, neue digitale Technologien wie Blockchain, KI und das Internet der Dinge auf dem Laufenden und beraten Sie über ihre rechtlichen Auswirkungen. - Aufbau und Pflege von Netzwerken durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Rechts- und Compliance-Kollegen, IT-Sicherheit, People & Culture, Finanzen, Support Services und anderen Geschäftsteams, um einen kohärenten Ansatz für den Datenschutz und den digitalen Betrieb in den USA zu gewährleisten.
• Requisiti - Ein Doktor der Jurisprudenz von einer ABA-akkreditierten juristischen Fakultät, lizenziert, um Recht in einem oder mehreren der 50 Staaten in gutem Ansehen zu üben. - Mindestens acht (8) Jahre Erfahrung in der Rechtspraxis in einer großen bis mittleren Anwaltskanzlei oder Erfahrung in einer Datenschutz-, Compliance-, Rechts- oder Vertragsabteilung in einem Life Sciences-Unternehmen (d. H. Pharma, Diagnostics, Devices, Biotech). - Kenntnis und Berufserfahrung in Bezug auf Datenschutz und digitale Angelegenheiten, Bundes-, Landes- und internationale Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzgesetze, Regeln, Vorschriften und Industriestandards (wie HIPAA, CCPA, DSGVO). - Erfahrung bei der Überprüfung, Erstellung und Verhandlung; Erfahrung mit Informationssicherheits- und Datenschutzbestimmungen in Vereinbarungen, Geschäftspartnervereinbarungen und Datenübertragungs- oder Verarbeitungsvereinbarungen wird bevorzugt. Eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, offene, offene, kooperative und vertrauensvolle Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und aufrechtzuerhalten. - Die Fähigkeit, ein unabhängiges Urteilsvermögen auszuüben und eine konsistente Botschaft angesichts von Druck oder Widrigkeiten zu vermitteln und mit Vertrauen zu arbeiten und zu pflegen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Nous croyons au potentiel de la science, des données et des idées pour améliorer le niveau de soins pour l'humanité. Nous croyons également que le droit à la vie privée est un droit fondamental de la personne. Nous traitons les données personnelles avec soin. Les membres de l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy apportent leurs talents en mettant fortement l'accent sur la collaboration et le travail d'équipe pour soutenir Roche Diagnostic Customer Areas, les affiliés nord-américains et les collègues du Groupe sur les questions de confidentialité et de droit numérique. En tant qu'avocat principal, United States Privacy, vous vous joindriez à notre équipe North America Digital & Privacy pour jouer un rôle clé dans la prestation de conseils juridiques sur un large éventail de questions liées à la protection des données, aux initiatives numériques, aux lois et règlements américains sur la protection de la vie privée et à la gouvernance des données. Opportunità - Fournir des conseils aux intervenants clés, y compris aux autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, à l'entreprise et à l'équipe de Roche Diagnostics North America Digital & Privacy afin de soutenir les organisations. Ces lignes directrices peuvent comprendre : - Examiner les évaluations des répercussions sur la vie privée des nouveaux projets et des nouvelles technologies et donner des conseils sur les stratégies d'atténuation des risques. - Soutenir le Diagnostics US Privacy Office dans l'élaboration et le maintien de politiques, procédures et communications. - Élaborer et diriger des programmes de formation à l'intention de nos collègues juridiques et de conformité et d'autres membres de l'effectif sur la conformité aux lois sur la protection des données et aux pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance des données. - Examiner et négocier des contrats avec des tiers, en veillant à ce que les clauses de protection des données et de protection de la vie privée soient conformes aux politiques et aux positions de Roches. - Conseiller et appuyer pendant la réponse à une infraction présumée ou à d'autres incidents liés à la confidentialité des données, y compris les enquêtes internes et donner des conseils sur les obligations de notification et de déclaration. - Restez à jour sur les exigences applicables en matière de cybersécurité, les nouvelles technologies numériques comme la blockchain, l'IA et l'Internet des objets et donnez des conseils sur leurs implications juridiques. - Développer et maintenir les réseaux en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec d'autres collègues juridiques et de conformité, la sécurité informatique, People & Culture, Finance, Services de soutien, et d'autres équipes d'affaires pour assurer une approche cohérente de la protection des données américaines et des opérations numériques.
• Requisiti - Docteur en droit d'une école de droit agréée par l'ABA, autorisée à pratiquer le droit dans un ou plusieurs des 50 États en règle. - Oui. Au moins huit (8) ans d'expérience pratique du droit dans un grand ou moyen cabinet d'avocats ou expérience au sein d'un service de protection de la vie privée, de conformité, juridique ou contractuel dans une entreprise des sciences de la vie (p. ex., Pharma, Diagnostics, Appareils, Biotech). - Connaissance des lois, des règles, des règlements et des normes de l'industrie sur la protection des données et les questions numériques, ainsi que sur la sécurité de l'information et la protection de la vie privée à l'échelle fédérale, des États et internationale (comme HIPAA, CCPA, RGPD). - Expérience de l'examen, de la rédaction et de la négociation; l'expérience des dispositions relatives à la sécurité de l'information et à la protection des renseignements personnels dans les accords, les accords commerciaux associés et les accords de transfert ou de traitement de données est privilégiée. - Une capacité démontrée d'établir et de maintenir des relations de travail ouvertes, franches, collaboratives et confiantes. - Oui. Capacité à exercer un jugement indépendant et à transmettre un message cohérent face à la pression ou à l'adversité, et à travailler avec et maintenir la confiance

jobs.title: Practicante - Legal & Compliance
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
xt

En Roche estamos buscando talento dispuesto a tomar retos innovar con proyectos, e interactuar con la diversidad con la que cuenta nuestro equipo multidisciplinar.

Si eres estudiante de últimos semestres de Derecho consideras que tienes un nivel de inglés B2 - C2 y te interesa explorar el área de Legal & Compliance ( Derecho Corporativo); te invitamos a que hagas parte de este equipo.
Donde harás parte de proyectos críticos y de impacto para el negocio, en temas de Compliance, apoyando en elaboración de documentos legales, apoyo en investigaciones legales y monitoreo del cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y Códigos de ética de la industria.

¿Qué harías?

• Elaborar documentos legales atendiendo la operatividad del negocio y regulaciones locales.

• Apoyar al Legal & Compliance Business Partner Pharma en diversas tareas incluidas la realización de investigaciones legales, redacción y revisión de documentos.

• Preparar sesiones de capacitación en asuntos legales, regulatorios y de compliance, cuando sea requeridas.

• Apoyar a los diferentes Legal & Compliance Business Partners Pharma/DIA/DC en la implementación de los mandatos legales y éticos aplicables en Colombia, a través de herramientas innovadoras.

• Realizar y acompañar las labores de monitoreo y seguimiento al cumplimiento de las acciones correctivas y preventivas que correspondan para el cabal cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas, regulaciones locales y código de ética de la industria farmacéutica de AFIDRO y normas vigentes.

• Soportar las labores que tengan impacto legal corporativo y comercial que requiera el negocio tales como elaboración de Actas de Junta directiva, modificaciones estatutarias, otorgamiento de poderes generales y especiales y sus correspondientes trámites ante las Autoridades.

• Apoyar en entrenamiento y consultas relacionadas con la herramienta de contratos ECML y el procedimiento de contratación.

¿Quién eres?

• Eres estudiante de últimos semestres de la carrera de Derecho.

• Tienes manejo de paquete de Microsoft Office.

• Tienes manejo de Inglés Intermedio - avanzado.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Pharma Technical Operations (PT) is responsible for manufacturing, supply chain, and quality across the pharmaceutical network. Within PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network.
Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT ensures our device-related products including platforms and packaging systems are robustly engineered, efficiently manufactured, and safely delivered and maintained.
The medical device platform team at Roche advances innovative drug delivery systems supporting Roche’s therapeutic, eye care and incretin portfolios. We are seeking a highly skilled Medical Device Platform Design Engineer to contribute to the design and maintenance of Autoinjector and/or PFS-Needle Safety Device platforms utilized in drug-device combination products.

The Opportunity

The successful candidate is a hands-on problem solver, a strategic thinker, and a trusted technical advisor who can both dive deep into engineering challenges and provide actionable guidance and feedback across Roche’s development and sustaining engineering lifecycles.

• Act as technical product design expert supporting product development and sustaining engineering teams throughout the platform-based combination product lifecycle.

• Provide professional mechanical engineering design expertise on multiple products, from concept generation and engineering analysis to both internally and externally utilized device design platform technologies.

• Interface with external suppliers and partners to provide technical oversight on the mechanical design of components and subassemblies used in combination products (prefilled syringes and autoinjectors), driving performance, accountability, and innovation.

• Lead reliability engineering assessments including edge-of-failure testing, variance management activities, tolerance sensitivity assessments, and creation/maintenance of Computer Aided Engineering models and digital twins for virtual analytical data collection.

• Actively seek out, anticipate, and solve significant functional and assembly related technical challenges of platform based Autoinjector and PFS-NSD combination products.

• Lead technical investigations, both within Roche as well as at third party manufacturers, for technical challenges related to design, manufacturing, and scale-up processes, to resolve device and assembly issues timely and effectively.

• Lead and participate in writing product and customer requirements, design and design phase reviews, product and process risk assessments, root cause investigations, and corrective action planning.

Who you are

This role is ideal for a versatile, self-motivated engineer with a broad technical design foundation and the ability to adapt quickly across disciplines, projects, and challenges.

• BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical degree with experience including in-depth understanding of prefilled syringes, Autoinjector, PFS-Needle Safety Device and/or novel drug delivery design and manufacturing processes

• Familiarity with materials science, particularly as it relates to drug delivery systems, including knowledge of damage mechanisms, common defects, and performance testing.

Ci concentriamo sull'integrazione della salute del prodotto, della salute del processo con adatte allo scopo e sulla prontezza delle strutture a supporto della rete di produzione. Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT garantisce che i nostri prodotti correlati ai dispositivi, inclusi piattaforme e sistemi di istruzione, siano ingegnerizzati in modo robusto, prodotti in modo efficiente e consegnati e mantenuti in sicurezza. Il team della piattaforma per dispositivi medici in Roche sviluppa sistemi innovativi di somministrazione di farmaci a supporto dei portafogli terapeutico, oftalmico e incretino di Roche.

Ich konzentriere mich auf die Integration des Produktions- und Prozessmanagements, das dem gesamten Umfang und der Struktur zur Unterstützung des Produktionsnetzwerks entspricht. Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT garantiert, dass unsere Produkte mit den verfügbaren Geräten in Zusammenhang stehen, einschließlich Formgebung und Liefersystemen, zuverlässigen Ingenieuren, effizienten Produkten und sicherer Handhabung und Wartung. Das Team der medizinischen Fachkräfte von Roche entwickelt ein innovatives landwirtschaftliches Managementsystem und unterstützt die therapeutischen Portefeuilles, die Klinik und die Entwicklung von Roche. Ich bemühe mich um einen Ingenieur, der sich mit der Entwicklung von Piattaformern für medizinische Geräte beschäftigt, die über eine hohe Qualifikation verfügen, um an der Entwicklung und der Bedienung von Piattaformes für die automatische Inbetriebnahme und/oder an Sicherheitseinrichtungen für die Erstversorgung (PFS-NSD) mitzuwirken, die in kombinierten Produkten eingesetzt werden farmaco-dispositivo. Die ideale Gelegenheit für einen Kandidaten ist ein praktischer Problemlöser, ein strategischer Denker und eine treuhänderische technische Beratung auf dem Weg in die Welt der Ingenieure, die Hinweise und das Feedback geben, die sie in ihrem Lebenslauf und der Unterstützung von Roche einbringen. - Wir kümmern uns um die technische Planung des Produkts und unterstützen das Team der Produktentwicklung und -entwicklung während des ersten Lebenszyklus des Produkts, der auf der Piattaforma basiert. - Wir verfügen über professionelle technische Ingenieurskompetenz für die meisten Produkte, die von der Konzeption bis zur Ingenieursanalyse aller Technologien für die Entwicklung von internen und externen Geräten reichen. - Schnittstellen mit Herstellern und Partnern für die technische Überwachung der mechanischen Entwicklung von Komponenten und Systemen, die in kombinierten Produkten (Vorbereitung und Autoinitiierung) eingesetzt werden, Anleitung der Mitarbeiter, Verantwortung und Innovation. - Anleitung zur Bewertung von Ingenieuren durch die Zuverlässigkeit, einschließlich Test bis zum Limit des Kunden, Aufmerksamkeit bei der Handhabung von Variationen, Bewertung der Sensibilität der Qualität und Erstellung/Manuskription von Modellen von Ingenieuren, die mit Computern und digitalen Geräten arbeiten, um virtuelle Daten zu analysieren. - Achten Sie darauf, dass Sie sorgfältig ausgewählte Funktions- und Montagetechniken für die Produktkombinationen auf Basis der Autoinitiierungs- und PFS-NSD-Formulare einhalten und lösen. - Leiten Sie die Indagini-Technik, die alle von Roche übernommen wurde, um dort Druck zu produzieren, für die sichere Technik in Bezug auf Planung, Produktion und Maßstabsvergrößerung, um stürmische und wirksame Methoden sowie Probleme bei der Anlage und Montage zu bewältigen. - Anleitung und Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Produkt- und Kundenanforderungen, Projekt- und Projektrevisionen, Produkt- und Prozessbewertungen, Eingaben auf Grund und Boden und Korrektur der Aziensionen. Diese Frage ist ideal für einen vielseitigen und motivierten Spieler, der auf einer technischen und wissenschaftlichen Basis basiert und die Fähigkeit hat, sich schnell einer Disziplin anzupassen, zu lernen und vielfältig zu sein. - Laurea in Meccanica Ingegneria oder gleichwertige Technik in Erfahrung mit Erfahrungen, die eine anerkannte Genehmigung für die Herstellung von Vorräten, Autoinitiatoren, PFS-Nadelsicherheitsgeräten und/oder Entwicklungs- und Produktionsverfahren für innovative landwirtschaftliche Betriebe umfassen. - Vertrautheit mit der Wissenschaft der Materialien, insbesondere hinsichtlich der Art und Weise, wie man sich mit den Verwaltungssystemen in der Landwirtschaft beschäftigt, die Kenntnisse über die Arbeitskräfte, die Probleme der Gemeinschaft und die Prüfung der Druckqualität umfasst. - Conoscenza pratica degli strumenti e delle methodologie di modellazione di sistema (

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our Warehouse Operations team at Roche and take on a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless flow of materials across our facilities. As a Warehouse Operations Specialist, you'll maintain the functional integrity of our warehouse operations while upholding the highest standards of compliance, safety, and efficiency. This position offers the opportunity to lead by example, mentor team members, and directly contribute to Roche's mission of advancing healthcare through meticulous inventory management, regulatory adherence, and operational excellence in a fast-paced, FDA-regulated environment.

The Opportunity

• Maintains functional operation of assigned warehouse area while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Ensures accurate receipt, storage, and disbursement of materials in accordance with FDA, OSHA, Good Manufacturing Practices, and company policies.

• Oversees orderly flow of materials from warehouse to offsite locations and internal customers while managing inventory accuracy through physical counts and system reconciliation.

• Serves as the primary point of contact for warehouse personnel to solve operational issues, drive efficiency improvements, and provide training and coaching.

• Properly handles and stores hazardous materials in compliance with DOT, IATA, and federal regulations regarding transportation of hazardous and infectious substances.

• Operates material handling equipment safely and maintains warehouse equipment in good working condition, issuing work orders as needed.

• Prepares and submits daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports while maintaining auditable records of all warehouse activities.

Who you are

• High school diploma or GED with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a warehouse environment performing various warehousing procedures.

• Proficiency with material handling equipment (pallet jacks, hand trucks, motorized lifts) and strong working knowledge of computerized inventory systems.

• Demonstrated strong math, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively at all organizational levels.

• Must be organized, self-directed, and conscientious with excellent time management skills and the ability to work in a dynamic, constantly changing environment.

• Able to lift up to 65 pounds and perform warehouse tasks requiring bending, kneeling, squatting, reaching, and pulling with or without reasonable accommodation.

Relocation benefits not available for this role.

• Maintains functional operation of assigned warehouse area while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• High school diploma or GED with 4+ years of hands-on experience in a warehouse environment performing various warehousing procedures.
• Proficiency with material handling equipment (pallet jacks, hand trucks, motorized lifts) and strong working knowledge of computerized inventory systems.
• Demonstrated strong math, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively at all organizational levels.
• Must be organized, self-directed, and conscientious with excellent time management skills and the ability to work in a dynamic, constantly changing environment.
• Able to lift up to 65 pounds and perform warehouse tasks requiring bending, kneeling, squatting, reaching, and pulling with or without reasonable accommodation. jobs.title: （Senior) Specialist - Filling/分装(高级)专员
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:
● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery.
● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes.
● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan.
● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Routine Operation:
● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements.
● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping.
● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team.
● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards.
● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA.
● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime.
● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS.
● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area.
● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone.
● Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualification and Experience
Education/
• Qualifications
● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above.

Job Required Competencies
● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred.
● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred.
● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry.
● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

titleByLocale.fr: Chef, gestionnaire de la prestation des TI (espace de sécurité des patients)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
You will be:

• Strong background in IT service management such as ITIL.

• Experience in applying IT service improvement methodologies like LEAN management, Six Sigma or others. Ability to cooperate and communicate with people at different organization levels and within multi-disciplinary teams.

• Supplier performance management including KPI-driven activities. Knowledge on Project Management (e.g.PMI, Prince2) and Agile methodologies (like Scrum, Kanban, Lean) will have added advantage

• Manage project deliverables which includes building up solution team and responsible for the delivery as per agreed plan. Ensure transition to support activities is completed before a project is closed. Translate the operational needs of services into written Service Agreements and Service Catalogues following Group standard. Responsible for smooth running of day-to-day service operations as per SLA as well as maintaining the service lifecycle as per target operating environment. Partnering with Vendor Management Office with a focus in delivering projects and services via strategic and specialized suppliers in both Time & Material and Managed Services. Main responsibilities will be on service scope setup, providing input for work estimation and cost model, participating in supplier selection as well as being involved in resource selection process. Drive service performance by closely working with suppliers and other IT Partners using global standard KPIs. Participating in service status meetings, reviewing service operational report and scorecards and producing management reports to the Leadership team and business stakeholders.

• Responsible in building, maintaining and managing relations with business partners addressing requirements/escalations/improvement needs related to respective services, consulting, proposing solutions and take accountability for their delivery. Adopt Roche global financial management processes and tools to respective portfolio and ensure monthly demand and supply figures are accurate and maintain cost transparency with relevant budget owner. Initiate and drive cost optimization efforts in order to provide savings to the company. Manage escalations by working with the right party(s) to resolve problems, lead service improvement plans or task force if necessary. Ensure clear communication on escalation responses is done in a timely manner. Ensure knowledge management activities are set up and maintained evergreen as well as keep additional focus in retaining critical knowledge within the organization. Support innovation in scope of processes and technologies and identifying opportunities to reuse existing solutions.

Who you are:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in leading project/service teams and managing IT projects/services of local and global scope, in multicultural, international and distributed environment. Hands on experience in service design, service transition and service operation activities.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in application projects and operational support with good understanding of of Java and .NET (common technologies and platforms), SQL and Oracle, BI, ETL (Infomatica) and/or BI Reporting tools (Tableau, SAP BO). Minimum 3 years of experience in working with external suppliers of IT services in software development and maintenance.

• Excellent command of English with outstanding communication skills. Skills to envisage possible problems, determine and implement solutions.

• Influencing, persuasion and negotiations s

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni: - Forte background in IT service management, ad esempio ITIL. - Esperienza nell'applicazione di metodi di miglioramento dei servizi IT come la gestione LEAN, Six Sigma o altre. Capacità di cooperare e comunicare con persone a diversi livelli organizzativi e all'interno di team multidisciplinari. - Gestione delle prestazioni dei fornitori, comprese le attività guidate da KPI. Conoscenza della Gestione di Progetto (ad es. PMI, Prince2) e metodologie Agile (come Scrum, Kanban, Lean) saranno un vantaggio aggiunto. - Gestire le consegne del progetto, che comprendono la costituzione del team di soluzione e la responsabilità della consegna secondo il piano concordato. Assicurarsi che la transizione alle attività di supporto sia completata prima della chiusura di un progetto. Tradurre i processi operativi dei servizi in Accordi di Servizio e Cataloghi di Servizi scritti seguendo gli standard del Gruppo. Responsabile per il corretto funzionamento delle operazioni di servizio secondo l'SLA e per il mantenimento del ciclo di vita del servizio secondo l'ambiente target. Collaborare con l'Ufficio di Gestione dei Fornitori con un focus sulla consegna di progetti e servizi tramite fornitori strategici e specializzati in entrambi i servizi Time & Material e Managed Services. Le principali responsabilità riguarderanno l'impostazione dell'ambito del servizio, forniti input per la stima del lavoro e il modello di costo, partecipando alla selezione dei fornitori e coinvolgendosi nel processo di selezione delle risorse. Guidare le prestazioni del servizio collaborando attivamente con i fornitori e altri partner IT utilizzando KPI standard globali. Partecipare alle riunioni sullo stato del servizio, rivedere i report operativi del servizio e schede di valutazione e produrre report di gestione per il team di leadership e gli stakeholder aziendali. - Responsabile della costruzione, del mantenimento e della gestione delle relazioni con i partner aziendali, affrontando requisiti/escalation/bisogni di miglioramento relativi ai rispettivi servizi, consultndo, proponendo soluzioni e assumendosi la responsabilità della loro consegna. Adottare i processi e gli strumenti di gestione finanziaria globale di Roche per il rispettivo portafoglio e garanzia che le figure mensili di domanda e siano accurate e mantenere la trasparenza dei costi con il proprietario del budget pertinente. Avviare e guidare gli sforzi di appropriazione dei costi per prevedere tutte'azienda. Gestire le escalation lavorando con la/le parte/i giusta/e per risolvere i problemi, guida i piani di miglioramento del servizio o il task force se necessario. Assicurarsi che la comunicazione sulle risposte alle escalation sia chiara e tempestiva. Assicurarsi che le attività di gestione della conoscenza siano impostate e mantenute sempre aggiornate e mantenere un focus aggiuntivo sulla conoscenza critica all'interno dell'organizzazione. Supportare l'innovazione nell'ambito dei processi e delle tecnologie e identificare le opportunità per riutilizzare soluzioni esistenti.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Learning Technology Systems Analyst

At Roche, we are passionate about transforming healthcare and changing patients' lives for the better. As a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, we commit ourselves to scientific excellence, cutting-edge innovation, and sustainable growth. We believe that good business means a better world, and we achieve this by fostering an inclusive, collaborative environment where our people are empowered to push the boundaries of medical science and technology. Joining Roche means bringing your purpose to a team that values integrity, courage, and passion, ensuring that the right treatment reaches the right patient at the right time.

The Opportunity

• Drive System Strategy: Serve as the global Technology PT Product Owner for Learning Management technologies (specifically Cornerstone on Demand), effectively translating complex business requirements into standardized technical solutions.

• Manage Lifecycle & Governance: Direct the entire system lifecycle—including upgrades, system replacements, and retirements—while strictly adhering to established change management processes.

• Shape Product Roadmaps: Partner closely with the Global Learning Solutions (GLS) team to define product vision, align roadmaps, manage feature backlogs, and prioritize system enhancements.

• Ensure Compliance & Data Stewardship: Act as the dedicated Business Data Steward, ensuring unwavering GxP compliance, strict data governance, and adherence to global quality policies.

• Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Mobilize and lead high-performing, cross-functional teams spanning global Learning departments, business stakeholders, IT partners, and validation functions.

• Optimize Processes & Systems: Drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage deviations and CAPAs, and oversee master data validation within validated quality systems.

• Govern the Learning Ecosystem: Manage the integration and structural nuances of the learning ecosystem, ensuring seamless data flow, reporting, and interface connectivity across global manufacturing and commercial sites.

​
Who you are

• You possess deep technical expertise: You bring 7+ years of experience in Learning Management technology and platform management—specifically Cornerstone on Demand—ideally with Roche Super Admin-level competency.

• You are an expert in regulated environments: You possess a strong understanding of database management, data analytics, and software validation within validated or controlled pharmaceutical/healthcare environments (GMP, FDA, GxP).

• You are strategically and academically qualified: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field (or an equivalent qualification like a Federal Diploma of Higher Education) combined with a proven track record in formulating long-term computer system strategies.

• You are an Agile collaborator and communicator: You are highly skilled at utilizing Agile methodologies and possess exceptional communication skills to convey technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• You are an advanced Cornerstone administrator: You have mastered creating dynamic groups, modifying training components, building complex Reporting 2.0 dashboards, and resolving system configuration errors efficiently.

The PO will be responsible for translating business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions. This role requires a blend of technical expertise and the ability to bridge the gap between intricate business challenges and transformative solutions. Working in multidisciplinary teams, you’ll maintain, transform, and construct technologies integral to our technology landscape. This role will also be responsible for global master data entity. As a PO, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams consisting of business stakeholders, use case leads, IT, and validation teams to understand business needs, translate them into technical requirements, and deliver impactful solutions that are compliant to regulations. This role works with Business and Informatics to ensure high quality innovative solutions are defined, developed, enhanced and implemented using consistent technologies and processes and assists the organization with expertise during inspections, investigation and resolution of deviations and implementation of initiatives. This role calls for a collaborative, open-minded individual who values learning from colleagues, thoughtfully challenges ideas, and prioritizes impactful work. We seek someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, has a passion for continuous learning, and can be relied upon to work in the best interest of the team.

• Ensure compliance with system access processes, periodic user access reviews, and adherence to GxP Computer Systems' intended use and regulatory standards. Maintain a compliant mindset with data from commercial manufacturing processes while enforcing Information Security standards.
