jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Technical Product Owner

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity

As a Technical Product Owner for our Source-to-Procure (S2P) ecosystem, you bridge the gap between technical execution and business objectives. Working at an advanced professional level alongside Senior Product Managers, you own the product backlog and drive the execution of our digital procurement roadmap. You join a collaborative, forward-thinking Informatics team focused on delivering enterprise-scale value.
In this role, you will:

• Own and prioritize the S2P product backlog, translating strategic business goals into actionable technical user stories.

• Lead the end-to-end scope and execution of large-scale S2P initiatives, managing dependencies across cross-functional teams.

• Optimize delivery methodologies by tailoring frameworks like Scrum, SAFe, Kanban, or ITSM to maximize efficiency and maintain high quality.

• Act as a trusted advisor to a diverse group of stakeholders, navigating complex matrix environments to align expectations and build consensus.

• Diagnose system bottlenecks and lead root-cause analysis to design and validate technical or workflow enhancement plans.

• Mentor team members , fostering a collaborative spirit, driving mutual accountability, and guiding the team through ambiguity.

Who You Are

You are a versatile, analytical professional who thrives at the intersection of agile delivery and procurement technology. You are a natural facilitator who handles uncertainty with a pragmatic mindset and communicates effortlessly with both technical and business partners.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• 6-8 years of experience working with procurement platforms (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting, or Requisition-to-Pay), including at least 2 years supporting the life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• A proven track record of leading the delivery of complex features, major product releases, or service transitions within a product ownership or delivery management capacity.

• Versatile framework expertise with hands-on experience navigating environments as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager, or Agile Coach.

• Strong strategic acumen with a demonstrated ability to translate high-level business goals into structured implementation roadmaps and technical delivery strategies.

• Advanced problem-solving skills and proficiency with modern delivery tools to analyze dependencies, run root-cause analysis, and optimize workflows.

• Exceptional relationship-building skills , with a coaching mindset

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra uno scopo preciso. Come team globale al cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi con una mentalità imprenditoriale, impegnati ad aiutare a plasmare il futuro digitale dell'assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e di innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidati da uno scopo e da una passione, stiamo preparando un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza trainante in tutta Roche, volendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, sperimentando il potenziale umano e guidando le innovazioni che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. Opportunità di lavoro Come Technical Product Owner per il nostro ecosistema Source-to-Procure (S2P), colmi il potenziale tra l'esecuzione tecnica e gli obiettivi aziendali. Un livello professionale avanzato insieme ai Senior Product Manager, possiedi il product backlog e guidi l'esecuzione della nostra roadmap digitale di appalti. Ti unirai a un team informatico collaborativo e lungimirante, concentrato sulla consegna di valore su scala aziendale. In questo ruolo, ti ripudiai di: - Possedere e osare priorità al prodotto backlog S2P, diffusondo gli obiettivi strategici in storie utente implementabili. - Guidare l'ambito e l'esecuzione end-to-end di iniziative S2P su larga scala, gestendo le dipendenze tra team multifunzionali. - Ottimizzare le metodologie di consegna adattando framework come Scrum, SAFe, Kanban o ITSM per massimizzare l'efficienza e mantenere un'alta qualità. - Agire come consulente fidato per un gruppo diversificato di stakeholder, navigando in ambienti complessi a matrice per allineare le aspettative e costruire il consenso. - Diagnosticare i colli di bottiglia del sistema e guidare l'analisi delle cause radice per progettare e convalidare piani di potenziamento tecnici o di flusso di lavoro. - Mentore dei membri del team, promuovendo uno spirito collaborativo, favorndo la responsabilità reciproca e guidando il team attraverso l'ambiguità. Chi sei Sei un professionista versatile e analitico che prospera all'incrocio tra consegna agile e tecnologia di approvvigionamento. Sei un facilitatore naturale che controlla l'errore con un mindset pragmatico e comunica senza sforzo con entrambi i partner tecnici e aziendali. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - 6-8 anni di esperienza nel lavoro con piattaforme di approvvigionamento (Source-to-Pay, Sourcing, Contracting o Requisition-to-Pay), inclusi almeno 2 anni di supporto al settore delle scienze della vita o dell'industria farmaceutica. - No. Un track record comprovato nella guida della consegna di funzionalità complesse, di importanti rilasci di prodotti o di transizioni di servizi all'interno di una capacità di proprietà del prodotto o di gestione della consegna. - Esperienza versatile con i framework con esperienza pratica nella navigazione di ambienti come Product Owner, Project Manager, Service Delivery Manager o Agile Coach. - Forte acume strategica con capacità dimostrata di tradurre obiettivi aziendali di alto livello in road map di implementazione strutturate e strategie di consegna tecnica. - Abilità avanzata di problem solving e competenza con strumenti di consegna moderni per analisi le dipendenze, eseguire l'analisi delle cause eredita e ottimizza i flussi di lavoro. - Eccellenti capacità di costruzione di relazioni, con un mindset di coaching.

jobs.title: Field Service Representative
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Service Engineer – South Region

The Opportunity

Are you ready to take on a role where the work you do truly makes a difference to patients’ lives? As a Field Service Engineer with Roche Diagnostics, you’ll be at the forefront of maintaining and supporting our world-class medical equipment across the South region of the UK.

You’ll play a vital role in ensuring healthcare providers can deliver the best care possible by keeping our diagnostic systems running smoothly. From installations and preventative maintenance to troubleshooting and customer training, your expertise will help healthcare teams deliver results that patients rely on every day.

With exciting product launches and ongoing investment in R&D, this is your chance to be part of a progressive, high-tech business that values innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

You’re an experienced and motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working hands-on with high-value capital equipment. You thrive on building strong customer relationships and take pride in representing a trusted global brand in the field.

What You’ll Do

• Diagnose, repair, and maintain electro-mechanical, fluidic, and electronic systems across the South England region.

• Carry out preventative, corrective, modification, installation, and out-of-hours support for a range of Roche products.

• Deliver both on-site and office-based customer training to ensure effective equipment use.

• Support new product launches and help grow key business accounts across your territory.

• Collaborate with the Regional Technical Manager and wider Technical Services team to deliver exceptional service.

• Represent Roche with professionalism and integrity at customer sites across the region (with occasional UK travel).

What You Bring

• An engineering or electrical qualification, ideally with experience in biomedical, industrial, automation, aerospace, or related fields.

• Previous field service experience with high-value capital equipment.

• Strong diagnostic skills — from component-level troubleshooting through to system-level expertise.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trusted, long-term customer relationships.

• Flexibility and willingness to travel within the South region (and occasionally across the UK).

Join us and be part of a purpose-driven organisation where your expertise helps healthcare professionals do now what patients need next.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to buildin

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
LEL 区域生态圈负责人
Local Ecosystem Lead

生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

B. 客户管理与区域合作

• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

我们期待这样的您加入：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力

• 具有卓越合规意识，以身作则，带领团队业务在合规基石上稳健发展

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

jobs.title: Data Transfer Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Data Transfer Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for owning the high-speed data transfer services that feed our advanced compute environments. With the introduction of our industry-leading AI Factory, the ability to move massive, petabyte-scale datasets rapidly and securely is more critical than ever. You will own the deployment, configuration, and ongoing optimization of specialized Data Transfer Appliances that bridge our traditional HPC clusters with our next-generation AI infrastructure. By ensuring seamless, high-bandwidth data mobility and aggressively eliminating network and I/O bottlenecks, you will play a foundational role in ensuring that our researchers can train complex AI models and execute large-scale computational science workloads without friction.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Pipeline Architecture & Management

• Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of specialized Data Transfer Appliances.

• Identify and resolve systemic network and I/O bottlenecks to maximize throughput between storage tiers and compute nodes.

Technical Operations & Optimization

• Manage integration with various storage architectures, including Object Storage, NAS (NFS), and parallel file systems such as GPFS.

• Implement automation for on-site deployment and configuration of our factory-built and tuned Data Transfer appliances using Ansible, Kickstart, or Red Hat Satellite to ensure scalable and reproducible environments.

Performance & Monitoring

• Analyze system logs, kernel messages, and network statistics to proactively monitor the health and performance of the data transfer fabric.

• Define and track success metrics for data mobility, providing insights to leadership on infrastructure utilization and performance trends.

User Enablement & Support Experience .

• Explore innovative approaches to drive more frictionless consumption of our Data Transfer appliances, e.g, Agentic AI and MCP

• Develop user-facing documentation, scripts, and tools that simplify complex data movement tasks for the broader scientific community.

• Provide high-level technical support, isolating complex issues across storage, network, and application layers in a collaborative, cross-functional manner.

Who You Are

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical discipline.

• Proven experience in managing large-scale Linux environments (RHEL/rebuilds) with deep proficiency in CLI tools (grep, awk, sed, etc.).

• Demonstrated experience in high-performance computing (HPC

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Expert Permit Management (Building Law, Federal Immission Control Act, Ordinance on Installations for Handling Substances Hazardous to Water) (m/w/d) | Experte Genehmigungsmanagement (Baurecht, BImSchG, AwSV)

Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explizit des Teams "Implementation Management". In unserem Team übernehmen wir die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Überführung von rechtlichen Anforderungen, globalen SHE-Standards sowie Prozessen und Systemen in praktische und wirtschaftliche Lösungen an unseren Standorten. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und stellen sicher, dass Rahmenbedingungen nachhaltig implementiert und gelebt werden. Wir sind verantwortlich für zwei Standorte, aber dennoch ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
In der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Steuerung und Implementierung von Genehmigungsverfahren. Dein Fokus liegt dabei auf der Einhaltung umweltrechtlicher und baurechtlicher Vorgaben und deren wirtschaftlicher Umsetzung in Projekten. Darüber hinaus übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du unterstützt und koordinierst bei der Vorbereitung von Anzeige und Genehmigungsverfahren nach BImSchG, AwSV und Bauordnungsrecht und stellst die Kommunikation zwischen Projekten (CAPEX&OPEX) und den Behörden sicher und begleitest diese bis zur Umsetzung.

• Du wirkst auf die Vollständigkeit von Genehmigungsanforderungen hin, um die Rechtssicherheit der Verantwortlichen zu gewährleisten.

• In Investitionsprojekten (CAPEX) agierst du als strategische Beratungsinstanz für alle SHE-relevanten Genehmigungsfragen.

• Gemeinsam mit den Business Units entwickelst du nachhaltige Lösungen, die lokale Gegebenheiten und globale Trends harmonisieren.

• Du stellst den nachhaltigen Erfolg deiner Maßnahmen sicher und weist deren ökonomischen sowie sicherheitstechnischen Wert für die Organisation nach.

• Du verantwortest in Abstimmung mit SHE-Legislation sowie den Business Units die gesamte genehmigungsrechtliche Dokumentation.

• Hai una solida e rilevante esperienza professionale (6-8 anni per una laurea, 5-7 anni per un master), idealmente nel settore chimico.
• Conoscete approfonditamente le normative pertinenti, in particolare quelle relative a BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 e K16.

• Ein ausgeprägtes wirtschaftliches Denken und Ha

Sil-Graph & K16] (m/f/d) Votre nouvelle équipe Sur le site de gestion de Mannheim/Penzberg, nous sommes 1 300 spécialistes d'une large gamme d'infrastructures et de services professionnels, qui les fournissent pour les sites de Mannheim et de Penzberg. Dans un environnement dynamique, nous promouvons une collaboration transparente entre les domaines d'activité et les fonctions, proposons des solutions innovantes et améliorons l'environnement de travail des employés des sites de Mannheim et de Penzberg. Dans ce rôle, vous faites partie de Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explicitement de l'équipe "Implementation Management". Au sein de notre équipe, nous assumons la responsabilité de traduire avec succès les exigences légales, les normes mondiales SHE ainsi que les processus et systèmes en solutions pratiques et économiques sur nos sites. Nous agissons toujours en étant conscients de notre grande responsabilité envers l’environnement et la société et veillons à ce que les conditions-cadres soient mises en œuvre et vécues de manière durable. Nous sommes responsables de deux sites, mais toujours d'une seule équipe : malgré la distance physique, nous sommes liés par un échange étroit entre les sites et un fort esprit d'équipe. Responsabilités | C'est ce qui vous attend Dans ce rôle, vous assumerez la responsabilité d'assurer la sécurité des systèmes techniques et des processus ainsi que la sécurité au travail au sein du RDG, en mettant clairement l'accent sur la sécurité fonctionnelle et la conception d'environnements de travail sûrs. En outre, vous assumerez les tâches passionnantes suivantes :
• Vous réaliserez des réflexions spécialisées en matière de sécurité et des analyses de risques, en apportant notamment votre expertise en matière de classification de la sécurité fonctionnelle (graphiques SIL) et d'évaluation des systèmes avec gaz asphyxiants (norme K16).
• Vous coordonnez les exigences de sécurité et les mettez en œuvre de manière cohérente afin d'accroître la sécurité juridique pour tous les responsables du département.
• En tant qu'interlocuteur compétent, vous contrôlez les concepts de sécurité et conseillez l'organisation sur la mise en œuvre d'exigences techniques complexes.
• Vous enquêtez sur les accidents du travail ou les expositions médiatiques, effectuez des analyses approfondies des causes et en déduisez des mesures préventives.
• En collaboration avec les unités commerciales, vous développerez des solutions durables et les soutiendrez activement jusqu'à ce qu'elles soient transférées avec succès dans les opérations opérationnelles.
• Vous vous assurez que les mesures prises sont non seulement sécuritaires mais aussi économiques et démontrent leur succès durable pour l'organisation.
• Vous êtes responsable de tous les documents d'approbation entre Roche et les autorités d'approbation en coordination avec la législation SHE et les unités commerciales. Qualifications | Ce que vous apportez
• Vous avez obtenu avec succès un diplôme (Master ou Bachelor) en ingénierie, technologie de sécurité, gestion de la santé ou une qualification comparable.
• Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle solide et pertinente (6 à 8 ans pour une licence, 5 à 7 ans pour un master), idéalement dans l'industrie chimique.
• Vous disposez d'une connaissance approfondie des réglementations en vigueur, notamment en ce qui concerne BetrSichV, TRBS, TRGS, TRAS, DIN EN 61508, DIN EN 615011 et K16.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Security Insights and Automation

titleByLocale.it: Data Ingegnere - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.en: Data Engineer - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.de: Data Ingenieur - Security Insights and Automation
titleByLocale.fr: Data Ingénieur - Security Insights and Automation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Security Insights and Automation Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure within the Roche’s DataOne ecosystem. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, implementing decentralized Data Products following Data Mesh principles, utilizing strong programming skills in Python, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Snowflake.

Job Responsibilities:

• Data Architecture & Pipeline Engineering : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable end-to-end data pipelines using Talend, dbt, and Python. Ensure all architectures are scalable, secure, and aligned with the Data Mesh standards. .

• Security Intelligence Support: Transform raw security telemetry and vulnerability data into high-quality feature sets for predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and automated risk scoring. .

• Stakeholder Management: Engages directly with broader business units and data scientists to thoroughly understand and meet their data needs. Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Visualization & Insights: Support the mastery of Tableau and ThoughtSpot by ensuring underlying data structures and schemas are optimized for intuitive executive narratives and self-service analytical apps.

• System Optimization: Solve complex data ingestion problems and perform expert-level Snowflake table optimizations and schema designs. Leads high-impact, large-scale data engineering initiatives by implementing robust strategies and integrating complex, diverse infrastructures to ensure seamless organizational data flow.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling big-sized data engineering projects and managing complex, large-scale data systems.

• Proven track record of independently building ETL/ELT processes and optimizing data storage solutions such as data warehouses and data lakes.

• Experience ensuring data quality, reliability, and monitoring data systems

Technical Skills

• Expert SQL & Snowflake : Advanced proficiency in designing Snowflake data structures, schemas, and performance optimizations.

• Advanced Programming: Expert-level Python or Scala for data engineering and Gitlab for version control and orchestration.

• Modern Data Stack: Hands-on experience with dbt for transformation and Talend for integration.

• Data Mesh & AI/ML: Solid understanding of decentralized Data Mesh principles and preparing data for AI/ML initiatives (e.g., feature engineering).

• BI Tooling: Technical capability to support advanced visualizations in Tableau and ThoughtSpot.

• API Integration: Expertise in consuming and exposing APIs to integrate security insights across the enterprise ecosystem

Additional Qualifications
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to engage effectively with both technical audiences (like data scientists) and non-technical business stakeholders.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result i

jobs.title: Policy, Access & Communications Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a dynamic and motivated intern to support our Policy, Access, and Communications team initiatives. This role provides hands-on experience in health policy, market access, pricing, and strategic communications, allowing you to contribute to meaningful projects that shape healthcare access and engagement.

You will support internal and external events, projects and strategic communication efforts, while gaining exposure to healthcare policy discussions, pricing frameworks and access-related initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Communications:

• Support internal events (monthly townhalls) and external events to increase awareness of products, disease areas and healthcare access strategies.

• Develop communication materials (presentations, infographics, posters, reports, digital content).

• Videography (concept, shoot, editing) and photography for internal and external initiatives.

• Assist in updating and managing the intranet and social media channels.

• Manage the corporate inbox by responding to emails and routing enquiries to the relevant teams.

Access & Pricing Support:

• Assist the Pricing Lead and Pricing & Tender Partner in tracking, analysing and ensuring compliance with pricing strategies and policies.

• Assist the Pricing & Tender Partner in daily operational tasks.

• Support the Policy & Access Partners by gathering, analysing and compiling key data to inform access strategies and decision-making.

• Conduct market research and monitor pricing and reimbursement trends to support strategic recommendations.

• Help prepare pricing submissions, reports, dossier and stakeholder engagement materials for internal and external use.

External Engagement & Policy Support:

• Assist in organising and coordinating high-impact healthcare events and meetings.

• Provide research and logistical support for policy roundtables, media briefings and advocacy initiatives.

• Track and summarise pricing, access and policy trends relevant to the healthcare landscape.

Skills & Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who:

• Has completed coursework in Public Policy, Health Economics, Communications, Business, or related fields.

• Is passionate about healthcare policy, access, and pricing.

• Has experience with graphic design tools (Adobe Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, Illustrator) and video editing software.

• Is digitally savvy, with strong storytelling, writing, and communication skills.

• Has proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).

• Can manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrates high integrity, professionalism, and a strong sense of accountability.

This role offers an opportunity to gain exposure to real-world policy, access, and pricing strategies while contributing to impactful healthcare initiatives. If you are eager to learn and want to make a difference in the healthcare landscape, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier fu

jobs.title: (Sr) AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Summary:
Serving as the Lead Architect of AI Transformation, this role is the visionary and technical engine behind redefining how the organization builds software. Much like a technical evangelist and researcher, you will bridge the gap between "Research AI" and "Applied AI Engineering." Your mission is to revolutionize the engineering lifecycle through AI, establish world-class methodologies for AI-native product development, and act as a high-impact coach to transition the entire engineering team into an AI-augmented powerhouse. You will ensure we don't just "use AI," but fundamentally change how we engineer for the future.

The Opportunity:

AI-Driven Engineering Transformation

• Methodology Research: Deeply research and define the next generation of software engineering workflows (e.g., Software 2.0, Agentic Workflows, AI-assisted coding architectures).

• Process Redesign: Diagnose existing engineering bottlenecks and deploy AI tools/frameworks to automate and optimize the SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), achieving radical efficiency gains.

• Evolutionary Catalyst: Serve as a "Strategic Catalyst" to steer the engineering culture toward an AI-Native mindset.

Product Engineering & AI Integration

• AI Engineering Excellence: Design and oversee the implementation of robust, scalable AI engineering patterns (LLMOps, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning pipelines) to bring AI capabilities into the core product portfolio.

• Agile Prototyping: Rapidly translate the latest breakthroughs in AI research (from multi-modal models to reasoning-step optimizations) into production-ready features with an agile, hands-on approach.

• Technical Interpretation: Translate complex algorithmic logic and technical constraints into actionable business roadmaps and product strategies.

Capability Building & Knowledge Hub

• Master Educator: Design and lead high-level AI training programs for senior engineers and architects, focusing on Prompt Engineering, model evaluation, and AI-native architecture.

• AI Knowledge Hub: Build and iterate an enterprise-level repository of AI best practices, reusable code patterns, and internal benchmarks to ensure consistent technical excellence.

• Talent Coaching: Mentor engineering leads on how to leverage AI to scale their own teams’ output and creative capacity.

Who you are:

Education & Qualifications

• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

• A proven track record of open-source contributions or technical thought leadership in the AI space.

Experience

• 5+ years of senior engineering experience, with at least 3+ years specifically focused on deploying AI/ML systems at scale.

• Experience in Digital Transformation or leading large-scale engineering team transitions is highly preferred.

Professional Capabilities/Skills

• AI Technical Mastery: Deep expertise in LLMs, Generative AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and modern AI infrastructure (GPU orchestration, vector databases).

• Engineering Methodology: Strong opinions, weakly held, on software architecture, clean code in the age of AI, and "Human-in-the-loop" engineering systems.

• Business Acumen: The ability to match bleeding-edge AI capabilities with specific market pain points and IVD/Tech business scenarios.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication and "Change Management" capabilities—the ability to inspire a team to unlearn old habits an

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Die Abteilung
Du bist eine erfahrene Führungskraft in der Diagnostik und bist davon überzeugt, dass jede/r bei Roche eine großartige Führungskraft verdient? Bei uns leitest du ein Team aus Expert:innen und Spezialist:innen, die technologische Innovationen entwickeln und damit die Grundlage für die Diagnostik von morgen legen . Unser interdisziplinäres Team begleitet den gesamten frühen Entwicklungsprozess – von Kundenanforderungen über Konzeptentwicklung bis hin zu Prototypen und Machbarkeitsstudien sowie der nachgeschalteten Assaybereitstellung . Wir arbeiten abteilungsübergreifend, setzen auf moderne, kundenorientierte Methoden wie Design Thinking und schätzen eine vertrauensvolle Teamkultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Wertschätzung geprägt ist .

Deine Mission
In dieser Position trägst du die operative Leitung sowie die Ergebnisverantwortung für dein Team und passt Abteilungsziele sowie Prioritäten eigenständig an .

Deine zentralen Aufgaben:

• Menschen führen und entwickeln: Du führst, coachst und förderst dein Team von ungefähr 10 Expert:innen durch individuelle Entwicklungspläne und schaffst ein Umfeld, das von Vertrauen, Kollaboration und Leistungsbereitschaft geprägt ist .

• Proaktiver Change & agile Agent: Du treibst Veränderungsprozesse aktiv voran, unterstützt dein Team dabei, Veränderungen mitzugestalten, und fungierst als Vorbild für agile Arbeits- und Denkweisen .

• Ziele erreichen und selbstständig Handeln: Du verantwortest die Erreichung der Teamziele als Beitrag zur übergeordneten Einheit, löst komplexe Probleme und triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig innerhalb von Richtlinien .

• Strategie in die Tat umsetzen: Du übersetzt die strategischen Ziele der Abteilung in konkrete Maßnahmen für dein Team, managest Ressourcen clever und stellst die Einhaltung aller Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Vorgaben sicher .

• Fachliche Entwicklung des Teams: Aufgrund deiner fundierten Expertise agierst du als zentrale:r technische:r Ansprechpartner:in für Mitarbeitende, Kolleg:innen und Kund:innen bei der fachlichen Unterstützung von Projekten .

Dein Profil
Für diese anspruchsvolle Führungsrolle suchen wir eine gestandene Persönlichkeit mit nachweisbarer Führungspraxis. Dies ist keine Einstiegsposition – fundierte Führungserfahrung ist zwingend erforderlich .

Das bringst du mit:

• Akademischer Hintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Biowissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Chemie oder Pharmazie, idealerweise mit einer anschließenden Promotion .

• Berufserfahrung mit Führungsschwerpunkt: Mindestens 5 Jahre fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Assay- und/oder Instrumentenentwicklung in der Diagnostikindustrie. Mehrjährige, nachweisbare Erfahrung in einer Rolle mit disziplinarischer Führungsverantwortung sowie im Schnittstellenmanagement ist zwingend notwendig .

• Fachliche Expertise: Tiefgehendes Wissen in der System- und Testentwicklung, insbesondere im Bereich massenspektrometrischer und immunologischer Tests . Hands-on-Erfahrungen im Labor mit der Massenspektrometrie und der Elecsys®-Technologie sowie ein starkes abstraktes Denkvermögen sind ein großes Plus .

• Führungspersönlichkeit & Teamplayer: Du bist eine inspirierende, selbstbewusste Führungskraft mit ausgeprägten Coaching-, Mentoring- und Change-Management-Fähigkeiten . Du verstehst es, tragfähige Beziehungen zu strategischen Partnern aufzubauen und funktionsübergreifende Teams in einer positiven, leistungsorientierten Atmosphäre zu führen .

• Agilität & Kommunikation: Ideale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Business System Analyst focuses on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under the guidance of more experienced analysts. In this entry-level role, you will operate within well-defined, routine tasks, focusing on continuous learning and applying core business analysis principles. By supporting the delivery of clearly documented requirements and assisting with problem definition, you will build foundational skills while contributing to the design of specific IT solution features.

Pharma Technical Development (PTD) collaborates across Research & Development to efficiently transform scientific ideas into products by developing robust and efficient manufacturing processes and quality control systems. They reliably deliver the clinical pipeline, supplying quality products for patients enrolled in clinical studies worldwide, while developing new and convenient Drug Delivery Systems for patients.

Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership):

• Operates within well-defined, routine tasks under close supervision, with a primary focus on continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards.

• Executes work within existing templates and processes, proactively seeking clarification and collaborating effectively with team members to build confidence and capability.
Accountability/Problem Solving:

• Supports senior Business Analysts in analyzing business problems within a defined scope, contributing to problem definition, and identifying potential root causes under guidance.

• Elicits and clarifies stakeholder needs, analyzes and maps requirements, and assists in identifying and presenting basic solutions. Accountable for the timely completion and quality of assigned discrete tasks and delivering clearly documented requirements.

Stakeholder Management:

• Identifies primary team members and internal stakeholders within a project, interacting closely with agile team members working on IT solutions.

• Acts as a supportive communicator and information gatherer, assisting in preparing basic project updates, capturing stakeholder feedback, and clarifying basic requirements on small, well-defined engagements.

Impact/Strategy:

• Focuses on participation, observation, and learning to understand foundational objectives and their relevance. Makes foundational contributions to project objectives while learning how they align with broader goals.

Complexity / (Product Size):

• Works typically on a single solution level, supporting the analysis and documentation of requirements for specific features or functionalities.

• Demonstrates the ability to analyze individual solution components and understands the basic impacts of changes within this limited scope.

Business / Technical ability:

• Exhibits a basic understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.

• Possesses a foundational understanding of the relevant business or technical domain and supporting technologies.

Who you are

Education / Experience

• 1-3 years of experience in business analysis with a focus on assisting with requirement gathering, supporting project objectives, and performing routine data analysis under guidance.

• Demonstrated eagerness for continuous learning and adherence to established business analysis principles, frameworks, and standards.

Technical Skills

• Basic understanding

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'analista di sistema aziendale si concentra sull'assistenza nella raccolta dei requisiti, nel supporto degli obiettivi del progetto e nell'esecuzione di analisi di routine dei dati sotto la guida di analisti più esperti. In questo ruolo entry-level, opererai nell'ambito di attività di routine ben definite, concentrandoti sull'apprendimento continuo e applicando i principi di analisi aziendale principale. Supportando la fornitura di requisiti chiaramente documentati e assistendo nella definizione dei problemi, svilupperai competenze fondamentali contribuendo al tempo stesso alla progettazione di funzionalità specifiche della soluzione IT. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) collabora nel settore ricerca e sviluppo per trasformare in modo efficiente le idee scientifiche in prodotti sviluppando processi di produzione e sistemi di controllo qualità robusti ed efficienti. Forniscono in modo affidabile la pipeline clinica, fornendo prodotti di qualità per i pazienti arruolati in studi clinici in tutto il mondo, sviluppando al contempo nuovi e convenienti sistemi di somministrazione dei farmaci per i pazienti. Ambito delle responsabilità / (Leadership dei contenuti):
• Opera nell'ambito di compiti di routine ben definiti sotto stretta supervisione, con un focus primario sull'apprendimento continuo e sull'adesione a principi, strutture e standard di analisi aziendale stabiliti.
• Esegue il lavoro all'interno di modelli e processi esistenti, cercando proattivamente chiarimenti e collaborando efficacemente con i membri del team per creare fiducia e capacità. Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi:
• Supporta gli analisti aziendali senior nell'analisi dei problemi aziendali all'interno di un ambito definito, contribuendo alla definizione del problema e identificando le potenziali cause profonde sotto guida.
• Evidenzia e chiarisce le esigenze delle parti interessate, analizza e mappa i requisiti e assiste nell'identificazione e presentazione di soluzioni di base. Responsabile del completamento tempestivo e della qualità dei compiti distinti assegnati e della fornitura di requisiti chiaramente documentati. Gestione degli stakeholder:
• Identifica i membri principali del team e gli stakeholder interni all'interno di un progetto, interagendo a stretto contatto con i membri agili del team che lavorano su soluzioni IT.
• Agisce come comunicatore di supporto e raccoglitore di informazioni, assistendo nella preparazione degli aggiornamenti di base del progetto, raccogliendo il feedback delle parti interessate e chiarendo i requisiti di base su impegni piccoli e ben definiti. Impatto/Strategia:
• Si concentra sulla partecipazione, sull'osservazione e sull'apprendimento per comprendere gli obiettivi fondamentali e la loro rilevanza. Fornisce contributi fondamentali agli obiettivi del progetto mentre apprende come si allineano con obiettivi più ampi. Complessità/(dimensione del prodotto):
• Funziona tipicamente a un livello di soluzione singola, supportando l'analisi e la documentazione dei requisiti per caratteristiche o funzionalità specifiche.
• Dimostra la capacità di analizzare i singoli componenti della soluzione e comprende gli impatti di base dei cambiamenti all'interno di questo ambito limitato. Abilità commerciale/tecnica:
• Dimostra una comprensione e un'applicazione di base di strumenti, principi, concetti e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi dei processi.
• Possiede una conoscenza fondamentale del settore aziendale o tecnico pertinente e delle tecnologie di supporto. Chi sei Formazione/Esperienza
• 1-3 anni di esperienza nell'analisi aziendale con particolare attenzione all'assistenza nella raccolta dei requisiti, nel supporto degli obiettivi del progetto e nell'esecuzione di analisi di dati di routine sotto guida.
• Dimostrato desiderio di apprendimento continuo e aderenza ai principi, ai framework e agli standard di analisi aziendale stabiliti. Competenze tecniche
• Comprensione di base

Sie beliefern zuverlässig die klinische Pipeline, liefern Qualitätsprodukte für Patienten, die weltweit an klinischen Studien teilnehmen, und entwickeln gleichzeitig neue und praktische Arzneimittelverabreichungssysteme für Patienten. Aufgabenbereich / (Inhaltsleitung):
• Erledigt klar definierte Routineaufgaben unter strenger Aufsicht, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf kontinuierlichem Lernen und der Einhaltung etablierter Geschäftsanalyseprinzipien, -rahmen und -standards liegt.
• Führt Arbeiten innerhalb bestehender Vorlagen und Prozesse aus, sucht proaktiv nach Klärungen und arbeitet effektiv mit Teammitgliedern zusammen, um Vertrauen und Fähigkeiten aufzubauen. Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung:
• Unterstützt leitende Business-Analysten bei der Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen innerhalb eines definierten Umfangs, trägt zur Problemdefinition bei und identifiziert unter Anleitung potenzielle Grundursachen.
• Ermittelt und klärt die Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder, analysiert und bildet Anforderungen ab und hilft bei der Identifizierung und Präsentation grundlegender Lösungen. Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige Erledigung und Qualität der zugewiesenen Einzelaufgaben sowie für die Erfüllung klar dokumentierter Anforderungen. Stakeholder-Management:
• Identifiziert primäre Teammitglieder und interne Stakeholder innerhalb eines Projekts und interagiert eng mit agilen Teammitgliedern, die an IT-Lösungen arbeiten.
• Fungiert als unterstützender Kommunikator und Informationssammler und hilft bei der Vorbereitung grundlegender Projektaktualisierungen, der Erfassung von Stakeholder-Feedback und der Klärung grundlegender Anforderungen für kleine, klar definierte Projekte. Wirkung/Strategie:
• Konzentriert sich auf Teilnahme, Beobachtung und das Erlernen des Verständnisses grundlegender Ziele und ihrer Relevanz. Leistet grundlegende Beiträge zu Projektzielen und lernt gleichzeitig, wie diese mit umfassenderen Zielen übereinstimmen. Komplexität / (Produktgröße):
• Funktioniert typischerweise auf einer einzelnen Lösungsebene und unterstützt die Analyse und Dokumentation von Anforderungen für bestimmte Features oder Funktionalitäten.
• Zeigt die Fähigkeit, einzelne Lösungskomponenten zu analysieren und versteht die grundlegenden Auswirkungen von Änderungen innerhalb dieses begrenzten Bereichs. Geschäftliche/technische Fähigkeiten:
• Zeigt ein grundlegendes Verständnis und die Anwendung von Werkzeugen, Prinzipien, Konzepten und Techniken im Zusammenhang mit Anforderungen, Daten, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Prozessanalyse.
• Verfügt über ein grundlegendes Verständnis des relevanten geschäftlichen oder technischen Bereichs und der unterstützenden Technologien. Wer Sie sind: Ausbildung/Erfahrung
• 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Geschäftsanalyse mit Schwerpunkt auf der Unterstützung bei der Anforderungserfassung, der Unterstützung von Projektzielen und der Durchführung routinemäßiger Datenanalysen unter Anleitung.
• Nachgewiesener Eifer für kontinuierliches Lernen und Einhaltung etablierter Geschäftsanalyseprinzipien, -rahmen und -standards. Technische Fähigkeiten
• Grundverständnis

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste L'analyste de système d'affaires se concentre sur l'aide à la collecte des exigences, au soutien des objectifs du projet et à l'analyse de données de routine sous la direction d'analystes plus expérimentés. Dans ce rôle de débutant, vous opérerez dans le cadre de tâches de routine bien définies, en vous concentrant sur l'apprentissage continu et en appliquant les principes fondamentaux de l'analyse commerciale. En soutenant la fourniture d'exigences clairement documentées et en aidant à la définition des problèmes, vous développerez des compétences fondamentales tout en contribuant à la conception de fonctionnalités spécifiques de la solution informatique. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) collabore dans la recherche et le développement pour transformer efficacement les idées scientifiques en produits en développant des processus de fabrication et des systèmes de contrôle qualité robustes et efficaces. Ils fournissent de manière fiable le pipeline clinique, en fournissant des produits de qualité aux patients inscrits dans des études cliniques dans le monde entier, tout en développant de nouveaux systèmes d'administration de médicaments pratiques pour les patients. Portée des responsabilités / (Leadership du contenu) :
• Opère dans le cadre de tâches de routine bien définies sous une supervision étroite, en mettant l'accent principalement sur l'apprentissage continu et le respect des principes, cadres et normes d'analyse commerciale établis.
• Exécute le travail selon les modèles et processus existants, en recherchant de manière proactive des éclaircissements et en collaborant efficacement avec les membres de l'équipe pour renforcer la confiance et les capacités. Responsabilité/Résolution de problèmes :
• Aide les analystes commerciaux seniors à analyser les problèmes commerciaux dans un périmètre défini, à contribuer à la définition des problèmes et à identifier les causes profondes potentielles sous direction.
• Obtient et clarifie les besoins des parties prenantes, analyse et cartographie les exigences, et aide à identifier et à présenter des solutions de base. Responsable de l'achèvement dans les délais et de la qualité des tâches discrètes assignées et de la satisfaction des exigences clairement documentées. Gestion des parties prenantes :
• Identifie les principaux membres de l'équipe et les parties prenantes internes au sein d'un projet, en interagissant étroitement avec les membres de l'équipe agile travaillant sur des solutions informatiques.
• Agir en tant que communicateur et collecteur d'informations de soutien, en aidant à préparer les mises à jour de base du projet, à recueillir les commentaires des parties prenantes et à clarifier les exigences de base sur de petits engagements bien définis. Impact/Stratégie :
• Se concentre sur la participation, l'observation et l'apprentissage pour comprendre les objectifs fondamentaux et leur pertinence. Apporte des contributions fondamentales aux objectifs du projet tout en apprenant comment ils s’alignent sur des objectifs plus larges. Complexité / (taille du produit) :
• Fonctionne généralement sur un seul niveau de solution, prenant en charge l'analyse et la documentation des exigences pour des caractéristiques ou des fonctionnalités spécifiques.
• Démontre la capacité d'analyser les composants individuels de la solution et comprend les impacts fondamentaux des changements dans cette portée limitée. Capacité commerciale/technique :
• Démontre une compréhension et une application de base des outils, principes, concepts et techniques liés aux exigences, aux données, à la convivialité et à l'analyse des processus.
• Possède une compréhension fondamentale du domaine commercial ou technique concerné et des technologies de support. Qui vous êtes Formation/Expérience
• 1 à 3 ans d'expérience en analyse commerciale, en mettant l'accent sur l'aide à la collecte des exigences, le soutien aux objectifs du projet et l'exécution d'analyses de données de routine sous la direction.
• Désir démontré pour l'apprentissage continu et le respect des principes, cadres et normes établis en matière d'analyse commerciale. Compétences techniques
• Compréhension de base

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Posting: Product Manager
Company: Roche Diagnostics Turkey
Location: Istanbul
Department: Marketing

About Roche
At Roche, our mission is "Doing now what patients need next" . We lead the transformation in healthcare by providing innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make the right decisions and touch the lives of millions of patients. Join our Marketing team to drive the success of our Core Lab product portfolio, which is critical for healthcare professionals' usage.

The Purpose of the Role

As a Product Manager , you will be responsible for defining and executing the comprehensive business and marketing strategy for a highly professional portfolio used directly by healthcare facilities. You will identify market opportunities, understand the needs of healthcare professionals and laboratories, and ensure our innovative solutions are positioned for maximum value and strategic market penetration. This role requires a strong commercial mindset , exceptional stakeholder/KOL management skills , and a focus on B2B dynamics. You will report to the Marketing Manager.

Key 
• Responsibilities

Strategy and Business Leadership

● Define the overarching business strategy for the current and future product portfolio.
● Develop and execute specific marketing plans and strategies for the assigned product groups.
● Identify market opportunities and customer needs to create value for healthcare professionals and patients.
● Develop business cases for new initiatives and manage resources and budget for all assigned programs and initiatives.
● Utilize a strong commercial mindset to drive demand and maximize sales for the portfolio.

Market Engagement and Collaboration

● Engage with key external stakeholders and KOLs , including Lab Directors, Clinicians and Business Partners (distributors) , for current and future solutions portfolio.
● Represent the marketing group on local and global cross-functional teams, driving innovation and market penetration.
● Foster strong collaboration with diverse internal functions such as Sales, Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Finance, ensuring a seamless and integrated approach.
● Organize and conduct training programs for the sales team/distributors about product specifications, marketing strategies, and competition.

Product Management and Leadership

● Co-create and implement customized solutions to meet defined outcomes.
● Drive process improvements to deliver higher productivity.
● Demonstrate qualities of Creativity, Collaboration, and Contribution in day-to-day work, reflecting an entrepreneurial approach.
● Involve/contribute forecasting, demand management processes.
● Actively collaborate with Healthcare Consultants for required projects.

Qualifications We Are Looking For

● Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science or Business in the related field.
● Experience: Previous experience in Marketing within the Healthcare (pharmaceutical or diagnostics) sector is important.
● Mindset: Demonstrated Growth Mindset and a strong commercial mindset .
● Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to build relationships, trust, and influence with internal members and other key stakeholders.
● Project Management: Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects .
● Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills and presentation skills are important.
● Language: At least an upper-intermediate level of English (both written and verbal) to collaborate interna

jobs.title: Clinical Educator (North) - 10-month FTC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As a Clinical Educator at Roche in the north of the UK, you will play a pivotal role in providing expert education and support to healthcare professionals across key accounts.

This role is a 10-month FTC contract for the north part of the UK.

About Roche UK

We’re here to deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster.
That means the world to us.

Our achievements help to transform the lives of millions of people. We’ve been supporting patients for over 100 years in the UK, building a reputation that we’re intensely proud of. Through this success, we’ve set an incredibly high standard. Those expectations continue to grow. The environment in which we operate changes at an ever-increasing pace. The industry is never going to stand still.

As one united team at Roche UK, we know we need to boldly respond to these changes whilst keeping our customers and our patients at the heart of everything we do.

So, we’re shooting for the stars, transforming ourselves into a much more open, dynamic, transparent, inclusive, collaborative and agile business.

Main responsabilities:

• Provide expert educational services to key account customers, Clinical Nurse Specialists, pharmacists, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), infusion nurses and physicians, fostering strong professional advocacy.

• Drive positive customer experiences by delivering ongoing, high-quality clinical and educational support that meets their needs.

• Strategically manage your geographical territory, identifying target customers, maintaining customer records, and ensuring timely, accurate electronic reporting.

• Elevate your impact by proactively identifying opportunities to add value to patients and customers through the ethical and compliant delivery of sponsored services.

• Collaborate across functions by working as an integral part of the local account team, providing clinical insight that informs local business and account plans.

• Act as a subject matter expert, continuously maintaining and applying up-to-date technical knowledge of our specialty and disease areas, including relevant publications.

• Manage customer objections and issues, confidently resolving day-to-day queries and escalating complex or sensitive concerns appropriately.

Who you are

You are a highly motivated individual with a strong clinical background and a genuine passion for education and customer support. You thrive on solving problems and are eager to drive strategic impact within a local account team.

• A Bachelor of Science or a nursing background (or equivalent relevant experience) is required.

• You possess effective verbal and written communication skills and the ability to conduct compelling face-to-face presentations.

• You have a good understanding of the Pharma Market and the local Health Service environment, alongside fluency with MS Office and Customer Relationship Management systems.

• Demonstrated experience in a clinical environment, ideally with an understanding and experience working within Haematology, oncology or infusion-related products is preferred.

• You are highly motivated with the drive and determination to succeed and possess strong business planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• You are located in the north part of the UK.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Als Teil einer globalen Matrix-Organisation, entwickelt und produziert der Bereich „Pharma Operations Penzberg“ mit mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitenden biotechnologische Wirkstoffe für innovative Medikamente zum Wohle unserer Patienten. Um eine optimale und effiziente Produktion sicherzustellen, versorgen wir als “Facilities & Engineering” die Wirkstoffproduktion mit Reinstmedien (WFI, CIP, Reinstdampf, Gase) und managen die Wartungs- und Instandhaltungs Aktivitäten rund um unsere Produktionsanlagen und Gebäude.
Unser Team ist verantwortlich für die GMP Compliance in diesem Bereich. Wir sind ein Team von 7 Mitarbeitern und bearbeiten die ganze Palette der GMP Themen (Dokumentenmanagement, Abweichungen, Training, Change Control, Quality Risk Management). Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung in die grundlegenden GMP Anforderungen wollen wir Dich in die Themen Dokumentenmanagement und Quality Risk Management miteinbeziehen. Dabei wirst Du mit einem diversen und motivierten Team zusammenarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben

als Praktikant unterstützt Du die Mitarbeiter des GMP Service Facilities & Engineering und verrichtest zum Teil selbständig nach Anweisung oder nach Vorgabe folgende Tätigkeiten:

• Erstellung von Standard Operating Procedures

• Erstellung von Quality Risk Dokumenten

• weitere Qualitätssicherungstätigkeiten nach Bedarf

Die Tätigkeit ist auf Wunsch auch größtenteils remote möglich. Ein Laptop wird gestellt. Ein Anspruch auf weitere Ausstattung für mobile Arbeiten besteht nicht.

Dein Profil

• Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium im naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in einem Gap-Year

• Du bringst idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im Bereich Clean Utilities und grundlegende theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in der Analyse und Aufbereitung technischer Fragestellungen mit

• Du arbeitest gern in der Matrix

• Du kannst Dich gut selbst organisieren, arbeitest strukturiert und hast sehr gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung

• You are good in English

Deine Vorteile

• Flexible Zeiteinteilung

• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum

• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)

• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus

• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge

• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus

• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle

Deine Bewerbung

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung für die Dauer von 6 Monaten (bis 37.5 h/Woche) bzw. 12 Monaten (20 h/Woche)

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wer wir sind

Roche beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeitende, Pionierarbeit in Diagnostik und Pharma leisten, um eine gesündere Zukunft für alle zu schaffen. Das Unternehmen ist zu einem der größten Biotech-Unternehmen der Welt gewachsen, ebenso zu einem führenden Anbieter von In-vitro-Diagnostika und einem globalen Anbieter von innovativen Lösungen für große Therapiebereiche. In Deutschland arbeiten rund 18.600 Mitarbeitende täglich für das Wohl von Patient:innen.

Unser Erfolg gründet sich auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt – und darauf, dass wir unsere Unterschiede als Vorteil betrachten. Um das Gesundheitswesen durch Innovationen voranzutreiben, wollen wir weiterhin lernen und wachsen. Deshalb suchen wir nach neuen Kolleg:innen, die die gleichen ehrgeizigen Ziele wie wir verfolgen.

Group Communications

Wir sind Teil von Group Communications als zentrale Konzernkommunikation von Roche. Der Bereich verantwortet die Schaffung eines nachhaltig positiven Images von Roche und vertritt die Stimme des Unternehmens auf Konzernebene. Das heißt: Wir kommunizieren die Strategie von Roche und die Umsetzung unseres Ziels “Doing now what patients need next” an Roche-Kolleg:innen und vielfältige externe Zielgruppen. Wir führen integrierte und globale Kampagnen durch und stellen Plattformen zur Verfügung, über die unsere Geschäftspartner und Tochtergesellschaften mit den Zielgruppen kommunizieren können. Wir tragen dazu bei, das Vertrauen wichtiger Anspruchsgruppen in unser Unternehmen aufzubauen, die Marke und den Ruf von Roche zu pflegen und ein günstiges Umfeld für unser Geschäft zu schaffen. Wir streben ebenso danach, innovativ, zukunftsorientiert, kreativ und mutig zu sein und eine starke, integrierte Unternehmensmarke und ein positives Publikumserlebnis zu repräsentieren. Wir arbeiten in einem Umfeld, in dem Menschen sich entfalten, neue Fähigkeiten erlernen, großartige Dinge schaffen und gemeinsam Spaß haben können.

Unsere Kommunikationsvision ist ehrgeizig und einfach: Wir begeistern die Welt für den Beitrag von Roche zur Gesundheit der Menschen.

Sites Network Communications Germany

Das deutsche Kommunikationsteam des Sites Networks ist verantwortlich für die Umsetzung von Kommunikationsstrategien und -maßnahmen, die zur positiven Wahrnehmung von Roche und unserer Standorte beitragen – und das sowohl bei unseren derzeitigen und zukünftigen Mitarbeitenden als auch den Communities, in denen wir tätig sind. Mit unserem lokalen Fachwissen und Netzwerk fördern wir die integrierte Kommunikation innerhalb der Konzernkommunikation und schlagen Brücken zwischen lokalen Bedürfnissen und globalen Prioritäten, um die Wirkung unserer Kommunikationsarbeit zu maximieren.

Die Position

Als Kommunikationsabteilung des Sites Network Germany arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, aus den vielfältigen Inhalten unseres Unternehmens spannende Geschichten zu entwickeln und diese mit kreativen Ideen und Formaten für unsere Mitarbeitenden, Medienvertreter:innen und unser Umfeld kommunikativ umzusetzen. So unterstützen wir die strategische Ausrichtung des Unternehmens und machen die Identität von Roche erlebbar.

Als Volontär:in erhältst du Einblicke in die inhaltlichen und organisatorischen Abläufe der Unternehmenskommunikation und lernst unser kommunikatives Tagesgeschäft kennen. Du hilfst mit, die Transformation des Geschäfts und die Geschichten unserer Standorte Mannheim, Penzberg und Ludwigsburg verständlich darzustellen und dabei den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen. Im

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) 主要工作目标（岗位简介）

• Lead CE-ON event planning and execution excellence

• Lead strategic initiatives of AI and employee engagement

• Implement and track license-to-operate activities and optimize business process

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
(Major functions of the position)

Lead

• Deliver cycle meeting, annual meeting, BTP -enabling meeting, and regular cross-function meeting to drive CE-ON’s strategic priorities

• Elevate CE-ON employee engagement, motivation and recognition mechanisms through close collaborations with TA and cross-functions

• Spearhead Everyday AI to enhance employee efficiency and to drive strategic customer engagement

• Manage CE-ON budget planning, PO and ad-hoc finance analysis with the support of operational specialist

• Serve as PPoC (primary point of contact) in EBPG (Event Business Process Group) to continuously optimize the policies, processes and systems for operational efficiency

• Serve as PPoC to implement and track enterprise-level license-to-operate (e.g., legal & compliance) initiatives and regular requirements

Support

• Proactively contribute to CE-ON People Strategy initiatives (e.g., leadership, capability building, hi-potential program) in collaborations with TA, RCA, P&C and P&OG

• Provide coaching to the operational specialist for the maintenance of internal communication content and key channels, event and meeting logistics

Our therapeutic focus spans Ophthalmology and Neuroscience (ON). Under the Roche One Pharma Strategy, these two end-to-end disease areas are prioritized both globally and in China across the entire value chain—from R&D and manufacturing through to commercialization. We offer an industry-leading pipeline, a best-in-class inline portfolio, and innovative solutions specifically tailored to address the unmet needs of patients and the clinical community.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验

Education/Qualifications教育程度/所获资格证书

• Master degree preferred

• Project management and/or operation management certificates preferred

• Event planning or internal communications, event management excellence, HR training experience is a plus

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力

• Strong organizational and business acumen

• Strong communication skills and cross-functional teamwork

• Influencing skills

• High learning agility

• Accountability and self-motivated

Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in operations management, process improvement, or business excellence roles within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry

• Proven record of excellent project management and organizational skills, with a focus on delivering results

• Fluent in both written and spoken English

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
