Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 【職務内容】 本ポジションは、検査に関して高度な専門性、学術知識を持つスペシャリストとして、臨床検査技師や医師、コメディカルに対して最前線で向き合い、検査機器の設置時の最適なアプリケーションセットアップや、検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得に向けた技術的アプローチを主導します。日進月歩で進化する医療技術や個別化医療のトレンドを捉えながら、医療現場や検査室が抱える潜在的な課題を専門的見地から抽出し、解決へと導くことが求められます。 高い責任感を持って検査室の検査の質や生産性向上にダイレクトに貢献し、ひいては患者様への最適な医療提供や「臨床検査の価値向上」に繋げていただく、非常にやりがいがあるポジションです。 【業務内容】 ご自身の専門領域および担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼、および電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼に基づき、病院や検査センターに訪問して以下の業務を担っていただきます。 1. 医療従事者との関係構築・学術活動（拡販活動）
• 臨床検査技師、医師、コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた強固な関係構築
• 当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動（病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の企画・実施等を含む） 2.アプリケーション・セットアップおよび高度なデータサポート
• 検査機器の設置時における、専門的なアプリケーションセットアップ業務
• 検査試薬を用いた、正確なデータ取得のための技術的なサポート業務
• Digital Productを用いた検査業務の運用最適化の推進業務
• 機器試薬に関する問い合わせ、苦情対応業務 3. セールス・サポートおよび将来のプロモーション活動
• 専門的知見を用いた、機器・DigitalProduct・試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務および検査室への学術情報の提供
• 将来的にはセールスサイエンティストとして、顧客の課題抽出やソリューション提案、プロモーション活動など、ビジネスを牽引する役割も期待されます 【応募条件（必須要件）】
• 普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有すること。
• 全国転勤可であること。
• 以下1〜4いずれかのご経験・志向をお持ちの方 臨床検査技師の方: 病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方（※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎します）。 診断薬・医療機器メーカーの経験者 体外診断薬や医療機器メーカーにおいて、アプリケーションスペシャリスト（AS）やアプリケーションサイエンティストとしての実務経験をお持ちの方。これまでの経験を活かし、より専門性を高めながら、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上やビジネスの拡大に深くコミットしたい方。 学術部門のご経験者 製薬メーカー等の学術部門での経験があり、病気の早期発見から治療方針決定、モニタリングまで幅広く貢献する「臨床検査学」に関心をお持ちの方。 【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】
• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方。
• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方。
• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方。
• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。 雇用形態および期間 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用） 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり） 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 フィールドサイエンティスト （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり 就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）:大宮オフィス 〒330-0854埼玉県さいたま市大宮区桜木町1-10-16 シーノ大宮ノースウイング 10F （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする 給与 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。 時間外固定手当：月51,936円 （時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給） ※20時間を超える時間外労働分についての割増賃金は追加で支給 ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月） 諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給 労働時間・休憩時間 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00 （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。） 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ） 休日および休暇 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日 休暇: ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり） ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など） 福利厚生・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノ

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our Pharma Technical Development team for a 6-month internship, where you will gain valuable early-career exposure to vital strategic projects. In this role, you will help design new processes, develop your project management skills, and leverage emerging technologies across a variety of cross-functional initiatives.

The Opportunity

You will thrive in an agile working environment, ensuring compliance with relevant standards while building a healthier future. Your key responsibilities are as follows:

• Shape Our Story: Develop and implement internal communication strategies to effectively convey site stories across Pharma Technical Operations.

• Drive Employee Engagement: Support the launch of the department newsletter and co-create engaging content for internal channels including Town Halls, digital platforms, and collaborative spaces.

• Optimize Data & Systems: Audit, clean, and standardize active communication distribution lists, merging duplicates and establishing uniform naming conventions to ensure seamless internal connectivity.

• Establish Best Practices: Author clear documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for ongoing distribution list management and directory data governance.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with department stakeholders and cross-functional squads to verify communication needs, align messaging, and provide subject matter expertise.

• Coordinate Special Projects: Support end-to-end project management, calendar logistics, and content creation for high-impact communication workstreams.

Who You Are

You are an enthusiastic, detail-oriented communicator who is eager to learn and passionate about making a meaningful impact in the healthcare industry. You enjoy solving problems creatively, organizing complex data, and collaborating with diverse teams to achieve shared successes. Your bring the following qualifications:

• Academic Foundation: Current student or recent graduate (within the last 12 months) of a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Communications, Business, Marketing, or a related field, and must be available to commit to a full-time, 6-month term.

• Analytical & Data Skills: Strong proficiency in spreadsheet tools (such as Excel or Google Sheets) for data filtering, deduplication, and analysis.

• Platform Curiosity: Comfort or familiarity navigating digital workspace environments (such as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace).

• Communication & Organization: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong eye for detail and the ability to securely manage internal directory information.

• Project Mindset: Foundational understanding of project planning, critical thinking, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Language Proficiency: Fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional Information

• Prior internship or initial work experience in a communications-related field is a plus

• Familiarity with basic HTML formatting is a plus

• Please Note: This is a full-time, 6-month internship. This position is not suitable for writing a university thesis.

Application Process

• To apply, please submit your CV, a cover letter, copies of your diplomas, and an enrollment certificate if you are currently studying.

• Under Swiss regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a university certificate confirming that the internship is a mandatory requirement for their degree, specifying its exact duration. Additionally, students must maintain active enrol

Ecco un processo di riflessione: 1. Analizzare l'input dell'utente: - Ruolo: formattatore dell'elenco di lavoro - Compito: Ristrutturare una semplice descrizione del lavoro in un markdown italiano ben formattato - Regole: - Utilizzare `##` per i titoli delle sezioni (ad esempio, `## Mansioni`, `## Requisiti`, `## Cosa offerta`, `## Contatto`) - Utilizzare `-` per i punti elenco - Ogni punto elenco deve essere un singolo elemento completo - Mantenere TUTTO il contenuto originale alla lettera - NON aggiungi, rimuovi o riformula qualsiasi testo - Aggiungi solo la struttura di ribasso (titoli, punti elenco, interruzioni di riga) - Se non esiste una struttura di sezione chiara, utilizza `## Descrizione` come intestazione - Emetti SOLO il ribasso formattato, senza spiegazioni, preamboli o recinzioni di codice - Testo di input: una descrizione del lavoro in inglese per uno stage Roche. Ha sezioni come "La posizione", "L'opportunità", "Chi sei", "Informazioni aggiuntive", "Processo di candidatura" e termina bruscamente con "Se questo ruolo risuona con te, ti incoraggiamo a farlo". - Nota sulla lingua: il messaggio dice "Ribasso italiano", ma le regole dicono "Mantieni TUTTO il contenuto originale alla lettera". Ciò significa che dovrei mantenere il testo inglese esattamente com'è, ma utilizzare i titoli delle sezioni italiani come specificato nelle regole (`## Mansioni`, `## Requisiti`, `## Cosa offriamo`, `## Contatto` o `## Descrizione`). Associamo le sezioni inglesi alle intestazioni italiane previste nel regolamento. 2. Associa le sezioni di input alle intestazioni italiane: - Paragrafo introduttivo -> `## Descrizione` (o potrebbe far parte della prima sezione, ma mi attengo alla regola: se non c'è una struttura chiara, usa `## Descrizione`. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join our Pharma Technical Development team for a 6-month internship, where you will gain valuable early-career exposure to vital strategic projects. In this role, you will help design new processes, develop your project management skills, and leverage emerging technologies across a variety of cross-functional initiatives. The Opportunity You will thrive in an agile working environment, ensuring compliance with relevant standards while building a healthier future. Your key responsibilities are as follows:
• Shape Our Story: Develop and implement internal communication strategies to effectively convey site stories across Pharma Technical Operations.
• Drive Employee Engagement: Support the launch of the department newsletter and co-create engaging content for internal channels including Town Halls, digital platforms, and collaborative spaces.
• Optimize Data & Systems: Audit, clean, and standardize active communication distribution lists, merging duplicates and establishing uniform naming conventions to ensure seamless internal connectivity.
• Establish Best Practices: Author clear documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for ongoing distribution list management and directory data governance.
• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with department stakeholders and cross-functional squads to verify communication needs, align messaging, and provide subject matter expertise.
• Coordinate Special Projects: Support end-to-end project management, calendar logistics, and content creation for high-impact communication workstreams. Who You Are You are an enthusiastic, detail-oriented communicator who is eager to learn and passionate about making a meaningful impact in the healthcare industry. You enjoy solving problems creatively, organizing complex data, and collaborating with diverse teams to achieve shared successes. Your bring the following qualifications:
• Academic Foundation: Current student or recent graduate (within the last 12 months) of a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Communications, Business, Marketing, or a related field, and must be available to commit to a full-time, 6-month term.
• Analytical & Data Skills: Strong proficiency in spreadsheet tools (such as Excel or Google Sheets) for data filtering, deduplication, and analysis.
• Platform Curiosity: Comfort or familiarity navigating digital workspace environments (such as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace).
• Communication & Organization: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong eye for detail and the ability to securely manage internal directory information.
• Project Mindset: Foundational understanding of project planning, critical thinking, and a structured approach to managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Language Proficiency: Fluency in written and spoken English. Additional Information
• Prior internship or initial work experience in a communications-related field is a plus
• Familiarity with basic HTML formatting is a plus
• Please Note: This is a full-time, 6-month internship. This position is not suitable for writing a university thesis. Application Process
• To apply, please submit your CV, a cover letter, copies of your diplomas, and an enrollment certificate if you are currently studying.
• Under Swiss regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a university certificate confirming that the internship is a mandatory requirement for their degree, specifying its exact duration. Additionally, students must maintain active enrol

titleByLocale.fr: Chef des opérations commerciales (chef de file associé)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Operations Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation.

Your Opportunity

• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.

• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.

• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.

• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.

• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.

• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.

• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .

• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

jobs.title: e-Commerce Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Diabetes Care
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key 
• Responsibilities

E-commerce Strategy Planning and Execution
Oversee the day-to-day operations of the e-commerce platform(s) to ensure smooth performance, accuracy, and timely execution of campaigns.
Understand business goals and key priorities to develop an end-to-end e-commerce marketing strategy and campaigns
Monitor inventory, pricing, and product listings to maintain consistency with brand standards and competitive market positioning
Develop strategies to optimize visibility, conversions, and overall performance on owned online platforms
Ensure high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints, resolving any operational issues and improving customer satisfaction.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Conversion Rate, Average Order Value (AOV), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), providing regular data-driven reports.

E-shop and Naver Brand Store Management
Plan and manage to develop the whole scope of owned e-shop and Naver Brand Store
Create strategic action plans to attain consumers connected to the brand
Analyze traffic of e-shop and Naver brand store on a regular basis to understand the trend of online consumer's behavior
Closely work with APAC and global team to enhance owned e commerce shop and unified portal

CRM activation
Plan and execute CRM activities based on SFDC & Commercial website analysis
Plan to expand CRM to customers (retail stores/E-commerce/etc,)
Champion the digital customer journey, leveraging CRM strategies and market insights to foster customer loyalty and retention.

Key stakeholder Management
E-commerce distributor management
Other agencies and partners depending on business situations
Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and IT, to ensure seamless digital operations and efficient inventory management.

Who You Are

Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in e-commerce, digital merchandising, or online retail operations
Language Skills: Advanced English proficiency (both written and verbal) required for seamless communication with APAC and global team.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data (e.g., sales history, search trends, customer buying patterns) to drive actionable insights and optimize product visibility.
Platform & Tech Expertise: Solid understanding of e-commerce platforms and proficiency in web analytics tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

Submission
자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출)
※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다.
※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다.
※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다.
※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오.
※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다.

Process
서류 전형▶ 면접 전형 ▶ 종합 심사 ▶ 최종 합격 통지
※ 면접은 서류전형 합격자에 한해 개별 통보합니다.
※ 면접 일정 안내 및 조율을 위해 해외 번호(중국)로 연락이 갈 수 있는 점 미리 안내드립니다.
※채용이 유력한 후보자에 대해서 이력 검증 및 평판 조회, 건강검진 등의 종합심사를 진행하여 최종 합격자를 선정합니다.

The Position
Das sind wir

Das Chapter Engineering RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte im dreistelligen Millionenbereich, wie z.B. Labor-/ Produktionsgebäuden oder Produktionsanlagen, verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patient:innen mit innovativen Produkten und die Weiterentwicklung der Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg.
Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit.
Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung der Kollegen und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Als Werkstudent:in Business Operations (m/w/d) unterstützt Du unser Team bei der Optimierung interner Abläufe.ű

Das erwartet Dich

• Projektmanagement: Eigenständige Unterstützung bei der Aktualisierung und Harmonisierung von Prozessen (Tools, Ablagestruktur, Wissenstransfer) inklusive Stakeholdermanagement .

• Prozessverbesserung: Erarbeitung von Optimierungsvorschlägen für vielseitige Anwendungsgebiete .

• Kommunikation & Dokumentation: Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation systemischer Änderungen sowie Nachhalten von Aktionen und Protokollen .

• Datenpflege: Aktualisierung von Datenbanken, Masterdateien und Pflege personalrelevanter Daten in SAP.

Das bringst Du mit

• Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Masterstudiengang an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert .

• IT-Kenntnisse: Sicherer Umgang mit Google Workspace (gSuite), Smartsheet sowie MS Office Produkten (z. B. Visio, Lucidchart) .

• Projekt-Know-how: Grundwissen im Projektmanagement und idealerweise erste Erfahrung in der Projektarbeit .

• Sprachen: Gute englische Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift .

• Soft Skills: Du zeichnest Dich durch Kommunikationsstärke, Organisationsvermögen und eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit aus .

Deine Bewerbung

Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch.

Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet.

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten ausgeschlossen sind.

Zeitraum : 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: 实习医药信息顾问
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• 职位职责：
• （1 ） 协助 在公司政策和程序指引下向指定客户群传达医学信息
• （2 ） 协助 进行区域内外部客户医学信息沟通和传递，医学教育活动和培训
• （3 ） 协助 开展学术会议，协助带教人员向客户介绍产品在不同适应症上的优点
• （4 ） 协助 及时收集、提供市场信息并做出适当建议

职位要求：
• （1 ）在校大学生
• （2 ）本科及以上学历，医药相关专业
• （3 ）拥有良好的沟通能力、学习能力、执行能力、抗压能力以及团队合作精神
• （4 ）熟练运用Excel、PPT、Word等办公应用软件
• （5 ）拥有良好的英语书写能力

descriptionByLocale.it: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Riportando al Regional Sales Manager, sarai inserito all'interno del team dedicato alla proposizione presso gli ospedali e i presidi pubblici delle soluzioni Roche per le anatomie patologiche. Nello specifico ti occuperai di - Instaurare relazioni efficaci con i clienti esistenti e potenziali, fungendo da facilitatore e coordinando il contributo delle diverse funzioni aziendali su specifiche opportunità di business; - Perseguire nuove opportunità commerciali con i clienti esistenti e potenziali, in linea con la strategia commerciale; - Contribuire alla migliore Customer Experience per i clienti esistenti. L’area di lavoro comprende Emilia-Romagna e Marche. Chi sei - Laurea in materie scientifiche (Biologia, CTF, Biotecnologie, etc.); - Esperienza commerciale nell’ambito healthcare e nella gestione di gare d'appalto pubbliche; - Spiccate competenze relazionali e di negoziazione; - Forte attitudine al lavoro in team; - Residenza in Emilia Romagna o Marche; - Conoscenza della lingua inglese e della lingua italiana. Completano il profilo dinamicità, proattività, orientamento al cliente, al raggiungimento degli obiettivi e al problem solving. La conoscenza pregressa dei segmenti clienti, o di parte di essi, in cui opera Roche Diagnostics (laboratorio analisi, microbiologia, centro trasfusionale e anatomia patologica) sarà valutata positivamente. La fascia salariale prevista per questa posizione, è di euro 43.377–80.570 euro. Roche Italia offre una retribuzione su 14 mensilità. La retribuzione finale sarà determinata da una serie di fattori, tra cui le competenze, l'esperienza e le qualifiche. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network

titleByLocale.it: Senior Cybersecurity Ingegnere for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.en: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.de: Senior Cybersecurity Ingenieur for Secure Access Network
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Cybersecurity Ingénieur for Secure Access Network

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate network-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee ingress and egress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are delivered through leading-edge security platforms, automation, and orchestration .
You’ll be working within the Network Security Product area. This area is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of solutions—designing, building, and maintaining the technologies that protect Roche networks and the Internet, whether on-prem or cloud-based. This includes continuous improvement of capabilities like Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control and Deep Packet Inspection to stay ahead of an ever-evolving threat landscape.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Network Security), you will act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access Network Services, leading the evolution of Network Access Control, identity-driven security, segmentation and authentication services across Roche's global enterprise.
Your mission is to ensure that Roche’s network remains resilient and compliant through the continuous evolution of our "Defense in Depth" strategy.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Technical Leadership

• Act as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Secure Access technologies, providing deep technical expertise in the evaluation and selection of emerging security tools.

• Drive the long-term technical roadmap for network access, ensuring all initiatives are strictly aligned with Roche's Zero Trust security architecture and strategy.

• Partner with business units to translate high-level security requirements into actionable, scalable technical initiatives and functional policies.

• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence within the team.

Identity-Based Access and Authentication

• Design, deploy, and maintain robust authentication solutions utilizing protocols such as 802.1X, EAP-TLS, EAP-TEAP, RADIUS, TACACS+, SAML, and MFA.

• Integrate disparate security platforms with enterprise Identity Providers (IdPs) to ensure a seamless and secure authentication flow across the environment.

• Architect and manage highly available authentication services to support Roche's global workforce and critical business operations.

Network Access Control (NAC) and Segmentation

• Lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of Cisco ISE deployments, including software upgrades, capacity planning, and platform optimization.

• Develop and refine endpoint profiling techniques to accurately identify and secure corporate, medical, and IoT devices.

• Implement advanced access control mechanisms , including Dot1x, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), Guest Access, and posture-based authorization.

• Design and oversee the implementation of Cisco TrustSec and Scalable Group Tag (SGT)-based micro-segmentation to reduce the network attack surface.

Operational Excellence and Automation

• Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex technical incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Develop and maintain comprehensive observability, monitoring, and reporting dashboards to track platform health and security compliance.

• Advocate for and implement Infrastruct

jobs.title: Praktikum im Energiemanagement & Nachhaltigkeit (m/w/d)

titleByLocale.fr: Stage en gestion de l'énergie et durabilité (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Du willst an Lösungen arbeiten, die wirklich etwas bewegen – für Menschen, Umwelt und Zukunft? Dann werde Teil unseres Energy Supply Teams am Roche-Standort Mannheim und hilf mit, unsere ambitionierten Nachhaltigkeitsziele zu erreichen.
Hier arbeitest du mit an der Umsetzung unserer Dekarbonisierungsstrategie, der Optimierung von Energieverbräuchen und der Weiterentwicklung innovativer Versorgungssysteme – direkt an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Nachhaltigkeit und Industrie. Du unterstützt mit deiner Arbeit das Team, das als zentraler Dienstleister für die Energie- und Medieninfrastruktur des Werks Mannheim verantwortlich ist.

Wer wir sind:
Roche ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Pharma und Diagnostik mit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit, das durch Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit die Lebensqualität der Menschen verbessert. An unserem Standort Mannheim arbeiten rund 9.000 Mitarbeitende an innovativen Lösungen für eine bessere Gesundheitsversorgung.
In unserer Abteilung Energy Supply arbeiten wir daran, den ökologischen Fußabdruck unseres Produktionsstandortes zu minimieren – durch technische Innovationen, intelligente Energiemonitoringsysteme und konkrete Maßnahmen zur CO₂-Reduktion.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du entwickelst smarte Energie-KPIs und Dashboards zur Visualisierung von Verbräuchen, um Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren.

• Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung einer mobilen Energiemessungen, um auf Anlagenebene Verbräuche darzustellen.

• Du unterstützt bei der Identifikation von Ineffizienzen (z.B. gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen).

• Du hilfst mit der grafischen Aufbereitung von Verbrauchsdaten zur Überprüfung der Wirksamkeit umgesetzter technischer Maßnahmen.

• Du übernimmst die Erstellung von Entwürfen für die jährlichen Kurzberichte sowie die Abschlussberichte nach Ende der Optimierungsphase gemäß Prozessvorgabe.

• Du übernimmst eigenständig kleine Teilprojekte und setzt deine Ideen direkt um.

Das bringst Du mit:

• Studium: Du studierst im Bereich Energie-, Umwelt-, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Versorgungstechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und bist für die Dauer des Praktikums immatrikuliert.

• Begeisterung: Du bringst Leidenschaft mit für die Themen der Nachhaltigkeit und Technik.

• Sprachen: Du besitzt sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

Deine Vorteile:

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten (37,5 Stundenwoche) & attraktive Vergütung von 2.268 €/Monat > 3 Monate

• Home-Office Möglichkeit

• Rabatt von -50 % auf Kantinenessen

• Fitnesszentrum auf dem Roche-Campus

• Umfassendes Onboarding und Mentoring & Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden

Erfahre mehr über unseren Standort Penzberg:
https://www.roche.de/unternehmen/unsere-standorte/mannheim

Deine Bewerbung
Bitte lade Deinen Lebenslauf, ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse/Bescheinigungen online hoch.

Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation richtet oder alternativ an Personen im Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium).

Start: ab August 2026
Dauer des Praktikums : max. 6 Monate

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind.

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future dr

titleByLocale.it: Cloud DevOps & Validation Ingegnere - Roche Cloud Platform

titleByLocale.de: Cloud DevOps & Validation Ingenieur - Roche Cloud Platform
titleByLocale.fr: Cloud DevOps & Validation Ingénieur - Roche Cloud Platform

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a DevOps Infrastructure Engineer & Validation Engineer, you will independently solve technical business problems with guidance if needed and contribute to projects requiring knowledge in DevOps and infrastructure management.

You will work closely with IT Quality and the Enterprise Cloud teams to ensure that the latest ITSM and IDLC standards are applied and the platform is maintaining the qualified status.

Your Responsibilities

• Scope/(Content Leadership): Engages in and improves, with guidance, the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products, abstracting away infrastructure complexity by providing self-service tools and APIs for developers. Implements and maintains CI/CD pipelines and develops self-healing features.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Effectively applies problem-solving and decision-making skills to address issues that impact development, deployment, and performance. Ensures IT infrastructure services reach and maintain agreed Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Objectives (SLOs), and Agreements (SLAs) in compliance with QA requirements. Monitors and resolves incidents, practices sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems, and contributes to Disaster Recovery execution plans.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a customer and delivery-focused mindset. Collaborates closely with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve development velocity and service reliability.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and implements cost, compliance, and security best practices. Contributes to audit exercises, manages ITSM processes, and maintains in-depth knowledge of emerging technologies to address complex, interdisciplinary problems.

• Complexity/(Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse, virtual team members from various locations and cultural backgrounds to achieve project or product goals.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated ability to research technical topics, learn new tools quickly, and a strong desire to develop expertise in Cloud and DevOps practices.

• Ability to work effectively within a team, actively participating in discussions and code reviews.

Technical Skills

• Basic understanding of core AWS, Azure, GCP, CaaS services.

• Hands-on experience building Cloud applications via Terraform or CDK.

• Familiarity with Gitlab/Github, SDLC practices and CI/CD.

• Hands-on experience using scripting languages such as Python or Bash and testing frameworks like Pytest.

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies (SAFe), principles, processes, and tools.

• Openness to using AI assistants to support learning, code generation and debugging.

Additional Qualifications

• Familiarity with incident response, including supporting the adoption of ITSM processes and conducting blameless postmortems.

• Proactive approach to troubleshooting issues and finding potential solutions.

#RDT2026

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Di

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Key Account Manager (KAM) , serás responsable de liderar la ejecución de la estrategia integral de Roche en las cuentas estratégicas asignadas y dentro de tu squad de trabajo en Paraguay, bajo el modelo operativo ágil ReImagine Latam . Tu propósito será orquestar planes de cuenta estratégicos que integren innovación, gestión de relaciones de alto nivel (C-Suite) y planificación de ventas, actuando como un socio consultor experto que conecte la visión de la organización con las necesidades del cliente para maximizar la rentabilidad y acelerar el acceso de la innovación a los pacientes.

The Opportunity

• Liderar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas, el forecast comercial y la gestión eficiente de los presupuestos en el territorio asignado.

• Diseñar y orquestar los Account Plans integrando objetivos estratégicos, planificación de la base instalada (IP) e innovación para maximizar la cuota de mercado.

• Trabajar proactivamente dentro del modelo operativo de Squad , colaborando de forma transversal con áreas como Finanzas, Servicio Técnico, Supply, Médica y Marketing.

• Liderar con autonomía la renovación de contratos y la gestión integral del ciclo de vida de la cuenta para mitigar riesgos de pérdida de negocio.

• Identificar y desarrollar activamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling para expandir el portafolio de soluciones en cada cuenta.

• Diseñar soluciones de negocio a medida y Business Cases de alto impacto que demuestren el retorno de inversión (ROI) ante perfiles directivos y tomadores de decisión.

• Mantener actualizado de forma impecable el pipeline de ventas, los contactos clave y los planes estratégicos por cuenta dentro de la plataforma CRM.

Who you are

• Profesional graduado con título universitario en áreas de la Salud, Gestión Empresarial, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

• Trayectoria comprobable de más de 5 años en la industria de la salud, con una fuerte preferencia dentro del sector de Diagnóstico (IVD).

• Experiencia sólida gestionando cuentas complejas de alto desempeño y mapeando roles de decisión clave a nivel directivo (C-Level).

• Habilidades avanzadas en venta consultiva, competencias de comunicación estratégica, disciplina operativa y fuerte orientación a resultados.

• Capacidad probada para trabajar de manera autónoma, colaborativa (Framework VACC) y con alta resiliencia en entornos de volatilidad y complejidad.

• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para radicarte en Asunción y realizar viajes de negocio tanto al interior como al exterior del país según las necesidades comerciales.

titleByLocale.it: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingegnere - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.en: Cloud Infrastructure Network Engineer - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.de: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingenieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure
titleByLocale.fr: Cloud Infrastructure Network Ingénieur - Roche Cloud Platform Azure

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer is a highly skilled, technology-agnostic expert responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. In this role, you will leverage your deep knowledge of IT infrastructure's impact on Roche's business to make critical technical decisions with considerable independence. As a leader, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor global teams, and ensure that all technical designs and deliveries align with long-term organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Acts as a multi-disciplinary, technology-agnostic solution architect, designing, building, testing, and implementing integrated and resilient solutions across the entire infrastructure technology space. Demonstrates a broad view of how different solutions work together and adapt to business demands, taking accountability for ultimate decision-making in technical design and delivery with considerable independent judgment.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Utilizes outstanding problem-solving skills to develop innovative technological ideas and guide them into final products. Follows industry advancements closely to evaluate promising technologies via Proofs of Concept (PoCs) across technology domains. Leads the end-to-end design of infrastructure solutions, maintains related component standards, and provides internal escalation support to resolve major incidents proactively.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex information and potential solutions across the organization, including to the most senior levels of the business, in non-technical terms. Leads as a consultant to senior managers on technology strategy, policies, and objectives, while managing relationships with line-of-business stakeholders. Influences technology vendors and collaborates extensively with IT partners, such as Enterprise Architects and Solution Owners, to integrate feedback.

• Impact/Strategy: Makes strategic decisions that significantly affect departmental goals and leads large to enterprise-level project teams to ensure successful implementation. Ensures that all solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and adhere to the organization’s Technical Architecture Framework (TAF). Plays a pivotal role in project planning by estimating engineering resources, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Drives success across multiple product lines within a domain by collaborating effectively with diverse, virtual teams from various locations and cultural backgrounds. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced technical principles, theories, and concepts, acting as a recognized expert with proven depth and breadth across many areas. Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of multiple Roche business areas beyond IT infrastructure, understanding exactly how infrastructure impacts business processes.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated hands-on experience architecting and implementing Azure cloud network solutions , in depth knowledge of advanced Azure networking architectures and interconnectivity options

• General network engineering experience

• Infrastructure as code software: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro L'Ingegnere di rete per infrastrutture IT di Azure Cloud è un esperto altamente qualificato e diagnostico della tecnologia responsabile della soluzione di problemi aziendali insolitamente complessi con soluzioni innovative in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. In questo ruolo, potrete sfruttare la vostra profonda conoscenza dell'impatto dell'infrastruttura IT sul business di Roche per prendere decisioni tecniche critiche con notevole indipendenza. In qualità di leader, influenzerai proattivamente la strategia tecnologica, tutor team globali, e ti assicurerai che tutti i progetti tecnici e le consegne si allineino agli obiettivi organizzativi a lungo termine e agli standard normativi. Descrizione della zona Responsabilità del lavoro
• Scope / (Content Leadership): agisce come architetto di soluzioni multidisciplinari e diagnostiche, progettando, costruendo, testando e implementando soluzioni integrate e resilienti in tutto lo spazio tecnologico delle infrastrutture. Dimostra un ampio punto di vista sul modo in cui le diverse soluzioni lavorano insieme e si adattano alle esigenze aziendali, tenendo conto della responsabilità del processo decisionale definitivo nella progettazione tecnica e nella consegna con un giudizio indipendente considerevole.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: utilizza eccezionali capacità di problem solving per sviluppare idee tecnologiche innovative e guidarle nei prodotti finali. Segui i progressi del settore per valutare le tecnologie promettenti tramite Proofs of Concept (PoCs) attraverso i domini tecnologici. Conduce la progettazione end-to-end di soluzioni infrastrutturali, mantiene i relativi standard di componenti, e fornisce supporto di escalation interno per risolvere i principali incidenti proattivamente.
• Stakeholder Management: Comunica informazioni complesse e potenziali soluzioni in tutta l'organizzazione, compresi i livelli più anziani del business, in termini non tecnici. Leader come consulente per i senior manager sulla strategia, le politiche e gli obiettivi della tecnologia, mentre la gestione dei rapporti con le parti interessate della linea di business. Influenza fornitori di tecnologia e collabora ampiamente con partner IT, come Enterprise Architects e Solution Owners, per integrare i feedback.
• Impatto/Strategia: Prende decisioni strategiche che influiscono significativamente sugli obiettivi dipartimentali e porta grandi team di progetto a livello aziendale per garantire una corretta implementazione. Assicura che tutte le soluzioni siano conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione e aderiscano al Framework di Architettura Tecnica dell’organizzazione (TAF). Svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella pianificazione del progetto valutando risorse ingegneristiche, dipendenze, rischi e tempistiche.
• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): consente di ottenere il successo su più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio collaborando efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali provenienti da varie sedi e background culturali. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: si basa su principi tecnici avanzati, teorie e concetti, che agiscono come esperto riconosciuto con profondità e larghezza comprovate in molte aree. Dimostra la conoscenza approfondita di più aree aziendali Roche oltre l'infrastruttura IT, capire esattamente come l'infrastruttura influisce sui processi aziendali. Qualifiche Istruzione / Esperienza
• Dimostrata esperienza nell'architettura e nell'implementazione di soluzioni di rete cloud Azure, conoscenza approfondita delle architetture avanzate di rete Azure e delle opzioni di interconnessione
• Esperienza di ingegneria della rete generale
• Infrastrutture come software di codice: Terraform, Ansible, Pyt

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Der Azure Cloud IT Infrastructure Network Engineer ist ein hochqualifizierter, technologieunabhängiger Experte, der für die Lösung ungewöhnlich komplexer Geschäftsprobleme mit innovativen Lösungen im gesamten Bereich der Infrastrukturtechnologie verantwortlich ist. In dieser Funktion nutzen Sie Ihr fundiertes Wissen über die Auswirkungen der IT-Infrastruktur auf das Geschäft von Roche, um kritische technische Entscheidungen mit erheblicher Unabhängigkeit zu treffen. Als Führungskraft beeinflussen Sie proaktiv die Technologiestrategie, beraten globale Teams und stellen sicher, dass alle technischen Entwürfe und Lieferungen mit langfristigen organisatorischen Zielen und regulatorischen Standards übereinstimmen. Beschreibung des Gebiets Aufgabenbereich
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Agiert als multidisziplinärer, technologieunabhängiger Lösungsarchitekt und entwirft, baut, testet und implementiert integrierte und belastbare Lösungen für den gesamten Technologiebereich der Infrastruktur. Zeigt einen breiten Überblick darüber, wie verschiedene Lösungen zusammenarbeiten und sich an geschäftliche Anforderungen anpassen, wobei die Verantwortung für die endgültige Entscheidungsfindung in der technischen Gestaltung und Lieferung mit erheblichem unabhängigem Urteilsvermögen übernommen wird.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Nutzt herausragende Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, um innovative technologische Ideen zu entwickeln und sie in Endprodukte zu leiten. Verfolgt die Fortschritte der Industrie, um vielversprechende Technologien über Proofs of Concept (PoCs) in allen Technologiebereichen zu bewerten. Leitet das End-to-End-Design von Infrastrukturlösungen, unterhält die zugehörigen Komponentenstandards und bietet interne Eskalationsunterstützung, um große Vorfälle proaktiv zu lösen. Stakeholder-Management: Kommuniziert komplexe Informationen und potenzielle Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen, einschließlich der obersten Ebenen des Unternehmens, in nicht-technischen Begriffen. Führt als Berater für leitende Manager zu Technologiestrategien, -richtlinien und -zielen und verwaltet gleichzeitig die Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern aus der Branche. Beeinflusst Technologieanbieter und arbeitet intensiv mit IT-Partnern wie Enterprise Architects und Solution Ownern zusammen, um Feedback zu integrieren. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE7 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards.

Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.

• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.

• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.

• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. Implements and maintains Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and CI/CD pipelines. Applies design thinking, lean, prioritization, and agile methodologies to evo

Possedere profonda conoscenza dell'impatto delle pratiche DevOps sull'infrastruttura aziendale, prendere decisioni tecniche critiche in più linee di prodotto con notevole indipendenza. • Scope / (Content Leadership): stabilisce la direzione tecnica per l'intero ciclo di vita di piattaforme e servizi, dall'inizio e dal design attraverso la distribuzione, il funzionamento e il pensionamento. Si basa sui principi di ingegneria del software per costruire e gestire prodotti e servizi di infrastruttura IT su larga scala, astrattando la complessità delle infrastrutture per fornire strumenti self-service e API per gli sviluppatori. Disegni complessi CI / CD condutture, progetta e sviluppa caratteristiche auto-guarigione, e conduce Disaster Recovery progettazione e piani di esecuzione.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: applica strategicamente competenze avanzate di problem solving e decision-making per affrontare problemi altamente complessi che spaziano da più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio. Conduce la manutenzione dei servizi dal vivo progettando metriche per misurare la disponibilità, la latenza e la salute del sistema, ed è responsabile dell'identificazione delle metriche critiche utilizzate per stabilire SLIs, SLOs e SLAs. Proattivamente piani per la capacità, le prestazioni e la scalabilità delle infrastrutture IT, e conduce grandi iniziative volte a ottimizzare le piattaforme interconnesse. Contabile per la disponibilità, l'ottimizzazione, l'efficienza, la gestione delle modifiche e delle configurazioni e la risposta di emergenza.
• Stakeholder Management: dimostra un'attenzione eccezionale al cliente e alla consegna, guidando attivamente partnership e collaborazione con sviluppatori, fornitori di Managed Services e fornitori per migliorare continuamente la velocità di sviluppo delle applicazioni e ottimizzare l'affidabilità dei servizi. Lavora a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo per garantire nuove funzionalità vengono implementate con una comprensione strategica dell'affidabilità. Fornisce la direzione, la guida e l'impostazione prioritaria, agendo come analista senior per trasformare le esigenze del cliente e dello sviluppatore in requisiti specifici.
• Impatto/Strategia: assicura le soluzioni implementate conformi agli standard di qualità/regolazione ed è responsabile dell'implementazione e dell'aggiornamento dei costi, della conformità e delle best practice di sicurezza. Conduce esercizi di audit complessi, fornendo prove richieste ai team di audit e conduce i piani di bonifica di audit. Gestisce i processi ITSM, sfida i requisiti per scalare i sistemi in modo sostenibile e applica l'innovazione per promuovere la strategia aziendale.
• Complessità/ (dimensione del prodotto): dimostra la comprovata capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diverse squadre virtuali a livello globale, guidando il successo attraverso più linee di prodotto all'interno di un dominio. Conduce team geo-distribuiti attraverso l'influenza e la mentorship, fornendo una guida specializzata per ottimizzare le prestazioni e l'innovazione.
• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: utilizza un'ampia esperienza nell'applicazione dei principi di Software Engineering, dei test automatizzati e degli strumenti CI/CD per definire l'infrastruttura informatica tecnica interamente sotto il controllo del software senza intervento umano. Implementa e mantiene piattaforme interne di sviluppo (IDP) e tubazioni CI/CD. Applica il pensiero di progettazione, magra, priorità e metodologie agili per evo

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Major Responsibilities and Accountabilities :
Accountable for the scientific and technical quality and the timeliness of the pharmacometric (i.e. Modeling and Simulation - M&S) support provided for development projects within one or several Disease Translational Areas (DTA) by integration of scientific knowledge from literature and pre-clinical and clinical studies into mathematical models, in order to support optimal decision making in drug development from exploratory phase to confirmatory phase. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Wichtige Verantwortlichkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten: Verantwortlich für die wissenschaftliche und technische Qualität und die Aktualität der pharmakometrischen (dh Modellierung und Simulation - M & S) Unterstützung für Entwicklungsprojekte in einem oder mehreren Disease Translational Areas (DTA) durch die Integration von wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen aus der Literatur und vorklinischen und klinischen Studien in mathematische Modelle, um eine optimale Entscheidungsfindung in der Arzneimittelentwicklung von der Erkundungsphase bis zur Bestätigungsphase zu unterstützen. Darüber hinaus bietet die Position professionellen Spielraum, um gewidmete Zeit für methodische Innovationen, die Bewertung neuer Modellierungstechniken und die Standard-Prozessoptimierung zu verwenden, um die Exzellenz der funktionalen Modellierung zu erweitern. Für Kandidaten mit starkem Hintergrund oder Interesse an klinischer Pharmakologie kann ein Dual-Role-Framework angepasst werden.
• Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung einer zeitnahen, wissenschaftlich fundierten, innovativen und geschäftsorientierten M&S-Strategie für die Projekte innerhalb oder innerhalb des DTA gemäß der vom DTA Clinical Pharmacology und dem DTA Disease Modeling Leader definierten Gesamtstrategie für klinische Pharmakologie
• Entwickelt und führt geeignete (Populations-) pharmakokinetische und (Populations-) pharmakodynamische Modelle für das Projekt aus und wendet, falls für das Projekt verfügbar, empirische und / oder mechanistisch basierte Drogenkrankheitsmodelle an
• Führt Simulationen durch, um die Auswirkungen von Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu veranschaulichen, wie z. B. die Auswahl des Dosierungsschemas und andere Merkmale des Studiendesigns sowie die Berichterstattung über das jeweilige Ergebnis für interne Entscheidungsfindungen oder NDA-Dokumente oder Peer-Review-Zeitschriften
• Interagiert auf wissenschaftlicher Ebene mit dem klinischen Pharmakologen in Bezug auf alle Aspekte der Integration von M & S, um eine effiziente und angemessene M & S-Strategie und -Aktivitäten für das Projekt zu gewährleisten

• Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung von M&S-Projekten für vorklinische und klinische Studiendaten.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Principales responsabilités et responsabilités : Responsable de la qualité scientifique et technique et de l'actualité du soutien pharmacométrique (c.-à-d. modélisation et simulation - M et S) fourni pour des projets de développement dans un ou plusieurs domaines translationnels de la maladie (DTA) par l'intégration des connaissances scientifiques issues de la littérature et des études précliniques et cliniques dans des modèles mathématiques, afin d'appuyer la prise de décision optimale en matière de développement de médicaments, de la phase exploratoire à la phase de confirmation. De plus, le poste offre une latitude professionnelle pour consacrer du temps à l'innovation méthodologique, à l'évaluation des nouvelles techniques de modélisation et à l'optimisation standard des processus afin d'accroître l'excellence de la modélisation fonctionnelle. Pour les candidats ayant de solides antécédents ou qui s'intéressent à la pharmacologie clinique, un cadre à double rôle peut être personnalisé.
• Élaborer et maintenir une stratégie de S-S opportune, scientifiquement solide, novatrice et axée sur l'entreprise pour les projets à l'intérieur ou à l'extérieur du DTA, conformément à la stratégie globale de pharmacologie clinique du DTA définie par le DTA Clinical Pharmacologue et le chef de la modélisation de la maladie du DTA
• Concevoir et exécuter des modèles pharmacocinétiques et pharmacodynamiques appropriés (population) pour le projet et appliquer, s'ils sont disponibles pour le projet, des modèles empiriques et/ou des modèles de médicaments à base mécanique
• Effectue des simulations pour illustrer l'impact des décisions de développement telles que la sélection des régimes posologiques et d'autres caractéristiques de conception des essais, ainsi que la présentation des résultats respectifs pour la prise de décision interne ou les documents de l'EDN ou les revues examinées par les pairs
• Interagit au niveau scientifique avec le pharmacologue clinique en ce qui concerne tous les aspects de l'intégration de la M&S pour assurer une stratégie et des activités de M&S efficaces et appropriées pour le projet
• Prépare l'information et la stratégie à présenter lors des réunions de l'équipe de projet PRED et PD afin d'assurer la cohérence des activités/objectifs de M&S avec les objectifs généraux du projet et les normes actuelles de Roche
• S'assure que les membres de l'équipe et de la direction du projet comprennent suffisamment les méthodes et les résultats de M&S appliqués au projet;
• S'assure que la stratégie et les résultats de M&S sont intégrés dans les documents de projet internes et externes (p. ex. plan de développement clinique, brochure du chercheur)
• Gère des consultants et des collaborateurs extérieurs qui fournissent une expertise en M & S pour des tâches individuelles ou des projets entiers.
• Veiller à ce que les activités de S&S menées dans le cadre du projet soient exécutées en temps voulu et conformément aux normes élevées requises en matière de statistiques, de pharmacologie et d'autres rapports;
• Développer et maintenir une expertise scientifique spécifique dans les domaines nouveaux et émergents de la pharmacométrie. Établir et gérer des contacts et des alliances externes dans ce domaine et veiller à ce que les connaissances pour les domaines assignés soient partagées efficacement dans l'ensemble du Ministère.
• Assurer le mentorat et le leadership scientifique et professionnel d'autres membres du département de pharmacologie clinique.
• Pour les candidats qui ont une solide expérience ou qui s'intéressent à la pharmacologie clinique locale et mondiale, un cadre à double rôle peut être personnalisé. Qualifications Diplôme médical ou PharmD ou doctorat en sciences naturelles ayant une expérience pertinente dans la planification et la conduite de projets de M et S pour des données précliniques ou cliniques (de préférence dans un contexte d'industrie pharmaceutique) Expérience et/ou compétences requises :
• Expérience de la planification et de la réalisation de projets de M et S pour les données des études précliniques et cliniques.

The Position

IT Business Analyst - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Principal Business Analyst is a senior, high-impact role that sits at the crossroads of clinical science, product strategy, and technology delivery. While positioned as a Business Analyst, this role operates with the breadth, depth, and strategic influence of a seasoned analyst owning the vision, innovation pipeline, and feature delivery of the Study Designer, a flagship product enabling clinical trial teams to design smarter, faster, and more impactful studies.This individual brings a rare combination of deep scientific credibility, product leadership, and technical fluency - capable of earning the trust of Clinical Scientists in one meeting and driving an engineering sprint in the next. They are relentlessly curious, innovation-driven, and passionate about using technology to transform how clinical trials are conceived and executed - ultimately accelerating therapies to patients.

The Opportunity

• Clinical & Scientific Collaboration : Act as the primary link between clinical/scientific teams and product engineering, building long-term relationships and facilitating discovery workshops with medical experts to deeply understand trial design and represent the clinical user's voice.

• Product Feature Innovation: Define and own the feature roadmap by balancing business, scientific, and technical needs; foster innovation through design thinking sprints to identify new opportunities, create compelling business cases, and track feature success metrics/KPIs post-release.

• Feature Design & Requirements Excellence: Author precise, actionable user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria; partner with UX to create wireframes and prototypes, ruthlessly filter requests based on value, and maintain a living product specification traceable to user needs.

• Technology & Engineering Partnership: Act as a technical translator by converting complex clinical workflows into structured requirements, leveraging strong literacy in architecture, data modeling, and APIs to collaborate with engineers on technical risks, dependencies, and solutions.

• Quality Assurance & UAT Support: Partner with architects, senior engineers, and QA leads throughout the development build cycle to ensure feature scalability and quality, while supporting UAT design and execution to meet scientific intent and usability standards.

• Agile Leadership & Delivery: Drive iterative delivery, rapid feedback, and hypothesis-driven development; own and groom a sprint-ready
