jobs.title: Competitive Intelligence Leader
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) team is the heartbeat of Pharma, setting the rhythm by shaping Roche’s strategic direction and ensuring our portfolio delivers meaningful innovation to patients worldwide. By integrating scientific, commercial, and market insights, GPS drives enterprise-wide strategy, portfolio prioritization, and business model innovation to advance Roche’s leadership in the evolving healthcare landscape. As part of the Portfolio, Strategy, and Insights (PSI) team within GPS, which is composed of Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, and Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, these teams work together to provide unbiased, expertly curated, and technology-enabled intelligence to drive lifecycle management, commercialization excellence, and portfolio strategies. The Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) team delivers high-quality competitive intelligence and actionable recommendations that shape Roche’s decision-making across leadership and end-to-end (E2E) molecule teams.
In this role as a Competitive Intelligence Leader based in Basel, you will lead and implement competitive intelligence strategies for both early- and late-stage pipeline assets, as well as prioritized on-market products by leveraging AI-driven technologies and deep analysis of scientific, clinical, and commercial information. You will serve as a strategic thought partner and trusted advisor in guiding Roche’s product, disease area, pharma, and corporate strategy, focusing your efforts on specific Disease Areas (DA) within a Therapeutic Area (TA) and broader industry trends. As a catalyst for strategic collaboration, you will engage with key functions including Research and Early Development (RED), Product Development (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partnering/Business Development, US Pharma, and Pharma International to drive strategic impact.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Thought Leadership & Competitive Intelligence: Act as a strategic thought partner, providing high-quality insights and recommendations to guide decision-making at the Disease Area (DA), Therapeutic Area (TA), and enterprise levels. Analyze and synthesize data from multiple sources (including primary/secondary research, real-world evidence, and AI-driven analytics) to anticipate market evolution, competitor moves, and emerging trends that impact Roche’s strategy and competitiveness.

• Competitive Pipeline Development: Shape competitive strategies by informing competitive positioning, TPP creation, and launch plans (value proposition, differentiation, messaging), while leading the assessment of standard-of-care evolution by synthesizing insights at pre-clinical and clinical stages, including emerging trends and modalities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Partner with key internal stakeholders (GPS, R&D, Product Development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams) to ensure insights are embedded in strategic planning, while fostering collaboration across the lifecycle, functions, and geographies to maximize impact.

• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Lead and execute strategic initiatives with clear objectives, ensuring timely, high-quality, and impactful deliverables. Manage relationships with external agencies and internal partners, ensuring complete alignment with business priorities and objectives.

• Innovation & AI-Enabled Insights: Champion the adoption of advanced analytics, AI-driven intelligence

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il nostro team Global Pharma Strategy (GPS) è il battito cardiaco di Pharma, impostando il ritmo plasmando la direzione strategica di Roche e assicurando che il nostro portafoglio offre innovazione significativa ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. Integrando intuizioni scientifiche, commerciali e di mercato, il GPS guida la strategia aziendale, la priorità del portafoglio e l’innovazione del modello di business per far progredire la leadership di Roche nel panorama sanitario in evoluzione. Nell'ambito del team Portfolio, Strategy e Insights (PSI) all'interno del GPS, composto da Advanced Analytics for Business Insights, Competitive Intelligence, Ecosystem Insights, Partnering Commercial Assessment Leads, e Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, questi team lavorano insieme per fornire un'intelligenza impareggiabile, sapientemente curata e tecnologica per guidare la gestione del ciclo di vita, l'eccellenza di commercializzazione e il portafoglio strategie. Il team Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) fornisce un'intelligenza competitiva di alta qualità e raccomandazioni attuabili che modellano il processo decisionale di Roche tra i team di leadership e di end-to-end (E2E). In questo ruolo di Competitive Intelligence Leader con sede a Basilea, guiderai e implementerai strategie di intelligenza competitive sia per i beni delle tubazioni di primo e ultimo stadio, sia per i prodotti privilegiati sul mercato sfruttando le tecnologie AI-driven e la profonda analisi delle informazioni scientifiche, cliniche e commerciali. Potrai servire come partner di pensiero strategico e consulente di fiducia nella guida di Roche prodotto, area di malattia, farmacia e strategia aziendale, concentrando i tuoi sforzi su specifiche aree di malattia (DA) all'interno di uno spazio terapeutico (TA) e tendenze del settore più ampio. Come catalizzatore per la collaborazione strategica, si impegnano con funzioni chiave tra cui ricerca e sviluppo precoce (RED), sviluppo del prodotto (PD), PDMA, GPS, Partner/Business Development, US Pharma e Pharma International per guidare l'impatto strategico. L'opportunità
• Leadership strategica del pensiero e intelligenza competitiva: agire come partner di pensiero strategico, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni di alta qualità per guidare il processo decisionale presso l'Area Malattia (DA), Area terapeutica (TA), e livelli di impresa. Analizzare e sintetizzare i dati da più fonti (compresa la ricerca primaria/secondaria, le prove del mondo reale e l'analisi guidata dall'IA) per anticipare l'evoluzione del mercato, le mosse dei concorrenti e le tendenze emergenti che influiscono sulla strategia e sulla competitività di Roche.
• Sviluppo competitivo del Pipeline: Formare strategie competitive informando il posizionamento competitivo, la creazione di TPP e i piani di lancio (proposizione del valore, differenziazione, messaggistica), mentre leader la valutazione dell'evoluzione standard-of-care sintetizzando intuizioni a fasi precliniche e cliniche, comprese le tendenze e le modalità emergenti.
• Collaborazione & Influenza trasversale: Partner con i principali stakeholder interni (GPS, R&D, Sviluppo del Prodotto, Affari Medici, Sviluppo Business e team commerciali) per garantire che gli insight siano incorporati nella pianificazione strategica, promuovendo la collaborazione tra il ciclo di vita, le funzioni e le geografie per massimizzare l'impatto.
• Project, Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Guidare ed eseguire iniziative strategiche con obiettivi chiari, garantendo consegne tempestive, di alta qualità e di impatto. Gestisci i rapporti con le agenzie esterne e con i partner interni, garantendo un allineamento completo con le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Innovazione & AI-Enabled Insights: Campione dell'adozione di analisi avanzate, intelligenza basata sull'intelligenza

Dans le cadre de l'équipe du portefeuille, de la stratégie et des perspectives (PSI) au sein du GPS, qui est composée d'Avancé Analytics for Business Insights, de Competitive Intelligence, d'Ecosystem Insights, de Partenaires responsables de l'évaluation commerciale et de Pharma Portfolio & Strategy, ces équipes travaillent ensemble à fournir des renseignements impartiaux, spécialisés et axés sur la technologie afin de stimuler la gestion du cycle de vie, l'excellence en matière de commercialisation et les stratégies de portefeuille. L'équipe de Global Competitive Intelligence (CI) fournit une intelligence concurrentielle de haute qualité et des recommandations pratiques qui façonnent la prise de décision de Roche dans les équipes de direction et de molécule de bout en bout (E2E). Dans le cadre de ce rôle de chef de file en matière de renseignements concurrentiels basé à Bâle, vous dirigerez et mettre en oeuvreez des stratégies de renseignement concurrentiel pour les actifs des pipelines en début et en fin de phase, ainsi que des produits prioritaires sur le marché en tirant parti des technologies axées sur l'IA et en analysant en profondeur l'information scientifique, clinique et commerciale. Vous servirez de partenaire de réflexion stratégique et de conseiller de confiance pour guider les produits, les maladies, les produits pharmaceutiques et la stratégie d'entreprise de Roches, en concentrant vos efforts sur des zones de maladies particulières dans un domaine thérapeutique (TA) et des tendances plus générales de l'industrie. En tant que catalyseur de la collaboration stratégique, vous participerez à des fonctions clés telles que la recherche et le développement précoce (RED), le développement de produits (PD), la PDMA, le GPS, le partenariat/développement d'entreprises, la pharmacie américaine et Pharma International pour stimuler l'impact stratégique. L'opportunité
• Leadership de la pensée stratégique et intelligence concurrentielle : agir en tant que partenaire de la pensée stratégique, fournir des idées et des recommandations de haute qualité pour guider la prise de décisions dans la région de la maladie (DA), la région thérapeutique (TA) et l'entreprise. Analyser et synthétiser les données provenant de sources multiples (y compris la recherche primaire/secondaire, les données factuelles et l'analyse de l'IA) pour anticiper l'évolution du marché, les mouvements des concurrents et les tendances émergentes qui influent sur la stratégie et la compétitivité de Roche.
• Développement concurrentiel des pipelines : façonner les stratégies concurrentielles en informant le positionnement concurrentiel, la création de PPT et les plans de lancement (proposition de valeur, différenciation, messagerie), tout en dirigeant l'évaluation de l'évolution des normes de soins en synthétisant les idées aux stades préclinique et clinique, y compris les nouvelles tendances et modalités.
• Collaboration et influence interfonctionnelles : partenariat avec les principaux intervenants internes (GPS, R-D, Développement des produits, Affaires médicales, Développement des affaires et des équipes commerciales) pour s'assurer que les idées sont intégrées dans la planification stratégique, tout en favorisant la collaboration tout au long du cycle de vie, des fonctions et des géographies afin de maximiser l'impact.
• Gestion des projets, des parties prenantes et des fournisseurs : Diriger et exécuter des initiatives stratégiques avec des objectifs clairs, en veillant à ce que les produits livrables soient fournis en temps opportun, de qualité et d'impact. Gérer les relations avec les organismes externes et les partenaires internes, en assurant l'harmonisation complète avec les priorités et les objectifs opérationnels.
• Innovation & Intelligences activées par l'IA : Championne de l'adoption d'analyses avancées, d'intelligences induites par l'IA

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about transforming procurement processes through technology and data? Join Roche and play a key role in shaping the future of our global ERP landscape.

As a Senior ERP Solution Consultant, you will partner with business and IT stakeholders to design and deliver innovative solutions across the Source-to-Procure (S2P) lifecycle. You will bridge business needs with technical capabilities, driving efficiency, data integrity, and digital transformation across procurement processes.

This is a highly visible role where you will contribute to global initiatives, influence solution design, and support the evolution of Roche’s procurement ecosystem.

Your Opportunity
In this role, you will:

• Lead end-to-end analysis and solution design across the Source-to-Procure lifecycle, including sourcing, contracting, purchasing, and invoicing

• Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and user stories

• Act as a functional expert for procurement platforms (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Ariba, Coupa, GEP), ensuring system stability and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, and IT to deliver integrated solutions

• Drive testing activities (SIT, UAT) and ensure high-quality, business-ready system deployments

• Support product and roadmap discussions, balancing quick wins with long-term system sustainability

• Contribute to process optimization, data quality, and user adoption through training and change management

Who you are
You bring a strong mix of functional expertise, problem-solving skills, and stakeholder management:

• 6–8 years of experience in ERP solution consulting or business analysis within procurement or Source-to-Pay environments

• Hands-on experience with platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, Coupa, GEP, or similar

• Strong understanding of end-to-end Source-to-Procure / Procure-to-Pay processes

• Experience translating business needs into technical requirements and implementation plans

• Familiarity with system integrations, APIs, or middleware solutions is an advantage

• Ability to work in agile environments and manage multiple priorities

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Roche has defined an exciting 10-year ambition plan, and our Global Procurement (GP) organization is already established as an agile, high-functioning team dedicated to delivering on our mission for patients. We operate with a focus on accelerating Roche’s goal to bring innovative solutions to patients quickly and efficiently through robust business and supplier partnerships. Are you wondering what is in it for you? Are you interested in further developing and leveraging your market knowledge, business partnering, and influencing skills? Here is why we think the Procurement Specialist - Research & Development role is a fantastic job to consider! As a Procurement Specialist, you will work in a dynamic global environment where you bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Thanks to your strong problem-solving and core procurement skills, you will effectively collaborate with internal procurement (customer relationship management, contracting, solutions, etc.) and business stakeholders to translate business needs into sourcing, spend management activities, and content enhancement. Based on your general procurement and commodity expertise, you ensure the effective and efficient delivery of core procurement services and continuous improvement of automation and content availability. You will work closely with team members to support customer demand, improve the customer buying experience, deliver on day-to-day operational activities, and provide capacity and expertise to provide productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions. The Opportunity: Your successful performance and contribution depend on the full embodiment and demonstration of core mindsets and behaviors, including an entrepreneurial spirit, enterprise thinking, inclusive collaboration, and desire for continuous learning that underpin our culture and ways of working. As a Procurement Specialist, you will work within the broader team and GP networks and squads to determine the various roles needed to deliver project and foundational work. You will also play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, such as:
• Sourcing and category subject matter specialist conducting market and internal analysis to develop and implement strategies and tactical plans for Roche to source and negotiate for third-party goods and services that satisfy stakeholder requirements.
• Procurement practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management, and project management skills to achieve objectives and key results.
• Content and automation advocate translating sourcing outcomes and opportunities into content and automated buying channels that improve business adoption, satisfaction, and overall efficiency. Who you are :
• You hold a university degree, with a business degree preferable. You also have 3+ years of experience in sourcing, contracting, operational efficiency projects, or relevant commodity experience, preferably in the Pharmaceutical industry.
• You demonstrate knowledge in the C

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Solutions Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the Strategy and Solutions Chapter, a hub of innovation that guides strategic priorities and strengthens Global Procurement's impact across Roche. As our Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (Procurement Governance), you become an Ambassador for Digital Procurement and Excellence — bringing structured thinking and creativity to the technology, processes and frameworks that shape how we work. You thrive in a fast-moving global environment and proactively drive a digital roadmap toward automation, efficiency and an exceptional user experience.
The Opportunity:

• You drive the digital procurement strategy — identifying and delivering approaches that move the wider roadmap forward.

• You take ownership of designated solutions as the subject-matter expert, with an immediate focus on external workforce solutions and their governance and direction.

• You optimise processes and solutions continuously, maximising value through analytics and data insights.

• You collaborate across the matrix — partnering with Procurement, IT, Business Process Management and external vendors to align priorities and enhance enabling technologies.

• You build governance excellence — developing frameworks, guides, tools and training, and overseeing key configurations such as workflow, thresholds and access control in no-code contexts.

• You shape vendor roadmaps — managing relationships with solution providers and influencing their products to meet Roche's needs.

Who you are:

• You hold a university degree in Business or IT and bring significant experience across Procurement, Supply Chain, Procurement Technology, or Management Consulting.

• You have deep expertise in procurement technology management, including backlog management, KPIs, and applying LLMs.

• You translate complex data into actionable insights and craft clear messages for senior stakeholders.

• You influence and collaborate across teams without direct authority, adapting quickly to changing priorities in a matrix organisation.

• You are a strategic, action-oriented and inclusive thinker who understands both the power of technology and the human change management that underpins it.

Preferred:

• Certified expertise in Scrum/SAFe, LEAN, or Change Management.

• Technical/coding experience or familiarity with low/no-code platforms.

• Business fluency in German, in addition to business fluency in English.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process.
Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Fur

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti al capitolo Strategy and Solutions, un hub di innovazione che guida le priorità strategiche e rafforza l'impatto del Global Procurement su Roche. In qualità di nostro Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (Procurement Governance), diventi Ambasciatore per il Digital Procurement and Excellence - portando il pensiero strutturato e la creatività alla tecnologia, ai processi e alle strutture che modellano il nostro lavoro. Si prospera in un ambiente globale in rapida evoluzione e guidare proattivamente una roadmap digitale verso l'automazione, l'efficienza e un'esperienza utente eccezionale. L'opportunità:
• Guidare la strategia di approvvigionamento digitale - identificare e fornire approcci che spostano la roadmap più ampia in avanti.
• Prendere la proprietà di soluzioni designate come esperto soggetto-materia, con un focus immediato sulle soluzioni esterne della forza lavoro e la loro governance e direzione.
• Ottimizza i processi e le soluzioni continuamente, massimizzando il valore attraverso analisi e informazioni sui dati.
• Collabori attraverso la matrice — collaborando con Procurement, IT, Business Process Management e fornitori esterni per allineare le priorità e migliorare le tecnologie abilitanti.
• Costruisci l'eccellenza della governance — sviluppando quadri, guide, strumenti e formazione, e supervisionando configurazioni chiave come flusso di lavoro, soglie e controllo degli accessi in contesti no-code.
• Formare roadmap del fornitore — gestire i rapporti con i fornitori di soluzioni e influenzare i loro prodotti per soddisfare le esigenze di Roche. Chi sei:
• Ha una laurea in Business o IT e portare esperienza significativa in Procurement, Supply Chain, Procurement Technology, o Management Consulting.
• Hai una profonda esperienza nella gestione della tecnologia di approvvigionamento, inclusa la gestione del backlog, i KPI e l'applicazione di LLM.
• Traduci dati complessi in insight attuabili e inserisci messaggi chiari per gli stakeholder senior.
• Influenzi e collabori in team senza autorità diretta, adattandosi rapidamente al cambiamento delle priorità in un'organizzazione di matrice.
• Sei un pensatore strategico, orientato all'azione e inclusivo che comprende sia il potere della tecnologia che la gestione del cambiamento umano che lo sostiene. Preferito:
• Competenze certificate in Scrum/SAFe, LEAN o Change Management.
• Esperienza tecnica/codifica o familiarità con piattaforme low/no-code.
• Fluency aziendale in tedesco, oltre alla fluidità aziendale in inglese. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Le dichiarazioni di cui sopra sono destinate a descrivere la natura generale e il livello di lavoro che vengono eseguiti dai dipendenti, e non devono essere interpretate come un elenco esaustivo di responsabilità, doveri e competenze richieste dal personale così classificato. Furto

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Rejoignez le chapitre Stratégie et solutions, un pôle d'innovation qui guide les priorités stratégiques et renforce l'impact de l'approvisionnement mondial à Roche. En tant que chef des solutions d'approvisionnement (gouvernance de l'approvisionnement), vous devenez ambassadeur pour l'approvisionnement et l'excellence numériques. Vous prospèrez dans un environnement mondial en évolution rapide et conduisez de manière proactive une feuille de route numérique vers l'automatisation, l'efficacité et une expérience utilisateur exceptionnelle. La possibilité :
• Vous dirigez la stratégie d'approvisionnement numérique — identifier et mettre en œuvre des approches qui font avancer la feuille de route plus large.
• Vous êtes propriétaire des solutions désignées en tant qu'expert en la matière, en mettant immédiatement l'accent sur les solutions externes en matière de main-d'œuvre ainsi que sur leur gouvernance et leur orientation.
• Vous optimisez les processus et les solutions en continu, maximisant la valeur grâce à l'analyse et aux données.
• Vous collaborez à travers la matrice — en partenariat avec les fournisseurs d'approvisionnement, d'informatique, de gestion des processus opérationnels et d'autres fournisseurs pour harmoniser les priorités et améliorer les technologies habilitantes.
• Vous construisez l'excellence en matière de gouvernance — élaboration de cadres, de guides, d'outils et de formations, et supervision de configurations clés telles que les flux de travail, les seuils et le contrôle d'accès dans des contextes sans code.
• Vous façonnez les feuilles de route des fournisseurs – gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs de solutions et influencer leurs produits pour répondre aux besoins de Roche. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en affaires ou en TI et vous apportez une expérience importante dans l'approvisionnement, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la technologie d'approvisionnement ou le conseil en gestion.
• Vous disposez d'une expertise approfondie dans la gestion des technologies d'approvisionnement, y compris la gestion de l'arriéré, les KPI et l'application des LLM.
• Vous traduisez des données complexes en informations exploitables et créez des messages clairs pour les principaux acteurs.
• Vous influencez et collaborez entre des équipes sans autorité directe, en vous adaptant rapidement à l'évolution des priorités dans une organisation matricielle.
• Vous êtes un penseur stratégique, pragmatique et inclusif qui comprend à la fois le pouvoir de la technologie et la gestion du changement humain qui la sous-tend. Préféré:
• Expertise certifiée en Scrum/Safe, LEAN ou gestion du changement.
• Expérience technique/codage ou connaissance des plates-formes basses/sans code.
• La maîtrise des affaires en allemand, en plus de la maîtrise des affaires en anglais. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Welwyn. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Ces énoncés visent à décrire la nature générale et le niveau de travail des employés et ne doivent pas être interprétés comme une liste exhaustive des responsabilités, des fonctions et des compétences requises du personnel ainsi classifié. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are developing the next-generation of sequencing systems. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are also broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing workflows.

Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a Principal Mechanical Engineer to contribute to the design, development, characterization, and integration of cutting-edge sequencing systems.This is a hands-on role focused on solving the fluidic and consumable challenges at the heart of our next-generation platforms. We are looking for someone who exhibits a high degree of motivation, independence, and resourcefulness to help us develop solutions to our automation challenges in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Core Responsibilities:

• Contribute to architecture, design, research and early development of specialized consumables and mating mechanisms.

• Contribute to the layout, prototyping, and characterization of new fluidic circuits and architectures.

• Design, build, and assemble custom test fixtures to support testing of fluidic subsystems and novel consumables.

• Translate high-level system and assay requirements into fluidic schematics, system architectures and concepts to evaluate, compare, and downselect design paths.

• Create and maintain comprehensive design documentation for your sub-systems, including detailed 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and material specifications with a focus on chemical compatibility and robustness.

• Conduct cross-functional design reviews. Present progress, data, and engineering decisions clearly to stakeholders.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA. (This is not a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are
(Required)

• You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant years of industry experience (7+ years for a Bachelor's, 5+ years for a Master's, or 3+ years for a PhD).

• You have demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex fluidic manifolds, consumable interfaces, or moving mechanisms, preferably for life science or diagnostic instrumentation.

• You have a high level of proficiency with Python for device control, automated test bench execution, and data acquisition/analysis.

• You have a strong background in experimental design for fluidic characterization.

• You have a high level of proficiency with machine shop tools, measurement equipment, and rapid prototyping technologies.

• You have demonstrated expertise in SolidWorks for detailed assembly design and the creation of manufacturing drawings.

• You have demonstrated troubleshooting skills, with a solid understanding of physics, chemistry and engineering fundamentals.

Preferred:

• You have experience with plastic bonding techniques and injection molding principles.

• You have experience utilizing CFD or FEA tools to guide fluidic and thermal design decisions.

• You have experience developing DNA sequencing, DNA synthesizers and other complex fluidic automation instrumentation.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, stiamo sviluppando la prossima generazione di sistemi di sequenziamento. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo anche ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento di nuova generazione. Il nostro System Technology Group, parte di Roche Sequencing Solutions, si concentra sulla creazione e l'avanzamento di tecnologie per migliorare in modo significativo i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento del DNA. Stiamo cercando un ingegnere meccanico principale per contribuire alla progettazione, sviluppo, caratterizzazione e integrazione di sistemi di sequenziamento all'avanguardia. Questo è un ruolo pratico focalizzato sulla soluzione delle sfide fluidiche e di consumo al centro delle nostre piattaforme di nuova generazione. Stiamo cercando qualcuno che esibisce un alto grado di motivazione, indipendenza e risorse per aiutarci a sviluppare soluzioni alle nostre sfide di automazione in un ambiente veloce e collaborativo. Responsabilità fondamentali:
• Contribuire all'architettura, alla progettazione, alla ricerca e allo sviluppo precoce dei materiali di consumo specializzati e dei meccanismi di accoppiamento.
• Contribuire al layout, alla prototipazione e alla caratterizzazione di nuovi circuiti e architetture fluidiche.
• Progettare, costruire e assemblare dispositivi di prova personalizzati per supportare la sperimentazione di sottosistemi fluidi e nuovi materiali di consumo.
• Tradurre i requisiti di sistema e di analisi di alto livello in schemi fluidi, architetture di sistema e concetti per valutare, confrontare e downselect percorsi di progettazione.
• Creare e mantenere una documentazione di progettazione completa per i sottosistemi, compresi i modelli CAD 3D dettagliati, i disegni di produzione e le specifiche dei materiali con un focus sulla compatibilità chimica e la robustezza.
• Condurre recensioni di design interfunzionali. Presentare i progressi, i dati e le decisioni di ingegneria chiaramente agli stakeholder. Questa posizione si basa sul sito in Santa Clara, CA. (Questa non è una posizione ibrida.) I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo. Chi sei (richiesto)
• Hai una laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, con anni rilevanti di esperienza del settore (7+ anni per un Bachelor, 5+ anni per un Master, o 3+ anni per un dottorato).
• Hai dimostrato la progettazione, lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di collettori fluidi complessi, interfacce di consumo o meccanismi mobili, preferibilmente per la scienza della vita o la strumentazione diagnostica.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con Python per il controllo del dispositivo, l'esecuzione automatica del banco di prova e l'acquisizione/analisi dei dati.
• Hai uno sfondo forte nel design sperimentale per la caratterizzazione fluidica.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con macchine utensili, apparecchiature di misura e tecnologie di prototipazione rapida.
• Hai dimostrato competenze in SolidWorks per la progettazione dettagliata del montaggio e la creazione di disegni di produzione.
• Hai dimostrato le capacità di risoluzione dei problemi, con una solida comprensione della fisica, della chimica e dei fondamenti ingegneristici. Preferito:
• Hai esperienza con tecniche di incollaggio in plastica e principi di stampaggio ad iniezione.
• Hai esperienza utilizzando strumenti CFD o FEA per guidare le decisioni di progettazione fluida e termica.
• Hai esperienza nello sviluppo di sequenziamento del DNA, sintetizzatori del DNA e altre complesse strumentazione di automazione fluidica.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Bei Roche entwickeln wir die nächste Generation von Sequenziersystemen. Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir auch den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Hindernisse für die Annahme. Von robusten Werkzeugen zur Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für Sequenzierungs-Workflows der nächsten Generation. Unsere Systems Technology Group, ein Teil von Roche Sequencing Solutions, konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Technologien, um DNA-Sequenzierungs-Workflows deutlich zu verbessern. Wir suchen einen Hauptmechaniker, der zur Gestaltung, Entwicklung, Charakterisierung und Integration modernster Sequenzierungssysteme beiträgt. Dies ist eine praktische Rolle, die sich auf die Lösung der fluidischen und verbrauchbaren Herausforderungen im Herzen unserer Plattformen der nächsten Generation konzentriert. Wir suchen jemanden, der ein hohes Maß an Motivation, Unabhängigkeit und Einfallsreichtum zeigt, um Lösungen für unsere Automatisierungsherausforderungen in einer schnelllebigen und kollaborativen Umgebung zu entwickeln. Kernaufgaben:
• Beitrag zur Architektur, Design, Forschung und frühen Entwicklung von spezialisierten Verbrauchsmaterialien und Paarungsmechanismen.
• Beitrag zum Layout, Prototyping und zur Charakterisierung neuer fluidischer Schaltkreise und Architekturen. Entwerfen, bauen und montieren Sie benutzerdefinierte Prüfvorrichtungen, um das Testen von fluidischen Subsystemen und neuartigen Verbrauchsmaterialien zu unterstützen.
• Übersetzen von High-Level-System- und Assay-Anforderungen in fluidische Schaltpläne, Systemarchitekturen und Konzepte, um Designpfade zu bewerten, zu vergleichen und herunterzuselektieren. Erstellen und pflegen Sie eine umfassende Entwurfsdokumentation für Ihre Subsysteme, einschließlich detaillierter 3D-CAD-Modelle, Fertigungszeichnungen und Materialspezifikationen mit Schwerpunkt auf chemischer Kompatibilität und Robustheit.
• Durchführung funktionsübergreifender Design-Reviews. Präsentieren Sie Fortschritt, Daten und technische Entscheidungen den Stakeholdern klar. Diese Position basiert vor Ort in Santa Clara, CA. (Dies ist keine hybride Position.) Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Rolle nicht angeboten. Wer du bist (erforderlich)
• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einschlägiger jahrelanger Branchenerfahrung (7+ Jahre für einen Bachelor, 5+ Jahre für einen Master oder 3+ Jahre für einen PhD).
• Sie haben praktische Erfahrungen mit dem Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Testen komplexer fluidischer Mannigfaltigkeiten, verbrauchsfähiger Schnittstellen oder beweglicher Mechanismen, vorzugsweise für Life Science oder diagnostische Instrumente, gesammelt.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen in Python für Gerätesteuerung, automatisierte Ausführung auf dem Prüfstand und Datenerfassung / -analyse.
• Sie haben einen starken Hintergrund im experimentellen Design für die fluidische Charakterisierung.
• Sie verfügen über ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen in Bezug auf Werkzeugmaschinen, Messgeräte und Rapid Prototyping-Technologien.
• Sie haben Fachwissen in SolidWorks für die detaillierte Montageplanung und die Erstellung von Fertigungszeichnungen unter Beweis gestellt.
• Sie haben Fähigkeiten zur Fehlerbehebung unter Beweis gestellt, mit einem soliden Verständnis von Physik, Chemie und technischen Grundlagen. Bevorzugt:
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Kunststoffbindungstechniken und Spritzgießprinzipien.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit CFD- oder FEA-Tools, um fluidische und thermische Designentscheidungen zu treffen.
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von DNA-Sequenzierung, DNA-Synthesizern und anderen komplexen fluidischen Automatisierungsinstrumenten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chez Roche, nous développons la prochaine génération de systèmes de séquençage. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les flux de travail et en élargissant les menus d'essais, nous élargissons également l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption. Des outils d'isolement et de préparation d'échantillons robustes aux nouvelles technologies de séquençage et à la bioinformatique avancée, nous développons des solutions de bout en bout différenciées et hautement intégrées pour le séquençage de prochaine génération. Notre Groupe de technologie des systèmes, qui fait partie de Roche Sequencing Solutions, est axé sur la création et l'avancement de technologies visant à améliorer considérablement les processus de séquençage de l'ADN. Nous cherchons un ingénieur mécanique principal pour contribuer à la conception, au développement, à la caractérisation et à l'intégration de systèmes de séquençage de pointe. Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique axé sur la résolution des défis fluides et consommables au cœur de nos plateformes de prochaine génération. Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui fait preuve d'un haut degré de motivation, d'indépendance et d'ingéniosité pour nous aider à développer des solutions à nos défis d'automatisation dans un environnement rapide et collaboratif. Responsabilités essentielles :
• Contribuer à l'architecture, à la conception, à la recherche et au développement précoce de consommables spécialisés et de mécanismes d'accouplement.
• Contribuer à la mise en page, au prototypage et à la caractérisation de nouveaux circuits et architectures fluidiques.
• Concevoir, construire et assembler des appareils d'essai personnalisés pour soutenir les essais de sous-systèmes fluidiques et de nouveaux consommables.
• Traduire les exigences de système et de test de haut niveau en schémas fluidiques, architectures et concepts de système pour évaluer, comparer et réduire les trajectoires de conception.
• Créez et maintenez une documentation complète de conception pour vos sous-systèmes, y compris des modèles CAO 3D détaillés, des dessins de fabrication et des spécifications de matériaux avec un accent sur la compatibilité chimique et la robustesse.
• Effectuer des examens de conception interfonctionnels. Présenter clairement aux intervenants les progrès, les données et les décisions d'ingénierie. Cette position est basée sur site à Santa Clara, CA. (Ce n'est pas une position hybride.) Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas offertes pour ce rôle. Qui vous êtes (Requis)
• Vous avez un diplôme en génie mécanique, ou une discipline étroitement liée, avec des années pertinentes d'expérience dans l'industrie (7+ ans pour un baccalauréat, 5+ ans pour une maîtrise, ou 3+ ans pour un doctorat).
• Vous avez démontré votre expérience pratique en concevant, développant et testant des collecteurs fluidiques complexes, des interfaces consommables ou des mécanismes mobiles, de préférence pour les sciences de la vie ou les instruments de diagnostic.
• Vous avez un haut niveau de compétence avec Python pour le contrôle des appareils, l'exécution automatique des bancs de test et l'acquisition/analyse de données.
• Vous avez un fond solide dans la conception expérimentale pour la caractérisation fluidique.
• Vous avez un niveau élevé de compétence avec les machines-outils, les équipements de mesure et les technologies de prototypage rapide.
• Vous avez démontré votre expertise dans SolidWorks pour la conception détaillée du montage et la création de dessins de fabrication.
• Vous avez démontré des compétences de dépannage, avec une solide compréhension de la physique, de la chimie et des fondamentaux d'ingénierie. Préféré:
• Vous avez une expérience des techniques de collage en plastique et des principes de moulage par injection.
• Vous avez l'expérience d'utiliser les outils CFD ou FEA pour guider les décisions de conception fluide et thermique.
• Vous avez l'expérience de développer le séquençage de l'ADN, synthétiseurs d'ADN et autres instruments complexes d'automatisation fluidique.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Molecular Account Executive - Clinical MD

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity:
Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers.

Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions.

As a Molecular Account Executive you will:

• be responsible for promoting Roche’s molecular products and services.

• contacting new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.

• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.

• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.

• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.

• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.

• communicates competitive market information internally.

• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.

This is a field-based role - the territory is Utah, Northern Arizona. You must live within 50 miles of the territory.

Travel expectation: 50% Overnight

Who You Are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience

• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations

• Proven leadership abilities

• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a regulated environment

• Strategic planning and organizational skills

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Utah is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensation that is calculated and paid in accordance with the applicable Incentive Compensation Plan

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche is working to improve DNA sequencing data analysis. Roche is innovating new approaches that fundamentally change when and where DNA sequencing gets processed. Our goal is to analyze data as it's generated, where it’s generated.

We are seeking a visionary and deeply technical leader to champion the customer-facing bioinformatics and software strategy for our revolutionary Axelios sequencing platform. As we launch XOOS —our cutting-edge ecosystem of bioinformatics tools—you will be the bridge between our pioneering new customers and our internal development teams.

This is not a traditional role. You will lead an elite team of bioinformatics scientists and software engineers to create bespoke, high-impact solutions, resolve sophisticated technical roadblocks, and even engage in collaborative research with early adopters. Because the Axelios platform operates on a completely different paradigm than traditional Sequencing-by-Synthesis (SBS), you will be instrumental in educating the market, ensuring seamless migration to our tools, and translating complex customer feedback into actionable development pipelines.

The Opportunity

• Customer Advocacy & Technical Enablement: Serve as the primary executive-level technical contact for new customers, driving deep adoption of the XOOS bioinformatics ecosystem across major clinical and research applications.

• Team Leadership: Build, inspire, and manage a high-performing team of customer-facing bioinformatics scientists and solutions architects.

• Bespoke Solution Engineering: Lead the creation of customized workflows, data analysis pipelines, and software integrations to solve unique customer pain points and accelerate Axelios platform adoption.

• Collaborative Research: Partner with strategic early-adopter customers on collaborative research projects, co-authoring whitepapers, and demonstrating the unique capabilities of Axelios non-SBS data.

• Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Act as a critical strategic partner to internal Bioinformatics and Software R&D teams, synthesizing market requirements, feature requests, and technical friction points into the product roadmap.

• Commercial & Technical Strategy: Collaborate with Sales and Product Management to support high-value customer engagements, technical evaluations, and complex contract closures.

This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA or San Diego, CA. (This is a hybrid position.)
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a Ph.D.in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 4+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field with 6+ years of industry experience.

• You have 8+ years of progressive experience in next-generation sequencing (NGS) bioinformatics, with a demonstrated track record of leadership in an industry setting.

• You have a significant level of expertise and comprehensive knowledge of the NGS landscape, clinical genomics space, and secondary/tertiary data analysis pipelines.

• You demonstrated leadership experience.

• You have a high level of proficiency with cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern software development practices, pipeline frameworks (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake), and scripting languages (Python, R).

• You have demonstrated experience in product commercialization, go-to-market execution, or technical c

• Loop Cross-Functional Feedback: Agire come partner strategico critico per i team interni di Bioinformatica e R&D software, sintetizzare i requisiti di mercato, le richieste di funzionalità e i punti di attrito tecnico nella roadmap del prodotto.
• Strategia commerciale e tecnica: Collaborare con Sales e Product Management per supportare gli impegni dei clienti di alto valore, le valutazioni tecniche e le complesse chiusure contrattuali. • Hai 8+ anni di esperienza progressiva nella sequenziamento di prossima generazione (NGS) bioinformatica, con una traccia dimostrata di leadership in un ambiente industriale.
• Hai un livello significativo di competenze e una conoscenza completa del paesaggio NGS, dello spazio di genomica clinica e delle condotte di analisi dati secondarie/terziarie.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza di leadership.
• Hai un alto livello di competenza con le architetture cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), le moderne pratiche di sviluppo del software, i framework pipeline (ad esempio, Nextflow, Snakemake), e le lingue di scripting (Python, R).
• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella commercializzazione dei prodotti, nell'esecuzione del go-to-market, o c tecnico

Roche innove de nouvelles approches qui changent fondamentalement quand et où le séquençage de l'ADN est traité. jobs.title: Subchapter Lead, Head of Pathology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies.

The Opportunity
As the Subchapter Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, you will stand at the intersection of cutting-edge science and people leadership. Based in our Tucson, AZ campus, you will lead a world-class team of pathologists dedicated to shaping the future of diagnostics and targeted cancer therapies.
In this role, you provide strategic and scientific leadership while overseeing pathology operations that support more than 100 new and existing product development initiatives and enhancements annually across Primary Antibodies, Special Stains, Digital Pathology, Companion Diagnostics and Instruments. Your team plays a critical role in enabling innovative diagnostics that support precision medicine and targeted cancer therapies worldwide.

In this role, you aren't just managing—you are mentoring, inspiring, and working hands-on with leading-edge technologies to transform patient care globally.

• People Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, and foster the professional growth of Instrua highly specialized team of pathologists and 6-7 team leaders. Drive a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Medical oversight for day to day Path Lab activities.

• Scientific & Clinical Strategy: Serve as the pathology subject matter expert within the Companion Diagnostics & Oncology business unit, ensuring scientific rigor and clinical relevance in all assay development programs.

• Advanced Assay Development: Guide the team in the development, validation, and implementation of complex assays utilizing top-tier technologies including:

• Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and in situ hybridization (ISH)

• Immunofluorescence (IF) and Multiplex assays

• Digital Pathology and AI-driven image analysis

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with life science companies, clinical trial teams, regulatory bodies, and internal R&D stakeholders

• Innovation Champion: Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging pathology technologies to maintain Roche’s position as the market leader in companion diagnostics and oncology

Who You Are:

You are a visionary leader who balances deep clinical expertise with a passion for developing people. You thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments and are motivated by the tangible impact your work has on cancer patients worldwide.

• You are a MD with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology

• You have 10+ years of people management and leadership within a pharmaceutical, diagnostics, or major academic or medical center environment.

• You have deep expertise in oncology pathology and hands-on experience with tissue-based biomarkers (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).

• You have strong familiarity with development processes including digital pathology workflows, image analysis tools, Clinical Case and CAP/CLIA

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche è il fornitore numero 1 del mondo di diagnostica dei compagni e offre un'esperienza impareggiabile nello sviluppo e nella commercializzazione di diagnostica predittiva che consentono strategie di trattamento personalizzate per i pazienti con cancro. Offriamo opportunità uniche per i patologi interessati a svolgere un ruolo nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di nuovi saggi critici al nostro obiettivo di fornire un accesso più paziente a nuove terapie innovative. L'opportunità Come il Subchapter Lead in Sviluppo Clinico, Capo di Patologia, si starà all'incrocio di scienza all'avanguardia e la leadership della gente. Con sede nel nostro campus di Tucson, AZ, guiderai un team di patologi di livello mondiale dedicato a plasmare il futuro della diagnostica e terapie mirate al cancro. In questo ruolo, si fornisce leadership strategica e scientifica, supervisionando le operazioni di patologia che supportano più di 100 nuove e esistenti iniziative di sviluppo del prodotto e miglioramenti ogni anno attraverso gli anticorpi primari, le macchie speciali, la patologia digitale, la diagnostica e gli strumenti di Companion. Il vostro team svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel consentire una diagnostica innovativa che supporta la medicina di precisione e terapie mirate per il cancro in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo, non si sta solo gestendo—si sta guidando, ispirando e lavorando hands-on con tecnologie all'avanguardia per trasformare la cura del paziente a livello globale.
• People Leadership & Development: Diretto, mentore e promuovere la crescita professionale di Instrua team altamente specializzato di patologi e 6-7 team leader. Guidare una cultura dell'innovazione, della collaborazione e dell'apprendimento continuo. Supervisione medica per le attività di Path Lab di giorno in giorno.
• Strategia scientifica e clinica: servire come esperto di materia patologia all'interno dell'unità di business Companion Diagnostics & Oncology, assicurando rigore scientifico e rilevanza clinica in tutti i programmi di sviluppo di saggi.
• Sviluppo del saggio avanzato: Guida il team nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi complessi che utilizzano tecnologie di alto livello tra cui:
• Immunohistochimica (IHC) e ibridazione in situ (ISH)
• Immunofluorescenza (IF) e saggi Multiplex
• Patologia digitale e analisi dell'immagine guidata dall'IA
• Collaborazione trasversale: collaborare a stretto contatto con le aziende di scienze della vita, i team di sperimentazione clinica, gli organismi normativi e gli stakeholder R&D interni
• Campione dell’Innovazione: Restate davanti alle tendenze del settore e alle tecnologie di patologia emergenti per mantenere la posizione di Roche come leader di mercato nella diagnostica dei compagni e nell’oncologia Chi sei? Sei un leader visionario che bilancia profonda esperienza clinica con la passione per lo sviluppo delle persone. Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e veloci e sono motivati dall'impatto tangibile che il vostro lavoro ha sui pazienti tumorali in tutto il mondo.
• Sei un MD con certificazione US Board in Patologia Anatomica
• Hai 10 anni di gestione e leadership delle persone all'interno di un ambiente farmaceutico, diagnostico, o principale centro accademico o medico.
• Hai una profonda esperienza nella patologia oncologica e nell'esperienza pratica con biomarcatori basati sui tessuti (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Hai una forte familiarità con i processi di sviluppo, inclusi i flussi di lavoro di patologia digitale, gli strumenti di analisi delle immagini, il caso clinico e CAP/CLIA

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Roche ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Begleitdiagnostik und bietet einzigartige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Kommerzialisierung prädiktiver Diagnostik, die personalisierte Behandlungsstrategien für Krebspatienten ermöglicht. Wir bieten einzigartige Möglichkeiten für Pathologen, die daran interessiert sind, eine Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Assays zu spielen, die entscheidend für unser Ziel sind, Patienten mehr Zugang zu innovativen neuen Therapien zu bieten. Die Chance Als Unterkapitel Lead in Clinical Development, Head of Pathology, stehen Sie an der Schnittstelle von Spitzenwissenschaft und People Leadership. Mit Sitz in unserem Campus in Tucson, AZ, leiten Sie ein erstklassiges Team von Pathologen, das sich der Gestaltung der Zukunft der Diagnostik und gezielter Krebstherapien widmet. In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die strategische und wissenschaftliche Führung bei der Überwachung von Pathologieoperationen, die jährlich mehr als 100 neue und bestehende Produktentwicklungsinitiativen und -verbesserungen in Primärantikörpern, Spezialbereichen, digitaler Pathologie, Begleitdiagnostik und Instrumenten unterstützen. Ihr Team spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Ermöglichung innovativer Diagnostik, die Präzisionsmedizin und gezielte Krebstherapien weltweit unterstützt. In dieser Rolle managen Sie nicht nur – Sie betreuen, inspirieren und arbeiten praxisnah mit Spitzentechnologien, um die Patientenversorgung weltweit zu verändern.
• People Leadership & Development: Direkt, Mentor und fördern das professionelle Wachstum von Instrua hochspezialisierten Team von Pathologen und 6-7 Teamleiter. Fördern Sie eine Kultur der Innovation, der Zusammenarbeit und des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Medizinische Aufsicht für tägliche Path Lab-Aktivitäten.
• Wissenschaftliche & Klinische Strategie: Dienen Sie als Experte für Pathologiethemen innerhalb der Companion Diagnostics & Oncology Business Unit und gewährleisten Sie wissenschaftliche Strenge und klinische Relevanz in allen Testentwicklungsprogrammen. Fortgeschrittene Assay-Entwicklung: Führen Sie das Team bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung komplexer Assays unter Verwendung erstklassiger Technologien, darunter:
• Immunhistochemie (IHC) und In-situ-Hybridisierung (ISH) Immunfluoreszenz (IF) und Multiplex-Assays
• Digitale Pathologie und KI-gesteuerte Bildanalyse
• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Life-Science-Unternehmen, klinischen Studienteams, Regulierungsbehörden und internen F & E-Stakeholdern Innovation Champion: Bleiben Sie Branchentrends und aufkommenden Pathologietechnologien voraus, um Roches Position als Marktführer für Begleitdiagnostik und Onkologie zu behaupten Wer Du bist: Sie sind eine visionäre Führungskraft, die tiefe klinische Expertise mit einer Leidenschaft für die Entwicklung von Menschen in Einklang bringt. Sie gedeihen in kollaborativen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen und sind motiviert durch die konkreten Auswirkungen Ihrer Arbeit auf Krebspatienten weltweit.
• Sie sind ein MD mit US-Board-Zertifizierung in anatomischer Pathologie
• Sie haben mehr als 10 Jahre Management und Führung in einer pharmazeutischen, diagnostischen oder großen akademischen oder medizinischen Umgebung.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes Fachwissen in der Onkologie-Pathologie und praktische Erfahrung mit gewebebasierten Biomarkern (IHC, ISH, Multiplex).
• Sie sind mit Entwicklungsprozessen wie digitalen Pathologie-Workflows, Bildanalyse-Tools, Clinical Case und CAP/CLIA vertraut

The Position
Vision
By 2028, we aim to significantly expand patient access across our priority disease areas , delivering sustainable growth while establishing and defending market leadership positions as a trusted partner to healthcare systems and professionals.
We will achieve this by focusing on the areas where we can create the greatest impact for patients, and by continuously improving how we understand, engage and support healthcare communities.

Ultimately, you contribute to delivering "Triple Win" outcomes by helping create meaningful value for patients, healthcare professionals, healthcare systems and Roche.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Analyst - Pharma Medicines TechOps MES

Introduction A short version of our brand new EEO Statement is included to highlight the importance of Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Roche . At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team . As a Business Analyst in Pharma Medicines TechOps MES, you will act as a trusted advisor to leadership, navigating complex systems to drive sustainable business transformation .

The Opportunity:

• Lead Strategic Initiatives: Oversee complex initiatives and streams with full autonomy, coordinating scale and quality across the business analysis domain .

• Solve Complex Problems: Lead the analysis of business problems by defining the problem space and conducting comprehensive root cause analysis across organizational boundaries .

• Shape Future Roadmaps: Drive significant impact by evaluating strategic solution options and actively shaping long-term technology roadmaps .

• Manage Key Stakeholders: Identify and engage management-level stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor to navigate conflicts and achieve alignment .

• Master Systems Thinking: Apply holistic systems thinking to provide enterprise-wide consulting advice, considering both micro and macro implications .

• Drive Technical Innovation: Use in-depth domain knowledge to recommend optimal, innovative technology solutions for sustainable business transformation .

• Mentor Future Leaders: Show leadership within the Community of Practice by mentoring senior practitioners and contributing to organizational development .

• Integrate Analysis Design: Anticipate challenges and proactively integrate complex analysis into broader solution designs across cross-functional teams

Who you are:

• Experienced Leader: You possess extensive experience overseeing autonomous initiatives and driving alignment in highly ambiguous environments .

• Academic Excellence: You hold a relevant University Degree (Master’s preferred) and bring years of proven experience in Business Analysis or Consultancy .

• Strategic Consultant: You demonstrate advanced knowledge of Business Analysis Advisory practices and a track record of delivering innovative solutions .

• Technical Expert: You have a mastery of requirements and domain knowledge, including advanced value analysis and risk assessment .

• Systems Thinker: You are skilled in tailoring and combining methodologies to fit complex problem spaces and provide holistic advice .

• Collaborative Partner: You act as a role model in teamwork, fostering collaboration across Informatics and various business structures .

• Clear Communicator: You possess exceptional communication skills, capable of driving consensus and persuading leadership on strategic initiatives .

Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
#RDT2026
