In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analista aziendale - Farmaci farmaceutici TechOps MES Introduzione È inclusa una versione breve della nostra nuovissima Dichiarazione EEO per evidenziare l'importanza della diversità, dell'equità e dell'inclusione in Roche. In Roche crediamo che ogni voce sia importante e ti invitiamo a portare la tua prospettiva unica nel nostro team. In qualità di analista aziendale in TechOps MES dei medicinali farmaceutici, agirai come consulente fidato della leadership, esplorando sistemi complessi per guidare una trasformazione aziendale sostenibile. L'opportunità:
• Guidare iniziative strategiche: supervisionare iniziative e flussi complessi in piena autonomia, coordinando la scala e la qualità in tutto il dominio dell'analisi aziendale.
• Risolvere problemi complessi: condurre l'analisi dei problemi aziendali definendo l'area del problema e conducendo un'analisi completa delle cause profonde oltre i confini dell'organizzazione.
• Modellare le roadmap del futuro: ottenere un impatto significativo valutando le opzioni di soluzioni strategiche e modellando attivamente le roadmap tecnologiche a lungo termine .
• Gestire le parti interessate chiave: identificare e coinvolgere le parti interessate a livello gestionale, agendo come un consulente fidato per superare i conflitti e raggiungere l'allineamento.
• Master Systems Thinking: applicare il pensiero sistemico olistico per fornire consulenza a livello aziendale, considerando le implicazioni sia micro che macro.
• Promuovere l'innovazione tecnica: utilizzare una conoscenza approfondita del settore per consigliare soluzioni tecnologiche ottimali e innovative per una trasformazione aziendale sostenibile.
• Mentore dei futuri leader: mostrare leadership all'interno della comunità di pratica facendo da mentore ai professionisti senior e contribuendo allo sviluppo organizzativo.
• Integrazione della progettazione dell'analisi: anticipa le sfide e integra in modo proattivo analisi complesse in progetti di soluzioni più ampi tra team interfunzionali. Chi sei:
• Leader esperto: possiedi una vasta esperienza nella supervisione di iniziative autonome e nella guida dell'allineamento in ambienti altamente ambigui.
• Eccellenza accademica: sei in possesso di un titolo universitario pertinente (preferibilmente Master) e porti anni di comprovata esperienza nell'analisi aziendale o nella consulenza.
• Consulente strategico: dimostri una conoscenza avanzata delle pratiche di consulenza sull'analisi aziendale e un track record nella fornitura di soluzioni innovative.
• Esperto tecnico: possiedi una padronanza dei requisiti e della conoscenza del settore, comprese l'analisi avanzata del valore e la valutazione del rischio.
• Pensatore di sistemi: sei abile nel personalizzare e combinare metodologie per adattarle a spazi problematici complessi e fornire consulenza olistica.
• Partner collaborativo: agisci come un modello nel lavoro di squadra, promuovendo la collaborazione tra l'informatica e varie strutture aziendali.
• Comunicatore chiaro: possiedi eccezionali capacità comunicative, in grado di suscitare consenso e persuadere la leadership su iniziative strategiche. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roles & Responsibilities

• Data & SOP Maintenance : Assist in drafting SOPs; collect and input master data into the ERP system to ensure data accuracy.

• Document & Archive Management : Support project document handovers; collect, classify, and archive information to maintain an efficient filing system.

• Bilingual Translation : Assist the department with English-Chinese translation of routine documents, technical materials, and meeting minutes.

• Admin & Logistics : Handle day-to-day administrative and logistical tasks to ensure smooth department operations.

• Meetings & Document Processing : Draft meeting minutes, track action items, and prepare routine official documents and announcements.

• Event Organization : Assist in planning and organizing team-building activities and training sessions to foster a positive team culture.

• Ad-hoc Tasks : Efficiently complete other temporary or phase-based tasks assigned by supervisors.

• Liaison Window : Act as a departmental contact point to facilitate daily cross-functional communication and coordination.

• Project Tracking : Monitor key milestones of major projects and provide timely progress reminders to respective owners.

Qualifications

(1) Bachelor's degree or above with a major related to Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or Automation.
(2) Possess good communication skills, learning ability, execution ability, stress tolerance, and team spirit.
(3) Proficient in using Autodesk CAD and Office Project software.
(4) Proficient in using office application software such as Excel, PPT, and Word,especially PPT skill
(5) CET-6 (College English Test Band 6) or above.
(6) At least 3-5 days/week. The student who can stay until Dec 2026 and based in Shanghai will be preferable.
(7) Plus: Skills in photography, videography, and video editing (Premiere/CapCut), with the ability to support department event filming and video production.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: ERP Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready E2E solutions that involve, but go beyond ERP. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization.
Description of the area

Job Responsibilities

• Scope: Primary point of contact on all matters concerning mediation and digital product provisioning. Designs solutions that meet requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR). Documents and evolves the architecture and ensures alignment with RDT architecture and governance.

• Accountability: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Owns all technical matters related to usage mediation and the provisioning of digital products in accordance to defined commercial models

• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers. Drive all discussions with digital product teams to ensure adoption of commercial backoffice standards and processes

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation for digital product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.

• Business / Technical ability: Brings technical expertise together with strong business understanding to lead the integration of digital product teams with commercial backoffice products

• Support and operations: Supports the operational processes by analyzing end to end production issues and ensuring accurate and timely corrective actions.

Qualifications

• Possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field.

• Extensive experience with System Integration Technologies and common Integration Design Pattern (MuleSoft and CPI preferred).

• Knowledge of Convergent mediation (by digital Route)

• Ability to work effectively in a complex, integrated system landscape.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Proficient in using API tools like Postman/Bruno.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support, design or write functional specifications to ensure correct implementation of end to end / cross application features

• Use your expertise in Agile methods like SAFe and Scrum, along with excellent interpersonal skills, to work seamlessly with local, nearshore and offshore teams.

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing and implementing business-driven, standards-based solutions within an ERP environment.

• Proven track record of maintaining

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

The Data Solution Architect focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex, multiple solution, or product context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies to continuously improve existing solutions and manage technical debt.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance. Applies frameworks in a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads others to solve complex problems; uses sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for the product. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded and published for multiple solutions or the product. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including vendor assessments.

• Stakeholder Management: Communicates difficult concepts clearly and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view. Drives information sharing across the complete product.

• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within a Complex or Multiple Solution or Product Context.

• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas. Proactively contributes to Architecture Practices development and mentoring.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context.

• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes.

• Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others.

Technical Skills

• In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas

• Strong understanding of modern data engineering architectures and patterns, including cloud-based data platforms, batch and streaming data pipelines, and analytics layers

• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomie

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Backend (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality.

The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here .

Here's what we're looking for:

Developing software is great, but developing software with a purpose is even better! As a Senior Software Engineer Backend, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. In collaborative teams of engineers, designers, product owners, and QA experts, you’ll experience best-in-class software development practices daily and contribute to software that meets the highest expectations — we do not put our users' lives at risk!

We are looking for an experienced, motivated Senior Software Engineer Backend who will work closely with their backend colleagues, and who ideally has built digital products and platforms. As a code-magician, you will support our efforts to improve the digital health ecosystem. You will contribute with your knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, relational databases & REST within our agile and cross-functional teams. As a flexible and open-minded person with a passion for clean code you will be a perfect addition to our team. We are committed to quality, dedicating time to code reviews, test coverage, quality days and CI/CD principles. If this resonates with you, we would love to hear from you!
You will be part of the Platform Engineering chapter working on our navify platform.

Essentials skills for your mission:

• At least 5 years of experience working as a software engineer including 2 years as a backend engineer.

• You are familiar with the following backend technologies: Java 21+ and frameworks like Spring Boot 3+

• SQL and relational databases (e.g.PostgreSQL) are second nature to you

• You have experience with OpenID Connect standard and Keycloak or other open source software product that allows single sign-on with identity and access management

• You have experience building AI/LLM-powered backend services and tools

• You enjoy developing clean, stable, testable, and performant backend code, serving our beautiful applications

• You are passionate about solid technical design, clean code, and future-proof architectures

• You have experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or other cloud providers

• You enjoy guiding and sharing your knowledge with other engineers

• Great written and verbal communication in English

Bonus skills:

• Experienced in automated testing with Selenium or Selenide

• Knowledge of Infra as Code, Terraform and Github Actions

• Understanding of medical, security, and privacy regulations

• Knowledge of the diabetes industry or other comparable health industries

Here's what you can expect from us:

• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience

• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams

• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)

• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation

• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world!

You will learn about the wide range of technologies we employ, from native mobile development to infrastructure-as-code in our cloud environment, gaining a rich understanding of the spec

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division , you will play a critical role in ensuring that our operations and business interactions comply with all relevant requirements and internal Roche policies, and will also support the organization in day-to-day legal matters.
As the Legal & Compliance Manager at Roche Latvia Pharma Division, you will be:

• Strategic Partner: Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure the fulfillment of all Roche divisional and local requirements.

• Role Model: Serve as a role model in ethical behavior and decision-making, promoting a culture of integrity and compliance across the organization.

• Strategic Influence: Drive compliance integration into business processes and decision-making.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Work proactively with various departments to help them achieve their business goals in compliance with Roche policies and guidelines.

• Culture Building: Lead the development and nurturing of a robust compliance culture within the Roche Latvia Pharma organization to ensure business processes align with legal requirements and internal policies.

Legal support: support Roche Latvia Pharma organization and Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster with day to day legal matters, which includes legal advice, drafting and reviewing contracts, etc.
Compliance support to Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Riga: you will extend, scale and apply compliance work done for Pharma also to the Roche Services & Solutions site in Riga (e.g. joint SOPs & training). Serve as Compliance Officer for RSS Riga and report to the Head of RSS Riga in this capacity.

Key Compliance Responsibilities
Under the oversight of and in collaboration with the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster, perform the following tasks in the Compliance Manager capacity:

• Guidance and Support: With a solution-oriented mindset, provide clear and actionable guidance to other departments to enable them to achieve their business goals in a compliant manner and in accordance with policies and guidelines. Escalate more complex inquiries to, and work with, the Director Legal & Compliance Pharma Baltics Cluster to address these.

• Global Standardization: Ensure adherence to Roche global standards such as the Code of Conduct and all Pharma Compliance-related Directives and guidelines, relevant Latvian legislation and local industry association Code of Ethics and any other relevant global and local regulations.

• Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities for efficiency in the compliance function and implement improvement initiatives. Develop compliance SOPs or policies and provide targeted training to employees. Strive for simplification & user-friendliness while maintaining a robust compliance system that adequately protects the organization’s license to operate and reputation.

• Strategic Risk Assessment: Identify, assess, and manage compliance risks associated with business operations, products, and services using data-driven approaches.

• Monitoring Activities: Conduct periodic monitoring activities, including spot checks and approvals, to confirm compliance with company policies.

• Comprehensive Training Programs: Design and deliver training on directives, guidelines, standards, and industry regulations. Customize training for different organizational levels. Conduct compliance onboarding training for new employees, tailored to their function and role.

• Promoting Compliance

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

This role is based in Global MSAT, Engineering, and Sustainability (PTT), an organization that is responsible for ensuring Pharma Technical Operations (PT) stays at the forefront of technology in our current and future facilities. PTT, composed of global MSAT and Engineering, plays a key role in leading seamless industrialization and thorough technical product management through integrating SHE, proactive maintenance, facility fitness, performance optimization, and scalable manufacturing processes and technologies in support of the manufacturing network. In this role, you have the opportunity to shape the manufacturing network that delivers life saving medicines to patients.
The Engineering Project Feasibility and Product Sourcing Leader within the PTT CapEx Feasibility and Investment Planning (CFIP) group conducts early feasibility and product sourcing assessments for Global Engineering CapEx projects.

The Opportunity
This role ensures that capital investments and investments supporting sourcing decisions align with and enable the Pharma long-range plan. A core responsibility of this role is partnering closely with Network Strategy, Global Product & Supply Chain Management, manufacturing sites, and Finance to develop robust business cases that inform PT governance decisions regarding capital investments and product sourcings.

• Secure buy-in from stakeholders and senior leadership, drive cross-functional alignment, and resolve issues within the engineering community and broader network for Global Engineering CapEx projects

• Build robust scenarios that model best- and worst-case outcomes and provide flexibility for informed decision-making in a dynamic business environment

• Develop comprehensive business cases for capital projects, maintaining fiduciary responsibility for real estate and equipment assets

• Assess requirements for product launches, technology transfers, and capital investments; ensuresassumptions across options are agreed upon and aligned with stakeholders

• Conduct complex early feasibility assessments across sites and functions, collaborating closely with senior leaders, subject matter experts, and site engineering teams

• Partner with the engineering community/network to apply technology standards that enable successful project outcomes and reduce business risk

• Transition completed early feasibility assessments to Project Initiation teams and contribute as an expert reviewer during project reviews

Who You Are
You are an engineering leader with a distinguished track record in complex global CapEx project execution, ideally bringing a strong background in process engineering combined with the proven ability to seamlessly drive results through matrix leadership.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field

• 12+ years of Pharmaceutical or Biotech experience, process engineering experience preferred

• Minimum of 8 years of management leadership experience in a matrix organization

• Experience in a complex global environment with CapEx project execution

• International/global experience is strongly preferred

​ Flexibility for domestic and international travel as required

Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity!

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo ha sede in Global MSAT, Engineering e Sustainability (PTT), un'organizzazione che ha la responsabilità di garantire che Pharma Technical Operations (PT) rimanga all'avanguardia della tecnologia nelle nostre strutture attuali e future. PTT, composto da MSAT globale e Engineering, svolge un ruolo chiave nel guidare un'industrializzazione senza soluzione di continuità e un'accurata gestione tecnica del prodotto attraverso l'integrazione di SHE, manutenzione proattiva, idoneità delle strutture, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni e processi e tecnologie di produzione scalabili a supporto della rete di produzione. In questo ruolo, hai l'opportunità di plasmare la rete di produzione che fornisce farmaci salvavita ai pazienti. Il responsabile della fattibilità dei progetti di ingegneria e dell'approvvigionamento dei prodotti all'interno del gruppo CFIP (CapEx Feasibility and Investment Planning) di PTT conduce valutazioni iniziali di fattibilità e di approvvigionamento dei prodotti per i progetti Global Engineering CapEx. L'opportunità Questo ruolo garantisce che gli investimenti di capitale e gli investimenti a supporto delle decisioni di approvvigionamento siano in linea e consentano il piano a lungo termine del settore farmaceutico. Una delle responsabilità principali di questo ruolo è quella di collaborare strettamente con la strategia di rete, la gestione globale della catena di fornitura e dei prodotti, i siti di produzione e la finanza per sviluppare solidi casi aziendali che informino le decisioni di governance di PT relative agli investimenti di capitale e all'approvvigionamento dei prodotti.
• Garantire il consenso delle parti interessate e della leadership senior, favorire l'allineamento interfunzionale e risolvere i problemi all'interno della comunità ingegneristica e della rete più ampia per progetti CapEx di ingegneria globale.
• Costruire scenari solidi che modellano i risultati dei casi migliori e peggiori e fornire flessibilità per un processo decisionale informato in un ambiente aziendale dinamico.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali completi per progetti di capitale, mantenendo la responsabilità fiduciaria per beni immobili e attrezzature. garantisce che le ipotesi tra le opzioni siano concordate e allineate con le parti interessate
• Condurre complesse valutazioni iniziali di fattibilità tra siti e funzioni, collaborando a stretto contatto con dirigenti senior, esperti in materia e team di ingegneria del sito
• Collaborare con la comunità/rete di ingegneri per applicare standard tecnologici che consentano risultati positivi del progetto e ridurre il rischio aziendale

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Ce rôle est basé au sein de Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT), une organisation chargée de garantir que les opérations techniques pharmaceutiques (PT) restent à la pointe de la technologie dans nos installations actuelles et futures. PTT, composé de MSAT et d'ingénierie mondiaux, joue un rôle clé dans la direction d'une industrialisation transparente et d'une gestion technique approfondie des produits grâce à l'intégration de SHE, de maintenance proactive, de remise en forme des installations, d'optimisation des performances et de processus et technologies de fabrication évolutifs à l'appui du réseau de fabrication. Dans ce rôle, vous avez la possibilité de façonner le réseau de fabrication qui fournit aux patients des médicaments qui sauvent des vies. Le responsable de la faisabilité des projets d'ingénierie et de l'approvisionnement en produits au sein du groupe de planification de la faisabilité et des investissements (CFIP) de PTT CapEx effectue des évaluations précoces de faisabilité et d'approvisionnement en produits pour les projets mondiaux d'investissement en ingénierie. L'opportunité Ce rôle garantit que les investissements en capital et les investissements soutenant les décisions d'approvisionnement s'alignent et permettent le plan à long terme de l'industrie pharmaceutique. L'une des principales responsabilités de ce rôle consiste à collaborer étroitement avec la stratégie de réseau, la gestion mondiale des produits et de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les sites de fabrication et les finances pour élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation solides qui éclairent les décisions de gouvernance des PT concernant les investissements en capital et l'approvisionnement en produits.
• Obtenir l'adhésion des parties prenantes et de la haute direction, favoriser l'alignement interfonctionnel et résoudre les problèmes au sein de la communauté des ingénieurs et du réseau plus large pour les projets Global Engineering CapEx.
• Créer des scénarios robustes qui modélisent les meilleurs et les pires résultats et offrir une flexibilité pour une prise de décision éclairée dans un environnement commercial dynamique. s'assure que les hypothèses relatives aux options sont convenues et alignées avec les parties prenantes
• Mener des évaluations de faisabilité précoces complexes sur tous les sites et fonctions, en collaborant étroitement avec les hauts dirigeants, les experts en la matière et les équipes d'ingénierie de site
• Collaborer avec la communauté/le réseau d'ingénierie pour appliquer des normes technologiques qui permettent des résultats de projet réussis et réduire les risques commerciaux
• Transition terminée les premières évaluations de faisabilité vers les équipes de lancement de projet et contribuer en tant qu'examinateur expert lors des examens de projet. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un leader en ingénierie avec une expérience distinguée dans l'exécution de projets d'investissement mondiaux complexes, apportant idéalement une solide expérience en l'ingénierie des processus combinée à la capacité éprouvée à générer des résultats de manière transparente grâce à un leadership matriciel.
• Baccalauréat en ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe
• Plus de 12 ans d'expérience en pharmacie ou en biotechnologie, expérience en génie des procédés préférée
• Minimum de 8 ans d'expérience en leadership en gestion dans une organisation matricielle
• Expérience dans un environnement mondial complexe avec l'exécution de projets CapEx
• Une expérience internationale/mondiale est fortement préférée Flexibilité pour les voyages nationaux et internationaux selon les besoins Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Postulez dès maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante ! Lorsque la transparence salariale s’applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d’affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, le site principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le poste pourrait être disponible, nous vous fournirons les informations nécessaires.

titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe Clinical Trial Payment Operations

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Team Lead Clinical Trial Payment Operations
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

The Team Lead Clinical Trail Payment Operations will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating the payment-related activities for our Clinical Studies within the team. This includes managing the team, ensuring efficient operations, handling people management tasks, and cultivating relationships with stakeholders and customers. The role demands a combination of payment expertise and leadership competencies to drive the team's performance and meet organizational standards and objectives.

Your Opportunity

Team Coordination and Management:

• Coordinate and manage the team’s daily activities in payment processing and related tasks

• Perform people management activities, including onboarding, offboarding, training, and development of team members

• Facilitate regular team meetings to ensure smooth communication and collaboration

• Provide functional expertise and guidance to the team, sharing knowledge and best practices

Payment Processing Activities:

• Oversee the regional processing of payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies

• Monitor payment-related KPIs, quality, and budget adherence

• Track performance, compliance, costs, and deviations in payment processes

• Actively participate in the day-to-day operations of payment processing

Stakeholder and Relationship Management:

• Develop and manage key stakeholder relationships to ensure satisfaction and alignment with business objectives

• Act as a primary point of contact for stakeholder inquiries and concerns

• Manage outsourcing activities and relationships with external service providers

Regulatory and Compliance:

• Ensure all payment activities are in line with legal, regulatory, and company standards and codes of practice

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulations and compliance requirements

• Implement and monitor compliance measures within the team

Who You Are:

• The ideal candidate should be motivated and skilled professional with a solid background in financial processes, particularly in calculating and processing complex payments and team leadership

• You should thrive in dynamic environments, have exceptional problem-solving abilities, and possess a strong commitment to both team and stakeholder satisfaction

• You should bring a collaborative approach, excellent communication skills, and a validated track record of leadership success

• You are someone who holds University degree in Finance, Accounting, or related business discipline with 10+ years of experience, minimum 7 years of team management and practical experience in payment processing or related financial activities

• Proficiency in SAP, MDMS, and other approval tools

Leadership Competencies:

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success in team coordination and stakeholder management. Alternatively, you are an identified talent showing high growth potential in leadership and are ready to take the first steps into leadership

• Proven ability to provide guidance and support to team members in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, and a growth mindset

Skills:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Proficiency in English

• Ability to interpret and analyze payment-related data and performance metrics

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

Personal Attributes:

• Agile mindset to adapt to changin

jobs.title: Internship in Internal Engagement Hubs (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Every breakthrough begins with a challenge. Every day, across Roche, our people work to improve health outcomes so that we all have more time with the people we love.
To achieve our ambitious goals, including delivering 20 transformative medicines by 2030, our employees need clear direction and meaningful engagement. That is where Global Internal Engagement comes in; we sit within Group Communications as one of the centres of excellence, responsible for the performance of all internal communications at Roche. Our mandate is to support a high-performing organisation by giving our 100,000+ employees the Clarity, Connection and Confidence to act. We help turn complex business priorities into clear, relevant and engaging internal communications that support Roche’s Ten Year Ambitions.

The Opportunity
Roche operates three central Internal Engagement Hubs: Pharma, Diagnostics and Corporate. These Hubs help align internal communications across the organisation, reduce duplication and information overload, and support more focused, strategic storytelling.
We are looking for a motivated intern to support the coordination and execution of key Global Internal Engagement activities across these Hubs. In this role, you will help maintain project information, support meeting preparation and follow up, contribute to campaign and editorial coordination, and support data and reporting activities. You will gain broad exposure to how global internal communications are planned, prioritised and executed in a complex healthcare organisation.

1. Hub operations and portfolio coordination

• Support the maintenance of our global project portfolio on Monday.com, ensuring project information is accurate, up to date and easy to use.

• Help prepare agendas, materials and follow ups for selected Hub meetings, Strategic Syncs and Quarterly Deep Dives.

Per raggiungere i nostri obiettivi ambiziosi, tra cui la fornitura di 20 farmaci trasformativi entro il 2030, i nostri dipendenti hanno bisogno di una direzione chiara e di un impegno significativo. Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. Jeder Durchbruch beginnt mit einer Herausforderung. Jeden Tag arbeiten unsere Mitarbeiter bei Roche daran, die Gesundheitsergebnisse zu verbessern, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Um unsere ehrgeizigen Ziele zu erreichen, einschließlich der Bereitstellung von 20 transformativen Medikamenten bis 2030, brauchen unsere Mitarbeiter eine klare Richtung und ein sinnvolles Engagement. Hier setzt Global Internal Engagement an; wir sitzen in Group Communications als eines der Exzellenzzentren, das für die Leistung der gesamten internen Kommunikation bei Roche verantwortlich ist. Unser Auftrag ist es, eine leistungsstarke Organisation zu unterstützen, indem wir unseren über 100.000 Mitarbeitern Klarheit, Verbindung und Zuversicht zum Handeln geben. Wir helfen dabei, komplexe Geschäftsprioritäten in eine klare, relevante und ansprechende interne Kommunikation umzuwandeln, die die zehnjährigen Ambitionen von Roche unterstützt. Wir suchen einen motivierten Praktikanten, der die Koordination und Durchführung der wichtigsten Aktivitäten des globalen internen Engagements in diesen Hubs unterstützt. In dieser Rolle helfen Sie bei der Pflege von Projektinformationen, unterstützen die Vorbereitung und Nachverfolgung von Besprechungen, tragen zur Kampagnen- und redaktionellen Koordination bei und unterstützen Daten- und Berichtsaktivitäten. Hub Operations und Portfoliokoordination

• Helfen Sie, mögliche Überschneidungen, Timing-Konflikte oder fehlende Informationen über Hub-Aktivitäten hinweg zu identifizieren. 2. Kampagnen- und Redaktionskoordination
• Arbeiten Sie mit Hub Leads und Editorial Leads zusammen, um genehmigte Kampagnen dem globalen Redaktionskalender zuzuordnen.
• Unterstützung der Durchführung ausgewählter interner Kommunikationskampagnen, einschließlich Planung, Koordination und Nachverfolgung. 3. Unterstützung für Daten, Insights und Ausführung
• Unterstützung beim Rollout des Interactive Audience Dashboards durch das Sammeln, Strukturieren und Zusammenfassen von Engagement-Metriken.
• Helfen Sie bei der Vorbereitung einfacher Leistungszusammenfassungen über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg, z. B. Leseraten, Videoaufrufe und Teilnahme an Veranstaltungen.
• Helfen Sie bei der Veröffentlichung von Kampagnen über unsere internen Kanäle Wer Sie sind
• Sie sind derzeit in einem Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Kommunikation oder Marketing an einer Universität eingeschrieben oder haben innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate vor dem Startdatum einen Abschluss gemacht
• Sie interessieren sich für Unternehmenskommunikation, Mitarbeiterengagement und wie globale Organisationen Menschen an der Strategie ausrichten.
• Sie sind organisiert, zuverlässig und komfortabel und bringen Struktur zu komplexen Informationen.
• Sie kommunizieren klar und sind zuversichtlich, mit Kollegen professionell zu folgen.
• Sie arbeiten gerne mit digitalen Tools und sind daran interessiert, Daten zur Verbesserung der Kommunikationsplanung zu verwenden.
• Sie sind proaktiv, neugierig und bereit, in einem globalen Umfeld zu lernen.
• Erfahrung mit Monday.com, Google Workspace, Excel oder ähnlichen Projektmanagement- und Collaboration-Tools ist ein Plus. Was Sie gewinnen werden
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chaque percée commence par un défi. Chaque jour, à travers Roche, nos gens travaillent pour améliorer les résultats de santé afin que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Pour atteindre nos objectifs ambitieux, y compris la livraison de 20 médicaments transformatifs d'ici 2030, nos employés ont besoin d'une orientation claire et d'un engagement significatif. C'est là qu'intervient l'engagement interne global; nous sommes au sein du Groupe Communications comme l'un des centres d'excellence, responsable de la performance de toutes les communications internes à Roche. Notre mandat est de soutenir une organisation performante en donnant à plus de 100 000 employés la clarté, la connexion et la confiance d'agir. Nous aidons à transformer les priorités opérationnelles complexes en communications internes claires, pertinentes et engageantes qui soutiennent les ambitions de dix ans de Roche. L'Opportunity Roche exploite trois pôles d'engagement interne : Pharma, Diagnostic et Entreprise. Ces centres aident à harmoniser les communications internes dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, à réduire la duplication et la surcharge d'information, et à soutenir des récits stratégiques plus ciblés. Nous recherchons un stagiaire motivé pour appuyer la coordination et l'exécution des principales activités d'engagement interne mondial dans ces centres. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir l'information sur le projet, à appuyer la préparation et le suivi des réunions, à contribuer à la coordination de la campagne et de la rédaction, et à appuyer les données et les activités de rapport. Vous aurez une grande visibilité sur la façon dont les communications internes globales sont planifiées, hiérarchisées et exécutées dans une organisation de soins de santé complexe. 1. Hub opérations et coordination du portefeuille
• Soutenir la maintenance de notre portefeuille de projets mondiaux sur Monday.com, en veillant à ce que les informations sur le projet soient exactes, à jour et faciles à utiliser.
• Aider à préparer des ordres du jour, des documents et des suivis pour des réunions du Hub, des synthèses stratégiques et des plongées profondes trimestrielles.
• Suivre les actions, les décisions et les dépendances dans le cadre de projets convenus, en aidant les chefs de file et les propriétaires de projets à rester alignés.
• Aider à identifier les chevauchements potentiels, les conflits de calendrier ou les renseignements manquants entre les activités du centre. 2. Coordination de la campagne et de l'édition
• Travailler avec les directeurs principaux et les directeurs principaux de l'édition pour aider à cartographier les campagnes approuvées au calendrier mondial de l'édition.
• Appuyer l'exécution de certaines campagnes de communication interne, y compris la planification, la coordination et le suivi. 3. Support des données, des idées et de l'exécution
• Soutenir le déploiement du tableau de bord interactif de l'auditoire en aidant à collecter, structurer et résumer les paramètres d'engagement.
• Aider à préparer des résumés de performance simples sur tous les canaux, tels que les taux de lecture, les vues vidéo et la participation à l'événement.
• Aide pour les campagnes d'édition sur nos canaux internes Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes actuellement inscrit à un baccalauréat ou à une maîtrise en communication ou marketing dans une université ou diplômé dans les 12 derniers mois avant la date de début
• Vous vous intéressez aux communications d'entreprise, à l'engagement des employés et à la façon dont les organisations mondiales harmonisent les gens autour de la stratégie.
• Vous êtes organisé, fiable et confortable en apportant une structure à des informations complexes.
• Vous communiquez clairement et êtes confiant avec vos collègues de manière professionnelle.
• Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec des outils numériques et intéressés à utiliser les données pour améliorer la planification de la communication.
• Vous êtes proactif, curieux et prêt à apprendre dans un environnement mondial.
• Expérience avec lundi.com, Google Workspace, Excel ou des outils similaires de gestion de projet et de collaboration est un plus. Ce que vous gagnerez

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Your new team
You will be part of our EMEA Customer Support Center Hub here in Mannheim. We are a team of technical and application experts supporting customers in the RCSC countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, and Turkey). Cohesion and working in intercultural teams are important to us; we work closely networked, including with 2nd-level support and our colleagues in the field.

Responsibilities | What awaits you
As a Junior Specialist (m/f/d) , you are the technical interface to our customers and colleagues. Your goal is to find fast and sustainable solutions for complex inquiries. Your main tasks include:

• As the central point of contact, you process customer and employee inquiries digital or by phone.

• You use remote services for customer support and, if necessary, simulate customer situations in our laboratory to quickly identify and resolve errors.

• You document your solution approaches structured in our CRM system and handle advanced complaint management for medium-complexity issues.

• You work closely with 2nd-level support and escalate product quality problems to the next competence level. Occasionally, you also support the technical field service during on-site activities.

Qualifications | What you bring
In addition to successfully completed training as a Medical Technical Assistant (MTA), Technician (e.g., Mechatronics, Medical Technology, Electrical Engineering), or a Bachelor's degree (e.g., Natural Sciences, IT, Chemical or Electrical Engineering), you have initial professional experience in the medical technology field – be it in customer support, service, marketing, or directly in a service function in a laboratory. Furthermore, the following points round out your profile:

• You speak fluent Dutch/Flemish and German (C1) . You also communicate confidently in English (min. B1/B2) .

• You have good user knowledge of medical analysis systems or, alternatively, know-how in robotics, mechanics, or electrical engineering. Basic IT network knowledge and familiarity with CRM tools are familiar to you.

• You are strongly customer-oriented, a real team player in intercultural teams, and possess pronounced methodical competence in troubleshooting.

Your Application
We ask you for the following documents:

• Current CV

Further documents are not mandatory at this time. Please note before submitting your application that no further documents can be added afterward.

Apply now – we look forward to it!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de la valeur du compte

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position: Account Value Partner (Sales - Upper South), 1 year contract
Area : Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

Purpose of the Job
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

QUALIFICATIONS
Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Preferred area Petchaburi, Prachuabkhirikhan, Chumporn, Ranong

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de valeur du compte( Ventes - Nord-Est)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The position is responsible for managing your customers by promoting the Roche Diagnostics range of products to hospitals, clinics etc. Reporting to Account Value Lead you will use your expertise to:

• Manage customers / key account customers by promoting the Roche Diagnostics range of products (Area Upper Northeast)

• Manage key customers include hospitals, clinics, and others

• Support overall objectives to achieve sales targets by building relationships, establish network and strengthen brand and corporate / product reputation

• Calls on physicians, clinics and other organizations that require diagnostic products or services that focus on the monitoring and testing of specialized therapeutic and/or specialized patient care.

• Responsible for the sale of the company’s diagnostic products within an assigned territory or geographic region.

• Complies with applicable laws in providing physicians with literature.

• Provides expertise and customer service to accounts.

• May provide expertise to physicians and other medical/therapeutic clients.

• May gather data on marketing trends, competitive products and pricing to capitalize on selling opportunities.

• Builds relationships with physicians and key thought leaders to influence the acceptance and use of company’s products.

• Typically requires a university degree in a scientific or related field and/or equivalent related experience.

• May include individuals selling diagnostic laboratory services. CRO/CMO companies, match to S681 - S685 - Sales Account Manager - Consulting Services.

• Individuals selling directly to physicians or other medical staff should select Channel 1 - Direct/End User.

• Use channel-specific Field Sales Management job codes to match the managers of these incumbents (e.g., Field Sales Management - S3X3 - S3X6).

Who you are :
You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, and where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.
To be successful in this role, our new team member will be able to demonstrate the following:

• Bachelor's degree in in Medical Technologist

• Minimum of 2 years of work experience related field preferred

• Good interpersonal and communication skills

• Good human relationship, problem solving skills and teamwork abilities

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Computer literacy in Microsoft Office and related programs

• Be able to work in upcountry

• Own car and valid drive license

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. • Minimum of 2 years of work experience related field preferred
• Good interpersonal and communication skills
• Good human relationship, problem solving skills and teamwork abilities
• Good command of spoken and written English
• Computer literacy in Microsoft Office and related programs
• Be able to work in upcountry

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
主要职责/责任
客户管理

• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求

• 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

a)传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
b)传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
c)传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设

• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程

• 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

• 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育

• 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。

• 组织和支持区域专家会议

• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈

• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理

• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗

• 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作

• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家

• 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

能力与经验
岗位所需胜任力

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力

• 业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限

• 1年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

教育程度/所获资格证书

• 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

• 在试用期内通过RDPAC考试

• 在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Digital Solution Lead at this level, you lead the strategy, operating model, and delivery governance for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and the supporting technology ecosystem, including Roche's in-house standards and reference data platforms (Global Clinical Data Standards Repository (GDSR) and Lynx). You partner with PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Roche Data Technologies, and Enterprise Informatics to ensure clinical data is defined once, governed consistently, delivered reliably, and reused at scale. This role requires deep expertise in CDISC and semantic modelling, combined with strong delivery leadership, to shape interoperable, metadata-driven foundations and ensure the associated platforms are run with the right quality, compliance, and service levels.

Description of the area

Within PD Data Sciences, this area is responsible for defining, governing, and operationalizing the standards and master data that underpin Roche's clinical data landscape. The team ensures consistent use of clinical data standards, controlled terminology, metadata, and master/reference data across protocol design, data collection, transformation, analysis, submission, and downstream reuse. It also drives the roadmap and business-facing direction for the in-house technologies that manage these assets (GDSR and Lynx), enabling study teams and downstream analytical environments to consume trusted standards and master data through governed, reusable services.
A key focus of the area is advancing semantic interoperability across the clinical ecosystem. This includes developing semantically rich information models, metadata structures, and linked data concepts that improve traceability, reuse, and machine readability across clinical workflows. By combining strong governance with fit-for-purpose technology and disciplined delivery management, the team creates AI-ready foundations that allow analytics and agentic solutions to reason over high-quality, well-defined clinical data assets safely and consistently, while sustaining operational reliability, release quality, and business continuity for downstream consumers.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads the domain vision for Clinical Data Standards, Master Data, and supporting technologies, shaping cross-functional strategy, governance, priorities, and delivery models. Acts as a subject matter expert in CDISC, master/reference data management, and semantic modelling, while setting clear expectations for platform health, release quality, and vendor or partner accountability.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads resolution of complex issues spanning data standards adoption, metadata definition, master data stewardship, technology integration, and downstream consumption. Establishes transparent tracking for roadmap delivery, defects, incidents, and service health; anticipates gaps in process, governance, and architecture; conducts root cause analysis across organizational boundaries; and drives sustainable solutions that improve data quality, lineage, platform reliability, and operational efficiency.

• Stakeholder Management: Builds trusted partnerships across PD Data Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Biostatistics, Study Teams, Regulatory, Roche Data Technologies, Enterprise Data, Architecture, Informatics, and external delivery partners. Translates between scientific, operational, and technical stakeholders, acts as a trusted liaison between business owners

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Dein neues Team
Du verstärkst unseren Vertriebsservice in der Region Berlin / Potsdam. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
Als Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d) bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Roche-Standardgeräte sicher und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:

• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch unterstützend am Telefon. Dabei übernimmst du auch die Dokumentation im CRM-System und die Fakturierung.

• Du bist verantwortlich für die Aufstellung neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.

• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.

• Du weist Kunden technisch ein und berätst sie zu Themen wie vorbeugender Wartung oder Geräteablösungen.

• Du erkennst Verkaufschancen und gibst Informationen zu Mitbewerberaktivitäten an die Regionale Serviceleitung und den Vertrieb weiter.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du verfügst über eine Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in mit Berufserfahrung oder ein Studium (Ing. FH) in Fachrichtungen wie Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder Medizintechnik. Wichtig ist eine Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:

• Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Systemen mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hydraulik, Elektronik und Messtechnik.

• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware und hast idealerweise chemisches Basiswissen.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt gute fach- und allgemeinsprachliche Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B1/B2).

• Du arbeitest ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvereinbarungen und bist bereit, Verantwortung im Rahmen von Not- und Bereitschaftsdiensten zu übernehmen.

• Für die optimale Betreuung der Region wohnst du idealerweise im Großraum Berlin (bevorzugt Westen/Potsdam).

Deine Bewerbung
Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf

Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.

Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions
