jobs.title: Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

titleByLocale.fr: Architecte des données/de l'information - Plateformes de données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Data/Information Architect - Data Platforms

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, w e offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The role of an Information Architect is to understand business processes and information objects and to work with members of the informatics and business team to identify and design information flows and information standards that meet the business needs . The Information Architect works toward consistency within and across groups and drives for reuse and simplicity of information objects . The Information Architect will do this by identifying, classifying, standardizing information objects and creating information flows, working closely with Business Stakeholders, Solution Architects, Software Architects, IT Business Partners, and Business Analysts .

The Opportunity:

• Design and maintain the comprehensive information landscape and streamline both incoming and outgoing information flows for MRHub .

• Establish and enforce critical standards and governance for information objects in close partnership with the Data Engineering Lead .

• Drive quality assurance by performing periodic reviews on the compliance and integrity of all information objects and architectural flows .

• Provide strategic leadership on information modeling to project and operational teams, ensuring alignment with global informatics goals .

• Identify and organize complex information requirements and objects for MRHub to ensure seamless traceability and easy access .

• Support remediation of sub-optimal data flows within business processes to enhance overall system efficiency and performance .

• Ensure architectural accuracy by maintaining up-to-date automated flows in Archimedes and creating conceptual designs that fit IT/Business strategies .

• Collaborate with Agile teams and Solution Architects to document governance, compliance, and master data standards within solution architecture .

Who you are:

• Extensive experience leading complex data science and information architecture projects from end-to-end with a drive for significant business impact .
Proven track record of working closely with senior leadership to inform and influence high-level strategic business decisions and data frameworks .

• Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing enterprise-wide data science frameworks, information lifecycles, and governance best practices .

• Deep technical proficiency in programming languages such as Python and R, coupled with the ability to architect and maintain complex version control workflows using Git.

• Comprehensive expertise in cloud-native database manageme

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data/Information Architect - Piattaforme dati Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. Il ruolo di un architetto dell'informazione è comprendere i processi aziendali e gli oggetti informativi e lavorare con i membri del team informatico e aziendale per identificare e progettare flussi di informazioni e standard informativi che soddisfino le esigenze aziendali. L'Architetto dell'Informazione lavora per garantire la coerenza all'interno e tra i gruppi e promuove il riutilizzo e la semplicità degli oggetti informativi. L'architetto dell'informazione lo farà identificando, classificando, standardizzando gli oggetti informativi e creando flussi di informazioni, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate aziendali, gli architetti di soluzioni, gli architetti di software, i partner commerciali IT e gli analisti aziendali. L'opportunità:
• Progettare e mantenere il panorama informativo completo e semplificare i flussi di informazioni in entrata e in uscita per MRHub.
• Stabilire e applicare standard critici e governance per gli oggetti informativi in ​​stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'ingegneria dei dati.
• Promuovere la garanzia della qualità eseguendo revisioni periodiche sulla conformità e l'integrità di tutti gli oggetti informativi e dei flussi architettonici.
• Fornire leadership strategica sulla modellazione delle informazioni ai team operativi e di progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi informatici globali.
• Identificare e organizzare requisiti di informazioni e oggetti complessi per MRHub per garantire tracciabilità senza soluzione di continuità e facile accesso.
• Supportare la correzione dei flussi di dati non ottimali all'interno dei processi aziendali per migliorare l'efficienza e le prestazioni complessive del sistema.
• Garantire l'accuratezza dell'architettura mantenendo flussi automatizzati aggiornati in Archimedes e creando progetti concettuali che si adattino alle strategie IT/aziendali.
• Collaborare con team Agile e Solution Architect per documentare gli standard di governance, conformità e dati master all'interno dell'architettura della soluzione. Chi sei:
• Vasta esperienza nella guida di progetti complessi di data science e architettura dell'informazione dall'inizio alla fine con una spinta verso un impatto aziendale significativo. Comprovata esperienza di lavoro a stretto contatto con la leadership senior per informare e influenzare decisioni aziendali strategiche di alto livello e strutture di dati.
• Competenza dimostrata nella progettazione e implementazione di strutture di data science, cicli di vita delle informazioni e best practice di governance a livello aziendale.
• Profonda competenza tecnica nei linguaggi di programmazione come Python e R, unita alla capacità di progettare e mantenere flussi di lavoro complessi di controllo delle versioni utilizzando Git.
• Competenza completa nella gestione di database nativi del cloud

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und in den kommenden Generationen Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Daten-/Informationsarchitekt – Datenplattformen Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Die Rolle eines Informationsarchitekten besteht darin, Geschäftsprozesse und Informationsobjekte zu verstehen und mit Mitgliedern des Informatik- und Geschäftsteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um Informationsflüsse und Informationsstandards zu identifizieren und zu entwerfen, die den Geschäftsanforderungen entsprechen. Der Informationsarchitekt strebt die Konsistenz innerhalb und zwischen Gruppen an und fördert die Wiederverwendung und Einfachheit von Informationsobjekten. Der Informationsarchitekt wird dies tun, indem er Informationsobjekte identifiziert, klassifiziert, standardisiert und Informationsflüsse erstellt und dabei eng mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Lösungsarchitekten, Softwarearchitekten, IT-Geschäftspartnern und Geschäftsanalysten zusammenarbeitet. Die Chance:
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie die umfassende Informationslandschaft und optimieren Sie sowohl den eingehenden als auch den ausgehenden Informationsfluss für MRHub.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Engineering Lead kritische Standards und Governance für Informationsobjekte etablieren und durchsetzen.
• Fördern Sie die Qualitätssicherung durch regelmäßige Überprüfungen der Konformität und Integrität aller Informationsobjekte und Architekturabläufe.
• Bereitstellung strategischer Führung bei der Informationsmodellierung für Projekt- und Betriebsteams und Sicherstellung der Ausrichtung auf globale Informatikziele.
• Identifizieren und organisieren Sie komplexe Informationsanforderungen und -objekte für MRHub, um eine nahtlose Rückverfolgbarkeit und einen einfachen Zugriff sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Behebung suboptimaler Datenflüsse innerhalb von Geschäftsprozessen, um die Effizienz und Leistung des Gesamtsystems zu verbessern.
• Stellen Sie architektonische Genauigkeit sicher, indem Sie aktuelle automatisierte Abläufe in Archimedes beibehalten und konzeptionelle Designs erstellen, die zu IT-/Geschäftsstrategien passen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit agilen Teams und Lösungsarchitekten zusammen, um Governance, Compliance und Stammdatenstandards innerhalb der Lösungsarchitektur zu dokumentieren. Wer Sie sind:
• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Datenwissenschafts- und Informationsarchitekturprojekte von Anfang bis Ende mit dem Streben nach erheblichen geschäftlichen Auswirkungen. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, um strategische Geschäftsentscheidungen und Datenrahmen auf hoher Ebene zu informieren und zu beeinflussen.
• Nachgewiesene Fachkenntnisse in der Gestaltung und Implementierung unternehmensweiter Data-Science-Frameworks, Informationslebenszyklen und Best Practices für die Governance.
• Tiefe technische Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen wie Python und R, gepaart mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Versionskontroll-Workflows mit Git zu entwerfen und zu verwalten.
• Umfassende Expertise im Cloud-nativen Datenbankmanagement
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Architecte de données/informations - Plateformes de données Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l’instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. Le rôle d'un architecte de l'information est de comprendre les processus métier et les objets d'information et de travailler avec les membres de l'équipe informatique et commerciale pour identifier et concevoir des flux d'informations et des normes d'information qui répondent aux besoins de l'entreprise. L'architecte de l'information travaille à la cohérence au sein et entre les groupes et favorise la réutilisation et la simplicité des objets d'information. Pour ce faire, l'architecte de l'information identifiera, classifiera, standardisera les objets d'information et créera des flux d'informations, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise, les architectes de solutions, les architectes logiciels, les partenaires commerciaux informatiques et les analystes commerciaux. L'opportunité :
• Concevoir et maintenir un paysage d'informations complet et rationaliser les flux d'informations entrants et sortants pour MRHub.
• Établir et appliquer des normes et une gouvernance critiques pour les objets d'information en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'ingénierie des données.
• Piloter l'assurance qualité en effectuant des examens périodiques sur la conformité et l'intégrité de tous les objets d'information et flux architecturaux.
• Fournir un leadership stratégique sur la modélisation de l'information aux équipes de projet et opérationnelles, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs informatiques mondiaux.
• Identifiez et organisez les exigences et les objets d'informations complexes pour MRHub afin de garantir une traçabilité transparente et un accès facile.
• Prise en charge de la correction des flux de données sous-optimaux au sein des processus métier afin d'améliorer l'efficacité et les performances globales du système.
• Assurer l'exactitude architecturale en maintenant les flux automatisés à jour dans Archimède et en créant des conceptions conceptuelles adaptées aux stratégies informatiques/commerciales.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Agile et les architectes de solutions pour documenter la gouvernance, la conformité et les normes de données de base au sein de l'architecture de la solution. Qui vous êtes :
• Vaste expérience dans la direction de projets complexes de science des données et d'architecture de l'information de bout en bout avec une volonté d'avoir un impact commercial significatif. Expérience avérée de travail en étroite collaboration avec la haute direction pour éclairer et influencer les décisions commerciales stratégiques de haut niveau et les cadres de données.
• Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de cadres de science des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise, de cycles de vie de l'information et de meilleures pratiques de gouvernance.
• Maîtrise technique approfondie des langages de programmation tels que Python et R, associée à la capacité d'architecturer et de maintenir des flux de travail de contrôle de version complexes à l'aide de Git.
• Expertise complète dans la gestion de bases de données cloud natives

As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The ERP Test Manager is the strategic architect and operational guardian of the ASPIRE Test Methodology. You are tasked with identifying operational "white space" and engineering new processes to fill those gaps. You will ensure the testing organization is compliant with Computer System Validation (CSV) and Quality standards while driving continuous evolution. As the primary defender of processes during audits and the lead architect for system upgrades, you balance regulatory rigor with operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Scope / (Content Leadership): Provides expert-level leadership and strategic guidance for high-impact and/or complex quality assurance projects. Develops and implements Quality Engineering best practices across multiple initiatives, ensuring consistency, test traceability, and alignment with enterprise standards. Leads quality analysis efforts on significant projects, provides guidance to less experienced Quality Engineers, and contributes to strategic initiatives. Provides oversight, advisory, and quality assurance across strategic initiatives, ensuring testing purpose and scope alignment, test cohesion, traceability, and ultimate product value.

• Custodianship: Own the master version of the ASPIRE Test Methodology.

• Regulatory Alignment: Ensure every process update is "pre-validated" by aligning with CSV and Quality teams before rollout.

• Content Creation: Author high-quality technical documentation, including SOPs, Work Instructions, and User Guides.

Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex and strategic software quality problems, defining the quality assurance scope and driving comprehensive root cause analysis for critical defects that may span organizational boundaries. Elicits and analyzes complex stakeholder quality needs with expertise, influencing business stakeholders to inform and make the right decisions regarding product quality and release readiness. Defines strategic testing solution scope, manages complexity, and drives consensus on quality standards and release criteria through persuasive communication. Recommends optimal quality assurance technologies and tools for business transformation, providing highly innovative solutions to unusually complex quality challenges.

• Milestone Management: Take full accountability for ensuring all test phases (e.g., SAT, UAT, RT) start on time according to the global release calendar.

• Progress Monitoring: Track real-time testing metrics, defect burn-

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è il luogo in cui l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. In qualità di team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnici orientati al business impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale dell’assistenza sanitaria di domani. La nostra missione è potenziare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all’avanguardia, sfruttando il potenziale dell’intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Spinti dallo scopo e dalla passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale sarà un punto di forza fondamentale per tutta Roche, consentendo modi di lavorare più intelligenti, liberando il potenziale umano e promuovendo scoperte che contano davvero per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo. In Roche offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità e collaborazione di persona. Per ora, richiediamo che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni di ufficio specifici possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, riunioni comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi di collaborazione. L'ERP Test Manager è l'architetto strategico e il custode operativo della metodologia di test ASPIRE. Hai il compito di identificare gli "spazi bianchi" operativi e progettare nuovi processi per colmare tali lacune. Ti assicurerai che l'organizzazione di test sia conforme agli standard di convalida del sistema informatico (CSV) e di qualità, guidando al tempo stesso l'evoluzione continua. In qualità di difensore principale dei processi durante gli audit e di architetto principale per gli aggiornamenti di sistema, riesci a bilanciare il rigore normativo con l'efficienza operativa. Ambito delle responsabilità / (Leadership dei contenuti): fornisce leadership di livello esperto e guida strategica per progetti di garanzia della qualità ad alto impatto e/o complessi. Sviluppa e implementa le migliori pratiche di ingegneria della qualità in molteplici iniziative, garantendo coerenza, tracciabilità dei test e allineamento con gli standard aziendali. Dirige le attività di analisi della qualità su progetti significativi, fornisce indicazioni agli ingegneri della qualità meno esperti e contribuisce a iniziative strategiche. Fornisce supervisione, consulenza e garanzia della qualità in tutte le iniziative strategiche, garantendo l'allineamento dello scopo e dell'ambito dei test, la coesione dei test, la tracciabilità e il valore finale del prodotto.
• Custodianship: possedere la versione master della metodologia di test ASPIRE.
• Allineamento normativo: garantire che ogni aggiornamento del processo sia "pre-convalidato" allineandosi con i team CSV e Qualità prima dell'implementazione.
• Creazione di contenuti: creazione di documentazione tecnica di alta qualità, comprese SOP, istruzioni di lavoro e guide per l'utente. Responsabilità/Risoluzione dei problemi: guida l'analisi di problemi complessi e strategici di qualità del software, definendo l'ambito di garanzia della qualità e conducendo un'analisi completa delle cause alla radice dei difetti critici che possono oltrepassare i confini dell'organizzazione. Sollecita e analizza le complesse esigenze di qualità delle parti interessate con competenza, influenzando le parti interessate aziendali a informare e prendere le giuste decisioni in merito alla qualità del prodotto e alla disponibilità del rilascio. Definisce l'ambito della soluzione di test strategico, gestisce la complessità e guida il consenso sugli standard di qualità e sui criteri di rilascio attraverso una comunicazione persuasiva. Raccomanda tecnologie e strumenti ottimali di garanzia della qualità per la trasformazione aziendale, fornendo soluzioni altamente innovative a sfide di qualità insolitamente complesse.
• Gestione delle tappe fondamentali: assumersi la piena responsabilità di garantire che tutte le fasi di test (ad esempio SAT, UAT, RT) inizino in tempo secondo il calendario di rilascio globale.
• Monitoraggio dei progressi: traccia in tempo reale i parametri di test e l'eliminazione dei difetti

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen und sich für Ihre einzigartigen Qualitäten begeistern. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, so wie Sie sind, sodass Sie sich sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich entfalten können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass heute und in den kommenden Generationen jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Werden Sie Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position ERP Test Manager (ASPIRE) bei Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation auf Zweck trifft. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft geschäftsorientierter Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien voranzutreiben und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der die Digitalisierung eine zentrale Stärke von Roche darstellt. Wir ermöglichen intelligentere Arbeitsweisen, setzen menschliches Potenzial frei und treiben Durchbrüche voran, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt wirklich von Bedeutung sind. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Derzeit verlangen wir von unseren Mitarbeitern, dass sie durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Townhalls, Teambesprechungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Der ERP-Testmanager ist der strategische Architekt und operative Hüter der ASPIRE-Testmethodik. Ihre Aufgabe ist es, betriebliche „Leerräume“ zu identifizieren und neue Prozesse zu entwickeln, um diese Lücken zu schließen. Sie stellen sicher, dass die Testorganisation den Computersystemvalidierungs- (CSV) und Qualitätsstandards entspricht und treiben gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung voran. Als Hauptverteidiger der Prozesse bei Audits und leitender Architekt für Systemaktualisierungen sorgen Sie für ein Gleichgewicht zwischen regulatorischer Strenge und betrieblicher Effizienz. Aufgabenbereich / (Content Leadership): Bietet Führung auf Expertenebene und strategische Anleitung für wirkungsvolle und/oder komplexe Qualitätssicherungsprojekte. Entwickelt und implementiert Best Practices für die Qualitätstechnik über mehrere Initiativen hinweg und stellt so Konsistenz, Testrückverfolgbarkeit und Ausrichtung an Unternehmensstandards sicher. Leitet Qualitätsanalysebemühungen bei bedeutenden Projekten, gibt weniger erfahrenen Qualitätsingenieuren Anleitung und trägt zu strategischen Initiativen bei. Bietet Aufsicht, Beratung und Qualitätssicherung bei strategischen Initiativen und stellt die Ausrichtung von Testzweck und -umfang, Testkohäsion, Rückverfolgbarkeit und den ultimativen Produktwert sicher.
• Verwahrung: Besitzen Sie die Masterversion der ASPIRE-Testmethodik.
• Regulierungsabstimmung: Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Prozessaktualisierung vorab validiert wird, indem Sie sie vor der Einführung mit den CSV- und Qualitätsteams abstimmen.
• Inhaltserstellung: Verfassen Sie hochwertige technische Dokumentation, einschließlich SOPs, Arbeitsanweisungen und Benutzerhandbücher. Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse komplexer und strategischer Softwarequalitätsprobleme, definiert den Umfang der Qualitätssicherung und führt eine umfassende Ursachenanalyse für kritische Fehler durch, die sich über Organisationsgrenzen erstrecken können. Ermittelt und analysiert komplexe Qualitätsanforderungen von Stakeholdern mit Fachwissen und beeinflusst die Stakeholder des Unternehmens, um sie zu informieren und die richtigen Entscheidungen hinsichtlich Produktqualität und Release-Bereitschaft zu treffen. Definiert den Umfang der strategischen Testlösung, verwaltet die Komplexität und sorgt durch überzeugende Kommunikation für einen Konsens über Qualitätsstandards und Freigabekriterien. Empfiehlt optimale Qualitätssicherungstechnologien und -tools für die Geschäftstransformation und bietet hochinnovative Lösungen für ungewöhnlich komplexe Qualitätsherausforderungen.
• Meilensteinmanagement: Übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung dafür, dass alle Testphasen (z. B. SAT, UAT, RT) pünktlich gemäß dem globalen Release-Kalender beginnen.
• Fortschrittsüberwachung: Verfolgen Sie Testmetriken und Fehlerverbrennungen in Echtzeit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste de gestionnaire de tests ERP (ASPIRE) Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation rencontre l'objectif. En tant qu’équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues à l’esprit commercial engagés à contribuer à façonner l’avenir numérique des soins de santé de demain. Notre mission est de propulser Roche grâce à des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Animés par un objectif et une passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique constitue une force essentielle dans l’ensemble de Roche, permettant des méthodes de travail plus intelligentes, libérant le potentiel humain et conduisant à des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde. Chez Roche, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride qui allie flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient présents dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier en fonction des besoins de l'entreprise, tels que des ateliers, des conférences, des assemblées publiques, des réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements collaboratifs. L'ERP Test Manager est l'architecte stratégique et le gardien opérationnel de la méthodologie de test ASPIRE. Vous êtes chargé d'identifier les « espaces blancs » opérationnels et de concevoir de nouveaux processus pour combler ces lacunes. Vous veillerez à ce que l'organisation de test soit conforme aux normes de validation du système informatique (CSV) et de qualité tout en favorisant une évolution continue. En tant que principal défenseur des processus lors des audits et architecte principal des mises à niveau des systèmes, vous équilibrez rigueur réglementaire et efficacité opérationnelle. Portée des responsabilités / (Leadership du contenu) : Fournit un leadership de niveau expert et des conseils stratégiques pour des projets d'assurance qualité à fort impact et/ou complexes. Développe et met en œuvre les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie qualité dans plusieurs initiatives, garantissant la cohérence, la traçabilité des tests et l'alignement avec les normes de l'entreprise. Dirige les efforts d’analyse de la qualité sur des projets importants, fournit des conseils aux ingénieurs qualité moins expérimentés et contribue aux initiatives stratégiques. Fournit une supervision, des conseils et une assurance qualité pour l’ensemble des initiatives stratégiques, garantissant l’alignement de l’objectif et de la portée des tests, la cohésion des tests, la traçabilité et la valeur finale du produit.
• Dépositaire : Posséder la version principale de la méthodologie de test ASPIRE.
• Alignement réglementaire : assurez-vous que chaque mise à jour de processus est « pré-validée » en vous alignant sur les équipes CSV et Qualité avant le déploiement.
• Création de contenu : rédigez une documentation technique de haute qualité, notamment des SOP, des instructions de travail et des guides d'utilisation. Responsabilité/Résolution de problèmes : dirige l'analyse des problèmes de qualité logiciels complexes et stratégiques, définissant la portée de l'assurance qualité et conduisant une analyse complète des causes profondes des défauts critiques pouvant dépasser les limites de l'organisation. Obtient et analyse les besoins complexes en matière de qualité des parties prenantes avec une expertise, influençant les parties prenantes de l'entreprise à informer et à prendre les bonnes décisions concernant la qualité des produits et la préparation à la sortie. Définit la portée de la solution de test stratégique, gère la complexité et recherche un consensus sur les normes de qualité et les critères de publication grâce à une communication convaincante. Recommande des technologies et des outils d'assurance qualité optimaux pour la transformation de l'entreprise, en fournissant des solutions hautement innovantes à des défis de qualité inhabituellement complexes.
• Gestion des étapes : assumez l'entière responsabilité de garantir que toutes les phases de test (par exemple, SAT, UAT, RT) démarrent à temps, conformément au calendrier de publication mondial.
• Surveillance des progrès : suivez les mesures de test en temps réel et la gravure des défauts.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Unsere Pharma-Vision
Wir wollen viel mehr Menschen in allen Teilen der Welt mit unseren Medikamenten helfen. Dazu wollen wir 3-5x mehr medizinische Fortschritte zu 50% geringeren Kosten für Patienten, der Gesellschaft zur Verfügung stellen.
Unsere Arbeit, unser täglicher Einsatz und unser Engagement bedeuten für sehr viele große Hoffnung und Zuversicht und deswegen müssen wir anders denken und arbeiten. Mit dem Patient im Fokus setzen wir auf eine neue Organisation und zwar #WIRGEMEINSAM in SDPM!

Wertströme
Mit der Organisation in Wertströme konzentrieren wir uns auf die wesentlichen, wertschöpfenden Tätigkeiten. Neben der Verringerung von doppelt oder unnötig durchgeführter Arbeit steht die Verbesserung von Schnittstellen und Prozessen zwischen den beteiligten Organisationseinheiten im Vordergrund.
Als Facharbeiter Ansatz/API Handling (m/w/d) bist Du für die Ansatzherstellung und API Handling, Durchführung und GMP-gerechte Dokumentation von Prozessen, Unterstützung von technischen Wartungen und Crossfunktionale Zusammenarbeit im Wertstrom verantwortlich.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du bist für die Herstellung von Anatzlösungen zuständig. Ebenso unterstützt du beim Auftau und Einfrierprozess.

• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen

• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.

• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du komplexe Produktionsanlagen und Kleinteile

• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)

• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
Du bist eine positiv denkende, integre und selbstreflektierende Persönlichkeit mit starken kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du hast ein offenes Ohr für die täglichen Herausforderungen Deiner Kolleg*innen und schaffst ein Klima der gegenseitigen Unterstützung. Du stellst Fragen um zu verstehen, sprichst kontroverse Themen offen und ehrlich an. Darüber hinaus motivierst Du alle mit deiner Can-Do-Einstellung. In diesem Sinne treibst du eine neue Denkweise und Mindset voran, die es für die erfolgreiche Arbeit in Wertströmen benötigt.
Als Facharbeiter Ansatz/API Handling hast du eine dreijährige Ausbildung erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion zeichnet Dich aus.

Darüber hinaus zeichnen Dich folgende Kompetenzen aus:

• Gute Kenntnisse über die Arbeit im Hygienebereich und den GMP-Richtlinien

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Dokumentationsarbeiten und der Umgang mit den gängigen DV-Anwendungen (u.a. MS Office, MES, Unilab) sind für Dich selbstverständlich

• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis zur Bedienung von Maschinen und besitzt sehr gute Anlagenkenntnisse

• Zudem arbeitest Du gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln

• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung

• Es besteht die Bereitsch

jobs.title: Expert Software Developer / Architect C#
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are
At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalize treatment because every patient is unique. Within Computational Science & Informatics (CSI) , we are the bridge between our origin and our future, shaping the next era of human health through precise, data-driven diagnostics and precision medicine.

We excel in delivering rigorous, clinically actionable data analysis across our diagnostics portfolio, believing that advancing computational methods and informatics solutions is essential to harnessing dynamic human health data. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitization and cutting-edge technologies, we work collaboratively to turn insights into impact.

This shared spirit creates an environment where ideas grow, new approaches are trialed, and competitive products reach patients faster—ultimately realizing the DIA 10-year vision and our One Roche ambitions so that everyone can access personalized healthcare solutions.

The Opportunity
We are seeking a Expert Software Developer / Architect C# for a role in Spain, focused on strategic decision-making and setting the organizational technical strategy. You will drive high-level system design and the technical vision while establishing elite coding standards for the enterprise across C#, WPF, and .NET 8.0.
If you excel at navigating ambiguity, utilizing modern AI-supporting tools, and mentoring engineers to build highly scalable, secure, and high-quality systems, this is the perfect opportunity to make a lasting technical impact.

Key Responsibilities
Engineering & Development (50%)

• Software Development Lifecycle : Participate fully in all phases of software development, including feasibility studies, design, development, testing, bug fixing, and ongoing software maintenance.

• Design & Implementation: Produce unit and subsystem specifications based on software requirements, project architecture, and guidelines. Accurately design and implement code, including the necessary tests to verify functionality against specifications.

• Strategic Tech Roadmapping & Governance: Define the technical roadmap and maintain architectural governance across development teams. Proactively align implementation with long-term business goals and project management strategies.

• Quality Assurance & Review: Conduct thorough reviews and analysis of personal source code and, upon request, the source code of peers. Review application design, functionality, usability, and performance to drive enhancements.

• Ambiguity Management: Possess the ability to navigate ambiguity and maintain forward progress.

• Role Type: Function as a Fullstack Developer.

Architect & Technical Expert (50%)

• Define all aspects of development, selecting appropriate technologies, workflows, and establishing rigorous coding standards.

• Collaborate with other professionals to determine and analyze functional and non-functional requirements for new software or applications.

• Mentorship & Talent Development: Provide high-level guidance and professional coaching to developers, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous learning within the engineering organization.

• Monitor the progress of the development team to ensure consistency with the initial design and technical vision.

• Ensure all software complies strictly with requirements for quality, security, modifiability, and extensibility.

Who You Are
Technical Skills

• Programming & Frameworks

Specialist Inbound (m/w/d)

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

In dieser Rolle bist Du Teil unseres Inbound-Teams und treibst die digitale und operative Transformation unserer Logistikprozesse aktiv voran. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du nimmst eigenverantwortlich an fachbezogenen Projekten innerhalb der GSC Operations EMEA mit Fokus auf Prozessoptimierung und Netzwerkausbau.

• Die Analyse und Auswertung von Inbound-Daten liegt in Deiner Hand, um mittels KPIs eine effektive Steuerung und präzise Forecasts zu ermöglichen.

• Du gestaltest die Zukunft unserer IT-Landschaft mit, indem Du Inboundprozesse in neue EWM-Lösungen etablierst und Tools wie die Fiori App und den HUT-Prozess weiterentwickelst.

• Sicher und routiniert steuerst Du die Warenannahme, inkl. Buchungsprozessen, zolltechnischer Abwicklung und Temperaturassessments.

• Du sicherst die Einhaltung höchster Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards und passt Arbeitsanweisungen kontinuierlich an neue Gegebenheiten an.

Du brennst für innovative Logistiklösungen und behältst auch bei komplexen Datenströmen stets den Überblick. Das zeichnet Dich aus:

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder IT.

The Position

Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert - EPIE

The Senior Partner Systems Delivery Expert will provide technical guidance on complex system integrations, drive architectural efficiency, influence technical stakeholder decisions, and mentor cross-functional teams to achieve strategic ecosystem alignment. In this role, you will navigate both organizational and technical complexity to drive the alignment of related roadmaps for large-scale, strategically critical initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in validating interface testing, ensuring seamless data and transaction synchronization across the broader ecosystem landscape. By diving deep into technical details with internal and external stakeholders, you will define and communicate comprehensive integration solution visions. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Technical Program Manager, Integration Lead, Systems Readiness SME, or Technical Delivery Manager.

Develops, implements, and champions interface testing frameworks, readiness criteria, and integration best practices. Oversees the management of scope changes related to technical endpoints, ensuring strategic alignment across related roadmaps while proactively driving improvements to integration processes.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of complex technical integration issues across ecosystem boundaries, eliciting detailed system requirements and influencing architectural decisions. Accountable for overall system readiness on significant initiatives, defining data and transaction synchronization solutions, and driving consensus through persuasive technical communication. Plonge dans les détails techniques avec les parties prenantes, gère les conflits concernant les spécifications d'interface et établit de solides relations de collaboration au sein de l'écosystème.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Specialist Strategic Order Control (m/w/d)

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Abteilung und das Team

Bei Roche Diagnostics leisten wir Pionierarbeit, um die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens zu gestalten. Unsere Arbeit gibt Menschen mehr Zeit mit denjenigen, die sie lieben – ein Wunsch, den wir alle teilen und der uns zu medizinischen Durchbrüchen antreibt. In Deiner Rolle als Specialist Strategic Order Control sicherst Du die operativen Abläufe in unserem Logistik-Hub EMEA. Durch vorausschauende Steuerung und kluges Engpassmanagement sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Innovationen genau dann dort ankommen, wo sie am dringendsten benötigt werden: bei den Patient:innen. Werde Teil unserer Mission, durch wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und effiziente Logistik ein gesünderes Morgen zu schaffen.

Du wirst Teil des Control Tower Teams, einer dynamischen Einheit, die die verschiedenen Bereiche der operativen Abwicklung durch datengestützte Analysen verbindet und für eine reibungslose, übergeordnete Steuerung sorgt. Wir leben eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der Zusammenarbeit und des gegenseitigen Respekts. In unserem Team schätzen wir unterschiedliche Perspektiven, denn wir wissen, dass die besten Lösungen durch den Austausch vielfältiger Ideen entstehen. Gemeinsam meistern wir komplexe Herausforderungen und sorgen für Prozessstabilität im Hub EMEA.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

In dieser Position bist Du der Dirigent unserer logistischen Prozesse und stellst sicher, dass alle Zahnräder effizient ineinandergreifen. Dabei übernimmst Du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Du übernimmst die strategische Überwachung der Auftragslage und entwickelst eigenständig Maßnahmen zur Lastverteilung und Effizienzsteigerung im Hub EMEA.

• Die Identifikation von Prozessengpässen (Personal, Systeme, Fläche) gehört ebenso zu Deinem Bereich wie das Erarbeiten von Handlungsempfehlungen für die operativen Einheiten.

• Du koordinierst und entwickelst Notfallstrategien weiter und leitest Taskforces zur Wiederherstellung der Prozessstabilität bei komplexen Störungen.

• Mittels komplexer Analysen und Leistungsstatistiken identifizierst Du Potenziale und führst datenbasierte Diskussionen mit Deinen Stakeholdern.

• Du wirkst aktiv an der Ausgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung der Funktion der strategischen Steuerung mit.

• Als Expert:in begleitest Du Projekte (z. B. SAP-Integration, Logsys-Updates) und planst sowie führst komplexe Softwaretests eigenverantwortlich durch.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Logistik und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick? Dann suchen wir genau Dich:

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (idealerweise Schwerpunkt Logistik) mit entsprechender Weiterbildung oder mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.

• Fundierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich Logistik sowie ein tiefes Verständnis von Intralogistik-Abläufen (Wareneingang bis Warenausgang) sind wünschenswert und von großem Vorteil.

• Du

Diventa parte della nostra missione per creare un domani più sano attraverso l'eccellenza scientifica e la logistica efficiente. Diventate parte del Control Tower Team, un'unità dinamica che collega le diverse aree di gestione operativa attraverso l'analisi data-driven e garantisce un controllo regolare e di livello superiore. Viviamo una cultura di fiducia, cooperazione e rispetto reciproco. Nel nostro team, apprezziamo diverse prospettive, perché sappiamo che le migliori soluzioni sono create dallo scambio di idee diverse. Insieme padroneggiamo complesse sfide e garantiamo la stabilità dei processi nel mozzo EMEA. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta In questa posizione, siete il direttore dei nostri processi logistici e assicuratevi che tutti gli ingranaggi si interblocchino in modo efficiente. Prenderai i seguenti compiti entusiasmanti:
• Prendere il controllo strategico della situazione dell'ordine e sviluppare autonomamente misure per la distribuzione del carico e aumentare l'efficienza nel hub EMEA.
• L'identificazione di strozzature di processo (staff, sistemi, area) è tanto una parte della vostra area quanto lo sviluppo di raccomandazioni per l'azione per le unità operative.
• Potrai inoltre coordinare e sviluppare strategie di emergenza e guidare le task force per ripristinare la stabilità del processo in interruzioni complesse.
• Utilizzando analisi complesse e statistiche sulle prestazioni, si identificano potenziali e si conducono discussioni basate sui dati con i propri stakeholder.
• Partecipa attivamente alla progettazione e allo sviluppo della funzione di controllo strategico.
• In qualità di esperto, accompagni progetti (ad esempio integrazione SAP, aggiornamenti Logsys) e pianifichi e effettui test software complessi indipendentemente. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti con te Hai una passione per la logistica e tieni una panoramica anche in situazioni complesse? Allora ti cerchiamo:
• L'utente ha completato la formazione commerciale (orientatamente focalizzata sulla logistica) con un'adeguata formazione ulteriore o diversi anni di esperienza professionale rilevante.
• Esperienza professionale ben fondata nel campo della logistica, nonché una profonda comprensione dei processi intralogistici (in arrivo di merci a merci in uscita) sono auspicabili e di grande vantaggio.
• Du

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. Our culture promotes personal expression, open dialogue and genuine connections. Here you will be valued, accepted and respected for who you are. This creates an environment where you can grow both personally and professionally. Together we want to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure that everyone has access to healthcare – today and in the future. Become part of Roche, where every voice counts. The department and the team At Roche Diagnostics, we are pioneering the future of healthcare. Our work gives people more time with those they love – a desire we all share that drives us to make medical breakthroughs. In your role as Specialist Strategic Order Control, you ensure the operational processes in our logistics hub EMEA. Through forward-looking control and clever bottleneck management, you ensure that our innovations arrive exactly where they are most needed: with the patients. Become part of our mission to create a healthier tomorrow through scientific excellence and efficient logistics. You will become part of the Control Tower Team, a dynamic unit that connects the different areas of operational management through data-driven analysis and ensures smooth, higher-level control. We live a culture of trust, cooperation and mutual respect. In our team, we value different perspectives, because we know that the best solutions are created by the exchange of diverse ideas. Together we master complex challenges and ensure process stability in the EMEA hub. • The identification of process bottlenecks (staff, systems, area) is just as much a part of your area as the development of recommendations for action for the operational units.
• You will further coordinate and develop emergency strategies and lead task forces to restore process stability in complex disruptions.
• Using complex analyses and performance statistics, you identify potential and conduct data-based discussions with your stakeholders.
• You actively participate in the design and further development of the strategic control function.
• As an expert, you accompany projects (e.g. SAP integration, Logsys updates) and plan and carry out complex software tests independently. Qualifications | This is what you bring with you You have a passion for logistics and keep an overview even in complex situations? Then we look for you:
• You have completed commercial training (ideally focusing on logistics) with appropriate further training or several years of relevant professional experience.
• Well-founded professional experience in the field of logistics as well as a deep understanding of intralogistics processes (incoming goods to outgoing goods) are desirable and of great advantage.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Senior DevOps Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Our Certman team issues and manages the digital certificates that secure Roche's internal systems and services worldwide. We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help us automate, scale, and secure that trust infrastructure end-to-end.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

What You'll Do

You'll own the infrastructure that keeps our PKI running . That means designing and maintaining Terraform modules across multi-cloud environments, operating Kubernetes in a genuinely hybrid setup, and running the secrets and PKI plumbing that everything else depends on.

Day-to-day, you'll shape how we ship and observe things : improving CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, maturing our ArgoCD-based GitOps, managing self-hosted runners, and building observability with Grafana Cloud. When on-prem workloads need it, you'll build VM images.

Beyond the tools, you'll support three product teams in the Certificates organization, balancing their operational needs with the longer-term infrastructure work — and you'll have the autonomy to propose better ways of doing things rather than just executing tickets.

What You Bring

We are looking for thinkers that implement solutions to technical problems (optimisation, reliability). Someone with production Kubernetes experience who's comfortable owning clusters end-to-end, and who has solid hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS, secrets management, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Scripting in Python or Bash should feel natural, and your English — written and spoken — needs to be excellent. Your communication skills must be so good that we can see you leading technical conversations at all levels from day one.

But honestly, the mindset matters more than the checklist . In a cohesive DevOps and delivery team, we need someone who takes ownership without being asked, communicates openly when things are unclear, asks for help before getting stuck, and treats teammates and stakeholders with patience and respect. We value people who are curious, pragmatic, and genuinely enjoy improving the things around them.

Your Opportunity to Shine:

This role is about taking ownership and leading the charge toward transformational DevOps best practices, precision engineering, and cutting-edge cloud integration. Show your skills, grow your career, and make a measurable impact on enterprise security — all alongside a team that has your back.

Why Choose This Role?

At Roche, y

jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The PTE (Pharma Technical Operations Digital Analytics & Operational Excellence) organization will catalyze the global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We will build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients.
PTE’s Digital Data Backbone Chapter will enable this vision by making FAIR data available across the organization establishing a decentralized, value driven and data product centric approach.

As a member of the PTE Data Engineering and Architecture Team, you will work in multi-disciplinary environments harnessing data to provide real-world impact for our processes and products. You’ll work closely with a team of data scientists, subject matter experts and other data engineers in order to curate, transform and construct features which feed directly into our modeling approach. Additionally, you will contribute to the delivering FAIR data products.

This role requires an individual who can and wants to collaborate, listen and learn from colleagues, challenge thoughtfully and prioritize impact of work. You will be responsible for finding improvements in advanced data analytic models and data architecture. We are looking for someone who can quickly adapt to an ever changing environment, has a passion to learn and can be trusted to work in the best interests of colleagues.

Job Responsibilities

• Acquire, ingest, and process data from multiple sources and systems into Big Data platforms

• Building modular pipeline to construct features and modeling tables

• Collect clear requirements from SMEs and process experts.

• Hybrid technical role interfacing with process SMEs using state of the art technologies, whilst also being able to communicate complex intractable ideas to non-technical audiences.

• Understanding, assessing and mapping the data landscape

• Work with our process experts to model their data landscape, obtain data extracts and define secure data exchange approaches

• Collaborate with our data scientists to map data fields to hypotheses and curate, wrangle, and prepare data for use in their advanced analytical models

Supplementary Responsibilities

• Maintaining our Information Security standards on the engagement

• Defining the technology stack to be provisioned by our infrastructure team

• Use new and creative techniques to deliver impact for our clients as well as internal R&D projects

Who you are

Education and Experience

• University Degree with a minimum of 3+ years of relevant work experience in the bio-pharmaceutical industry specializing in bioprocess manufacturing sciences and technology or 5+ years of working experience with a degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics or a related field.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• Proven and significant experience building and managing data pipelines.

• Ability to build and manage data pipelines with Python, Scala or Java.

• Knowledge of software engineering best practices such as code reviews, testing frameworks, maintainability and readability.

• Commercial client-facing project experience is helpful, including working in close-knit teams

• Capable of working across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, ex

Conoscenza, abilità e abilità

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The PT Digital & Operational Excellence (PTE) organization works in partnership across major global business functions, establishing and implementing an overall Digital / Technology strategy. Our goal is to drive the delivery and scale of key data and digital solutions in support of Roche’s vision.
As a Senior Data Engineer at Roche PT, you will play a pivotal role in developing and optimizing the data infrastructure that powers our pharmaceutical operations and data products. Working in multidisciplinary teams—alongside data scientists, subject matter experts, and fellow data engineers—you'll curate, transform, and construct features integral to our modeling approaches. This role calls for a collaborative, open-minded individual who values learning, thoughtfully challenges ideas, and prioritizes impactful work.

The Opportunity

• Design & Build Infrastructure: Design and build scalable data pipelines and storage solutions for real-time and batch processing, aligning them with Subject Matter Expert (SME) needs.

• Lead FAIR Data Product Creation: Lead the creation of FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data products that enhance decision-making and maintain data integrity, availability, and performance across platforms.

• Data Acquisition & Processing: Acquire, ingest, and process data from diverse sources into Big Data platforms (e.g., Snowflake).

• Model Data Landscapes: Collaborate with process experts to model data landscapes, obtain extracts, define secure exchange methods, and shape data products, developing ERDs and reusable pipelines.

• Mentor & Coach: Coach junior data engineers, helping implement best practices and data engineering standards, and fostering a culture of innovation (DevOps, Data Streaming, etc.).

• Governance & Compliance: Uphold data governance standards to ensure regulatory compliance and secure sensitive data, addressing data quality issues to maintain asset accuracy and reliability.

• Technical Stewardship: Contribute to templates and best practices for the technology stack, collaborate with infrastructure teams, and apply innovative techniques to deliver impact.

Who You Are

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.

• Core Experience: 6+ years in data engineering with experience in designing large-scale systems and experience in leading junior data engineers across projects.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency with data quality and observability tools, including Ataccama and Monte Carlo.

• Communication & Collaboration: Proven ability to clearly communicate complex solutions to audiences of varied technical levels; strong organizational and interpersonal skills; and a drive to collaborate and prioritize impactful work.

• Preferred Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., GMP, FDA) and Quality systems, and experience with AI-driven data solutions and machine learning pipelines.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver lif

• Governance & Compliance: Mantenere gli standard di governance dei dati per garantire la conformità normativa e proteggere i dati sensibili, affrontare i problemi di qualità dei dati per mantenere l'accuratezza e l'affidabilità degli asset.

• Istruzione: Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria dei dati, o un campo relativo.
• Core Experience: 6+ anni di ingegneria dei dati con esperienza nella progettazione di sistemi su larga scala e esperienza nei principali ingegneri di dati junior su progetti.
• Competenze tecniche: competenza con strumenti di qualità dei dati e di osservabilità, tra cui Ataccama e Monte Carlo.
• Comunicazione e collaborazione: comprovata capacità di comunicare con chiarezza soluzioni complesse al pubblico di vari livelli tecnici; forti capacità organizzative e interpersonali; e un'iniziativa per collaborare e privilegiare un lavoro d'impatto.
• Preferite Qualificazioni: 3+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o sanitario, conoscenza dei requisiti normativi (ad esempio, GMP, FDA) e sistemi di qualità, e l'esperienza con soluzioni di dati basate su AI e condotte di apprendimento automatico. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We deliver knowledge on the safety profiles of our medicines, define how to manage risks to patients and coordinate the pharmacovigilance system activities for the company providing a safe journey for each individual patient, everywhere.

The Opportunity:

• Contribute to shaping the future of healthcare by providing essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support across the entire Roche portfolio, influencing both early and late-phase development activities.

• Serve as a key member of the safety team, offering crucial safety oversight and input into all aspects of study management from development through post-market.

• Lead critical post-market safety activities, including signal evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, and comprehensive safety risk management.

• Take ownership of individual and aggregate case reporting, encompassing ICSR case management and critical aggregate reporting activities like DSUR and PBRER.

• Drive signal detection and management, and contributing to the strategic review of safety assessments and drug safety reports.

• Influence product safety strategy and provide vital drug safety input into the overarching Clinical Development strategy.

• Contribute significantly to risk management by preparing and maintaining CCDS, labeling documents (including the IB), risk communications, RMP, and REMS.

• Act independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong self-leadership, and proactively identifying and pursuing areas for personal and professional development.

Who you are:

• Preferred Qualifications: A relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. PHD/MSc in a Life sciences discipline; Medical qualification; PharmD or other post-graduate health professional qualifications) would be advantageous

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.

• Exhibit excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of effectively collaborating with remote partners on a global team.

• Adept at applying complex data analysis and statistical methods to evaluate, interpret, and present scientific data with clarity.

• Possess strong presentation skills, effective at summarizing and presenting key considerations and decision points to diverse audiences.

• Proven ability to act independently and with minimal supervision, managing safety responsibilities on study teams and supporting safety science activities.

Please note the role level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated expertise.

This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

dell'Autorità di regolamentazione ● Contribuire allo sviluppo della strategia di sicurezza del prodotto e fornire input di sicurezza della droga nella strategia di sviluppo clinico ● Contribuire alle attività di gestione del rischio, tra cui la preparazione e la manutenzione di CCDS, l'etichettatura della manutenzione dei documenti (incluso IB), le comunicazioni di rischio, RMP, REMS ● Contribuire alla gestione dello studio da una prospettiva di sicurezza attraverso attività SMT/PET e la revisione e la manutenzione dei documenti attraverso il continuum di sviluppo (prima fase di studi post marketing), tra cui PASS ● Contribuire alle richieste dell'autorità di regolamentazione (Applicazioni di Nuovi farmaci/IND, Nuove Applicazioni di Droga/NDA, Applicazioni di Autorizzazione di preparazione e la manutenzione delle sezioni di sicurezza della Scheda Dati Core e/o Informazioni di Sicurezza di riferimento nell'IB ● Partecipare e fornire input per i comitati di monitoraggio della droga (iDMC) o riunioni del comitato di monitoraggio interno (IMC), come applicabile ● In collaborazione con il SSL, la presentazione di importanti questioni di sicurezza al Comitato per la sicurezza della droga (DSC), il Comitato per la revisione dello sviluppo (DRC) e altri comitati di controllo e di governance interni ed esterni. ● Autore o contribuire a pubblicazioni scientifiche (abstracts, manifesti, documenti) per incontri scientifici/giorni ● agisce indipendentemente per gestire le responsabilità di sicurezza sui team di studio e nelle attività di supporto alla scienza della sicurezza ● Assumere la responsabilità per ruoli specializzati con PCS. Questi possono includere, ma non sono limitati a; proprietario di processo operativo, esperto di materia. (
• Responsabilità dovute a qualifiche mediche) Essi forniranno competenze mediche cliniche e processi decisionali, in aree in cui questo è specificamente richiesto per supportare i colleghi in PCS. Situazioni in cui l'ingresso medico clinico qualificato può in genere essere cercato potrebbero includere, ma non sono limitati a: ● Interpretazione dei dati rilevanti per la sicurezza, nell'ambito dell'esperienza acquisita durante la pratica in settori rilevanti di medicina clinica/assistenza sanitaria. ● Definire i tipi di domanda di sicurezza o problema di sicurezza, nel contesto di una molecola/programma, che possono richiedere specifiche valutazioni o decisioni di sicurezza medica. ● Effettuare valutazioni sull'impatto della pratica medica nel contesto di problemi di sicurezza della qualità del prodotto (ad esempio, nell'ambito di attività definite delineate nei processi gestiti da PT che richiedono una valutazione formale da parte di qualifiche mediche
