descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht.
• Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit einem globalen Icon
• Einfluss auf die Verbesserung unserer Kunden und Patienten
• Agiles, flexibles und stärkendes Arbeitsumfeld im Angebot Berichterstattung an den National Sales Manager Near Patient Care (NPC), suchen wir einen dynamischen Account Manager, um das Wachstum und die Expansion von Roches Near Patient Care Business, das sowohl Diabetes Care als auch Point of Care Produktportfolios umfasst, voranzutreiben. Als wichtiges Mitglied der Access and Innovation Community ist der Hauptzweck des Account Managers, den Unternehmenswert durch kommerzielle Zusammenarbeit und Vertriebsausführung zu steigern. Die Rolle des Account Managers trägt wesentlich zum Erfolg bei, durch einen starken Vertriebs- und Geschäftssinn, der außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse in diesem Bereich liefert. Datenanalysen, Marktbewertungen, proaktive Verkaufsanalysen und die Nutzung von CRM-Lösungen werden der Schlüssel zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung sein und eine starke Präsenz vor Ort bei aktuellen und potenziellen Kunden ergänzen. Entscheidend für ein erfolgreiches Account Management ist der Fokus auf strategische Beziehungen zur Entwicklung von Wachstumspartnerschaften, die für Roche und unsere Kunden geschäftliche Auswirkungen haben. Mit starker Präsenz oder nachgewiesener Verkaufserfahrung in Medizinprodukten haben Sie den Antrieb und / oder die nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz, um Verkaufsergebnisse zu erzielen und Geschäftsbeziehungen aufzubauen. Diese Rolle koordiniert Roche-Ressourcen und nutzt Fachwissen, um die Wertschöpfung von Roche-Lösungen im gesamten Kundennetzwerk zu entwickeln, zu kommunizieren und zu positionieren. Der Umfang der Kunden umfasst öffentliche und private Gesundheitsunternehmen in den Ökosystemen Diabetes Care und Point of Care. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Umsetzung der Verkaufsstrategie und -taktik für das Unternehmen.
• Förderung des Wachstums durch Service und Verkauf an zielgerichtete Apotheken, Krankenhäuser, Diabeteskliniken und Altenpflegeeinrichtungen.
• Aufbau und Entwicklung gut etablierter Kundenbeziehungen in staatlichen Schlüsselkonten.
• Unterstützung der Umsetzung des Businessplans zur Erreichung der Verkaufsziele.
• Verwalten Sie zielgerichtete Konten und wichtige Geschäftsbeziehungen, um den Marktanteil von Accu-Check Diabetes Care Produkten und Dienstleistungen zu erhöhen und gleichzeitig Möglichkeiten für Point of Care Produktplatzierungen zu identifizieren.
• Bereitstellung von Produkt- und Softwareschulungen und -schulungen für medizinische Fachkräfte in Apotheken und Krankenhäusern.
• Verwalten und Aufzeichnen aller Verkaufsinteraktionen innerhalb des CRM-Systems täglich.
• Pflegen Sie ein hohes Maß an Kunden-, Produkt- und therapeutischem Wissen.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der RDA-Richtlinien und des Verhaltenskodex.
• Lebe die Roche Vision und Werte. Wer du bist:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Marketing, Wissenschaft oder Medizin oder gleichwertige 5 - 10 Jahre Account-Management-Fähigkeiten in Diagnostik / OTC / Gesundheitswesen sowohl im Einzelhandel Apotheke & Krankenhaus
• Nachgewiesene strategische Account Management Erfahrung im Bereich Diabetes-Therapie ist wünschenswert.
• Fähigkeit, neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und zu bewerten.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.
• Eignung für Marktentwicklungsstrategien, um das Umsatzwachstum zu steigern, Ergebnisse fokussiert professionell, die wissen, wie man gewinnt.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zu arbeiten sowie intern und extern mit einem Hi zu vernetzen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.
• Position permanente à temps plein avec une icône globale
• Faire un impact pour l'amélioration de nos clients et patients
• Un environnement de travail agile, flexible et autonomisant Sous l'autorité du directeur national des ventes des soins aux patients (CNP), nous cherchons un gestionnaire de compte dynamique pour stimuler la croissance et l'expansion de l'entreprise Roche's Near Patient Care qui englobe à la fois les soins au diabète et les produits de points de soins. Membre clé de la communauté de l'accès et de l'innovation, l'objectif premier du gestionnaire de compte est d'accroître la valeur de l'entreprise grâce à la collaboration commerciale et à l'exécution des ventes. Le rôle de gestionnaire de compte est un facteur clé du succès, grâce à des ventes solides et à un sens commercial qui donnent des résultats exceptionnels sur le terrain. L'analyse des données, l'évaluation du marché, l'analyse proactive des ventes et l'utilisation de la solution CRM seront essentielles au succès de l'exécution et compléteront une forte présence sur le terrain avec les clients actuels et potentiels. La clé du succès de la gestion de compte est l'accent mis sur les relations stratégiques visant à développer des partenariats de croissance qui créent un impact commercial pour Roche et nos clients. Avec une forte exposition ou une expérience de vente démontrée dans les appareils médicaux, vous aurez le moteur et/ou une expérience éprouvée d'atteindre les résultats de vente et de développer des relations d'affaires. Ce rôle coordonne les ressources de Roche et mobilise l'expertise pour développer, communiquer et positionner les solutions Roche dans l'ensemble du réseau client. La clientèle comprend des entreprises de soins de santé publiques et privées dans les écosystèmes de soins du diabète et de points de soins. Principales responsabilités :
• Mise en oeuvre de la stratégie de vente et des tactiques pour l'entreprise.
• Favoriser la croissance en assurant le service et la vente aux pharmacies, aux hôpitaux, aux dispensaires de diabète et aux établissements de soins âgés.
• Mettre à profit et développer des relations client bien établies dans les comptes clés de l'État.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre du plan d'entreprise pour atteindre les objectifs de vente.
• Gérer des comptes ciblés et des relations commerciales clés pour stimuler la croissance des parts de marché des produits et services Accu-Check Diabetes Care tout en identifiant les possibilités de placement de produits Point of Care.
• Dispenser une formation et un enseignement aux professionnels de la santé en pharmacie et en milieu hospitalier.
• Gérer et enregistrer quotidiennement toutes les interactions de vente au sein du système CRM.
• Maintenir un haut niveau de connaissance client, produit et thérapeutique.
• Veiller à ce que les politiques et le code de conduite de la RDA soient respectés.
• Vivez la vision et les valeurs Roche. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat en affaires, marketing, sciences ou médecine ou équivalent de 5 à 10 ans compétences de gestion de compte en diagnostic/OTC/soins de santé dans la pharmacie de détail et l'hôpital
• Une expérience éprouvée de la gestion stratégique des comptes dans le domaine de la thérapie contre le diabète est souhaitable.
• Capacité d'identifier et d'évaluer de nouvelles possibilités d'affaires.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes.
• Aptitude aux stratégies de développement du marché pour stimuler la croissance des revenus, les résultats orientés professionnels qui savent gagner.
• Capacité éprouvée de travailler dans des équipes interfonctionnelles, ainsi que de réseau interne et externe avec une hi

jobs.title: Especialista em Comércio Exterior (Trade Compliance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Especialista em Comércio Exterior com foco em Trade Compliance no Chapter de Supply Chain, você terá a responsabilidade pela manutenção da excelência operacional e da integridade corporativa. Você será o principal responsável por assegurar a total conformidade de todas as operações de comércio exterior da RDB, o que abrange a importação de insumos críticos garantindo o rigoroso cumprimento das complexas regulamentações aduaneiras, fiscais e internacionais vigentes no país. Atuando como um especialista de riscos, sua função é essencial para mitigar vulnerabilidades legais e operacionais na cadeia de suprimentos, implementando políticas e procedimentos robustos. Além disso, como Especialista de Trade Compliance você deverá trabalhar para proteger a reputação da Roche, otimizar a eficiência dos fluxos logísticos e assegurar que o acesso a produtos de saúde vitais não seja interrompido por questões de não conformidade, contribuindo diretamente para os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Atuar como o consultor técnico de referência para todas as áreas da companhia em temas de alta complexidade aduaneira, esclarecendo e desatando nós operacionais sobre aduana, regimes tributários e barreiras regulatórias.

• Liderar tecnicamente o atendimento a auditorias externas e fiscalizações promovidas pela RF, Anvisa ou MAPA. Preparar pareceres aduaneiros, impugnações e pleitos para a obtenção e manutenção de Regimes Especiais ou certificações de conformidade

• Desenhar e executar uma rotina minuciosa de auditoria em grandes volumes de dados, validando o histórico e os registros vigentes de Declarações de Importação, faturas comerciais e LIs para identificar e retificar inconformidades antes de sua parametrização fiscal.

• Estruturar novos Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão de conformidade aduaneira e matrizes de conhecimento, blindando o ecossistema operacional contra a perda contínua de inteligência técnica gerada pela alta rotatividade de pessoal.

• Liderar de ponta a ponta o saneamento e a governança do banco de dados de classificação fiscal de mercadorias (NCM), valoração aduaneira e descrições técnicas de produtos, mitigando riscos de autuações por erro de classificação ou subvaloração.

• Estabelecer malhas de controle e auditar com rigor métrico as atividades executadas por despachantes aduaneiros e consultorias externas, garantindo que operem rigorosamente sob as diretrizes e políticas de compliance estabelecidas pela empresa.

• Mapear, rastrear e sanar proativamente lacunas operacionais históricas na cadeia de importação, construindo defesas robustas e planos de conformidade para neutralizar potenciais passivos regulatórios existentes.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Graduação superior completa em Direito (com foco tributário/aduaneiro), Comércio Exterior, Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.Especialização, Pós-graduação ou MBA concluído em Direito Aduaneiro, Gestão Fiscal ou Auditoria Fiscal será considerado um diferencial.

• Experiência consolidada atuando na área de Trade Compliance, auditoria de comércio exterior ou consultoria aduaneira de grande porte. Histórico comprovado de atuação frente a fiscalizações.

• Domínio irrestrito e atualizado do Regulamento Aduaneiro brasileiro, Soluções de Consulta da RFB, jurisprudências do CARF relativas ao comércio exterior e tratados internacionais de comércio.

• Proficiência avançada em técnicas de auditoria amostral e de massa de dados aduaneiros (DIs, Duimp

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning & IBP (S&OP) Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Gerente de Planejamento de Demanda, você irá liderar o processo de Planejamento Integrado de Negócios (IBP) e a equipe de Demanda e Suprimentos, atuando no chapter de Supply Chain da Roche Diagnóstica. Você irá executar o IBP atual, além de documentar, implementar e amadurecer o processo, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua e simplificação alinhada aos Princípios Operacionais da Roche.
Sob sua responsabilidade estará garantir que a equipe preveja com precisão os requisitos de produtos (instrumentos, reagentes e peças), estruturando um plano de demanda assertivo para abastecer a cadeia de suprimentos de forma eficiente. O gestor também manterá o sistema e as metas de qualidade por meio de ações diárias, conformidade com diretrizes e resolução de problemas. Por fim, você irá desempenhar um papel fundamental de integração para assegurar o equilíbrio ideal do estoque, evitando interrupções no fornecimento ou custos elevados de distribuição.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Atuar em parceria com o time Comercial para entender, com antecedência, os sinais de mercado e os direcionadores de demanda que informam os cenários de planejamento de suprimentos, bem como riscos e oportunidades relacionados aos planos de negócio de médio e longo prazo.

• Liderar e fornecer direcionamento estratégico e tático para as interdependências de IBP com o Planejamento de Demanda e todos os chapters e funções envolvidos.

• Atuar como especialista no assunto em Operações Comerciais e de Supply Chain para fornecer suporte, orientação, educação e treinamento para os principais stakeholders/usuários.

• Liderar a cadência diária e semanal com todos os colaboradores para garantir a execução da disponibilidade de produtos e estabelecer a gestão de rotina para evitar excesso de estoque além de seus contribuidores em tópicos de desenvolvimento de carreira provendo coach inspirador e transformador.

• Responsável pelo desempenho superior de entrega no prazo ao cliente (OTIF), mantendo níveis otimizados de estoque de produtos acabados e Instrumentos para as cadeias de valor atribuídas.

• Estabelecer parcerias, negocia e influencia os principais stakeholders para impulsionar o alinhamento e apoiar a implementação do IBP entre Comercial e Operações.

• Liderar e coordenar o processo de planejamento de longo prazo entre as cadeias de valor com Logística de Entrada (Inbound) e Saída (Outbound), times comerciais e dentro da cadeia de suprimentos da DIA.

• Compreender e prioriza os requisitos de negócios de múltiplos colaboradores/clientes, simplificando-os para facilitar a análise, o desenho de soluções e a tomada de decisão;

• Colaborar com parceiros multifuncionais, como o parceiro de Supply Chain da DIA globalmente e a área de Supply Chain Excellence, para documentar o processo de IBP de ponta a ponta e implementar iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

• Identificar restrições de produção e suprimento, analisa opções para resolvê-las e prepara alternativas para a tomada de decisão da alta gestão e navega pelas mudanças na demanda de mês a mês, bem como dentro do mês, planos de inventário, variações de desempenho e metas de negócios.

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas

• Sólida competência em gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos e visão de negócios com experiência mínima de 10 anos de acumulada em Planejamento de Demanda e Suprimentos e Supply Chain.

• Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de saúde, farmacêutica

jobs.title: Customer Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Customer Partner, you will be responsible for growing the market share and achieving sales goals for the assigned territory. You will be responsible for executing the sales process, ensure operation effectiveness and efficiency, with proficient interpersonal and communication skills, and providing effective solutions to establish and maintain relationships that result in customer satisfaction, retention and acquisition.

You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

Territory coverage: Central + Negeri Sembilan
Primary work location: Central - based

In this role, you will

• Lead the complete sales process including prospecting, qualification, closing, contracting, implementation, and ensuring high-standard after-sales support through solution/consultative selling.

• Build long-term, value-based customer relationships by continuously uncovering changing needs, improving customer experience, and adding value through creative solutions.

• Establish credibility with stakeholders by demonstrating business acumen, professional expertise, and adapting one's communication style to align with customers' working styles.

• Drive business development by identifying, developing, retaining, extending, and acquiring accounts, and collaborating across teams to attain objectives.

• Strategize for growth by developing and implementing annual territorial plans to achieve sales goals and future growth, and profiling accounts to position RDMY strongly to win tenders.

• Maintain data integrity in REXIS Salesforce by regularly updating accounts/contacts, and ensuring weekly entry and monitoring of activities and business opportunities.

• Support sales execution with technical proficiency, including conducting basic troubleshooting and using the Global Deal Calculator (GDC) to prepare sales proposals, along with participation in relevant marketing events.

Any other tasks or projects as assigned from time to time.

Who you are

• Strong client-facing skills including communication, negotiation, and influencing.

• Highly efficient and results-driven, demonstrating strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

• Commercial awareness and product knowledge, plus the ability to be a team player who thrives and collaborates in a cross-functional, fast-changing environment.

• Required education is a Bachelor or Master Degree in Health/Science/Medical disciplines (Tertiary qualification in Science and Business focus is desired), preferably with at least one year of related industry experience.

• High technical ability and computer literacy are required, along with a valid Malaysian driver’s license and the ability to travel interstate; IT, people management, marketing, and business development experience are beneficial.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint.

PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights.

The Opportunity
This role is responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Supply Chain domain, e.g. Network Optimization, Warehouse Capacity Forecasting. As the Digital Strategy Delivery Lead you will take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with stakeholders / customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.

• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.

• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.

• Scalability: Utilize your broad Supply Chain end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on network scalability.

• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.

• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.

• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.

• Risk Assessment and Mitigation : Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.

• Innovation

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Facciamo avanzare la scienza in modo che tutti noi abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. In Roche, ci impegniamo a fornire maggiori vantaggi ai nostri pazienti come parte della nostra visione decennale nel settore farmaceutico. Una parte integrante del raggiungimento di questa visione è fornire soluzioni di analisi dei dati nuove e innovative ai nostri scienziati in tutta la divisione Pharma Technical Operations (PT). Per fare ciò, abbiamo formato una nuova organizzazione denominata PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) con l’aspirazione di costruire operazioni digitali e snelle leader del settore in tutte le funzioni e nella nostra intera impronta produttiva. PTE è l'organizzazione che catalizza lo sviluppo globale e l'attuazione della strategia di eccellenza operativa e digitale di PT per consentire a PT di realizzare le proprie promesse di performance. Costruiamo una forte comunità interfunzionale e inclusiva, mettiamo il potere dei dati nelle mani delle nostre persone, sviluppiamo ulteriormente le competenze Lean e Digitali in tutto il PT e ampliamo le nostre soluzioni di analisi digitale e avanzata, a vantaggio dei nostri colleghi e pazienti. Il nostro obiettivo è attivare la cittadinanza dei dati e la mentalità digitale, rivoluzionare il nostro ecosistema di dati e il panorama dei sistemi FAIR, riprogettare processi eccellenti e generare intuizioni trasformative. L'opportunità Questo ruolo è responsabile della guida della strategia della tecnologia digitale attraverso la fornitura di iniziative digitali chiave e casi d'uso nel dominio della catena di fornitura, ad es. Ottimizzazione della rete, previsione della capacità del magazzino. In qualità di Digital Strategy Delivery Lead, assumi il ruolo di Agile Product Owner (PO) per collaborare con le parti interessate/clienti in tutte le funzioni PT per architettare la pianificazione (ad esempio diagnosi), l'esecuzione (ad esempio progettazione e costruzione) e il sostegno delle soluzioni digitali per raggiungere le aspirazioni digitali PT.
• Trasformazione digitale strategica: progettare iniziative chiave e agire come traduttore digitale tra le esigenze aziendali e i ruoli tecnici navigando in entrambi i domini senza soluzione di continuità.
• Impatto: definire le aspirazioni di impatto (ad esempio visione del prodotto, roadmap, valutazioni del valore, casi aziendali) nonché guidare l'implementazione di una soluzione globale in una funzione o sito. Consentire miglioramenti significativi nei processi di gestione della catena di fornitura attraverso soluzioni digitali innovative, confermate attraverso la misurazione delle principali metriche aziendali.
• Analisi dei requisiti: utilizza la comprensione aziendale end-to-end della catena di fornitura per eseguire analisi dettagliate dei requisiti con il team, con una forte attenzione al bilanciamento dei requisiti del processo, dei requisiti delle parti interessate con la semplicità del prodotto digitale, scalabilità della rete e sostenibilità.
• Definizione delle priorità e configurazione del team: definizione delle priorità dei casi d'uso e assunzione del ruolo di proprietario del prodotto per catalizzare l'implementazione dei principali casi d'uso digitali. Formare i team che stanno sviluppando e implementando casi d'uso digitali, ad es. condividere le migliori pratiche, modalità di lavoro agili, gestione degli arretrati, pianificazione degli sprint e garantire la piena acquisizione e coordinamento dell'impatto tra le diverse iniziative. Guida team di progetto interfunzionali con esperti digitali e PMI in più siti e fusi orari.
• Conformità e definizione delle soluzioni: facilitare soluzioni conformi per dati e prodotti digitali nell'ambiente GxP.
• Valutazione e mitigazione del rischio: identificare i potenziali rischi associati alle iniziative della catena di fornitura digitale e sviluppare strategie per mitigare tali rischi.
• Innovazione e miglioramento: esplorare e valutare continuamente le tecnologie digitali emergenti e le tendenze del settore. Promuovere l'innovazione e il miglioramento dei processi nell'ambito della catena di fornitura

Coachen Sie Teams, die digitale Anwendungsfälle entwickeln und einsetzen, z. Teilen Sie Best Practices, agile Arbeitsweisen, Backlog-Management und Sprint-Planung und stellen Sie eine vollständige Wirkungserfassung und Koordination zwischen verschiedenen Initiativen sicher. Leiten Sie funktionsübergreifende Projektteams mit Digitalexperten und KMUs über mehrere Standorte und Zeitzonen hinweg.
• Compliance und Lösungsgestaltung: Ermöglichung konformer Lösungen für Daten und digitale Produkte im GxP-Umfeld.
• Risikobewertung und -minderung: Identifizieren Sie potenzielle Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Initiativen zur digitalen Lieferkette und entwickeln Sie Strategien zur Minderung dieser Risiken.
• Innovation und Verbesserung: Kontinuierliche Erforschung und Bewertung neuer digitaler Technologien und Branchentrends. Fördern Sie Innovationen und Prozessverbesserungen im Bereich Supply Chain

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons progresser la science afin que nous puissions tous passer plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. Chez Roche, nous nous efforçons d’offrir davantage d’avantages à nos patients dans le cadre de notre vision pharmaceutique sur 10 ans. Une partie intégrante de la réalisation de cette vision consiste à fournir des solutions d'analyse de données nouvelles et innovantes à nos scientifiques des opérations techniques pharmaceutiques (PT). Pour ce faire, nous avons formé une nouvelle organisation appelée PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) avec l'aspiration de créer des opérations numériques et Lean de pointe dans l'ensemble des fonctions et de l'ensemble de notre empreinte de fabrication. PTE est l'organisation qui catalyse le développement et l'exécution à l'échelle mondiale de la stratégie d'excellence numérique et opérationnelle de PT pour permettre à PT de réaliser nos promesses de performance. Nous construisons une communauté interfonctionnelle forte et inclusive, mettons le pouvoir des données entre les mains de nos collaborateurs, développons davantage les compétences Lean et numériques au sein de PT et développons nos solutions numériques et d'analyse avancée, pour le bénéfice de nos collègues et de nos patients. Notre objectif est d’activer la citoyenneté des données et la mentalité numérique, de révolutionner notre écosystème de données et notre paysage de systèmes FAIR, de repenser d’excellents processus et de générer des informations transformatrices. L'opportunité Ce rôle est chargé de piloter la stratégie technologique numérique à travers la livraison d'initiatives numériques clés et de cas d'utilisation dans le domaine de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, par ex. Optimisation du réseau, prévision de la capacité des entrepôts. En tant que responsable de la mise en œuvre de la stratégie numérique, vous jouez le rôle d'un Product Owner (PO) Agile pour collaborer avec les parties prenantes/clients dans toutes les fonctions PT afin d'architecturer la planification (par exemple, diagnostiquer), l'exécution (par exemple, conception et construction) et le maintien des solutions numériques pour atteindre les aspirations numériques de PT.
• Transformation numérique stratégique : concevoir des initiatives clés et agir en tant que traducteur numérique entre les besoins commerciaux et les rôles techniques en naviguant de manière transparente entre les deux domaines.
• Impact : définir les aspirations d'impact (par exemple, vision produit, feuille de route, évaluations de valeur, analyses de rentabilisation) ainsi que diriger le déploiement d'une solution globale dans une fonction ou un site. Permettre des améliorations significatives des processus de gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement grâce à des solutions numériques innovantes, confirmées par la mesure d’indicateurs commerciaux clés.
• Analyse des exigences : utilisez votre compréhension globale de bout en bout de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour effectuer des analyses détaillées des exigences avec l'équipe, en mettant l'accent sur l'équilibre entre les exigences des processus et les exigences des parties prenantes avec la simplicité des produits numériques, l'évolutivité et la durabilité du réseau.
• Priorisation et configuration de l'équipe : effectuer la priorisation des cas d'utilisation et assumer le rôle de propriétaire de produit pour catalyser la mise en œuvre des cas d'utilisation numériques clés. Coacher les équipes qui développent et déploient des cas d'utilisation numérique, par ex. partager les meilleures pratiques, les méthodes de travail agiles, la gestion du backlog, la planification des sprints et assurer la capture et la coordination complètes de l'impact entre les différentes initiatives. Dirigez des équipes de projet interfonctionnelles avec des experts du numérique et des PME sur plusieurs sites et fuseaux horaires.
• Conformité et élaboration de solutions : faciliter des solutions conformes pour les données et les produits numériques dans l'environnement GxP.
• Évaluation et atténuation des risques : identifier les risques potentiels associés aux initiatives de chaîne d'approvisionnement numérique et développer des stratégies pour atténuer ces risques.
• Innovation et amélioration : explorer et évaluer en permanence les technologies numériques émergentes et les tendances de l'industrie. Piloter l’innovation et l’amélioration des processus dans le domaine de la chaîne d’approvisionnement

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst - RDT EPIE
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Analyst

We focus on the long - term, leading investment in research and development, striving to improve lives today and for generations to come. Poland plays the role of Technology Co-creation and Acceleration Hub building capabilities driving digital innovation. In Roche Informatics we are a diverse team of open and friendly people, enthusiastic about technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the strategic engine for RDT Enterprise Platforms, Infrastructure & Engineering (EPIE), our team bridges high-level vision with world-class execution. We are a high-performing collective of experts—from project leaders to business analysts and human centered design experts—dedicated to elevating operational excellence and driving long-term strategy. By harnessing data-driven insights and managing critical shared capabilities, we ensure our division meets its global commitments with precision. Joining us means operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and operational effectiveness, with the autonomy to streamline complex processes and the influence to shape the digital future of healthcare at Roche.

The opportunity:
As a Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans. In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

• Scope: Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Leads the analysis of needs and problems, performs thorough research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to operational excellence and effectiveness solutions, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Analizzatore di affari Ci concentriamo sul lungo termine, che porta gli investimenti nella ricerca e nello sviluppo, cercando di migliorare le vite di oggi e per le generazioni a venire. La Polonia svolge il ruolo di Technology Co-creation and Acceleration Hub building che guida l'innovazione digitale. In Roche Informatics siamo un team di persone aperte e amichevoli, entusiasti delle novità tecnologiche e delle soluzioni IT ottimali. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Come motore strategico per piattaforme aziendali RDT, infrastrutture e ingegneria (EPIE), il nostro team collega una visione di alto livello con l'esecuzione di livello mondiale. Siamo un collettivo di esperti altamente performanti, dai leader di progetto agli analisti di business e agli esperti di design centrati sull'uomo, che si è dedicato ad elevare l'eccellenza operativa e a guidare la strategia a lungo termine. sfruttando le informazioni e gestendo le capacità condivise critiche, garantiamo che la nostra divisione soddisfi i suoi impegni globali con precisione. Unisciti a noi significa operare all'incrocio tra strategia, tecnologia e efficacia operativa, con l'autonomia di semplificare i processi complessi e l'influenza per plasmare il futuro digitale della salute a Roche. L'opportunità: Come Business Analyst, gestirai in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end, affrontando complessi problemi aziendali con l'ambiguità emergente. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente affidabile per i team interfunzionali, modellando le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze di processo, e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e validazione di soluzioni efficaci. Potrai anche mentore analisti junior e modellare attivamente i processi del team, le metodologie e le migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di Pratica.
• Ambito: gestisce autonomamente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end senza guida, affrontando problemi con l'ambiguità emergente. Proficientemente adatta una gamma di quadri standard e forma proattivamente i modi di team di lavoro e le migliori pratiche.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi delle esigenze e dei problemi, esegue una ricerca approfondita e guida l'analisi delle cause root. Contabile per fornire requisiti completi, contribuendo in modo significativo alle soluzioni di eccellenza operativa e di efficacia, e identificare proattivamente discrepanze di risoluzione delle esigenze per proporre miglioramenti creativi.
• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Identificare una vasta gamma di stakeholder interfunzionali e consolida l'affidabilità attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale per agire come consulente affidabile. Facilita i workshop, risolve i conflitti e forma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle agli obiettivi del progetto.
• Impatto/Strategia: Fornisce impatto che si estende a un prodotto specifico, iniziativa o cluster, contribuendo agli obiettivi di dominio garantendo soluzioni che forniscono un valore aziendale dimostrabile. Traduci i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategica, influenza le decisioni tattiche, e contribuisce a soluzioni a lungo termine roadmap.

Polen spielt die Rolle von Technology Co-Creation und Acceleration Hub Building Fähigkeiten, die digitale Innovation vorantreiben. Mit Roche Informatics sind wir ein vielfältiges Team von offenen und freundlichen Menschen, die sich für technologische Neuheiten und optimale IT-Lösungen begeistern. Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen. Als strategischer Motor für RDT Enterprise Platforms, Infrastructure & Engineering (EPIE) verbindet unser Team eine hochrangige Vision mit einer erstklassigen Ausführung. Wir sind ein leistungsstarkes Expertenkollektiv – von Projektleitern über Business Analysten bis hin zu Experten für menschenzentriertes Design –, das sich der Verbesserung der operativen Exzellenz und der Förderung einer langfristigen Strategie widmet. Durch die Nutzung datengesteuerter Erkenntnisse und das Management kritischer gemeinsamer Fähigkeiten stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Division ihre globalen Verpflichtungen präzise erfüllt. Zu uns zu kommen bedeutet, an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Technologie und operativer Effektivität zu arbeiten, mit der Autonomie, komplexe Prozesse zu rationalisieren und die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens bei Roche zu gestalten. Die Gelegenheit: Als Business Analyst verwalten Sie selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen und lösen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten. Sie werden ein starkes Verständnis für die Geschäftsdomäne, verwandte Technologien und ihre Interdependenzen demonstrieren, indem Sie fortschrittliche Werkzeuge und Techniken anwenden, um Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne zu übersetzen. In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams, gestalten Stakeholder-Perspektiven, behandeln Prozess-Interdependenzen und tragen wesentlich zur Gestaltung und Validierung effektiver Lösungen bei. Sie werden auch Junior-Analysten betreuen und Teamprozesse, Methoden und Best Practices innerhalb der breiteren Community of Practice aktiv gestalten.
• Umfang: Verwaltet selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen ohne Anleitung und geht Probleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten an. Passt eine Reihe von Standard-Frameworks professionell an und gestaltet proaktiv Arbeitsweisen und Best Practices im Team.

Verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung umfassender Anforderungen, einen wesentlichen Beitrag zu operativen Exzellenz- und Effektivitätslösungen und die proaktive Identifizierung von Bedarfs-Lösungs-Diskrepanzen, um kreative Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen. Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert eine Vielzahl von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern und baut durch ein tiefes Geschäftsverständnis Vertrauen auf, um als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zu fungieren. Ermöglicht Workshops, löst Konflikte und gestaltet proaktiv Stakeholder-Perspektiven, um Erwartungen strategisch zu managen und an den Projektzielen auszurichten. Wirkung/Strategie: Liefert Wirkung, die sich auf ein bestimmtes Produkt, eine bestimmte Initiative oder einen bestimmten Cluster erstreckt und zur Erreichung der Domänenziele beiträgt, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Lösungen einen nachweisbaren Geschäftswert bieten. Übersetzt Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne, beeinflusst taktische Entscheidungen und trägt zu langfristigen Lösungs-Roadmaps bei.

The Position
We are looking for an experienced and passionate Legal Counsel to join our Legal team at Roche Diagnostics Turkiye. In this role, you will play a key part in protecting our reputation and supporting strategic decision-making with expert legal guidance.

• Une solide expertise dans le développement de modèles d'affaires et de solutions client qui conduisent à des résultats commerciaux supérieurs.
• Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite en anglais (les langues supplémentaires sont un plus).
• Haute adaptabilité et empressement à l'apprentissage continu et à l'autodéveloppement.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière d'analyse, d'enquête et d'organisation.
• L'expérience dans le secteur de la santé est un avantage. Pourquoi Roche ? Chez Roche, nous croyons en la promotion d'une culture d'apprentissage, d'innovation et de collaboration. Nous offrons un environnement où vous avez la liberté de façonner votre rôle d'une manière qui s'harmonise avec vos forces et ambitions. La diversité et l'inclusion sont au cœur de notre identité, et nous vous encourageons à apporter votre authentique soi au travail chaque jour. Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?
• Une entreprise dynamique et leader sur le marché avec des opportunités de carrière nationales et internationales.

The Position
We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel in the Early Development department in the Neuroscience and Rare Disease DTA. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities.

We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the neuroscience community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, multiple sclerosis, and rare disease community.

The Opportunity

• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.

• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.

• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.

• Work as medical monitor of phase 1 and phase 2 clinical trials in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• Work on advanced imaging technique to measure neurodegeneration (e.g. neuromelanin-MRI) in Parkinson’s and Alzheimer’s disease

• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions.

Who you are

• Degree in Medicine required (e.g. MD, MBBS). An advanced clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• 1 to 3 years of clinical development experience. While prior experience is a plus, we are primarily looking for someone with high potential, strong motivation, and a willingness to learn

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

jobs.title: Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials
Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX).

Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:

• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)

• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM)

This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category Strategy Owner in charge of driving, coordinating, and signing the category strategy.

You will collaborate with internal procurement functions (such as Business Partners, Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive LEM/LCC sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives.

You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to-day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions.

As a Procurement Manager, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and business requirements, including but not limited to:

• You are a category and sourcing subject matter expert, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source, negotiate, and manage suppliers in this space to maximize value for Roche.

• You are a procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies, and project management s

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics Africa is seeking a Bilingual Pan-Africa Quality Assurance Audit and Certification Lead to join them in either one of these locations: Nairobi, Accra or Cairo.

The Opportunity

As the Pan-Africa Quality Assurance Audit and Certification Lead, you play a vital role within the Africa Quality and Regulatory Chapter. Operating within the highly regulated Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics sector, you drive, govern, and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS) across all Sub-Region Africa networks to ensure compliance with global quality and ISO 13485 standards.

This opportunity is for an individual who is an analytical thinker with a diplomatic touch, who knows how to hold the line on compliance while maintaining excellent working relationships with local teams and external partners. We are looking for an ISO 13485 certified Lead Auditor with a deep understanding of medical devices and In Vitro Diagnostics regulatory environments.

Key Challenges

• Design and execute a risk-based annual internal and external audit strategy for all networks, distribution hubs, and critical third-party partners across Africa.

• Lead as the principal auditor for internal quality management system audits, evaluating compliance against ISO 13485, ISO 9001, and local medical devices and In Vitro Diagnostics regulations.

• Conduct audits and review documentation seamlessly in both English and French, ensuring accurate interpretation of local operations across African territories.

• Manage external certification audits and regulatory inspections across the region, serving as the primary point of contact and host for the regional chapter.

• Track and validate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), partnering with local teams to ensure root-cause analyses are robust and effective.

• Safeguard existing certifications and lead compliance readiness for expansion projects across Africa.

• Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape in Africa (including regulatory bodies like SAHPRA, NAFDAC, EDA, TFDA, and PPB) to proactively align audit initiatives with changing laws.

• Establish and monitor Quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across regional networks, providing data-driven insights to the Q&R Chapter leadership.

• Standardize cross-border workflows, including warehousing, cold chain diagnostics logistics, distribution, and post-market surveillance.

• Foster an ongoing culture of audit readiness through targeted training, workshops, and mock simulations delivered in preferably both English and French.

Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate

We are seeking an experienced individual in leading audits within the medical device, diagnostics, or life sciences industries. You should have a track record of turning complex audit non-conformances into actionable, pragmatic business improvements. Preferably you are bilingual (English & French) and have strong communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across diverse cultures and geographies. You also need to have experience working within structured vendor or partner frameworks (like a BPMF).
Your qualifications include:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline.

• Certifications: Certified Lead Auditor for ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 (e.g., IRCA registered) is mandatory.

• Language Capabilities: Professional fluency in both English and French is desired. You are fully confident in auditing, writi

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics Africa sta cercando un bilingue Pan-Africa Quality Assurance Audit e la certificazione portano ad unirsi a loro in uno di questi luoghi: Nairobi, Accra o Cairo. L'opportunità Come il controllo di qualità Pan-Africa e il piombo di certificazione, si gioca un ruolo vitale all'interno del Capitolo di qualità e regolamentazione Africa. Operando all'interno del settore altamente regolamentato Medical Devices e In Vitro Diagnostics, guidi, governi e mantieni il sistema di gestione della qualità (QMS) in tutte le reti sub-regione Africa per garantire il rispetto della qualità globale e degli standard ISO 13485. Questa opportunità è per un individuo che è un pensatore analitico con un tocco diplomatico, che sa come mantenere la linea sulla conformità, mantenendo eccellenti rapporti di lavoro con le squadre locali e partner esterni. Siamo alla ricerca di un Auditor Lead certificato ISO 13485 con una profonda comprensione dei dispositivi medici e degli ambienti normativi di Vitro Diagnostics. Le sfide chiave
• Progettare ed eseguire una strategia di audit interno ed esterno basata sul rischio per tutte le reti, hub di distribuzione e partner critici di terze parti in Africa.
• Guidare come revisore principale per gli audit del sistema di gestione della qualità interna, valutando la conformità a ISO 13485, ISO 9001, e dispositivi medici locali e le normative In Vitro Diagnostics.
• Condurre audit e rivedere la documentazione senza soluzione di continuità sia in inglese che in francese, garantendo un'interpretazione accurata delle operazioni locali in tutti i territori africani.
• Gestire controlli di certificazione esterni e controlli normativi in tutta la regione, servendo come punto primario di contatto e host per il capitolo regionale.
• Tracciare e convalidare Azioni Correttive e Preventive (CAPAs), collaborando con i team locali per garantire analisi root-cause sono robuste ed efficaci.
• Salvaguardare le certificazioni esistenti e garantire la conformità ai progetti di espansione in Africa.
• Monitorare l'evoluzione del paesaggio normativo in Africa (compresi gli organismi normativi come SAHPRA, NAFDAC, EDA, TFDA e PPB) per allineare proattivamente le iniziative di audit con le modifiche delle leggi.
• Stabilire e monitorare Indicatori di performance chiave di qualità (KPI) attraverso le reti regionali, fornendo informazioni guidate dai dati alla leadership del Capitolo Q&R.
• Standardizzare i flussi di lavoro transfrontalieri, tra cui il deposito, la diagnostica a catena fredda logistica, la distribuzione e la sorveglianza post-mercato.
• Promuovere una cultura continua della prontezza dell'audit attraverso la formazione mirata, i workshop e le simulazioni di mock fornite preferibilmente sia in inglese che in francese. Chi sei come candidato ideale Stiamo cercando un individuo esperto in audit leader all'interno del dispositivo medico, diagnostica, o le industrie di scienze della vita. Si dovrebbe avere un track record di trasformare l'audit complesso non-conformances in miglioramenti operativi e pragmatici del business. Preferibilmente siete bilingue (inglese e francese) e hanno forti capacità di comunicazione con la capacità di influenzare e collaborare in diverse culture e geografie. È inoltre necessario avere esperienza di lavoro all'interno di strutture di vendor o partner (come un BPMF). Le tue qualifiche includono:
• Istruzione: laurea in Scienze della vita, Ingegneria biomedica, Farmacia, Gestione della qualità, o una disciplina tecnica correlata.
• Certificazioni: Auditore di piombo certificato per ISO 13485 e ISO 9001 (ad esempio, IRCA registrato) è obbligatorio.
• Capacità linguistiche: Si desidera una fluenza professionale sia in inglese che in francese. Sei pienamente fiducioso nell'auditing, writi

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Roche Diagnostics Africa est à la recherche d'un audit d'assurance de la qualité et d'un certificat bilingue pan-africain pour les rejoindre dans l'un de ces lieux : Nairobi, Accra ou Le Caire. L'opportunité En tant que responsable panafricain de l'audit et de la certification de la qualité, vous jouez un rôle essentiel au sein du chapitre sur la qualité et la réglementation en Afrique. Opérant dans le secteur hautement réglementé des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic In Vitro, vous pilotez, gouvernez et maintenez le système de gestion de la qualité (QMS) dans tous les réseaux de la sous-région Afrique afin d'assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiale et ISO 13485. Cette opportunité s'adresse à une personne qui est un penseur analytique avec une touche diplomatique, qui sait tenir la ligne sur la conformité tout en maintenant d'excellentes relations de travail avec les équipes locales et les partenaires externes. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un vérificateur principal certifié ISO 13485 avec une compréhension approfondie des dispositifs médicaux et des environnements réglementaires In Vitro Diagnostics. Principaux défis
• Concevoir et exécuter une stratégie annuelle d'audit interne et externe axée sur les risques pour tous les réseaux, les centres de distribution et les partenaires tiers essentiels en Afrique.
• Diriger en tant que principal vérificateur des audits internes des systèmes de gestion de la qualité, évaluer la conformité avec les normes ISO 13485, ISO 9001, et les réglementations locales en matière de dispositifs médicaux et de diagnostic In Vitro.
• Effectuer des audits et examiner la documentation de manière transparente en anglais et en français, en veillant à une interprétation exacte des opérations locales dans les territoires africains.
• Gérer les audits externes de certification et les inspections réglementaires dans toute la région, en servant de point de contact principal et d'hôte pour le chapitre régional.
• Suivre et valider les actions correctives et préventives (CAPA), en partenariat avec les équipes locales pour s'assurer que les analyses des causes profondes sont solides et efficaces.
• Préserver les certifications existantes et diriger l'état de préparation aux projets d'expansion en Afrique.
• Surveiller l'évolution du paysage réglementaire en Afrique (y compris les organismes de réglementation tels que la SAHPRA, la NAFDAC, l'EDA, la TFDA et la PPB) afin d'harmoniser les initiatives d'audit avec les lois en évolution.
• Établir et surveiller des indicateurs clés de rendement de la qualité (ICP) dans l'ensemble des réseaux régionaux, en fournissant des renseignements fondés sur les données au leadership du chapitre de la Q-R.
• Normaliser les flux de travail transfrontaliers, y compris l'entreposage, le diagnostic de la chaîne du froid, la logistique, la distribution et la surveillance post-commercialisation.
• Favoriser une culture permanente de préparation à l'audit grâce à une formation ciblée, à des ateliers et à des simulations simulées en français et en anglais de préférence. Qui vous êtes comme candidat idéal Nous recherchons une personne expérimentée dans la conduite d'audits au sein des industries des instruments médicaux, des diagnostics ou des sciences de la vie. Vous devriez avoir une expérience de transformation de non-conformités complexes en améliorations opérationnelles pragmatiques et réalisables. De préférence, vous êtes bilingue (anglais et français) et avez de solides compétences en communication avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer dans diverses cultures et géographies. Vous devez également avoir de l'expérience dans le cadre structuré de fournisseurs ou de partenaires (comme un BPMF). Vos qualifications comprennent:
• Éducation: Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie, génie biomédical, pharmacie, gestion de la qualité, ou une discipline technique connexe.
• Certifications : Le contrôleur de bord certifié ISO 13485 et ISO 9001 (par exemple, IRCA enregistré) est obligatoire.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Clinical Fellowship in Product Development Oncology/Haematology (PDOH)
Summary

This Roche Clinical Fellowship is aimed at medically qualified individuals with a specific interest in haematology or oncology, either before or immediately post specialist training.
Established in 2013, the program was designed to diversify and broaden clinical training through exposure to clinical research methodology from the pharmaceutical medicine perspective. The fellowship will be 1 year in duration, primarily based at Roche Products Ltd in Welwyn Garden City, UK. The position is within the Clinical Development Group, which is responsible for the strategy, design and execution of late phase clinical trials in oncology, haemato-oncology and non-malignant haematology disease areas. Every attempt will be made to accommodate your specific areas of interest and expertise, but available projects will likely need to be determined by the development timelines of each disease area programme There will be the opportunity for direct interaction across Roche/Genentech. There may be opportunities to attend scientific conferences, depending on the project and programme. Your supervisor will be an experienced member of the Clinical Development Group working in Welwyn. In addition, you will be assigned a mentor who is a UK accredited Physician. If successful, you need to be available to start the role before the end of this year.

There is 1 MD Fellow position in:-

• Oncology/Haematology (PDOH), which incorporates the following areas of specialty:
• Oncology

• Haemato-oncology (lymphoid and myeloid)

• Non-malignant haematology (haemophilia and allied bleeding disorders, gene therapy, thrombosis)

As a Fellow in the Global Clinical Development Group you may:

• Be involved in the design, execution, data review, analysis and interpretation of data from clinical studies for molecules in development as well as marketed compounds.

• Interact with globally recognised academic experts and clinical investigators

• Participate in key clinical strategy, implementation and molecule management meetings in order to gain a deeper understanding of the complexities and challenges of the development of medicines

• Provide clinical expertise in the disease area for cross functional pharmaceutical development teams

• Contribute to the generation of abstracts and oral presentations for key external conferences and other specialty meetings as well as publication opportunities.

• Be involved in discussions and initiatives around Personalised Health Care (PHC) and patient selection for different therapeutic interventions

Who is the Roche Clinical Research Fellowship suitable for?
Essential Criteria:

• GMC Registration: Must hold active registration with the General Medical Council (GMC) at the time of application.

• Clinical Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of direct clinical experience post-qualification.

• Specialty Experience: Proven experience working within haematology or oncology settings.

• An individual looking to diversify their training. While some previous clinical research experience is preferred, it is not essential.

• An individual interested in further understanding and influencing the development and approval of medicines for patients within the specific disease area.
