descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que responsable mondial de la régression ERP, vous êtes l'architecte stratégique et le principal défenseur de la sécurité de notre environnement de production. Vous êtes responsable de la stratégie de régression de bout en bout à travers les paysages DIA et ASPIRE (S/4HANA) et tous les ERP dans la portée. En plus de définir la « loi », vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans l'éducation et l'engagement des intervenants. Vous travaillerez directement avec les propriétaires de modèles SAP mondiaux et de sites locaux en direct pour s'assurer qu'ils comprennent la valeur des tests de régression, les aider à identifier une nouvelle portée à mesure que le produit évolue et fournir des rapports transparents et de haut niveau pour s'assurer que tous les intervenants sont alignés avant toute sortie de production. Vous serez le gardien de la mise en oeuvre, de la mise à jour et du maintien de la stratégie d'essai de régression conformément au cadre et à la stratégie d'essai globaux. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe ou des internes ou des externes pour aider à soutenir les efforts de tests de régression pour toute la portée. L'objectif sera d'automatiser toute la portée possible des tests de régression et donc de travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Test Automation. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Gestion de bout en bout de l'assurance qualité : gère de façon indépendante les tâches d'assurance de la qualité de bout en bout à travers diverses capacités et contribue à des tests et des problèmes de qualité plus complexes.
• Mentorship & Best Practices: Mentors plus de membres de l'équipe junior et contribue au développement des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie de qualité.
• Prise en charge globale de la stratégie: maintenir la stratégie d'essai de régression principale, en veillant à ce qu'elle évolue parallèlement à la feuille de route ASPIRE et au démantèlement éventuel de la DIA.
• Méthodologie & CSV: Veiller à ce que toutes les activités de régression soient conformes à la méthodologie d'essai ASPIRE et soient pleinement conformes aux normes de qualité/CSV. Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes
• Analyse des problèmes et cause racine: Dirige indépendamment l'analyse des problèmes de qualité des logiciels modérément complexes, définissant clairement la portée des tests et motivant l'analyse des causes racine.
• Requirements & Test Planning: Élite, analyse et synthétise les besoins complexes des parties prenantes concernant la qualité du logiciel et l'expérience utilisateur. Responsable de l'exécution de plans d'essais complets et des exigences de qualité, contribuant de façon significative à la conception et à la validation de stratégies d'essais efficaces.
• Amélioration des processus : analyse la technologie adaptée aux outils de qualité, identifie de façon proactive les lacunes des tests et lance des initiatives d'amélioration des processus d'AQ.
• Remise en état des lacunes: construire et améliorer de manière proactive des processus où le transfert entre déploiement et soutien à la production est faible.
• Leadership et responsabilisation : la responsabilité des champions par exemple (comme prendre la tête de l'AQ et/ou tester les rôles d'architecte).
• Gestion des écarts : enregistrer et justifier les écarts par rapport à la stratégie globale, en assurant une piste d'audit claire. Gestion des parties prenantes
• Gestion des relations : Identifier et gérer efficacement les relations avec un éventail varié de parties prenantes dans les domaines fonctionnels sur des engagements de taille moyenne à grande.
• Engagement et facilitation: Facilite les ateliers, résout les conflits et agit en tant que leader indépendant en définissant des stratégies d'engagement des parties prenantes pour des initiatives complexes.
• Orientation stratégique : façonne de façon proactive les perspectives des parties prenantes, anticipe et gère stratégiquement les attentes, et offre des conseils d'experts pour renforcer la confiance en tant que conseiller de confiance.
• L'évangélisation du changement : sensibiliser les propriétaires d'ITOT et de capacités d'affaires sur les raisons des tests de régression, changer la perception d'un « goulot d'étranglement ».

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About the job

At Roche you can show up as yourself, and be embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Opportunity

Imagine working for an organisation that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission.

As a Medical Affairs Partner you will be a vital part of our Medical Affairs Chapter in the Roche UK affiliate. You will leverage your deep medical and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives both locally and globally. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives.

Who You Are

You are a passionate medical affairs expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. You thrive in a collaborative environment and take pride in sharing your knowledge to help others grow. You are experienced in translating complex scientific data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions. With a strong track record of building relationships with healthcare experts and influencers, you are ready to contribute to high-impact projects and collaborate across teams.

You also bring:

• A scientific university degree and relevant experience in Medical Affairs, with NHS/clinical experience where applicable

• Broad expertise in medical affairs, including data & insight generation, scientific partnerships, medical education, and strategy

• Proven ability to engage and collaborate with the clinical community to deliver value-adding outcomes

• Experience in leading and mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships

• Strong critical appraisal and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for external audiences

• Experience in Nephrology, Rheumatology or Immunology is strongly preferred

Ready to keep innovation moving?

Apply today!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Lead/ Senior Analyst – Business Research/ Market Intelligence
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad/ Chennai

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) at Chennai/ Hyderabad to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As a Lead/ Senior Analyst, you will act as a dedicated SME to Roche’s global business partners. You will transcend traditional data collection by integrating Clinical and Commercial Competitive Intelligence (CI), Market intelligence with advanced GenAI-driven analytics. Your goal is to provide high-level strategic foresight using established business frameworks to influence Roche’s global product pipeline and commercial launch strategies.

Your Opportunity

• Integrated Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence: Lead the end-to-end monitoring of the competitive landscape, bifurcating insights into Clinical CI (R&D pipeline, trial design shifts, MoA breakthroughs) and Commercial CI (pricing, market access, field force shifts, and launch trajectories)

• Strategic Framework Application: Synthesize complex market signals into actionable strategies using structured frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, and Patient Journey Mapping to identify unmet needs and white-space opportunities

• GenAI & Innovation: Architect and implement GenAI-powered workflows (e.g., LLMs for rapid secondary research synthesis, automated earnings call sentiment analysis, or GPT-based clinical trial summarization) to increase the velocity and depth of strategic recommendations

• High-Stakes Conference Coverage (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, etc.): Provide pre-conference/ post-conference impact assessment analysis of competitor data readouts on Roche’s portfolio

• Strategic Advisory: Transform market insights from public & proprietary data sources (e.g. CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) into "Executive Stories" that provide clear "So What?" and "Now What?" recommendations to partners & senior leadership

• Predictive Intelligence: Flag "Trigger Events" (e.g., Breakthrough Designations, FDA/ regulatory signals, M&A activity) and perform Scenario Planning to assess potential implications for Roche brands

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor's degree in B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm and 5 to 8 years of experience in Strategic Business Research/ Market Research/ CI within Pharma/Life Sciences. Preferably, you have a Master's degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology

• Methodology : Expert-level proficiency in applying Business Research Frameworks (SWOT, PESTLE) to the pharmaceutical lifecycle—from Phase I to Loss of Exclusivity (LoE).

• Tech-Savviness: Proven experience or a strong vision for using GenAI tools to automate data extraction and enhance strategic consulting.

• Commercial Acumen : Deep understanding of the Drug Development Process, including clinical trial endpoints, regulatory pathways (FDA/EMA), and commercial launch excellence.

• Communication: Ability to influence global stakeholders through structured communication and data visualization.

• Self-Driven Ownership: A proactive "self-starter" who manages compl

Come Lead/ Senior Analyst, agirai come una PMI dedicata ai partner commerciali globali di Roche. Trascenderai la raccolta di dati tradizionale integrando l'Intelligenza Competitiva Clinica e Commerciale (CI), l'Intelligenza di mercato con l'analisi avanzata basata su GenAI. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di fornire una previsione strategica di alto livello utilizzando i framework aziendali consolidati per influenzare le strategie di lancio globali di Roche e di lancio commerciale. La tua opportunità
• Strategic Competitive/ Market Intelligence integrata: condurre il monitoraggio end-to-end del paesaggio competitivo, biforcando intuizioni in Clinical CI (R&D pipeline, turni di progettazione di prova, scoperte di MoA) e Commercial CI (pricing, accesso di mercato, turni di forza di campo e traiettorie di lancio)
• Applicazione Quadro Strategico: sincronizzare i segnali di mercato complessi in strategie attuabili utilizzando framework strutturati come SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, e la Mapping del Viaggio Paziente per identificare le esigenze inutilizzate e le opportunità di spazio bianco
• GenAI & Innovation: Architetto e implementa i flussi di lavoro alimentati da GenAI (ad esempio, LLM per la sintesi rapida della ricerca secondaria, l'analisi automatizzata del sentimento dei guadagni, o la sintesi clinica basata su GPT) per aumentare la velocità e la profondità delle raccomandazioni strategiche
• Copertura delle conferenze ad alto livello (ASCO, ESMO, AACR, JP Morgan, Jefferies, ecc.): Fornire analisi di valutazione dell’impatto pre-conferenza/ post-conferenza delle letture dei dati concorrenti sul portafoglio di Roche
• Consulenza strategica: Trasforma le intuizioni di mercato da fonti di dati pubbliche e proprietarie (ad esempio CT.gov, Clarivate, AlphaSense, EvaluatePharma) in "Storie Esecutive" che forniscono chiare "So Che cosa?" e "Now Che?" raccomandazioni ai partner & senior leadership
• Intelligenza predittiva: Bandiera "Trigger Events" (ad es., Designazioni Breakthrough, segnali normativi FDA/M&A) e eseguire Scenario Planning per valutare le potenziali implicazioni per i marchi Roche Chi sei
• Ha una laurea in B. Tech/B.E./B. Pharm e da 5 a 8 anni di esperienza in Ricerca Strategica di Business / Ricerca di mercato / CI all'interno di Pharma / Scienze della vita. Preferibilmente, hai una laurea magistrale in Scienze della Vita / Biotecnologie
• Metodologia: competenza a livello di esperti nell'applicazione dei Quadri di Ricerca per le Imprese (SWOT, PESTLE) al ciclo di vita farmaceutico — dalla Fase I alla Perdita di Esclusività (LoE).
• Tech-Savviness: esperienza comprovata o una visione forte per l'utilizzo di strumenti GenAI per automatizzare l'estrazione dei dati e migliorare la consulenza strategica.
• Acume commerciale: profonda comprensione del processo di sviluppo della droga, compresi gli endpoint di sperimentazione clinica, i percorsi normativi (FDA/EMA), e l'eccellenza di lancio commerciale.
• Comunicazione: Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder globali attraverso la comunicazione strutturata e la visualizzazione dei dati.
• Proprietà autonoma: un proattivo "self-starter" che gestisce

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Please note: This is a 30 hours / week part-time position.

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

The Opportunity:

As Credit & Collection Analyst for Central Europe you are an important link between the business and the customers across Roche Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics division. You implement credit management strategies to minimize Roche's risk of doubtful accounts, propose improvements to enhance the efficiency of credit management processes, while continuously improving the performance of the RSS.

• Conducting an effective credit management strategy to reduce Company (Roche) exposure risk to doubtful accounts

• Evaluating Customer Credit based on financial strength and ability to pay on time, classify risk categories

• Determining and managing Customer Credit Profile Data including worthiness’ score/risk class / group, etc.; instruct Master Data team to update profile

• Managing blocked Sales Orders as defined by the Local Credit Management Policy

• Preparing and analyzing Customer Ageing/Open item Report (as defined in the Local Credit Management Policy and in alignment with FGAR)

• Collaborating with other teams/ team members, stakeholder, daily based conversation with the supported Affiliate

Who you are:

• 1-3 years of related experience in Credit Management is desirable and experience in Shared Service Center environment is preferred

• University or College Education, concentration on Finance or Accounting is a plus

• SAP knowledge, Intermediate Excel skills and understanding of the Order to Cash process & analytical skills is an advantage

• Self-driven, Team-player attitude with independent decision making skills is required

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

• SAP knowledge, Intermediate Excel skills and understanding of the Order to Cash process & analytical skills is an advantage
• Self-driven, Team-player attitude with independent decision making skills is required
• Proficiency in English In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Automation Engineer bist du im Bereich „Business Solutions“ und dort im Circle „Pharma Engineering Solutions“ des Standortes Basel / Kaiseraugst tätig. Der Bereich „Business Solutions“ der Roche Pharma ist am Standort Basel/ Kaiseraugst verantwortlich für innovatives, kostengünstiges und GMP-gerechtes Planen und Umsetzen von Investitionsprojekten. Darüber hinaus realisiert der Bereich das Gebäude- und Betriebsingenieurwesen, das technische Qualitätsmanagement und ist verantwortlich für eine zuverlässige Störungsbehebung und Instandhaltung, inklusive dem Betreiben der erforderlichen Infrastruktur. Wir unterstützen unser Management und unsere Kunden bei biotechnologischen, chemischen und galenischen Produktions-/ Verpackungsanlagen, Laborbauten und Administrationsbauten.

Die Möglichkeit
Als Automation Engineer betreust du bestehende und neue Automationssysteme, welche in die Roche Infrastruktur integriert sind/werden. Die zu betreuenden Prozessanlagen verfügen über einen sehr hohen Automatisierungsgrad und sind stark untereinander bzw. mit übergeordneten IT Systemen vernetzt.

Ihr Hauptaufgabengebiet umfasst:

• Leitung und Abwicklung von Automationsprojekten in allen Projektphasen wie Initiierung, Design und Realisierung (selbständig und mit Unterstützung von internen und externenSpezialisten)

• Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen bei Projekten und Change

• Implementierung von Automationssystemen in die Roche Infrastruktur

• Anbindungen der Automationssysteme an den Data Historian

• Strategie und Aufrechterhaltung des Lifecycles von PC basierten Automationssystemen

• Unterstützung unserer internen Kunden bei technischen Fragen sowie bei Behördeninspektionen Betriebsengineering mit dem Ziel, die Aufrechterhaltung der Produktion jederzeit zu gewährleisten

• kontinuierliche Optimierung der Prozessanlagen und Evaluieren, Prüfen und Empfehlen neuer Technologien

• proaktives Unterstützen der Kunden bei der Definition und Initiierung von Investitionsvorhaben

Wer du bist
Du besitzt eine fundierte Grundausbildung mit abgeschlossenem Studium (FH/TU) in Automation oder Informatik oder die entsprechenden Kenntnisse sowie mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automation oder Informatik.
Du bist vertraut mit der Abwicklung von Investitionsprojekten, insbesondere mit der Beschaffung von Package Units.

• Du hast die technische Expertise von Netzwerktechnik und Automationssoftware: Siemens PCS7, S7, TIA, WinCC ( *)

• Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Projektleiter mit

• Fundierte Erfahrung im GMP- und GAMP- Umfeld

• Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeiten innerhalb der Organisation sowie ein angemessener Umgang mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen

• Bereitschaft im agilen, selbstorganisierten Arbeitsumfeld zu arbeiten

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Setze dein Know-how ein und gestalte den Bereich 'Pharma Engineering Solutions' am Standort Basel / Kaiseraugst mit. Bewirb dich jetzt !

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come ingegnere di automazione, lavori nell'area di "Business Solutions" e lì nel cerchio "Pharma Engineering Solutions" della sede di Basilea / Kaiseraugst. La divisione Business Solutions di Roche Pharma è responsabile della pianificazione e dell’implementazione di progetti di investimento innovativi, economici e conformi a GMP nel sito di Basilea/Kaiseraugst. Inoltre, il dipartimento implementa l'ingegneria dell'edificio e delle operazioni, la gestione della qualità tecnica ed è responsabile per la risoluzione e la manutenzione affidabili, compreso il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura necessaria. Sosteniamo la nostra gestione e i nostri clienti in impianti di produzione/imballaggio biotecnologici, chimici e galenici, edifici di laboratorio e edifici amministrativi. La possibilità In qualità di ingegnere di automazione, gestirai sistemi di automazione esistenti e nuovi che saranno integrati nell'infrastruttura Roche. Gli impianti di processo da servire hanno un elevato grado di automazione e sono fortemente collegati tra loro o con sistemi IT di livello superiore. Le sue principali aree di responsabilità includono:
• Gestione e gestione di progetti di automazione in tutte le fasi del progetto, quali l'avvio, la progettazione e l'implementazione (indipendente e con il supporto di specialisti interni ed esterni)
• Collaborazione con interfacce in progetti e cambiamenti
• Attuazione dei sistemi di automazione nell'infrastruttura Roche
• Connessioni di sistemi di automazione allo storico dei dati
• Strategia e manutenzione del ciclo di vita dei sistemi di automazione basati su PC
• Assistere i nostri clienti interni con problemi tecnici e con ispezioni da parte delle autorità di ingegneria operativa al fine di garantire il mantenimento della produzione in ogni momento
• Ottimizzazione continua degli impianti di processo e valutazione, sperimentazione e consulenza di nuove tecnologie
• Sostenere attivamente i clienti nella definizione e nell'avvio di progetti di investimento Chi sei Hai una formazione di base ben fondata con studi completati (FH/TU) in automazione o informatica o le conoscenze corrispondenti e min. 5 anni di esperienza professionale nell'automazione o nell'informatica. Conoscete la gestione di progetti di investimento, in particolare l'approvvigionamento di unità di pacchetto.
• Hai la competenza tecnica del software di tecnologia e automazione di rete: Siemens PCS7, S7, TIA, WinCC (*)
• Porti diversi anni di esperienza come project manager
• Esperienza sonora nell'ambiente GMP e GAMP
• Lavoro di squadra e ottime capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento all'interno dell'organizzazione, nonché un'adeguata interazione con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli
• Volontà di lavorare in un ambiente di lavoro agile e autonomo
• Hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura Usa il tuo know-how e aiuta a plasmare l'area 'Pharma Engineering Solutions' presso la sede di Basilea / Kaiseraugst. Applicate subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire la salute che cambia la vita

jobs.title: Senior Quality Lead
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), we strive for confidence in the integrity of our data and processes, agility, and unrivalled transparency with health authorities, patients, and society. As a Senior Quality Lead within our Quality Assurance Process and Affiliate team, you will bring diverse thinking and technical expertise across various quality disciplines to support the Roche/Genentech organisation.

In this pivotal role, you will design and deliver risk-based Quality Assurance strategies, audits, and conclusions for post-approval products, affiliates, and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders, guiding cross-functional collaboration to ensure global quality standards are met while navigating complex regulatory landscapes.

• Design and Implement QA Strategies: Partner with business stakeholders to independently define the QA approach, assessing risks and adapting strategies using the Critical to Quality (CtQ) framework across GCP, GVP, and Medical Device areas.

• Define and Lead Audits: Determine required audits, leverage data analytics to develop methodologies, and independently manage the end-to-end audit process from preparation to reporting.

• Manage Quality Issues: Independently manage quality issues, tracking systematic findings for process improvement and escalating significant risks to PDQ management.

• Quality Conclusion and Stakeholder Communication: Independently evaluate quality positions to drive compliance action plans. Lead high-level risk presentations and strategic discussions with business stakeholders, Pharma representatives, Legal, and Regulatory Affairs.

• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: Lead preparation, staff training, and the management of major regulatory inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA), confidently presenting quality strategies and conclusions.

• Drive PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribute to the long-term strategic direction of PDQ, lead compliance projects, and act as a dedicated mentor to develop Quality Leads within the team.

Who You Are

You are a proactive, strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, matrixed environment and is passionate about driving Quality outcomes. You possess strong digital and data literacy, allowing you to turn data into insights, and you are comfortable asking challenging questions to support PDQ outcomes.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Extensive Quality Expertise: A strong background in the drug development process and clinical trials, with robust cross-functional experience in GCP, GVP/PV, or Medical Devices/SaMD.

• Inspection Leadership: A proven track record of leading major Health Authority inspections (such as FDA or EMA), including inspection readiness and post-inspection management.

• Analytical & Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving skills with a proactive, risk-based mindset and the ability to utilise data and data visualisation tools to drive decisions.

• Influencing & Communication Skills: Exceptional relationship management skills with a proven ability to negotiate effective solutions and influence senior stakeholders.

• Inclusive Leadership: Experience managing projects in global, multicultural teams, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others.

• Academic Qualifications: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a scientific or quality-related field (an advanced degree is preferred).

Location

In Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), ci sforziamo di fiducia nell'integrità dei nostri dati e processi, agilità e trasparenza senza rivali con autorità sanitarie, pazienti e società. In qualità di Senior Quality Lead all'interno del nostro team di Quality Assurance e Affiliazione, avrai diverse competenze tecniche e di pensiero in diverse discipline di qualità per supportare l'organizzazione Roche/Genentech. In questo ruolo fondamentale, progettare e fornire strategie di assicurazione della qualità basate sul rischio, audit e conclusioni per i prodotti post-approvazione, affiliati e processi. Potrai agire come partner affidabile per gli stakeholder aziendali senior, guidando la collaborazione interfunzionale per garantire standard di qualità globali sono soddisfatti durante la navigazione di paesaggi normativi complessi.
• Design e Implement QA Strategie: Partner con gli stakeholder aziendali per definire in modo indipendente l'approccio QA, valutare i rischi e adattare le strategie utilizzando il framework Critical to Quality (CtQ) in aree GCP, GVP e Medical Device.
• Definire e Lead Audits: Determinare gli audit necessari, sfruttare l'analisi dei dati per sviluppare metodologie e gestire in modo indipendente il processo di audit end-to-end dalla preparazione alla reportistica.
• Gestione dei problemi di qualità: gestire in modo indipendente i problemi di qualità, tracciare i risultati sistematici per il miglioramento del processo e aumentare i rischi significativi per la gestione del PDQ.
• Conclusione di qualità e Stakeholder Comunicazione: Valutare in modo indipendente le posizioni di qualità per guidare i piani di azione di conformità. Condurre presentazioni di rischio di alto livello e discussioni strategiche con gli stakeholder aziendali, i rappresentanti di farmaci, gli affari legali e regolamentari.
• Lead and support Health Authority Inspections: preparazione del piombo, formazione del personale, e la gestione di importanti ispezioni normative (ad esempio, FDA, EMA), presentando con fiducia strategie e conclusioni di qualità.
• Guida PDQ Leadership & Mentorship: Contribuisci alla direzione strategica a lungo termine del PDQ, ai progetti di conformità dei lead e funge da mentore dedicato per sviluppare i lead di qualità all'interno del team. Chi sei Sei un proattivo, pensatore strategico che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo, matrice ed è appassionato di guidare i risultati di qualità. Possiedi una forte alfabetizzazione digitale e dei dati, permettendoti di trasformare i dati in insight, e sei a tuo agio a porre domande impegnative per supportare i risultati PDQ. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Esperienza di qualità estesa: uno sfondo forte nel processo di sviluppo del farmaco e studi clinici, con una solida esperienza interfunzionale in GCP, GVP/PV, o dispositivi medici/SaMD.
• Leadership di ispezione: una comprovata traccia di importanti ispezioni dell'Autorità sanitaria (come FDA o EMA), compresa la disponibilità di ispezione e la gestione post-ispezione.
• pensiero analitico e critico: competenze avanzate di problem solving con una mentalità proattiva e basata sul rischio e la capacità di utilizzare strumenti di visualizzazione dati e dati per guidare le decisioni.
• Influencing & Communication Skills: competenze di gestione delle relazioni eccezionali con una comprovata capacità di negoziare soluzioni efficaci e influenzare gli stakeholder senior.
• Leadership Inclusive: esperienza nella gestione di progetti in team globali e multiculturali, con la passione per allenare e sostenere gli altri.
• Qualifiche accademiche: diploma di laurea o equivalente in un campo scientifico o di qualità (è preferito un grado avanzato). Location

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Bei Roche bringen wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Bei Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) streben wir nach Vertrauen in die Integrität unserer Daten und Prozesse, Agilität und konkurrenzlose Transparenz gegenüber Gesundheitsbehörden, Patienten und der Gesellschaft. Als Senior Quality Lead in unserem Qualitätssicherungsprozess und Affiliate-Team bringen Sie vielfältiges Denken und technisches Know-how in verschiedenen Qualitätsdisziplinen mit, um die Roche / Genentech-Organisation zu unterstützen. In dieser zentralen Rolle entwerfen und liefern Sie risikobasierte Qualitätssicherungsstrategien, Audits und Schlussfolgerungen für Produkte, verbundene Unternehmen und Prozesse nach der Zulassung. Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Senior Business Stakeholder fungieren und die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass globale Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden, während Sie durch komplexe Regulierungslandschaften navigieren.
• Gestaltung und Umsetzung von QA-Strategien: Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsbeteiligten, um den QA-Ansatz unabhängig zu definieren, Risiken zu bewerten und Strategien unter Verwendung des CtQ-Rahmens (Critical to Quality) in den Bereichen GCP, GVP und Medical Device anzupassen.
• Definieren und Leiten von Audits: Bestimmen Sie erforderliche Audits, nutzen Sie Datenanalysen zur Entwicklung von Methoden und verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Auditprozess von der Vorbereitung bis zum Reporting unabhängig.
• Qualitätsprobleme verwalten: Verwalten Sie Qualitätsprobleme unabhängig, verfolgen Sie systematische Ergebnisse zur Prozessverbesserung und eskalieren Sie erhebliche Risiken für das PDQ-Management.
• Qualitätsschlussfolgerung und Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Unabhängige Bewertung von Qualitätspositionen, um Compliance-Aktionspläne voranzutreiben. Führen Sie hochkarätige Risikopräsentationen und strategische Gespräche mit Geschäftsinteressenten, Pharmavertretern, Rechts- und Regulierungsangelegenheiten.
• Führen und Unterstützen von Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörden: Lead-Vorbereitung, Schulung des Personals und Management von wichtigen behördlichen Inspektionen (z. B. FDA, EMA), wobei Qualitätsstrategien und Schlussfolgerungen selbstbewusst präsentiert werden.
• PDQ Leadership & Mentorship fördern: Tragen Sie zur langfristigen strategischen Ausrichtung von PDQ bei, leiten Sie Compliance-Projekte und agieren Sie als engagierter Mentor, um Qualitätsleiter im Team zu entwickeln. Wer du bist Sie sind ein proaktiver, strategischer Denker, der in einer kollaborativen, matrixförmigen Umgebung lebt und sich leidenschaftlich für Qualitätsergebnisse einsetzt. Sie verfügen über eine starke Digital- und Datenkompetenz, mit der Sie Daten in Erkenntnisse umwandeln können, und Sie stellen gerne herausfordernde Fragen, um die PDQ-Ergebnisse zu unterstützen. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie: Umfangreiche Qualitätsexpertise: Ein starker Hintergrund im Arzneimittelentwicklungsprozess und in klinischen Studien mit robuster funktionsübergreifender Erfahrung in GCP, GVP/PV oder Medical Devices/SaMD.
• Inspektionsleitung: Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz führender großer Inspektionen der Gesundheitsbehörde (wie FDA oder EMA), einschließlich Inspektionsbereitschaft und Post-Inspektionsmanagement. Analytisches und kritisches Denken: Fortgeschrittene Problemlösungskompetenzen mit einer proaktiven, risikobasierten Denkweise und der Fähigkeit, Daten und Datenvisualisierungswerkzeuge zu nutzen, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
• Einflussnahme und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten: Außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsmanagement mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, effektive Lösungen auszuhandeln und leitende Stakeholder zu beeinflussen.
• Inklusive Führung: Erfahrung im Management von Projekten in globalen, multikulturellen Teams mit einer Leidenschaft für das Coaching und Mentoring anderer.
• Akademische Qualifikationen: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertig in einem wissenschaftlichen oder qualitätsbezogenen Bereich (ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss wird bevorzugt). Standort
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Dans Pharma Development Quality (PDQ), nous nous efforçons de faire confiance à l'intégrité de nos données et de nos processus, à l'agilité et à une transparence inégalée avec les autorités sanitaires, les patients et la société. En tant que responsable principal de la qualité au sein de notre équipe de processus d'assurance de la qualité et d'affiliation, vous apporterez une diversité de réflexion et d'expertise technique dans différentes disciplines de qualité pour soutenir l'organisation Roche/Genentech. Dans ce rôle pivot, vous concevrez et fournirez des stratégies, des vérifications et des conclusions d'assurance de la qualité fondées sur les risques pour les produits, les filiales et les processus post-approbation. Vous agirez en tant que partenaire de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants commerciaux, en guidant la collaboration interfonctionnelle pour assurer le respect des normes de qualité mondiales tout en naviguant dans des paysages réglementaires complexes.
• Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'AQ : établir des partenariats avec les intervenants commerciaux pour définir de façon indépendante l'AQ, évaluer les risques et adapter les stratégies à l'aide du cadre essentiel à la qualité (CtQ) dans l'ensemble des secteurs du GCP, du GVP et des instruments médicaux.
• Définir et diriger les audits : Déterminer les audits requis, tirer parti de l'analyse des données pour élaborer des méthodologies et gérer de manière indépendante le processus d'audit de bout en bout, de la préparation à l'établissement de rapports.
• Gérer les problèmes de qualité : gérer les problèmes de qualité de façon indépendante, suivre les constatations systématiques pour améliorer les processus et augmenter les risques importants pour la gestion des PDQ.
• Conclusion sur la qualité et communication avec les parties prenantes: évaluer de manière indépendante les positions de qualité afin d'orienter les plans d'action en matière de conformité. Diriger des présentations de risques de haut niveau et des discussions stratégiques avec les intervenants commerciaux, les représentants des pharmaciens, les Affaires juridiques et réglementaires.
• Diriger et appuyer les inspections des autorités sanitaires : préparation des responsables, formation du personnel et gestion des principales inspections réglementaires (par exemple, FDA, EMA), présentation confiante de stratégies et de conclusions de qualité.
• Diriger le leadership et le mentorat du PDQ : contribuer à l'orientation stratégique à long terme du PDQ, diriger des projets de conformité et agir comme un mentor dévoué pour développer des responsables de qualité au sein de l'équipe. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur proactif et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement collaboratif et matriciel et qui est passionné par les résultats de qualité. Vous possédez une solide connaissance du numérique et des données, vous permettant de transformer les données en idées, et vous êtes à l'aise de poser des questions difficiles pour soutenir les résultats de la PDQ. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Expertise en qualité étendue : une solide expérience dans le processus de développement des médicaments et les essais cliniques, avec une solide expérience interfonctionnelle en GCP, GVP/PV ou dispositifs médicaux/saMD.
• Leadership en matière d'inspection : une expérience éprouvée des principales inspections des autorités sanitaires (comme la FDA ou l'EMA), y compris la préparation aux inspections et la gestion après inspection.
• Analyse et réflexion critique: compétences avancées en résolution de problèmes avec un état d'esprit proactif et basé sur le risque et la capacité d'utiliser des outils de visualisation de données et de données pour conduire les décisions.
• Influencer et communiquer : compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des relations avec une capacité éprouvée de négocier des solutions efficaces et d'influencer les acteurs seniors.
• Leadership inclusif: Expérience de la gestion de projets dans des équipes mondiales et multiculturelles, avec une passion pour le coaching et le mentorat.
• Qualifications académiques: un baccalauréat ou l'équivalent dans un domaine scientifique ou lié à la qualité (un diplôme avancé est préféré). Lieu

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

This role involves writing clean, testa

Chi siamo: Un domani migliore inizia oggi A Roche, tutto quello che facciamo è alimentato dalla nostra passione per trasformare la vita dei pazienti. Abbracciamo scienza, etica e innovazione. Siamo coraggiosi nelle nostre decisioni e azioni perché sappiamo che un futuro più luminoso dipende da esso. Ogni giorno, ci presentiamo per costruire quel futuro — per un mondo migliore, per l'umanità. La diversità e l’inclusione non sono solo parole d’ordine, ma sono essenziali per chi siamo. Crediamo che le prospettive uniche generino innovazione e creatività, per questo ci impegniamo a costruire team che riflettano la straordinaria gamma di potenzialità umane. Il tuo ruolo: Ridefinisci l'eccellenza nell'ingegneria di software sicura Come Ingegnere di software all'interno del team di Roche Certman PKI, diventerai una forza trainante dietro la progettazione, lo sviluppo e l'evoluzione del nostro software di fiducia e identità aziendale mission-critical. Lavorando a stretto contatto con le ultime tendenze tecnologiche, si costruirà lo strato software che gestisce cicli di vita certificati digitali, chiavi crittografiche e autenticazione sicura. Ogni funzione che si codifica, ogni sistema che si architetto, e ogni applicazione ottimizzata contribuirà direttamente a salvaguardare la tecnologia che migliora la vita delle persone in tutto il mondo. Un elemento chiave del tuo contributo: In qualità di ingegnere C# esperienza, progetta e fornisce servizi software ad alte prestazioni e resilienti che alimentano le operazioni globali di Roche. Questo ruolo richiede competenze profonde in tutto lo stack .NET completo — dalla gestione avanzata della memoria e modelli di programmazione asincrono per la progettazione di sistemi backend sicuri e scalabili e l'orchestrazione di microservizi containerizzati in AWS e Kubernetes a scala aziendale. Si applicano pratiche di programmazione asincrono e l'eccellenza del design per la costruzione di API ad alta produttività, a bassa latenza che soddisfano i requisiti di affidabilità e conformità dei dispositivi medici che servono pazienti in tutto il mondo. Il vostro impegno per l'eccellenza dell'ingegneria software, i principi del codice pulito e i modelli di design robusti saranno fondamentali per offrire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità e sicure che sostengono gli standard di qualità e fiducia di Roche. Cosa farai: Come Ingegnere di software nel team di Certman PKI, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella progettazione, costruzione e evoluzione della nostra API di emissione di certificati utilizzando ASP.NET Core (C#). Avrete la qualità end-to-end del servizio. Potrai progettare e implementare le API REST ben convertite, automatizzare i flussi di lavoro crittografico e certificato del ciclo di vita, e diagnosticare e risolvere le prestazioni complesse, la convalutazione, o strozzature architettoniche utilizzando la profilazione e l'osservabilità tooling. Potrai implementare e gestire i nostri servizi in modo nativo su AWS e AliCloud, lavorando hands-on con EKS/Kubernetes, KMS per le operazioni chiave, EC2, IAM e altri blocchi di costruzione AWS core. Azioni GitLab e GitHub - costruzione riproducibile, sicura e completamente automatizzata costruire, testare, eseguire la scansione e distribuire flussi di lavoro per i servizi containerizzati .NET. Questo ruolo coinvolge la scrittura pulita, testa

We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

Lo facciamo oggi per costruire un domani migliore. Roche è fortemente impegnata in un luogo di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo. Ci sforziamo di costruire squadre che rappresentano una gamma di sfondi, prospettive e competenze. Abbracciare la diversità ci permette di creare un ottimo posto di lavoro e di innovare per i pazienti. Entra nel futuro dell'IT con Roche! In qualità di esperto Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) a Roche, potrai sfruttare la tua profonda esperienza di ingegneria software per spingere i nostri prodotti a nuove altezze di robustezza, scalabilità e affidabilità. Questo non è solo un ruolo: è un invito a modellare la spina dorsale delle innovazioni tecnologiche in avanti. La tua missione Progettare e mantenere strumenti all'avanguardia, script e framework che automatizzano le attività ripetitive, semplificano l'implementazione del software e gestiscono sistemi espansivi con efficienza senza pari. Affidatevi a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo avanzati per l'architettura e l'implementazione di soluzioni ad alte prestazioni che elevano l'efficienza del sistema, ottimizzano l'utilizzo delle risorse e migliorano i processi di implementazione per una migliore soddisfazione degli utenti. Il tuo impatto Guidare l'accusa nella gestione e risposta degli incidenti. Rileva le anomalie del sistema, risolvere rapidamente i problemi e condurre analisi approfondite causa radice per evitare problemi ricorrenti. Campione continuo miglioramento raffinando i meccanismi di monitoraggio e di avviso, conducendo approfondite recensioni post-incidenti e incorporando le migliori pratiche nella gestione del ciclo di vita del software. La vostra visione strategica e la pianificazione meticolosa garantiranno che i nostri sistemi non siano solo affidabili ma anche superlativamente performanti. Unendo il nostro team di élite, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel fornire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità ai nostri utenti finali, superando le richieste di business e clienti, e consolidando la reputazione di Roche come leader nell'innovazione IT. • Definire e implementare SLIs, SLOs e budget di errore con team di prodotto e ingegneria
• Condurre recensioni di affidabilità per i servizi nuovi e esistenti
• Design architetture scalabili e tolleranti ai guasti in ambienti AWS e Azure
• Iniziative di pianificazione, performance e ottimizzazione dei costi
• Migliorare la resilienza del sistema attraverso l'automazione e i modelli di autoguarigione
• Maturazione dell'osservanza organizzativa dell'azionamento (metri, registri, tracce, qualità dell'avviso) Gestione degli incidenti e miglioramento continuo
• Eseguire analisi complesse cause radice e guidare la mitigazione rapida
• Partecipare a postmortems e follow-through senza colpa
• Migliorare il MTTR, ridurre la frequenza degli incidenti e elevati standard di produzione
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con i team di ingegneria per consentire tempestive ed efficaci

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Position Wir bauen ein globales Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)-Team auf, um wichtige kommerzielle und interne Plattformen und Anwendungen zu unterstützen. Als SRE unterstützen Sie das Design, den Aufbau und die Skalierung zuverlässiger verteilter Systeme, die Innovationen im Gesundheitswesen weltweit vorantreiben. Diese Rolle konzentriert sich auf Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Automatisierung und operative Exzellenz. Sie beeinflussen das Systemdesign, definieren Zuverlässigkeitsstandards und reduzieren den betrieblichen Aufwand durch technische Lösungen. Diese Rolle umfasst die Teilnahme an einer strukturierten On-Call-Rotation. Wer wir sind Bei Roche sind wir leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern, und wir sind mutig in Entscheidung und Handeln - wir glauben, dass gutes Geschäft eine bessere Welt bedeutet. Deshalb kommen wir jeden Tag zur Arbeit. Wir verpflichten uns zu wissenschaftlicher Strenge, unangreifbarer Ethik und Zugang zu medizinischen Innovationen für alle. Wir tun dies heute, um ein besseres Morgen zu schaffen. Roche setzt sich stark für einen vielfältigen und integrativen Arbeitsplatz ein. Wir bemühen uns, Teams aufzubauen, die eine Reihe von Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten repräsentieren. Die Vielfalt ermöglicht es uns, einen großartigen Ort für die Arbeit und Innovation für Patienten zu schaffen. Schritt in die Zukunft der IT mit Roche! Als erfahrener Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) bei Roche nutzen Sie Ihre umfassende Software-Engineering-Expertise, um unsere Produkte auf neue Höhen der Robustheit, Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit zu bringen. Dies ist nicht nur eine Rolle - es ist eine Einladung, das Rückgrat technologischer Innovationen voranzutreiben. Deine Mission Entwerfen und pflegen Sie modernste Tools, Skripte und Frameworks, die sich wiederholende Aufgaben automatisieren, die Softwarebereitstellung optimieren und expansive Systeme mit beispielloser Effizienz verwalten. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit zukunftsorientierten Entwicklungsteams, um leistungsstarke Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die die Systemeffizienz erhöhen, die Ressourcenauslastung optimieren und die Bereitstellungsprozesse für überlegene Betriebszeit und Benutzerzufriedenheit verbessern. Ihre Wirkung Führen Sie die Ladung im Incident Management und Response. Systemanomalien erkennen, schnell Fehler beheben und gründliche Ursachenanalysen durchführen, um wiederkehrende Probleme zu vermeiden. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position La position Nous construisons une équipe mondiale d'ingénierie de fiabilité du site (SRE) pour soutenir les plateformes et applications commerciales et internes critiques. En tant que SRE, vous aiderez à concevoir, construire et mettre à l'échelle des systèmes distribués fiables qui alimentent l'innovation en soins de santé dans le monde entier. Ce rôle est axé sur la fiabilité, l'évolutivité, l'automatisation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Vous influerez sur la conception du système, définirez des normes de fiabilité et réduirez le travail opérationnel grâce à des solutions d'ingénierie. Ce rôle comprend la participation à une rotation structurée sur appel. Qui nous sommes Chez Roche, nous sommes passionnés par la transformation des vies des patients, et nous sommes audacieux tant dans la décision que dans l'action - nous croyons que la bonne entreprise signifie un monde meilleur. C'est pourquoi nous venons travailler tous les jours. Nous nous engageons à la rigueur scientifique, à l'éthique inlassable et à l'accès aux innovations médicales pour tous. Nous le faisons aujourd'hui pour bâtir un avenir meilleur. Roche est fermement attachée à un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif. Nous nous efforçons de créer des équipes qui représentent un éventail de milieux, de perspectives et de compétences. Faire place à la diversité nous permet de créer un endroit idéal pour travailler et innover pour les patients. Entrez dans l'avenir de l'informatique avec Roche! En tant qu'ingénieur chevronné de fiabilité du site (SRE) chez Roche, vous tirerez parti de votre expertise en ingénierie logicielle profonde pour propulser nos produits vers de nouvelles hauteurs de robustesse, d'évolutivité et de fiabilité. Ce n'est pas seulement un rôle, c'est une invitation à façonner l'épine dorsale des innovations technologiques. Votre mission Concevoir et entretenir des outils, des scripts et des cadres de pointe qui automatisent les tâches répétitives, rationalisent le déploiement des logiciels et gèrent des systèmes étendus avec une efficacité inégalée. Collaborez étroitement avec des équipes de développement avant-gardistes pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de haute performance qui améliorent l'efficacité du système, optimisent l'utilisation des ressources et améliorent les processus de déploiement pour un temps de pointe supérieur et la satisfaction des utilisateurs. Votre impact Diriger l'accusation dans la gestion des incidents et l'intervention. Détecter les anomalies du système, dépanner rapidement et effectuer des analyses profondes des causes profondes afin de prévenir les problèmes récurrents. Promouvoir l'amélioration continue en perfectionnant les mécanismes de surveillance et d'alerte, en effectuant des examens approfondis après les incidents et en intégrant les meilleures pratiques dans la gestion du cycle de vie des logiciels. Votre prospective stratégique et votre planification méticuleuse garantiront que nos systèmes sont non seulement fiables, mais également superlativement performants. En vous joignant à notre équipe d'élite, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prestation d'expériences sans faille à nos utilisateurs finaux, en dépassant les exigences des entreprises et des clients, et en solidifiant la réputation de Roche en tant que leader de l'innovation informatique. • Effectuer des examens de fiabilité pour les services nouveaux et existants
• Concevoir des architectures évolutives et tolérantes aux défauts dans les environnements AWS et Azure
• Initiatives de planification des capacités, de performance et d'optimisation des coûts

• Collaborer en toute transparence avec les équipes d'ingénieurs pour permettre une utilisation rapide et efficace

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Expert Safety Assessments (m/w/d) Explosion Protection | Experte Sicherheitsbetrachtungen (m/w/d) Explosionsschutz / Ex-Schutz

Dein neues Team
Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg.

In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH "Risk Management & SHE Compliance", explizit des Teams "Implementation Management". In unserem Team übernehmen wir die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Überführung von rechtlichen Anforderungen, globalen SHE-Standards sowie Prozessen und Systemen in praktische und wirtschaftliche Lösungen an unseren Standorten. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und stellen sicher, dass Rahmenbedingungen nachhaltig implementiert und gelebt werden. Wir sind verantwortlich für zwei Standorte, aber dennoch ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
n der Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die technische Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit sowie die Arbeitssicherheit bei Roche Diagnostics durch die Abstimmung und Implementierung von Vorgaben mit dem Schwerpunkt systematische Sicherheitsbetrachtungen und Explosionsschutz. Dazu übernimmst du folgende spannende Aufgaben:

• Sicherheitsbetrachtungen: Du koordinierst und implementierst technische Sicherheitsanforderungen und führst systematische Sicherheitsbetrachtungen (z. B. PAAG/HAZOP) sowie Bewertungen im Rahmen des Explosionsschutzes durch.

• Beratung & Netzwerken: Du berätst die Business Units proaktiv bei komplexen sicherheitstechnischen Fragestellungen und arbeitest eng mit Global SHE sowie den lokalen Engineering- und Produktionsteams zusammen.

• Konzepterstellung: Du erstellst und überprüfst Sicherheits- sowie Explosionsschutzkonzepte und stellst deren Konformität zu internationalen Standards und internen Richtlinien sicher.

• Wirtschaftlichkeit: Du achtest bei der Umsetzung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen auf globale Abstimmung und hohe Wirtschaftlichkeit, ohne Kompromisse bei der Compliance einzugehen.

• Bestellte Funktion : Du nimmst fachspezifische Aufgaben als zur Prüfung befähigte Person im Explosionsschutz wahr und trägst so zur Rechtssicherheit der Verantwortlichen bei.

• Prozessbegleitung: Du begleitest technische Lösungen aktiv von der Planungsphase bis zur Übergabe in die Operative und stellst eine nahtlose Integration in den Betrieb sicher.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Sicherheitstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Gesundheitsmanagement oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du verfügst über mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung (je nach Abschluss ca. 5-8 Jahre), idealerweise innerhalb der chemischen Industrie oder einem vergleichbar regulierten Umfeld.

• Du bringst tiefgreifende Kenntnisse der relevanten Vorschriften (z.B. ATEX, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, ProdSV) sowie der zugehörigen technischen Regelwerke mit.

The Position
Analytics & Intelligence - Lead Analyst
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Chennai or Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche has established Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) to drive analytics & technology driven solutions by partnering with Roche affiliates across the globe.

As a Lead Analyst , you will collaborate closely with the Strategic Analytics & Insights team based in the US, Therapy Areas Insights Directors, Ecosystem Insights Leads, and the broader GATE team. Your primary responsibility will be to deliver advanced analytics and actionable insights that support strategic priorities, ultimately aiming for the greatest impact with customers and patients.

Your Opportunity

• Lead complex projects and initiatives in pharma commercial operations, focusing on Brand Performance tracking, Disease Market Overview, Patient Journeys (Treatment and Drug Fulfilment), Forecasting, Product launch support and assessment, Patient adherence, Physician / Account Targeting, Payer Mix, Marketing Impact and ROIs

• Collaborate with Therapy area managers, Ecosystem insights leads and other business stakeholders to understand market dynamics and customer behaviors, leveraging this knowledge to support data-driven strategies

• Comprehend stakeholder requirements, prioritize tasks, and effectively manage day-to-day responsibilities, including liaising and coordinating with the GATE internal team for delivery

• Lead the team and stakeholder discussions, act as thought partner and provide them with high quality analytics solutions and recommendations

• Create impactful presentations to convey crucial insights and recommendations to stakeholders effectively

• Attend meetings with teams across different time zones to ensure smooth delivery of analytical & operations related requests for the business partners

• Take an enterprise mindset, linking individual responsibilities with broader organization, focus on outcomes that provide most business and patient value

• Be flexible to attend meeting during IST/PST overlapping working hours

• Provide mentorship and training to junior team members and interns on analytics principles and the Pharma domain, fostering the development of skill sets and capabilities

Who you are

• You hold a bachelor degree in Technology or a relevant discipline, with a preference for Computer Science, Software, Statistics, Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and related fields and 5-8 years of analytics / consulting experience, with 4 to 6 years specifically in Pharma/Biotech/Healthcare analytics projects. Preferably, Master’s Degree or any certifications on analytics or data science would be an added advantage.

• Must demonstrate expertise in US Pharma Commercial Operations and possess a strong background in Sales analytics, Claims analytics, Product analysis, Patients analytics, forecasting and ROI analysis

• Experience with a range of secondary data sets, including IQVIA Sales data, 867 data, LAAD Claims, affiliations, field interactions, Veeva, medical data, and more, is a significant advantage

• Exposure to therapeutic areas like oncology, neurology, immunology, etc., along with a working knowledge of Salesforce or Veeva, is a valuable addit

• Être flexible pour assister aux réunions pendant les heures de travail recoupant IST/PST

jobs.title: Lead - Coaching & Development
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Title: Lead - Coaching & Development
Job Location: Location Agnostic (travel requirement is mandatory)
The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Your Opportunity
This individual will be responsible for leading and driving the coaching efforts for the customer facing functions aligned to the disease area strategies. This individual would also be responsible for one disease area while functioning as the people manager for the other disease area coaching partners
Accountabilities

• Provide field teams with elite clinical skill development for maximum effectiveness

• Deliver SME-led training for a specific DA using content from DA Medical and Marketing.

• Lead affiliate-level onboarding and induction for new hires

• Utilize tools like MindTickle and NotebookLM for learning

• Collaborate with DAs to facilitate specialized training sessions

• Own content execution while DA medico-marketing supports module development

• Advance scientific communication via AI simulations and digital tools

• Develop consultative persuasion and sales process skills

• Deploy dedicated L&D resources for coaching and affiliate programs

• Focus on priority clusters with responsibilities aligned to a 70% DA and 30% Affiliate split

You are someone with

• Disease Area expertise or ability to learn quickly

• Ability to coach on in clinic delivery effectiveness (incl sales process, soft skills, consultative persuasion and value proposition/ scientific communication delivery)

• Ability to skill build and move PJPs up on adoption ladder of being a highly skilled PJP in customer engagement (intermediate as minimum requirement)

• Great sales and coaching skills; excellent communication skills

• Ability to engage and put the truth on the table with senior management on where progress is happening and where gaps exist, and solutions

• Highly collaborative, solutions oriented, creative - focussed on development and growth, holding PJPs to a high performance in a supportive and psychologically safe way of working

• Competent to use AI and latest technology tools

More details

• Travel required 40-50% of time via individual in field PJP coaching on in clinic effectiveness, cluster visits

• Location agnostic role - however expectation for 50% travel

• As a people leader, has to demonstrate people leadership capabilities

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Capacità di costruire e spostare PJPs su scala di adozione di essere un PJP altamente qualificato nell'impegno del cliente (intermedio come requisito minimo)
• Grandi capacità di vendita e coaching; eccellenti capacità di comunicazione
• Capacità di coinvolgere e mettere la verità sul tavolo con una gestione senior su dove avviene il progresso e dove esistono lacune e soluzioni
• Altamente collaborativo, soluzioni orientate, creativo - focalizzato sullo sviluppo e la crescita, tenendo PJPs ad alte prestazioni in un modo di lavoro solidale e psicologicamente sicuro
• Competente per l'utilizzo di AI e strumenti tecnologici più recenti Maggiori dettagli
• Viaggi richiesto 40-50% di tempo tramite individuo in campo PJP coaching su in efficacia clinica, visite a cluster
• Posizione ruolo agnostico - tuttavia aspettativa per il 50% di viaggio
• Come leader delle persone, deve dimostrare le capacità di leadership delle persone Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

• FH/HTL in Fachrichtung Mechatronik, Telekommunikation, Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik oder gleichwertiges Studium bzw. abgeschlossene Lehre mit Praxiserfahrung
