jobs.title: Principal Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to unlock the power of clinical and real-world data to accelerate life-changing innovation? As the Principal Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist, you will drive analytical excellence and shape advanced data strategies that directly influence evidence generation and clinical decision-making. Working within our collaborative global ecosystem, you will bridge the gap between complex scientific questions and technical data solutions to deliver meaningful outcomes for patients.

Key Responsibilities:

• Drive Data Strategy: Develop and execute therapeutic area-specific data strategies that align with clinical, scientific, and translational goals.

• Lead Advanced Analytics: Design and execute complex analytical frameworks leveraging multi-modal data sources across real-world data (RWD), clinical trials, and operational domains.

• Enable Innovation: Act as a thought leader on data access, integration, and interoperability approaches to build a future-ready healthcare data ecosystem.

• Collaborate Globally: Partner closely with data scientists, data stewards, and external vendors to translate complex business needs into clear, technical data solutions.

• Advance Data Standards: Contribute directly to enterprise-wide data standardization, metadata harmonization, and data asset definitions to maximize data reuse and accessibility.

Who You Are

You are an analytical thinker and strategic problem-solver who thrives on transforming complex data into actionable medical insights. You bring a collaborative mindset, excellent communication skills, and a passion for mentoring others in a diverse, global environment.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Education : A Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Statistics, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.

• Proven Research Experience: 6+ years of experience conceptualizing and delivering real-world data (RWD) studies or using historical clinical trial data within a research or healthcare setting.

• Deep Methodological Expertise: A strong foundation in pharmacoepidemiology principles, observational study designs, and advanced methods to control for confounding (such as Propensity Score Matching or Inverse Probability Weighting).

• Technical & Machine Learning Proficiency : Advanced skills in R or Python, along with experience applying machine learning or artificial intelligence models to complex clinical or prognostic datasets.

• Strategic Communication & Mentorship: The ability to explain highly complex statistical concepts clearly, translate business objectives into structured analytical frameworks, and act as a supportive and positive influence on peers through active mentoring and upskilling, demonstrating the ability to influence key stakeholders by delivering clear, data-driven narratives that effectively drive decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as CDISC, OMOP, or FHIR.

• Experience working with malignancy hematology or oncology datasets.

Location

• This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week.

• Relocation Assistance is not available

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. Ready to make a difference? Apply today!

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Sei pronto a sbloccare il potere dei dati clinici e reali per accelerare l'innovazione in evoluzione della vita? Come Principal Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist, guiderai l'eccellenza analitica e formerai strategie di dati avanzate che influenzano direttamente la generazione delle prove e il processo decisionale clinico. Lavorando all'interno del nostro ecosistema globale collaborativo, collaborerai il divario tra complesse domande scientifiche e soluzioni tecniche per fornire risultati significativi per i pazienti. Responsabilità chiave:
• Drive Data Strategy: Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie terapeutiche specifiche di dati che si allineano con obiettivi clinici, scientifici e traduttivi.
• Lead Advanced Analytics: Progettare ed eseguire complesse strutture analitiche sfruttando fonti di dati multi-modali in dati reali (RWD), studi clinici e domini operativi.
• Abilitare l'innovazione: agire come leader di pensiero per l'accesso ai dati, l'integrazione e l'interoperabilità approcci per costruire un ecosistema di dati sanitari pronto per il futuro.
• Collaborare a livello globale: collaborare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati dei dati, gli amministratori di dati e i fornitori esterni per tradurre le complesse esigenze aziendali in soluzioni chiare e tecniche dei dati.
• Advance Data Standards: Contribuisci direttamente alla standardizzazione dei dati a livello aziendale, all'armonizzazione dei metadati e alle definizioni degli asset dei dati per massimizzare il riutilizzo e l'accessibilità dei dati. Chi sei Sei un pensatore analitico e un problem-solver strategico che prospera sulla trasformazione di dati complessi in insight medici attuabili. Porti una mentalità collaborativa, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, e una passione per il mentoring degli altri in un ambiente diversificato e globale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Educazione avanzata: Laurea Magistrale o Dottorato di Ricerca in Epidemiologia, Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Bioinformatica, Scienze della vita o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Esperienza di ricerca provata: 6+ anni di esperienza concettualizzare e fornire studi di dati reali (RWD) o utilizzando dati di prova clinici storici all'interno di una ricerca o ambiente sanitario.
• Esperienza metodologica profonda: una solida base in principi di farmacoepidemiologia, disegni di studio osservazionali e metodi avanzati per il controllo per la confondazione (come ad esempio la corrispondenza del punteggio di propensione o la ponderazione della probabilità inversa).
• Tecnico & Machine Learning Proficiency: competenze avanzate in R o Python, insieme all'esperienza di applicazione di modelli di machine learning o di intelligenza artificiale per complessi set di dati clinici o prognostici.
• Comunicazione strategica & Mentorship: La capacità di spiegare chiaramente concetti statistici altamente complessi, tradurre obiettivi aziendali in strutture analitiche strutturate, e agire come un'influenza positiva e solidale sui pari attraverso il mentoring attivo e upskilling, dimostrando la capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder chiave, fornendo narrazioni chiare e basate sui dati che guidano efficacemente il processo decisionale. Preferiti:
• Familiarità con gli standard di dati sanitari come CDISC, OMOP o FHIR.
• Esperienza di lavoro con ematologia malignanza o dataset oncologia. Location
• Questo ruolo si basa sul nostro ufficio Welwyn, Regno Unito. Il nostro team segue una struttura di lavoro ibrida, che richiede un numero fisso di giorni in loco a settimana.
• L'assistenza di trasferimento non è disponibile A Roche, prospererai in una cultura che valorizza diverse prospettive e crea un luogo di appartenenza, dove ci impegniamo ad eccellere e raggiungere risultati forti, insieme. Pronto a fare la differenza? Applicare oggi!

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Leistungsfähigkeit klinischer und realer Daten zu nutzen, um lebensverändernde Innovationen zu beschleunigen? Als Principal Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist treiben Sie analytische Exzellenz voran und gestalten fortschrittliche Datenstrategien, die die Evidenzerzeugung und klinische Entscheidungsfindung direkt beeinflussen. In unserem kollaborativen globalen Ökosystem schließen Sie die Lücke zwischen komplexen wissenschaftlichen Fragen und technischen Datenlösungen, um sinnvolle Ergebnisse für Patienten zu liefern. Wichtigste Aufgaben:
• Drive Data Strategie: Entwicklung und Umsetzung therapeutischer bereichsspezifischer Datenstrategien, die sich an klinischen, wissenschaftlichen und translationalen Zielen orientieren. Lead Advanced Analytics: Konzipieren und Ausführen komplexer analytischer Frameworks, die multimodale Datenquellen für reale Daten (RWD), klinische Studien und operative Domänen nutzen. Innovation ermöglichen: Handeln Sie als Vordenker bei Datenzugriff, Integration und Interoperabilitätsansätzen, um ein zukunftsfähiges Gesundheitsdaten-Ökosystem aufzubauen.
• Global zusammenarbeiten: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Data Scientists, Data Stewards und externen Anbietern, um komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, technische Datenlösungen umzusetzen.
• Voranbringen von Datenstandards: Tragen Sie direkt zur unternehmensweiten Datenstandardisierung, Metadatenharmonisierung und Datenbestandsdefinitionen bei, um die Wiederverwendung und Zugänglichkeit von Daten zu maximieren. Wer du bist Sie sind ein analytischer Denker und strategischer Problemlöser, der es schafft, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare medizinische Erkenntnisse umzuwandeln. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und eine Leidenschaft für die Betreuung anderer in einem vielfältigen, globalen Umfeld mit. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:
• Advanced Education: Ein Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Epidemiologie, Statistik, Data Science, Bioinformatik, Life Sciences oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Nachgewiesene Forschungserfahrung: 6+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Bereitstellung von Real-World-Daten (RWD) Studien oder mit historischen klinischen Studiendaten in einer Forschungs- oder Gesundheitsumgebung. Tiefes methodisches Know-how: Eine solide Grundlage für pharmakoepidemiologische Prinzipien, Beobachtungsstudiendesigns und fortschrittliche Methoden zur Kontrolle von Verwechslungen (wie Propensity Score Matching oder Inverse Probability Weighting).
• Technisches und maschinelles Lernen: Fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten in R oder Python sowie Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Modellen für maschinelles Lernen oder künstliche Intelligenz auf komplexe klinische oder prognostische Datensätze. Strategische Kommunikation & Mentoring: Die Fähigkeit, hochkomplexe statistische Konzepte klar zu erklären, Geschäftsziele in strukturierte analytische Rahmenbedingungen zu übersetzen und durch aktives Mentoring und Weiterbildung als unterstützender und positiver Einfluss auf Peers zu wirken und die Fähigkeit zu demonstrieren, wichtige Stakeholder zu beeinflussen, indem klare, datengesteuerte Narrative geliefert werden, die die Entscheidungsfindung effektiv vorantreiben. Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:
• Vertrautheit mit Gesundheitsdatenstandards wie CDISC, OMOP oder FHIR.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit malignen Hämatologie oder Onkologie-Datensätzen. Standort
• Diese Rolle basiert vor Ort in unserem Büro in Welwyn, Großbritannien. Unser Team folgt einer hybriden Arbeitsstruktur, die eine feste Anzahl von Tagen vor Ort pro Woche erfordert.
• Relocation Assistance ist nicht verfügbar Bei Roche werden Sie in einer Kultur gedeihen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven schätzt und einen Ort der Zugehörigkeit schafft, in dem wir uns herausfordern, gemeinsam zu übertreffen und starke Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à débloquer la puissance des données cliniques et réelles pour accélérer l'innovation qui change la vie? En tant que spécialiste principal de la stratégie et de l'analyse des données, vous dirigerez l'excellence analytique et façonnerez des stratégies de données avancées qui influencent directement la production de données probantes et la prise de décisions cliniques. En travaillant au sein de notre écosystème mondial collaboratif, vous comblerez l'écart entre les questions scientifiques complexes et les solutions de données techniques pour obtenir des résultats significatifs pour les patients. Principales responsabilités :
• Stratégie de transmission des données : Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de transmission des données spécifiques à un domaine thérapeutique qui s'harmonisent avec les objectifs cliniques, scientifiques et translationnels.
• Lead Advanced Analytics: Concevoir et exécuter des cadres analytiques complexes à partir de sources de données multimodales à travers des données réelles, des essais cliniques et des domaines opérationnels.
• Permettre l'innovation : agir en tant que chef de file en matière d'accès aux données, d'intégration et d'interopérabilité pour construire un écosystème de données de santé prêt à l'avenir.
• Collaborer à l'échelle mondiale : collaborer étroitement avec les data savants, les data stewards et les fournisseurs externes pour traduire les besoins complexes en solutions de données techniques claires.
• Normes préalables en matière de données : Contribuer directement à la normalisation des données à l'échelle de l'organisation, à l'harmonisation des métadonnées et à la définition des biens de données afin de maximiser la réutilisation et l'accessibilité des données. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur analytique et un résolveur de problèmes stratégiques qui prospère en transformant des données complexes en informations médicales exploitables. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une passion pour le mentorat dans un environnement mondial diversifié. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :
• Enseignement supérieur : Maîtrise ou doctorat en épidémiologie, statistique, science des données, bioinformatique, sciences de la vie ou domaine technique connexe.
• Expérience de recherche éprouvée : 6 ans et plus d'expérience dans la conceptualisation et la fourniture d'études sur les données du monde réel ou l'utilisation de données historiques d'essais cliniques dans un cadre de recherche ou de soins de santé.
• Deep Methodological Expertise: Une base solide dans les principes de pharmacoépidémiologie, les plans d'étude observationnelle et les méthodes avancées de contrôle de la confusion (comme le couplage des scores de propension ou la pondération inverse de la probabilité).
• Compétences techniques et d'apprentissage automatique : Compétences avancées en R ou Python, ainsi que l'expérience d'application de modèles d'apprentissage automatique ou d'intelligence artificielle à des ensembles de données cliniques ou pronostiques complexes.
• Communication stratégique et mentorat : la capacité d'expliquer clairement les concepts statistiques très complexes, de traduire les objectifs opérationnels en cadres analytiques structurés et d'exercer une influence positive et positive sur les pairs par le biais d'un mentorat actif et d'un perfectionnement des compétences, ce qui démontre la capacité d'influencer les principales parties prenantes en fournissant des récits clairs et axés sur les données qui orientent efficacement la prise de décisions. Qualifications préférées :
• Familiarisation avec les normes de données de santé telles que le CDISC, OMOP ou FHIR.
• Expérience de travail avec l'hématologie maligne ou les ensembles de données oncologiques. Lieu
• Ce rôle est basé sur notre bureau de Welwyn, au Royaume-Uni. Notre équipe suit une structure de travail hybride, nécessitant un nombre fixe de jours sur place par semaine.

jobs.title: Senior Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you passionate about turning complex biomedical data into actionable strategies that shape the future of healthcare? As our Senior Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist, you will play a key role in designing and executing data strategies that enable advanced decision-making across our therapeutic areas and molecule portfolios. Based within the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team, you will bridge the gap between scientific questions and practical technical solutions, transforming clinical, operational, and real-world data into innovative assets that accelerate drug development.

Key Responsibilities:

• Execute Data Strategies: Lead the execution of defined components of therapeutic area or program-level data strategies, seamlessly integrating diverse, multi-modal data types.

• Design Advanced Analyses: Design and execute complex data analyses for specific use cases across real-world, clinical, and operational domains.

• Advocate for Harmonization: Independently apply standard data models and metadata practices to support long-term data governance and harmonization efforts.

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert : Support scientific and operational teams as an expert in data sourcing, curation, and analytical readiness, while also executing the required analytical work when needed.

• Drive Data Accessibility: Collaborate closely with internal data stewards, scientists, and stakeholders to improve data workflows, technical requirements, and analytical usability.

​
Who You Are

You are an independent, analytical thinker who excels at translating complex scientific research needs into structured data workflows. You bring excellent communication skills, strategic agility, and a collaborative mindset that allows you to thrive in a global, multicultural environment.
To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Advanced Technical Education : A Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Life Sciences, Informatics, or a related technical discipline.

• Data & Analytics Experience : 3+ years of experience working directly with clinical, operational, or real-world data (RWD) systems.

• Modern Software Proficiency : Advanced, hands-on experience using analytical programming languages like R or Python.

• Data Framework Mastery: Demonstrated experience applying FAIR data principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) and managing metadata in a regulated data environment.

• Production-Grade Analytics : Working knowledge of Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including containerization and pipeline orchestration, to transition models from experimentation to production-grade systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with common healthcare data standards such as OMOP, CDISC, or HL7 FHIR.

• Exposure to cloud-based data engineering tools, knowledge graphs, or clinical trial development workflows.

Location :

• This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week.

• Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. Ready to make a difference? Apply today!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access

• Agire come esperto di materia: sostenere i team scientifici e operativi come esperto di approvvigionamento di dati, cura e prontezza analitica, eseguendo anche il lavoro analitico richiesto quando necessario.
• Guidare l'accessibilità dei dati: collaborare strettamente con gli amministratori di dati interni, gli scienziati e gli stakeholder per migliorare i flussi di lavoro dei dati, i requisiti tecnici e l'usabilità analitica. Chi sei Sei un pensatore analitico indipendente che eccelle nel tradurre complesse esigenze di ricerca scientifica in flussi di dati strutturati. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Educazione Tecnica Avanzata: Laurea Magistrale o Dottorato di Ricerca in Scienza dei Dati, Scienze della Vita, Informatica o disciplina tecnica correlata.
• Esperienza di dati e analisi: 3+ anni di esperienza che lavorano direttamente con sistemi di dati clinici, operativi o reali (RWD).
• Modern Software Proficiency: Avanzata, esperienza pratica utilizzando linguaggi di programmazione analitici come R o Python.
• Mastery Data Framework: Esperienza dimostrata che applica i principi di dati FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) e la gestione dei metadati in un ambiente di dati regolamentato.
• Analisi della produzione-classificazione: Conoscenze di lavoro delle pratiche di Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), compresa la containerizzazione e l'orchestrazione delle tubazioni, ai modelli di transizione dalla sperimentazione ai sistemi di produzione. Preferiti:
• Familiarità con standard comuni di dati sanitari come OMOP, CDISC o HL7 FHIR.
• Esposizione a strumenti di ingegneria dei dati basati su cloud, grafici di conoscenza o flussi di lavoro di sviluppo di studi clinici. Posizione:
• Questo ruolo si basa sul nostro ufficio Welwyn, Regno Unito. Il nostro team segue una struttura di lavoro ibrida, che richiede un numero fisso di giorni in loco a settimana.
• I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro. Pronto a fare la differenza? Applicare oggi! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. jobs.title: R&D Specialist NMR-Spektroskopie (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deine Position und Abteilung

Du arbeitest innerhalb des Sub-Chapters/Gruppe Spectroscopy and Separation Science (DSRRIS) im Chapter Instrumentelle Analytik. Die Gruppe fokussiert sich auf die Entwicklung und Anwendung anspruchsvoller spektrometrischer Verfahren zur Charakterisierung von Diagnostika- und Biochemika-Präparaten und liefert damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Qualität und Innovation unserer Produkte. Du berichtest direkt an den Gruppenleitenden. Du willst deine Entwicklung aktiv mitgestalten und suchst ein Unternehmen, das dir Freiraum über Funktionen und Standorte hinweg bietet, wo deine Stellenbezeichnung erst der Anfang ist. Hochmotiviert nimmst du die Dynamik eines führenden Entwicklungsbereichs an und leistest ab Tag eins einen produktiven Beitrag.

Deine wichtigsten Aufgaben

Du führst selbstständig anspruchsvolle, nicht-routinemäßige NMR- und q-NMR-spektroskopische Analysen an kleinen Molekülen durch. Dazu gehören insbesondere:

• Selbständige Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von NMR- und q-NMR-Analysen an kleinen Molekülen, inklusive Probenvorbereitung

• Eigenständige Optimierung und Entwicklung neuer NMR-Methoden sowie Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Methodenvalidierungen, Methodentransfers zu anderen Abteilungen und Stabilitätsuntersuchungen inkl. Reporting

• Selbständige Ergebnisauswertung mittels EDV (z. B. MestReNova, Bruker TopSpin, Delta), Erstellung von Plänen, Berichten, Vorschriften und SOPs sowie Präsentation der Ergebnisse in Besprechungen

• Dokumentation nach den gültigen Qualitätsrichtlinien (GMP)

• Arbeitsbesprechungen mit Vorgesetzten und Auftraggebern, Teilnahme an laborinternen Kolloquien

• Pflege und Wartung der NMR-Spektrometer (Jeol und Bruker), inklusive Durchführung kleinerer Reparaturen

• Engagierte Zusammenarbeit in multidisziplinären Teams

Hinweis: Diese Position erfordert die Bereitschaft zum Umgang mit Diagnostika- und Biochemika-Präparaten sowie S2 Arbeiten.

Dein Profil

• Independent planning, implementation and documentation of NMR and q-NMR analyses on small molecules, including sample preparation
• Independent optimization and development of new NMR methods as well as planning, implementation and documentation of method validations, method transfers to other departments and stability investigations incl. Reporting
• Independent evaluation of results by computer (e.g. MestReNova, Bruker TopSpin, Delta), preparation of plans, reports, regulations and SOPs and presentation of results in meetings
• Documentation according to the valid quality guidelines (GMP)
• Working meetings with supervisors and clients, participation in internal laboratory colloquia
• Maintenance and maintenance of NMR spectrometers (Jeol and Bruker), including minor repairs
• Engaged collaboration in multidisciplinary teams Note: This position requires willingness to deal with diagnostic and biochemical preparations as well as S2 work. Your profile
• You have a successfully completed Master in Chemistry with initial professional experience or a Bachelor in Chemistry with many years of professional experience, Analytical Chemistry or a related discipline
• You have extensive practical experience in NMR and q-NMR spectroscopy on small molecules
• You have knowledge in dealing with Jeol and Bruker NMR spectrometers as well as with the evaluation software solutions TopSpin, Delta and MestReNova
• Ideally, you will bring basic knowledge in other spectrometric methods (UV-Vis, IR, MS)
• You have experience in the GMP-regulated environment as well as in method development, qualification and validation
• You convince us through reliability, care and accuracy as well as solution-oriented thinking, and enjoy working in a team and showing intercultural competence
• You are fluent in German in word and writing; English skills are beneficial The job is limited to 2 years. Your application We ask you for the following documents:
• Current CV
• Your official (educational) certificates / proofs. No further documents are currently required. Before submitting the application, please note that no further documents can be added afterwards. After viewing your documents, a telephone interview will first take place. In the event of mutual interest, the last step will be a personal interview with presentation at the Penzberg location. Application period until at least 03.07.2026 (Application)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the PCR Software Development chapter develops, delivers, and maintains integrated, unified, and reliable software solutions for Molecular Diagnostics Systems. By leveraging our advanced capabilities and strong internal and external partnerships, we drive accuracy and agility in innovating the Molecular Lab experience for our customers and patients.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Vendor Manager and Project Leader, you will drive the collaboration, compliance, and performance of third-party engagements within Roche Diagnostics Solutions R&D. Acting as the primary interface between the vendor's delivery manager and Roche, you ensure external partners deliver according to contractual obligations and industry best practices while aligning internal stakeholders to guarantee overall project success.

This role is based in Rotkreuz, Switzerland, with a hybrid working model expecting approximately 50% on-site presence. Your contributions will directly support the Roche Diagnostics 10-year ambition.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• You build strong, collaborative vendor partnerships based on transparency and trust, driving daily alignment, stakeholder connections, and domain onboarding.

• You manage operational oversight by conducting regular review meetings and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to ensure long-term contractual compliance.

• You partner with vendors and Roche Procurement to draft work orders and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) tied to "at-risk" amounts for maximum accountability.

• You verify invoicing accuracy against milestones and "at-risk" delivery outcomes to prevent budget overruns.

• You establish and monitor robust metrics to track feature progress, value realization, and the alignment of development efforts with contractual milestones.

• You guard against scope creep, strictly aligning SOW requirements with the agile backlog while balancing fixed-price constraints and agile flexibility.

• You lead moderate-sized squads or ARTs, taking full accountability for delivering engagements within schedule, scope, budget, and quality constraints.

• You enforce a Quality-First framework (e.g., defect density, V&V rates, technical debt) to ensure vendors prioritize product integrity over pure velocity.

Who You Are

You are a dynamic professional who thrives in complex, multi-faceted environments and possesses a "win-win" partnership mindset.

Your skills and experience include:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably in the field of Computer Science.

• You hold a project management certification such as PMP, IPMA Level B, or equivalent (SAFe certifications like Leading SAFe are a strong plus).

• You possess in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge of software engineering, preferably within IVD, regulated environments, agile setups (SAFe), and project management.

• You bring a proven track record in near- or offshore software projects and vendor management, backed by excellent intercultural communication skills.

• You demonstrate a strong experience in defining and measuring quality-driven KPIs, understanding that "done" means compliant, maintainable, and high-quality.

• You prevent scope creep through rigorous change control and negotiation with internal and external stakeholders to successfully maintain project boundaries.

Sfruttando le nostre capacità avanzate e forti partnership interne ed esterne, guidiamo accuratezza e agilità nell'innovazione dell'esperienza di laboratorio molecolare per i nostri clienti e pazienti. L'opportunità In qualità di Senior Vendor Manager e Project Leader, guiderai la collaborazione, la conformità e le prestazioni di impegni di terze parti all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Solutions R&D. Essendo l'interfaccia principale tra il responsabile della consegna del fornitore e Roche, si garantisce che i partner esterni forniscono in base agli obblighi contrattuali e alle best practice del settore, allineando gli stakeholder interni per garantire il successo complessivo del progetto. Questo ruolo ha sede a Rotkreuz, in Svizzera, con un modello di lavoro ibrido che aspetta circa il 50% di presenza in loco. I vostri contributi sosterranno direttamente l'ambizione di 10 anni Roche Diagnostics. In questa posizione, sarete responsabili delle seguenti aree:
• Costruisci partnership di fornitori forti e collaborativi basate sulla trasparenza e la fiducia, guidando l'allineamento quotidiano, le connessioni degli stakeholder e l'inserimento di domini.
• Gestisci la supervisione operativa effettuando riunioni di revisione regolari e Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) per garantire la conformità contrattuale a lungo termine.
• Collaborate con i fornitori e Roche Procurement per redigere ordini di lavoro e Service Level Agreement (SLA) legati agli importi "a rischio" per la massima responsabilità.
• Verifica l'accuratezza di fatturazione contro le pietre miliari e i risultati di consegna "a rischio" per prevenire i sovraccarichi di bilancio.
• Stabilire e monitorare metriche robuste per monitorare il progresso delle caratteristiche, la realizzazione del valore e l'allineamento degli sforzi di sviluppo con pietre miliari contrattuali.
• Protezione contro lo sfregamento, rigorosamente allineando i requisiti SOW con il backlog agile, bilanciando i vincoli a prezzo fisso e la flessibilità agile.
• Conduci squadre di medie dimensioni o ARTs, tenendo piena responsabilità per la fornitura di impegni entro limiti di pianificazione, portata, budget e qualità.
• Esecuzione di un framework Quality-First (ad esempio, densità di difetti, tassi V&V, debito tecnico) per garantire ai fornitori priorità l'integrità del prodotto sulla velocità pura. Chi sei Sei un professionista dinamico che prospera in ambienti complessi e sfaccettati e possiede una mentalità di partnership "win-win". Le tue competenze e esperienza includono:
• Hai una laurea in Ingegneria, preferibilmente nel campo della Scienza informatica.
• Hai una certificazione di gestione del progetto come PMP, IPMA Livello B, o equivalente (le certificazioni SAFe come Leading SAFe sono un vantaggio forte).
• Possiedi un'approfondita conoscenza concettuale e pratica dell'ingegneria del software, preferibilmente all'interno di ambienti IVD, regolamentati, configurazioni agili (SAFe) e gestione del progetto.
• Porti un record di traccia provata in progetti software e gestione di fornitori in prossimità o off-shore, sostenuti da eccellenti capacità di comunicazione interculturale.
• Lei dimostra una forte esperienza nella definizione e nella misura dei KPI guidati dalla qualità, comprendendo che "fatto" significa conforme, manutenbile e di alta qualità.
• Prevenire lo scopo strisciare attraverso il controllo rigoroso dei cambiamenti e la negoziazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per mantenere con successo i confini del progetto.
• Tu adotti un ambiente inclusivo e psicologicamente sicuro, motivato a rendere reale

jobs.title: Scientist - PHCS
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Scientist in the Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) Development team, you will initiate, direct, and perform scientific research, development and manufacturing process strategies to support new and existing diagnostics products . You will join us and chip in to groundbreaking product development to support ongoing research and innovation!

The Opportunity

• Create potentially patentable components for systems, reagents or processes, utilizing DOE where appropriate .

• Participate in cross functional technical team activities .

• Share knowledge and expertise with others .

• Contribute to project planning, process updates and experimental design .

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to others .

• Monitor work to ensure quality and continuously promote Quality First Time .

• Analyze data, evaluate results, form conclusions and provide/implement process or document improvements .

• Execute detailed assay design studies, technical product verification studies, optimization studies for antibody development, planning analytical method development, creating or approving labels, and developing or updating Material Safety Data Sheets .

Who you are

• You hold a Bachelor's Degree in science and 8 years of relevant experience in product development, or a Master's or entry level PhD with 3 years of experience .

• You have hands-on experience with histology-based antibody assays (such as IHC) .

​
Preferred

• You have knowledge in Agile Methodologies .

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is $82 740.00 - $127 000 Annual . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact us by completing this form Accommodations for Applicants .

jobs.title: Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications

titleByLocale.it: Pasante de Affari Aziendali e Comunicazione

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Pasante de Corporate Affairs & Communications en Roche Chile, tienes la oportunidad única de adquirir experiencia real dentro de una industria altamente regulada. Al integrarte a nuestra área, serás un actor clave para dar vida a nuestra cultura, conectando nuestro propósito y valores institucionales con los medios de comunicación, líderes de la salud y nuestra propia comunidad interna.

La Oportunidad:

• Apoyas en tácticas de relaciones públicas mediante el monitoreo diario de prensa, la actualización de bases de datos de periodistas y la redacción de comunicados para hitos corporativos.

• Colaboras en planes de posicionamiento para promover a líderes internos de Roche como referentes técnicos del debate de salud pública.

• Ejecutas estrategias de comunicación interna usando narrativas transmedia para traducir información en mensajes movilizadores que fortalezcan nuestra cultura corporativa.

• Planificas y redactas contenido para los canales digitales de Roche Chile, adaptando mensajes complejos a formatos multiplataforma para interactuar de forma fluida con la comunidad digital.

• Asistes en el análisis de entorno y en la preparación de documentos de posición dirigidos a autoridades ministeriales y legislativas, apoyando nuestro rol en la modernización del sistema de salud chileno.

• Aseguras el soporte operativo controlando los flujos de trabajo de comunicación y garantizando el cumplimiento riguroso de los estándares normativos de la industria farmacéutica.

Quién eres:

• Eres estudiante activo de 3ero o 4to año de la carrera de Periodismo .

• Cuentas con alta capacidad de autogestión para dedicar al menos 4 horas diarias, las cuales puedes coordinar de manera flexible según tus compromisos universitarios.

• Posees sólidas habilidades de redacción periodística, ortografía, capacidad de entrevista y un excelente criterio editorial.

• Manejas a nivel intermedio herramientas de edición digital, multimedia y creación de imágenes.

• Tienes un nivel de inglés intermedio.

*Los beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta vacante.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Product Engineering Expert (Manufacturing)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz is one of the world's leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for hospitals, laboratories, and physician offices. With over 2,200 employees, Rotkreuz is one of Roche Diagnostics' main sites, making it the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland with more than 2,700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare, working together as one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups where success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe in the power of diversity and inclusion, striving to identify and create opportunities that enable all people to bring their unique selves to Roche, while offering extensive development and training opportunities, flexible working options, 18 weeks of maternity leave, 10 weeks of gender independent partnership leave, and multiple on-site services such as child-care facilities, medical services, restaurants, cafeterias, and various employee events.
In this highly specialized permanent, full-time role as Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) within the DODINL Production Laboratory & QC line organisation led by Eric Wanko, you will be the key technical anchor for the critical technology transfer of advanced genetic sequencing workflows. As part of Roche’s global Dual-Site Strategy, we are expanding our manufacturing footprint to establish parallel production capabilities, where this transfer to Rotkreuz, Switzerland, is designed to complement and work in tandem with our existing operations in Santa Clara, USA, ensuring long-term global supply security and scaling our production capacity across both key sites. In this position, you will act as the ultimate Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical execution, optimization, and scaling of our proprietary sequencing consumable portfolios in Europe, leveraging your deep, pre-existing technical knowledge of our US-developed manufacturing lines to ensure seamless cross-site standardization as a central part of a genius team and shaping role.

The Opportunity

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Subject Matter Expert (SME): Serve as the primary technical authority for drafting, reviewing, and auditing site-specific operating procedures (SOPs), batch record templates, and work instructions for critical consumable components.

• Process Optimization & Scaling: Manage and execute complex experiments throughout the product lifecycle, from initial feasibility and stability testing through to official launch and routine manufacturing transfer.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Cross-Functional Training: Translate development workflows into standardized work procedures, providing deep technical guidance and training local operators on complex reagent handling, raw material formulation, automated dispensing, and data analyzation.

• End-to-End Quality Inspectio

La posizione Roche Diagnostics International AG di Rotkreuz è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di soluzioni di sistema diagnostico per ospedali, laboratori e uffici medici. Con oltre 2.200 dipendenti, Rotkreuz è uno dei principali siti di Roche Diagnostics, che lo rende il più grande produttore di sistemi diagnostici in vitro completamente automatizzati in Svizzera con oltre 2.700 colleghi appassionati di oltre 65 nazionalità. A Roche, più di 100.000 persone in 100 paesi stanno spingendo indietro le frontiere della sanità, lavorando insieme come uno dei principali gruppi sanitari focalizzati sulla ricerca in cui il successo è costruito su innovazione, curiosità e diversità. Crediamo nel potere della diversità e dell'inclusione, cercando di identificare e creare opportunità che consentano a tutte le persone di portare i loro se stessi unici a Roche, offrendo ampie opportunità di sviluppo e formazione, opzioni di lavoro flessibili, 18 settimane di congedo di maternità, 10 settimane di congedo di partenariato indipendente di genere, e più servizi on-site come strutture per l'infanzia, servizi medici, ristoranti, caffetterie e vari eventi dei dipendenti. In questo ruolo permanente e a tempo pieno altamente specializzato come Senior Specialist – Tech Transfer & Manufacturing Science (SBX Sequencing) all'interno dell'organizzazione della linea DODINL Production Laboratory & QC guidata da Eric Wanko, sarete l'ancora tecnica chiave per il trasferimento di tecnologia critica dei flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico avanzati. Nell’ambito della strategia globale Dual-Site di Roche, stiamo espandendo la nostra impronta produttiva per stabilire capacità di produzione parallele, dove questo trasferimento a Rotkreuz, in Svizzera, è stato progettato per integrare e lavorare in sintonia con le nostre operazioni esistenti a Santa Clara, negli Stati Uniti, garantendo la sicurezza globale a lungo termine e scalando la nostra capacità produttiva in entrambi i siti chiave. In questa posizione, si agirà come ultimo Oggetto Matter Expert (SME) per l'esecuzione tecnica, l'ottimizzazione e lo scaling dei nostri portafogli di materiali di sequenziamento proprietari in Europa, sfruttando la vostra profonda e preesistente conoscenza tecnica delle nostre linee di produzione sviluppate dagli Stati Uniti per garantire la standardizzazione trasversale senza soluzione di continuità come parte centrale di un team di genio e ruolo di modellazione. L'opportunità
• Trasferimento Tecnologico & Site Alignment: Guidare il trasferimento tecnico di RUO (solo ricerca) e i flussi di lavoro di sequenziamento genetico regolamentati (specialmente la chimica di sequenziamento SBX) da Roche Santa Clara (US) al sito Rotkreuz, garantendo l'allineamento assoluto del processo tra entrambi i siti operativi.
• Oggetto Matter Expert (SME): Serve come autorità tecnica primaria per la redazione, la revisione e l'audit delle procedure operative specifiche del sito (SOP), modelli di record batch e istruzioni di lavoro per i componenti di consumo critici.
• Ottimizzazione del processo & Scaling: Gestire ed eseguire esperimenti complessi in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla prima fattibilità e test di stabilità fino al lancio ufficiale e trasferimento di produzione di routine.
• Controllo avanzato della qualità: supervisionare le indagini ad alta priorità in caso di guasti complessi di processo o deviazioni di produzione, applicare tecniche statistiche avanzate e analisi dei dati per implementare robuste Azioni Correttive e Preventive (CAPA).
• Cross-Functional Training: Tradurre i flussi di lavoro di sviluppo in procedure di lavoro standardizzate, fornendo una profonda guida tecnica e formazione degli operatori locali sulla gestione complessa dei reagenti, la formulazione delle materie prime, l'erogazione automatica e l'analisi dei dati.
• Ispezione di qualità end-to-end

• Technology Transfer & Site Alignment: Drive the technical transfer of RUO (Research Use Only) and regulated genetic sequencing workflows (specifically SBX sequencing chemistry) from Roche Santa Clara (US) to the Rotkreuz site, ensuring absolute process alignment between both operating sites.

• Advanced Quality Control: Oversee high-priority investigations into complex process failures or manufacturing deviations, applying advanced statistical techniques and data analysis to implement robust Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
AIDD (AI for Drug Discovery), part of Roche Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-COE), is applying cutting-edge machine learning to reimagine how biologic drugs are discovered and engineered. Within the Large Molecule Drug Discovery (LMDD) team, we focus on developing next-generation therapeutics, particularly therapeutic antibodies, by combining deep biological expertise with innovative computational methods.

Our team leverages machine learning to analyze extensive sequence data, uncovering valuable insights that drive the creation of potent molecules. We are seeking motivated individuals to join us in this endeavor. If you are enthusiastic about using machine learning for antibody discovery and sequencing data analysis, we encourage you to explore this opportunity.

The Opportunity

• You will develop methods inspired by language models and unsupervised learning to deliver robust, generalizable solutions.

• You will collaborate closely with our team in Basel, New York, and San Francisco.

• You are expected to contribute to and drive publications, and present your results at internal and external scientific conferences.

Who You Are

• You are an enrolled university student in your Master’s programme in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, related technical field.

• Good knowledge of machine learning fundamentals. Familiarity with language models, causal representation learning and unsupervised learning. Experience with ML on biological data is desired.

• Detailed hands-on experience on building and training neural networks - experience with at least one DL framework (preferably Pytorch), keen to build unconventional models, a knack for getting things to work.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion.

Additional Information

• This internship position is located in Basel, Switzerland, on site.

• This is a full-time (40 hours/week) internship for a duration of 6 months.

• Due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university program for the whole duration of this internship.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La posizione AIDD (AI for Drug Discovery), parte del Roche Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-COE), sta applicando l'apprendimento automatico all'avanguardia per reimmaginare il modo in cui i farmaci biologici vengono scoperti e ingegnerizzati. All’interno del team Large Molecule Drug Discovery (LMDD), ci concentriamo sullo sviluppo di terapie di prossima generazione, in particolare anticorpi terapeutici, combinando profonde competenze biologiche con metodi computazionali innovativi. Il nostro team sfrutta l’apprendimento automatico per analizzare dati di sequenze estese, scoprendo preziose informazioni che guidano la creazione di potenti molecole. Cerchiamo persone motivate che si uniscano a noi in questa impresa. Se sei entusiasta dell'utilizzo dell'apprendimento automatico per la scoperta di anticorpi e l'analisi dei dati di sequenziamento, ti invitiamo a esplorare questa opportunità. L'opportunità
• Svilupperai metodi ispirati a modelli linguistici e all'apprendimento non supervisionato per fornire soluzioni robuste e generalizzabili.
• Collaborerai a stretto contatto con il nostro team a Basilea, New York e San Francisco.
• Dovrai contribuire e guidare le pubblicazioni e presentare i tuoi risultati a conferenze scientifiche interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Sei uno studente universitario iscritto al tuo programma di Master in Bioinformatica, Biologia computazionale, Informatica, Statistica, Matematica applicata, Fisica, settore tecnico correlato.
• Buona conoscenza dei fondamenti del machine learning. Familiarità con i modelli linguistici, l'apprendimento della rappresentazione causale e l'apprendimento non supervisionato. È auspicabile esperienza con il machine learning su dati biologici.
• Esperienza pratica dettagliata sulla costruzione e l'addestramento di reti neurali: esperienza con almeno un framework DL (preferibilmente Pytorch), desideroso di costruire modelli non convenzionali, un talento per far funzionare le cose.
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione e interpersonali.
• Integra la nostra cultura e gli standard che guidano il nostro comportamento e le nostre decisioni quotidiane: integrità, coraggio e passione. Informazioni aggiuntive
• Questa posizione di stage si trova a Basilea, in Svizzera, in loco.
• Si tratta di uno stage a tempo pieno (40 ore settimanali) della durata di 6 mesi.
• A causa della normativa, i cittadini non UE/AELS devono fornire un certificato dell'università che attesti uno stage obbligatorio come parte dei documenti di candidatura e devono essere iscritti continuativamente al loro programma universitario per l'intera durata di questo stage. Pronto a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentire la tua opinione. Candidati ora per esplorare questa entusiasmante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si dedicano al progresso della scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone curate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita e hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità.

• Vous collaborerez étroitement avec notre équipe à Bâle, New York et San Francisco.
• Vous êtes censé contribuer et piloter des publications, et présenter vos résultats lors de conférences scientifiques internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes un étudiant universitaire inscrit dans votre programme de maîtrise en bioinformatique, biologie computationnelle, informatique, statistiques, mathématiques appliquées, physique, domaine technique connexe.
• Bonne connaissance des fondamentaux de l'apprentissage automatique. Familiarité avec les modèles de langage, l'apprentissage des représentations causales et l'apprentissage non supervisé. Une expérience en ML sur des données biologiques est souhaitée.
• Expérience pratique détaillée sur la création et la formation de réseaux de neurones - expérience avec au moins un framework DL (de préférence Pytorch), désireux de créer des modèles non conventionnels, talent pour faire fonctionner les choses.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, en collaboration et en relations interpersonnelles.
• Complète notre culture et les normes qui guident notre comportement et nos décisions quotidiens : intégrité, courage et passion. Informations complémentaires
• Ce poste de stage est situé à Bâle, en Suisse, sur place.
• Il s'agit d'un stage à temps plein (40 heures/semaine) d'une durée de 6 mois.
• En raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non-UE/AELE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université attestant qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre du dossier de candidature, et doivent être inscrits en permanence dans leur programme universitaire pendant toute la durée de ce stage. Prêt à passer à l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de vos nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante ! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, garantissant à chacun l’accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Bâtissons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will independently manage end-to-end business analysis workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity. You will demonstrate a strong understanding of the business domain, related technologies, and their interdependencies, applying advanced tools and techniques to translate requirements into strategic implementation plans.

In this role, you will act as a trusted advisor to cross-functional teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives, handling process interdependencies, and significantly contributing to the design and validation of effective solutions. You will also mentor junior analysts and actively shape team processes, methodologies, and best practices within the broader Community of Practice.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently manages end-to-end business analysis workstreams without guidance, tackling problems with emerging ambiguity. Proficiently adapts a range of standard frameworks, mentors junior and intermediate BAs, and proactively shapes team ways of working and best practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Leads the analysis of business problems, performs thorough domain research, and drives root cause analysis. Accountable for delivering comprehensive requirements, contributing significantly to solution selection, and proactively identifying needs-solution discrepancies to propose creative improvements.

• Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of cross-functional stakeholders and builds reliance through deep business understanding to act as a trusted advisor. Facilitates workshops, resolves conflicts, and proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives to strategically manage expectations and align them with project goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Delivers impact that extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster, contributing to domain goals by ensuring solutions provide demonstrable business value. Translates requirements into strategic implementation plans, influences tactical decisions, and contributes to long-term solution roadmaps.

• Complexity/(Product Size): Works at a solution or product level involving multiple solutions, handling ambiguous requirements and systematically interacting with stakeholders across a broader product environment. Evaluates solution impacts considering both immediate and long-term business implications.

• Business/Technical ability : Demonstrates a deep understanding of business and technical domains, technologies, and their interdependencies. Independently applies tools, principles, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis to manage interconnections and improve overall efficiency.

Education / Experience

• You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with 5+ years of Business Analysis/Consultancy experience in life sciences, medical, or pharmaceutical sectors in regulated environments.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche Come Senior Business Analyst, gestirai in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end, affrontando problemi aziendali complessi con l'ambiguità emergente. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente affidabile per i team interfunzionali, modellando le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze di processo, e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e validazione di soluzioni efficaci. Potrai anche mentore analisti junior e modellare attivamente i processi del team, le metodologie e le migliori pratiche all'interno della più ampia Comunità di Pratica. L'opportunità:
• Scope / (Content Leadership): gestisce in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi end-to-end senza guida, affrontando problemi con l'ambiguità emergente. Proficientemente adatta una gamma di quadri standard, mentori BA junior e intermedi, e forma proattivamente i modi di lavoro e le migliori pratiche di squadra.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue un'accurata ricerca sul dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause. Contabile per fornire requisiti completi, contribuendo in modo significativo alla selezione delle soluzioni, e identificare proattivamente discrepanze di risoluzione delle esigenze per proporre miglioramenti creativi.
• Gestione degli Stakeholder: Identificare una vasta gamma di stakeholder interfunzionali e consolida l'affidabilità attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale per agire come consulente affidabile. Facilita i workshop, risolve i conflitti e forma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle agli obiettivi del progetto.
• Impatto/Strategia: Fornisce impatto che si estende a un prodotto specifico, iniziativa o cluster, contribuendo agli obiettivi di dominio garantendo soluzioni che forniscono un valore aziendale dimostrabile. Traduci i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategica, influenza le decisioni tattiche, e contribuisce a soluzioni a lungo termine roadmap.
• Complessità/(dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a una soluzione o a livello di prodotto che coinvolge più soluzioni, gestire requisiti ambigui e interagire sistematicamente con gli stakeholder in un ambiente di prodotto più ampio. Valuta gli impatti della soluzione considerando le implicazioni aziendali immediate e a lungo termine.
• Capacità commerciale/tecnica: dimostra una profonda comprensione dei domini aziendali e tecnici, delle tecnologie e delle loro interdipendenze. Applica in modo indipendente strumenti, principi e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi dei processi per gestire le interconnessioni e migliorare l'efficienza complessiva. Chi sei? Istruzione / Esperienza

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Es ist das, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche Als Senior Business Analyst verwalten Sie selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen und lösen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten. Sie werden ein starkes Verständnis für die Geschäftsdomäne, verwandte Technologien und ihre Interdependenzen demonstrieren, indem Sie fortschrittliche Werkzeuge und Techniken anwenden, um Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne zu übersetzen. In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für funktionsübergreifende Teams, gestalten Stakeholder-Perspektiven, behandeln Prozess-Interdependenzen und tragen wesentlich zur Gestaltung und Validierung effektiver Lösungen bei. Sie werden auch Junior-Analysten betreuen und Teamprozesse, Methoden und Best Practices innerhalb der breiteren Community of Practice aktiv gestalten. Die Gelegenheit:
• Umfang / (Content Leadership): Verwaltet selbstständig End-to-End-Workstreams für Geschäftsanalysen ohne Anleitung und geht Probleme mit aufkommenden Mehrdeutigkeiten an. Passt eine Reihe von Standard-Frameworks professionell an, betreut Junior- und Intermediate-BAs und gestaltet proaktiv Arbeitsweisen und Best Practices im Team.
• Verantwortlichkeit / Problemlösung: Leitet die Analyse von Geschäftsproblemen, führt gründliche Domänenforschung durch und treibt die Ursachenanalyse voran. Verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung umfassender Anforderungen, einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Lösungsauswahl und die proaktive Identifizierung von Bedarfs-Lösungs-Unstimmigkeiten, um kreative Verbesserungen vorzuschlagen. Stakeholder-Management: Identifiziert eine Vielzahl von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern und baut durch ein tiefes Geschäftsverständnis Vertrauen auf, um als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zu fungieren. Ermöglicht Workshops, löst Konflikte und gestaltet proaktiv Stakeholder-Perspektiven, um Erwartungen strategisch zu managen und an den Projektzielen auszurichten. Wirkung/Strategie: Liefert Wirkung, die sich auf ein bestimmtes Produkt, eine bestimmte Initiative oder einen bestimmten Cluster erstreckt und zur Erreichung der Domänenziele beiträgt, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Lösungen einen nachweisbaren Geschäftswert bieten. Übersetzt Anforderungen in strategische Umsetzungspläne, beeinflusst taktische Entscheidungen und trägt zu langfristigen Lösungs-Roadmaps bei. Komplexität/(Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Lösungs- oder Produktebene mit mehreren Lösungen, behandelt mehrdeutige Anforderungen und arbeitet systematisch mit Stakeholdern in einer breiteren Produktumgebung zusammen. Bewertet die Auswirkungen von Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung sowohl unmittelbarer als auch langfristiger Geschäftsauswirkungen.
• Business / Technical Fähigkeit: Demonstriert ein tiefes Verständnis von Business und technischen Domänen, Technologien und ihre Interdependenzen. Wendet Werkzeuge, Prinzipien und Techniken in Bezug auf Anforderungen, Daten, Benutzerfreundlichkeit und Prozessanalyse unabhängig an, um Verbindungen zu verwalten und die Gesamteffizienz zu verbessern. Wer Du bist: Bildung / Erfahrung

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche En tant qu'analyste principal des affaires, vous gérerez de façon indépendante les processus d'analyse commerciale de bout en bout, en s'attaquant aux problèmes d'affaires complexes avec l'ambiguïté émergente. Vous démontrerez une bonne compréhension du domaine d'activité, des technologies connexes et de leurs interdépendances, en appliquant des outils et des techniques avancés pour traduire les exigences en plans stratégiques de mise en oeuvre. Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des équipes interfonctionnelles, façonnerez les points de vue des intervenants, gérerez les interdépendances des processus et contribuerez de façon significative à la conception et à la validation de solutions efficaces. Vous encadrerez également les analystes subalternes et façonnerez activement les processus, les méthodologies et les pratiques exemplaires des équipes au sein de la communauté de pratique. La possibilité :
• Champ d'application / (Le leadership du contenu) : gère de manière indépendante les travaux d'analyse de bout en bout sans orientation, en s'attaquant aux problèmes avec l'ambiguïté émergente. Adapte efficacement une gamme de cadres standard, mentore des B.A. juniors et intermédiaires et façonne de façon proactive les méthodes de travail et les pratiques exemplaires des équipes.
• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Dirige l'analyse des problèmes d'affaires, effectue des recherches approfondies sur le domaine et stimule l'analyse des causes profondes. Responsable de la réalisation d'exigences complètes, contribuant de façon significative au choix des solutions et identifiant de manière proactive les écarts entre les besoins et les solutions pour proposer des améliorations créatives.
• Gestion des parties prenantes : identifie un éventail diversifié de parties prenantes interfonctionnelles et renforce la confiance grâce à une profonde compréhension des affaires pour agir en tant que conseiller de confiance. Facilite les ateliers, résout les conflits et oriente de façon proactive les perspectives des intervenants afin de gérer stratégiquement les attentes et de les aligner sur les objectifs du projet.
• Impact/Stratégie: produit un impact qui s'étend à un produit, une initiative ou un groupe spécifique, contribuant aux objectifs du domaine en garantissant que les solutions apportent une valeur commerciale démontrable. Traduit les exigences en plans de mise en oeuvre stratégiques, influence les décisions tactiques et contribue aux feuilles de route des solutions à long terme.
• Complexité/(Taille du produit): Fonctionne à un niveau de solution ou de produit impliquant plusieurs solutions, manipulant des exigences ambiguës et interagissant systématiquement avec les parties prenantes dans un environnement de produit plus large. Évaluer les répercussions de la solution en tenant compte des répercussions immédiates et à long terme sur les activités.
• Capacités commerciales/techniques : Démontre une compréhension approfondie des domaines, des technologies et de leurs interdépendances. Appliquer de façon indépendante les outils, les principes et les techniques liés aux besoins, aux données, à la facilité d'utilisation et à l'analyse des processus pour gérer les interconnexions et améliorer l'efficacité globale. Qui vous êtes : Éducation / Expérience
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master en Ingénierie, Informatique ou d'un domaine technique connexe avec 5 ans et plus d'expérience en Analyse d'affaires/Consultation dans les sciences de la vie, les secteurs médicaux ou pharmaceutiques dans les environnements réglementés.
