jobs.title: Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A Roche Diagnóstica está em busca de um Estagiário de Pricing e Contratos para se juntar à nossa equipe de Finanças. Esta posição oferece uma excelente oportunidade para desenvolver as suas habilidades financeiras, monitorização comercial e gestão de projetos numa das maiores empresas do setor farmacêutico do mundo!

A Oportunidade:

• Auxilia na preparação e análise de dados de preços e realiza a monitorização ativa de contratos.

• Colabora diretamente com as equipas de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de gestão de faturação e pagamentos.

• Participa ativamente na preparação de relatórios e apresentações para a gestão sénior.

• Ajuda na implementação de medidas de eficiência e monitoriza a sua execução no dia a dia.

• Dá suporte à manutenção de sistemas de preços e ferramentas analíticas vitais para a equipa.

• Lidera o processo de implementação de reajustes com uma vasta carteira de clientes.

• Contribui com impacto em projetos especiais relacionados com preços, custos e reajustes.

Quem você é:

• Formação Acadêmica: em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas. Com previsão de conclusão de curso para 2028 .

• Disponibilidade: Carga horária de 6 horas diárias .

• Disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos , mantendo vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Idiomas: Inglês nível intermediário.

• Ferramentas: Excel do nível intermediário ao avançado .

• Possui forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes na execução das suas tarefas.

• Demonstra excelentes competências de comunicação verbal e escrita.

• Tem capacidade para trabalhar de forma independente e em equipa, interagindo com stakeholders de diversas áreas e níveis de senioridade.

• Possui conhecimentos de Excel de nível intermediário a avançado e inglês de nível intermediário.

Preferencial:

• Tem conhecimentos prévios em SAP.

*Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer for Cloud & Edge Defense, you will be the primary architect and engineer responsible for the security of our global digital boundaries and multi-cloud ecosystems. Your mission is to secure our "front door" by designing and implementing high-performance traffic inspection solutions across AWS, GCP, and Azure using Palo Alto VM-Series as the central pillar. This is a technical "implementer" role where you will architect, design, build, and operate cloud network security infrastructure.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Design and develop robust cloud network infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, leveraging Palo Alto instances for deep traffic inspection.

• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Execute advanced configuration and management of Palo Alto solutions (VM-Series, Panorama), including complex upgrades and migrations in production.

• Cloud Programming & Automation: Leverage cloud vendor network infrastructures to configure and deploy security solutions via automated pipelines using Terraform and Python.

• Feature Enforcement: Implement and manage App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption, and GlobalProtect to enforce a Zero Trust posture.

• Operational Excellence: Manage security policies as code and improve automation workflows and cross-platform orchestration to eliminate manual friction.

• Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Troubleshoot complex issues related to cloud-native routing, load balancing, and firewall inspection within multi-cloud environments.

Who you are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, or a related technical field.

• You have a proven track record of implementing network security controls in at least two major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• You possess 3+ years of experience configuring and maintaining Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including TLS inspection, WildFire, and GlobalProtect.

• You have proven experience using Ansible, Terraform, or Python to manage network security infrastructure at scale.

• You have a deep understanding of core protocols (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) and how they intersect with security enforcement.

Preferred:

• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security, or Azure Security Engineer Associate certifications.

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and GitHub to maintain version-controlled security configurations.

• Strong scripting skills in Python or Go to build custom API integrations between security platforms.

• Experience working in highly regulated environments such as Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare, or Finance.

• A self-starter with the ability to manage technical workstreams from concept to production with minimal supervision.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier fut

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità: Come Senior Cybersecurity Engineer per Cloud & Edge Defense, sarai l'architetto e ingegnere primario responsabile della sicurezza dei nostri confini digitali globali e degli ecosistemi multi-cloud. La vostra missione è quella di garantire la nostra "porta anteriore" progettando e implementando soluzioni di controllo del traffico ad alte prestazioni in AWS, GCP e Azure utilizzando Palo Alto VM-Series come pilastro centrale. Questo è un ruolo tecnico "implementer" in cui si architetto, progettazione, costruzione e operare infrastrutture di sicurezza della rete cloud. Le tue principali responsabilità includono:
• Multi-Cloud Infrastructure Design: Progettazione e sviluppo di robuste infrastrutture di rete cloud in AWS, GCP e Azure, sfruttando istanze Palo Alto per l'ispezione del traffico profondo.
• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Eseguire la configurazione avanzata e la gestione delle soluzioni Palo Alto (VM-Series, Panorama), compresi gli aggiornamenti complessi e le migrazioni in produzione.
• Programmazione e automazione cloud: infrastrutture di rete del fornitore cloud Leverage per configurare e distribuire soluzioni di sicurezza tramite pipeline automatizzate utilizzando Terraform e Python.
• Esecuzione caratteristica: Implementa e gestisci App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption e GlobalProtect per far rispettare una posizione di Zero Trust.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Gestisci le politiche di sicurezza come codice e migliora i flussi di lavoro di automazione e l'orchestrazione cross-platform per eliminare l'attrito manuale.
• Competenza Tecnica: Risoluzione dei problemi complessi relativi al routing, al bilanciamento del carico e all'ispezione del firewall in ambienti multi-cloud. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, ingegneria del software, sicurezza delle informazioni, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Hai una comprovata traccia di implementare i controlli di sicurezza di rete in almeno due principali fornitori di cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP).
• Possiedi 3+ anni di esperienza nella configurazione e nel mantenimento di Palo Alto Firewall di prossima generazione (NGFW), tra cui ispezione TLS, WildFire e GlobalProtect.
• Hai dimostrato esperienza utilizzando Ansible, Terraform o Python per gestire l'infrastruttura di sicurezza di rete in scala.
• Hai una profonda comprensione dei protocolli di base (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) e come si intersecano con l'applicazione della sicurezza. Preferito:
• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security o Azure Security Engineer Associate certificazioni.
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizzando Terraform e GitHub per mantenere le configurazioni di sicurezza controllate dalla versione.
• Forte capacità di scripting in Python o Vai a costruire integrazioni API personalizzate tra piattaforme di sicurezza.
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti altamente regolamentati come Pharmaceuticals, Healthcare o Finance.
• Un self-starter con la capacità di gestire i flussi di lavoro tecnici dal concetto alla produzione con una supervisione minima. I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un fut più sano

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Gelegenheit: Als Senior Cybersecurity Engineer für Cloud & Edge Defense sind Sie der primäre Architekt und Ingenieur, der für die Sicherheit unserer globalen digitalen Grenzen und Multi-Cloud-Ökosysteme verantwortlich ist. Ihre Mission ist es, unsere "Haustür" zu sichern, indem Sie leistungsstarke Verkehrsinspektionslösungen für AWS, GCP und Azure entwerfen und implementieren, wobei Sie die Palo Alto VM-Serie als zentrale Säule verwenden. Dies ist eine technische "Implementierer" -Rolle, bei der Sie eine Cloud-Netzwerksicherheitsinfrastruktur erstellen, entwerfen, bauen und betreiben. Ihre Hauptaufgaben umfassen: Multi-Cloud-Infrastrukturdesign: Konzipieren und entwickeln Sie eine robuste Cloud-Netzwerkinfrastruktur für AWS, GCP und Azure und nutzen Sie Palo Alto-Instanzen für eine gründliche Verkehrsinspektion.
• Advanced Palo Alto Engineering: Führen Sie eine erweiterte Konfiguration und Verwaltung von Palo Alto-Lösungen (VM-Serie, Panorama) durch, einschließlich komplexer Upgrades und Migrationen in der Produktion. Cloud-Programmierung und -Automatisierung: Nutzen Sie Cloud-Anbieter-Netzwerkinfrastrukturen, um Sicherheitslösungen über automatisierte Pipelines mit Terraform und Python zu konfigurieren und bereitzustellen. Feature Enforcement: Implementieren und verwalten Sie App-ID, User-ID, WildFire, Threat Prevention, SSL Decryption und GlobalProtect, um eine Zero Trust-Haltung durchzusetzen. Operational Excellence: Verwalten Sie Sicherheitsrichtlinien als Code und verbessern Sie Automatisierungsworkflows und plattformübergreifende Orchestrierung, um manuelle Reibungen zu vermeiden. Technische Fachkompetenz: Behebung komplexer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Cloud-nativem Routing, Load Balancing und Firewall-Inspektion in Multi-Cloud-Umgebungen. Wer du bist:
• Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering, Informationssicherheit oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Implementierung von Netzwerksicherheitskontrollen in mindestens zwei großen Cloud-Anbietern (AWS, Azure oder GCP).
• Sie verfügen über mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konfiguration und Wartung von Palo Alto Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), einschließlich TLS-Inspektion, WildFire und GlobalProtect.
• Sie haben nachweislich Erfahrung mit Ansible, Terraform oder Python, um die Netzwerksicherheitsinfrastruktur in großem Maßstab zu verwalten.
• Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis von Kernprotokollen (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) und wie sie sich mit der Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen überschneiden. Bevorzugt:
• Zertifizierungen von Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security oder Azure Security Engineer Associate.
• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mit Terraform und GitHub zur Aufrechterhaltung versionengesteuerter Sicherheitskonfigurationen.
• Starke Skriptkenntnisse in Python oder Go, um benutzerdefinierte API-Integrationen zwischen Sicherheitsplattformen zu erstellen.
• Erfahrung in stark regulierten Umgebungen wie Pharma, Gesundheitswesen oder Finanzen.
• Ein Selbststarter mit der Fähigkeit, technische Workstreams vom Konzept bis zur Produktion mit minimaler Aufsicht zu verwalten. • Expertise technique : résoudre des problèmes complexes liés au routage cloud-natif, à l'équilibrage des charges et à l'inspection des pare-feu dans des environnements multi-cloud. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, sécurité de l'information ou un domaine technique connexe.
• Vous avez prouvé que vous avez mis en place des contrôles de sécurité réseau dans au moins deux grands fournisseurs de cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
• Vous possédez plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la configuration et la maintenance des pare-feu Palo Alto Next-Generation (NGFW), y compris l'inspection TLS, WildFire et GlobalProtect.
• Vous avez prouvé votre expérience en utilisant Ansible, Terraform ou Python pour gérer l'infrastructure de sécurité du réseau à l'échelle.
• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des protocoles de base (BGP, OSPF, DNS, TLS/SSL) et de la façon dont ils se croisent avec l'application de la sécurité. Préféré:
• Palo Alto Networks PCNSE, AWS Certified Security ou Azure Security Engineer Associate certifications.
• Compétence en infrastructure comme code (IaC) en utilisant Terraform et GitHub pour maintenir des configurations de sécurité contrôlées par version.
• Des compétences de script solides en Python ou Go pour construire des intégrations d'API personnalisées entre les plateformes de sécurité.
• Expérience de travail dans des environnements hautement réglementés comme les produits pharmaceutiques, les soins de santé ou les finances.
• Un auto-démarrage avec la capacité de gérer les flux de travail techniques du concept à la production avec une supervision minimale. jobs.title: Gerente de Comércio Exterior
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Como Gerente de Comércio Exterior, você atuará como um pilar fundamental na gestão da estratégia de comércio exterior e governança regulatória da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil (RDB), sendo responsável pela blindagem fiscal e aduaneira que mitiga riscos críticos de conformidade. Você deverá liderar a otimização do P&L logístico com foco rigoroso na redução de custos e lead times, além de coordenar a governança de parceiros globais e assegurar a eficiência end-to-end da cadeia de suprimentos internacional. Combinando liderança técnica e de pessoas, você irá desempenhar um papel decisivo na articulação cross-funcional com áreas como Finanças e Planejamento (S&OP) e na gestão de crises complexas, garantindo a sustentabilidade operacional e entregando valor agregado contínuo à Diagnóstica por meio de uma visão estratégica orientada a resultados e conformidade de alto padrão.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Garantir o compliance técnico das Declarações de Importação (DI) e processos aduaneiros junto à Receita Federal, Anvisa e demais órgãos reguladores, mitigando riscos de passivos fiscais e multas retroativas.

• Assegurar que o time tenha visibilidade em tempo real do fluxo de cargas, integrando dados logísticos com o planejamento operacional para mitigar rupturas de estoque governando a estratégia E2E de malha logística internacional da RDB.

• Gerenciar o P&L da operação de comércio exterior, com foco obsessivo na redução de Lead Time, custos de frete internacional e eliminação de despesas extraordinárias (como demurrage e armazenagens adicionais).

• Liderar, capacitar e reter os times de Compliance e Logística Internacional, mitigando riscos de turnover através de um plano robusto de gestão do conhecimento e matriz de competências.

• Atuar de maneira cross funcional com as lideranças da RDB e/ou One Roche de maneira consistente para comunicar temas estratégicos e reputacionais de relevante impacto antecipadamente.

• Liderar o monitoramento de atualizações nas legislações e normas aduaneiras do comércio exterior brasileiro e internacional, desenhando planos de ação imediatos para adaptação do negócio.

• Liderar os processos de concorrência (RFPs) e gerenciar a governança/SLAs de múltiplos parceiros críticos (freight forwarders, despachantes aduaneiros e recintos aduaneiros).

• Atuar como representante de relacionamento institucional e técnico com autoridades fiscais e aduaneiras durante processos de fiscalização ou pleitos de regimes especiais em parceria com outros times da RDB (taxes, finanças, etc)

Quem você é:

• Graduação completa em Direito (com foco tributário/aduaneiro), Comércio Exterior, Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Especialização, Pós-graduação ou MBA em Direito Aduaneiro, Gestão Fiscal ou Auditoria Fiscal será considerado um diferencial.

• Sólida experiência em gestão de processos de importação e visão de negócios com atuação em Comércio Exterior e/ou Gestão Aduaneira.

• Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de saúde, farmacêuticas e/ou de diagnóstico in vitro.

• Experiência consolidada atuando na área de Trade Compliance, auditoria de comércio exterior ou consultoria aduaneira de grande porte, tendo atuado como representante em junto aos órgãos reguladores.

• Inglês avançado; desejável conhecimento de Espanhol.

• Disponibilidade para atuar com base em São Paulo no modelo híbrido.

Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição.

jobs.title: Squad Lead- Opthalmology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Squad Lead - Ophthalmology
The Ophthalmology Squad Lead is responsible for setting and executing the Outcome Based Plan. Ophthalmology in India is a critical component of the India portfolio priorities today and in the future and our ambitions for positive patient outcomes are extensive.
The Squad Lead is the accountable person for delivering on our Ophthalmology therapy area ambition(s) in the cluster and this role requires strong Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coaching capabilities.

Key responsibilities:
The Squads will focus on system shaping, partnership priorities and driving execution excellence which will in turn define what work needs to be delivered. Squad leads are empowered with, and E2E accountable for, creating and delivering value propositions to our customers, including defining work packages (incl. start & end date, resource & investment requirements), optimal working models (e.g. commissioning of work vs. execution within squad) & for executing/overseeing work in alignment with Disease Area Strategy and close collaboration with Disease Area Squad and Key Account Managers under the supervision of Cluster Heads.

• Preferred Ophthalmology therapy area experience i as well as a track record of effective people leadership in functional and/or network teams.

• Customer facing experience in Pharmaceutical healthcare (ideally in Ophthalmology)

• Providing inspirational leadership in setting the vision and strategic ambition for the cluster and assuming overall accountability for the delivery for this vision/ambition

• Creating an environment where diverse technical disciplines can align, develop and execute in order to pursue the cluster/affiliate/disease area North Star ambition

• Leadership coaching of PJPs, peers and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organisation

• Acting as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the centre of all actions by consistent business behaviour that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct.

• Responsible for co-creating and executing strategic partnerships to improve penetration of Roche innovation in Corporate accounts and other important regional accounts

• Ensuring PJP’s purpose/vision, goals, strategy, planning and execution (including investment) are aligned to both DA squad AND Cluster Priorities

• Partnering with the broader affiliate (including Disease Area Squad, Key Account Managers, Cluster Enabling functions etc) to ensure appropriate strategic alignment and required customized modifications

• Fostering collaboration and expertise-sharing across the organisation to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill-sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the North Star

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Führungscoaching von PJPs, Peers und im weiteren Sinne, um sicherzustellen, dass sich Einzelpersonen und Teams im Einklang mit ihrer Leidenschaft und den Bedürfnissen der Organisation entwickeln und wachsen
• Als Hüterin für hohe Standards in Bezug auf Compliance, Ethik und Sicherheit; Patienten in den Mittelpunkt aller Maßnahmen durch konsequentes Geschäftsverhalten stellen, das den geltenden Gesetzen, Branchenkodizes und dem Verhaltenskodex von Roche entspricht.

• Sicherstellen, dass der Zweck/die Vision, die Ziele, die Strategie, die Planung und Ausführung (einschließlich der Investitionen) von PJP sowohl auf die DA-Truppe als auch auf die Clusterprioritäten ausgerichtet sind
• Partnerschaft mit dem größeren Partnerunternehmen (einschließlich Disease Area Squad, Key Account Manager, Cluster Enabling-Funktionen usw.), um eine angemessene strategische Ausrichtung und die erforderlichen kundenspezifischen Änderungen sicherzustellen
• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und des Know-how-Sharing in der gesamten Organisation, um Silos und Duplikationen zu beseitigen, eine effiziente Nutzung ähnlicher Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten und letztendlich die gemeinsame Verfolgung des Nordsterns zu unterstützen Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben. Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen. Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Plomb de l'escouade - Ophtalmologie Le chef de l'équipe d'ophtalmologie est chargé d'établir et d'exécuter le plan axé sur les résultats. L'ophtalmologie en Inde est une composante essentielle des priorités du portefeuille de l'Inde aujourd'hui et à l'avenir, et nos ambitions pour des résultats patients positifs sont vastes. Le chef d'équipe est la personne responsable de la réalisation de nos ambitions de la zone de thérapie ophtalmologique dans le cluster et ce rôle nécessite de solides capacités Visionnaire, Architecte, Catalyste et Coaching. Principales responsabilités : Les équipes se concentreront sur l'élaboration des systèmes, les priorités en matière de partenariat et l'excellence de l'exécution, qui définiront à leur tour les tâches à accomplir. Les responsables de l'équipe sont responsabilisés, et E2E est responsable de la création et de la livraison de propositions de valeur à nos clients, y compris la définition de paquets de travail (y compris la date de début et de fin, les exigences en matière de ressources et d'investissement), des modèles de travail optimaux (p. ex. la mise en service du travail par rapport à l'exécution au sein de l'équipe) et pour l'exécution ou le contrôle de travaux conformément à la Stratégie de la région de la maladie et une collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de la région de la maladie et les gestionnaires de comptes clés sous la supervision des chefs de grappe.
• Expérience de la thérapie ophtalmologique préférée i ainsi qu'une expérience de leadership personnel efficace dans les équipes fonctionnelles et/ou réseau.
• Expérience client en soins pharmaceutiques (idéalement en ophtalmologie)
• Inspirer l'esprit d'initiative pour définir la vision et l'ambition stratégique du groupe et assumer la responsabilité globale de la réalisation de cette vision/ambition;
• Création d'un environnement où diverses disciplines techniques peuvent aligner, développer et exécuter afin de poursuivre l'ambition du pôle/de l'affiliation/de la maladie North Star
• Coaching en leadership des PJP, des pairs et plus largement au besoin, pour s'assurer que les individus et les équipes se développent et se développent en fonction de leur passion et des besoins de l'Organisation
• En tant que gardien de normes élevées en matière de conformité, d'éthique et de sécurité; placer les patients au centre de toutes les actions par un comportement d'entreprise cohérent et conforme aux lois, codes industriels et code de conduite de Roches.
• Responsable de la création et de l'exécution de partenariats stratégiques pour améliorer la pénétration de l'innovation Roche dans les comptes d'entreprise et autres comptes régionaux importants
• Veiller à ce que l'objectif/la vision du PJP, les objectifs, la stratégie, la planification et l'exécution (y compris l'investissement) soient alignés à la fois sur l'équipe de DA et les priorités des groupes
• Partenariat avec la filiale (y compris l'Escouade régionale des maladies, les gestionnaires de comptes clés, les fonctions d'habilitation des grappes, etc.) pour assurer l'alignement stratégique approprié et les modifications personnalisées requises
• Favoriser la collaboration et le partage d'expertise dans l'ensemble de l'organisation afin d'éliminer les silos et les doubles emplois, d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ensembles de compétences similaires et, en fin de compte, de soutenir la poursuite commune de l'étoile du Nord Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

Hauptzuständigkeiten: Die Squads werden sich auf Systemgestaltung, Partnerschaftsprioritäten und die Förderung von Execution Excellence konzentrieren, was wiederum definieren wird, welche Arbeit geliefert werden muss. Squad-Leads sind befähigt und E2E verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Bereitstellung von Wertversprechen für unsere Kunden, einschließlich der Definition von Arbeitspaketen (einschließlich Start- und Enddatum, Ressourcen- und Investitionsanforderungen), optimalen Arbeitsmodellen (z. B. Inbetriebnahme von Arbeit vs. Ausführung innerhalb des Squads) und für die Ausführung / Überwachung von Arbeiten in Übereinstimmung mit der Strategie für Krankheitsgebiete und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Disease Area Squad und Key Account Managern unter der Aufsicht von Cluster-Leitern.
• Bevorzugte Ophthalmologie-Therapie-Bereich Erfahrung i sowie eine Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven Menschen Führung in funktionalen und / oder Netzwerk-Teams.
• Kundenerfahrung im pharmazeutischen Gesundheitswesen (idealerweise in der Augenheilkunde)
• Eine inspirierende Führung bei der Festlegung der Vision und der strategischen Ambitionen für den Cluster und die Übernahme der Gesamtverantwortung für die Umsetzung dieser Vision / dieser Ambitionen
• Schaffung eines Umfelds, in dem sich verschiedene technische Disziplinen ausrichten, entwickeln und ausführen können, um die Ambitionen des Cluster-/Affiliate-/Krankheitsbereichs North Star zu verfolgen
• Führungscoaching von PJPs, Peers und im weiteren Sinne, um sicherzustellen, dass sich Einzelpersonen und Teams im Einklang mit ihrer Leidenschaft und den Bedürfnissen der Organisation entwickeln und wachsen
• Als Hüterin für hohe Standards in Bezug auf Compliance, Ethik und Sicherheit; Patienten in den Mittelpunkt aller Maßnahmen durch konsequentes Geschäftsverhalten stellen, das den geltenden Gesetzen, Branchenkodizes und dem Verhaltenskodex von Roche entspricht.
• Verantwortlich für die Mitgestaltung und Durchführung strategischer Partnerschaften zur Verbesserung der Durchdringung von Roche-Innovationen in Unternehmenskonten und anderen wichtigen regionalen Konten
• Sicherstellen, dass der Zweck/die Vision, die Ziele, die Strategie, die Planung und Ausführung (einschließlich der Investitionen) von PJP sowohl auf die DA-Truppe als auch auf die Clusterprioritäten ausgerichtet sind
• Partnerschaft mit dem größeren Partnerunternehmen (einschließlich Disease Area Squad, Key Account Manager, Cluster Enabling-Funktionen usw.), um eine angemessene strategische Ausrichtung und die erforderlichen kundenspezifischen Änderungen sicherzustellen
• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und des Know-how-Sharing in der gesamten Organisation, um Silos und Duplikationen zu beseitigen, eine effiziente Nutzung ähnlicher Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten und letztendlich die gemeinsame Verfolgung des Nordsterns zu unterstützen Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. • Inspirer l'esprit d'initiative pour définir la vision et l'ambition stratégique du groupe et assumer la responsabilité globale de la réalisation de cette vision/ambition;
• Création d'un environnement où diverses disciplines techniques peuvent aligner, développer et exécuter afin de poursuivre l'ambition du pôle/de l'affiliation/de la maladie North Star

• En tant que gardien de normes élevées en matière de conformité, d'éthique et de sécurité; placer les patients au centre de toutes les actions par un comportement d'entreprise cohérent et conforme aux lois, codes industriels et code de conduite de Roches.
• Responsable de la création et de l'exécution de partenariats stratégiques pour améliorer la pénétration de l'innovation Roche dans les comptes d'entreprise et autres comptes régionaux importants
• Veiller à ce que l'objectif/la vision du PJP, les objectifs, la stratégie, la planification et l'exécution (y compris l'investissement) soient alignés à la fois sur l'équipe de DA et les priorités des groupes
• Partenariat avec la filiale (y compris l'Escouade régionale des maladies, les gestionnaires de comptes clés, les fonctions d'habilitation des grappes, etc.) pour assurer l'alignement stratégique approprié et les modifications personnalisées requises
• Favoriser la collaboration et le partage d'expertise dans l'ensemble de l'organisation afin d'éliminer les silos et les doubles emplois, d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ensembles de compétences similaires et, en fin de compte, de soutenir la poursuite commune de l'étoile du Nord Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• 主要工作目标
治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

主要职责/责任
规范诊疗
1.基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
2.基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升
学科建设
1.访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
2.组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范疾病全程管理
支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识；3年以上医药行业工作经验
• 良好学习能力，业务敏锐度；较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)
• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验，跨职能工作经验为佳
教育程度/所获资格证书
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历
•在试用期内通过RDPAC考试；在试用期内完成罗氏所有必修课程

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Abteilung
Im Bereich Clinical Supplies Manufacturing Management leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Entwicklung neuer therapeutischer Ansätze bei Roche. Unser Team im Clinical Supply Center ist darauf spezialisiert, Proteine und Plasmide für klinische Studien in höchster Qualität aufzureinigen. Hier verbindet sich technologische Spitzenleistung mit einer Kultur des Vertrauens und der Innovation. Wenn Du eine agile Arbeitsumgebung schätzt, in der wissenschaftlicher Fortschritt und menschlicher Zusammenhalt Hand in Hand gehen, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Die Möglichkeiten
Als Team Lead Downstream Processing (w/m/d) führst Du ein mittelgroßes Produktionsteam bestehend aus Spezialist:innen und Expert:innen für die Aufreinigung von Proteinen und Plasmiden. In dieser Schlüsselposition balancierst Du moderne Führung mit operativer Exzellenz und gestaltest die Prozesse von morgen aktiv mit.

Deine zentralen Aufgaben

• Produktionssteuerung & Fachverantwortung : Du verantwortest die Herstellung biotechnologischer Wirkstoffe (Antikörper und Plasmide) unter Einhaltung von GMP-Richtlinien und sicherst so die termingerechte Versorgung klinischer Studien.

• Teamführung & Kultur: Du führst, motivierst und coachst Dein Team (ca. 10 Direktberichtende). Du schaffst eine Teamkultur, in der Innovation gefördert wird, und treibst organisatorische Veränderungsprozesse aktiv und empathisch voran.

• Ressourcen- & Zielmanagement : Du verantwortest die Erreichung der Teamziele und passt Prioritäten sowie Ressourcen flexibel an interne und externe Bedingungen an. Die Budgetverantwortung für Dein Team liegt in Deinen Händen.

• Strategie & Vision: Du brichst die übergeordnete Abteilungs- und Unternehmensstrategie verständlich für Dein Team herunter und befähigst Deine Mitarbeitenden, diese aktiv mitzugestalten.

• Expertise & Schnittstelle: Bei komplexen Fragestellungen stehst Du Deinem Team als fachliche:r Expert:in zur Seite und triffst fundierte Entscheidungen im Rahmen der Richtlinien und GMP-Vorgaben.

Wer Du bist
Du zeichnest sich durch ein sicheres, kompetentes und integres Auftreten aus. Es fällt Dir leicht, vertrauensvolle sowie effektive Beziehungen aufzubauen, und Du navigierst dein Team sicher in einem regulierten und dynamischen Umfeld.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
工作职责

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域相关科学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案。

• 运用专业知识，传递诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升。

• 拜访临床及病理医生，维护客户关系，按时按质的完成相关客户洞见，尤其重点专家对于疾病领域洞见的收集并进行总结/分析/反馈。

• 组织/协调/整合各类疾病领域学术会议，推动建立疾病领域治疗规范。

• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力。

能力要求

• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识

• 良好学习能力和业务敏锐度

• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力

• 多产品资源整合能力

• ​3年以上医药行业工作经验，医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Main Tasks & Responsibilities :

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc.) implementation project, especially in configuration work for project. Make sure all configuration related activities are delivered on time with high quality (eg: minimum deviation, minimum finding, minimum major incident), support PI & Interface Layer system implementation project and the whole site project go live on time. Detail work including:

• System solution and information flow confirmation

• User requirements collection and confirmation

• Tag configuration in the system according to Roche change process and tag configuration process

• Tag verification according to Roche Validation & Qualification process

• Training if any

• All related documentation

• Other work may be needed

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc) configuration change and small projects in routine operation for SHA site after project go live. Make sure all configuration related activities are delivered on time with high quality (eg: minimum deviation, minimum finding, minimum major incident), support PI & Interface Layer system configuration change and small projects deliver on time. Detail work including:

• Tag configuration in the system according to Roche change SOP and tag configuration SOP

• Tag verification according to Roche Validation & Qualification SOP

Responsible for the 2nd level support for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc) in routine operation for SHA site after project go live. Track and solve incidents & problems according to ITOT incident & problem management SOP, base on OSP and SLA.

Responsible for ITOT PI & Interface Layer system (such as File Transfer, SCADA, MQTT and etc.) configuration work for future project. jobs.title: R&D Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) functions as a center of excellence for research and early development, and CICoR Oncology group is looking for a motivated and curious intern student majoring in Biotechnology or related fields to join our team. This role offers a unique cross-functional experience, combining dry-lab data analysis, wet-lab experimental support, and creative science communication. You will work closely with senior scientists and bioinformaticians, gaining hands-on industry experience.

• The main responsibilities of the position include:
• Bioinformatics & Data Analysis Support
• Assist in basic bioinformatics workflows.

• Support the team in data visualization, creating charts, and organizing datasets for internal research projects.

• Learn and utilize internal platforms or open-source tools to assist in literature mining and biological database searches.

• Wet-Lab Experimental Assistance
• Support routine laboratory operations, including reagent preparation, sample archiving, and inventory management under strict safety guidelines.

• Assist scientists in executing basic molecular biology or cell culture experiments (training will be provided).

• Science Communication & Video Creation

Brainstorm, script, and produce short promotional or educational videos to showcase team achievements, lab technologies, or internal scientific events.

• Qualifications / Discipline:
Bachelor of Biotechnology degree in relevant fields.

• Skills:
Strong motivation and leadership in pursuing challenging scientific questions.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Biotechnologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

The Opportunity
This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

Others:

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Preferred
Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who You Are

• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders. Diploma holders with at least 3 years of experience. NITEC or equivalent holders with 7 years of experience. Biologics experience is a plus.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity
This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

Who Are You

• Fresh Graduate with degree in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or Diploma or NITEC or equivalent holders. Diploma holders with at least 3 years of experience. NITEC or equivalent holders with 7 years of experience. Biologics experience is a plus.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link. Company Shuttle Bus is provided at the MRT Stations.

Preferred

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) for People & Culture (P&C) acts as the "Capability Factory" for Roche. We are a team of business-minded technologists who play "offense"—moving beyond supporting systems to architecting a high-performance digital chassis. We aim to amplify human potential by creating a zero-effort, intelligent ecosystem where technology simplifies complexity and empowers every Roche employee to do their best work.

The Opportunity

The Delivery Service Manager (DSM) for Financial & Mobility technology ensures that the "what" and "why" of the product vision are actually realized through a disciplined "how". While other roles may focus on long-term strategy or technical design, the DSM ensures that the delivery ecosystem works together effectively to provide a stable, supportable, and high-value service.

• Backlog Ownership: Manage and prioritize the product backlog by balancing business value, risks, and technical dependencies.

• Requirement Translation: Convert stakeholder needs into clear, "ready" user stories equipped with specific acceptance criteria for the development team.

• Release Planning: Lead operational readiness and impact assessments to ensure feature deployments are successfully integrated into daily operations.

• Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the bridge between business leaders and developers to manage expectations and refine the product roadmap.

• End-to-End Execution: Oversee daily operations and track progress to ensure the stable and reliable delivery of services.

• Vendor Management: Serve as the primary contact for external partners, ensuring they meet quality, scope, and compliance standards in collaboration with the Transformation Lead.

• Quality & Health Monitoring: Monitor system health and maintain performance dashboards to ensure high service availability.

• Risk & Compliance: Maintain audit readiness and internal controls to ensure all delivery activities align with security and regulatory policies.

Who you are

• Domain & Methodological Expertise: Possesses deep technical knowledge in specified systems alongside a strong understanding of IT Service Management and SCRUM methodologies.

• Stakeholder & Communication Mastery: Demonstrates excellent English communication skills and the ability to represent user groups, influencing and managing expectations across all levels of the organization.

• Strategic Prioritization: Combines analytical thinking with a "good enough instead of perfection" philosophy to manage high input volumes and meet objectives effectively.

• Independent & Virtual Collaboration: Proven ability to work with minimal supervision and plan personal workloads while remaining a highly effective contributor to virtual teams.

• Problem-Solving & Growth Mindset: Driven by a passion for continuous learning and sharing knowledge, utilizing a hands-on, customer-service-oriented approach to resolve issues.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Cybersecurity Expert - Security Expert - RDT Monitoring & Incident Response

Introduction The Security and Cybersecurity Expert manages a team of analysts, defines team objectives and processes, and is responsible for critical security programs and strategic initiatives . Within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) Monitoring & Incident Response, you will leverage advanced infrastructure data and systems thinking to protect our digital ecosystem, ensuring resilience against complex cyber threats .
The Opportunity:

• Provide Expert Leadership: Provide expert-level leadership and strategic guidance for high-impact, complex cybersecurity projects across multiple domains .

• Manage Analytical Teams: Manage a dedicated team of security analysts, defining clear team objectives, workflows, and process improvement initiatives .

• Architect Resilient Solutions: Lead the end-to-end design, definition, and root cause analysis of complex, strategic business and security problems spanning organizational boundaries .

• Govern Security Standards: Develop, embed, and implement security best practices and Quality assurance across strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with Technical Architecture Frameworks .

• Drive Strategic Alignment: Recommend and guide the implementation of optimal strategies, solution options, advanced value analyses, and risk assessments to align with global goals .

• Influence Enterprise Strategy: Shape strategy as a trusted advisor and master negotiator to senior leadership, driving consensus on the strategic security vision through persuasive communication .

• Foster Teamwork and Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with global cross-functional networks, cultivating collaboration and serving as a role model in teamwork between Informatics and the business .

• Nurture Community Expertise: Mentor senior practitioners, help colleagues develop technical expertise, and show visible leadership within the internal security Communities of Practice (CoPs) .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field .

• Experienced Security Leader: You bring 7+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity operations, with a proven track record of managing analyst teams and leading complex infrastructure security initiatives .

• Incident Response Expert: You demonstrate in-depth knowledge of monitoring and incident response methodologies, technical domain architectures, and organizational security strategy .

• Systems & Advisory Thinker: You apply advanced systems thinking and advisory concepts to provide holistic, enterprise-wide consulting advice across highly interconnected and ambiguous environments .

• Strategic Problem Solver: You possess expert-level analytical and logical reasoning skills to proactively identify risks, manage evolving requirements, and deliver innovative security solutions .

• Master Stakeholder Negotiator: You excel at analyzing complex global stakeholder networks, managing senior personnel expectations, and translating intricate technical risks into clear, actionable insights .

• Agile Framework Practitioner: You are highly proficient in navigating dynamic environments, managing project resource dependencies under tight timelines, and driving continuous improvement in an always-available environment .

Call to Action: Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply no

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
● A field-based medical expertise for field medical strategy development and execution on the assigned disease area and related biomarker under the leadership of Medical Science Manager Leader.
● Be responsible for data generation activities for assigned disease area and related biomarker.
● Establish long-term, peer-to-peer relationships with TAEs and investigators，including biomarker area experts, in a given therapeutic field and deliver quality interactions and services that bring value to HCPs, and that are aligned with medical strategies.
● Lead implementation of the tactical / field medical plans in collaboration with Country Medical Manager.
● Identify opportunities for collaborations between the company and the TAEs and investigators.
● Ensures strict adherence to the company’s corporate policies, SOP and local regulations for all medical science initiatives for assigned disease area.

Principle Roles & 
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities (Major functions of the position)
1) A field-based medical expertise for medical science in assigned disease area and related biomarker
● Drive development, implementation and monitoring field medical plan under coaching of MSM Leader and align with country medical strategy.
● Define and execute field medical short term to long term vision includes scientific communications and strategic partnerships through interaction with TAEs.
● Collect field TAE insights and determine TAE interest in ongoing research and educational events; Develop and regularly update TAE profile to better understand TAE’s clinical practices, needs, preferences and views of new data.
● Provide scientific support for cross functional partners in medical training, scientific query handling, speaker material preparation.
● Lead the local innovative business model developing, implementation and further optimization, such as the establishment of regional pathology referral center with synergy from Roche diagnostic company and other external diagnostic related company or medical society.
● Contribute to the execution of advisory boards.
2) Data Generation
● Translate insights on local stakeholder needs and value decision drivers into an effective medical strategy, prioritize gaps and hurdles related to the local patient journey.
● Ensure excellence in access evidence planning and generation as part of the medical strategy, incorporating RWE, clinical studies and data inputs for local economic models etc.
● Receive IISs request, work with country medical manager to review of IISs within the company, and following-up with investigators, in accordance to all local laws and regulations.
● Support site feasibility assessments, site development plan, patients enrollment in trials and investigator engagementof Phase I-IIIa clinical studies under the direction of PDof Phase IIIb-IV Medical Affairs clinical studies in collaboration with clinical operations
3) Knowledge exchange
● Translate clinical/scientific evidence into local value messages and communicate those in cross functional collaboration to relevant stakeholders in a tailored manner.
● Exchange scientific data with HCPs; facilitate their needs of up to date scientific data, including but not limited to publications of clinical trials, guidelines, by ensuring they have the best quality available information they require.
● Develop and deliver medical training and education program to the target audience.
● Provide inputs to country medical manager on the aff

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts.
As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization.
You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business.
You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.

• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.

• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.

• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.

• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.

• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.

• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies.

Who you are

• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.

• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.

• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.

• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.

• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
项目管理

• 协助项目经理执行园区Capex 项目，如办公室装修、实验室改造、新建楼宇等大型项目。

• 协助项目经理进行项目招标文件撰写以及协调采购进行项目招标确定服务商。

• 协助项目经理进行项目过程中供应商、用户、利益相关方沟通协调工作。

• 协助项目经理进行罗氏总部工程文件的编写和审核，若有需要针对项目与总部工程团队进行沟通和协调。

• 协助项目经理进行项目的进度、成本、安全、质量管理，对项目进行生命周期管理，从启动到交付。

• 负责项目会议记录和行动跟踪。

文档管理

• Capex项目文档管理流程起草及审批，项目文件命名标准变化。

• 项目管理过程中文档流转签字及归档。

• 项目共享文件夹权限管理以及电子档文件归档。

• CFE建筑文档定期盘查，若需要报废及时申请报废。

其他：
特种设备以及能源管理工作支持，处理数据以及现场查验仪表标签情况

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care

titleByLocale.it: Cardiologia del partner di valore medico e cura critica
titleByLocale.en: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
titleByLocale.de: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de valeur médicale Cardiologie et soins essentiels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Migration-integration expert & Technical Product Owner you are responsible for:

• Leading technically Roche’s high-stakes AWS account migrations. Your primary mission is to facilitate the seamless integration of newly acquired entities (M&A) and the consolidation of legacy infrastructure into the Roche Cloud Platform (RCP) AWS .

• Advanced AWS engineering for complex networking, security and IAM environments and stakeholder management at all levels in the organization.
