jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Metadata & Terminologies Management - Data Platforms Delivery Expert

The Data Platforms Delivery Expert is responsible for the operational delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of services related to Metadata & Terminologies Management Function. This role requires strong stakeholders relationship management skills, a service-oriented approach, and the ability to effectively communicate deliverables, risks and needs.

Responsibilities:

• Service Management and Governance: Assume accountability for the management, governance, and continuous improvement of designated IT Services. Prioritize consumer requirements and ensure the requisite processes, resources, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are established to fulfill service commitments.

• Operational Execution: Be accountable for the day-to-day operational execution, supporting the Service Delivery Manager to ensure services meet business requirements and adhere to agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Process Compliance and Consulting: Ensure process compliance and provide expert consultancy on Service Management topics across the organization. Guide process practitioners to focus on adoption, adherence, and continuous learning.

• External Sourcing and Vendor Management: Co-create the external sourcing strategy, execute and maintain contractual orders for external resources, and support the organization in optimizing the value delivered by Digital and Technology partners and vendors.

• Portfolio Oversight: Oversee the entire portfolio lifecycle, encompassing goal definition, risk identification, and ensuring the delivery of requisite business value.

• Investment Health: Safeguard the health of investment portfolios through rigorous analysis, proactive risk management communication, and adherence to established best practices.

• People Management: Perform people management duties, including resource assignment, timesheet review and approval, mandatory training compliance tracking, and managing onboarding and offboarding procedures.

• Financial Stewardship: Provide financial oversight, managing both financial planning and the reconciliation of planned versus actual expenditure.

• Procurement Expertise: Maintain current knowledge of procurement processes and cultivate robust partnerships with the cVMO and procurement teams.

• Contract Management: Administer contracts with software vendors, consultants, and external partners.

• Release Management: Design and execute strategy and tasks contributing to Release Management.

Required Capabilities and Competencies:

• Proficiency in utilizing Service Management tools, including ServiceNow and Tableau dashboards, EPP, and other relevant applications.

• Ability to refine, negotiate, and implement Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with vendors and contingent workforce suppliers. Lead discussions to position Master Service Agreements with strategic vendors, ensuring alignment with the RDT strategy.

• Demonstrated successful experience in performing the Core ITIL Responsibilities and Principles.

• Accountability and Problem Solving: Identify and resolve intermediate to complex data problems. Validate models and ensure their accuracy with minimal supervision.

• Possession of a Lean mindset.

• Exhibit a holistic organizational view and collaborate across functional boundaries to accelerate the business agility journey.

• Fluency in English.

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę).

• Annual bonus payment based on your perf

• Salute degli investimenti: salvaguardare la salute dei portafogli di investimento attraverso analisi rigorose, comunicazione proattiva di gestione dei rischi e l'adesione alle migliori pratiche stabilite.
• Gestione delle persone: Eseguire i doveri di gestione delle persone, tra cui l'assegnazione delle risorse, la revisione del foglio di tempo e l'approvazione, il monitoraggio obbligatorio della conformità della formazione e la gestione delle procedure di bordo e offboarding.
• Financial Stewardship: Fornire la supervisione finanziaria, gestire sia la pianificazione finanziaria che la riconciliazione delle spese previste rispetto alle spese effettive.
• Competenza Procurement: Mantenere la conoscenza corrente dei processi di approvvigionamento e coltivare partnership robuste con i team cVMO e di approvvigionamento.
• Gestione dei contratti: Contratti di amministrazione con fornitori di software, consulenti e partner esterni.
• Gestione del rilascio: Progettazione ed esecuzione di strategia e compiti che contribuiscono a Gestione del rilascio. Capacità e competenze necessarie:
• La competenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di Service Management, tra cui dashboard ServiceNow e Tableau, EPP e altre applicazioni rilevanti.
• Capacità di perfezionare, negoziare e implementare gli accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) con fornitori e fornitori di forza lavoro contingenti. Condurre le discussioni a posizionare gli accordi di servizio master con i fornitori strategici, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia RDT.
• Dimostrata esperienza di successo nell'esecuzione delle responsabilità e dei principi fondamentali ITIL.
• Accountability e Problem Solving: Identificare e risolvere problemi di dati intermedi e complessi. Convalidare i modelli e garantire la loro precisione con una supervisione minima.
• Possessione di una mentalità magra.
• Mostrare una visione organizzativa olistica e collaborare attraverso i confini funzionali per accelerare il viaggio di agilità aziendale.
• Fluency in inglese. Che cosa si ottiene:
• Contratto di lavoro (Umowa o pracę).
• Pagamento bonus annuale basato sul tuo perf

Diese Rolle erfordert starke Fähigkeiten im Beziehungsmanagement der Stakeholder, einen serviceorientierten Ansatz und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse, Risiken und Bedürfnisse effektiv zu kommunizieren. • Operational Execution: Seien Sie für die tägliche operative Ausführung verantwortlich und unterstützen Sie den Service Delivery Manager, um sicherzustellen, dass die Dienste die Geschäftsanforderungen erfüllen und vereinbarte Service Level Agreements (SLAs) einhalten.
• Prozess-Compliance und -Beratung: Sicherstellen der Prozess-Compliance und kompetente Beratung zu Service-Management-Themen im gesamten Unternehmen. Führen Sie Prozesspraktiker dazu, sich auf Adoption, Einhaltung und kontinuierliches Lernen zu konzentrieren.
• Externes Sourcing und Vendor Management: Co-Kreation der externen Sourcing-Strategie, Ausführung und Aufrechterhaltung vertraglicher Aufträge für externe Ressourcen und Unterstützung des Unternehmens bei der Optimierung des Werts von Digital- und Technologiepartnern und -anbietern.

• Finanzverwaltung: Bereitstellung einer Finanzaufsicht, die sowohl die Finanzplanung als auch den Abgleich von geplanten und tatsächlichen Ausgaben verwaltet.
• Beschaffungskompetenz: Aktuelles Wissen über Beschaffungsprozesse pflegen und robuste Partnerschaften mit dem cVMO und den Beschaffungsteams pflegen.
• Vertragsmanagement: Verwalten Sie Verträge mit Softwareanbietern, Beratern und externen Partnern.
• Release Management: Entwerfen und Ausführen von Strategie und Aufgaben, die zum Release Management beitragen. Erforderliche Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen:
• Kenntnisse in der Nutzung von Service Management Tools, einschließlich ServiceNow und Tableau Dashboards, EPP und anderen relevanten Anwendungen.
• Fähigkeit zur Verfeinerung, Verhandlung und Implementierung von Service Level Agreements (SLAs) mit Lieferanten und kontingentierten Arbeitskräftelieferanten. • Nachweis erfolgreicher Erfahrungen bei der Durchführung der Kern-ITIL-Verantwortungen und -Prinzipien.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer

Impact

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

What You Will Do

As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently.

Purpose
The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context.

Key Activities and Deliverables

• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.

• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.

• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.

• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.

• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.

• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.

• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.

• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices

Job Skills Required

• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.

• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities

• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor

• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.

• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.

• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Qualifications and Experience Required

• 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.

• Demonstrated hands-on experie

La posizione Ingegnere di sicurezza senior Impatto Il nostro team di Secure Access protegge la forza lavoro globale dell'organizzazione fornendo e operando le tecnologie che consentono un accesso sicuro, affidabile e conforme alle risorse aziendali. Lavoriamo nell'intersezione della sicurezza della rete, dell'identità e del cloud, supportando gli utenti e i sistemi business-critical in un ambiente industriale regolamentato. Vuoi fare un impatto significativo come un ingegnere di sicurezza focalizzato su accesso sicuro e sicurezza di rete? Si prospera in un ambiente veloce e diretto? Se è così, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi! Cosa farai In qualità di Ingegnere di Sicurezza del team Secure Access, disegnare, implementare e utilizzare le tecnologie che sostengono le capacità di accesso remoto della nostra organizzazione, la sicurezza web e la protezione della rete. Sarete un collaboratore pratico che porta sia competenze tecniche profonde e l'energia per guidare i miglioramenti indipendentemente. Oggetto Gli ingegneri del team Secure Access, forniscono e supporta le soluzioni utilizzate per fornire un accesso sicuro alla rete in tutto l'ambiente aziendale – che spaziano su premi, cloud e infrastrutture ibride. Il team fornisce un supporto pratico per l'ingegneria, la gestione della configurazione e l'automazione per mantenere i controlli di accesso robusti, verificabili e scalabili in un contesto industriale regolamentato. Attività chiave e consegnabili
• Progettare, implementare e utilizzare soluzioni di accesso web basate su Cloudflare e Zero Trust.
• Amministra e supporta l'infrastruttura VPN GlobalProtect, tra cui gestione delle politiche, risoluzione dei problemi e operazioni del ciclo di vita.
• Costruisci e mantieni le tubazioni di automazione per ridurre la fatica manuale e migliorare la coerenza tra le configurazioni di sicurezza.
• Gestisci il codice dell'infrastruttura utilizzando Terraform e mantieni le configurazioni controllate dalla versione in GitHub.
• I propri processi di gestione della configurazione in ServiceNow, assicurando la corretta conformità ai record CMDB e alla gestione dei cambiamenti.
• Assicurarsi che le soluzioni di sicurezza soddisfino i requisiti normativi e supportano le attività di audit e compliance.
• Identificare attivamente le lacune nei controlli di accesso e proporre miglioramenti con un self-driven, soluzione-oriented mindset.
• Collabora con partner interfunzionali tra cui team di rete, identità e cloud per offrire funzionalità di accesso sicure integrate.
• Mentori più membri del team junior e contribuisce allo sviluppo delle best practice di sicurezza Competenze di lavoro richieste
• Alta energia, auto-motivata, e capace di possedere lavoro end-to-end con direzione minima.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Indipendentemente conduce l'analisi di incidenti di sicurezza cibernetica moderatamente complessi e problemi tecnici, definendo chiaramente la portata del problema di sicurezza e l'analisi della causa principale di guida per violazioni di sicurezza o vulnerabilità
• Identificare una vasta gamma di stakeholder di sicurezza in tutte le aree funzionali e gestire efficacemente le relazioni per costruire affidamento attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale e tecnica, agendo come consulente affidabile
• Forte attenzione al cliente con un servizio altamente reattivo consegna e supporto etico.
• Collaborativo e comunicativo — comodo lavoro in team distribuiti e interfunzionali.
• Dettaglio orientato con un impegno a qualità, documentazione e eccellenza operativa.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale inglese. Qualifiche e esperienza richiesti
• 3-7 anni di esperienza tecnica pratica in ingegneria della sicurezza, con un focus sulla sicurezza della rete e tecnologie di accesso sicuro.
• Mani-su esperie dimostrate
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer Impact Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud — supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. Do you want to make a meaningful impact as a Security Engineer focused on secure access and network security? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, self-directed environment? If so, we’d love to hear from you! What You Will Do As a Security Engineer on the Secure Access team, you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor who brings both deep technical expertise and the energy to drive improvements independently. Purpose The Secure Access team engineers, delivers, and supports the solutions used to provide secure network access across the corporate environment — spanning on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. The team provides hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable in a regulated industry context. Key Activities and Deliverables
• Design, implement, and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions.
• Administer and support GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including policy management, troubleshooting, and lifecycle operations.
• Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and improve consistency across security configurations.
• Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations in GitHub.
• Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and change management compliance.
• Ensure security solutions meet regulatory requirements and support audit and compliance activities.
• Proactively identify gaps in access controls and propose improvements with a self-driven, solution-oriented mindset.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners including network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated secure access capabilities.
• Mentors more junior team members and contributes to the development of security best practices Job Skills Required
• High energy, self-motivated, and capable of owning work end-to-end with minimal direction.
• Accountability/Problem Solving : Independently leads the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, clearly defining the security problem scope and driving root cause analysis for security breaches or vulnerabilities
• Identifies a diverse range of security stakeholders across functional areas and effectively manages relationships to build reliance through deep business and technical understanding, acting as a trusted advisor
• Strong customer focus with a highly responsive service delivery and support ethic.
• Collaborative and communicative — comfortable working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
• Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality, documentation, and operational excellence.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Qualifications and Experience Required
• 3-7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, with a focus on network security and secure access technologies.
• Demonstrated hands-on experie

Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Netzwerksicherheit, Identität und Cloud und unterstützen Benutzer und geschäftskritische Systeme in einem regulierten Industrieumfeld. Möchten Sie als Security Engineer, der sich auf sicheren Zugang und Netzwerksicherheit konzentriert, einen sinnvollen Einfluss haben? Gedeihen Sie in einer schnelllebigen, selbstgesteuerten Umgebung? • Erkennen Sie proaktiv Lücken in den Zugangskontrollen und schlagen Sie Verbesserungen mit einer selbstgesteuerten, lösungsorientierten Denkweise vor.

• Identifiziert eine Vielzahl von Sicherheitsakteuren in verschiedenen Funktionsbereichen und verwaltet effektiv Beziehungen, um durch ein tiefes Geschäfts- und technisches Verständnis Vertrauen aufzubauen und als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zu fungieren

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As the External Affairs Lead for the Southern African Network, you design and implement strategic stakeholder engagement plans that build sustainable partnerships, shape healthcare policy, and expand patient access to cutting-edge diagnostics across the region. You lead an impactful function, serving as a critical bridge between our scientific innovations and the public and private healthcare ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities:

- Drive Access & Stakeholder Engagement Strategy: Design and lead a comprehensive Stakeholder Engagement Strategy for Roche Southern Africa, ensuring alignment with our long-term African continent vision.
- Cultivate Strategic Networks: Map, develop, and maintain deep relationships with national and provincial governments, NGOs, public health organizations, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to position our strategic diagnostic portfolios.
- Advocate for Systemic Change: Engage key decision-makers and build networks to provide evidence-based policy inputs, actively facilitating healthcare policy amendments that improve patient journeys.
- Co-Create Innovative Access Solutions: Partner with Healthcare Access and Quality & Regulatory (QARA) teams to analyze public and private healthcare environments, pilot innovative access solutions, and maps patient journeys.
- Empower and Lead Teams: Resource, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team, fostering an environment of continuous learning, strategic agility, and accountability.
- Ensure Compliance and Excellence: Champion full regulatory policy compliance and quality standards (including ISO 13485) by leveraging emerging policy models to accelerate product availability for patients.

Who You Are

You are a visionary, collaborative leader who thrives on building meaningful connections and navigating complex healthcare landscapes. You possess the strategic agility to transform challenges into healthcare access opportunities, backed by excellent communication and relationship-management skills.

Qualifications & Experience:
- Education: A University Degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant scientific, medical, or healthcare field (extensive professional experience in the field at a similar level will also be considered).
- Industry Track Record: Minimum of 10 years of experience in health sciences, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a related sector, with a proven track record across policy design, market access, and government affairs.
- Leadership Experience: At least 8 years of management experience, including a minimum of 3 years of direct people leadership and team development.
- Regional Landscape Knowledge: Broad understanding of the regulatory environment and healthcare systems across Southern Africa.
- Mobility: Ability to travel both nationally and internationally to engage with regional and global stakeholders.

Let’s build a workplace that prioritises your wellbeing.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Sales Manager (Diabetes Care)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Sales Manager executes the commercial strategy within their assigned geographical region. This role involves actively promoting products to current and potential prescribers and influencers to achieve sales targets. The Sales Manager co-creates commercial strategies, shares best practices locally and globally, and collaborates with Marketing on KOL management, product promotion, and competitive analysis.

Your Impact:

Business Development:

• Cultivate new and existing customer relationships to achieve sales KPIs, including a minimum of 12 daily visits, timely plan updates, and meeting all sales targets. Ensure all interactions and time allocations are accurately documented in the CRM system.

• Identify commercial process limitations and propose solutions to relevant stakeholders; co-lead the implementation of these improvements.

• Prioritize new opportunities across the entire portfolio and continue the activation of blood glucose meters and related services.

• Maintain existing and develop potential customer base

• Analyze customer needs, competition, and regulatory shifts to identify market opportunities and threats. Recommend and implement measures to achieve objectives in collaboration with commercial teams.

Controlling and Reporting:

• Report activities, sales plan progress, and target achievements in Salesforce/REXIS to commercial management.

• Provide regular feedback on product quality, customer satisfaction, and profitability through benchmarking and analysis.

• Document all interactions with HCPs and HCOs in compliance with DIA Symphony, Roche Code of Conduct, internal policies, and local regulations.

Adherence to Compliance Policies and Company Operating Standards:

• Complete administrative tasks, including call reports and expenses, within standard deadlines.

• Ensure that financial responsibilities are correctly managed, including expense compliance, sponsorship budget and FOC meter budget.

• Ensure that all relevant Company policies and procedures are understood and adhered to.

• Maintain confidence in the confidential information, management of document accuracy.

Dia Symphony adherence:

• Adhere to Roche Directives regarding the differentiation of Medical and Commercial functions (Standard 61) and maintain effective cross-functional collaboration.

• Any off-label promotion of Roche products is strictly prohibited, above mentioned products always refer to on-label products

• Ensure compliance with Roche Group Code of Conduct and all other local laws, company policies and regulations

• Pass mandatory trainings related to behavior in business, compliance, quality, regulatory.

External and Internal collaboration:

• Foster a positive organizational culture and collaborate with stakeholders across all levels to share best practices and knowledge.

• Increase knowledge and best practice sharing through networking and connecting experts and talents

• Focus on efficiency, performance

• Ensure effective information flow and cooperate with other departments to optimize procedures and enhance customer satisfaction.

Personal Development and growth:

• Engage in continuous professional upskilling to deepen understanding of Roche products and operating standards.

• Commit to a personal development plan focused on enhancing soft skills and competencies to maintain high performance.

Who you are

• You hold University master's degree in Natural/Life Sciences, Engineering, Business & Economics Project Management. Preferably relation

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Sales Manager esegue la strategia commerciale all'interno della loro regione geografica assegnata. Questo ruolo coinvolge attivamente la promozione dei prodotti ai prescritti e agli influencer attuali e potenziali per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita. Il Sales Manager co-crea strategie commerciali, condivide le migliori pratiche a livello locale e globale, e collabora con Marketing sulla gestione KOL, la promozione dei prodotti e l'analisi competitiva. Il tuo impatto: Sviluppo aziendale:
• Coltivare nuove e esistenti relazioni con i clienti per raggiungere i KPI di vendita, tra cui un minimo di 12 visite giornaliere, aggiornamenti tempestivi del piano e soddisfare tutti gli obiettivi di vendita. Assicurarsi che tutte le interazioni e le allocazioni di tempo siano documentate con precisione nel sistema CRM.
• Identificare le limitazioni dei processi commerciali e proporre soluzioni alle parti interessate pertinenti; co-perare l'attuazione di tali miglioramenti.
• Priorizzare nuove opportunità in tutto il portafoglio e continuare l'attivazione di contatori di glucosio nel sangue e servizi correlati.
• Mantenere la base clienti esistente e sviluppare potenziali
• Analizzare le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza e i cambiamenti normativi per identificare le opportunità di mercato e le minacce. Raccomandare e attuare misure per raggiungere obiettivi in collaborazione con team commerciali. Controllo e reporting:
• Rapporti le attività, i progressi del piano di vendita e i risultati raggiunti in Salesforce/REXIS alla gestione commerciale.
• Fornisci un feedback regolare sulla qualità del prodotto, sulla soddisfazione del cliente e sulla redditività attraverso il benchmarking e l'analisi.
• Documenta tutte le interazioni con HCP e HCO in conformità con DIA Symphony, Roche Code of Conduct, politiche interne e normative locali. Aderenza alle politiche di conformità e agli standard operativi aziendali:
• Completi compiti amministrativi, inclusi i rapporti di chiamata e le spese, entro scadenze standard.
• Assicurarsi che le responsabilità finanziarie siano correttamente gestite, tra cui la conformità delle spese, il bilancio di sponsorizzazione e il bilancio del misuratore FOC.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali pertinenti sono comprese e aderite.
• Mantenere la fiducia nelle informazioni riservate, la gestione della precisione dei documenti. Aderenza Sinfonica di Dia:
• Direttive Roche per quanto riguarda la differenziazione delle funzioni mediche e commerciali (Standard 61) e mantenere un'efficace collaborazione interfunzionale.
• Qualsiasi promozione off-label dei prodotti Roche è severamente vietata, i prodotti sopra menzionati si riferiscono sempre ai prodotti on-label
• Assicurarsi il rispetto del Codice di condotta del Gruppo Roche e di tutte le altre leggi locali, politiche aziendali e regolamenti
• Passare formazioni obbligatorie relative al comportamento in affari, conformità, qualità, regolazione. Collaborazione esterna e interna:
• Promuovere una cultura organizzativa positiva e collaborare con gli stakeholder di tutti i livelli per condividere le migliori pratiche e conoscenze.
• Aumentare la conoscenza e la migliore condivisione delle pratiche attraverso il networking e la connessione di esperti e talenti
• Focus su efficienza, prestazioni
• Assicurare un flusso di informazioni efficace e collaborare con altri dipartimenti per ottimizzare le procedure e migliorare la soddisfazione del cliente. Sviluppo personale e crescita:
• Impegnarsi in continuo aggiornamento professionale per approfondire la comprensione dei prodotti Roche e degli standard operativi.
• Impegnarsi a un piano di sviluppo personale mirato a migliorare le competenze e le competenze morbide per mantenere alte prestazioni. Chi sei
• Hai conseguito la laurea in Scienze naturali/vita, Ingegneria, Business & Economics Project Management. Preferito rapporto

The Sales Manager executes the commercial strategy within their assigned geographical region. Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Interaktionen und Zeitzuweisungen im CRM-System genau dokumentiert sind.

• Pflegen Sie bestehende und potenzielle Kundenbasis
• Analysieren Sie Kundenbedürfnisse, Wettbewerb und regulatorische Veränderungen, um Marktchancen und -bedrohungen zu identifizieren. Empfehlen und implementieren Sie Maßnahmen, um Ziele in Zusammenarbeit mit kommerziellen Teams zu erreichen. Controlling und Reporting:

• Halten Sie das Vertrauen in die vertraulichen Informationen, Verwaltung der Dokumentgenauigkeit. Einhaltung von Dia Symphony:

• Engagieren Sie sich in einer kontinuierlichen beruflichen Weiterbildung, um das Verständnis der Roche-Produkte und Betriebsnormen zu vertiefen.
• Verpflichten Sie sich zu einem persönlichen Entwicklungsplan, der sich auf die Verbesserung von Soft Skills und Kompetenzen konzentriert, um eine hohe Leistung zu gewährleisten. Wer du bist

jobs.title: Technical Customer Experience Manager, Sequencing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities.
We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

Roche Sequencing & Life Sciences is seeking a Technical Customer Experience Manager, Sequencing to join its Support & Applications Team in Wilmington, MA . This highly-experienced individual will leverage a blend of technical expertise, customer-centricity, and program management skills to drive impactful customer engagements on behalf of the Sequencing Support organization. This individual will help shape and facilitate customer visits to the Wilmington site for product demonstrations, showcasing the product portfolio, including KAPA DNA and RNA Library Prep chemistries and Roche’s groundbreaking Sequencing by Expansion (SBX) technology on the AXELIOS 1 System.

The successful candidate will coordinate feasibility studies and proof-of-concept experiments while serving as a vital conduit for customer feedback between local and global stakeholders. In addition, the Customer Experience Manager will play a critical role in orchestrating efforts for customer implementations, HyperCare activities, internal and external training events, ultimately liaising with Support functions and local and global business teams to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and team readiness. As the program grows, this individual will continue to enable and influence other Support Leaders, while simultaneously building a team to support these efforts.

The Opportunity:

This on-site position is located in Wilmington, MA . The successful candidate will report to the Director of Support & Applications and have responsibilities that include, but are not limited to:

• Strategic Customer Experience Leadership: Define and strategically lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance the end-to-end customer experience, ensuring alignment between customer interests and business objectives.

• Implementation and Feedback Conduit: Act as the primary liaison between technical teams (Support & Applications) and internal stakeholders (Sales, Digital Solutions, Commercial Project Management Office) to support successful customer implementations and capture critical service experience feedback for local and global teams.

• Escalation Management: Efficiently manage and maintain visibility for key stakeholders regarding all customer implementation-related escalations.

• Stakeholder Advocacy: Ensure customer perspectives are clearly articulated and addressed by business leaders to drive continuous improvement in product and service delivery.

• Wilmington Site Program Management: Serve as the central point of contact for Sales and Marketing concerning all customer visits to the Wilmington, MA site, managing all logistics for post-sales training, pro

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. Roche Sequencing & Life Sciences est à la recherche d'un responsable de l'expérience client technique, Sequencing, pour rejoindre son équipe Support & Applications à Wilmington, MA . Cette personne hautement expérimentée tirera parti d'un mélange d'expertise technique, de centricité client et de compétences en gestion de programme pour stimuler des engagements de clients influents au nom de l'organisation Sequencing Support. Cette personne aidera à façonner et à faciliter les visites des clients sur le site de Wilmington pour des démonstrations de produits, en mettant en valeur le portefeuille de produits, y compris les produits KAPA DNA et RNA Library Prep chimistries et Roches, séquençage révolutionnaire par expansion (SBX) sur le système AXELIOS 1. Le candidat retenu coordonnera les études de faisabilité et les expériences de validation de concept tout en servant de canal vital pour la rétroaction des clients entre les intervenants locaux et mondiaux. En outre, le gestionnaire d'expérience client jouera un rôle crucial dans l'orchestration des efforts pour les implémentations client, les activités HyperCare, les formations internes et externes, en liaison avec les fonctions de support et les équipes d'affaires locales et mondiales pour assurer un haut niveau de satisfaction client et de préparation de l'équipe. Au fur et à mesure que le programme augmentera, cette personne continuera de permettre et d'influencer d'autres leaders de soutien, tout en constituant une équipe pour appuyer ces efforts. La possibilité : Cette position sur place est située à Wilmington, MA . Le candidat retenu relèvera du directeur de l'appui et des demandes et aura des responsabilités qui comprennent, sans s'y limiter :
• Leadership stratégique de l'expérience client : Définir et diriger stratégiquement des initiatives interfonctionnelles pour améliorer l'expérience client de bout en bout, en assurant l'alignement entre les intérêts des clients et les objectifs opérationnels.
• Conduit de mise en oeuvre et de rétroaction : Agir comme principale liaison entre les équipes techniques (soutien et applications) et les intervenants internes (ventes, solutions numériques, bureau de gestion de projet commercial) pour soutenir la mise en oeuvre réussie des clients et recueillir les commentaires sur l'expérience de service critique pour les équipes locales et mondiales.
• Gestion de l'escalation : Gérer et maintenir efficacement la visibilité des principaux intervenants concernant toutes les escalades liées à la mise en œuvre par les clients.
• Plaidoyer des intervenants : Veiller à ce que les points de vue des clients soient clairement formulés et pris en compte par les chefs d'entreprise afin d'améliorer continuellement la prestation des produits et des services.
• Wilmington Gestion de programme de site: Servir de point de contact central pour les ventes et le marketing concernant toutes les visites des clients sur le site Wilmington, MA, gérer toute la logistique pour la formation post-vente, pro

jobs.title: Sales Specialist Core Lab - Cataluña
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Specialty , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

• Formación: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en el ámbito de la docencia/formación técnica.

• Apertura al Talento Diverso: En Roche creemos en el valor de las perspectivas únicas; por ello, también valoraremos aquellos perfiles que, aun no cumpliendo estrictamente con la formación o experiencia técnica tradicional, aporten un trasfondo comercial relevante y diferencial para la organización.

• Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad estratégica y habilidad técnica y de negocio para navegar en entornos hospitalarios complejos.

• Orientación a la consecución de resultados , con autonomía y toma de decisiones ágiles.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación , con capacidad de inspiración e influencia .

• Mentalidad colaborativa, fuerte orientación al trabajo en equipo y apertura para dar y recibir feedback y coaching .

• Un perfil promotor de la innovación y con competencias sólidas en gestión del cambio para acompañar al cliente en su transformación digital y organizativa.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español y catalán; se valorarán conocimientos de inglés .

• Ubicación : Barcelona y alrededores.

What is here for You?

• Propósito Elevado: Trabajar en una compañía líder donde tu actividad diaria imp

titleByLocale.it: Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Service AI
titleByLocale.fr: Propriétaire de produit technique - Service AI

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Service AI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to helping shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche with cutting-edge digital technologies by harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter to millions of patients worldwide.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

As the Technical Product Owner for the DIA Commercial Customer Service Product, you will operate at the intersection of complex systems engineering and strategic commercial outcomes. You will own the technical vision, architectural coherence, and feature backlog for the platforms that enable our commercial customer service ecosystem. Acting as the definitive bridge between Business Product Owners, engineering squads, Managed Service Providers (MSPs), and enterprise architecture, you will translate high-level business priorities into precise, scalable, secure, and compliant technical implementations.

Communication is essential, and effective expectation management is a must. This role requires an understanding of AI fundamentals and a demonstrated ability to learn quickly and to deep-dive when necessary, with a focus on maximizing business value and outcomes.

The Opportunity
In this role, you will be responsible for:

• Outcome Accountability & Execution: Own the product backlog for assigned systems, prioritizing features and operational needs based on business value and compliance. You will be accountable for backlog execution in accordance with CSV and best QA practices, including adherence to AI-specific data privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements. Actively champion high-value work and challenge low-impact efforts.

• Architecture & Non-Functional Excellence: Proactively ensure all solutions adhere to established architectural patterns, enterprise technology strategies, and non-functional expectations (performance, reliability, scalability).

• Business Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Owners to align technical execution with commercial objectives, translating functional customer service needs into robust technical realities. Provides clear direction to achieve goals and objectives. Operates at a DIA Customer Service level, directly impacting the growth and engagement of all involved team members and resources. Collaborate in the matrix environment across various RDT stakeholders.

• System Ownership & Governance: Serve as the accountable System Owner, ensuring applications remain fit-for-purpose, secure, and fully compliant with IT governance throughout their lifecycle. Closely partners with the DIA Commercial AI workstream to ensure alignment of Service AI initiatives with broader Commercial AI strategy. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to look beyond a traditional job title and focus on where you can have the most profound impact on patient safety?

As a Central Operations Lead within our Patient Safety Operations team, you will use your deep pharmacovigilance expertise to shape how safety data is processed and reported globally. You will join a forward-thinking environment where we actively connect people, processes, and data to ensure the highest standards of quality and regulatory compliance.

In this pivotal role, you will champion a quality mindset, driving proactive process improvements and leading complex initiatives with diverse stakeholders. From navigating rapidly evolving regulations to embracing cutting-edge tools like artificial intelligence with 'humans in the loop,' your insights will directly influence how we understand and communicate product benefit-risk profiles to protect patients worldwide.

• Oversee Service Providers: Drive effective relationship management and use data-driven metrics to oversee external partners executing ICSR tasks and Medical Device reports.

• Provide Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a trusted advisor, sharing your deep technical knowledge with internal colleagues, service providers, business partners, auditors, and regulatory inspectors.

• Lead Continuous Improvement: Proactively conduct comprehensive process reviews to design, co-create, and implement strategic process improvements and simplify workflows.

• Manage Compliance & Risks: Identify root causes of non-compliance to design and implement robust Corrective Actions and Preventative Actions (CAPAs), while transparently escalating risks to the BPO/GPO network.

• Evaluate Regulatory Impact: Conduct thorough impact assessments of new or updated international regulatory requirements across your assigned topics.

• Drive Complex Initiatives: Formulate and lead complex, time-pressured projects, collaborating across virtual and co-located matrix teams to meet customer needs.

Who You Are

• Pharmacovigilance Expertise: Deep knowledge of international regulations (such as ICH, EU GVP Modules, and FDA) and a solid understanding of the broader pharmaceutical industry and personalized healthcare environment.

• ICSR & Case Processing Knowledge: Profound, end-to-end knowledge of ICSR case processing, regulations, and stakeholder expectations.

• Proven Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading complex, fast-paced initiatives while managing a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders.

• Analytical Problem-Solving: A clear history of independent decision-making, issue containment, and risk mitigation.

• Flexible Learning Mindset: An undergraduate degree or equivalent on-the-job pharmacovigilance experience, alongside a passion for exploring new digital tools and regulations.

• Desirable Experience: Prior experience or knowledge handling Medical Device processing is highly advantageous.

Please note that this is a fixed term (12 month) CONTRACTOR/CONTINGENT POSITION. You will be employed by our 3rd party service provider.

Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics pro

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, über eine traditionelle Berufsbezeichnung hinauszuschauen und sich darauf zu konzentrieren, wo Sie den größten Einfluss auf die Patientensicherheit haben können? Als Central Operations Lead in unserem Team für Patientensicherheit nutzen Sie Ihre umfassende Pharmakovigilanz-Expertise, um die Verarbeitung und Meldung von Sicherheitsdaten weltweit zu gestalten. Sie treten in ein zukunftsorientiertes Umfeld ein, in dem wir Menschen, Prozesse und Daten aktiv miteinander verbinden, um höchste Qualitäts- und Compliance-Standards zu gewährleisten. In dieser zentralen Rolle verfechten Sie eine qualitativ hochwertige Denkweise, fördern proaktive Prozessverbesserungen und leiten komplexe Initiativen mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern. Von der Navigation durch sich schnell entwickelnde Vorschriften bis hin zur Nutzung modernster Werkzeuge wie künstlicher Intelligenz mit "Menschen in der Schleife" werden Ihre Erkenntnisse direkt beeinflussen, wie wir Produktnutzen-Risiko-Profile verstehen und kommunizieren, um Patienten weltweit zu schützen.
• Oversee-Dienstleister: Führen Sie ein effektives Beziehungsmanagement durch und verwenden Sie datengesteuerte Metriken, um externe Partner bei der Ausführung von ICSR-Aufgaben und Berichten über medizinische Geräte zu überwachen.
• Geben Sie Fachkompetenz: Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater und teilen Sie Ihr fundiertes technisches Wissen mit internen Kollegen, Dienstleistern, Geschäftspartnern, Auditoren und Regulierungsinspektoren.
• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen: Führen Sie proaktiv umfassende Prozessüberprüfungen durch, um strategische Prozessverbesserungen zu entwerfen, gemeinsam zu erstellen und zu implementieren und Workflows zu vereinfachen.
• Manage Compliance & Risks: Identifizieren Sie die Ursachen der Nichteinhaltung, um robuste Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen (CAPAs) zu entwerfen und zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Risiken für das BPO/GPO-Netzwerk transparent zu erhöhen.
• Bewerten Sie regulatorische Auswirkungen: Führen Sie gründliche Folgenabschätzungen neuer oder aktualisierter internationaler regulatorischer Anforderungen für Ihre zugewiesenen Themen durch.
• Komplexe Initiativen vorantreiben: Formulieren und leiten Sie komplexe, unter Zeitdruck stehende Projekte und arbeiten Sie mit virtuellen und co-lokalisierten Matrixteams zusammen, um die Kundenbedürfnisse zu erfüllen. Wer du bist
• Pharmakovigilanz-Expertise: Tiefes Wissen über internationale Vorschriften (wie ICH, EU GVP Module und FDA) und ein solides Verständnis der breiteren Pharmaindustrie und des personalisierten Gesundheitswesens.
• ICSR & Case Processing Knowledge: Umfassendes, umfassendes Wissen über ICSR-Fallbearbeitung, Vorschriften und Stakeholder-Erwartungen.
• Bewährte Projektführung: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Leitung komplexer, schnelllebiger Initiativen bei der Verwaltung einer Vielzahl von funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern.
• Analytische Problemlösung: Eine klare Geschichte der unabhängigen Entscheidungsfindung, Problemeindämmung und Risikominderung.
• Flexible Learning Mindset: Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige Pharmakovigilanz-Erfahrung am Arbeitsplatz sowie eine Leidenschaft für die Erforschung neuer digitaler Tools und Vorschriften.
• Wünschenswerte Erfahrung: Vorkenntnisse oder Kenntnisse im Umgang mit der Verarbeitung von Medizinprodukten sind sehr vorteilhaft. Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine feste Laufzeit (12 Monate) AUFTRAGNEHMER / CONTINGENT POSITION ist. Sie werden bei unserem 3rd-Party-Dienstleister beschäftigt. Standort: Diese Position hat ihren Sitz in Budapest. Relocation Assistance ist nicht verfügbar Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unserem Diagnostics pro durchgeführt werden

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à regarder au-delà d'un titre d'emploi traditionnel et à vous concentrer sur l'endroit où vous pouvez avoir l'impact le plus profond sur la sécurité des patients? En tant que responsable des opérations centrales au sein de notre équipe des opérations de sécurité des patients, vous utiliserez votre expertise en pharmacovigilance profonde pour façonner la façon dont les données sur l'innocuité sont traitées et déclarées à l'échelle mondiale. Vous rejoindrez un environnement d'avant-garde où nous raccordons activement les personnes, les processus et les données pour assurer les normes les plus élevées de qualité et de conformité réglementaire. Dans ce rôle central, vous allez défendre un état d'esprit de qualité, conduire des améliorations proactives des processus et diriger des initiatives complexes avec divers intervenants. De la navigation à l'évolution rapide de la réglementation à l'adoption d'outils de pointe comme l'intelligence artificielle avec des « humains en boucle », vos idées influeront directement sur la façon dont nous comprenons et communiquons les profils avantages-risques des produits pour protéger les patients dans le monde entier.
• Superviser les fournisseurs de services : Mener une gestion efficace des relations et utiliser des paramètres fondés sur les données pour superviser les partenaires externes qui exécutent les tâches du CISR et les rapports sur les matériels médicaux.
• Fournir une expertise en la matière : agir en tant que conseiller de confiance, partager vos connaissances techniques approfondies avec des collègues internes, des fournisseurs de services, des partenaires commerciaux, des vérificateurs et des inspecteurs réglementaires.
• Diriger l'amélioration continue : Effectuer de façon proactive des examens exhaustifs des processus pour concevoir, cocréer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations des processus stratégiques et simplifier les flux de travail.
• Gérer la conformité et les risques : Déterminer les causes profondes de la non-conformité pour concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives et des mesures préventives robustes, tout en augmentant les risques pour le réseau BPO/BPO.
• Évaluer l'impact de la réglementation : Effectuer des évaluations d'impact approfondies des exigences réglementaires internationales nouvelles ou mises à jour pour tous les sujets qui vous sont assignés.
• Lancer des initiatives complexes : Formuler et diriger des projets complexes et pressés dans le temps, en collaborant avec des équipes matricielles virtuelles et colocalisées pour répondre aux besoins des clients. Qui vous êtes
• Expertise en pharmacovigilance: Connaissance approfondie de la réglementation internationale (comme les modules ICH, GVP de l'UE et FDA) et une compréhension solide de l'industrie pharmaceutique et de l'environnement de santé personnalisé.
• Connaissances du CISR et du traitement des cas : Connaissances profondes, de bout en bout, du traitement des cas du CISR, des règlements et des attentes des intervenants.
• Leadership de projet éprouvé : Expérience démontrée menant des initiatives complexes et rapides tout en gérant un large éventail d'intervenants interfonctionnels.
• Analyse de la résolution des problèmes : Un historique clair de prise de décision indépendante, de confinement des problèmes et d'atténuation des risques.
• Flexible Learning Mindset : Un diplôme de premier cycle ou une expérience de pharmacovigilance équivalente en cours d'emploi, parallèlement à une passion pour explorer de nouveaux outils et règlements numériques.
• Expérience souhaitable : Expérience préalable ou manipulation des connaissances Le traitement des instruments médicaux est très avantageux. Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'une période déterminée (12 mois) POSITION CONTRACTANTE/CONTINENTE. Vous serez employé par notre prestataire de services tiers. Lieu: Cette position est basée à Budapest. L'aide à la réinstallation n'est pas disponible Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.title: Central Operations Specialist (PV, Pharmacovigilance)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in transforming how patient safety data is delivered globally?

As our Central Operations Specialist within Patient Safety Operations , you will be at the heart of our mission to ensure the efficient, high-quality, and compliant delivery of safety data outputs. You will process and report Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and device safety reports, via the utilisation of current/future safety systems, and use of vendor services, and co-develop innovative approaches for the transformation and reporting of wider types of safety-relevant data, beyond ICSRs.

In this dynamic role, you will collaborate closely with global vendors, business process owners, and cross-functional teams to maintain our inspection readiness and drive continuous improvements. You will have the unique opportunity to support change initiatives, explore cutting-edge technologies like artificial intelligence in pharmacovigilance, and guide our operations to meet both current and future regulatory requirements.

• Oversee Safety Data Quality: Monitor workload, compliance, and quality across the global ICSR footprint to ensure internal and external performance standards are consistently met.

• Manage Vendor & Process Collaboration: Support the oversight, coordination, and inspection readiness of ICSR and medical device safety activities in collaboration with external vendors and internal alliance managers.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Develop, maintain, and review metrics and KPIs to identify and execute process enhancements within safety reporting sub-processes.

• Lead AI & Innovation Initiatives: Support the implementation of AI-augmented activities and human-in-the-loop interventions to optimize operational safety report delivery.

• Provide Governance & Subject Matter Expertise: Act as a key point of contact for queries and issue escalations, supporting Case Processing Governance across Patient Safety Operations sites.

• Support Regulatory Reporting Projects: Execute and coordinate regulatory reporting projects for Roche products by preparing documentation and ensuring adherence to established quality standards.

Who You Are

• Industry Experience: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably with an emphasis on pharmacovigilance.

• PV Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of global Pharmacovigilance regulatory obligations and compliance standards.

• Project & Conflict Management: Proven ability to support or lead projects to a successful conclusion while demonstrating strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

• Agile Mindset: Comfort working in a matrix environment, actively participating in or leading agile squads and sprints to deliver on business strategies.

• Educational Background: A minimum of a degree-level qualification in a scientific or relevant field.

This position is based in Budapest, Hungary. Relocation Assistance is not available.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make

jobs.title: Senior Statistician
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Statistician

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
This role is within Biostatistics, a core function within Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) that provides strategic leadership and scientific rigor across Development at Roche. Biostatistics identifies opportunities to apply the full breadth of data, digital, and design capabilities to deploy innovative methods across PDD, PD and the broader Roche Pharma organization.
As trusted analytical partners in end-to-end drug development, Biostatistics leverages data to drive scientifically rigorous programmatic decisions across Roche’s Development portfolio; Biostatistics designs robust trials and analysis plans that increase the probability of technical success, accelerating timelines to advance Roche’s clinical pipeline and promote regulatory success — ultimately bringing medicines to our patients faster.

The Opportunity:

The Statistician is a key member of the cross-functional study or molecule team, responsible for applying statistical expertise to the design, conduct, analysis, and interpretation of individual clinical trials. This role ensures the scientific rigor and regulatory compliance of the study by contributing to protocol development, authoring statistical analysis plans, performing or overseeing data analyses, and supporting the interpretation and communication of results. The Statistician plays a critical role in ensuring that each study generates robust, meaningful data to support decision-making and regulatory submissions.

• You independently lead statistical input into clinical trial design, aligning with scientific objectives

• You own the development and quality review of statistical study documents

• You design and execute complex analyses, proactively resolving challenges

• You represent Biostatistics and PDD at the Study Team level, ensuring statistical and scientific rigor of study deliverables

• You collaborate proactively with cross-functional teams to align deliverables and timelines

• You interpret and communicate results in context, influencing study-level decisions

• You lead statistical contributions to CSRs and selected regulatory documents

• You provide functional guidance and informal mentoring to less experienced statisticians

• You may lead or influence study-level projects or contribute significantly to large project teams or initiatives

Who You Are:

• You hold an MSc or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a closely related quantitative field

• You have a confirmed experience in clinical trial statistics within a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO setting

• You have demonstrated experience contributing to the design, analysis, and interpretation of clinical studies across different phases

• You have a solid understanding of regulatory expectations and statistical methodologies for clinical development

• You are proficient in SAS and/or R and familiar with CDISC standards

• You are able to work autonomously while collaborating effectively in cross-functional teams

• You demonstrate capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles

• You bring excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond the te

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Statistici senior Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Questo ruolo è all'interno di Biostatistics, una funzione fondamentale all'interno di Product Development Data Science and Analytics (PDD) che fornisce leadership strategica e rigore scientifico attraverso lo sviluppo a Roche. La biostatistica identifica le opportunità di applicare la larghezza completa delle capacità di dati, digitali e di progettazione per implementare metodi innovativi attraverso PDD, PD e l'organizzazione Roche Pharma più ampia. Come partner analitici di fiducia nello sviluppo di droga end-to-end, Biostatistics sfrutta i dati per guidare le decisioni programmatiche scientificamente rigorose in tutto il portafoglio di sviluppo di Roche; Biostatistics progetta studi e piani di analisi robusti che aumentano la probabilità di successo tecnico, accelerando le linee temporali per avanzare la pipeline clinica di Roche e promuovere il successo normativo - alla fine portando i farmaci ai nostri pazienti più velocemente. L'opportunità: Lo statististico è un membro chiave del team di studio o molecola multifunzione, responsabile dell'applicazione di competenze statistiche alla progettazione, alla conduzione, all'analisi e all'interpretazione di singoli studi clinici. Questo ruolo garantisce il rigore scientifico e la conformità normativa dello studio contribuendo allo sviluppo del protocollo, autorizzando piani di analisi statistica, eseguendo o supervisionando analisi dei dati, e sostenendo l'interpretazione e la comunicazione dei risultati. Lo statististico svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che ogni studio genera dati robusti e significativi per supportare il processo decisionale e le sottomissioni normative.
• Condurre in modo indipendente l'ingresso statistico nella progettazione clinica di prova, allineando con gli obiettivi scientifici
• Lei possiede lo sviluppo e la revisione di qualità dei documenti di studio statistico
• Progettare ed eseguire analisi complesse, risolvendo proattivamente le sfide
• Tu rappresenti Biostatistica e PDD a livello del Team di Studio, garantendo rigore statistico e scientifico dei risultati di studio
• Collabori in modo proattivo con i team interfunzionali per allineare le consegne e le tempistiche
• Interpreti e comunichi i risultati nel contesto, influenzando le decisioni a livello di studio
• Conduci contributi statistici alla RSI e ai documenti regolamentari selezionati
• Fornisci una guida funzionale e un mentore informale agli statistici meno esperti
• È possibile condurre o influenzare progetti a livello di studio o contribuire in modo significativo a grandi team di progetto o iniziative Chi sei?
• Hai un MSc o un dottorato in Statistica, Biostatistica, o un campo quantitativo strettamente correlato
• Hai un'esperienza confermata nelle statistiche di sperimentazione clinica all'interno di un'impostazione farmaceutica, biotecnologia o CRO
• Hai dimostrato esperienza contribuendo alla progettazione, analisi e interpretazione di studi clinici in diverse fasi
• Hai una solida comprensione delle aspettative normative e delle metodologie statistiche per lo sviluppo clinico
• Sei esperto in SAS e/o R e conosci gli standard CDISC
• Siete in grado di lavorare autonomamente mentre collaborate efficacemente in team interfunzionali
• Lei dimostra capacità di pensiero indipendente e capacità di prendere decisioni basate su principi sani
• Porti un'eccellente agilità strategica tra cui capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico, e agilità che si estende oltre il te
