Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le Formulateur de fabrication senior collabore à la production de produits et de fournitures d'instruments médicaux fiables avec des opérations efficaces dans une organisation habilitée. Dans le cadre d'une équipe dynamique, les Formulateurs de fabrication seniors assument les responsabilités suivantes : effectuer des tests de pesée, de mélange et de procédé des réactifs chimiques dans un environnement réglementé, par le traitement ou l'exploitation manuelles de l'équipement automatisé. De plus, un Formulateur de fabrication senior appuie la production en reconnaissant de façon proactive et en élevant les questions de sécurité, d'équipement et de produits, contribuant ainsi à la réalisation des objectifs de production. Ils utilisent des logiciels validés pour maintenir les processus, les registres de lots et le contrôle des stocks, en veillant à ce que toute la documentation liée à la production soit conforme aux règlements du système de qualité. Ils sont responsables de la formation des nouveaux employés, de l'échange des pratiques exemplaires et du fait que les membres de l'équipe sont qualifiés pour effectuer le travail. Un formateur de fabrication senior influence, motive et fournit des conseils aux membres de l'équipe, sert de chef de processus de soutien, communique et collabore avec le leadership au besoin. Ils possèdent également d'excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation, ainsi que la capacité d'identifier les occasions de faire avancer l'entreprise tout en respectant les processus et les objectifs de qualité. Il s'agit d'un poste essentiel qui appuie les objectifs organisationnels exigeant une présence le week-end, les jours fériés et pendant les situations d'urgence ou les conditions exceptionnelles. Production
• Agit en tant qu'expert en matière de formulation et de production de stocks et de solutions en vrac en effectuant des calculs, en remplissant les demandes de matériel et les transactions et en utilisant du matériel de laboratoire dans les zones contrôlées.
• Identifie les améliorations au fur et à mesure que le travail est effectué pour améliorer le temps de cycle, la qualité, la sécurité et la livraison des produits.
• Exécute des essais en cours de fabrication de réactifs tels que détaillés dans les formules de fabrication, les dépannages et élabore des procédures d'exploitation normalisées.
• Soutient les membres de l'équipe avec des vérifications, y compris les concentrations/titres, le dégagement de la ligne et la fermeture de la ligne.
• Remplir les réservations en vérifiant proactivement les réservations ouvertes, en demandant du matériel, en tirant du matériel aliquot et en étiquetant correctement le matériel.
• Effectue la planification, la saisie et l'exécution des validations, des protocoles et des recherches scientifiques. Lance et dirige des projets d'amélioration des processus.
• Contribue au calendrier de fabrication en soutenant au moins 3 lignes de réactif (détection, moléculaire, taches spéciales, anticorps, réactifs en vrac).
• Fonctionne en tant que gestionnaire de sujets expert dans les systèmes de production validés dans le cadre de la documentation de fabrication et de la gestion des stocks.
• Communique et collabore avec les équipes de planification, de contrôle de la qualité, de transport du matériel et d'autres équipes de production pour accélérer le travail.
• Partenaires avec le processus Diriger la compréhension et l'exécution du calendrier de production; S'assurer que les rapports de fin de travail quotidiens/dépassements sont terminés pour assurer une bonne communication et des synergies entre les équipes et les équipes.
• Aide à l'examen des dossiers de lots. Sécurité et qualité
• Maintient le droit de fonctionner et veille à ce que tous les processus soient exécutés de manière sécuritaire et saine; S'attaque aux dangers potentiellement dangereux et les augmente; Veiller à ce que la déclaration des dangers, des incidents et des quasi-incidents de sécurité soit faite en temps opportun au moyen d'outils de déclaration de la sécurité.
• Reconnaît et lance des projets d'amélioration de la sécurité, communique et collabore avec le groupe et le leadership de la SHE pour les mettre en oeuvre.
• S'assurer que la vérification est prête (OSHA, NMPA, FDA, etc.);

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Manufacturing Operator contributes to producing reliable products and supplies with effective operations in an empowered organization. As part of a dynamic team, the Manufacturing Operator is responsible for collaborating with their team to operate automated equipment and systems to perform a wide variety of complex tasks related to assembly, printing, filling, and kitpack manufacturing operations.
Recognizes and elevates safety, equipment, and product problems, contributing to the achievement of production goals. Utilizes validated software and systems to maintain processes, batch records, and inventory control. Ensures all production-related documentation is in compliance with quality system regulations. May be responsible for low complexity training of new employees and sharing best practices.
They must have good communication and organizational skills and the ability to identify opportunities that would drive the business forward.

This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays, and during emergency or exceptional conditions.

Responsibilities:

Production
◦ Executes the process of assembly, filling, labeling & packaging equipment of varying complexity and in accordance with production manufacturing records, operating procedure requirements to produce finished intermediates and final kits while meeting production targets.
◦ Performs basic transactions within highly complex systems and controls in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., receive, process, build product/materials, facilitate material availability, SA transactions/confirmations).
◦ Runs automated systems/equipment and sequences of operation, including: equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; monitoring and performing basic troubleshooting.
◦ Participates in the execution of protocol/validations.
◦ Maintains the ability to be a subject matter expert (SME) in one or more areas of production.
◦ Contributes to daily end-of-shift reports and pass-downs.

Safety and Quality
◦ Maintains Right to Operate and ensures that all processes are performed in a safe and healthy manner.
Addresses and escalates any potentially unsafe hazards; Provides feedback during the investigation of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses using safety reporting tools.
◦ Performs tasks/transactions in the quality system to ensure we achieve our quality objectives.
◦ Understands the expectations of audit readiness (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO, etc.); may be required to answer questions about processes on the spot.
◦ Maintains accurate and complete system transactions, ensuring material traceability and inventory accuracy (e.g., receipt, storage, issuance of materials, and other inventory transactions).
◦ Provides feedback on NCR investigations, reworks, and corrective actions.
◦ Adheres to 95% or above internal training compliance

Continuous Improvement
◦ Performs 6S activities, gathers/meets cycle times and develops/follows standard work; identifies and implements process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing lean tools.
◦ Participates and contributes in tier meetings.
◦ May participate in the collection of data for daily metrics purposes and to support operational excellence initiatives and improvements.

Teamwork and Collaboration
◦ Proactively collaborates with peers in other shifts/functions to ensure daily targets are achieved.
◦ Assists in the successful onboarding of new employees and contractors.
• Other duties as assign

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Manufacturing Operator contribuisce a produrre prodotti e forniture affidabili con operazioni efficaci in un'organizzazione potenziata. Nell'ambito di un team dinamico, il Manufacturing Operator è responsabile della collaborazione con il proprio team per l'utilizzo di apparecchiature e sistemi automatizzati per svolgere una vasta gamma di compiti complessi relativi alle operazioni di montaggio, stampa, riempimento e produzione di kitpack. Riconosce ed eleva sicurezza, attrezzature e problemi di prodotto, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di produzione. Utilizza software e sistemi convalidati per mantenere processi, record di lotti e controllo dell'inventario. Assicura che tutta la documentazione relativa alla produzione sia conforme alle normative del sistema di qualità. Può essere responsabile della formazione a bassa complessità di nuovi dipendenti e della condivisione delle migliori pratiche. Essi devono avere una buona comunicazione e capacità organizzative e la capacità di identificare le opportunità che spingerebbero il business avanti. Si tratta di una posizione essenziale che sostiene gli obiettivi organizzativi che richiedono la partecipazione nei fine settimana, nei giorni festivi e in caso di emergenza o condizioni eccezionali. Responsabilità: Produzione Esecuzione del processo di assemblaggio, riempimento, etichettatura e confezionamento di varie complessità e in conformità con i record di produzione, requisiti di procedura di funzionamento per produrre intermedi e kit finali finiti durante il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di produzione. Esegue operazioni di base all'interno di sistemi e controlli altamente complessi in un ambiente di produzione regolamentato (ad esempio, ricevere, elaborare, costruire prodotti/materiali, facilitare la disponibilità dei materiali, transazioni SA/confermazioni). Esegue sistemi/attrezzature automatizzate e sequenze di funzionamento, tra cui: installazione delle attrezzature, funzionamento e pulizia; monitoraggio ed esecuzione dei problemi di base. ◦ Partecipa all'esecuzione di protocolli/validazioni. ◦ Mantiene la capacità di essere un esperto di materia (SME) in una o più aree di produzione. ◦ Contribuisce ai report e ai pass-down giornalieri. Sicurezza e qualità ◦ Mantiene il diritto di operare e assicura che tutti i processi siano eseguiti in modo sicuro e sano. Indirizzi ed escala eventuali pericoli potenzialmente pericolosi; Fornisce feedback durante l'indagine sui rischi di sicurezza, incidenti e quasi manca utilizzando strumenti di segnalazione della sicurezza. ◦ Esecuzione delle attività/transazioni nel sistema di qualità per garantire il raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi di qualità. Comprende le aspettative della disponibilità di audit (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO, ecc.); può essere richiesto di rispondere a domande sui processi sul posto. Mantiene transazioni di sistema accurate e complete, garantendo la tracciabilità del materiale e l'accuratezza dell'inventario (ad esempio, la ricevuta, lo stoccaggio, l'emissione di materiali e altre transazioni di inventario). ◦ Fornisce feedback sulle indagini NCR, rielaborazioni e azioni correttive. ◦ Aderisce al 95% o al di sopra della conformità della formazione interna Miglioramento continuo ◦ Esegui le attività 6S, raccoglie/meet i tempi di ciclo e sviluppa/segue il lavoro standard; identifica e implementa i miglioramenti del processo e le iniziative di miglioramento continuo che utilizzano gli strumenti magre. ◦ Partecipa e contribuisce in incontri di livello. ◦ Può partecipare alla raccolta dei dati per finalità metriche quotidiane e sostenere iniziative di eccellenza operativa e miglioramenti. Lavoro di squadra e collaborazione ◦ Collabora attivamente con i coetanei in altri turni / funzioni per garantire obiettivi giornalieri sono raggiunti. ◦ Assist nel successo di bordo di nuovi dipendenti e appaltatori.
• Altri compiti da assegnare

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Produktionsbetreiber trägt zur Herstellung zuverlässiger Produkte und Lieferungen mit effektiven Operationen in einer ermächtigten Organisation bei. Als Teil eines dynamischen Teams ist der Fertigungsbetreiber für die Zusammenarbeit mit seinem Team verantwortlich, um automatisierte Geräte und Systeme zu betreiben, um eine Vielzahl komplexer Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit Montage, Druck, Füllung und Kitpack-Fertigung durchzuführen. Erkennt und erhöht Sicherheits-, Ausrüstungs- und Produktprobleme und trägt zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele bei. Verwendet validierte Software und Systeme, um Prozesse, Batch-Datensätze und Bestandskontrolle zu verwalten. Stellt sicher, dass alle produktionsbezogenen Dokumentationen den Vorschriften des Qualitätssystems entsprechen. Kann für die Schulung neuer Mitarbeiter mit geringer Komplexität und den Austausch von Best Practices verantwortlich sein. Sie müssen über gute kommunikations- und organisatorische fähigkeiten verfügen und in der lage sein, möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, die das geschäft voranbringen würden. Dies ist eine wichtige Position, die die organisatorischen Ziele unterstützt, die die Teilnahme an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und bei Notfällen oder außergewöhnlichen Bedingungen erfordern. Zuständigkeiten: Produktion Führt den Prozess der Montage, Füllung, Etikettierung und Verpackung von Geräten unterschiedlicher Komplexität und in Übereinstimmung mit den Produktionsunterlagen, den Betriebsverfahrensanforderungen aus, um fertige Zwischenprodukte und endgültige Kits zu produzieren, während die Produktionsziele erreicht werden. Führt grundlegende Transaktionen in hochkomplexen Systemen und Kontrollen in einer regulierten Fertigungsumgebung durch (z. B. Empfangen, Verarbeiten, Bauen von Produkten / Materialien, Erleichterung der Materialverfügbarkeit, SA-Transaktionen / -Bestätigungen). Läuft automatisierte Systeme/Geräte und Abläufe aus, einschließlich: Einrichtung, Betrieb und Reinigung der Ausrüstung; Überwachung und Durchführung grundlegender Fehlerbehebungen. Beteiligt sich an der Ausführung von Protokoll/Validierungen. Behält die Fähigkeit, ein Fachexperte (KMU) in einem oder mehreren Bereichen der Produktion zu sein. Tägliche Beiträge zu End-of-Shift-Berichten und Pass-Downs. Sicherheit und Qualität Behält das Recht auf Betrieb und stellt sicher, dass alle Prozesse in einer sicheren und gesunden Weise durchgeführt werden. Behebt und eskaliert potenziell unsichere Gefahren; Bietet Feedback während der Untersuchung von Sicherheitsrisiken, Vorfällen und Beinaheunfällen mithilfe von Tools zur Sicherheitsberichterstattung. Führt Aufgaben/Transaktionen im Qualitätssystem durch, um sicherzustellen, dass wir unsere Qualitätsziele erreichen. Versteht die Erwartungen an die Auditbereitschaft (OSHA, FDA, QSR, GMP, ISO usw.); möglicherweise müssen Sie Fragen zu Prozessen vor Ort beantworten. Aufrechterhaltung genauer und vollständiger Systemtransaktionen, um die Materialrückverfolgbarkeit und Bestandsgenauigkeit zu gewährleisten (z. B. Empfang, Lagerung, Ausgabe von Materialien und andere Bestandstransaktionen). Gibt Feedback zu NCR-Untersuchungen, Überarbeitungen und Korrekturmaßnahmen. Einhaltung von 95% oder mehr interner Schulungen Kontinuierliche Verbesserung Führt 6S-Aktivitäten durch, sammelt / trifft Zykluszeiten und entwickelt / folgt Standardarbeit; identifiziert und implementiert Prozessverbesserungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen mit Lean-Tools. ◦ Beteiligt sich an Tier-Meetings und trägt dazu bei. Kann an der Erhebung von Daten für tägliche Metriken und zur Unterstützung operativer Exzellenzinitiativen und -verbesserungen teilnehmen. Teamwork und Zusammenarbeit Proaktiv arbeitet mit Peers in anderen Schichten / Funktionen zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die täglichen Ziele erreicht werden. Hilft beim erfolgreichen Onboarding neuer Mitarbeiter und Auftragnehmer.
• Sonstige übertragene Aufgaben

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a member of the Global Diagnostics Partnering Assistant Chapter, the Executive Assistant will be an integral part of a globally operating team.
In this role, you will support the Partnering Leadership as a single point of contact with executive tasks and the various Networks and Chapters within Roche Diagnostics Partnering with a variety of highly sophisticated and ambitious administrative and operational activities, including but not limited to:

Administrative support

• Planning and coordinating meetings and/or team events e.g. booking of meeting room facilities, hotel accommodations, organizing AV requirements coordinating catering, flights, and arranging team building activities

• Arrange complex conference calls

• Management of office supplies

• Support coordinating complex travel: Provide guidance for travels and assist with complex travel arrangements (incl. coordination of visa requirements & invitation letters)

• Assist with complex expense Reports through Concur

• Ensuring all travel and entertainment expenses strictly adhere to the company’s internal audit policies

• Managing budget, preparing and submitting purchase orders and maintaining vendor relations, accruals

• Interview scheduling

• Cultural ambassador' for the team, acting in a professional and exemplary manner whilst supporting change management activities e.g. as AI tools

• Contact person for new software to implement in the department software and tools such as MyBuy, Concur.

• Catering

• Planning and support of onboarding and offboarding activities, developing and/or deliver training and onboarding materials for new team members and potentially other stakeholder groups

• Maintaining distribution (CIDM) lists

• Channeling executive and employee communications

• Routinely working with Executive Assistant(s) and supporting leadership by demonstrating flexibility, adaptability and positive behaviour in the face of change

• Tracking contracts, arranging signatures

• Arranging logistics for EDO`s ( express development opportunities) and shadowings

Project support

• Support project and coordination of various initiatives

• Support Decision Committees (Partnering Decision Committees (CA PDC`s)

• Management and organization of complex events

• Management and organization of functional off-site meetings, Sprints and Trainings

• Set up and maintaining of gSites

• Actively participating in meetings with other professionals, promoting our ways of working and improvements to work processes, as well as sharing ideas and support amongst colleagues

• Dedicated AI project support (e.g. every-day AI)

Lead Accountabilities

• Roche Partnering Meetings at JP Morgan Conference: Serve as the central logistical anchor and strategic liaison to the Pharma Partnering division, ensuring seamless operations before and during the conference. Key responsibilities include being the logistical SPoC, vendor and contact management, and support event and onsite operations.

• We are looking for a motivated and committed person able to inspire our team oriented towards the values of passion, integrity and courage!

• You should have an Associates Degree or equivalent experience and proven experience with relevant administrative assistance, ideally having worked in a global team environment.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

• You are digitally literate in Microsoft Office applications, G-Suite and SAP.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a member of the Global Diagnostics Partnering Assistant Chapter, the Executive Assistant will be an integral part of a globally operating team. In this role, you will support the Partnering Leadership as a single point of contact with executive tasks and the various Networks and Chapters within Roche Diagnostics Partnering with a variety of highly sophisticated and ambitious administrative and operational activities, including but not limited to: Administrative support
• Planning and coordinating meetings and/or team events e.g. booking of meeting room facilities, hotel accommodations, organizing AV requirements coordinating catering, flights, and arranging team building activities
• Arrange complex conference calls
• Management of office supplies
• Support coordinating complex travel: Provide guidance for travels and assist with complex travel arrangements (incl. coordination of visa requirements & invitation letters)
• Assist with complex expense Reports through Concur
• Ensuring all travel and entertainment expenses strictly adhere to the company’s internal audit policies
• Managing budget, preparing and submitting purchase orders and maintaining vendor relations, accruals
• Interview scheduling
• Cultural ambassador' for the team, acting in a professional and exemplary manner whilst supporting change management activities e.g. as AI tools
• Contact person for new software to implement in the department software and tools such as MyBuy, Concur.
• Catering

• Maintaining distribution (CIDM) lists
• Channeling executive and employee communications
• Routinely working with Executive Assistant(s) and supporting leadership by demonstrating flexibility, adaptability and positive behaviour in the face of change
• Tracking contracts, arranging signatures
• Arranging logistics for EDO`s ( express development opportunities) and shadowings Project support
• Support project and coordination of various initiatives
• Support Decision Committees (Partnering Decision Committees (CA PDC`s)
• Management and organization of complex events
• Management and organization of functional off-site meetings, Sprints and Trainings
• Set up and maintaining of gSites
• Actively participating in meetings with other professionals, promoting our ways of working and improvements to work processes, as well as sharing ideas and support amongst colleagues

jobs.title: Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Summary: As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaign content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaign content creation, coordination, and completion. The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party vendors, and campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns' content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns' content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are:
You are a person with high interest and ability in project coordination with a keen understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your excellent organizational and communication skills enable you to manage multiple projects efficiently, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. You excel at collaborating with diverse stakeholders and adapting to their feedback to meet their needs and expectations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, with at least 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management and openness to learn and use project management tools and software.

• Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities, with a demonstrated track record of prioritizing and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Experience coordinating and collaborating with cross-functional teams, including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.
#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a health

Riepilogo: In qualità di Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist nel Global Digital Hub, garantisci la consegna di progetti di creazione di contenuti per campagne digitali all'interno del Digital Campaigns Chapter. Il ruolo svolge un ruolo cruciale nel garantire la creazione, il coordinamento e il completamento dei contenuti delle campagne digitali tempestive e di alta qualità. Il Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist può collaborare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali di affiliazione o i team di marca, i fornitori di terze parti, e i coordinatori della campagna e della campagna globale nell'organizzazione relativa ai requisiti di progetto, obiettivi e tempi. L'opportunità:
• Gestire la creazione e il processo di consegna dei contenuti delle campagne digitali affiliate o globali, assicurando il completamento tempestivo e di successo di tutti i progetti dall'iniziazione all'implementazione finale, assicurando al contempo che vengano rispettati gli standard di consegna.
• Incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder e rivedere le richieste di contenuti delle campagne digitali di conseguenza per garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.
• Istruisce le parti interessate a nuovi processi o requisiti che aumenterebbero l'efficienza nei modi di lavorare nell'area tematica
• Supporta i Coordinatori della Campagna e i Coordinatori della Campagna Globale nelle comunicazioni dei clienti nell'ambito dell'offerta di servizi, della gestione dei cambiamenti o della comunicazione
• Adozione e Centro di Eccellenza: seguire i processi esistenti, stabilire i principi di governance dei processi e mantenere una corretta documentazione e attuazione nell'ambito della responsabilità Chi sei: Sei una persona con alto interesse e capacità nel coordinamento del progetto con una profonda comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale e dei processi di creazione di contenuti. Le tue eccellenti capacità organizzative e comunicative consentono di gestire in modo efficiente più progetti, garantendo consegne tempestive e di alta qualità. Si eccelle nel collaborare con diversi stakeholder e adattarsi al loro feedback per soddisfare le loro esigenze e aspettative.
• Corso di laurea in Marketing, Business, Comunicazioni, o un campo correlato, con almeno 1+ anni di comprovata esperienza di gestione del progetto, preferibilmente nel marketing digitale o nella creazione di contenuti.
• Forte comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale e la gestione della campagna e l'apertura per imparare e utilizzare strumenti di gestione del progetto e software.
• Eccellente capacità organizzative, di gestione del tempo e multitasking, con un record di traccia dimostrata di priorità e gestione di più progetti contemporaneamente in un ambiente veloce e guidato da scadenza.
• Comunicazione eccezionale e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder.
• Esperienza di coordinamento e collaborazione con team interfunzionali, tra cui designer, copywriter, marketer e clienti/stakeholders. Si prega di notare: I reclami devono essere presentati in inglese, in quanto il nostro pannello di intervista può includere partecipanti provenienti da fuori del vostro paese locale. #LI-DC1 Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo una salute

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity:

Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers.

• As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.

• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.

• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.

• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role.

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 60% overnight travel. Ideal candidate to live within the territory.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Colorado is $71,100 and $132,000 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law . A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits
*LI-MG1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. jobs.title: Manufacturing Supervisor (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join our dynamic team in Carlsbad as a leader committed to excellence in manufacturing! As a key member of our organization, you will provide both leadership and technical support to our dedicated manufacturing personnel, ensuring the production of high-quality products that delight our customers. In this pivotal role, you will directly manage a team of skilled production assemblers, oversee the fulfillment of our production schedule, and uphold the highest standards of quality compliance.

Your expertise and technical skills will be instrumental in guiding our manufacturing team to achieve our ambitious goals in New Product Development, Continuous Improvement, Quality, Compliance, and Operational metrics. Your proven track record in operations will empower our team to consistently deliver top-notch results, driving our success and innovation forward.

You will be working on 2nd shift during the hours of 2:00 PM - 10:30 PM (Pacific).

The Opportunity

• Supervise, hire, train, develop, and evaluate production personnel to support manufacturing needs for existing products, new introductions, and R&D builds, ensuring appropriate resources and talent are in place.

• Plan and schedule resources and activities to meet business needs, and track, analyze, summarize, and report key metrics for areas of responsibility.

• Ensure compliance with quality systems (FDA, GMP, QSR, ISO), product specs, process instructions, safety requirements, and company policies, managing non-conformances to implement corrective and preventive actions.

• Identify potential failure modes affecting quality or business risks and collaborate with New Product teams for design for manufacturing (DFM) guidance, process/tooling development, and manufacturing instructions.

• Collaborate with Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing Engineering, and Quality to drive lean manufacturing improvements and provide technical guidance on new processing strategies and equipment procurement.

• Provide technical guidance and input regarding new processing strategies and associated equipment procurement.

• Identify and implement lean manufacturing opportunities in effort to improve quality, increase productivity, reduce costs and reduce cycle times.

• Develop and sustain the manufacturing team as a quality minded culture driven by focusing on customer service (external and internal), outstanding compliance, continuous improvement activities that support business objectives.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or Associate's degree and 3 years of supervisory experience in a regulated manufacturing environment. Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Preferred requirements and skills

Skills – Technical

• 2+ years experience in Technical Supervision and/or Engineering in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.

• Working knowledge of quality system requirements (QSR) and good manufacturing practices (GMP).

• Experience working with a clean room environment, and application of environmental procedures.

• Experience working with manufacturing/MRP systems (QAD preferred)

• Experience and/or certification in LEAN Manufacturing principles.

• Experience and prior training (or ideally certification) with Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies. Experience with Statistical Process Control a plus.

Skills – General

• Must be a hands-on, self-directed, organized and conscientious individual

• Complete work in a timely, accurate and thorough manner

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Treten Sie unserem dynamischen Team in Carlsbad als führendes Unternehmen bei, das sich der Exzellenz in der Fertigung verschrieben hat! Als wichtiges Mitglied unserer Organisation bieten Sie unseren engagierten Produktionsmitarbeitern sowohl Führungs- als auch technische Unterstützung, um die Produktion hochwertiger Produkte sicherzustellen, die unsere Kunden begeistern. In dieser zentralen Rolle leiten Sie direkt ein Team von qualifizierten Montagebetrieben, beaufsichtigen die Erfüllung unseres Produktionsplans und halten die höchsten Standards für die Einhaltung der Qualitätsanforderungen ein. Ihre Expertise und technischen Fähigkeiten werden dazu beitragen, unser Fertigungsteam bei der Erreichung unserer ehrgeizigen Ziele in den Bereichen Entwicklung neuer Produkte, kontinuierliche Verbesserung, Qualität, Compliance und Betriebskennzahlen zu unterstützen. Ihre nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz im operativen Geschäft wird unser Team befähigen, konsequent erstklassige Ergebnisse zu liefern und unseren Erfolg und unsere Innovation voranzutreiben. Sie werden in der 2. Schicht in den Stunden von 14:00 bis 22:30 Uhr (Pazifik) arbeiten. Die Chance
• Beaufsichtigen, mieten, schulen, entwickeln und bewerten Sie das Produktionspersonal, um die Fertigungsanforderungen für bestehende Produkte, neue Einführungen und F & E-Builds zu unterstützen und sicherzustellen, dass geeignete Ressourcen und Talente vorhanden sind.
• Planen und planen Sie Ressourcen und Aktivitäten, um die Geschäftsanforderungen zu erfüllen, und verfolgen, analysieren, zusammenfassen und berichten Sie wichtige Metriken für Verantwortungsbereiche.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Qualitätssystemen (FDA, GMP, QSR, ISO), Produktspezifikationen, Prozessanweisungen, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien, Verwaltung von Nichtkonformitäten zur Umsetzung von Korrektur- und Vorbeugungsmaßnahmen.
• Identifizieren Sie mögliche Fehlermodi, die sich auf Qualitäts- oder Geschäftsrisiken auswirken, und arbeiten Sie mit New Product-Teams für Design for Manufacturing (DFM)-Anleitung, Prozess- / Werkzeugentwicklung und Fertigungsanweisungen zusammen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Supply Chain, Logistik, Fertigungstechnik und Qualität zusammen, um schlanke Fertigungsverbesserungen voranzutreiben und technische Anleitungen für neue Verarbeitungsstrategien und die Beschaffung von Ausrüstung bereitzustellen.
• Bereitstellung technischer Leitlinien und Beiträge zu neuen Verarbeitungsstrategien und der damit verbundenen Beschaffung von Ausrüstung.
• Identifizieren und implementieren Sie schlanke Fertigungsmöglichkeiten, um die Qualität zu verbessern, die Produktivität zu steigern, Kosten zu senken und die Zykluszeiten zu reduzieren.
• Entwickeln und unterstützen Sie das Fertigungsteam als eine qualitätsorientierte Kultur, die sich auf den Kundenservice (extern und intern), herausragende Compliance und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsaktivitäten konzentriert, die die Geschäftsziele unterstützen. Wer du bist:
• Bachelor- oder Associate-Abschluss und 3 Jahre Aufsichtserfahrung in einer regulierten Fertigungsumgebung. Eine gleichwertige Kombination von Bildung und Erfahrung kann in Betracht gezogen werden. Bevorzugte Anforderungen und Fähigkeiten Fähigkeiten – technische
• 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in der technischen Überwachung und / oder Engineering in der Medizintechnik oder Pharmaindustrie.
• Kenntnisse der Qualitätsanforderungen (QSR) und der guten Herstellungspraxis (GMP).
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit einer Reinraumumgebung und der Anwendung von Umweltverfahren.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Fertigungs- / MRP-Systemen (QAD bevorzugt)
• Erfahrung und / oder Zertifizierung in LEAN Manufacturing Prinzipien.
• Erfahrung und vorherige Schulung (oder idealerweise Zertifizierung) mit Lean Manufacturing und / oder Six Sigma Methoden. Erfahrung mit Statistical Process Control ein Plus. Qualifikationen — Allgemeines
• Muss ein praktisches, selbstgesteuertes, organisiertes und gewissenhaftes Individuum sein
• Komplette Arbeit in einer zeitnahen, genauen und gründlichen Weise
• Muss ab sein
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique à Carlsbad en tant que leader engagé dans l'excellence dans la fabrication! En tant que membre clé de notre organisation, vous fournirez un leadership et un soutien technique à notre personnel de fabrication dédié, assurant la production de produits de haute qualité qui ravissent nos clients. Dans ce rôle central, vous gérerez directement une équipe d'assembleurs de production qualifiés, superviserez l'exécution de notre calendrier de production et respecterez les normes les plus élevées de conformité à la qualité. Votre expertise et vos compétences techniques seront déterminantes pour guider notre équipe de fabrication dans la réalisation de nos objectifs ambitieux de développement de nouveaux produits, d'amélioration continue, de qualité, de conformité et de mesures opérationnelles. Votre expérience éprouvée en matière d'exploitation permettra à notre équipe d'obtenir des résultats de premier ordre, ce qui nous permettra d'atteindre notre succès et notre innovation. Vous travaillerez en 2e quart pendant les heures de 14 h à 22 h 30 (Pacifique). L'opportunité
• Superviser, embaucher, former, former et évaluer le personnel de production afin de répondre aux besoins de fabrication des produits existants, des nouvelles introductions et de la R-D, en veillant à ce que les ressources et les talents nécessaires soient en place.
• Planifier et planifier les ressources et les activités pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels et suivre, analyser, résumer et rendre compte des principales mesures des secteurs de responsabilité.
• Veiller à la conformité avec les systèmes de qualité (FDA, GMP, QSR, ISO), les spécifications du produit, les instructions de procédé, les exigences de sécurité et les politiques de l'entreprise, gérer les non-conformités pour mettre en œuvre des mesures correctives et préventives.
• Identifier les modes d'échec potentiels affectant les risques de qualité ou d'entreprise et collaborer avec les équipes du nouveau produit pour la conception de directives de fabrication, le développement de procédés et d'outils et les instructions de fabrication.
• Collaborer avec la chaîne d'approvisionnement, la logistique, l'ingénierie manufacturière et la qualité pour améliorer la fabrication maigre et fournir des conseils techniques sur les nouvelles stratégies de transformation et l'acquisition d'équipement.
• Fournir des conseils et des commentaires techniques concernant les nouvelles stratégies de traitement et l'acquisition d'équipement connexe.
• Identifier et mettre en oeuvre des possibilités de fabrication maigre pour améliorer la qualité, accroître la productivité, réduire les coûts et réduire les cycles.
• Développer et soutenir l'équipe de fabrication en tant que culture de qualité axée sur le service à la clientèle (externe et interne), la conformité exceptionnelle et les activités d'amélioration continue qui appuient les objectifs opérationnels. Qui vous êtes :
• Licence ou diplôme d'associé et 3 ans d'expérience en supervision dans un environnement de fabrication réglementé. Une combinaison équivalente d'éducation et d'expérience peut être envisagée. Exigences et compétences privilégiées Compétences techniques
• 2+ ans d'expérience en supervision technique et/ou en ingénierie dans l'industrie des instruments médicaux ou pharmaceutiques.
• Connaissance pratique des exigences des systèmes de qualité et des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF).
• Expérience de travail avec un environnement propre et application des procédures environnementales.
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes de fabrication/RPM (QAD préféré)
• Expérience et/ou certification en matière de principes de fabrication LEAN.
• Expérience et formation préalable (ou idéalement certification) avec les méthodologies Lean Manufacturing et/ou Six Sigma. Expérience du contrôle statistique des processus a plus. Compétences générales
• Doit être une personne directe, auto-dirigée, organisée et consciencieuse
• Achever le travail en temps opportun, de manière précise et approfondie
• Ça doit être ab.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
（高级）治疗领域专员负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Biotechnologist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

The Opportunity

This position has overall accountability for completing the manufacturing tasks as scheduled while in full compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices and Roche’s corporate principles, quality policies and standards.

Key Responsibilities/Tasks:

• Support the Biochemical Manufacturing Department by working effectively within the group to meet department goals and objectives.

• Responsible for completing assigned tasks which may include preparing small equipment, cleaning and sterilizing vessels, preparing solutions, monitoring and operation biochemical processing equipment, raw materials sampling, dispensing and environmental monitoring sampling and maintain housekeeping of the areas while adhering to Safety, cGMP and Biochemical Manufacturing guidelines.

• Assigned tasks must be prioritized and work must be documented per approved manufacturing formulae.

• Troubleshoot equipment and process problems.

• Support process improvement efforts.

• Operate computers for process control and data entry.

• Participate in staff and shift change meetings and work closely with other shift personnel and external support groups.

• Ensure all assigned tasks are performed as per safety requirement. Report safely incident and near misses on a timely basis and support SHE in incident investigation.

Safety, Health & Environment:

• Comply with all RSTO’s Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements, never put oneself and others at safety & health risks, and report any workplace accidents, near misses and hazards as soon as practicable.

• Observe all RSTO’s site security measures at all times, and report any suspicious characters/objects & damaged security mechanisms to Site Security immediately.

Lean Production System:

• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), while demonstrating a continuous improvement mindset and behaviors through the use and application of LPS tools for continuous improvement initiatives.

Who Are You

• Diploma in Life Sciences or Engineering discipline or equivalent holders. Minimum 3 years of related working experience for diploma equivalent holders with combination of education and relative work experience.

• Related working experience in a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment is preferred.

• Must possess good problem solving, interpersonal communication and team skills.

• Must be a self-starter with a strong focus on safety, quality, details and results.

• Mechanical aptitude and a familiarity with computer based systems are highly desirable.

• Background in microbiology, fermentation, or protein purification is desired.

Preferred

• Must be willing to work at Singapore Tuas Bay Link . Company Shuttle Bus is provided at the MRT Stations.

• Must be able to work weekends, off-shifts and overtime as required.

• Must be able to carry heavy loads of up to 25kg.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier futu

• Osservare tutte le misure di sicurezza del sito di RSTO in ogni momento, e segnalare eventuali caratteri/oggetti sospetti e meccanismi di sicurezza danneggiati alla sicurezza del sito immediatamente. Sistema di produzione magra:
• Embody PT Lean Production System (LPS), dimostrando un continuo miglioramento della mentalità e dei comportamenti attraverso l'uso e l'applicazione di strumenti LPS per iniziative di miglioramento continuo. Chi sei
• Diploma in Scienze della Vita o in Ingegneria disciplina o titolari equivalenti. Minimo 3 anni di esperienza lavorativa relativa per titolari equivalenti di diploma con combinazione di istruzione e esperienza lavorativa relativa.
• È preferibile un'esperienza lavorativa correlata in un ambiente operativo biotecnologico o farmaceutico.
• Deve possedere un buon problem solving, comunicazione interpersonale e competenze di squadra.
• Deve essere un auto-starter con una forte attenzione alla sicurezza, qualità, dettagli e risultati.
• L'attitudine meccanica e la familiarità con i sistemi basati su computer sono altamente desiderabili.
• Lo sfondo in microbiologia, fermentazione o purificazione delle proteine è desiderato. Preferito
• Deve essere disposto a lavorare a Singapore Tuas Bay Link . L'azienda Shuttle Bus è disponibile presso le stazioni MRT.

Costruiamo un futu più sano

L'opportunité Ce poste a la responsabilité globale d'accomplir les tâches de fabrication comme prévu tout en respectant pleinement les bonnes pratiques de fabrication actuelles et les principes, les politiques et les normes de qualité de Roche. Principales responsabilités et tâches :
• Appuyer le Département de la fabrication biochimique en travaillant efficacement au sein du groupe pour atteindre les buts et objectifs du Ministère.
• Responsable de l'exécution des tâches assignées qui peuvent comprendre la préparation de petits équipements, le nettoyage et la stérilisation des navires, la préparation de solutions, la surveillance et l'exploitation de l'équipement de traitement biochimique, l'échantillonnage des matières premières, l'échantillonnage de la distribution et de la surveillance environnementale et le maintien de l'entretien ménager des zones tout en respectant les lignes directrices sur la sécurité, les BPF et la fabrication biochimique.

• Utiliser des ordinateurs pour le contrôle des processus et la saisie des données.
• Participer aux réunions sur le changement de poste et travailler en étroite collaboration avec d'autres équipes et des groupes d'appui externes.

jobs.title: Administrative & Finance Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche.

The Administrative & Finance Specialist provides critical operational support across multiple departments. This role is responsible for streamlining travel logistics, managing expense compliance, coordinating large-scale corporate events, and supporting the integrity of the company’s financial cycle through diligent Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) management.

Key Duties and Responsibilities;

1. General Administrative Support

• Travel & Entertainment (T&E): Coordination of business travels. This includes booking airfare, hotel accommodations and ground transfers, ensuring arrangements align with company travel policies.

• Expense Management (Concur): Ensure all claims include valid supporting documents (Official Receipts, invoices) and comply with internal audit standards.

• Corporate Credit Card Management: Oversee card issuance, limit monitoring and support usage compliance.

• Operational Monitoring: Track and maintain "Events Forms" and other administrative logs to ensure departmental requests are processed and filed systematically.

• Corporate Events Management: Support the logistics of companywide events such as National Conventions, Mid-Year Conferences and Holiday Celebrations to name a few. Manage relationships with external vendors (catering, audiovisual, venues) and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution.

2. Grants, Sponsorships & Donations (GSD) Support

• Compliance & Documentation: Facilitate the administrative processing of GSD requests, ensuring all contributions are documented, approved, and tracked.

3. Finance Operations
A. Accounts Receivable (AR) Management

• Customer Reconciliation: Perform regular audits of customer accounts to identify discrepancies and support resolution of payment issues.

• Credit & Collection Support: Assist the finance team in monitoring aging reports and following up on overdue accounts to maintain healthy cash flow.

• KPI Achievement: Actively contribute to meeting departmental AR goals, such as reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
B. Accounts Payable (AP) Management

• Stakeholder & Vendor Relations: Act as a bridge between internal departments and external vendors to reconcile outstanding invoices and resolve billing disputes.

• Procurement Cleanup: Regularly audit Purchase Orders (PO) and Purchase Requisitions (PR) to close out aged items and ensure the accuracy of the general ledger.

Who you are;

• Experience: 3+ years in a dual Admin/Finance role or as an Operations Coordinator.

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP/Concur and advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).

• Competencies: High attention to detail, strong negotiation skills for vendor management, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Technical Proficiencies & Software Skills

• ERP & Expense Management:
• Proficiency in SAP for auditing and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems specifically for AR/AP modules and PO management.

• Data Analysis & Reporting:
• Advanced MS Excel Skills: Must be comfortable with VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, and Data Validation to reconcile large financial datasets.

This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Ph

• Riconciliazione del cliente: Eseguire controlli regolari dei conti del cliente per identificare discrepanze e risoluzione di supporto dei problemi di pagamento.
• Credit & Collection Support: Assistere il team finanziario nel monitoraggio dei rapporti di invecchiamento e seguire i conti in ritardo per mantenere il flusso di cassa sano.
• KPI Achievement: Contribuisci attivamente alla riunione di obiettivi AR dipartimentali, come la riduzione di Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). B. Gestione dei conti pagabili (AP)
• Stakeholder & Vendor Relations: Agite come ponte tra i dipartimenti interni e i fornitori esterni per conciliare fatture eccezionali e risolvere controversie di fatturazione.
• Procurement Cleanup: controlla regolarmente gli ordini di acquisto (PO) e le richieste di acquisto (PR) per chiudere gli articoli anziani e garantire l'accuratezza del registro generale. Chi sei!
• Esperienza: 3+ anni in un duplice ruolo di Admin/Finance o come Coordinatore Operativo.
• Competenze tecniche: competenza in SAP/Concur e competenze Excel avanzate (VLOOKUP, tabelle pivot).
• Competenze: Alta attenzione ai dettagli, forti capacità di negoziazione per la gestione dei fornitori, e la capacità di multitask in un ambiente veloce. Competenze tecniche e competenze software
• ERP & Expense Management:
• Competenza in SAP per la verifica e la segnalazione.
• Esperienza pratica con sistemi ERP specificatamente per moduli AR/AP e gestione PO.
• Analisi dei dati & Reporting:
• Abilità avanzate di MS Excel: Deve essere comodo con VLOOKUP, tabelle pivot e convalida dei dati per conciliare grandi set di dati finanziari. Questo ruolo è aperto solo ai candidati che hanno piena idoneità a vivere e lavorare in Ph

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Le spécialiste de l'administration et des finances fournit un soutien opérationnel essentiel à plusieurs ministères. Ce rôle est chargé de rationaliser la logistique des voyages, de gérer la conformité des dépenses, de coordonner les grands événements organisationnels et de soutenir l'intégrité du cycle financier de l'entreprise par une gestion diligente des comptes débiteurs et des comptes créditeurs. Fonctions et responsabilités clés; 1. Appui administratif général
• Voyages et divertissements (T&E): Coordination des voyages d'affaires. Cela comprend la réservation de billets d'avion, d'hébergements d'hôtel et de transferts terrestres, en veillant à ce que les arrangements soient conformes aux politiques de voyage de l'entreprise.
• Gestion des dépenses (Concur): S'assurer que toutes les demandes comprennent des documents justificatifs valides (réceptions officielles, factures) et qu'elles sont conformes aux normes de vérification interne.
• Gestion de la carte de crédit : Surveiller l'émission de la carte, limiter la surveillance et appuyer la conformité à l'utilisation.
• Surveillance opérationnelle : Suivre et tenir à jour les « formulaires d'événements » et les autres registres administratifs pour s'assurer que les demandes ministérielles sont traitées et déposées systématiquement.
• Gestion des événements d'entreprise : Soutenir la logistique d'événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise tels que les congrès nationaux, les conférences de mi-année et les célébrations des fêtes. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs externes (quartier, audiovisuel, lieux) et les intervenants internes pour assurer une exécution transparente. 2. Soutien aux subventions, aux commandites et aux dons
• Conformité et documentation : Faciliter le traitement administratif des demandes de DSG, en veillant à ce que toutes les contributions soient documentées, approuvées et suivies. 3. Opérations financières A. Gestion des comptes débiteurs
• Rapprochement des clients : Effectuer des vérifications régulières des comptes clients afin de déceler les écarts et de faciliter la résolution des problèmes de paiement.
• Soutien au crédit et à la perception : Aider l'équipe financière à surveiller les rapports sur le vieillissement et à suivre les comptes en souffrance afin de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains.
• Réalisation de l'ICP : Contribuer activement à la réalisation des objectifs ministériels en matière d'EI, comme la réduction des ventes de jours en circulation. B. Gestion des comptes créditeurs (AP)
• Relations avec les intervenants et les fournisseurs : Agir comme un pont entre les ministères internes et les fournisseurs externes afin de concilier les factures en souffrance et de régler les différends en matière de facturation.
• Nettoyage de l'approvisionnement : Vérification régulière des bons de commande et des demandes d'achat afin de fermer les articles vieillis et d'assurer l'exactitude du grand livre. Qui vous êtes;
• Expérience : 3 ans et plus dans un double rôle d'admin/Finance ou en tant que coordonnateur des opérations.
• Compétences techniques : maîtrise des compétences SAP/Concur et Excel avancées (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables).
• Compétences : Une grande attention aux détails, de solides compétences en négociation pour la gestion des fournisseurs et la capacité de multitâche dans un environnement accéléré. Compétences techniques et compétences logicielles
• ERP & Gestion des frais :
• Compétence en SAP pour la vérification et l'établissement de rapports.
• Expérience pratique des systèmes ERP spécifiquement pour les modules AR/AP et la gestion PO.
• Analyse des données et rapports :
• Compétences avancées MS Excel : doit être à l'aise avec VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, et la validation des données pour concilier les grands ensembles de données financières. Ce rôle n'est ouvert qu'aux candidats qui ont la pleine admissibilité à vivre et à travailler à Ph

The Position Field Service Implementation Representative Location: For this position, we are looking for someone who lives in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) in Ontario and/or resides within 100 km of a major metropolitan airport. A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. You are an effective problem solver passionate about the healthcare environment and understand the importance of our solutions on the customer experience and patient care. Your passion for problem resolution and customer satisfaction is supported by your technical knowledge to deliver a stellar customer experience. You will provide timely, accurate and consistent support to our customers to minimize the disruption of their diagnostic service delivery.
• Building relationships with laboratory systems operators and managers for a dedicated customer base and use your strong communication and active listening skills to identify and diagnose customer issues and provide accurate and timely resolution.
• Participating in service, sales and customer meetings, where required.
• Collaborating with the Customer Support team on installations (pre-site inspections, technical installation), upgrades and issue resolution, where required.
• Performing preventative maintenance and technical service bulletin resolution to support regional teams, as needed.
• Working with local teams to install and configure instrument software and hardware components, as required.
• Working with local RIS application specialist and technical specialist teams to install, configure and support IT software and hardware components as needed.
• Supporting technical issues during the installation process to ensure installations are completed successfully.
• Acting as implementation crew team member or lead to ensure and maximize efficient completion of installations.
• Processing service activity close-outs at the end of each customer site visit. Able to manage day-to-day administrative activities. Who you are:
• You hold a diploma of collegial studies in electronic technology or related education.
• You possess 5+ years of relevant field service experience, laboratory experience is considered a strong asset.
• You have prior customer support experience.
• You demonstrate knowledge of IT systems & Network infrastructure and Customer Centricity.
• In this position, you will be in contact with colleagues and customers across Canada. English and French bilingualism is preferred (written and spoken).
• You have a valid and complete driver's license in Canada.

Key Duties and Responsibilities;

• Provide Executive Level Support to Country Manager

• Travel & Entertainment (T&E): Coordination of business travels. This includes booking airfare, hotel accommodations and ground transfers, ensuring arrangements align with company travel policies.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinate with customers or internal stakeholders to determine event goals, budget, timeline, and logistical requirements. Develop and maintain relationships with event suppliers, negotiate contracts, and ensure cost-effective solutions.
