jobs.title: Geopolitics and Trade Policy Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Géopolitique et responsable des politiques commerciales

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

At Roche Diagnostics, our Health Policy team is dedicated to cultivating thought leadership and driving vital policy changes to improve global diagnostic access.

We are seeking a Geopolitics and Trade Policy Manager to navigate the complex, rapidly evolving geopolitical landscape; a context defined not by black and white, but by a thousand shades of grey. In this global role, you will analyze international frameworks, monitor trade dynamics, and engage with key external stakeholders to ensure Roche's freedom to operate and support healthcare delivery to patients.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will serve as a core analytical and networking anchor for our global diagnostic policy strategy. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring & Data Mining: Conduct deep desk research and data mining to track shifting trade dynamics, tariffs, and geopolitical events.

• Shaping Policy Positions: Translate complex legal and geopolitical intelligence into clear global diagnostic policy positions and advocacy content.

• EU Institutional Engagement: Build strong, off-the-record connections within the "Brussels bubble" and closely monitor EU institutions to anticipate regulatory impacts.

• Optimizing Business Efficiency: Address requirements for new or revised policy initiatives to ensure current market dynamics and positions are accurately reflected.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with regional and affiliate policy functions to leverage collective capabilities and break down organizational silos.

Who You Are

You are a highly curious, adaptable, and resilient professional who thrives in ambiguity and is eager to build strong business acumen in the diagnostics market.
To excel in this role, you bring:

• A degree in International Trade Law is highly preferred (or a Bachelor’s/Advanced degree in International Relations, Public Policy, or Economics).

• Proven professional experience in international trade law, with a strong ability to easily read, interpret, and analyze complex legal texts.

• Exceptional skills in desk research, intelligence gathering, and data mining, with a sharp attention to detail.

• A natural ability to navigate political environments, connect with institutional stakeholders, and confidently communicate complex business cases.

• Fluency in English alongside a European language, an open and agile mindset, and the absolute willingness to travel globally (with a strong focus on Brussels).

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Posizioni: Traduci l'intelligenza legale e geopolitica complessa in chiare posizioni politiche diagnostiche globali e contenuti di advocacy.
• Impegno istituzionale dell'UE: costruire connessioni forti e off-the-record all'interno della "Bruxelles bolla" e monitorare attentamente le istituzioni dell'UE per anticipare gli impatti normativi.

• Collaborazione interattiva: Partner a stretto contatto con le funzioni di politica regionale e di affiliazione per sfruttare le capacità collettive e abbattere i silos organizzativi. Chi sei Sei un professionista altamente curioso, adattabile e resiliente che prospera in ambiguità ed è desideroso di costruire forte acume aziendale nel mercato della diagnostica. Per eccellere in questo ruolo, si porta:
• Una laurea in diritto commerciale internazionale è altamente preferito (o una laurea / laurea in relazioni internazionali, politica pubblica, o economia).
• Provata esperienza professionale nel diritto commerciale internazionale, con una forte capacità di leggere, interpretare e analizzare testi legali complessi.
• Competenze eccezionali nella ricerca della scrivania, raccolta di informazioni e data mining, con una forte attenzione ai dettagli.
• Una naturale capacità di navigare in ambienti politici, connettersi con gli stakeholder istituzionali, e comunicare con fiducia casi di business complessi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, our Health Policy team is dedicated to cultivating thought leadership and driving vital policy changes to improve global diagnostic access. We are seeking a Geopolitics and Trade Policy Manager to navigate the complex, rapidly evolving geopolitical landscape; a context defined not by black and white, but by a thousand shades of grey. In this global role, you will analyze international frameworks, monitor trade dynamics, and engage with key external stakeholders to ensure Roche's freedom to operate and support healthcare delivery to patients. The Opportunity In this role, you will serve as a core analytical and networking anchor for our global diagnostic policy strategy. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Monitoring & Data Mining: Conduct deep desk research and data mining to track shifting trade dynamics, tariffs, and geopolitical events.
• Shaping Policy Positions: Translate complex legal and geopolitical intelligence into clear global diagnostic policy positions and advocacy content.
• EU Institutional Engagement: Build strong, off-the-record connections within the "Brussels bubble" and closely monitor EU institutions to anticipate regulatory impacts.
• Optimizing Business Efficiency: Address requirements for new or revised policy initiatives to ensure current market dynamics and positions are accurately reflected.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with regional and affiliate policy functions to leverage collective capabilities and break down organizational silos. Who You Are You are a highly curious, adaptable, and resilient professional who thrives in ambiguity and is eager to build strong business acumen in the diagnostics market. To excel in this role, you bring:
• A degree in International Trade Law is highly preferred (or a Bachelor’s/Advanced degree in International Relations, Public Policy, or Economics).
• Proven professional experience in international trade law, with a strong ability to easily read, interpret, and analyze complex legal texts.
• Exceptional skills in desk research, intelligence gathering, and data mining, with a sharp attention to detail.
• A natural ability to navigate political environments, connect with institutional stakeholders, and confidently communicate complex business cases.
• Fluency in English alongside a European language, an open and agile mindset, and the absolute willingness to travel globally (with a strong focus on Brussels). Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Researcher (CX Researcher)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The Customer Experience Researcher (CX Researcher) will be responsible for supporting the Experience Design Director in planning and conducting end-to-end customer experience research across the prioritized Experience Operations roadmap. By employing best practices in human-centered research methodologies, the CX Researcher will be expected to present research findings at multiple levels within the organization. These findings will include the analysis of qualitative data and metrics to identify current-state customer experiences, gaps and opportunities in experiences, and the comparison of brand experiences across the portfolio.

The Opportunity

• Lead qualitative and quantitative CX/UX research (user evaluation, testing, insight generation) within a human-centered design framework to uncover actionable insights that shape customer journeys and experience strategies.

• Translate research findings into clear, evidence-based recommendations, communications, and reports that inform innovative experience designs aligned with business goals.

• Collaborate closely with CX Insight Managers, UX Designers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders, managing relationships and contributing to analysis, strategy, and design support across initiatives.

• Support and grow the Human-Centered Design practice at Roche, creating transformational opportunities and improved experiences for patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and employees.

Who You Are

• Structured, research-driven professional with a strong Human-Centered Design mindset, 5+ years of CX/UX research experience, and comfort working independently in fast-paced, cross-functional environments while engaging patients, caregivers, HCPs, and external stakeholders.

• Bachelor’s degree (preferably in HCI, Human Factors, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or related) with demonstrated qualitative and quantitative/mixed-methods research expertise, including interviews, survey design, documentation, analysis, validation with end users, and use of CX frameworks such as Journey Mapping, Design Thinking, and Service Design (incl. workshop facilitation).

• Hands-on experience with CX/UX and analytics tools (e.g., UserTesting, UserZoom, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, dscout, Optimal Workshop, Maze, Adobe Analytics, ContentSquare, and Medallia); productivity and collaboration tools (Google Workspace, MS Office, Jira, and Confluence); and familiarity with emerging technologies (AI/ML and AR/VR) and UX dev tools (HTML/CSS/JS preferred).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills and high attention to detail, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear narratives, visualizations, and actionable insights using tools such as Visio or LucidSpark.

• Experience with content management systems (e.g., AEM, CQ5) and a collaborative, detail-oriented working style, combining analytical rigor with customer empathy to drive impactful, human-centered experience improvements.

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.

jobs.title: Information Security Governance Expert

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di governance della sicurezza dell'informazione
titleByLocale.fr: Expert en gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

As an Information Security Governance Expert, you drive the integrity and resilience of Roche's Information Security Management System (ISMS). You are responsible for ensuring the organization maintains its yearly security certifications and remains compliant with evolving global regulations such as the US DOJ, NIS2 and RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11. You combine deep information security experience with sound regulatory knowledge and project management skills, to lead external audits & inspections and strategic security initiatives across the group. Your goal is to ensure that the security framework is not only compliant but also scalable and effective in protecting Roche's critical assets in a highly regulated environment. You have a proven track record of turning information security governance into a business enabler.

The Information Security & Privacy Governance team provides the framework for Roche to identify, assess, and mitigate information risks. The area is organized around three pillars:

• Governance & ISMS: Maintaining Roche Global ISMS framework and certification (ISO/IEC 27001).

• Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring adherence of Roche global ISMS to US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 and global healthcare/medical device regulations.

• Audit & Assurance: Support Roche affiliates during external inspections, demonstrating their commitment to compliance.

Job Responsibilities
ISMS Strategy & Framework Management

• Global ISMS Ownership : Own and maintain the Roche ISMS framework, ensuring full alignment with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and integration with other quality management systems.

• Continual Improvement: Drive the ISMS "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) cycle to ensure the framework evolves with the threat landscape and business needs, maintaining successful yearly certification continuity.

• Policy Governance: Define and maintain enterprise-level security policies, standards, directives and procedures, ensuring they are fit-for-purpose, actionable and measurable.

• Risk Monitoring: Monitor the global risk landscape to identify adaptations required to the governance framework.

Regulatory & Compliance Orchestration

• Regulatory Translation: Integrate complex global requirements (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) into Roche Global ISMS.

• Product & Services: Collaborate with product teams to ensure "Security by Design" integration into their culture, skillset, processes and projects.

• Control Mapping: Maintain a unified control framework that maps internal Roche controls to multiple external regulatory requirements to validate coverage of the Roche Global ISMS.

• Consulting: Act as a consultant to Roche affiliates, guiding them toward compliance with regional or functional security directives.

Audit & Inspection Support

• External Audit & Inspection Support: Support legal entities of the Roche Group & functions during external audits and regulatory inspections.

• Risks Treatment Oversight: Coordinate remediation plans for audit and inspection findings and track progress to closure.

• Third-Party Governance: Oversee the security governance framework for critical supply chain partners and Cloud Service Providers.

Stakeholder & Change Management

• Strategic Advisory: Serve as a bridge between senior leadership, legal, privacy and quality to communicate information security risks and maturity milestones.

• Culture & Awareness: Support the Information Security networks by providing high-level governance guidance and strategic direction.

Qualification

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come esperto di gestione della sicurezza delle informazioni, si guida l'integrità e la resilienza del sistema di gestione della sicurezza delle informazioni di Roche (ISMS). Lei è responsabile di garantire che l'organizzazione mantiene le sue certificazioni annuali di sicurezza e rimane conforme alle normative globali in evoluzione come la US DOJ, NIS2 e RCE/CER, GMP Allegato 11. Unisci profonda esperienza di sicurezza delle informazioni con solide conoscenze normative e competenze di gestione dei progetti, per condurre audit esterni e ispezioni e iniziative di sicurezza strategica in tutto il gruppo. Il vostro obiettivo è quello di garantire che il quadro di sicurezza non è solo conforme, ma anche scalabile ed efficace nella protezione dei beni critici di Roche in un ambiente altamente regolamentato. Hai una comprovata traccia di trasformare la governance della sicurezza delle informazioni in un attivatore aziendale. Il team di Information Security & Privacy Governance fornisce il quadro per Roche per identificare, valutare e mitigare i rischi di informazione. L'area è organizzata intorno a tre pilastri:
• Governance & ISMS: Mantenere Roche Global ISMS framework e certificazione (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Compliance regolamentare: garantire l'adesione di Roche ISMS globale a US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Allegato 11 e le normative sanitarie/medicali globali.
• Audit & Assurance: Support Roche affiliati durante le ispezioni esterne, dimostrando il loro impegno per la conformità. Responsabilità del lavoro Strategia ISMS e Gestione Quadro
• Proprietà ISMS Globale: Possedere e mantenere il framework Roche ISMS, garantendo il pieno allineamento con ISO/IEC 27001:2022 e l'integrazione con altri sistemi di gestione della qualità.
• Miglioramento continuo: Guidare l'ISMS "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA) ciclo per garantire che il framework si evolva con il paesaggio minaccia e le esigenze aziendali, mantenendo la continuità di certificazione annuale di successo.
• Governance della politica: Definire e mantenere le politiche di sicurezza a livello aziendale, gli standard, le direttive e le procedure, assicurando che siano adeguate, attuabili e misurabili.
• Monitoraggio del rischio: Monitorare il panorama del rischio globale per identificare gli adattamenti necessari al quadro di governance. Orchestrazione di regolamentazione e conformità
• Traduzione normativa: Integra i complessi requisiti globali (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) in Roche Global ISMS.
• Product & Services: Collabora con i team di prodotti per garantire l'integrazione "Security by Design" nella loro cultura, competenza, processi e progetti.
• Mapping di controllo: Mantenere un quadro di controllo unificato che mappa i controlli interni Roche a più requisiti normativi esterni per convalidare la copertura del Roche Global ISMS.
• Consulenza: agire come consulente per gli affiliati Roche, guidandoli verso il rispetto delle direttive di sicurezza regionali o funzionali. Supporto di controllo e ispezione
• Supporto per la verifica e l'ispezione esterna: Supporta le entità giuridiche del Gruppo Roche e le funzioni durante i controlli esterni e le ispezioni normative.
• Supervisione del trattamento dei rischi: Coordinate piani di bonifica per i risultati dell'audit e dell'ispezione e tracciate i progressi verso la chiusura.
• Governance di terze parti: supervisionare il quadro di governance della sicurezza per i partner critici della supply chain e i provider di servizi cloud. Stakeholder & Change Management
• Strategic Advisory: Servire come ponte tra leadership senior, legale, privacy e qualità per comunicare i rischi di sicurezza delle informazioni e le pietre miliari di maturità.
• Cultura & Awareness: Sostenere le reti di sicurezza dell'informazione fornendo una guida di governance di alto livello e una direzione strategica. Qualificazione

Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Information Security Governance Expert treiben Sie die Integrität und Belastbarkeit des Roche Information Security Management Systems (ISMS) voran. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass das Unternehmen seine jährlichen Sicherheitszertifizierungen beibehält und die sich ändernden globalen Vorschriften wie das US-amerikanische DOJ, NIS2 und RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 erfüllt. Sie kombinieren fundierte Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit mit fundierten regulatorischen Kenntnissen und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten, um externe Audits und Inspektionen sowie strategische Sicherheitsinitiativen in der gesamten Gruppe zu leiten. Ihr Ziel ist es, sicherzustellen, dass das Sicherheits-Framework nicht nur konform, sondern auch skalierbar und effektiv ist, um die kritischen Assets von Roche in einem stark regulierten Umfeld zu schützen. Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umwandlung von Information Security Governance in ein Business Enabler. Das Team Information Security & Privacy Governance bietet Roche den Rahmen, um Informationsrisiken zu identifizieren, zu bewerten und zu mindern. Der Bereich ist um drei Säulen organisiert:
• Governance & ISMS: Pflege des Roche Global ISMS Frameworks und der Zertifizierung (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung des globalen IMS von Roche nach US DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER, GMP Annex 11 und globalen Vorschriften für das Gesundheitswesen/Medizinprodukte.
• Audit & Assurance: Unterstützen Sie Roche-Tochtergesellschaften bei externen Inspektionen und zeigen Sie ihre Verpflichtung zur Einhaltung. Aufgabenbereich ISMS Strategie & Framework Management
• Globales ISMS-Eigentum : Besitzen und pflegen Sie das Roche ISMS-Framework, um eine vollständige Übereinstimmung mit ISO / IEC 27001: 2022 und die Integration mit anderen Qualitätsmanagementsystemen zu gewährleisten.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Fahren Sie den ISMS-Zyklus "Plan-Do-Check-Act" (PDCA), um sicherzustellen, dass sich das Framework mit der Bedrohungslandschaft und den Geschäftsanforderungen entwickelt und die erfolgreiche jährliche Zertifizierungskontinuität gewahrt bleibt.
• Policy Governance: Definieren und pflegen Sie Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Standards, Richtlinien und Verfahren auf Unternehmensebene, um sicherzustellen, dass sie zweckdienlich, umsetzbar und messbar sind.
• Risikoüberwachung: Überwachen Sie die globale Risikolandschaft, um Anpassungen zu identifizieren, die an den Governance-Rahmen erforderlich sind. Regulatory & Compliance Orchestrierung
• Regulatory Translation: Integration komplexer globaler Anforderungen (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) in Roche Global ISMS.
• Produkt & Services: Arbeiten Sie mit Produktteams zusammen, um die Integration von "Security by Design" in ihre Kultur, Fähigkeiten, Prozesse und Projekte sicherzustellen.
• Control Mapping: Pflegen Sie ein einheitliches Kontroll-Framework, das interne Roche-Steuerungen mehreren externen regulatorischen Anforderungen zuordnet, um die Abdeckung des Roche Global ISMS zu validieren.
• Beratung: Handeln Sie als Berater für Roche-Tochtergesellschaften und führen Sie sie zur Einhaltung regionaler oder funktionaler Sicherheitsrichtlinien. Audit & Inspection Support
• Externe Audit- und Inspektionsunterstützung: Unterstützung von Rechtspersonen der Roche-Gruppe und Funktionen bei externen Audits und behördlichen Inspektionen.
• Risikobehandlungsaufsicht: Koordinieren Sie Sanierungspläne für Audit- und Inspektionsergebnisse und verfolgen Sie den Fortschritt bis zur Schließung.
• Third-Party Governance: Überwachen Sie das Security Governance Framework für kritische Supply Chain Partner und Cloud Service Provider. Stakeholder & Change Management
• Strategische Beratung: Dienen Sie als Brücke zwischen Führungskräften, Recht, Datenschutz und Qualität, um Informationssicherheitsrisiken und Meilensteine zu kommunizieren.
• Kultur & Bewusstsein: Unterstützen Sie die Informationssicherheitsnetzwerke durch eine hochrangige Governance-Anleitung und strategische Ausrichtung. Qualifikation

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'expert en gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information, vous dirigez l'intégrité et la résilience du Système de gestion de la sécurité de l'information (SGI) de Roche. Vous êtes responsable de veiller à ce que l'organisation conserve ses certifications de sécurité annuelles et demeure conforme à l'évolution de la réglementation mondiale telle que le DOJ, NIS2 et RCE/CER, GMP Annexe 11. Vous combinez une expérience approfondie en matière de sécurité de l'information avec de solides connaissances réglementaires et des compétences en gestion de projet, pour diriger des audits et inspections externes et des initiatives stratégiques en matière de sécurité dans tout le groupe. Votre objectif est de veiller à ce que le cadre de sécurité soit non seulement conforme, mais aussi évolutif et efficace pour protéger les actifs essentiels de Roche dans un environnement hautement réglementé. Vous avez prouvé que la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information est devenue un moteur d'affaires. L'équipe de la gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information et de la protection des renseignements personnels fournit le cadre permettant à Roche de cerner, d'évaluer et d'atténuer les risques liés à l'information. La zone est organisée autour de trois piliers :
• Gouvernance et SIGS : Maintenir le cadre et la certification du SIGS mondial de Roche (ISO/IEC 27001).
• Conformité à la réglementation : Assurer le respect de Roche ISMS mondial au DOJ/NIS2, RCE/CER des États-Unis, à l'annexe 11 des BPF et aux règlements mondiaux en matière de soins de santé et de dispositifs médicaux.
• Audit & Assurance: Soutenez les affiliés de Roche lors d'inspections externes, démontrant leur engagement envers la conformité. Responsabilités professionnelles Stratégie et cadre de gestion du SGIS
• Global ISMS Ownership : Possédez et maintenez le cadre de l'ISMS Roche, assurant un alignement complet avec ISO/IEC 27001:2022 et l'intégration avec d'autres systèmes de gestion de la qualité.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger le cycle de « Plan-Do-Check-Act » (PDCA) du SGSI afin de s'assurer que le cadre évolue en fonction du paysage de la menace et des besoins opérationnels, tout en maintenant une continuité de certification annuelle réussie.
• Gouvernance des politiques : Définir et maintenir des politiques, des normes, des directives et des procédures de sécurité au niveau de l'entreprise, en veillant à ce qu'elles soient adaptées à l'usage, réalisables et mesurables.
• Surveillance des risques : Surveiller le paysage mondial des risques afin de déterminer les adaptations nécessaires au cadre de gouvernance. Réglementaire & Conformité Orchestration
• Translation réglementaire: Intégrer des exigences mondiales complexes (NIS2, HIPAA, US DOJ) dans Roche Global ISMS.
• Produits et services : Collaborez avec les équipes de produits pour assurer l'intégration de la sécurité par le design dans leur culture, leurs compétences, leurs processus et leurs projets.
• Cartographie des contrôles : Maintenir un cadre de contrôle unifié qui cartographie les contrôles internes de Roche en fonction de multiples exigences réglementaires externes pour valider la couverture du SIGS mondial de Roche.
• Conseils : Agir en tant que consultant auprès des affiliés Roche, les guidant vers le respect des directives de sécurité régionales ou fonctionnelles. Soutien à la vérification et à l'inspection
• Soutien à l'audit externe et à l'inspection : Soutenir les entités juridiques du Groupe Roche et les fonctions lors des audits externes et des inspections réglementaires.
• Risques Surveillance du traitement : Coordonner les plans d'assainissement pour les constatations de vérification et d'inspection et suivre les progrès réalisés jusqu'à la clôture.
• Gouvernance de tiers : Surveiller le cadre de gouvernance de la sécurité pour les partenaires essentiels de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et les fournisseurs de services Cloud. Gestion des intervenants et du changement
• Avis stratégique : Servir de passerelle entre les cadres supérieurs, le droit, la protection des renseignements personnels et la qualité pour communiquer les risques liés à la sécurité de l'information et les étapes de maturité.
• Culture et sensibilisation : Appuyer les réseaux de sécurité de l'information en fournissant des conseils de gouvernance et une orientation stratégique de haut niveau. Compétence

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms. We make medicines at 16 plants and 12 sites around the world. If you would like to get more information about Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT).

Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) focuses on business insights delivery and innovation within the PT financial results through consistent set of processes, reports and analytic tools which enables Business Partners decisions making.

In this role as Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) you are expected to unlock business value working with PT Global Functions, in particular partnering with Global Quality. You will operate in networks and according to agile standards. You will engage and influence decision making with the business and will have the opportunity to engage in relevant work packages with impact on both, company priorities and personal development. You bring expertise and experience which proves track records of solid performance and seniority.

You will bring strong technical expertise (relative to your experience) together with the ability to work in a self-aligning team with minimal hierarchy. You will be a catalyst for the Finance transformation and work effectively as an influencer, leaning in as a coach and catalyst to the Finance network as needed. You have a passion for piloting new approaches and constructively challenging the status quo. You know what great FP&A looks like and can identify improvement areas and also make it happen through effective stakeholder management. You can tolerate ambiguity.

Your main focus area will be Global Quality.

The Opportunity:

• Strengthen Quality Partnership: Act as the primary financial business partner to the Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ) leadership, providing strategic financial guidance on quality system investments, compliance-related projects, and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) resource allocation.

• Focus on Systemic Insights: Collaborate with Quality stakeholders to translate performance metrics, such as deviations and inspection findings, into actionable financial insights, supporting long-term strategic shifts from reactive to proactive quality management.

• Governance & Decision Support: Support business cases for quality-driven initiatives, ensuring financial rigor in decisions impacting manufacturing network harmonization, risk mitigation, and the "Quality Unites Us" strategic agenda.

In this role, you are expected to connect the information received through various channels analyze the impacts in PT Financials and beyond, and communicate such to the PT Finance head and other stakeholders where necessary. The enterprise view looking beyond the PT will be a significant success factor for this role.

Who you are

• At least 5-10 years of experience in a multinational financial consolidation environment

• Strong knowledge of manufacturing finance especially in consolidation related to COGS and Inventory and strong knowledge of IFRS, ACCA, or CPA preferred

• Experience with internal controls and external audits is preferred

• Strong stakeholder management skills with various levels and groups of stakeholders. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Entrepreneurial spirit and curiosity that is inspirational to others

• Proven technica

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione PT è coinvolta nella produzione di ogni medicina Roche. dal processo di sviluppo attraverso sperimentazioni cliniche e continuando a maturità del prodotto. La nostra organizzazione coordina tutti gli aspetti della produzione di farmaci Roche in tutte le aree di malattia e forme di dosaggio. Produciamo medicinali in 16 piante e 12 siti in tutto il mondo. Se volete ottenere maggiori informazioni su Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT). Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) si concentra sulla fornitura di informazioni aziendali e sull'innovazione all'interno dei risultati finanziari del PT attraverso una serie coerente di processi, report e strumenti analitici che consentono di prendere decisioni dei Business Partner. In questo ruolo come Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) ci si aspetta di sbloccare il valore aziendale lavorando con PT Global Functions, in particolare collaborando con Global Quality. Intraprenderai e influenzerai il processo decisionale con il business e avrai l'opportunità di impegnarsi in pacchetti di lavoro pertinenti con impatto su entrambe le priorità aziendali e sviluppo personale. Porterai competenze ed esperienza che dimostra record di prestazioni solide e anzianità. Porterai una forte esperienza tecnica (relativa alla tua esperienza) insieme alla capacità di lavorare in un team di auto-allineamento con una gerarchia minima. Sarai un catalizzatore per la trasformazione della finanza e lavorerai efficacemente come influencer, appoggiandoti come allenatore e catalizzatore alla rete finanziaria, se necessario. Hai la passione per pilotare nuovi approcci e sfidare costruttivamente lo status quo. Sai come appare grande FP&A e può identificare aree di miglioramento e farlo accadere anche attraverso una gestione efficace delle parti interessate. Puoi tollerare l'ambiguità. La tua area di messa a fuoco principale sarà la Qualità Globale. Opportunità:
• Rafforzare il partenariato qualità: agire come partner primario del business finanziario per la leadership Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ), fornendo orientamenti finanziari strategici sugli investimenti di sistema di qualità, progetti connessi alla conformità, e l'assegnazione delle risorse CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action).
• Focus su Insight sistemici: ditta di partnership con gli stakeholder di qualità per tradurre le metriche delle prestazioni, come deviazioni e risultati delle ispezioni, in in approfondimenti finanziari attuabili, supportando spostamenti strategici a lungo termine da una gestione della qualità reattiva a una proattiva.
• Governance e supporto decisionale: sostenere i casi aziendali per iniziative basate sulla qualità, garantire un rigor finanziario nelle decisioni che incidono sull'armonizzazione delle reti di produzione, sulla mitigazione dei rischi e sull'agenda strategica "Quality Unites Us." In questo ruolo, ci si aspetta che le informazioni ricevute attraverso vari canali analizzino gli impatti in PT Financials e non solo, e comunichino tali effetti alla testa di PT Finance e ad altri stakeholder, ove necessario. La visione dell'impresa che guarda oltre il PT sarà un fattore di successo significativo per questo ruolo. Chi sei
• Almeno 5-10 anni di esperienza in un contesto di consolidamento finanziario multinazionale
• Forte conoscenza del finanziamento manifatturiero soprattutto nel consolidamento legato ai COGS e all'inventario e forte conoscenza degli IFRS, ACCA, o CPA preferita
• Esperienza con controlli interni e audit esterni è preferibile
• Forte competenze di gestione delle parti interessate con vari livelli e gruppi di stakeholder. Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente e parte di un team. Spirito imprenditoriale e curiosità che è ispirazione per gli altri
• Proven technica

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen. Die Position PT ist an der Herstellung jedes Roche-Medikaments beteiligt – vom Entwicklungsprozess über klinische Studien bis hin zur Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Herstellung von Roche-Medikamenten in allen Krankheitsgebieten und Dosierungsformen. Wir stellen Medikamente an 16 Standorten und 12 Standorten weltweit her. Wenn Sie mehr über Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) erfahren möchten. Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) konzentriert sich auf die Bereitstellung und Innovation von Geschäftseinblicken innerhalb der PT-Finanzergebnisse durch konsistente Prozesse, Berichte und Analysewerkzeuge, die es den Geschäftspartnern ermöglichen, Entscheidungen zu treffen. In dieser Funktion als Finance Enterprise Partner PT (Pharma Technical) wird erwartet, dass Sie die Geschäftswerte der Arbeit mit PT Global Functions, insbesondere der Partnerschaft mit Global Quality, freisetzen. Sie arbeiten in Netzwerken und nach agilen Standards. Sie werden die Entscheidungsfindung mit dem Unternehmen involvieren und beeinflussen und haben die Möglichkeit, relevante Arbeitspakete mit Auswirkungen auf die Unternehmensschwerpunkte und die persönliche Entwicklung zu betreiben. Sie bringen Expertise und Erfahrung, die Erfolge von solider Leistung und Seniorität beweist. Sie bringen starke technische Expertise (bezogen auf Ihre Erfahrung) zusammen mit der Fähigkeit, in einem selbstjustierenden Team mit minimaler Hierarchie zu arbeiten. Sie werden ein Katalysator für die Finanztransformation sein und effektiv als Influencer arbeiten, sich als Coach und Katalysator für das Finanznetzwerk bei Bedarf einverleiben. Sie haben die Leidenschaft, neue Ansätze zu steuern und konstruktiv den Status Quo herauszufordern. Sie wissen, wie groß FP&A aussieht und können Verbesserungsbereiche identifizieren und es auch durch effektives Stakeholder-Management geschehen lassen. Sie können Mehrdeutigkeit tolerieren. Ihr Schwerpunktbereich wird globale Qualität sein. Die Chance:
• Qualitätspartnerschaft stärken: Als primärer Finanzpartner der Führung der Global Technical Operations Quality (PTQ) fungieren, strategische Finanzleitlinien für Investitionen in Qualitätssicherungssysteme, Compliance-bezogene Projekte und die Ressourcenzuweisung von CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) liefern.
• Fokus auf Systemische Erkenntnisse: Zusammenarbeit mit Qualitätsakteuren, um Leistungskennzahlen wie Abweichungen und Inspektionsergebnisse in umsetzbare finanzielle Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen, die langfristige strategische Verschiebungen von reaktivem zu proaktivem Qualitätsmanagement unterstützen.
• Governance & Decision Support: Unterstützung von Geschäftsfällen für qualitätsorientierte Initiativen, Gewährleistung finanzieller Strenge bei Entscheidungen, die die Harmonisierung des Fertigungsnetzes, Risikominderung und die strategische Agenda „Quality Unites Us" beeinflussen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie erwartet, dass Sie die Informationen, die über verschiedene Kanäle erhalten werden, analysieren und diese an den PT Finance-Chef und andere Stakeholder, wenn nötig, kommunizieren. Wer Sie sind
• Mindestens 5-10 Jahre Erfahrung in einem multinationalen Finanzkonsolidierungsumfeld
• Starke Kenntnisse der Fertigungsfinanzierung vor allem in der Konsolidierung im Zusammenhang mit COGS und Inventar und starke Kenntnisse der IFRS, ACCA oder CPA bevorzugt
• Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollen und externen Audits bevorzugt
• Starke Stakeholder Management-Fähigkeiten mit verschiedenen Ebenen und Gruppen von Stakeholdern. Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten sowie Teil eines Teams. Unternehmergeist und Neugier, die andere inspirierend ist
• Bewährte Technica
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Notre organisation coordonne tous les aspects de la production de médicaments Roche dans toutes les zones de maladies et formes posologiques. Nous fabriquons des médicaments à 16 usines et 12 sites dans le monde. Si vous souhaitez obtenir plus d'informations sur Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT), nous vous invitons à utiliser des médicaments pour la fabrication de médicaments. Pharma Technical Operations Finance (PFT) se concentre sur la diffusion de perspectives d'affaires et l'innovation dans les résultats financiers PT grâce à un ensemble cohérent de processus, rapports et outils d'analyse qui permet aux partenaires d'affaires de prendre des décisions. Dans ce rôle en tant que partenaire d'entreprise PT (Pharma Technical) vous êtes censés débloquer la valeur commerciale de travailler avec PT Global Functions, en particulier en partenariat avec Global Quality. Vous aurez la possibilité de participer à des programmes de travail pertinents qui auront une incidence sur les priorités de l'entreprise et sur le développement personnel. Vous apporterez une expertise et une expérience qui prouvent des antécédents de performance et d'ancienneté solides. Vous apporterez une expertise technique solide (relative à votre expérience) ainsi que la capacité de travailler dans une équipe auto-alignement avec une hiérarchie minimale. Vous serez un catalyseur de la transformation des Finances et travaillerez efficacement comme une intrusion, en vous penchant comme un entraîneur et un catalyseur du réseau des Finances au besoin. Vous avez une passion pour piloter de nouvelles approches et contester de façon constructive le statu quo. Vous savez à quoi ressemble la FP&A et pouvez identifier les domaines d'amélioration et aussi faire en sorte que cela se produise par une gestion efficace des intervenants. L'opportunité :
• Renforcer le partenariat qualité : agir en tant que principal partenaire financier du leadership mondial de la qualité des opérations techniques (PTQ), en fournissant des orientations financières stratégiques sur les investissements des systèmes qualité, les projets liés à la conformité et l'allocation des ressources de l'ACAP (Actions correctives et préventives).
• Se concentrer sur les points forts : collaborer avec les intervenants de la qualité pour traduire les mesures de rendement, comme les écarts et les constatations d'inspection, en points forts, en points forts, en appui aux changements stratégiques à long terme, passant d'une gestion de la qualité réactive à une gestion proactive.
• Gouvernance et soutien à la décision : soutien aux analyses de rentabilisation pour des initiatives axées sur la qualité, en assurant la rigueur financière dans les décisions ayant une incidence sur l'harmonisation des réseaux de fabrication, l'atténuation des risques et le programme stratégique « Qualité Nous unit ». Dans ce rôle, vous devez relier les informations reçues par divers canaux analyser les impacts dans PT Financials et au-delà, et communiquer ces informations au responsable PT Finance et aux autres parties prenantes, si nécessaire. Qui vous êtes
• Au moins 5-10 ans d'expérience dans un environnement de consolidation financière multinational
• Une solide connaissance du financement manufacturier, notamment dans la consolidation liée aux COGS et aux stocks et une solide connaissance des IFRS, ACCA ou CPA préférées
• Une expérience des contrôles internes et des audits externes est privilégiée
• Des compétences fortes en gestion des parties prenantes avec différents niveaux et groupes d'intervenants.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As part of the Sites Network, Global Capital Investment & Real Estate is responsible for improving the built environment of Roche globally. Within Global Capital Investment and Real Estate, the Global Real Estate Operations Manager is responsible for the tracking, analysis, and optimisation of our real estate portfolio, systems, and sustainability initiatives.

The opportunity
As Global Real Estate Operations Manager, you will ensure high data quality, financial compliance, and governance-compliant operations are delivered across the Roche occupied real estate portfolio.

The Global Real Estate Operations Manager supports the Global Lead Real Estate Transactions in implementing governance compliance, best practice processes, and managing real estate transactions. This role encompasses the management of real estate technology, data, and digital initiatives, delivering consistent high-quality performance within the real estate organisation while introducing innovative ways to optimise workflows.
As Global Real Estate Operations Manager you will have following responsibilities:

• Portfolio & Transaction Support: Support managing real estate transactions and asset portfolios, ensuring data quality, M&A due diligence support, and providing governance approval quality control.

• Green Leasing Programme: Coordinate the Roche Green Leasing program, including workflow management, performance measurement, reporting, and external certification.

• Real Estate Systems & Data: Oversee real estate technology solutions (e.g. Lease Harbor, OutSystems/”CREM”), drive digital initiatives, and demonstrate AI fluency to automate workflows and enhance data analysis.

• Reporting & Financial Compliance: Coordinate KPI tracking, support financial modelling, coordinate annual IFRS16 lease validation, and ensure accurate reporting.

• Vendor & Budget Coordination: Track vendor performance (SLAs), invoicing, annual cost budgeting, and Purchase Order tracking.

• Cross-Functional Support: Assist with M&A due diligence, support creation of leadership presentations, and drive continuous documentation improvements.

Who you are

• You hold a university degree (BA/BSc) in Real Estate, Facility Management, Business Administration, or a related field, along with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience

• Strong analytical, estimating, and problem-solving skills, with expertise in financial model architecture, scenario analysis, and proficiency in Google Workspace and MS 365.

• Keen eye for detail with a passion for accuracy in data, documentation, and compliance processes.

• AI fluency and a proactive aptitude for experimenting with emerging tools to enhance workflows and outcomes.

• Ability to think strategically and develop efficient, practical tactical methods to achieve objectives, while proactively anticipating risks across multiple projects.

• Strong team player with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse and geographically dispersed internal and external stakeholders in both physical and virtual settings.

• Self-motivated, disciplined, and accountable, demonstrating initiative, entrepreneurialism, and composure under pressure.

• Fluent in English

Application process
Please submit your complete application, including your CV and a compelling motivation letter

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

jobs.title: Process Engineer Upstream Manufacturing
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Als Process Engineer Upstream Manufacturing lieferst Du Lösungen in der Bau 91 Manufacturing Unit SUT (Single-use Technology) bei Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing für eine sichere und qualitativ hochwertige Antikörper Produktion. Du dienst sowohl unseren Patienten als auch unseren Mitarbeitern, indem Du Prozessverbesserungen entwickelst und implementierst und den Dialog und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen lokalen und globalen Funktionen in den Bereichen Entwicklung, Innovation und Regulatory förderst. Innerhalb unseres RePeng-Teams (Recipe and Process Engineering) suchen wir Dich als Process Engineer zur Optimierung unserer Upstream-Prozesse.

Die Möglichkeit:

Deine Hauptaufgabe ist die technische und wissenschaftliche Unterstützung für robuste und effiziente Herstellungsprozesse im GMP-Umfeld, einschließlich Bereitschaftsdienst. Des Weiteren:

• Technische und wissenschaftliche Unterstützung der Schichten zur Sicherstellung robuster und effizienter Herstellungsprozesse im GMP-Umfeld, sowie Bereitschaftsdienst (On-Call)

• Umgang mit geplanten und ungeplanten Ereignissen nach GMP-Richtlinien

• Überprüfung und Genehmigung elektronischer Chargenprotokolle für kommerzielle und klinische Produkte

• Leitung oder Unterstützung von Optimierungsprojekten und Einführung neuer Technologien oder Produkte

• Erstellung und Präsentation von Konzepten, Dokumenten und Assessments bei GMP-Audits und Behördeninspektionen

Wer Du bist:

Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaften, Biotechnologie, Bioprozesstechnik bevorzugt). Des Weiteren:

• Umfassende Kenntnisse im Upstream Processing biotechnologisch hergestellter Produkte

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in biopharmazeutischer Herstellung oder Entwicklung

• Erfahrung im Arbeiten in einer GMP-Umgebung sowie bei technischen Transfers und im Qualitätsrisikomanagement (QRM) von Vorteil

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Team und an Schnittstellen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Servite sia i nostri pazienti che i nostri dipendenti sviluppando e implementando i miglioramenti dei processi e promuovendo il dialogo e la collaborazione tra lo sviluppo locale e globale, l'innovazione e le funzioni normative. • Conoscenza completa della lavorazione a monte dei prodotti biotecnologici
• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella produzione o nello sviluppo biofarmaceutico
• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente GMP così come nei trasferimenti tecnici e nella gestione del rischio di qualità (QRM)
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione nel team e nelle interfacce.

I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche.

Como um Parceiro da Jornada do Paciente com foco em Esclerose Múltipla você será o ponto focal da Roche no ecossistema, trabalhando em parceria com os stakeholders que lidam diretamente com a jornada do paciente. O objetivo é obter um entendimento profundo de suas necessidades para, então, conectar as capacidades da Roche e co-criar soluções significativas. Seu foco será proporcionar o melhor resultado e o acesso de nossas inovações em um curto prazo aos nossos pacientes, garantindo uma execução com excelência.

Sobre a oportunidade:

• Responsável por identificar um propósito compartilhado dentro do ecossistema relacionado à jornada do paciente visando co-criar soluções relacionadas a mudanças necessárias do ponto de vista científico.

titleByLocale.it: Modulo di consegna del trasferimento dati RDT M&A
titleByLocale.en: RDT M&A Data Transfer Delivery Lead
titleByLocale.de: RDT M&A Data Transfer Delivery Lead
titleByLocale.fr: RDT Responsable de la transmission des données

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As the Data Transfer Delivery Lead, you will take on a vital role driving the successful delivery of Data Transfer, Data Migration, and Data Access requirements across multiple functional areas within the Mergers, Acquisitions, Partnerships, In-licensing, and Out-licensing space. Leading the Data Handling workstream across multiple integration and partnership projects, you will make critical technical decisions, manage complex inter-organizational initiatives, and ensure compliant, on-time delivery. This high-impact position demands exceptional problem-solving capabilities, strategic vendor relationship management, and the ability to confidently influence overarching technical strategies and senior stakeholders.

Your Opportunity
As our Data Transfer Delivery Lead, you will:

• Spearhead the end-to-end data strategy and execution for various Mergers, Acquisitions, Divestitures, and Strategic Partnerships, ensuring seamless and secure transitions.

• Guide and direct technical teams while effectively influencing architectural decisions to ensure scalable, secure, and compliant data transfers and access.

• Take full accountability for the timely and complete execution of all data transfer and migration activities, ensuring strict adherence to defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and project milestones.

• Drive proactive issue resolution by diagnosing and resolving complex technical challenges in close collaboration with system owners, engineering teams, and third-party vendors.

• Act as the primary point of contact for IT leadership, business stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring total alignment on data handling needs, access requirements, and project scope.

• Lead high-impact projects specifically focused on the data workstream within the RDT Mergers & Acquisitions portfolio.

• Orchestrate cross-functional data mapping sessions, actively guiding business stakeholders and data owners to finalize migration rules that align with target enterprise architecture.

• Uphold rigorous data integrity and privacy, ensuring all data transfers comply with global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), intellectual property protection, and corporate security standards.

Who you are
We are looking for a strategic thinker who thrives in complex enterprise environments. You possess:

• Education: A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer science / Engineering or equivalent.

• Experience: Overall 10+ years of experience in IT, with a proven track record of managing stakeholders and executing high-impact projects.

• Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading complex initiatives in data migration and contributing significantly to enterprise-level data governance.

• Team & Vendor Management: Proven track record of managing vendor teams with more than 10+ resources alongside comprehensive project budget management.

• Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in cloud data platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and modern ETL/ELT architecture patterns.

• Problem-Solving Depth: Deep technical knowledge of various enterprise data transfer tools and protocols, with a strong ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve system connectivity and data transit issues in real-time.

• Strategic Influence: Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to liaise with senior leadership, mentor junior team members, and influence cross-functional architectural decisions.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together

Conducendo il flusso di lavoro Data Handling attraverso molteplici progetti di integrazione e partnership, prenderete decisioni tecniche critiche, gestire complesse iniziative inter-organizzative e garantire la consegna puntuale e conforme. • Team & Vendor Management: Provato record di gestione dei team di fornitori con più di 10+ risorse insieme alla gestione completa del budget del progetto.
• Competenza tecnica: Forte competenza nelle piattaforme di dati cloud, nell'infrastruttura aziendale e nei moderni modelli di architettura ETL/ELT.
• Depth problem-solving: profonda conoscenza tecnica di vari strumenti e protocolli di trasferimento dati aziendali, con una forte capacità di diagnostica, risoluzione dei problemi, e risolvere problemi di connettività di sistema e di transito dei dati in tempo reale.
• Influenza strategica: forte leadership e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di legare con leadership senior, membri del team mentore junior e influenzare le decisioni architettoniche interfunzionali. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme

• Team & Vendor Management: Proven track record of managing vendor teams with more than 10+ resources alongside comprehensive project budget management.
• Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in cloud data platforms, enterprise infrastructure, and modern ETL/ELT architecture patterns.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que responsable de la livraison des données, vous assumerez un rôle essentiel qui permettra de fournir avec succès les exigences relatives au transfert, à la migration et à l'accès aux données dans plusieurs domaines fonctionnels au sein de l'espace Fusions, Acquisitions, Partenariats, Licences et Out-Licensing. Diriger le flux de travail sur le traitement des données dans le cadre de multiples projets d'intégration et de partenariat, vous prendrez des décisions techniques critiques, gérerez des initiatives interorganisations complexes et assurerez une prestation conforme et à temps. Cette position à fort impact exige des capacités exceptionnelles de résolution de problèmes, une gestion stratégique des relations avec les fournisseurs et la capacité d'influencer avec confiance les stratégies techniques globales et les principaux intervenants. Votre opportunité En tant que responsable de la livraison des données, vous devrez :
• Dirigez la stratégie de données de bout en bout et l'exécution de diverses fusions, acquisitions, divorces et partenariats stratégiques, en assurant une transition transparente et sécurisée.
• Guider et diriger les équipes techniques tout en influençant efficacement les décisions architecturales pour assurer des transferts et un accès de données évolutives, sécuritaires et conformes.
• Rendre pleinement compte de l'exécution en temps opportun et complète de toutes les activités de transfert de données et de migration, en veillant au strict respect des indicateurs clés de performance (ICP) et des étapes du projet.
• Diriger la résolution proactive des problèmes en diagnosticant et en résolvant les défis techniques complexes en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de systèmes, les équipes d'ingénierie et les fournisseurs tiers.
• Agir en tant que principal point de contact pour le leadership en TI, les intervenants commerciaux et les partenaires externes, en assurant l'alignement total sur les besoins de traitement des données, les exigences d'accès et la portée du projet.
• Diriger des projets à impact élevé axés spécifiquement sur le flux de données au sein du portefeuille Fusions et acquisitions de RDT.
• Organiser des séances de cartographie de données interfonctionnelles, en guidant activement les parties prenantes et les propriétaires de données pour finaliser les règles de migration qui s'harmonisent avec l'architecture d'entreprise cible.
• Maintenir l'intégrité et la confidentialité rigoureuses des données, en veillant à ce que tous les transferts de données soient conformes aux règles mondiales en matière de confidentialité des données (p. ex. RGPD, CCPA), à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle et aux normes de sécurité des entreprises. Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons un penseur stratégique qui prospère dans des environnements d'entreprise complexes. Vous possédez :
• Études : Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique / génie ou équivalent.
• Expérience : Au total, 10 ans et plus d'expérience en TI, avec une expérience éprouvée de gestion des intervenants et d'exécution de projets à impact élevé.
• Leadership du projet : Expérience démontrée menant des initiatives complexes en matière de migration des données et contribuant de façon significative à la gouvernance des données au niveau de l'entreprise.
• Gestion de l'équipe et des fournisseurs : Expérience éprouvée de la gestion des équipes de fournisseurs avec plus de 10 ressources et une gestion budgétaire complète du projet.
• Expertise technique: Forte compétence dans les plateformes de données en nuage, l'infrastructure d'entreprise et les modèles d'architecture ETL/ELT modernes.
• Profondeur de résolution des problèmes : Connaissance technique approfondie de divers outils et protocoles de transfert de données d'entreprise, avec une forte capacité de diagnostic, de dépannage et de résolution des problèmes de connectivité et de transit de données en temps réel.
• Influence stratégique : Fortes compétences en leadership et en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de communiquer avec les cadres supérieurs, de guider les membres de l'équipe subalterne et d'influencer les décisions d'architecture interfonctionnelles. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Diabetes Care

titleByLocale.it: Principal IT Support Ingegnere - Diabetes Care
titleByLocale.fr: Principal IT Support Ingénieur - Diabetes Care

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Principal Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s cloud and mobile-based Digital Diabetes Care solutions , among others, handling complaints related to HCP Platforms and patient-facing apps (e.g., mySugr, Accu-Chek SmartGuide) , continuous glucose monitoring data, and accompanying algorithms.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, focusing primarily on cloud-based medical software for patients , giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages.

Your core mission will be to act as the most experienced deep-dive investigator and internal-facing team organizer, as well as the main representative for the closer stakeholders (e.g., Local teams, Development…): You will analyze complex cases, system logs, coordinate investigations with internal partners, and source code to determine the root cause or causal factor of a software malfunction/issue, particularly those involving remote patient monitoring , patient-generated data (e.g., blood glucose levels) , and predictive insights . While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes.

The Opportunity:

• You are accountable for handling complex medical software complaints, safety issues, and product inquiries for patient-facing cloud and mobile applications within the Diabetes Care portfolio.

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle at global level, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as the most senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause factor of software malfunctions.

• You will coach and support more junior team members in technical and process aspects.

• You are the main interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You orchestrate work distribution, manage internal alignments, and ensure the team consistently meets its performance and compliance KPIs. Furthermore you coach your team members to systematically elevate the debugging and automation skillsets of the entire team

Who you are:

• A degree in computer science or an IT -related field

• 7+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Software engineering or IT support related functions, showcasing strong lateral leadership, a passion for coaching people and developing agile processes

• Excellent ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty, pressure and ambiguous information.

• Strong resilience and proven ability to steer a distributed team smoothly through high-pressure, uncertain, and highly visible product quality crises.

• Excellent ability to interact with stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forward

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

What you get:

• Employment contract (Umowa o pracę),

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance;

• Private healthcare ( LuxMed packages) and group life insurance (UN

jobs.title: Country Medical Manager (BC)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary)
The Country Medical Manager (CMM) is a trusted, externally focused, scientifically grounded partner within our customer engagement model. By building and maintaining deep and trusted connections with key top-tier customers over a meaningful period of time, the CMM will generate impact by anticipating and proactively optimizing medical practice, and ensure that Roche is a preferred partner in our key disease areas.
The Medical function serves as a critical engine of competitiveness to ensure our innovations reach their full potential for patients with an end to end perspective. The role of the CMM is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio by proactively capitalizing on "Moments that Matter" across the asset lifecycle.

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities
1. Contributing with Medical Expertise (core & common):

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a forward-thinking, scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

2. Proactive Customer Engagement & Insights (core & common):

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The CMM serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging top-tier TAEs, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles. In the pre-launch phase it is the priority to drive proactive E2E strategies that deliver superior experience, anticipate the future and shape medical practice accordingly. In the post-launch phase the engagement continues to ensure that the right patients are treated at the right time and the engagement scope expands on unserved patient populations. In-field engagement serves as a critical component of this overarching strategy for targeted scientific engagement. It is understood that based on business needs the CMM can serve as the primary point of contact for certain customers with the ambition to drive required healthcare system changes and where feasible earlier and broader adoption of our transformative portfolio.

• Medical Partnership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations withTAEs. Provide current, high-quality, integrated Medical Education plan and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional International/National Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement base

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Scopo primario di lavoro (Riepilogo del lavoro) Il Country Medical Manager (CMM) è un partner affidabile, esternamente focalizzato, scientificamente fondato all'interno del nostro modello di customer engagement. Con la costruzione e il mantenimento di connessioni profonde e affidabili con i clienti di alto livello chiave in un periodo di tempo significativo, il CMM genererà l'impatto anticipando e ottimizzando proattivamente la pratica medica, e assicurarsi che Roche è un partner preferito nelle nostre aree di malattia chiave. La funzione medica funge da motore critico di competitività per garantire che le nostre innovazioni raggiungano il loro pieno potenziale per i pazienti con una prospettiva finale. Il ruolo del CMM è progettato per massimizzare le attività mediche e scientifiche locali e di fondo per accelerare la consegna della nostra pipeline, differenziare il nostro portafoglio in base ai dati, guidare l'advocacy strategica, l'impegno della comunità, l'adozione della pratica medica, e l'accesso al nostro portafoglio mediante la capitalizzazione proattiva su "Momenti che Matter" attraverso il ciclo di vita degli asset. Principio ruoli e responsabilità / responsabilità 1. Contribuire con Medical Expertise (core & common):
• Competenza medica: responsabile per contribuire attivamente a una forte competenza scientifica, medica e terapeutica nell'ambito delle pertinenti malattie che informano la differenziazione della nostra pipeline e del nostro portafoglio. Agire come esperto medico per la pipeline e il portafoglio durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.
• Strategia di forma: Guidare la parte medica della strategia integrata, modellare una storia di valore, scientificamente sana e differenziata localmente e comunicare i contributi di Roche in aree chiave di malattia, riflettendo una prospettiva aziendale end-to-end che tira attraverso la strategia con impatto. 2. Impegno e opinioni dei clienti attivi (core & common):
• Impegno medico mirato attivo: come funzione medica la nostra ambizione è quella di trascorrere la maggior parte del nostro tempo attivamente coinvolgendo con i clienti esterni come partner nella strategia di coinvolgimento del cliente integrata. Il CMM funge da esperto scientifico e medico, attivando proattivamente TAE di alto livello e altri principali stakeholder in pieno allineamento strategico e operativo con altri ruoli in campo. Nella fase pre-lancio è la priorità di guidare strategie E2E proattive che offrono un'esperienza superiore, anticipare il futuro e modellare la pratica medica di conseguenza. Nella fase post-launch l'impegno continua a garantire che i pazienti giusti siano trattati al momento giusto e la portata di fidanzamento si espande sulle popolazioni dei pazienti non servite. Il coinvolgimento in campo serve come componente fondamentale di questa strategia di overarching per il coinvolgimento scientifico mirato. Si capisce che in base alle esigenze aziendali il CMM può servire come punto di contatto primario per alcuni clienti con l'ambizione di guidare i cambiamenti del sistema sanitario richiesti e dove possibile prima e più ampia adozione del nostro portafoglio trasformativo.
• Partenariato medico & Istruzione: Stabilire e mantenere efficaci relazioni tra pari e genitori con gli stakeholder esterni e identificare / sviluppare collaborazioni scientifiche conTAEs. Fornire corrente, di alta qualità, piano di educazione medica integrata e differenziare le informazioni scientifiche ai clienti esterni, sostenere la formazione scientifica dei team interni e garantire la formazione continua sulle conoscenze mediche per i ruoli PPoC. Condurre scambi scientifici internazionali e nazionali di alta qualità, non promozionali per diffondere i dati pertinenti, promuovere la fiducia del medico e la base di approvazione clinica
