jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to orchestrate the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Senior Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will be a key part of our global sourcing operations. You will lead end-to-end sourcing projects within our Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) portfolios, mentor a rising team of Sourcing Managers, and serve as a key advisor to executive leadership. If you thrive on complexity and want to feel a direct impact on the delivery of life-saving diagnostics to patients worldwide, this is where you belong.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead – NPC, Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will be part of a regional team of Senior Sourcing Managers and Sourcing Managers, managing relationships with other DOP stakeholders (Category, Delivery) as well as external suppliers and contract manufacturers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor with responsibilities to mentor junior team members.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing & contracting excellence, financial value, and compliance across the network footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics—including PPV savings, preferred supplier share, and shortened cycle times—to deliver bottom-line value while tracking stakeholder satisfaction.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and NPI benchmarking in close collaboration with Category and New Product Introductions (NPI) managers.

• Contract & Document Management: Setting up and reviewing high-complexity contracts (e.g., MSAs) and purchasing documentation, while accurately managing their lifecycle repository and renewals.

• Operational Excellence & SME Leadership: Acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to simplify workflows, analyze site user requirements for best-value methods, and ensure strict compliance with global policies.

• Bottleneck Resolution & CSR: Partnering with support functions like Accounts Payable (AP) to clear supplier-related administrative bottlenecks, while championing supply base CSR initiatives (diversity, sustainability, ethical practices).

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing high-stakes conflicts regarding competing project priorities or supplier selections, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to the CoE LT and DPLT.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can provide direction and mentor colleagues across different locations.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or equivalent and professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, ISM) are desirable.

• Experience: 5-7+ years of experie

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the sourcing operations for the advanced sensor technologies and external manufacturing networks that make near-patient testing possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will execute end-to-end tactical procurement within our Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) portfolios. In this role, you will elevate standard transactional requests into strategic, value-add opportunities, drive bottom-line cost savings, and ensure global supply reliability.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead – NPC, Sensors & Cartridges, and EM, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, global operations stakeholders, and external suppliers/contract manufacturers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global procurement efficiency, value execution, and compliance across your portfolios. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Sourcing Execution: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and market benchmarking for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing user requirements to identify value-driving methods, aggregating global demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources), participating in project teams, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and managing their full lifecycle, repository tracking, and potential renewals or improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) to simplify new and existing workflows, managing purchasing documentation, and ensuring strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking and delivering on key operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing process expectations and competing activity priorities, while presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and global stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in sourcing, specializing in tactical so

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti ad ottimizzare le operazioni di approvvigionamento per le tecnologie avanzate dei sensori e le reti di produzione esterne che rendono possibile il test a breve termine? Come nostro Sourcing Manager a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, eseguirai gli appalti tattici end-to-end all'interno dei nostri portafogli Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges e External Manufacturing (EM). In questo ruolo, eleverai richieste transazionali standard in opportunità strategiche, a valore aggiunto, guiderai il risparmio di costi di linea inferiore e garantirai l'affidabilità globale dell'offerta.
• Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Piombo Sourcing – NPC, Sensori e Cartucce, ed EM, ed è parte del Centro di Eccellenza Procurement (CoE).
• Team Wider e stakeholder: Partner con Categoria DOP, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, stakeholder di operazioni globali e fornitori esterni/fornitori esterni per risolvere strozzature amministrative e informare le strategie future.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale focalizzato sull'esecuzione di sourcing end-to-end, la gestione dei dati master e la creazione di valore.
• Impatto: si guida l'efficienza degli appalti globali, l'esecuzione del valore e la conformità attraverso i vostri portafogli. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Esecuzione Sourcing: Esecuzione di attività di approvvigionamento globale, processi standard (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), e benchmarking di mercato per i prodotti on-market e Nuove Introduzioni di prodotto (NPI).
• Aggregazione della domanda: Analizzando i requisiti degli utenti per identificare i metodi di gestione del valore, aggregando la domanda globale per massimizzare la leva e intensificando le richieste non standard alla gestione della categoria.
• Project & Risk Management: Sviluppo di piani di progetto completi (linee temporali, pietre miliari, risorse), partecipazione a team di progetto e identificazione proattiva e mitigazione dei rischi per gli obiettivi.
• Contratto Lifecycle: Impostazione dei contratti basati sui modelli (come CDAs e SOWs) e gestione del loro ciclo di vita completo, monitoraggio dei repository e potenziali rinnovi o miglioramenti.
• Eccellenza Operativa: Utilizzando gli strumenti aziendali (SAP, myBuy) per semplificare i flussi di lavoro nuovi e esistenti, gestire la documentazione di acquisto e garantire una rigorosa conformità alle politiche di approvvigionamento globale.
• Metrics & CSR: tracciare e fornire obiettivi operativi chiave e metriche di servizio al cliente (come i tempi di ciclo) mentre il campione della diversità dei fornitori, della sostenibilità e delle pratiche etiche.
• Conflict & Exposure: Gestione delle aspettative dei processi e delle priorità delle attività concorrenti, presentando regolarmente KPI e aggiornamenti dei progetti al Sourcing Lead e agli stakeholder globali. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare i problem-solvers analitici con una forte attenzione al servizio clienti.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria (Business o Scienze della Vita preferita) è richiesto; una certificazione MBA o CIPS è altamente desiderabile.
• Esperienza: 3–5+ anni di sourcing, specializzandosi in modo tattico

jobs.title: Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the sourcing channels for the cutting-edge hardware, sensor technologies, and core chemical components that drive our next generation of diagnostic innovations? As a Sourcing Manager in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will execute end-to-end tactical procurement within our diagnostic portfolios. In this role, you will elevate routine transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions, driving bottom-line cost savings and ensuring global supply reliability.
To support our rapid growth, we are hiring a cohort of Sourcing Managers who will be aligned to one of two specialized technology teams: Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) or Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Sourcing Lead, and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will partner seamlessly with critical global cross-functional teams, including Category, Delivery, Accounts Payable (AP) and RSS Demand to Pay, to clear supply bottlenecks and inform future procurement strategies. You will also manage operational relationships with a diverse base of external suppliers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, process optimization, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global procurement efficiency, value execution, and compliance across your portfolios. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Sourcing Execution: Executing global sourcing activities, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and market benchmarking for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing user requirements to identify value-driving methods, aggregating global demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources), participating in project teams, and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and managing their full lifecycle, repository tracking, and potential renewals or improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) to simplify new and existing workflows, managing purchasing documentation, and ensuring strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking and delivering on key operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Conflict & Exposure: Managing process expectations and competing activity priorities, while presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and global stakeholders.

Who you are

As our Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will drive operations for our Active Diagnostic Ingredients (ADI), Reagents, and Instruments portfolios. Balancing strategic alignment with tactical excellence, you will lead a highly capable team, drive digital procurement transformation, and collaborate directly with executive leadership to shape the future of our supply network.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a local team of up to 16 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. In addition, you will be part of the CoE Leadership Team (LT) and manage critical relationships with executive leadership, including the Direct Procurement LT.

• Role Type: A leadership position combining an even balance of strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution.

• Impact: Your impact is defined by driving measurable financial value, robust governance, and process optimization across the ADI, Reagents and Instruments Networks globally. Specifically, you are accountable for

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times) while managing your team’s OPEX budget.

• Sourcing & Contracts: Executing compliant global sourcing, market research, and NPI benchmarking. In addition, you will oversee a critical portfolio of low-to-high complexity contracts (e.g., CDAs, SOWs or MSAs).

• Digital Leadership: Governing and improving Roche`s iCollab platform to advance supplier integration alongside Planning, Global Supply Chain, and the Roche Shared Services (RSS).

• SLA Governance: Defining KPIs to guarantee on-time and in-full (OTIF) service delivery across your assigned portfolio.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving high-stakes matrix priority conflicts, representing Roche to external providers, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

• Process & Technology: Together with our Digital & Process experts, you foster and role model the development, deployment, and usage of novel AI / Digital solutions and continuously identify and implement process improvements.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can lead high-performance cultures, embrace collaboration, and remove operational friction.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences) is required; a Master's (MBA) and CIPS certification are highly preferred.

• Experience: 7 to 10 years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industries) with 3 to 5 years specifically in a Shared Service or CoE environment.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à être le pionnier des stratégies d'approvisionnement qui fournissent des technologies diagnostiques critiques et proches des patients au monde? En tant que leader d'approvisionnement à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous piloterez les opérations de nos portefeuilles d'ingrédients diagnostiques actifs (ADI), réactifs et instruments. Équilibrant l'alignement stratégique avec l'excellence tactique, vous dirigerez une équipe hautement compétente, piloterez la transformation des achats numériques et collaborerez directement avec les dirigeants pour façonner l'avenir de notre réseau d'approvisionnement.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : Vous êtes responsable de la direction, du coaching et du développement d'une équipe locale pouvant compter jusqu'à 16 gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et d'un responsable de la capacité opérationnelle. De plus, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de leadership du Conseil de l'Europe (EL) et gérerez des relations critiques avec les cadres supérieurs, y compris le LT d'approvisionnement direct.
• Type de rôle : Un poste de leadership combinant un équilibre uniforme entre l'alignement de catégorie stratégique et l'exécution tactique de l'approvisionnement.
• Impact : Votre impact est défini par une valeur financière mesurable, une gouvernance robuste et l'optimisation des processus à travers les réseaux ADI, Réactifs et Instruments à l'échelle mondiale. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable de
• Performance et économies : Diriger les paramètres clés (PPV, part de fournisseur préférée, temps de cycle) tout en gérant votre budget OPEX équipe.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Exécuter un approvisionnement mondial conforme, des études de marché et des analyses comparatives NPI. De plus, vous superviserez un portefeuille essentiel de contrats de faible à grande complexité (p. ex., ACD, ASU ou ASM).
• Leadership numérique : diriger et améliorer la plateforme iCollab de Roche pour faire progresser l'intégration des fournisseurs aux côtés de la planification, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et des services partagés de Roche (RSS).
• Gouvernance de l'ALS : Définir les ICR pour garantir la prestation de services à temps et en entier (OTIF) dans l'ensemble de votre portefeuille.
• Conflit et exposition : Résoudre les conflits de priorité de la matrice des prises élevées, représenter Roche auprès des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à la direction (CoE, Catégorie, Exécution et DPLT).
• Processus et technologie: Avec nos experts en processus numériques, vous encouragez et modélisez le développement, le déploiement et l'utilisation de nouvelles solutions d'IA / numérique et identifiez et implémentez en permanence les améliorations de processus. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de chercher des candidats qui peuvent diriger des cultures de haute performance, embrasser la collaboration et éliminer les frictions opérationnelles.
• Études : Un diplôme universitaire (affaires ou sciences de la vie) est requis; une maîtrise (MBA) et une certification CIPS sont hautement préférées.
• Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans dans l'approvisionnement en direct (industries Medtech, Automobile, Électronique, Pharmaceutique ou Chimie) avec 3 à 5 ans spécifiquement dans un environnement de service partagé ou de CdE.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This internship is a hands-on opportunity to join the ASPIRE project, a major digital transformation. You'll become a vital part of the ASPIRE project, a global IT and business transformation program that's shaping the future of Roche. Our mission is to create a unified, efficient, and user-friendly digital solution using SAP S/4HANA.
As an intern you will support the organizational readiness lead and the Project lead to establish and strengthen the connection between the project and the various business units to ensure a smooth transition for everyone involved.

The Opportunity

• Strategic Change Management Support: You will work closely with the Organizational Readiness team to help shape and implement our change strategy. This includes conducting stakeholder analyses, drafting and distributing project communications, and developing measures that promote the acceptance and success of new processes.

• Administrative and Operational Responsibilities: You will take on a range of administrative tasks essential for smooth project operations. This involves preparing reports and presentations, coordinating and booking meetings, maintaining distribution lists, and managing our shared inbox as well as Trello access permissions.

• Provide robust PMO support to ensure the smooth execution of transformation initiatives.

• Maintain project documentation, track action items, milestones, and deliverables across multiple timelines.

• Support resource management, capacity planning, and status reporting workflows.

• Utilize project management tools (such as Jira, Monday, or smart tracking sheets) to optimize team productivity and visibility.

• Event and Logistics Coordination: You will actively assist in the planning and execution of project-related events. Your tasks will include booking venues, arranging catering and logistics, and preparing all necessary materials for All Hands meetings, go-live celebrations, and team-building activities.

• Creative and Visual Contributions: You will contribute to the visual consistency of the project by ensuring that project branding is maintained (e.g., in the formatting of presentations and newsletters). Furthermore, you will support creative initiatives such as video production (e.g., with Camtasia), handling project merchandise, and running internal engagement campaigns.

Who You are

• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated with a degree in Business, Information Systems, Communications, Business Psychology, General Management or Project Management or a related field

• A strong interest in project management and organizational change

• Creative and detail-oriented, with an eye for visual design

• Highly motivated with a proactive and structured approach to work

• Excellent English communication skills; German is a plus.

• Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace; basic design/video editing skills (e.g., Camtasia, Canva) are a plus

Additional Information

• Duration: 3-9 months

• Fully Remote Work is not possible: We are convinced that we can best drive change by working directly with our teams. Therefore, the core of our work takes place on-site. While flexibility is available, working with people is our main focus.

Application Process

• To apply, please submit your complete application package, including your CV, cover letter, and any relevant certificates

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo stage è un'opportunità pratica per aderire al progetto ASPIRE, una grande trasformazione digitale. Diventerai una parte vitale del progetto ASPIRE, un programma globale di trasformazione IT e business che sta plasmando il futuro di Roche. La nostra missione è creare una soluzione digitale unificata, efficiente e facile da usare utilizzando SAP S/4HANA. In qualità di tirocinante supporterete il piombo di prontezza organizzativa e il Progetto condurrà a stabilire e rafforzare la connessione tra il progetto e le varie unità di business per garantire una transizione regolare per tutti i coinvolti. L'opportunità
• Supporto strategico per la gestione dei cambiamenti: lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team di prontezza organizzativa per contribuire a modellare e implementare la nostra strategia di cambiamento. Ciò include la conduzione di analisi, redazione e distribuzione delle comunicazioni di progetto e lo sviluppo di misure che promuovano l'accettazione e il successo dei nuovi processi.
• Responsabilità amministrative e operative: si assumerà una serie di compiti amministrativi essenziali per operazioni di progetto fluide. Ciò comporta la preparazione di report e presentazioni, il coordinamento e le riunioni di prenotazione, il mantenimento delle liste di distribuzione e la gestione delle nostre caselle di posta condivise e delle autorizzazioni di accesso Trello.
• Fornire un robusto supporto PMO per garantire l'esecuzione regolare delle iniziative di trasformazione.
• Mantenere la documentazione del progetto, tracciare oggetti di azione, pietre miliari e consegnabili attraverso più linee temporali.
• Supporta la gestione delle risorse, la pianificazione delle capacità e i flussi di lavoro di reporting dello stato.
• Utilizzare strumenti di gestione del progetto (come Jira, Lunedi, o fogli di tracciamento intelligenti) per ottimizzare la produttività e la visibilità del team.
• Coordinamento Evento e Logistica: assisterai attivamente alla pianificazione e all'esecuzione di eventi legati al progetto. I vostri compiti includono le sedi di prenotazione, l'organizzazione di catering e logistica, e la preparazione di tutti i materiali necessari per le riunioni All Hands, le celebrazioni di go-live e le attività di team-building.
• Contributi creativi e visivi: contribuirai alla coerenza visiva del progetto assicurando che il branding del progetto sia mantenuto (ad esempio, nella formattazione di presentazioni e newsletter). Inoltre, supporterete iniziative creative come la produzione video (ad esempio, con Camtasia), la gestione della merce del progetto e l'esecuzione di campagne di coinvolgimento interno. Chi sei
• Attualmente iscritta o recentemente laureata in Business, Sistemi Informativi, Comunicazioni, Psicologia aziendale, Gestione Generale o Project Management o un campo relativo
• Un forte interesse per la gestione del progetto e il cambiamento organizzativo
• Creativo e dettagliato, con un occhio per il design visivo
• Altamente motivato con un approccio proattivo e strutturato al lavoro
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione inglese; tedesco è un plus.
• La competenza in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) e Google Workspace; le competenze di progettazione / editing video di base (ad esempio, Camtasia, Canva) sono un plus Informazioni aggiuntive
• Durata: 3-9 mesi
• Completamente remoto Il lavoro non è possibile: siamo convinti che possiamo meglio guidare il cambiamento lavorando direttamente con le nostre squadre. Pertanto, il nucleo del nostro lavoro si svolge in loco. Mentre la flessibilità è disponibile, lavorare con le persone è il nostro obiettivo principale. Processo di applicazione
• Per applicare, si prega di inviare il pacchetto completo della domanda, compreso il vostro CV, lettera di copertura e qualsiasi certificato rilevante
• A causa di regolamenti non UE/EFTA i cittadini devono fornire un certificato dall'università affermando che uno stage è obbligatorio come p

jobs.title: Digital Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

Who you are

We look for curious, inclusive, and innovative change agents with a pro

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a portare il pensiero strutturato, l'esecuzione e la messa a fuoco per la digitalizzazione negli appalti, sbloccando nuovi livelli di automazione e self-service per le operazioni globali? Come il nostro Digital Enablement Manager, situato a Sant Cugat, Spagna, si proattivamente identificare e guidare opportunità digitali che supportano le nostre esigenze e l'efficienza del processo di impatto positivo. Essendo un vero ambasciatore per la digitalizzazione degli appalti, fornirete una leadership di pensiero strategica in un ambiente dinamico globale per garantire che gli strumenti digitali siano allineati perfettamente con i nostri obiettivi aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Report direttamente al Digital & Process Management Lead e fa parte del Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Il team e gli stakeholder dei Wider: gestirete le relazioni interfunzionali attraverso il DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Categoria, DOP Delivery, IT, fornitori esterni e stakeholder interni (ad esempio, responsabili dei processi e proprietari).
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di Contributor individuale focalizzato su abilitazione digitale, consulenza degli stakeholder e governance di trasformazione.
• Impatto: Guida l'efficienza operativa globale, la conformità dei processi e l'adozione digitale su larga scala. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia digitale & Roadmap: Sviluppare e governare la strategia di abilitazione digitale, stabilire obiettivi chiari, linee temporali e Indicatori di performance per monitorare l'impatto degli strumenti digitali sui risultati degli appalti.
• Valutazione della tecnologia: Ricerca e valutazione delle tecnologie emergenti (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) per migliorare i processi di approvvigionamento. Condurre programmi pilota per testare la fattibilità e allineare le iniziative attraverso le funzioni.
• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Agire come consulente affidabile per le business unit e l'IT, comprendere le loro priorità uniche, e promuovere un approccio inclusivo e collaborativo alla trasformazione digitale.
• AI Pipeline: Guidare la nostra trasformazione AI coordinando e/o costruendo soluzioni AI all'avanguardia in stretta collaborazione con RSS Demand to Pay e Roche Digital Technology (RDT).
• Comunicazione di valore: Evidenziare il ROI e l'impatto delle iniziative digitali sviluppando e fornendo presentazioni, storie di successo e report sui progressi verso gli stakeholder senior.
• Miglioramento del processo: Condurre analisi approfondite delle attuali attività di approvvigionamento per individuare inefficienze o strozzature, utilizzando i dati per priorità aree di intervento e automazione digitale.
• Attuazione & Adozione: Guidare progetti di digitalizzazione e implementazioni di soluzioni creando chiare roadmap. Agire come un collegamento con i partner esterni per garantire requisiti accurati e promuovere l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità, rendendo la digitalizzazione "facile da capire per tutti" attraverso la formazione mirata e la comunicazione. Chi sei Cerchiamo agenti di cambiamento curiosi, inclusi e innovativi con un pro

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, strukturiertes Denken, Ausführung und Fokus auf die Digitalisierung in der Beschaffung zu bringen, um neue Ebenen der Automatisierung und Self-Service für globale Operationen zu erschließen? Als unser Digital Enablement Manager mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, werden Sie proaktiv digitale Möglichkeiten identifizieren und vorantreiben, die unsere Bedürfnisse unterstützen und die Prozesseffizienz positiv beeinflussen. Als echter Botschafter für die Digitalisierung des Beschaffungswesens werden Sie in einem dynamischen globalen Umfeld eine strategische Vordenkerrolle übernehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass digitale Tools nahtlos an unseren allgemeinen Geschäftszielen ausgerichtet sind.
• Reporting Line: Berichtet direkt an den Digital & Process Management Lead und ist Teil des Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Ein breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Sie verwalten funktionsübergreifende Beziehungen zwischen dem DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, externen Anbietern und internen Stakeholdern (z. B. Prozessmanagern und Eigentümern).
• Rollentyp: Eine individuelle Rolle als Mitwirkender mit Schwerpunkt auf Digital Enablement, Stakeholder-Beratung und Transformations-Governance.
• Auswirkungen: Sie fördern die globale Betriebseffizienz, die Compliance von Prozessen und die groß angelegte digitale Einführung. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Digitale Strategie & Roadmap: Entwicklung und Steuerung der digitalen Enablement-Strategie, Festlegung klarer Ziele, Zeitpläne und Leistungsindikatoren zur Überwachung der Auswirkungen digitaler Tools auf die Beschaffungsergebnisse.
• Technologiebewertung: Erforschung und Bewertung neuer Technologien (AI, Machine Learning, RPA), um Beschaffungsprozesse zu verbessern. Durchführung von Pilotprogrammen, um die Machbarkeit zu testen und Initiativen funktionsübergreifend auszurichten.
• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Geschäftseinheiten und IT fungieren, ihre einzigartigen Prioritäten verstehen und einen integrativen, kollaborativen Ansatz für die digitale Transformation fördern.
• KI-Pipeline: Führung unserer KI-Transformation durch die Koordination und/oder den Aufbau modernster KI-Lösungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit RSS Demand to Pay und Roche Digital Technology (RDT).
• Value Communication: Hervorhebung des ROI und der Auswirkungen digitaler Initiativen durch die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung datengesteuerter Präsentationen, Erfolgsgeschichten und Fortschrittsberichte für leitende Stakeholder.
• Prozessverbesserung: Durchführung gründlicher Analysen der aktuellen Beschaffungsaktivitäten, um Ineffizienzen oder Engpässe zu erkennen, wobei Daten verwendet werden, um Bereiche für digitale Eingriffe und Automatisierung zu priorisieren.
• Implementierung & Adoption: Steuerung von Digitalisierungsprojekten und -lösungen durch die Erstellung klarer Roadmaps. Zusammenarbeit mit externen Partnern, um genaue Anforderungen zu gewährleisten und eine nahtlose Übernahme zu fördern, indem die Digitalisierung durch gezielte Schulungen und Kommunikation "für alle leicht verständlich" gemacht wird. Wer du bist Wir suchen neugierige, inklusive und innovative Change Agents mit einem Profi

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the global Demand-to-Pay landscape and drive the tactical execution of digital procurement innovations? As our Business Process Expert (BPE) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take tactical and strategic ownership over complex business processes in the Demand-to-Pay space for DOP. In this role, you will analyze, design, and implement innovative solutions - including adjoining IT ecosystems like SAP and myBuy - to increase stability, reduce errors, and drive seamless process adoption across the global network.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external service providers.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role blending tactical process execution with strategic design elements.

• Impact: You drive departmental efficiency, process compliance, and effective change management. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Optimization & System Integration: Managing and further developing complex business processes within the Demand-to-Pay landscape and designing efficient interfaces to other business processes.

• Innovation & Automation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process improvements, automation, and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à optimiser le paysage global de la demande à la paye et à conduire l'exécution tactique des innovations en matière d'approvisionnement numérique? En tant qu'expert en processus d'affaires (BPE) situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous prendrez la propriété tactique et stratégique des processus d'affaires complexes dans l'espace de demande à paiement pour DOP. Dans ce rôle, vous analyserez, concevoirez et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes - y compris des écosystèmes informatiques adjacents comme SAP et myBuy - pour augmenter la stabilité, réduire les erreurs et conduire à l'adoption de processus sans faille dans tout le réseau mondial.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement du responsable de la gestion numérique et des processus et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), le COE LT, la catégorie du DOP, la livraison du DOP, les équipes d'approvisionnement du DOP, la demande de paiement du RSS, l'approvisionnement mondial et les fournisseurs de services externes.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel rôle combinant l'exécution de processus tactiques avec des éléments de conception stratégique.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'efficacité ministérielle, la conformité des processus et une gestion efficace du changement. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Optimisation des processus et intégration des systèmes : gérer et développer des processus opérationnels complexes dans le contexte de la demande à la paye et concevoir des interfaces efficaces avec d'autres processus opérationnels.
• Innovation et automatisation : identifier proactivement les possibilités d'amélioration des processus, d'automatisation et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Leadership du projet : Diriger les projets partiels et globaux de façon indépendante, contribuer à la création de grandes équipes locales et mondiales interfonctionnelles, et concevoir des ateliers et des cours de formation de façon indépendante.
• Conception de solutions innovantes : Développer et analyser des approches novatrices pour résoudre des problèmes complexes et optimiser les systèmes, les vérifier au niveau mondial et guider leur mise en œuvre locale.
• Optimisation du processus : Analyser et mettre en œuvre des solutions spécifiques à une zone afin de réduire les erreurs critiques, d'accroître la stabilité et la productivité et d'intégrer les meilleures pratiques pour une utilisation optimale.
• Développement des processus stratégiques et transfert des connaissances : Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce à des processus opérationnels simples, rapides et agiles tout en agissant en tant qu'expert en matière (EMS) pour assurer un transfert solide de savoir-faire dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Conflits et exposition : Résoudre les conflits de matrice concernant les priorités concurrentes du projet ou les attentes en matière de processus, tout en fournissant des mises à jour de l'ICP à haute fréquence (mensuelle ou trimestrielle) - comme les temps de cycle et la conformité - au CdE LT et au DPLT. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des professionnels positifs et auto-réfléchissants avec une attitude « Can-Do » orientée vers la solution et un accent clair sur les perspectives de bout en bout.
• Éducation: Diplôme universitaire avec une entreprise ou une scie de vie

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à concevoir le paysage des processus numériques mondiaux et à diriger l'optimisation stratégique des systèmes qui pilotent nos opérations d'approvisionnement mondial de bout en bout? En tant que responsable des capacités d'affaires (BCL) pour la collaboration avec les fournisseurs, situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous prendrez en charge stratégique et opérationnelle des segments critiques du paysage mondial des processus de demande à paiement. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous définirez la gouvernance des processus, intégrerez des interfaces complexes entre les écosystèmes d'entreprise et servirez d'agent de changement essentiel pour accélérer nos solutions techniques de collaboration des fournisseurs, principalement notre solution iCollab, afin de favoriser l'adoption dans toute l'entreprise. iCollab est la nouvelle plateforme de collaboration de Roche pour la chaîne d'approvisionnement, offrant des mises à jour en temps réel, la transparence et l'automatisation avec nos fournisseurs.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de notre responsable d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : dirige une communauté mondiale des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME. Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), la CoE LT, la livraison, les équipes d'approvisionnement, la demande de RSS à payer, l'approvisionnement mondial et les fournisseurs de technologie externes.
• Type de rôle: En tant que BCL, vous représentez les intérêts commerciaux de DOP dans le monde entier dans les forums pertinents et vous êtes responsable du développement et de l'amélioration continue de la stratégie de collaboration des fournisseurs.
• Impact: Vous dirigez l'efficacité opérationnelle mondiale, la conformité des processus et l'adoption numérique à grande échelle. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Conception et stratégie des processus : Élaboration et déploiement de la feuille de route DOP pour iCollab et d'autres solutions adjacentes, en adéquation avec des partenaires fonctionnels comme DIA Global Supply Chain et RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automatisation et innovation: identifier proactivement les possibilités d'automatisation des processus et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus, et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Analyse et gouvernance des PME : agir à titre d'expert en la matière pour analyser, élaborer des options et concevoir des solutions qui résolvent les problèmes de processus, de système, d'indicateur de rendement ou de données, tout en appuyant les définitions des données et des règles.
• Délégation de projet de transformation : Être un délégué responsable des grandes initiatives ministérielles (comme le programme ASPIRE; notre processus global et la transformation numérique) pour appuyer l'adoption de modèles mondiaux et évaluer les impacts du changement localisé.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer l'alignement des besoins à l'échelle mondiale et établir des partenariats avec d'autres BCL et propriétaires de capacités d'affaires (BCO) pour optimiser les performances interfonctionnelles de bout en bout.
• Représentation de la communauté et des ARTS : Diriger la communauté des capacités d'affaires des PME et représenter le DOP dans les collectivités et les trains de libération Agile.

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la capacité opérationnelle - source à paiement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to architect the global digital process landscape and lead the strategic optimization of systems that drive our end-to-end global procurement operations? As our Business Capability Lead (BCL) located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take strategic and operational ownership over critical segments of the global Demand-to-Pay process landscape. In this high-impact role, you will define process governance, integrate complex interfaces across corporate ecosystems, and serve as a vital change agent to accelerate the myBuy solution adoption across the enterprise. myBuy is Roche's digital procurement platform, designed to enhance the procure-to-pay process by providing transparency, timely transactions, and automation for our buying operations.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to our Sourcing Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Leads a global Business Capability Community formed by SMEs. You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external technology providers.

• Role Type: As BCL, you represent DOP`s business interests globally in relevant forums, and you are responsible for the development and continuous improvement of DOP`s procure-to-pay strategy.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Design & Strategy: Developing and deploying the DOP roadmap for myBuy, in alignment with functional partners like DIA Global Supply Chain and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Automation & Innovation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process automation and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• SME Analysis & Governance: Acting as a deep subject matter expert to analyze, elaborate options, and design solutions that resolve process, system, performance indicator, or data concerns, while supporting data and rule definitions.

• Transformation Project Delegation: Serving as a responsible delegate on major corporate initiatives (such as the ASPIRE program; our overarching process and digital transformation) to support global template adoption and evaluate localized change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement: Leading continuous improvement initiatives, managing global requirement alignment, and partnering with fellow BCLs and Business Capability Owners (BCOs) to optimize end-to-end cross-functional performance.

• Community & ARTS Representation: Leading the Business Capability Community of SMEs and representing DOP in communities and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Knowledge Management: Governing the development, structural maintenance, and delivery of global system process doc

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. • Tipo di ruolo: Come BCL, tu rappresenti gli interessi aziendali di DOP a livello globale nei forum pertinenti, e sei responsabile per lo sviluppo e il miglioramento continuo della strategia di DOP.
• Impatto: Guida l'efficienza operativa globale, la conformità dei processi e l'adozione digitale su larga scala. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Process Design & Strategy: Sviluppo e distribuzione della roadmap DOP per myBuy, in allineamento con partner funzionali come DIA Global Supply Chain e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: individuare attivamente le opportunità per l'automazione dei processi e la digitalizzazione in stretta collaborazione con Delivery, Categoria, Digital & Process Management e RSS Demand to Pay.
• Analisi e Governance delle PMI: Agire come esperto di materia profonda per analizzare, elaborare opzioni e soluzioni di progettazione che risolvono problemi di processo, sistema, indicatori di performance o dati, supportando al contempo le definizioni dei dati e delle regole.
• Delegazione del progetto di trasformazione: servire come delegato responsabile per le principali iniziative aziendali (come il programma ASPIRE; il nostro processo di overarching e la trasformazione digitale) per sostenere l'adozione di modelli globali e valutare gli impatti di cambiamento localizzati.
• Miglioramento continuo: Conducendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo, gestendo l'allineamento dei requisiti globali e collaborando con altri BCL e Business Capability Owners (BCOs) per ottimizzare le prestazioni interfunzionali end-to-end.
• Rappresentanza comunitaria & ARTS: Leader della Comunità per la CapacitÃ aziendale delle PMI e rappresenta il DOP nelle comunitÃ e nei Treni di rilascio Agile (ART).
• Gestione della conoscenza: Governare lo sviluppo, la manutenzione strutturale e la consegna del processo di sistema globale doc

En tant que chef de file en matière de capacités d'affaires (BCL) situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous assumerez la responsabilité stratégique et opérationnelle de segments critiques du paysage mondial des processus de demande à paiement. Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous définirez la gouvernance des processus, intégrerez des interfaces complexes entre les écosystèmes d'entreprise et servirez d'agent de changement vital pour accélérer l'adoption de la solution myBuy dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. myBuy est la plateforme d'approvisionnement numérique de Roche, conçue pour améliorer le processus d'approvisionnement à la paye en fournissant la transparence, les transactions en temps opportun et l'automatisation pour nos opérations d'achat.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de notre responsable d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : dirige une communauté mondiale des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME. Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), le COE LT, la livraison du DOP, les équipes d'approvisionnement du DOP, la demande de paiement du RSS, les fournisseurs de technologie mondiaux et externes.
• Type de rôle: En tant que BCL, vous représentez les intérêts commerciaux de DOP à l'échelle mondiale dans les forums pertinents, et vous êtes responsable du développement et de l'amélioration continue de la stratégie d'achat à paiement de DOP.
• Impact: Vous dirigez l'efficacité opérationnelle mondiale, la conformité des processus et l'adoption numérique à grande échelle. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Conception et stratégie des processus : Élaborer et déployer la feuille de route DOP pour myBuy, en accord avec des partenaires fonctionnels comme DIA Global Supply Chain et RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automatisation et innovation: identifier proactivement les possibilités d'automatisation des processus et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus, et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Analyse et gouvernance des PME : agir en tant qu'expert en matière profonde pour analyser, élaborer des options et concevoir des solutions qui résolvent les problèmes de processus, de système, d'indicateur de rendement ou de données, tout en appuyant les définitions des données et des règles.
• Délégation de projet de transformation : Être un délégué responsable des grandes initiatives ministérielles (comme le programme ASPIRE; notre processus global et la transformation numérique) pour appuyer l'adoption de modèles mondiaux et évaluer les impacts du changement localisé.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer l'alignement des besoins à l'échelle mondiale et établir des partenariats avec d'autres BCL et propriétaires de capacités d'affaires (BCO) pour optimiser les performances interfonctionnelles de bout en bout.
• Représentation de la communauté et des ARTS : Diriger la communauté des capacités d'affaires des PME et représenter le DOP dans les collectivités et les trains de libération Agile.
• Gestion des connaissances: encadrement du développement, de l'entretien structurel et de la mise en œuvre des processus du système mondial

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to shape the long-term supplier strategies and project pipelines that deliver medical innovation to patients worldwide? As our Associate Category Manager (ACM) in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will support the development, validation, and execution of global category strategies and annual strategic initiatives. In this role, you will leverage rigorous procurement analytics to transform market intelligence into actionable category guidance, ensuring global supply resilience and portfolio value.
We are looking to fulfill one Associate Category Manager position per team. Successful candidates will be aligned to support one of the following dedicated procurement categories: Biologicals & Chemicals, Plastics & Packaging, Electronics & Systems, Mechanicals, Logistics.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the respective Category Lead within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Collaborates closely with Category Managers, Sourcing Managers, Delivery Managers, Finance, Legal, and external market intelligence providers. Participates in a global ACM Community of Practice (CoP) coordinated by the Category Integration & Excellence Lead to ensure consistency of methodologies, reporting standards, strategic planning processes, and cross-category collaboration.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role in support of the allocated Category, focused on strategic enablement, market data intelligence, and stakeholder management.

• Impact: You drive category compliance, data integrity, and strategic execution across the global operations network. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Pipeline Support: Collation of supplier, market, and internal business data to help formulate the long-term Category Strategy and build a proactive pipeline of future initiatives.

• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery, and Sourcing Managers in executing and deploying complex projects in strict compliance with global standards and procedures.

• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Supporting contract drafting and vendor negotiations for strategic, key, or bottleneck suppliers by delivering comprehensive analytics, fact-bases, and market benchmarks.

• Strategic Sourcing: Support selected high-value strategic sourcing initiatives and complex RFx activities to convert pipeline targets into realized business value.

• Reporting & Analytics: Collaborating with data analytics experts to generate Category-specific insights, generating monthly spend/savings metrics, and conducting data validation to safeguard governance.

• Implementation Support: Converting strategic outcomes into clear category guidance documents and support materials to ensure category strategies can be effectively implemented across the organization.

• Impatto: Guida la conformità della categoria, l'integrità dei dati e l'esecuzione strategica nella rete operativa globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Supporto Strategy & Pipeline: Collazione dei dati di fornitori, di mercato e di business interni per contribuire a formulare la strategia di categoria a lungo termine e costruire una pipeline proattiva di future iniziative.
• Strategic Initiative Deployment: Supporting Category Managers, Project Delivery, Delivery e Sourcing Managers nell'esecuzione e distribuzione di progetti complessi in stretta conformità con gli standard e le procedure globali.
• Negotiation & Contracting Preparation: Sostenere la redazione dei contratti e i negoziati dei fornitori per i fornitori strategici, chiave o strozzature offrendo analisi complete, basi di fatto e benchmark di mercato.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Participer à une communauté de pratique mondiale de la GCA, coordonnée par le responsable de l'intégration et de l'excellence des catégories, afin d'assurer l'uniformité des méthodes, des normes de rapport, des processus de planification stratégique et de la collaboration entre les catégories.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel à l'appui de la catégorie attribuée, axé sur l'habilitation stratégique, l'information sur le marché et la gestion des intervenants.
• Impact: Vous conduisez la conformité de catégorie, l'intégrité des données, et l'exécution stratégique dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial d'opérations. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to lead digital innovation and process excellence for DOP? As our Digital & Process Management Lead based in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will have an instrumental global impact on the deployment and continuous improvement of our processes, systems, and underlying data. This newly created role combines elements of previous teams to significantly increase organizational scale and impact within the Diagnostics Global Operations transformation (“FOM”).

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Interacts frequently with ASPIRE Program Leadership, the Diagnostics Procurement Leadership Team (DPLT), Category Management, Delivery, and RSS Demand to Pay. You will also represent DOP as the “Business Owner” in the strategic D2P Business Owner Community.

• Role Type: A senior leadership role, balancing strategic and tactical responsibilities, directing a global team of up to 15 professionals (including Digital Enablement Managers, Business Process Experts, and ASPIRE Deployment resources).

• Impact: You will drive a high-performance culture, transform challenges into opportunities, and unlock the potential of your team. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digitalization & Innovation: Identifying, planning, and executing digitalization initiatives (e.g., process automation, tool deployment). You will orchestrate relevant stakeholders, develop business cases, drive user adoption, and benchmark digital procurement capabilities.

• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Representing DOP in the Roche-wide ASPIRE transformation program (D2P stream). You are accountable for delivering project milestones, leading end-to-end process design, and transitioning successfully into the sustain organization.

• Business Process Management: Managing the D2P process landscape within DOP. You will collaborate with the Global Business Process Owner to develop specificities, ensure compliant execution, and collect feedback for continuous improvement.

• Financial Scope: Maintaining oversight and working within the GRP budgets provided for various multi-year initiatives (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).

• Talent Leadership: Coaching and developing a global team, ensuring cultural awareness, and fostering an environment of psychological safety to achieve ambitious divisional goals.

Who you are

We look for an authentic, courageous, and transformational leader who is a true "systems thinker"—someone who can navigate complexity, manage competing priorities, and craft integrated solutions that drive efficiency.

• Education: A University degree is required, with a focus on business or life sciences highly preferable. A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) and professional purchasing certifications (e.g., CIPS) are prefer
