La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Sei pronto a guidare l'innovazione digitale e l'eccellenza di processo per DOP? Con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, il nostro Digital & Process Management Lead avrà un impatto globale strumentale sull'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi, sistemi e dati sottostanti. Questo ruolo appena creato combina elementi di precedenti team per aumentare significativamente la scala organizzativa e l'impatto all'interno della trasformazione Diagnostics Global Operations (“FOM”).
• Linea di segnalazione: Rapporti direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza e fa parte del più ampio Centro di Eccellenza (CoE).
• Il team e le parti interessate del Wider: Interagisce frequentemente con ASPIRE Program Leadership, il team di Leadership dei contratti diagnostici (DPLT), la gestione della categoria, la consegna e la domanda di RSS da pagare. Lei rappresenterà anche il DOP come “proprietario di affari” nella strategica D2P Business Owner Community.
• Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo di leadership senior, bilanciando le responsabilità strategiche e tattiche, dirigendo un team globale di fino a 15 professionisti (tra cui Digital Enablement Managers, Business Process Experts, e ASPIRE Deployment Risorse).
• Impatto: Potrai guidare una cultura ad alte prestazioni, trasformare le sfide in opportunità e sbloccare il potenziale del tuo team. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Digitalizzazione & Innovazione: Identificare, pianificare ed eseguire iniziative di digitalizzazione (ad esempio, automazione dei processi, distribuzione degli strumenti). Potrai orchestrare le parti interessate rilevanti, sviluppare i casi aziendali, guidare l'adozione degli utenti e le capacità di approvvigionamento digitale di riferimento.
• Global Initiatives (ASPIRE & iCollab): Rappresentare il DOP nel programma di trasformazione ASPIRE (D2P stream). Sei responsabile per la fornitura di pietre miliari di progetto, progettazione di processo end-to-end leader, e transizione con successo nell'organizzazione di supporto.
• Business Process Management: Gestione del paesaggio di processo D2P all'interno del DOP. Collaborerai con il Global Business Process Owner per sviluppare specificità, garantire l'esecuzione conforme e raccogliere feedback per il miglioramento continuo.
• Ambito finanziario: Mantenere la supervisione e il lavoro all'interno dei bilanci GRP previsti per varie iniziative pluriennali (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).
• Talent Leadership: coaching e sviluppo di un team globale, garantire la consapevolezza culturale e promuovere un ambiente di sicurezza psicologica per raggiungere obiettivi di divisione ambiziosi. Chi sei Cerchiamo un leader autentico, coraggioso e trasformazionale, che è un vero "sistemi pensatore"—qualcuno che può navigare nella complessità, gestire le priorità concorrenti e creare soluzioni integrate che favoriscano l'efficienza.
• Istruzione: Una laurea universitaria è richiesto, con un focus sulle scienze aziendali o vita altamente preferibile. Le certificazioni di acquisto professionali (MBA o equivalente) e di master (ad esempio, CIPS) sono preferibili

Als unser Digital & Process Management Lead mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, werden Sie einen maßgeblichen globalen Einfluss auf die Bereitstellung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Prozesse, Systeme und zugrunde liegenden Daten haben. Diese neu geschaffene Rolle kombiniert Elemente früherer Teams, um den organisatorischen Umfang und die Auswirkungen innerhalb der Transformation von Diagnostics Global Operations ("FOM") deutlich zu erhöhen.
• Reporting Line: Berichtet direkt an den Leiter des Procurement Center of Excellence und ist Teil des erweiterten Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Interagiert häufig mit ASPIRE Program Leadership, dem Diagnostics Procurement Leadership Team (DPLT), Category Management, Delivery und RSS Demand to Pay. Sie werden DOP auch als "Business Owner" in der strategischen D2P Business Owner Community vertreten.
• Rollentyp: Eine Führungsrolle, die strategische und taktische Verantwortlichkeiten ausbalanciert und ein globales Team von bis zu 15 Fachleuten leitet (einschließlich Digital Enablement Manager, Business Process Experts und ASPIRE Deployment Resources).
• Wirkung: Sie werden eine Hochleistungskultur vorantreiben, Herausforderungen in Chancen verwandeln und das Potenzial Ihres Teams freisetzen. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Digitalisierung & Innovation: Identifikation, Planung und Durchführung von Digitalisierungsinitiativen (z.B. Prozessautomatisierung, Tool Deployment). Sie orchestrieren relevante Stakeholder, entwickeln Business Cases, fördern die Nutzerakzeptanz und vergleichen digitale Beschaffungsmöglichkeiten.
• Globale Initiativen (ASPIRE & iCollab): Vertretung von DOP im Roche-weiten ASPIRE Transformationsprogramm (D2P Stream). Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, Projektmeilensteine zu liefern, das End-to-End-Prozessdesign zu leiten und erfolgreich in die Sustain-Organisation überzugehen.
• Business Process Management: Verwaltung der D2P-Prozesslandschaft innerhalb von DOP. Sie arbeiten mit dem Global Business Process Owner zusammen, um Besonderheiten zu entwickeln, die konforme Ausführung sicherzustellen und Feedback für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen zu sammeln.
• Finanzumfang: Aufrechterhaltung der Aufsicht und Arbeit innerhalb der GRP-Budgets für verschiedene mehrjährige Initiativen (ASPIRE, iCollab, FOM Integration).
• Talent Leadership: Coaching und Entwicklung eines globalen Teams, Sicherstellung des kulturellen Bewusstseins und Förderung eines Umfelds der psychologischen Sicherheit, um ehrgeizige Divisionsziele zu erreichen. Wer du bist Wir suchen einen authentischen, mutigen und transformativen Führer, der ein echter "Systemdenker" ist - jemand, der Komplexität beherrschen, konkurrierende Prioritäten verwalten und integrierte Lösungen entwickeln kann, die die Effizienz steigern.
• Ausbildung: Ein Universitätsabschluss ist erforderlich, mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Business oder Life Sciences sehr bevorzugt. Ein Master-Abschluss (MBA oder gleichwertig) und professionelle Einkaufszertifizierungen (z. B. CIPS) sind bevorzugt

jobs.title: Project Engineer (m/w/d) Filling & Packaging
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Roche hat sich ein inspirierendes Ziel bis 2030 gesetzt: Mehr medizinische und hochwertige diagnostische Lösungen zu geringeren Kosten für die Gesellschaft bereitzustellen. Das Site Management für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg stellt Infrastruktur und Rahmenbedingungen für unsere rund 15.000 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland zur Verfügung, um mit diagnostischen und medizinischen Lösungen wertschöpfend für Patienten tätig sein zu können.

Das sind wir
Das Chapter Engineering der RDG ist mit 170 Mitarbeitenden für die erfolgreiche Planung und Umsetzung aller großen Investitionsprojekte an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg verantwortlich. Durch unsere Arbeit sichern wir die Versorgung unserer Patienten mit innovativen Produkten. Wir sind eine Einheit mit flachen Hierarchien und legen viel Wert auf Eigenverantwortlichkeit, eine offene Unternehmenskultur und Spaß an der Arbeit. Teamarbeit, gegenseitige Unterstützung und Freiheitsgrade bei der Projektbearbeitung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Die Gruppe Filling & Packaging ist für die eigenverantwortliche Planung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten zuständig. Wir unterstützen unsere Business-Partner kompetent in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und stellen die Einhaltung aller GMP-Richtlinien sicher.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du übernimmst die eigenverantwortliche Planung, Projektierung und Realisierung von maschinen- und verfahrenstechnischen Projekten im Bereich Filling & Packaging unter Einhaltung aller internen SOPs sowie gesetzlichen Vorgaben.

• Dein Fokus liegt auf der Leitung und dem Management kleiner bis mittelgroßer Projekte im pharmazeutischen und diagnostischen Umfeld inklusive Planung, Steuerung und Monitoring der Projektaktivitäten.

• Du verantwortest das Fremdfirmenmanagement : Von der Leistungsbeschreibung über die Auswahl und Steuerung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Abnahme von externen Dienstleistern und Fachfirmen.

• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für interne Business-Partner in Fragen der Pharma-, Dia- und Prozesstechnik und engagierst Dich aktiv in der Engineering Community zum Austausch von Best Practices.

• Du identifizierst Innovationen sowie neue Technologien und trägst zu deren wirtschaftlich bedeutsamen Entwicklung und dem Einsatz vor Ort bei.

• Die Tätigkeit wird primär am Hauptstandort Mannheim durchgeführt, beinhaltet jedoch auch Projektarbeit an weiteren Standorten sowie im Rahmen internationaler Projekte.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Du hast ein Studium des Ingenieurwesens mit Fachrichtung Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Biotechnologie oder einen ähnlichen Studiengang erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringst idealerweise mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position in der Industrie mit.

• Du verfügst über einschlägige Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement sowie in der Projektierung von diagnostischem und pharmazeutischem Equipment, idealerweise im Produktions- oder Verpackungsumfeld.

• Du besitzt tiefgreifendes Wissen in deinem Spezialgebiet (z. B. Abfülltechnik, Verpackungstechnik oder optische Inspektion) und hast Grundwissen in Bereichen wie Automation oder Serialisierung.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in GMP und in der konzeptionellen Planung zeichnen dich aus.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit relevanten DV-Anwendungen und verfügst über ein sehr gutes Ausdrucksvermögen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo avanzando la scienza in modo che tutti possiamo trascorrere più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Roche si è imposta un obiettivo ispiratore entro il 2030: fornire soluzioni diagnostiche più mediche e di alta qualità per la società a un costo più basso. La gestione del sito per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg fornisce l'infrastruttura e il framework per i nostri circa 15.000 dipendenti in Germania per poter lavorare con soluzioni diagnostiche e mediche che aggiungono valore ai pazienti. Noi siamo Con 170 dipendenti, RDG’s Chapter Engineering è responsabile della pianificazione e dell’implementazione di tutti i principali progetti di investimento nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. Attraverso il nostro lavoro, garantiamo la fornitura dei nostri pazienti con prodotti innovativi. Siamo un'unità con gerarchie piatte e attribuiamo grande importanza alla responsabilità personale, una cultura aziendale aperta e divertimento sul lavoro. Il lavoro di squadra, il sostegno reciproco e i gradi di libertà nello sviluppo del progetto sono una questione naturalmente per noi. Il Gruppo Filling & Packaging è responsabile per la pianificazione e l'implementazione auto-responsabili di progetti di ingegneria meccanica e di processo. Sosteniamo i nostri partner commerciali competenti in materia di tecnologia farmaceutica, dia e di processo e garantiamo il rispetto di tutte le linee guida GMP. Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta
• Si prende il controllo della pianificazione responsabile, la pianificazione del progetto e la realizzazione di progetti di ingegneria meccanica e di processo nel campo di Filling & Packaging in conformità a tutti i SOP interni e requisiti legali.
• L'attenzione è rivolta alla gestione e alla gestione di progetti di piccole e medie dimensioni nell'ambiente farmaceutico e diagnostico, tra cui la pianificazione, il controllo e il monitoraggio delle attività di progetto.
• L'utente è responsabile della gestione esterna dell'azienda: dalla specifica dei servizi alla selezione e al controllo fino alla riuscita accettazione di fornitori di servizi esterni e aziende specializzate.
• Lei agisce come consulente competente per i partner commerciali interni in materia di tecnologia farmaceutica, dia e di processo e sono attivamente coinvolti nella comunità di ingegneria per scambiare le migliori pratiche.
• Identificare innovazioni e nuove tecnologie e contribuire al loro sviluppo e distribuzione economicamente significativo sul posto.
• L'attività si svolge principalmente presso la sede centrale di Mannheim, ma comprende anche lavori di progetto in altre sedi e nel quadro di progetti internazionali. Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti
• Hai completato con successo una laurea in ingegneria con una specializzazione in ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria industriale, biotecnologia o un corso di laurea simile e idealmente portare diversi anni di esperienza professionale in una posizione paragonabile nell'industria.
• Hai una conoscenza rilevante nella gestione del progetto e nella pianificazione del progetto di apparecchiature diagnostiche e farmaceutiche, idealmente nell'ambiente di produzione o di imballaggio.
• Hai una conoscenza approfondita della tua specialità (ad esempio tecnologia di riempimento, tecnologia di imballaggio o ispezione ottica) e conoscenze di base in settori come l'automazione o la serializzazione.
• La conoscenza approfondita di GMP e la pianificazione concettuale vi distingue.
• Sei fiducioso nel trattare con applicazioni DV pertinenti e avere una buona espressività.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are advancing science so we can all spend more time with the people we love. Roche has set itself an inspiring goal by 2030: to provide more medical and high-quality diagnostic solutions for society at a lower cost. The site management for the Mannheim and Penzberg sites provides the infrastructure and framework for our approximately 15,000 employees in Germany to be able to work with diagnostic and medical solutions that add value to patients. We are With 170 employees, RDG’s Chapter Engineering is responsible for the successful planning and implementation of all major investment projects at the Mannheim and Penzberg sites. Through our work, we ensure the supply of our patients with innovative products. We are a unit with flat hierarchies and attach great importance to personal responsibility, an open corporate culture and fun at work. Teamwork, mutual support and degrees of freedom in project development are a matter of course for us. The Filling & Packaging Group is responsible for the self-responsible planning and implementation of machine and process engineering projects. We support our business partners competently in matters of pharmaceutical, dia and process technology and ensure compliance with all GMP guidelines. Responsibility | This is what awaits you
• You take over the responsible planning, project planning and realization of machine and process engineering projects in the field of Filling & Packaging in compliance with all internal SOPs as well as legal requirements.
• Your focus is on the management and management of small to medium-sized projects in the pharmaceutical and diagnostic environment, including planning, control and monitoring of project activities.
• You are responsible for external company management: from the specification of services to the selection and control up to the successful acceptance of external service providers and specialist companies.
• You act as a competent consultant for internal business partners in matters of pharmaceutical, dia and process technology and are actively involved in the engineering community to exchange best practices.
• You identify innovations and new technologies and contribute to their economically significant development and deployment on site.
• The activity is primarily carried out at the headquarters in Mannheim, but also includes project work at other locations and within the framework of international projects. Qualifications | This is what you bring
• You have successfully completed a degree in engineering with a specialization in mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, biotechnology or a similar degree program and ideally bring several years of professional experience in a comparable position in industry.
• You have relevant knowledge in project management as well as in the project planning of diagnostic and pharmaceutical equipment, ideally in the production or packaging environment.
• You have in-depth knowledge in your specialty (e.g. filling technology, packaging technology or optical inspection) and basic knowledge in areas such as automation or serialization.
• In-depth knowledge of GMP and conceptual planning sets you apart.
• You are confident in dealing with relevant DV applications and have a very good expressiveness.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
TAM 治疗领域经理
Therapeutic Area Manager

治疗领域经理负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Finance & Accounting Intern (Supply Chain) based in Sunway Pinnacle , you will support manufacturing and commercial sites by ensuring financial compliance, executing month-end close activities, and delivering standard cost and inventory-related activities. You will play a vital role in our finance operations, collaborating globally to continuously improve processes, systems, and standards across the network.

The Opportunity

• Execute month-end close activities, including the preparation of Manual Journal Entries as requested by the global team.

• Manage standard costing execution, ensuring the timely delivery of results while maintaining strict data quality.

• Investigate relevant accounts (such as inventory, variances, and allowances) and recommend actionable solutions to management.

• Ensure system and procedure compliance with company policies, acceptable accounting practices, and applicable financial regulations.

• Collaborate globally across the Roche network to improve financial operations and standardize processes

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing a Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline at a Malaysian university or professional body (e.g., ACCA, CPA).

• You possess a solid foundation in finance and accounting principles and are eager to apply them practically.

• You have strong proficiency in computerized applications, especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, and G-Suite (experience with financial databases is a distinct advantage).

• You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills in English to effectively collaborate with international stakeholders.

• Pinnacle Management InsightsYou are available for a full-time internship and are comfortable working in an agile, structured corporate environment.

jobs.title: Regulatory Program Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Position summary: Individual contributor regulatory professional in PTR who continuously deepens regulatory expertise and boldly innovates to deliver “one submission, one approval” worldwide by partnering across functions (molecule teams, affiliates, policy, and key initiatives) to shape the regulatory/technical environment, maintain licenses and GxP/Code of Conduct compliance, and enable a flexible, efficient, and thriving organization that meets evolving business and patient needs.

The Opportunity:

• Accountable for global planning, tracking, and monitoring of key regulatory information to ensure internal/external compliance and effective execution of submissions.

• Participate in developing and implementing the regulatory data strategy and configuring submission data in regulatory information management systems, including partnering with PT, PD, pRED, and gRED to enable a single regulatory data strategy and data flow across the systems environment.

• Execute end-to-end submission-support activities: perform defined steps in the submission process, edit/format technical documents (e.g., eCTD) to Roche/HA standards, coordinate document flow and version control in DMS, and partner with PTR Squad members to plan, track, and deliver content on time while liaising with technical SMEs.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by providing input on future system enhancements, business process updates, and submission model documents and by managing/reporting regulatory data across regions and sites, including work with external vendors (e.g., OBE Vendor Alliance) and use of submission/RIM tools and technologies.

• Serve as Business Process Owner and/or Subject Matter Expert for specific regulatory information activities and technologies, including defining and maintaining regulatory master data to uphold Roche/HA data governance standards globally, developing process documentation, and delivering training as needed.

Who you are

• Applies in-depth knowledge of Roche and regulatory guidelines, laws, and best practices to perform complex system searches, prepare/analyze reports, assemble documentation, and ensure compliance with regulations, company policies, and business processes.

• Builds and maintains productive, trusted relationships across departments and with external partners/regulators; acts as a key resource/mentor for junior colleagues, including on sensitive cases, and supports project activities.

• Demonstrates a continuous improvement and learning mindset: stays abreast of internal/external developments, understands regulatory strategy and processes, adapts to change, and proactively seeks opportunities to learn and apply new skills across a broader range of deliverables.

• Influences team processes, project outcomes, and customer activities by driving internal and external awareness of regulations and contributing expertise to regulatory and operational decisions.

• Brings 1–2+ years’ experience in a similar role, preferably with a BA/BS (or equivalent) in English, biology, chemistry, pharmacy, a related field, or a lab assistant degree (e.g., CTA, BTA, PTA).​

Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country.
#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare

L'opportunità:
• Contabile per la pianificazione globale, il monitoraggio e il monitoraggio delle informazioni di regolamentazione chiave per garantire la conformità interna / esterna e l'esecuzione efficace delle presentazioni.
• Partecipate allo sviluppo e all'attuazione della strategia dei dati normativi e alla configurazione dei dati di presentazione nei sistemi di gestione delle informazioni regolamentari, tra cui il partenariato con PT, PD, pRED e gRED per consentire un unico flusso di dati normativi nell'ambiente dei sistemi.
• Eseguire attività di supporto alla presentazione end-to-end: eseguire passi definiti nel processo di presentazione, modificare/format documenti tecnici (ad esempio, eCTD) agli standard Roche/HA, coordinare il flusso dei documenti e il controllo delle versioni in DMS, e collaborare con i membri della PTR Squad per pianificare, tracciare e fornire contenuti in tempo mentre si legano con le PMI tecniche.
• Contribuisci al miglioramento continuo fornendo input sui futuri miglioramenti del sistema, aggiornamenti dei processi aziendali e documenti del modello di presentazione e gestendo/riportando i dati normativi nelle regioni e nei siti, compreso il lavoro con fornitori esterni (ad esempio, OBE Vendor Alliance) e l'uso di strumenti e tecnologie di presentazione/RIM.
• Serve come Business Process Owner e/o Oggetto Matter Expert per specifiche attività e tecnologie di informazione regolamentare, tra cui la definizione e il mantenimento dei dati master normativi per sostenere gli standard di governance dei dati Roche/HA a livello globale, lo sviluppo della documentazione dei processi e la fornitura della formazione secondo le necessità. Chi sei
• Si basa sulla conoscenza approfondita di Roche e linee guida, leggi e best practice per eseguire ricerche di sistema complesse, preparare / analizzare i rapporti, assemblare la documentazione e garantire il rispetto delle normative, politiche aziendali e processi aziendali.
• Costruisce e mantiene relazioni produttive e attendibili in tutti i reparti e con partner esterni/regolatori; agisce come una risorsa chiave per i colleghi junior, inclusi i casi sensibili e supporta le attività di progetto.
• Dimostra un continuo miglioramento e mentalità di apprendimento: rimane al passo con gli sviluppi interni/esterni, comprende la strategia e i processi normativi, si adatta al cambiamento, e cerca proattivamente opportunità di imparare e applicare nuove competenze in una gamma più ampia di prodotti.
• Influenza i processi del team, i risultati del progetto e le attività del cliente, guidando la consapevolezza interna ed esterna delle normative e contribuendo a competenze alle decisioni normative e operative.
• Porta un’esperienza di 1–2+ anni in un ruolo simile, preferibilmente con un BA/BS (o equivalente) in inglese, biologia, chimica, farmacia, un campo correlato, o un grado assistente di laboratorio (ad esempio, CTA, BTA, PTA). Si prega di notare: I reclami devono essere presentati in inglese, in quanto il nostro pannello di intervista può includere partecipanti provenienti da fuori del vostro paese locale. #LI-DC1 Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando a tutti l’accesso alla sanità

jobs.title: Business Capability Lead - SAP
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to drive the strategic architecture and tactical enablement of our Demand-to-Pay processes, unlocking continuous improvement and seamless digital adoption? As our Business Capability Lead for SAP based in Mumbai/Pune , India, you will play a critical role in designing, managing, and governing our system processes. Operating at the intersection of strategic design and tactical execution, you will champion continuous improvement and drive the strategy for our key SAP solution.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with the DOP Leadership Team, DOP Delivery, Category teams, RSS Demand-to-Pay, Global Procurement, and external providers. You will also lead the Business Capability Community formed by SMEs and represent DOP in Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Role Type: A senior strategic and tactical individual contributor role focused on global process ownership, governance, and change management.

• Impact: You have a key, measurable impact on departmental efficiency and compliance (e.g., cycle times). Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Management: Acting as a deep Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business processes and systems, elaborating design options to resolve system, perfo mance, and data concerns while shaping the overall vision and strategy.

• System Strategy & Projects: Developing and deploying the DOP strategy for assigned solutions SAP and acting as a responsible delegate on global projects (e.g., Aspire), ensuring successful template adoption and managing change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement & Change Management: Proactively identifying and driving automation and digitalization opportunities. Acting as a change agent to escalate improvement areas, driving global requirements alignment, and partnering across functions to implement optimized End-to-End solutions.

• Governance & Analytics: Supporting delegated data and rules definition for global data. Serving as the primary enterprise reporting SME to advise senior leadership on maximizing ERP and SAP S/4HANA analytics to solve complex problems.

• Knowledge Management: Developing and maintaining global system process documentation and comprehensive training materials.

Who you are

We look for a positive, self-reflecting change agent with an entrepreneurial "Can-Do" attitude, a clear focus on End-to-End perspectives, and the ability to work in a self-organized manner.

• Education: A University degree with a business or life sciences focus is required. A Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) and CIPS certification (or equivalent) are highly preferred.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à piloter l'architecture stratégique et l'activation tactique de nos processus de demande à paiement, débloquant une amélioration continue et une adoption numérique transparente? En tant que responsable de la capacité opérationnelle pour SAP basé à Mumbai/Pune, en Inde, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception, la gestion et la gestion de nos processus système. Opérant à l'intersection de la conception stratégique et de l'exécution tactique, vous serez le champion de l'amélioration continue et pilotez la stratégie pour notre solution SAP clé.
• Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du responsable des opérations d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Élargir l'équipe et les intervenants : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de direction du DOP, la livraison du DOP, les équipes de catégorie, la demande de paiement RSS, l'approvisionnement mondial et les fournisseurs externes. Vous dirigerez également la communauté des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME et représenterez le DOP dans les trains de libération Agile.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle individuel stratégique et tactique de premier plan axé sur la maîtrise des processus mondiaux, la gouvernance et la gestion du changement.
• Impact : Vous avez une incidence clé et mesurable sur l'efficience et la conformité du Ministère (p. ex., durée du cycle). Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Gestion des processus : agir en tant qu'expert en matière profonde (EMS) pour les processus et systèmes opérationnels, élaborer des options de conception pour résoudre les problèmes de système, de perfo et de données tout en façonnant la vision et la stratégie globales.
• Stratégie et projets du système : Élaborer et déployer la stratégie du DOP pour les solutions attribuées SAP et agir comme délégué responsable sur les projets mondiaux (p. ex., Aspire), assurer l'adoption réussie de modèles et gérer les impacts du changement.
• Amélioration continue et gestion du changement : identifier et piloter de façon proactive les possibilités d'automatisation et de numérisation. Agir en tant qu'agent de changement pour intensifier les domaines d'amélioration, conduire l'alignement des exigences mondiales, et le partenariat entre les fonctions pour mettre en œuvre des solutions de bout en bout optimisées.
• Gouvernance et analyse: Soutien à la définition de données et de règles déléguées pour les données mondiales. En tant que principale entreprise déclarante, la PME conseille les cadres supérieurs sur la maximisation des analyses ERP et SAP S/4HANA pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
• Gestion des connaissances : Élaborer et tenir à jour une documentation sur les processus du système mondial et des matériels de formation complets. Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons un agent de changement positif et auto-réfléchissant avec une attitude entrepreneuriale « Can-Do », un accent clair sur les perspectives de bout en bout, et la capacité de travailler d'une manière auto-organisée.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to drive operational excellence and lead end-to-end purchasing efficiencies that support our global diagnostic innovations? As our Senior Procurement Specialist in Mumbai/Pune, India , you will be responsible for the execution of critical purchasing support activities. In this role, you will bring functional leadership to the operational and tactical procurement space, owning outcomes, delivering high stakeholder satisfaction, and ensuring seamless purchase-to-pay (P2P) operations.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with business partners and internal stakeholders in DOP across a multicultural, virtual setting, while guiding and mentoring junior Procurement Specialists.

• Role Type: A tactical position focused on executing critical operational activities, mitigating issues, and driving process optimization.

• Impact: You ensure stakeholder expectations are satisfied by efficiently supporting the end-to-end procurement process. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Operational Execution: Leading the operational and tactical activities for the effective and timely procurement of products and services in a compliant manner.

• Data & System Management: Maintaining material master data and supplier master data, executing workflows effectively, and ensuring accurate documentation within SAP.

• Mentorship & Issue Resolution: Guiding junior procurement specialists and business partners to mitigate procurement issues and achieve agreed business goals.

• Policy & Compliance: Executing activities in line with a responsible Procurement approach, utilizing tools, policy settings, and enforcement aligned with DOP business processes.

• Performance Metrics: Owning the achievement of established customer service metrics and performance targets.

• Continuous Improvement: Identifying new opportunities and supporting the optimization of processes to increase overall quality and efficiency standards.

• Internal Consulting: Working closely with the broader organization to act as a consultant on operational procurement and related system topics.

Who you are

We look for self-driven professionals with a continuous improvement mindset who can navigate complex enterprise systems and foster collaborative networks.

• Education: A relevant university business degree is required; SAP MM certifications are good to have.

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in operational/tactical Procurement processes. Experience working in a multicultural, virtual setting is required, and prior experience with planning and buying activities is required. Direct procurement experience is highly desirable.

• Leadership: Demonstrated ability or potential to lead, even informally, small to mid-size teams. Prior

jobs.title: Procurement Specialist (Pune)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to execute critical purchasing activities and deliver the operational excellence that supports our global diagnostic innovations? As our Procurement Specialist in Pune/ Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for the execution of foundational purchasing support activities. In this role, you will navigate enterprise tools and the purchase-to-pay process to meet business and project objectives in a fully compliant manner.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to Procurement Operations Lead and is part of the wider Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely with business partners and internal stakeholders in DOP across a multicultural, virtual setting.

• Role Type: An operational role focused on executing end-to-end purchasing activities and supporting continuous improvement.

• Impact: By efficiently supporting the procurement process and providing high levels of internal customer service, you ensure that stakeholder expectations are satisfied. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Operational Execution: Supporting the effective procurement of critical products and services in a timely and efficient manner.

• Data & Documentation: Maintaining master data for materials and suppliers, executing workflows, and ensuring all relevant documentation (e.g., Supplier Due Diligence, Price Lists) is complete and available in SAP or respective systems.

• Issue Resolution: Working with team members and business partners to mitigate any procurement or business issues and help achieve agreed business goals.

• Policy & Compliance: Executing operational procurement activities in line with a responsible Procurement approach, utilizing tools, processes, and policy settings aligned with DOP business processes.

• Performance Metrics: Contributing to the delivery of established customer service targets and metrics, tracking and monitoring these metrics where required, and escalating issues as they arise.

• Continuous Improvement: Supporting the optimization of processes to consistently increase quality and efficiency standards.

Who you are

We look for self-driven professionals with a continuous improvement mindset who can develop innovative ideas and foster collaborative networks.

• Education: A relevant university business degree is required.

• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in operational/tactical Procurement processes. Experience working in a multicultural, virtual setting is required. Direct procurement experience is highly desirable.

• Systems Expertise: Solid experience navigating SAP enterprise systems and procure-to-pay tools.

• Industry Knowledge: Life science industry experience is highly desirable.

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regarding the digital transformation of operations (Digital 2.0 / Indus

• Risoluzione dei problemi: Lavorare con i membri del team e i partner commerciali per mitigare qualsiasi problema di approvvigionamento o business e contribuire a raggiungere obiettivi aziendali concordati.

• Performance Metrics: Contribuire alla consegna di obiettivi e metriche del servizio clienti consolidati, monitoraggio e monitoraggio di queste metriche dove richiesto, e aumentare i problemi come si presentano.
• Miglioramento continuo: Sostenere l'ottimizzazione dei processi per aumentare costantemente gli standard di qualità ed efficienza. Chi sei Cerchiamo professionisti self-driven con una mentalità di miglioramento continuo che possono sviluppare idee innovative e promuovere reti collaborative.
• Istruzione: È richiesto un corso di laurea.
• Esperienza: da 3 a 5 anni di esperienza nei processi operativi/tactical Procurement. L'esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente multiculturale e virtuale è necessaria. L'esperienza di approvvigionamento diretto è altamente auspicabile.
• Competenza Sistemi: Esperienza solida che naviga i sistemi aziendali SAP e gli strumenti procure-to-pay.
• Conoscenza dell'industria: L'esperienza dell'industria della scienza della vita è altamente auspicabile.
• AI & Digitalization: Hai una forte affinità per esplorare soluzioni guidate dall'IA in generale, in particolare per quanto riguarda la trasformazione digitale delle operazioni (Digital 2.0 / Indus

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Mumbai/Pune, India, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).

• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.

• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.

• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.

• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.

• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.

• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.

• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing, specializing

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About Our Team We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you. We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next. The Opportunity Are you ready to optimize the supply networks that make life-saving diagnostics possible? As our Sourcing Manager in Mumbai/Pune, India, you will be a vital part of our APAC sourcing operations. In this high-impact role, you will execute end-to-end, medium- to high-complexity sourcing projects while acting as a key mechanism for the Asia Sourcing Office - identifying regional suppliers, performing initial due diligence, and translating transactional requests into strategic, value-add solutions.
• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Sourcing Lead APAC and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Wider team and stakeholders: Partners with DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, regional operations stakeholders, and external suppliers to resolve administrative bottlenecks and inform future strategies.
• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on end-to-end sourcing execution, master data management, and value creation.
• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and compliance across the APAC footprint. Specifically, you are accountable for:
• Asia Supplier Discovery: Identifying potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.
• Sourcing Execution: Compliantly executing regional sourcing projects, standard processes (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs), and eSourcing tools for on-market products and New Product Introductions (NPI).
• Demand Aggregation: Analyzing site user requirements, aggregating regional demand to maximize leverage, and escalating non-standard requests to Category Management.
• Project & Risk Management: Developing comprehensive project plans (timelines, milestones, resources) and proactively identifying and mitigating risks to objectives.
• Contract Lifecycle: Setting up template-based contracts (such as CDAs and SOWs) and accurately managing their lifecycle repository, renewals, and potential contractual improvements.
• Operational Excellence: Utilizing enterprise tools (SAP, myBuy) and master data management to simplify workflows and ensure strict compliance with global procurement policies.
• Metrics & CSR: Tracking operational targets and customer service metrics (such as cycle times and compliance) while championing supplier diversity, sustainability, and ethical practices.
• Collaboration & Exposure: Partnering with support functions (like Accounts Payable) to clear administrative bottlenecks and presenting regular KPI and project updates to the Sourcing Lead and regional stakeholders. Who you are We strive to keep our standards high and look for analytical problem-solvers with a strong customer-service focus.
• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences preferred) is required; an MBA or CIPS certification is highly desirable.
• Experience: 3–5+ years in procurement or sourcing, specializing

Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die Versorgungsnetze zu optimieren, die eine lebensrettende Diagnose ermöglichen? descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à optimiser les réseaux d'approvisionnement qui rendent le diagnostic de sauvetage possible? En tant que notre gestionnaire d'approvisionnement à Mumbai/Pune, en Inde, vous serez un élément essentiel de nos opérations d'approvisionnement APAC. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous exécuterez des projets d'approvisionnement de bout en bout, de moyenne à haute complexité tout en agissant comme un mécanisme clé pour le Asia Sourcing Office - identifier les fournisseurs régionaux, effectuer une diligence raisonnable initiale, et traduire les demandes transactionnelles en solutions stratégiques et à valeur ajoutée.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement du responsable de l'approvisionnement APAC et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et intervenants : Partenaires de la catégorie DOP, de la livraison DOP, de la demande de paiement RSS, des intervenants régionaux et des fournisseurs externes pour résoudre les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et éclairer les stratégies futures.
• Type de rôle : Un rôle de contributeur individuel axé sur l'exécution de l'approvisionnement de bout en bout, la gestion des données et la création de valeur.
• Impact : Vous dirigez l'excellence de l'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale, la valeur financière et la conformité à l'échelle de l'APAC. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Découverte des fournisseurs en Asie : Identifier les fournisseurs potentiels dans toute l'Asie, exécuter la diligence raisonnable initiale et effectuer des comparaisons régionales ciblées.
• Exécution de l'approvisionnement : Exécution des projets d'approvisionnement régionaux, des processus standard (RfI, RfQ, RfPs) et des outils eSourcing pour les produits sur le marché et les nouvelles introductions de produits (NPI).
• Agrégation de la demande : Analyse des besoins des utilisateurs du site, regroupement de la demande régionale pour maximiser l'effet de levier et augmentation des demandes non standard à la gestion de catégorie.
• Gestion des projets et des risques : Élaborer des plans de projets détaillés (échéanciers, jalons, ressources) et déterminer de façon proactive et atténuer les risques pour les objectifs.
• Cycle de vie des contrats : Établissement de contrats fondés sur des modèles (tels que les CDA et les SOW) et gestion précise de leur dépôt, renouvellements et améliorations contractuelles potentielles.
• Excellence opérationnelle : Utiliser les outils d'entreprise (SAP, myBuy) et la gestion des données de base pour simplifier les flux de travail et assurer le strict respect des politiques mondiales d'approvisionnement.
• Mesures et RSE : Suivi des cibles opérationnelles et des mesures du service à la clientèle (telles que les cycles et la conformité) tout en défendant la diversité des fournisseurs, la durabilité et les pratiques éthiques.
• Collaboration et exposition : Partenariat avec les fonctions de soutien (comme les comptes à payer) pour éliminer les goulets d'étranglement administratifs et présenter régulièrement des mises à jour de l'ICP et du projet au responsable de l'approvisionnement et aux intervenants régionaux. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de rechercher des solutions analytiques aux problèmes avec une forte orientation client-service.
• Études : Un diplôme universitaire (de préférence en sciences des affaires et de la vie) est requis; une certification MBA ou CIPS est hautement souhaitable.
• Expérience: 3-5 ans et plus en achats ou en approvisionnement, spécialisation

jobs.title: Performance & Insights Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to be a key driver in transforming our procurement function into a data-driven organization? As our Performance & Insight Manager, you will leverage complex data to generate actionable insights that optimize strategies, improve supplier performance, mitigate risks, and enhance overall procurement efficiency.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (DOP).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Works closely and cross-culturally with procurement team members, category managers, finance, IT, and other global stakeholders.

• Role Type: A highly analytical and strategic role focused on data integration, insights generation, and the continuous enhancement of procurement intelligence solutions.

• Impact: You will translate complex data into clear, impactful recommendations. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Insights Generation & Analysis: Proactively identifying areas where data can optimize decision-making. Conducting in-depth analysis to spot trends and opportunities, and performing scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for different procurement strategies.

• Reporting & Visualization: Designing and developing insightful dashboards, reports, and visualizations to track key procurement metrics (e.g., spend analysis, savings, supplier performance, risk, and compliance).

• Data Integration: Identifying, collecting, cleansing, and integrating relevant data from various internal and external sources, including ERP systems and market intelligence platforms.

• Program & Rollout Support: Supporting the deployment of procurement tools and processes by defining reporting requirements, developing tracking mechanisms, and ensuring data integrity during implementation.

• Technology Evaluation: Evaluating, recommending, and driving the implementation of appropriate data analytics tools and platforms in close collaboration with IT.

• Stakeholder Communication: Preparing and presenting findings effectively, translating complex data insights into clear, understandable formats for both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

Who you are

We look for professionals with a strong analytical mindset, a can-do mentality, and a high willingness to take personal responsibility to drive our data evolution.

• Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline is required.

• Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in data analysis and insights generation, specifically focused on procurement or supply chain. Experience working cross-culturally in a global position is essential.

• Procurement Knowledge: A deep understanding of procurement processes, methodologies, and best practices.

• Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in SQL, database mana

Condurre analisi approfondite per individuare tendenze e opportunità, e l'esecuzione della pianificazione dello scenario e analisi della sensibilità per diverse strategie di approvvigionamento.
• Reporting & Visualization: Progettazione e sviluppo di dashboard, report e visualizzazioni per monitorare le metriche di appalto chiave (ad esempio, passare analisi, risparmio, prestazioni dei fornitori, rischio e conformità).
• Integrazione dei dati: Identificare, raccogliere, pulire e integrare i dati pertinenti da varie fonti interne ed esterne, compresi i sistemi ERP e le piattaforme di intelligence di mercato.
• Supporto Program & Rollout: Sostenere l'implementazione di strumenti e processi di approvvigionamento definendo i requisiti di reportistica, sviluppando meccanismi di monitoraggio e garantendo l'integrità dei dati durante l'implementazione.

Chi sei Cerchiamo professionisti con una forte mentalità analitica, una mentalità can-do, e un'elevata disponibilità a prendere la responsabilità personale per guidare la nostra evoluzione dei dati.
• Istruzione: laurea o Master in un campo quantitativo come Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistica, Economia, Gestione della Supply Chain, o una disciplina relativa è necessaria.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di comprovata esperienza nell'analisi dei dati e nella generazione di approfondimenti, specificamente focalizzati sull'approvvigionamento o sulla supply chain. L'esperienza di lavoro interculturale in una posizione globale è essenziale.
• Conoscenza degli appalti: una profonda comprensione dei processi di approvvigionamento, delle metodologie e delle migliori pratiche.
