jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
IT Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduction Digital Presence Platform & Solutions (DPPS) is a part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and provides the foundational capabilities for Roche’s global internet ecosystem - encompassing web content publication, social media integration, external content repositories and web domains management . While the development and operations of individual, use case specific solutions remains decentralized, DPPS team provides a common layer that is being leveraged by business facing IT teams, in order to drive consistency and avoid duplication . As a Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer, you will lead the evolution of our Platform Toolchain . You will be responsible for engineering tools supporting maintenance of our platforms as well as applications hosted upon them . Ensuring they are robust, scalable, and secure . Your mission is to deliver a world-class Developer Experience and platform stability through advanced automation, AI, deep observability and baked-in compliance .
The Opportunity:

• Lead Toolchain Evolution: Autonomously lead the evolution of the Digital Presence Platforms toolchain by applying state-of-the-art practices and defining the roadmap and implementation strategy .

• Drive DevSecOps Principles: Abstract complexity across domains by applying DevSecOps principles and providing robust self-service tools for platform and application teams .

• Architect Reliability Solutions: Lead the end-to-end design, build, and implementation of reliability, observability, self-service, and advanced automation solutions .

• Partner for Velocity: Partner closely with platform and application teams to optimize service reliability and accelerate application development velocity .

• Deploy AI-Powered Operations: Design and implement robust monitoring and AIOps solutions to proactively detect anomalies, predict capacity constraints, and enable self-healing capabilities .

• Manage Key Initiatives: Lead small-to-medium technical teams on key initiatives, solving complex, interdisciplinary problems across the whole Digital Presence Platforms area .

• Ensure Framework Compliance: Align all technical designs and solutions with internal Quality, Security, and Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) policies .

• Coordinate Global Dependencies: Manage complex issues and variable factors across different organizational boundaries while coordinating multiple teams and moving parts .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical field .

• Experienced Technical Leader: You bring 7+ years of progressive infrastructure experience, with a proven track record of leading geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship .

• Core Domain Expert: You possess extensive technical expertise with in-depth knowledge in at least two domains, such as Site/Service Reliability Engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or Cloud Architecture .

• Automation & AI Innovator: You are highly skilled in leveraging AI tools and scripting languages to systematically eliminate manual tasks and drive self-healing automated operations .

• Systems & Observability Proficient: You are familiar with containerization, major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and observability tools like DataDog, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry .

• Agile Strategy Practitioner:

• Assicurare il Compliance Framework: allineare tutti i progetti tecnici e le soluzioni con le politiche interne di Quality, Security e Technical Architecture Framework (TAF).
• Coordinare le dipendenze globali: gestire i problemi complessi e i fattori variabili attraverso diversi confini organizzativi, coordinando più squadre e parti in movimento . Chi sei:

• Core Domain Expert: Lei possiede una vasta esperienza tecnica con una conoscenza approfondita in almeno due domini, come Site/Service Reliability Engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, or Cloud Architecture .
• Automation & AI Innovator: Lei è altamente qualificato nel sfruttare gli strumenti AI e le lingue di scrittura per eliminare sistematicamente le attività manuali e guidare auto-guarigione operazioni automatizzate.

Die Position IT Infrastructure Engineer - Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer (d/w/m) Die Digital Presence Platform & Solutions (DPPS) ist Teil von Roche Digital Technology (RDT) und bietet die grundlegenden Funktionen für das globale Internet-Ökosystem von Roche - einschließlich der Veröffentlichung von Webinhalten, der Integration sozialer Medien, externer Inhaltsrepositorien und des Managements von Webdomains. Während die Entwicklung und der Betrieb einzelner, anwendungsfallspezifischer Lösungen dezentralisiert bleibt, bietet das DPPS-Team eine gemeinsame Ebene, die von geschäftlichen IT-Teams genutzt wird, um Konsistenz zu erzielen und Doppelarbeit zu vermeiden. Als Digital Presence Platform Reliability Engineer führen Sie die Entwicklung unserer Platform Toolchain an. Sie sind für die Entwicklung von Tools verantwortlich, die die Wartung unserer Plattformen sowie der darauf gehosteten Anwendungen unterstützen. Sicherstellen, dass sie robust, skalierbar und sicher sind. Ihre Mission ist es, eine erstklassige Entwicklererfahrung und Plattformstabilität durch fortschrittliche Automatisierung, KI, tiefe Beobachtbarkeit und eingebrannte Compliance zu bieten. Die Gelegenheit:
• Lead Toolchain Evolution: Führen Sie autonom die Entwicklung der Toolchain der Digital Presence Platforms durch die Anwendung modernster Praktiken und die Festlegung der Roadmap und der Umsetzungsstrategie.
• Drive DevSecOps-Prinzipien: Abstrakte Komplexität über Domänen hinweg durch die Anwendung von DevSecOps-Prinzipien und die Bereitstellung robuster Self-Service-Tools für Plattform- und Anwendungsteams.
• Architect Reliability Solutions: Führen Sie das End-to-End-Design, den Aufbau und die Implementierung von Zuverlässigkeit, Beobachtbarkeit, Self-Service und fortschrittlichen Automatisierungslösungen.
• Partner für Velocity: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Plattform- und Anwendungsteams zur Optimierung der Servicezuverlässigkeit und Beschleunigung der Anwendungsentwicklung.
• Einsatz von AI-Powered Operations: Konzipieren und implementieren Sie robuste Überwachungs- und AIOps-Lösungen, um Anomalien proaktiv zu erkennen, Kapazitätsbeschränkungen vorherzusagen und Selbstheilungsfunktionen zu ermöglichen.
• Verwalten Sie Schlüsselinitiativen: Führen Sie kleine bis mittlere technische Teams bei Schlüsselinitiativen und lösen Sie komplexe, interdisziplinäre Probleme im gesamten Bereich der digitalen Präsenzplattformen.
• Framework-Compliance sicherstellen: Alle technischen Entwürfe und Lösungen an den internen Richtlinien für das Quality, Security und Technical Architecture Framework (TAF) ausrichten.
• Globale Abhängigkeiten koordinieren: Verwalten Sie komplexe Probleme und variable Faktoren über verschiedene organisatorische Grenzen hinweg, während Sie mehrere Teams und bewegliche Teile koordinieren. Wer du bist:
• Educated Professional: Sie haben einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Ingenieurwesen oder einem eng verwandten technischen Bereich.
• Erfahrener technischer Leiter: Sie bringen 7+ Jahre fortschrittliche Infrastrukturerfahrung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz von führenden geoverteilten Teams durch Einfluss und Mentoring mit.
• Core Domain Expert: Sie verfügen über umfangreiches technisches Know-how mit fundierten Kenntnissen in mindestens zwei Bereichen wie Site/Service Reliability Engineering, DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code oder Cloud Architecture.
• Automation & AI Innovator: Sie sind hochqualifiziert in der Nutzung von KI-Tools und Skriptsprachen, um manuelle Aufgaben systematisch zu eliminieren und selbstheilende automatisierte Vorgänge zu steuern.
• Systems & Observability Proficient: Sie sind mit Containerisierung, wichtigen Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, GCP, Azure) und Observability-Tools wie DataDog, Grafana und OpenTelemetry vertraut.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​Der Produktionsstandort Kaiseraugst ist ein Eckpfeiler im weltweiten Produktions- und Logistiknetzwerk von Roche. Ca. 2000 Personen sind hier beschäftigt und der Standort beherbergt den weltweit grössten und innovativsten Verpackungsbetrieb von Roche.

Als PraktikantIn innerhalb der Training Academy für die Manufacturing Unit Assembly & Packaging bist Du am Puls des Geschehens: Du unterstützt uns dabei, neue Mitarbeitende optimal auf ihre Aufgaben vorzubereiten, Trainings weiterzuentwickeln und die hohen Qualitätsstandards zu sichern.

Die Möglichkeit
In diesem Praktikum bist Du nicht nur administrative Unterstützung, sondern ein aktiver Teil des gesamten Programms.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte:

• Du bist die treibende Kraft bei der Organisation, Koordination und Weiterentwicklung unseres produktionsspezifischen Onboarding-Programms. Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen einen reibungslosen und motivierenden Start hinlegen.

• Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch ihre ersten Tage, bist Ansprechperson für Fragen und baust die Brücke zwischen der Academy und der Produktion.

• Du unterstützt uns aktiv bei der Konzeption und dem Design von modernen Trainings Modulen und erstellst zielgruppengerechte, anschauliche Trainingsmaterialien.

• Du übernimmst das eigenständige Handling von administrativen Prozessen (z. B. smarte Kalenderverwaltung, Ressourcenplanung und Materialbeschaffung für Schulungszwecke) und stimmst Dich dazu eng mit den verschiedenen Produktionslinien ab.

Wer Du Bist
Du bist immatrikuliert oder hast Dein Studium an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule, vorzugsweise im Bereich Erwachsenenbildung, Pharmazie, Medien- /Kommunikationswissenschaften oder Wirtschaft, innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate abgeschlossen und hast Interesse, Deine Kenntnisse im Rahmen eines 12-monatigen Praktikums bei einem Arbeitspensum von mindestens 80% in einer modernen Arbeitsumgebung einzusetzen, sowie die pharmazeutische Industrie kennenzulernen.

Überdies rundest Du Dein Profil mit folgenden Kompetenzen ab:

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe

• Ein hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative sowie selbstständiger, genauer und nachvollziehbarer Arbeitsweise

• Kreativität, Ideenreichtum und Innovation

• Hohe Teamfähigkeit und Lösungsorientierung sowie kollaborative Arbeitsweise

• Eine teamorientierte Denkweise mit Blick auf stete Verbesserung der Prozesse

• Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Zusätzliche Information

• Der bevorzugte Start des Praktikums ist ab September 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung.

• Bitte gib Dein präferiertes Startdatum, das Pensum und die gewünschte Praktikumsdauer in Deiner Bewerbung an.

• Nicht-EU / EFTA-Bürger müssen eine Bestätigung der Universität, dass ein Pflichtpraktikum Teil der Ausbildung ist, den Bewerbungsunterlagen beilegen.

Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören. Bewirb dich jetzt, um diese spannende Möglichkeit zu entdecken!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, tog

En tant que stagiaire à l'Académie de formation pour l'assemblage et l'emballage des unités de fabrication, vous êtes sur le pouls des événements: Vous nous aidez à préparer au mieux les nouveaux employés à leurs tâches, à développer des cours de formation et à garantir des normes de qualité élevées. • Vous êtes le moteur de l'organisation, de la coordination et du développement de notre programme d'embarquement spécifique à la production. Vous veillez à ce que les nouveaux collègues fassent un début doux et motivant.

En outre, vous arrondissez votre profil avec les compétences suivantes:
• Compréhension rapide
• Un degré élevé d'initiative ainsi qu'une méthode de travail indépendante, précise et compréhensible
• Créativité, imagination et innovation
• Un haut niveau de travail d'équipe et d'orientation des solutions ainsi que des méthodes de travail en collaboration
• Un état d'esprit orienté vers l'équipe en vue d'améliorer constamment les processus
• Volonté de prendre la responsabilité Informations complémentaires
• Le début préféré du stage est à partir de septembre 2026 ou par arrangement.
• Veuillez indiquer votre date de début préférée, la charge de travail et la durée de stage souhaitée dans votre candidature.

Bâtissons un avenir plus sain

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

As a Project Management Partner based in Lucknow and working to serve the UP Cluster and Punjab Cluster (remotely) regions, you will play a crucial role in driving cluster initiatives, streamlining operations, and championing digital transformation. You will ensure our teams execute their strategies effectively through agile processes, robust compliance, and seamless operational support, helping us deliver exceptional impact to the healthcare ecosystem.

The Opportunity

• Drive project execution and agility: You track the status of key cluster projects, coordinate execution, and maintain project documentation and business planning. You implement agile ways of working and leverage PMP tools to improve processes and bring system efficiencies.

• Lead strategic planning: You assess plan execution through key metrics and lead Outcome-Based Planning within the cluster, driving implementation conceptually and through digital means.

• Manage local operations and vendors: You support marketing campaign rollouts, patient awareness programs, and event logistics. You are responsible for local vendor management, purchasing, administrative support to the Cluster Head, and general office administration matters.

• Act as the Local Compliance Champion: You ensure the state office is SHE compliant and champion audit preparedness, COREMAP, and other critical compliance practices, carrying out due diligence for medico-marketing and access sponsorships.

• Digital Champion: You own cluster responsibilities for digital tools (including CRM and G Suite), driving user adoption and resolving queries. You also serve as the primary Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for SAP.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: You work closely with PJP (Patient Journey Partners) and other internal and external stakeholders to deliver solutions, manage brand collateral, and ensure commercial success.

Who You Are

• You hold a strong academic background with a university degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, or Life Sciences. An MBA (or equivalent) is highly preferred.

• You have proven experience in client handling and external stakeholder engagement, preferably in service industries. An understanding of the pharma environment and terminologies is highly desirable.

• You possess a strong grasp of technology and digital tools from both a user and admin standpoint. You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and have a high grasp of new tech applications.

• You have excellent oral and written communication skills, enabling you to build relationships and present information clearly to leadership and cross-functional teams.

• You exhibit strong logical reasoning and a positive, "can-do" attitude that thrives in dynamic environments.

• You act with a deep sense of ownership, responsibility, and empathy, ensuring you always keep patient and customer impact in mind.

• You are comfortable and capable of working effectively, managing and serving the UP and Punjab (remote) clusters.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to pioneer the sourcing strategies that deliver critical, near-patient diagnostic technologies to the world? As our Sourcing Lead in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will spearhead global sourcing operations for our Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges, and External Manufacturing (EM) portfolios. Balancing strategic alignment with tactical excellence, you will lead a highly capable team, drive digital procurement transformation, and collaborate directly with executive leadership to shape the future of our supply network.

- Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
- Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a local team of up to 16 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. In addition, you will be part of the CoE Leadership Team (LT) and manage critical relationships with executive leadership, including the Direct Procurement LT.
- Role Type: A leadership position combining an even balance of strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution.
- Impact: Your impact is defined by driving measurable financial value, robust governance, and process optimization across the NPC, Sensors & Cartridges and EM globally. Specifically, you are accountable for: ​

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times) while managing your team’s OPEX budget.

• Sourcing & Contracts: Executing compliant global sourcing, market research, and NPI benchmarking. In addition, you will oversee a critical portfolio of low-to-high complexity contracts (e.g., CDAs, SOWs or MSAs).

• Digital Leadership: Governing and improving Roche`s iCollab platform to advance supplier integration alongside Planning, Global Supply Chain, and the Roche Shared Services (RSS).

• SLA Governance: Defining KPIs to guarantee on-time and in-full (OTIF) service delivery across your assigned portfolio.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving high-stakes matrix priority conflicts, representing Roche to external providers, and delivering high-frequency monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

• Process & Technology: Together with our Digital & Process experts, you foster and role model the development, deployment, and usage of novel AI / Digital solutions and continuously identify and implement process improvements.

Who you are

We strive to keep our standards high and look for candidates who can lead high-performance cultures, embrace collaboration, and remove operational friction.

• Education: A University degree (Business or Life Sciences) is required; a Master's (MBA) and CIPS certification are highly preferred.

• Experience: 7 to 10 years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industries) with 3 to 5 years specifically in a Shared Service or Co

Bilanciando l'allineamento strategico con l'eccellenza tattica, guiderai un team altamente capace, guiderai la trasformazione degli appalti digitali e collaborerai direttamente con la leadership esecutiva per plasmare il futuro della nostra rete di approvvigionamento. ● Linea di segnalazione: La posizione riporta direttamente al Capo del Centro di Eccellenza di Procurement (CoE). ● team e stakeholder Wider: sei responsabile per leader, coaching, e lo sviluppo di un team locale di fino a 16 Sourcing Manager e un Leader per la Capability Business. Inoltre, sarete parte del CoE Leadership Team (LT) e gestire relazioni critiche con la leadership esecutiva, tra cui il Direct Procurement LT. ● Tipo di ruolo: Una posizione di leadership che combina un equilibrio uniforme di allineamento di categoria strategica e esecuzione di sourcing tattico. ● Impatto: il tuo impatto è definito guidando il valore finanziario misurabile, la governance robusta e l'ottimizzazione dei processi attraverso il NPC, sensori e cartucce ed EM a livello globale. In particolare, sei responsabile per: ○ Performance & Savings: Guidare metriche chiave (PPV, quota di fornitore preferita, tempi di ciclo) mentre gestisci il budget OPEX del tuo team. Sourcing & Contracts: Esecuzione di sourcing globale, ricerca di mercato e benchmarking NPI. Inoltre, si supervisionerà un portafoglio critico di contratti di scarsa complessità (ad esempio, CDAs, SOWs o MSAs). ○ Leadership digitale: Governare e migliorare la piattaforma iCollab di Roche per far avanzare l'integrazione dei fornitori insieme a Planning, Global Supply Chain, e Roche Shared Services (RSS). ○ Governance SLA: Definire i KPI per garantire la consegna dei servizi on-time e in-full (OTIF) attraverso il portafoglio assegnato. ○ Conflict & Exposure: Risolvere conflitti prioritari di matrice ad alto consumo, rappresentando Roche a fornitori esterni, e fornendo aggiornamenti mensili / trimestrali ad alta frequenza alla leadership esecutiva (CoE, Categoria, Consegna e DPLT). ○ Process & Technology: Insieme ai nostri esperti di Digital & Process, tu adotti e modella lo sviluppo, la distribuzione e l'utilizzo di nuove soluzioni AI / Digital e identifichi continuamente e implementa i miglioramenti del processo. Chi sei Ci sforziamo di mantenere i nostri standard elevati e cercare candidati che possono condurre culture ad alte prestazioni, abbracciare la collaborazione e rimuovere l'attrito operativo. ● Istruzione: è richiesto un diploma universitario (Business o Life Sciences); una certificazione Master (MBA) e CIPS sono molto preferiti. ● Esperienza: da 7 a 10 anni in Procurement diretto (Medtech, Automotive, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, or Chemicals industry) con 3 a 5 anni specificamente in un Servi condiviso

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Nous, chez Diagnostics Direct Approvisionnement (DOP), sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à être le pionnier des stratégies d'approvisionnement qui fournissent des technologies diagnostiques critiques et proches des patients au monde? En tant que leader d'approvisionnement à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous dirigerez les opérations d'approvisionnement à l'échelle mondiale pour nos portefeuilles Near Patient Care (NPC), Sensors & Cartridges et External Manufacturing (EM). Équilibrant l'alignement stratégique avec l'excellence tactique, vous dirigerez une équipe hautement compétente, piloterez la transformation des achats numériques et collaborerez directement avec les dirigeants pour façonner l'avenir de notre réseau d'approvisionnement. ● Ligne hiérarchique : Le poste relève directement du chef du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement. ● Équipe élargie et parties prenantes: Vous êtes responsable de la direction, de l'encadrement et du développement d'une équipe locale pouvant compter jusqu'à 16 gestionnaires d'approvisionnement et un responsable des capacités d'affaires. De plus, vous ferez partie de l'équipe de leadership du Conseil de l'Europe (EL) et gérerez des relations critiques avec les cadres supérieurs, y compris le LT d'approvisionnement direct. ● Type de rôle : Un poste de leadership combinant un équilibre uniforme entre l'alignement stratégique et l'exécution tactique de l'approvisionnement. ● Impact: Votre impact est défini par une valeur financière mesurable, une gouvernance robuste et l'optimisation des processus à travers le NPC, Sensors & Cartridges et EM à l'échelle mondiale. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable : Performances et économies : Diriger les mesures clés (PPV, part de fournisseur préférée, temps de cycle) tout en gérant le budget OPEX de votre équipe.
• Sourcing & Contracts: Exécuter un approvisionnement mondial conforme, des études de marché et des analyses comparatives NPI. De plus, vous superviserez un portefeuille essentiel de contrats de faible à grande complexité (p. ex., ACD, ASU ou ASM). Leadership numérique : diriger et améliorer la plateforme iCollab de Roche pour favoriser l'intégration des fournisseurs aux côtés de la planification, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et des services partagés de Roche (RSS). Gouvernance de l'ALS : Définir les ICR pour garantir la prestation des services à temps et en totalité (OTIF) dans l'ensemble de votre portefeuille. Conflit et exposition : résoudre les conflits prioritaires de la matrice des prises élevées, représentant Roche auprès des fournisseurs externes, et fournir des mises à jour mensuelles et trimestrielles à la direction (CoE, Catégorie, Exécution et DPLT). Processus et technologie : avec nos experts en processus numériques, vous encouragez et modélisez le développement, le déploiement et l'utilisation de solutions numériques et d'IA nouvelles et identifiez et implémentez en permanence les améliorations de processus. Qui vous êtes Nous nous efforçons de maintenir nos normes élevées et de chercher des candidats qui peuvent diriger des cultures de haute performance, embrasser la collaboration et éliminer les frictions opérationnelles. ● Éducation: Un diplôme universitaire (affaires ou sciences de la vie) est requis; une maîtrise (MBA) et une certification CIPS sont hautement préférés. ● Expérience : de 7 à 10 ans dans l'approvisionnement direct (industries de la métallurgie, de l'automobile, de l'électronique, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des produits chimiques) et de 3 à 5 ans dans un service partagé

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect provides both visionary technical steering and empathetic people leadership. This is a high-impact, hybrid role where 75% of your accountability is dedicated to Solution Architecture and Technical Oversight for the navify® Point of Care (PoC) Program, and 25% is dedicated to engineering management and people development.

As People Leader, you will be responsible for leading a team of Senior Software Engineers, advising on individual career paths for engineers, mentor Senior/Staff-level contributors, conducting regular performance appraisals, and manage professional growth through personalized development plans.

You will be responsible for the architectural health and delivery outcomes of our Point of Care Operations; a world wide scale solution deployed in more than 50 countries in all world wide regions, connected with more that 250.000 Point of Care instruments in the field. You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical implementation, ensuring our cloud-to-edge middleware solution remains scalable, secure, and performant. Point of Care and Healthcare domain knowledge becomes a critical asset to be able to thrive in such a complex environment.

Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for business stakeholders, product owners, and external clinical partners. And align between cross disciplines in a highly complex and cross-teams highly dependent environment, making sure Solution Architecture is in line with Enterprise Architecture and overarching E2E Solution design.

• Drive the creation of architectures consistent with project roadmaps, platform strategies, governance policies, and standards. Also, ensure the appropriate implementation of the above-mentioned items.

• Apply stakeholder management and soft skills; especially the ability to influence without formal authority, align architecture roadmaps and dependencies across multiple programs and capacity to build effective networks beyond purely technical expertise.

• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs to rapidly stream architectural designs and core team iterations. Proven experience embedding native AI capabilities into cloud and edge products. And build a deep understanding of the legal and regulatory constraints of AI in healthcare (e.g., FDA guidelines, EU AI Act). Ensures all AI models and features strictly adhere to patient privacy, security, and data integrity standards.

• Translate complex technical debt, roadmap trade-offs, and innovative opportunities into business-value-focused language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Remove blockers at the organization-team interface. Mediate between team dependencies and prioritize technical tasks in line with the architectural roadmap.

• Define and evolve a modular, high-availability architecture on AWS. Drive the adoption of modern Java frameworks that support elastic scaling and high-throughput data processing.

• Standardize our DotNet-based edge solutions. Oversee how we interface with diverse instrument fleets (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, etc.), ensuring resilience during network volatility.

• Master complex messaging topologies. Define patterns for event-driven architectures, distributed state synchronization, and reliable data delivery in environments where connectivity is intermittent.

• Set the benchmark for Non-Functional Requirements. Lead proactive threat modeling, integrate security-by-design, and ensure our middleware meets stringent med

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect fornisce sia lo sterzo tecnico visionario che la leadership empatica delle persone. Questo è un ruolo ibrido ad alto impatto, dove il 75% della tua responsabilità è dedicato a Solution Architecture e Technical Oversight per il navify® Programma Point of Care (PoC) e il 25% è dedicato alla gestione dell'ingegneria e allo sviluppo delle persone. Come People Leader, sarete responsabili di guidare un team di ingegneri di software senior, consigliando su percorsi di carriera individuali per gli ingegneri, il mentore Senior/Staff-level contributors, conducendo regolari valutazioni delle prestazioni, e gestire la crescita professionale attraverso piani di sviluppo personalizzati. Sarete responsabili per la salute architettonica e i risultati di consegna del nostro Point of Care Operations; una soluzione a scala mondiale schierata in più di 50 paesi in tutte le regioni del mondo, collegata con più di 250.000 strumenti Point of Care nel campo. Potrai colmare il divario tra strategia aziendale e implementazione tecnica, assicurando che la nostra soluzione middleware cloud-to-edge rimanga scalabile, sicura e performante. La conoscenza del dominio di Care and Healthcare diventa un bene critico per poter prosperare in un ambiente così complesso. Le tue responsabilità
• Agire come punto di contatto tecnico principale per gli stakeholder aziendali, i proprietari di prodotti e i partner clinici esterni. E allineare tra le discipline incrociate in un ambiente altamente complesso e cross-teams altamente dipendente, assicurandosi che Solution Architecture sia in linea con Enterprise Architecture e overarching E2E Solution Design.
• Guidare la creazione di architetture coerente con roadmap di progetto, strategie di piattaforma, politiche di governance e standard. Inoltre, assicurarsi l'implementazione appropriata degli articoli sopra menzionati.
• Applicare la gestione degli stakeholder e le competenze morbide; in particolare la capacità di influenzare senza autorità formale, allineare le roadmap di architettura e le dipendenze attraverso più programmi e capacità di costruire reti efficaci al di là di pura competenza tecnica.
• Master AI-accelerated SDLCs per trasmettere rapidamente progetti architettonici e core team iterations. Esperienza comprovata che incorpora le capacità AI native in prodotti cloud e edge. E costruire una profonda comprensione dei vincoli legali e normativi dell'IA nel settore sanitario (ad esempio, linee guida della FDA, EU AI Act). Garantisce che tutti i modelli e le caratteristiche AI aderiscano strettamente agli standard di privacy, sicurezza e integrità dei dati del paziente.
• Traduci il debito tecnico complesso, i trade-off roadmap e le opportunità innovative nel linguaggio focalizzato sul valore aziendale per gli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Rimuovere i bloccanti all'interfaccia di organizzazione-team. Mediate tra le dipendenze del team e priorità compiti tecnici in linea con la roadmap architettonica.
• Definire ed evolvere un'architettura modulare ad alta disponibilità su AWS. Guidare l'adozione di moderni framework Java che supportano lo scaling elastico e l'elaborazione di dati ad alto rendimento.
• Standardizzare le nostre soluzioni di bordo basate su DotNet. Scopri come ci interfacciamo con diverse flotte di strumenti (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, ecc.), assicurando resistenza durante la volatilità della rete.
• Master complesse topologie di messaggistica. Definire modelli per architetture basate su eventi, sincronizzazione di stato distribuita e distribuzione affidabile dei dati in ambienti in cui la connettività è intermittente.
• Impostare il punto di riferimento per i requisiti non operativi. Guidare la modellazione di minacce proattive, integrare la sicurezza per-design, e garantire che il nostro middleware incontra un med rigoroso

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Senior Engineering Manager & Solution Architect bietet sowohl visionäre technische Steuerung als auch einfühlsame Menschenführung. Dies ist eine einflussreiche, hybride Rolle, bei der 75% Ihrer Verantwortung der Lösungsarchitektur und der technischen Aufsicht für navify® gewidmet sind. Das Point of Care (PoC) -Programm und 25% sind dem Engineering-Management und der Entwicklung von Menschen gewidmet. Als People Leader sind Sie verantwortlich für die Leitung eines Teams von Senior Software Engineers, die Beratung über individuelle Karrierewege für Ingenieure, Mentor Senior / Mitarbeiter, die Durchführung regelmäßiger Leistungsbewertungen und die Verwaltung des beruflichen Wachstums durch personalisierte Entwicklungspläne. Sie sind verantwortlich für den architektonischen Zustand und die Lieferergebnisse unserer Point of Care-Operationen; eine weltweite Lösung, die in mehr als 50 Ländern in allen Regionen der Welt eingesetzt wird, verbunden mit mehr als 250.000 Point of Care-Instrumenten vor Ort. Sie schließen die Lücke zwischen Geschäftsstrategie und technischer Implementierung und stellen sicher, dass unsere Cloud-to-Edge-Middleware-Lösung skalierbar, sicher und performant bleibt. Point of Care- und Healthcare-Domänenwissen wird zu einem kritischen Asset, um in einer so komplexen Umgebung gedeihen zu können. Ihre Aufgaben
• Handeln Sie als primärer technischer Ansprechpartner für Geschäftsbeteiligte, Produktinhaber und externe klinische Partner. Und richten Sie sich zwischen disziplinübergreifenden in einer hochkomplexen und teamübergreifenden Umgebung aus, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lösungsarchitektur mit der Unternehmensarchitektur und dem übergreifenden E2E-Lösungsdesign übereinstimmt.
• Förderung der Schaffung von Architekturen, die mit Projekt-Roadmaps, Plattformstrategien, Governance-Richtlinien und Standards übereinstimmen. Stellen Sie auch die angemessene Umsetzung der oben genannten Punkte sicher.
• Anwendung von Stakeholder-Management und Soft Skills; insbesondere die Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen, Architektur-Roadmaps und Abhängigkeiten über mehrere Programme hinweg auszurichten und effektive Netzwerke über rein technisches Fachwissen hinaus aufzubauen.
• Master AI-beschleunigte SDLCs, um Architekturdesigns und Kernteam-Iterationen schnell zu streamen. Bewährte Erfahrung darin, native KI-Funktionen in Cloud- und Edge-Produkte einzubetten. Und bauen Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der rechtlichen und regulatorischen Zwänge der KI im Gesundheitswesen (z. B. FDA-Richtlinien, EU AI Act). Stellt sicher, dass alle KI-Modelle und Funktionen strikt den Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und Datenintegritätsstandards der Patienten entsprechen.
• Übersetzen Sie komplexe technische Schulden, Roadmap-Abwägungen und innovative Möglichkeiten in eine Business-Value-orientierte Sprache für nicht-technische Stakeholder.
• Entfernen Sie Blocker an der Oberfläche des Organisationsteams. Mediieren Sie zwischen Teamabhängigkeiten und priorisieren Sie technische Aufgaben gemäß der architektonischen Roadmap.
• Definieren und Entwickeln einer modularen, hochverfügbaren Architektur auf AWS. Führen Sie die Einführung moderner Java-Frameworks voran, die elastische Skalierung und Datenverarbeitung mit hohem Durchsatz unterstützen.
• Standardisieren Sie unsere DotNet-basierten Edge-Lösungen. Überwachen Sie, wie wir mit verschiedenen Instrumentenflotten (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat usw.) interagieren, um die Widerstandsfähigkeit während der Netzwerkvolatilität zu gewährleisten.
• Master komplexe Messaging-Topologien. Definieren Sie Muster für ereignisgesteuerte Architekturen, verteilte Zustandssynchronisation und zuverlässige Datenbereitstellung in Umgebungen, in denen die Konnektivität intermittierend ist.
• Setzen Sie den Benchmark für nichtfunktionale Anforderungen. Führen Sie proaktive Bedrohungsmodellierung, integrieren Sie Security-by-Design und stellen Sie sicher, dass unsere Middleware den strengen Anforderungen entspricht.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le gestionnaire d'ingénierie principal et architecte de solutions assure à la fois la direction technique visionnaire et le leadership des personnes empathiques. C'est un rôle hybride à fort impact où 75% de votre responsabilité est dédié à l'architecture de solutions et à la surveillance technique pour le navify® Programme Point of Care (PoC) et 25 % est consacré à la gestion de l'ingénierie et au perfectionnement des personnes. En tant que chef du personnel, vous serez chargé de diriger une équipe d'ingénieurs principaux en logiciels, de donner des conseils sur les cheminements de carrière individuels pour les ingénieurs, de mentorer des contributeurs seniors ou de niveau du personnel, de mener régulièrement des évaluations du rendement et de gérer la croissance professionnelle au moyen de plans de perfectionnement personnalisés. Vous serez responsable des résultats en matière de santé architecturale et de prestation de nos opérations Point of Care; une solution à l'échelle mondiale déployée dans plus de 50 pays dans toutes les régions du monde, liée à plus de 250.000 instruments Point of Care dans le domaine. Vous comblerez l'écart entre la stratégie d'affaires et la mise en œuvre technique, assurant que notre solution d'intergiciel Cloud-to-edge reste évolutive, sécurisée et performante. Point de soins et de santé connaissances du domaine devient un atout essentiel pour être en mesure de prospérer dans un environnement aussi complexe. Vos responsabilités
• Agir comme principal point de contact technique pour les intervenants commerciaux, les propriétaires de produits et les partenaires cliniques externes. Et s'aligner entre disciplines dans un environnement hautement complexe et cross-teams très dépendant, en s'assurant que Solution Architecture est en ligne avec l'architecture d'entreprise et la conception globale de la solution E2E.
• Conduire la création d'architectures compatibles avec les feuilles de route du projet, les stratégies de plateforme, les politiques de gouvernance et les normes. De même, veiller à la bonne application des points susmentionnés.
• Appliquer la gestion des intervenants et les compétences souples; particulièrement la capacité d'influencer sans autorité officielle, d'aligner les feuilles de route et les dépendances en architecture sur plusieurs programmes et la capacité de créer des réseaux efficaces au-delà de l'expertise purement technique.
• Maîtrisez les SDLC accélérés pour diffuser rapidement les conceptions architecturales et les itérations de l'équipe centrale. Expérience éprouvée intégrant des capacités d'IA natives dans les produits cloud et bord. Et de mieux comprendre les contraintes juridiques et réglementaires de l'IA dans le domaine des soins de santé (p. ex. lignes directrices de la FDA, loi de l'UE sur l'IA). S'assure que tous les modèles et caractéristiques d'IA respectent strictement les normes de confidentialité, de sécurité et d'intégrité des données du patient.
• Traduire la dette technique complexe, les compromis sur la feuille de route et les possibilités d'innovation en langage axé sur la valeur des entreprises pour les intervenants non techniques.
• Supprimer les bloqueurs à l'interface organisation-équipe. Méditer entre les dépendances de l'équipe et prioriser les tâches techniques conformément à la feuille de route architecturale.
• Définir et développer une architecture modulaire à haute disponibilité sur AWS. Conduire l'adoption de cadres Java modernes qui prennent en charge l'échelle élastique et le traitement de données à haut débit.
• Standardisez nos solutions de bord basées sur DotNet. Surveiller l'interface avec diverses flottes d'instruments (Accu-Chek Pulse, Inform II, Liat, etc.), en assurant la résilience pendant la volatilité du réseau.
• Maîtriser les topologies de messagerie complexes. Définir des modèles pour les architectures axées sur les événements, la synchronisation des états distribués et la livraison fiable de données dans des environnements où la connectivité est intermittente.
• Définir la référence pour les exigences non fonctionnelles. Diriger la modélisation proactive de la menace, intégrer la sécurité par conception, et s'assurer que notre intergiciel répond aux critères stricts

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Head of Business Partnering DIA APAC excl China

As the Head of Business Partnering DIA APAC excl China, you will act as a strategic visionary and trusted advisor, bridging the gap between Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and our dynamic Diagnostics markets. In this role, you will shape the digital roadmap and orchestrate cross-functional teams to deliver innovative technology solutions that directly impact our healthcare ecosystem. You will empower a high-performing team to drive customer and patient satisfaction across one of our most growth-oriented regions.

Description of the Area

This is a strategic role that enables commercial success for APAC markets excl China. This role has to align our product strategies and roadmap to fulfill the needs of these dynamic and growth markets and ensure the smooth execution of business processes through adoption of our solutions as a critical enabler of success in these markets. The Head of Business Partnering DIA APAC excl China has to understand the customer/patient experience needs and translate that into omnichannel strategies with the products that will drive Customer and Patient satisfaction in the markets.

The Opportunity:

• Drive Strategic Alignment: Act as the primary liaison and trusted advisor to business leaders, ensuring RDT strategies are perfectly synchronized with regional commercial goals.

• Shape the Digital Roadmap: Partner closely with senior stakeholders to develop strategic direction and co-create a technology portfolio that drives tangible business outcomes.

• Co-own Delivery Accountability: Oversee the planning, prioritization, and execution of complex technology projects, maintaining full accountability for scope, budget, and quality.

• Champion Thought Leadership: Bring innovative insights to stakeholders to shape digital capabilities that enhance our impact on the global healthcare ecosystem.

• Lead High-Impact Teams: Nurture a multidisciplinary team by fostering a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional excellence.

• Maximize Value Realization: Monitor and analyze KPIs to ensure IT services translate into measurable business value and widespread solution adoption in the markets.

• Orchestrate Global Collaboration: Work with internal and external partners to align strategies, share insights, and maximize the impact of technology investments.

• Manage Change & Risk: Proactively navigate project scope changes and escalate risks to ensure seamless business process execution and stability.

Who you are:

• Experienced Leader: You possess 10+ years of leadership experience with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving decision-making.

• Strategically Minded: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or Business (Advanced degree/MBA preferred) and can balance short-term needs with long-term objectives.

• Technical Visionary: You understand enterprise architecture principles and how emerging technologies can be applied to solve complex business challenges.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Chef des partenaires commerciaux DIA APAC excl Chine En tant que responsable du partenariat d'affaires DIA APAC à l'exception de la Chine, vous agirez en tant que conseiller stratégique visionnaire et de confiance, comblant l'écart entre la technologie numérique Roche (RDT) et nos marchés dynamiques de diagnostic. Dans ce rôle, vous façonnerez la feuille de route numérique et orchestrerez des équipes interfonctionnelles pour offrir des solutions technologiques innovantes qui impactent directement notre écosystème de santé. Vous allez permettre à une équipe performante de stimuler la satisfaction des clients et des patients dans l'une de nos régions les plus orientées vers la croissance. Description de la zone Il s'agit d'un rôle stratégique qui permet le succès commercial pour les marchés APAC à l'exclusion de la Chine. Ce rôle doit aligner nos stratégies de produits et notre feuille de route pour répondre aux besoins de ces marchés dynamiques et de croissance et assurer la bonne exécution des processus d'affaires grâce à l'adoption de nos solutions en tant que facteur essentiel de réussite sur ces marchés. Le Chef de Business Partnering DIA APAC excl Chine doit comprendre les besoins d'expérience client/patient et traduire cela en stratégies omnicanal avec les produits qui stimuleront la satisfaction client et patient sur les marchés. La possibilité :
• Diriger l'alignement stratégique : agir en tant que principale liaison et conseiller de confiance auprès des chefs d'entreprise, en veillant à ce que les stratégies de RDT soient parfaitement synchronisées avec les objectifs commerciaux régionaux.
• Former la feuille de route numérique : S'associer étroitement avec les intervenants de haut niveau pour élaborer une orientation stratégique et co-créer un portefeuille technologique qui favorise des résultats opérationnels tangibles.
• Responsabilité en matière d'exécution conjointe : Surveiller la planification, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution de projets technologiques complexes, en maintenant la pleine responsabilité de la portée, du budget et de la qualité.
• Champion Thought Leadership: Apportez des idées novatrices aux intervenants pour façonner les capacités numériques qui améliorent notre impact sur l'écosystème mondial des soins de santé.
• Diriger les équipes à haut impact : Nurturer une équipe multidisciplinaire en favorisant une culture d'innovation, d'amélioration continue et d'excellence professionnelle.
• Maximiser la réalisation de la valeur : Surveiller et analyser les ICR pour s'assurer que les services informatiques se traduisent en valeur opérationnelle mesurable et en adoption de solutions généralisées sur les marchés.
• Orchestrate Global Collaboration: Travailler avec des partenaires internes et externes pour harmoniser les stratégies, partager les idées et maximiser l'impact des investissements technologiques.
• Gérer le changement et les risques : naviguer de façon proactive dans les changements de portée du projet et augmenter les risques afin d'assurer l'exécution et la stabilité des processus opérationnels. Qui vous êtes :
• Leader expérimenté : Vous possédez plus de 10 ans d'expérience en leadership avec une expérience éprouvée d'influencer les principaux intervenants et de conduire la prise de décision.
• Stratégiquement pensé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou en affaires (diplôme avancé / MBA préféré) et peut équilibrer les besoins à court terme avec des objectifs à long terme.
• Visionnaire technique : Vous comprenez les principes de l'architecture d'entreprise et comment les technologies émergentes peuvent être appliquées pour résoudre des défis commerciaux complexes.
• People Developer: Vous êtes passionné par le coaching des équipes multidisciplinaires pour atteindre des objectifs de haute performance.
• Communicateur efficace : Vous avez des compétences exceptionnelles en négociation et en résolution de conflits, capables de traduire des concepts techniques complexes pour les entreprises.
• Business Savvy : Vous démontrez un sens des affaires et la capacité de connecter les capacités numériques directement à la satisfaction des patients et des clients. #RDT2026 Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain

jobs.title: Calibration Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Im Bereich Engineering & SHE in Kaiseraugst stehen dir zahlreiche Möglichkeiten offen, das Tätigkeitsgebiet im Bereich der pharmazeutischen Herstellung von festen und flüssigen Arzneiformen kennenzulernen. Engineering & SHE ist der zentrale Bereich für die Kalibrierung unserer GMP-Produktionssysteme (z.B. Temperatur, Druck, Masse) und unterstützt den Standort Kaiseraugst bei der Einhaltung der GMP-Produktionsvorgaben.

Die Möglichkeit:
Als Calibration Specialist umfasst dein Tätigkeitsgebiet folgende Aufgaben:

• Selbstorganisierte Koordination von Kalibrierungen - Überwachung, Dokumentation und fristgerechte Durchführung von Kalibrierungen

• Aufrechterhaltung des qualifizierten Anlagenstatus der betreuten Messmittel

• Dokumentenmanagement – Erstellung, Review und Update von Dokumenten

• GMP-gerechte Durchführung und Dokumentation deiner Aufgaben

• Entwicklung von Vorschlägen und Koordinierung der Umsetzung von Massnahmen zur Verbesserung der Qualität, Sicherheit, Effizienz der Kalibrierprozesse sowie der Kostenreduktion

• Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Pikett-Dienst

Wer Du Bist:
Um in dieser spannenden Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

• Fachkenntnisse und mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Kalibrierung. Idealerweise im Bereich Kalibrierung von pharmazeutischen, chemischen oder biotechnologischen Anlagen

• Technische Ausbildung im relevanten Tätigkeitsfeld: z.B. EMSR-Techniker oder Ingenieur: Richtung Bio-/Verfahrenstechnik, Steuer-& Regeltechnik

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse diverser Messinstrumente und Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld; wünschenswert sind Erfahrungen mit Umgang und Kalibrierung von Waagen

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von technischen GMP-Anforderungen der Zulassungsbehörden (RHI, FDA, EMA etc.)

• Gute EDV-Kenntnisse (SAP, Computerized Calibration Management System, Comos, MS Office, Google Suite, QS Systeme)

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem aktuellen Lebenslauf und releventen Zeugnissen und werde Teil unseres Teams, um gemeinsam die Zukunft zu gestalten!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nella zona di Engineering & SHE a Kaiseraugst, si hanno numerose opportunità di conoscere il campo di attività nel campo della produzione farmaceutica di forme di droga solide e liquide. Engineering & SHE è l'area centrale per la calibrazione dei nostri sistemi di produzione GMP (ad esempio temperatura, pressione, massa) e supporta il sito Kaiseraugst nel soddisfare i requisiti di produzione GMP. La possibilità: Come specialista di calibrazione, il vostro campo di attività include i seguenti compiti:
• Coordinamento auto-organizzato delle tarature - monitoraggio, documentazione e implementazione tempestiva delle tarature
• Manutenzione dello stato di installazione qualificato dell'attrezzatura monitorata
• Gestione dei documenti – creazione, revisione e aggiornamento dei documenti
• GMP-conforme attuazione e documentazione dei vostri compiti
• Sviluppo di proposte e coordinamento dell'attuazione di misure volte a migliorare la qualità, la sicurezza, l'efficienza dei processi di taratura e la riduzione dei costi
• Volontà di assumere il servizio Pikett Chi sei: Per avere successo in questo ruolo emozionante, è idealmente portare i seguenti:
• Competenza e diversi anni di esperienza pratica nel campo della calibrazione. Idealmente nel campo della taratura di impianti farmaceutici, chimici o biotecnologici
• Formazione tecnica nel campo di attività rilevante: ad esempio tecnico o ingegnere EMSR: direzione dell'ingegneria bio/processo, tecnologia di controllo e controllo
• Ampia conoscenza di vari strumenti di misura e di esperienza nell'ambiente GMP; L'esperienza con gestione e calibrazione delle scale è auspicabile
• Esperienza pratica nell'attuazione dei requisiti tecnici GMP delle autorità di regolamentazione (RHI, FDA, EMA ecc.)
• Buone competenze IT (SAP, sistema di gestione della calibrazione computerizzata, Como, MS Office, Google Suite, sistemi QS)
• Buone competenze tedesche nella parola e nella scrittura, le competenze inglesi sono un vantaggio Applicare ora con il tuo CV attuale e le recenti testimonianze e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
External Job Ad Text

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients.
The Opportunity

• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.

• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.

• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.

• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.

• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.

• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements.

Who You Are

• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.

• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.

• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.

• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.

• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position External Job Ad Text A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients. The Opportunity
• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.
• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.
• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.
• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.
• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.
• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements. Who You Are
• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.
• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.
• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.
• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.
• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner - Okulistyka

titleByLocale.it: Partner del viaggio del paziente - Okulistyka (woj. łódzkie)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Patient Journey Partner - Okulistyka

Dołącz do Roche jako Patient Journey Partner!

Chcesz pracować tam, gdzie Twoje działania naprawdę zmieniają sposób leczenia pacjentów ? Gdzie współtworzysz rozwiązania, zamiast realizować schematy? Jeśli tak - mamy coś dla Ciebie.

Do naszego zespołu poszukujemy 2 osób . Zapraszamy kandydatki i kandydatów z następujących lokalizacji:

• Szczecin (praca na terenie woj. zachodniopomorskiego i lubuskiego)

• Łódź - (praca na terenie woj. łódzkiego)

Jako Patient Journey Partner stajesz się kluczowym partnerem dla ośrodków medycznych i środowiska okulistycznego. Wspólnie projektujecie lepszy dostęp do nowoczesnych terapii, a Twoje działania przekładają się na to, jak szybko i skutecznie pacjent trafia do właściwej opieki.

To wyjątkowa rola, w której:

• łączysz perspektywę lekarzy, pacjentów i systemu ochrony zdrowia,

• budujesz partnerstwa zamiast relacji transakcyjnych,

• tworzysz realne usprawnienia na ścieżce pacjenta w okulistyce.

Twoje zadania:

• Budowanie i rozwijanie relacji z lekarzami i ośrodkami medycznymi,

• Identyfikowanie realnych wyzwań pacjentów i przekuwanie ich w konkretne rozwiązania,

• Dzielenie się ekspercką wiedzą o terapiach Roche,

• Organizacja spotkań, szkoleń i wydarzeń edukacyjnych,

• Współpraca z lokalnymi i globalnymi zespołami Roche.

Szukamy osoby, która:

• Ma doświadczenie w pracy terenowej i kontaktach z lekarzami (okulistyka będzie dużym atutem),

• Ma doświadczenie w programach lekowych

• Działa samodzielnie, proaktywnie i z naturalną otwartością,

• Świetnie komunikuje się z różnymi partnerami - zarówno w środowisku medycznym, jak i wewnątrz organizacji,

• Potrafi współpracować cross-funkcyjnie, angażując zespoły medyczne, marketingowe, market access i operacyjne,

• Lubi pracować zespołowo i czuje się dobrze w dynamicznym środowisku, gdzie wspólne rozwiązywanie wyzwań jest codziennością,

• Kieruje się empatią i misją realnej poprawy doświadczenia pacjentów,

• Zna język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym swobodną komunikację.

Mile widziane:

• Wykształcenie medyczne/biologiczne,

• Znajomość środowiska okulistycznego.

Co oferujemy?

• Umowę o pracę, atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i premię roczną,

• Prywatną opiekę medyczną, ubezpieczenie na życie, karta Multisport,

• Szkolenia, rozwój i lekcje językowe,

• Dwa dodatkowe wolne piątki kwartalnie („Recharge Fridays”),

• Dofinansowanie wakacji, program akcji pracowniczych i emerytalnych,

• Realny wpływ, zaufanie i przestrzeń do działania.

W Roche czekamy na ludzi, którzy chcą działać z misją.

Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie? Aplikuj!

Jeżeli znasz kogoś, kto idealnie tu pasuje - przekaż dalej.

Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Polska Sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warszawa. Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Przysługuje Ci prawo dostępu do treści swoich danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: ochrona.danych@roche.com . Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche Twoich danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/pl/content/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-pl.html

Roche Polska Sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Polska Sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia niepra

• łączysz perspektywę lekarzy, pacjentów i systemu ochrony zdrowia,
• budujesz partnerstwa zamiast relacji transakcyjnych,
• tworzysz realne usprawnienia na ścieżce pacjenta w okulistyce. Twoje zadania:
• Budowanie i rozwijanie relacji z lekarzami i ośrodkami medycznymi,
• Identyfikowanie realnych wyzwań pacjentów i przekuwanie ich w konkretne rozwiązania,

• Współpraca z lokalnymi i globalnymi zespołami Roche. Szukamy osoby, która:
• Ma doświadczenie w pracy terenowej i kontaktach z lekarzami (okulistyka będzie dużym atutem),
• Ma doświadczenie w programach lekowych
• Działa samodzielnie, proaktywnie i z naturalną otwartością,
• Świetnie komunikuje się z różnymi partnerami - zarówno w środowisku medycznym, jak i wewnątrz organizacji,

• Szkolenia, rozwój i lekcje językowe,

• Realny wpływ, zaufanie i przestrzeń do działania. W Roche czekamy na ludzi, którzy chcą działać z misją. Brzmi jak rola dla Ciebie? Aplikuj! jobs.title: Solution Integration & Testing Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Us: A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Within Core Lab Development (CLD) , a division of Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , we focus on developing cutting-edge test solutions spanning clinical and immunochemistry, coagulation, mass spectrometry, and advanced laboratory automation. As part of our Solution Automation Integration and Testing group, you will operate within the cobas ultra omni Solution Layer . Here, a "Solution" represents a massive, complex System of Systems (SoS) where physical medical devices, robotic transport automation, and digital edge-to-cloud workflow software interact seamlessly, combining hardware and software products.

Important Context for Applicants: This is a Product R&D engineering role focused on physical product orchestration and embedded/cloud systems, not an enterprise IT infrastructure position.

Your Role
As a Solution Integration & Testing Architect, you will lead the technical orchestration of our R&D validation campaigns, interfacing across multiple Product Development System Teams and strategic external partners.
You will work in close, hand-in-hand partnership with the Solution Integration Manager. You own the architectural definition of the Solution Integration & Testing Strategy and design the physical, hybrid, and virtual lab topologies needed for complex testing. Your primary challenge is ensuring that hardware products (with long, physical development lifecycles) and software products (with rapid, continuous release lifecycles) are designed and architected to work seamlessly together to enable End-to-End (E2E) clinical workflows. Partnering closely with Solution Definition and Systems Test Architects, as well as your managerial counterpart, you ensure that both functional and non-functional requirements (performance, reliability, scale) are verifiably testable at the E2E solution level.

Key Responsibilities:

• Overarching Integration Strategy: Architect the master Solution Integration Strategy. Define the integration levels, quality gates between those levels, and the Continuous Integration (CI) roadmap. Establish governance for global implementation environments and automated verification pipelines across the divergent development teams of system products.

• Lab & Emulator Topology Strategy: Define the virtual, hybrid, and physical lab setup strategy. Lead the conceptual design and architecture of the digital twin landscapes, and hardware/software emulator topologies required to accurately mirror different systems that compose the solution.

• Design for Testability: Act as the final technical gatekeeper by reviewing system use cases, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and high-level requirements to guarantee verifiable testability at the solution level. Identify and prioritize critical architectural risks for E2E solution workflows.

• Cross-Functional Product Boundaries: Establish and enforce clear cross-functional test and technical responsibilities across the product delivery nodes (e.g., hardware instruments, embedded control units, navify workflow software edge & cloud).

• Technical Guidance & Automation Vision: Provide dedicated technical leadership, automation strategy, and coaching to embedded integration engineers, test automation developers, and analysts across the Solution Train. Facilitate bidirectional feedback with delivery streams to ensu
